tei:div.tei:p: ༷༵༵||0nihūṃ///༵༵/༵༵༵༵mu~X7/dhri~X:30pa(00⑤0kha/0( ga50yig03/ga7/khu3/ kha07༅0(5⑤//5 kha༅
5460345(5'i yikhyeo— 1 stod cha/
dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa 'o/mkhas pa dga' ston/stod cha/dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/(dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉te bsdus ming la lho brag chos 'byung zhes kyang grags pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong mi pham chos kyi rgyal po don yongs su grub pa mtshan gzhan gtsug lag gi phreng ba 'dzin pa zhes yongs su grags pa des mdzad pa zhig yin zhing / gang de ni rig pa'i gnas kun la thos bsam gyi mdzad pa rgya che bas mkhyen pa'i dpal rab rgyas pa dang grub mtha'i phyogs lhung bral ba zhig yin pab/ 'chad par mdzad pa'i chos 'byung 'di'ang lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi 'dzoms la sgro skur gyi rtog mas ma gos pa'i sgo nas yan lag rnam grangs lngar phye zhing / nang gses le'u dang skabs so sor bkral te 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang bye brag sngar rabs kyi rgya gar rdang / rgya nag bod/ li yul/ mi nyagahor bcas kyi lo rgyus dang / chos lugs kyi grub mtha' khag sogs rgyas par bkod pa zhig yin 'dug pas lo rgyus dang chos lugs la zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams kyi dpyad gzhir sman nges par bsams te dpe skrun gyi bya ba brtsams shing / ma yig gi thog tu nyal te zhes par nyal ste’’dang / 'khor te zhes par ‘'khor stenya’zhes dang / 'dug kyang zhes par 'dug yang’ zhes dang /bzhes shing zhes par‘ bzhes cing’’zhes dang / bzhugs te zhes par ‘bzhugs ste’’zhes dang / spun zla zhes par ‘dpun zla’’zhes pa sogs deng skabs kyi yig srol dang gtan nas mi mthun pa rnams bcos pa las / de byings tshig dang don rnams ma yig sor bzhag tu bsgrigs yod lags/ dpe sgrig byed stangs sogs kyi byed sgor skyon dang nor 'khrul yod rigs la klog pa po rnams kyis 1

skyon 'don lhug por yod pa zhu rgyu dang / ma yig ni 'di ga'i las skred pa rngo rje rgyal por lho brag gi par ma zhig 'dug pa de yin zhing / der ma nga ba dang par yig mi gsal ba rnams kyi skyon sel la pe cin mi rigs dpe mdzod khang gis rgyab skyor zab nan mdzad byung bar thugs rje zhu rgyu bcas/pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas spyi lo 1khya85 lo'i zla ri mas 33 la/

dkar chagamachod brjod/ — 3bshad par dam bca' ba/ 3yan lag dang po 'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa/ 5yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs/ 29le'u dang po ston pa'i mdzad pa bshad pa/ 29le'u gnyis pa bka' bsdu ba khyad par bshad pa/ 53le'u gsum pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten byung tshul/ 73le'u bzhi pa rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs/ 84yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/ 101le' dang po thags rje chen pos bod bdag gir mdzad tshal/ 105ni sgo ri ri ri ri le'u gnyis pa bod kyi rgyal rabs/ 149le'u gsum pa 'dul ba'i chos byung / 465le'u bzhi pa lo paṇa chos byung / 509le'u lnga pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos byung / 537le'u drug pa bka' gdams chos byung / 655le'u bdun pa bka' rgyud spyi'i chos byung / 739le'u brgyad pa garma kham tshang gi chos byung / 859le'u dgu pa 'bri gung bka' rgyud kyi rnam thar/ 1337le'u bcu pa chos rgyud sna tshogs pa'i chos byung / 1359yan lag bzhi pa li yul dang / rgya nag snga ma/ mi nyag hor/rgya nag phyi ma bcas kyi skabs/ 13811

le'u dang po li yul gyi rgyal po dang chos byung / 1383le'u gnyis pa rgya nag snga ma'i rgyal po dang chos byung / 1389le'u gsum pa mi nyag gi rgyal po dang chos byung / 1408le'u bzhi pa hor gyi rgyal po dang chos byung / 1412le'u lnga pa rgya nag phyi ma'i rgyal po dang chos byung / 1427yan lag lnga pa yul spyi dang bye brag ma phye bar shes bya'i gtso bo rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul/ 1431〈chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus/ 1528

yan lag dang po 'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa dang yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los gasgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa la yan lag chen po lnga las yan lag dang po 'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa dang / yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs la le'u bzhi las dang po ston pa'i mdzad pa bshad pa/gnyis pa bka' bsdu ba khyad par du bshad pa/gsum pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten byung tshul/ bzhi pa rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs rnams bzhugs so/ / /

mchod brjod/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don kun rab grub skye 'gro'i rten gnas gcig po gang / /theg gsum dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los mnga' sgyur ba/ /ston pa mchog dang de sras slob mar bcas kun la/ /byang chub bar du spyi bos 'dud do rab 'dud do/ /bshad par dam bca' ba/rab mchog gtso bo rnams kyi ngo mtshar gtam/ /thos tshe bdag 'dra gyi na'i skye bo yang / /lus kyi spu ldang mchi ma khong nas 'khrug /dad pa'i shugs drag zlog par dka' gyur na/ /skal bzang blo gsal dpyod ldan skye bo rnams/ /ci phyir dad pa'i dbang stobs rgyas mi 'gyur/ /mtshan thos tsam yang don chen ldan 'gyur na/ /mos shing gus par gyur rnams lta ci smos/ /de phyir dam pa rnams kyi yon tan la/ /gcig tu dad pas yid rab drang ba dang / /bdag dang skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan bya'i phyir/ /chos rgyal rnams kyi mdzad pa'i tshul bzang 'bri/ /rgya mtsho'i chu bo sngon nas mang bcus mod/ /da dung su yis blangs kyang mi zad ltar/ /'di tshul sngon rabs mkhas pas mang sbyar mod/ /3

da dang legs bshad mkhas pa'i spyi nor yin/ /'on kyang don rgyas tshig nyang ri pa ri pa mtha' rgya chod/ /kun la gzur gnas nges pa'i khungs dang 'brel/ /chos nyid la 'jug mtshan mar mi smra ba/ /de ni legs bshad 'di yi khyad chos te/ /de bas blo ldan rnams kyis ma nyan par gyis/ /

yan lag dang po 'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa/chos kun rang bzhin gzod nas rnam dag nyid/ /'gag pa med pa'i rang rtsal mtha' yas ni/ /gnas skabs dag dang ma dag sna tshogs pa'i/ /rten 'brel snang ba sgyu ma tsam du 'char/ /ji ltar me long ngos la bzhin snang ltar/ /'jig rten zhes bya phyi na yod min yang / /byis rnams ji ltar snang ba de tsam la/ /bden par zhen te so sor a thang chad/ /ji ltar rmi lam snang ba sna tshogs de/ /snang dang mi bden gnyis ka yin pa ltar/ /'khor 'das snang ba sna tshogal thams cad kyang / /bden rdzun bral ba de ltar shes par gyis//de bas gdul bya'i snang ba ji bzhin du/ /mngon pa gong 'og 'jig rten gdaṭa pa dang / /dran pa nyer bzhag sangs rgyas phal po che/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dus kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos chen po ma nga zhig tu/ /'jig rten gnas tshul mi 'dra mang gsungs kyang / /rgyal bas 'jig rten zhen pas ma gzigs phyir/ /gar yang mi gnas gang du'ang 'gal ba med/ /de phyir chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad la'ang / /ma chags mi zhen mi gnas mi 'dor ba/ /bung bas me tog rtsi bcud len tshul gyis/ /bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad bya/ /gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i phyi rol khor yug gcig gis bskor/ /'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la thug bya

pa/ /'di ni gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams gcig/ yin/ /mchu zheng de yi nam mkha' 'das pa na/ /slar yang gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig yod/ /'di lta gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa yis/ /stong du tshang tshe rgya mtsho gcig gis brten/ /phyi rol khor yug gcig gis bskor ba ni/ /spyi phud stong gi 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /de 'dra gcig nas gnyis su bgrangs pa ni/ /stong du tshang tshe stong gnyis bar ma yi/ /'jig rten khams zer rgya mtsho gcig la brten/ /phyi nas khor yug 'bring pos bskor ba yin/ /stong gnyis bar ma'i 'jig rten kho na ni/ /stong phrag gcig du longs tshe stong gsum gyi/ /stong chen po yi 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /gangs chen mtsho yi rgya mtsho chen pos brten//phyi rol khor yug chen pos yongs su bskor/ /gling bzhi re re'ang bye ba phrag brgya yod/ /'di tsam mnyam du chags cing 'jig pa ru/ /thun mong mngon pa'i bstan bcos dag las bshad/ /mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi zhing du 'dod//theg chen ltar na stong gsum 'jig rten nyid/ /bye ba phrag brgyas rab 'byams mtshams sbyar te/ /de nyid bye ba phrag brgyar longs pa na/ /rab 'byams rgyud ces bya ba'i 'jig rten khams/ /de yang bye ba phrag brgyar brtsis pa na/ /rab 5'byams rgya mtsho'am bar ma'i rgyud ces bya/ /de yang bye ba phrag brgyar longs pa'i tshe/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /'jig rten khams te sprul sku gcig gi zhing / /re re'ang rang rang rgya mtsho khor yug bcas/ /'di tsam chags 'jig stongs gnas mnyam du byed/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /zhing khams de ni rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i/ /spu khung re na'ang bye ba phrag brgyar gnas/ /sku yi rdul phra re la'ang de 'dra ste/ /zhing de'i rdul re la yang de snyed gnas/ rnam snang de ni rgyal ba shāka thub 'di'i/ /longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ /de yi sku dang zhing la gang gnas 6

pa'i/ /zhing khams de kun gcig tu bsdoms byas pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku re re'i zhing du gsungs/ /tshul 'dis nam mkhas ji srid khyab gyur pa/ /de snyed rgyal ba'i zhing dang sku yang gnas/ /shin tu nges pa'i don du sku dang zhing //tshad med pha mtha' bzung bar mi nus so/ /de ltar 'jig rten rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa/ /la la nyon mongs la la yongs su dag /la la kun nas nyon mongs dag par ldan/ /la la dag zhing kun nas nyon mongs te/ /la la spyi'u tshugs la la snel zhi'i zhing / /rgyu dbyibs rgyan dang 'gro ba'ang tha dad nyid/ /de ltar pha mtha' yas par gnas pa las/ kho bo cag gi rten gnas zhing 'di ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho rgyal de'i/ /phyag gi lhung bzed nang na pad ma yi/ /sdong po yal ga me tog rab rgyas pa'i/ /ze'u 'bru nyer lnga brtseṭa mar gnas pa las/ /bcu gsum pa yi steng na gnas pa yi/ /dbus ma'i snying po me tog gis brgyan zhing / /de las dbus kyi rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing //de las dbus kyi rab 'byams rgyud kyi zhing / /de'i yang dbus kyi rab 'byams mtshams sbyor zhing / /de dbus gling bzhi ri rab bye ba ni/ /phrag brgyas brgyan pa mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /'gro rnams nyon mongs las mi 'byed pa'i phyir/ /zhing gi skyo nas smad par bya ba dang / /zhing 'di'i sems dpa' rnams ni lhag par yang / /bzod dang ldan pa'i yon tan bsngags pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams 'di mi mjed ces su brjod/ /de las spyi phung stong gi 'jig rten dbus/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten bcom pa dang ldan pa/ /rdo rje rin po che las legs par grub/ /gzhal med khang dbyibs spos chu'i mtsho la gnas/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par dag ldan par/ /rgyal bas phal po che yi mdo las gsungs/ rdo rje'i gzhi dang ri rab khor yug tu/ /ldan par dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang gsal/ /('jig rten bzhag pa dang mdzod pa'i lugs kyis/ rlung shārka

dkyil dpangs dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum rgyar grangs med/ de'i steng du chu da kyil 'bum phrag brgyad/ gser gyi sa gzhi sum 'bum nyi khri/ 'di gnyis blum po thad gar 'bum phrag nyi shu sum stong dang brgya phrag phyed dang lngar mnyam mo/ /de'i steng chus gang ba la dbus su ri rab rin po che bzhi las grub pa zheng dpag tshad brgyad khri/ chur brgyad khri nub cing brgyad khri steng du 'phags pa/ ri rab dang gnya' shing 'dzin gyi bar gyi rol mtsho yang dpag tshad brgyad khri'o/ /ri gzhan brgyad dpangs dang zheng nang ma'i phyed de ba tshwa'i mtsho chen ma gtogs rol mtsho rnams kyang nang ma'i phyed de/ gnya' shing 'dzin rgya dpangs bzhi khri/gshol mda' 'dzin nyi khri/ seng ldeng can khri/ lta na sdug lnga stong / rta rna nyis stong lnga brgya/rnam sdud stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mu khyud 'dzin ri drug brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ lcags ri sum brgya phyed dang bcu gsum/ phyi'i rgya mtsho /sum 'bum dang stong phrag nyer gnyis/ shar lus 'phags po zla gam ngos gsum la nyis stong re dang bcad kham la sum brgya lnga bcu/ 'dzam gling shing rta 'khor lo gnyis pa lta bu ngos gsum la nyis stong re dang gcig la stong phrag phyed dang bzhi/ nub ba lang spyod thum po thad mar bdun stong lnga brgya/ byang sgra mi snyan gru bzhi dpag tshad brgyad khri/ lcags ri lcags/ ri rab rin po che sna bzhi/ gzhan rnams gser du 'dod do) /thun mong mdo dang mngon pa ltar bshad na/ /'gro ba'i spyi mthun las dang bskal bzang 'di'i/ /byang sems rnams kyis zhing yongs sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /stongs bskal bar bskal nyi shu 'das 'og tu/ /phyogs bcu nas ni rlung g.yos phan tshun du/ /'phul bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor rgya gram dbyibs/ /sra zhing 'thas pa rngams su dpag tshad ni/ /sa ya drug 'bum rgya ru grangs med chags/ /de yi nam mkhar 'gro ba'i las dang ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu las grub pa yi/ /sprin chen gser gyi gnya' shing stug po chags/ /de las shing rta'i 'phang lo srog shing dang / /gnya' shing mda' smyug tsam dang char thiṭa ni/ /sbom po'i char rgyun ring du bab pa yis/ /chu yi phung po tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la/ /'thug par chags te de dbus dzam gser gyi/ /pad ma stong shar gnas gtsang lha yis mthong / /sangs rgyas stong zhig 'byung ba'i ltas su ཿ

shes/ /bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o thes brjod/ /de phyir bskal pa pad ma stong mthong ngam/ /bzang po'i bskal pa zhes byar grags pa yin/ /chu yi phung po rlung gis bsrubs pa las/ /spris ma'i tshul du gser gyi sa gzhi chags/ /chu yi phung po dpag tshad sum 'bum dang / /nyi khri zhom ste rngams su 'bum phrag brgyad/ / gser gzhi dpag tshad sum 'bum bzhi khrir ldan/ /de dbus lhun po bang rim bzhir ldan pa/ /shar dngul lho ni beeḍūrya sngon po/ /nub ni pad rāg byang phyogs gser las byas/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri phrag gnyis phyed mtshor nub/ /gnya' shing 'dzin dang gshol 'dzin seng ldeng can/ /lta na sdug ri rta rna rnam sdud dang / /mu khyud 'dzin ri zhes bya gser ri bdun/ /nang ma'i phyed du phyi ma'i rtses slebs par/ /ri rab phyi nas rim bzhin gru bzhir bskor/ /bar bar na ni rol pa'i mtsho bdun dang / /longs spyod sa pa'i gling gzhan du ma'ang yod/ /de yi phyi rol ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang ldan pa chags/ /shar gling gsum po zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs/ /lho gling shing rta'i dbyibs sam sog ka 'dra/ /nub gsum blum po byang gsum gru bzhi ste/ /rgyu ni so so'i phyogs kyi ri rab mtshungs/ /'on kyang rtsod par ldan pa'i dus byung tshe/ /rin chen nub ste sa gzhi phal par snang / /mi yi bzhin dbyibs rang rang gling dang 'dra/ /rgyan 'dogs tshul dang longs spyod tha dad de/ /rgyas par dran pa nyer bzhag mdo ru ltos/ /rgya mtsho'i phyi rol lcaṭa kyi ri bo yis/ /mu khyud lta bur bskor bas gnas pa yin/ /'dzam gling 'og na dmyal ba yi dwags yod/ /rnga yab gling na srin po gnas pa ste/ /gling bzhi gling phran gzhan rnams mi yi gnas/ /ri rab nang gi khong seng lha min gnas/ /logs kyi phyed man rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha/ /gzhan yang gzhal med khang pa'i lha rnams ni/ /mkha' la rgyu bas nyi zla gza' skar zer/ /de yan sum bcu 9

rtsa gsum lha rnams kyi/ /srung ma'i rim pa du ma logs na gnas / /rtse mor sum bcu rtsa gsum lha gnas dngos/ /brgya byin pho brang rnam rgyal khang bzang dang / /la ba dkar po lta bu'i rdo leb dang / /chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa skyed tshal bzhi/ /yongs 'du'i shing sogs 'byor ba dpag las 'das/ /'thab bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul te/ /lha gnas bzhi po mtsho nas rang rang bar/ ji tsam yod pa de srid steng du yang / /gzhal ba'i mkha' la sprin bzhin so sor chags/ /gzugs tshe longs spyod rim pas gong ma 'phaṭa/ /kun kyang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags ldan pa'i phyir/ /'di man 'dod pa'i khams su brjod pa yin/ /de steng gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun dang / /gzugs med bzhi ste srid pa'i rtse mor thug /de kun chags bral ting nge 'dzin gyis 'tsho/ /'dod gzugs kun na'ang rang rang rgyal po gnas/ /gzugs medan ni rang las gzhan mi snang / /de ltar khams gsum kun gyi nang na yang / /'khor los sgyur dang rang rgyal rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'byung zhing dge sdig las kun mthu che bas/ /lha las lhag pa mi yi 'gro bar gsungs/ /der yang sgra mi snyan pa longs spyod kyi/ /sa ste sngar med dam chos sgrub pa med/ /gling gsum 'di ni las kyi sa ste mchog /de las kyang ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i gnas/ 'dzam bu'i gling nyid khyad du 'phags pa yin/ /gser gling sisnyi la dang tsand+ra gling / /la sogs gling bran mang mod 'di ru 'du/ /de yang yul dbus rgya gar rgyal khams ni/ /za 'og bla res phub 'dra rin chen gling / /de la yul 'khor chen po bcu drug dang / /khyad par mnyan yod gnas bcas yangs pa can/ /tsaspa wa ra ṇa si ma ga dha/ /de rnams grong khyer chen po drug tu bshad/ /sog po li yul shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra ste/ /sna tshogs 'dod dgu dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gling / /hor dang rgya nag me tog padma ni/ kha bye 10

'dra ste ngo mtshar che ba'i gling / kha ba chags pa bod kyi rgyal khams ni/ /srin mo gan rkyal 'gyel 'dra ngam grog che/ /'dre srin gdug pa mang zhing ri nag rtsub/ /mun pa'i smag rum lta bur gnas pa yin/ /gzhan yang yul 'khor chen po mtha' yas te/ /rang rang dpal 'byor longs spyod ldan pas gnas/ /de ltar snod kyi 'jig rten mas rim chags/ /rdzogs tshe bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha zhig ni/ /shi 'phos tshangs chen gnas su brdzus te skyes/ /de yis bdag la grogs gzhan yod na snyam/ /de yi mod la lha gzhan brdzus ste byung / /de phyir 'jig rten pa rnams tshangs chen ni/ /sdod bcud byed po yin snyam 'khrul pa skyes/ /de ltar bcud kyi sems can yas rim bzhin/ /chags nas lha gnas ma lus tshang ba'i tshe/ /'od gsal lha zhig shi 'phos skad cig gis//'dzam bu'i gling du mi ru brdzus te skyes/ /de bzhin gzhan yang brdzus skyes mang byung ste/ /tshe tshad dpag yas bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho/ /lus la 'od ldan rdzu 'phrul mkha' la 'gro /gzugs kyi yon tan mtha' yas ldan pa yin/ /de tshe sa 'di bdud rtsi sa yi bcud/ /dkar zhing sbrang rtsi'i ro ldan 'jam la bzhun//mar gsar gong bu lta bu kho nar gnas/ /de la sred pas zos pas bsam gtan gyi/ /zas nyams lus kyi rdzu 'phrul nub par gyur/ /sred pa'i dbang gis sa bcud gting du nub/ /sa mo zhag ces kha dog dmar ser la/ /sbrang rtsi'i ro ldan byung ste zos pa yis/ /lci ba'i phyir na lus kyi 'od kyang nyams/ /de nas mkha' la nyi zla gza' skar byung / /sa zhag sa 'og nub ste bdud rtsi yi/ /myu gu'i tshal byung de yang zos pas nub/ /ma rmos sā li'i 'bras byung de zos pas/ /shin tu rags phyir snyigs ma bshang gci byung / /'di yan rdzogs ldan bskal pa zhes byar grags/ /rgyu des pho mo'i dbang po tha dad dod/ /lta dang rgod dang lag bcang 'khrig pa byung / /gzhan gyis bltas nas sa rdos 11

btab cing gshes/ /ngo tsha skyob phyir khyim byas mngal skyes byung / /mi tshangs spyod gyur gzhan gsum ma nyams phyir/ /gsum ldan bskal pa zhes byar grags pa yin/ /sā li'i 'bras de nam za len pa las/ /le lo can zhig gis ni gsog 'jog byas/ /de mthong kun kyang gsog 'jog byed par gyur/ /sred pa'i rgyu dang ser sna'i skyon de yis/ sā li'i 'bras kyang sbun pa sra bas g.yoṭa//brngas ma thag du skye ba yang med nas/ /mdzangs shing phan par dga' ba'i mi cig gis/ /cha mnyam zhing bgos rang gi skal ba chad/ /kun gyis cung zad tsam re byin pa yis/ /skal ba shin tu rgyal phyir rgyal por thogs/ / gcig gi skal pa cig shos kyis brkus pas/ /de nas gnyis ldan bskal pa zhes byar gyur/ /rku ba srung phyir sngar gyi rgyal po de/ /zhing rnams srung bskos drug cha glar byin pas/ /zhing dpon du grags dpya khral thog ma yin/ /rku ba byung tshe zhi bas ma bzlog nas/ /lus la bsnun ste bsad pas srog gcod byung / /gsod pas skrag rnams rdzun du smra bar byed/ /de ltar rtsa ba bzhi ga spyad pa'i phyir/ /rtsod par ldan pa'i dus su gyur pa yin/ /'di ni thub bstan skyon med lo bcu gnyis/ /gnas dang sngon gyi rdzogs ldan bskal pa sbyar/ /de nas chu bur dang po byung ba'i tshe/ /pham par bcas dang gsum ldan sbyar ba sogs/ /'dul ba'i lung las ji skad bshad bzhin te/ /chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i dus bzhi yin/ /mdo sde ltar na rtsod ldan 'char ba dang / /zhing de'i sangs rgyas thog ma dus mtshungs 'byung / /longs spyod mtha' dag tshang ba rdzogs ldan te/ /rkang pa gcig nyams gsum ldan la sogs sbyar/ /longs spyod dbang du byas pa'i dus bzhi ste/ /rtsod ldan dus su 'khor sgyur mi 'byung zhes/ /bshad pa'ang mdo sde'i lugs kyi dus bzhi yin/ /sngags las dus bzhi'i rnam gzhag gzhan mang bshad/ kha cig 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gsum po dang / /rdzogs 12

ldan la sogs re re bzhin sbyar te/ /rtsod ldan dus su nashākya'i tog byon zhes/ /'chad ni 'jig rten gna' gtam tsam zhig ste/ /bstan las byung ba'i dus bzhi'i rnam gzhag min/ kha cig dur sgra sgrog pa'i ljon shing las/ /rgyal ba'i sku gdung glum zhing che ba byung / /de yi nang nas brdzus skyes khye'u ni/ /lta bsami ngoms byung de mang bkur yin/ /de bas gdung gi brgyud par 'jog ces dang / /de bzhin yar 'ded lha bdun zhes zer mod/ /tshad ldan gzhung las bshad pa ma mthong ngo / /longs spyod nyams shing gsod pa'i bar byung bas/ /skyo ste nags su gnas pas bsam gtan thob/ /mngon shes ldan la drang srong zhes byar grags/ /bsam gtan ma thob skyo bas grong du 'ongs/ /snyan ngag sogs kyis 'tsho la bram zer thogs/ /dpya khral gyis 'tsho rgyal rigs ces su grags/ /tshong dpon sogs byed de rnams rje 'u'i rigs/ /zhing gi las kyis 'tsho ba dmangs rigs te/ /gsod sogs ngan las kyis 'tsho gdol pa'i riṭa//mdor na byed las so so tha dad las/ /rgyal rigs la sogs bzang ngan rigs lngar bzhag /'di yan rigs la khyad par yod ma yin/ /de bzhin dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba pa/ /rim par chags shing dmyal ba mnar med du/ /sems can gcig gcig skyes par gyur pa na/ /chags bskal bar bskal nyi shu rdzogs pa ste/ /de nas gnas pa'i bskal pa rtsom pa yin/ kha cig mang bkur ma dros mtshor khrus byas/ / khu ba lhung las dud 'gro'i skye gnas byung / /brkus pa'i mi gnyis gcig bsad gcig sprugs pas/ /bsad de smon lam log pas lha min gyur/ /sgyugs pa shi 'phos yi dwags thog mar skyes/ /mang bkur 'das nas lha dbang brgya byin gyur/ /smon lam mthu des lha dang lha min rtsod/ /dge mchog sdig spyad dmyal bar skyes gyur te/ /de tshe 'gro ba rigs drug tshang ngo zhes/ /bod gzhung snga rabs 'ga' las 'chad par snang / /zhing dpon 13

de yis mi rnams cha mnyam du/ /legs par bskyangs pas kun kyang dga' gyur te/ /mang pos dpon du bkur phyir mang bkur grags/ /zhing bdag phongs pa skyob pas rgyal rigs te/ /chos dang tshul khrims shes rab kun spyod kyis/ /'khor rnams mgu bar byed phyir rgyal por btags/ /bskal bzang 'di la 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na/ /mi yi rgyal po kun gyi thog ma yin/ /de tshe mi la sems can zhes su grags/ /de sras 'od mdzes mi la tshur shog zer/ /de sras dge ba mi la rme ba can/ /de sras dge mchog mi la sprin mgrin zer/ /de sras gso sbyong 'phags te de rnams la/ /sngon gyi rgyal po sde lnga zhes su grags//'di tshe mi la ta la'i rkang zhes 'bod/ ming de rnams ni 'dod rgyal kho na yin//gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bor sha rmen ni/ /'jam po las byung khye'u nga /las nu//gling bzhir dbang byas gser gyi 'khor los sgyur/ /lha dbang brgya byin stan phyed bstabs pa yin/ /tshe tshad brgya byin brgya dang so drug thub/ /'di dus mi yi tshe tshad dpag tu med/ /de yi brla g.yas las skyes mdzes pa ste/ /gling gsum dbang byed dngul gyi 'khor sgyur yin/ /de yi brla g.yon las skyes nye mdzes ni/ /gling gnyis dbang byed zangs kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /de yi rkang bol las skyes mdzes ldan ni/ /gling gcig dbang ba lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /de yi rkang mthil las skyes nye mdzes ldaca/ /'dzam gling la dbang stobs kyi 'khor skyur te/ /'di rnams 'khor los sgyur ba sde lnga zer/ /nga las nu tshe rigs pa'i gnas rnams la/ /dpyod phyir mi rnamab/ kyi ming dpyod pa can/ /de bzhin sems pa can dang nyer rtog can/ /shed bu shed las skyes sogs da lta'i bar/ /du mar brjod cing bdag dang gang zag sogs/ /byed pa'i skyes bu'i rnam grangs gzhan du'ang rtog /nye mdzes ldan gyis 'dzam gling skyong ba'i tshe/ /skye rgu'i tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa ste/ /de tshe bskal bzang sangs rgyas thog ma ni/ /'khor ba 14

'jig byon mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan/ /'di yan sde snod gsum pa phal cher mtshungs/ /nye mdzes ldan sras bzang po'am rgyas byed yin/ /de nas sred ba sred dang btang ba dang / /btang bzung lus thul shes ldan ngan spong dang / /shing rta sdug gu dug can dug can che/ /shasku/ni dang shadwa ni chen po/ /ku shi nye ba'i ku shi ku shi che/ /rgyas byed rgyas byed chen po legs mthong dang / /legs mthong chen po gnod sel nye gnod sel/ /rma bya nges 'gro bde byed rab 'dul dang / /rab tu sgra bsgrags rab gdung ldan 'od byed/ /lhun po ri rab lhun ldan me lce dang / /me lce'i phreng dang me lce ldan pa'i brgyud/ /'bum du tshang ba grong khyer gru 'dzin byung / /dgra rnams 'dul phyir dgra 'dul rgyal po'i brgyud/ /lnga khri bzhi stong dmag mi tshugs su byung / / de sras rgyal po ma phebs 'bebs kyi brgyud/ /drug khri sum stong wa ra ḍā sir byung / /(bzod dka'i rgyud) brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dar 'dzin grong du'o/ /(tshangs byin rgyud) sum khri nyis stong glang chen gnas su ste/ /(glang pos byin rgyud) grong khyer rdo mchog tu ni stong phrag lnga/ /(bal bu'i rgyud) grong gi rdal du sum khri nyis stong ste/ /(tshan chen thub rgyud) gzhan las rgyal du sum khri nyis stong nyid/ /(rgyal ba po'i rgyud) ka nu kurdzo'i grong du khri nyis stong / /(rgyal ba'i sde'i rgyud) tsam pa'i grong du khri dang stong phrag brgyad/ /(klu'i lha rgyud) tā la'i phreng bar nyi khri lnga stong dang / /slar yang mi yi lha rgyud khri nyis stong / /(dug can pa'i lha rgyud) ba so'i grong du khri dang stong phrag brgyad/ /(blo bzang rgyud) nyi khri chig stong rgyal po'i khab tu byung / /wa ra ṇa sir mun sel rgyud pa brgya/ /(dbang chen sde'i rgyud) rtswa can du ni brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ /gru 'dzin du ni mtsho lha'i rgyud pa stong / /(dka' thub sbyong rgyud)brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer rtswa can ste/ /sa gtso'i rgyud stong wa ra ḍā sir byung / /de yi tha ma rgyal po gnyen ldan te/ /de tshe skye rgu'i tshe lo sum khri 15

thub/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rten byon/ /(sa bdag rgyud)de nas dmag mi tshugs bar stong yin te/ /(sa 'dzin rgyud) brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dres pa'i grong du byung / /de yi tha ma rgyal po lha chen te/ /a smra'i tshag du rgyal po'i drang srong mdzad/ /de rgyud brgyad khri bzhi stong yang de bzhin/ /rgyal po'i drang srong tshangs par spyad pa spyod/ /de nas nges 'phen mu khyud mu khyud brtan/ /tshan chen po dang za ba nyer za dang / /za chen za ldan gya nom snang ba dang / /mnyam lta thos pa'i sde dang chos kyi sde/ /rtogs pa rtogs chen rtogs sde mya ngan med/ /mya ngan bral dang mtshams brtan rgan mtshams dang / /dusdu ma ra skya rengs phyogs bdag dang / /rdul bzang bde byed kun dga' me long gdong / /skyed po rgyal ba khyu mchog bza' btung ldan/ /bza' btung mod dang thub med gzhan las rgyal/ /brtan po rab brtan stobs chen gzhon pa mang /blo bzang brtan par zhon dang gzhu bcu pa/ /gzhu brgya dgu bcu'i gzhu dang rnam rgyal gzhu/ /gzhu bkra gzhu sra gzhu brtan shing rta bcu/ /shing rta brgya pa dgu bcu sna tshogs pa/ /shing rta rnam pa sna tshogs shing rta brling / /shing rta brtan rgyud bdun khri bdun stong ni/ /legs par snang ba'i grong khyer chen por byung / /(nam mkha'i bdag dang klus srung rgyud) wa ra ḍā sir brgya phrag gcig gi mthar/ /rgyal po kṛ kri tshe lo nyi khri ste/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten byon/ kṛ kri'i sras po legs par skyes kyi rgyud/ /brgya phrag gcig ni grong khyer gru 'dzin byung / /de nas rgyal po rna ba can gyi bu/ /che ba go ta ma rab tu byung / /chung ba ba ra dhwa dzar rgyal sa gtad/ /de tshe g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag gis/ /mig ser dbang gis smad tshong bzang mo bsad/ /ral gri rga ta ma'i spyil por bor/ /gshed mas go ta ma bzung ste go rar bcug /rgyal pos rang gi phu bo yin pa dang / /de la nyes pa med pa'ang ma shes nas/ /16

bsad shing la btsu ༅/sa 'chi khar mkhan po ni/ /drang srong mdog nag gis mthong rgyu dris pas/ /gi ta mas rang gis ma nyes pa'i/ /bden pa brjod pas mkhan po gser mdog gyur/ /bdag ni 'di nas 'gro ba gar skye dris/ /rgyal rgyud chad na mi rung bar shes nas/ /mkhan pos bram ze'i smreng las bu med pa/ /de la phyi ma'i 'gro ba med zer gyis/ /khyod kyis rigs rgyud 'jog par nus sam dris/ /bdag la bud med rgyus kyang mi 'tshal na/ /da lta gnad rnams 'chad tshe ga la zhig /mkhan pos rdzu 'phrul gyis ni rdzi char sprul/ /sdug bsngal cung zad zhi bar byas nas kyang / /chags pa yid la byed du bcug pa yis/ /khrag dang sa bon 'dres pa sa la zags/ /bsad shing rtsa bar sgong nga gnyis su gyur//mkhan pos khyer te bur shing tshal du bzhag— /nyi ma'i zer gyis smin zhing brdol ba las/ /khye 'u re byung gcig ni nyi ma'i gnyen/ /cig shos bu ram shing par btags te gsos/ /rgyal po de 'das sras kyang med pa'i tshe/ /drang srong gau ta ma btsal ba dang / /mkhan pos sngon gyi tshul brjod khye 'u gnyis/ /btang nas phu bo rgyal por bskos pa dang / /de yang rgyal bu med pa nyid du 'das/ /de —nas bu ram shing pa rgyal por bskos/ /'di gnyis bu ram shing pa'i stengs zhes zer/ /sras rgyud brgya ni gru 'dzin yul du byung / /de nas rgyal po 'phaṭa skyes po ces pa/ /de la sras bzhi skar mda'i gdong dang ni/ /lag na glang 'dul rkang gdub can zhes byung / /btsun mo shi nas rgyal po gzhan zhig gi /bu mo bslangs pas de las skyes pa'i bu/ /rgyal sar 'byin pa'i gtsegs yig bzung nas byin/ /de la khye 'u rgyal srid dga' zhes byung / /blon po'i g.yo yis phu bo bzhi po rnams/ /sring mo gnyen bcas gangs ri dang nye ba/ /chu bo ska9 4 ldan shing rta 'bab pa'i 'gram/ /drang srong ser skya'i gnas dang nye bar spyugs/ /de dag gnas der lo ma'i spyil po byas/ /ri dwags sha dang rtsa ba 17

'bras bus 'tsho/ /drang srong de la pha bzhin lta bar gyur/ /lang tsho rgyags ches 'dod pas nyen pa yis/ /lus rid gyur pa drang srong la smras pas/ /rang rang sring mo spongs la mas dben gyi/ /sring mo dag dang lhan cig 'grogs par gyis/ /rgyal rigs rgyal srid nyams la 'di rung zhes/ /smras pa tshad mar bzung ste ming sring 'grogs/ /de las khye 'u bu mo mang du 'phel/ /drang srong de yis yangs pa'i sa zhig tu/ /ril ba'i chu brims grong khyer bkod pa byas/ /rgyal rigs de dag thams cad der gnas bcas/༄ /ser skyas bstan phyir ser skya'i gzhi zhes grags/ /phyis nas mang du 'phel bas der ma shong / /'bab chu ro hi ka yi phar ngos su/ /lha yis bstan pa'i sa ru grong bcas pas /grong khyer lhas bstan zhes byar grags pa byung / /yab kyis rgyal bu bzhi yi gtam dris pas/ /ming sring 'grogs par thos tshe ngo mtshar nas/ /rgyal pos lag pa brkyangs te gzhon nu rnams/ /phod pa yin no zhes smras dbang chen gyis/ /smras phyir de phyin shākya zhes par grags/ /yab 'das rgyal srid 'ga' ni rgyal por gyur/ /de yang bu med 'das nas phu bo bzhi/ / rim pas bskos pas dang po gsum po ni/ /rgyal por gyur pa'i sras med bzhin du 'das/ /bzhi pa rkang gdub can gyi bu gnas 'jig /de sras ba lang gnas te de yi sras/ /seng ge'i 'gram dang seng ge'i sgra zhes gnyis/ /'dzam bu'i gling na gnam ru thogs pa'i mchog /seng ge'i 'gram la sras bzhi zas gtsang ma/ /zas dkar bre bo zas dang bdud rtsi zas/ /rgyal po gtsang ma'i zas la sras gnyis te/ /sgyu 'phrul che las bcom ldan 'das bltams shing / /sgyu 'phrul las ni gcung po mdzes dga' bo/ /zas dkar sras po rgyal dang bzang ldan gnyis/ /bre bo zas la ming chen ma 'gags pa/ /bdud rtsi zas la lhas byin kun dga' bo/ /don kun grub pa'i sras gcig dgra gcan zin/ /de yis 18

shākya chen po'i rgyud pa rdzogs/ /srid pa'i rgyun bcad yang srid med do zhes/ /shākya rnams kyis cho 'brang zhus pa'i tshe/ /mu stegs pa rnams gau ta ma ni/ /rang rigs sgrog zhes 'phya ba spang ba'i phyir/ /nga ni re zhig sku rgyab bsnyun pa bsal/ /khyod kyis ston zhes bsgos nas gzims par bstan/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan mchog moṅgal bu yis ni/ /mnyam par bzhag ste ting 'dzin las langs nas/ /rgya cher bshad ces 'dul ba'i lung las gsungs/ /mngon par byung ba'i mdo sde las bshad dang / /mngon pa'i 'jig rten bzhag par bshad pa ste/ /gsum po grangs dang go rim mi 'dra ba/ /sde snod gsum gyi 'chad tshul tha dad yod//chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' chems ka bkol mar/ /'phags skyes po yi sras gsum sring mor bcas/ /sgyugs pa'i che rgyud shākya chen po ste/ /bar ma'i rgyud la shākya li tsā bī/ /chung ba'i rgyud la ri brag pa ces gsungs/ /dang po'i rgyud pa gnas 'jog sa khyim nas khri —nga lnga stong grong khyer ser skyar byang de yi/ /ji na ri gye / / tha ma shing rta bcu pa nas/ /rgyal rabs bcu gcig pa la gzhu brtan byung / /de yi bu ni seng ge'i 'gram zhes gsungs/ kha cig rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i sras/ /gsum las shākya che sogs rigs gsum gyis/ /chen po nas bzung nyer brgyad 'das pa na/ /seng ge'i za 'gram byung bar 'chad pa dang / kha cig drang srong go ta ma yi/ /sgo nga gsum las rigs gsum gyes smra sogs/ /bshad pa'i rnam grangs du ma byed par snang / /gnas bskal ya thog ma thog ring mo gnyis/ /de yi bar du khug pa bco brgyad de/ /gsum gyis gnas bskam bar bskal nyi shu yin/ /da lta ya thog ring mo'i mjug yin te/ /tshe lo bcu pa rdzogs pa'i yar 'phel nas/ /bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad 'go rtsom byed/ /de yang da ltar gnas pa'i mi rnams kyis/ /pha ma dge sbyong bram ze rgan rabs sogs/ /brnyas shing mi dge'i las lam spyad pa'i rgyus/ /tshe dang 19

longs spyod rim pas bri gyur te/ /tshe yi ring tshad lo bcu thub par 'gyur / /de tshe gos mchog skra yi la ba ste/ /zas mchog ko ṭa rgyan mchog mtshon la byed/ /gab tse rus gong thur mas 'tsho ba yis/ /brjud de 'chi ba mu ge'i bskal pa ni/ /lo bdun zla bdun zhag bdun bar du 'byung / /de nas nad kyi bskal pa 'jigs rung ba/ /zla ba bdun dang zhag bdun bar du 'byung / /de nas mthong tshad gcig gis gcig gsod pa/ /mtshon cha'i bskal pa zhag bdun kho na 'byung / /de nas lhag mar lus pa'i mi rnams ni/ /sdig pas skyo ste srog gcod spong bar 'gyur/ /de yis tshe lo nyi shu thub par 'phel//gzugs mdog longs spyod sngon las lhag par gyur/ /de bzhin ma byin len sogs dgu rim bzhin/ /de nas chags dang 'dod dang log chos spangs/ /pha ma dge sbyong bram ze rgan rabs la/ /bskur dang byas shes drin gzo la gnas pas/ /sngon las tshe dang gzugs mdog longs spyod rnams/ /rim pas nyis 'gyur 'phel te brgyad khrir thug /mi yi tshe lo brgya par gyur pa'i tshe/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug 'dzam gling du/ /dgra bcom 'khor mang ldan pa gshegs nas ni/ /skal ldan rab tu 'byin zhing shākya'i bstan/ /slar yang skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo ni/ /brgya phrag drug par 3phel ba de srid gnas/ /mi rnams tshe lo bdun brgya thub pa'i tshe/ /gnas brtan bcu drug gis ni ston pa'i bka'i/ glegs bam kun bsdus rin chen mchod rten byas/ /bskor nas ston par phyag mdzad mya ngan 'da'/ /de yis shākya'i bstan pa mthar thug ces//dga' ba'i bshes kyi rtogs pa brjod las byung / / (kun mkhyen bus dga' ba'i bzhes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod las tshe lo drug brgya pa'i bar bstan pa gnas par bshad pa ni sku gdung gi mchod rten sogs la dgongs ba yin no zhes gsungs kyang de ni ma yin te 'khor ba 'jig la sogs pa 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gsum gyi yang sku gdung dang gtsug phud sogs kyi mchod rten da lta bzhugs pas de dag gi bstan pa'ang gnas par 'gyur ba'i phyir 20

ro/ /des na rtogs brjod de nyid las/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad na yul shi pi ga'i grong khyer byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba rgyal po rigs pa'i sde'i yul na dgra bcom pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan pa de mya ngan las 'da' khar dge slong rnams kyis bstan pa ji srid gnas dris pas/ khyed rnams mya ngan ma byed cig /ci'i phyir zhe na bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' khar gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi lag tu dam pa'i chos gtad de sbyin bdag rnams kyi sbyin pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang gnas brtan dang po ba ra dhwa dza bsod stoms len zhes bya ste 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dag lhan cig ba lang spyod kyi gling na gnas so/ /1 gser gyi bu 'khor lnga stong dang byang phyogs kha che'i yul na'o/ /1 ba ra dhwa dza drug stong dang shar lus 'phags gling na'o/ / 3mi byed pa bdun stong dang 'dzam gling na'o/ /4 bathu la drug stong dang sgra mi snyan na'o/ /5bzang po dgu stong dang zangs gling na'o/ /smo nag po stong dang siṅgha gling na'o/ /7bad sa'i bu stong phrag bcu gcig dang pan sa'i gling na'o/ /8ba lang skyong ni brgyad stong dang ri spos ngad ldang na'o/ /9 lam ba ni stong phrag bcu gsum dang sum cu rtsa gsum na'o/ /10 dgra gcan zin ni stong dang bṛ yartu'i gling na'o/ /11klu'i sde ni stong phrag bcu gnyis dang ri skya bo na'o/ /11 zur gyis shes ni stong phrag bcu gsum dang ri ngos yangs na'o/ /13 nags na gnas ni stong phrag bcu bzhi dang lus 'phaṭa kyi ri la'o/ /14 mi pham pa ni stong phrag bco lnga dang bya rgod phung po'i ri la'o//15gtsug gi lam ni stong phrag bcu drug dang ri bo gnya' shing 'dzin la gnas so/ /1caganas brtan de dag gis ma shes pa'am ma mthong ba'am mi thos pa'am mngon du ma byas pa cung zad kyang med do/ /dge 'dun gyi bya ba'am spyan drangs pa'am bco lnga ston nam gtsug lag khang du dbul ba'am gaṇḍi'i rab gnas sam gang yang cung zad mi shes pa med de de dag du gnas brtan bcu drug po de dag dang 'khor du bcas pa gzhan dang gzhan gyis de dang der byon zhing gnas te de ltar sbyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /ma 'ongs pa na mtshon gyi bskal pa byung ba 'das nas mi rnams dge ba bcu dang ldan pas tshe slar 'phel te lo brgya thub pa na ston pa'i nyan thos de dag kyang phyir la dzasbu'i gling du byon nas dam pa'i chos yang dag par ston par byed cing rab tu 'byin par byed de ji srid skye rgu rnams kyi tshe 21

lo drug brgya par gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos gnas pad 'gyur te mi rnams kyis tshe lo bdun brgya thub par gyur pa na nyan thos de dag gis gang sa'i steng 'di na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i tshogs ji snyed pa de dag gcig du pasdus nas rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten gcig byas te kun nas bskor nas skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug nas 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa —dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la 'dud pas phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod de phyag byas nas phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das sda'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten de yang nub nas 'og gi gser gyi sa gzhi gang yin pa de la gnas so/ /der bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs shing de phyin rang rgyal 'byung ba dang byams pa'i skabs lung du bstan no) /de phyin tshe lo yar 'phel de srid du/ shākya'i bstan la theg 'bring du zhugs pa'i/ /rang rgyal bye ba phrag bdun 'byung 'gyur te/ /slob dpon med par ye shes mngon byas nas/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul bsod stoms spyod pa yis/ /gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba spel bar mdzad/ /de ba/ zhin rang sangs rgyas pa thams cad kyang / /bstan pa med pa'i stongs la 'byung ba yin/ /mi rnams tshe lo brgyad khrir 'phel ba'i tshe/ /gzugs stobs kha dog longs spyod mtha' yas te/ /sa bon gcig las 'bras bu lan bdun 'phel/ /che zhing bcud dang ldan pa'i 'bru rnams ni/ /snye ma re las bre bo bzhi re 'byung / /phyogs rer rgya mtsho dpag tshad gnyis bskams te/'dzam gling yangs shing g.yang sa ngam grog med/ /mnyam zhing 'jam pa rin chen kun gyis brdal/ /bya gag 'phur stabs chod par grong gis khyab/ /mi rnams nad ni zas mi za ba dang / /'dod dang rga ba gsum yin nad gzhan med/ /de tshe rin chen bdun dang ldan pa yi/ /gling bzhi'i 'khor 'o sa sgyur rgyal dung dang ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa 'byung 'gyur te/ /dkon mchog rnam gnyis 22

cig car 'byung ba ni/ /smon lam mthu ru mchod sdong gling bzhir bshad/ /(lung 'a di las mkhan chen padma bzang pos mdo sde spyi rnam du byams pa gnyis la bstan pa gcig tu bshad pa de ni ma yin te/ spyir sangs rgyas rnams rtsod ldan kho na la 'byung ba dang rtsod ldan la 'khor los sgyur ba mi 'byung bar gsungs kyang 'dir sangs rgyas dang 'khor los sgyur ba ste dkon mchog gnyis cig car du 'byung ba ni smon lam gyi mthu yin pa'o) da ltar shākya'i rgyal po'i bstaca 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang mchod rten bzheng ba dang / /nyams pa gso sogs byed pa'i mi de rnams/ /byams pa'i 'dus pa dang por grol bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'bri zhing bzheng ba rnams/ /'dus pa gnyis par rnam par grol ba 'thob/ /da ltar dge slong dge 'dun mchod byed pa/ /'dus pa gsum par rnam par grol 'gyur zhes/ /mdo dang dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis lung bstan/ /(de yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dung gi mdun na 'don bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe'i btsun mo tshangs rab la khye'u zhig btsas pa na 'di mngal du zhugs pa nas nang mi thams cad byams pa dang ldan par gyur to zhes mtshan byams par btags/ de cher skyes nas phas bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya btang ste rig byed klog de'i tshe rgyal chen bzhis pad ma dang padma chen po dung dang dung chen po ste gter chen po bzhi phyung nas rgyal po dung la phul zhing sngon rgyal po sgra sgro gas la brgya byin gyis mtshan mar byin pa'i lha'i rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod sdong spoms su pho 'dom drug bcu pa lta bas mi ngoms pa de gaṅgā'i 'gram nas phyung ste phul zhing de rgyal po dung gis mdun na 'don dang des khye'u byams pa dang des khye'u lnga brgya la byin de dag gis dum bu lnga brgyar bgos pa mthong bas khye'u byams pa skyo ste khyim nas rab tu byung zhing sngon ring mo nas lam dang 'jug pa dang theg pa bde bas zhugs pa'i phyir dka' ba spyod pa med par de nyid kyi mtshan mo mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya zhing rgyal po dung gi rin po che sna bdun yang nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal pos lo nyi khri lhag par yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur zhing mthar rgyal po bu stong btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong blon po de snyed dang bcas pa dang yab bram ze'i 'khor de snyed dang bcas pa rab tu byung zhing 'khor 'dus pa 23

gsum 'byung la de rnams bcom ldan 'das byams pas ri bo bya rkang la khrid de ri'i g.yoṭa bsal nas 'od srung chen po'i sku gdung phyag mthil du bzhag nas 'di ni tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe sangs rgyas shākya sbyob pa byon pa'i nyan thos kyi mchog 'od srung chen po'i sku gdung ngo zhes bstan pas lus chung ngu 'di lta bus yon tan gyi tshogs de 'dra ba thob pa zhes skyo ba'i tshe gdung de las snam sbyar phral te 'di ni bcom ldan 'das de'i phyags bdar khrod pa'i snam sbyar ro zhes bstan pa'i mod la 'khor de thams cad dgra bcom pa 'thob par gyur la/de'i mthar gdung de yang nam mkha' la 'phags nas 'bar ba dang gsal ba dang 'od 'byin pa dang char dang glog dang ya ma zung la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma bstan te thugs ka nas rang byung ba'i mes 'tshig ste ring srel lhung ba rnams mchod rten du byed par gsungs shing / shākya'i bstan pa la sku gzugs bzheng pa sogs ba/ngas rgyas la bya ba byas pa rnams 'dus pa dang por grol/ gsung rab 'bri klog bzhengs pa sogs chos la bya ba byas pa rnams 'dus pa gnyis par grol/ dge slong re re la gdugs tshod stob pa yan nas dge 'dun la mchod pa byas pa dang 'du ba'i sgo sbyar ba rnams 'dus pa gsum par grol bar byams pa lung bstan gyi mdo gsum dang dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod las bshad do) tshe lo drug khrir rgyal ba seng ge ste/ /de sogs dgu brgya go dgu tshang bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba bzhi bcu gcig pa dgra gcan che/ /sa gzhi rin chen bdun yin ngan song med/ /mi rnams me tog padmar brdzus te skye/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba bzhi bcu'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /sangs rgyas nyis brgya bzhi bcu 105 155rtsa gnyis pa/ /me tog byin dang gzhan yang phal chen byin/ /ye shes nyi ma tshe 110 401 551 ca81dpag med pa dang / /rin chen grags pa dge ba smrang 'don pa/ /mi 'khrugs 580 700 701 835mdog dang 'dam brgal dran pa'i 'od/ /dge 'od dgra las rgyal dang dus 24

848 877 918 113 115mkhyen 'od/ /bshes gnyen bzang po sman bdag mdangs mnga' ba/ /dga' 910 911 955stobs 'khrul med blo dang lha bdag dang / /nam mkha'i dbyangs dang lha yi 955rgyal po rnams/ /theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig ston pa ste/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi ming yang med/ khyad par sangs rgyas drug brgya bcu gcig pa/ /gser 'od tshe na zhing de'i sems can kun/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems sha stag 'byung / /rgyal ba gzhan rnaswās theg pa gsum gyis 'dul/ /mngon pa'i mdzod las tshe lo mar 'grib kyi/ /brgyad khri pa nas brgya pa'i bar las gzhan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'byung gsungs pa ni/ /theg pa chung ngu'i rnam gzhag phyogs gcig ste/ /brgya dang gcig pa yon tan 'od 'phro ni/ /sku tshe bye ba nyis stong thub pa dang / /nyis brgya gsum pa rgyal ba rin chen tog /lo grangs bye ba 'bum du tshang bar bzhugs/ /nyis brgya so gcig tshogs chen gtso bo ni/ /sku tshe nyin gcig bzhugs pa la sogs ste/ /yul rigs 'od gdung yab yum sras dang ni/ rim gro ba dang mchog zung 'dus pa'i tshad/ /sku tshe bstan pa'i gnas tshad sku gdung dang / /mchod rten thugs bskyed tshul rnams tha dad par/ /bskal pa bzang po'i mdo las rgyas par gsungs/ /ma thog ring mor sangs rgyas mos pa ste/ /de yan sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las mdzad/ /rgyal ba dgu brgya go dgu po kun gyi/ /'khor dang sku tshe bstan pa'i gnas tshad rnams/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa rgyal ba snang mdzad 'di'i/ /'khor dang sku tshe bstan pa'i tshad du 'gyur/ /zhing 'di'i 'gro kun theg gsum so so las/ /phyir mi ldog thul gnas bskal rdzogs pa yin/ /mnar med dmyal bar sems can ma lus pa/ /de tshe 'jig pa'i bskal pa'i thog ma ste/ /chags bskal gnas 25

bskal 'jig bskal stongs bskal bzhi/ /yun ni bar bskal nyi shu re rer mtshungs/ /de ltar bar bskal brgyad bcu bsdoms pa la/ /bskal pa chen po gcig tu brjod pa yin/ /'jig bskal tshul yang cung zad bshad byas na/ /ngan song gsum du sems can ma lus tshe/ /mi zhig gis ni chos nyid kyis thob pa'i/ /bsam gtan dang po'i ting 'dzin 'grub gyur te/ /de las langs nas kye ma dben pa las/ /byung ba'i dga' bde 'di ni dam pa zhes/ /ched du brjod pas sgra de mod kho nar/ /so so'i gling gi mi rnams kun gyis thos/ /kun kyang bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob/ /shi 'phos gzugs kyi khams kyi tshangs ris dang / /tshangs pa'i mdun 'don tshangs chen gsum du skyes/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i lha ris drug ga yang / khams gong 'phos te 'dod khams ma lus stongs/ /bsam gtan dang po'i lha ris gsum ga yang / /rtog dpyod spangs pa'i bsam gtan gnyis pa thob/ /shi 'phos 'od chung la sogs gnas gsum du/ /skyes te tshangs chen man chad stongs par 'gyur/ /de tshe nyi ma'i gzhal med khang stong pa/ /gnyis pa shar bas chu mig steng ka skem/ /gsum pas chu phran ma lus skem par byed/ /bzhi pas chu bo che rnams skem par 'gyur/ /lnga pas rgya mtsho chen po dpag tshad sogs/ /rim pas skem zhing mi 'greng bdun nas ni/ /mi 'greng gang dang ba lang rmig rjes tsam/ /tha mar zil pa tsam yang med par skem/ /drug pa shar bas sa kun du bar 'thul/ /bdun pas ri rab khor yug bcas pa'i bar/ /gcig tu 'bar te tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man/ /me lce gcig tu gyur pas sreg par byed/ /me de rang zhi thal ba'ang ma lus pa/ /de tshe 'jig pa'i bskal pa'i mthar thug ces/ /nyi ma bdun lung bstan pa'i mdo drangs nas/ /'jig rten bzhag par moṅgal bu yis bshad/ /stongs bskal bar bskal nyi shu 'das pa nas/ /slar yang chags pa'i 26

bsaḍasha pa sngon bzhin 'byung / /'on kyang sgron me'i bskal pa zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas /'byung bskal u dum wa ra yi/ /me tog lta bur brgya la srid pa tsam//pha(se cher dkon mchog gsum gyi sgron me yis/ /dben pa mun pa'i bskal pa sha stag yi na/ /me yis 'jig pa lan bdun tshang ba'i tshe/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad chus gcig 'jig /rim pa 'di yis chu yis 'jig thebs bdun//tshang tshe bsam gtan gsum pa'i dge rgyas man/ /rlung chen rab tu g.yo bas 'jig pa nyid/ /yang ni me yis 'jig sogs sngar bzhin te/ /med bzhin snang ba'i rten 'brel rgyun mi chad/ /'du byed rlung ldang dga' bde chu ltar g.yo/ /rtog dpyod me 'dra nang gi bsam gtan skyon/ /rten 'brel mthu las phyi rol 'jig par snang / /bsam gtan bzhi pa snod bcud lhan cig tu/ /skye 'jig snang gi 'byung ba'i mthur mi stos/ / (de dag kyang bskal pa bzang po 'di'i rnam gzhag du zad de gzhan du na phal chen las 'jig rten gyi khams mi 'byed 'di'i bskal pa gang yin pa de ni bde ba yod pa'i zhing khams kyi nyin zhag gcig go /bde ba yod pa'i zhing khams kyi bskal pa de ni de bzhin geshegs pa rdo rje rab 'joms kyi zhing dur mig gis myo/tshan pa'i nyin zhag gcig go /de bzhin du snga ma'i bskal pa phyi ma'i nyin zhag tu bsgres te shin tu sku'i pad ma rgyas pa'i zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo rab tu sgrog pa dang / chos rgyal mtshan gyi zhing rdul med dang / seng ge'i zhing sgron ma bzang dang / rnam snang snying po'i zhing 'od bzang dang / chos 'od sku'i pad ma rgyas pa'i zhing 'da' bar dka' ba dang /mngon mkhyen kun 'od rgyan ldan gyi zhing thugs zla'i me long dkyil 'khor mdog nas grangs med sa ya gcig bgrangs pa'i tha ma'i bskal pa ni rgyal ba dpal bzang gi zhing padma'i dpal gyi nyin zhag du bshad pas mdor na tshad kyis gzhal bar bya ba min no) bskal pa bzang po 'di yi 'og rol du/ /mun bskal chen po drug bcu 'das pa'i rjes/ /sgron bskal snyan pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /de la sangs rgyas khri phrag gcig 'byung ngo //de nas mun bskal chen po khri 'das nas/ /skaro ma bkram pa zhes bya'i sgro na 27

bskal la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brgyad khri tshang bar 'byung / /yang ni mun bskal sum brgya 'das pa'i 'og /sgron me'i bskal chen yon tan bkod pa la//rgyal ba brgyad khri dang ni bzhi stong 'byung / /de tsam mdo las rgyal bas lung da bstan/ /de bzhin nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /bskal pa'i phyi ༄mtha' thug pa yod ma yin/ /'di ni 'jig rten khams 'di'i rnam gzhag ste/ /de bzhin phyogal bcu'i nam mkhas gar khyab par/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rgya mtsho rnams/ kha cig stongs shing la la 'jig dang chags/ /gzhan dag gnas sogs rgya mtsho'i sbu ba ltar/ /go mtshams med cing rgyun mi chad par snang / /zhing khams mtha' dag mthong ba'i mig dag pa/ /'phags mchog rnams kyi gzigs yul ltad mor che/ /nges pa'i don du zhing 'di 'jig pa med/ /rgyal bas bsten pa'i rtsa yi stan tsam yang / khams gsum 'byung ba kun gyis gzhig mi nus/ /rdo rje'i gdan dang bya rgod phung ri sogs/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba bgrang yas rgya mtsho'i yang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas dang shes phyin gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gnas yin zhes gsangs/ /me yis 'jig ༄par snang tshe'ang zhing 'di ni/ /cung zad ma nyams rgyal sras rnams kyis gang //'on kyang 'jig rten byed por rlom pa yi/ /tshangs sogs dregs dang nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /skyo ba bskyed cing rtag 'dzin ldog pa'i ched/ /me chu rlung gis 'jig pa'i bskal pa ston/ /de tshe zhing de stongs par gyur pa yis/ /sems can gcig gi srog la'ang mi gnod pa/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mchog ces gsungs/ /legs par bshad pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ /'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa'i yan lag ste dang po'o/ / 28

ma nga — tha —— nā — —— /6pasmyon sar ra nyangag gan /yi ra med 03 〉tem ngasale'u dang po ston pa'i mdzad pa bshad pa/da ni ston pa'i mdzad pa brjod par bya/ /bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa thub pa'i mchog /'dis ni bla med byang chub thugs bskyed de/ /rgyal sras gzhan las ches cher rmad byung ba'i/ /byams brtse spro dang rtsom pa rgya chen pos//byang chub lam bzang bde blag gis bgrod nas/ /mtha' yas bskal mang sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /sngon gyi smon lam chen po lnga brgya'i mthus/ /'dzam gling skye rgu tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe/ /snyigs ma lnga ldan lhag par gdul dka' ba'i//'gro rnams gdul phyir dga' ldan lha gnas na/ /lha yi ston pa dam pa tog dkar zhes/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ni rgyal tshab tu/ /bzhugs pa las bab 'dzam gling gshegs par dgongs/ /da lta 'dzam gling snyigs ma lnga bdo ste/ /rtog ge pa drug rjes su sgrogs pa drug /stoms par 'jug pa drug ste mu stegs kyi/ /ston pa bco brgyad kyis ni ma rung byas/ /gshegs pa'i dus min bzhuṭa par gsol 'debs zhes/ /lha rnams kun gyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /rol mo thams cad dus gcig dkrol cig gsungs/ /byang chub sems dpa'as dung dkar blangs te bus/ /rol mo'i sgra yi nang na mchog ci dris/ /kun kyang dung gi sgra yis zil mnan gsol/ /de bzhin bdud dang mu stegs ma lus pa/ /nga yis zil mnan 'gro kun drang ngo gsungs/ /tshe lo brgya pa'i dus dang go 29 ༄

tam gdung / /ser skyari grong mchog dag pa'i yab yum ste/ /gzigs pa lnga la rnam par gzigs nas ni/ /glang chen thal kur gser gyi dra ba yis/ /g.yogs pa'i rnam pas grong khyer ser skya ru/ /zas gtsang btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes/ /lhas bstan rgyal po legs par rab sad sras/ /dus gsum rgyal ba mtha' yas mang po yi/ /yum du smon pa grub pa'i 'phags ma de/ /gso sbyong dag par spyod pa'i lhums su zhugs/ /der yang mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par/ /tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khang bzang nang / /bzhugs nas phyogs bcu'i byang sems mtha' yas btul/ /chos kyi rnam grangs rgya mtsho du ma bstan/ /'dzam gling kun tu sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i ltas/ /ya mtshan dpag med mtha' yas snang bar gyur/ /gling gi dbus su byang chub ljon shing skyes/ /ser skya'i grong kun rin chen las byas gyur/ /gangs ri'i ngos nas seng ge'i phru gu dag /'ongs nas srang na gnod pa med par rtse/ /lumbi'i tshal kun rin chen ljon pas khyab/ /de tshe zla dgu ngo bcu tshang ba'i tshe/ (lhums su zla ba bcur zhag bdun gyis ma chog pa bzhugs pa la/ mdor zla ba bcu tshang ba'i tha snyad gyis brjod cing 'dir zla dgu ngo bcur brjod pa yin no)/ ngo mtshar ltas chen so gnyis byung ba las/ /rtsa gsum lha yi 'byor pa lta bu yis/ /yum gyis lumbi'i tshal gyi skyed tshal byon/ /rgyu skar rgyal dang ldan tshe yum gyi phyag /pa la kṣa yi ljon pa la 'jus te/ /bya rmyang mdzad pa'i rtsib logs g.yas pa nas/ /yum la gnod pa med cing nag nog gis/ /ma gos gser gong phyis pa lta bu ru/ /bltams tshe lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis/ /bran mo rgan mo'i rnam pas blangs pa'i tshe/ /theg par ma gyur stobs kyi nga rgyal bcom/ /klu dbang rnams kyis bdud rtsis sku khrus gsol/ /phyogs kun gom pa bdun bdun bor ba las/ /gser gyi pad ma 'dab stong pa re byung / /skye rga na 'chi kun las 'da' byed 30

cing / /'gro ba'i kha lo gyen du bsgyur ro gsungs/ /bsil ba'i 'od kyis 'jig rten snang bar byas/ /ngo mtshar ltas chen bco brgyad byung ba'i tshe/ /yab kyis phyag dang bstod pa dang po mdzad/ /tshangs pas bdud rtsi'i zil mngar blangs te phul/ /zhag bdun lon tshe yum gyi sprul pa bsdus/ /yum gyis skyed pa'i bya ba rdzogs zin zhing / /skye bo phal pa'i skyed mar mi rigs la/ /khyim nas byung ba yum gyis mi bzod pa/ /spang dang yum gyi phyag kyang mi bzhed phyir/ /'khrungs nas zhag bdun yum gyi tshe lus pa'i/ /tshe na lhums su 'jug par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /'di yang rgyal ba phal gyi thun mong yin/ /skye rgu'i bdag mo chen mo sgyu 'phrul sogs/ /ma ma sum bcu gnyis kyis zham ring byed//gzhan yang shākya'i khye 'u lnga brgya dang / /grags 'dzin ma sogs bu mo brgyad khri dang / /bran pho bran mo lnga brgya phrag re dang / /glang chen rta dang ma he ba glang sogs/ /lnga brgya phrag re dus gcig nyid du btsas/ /rin chen gter kun sa las rang byung gyur/ /phyogs bzhir mnyan yod rgyal po tshangs byin bu/ /gsal rgyal dang ni grong khyer rgyal po'i khab/ /pad snying sras po gzugs can snying po dang / /kau shambir ni dmag brgya'i bu shar pa/ /'phags rgyal du ni mu khyud mtha' yas bu/ /rab snang zhes bya rgyal phran bzhi yang btsas/ /dang por don kun grub par mtshan gsol to/ /shākya dregs ldan rnams kyang dul gyur nas/ /thub ltar gnas phyir shākya thub pa dang / /gnod sbyin shākya 'phel soṭa kyis btud pas/ /lha yi lha ste mtshan gsum rim par btags/ /khyim du gnas na gling bzhi'i 'khod sgyur dang / /rab tu byung na rdzogs 'tshang rgya 'o zhes/ /mtshan mkhan rnams kyis mgrin gcig lung ston gyur/ /drang srong nyon mongs med kyis phyag byas te/ /nges par rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan nas/ /rang gi snag tsha bram ze mes byin la/ /dgung lo so lnga lon nas 'tshang 31

rgya yis/ /de tshe slob mar byos zhes bstan nas 'das/ /ro brgya ldan pa'io'abras chan mang bzhes tshe/ /mdzub mo gcig gis gser gzhong bzung ba ni/ /glang chen lnga brgyas dbrog par ma nus phyir/ /glang chen stong gi stobs can zhes mtshan btags/ /byis pa'i slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen las/ /yi ge slob pa'i grwar byon yi ge'i rigs/ /drug bcu rtsa bzhi slob dpon la bstan pas/ /ya mtshan gyur te bstod phyag byas par gyur/ /sangs rgyas sam ni 'khor los sgyur byung tshe/ /yi ge 'di 'byung gzhan du mi 'byung zhes/ /bris te bstan pas mkha' las tshangs pa yis/ /mthun gyur brjod phyir tshangs pa'i yi ger grags/ /rtsis kyi pha mthar son pa srid sgrub kyis/ /mi 'khrugs pa las gong du bgrang ma nus/ /gzhon nus snying po mchog gi bar du brtsis/ /dzam bu'i shing grib ting 'dzin mdzad pa na/ / phyi dror gyur kyang grib mas sku ma btang / /'di tshe yab kyis bstod phyag gnyis pa mdzad/ /drang srong lnga yis mkha' la 'gro ma nus/ /zhabs la gtugs shing bstod nas song bar gyur/ /de nas bud med rnams kyi don mdzad phyir/ /grags 'dzin ma la rgyal ba'i ru mtshon byas/ /lhas byin mdzes dga' lag na be con can/ /la sogs tshan po che dang sred med bu'i/ /stobs ldan shākya'i khye 'u lnga brgya dang / /'phong dang 'degs dang gcod pa la sogs pa/ /sgyu rtsal 'gran pas de dag thams cad kyi/ /dregs pa tshar bcad 'jig rten zil gyis mnan/ /lag na be con bu mo grags 'dzin ma/ /dril bu sgra yi bu mo sa 'tsho ma/ /shā kya dus legs bu mo ri dwags skyes/ /la sogs btsun mo drug khri khab tu bzhes/ /'jig rten mthun par 'jug pa'i spyod pa yis/ /skye bo mgu bar mdzad nas srid pa las/ /nges par 'byung ba chen po bstan pa'i slad/ /ser skya'i sgo bzhir rga nad shi ba dang / /sprul pa'i dge slong gzigs pa'i rkyen dang ni/ /btsun mos sbyar ba'i 32

rol mo'i sgra dbyangs las/ /tshigs su bcad pa du cha/sa bskul ba yis/ /khyim las nges par 'byung ba nyid du dgongs/ /ma ning yin zhes skur pa spang ba'i phyir/ /bud med 'grogs ba'i tha ma 'di yin zhes/ /grags 'dzin ma lda sras kyi sa bon bzhag / rgyal pos ra ba lcag ri sgo 'phar dang / /dmag dpung mang pos bskor te srung la brtson/ /mtshan mo yab gcig mnal gyis non pa la/ /gsol ba btab pas mnal gyis myos pa dang / /nam yang bla ma'i gnas rnams kun gyi ngag /ma bcag bden pa'i tshig gi mthar phyin pa/ /de yi ngag tshig sus kyang mi zlog phyir/ khyod kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig ces/ /gnang ba byin te rgyu skar rgyal shar ba/ /mtshan phyed tshe na bsngags ldan la bcibs te/ /rgyal chen bzhi yis chibs kyi rkang lag bteg /tshangs dang brgya byin 'od kyis lam sna byas/ /gnas gtsang lhas bskor steng gi mkha' la byon/ /shākya khye 'u gyang yul las 'das pa/ /byang phyogs kā ma rū pa'i yul du bab/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi gtsug phud dor ba yis/ /rnam dag ces bya gtsug phud mchod rten byung / /'das pa'i sangs rgyas gsum gyi gtsug phud kyi/ /mchod rten kyang ni phyogs 'dir lhan cig gnas/ /ma byon rnams kyang gtsug phud 'di ru 'dor/ /rngon par sprul pa'i lha yis dur smrig phul/ /blangs sar 'dun pas dur smrig mchod rten brtsigs/ /gtsug phud dus ston gos kyi dus ston zhes/ /lha yul na yang dus ston re re yod/ /rta dang rgyan bskur 'dun pa slar log sar/ /'dun pa slar log pa yi mchod rten byas/ /'dun pas ser skyar rgyal 'bangs mya ngan bsal/ /btsun mo rnams kyis bsngags ldan mgul nas 'jus/ /rta mchog khyod kyis mi mchog gar bskyal zhes/ ta/ngus pas bsngags ldan cang shes mya ngan skyes/ /zas bcad dbugs kyis brnarngos te gum pa las/ khyim bdag bur skyes phyis nas dgra bcom bkod/ /rgyan rnams 83

gzhon nu gzhan la g.yogs pa na/ /lha phran gzhan gyis brgya byin rgyan thogs ltar/ /sus kyang ma theg skye gu'i bdag mo yis/ /rgyan cha mthong ba'i mya ngan spang ba'i phyir/ /rdzing du dor bas rgyan gyi rdzing bu byung / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rang byung gis/ /bsnyen par rdzogs ste chu bo dbyig ldan sogs/ /brgal nas yul dbus ma gadngha ru chas/ /drang srong ngan spong bu yi bsti gnas byon/ kho bo'i bsod nams mthu yis sngon gyi tshe/ /ljon tshogs 'di kun dzam bu'i gser las grub/ /lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rtag rgyas kyang / /nga ni phal ba'i shing gyur brnyid bskams pas/ kho bo 'chi bar nges ces bram ze de/ /mya ngan byed pa gzigs nas slar gsungs pa/ /de ni khyod kyi mthu min gangs ri dang / /nye sar shākya'i gzhon nu zhig byung ba/ khyim du gnas na 'khor los sgyur 'gyur la/ /'di ni de yi skyed mos tshal du 'gyur/ /de mthus sngon tshe 'byor pa rgyas pa yin/ /gzhon nu de ni khyim spangs rab byung bas/ /de bas bskams par zad ces gsungs pa na/ /de yis brtags nas 'o na gzhon nu de/ khyod nyid kho nar nges zhes mchod pa byas/ /ma ga: ru bsod stoms mdzad pa'i tshe/ /skye bo kun gyis dge sbyong mdzes par bsgrags/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mthong nas ni/ /'di lta'i gzugs dang na tshod dka' thub 'phangs/ /rgyal por 'os zhes rgyal srid phyed bstabs pa/ /ma bzhes rgyal pos slob mar khas len byas/ /me lnga pa dang nyi ma'i brtul zhugs dang / rkang pa gcig gis 'greng sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /dka' thub spyod pa'i mu stegs gnas su zhugs/ /de dag rnams dang mthun pa'i dka' ba ni/ /nyis 'gyur la sogs spyad pas de kun dang / /dge sbyong chen po ces byar mtshan du brjod/ /de nas stoms par 'jug ba drug po yi/ /nang nas sgyu rtsal zhes bu ring 'phur las/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched mngon du mdzad/ /slar yang rangs byed bu 34

ni lhag spyod kyi/ /slob mar mdzad de srid rtse'i skye mched nos/ /de dag mgu bas slob ma'i tshogs phul kyang / /de kun thar pa'i lam du ma gzigs nas/ /chu bo ni rañdza ra'i 'gram du byon/ /dka' thub tsam gyis grol 'dod dga' ba'i phyir/ /rgya shug 'bru re sā lu 'bru re dang / /chu thigs tsam gyis 'tsho dang cung zad kyang / /mi gsol sogs kyi dka' ba lo drug spyad/ /tshor ba zil mnan dbugs kyi dbyung rngub spangs/ /lhar bcas skye bo gzhan gyis ma zhugs pa/ /mkha' khyab ces bya'i ting 'dzin mdzad par gyur/ /de tshe yab dang zhang pos mi lnga brgya/ /'khor du bzhag pa'i brgya phrag re re nas/ /mi re bsdad nas gzhan rnams log pa la/ /lnga sde zhes bya 'khor gyi dang po byung / /mdo gzhan dag las ring 'phur lhag spyod kyi/ /slob ma lnga zhig zhabs phyir 'brangs pa ni/ /lnga sde bzang po yin par bshad pa'ang yod/ /gsang sngags yo ga ltar na dka' thub kyi/ khog pa mi yul du bzhag 'og min nam/ /ri rab rtser byon longs skur sangs rgyas te/ /slar yang dka' thub sbyong ba'i lus la zhugs/ /sprul skur 'tshang rgya tshul du ston par gsungs/ /thun mong snang ngor shin tu rid pa'i sku/ /grong gi byis pa'i rtsed mo'i gnas su gyur/ /ngal dub mtha' yis grol bar ma gzigs nas/ kha zas rags pa bza' 'o zhes gsungs pas/ /lnga sde ma dad wa ra ṇa sir song / /'di yang byang chub sems dpa' 'tshang rgya ba/ /mi yi skye bos bsnyen par mi nus pas/ /nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu ru bshad/ /de tshe grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / /dga' stobs ma zhes bya bas mtshan mkhan gyis/ /bu mo gang gis lo ni bcu gnyis su/ /tshangs par spyad de dka' thub rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /ma he stong gi 'o ma'i nying khu yis/ /bram ze mchod de smon lam btab pa na/ /don kun grub pa'i btsun mor 'gyur ro zhes/ /bstan thos lo ni bcu gnyis tshangs par spyad/ /35

dka' thub grub nas ma he mo stong bzhos/ /'o ma de dag rnams la blud nas ni/ /slar yang bzhos te lnga brgya la ni blud/ /de ltar ma he nyi shu rtsa lnga'i /bar/ /lan bdun nying khur byas pa'i 'o thug bskol/ /sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsi'i dwangs ma btab/ /sā li'i 'bras blug bskol bas bkra shis pa'i/ /rtags kyi ri mo du ma shar ba ni/ /mtshan mkhan gyis mthong 'di ni sus 'thungs pa/ /de ring bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zer/ /sbyin yul bram ze 'bod par bran mo bskul/ /brgya byin mthu yis dge sbyong bram ze gzhan/ /gcig kyang mi snang brgya byin tshangs pa gnyis/ /bram zer sprul pa mthong nas bos pa na/ /nga bas rnam pa du mas 'di lhag gis/ /'di la phul zhes brgya byin gyis tshangs pa (de yis byang chub sems dpa' bstan par gyur/ /'o thug de yis gser gyi gzhong pa bkang / /phul nas byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la gtugs/ /shākya'i gzhon nu gangs ri'i 'gram byung ba/ /don grub de yi btsun mor smon lam btab/ /byang chub sems dpas de ni khyim nas byung / /'dod pa spangs kyis smon lam gzhan thob gsungs/ /de gnyis mdza' zhing gcugs pa'i yid kyi rgyus/ /'o na de bsam 'grub par gyur cig zhes/ /bsngos ste byang chub sems dpas mthun gyur mdzad/ /gzhong pa 'di yang btang ngam zhes gsungs pas/ /kho mo cag ni snod dang bcas pa yis/ /byin te sdod ma mchis par ma yin zer/ /'di gnyis bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rdzogs 'tshang rgya kur bsod stoms 'bul ba por/ /smon lam btab ste 'grub par gyur pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpas chu bo'i 'gram du bsnams/ khrus mdzad sbrang rtsi lta bur mngar ba yi/ /'o thug bzhes pas sku yi mthu stobs rgyas/ /gser gzhong chur dor klu rgyal rgya mtshos khyer/ /brgya byin gyis ni mkha' lding du sprul te/ /phrogs nas lha yul du khyer mchod pa byas/ /deng sang na yang sdod kyi 36 —

dus ston yod/ /bran mo grub ma zhes pa'i ro dkris pa'i/ /gso ras blangs tebakrus shing kha bskyur nas/ /phyags bdar khrod pa'i snam sbyar mdzad par gyur/ /de tshe 'dzam gling rtsi shing ldum bu kun/ /rang rang lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rgyas/ /kun kyang rtse kun rdo rje'i gdan du phyogs/ /bur shing la sogs rang rang bcud rnams 'dzag /sa chen 'di ni 'khar ba las byas ltar/ /reg na 'khrol zhing sgra snyan 'byin par gyur/ /srog chags kun kyang byang chub snying po'i phyogs/ /rang bzhin gyis 'dud mgo bo ston par byed/ /byang chub shing mchog rab tu rgyas shing mdzes/ /bya rnams snyan pa'i sgra 'byin nyi 'od gsal/ /'gro kun mi dge'i bsam pa nub pas gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu chen po'i stobs/ /mtha' yas ldan pas seng ge'i stabs kyis chas/ /nags tshal me tog bkra ba'i spo cig gzigs/ /'di ru 'dug nas 'tshang rgya zhes dgongs tshe/ /ri de nyil zhing zhig par gyur pa na/ /cis nyes dgongs tshe gnas gtsang lha rnams kyis/ /mtshams med spyad dang srid pa tha ma pa'i/ /byang sems gnyis ni sa gzhi phal pa yis/ /bsten mi nus kyis ha cang mi ring bar/ /rdo rje'i gdan yod de ru gshegs zhes bstan/ /brgya byin gyis sprul rtswa tshong bkra shis las/ /rma bya'i mgrin mdog reg na 'jam pa yi/ /lha yi rtswa blangs byang chub shing drung byon/ /rtswa rnams g.yas skor nyid du ngang gis 'khyil/ /de steng bzhugs te byang chub ma thob bar/ /nam yang 'di las ldang bar mi bya zhes/ /dam bcas rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /'od zer bkye bas bdud kyi bdag po sbran/ /bdud kyi dpung tshogs mi 'khrugs phrag gcig ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can lhags te mtshon char phab/ /de kun me tog char gyur 'khyil zhing 'bab/ /bdud kyi bu mo rnams kyis chags pa yis/ /bslu bar brtsams pa rgan mor byin brlabs te/ /slar yang rgyal sras nyid la skyabs su song / /37

khyod kyis bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis de tsam gyis/ /'tshang rgya rigs pa min zhes bdud kyis rgol/ /byang chub sems dpas sdig pa can khyod kyis/ /gtan med mchod sbyin gcig cig byas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug tu gyur na/ /nga yis gtan med mchod sbyin dpag yas byas/ /gsungs tshe bdud kyis dpang po su yod zer/ /phyag g.yas brkyangs pa sa gzhi la bsnun te/ /kun la stoms shing nye khon med pa yi/ /sa 'di nga yi dpang zhes gsungs pa'i mod/ /sa chen rnam pa drug du g.yos pa las/ /sa yi lha mo brtan mas lus phyed thon/ /ji skad bka' bstsal de bzhin kho na ste/ /'di ni bdag la mngon sum nyid yin no/ /de lta mod kyis lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /dpang po tshang ma khyod nyid yin no zhes/ /brjod pa thos pas bdud tshogs skrag cing byer/ /mang zhig ston pa nyid la skyabs su song / /de ltar byams pa chen po gcig kho nas/ /g.yo ba med bzhin bdud sde kun btul te/ /bden pa bzhi dang luṭa 'byung lugs zlog gi / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba kun mkhyen pas/ /spyan dang mngon par shes pa mngon du mdzad/ /skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis/ /skya rengs shar tshe mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de tshe mkha' la zla ba gza' yis zin/ /grags 'dzin ma la dgra gcan zin sras btsas/ /rgyal pos gzhon nu'i sras min zhes dogs tshe/ /yum gyis gzhon nu'i pang tshang rdo ba dang / /lhan cig dmod bor rgyan gyi rdzing bur 'phangs/ /lhan cig bal 'dab bzhin du chu steng 'phyo/ /skye bo yid 'ches btsas ston rgya cher byas/ /de tshe bdud rtsi zas kyi bu btsas pas/ /kun dga' bo zhes dus las ming du btags/ /de ltar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /skyil krung nyid kyis tā la bdun srid kyi/ /tshad du lan bdun 'phags te cheng/ du brjod/ /lha rnams kun gyis rgya cher mchod par gyur/ /sangs rgyas ma byung dus su dmus 38

long zhing / /sangs rgyas byung dus mig rab rnyed pa yi/ /klu yi rgyal po nag pos kun nas bstod/ /bdun phrag zhag tu skyil krung ma gshig bzhugs/ /gnyis par byang chub shing la mi 'dzums gzigs/ /gsum par stong gsum rgyang ring bar du 'chag /bzhi par shar nub rgya mtsho'i bar du 'chag /lnga par btang bzung klu yi gnas na bzhugs/ /drug par nu gro dngha yi shing drung bzhugs/ /bdun par sgrol rgyu'i shing gi tshal na bzhugs/ /de tshe bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /thog ma'i bsod stoms 'bul po'i smon lam can/ /tshong pa ga gon dang ni bzang po yis/ /zong mang khal ded lho nas byang bgrod tshe/ /legs skyes dang ni grags pa ces bya ba/ /glang bu'i dam pa cang shes gnyis kyis ni/ /mgron po rnams kyi lam gyi sna 'dren zhing / /lam du 'jigs pa yod na mi 'gro bas/ /de tshe glang bu cang shes de gnyis kyis/ /lam du ma phyin ded kyang lam gzhan zhugs/ /nags kun myul bas 'jigs pa ma mthong ste/ /glang bu'i phyir phyin byang chub shing drung na/ /rgyal ba bzhugs mthong glang bu skor ba byed/ /lhas kyang sbran pas tshong pa dad gyur te/ /skyo ma lde gu sbrang rtsi bur shing sogs/ /bsod stoms phul tshe rgyal bas dgongs pa mdzad/ /lag gis blangs na mu stegs can bzhin 'gyur/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i bzhes snod gang yin dgongs/ /lhung bzed du mkhyen gnas gtsang lhas kyang gsol/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi yis rin chen tshogs/ /du ma'i lhung bzed phul ba ma bzhes nas/ /rdo yi lhung bzed re re phul ba bzhes/ /gcig tu byin rlabs bsod stoms bzhes nas ni/ /tshong pa rnams la bde legs tshigs bcad gsungs/ /lhums su zhugs nas mdzad pa 'di yi bar/ /phal cher thun mong skye bo'i mthong ba yi/ /dbang byas lung dang mngon byung rgya rol ltar/ /nyung ngur bsdus nas cung zad brjod pa yin/ /'phags chen rnams kyi gzigs pa'i 39

dbang byas tshe/ /byang chub shing gi rgyan dang bkod pa tshad/ /seng ge'i khri chen bsam yas ldan pa ste/ /byis pa'i 'gro bas bskal par bgrang mi nus/ /der bzhugs skal mnyam sen sa dpa'i 'khor mtha' yas/ /dbus su sangs rgyas rdo rje'i gdan spo las/ /g.yo ba med bzhin ri rab rtse mo dang / /'thab bral dga' ldan la sogs 'og min bar/ /so so'i gnas su sku yi bkod pa snang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing nas byang sems tshogs 'dus te/ /phal po che yi mdo sde gsungs pa nyid/ /de bzhin rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud 'ga' las/ /gsang sngags mthu yis bdud btul sangs rgyas tshul/ /du mar bshad rnams ma lus brjod mi lang / /thams cad gdul bya'i snang cha tha dad de/ /gcig rjes gcig mthud byung bar ma 'khrul zhig /de nas dam chos dkon par ston pa dang / /skye rgu tshangs la dad rnams gdul ba'i phyir/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags 'dab gnas bya zhes dgongs tshe/ /'jig rten du ni mi rung sna tshogs byung / /lha yis shes nas kun gyis gsol ba btab/ /tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa/ /phul te ma gadha 'dir ma dag chos/ /dri mar bcas par sems pa'i smra ba byung / /de slad thub pa bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye gsol/ /de skad bskal bzang rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar skul ba po/ /tshangs pas gsol ba'i mod la zhal gyis bzhes/ /gzhan gyis gsol ba btab la nga mi ltos/ /skye bo 'di kun tshangs la dad pa ste/ /de yis gsol btab 'khor lo bskor ro gsungs/ /sngon gyi slob dpon ring 'phur lhag sbyong gnyis/ /drang bar dgongs tshe 'das ma thag par mkhyen/ /thog ma'i gdul bya lnga sde yin mkhyen nas/ /wa ra ḍā sir gshegs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /gaṅgā'i mnyan pas gru btsas blangs pa na/ /gru btsas med 40 —

gsung mkha' la bya bzhin gshegs/ /rgyal pos de thos rab byung gru btsas bkag khor mo 'jig ces wa ra ḍā si'i yul/ /drang srong lhung ba ri dgas nags tshal du/ /lnga sdes ma gus pa yi khrims bcas kyang / /thub dbang gzi brjid ma bzod dang gis bral/ /gdung dang rigs nas bod par ma byed cig /da ni mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas so gsungs/ /rin chen khri stong sa las rang byung ba'i/ /dang po gsum la phyag dang skor ba mdzad/ /bzhi par bsnyengs pa med par bzhugs nas ni/ /bden bzhi'i ngo bo bya ba 'bras bu ste/ /bzlas pa gsum gyis rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi/ /chos 'khor lo grangs mi nyung ba ru bskor//dang pos kaurnyi nus ni mthong lam thob/ /ston pas khyod kyis chos kun shes sam zhes/ /lan gsum rmed pas kun shes mtshan du gyur/ /gnyis par kornyinus dgra bcom ste/ /snam sbyar rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog tu bstan/ /rta thul rlangs pa bzang ldan ming chen bzhis/ /mthong ba'i lam dang gsum par dgra bcom gyur/ /'di lnga ye shes khong chud kyis bsnyen rdzogs/ /'dod gzugs lha ni brgyad khris chos mig thob/ /lha kun lhung lhung ldegs ldegs sgra 'byin te/ /sngon tshe lha mi sas kyang ma bskor ba'i/ /chos 'khor bskor ba mthong ༄zhes ched tu brjod/ /theg dman lugs la chos 'khor gzhan mi 'dod/ /theg chen lugs kyi chos 'khor dang po yin/ /grags pa khyim na gnas bzhin dgra bcom bkod/ /mi slob khyim gnas srid pa min zhes gsungs/ /de sogs nye ba'i lnga sde rab tu byung / /rigs gtso'i bu ni lnga bcu dgra bcom bkod/ /drug bcu'i tshogs lden bzang sdes bden pa mthong / /cho 'phrul lnga brgyas lteng rgyas 'od srung btul/ /ral pa can stong zag pa zad par bkod/ ci༄ /gang zhig ma thong bas glang chen smyon pa yang / /dul byed rta thul gyi ni spyod lam gyis/ /'dzam gling smra ba'i mchog gyur nye rgyal dang / /'dun 'don bram ze'i dam pa 41

pang nas skyes/ /'khor bcas btul te shes rab rdzu 'phrul du/ /ldan pa'i dam pa mchog gi zung du bstan/ /de dag la sogs srid pa tha ma pa/ /phal cher dge slong tshur shog tshangs spyod byos/ /ces gsungs mod la chos gos snam sbyar bsgos/ /skra dang kha spu bregs nas zhag bdun tsam/ /ril ba thogs gyur bsnyen par rdzogs nas kyang / /lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam ltar gnas pa/ /dge slong dngos po ldan par gyur pa'i phyir/ /tshur shog gis ni bsnyen par rdzogs pa yin/ /ser skya bzang mo lha yi lus thob dang / /dzambha'i gser nas ma ga'i khal brgya pa'i/ /bang ba brgyad bcu la sogs spangs nas ni/ /rab byung ngang gis 'dod chags bral gyur pa/ /bram ze'i khye 'u nu gro dha skyes kyis/ /mthong ba'i mod la khyod ni ston pa ste/ kho bo khyod kyi nyan thos lags so zhes/ /lan gsum gsol bas bsnyen par rdzogs gyur pa/ /'od srung chen po stobs bcu pa ces grags/ /('od srung chen po dang 'od srung stobs bcu pa gnyis su mdo kha cig las 'byung la mdzad pa 'khrul med tu 'od srung stobs bcu pa ni ma ga dha pa yin par sems zhes bris mod kyang 'od srung chen po nyid kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pa 'dra snyam du rang la yang yang shar bas 'di ltar bris pa yin no)gzhon nu'i dpe yi mdo sdes gsal rgyal btul/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po dad par mdzad/ /mgon med zas byin dad dang bden pa la/ /bzhag ste rgyal byed tshal gyi kun ra bzhes/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas lo bdun lon pa'i tshe/ /yab kyi pho nya mdun na 'don 'char ka /de lta'i cho gas bsnyen par rdzogs su bcug /rdzu 'phrul bkod pas ser skya'i grong du gshegs/ /yab kyis bstod phyag gsum pa mdzad par gyur/ /chos gsung tshe na khye 'u kun dga' bo/ /rnga yab thogs te ston pa'i sku la g.yob/ /de las gzhan du 'gro bar ma 'dod nas/ /zham ring bgyis te thos pa 'dzin par gyur/ /nyid gcung 'dod chags drag po rab zlog nas/ /42

dgra bcom dbang po bsdams pa'i mchog tu bstan/ /rgyal po zas gtsang dreṭa dang zhum pa yis/ /bden pa cha/ rtogs mkhyen nas moṅkal bus/ /rdzu 'phrul bstan pas bdag gi bu 'ba' zhig /rdzu 'phrul ldan snyam dregs pa de dang bral//lha yi gzhal med khang par rgyal chen bzhis/ /sgo bsrungs tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs la/ /dam chos ston pa mthong bas lha rnams chos/ /mi nyan snyam pa'i zhum pa dang bral te/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i gnas la bkod/ /nga yi bstan la rigs rus mi gtso zhes/ /'breg mkhan nye 'khor tshur shog gis bsnyen rdzogs/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan lhas byin sogs/ /rigs gzugs mchog thob lnga brgya rab byung ste/ /de las phal gyis ston pa mnyes par byas/ /grags 'dzin mngal khung lo drug 'dzin pa dang / /dgra gcan zin ni de srid mngal gnas pa'i/ /rgyu ni 'di zhes sngon gyi las 'bras gsungs/ /grags 'dzin ma yis ston pa dbang byed phyir/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i la du sras la bskur/ /ston par phul bas slar gnang zo zhig gsungs/ /yab kyi phyir 'brangs rab tu 'byin pa'i phyir/ /shā ri'i bur btang de yi dge tshul gyur/ /sngon gyi drang srong mas byin dgra bcom bkod/ /rus las ka tu yā na zhes par grags/ /mtha' khob 'dul bar byed pa'i mchog tu bstan/ /de yis gtum po rab snang 'khor bcas btul/ /lho phyogs gser sa'i rgyal po gab phi na/ /dmag tshogs khri rer ldan pa'i zlon po ni/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong ldan pa btul byas nas/ /rab byung dge slong bsod stoms spyod par gyur/ /sgra sgrogs rgyal po u ta ya na ni/ /bris skus btul te thub pa'i 'khor du gyur/ /sdig grogs kyis zin rgyal po gtsug phud can/ /'khor dang bcas la mthong chos las 'bras bstan/ /bu ram shing 'phem slo ma'i grong la sogs/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag pha rol spyan drangs tshe/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i 'khor bcas tha dad pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan 4 3

pas gshegs te dul bar mdzad/ /rdzogs byed gnag lhas skyes dang rgyal ba can/ /gnyen gyi bu dang nog can skra'i la can/ /de ltar mu stegs rtog ge pa drug gis/ /cho 'phrul 'gran phyir yang yang bskul ba yis/ /cho 'phrul chen po bstan pas thams cad btul/ /'di yang nyan thos ltar na cho 'phrul gyi/ /zhing sbyangs nas ni cho 'phrul nyin gcig yin/ /de la'ang thun mong thun mong min pa gnyis/ /'di ni 'dul ba'i lung las bshad pa stos/ /theg chen ltar na gcig nas bco lnga'i bar/ /sbyin bdag cho 'phrul tha dad re bstan te/ /brgyad yan 'gran zlar bcas pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /de phyin 'gran zla med pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /'di ni mdo sde mdzangs blun nang na gsal/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen lhas byin gyis bskul ba'i/ /ma skyes dgra yis glang chen nor skyong ni/ /rbad pa btul te lha dang bden par bkod/ /ma skyes mngal gnas khye 'u nyid 'gyur zhing / /lha mi'i dpal thob pa yi bstan la zhugs/ /dgra bcom 'gyur zhes lung bstan dgag pa'i phyir/ /blun po du mas 'bad kyang dgag ma nus/ /ji skad lung bstan g.yo ba med par gyur/ /dpal sbas kyis ni sgo drung me dong bshams/ /dug can zas sbyar mgron du sbyan drangs tshe/ /zhabs bzhag tsam gyis me dong pad ma'i mtsho/ /bung ba'i khyu mang sgra 'byin ldan par gyur/ /pad mar zhabs bkod nang du stan la bzhugs/ /dkon mchog gsum la dug gsum mi mnga' ba'i/ /bden pa'i tshig gis zas kun dug med gyur/ /dad par mdzad de bden pa mthong la bkod/ /skye rgu'i bdag mo rab tu 'byin pa ru/ /kun dga' bo yis zhus tshe bstan pa la/ /bud med 'jug par zhu ba ma byed cig /bstan pa lo grangs lnga brgyas sngar nub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs lan gsum gsol ba'i tha mar gnang / /lci ba'i chos brgyad khas blangs kyis bsnyen rdzogs/ /de sogs bud med dgra bcom mang du byung / /ser skya'i grong du 44

yab kyi mchod rten mdzad/ /sngon nas pha mar gus zhes sngon byung gsungs/ / sangs rgyas stong gi nges pa'i 'phrin las ni/ /las kyi rgyu ba lung ston mdzad pa'i phyir/ /ti si'i gangs 'gram ma dros mtshor byon te/ /rin chen sna tshogs pad ma la bzhugs nas/ /sngon tshe mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas/ /zhabs la seng ldeng tshal pa zug pa dang / khye 'u bla mas sangs rgyas 'od srung tshe/ /mgo reg la ni byang chub ga la yod/ /byang chub thob par dka' 'o zhes smras pas/ /lo grangs drug du dka' ba spyad pa dang / /de bzhin utpal bkru sman mnams pa dang / /kun tu rgyu mo tsan tsas skur ba dang / /mu stegs mdzes ma rgyal byed tshal bsad dang / /mu ge'i grong du bsod sto mas spyad pa las/ /ma rnyed lhung bzed stong par byon pa dang / /sku stod bsnyung ba bsal phyir gzims pa dang / /bram ze ba ra dhwa dzas mi snyan tshig /lnga brgya brjod pas spyos shing dmad pa dang / /dgra mtha'i grong du dbyar gnas mdzad pa na/ /rta chas nas rul gsol bar bstan pa dang / /ser skya bcom tshe dbu bsnyun gyur pa ste/ / las kyi rnam pa bcu po lung bstan mdzad/ /gzhan yang dge 'dun dben gyis bye ba dang / /lhas byin gyis 'phangs rdo bas rma dod sogs/ /las kyi rgyu ni 'di zhes gsal bar bstan/ /'khor kun gyis kyang rang rang las kun bshad/ /mchog zung de tshe ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul rtse/ /lhas byin lus 'dis man ra med dmyal bar lhung / /tha mar rang sangs rgyas su lung bstan mdzad/ /ma skyes dgra ni rtsa ba med pa yi/ /dad pa la bkod sbyin bdag mchog tu gyur/ /de bzhim/ gdul bya'i tha ma 'dul gyi bar/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pas 'gro mang btul ba ste/ /lung dang las brgya rtogs brjod brgya pa dang / /mngon par phyung ba'i mdo sde rnams las gsal/ /'di rnams thun mong gdul bya'i snang ba yin/ /sprum mong min pa theg chen gdul bya'i ngor/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la sogs 46

par/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras mtha' yas 'dus pa la/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum ji bzhin sgras/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /zab pa sher phyin mdo sde mtha' yas gsungs/ /dpag med byang chub mchog tu lung bstan mdzad/ /lha yi gnas dang klu dang mi ci'i gnas/ /rtswa can grong sogs mtha' yas gnas rnams su/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa dpag yas la/ /la lar drang nges rnam par phye ba dang / /la lar dgongs dang ldem dgongs sgra gzhan dang / /la lar ji bzhin sgra sogs rnam mang gis/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid kho na las brtsams te/ /rgya chen thabs kyi pha rol phyin pa yi/ /chos 'khor mtha' yas bgrang las 'das par gsungs/ /de tshe las lam rnam pa bcu soṭa kyang / /des 'dul 'gro la thabs kyi mdzad pa ste/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la mi dge'i las med ces/ /gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo ru gsungs/lhas byin 'khor dang bcas dang drug sde dang / /bdud dang mu stegs ji snyed snang ba yang / /ston pa nyid kyi thabs kyi mdzad pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i che ba dbyung bar byed pa ste/ /rgyal la tho 'tsham nus pa mi srid ces/ /zab rgyas mdo sde du ma dag las bshad/ /ma skyes dgra yi 'gyod bsal mdo sde ni/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das tshe 'jam dpal mthus/ /rgyal po'i rmi lam nang du snang ba ru / /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las lung du bstan/ /'di dag thun mong phar phyin theg pa yi/ /snod gyur rgyal sras rnams la snang ba yin/ /shin tu skal ba mchog gi gdul bya'i ngor/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa'i 'khor lo che/ /e waX gnyis med mi phyed rtag pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i ba gar stoms zhugs ste/ /he ru ka dpal kha sbyor bdun ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho ni/ /nam yang nub pa med pa'i dus su bstan/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bye ba brgyad bcu dang / /ri rab sum bcu drug gi rdul mnyam pa'i/ /rnal 46
