'byor ma tshogs skad cig gis smin grol/ /'dus pa'i rgyud chen gnyis med rnam rgyal dang / /'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba la sogs par/ /zas gtsang 'jam dpal yum ni sgrol ma ste/ /grags 'dzin ma ni lha mo dpal chen mo/ /dgra gcan zin sras rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nyid du gnas par bshad/ /chos kun skad cig gcig gi snang ba ste/ /bden rdzun snga phyi thog mtha' la sogs pa/ /btags pas yin gyi rang gi ngo bos min/ /'di 'dra'i chos nyid zab mo la skrag pas/ /theg chen theg dman mdo sngags 'di thams cad/ /ji ltar 'khrul ldan skye bo'i ngag bzhin du/ /gcig rjes gcig mthud kho nar ma 'khrul zhig /tshad bzung med pa'i yul gyi tshad 'dzin na/ /mkhas par grags kyang byis las byis par go /ji ltar 'gro mang dus gcig gnyid log na/ /so so'i khams dang rkyen dang bag chags las/ /rmi lam snang ba tha dad 'byung mod kyi/ /kun la bden rdzun thog mtha' yod ma yin/ /de bzhin gdul bya'i mos khams dbang po dang / /bag nyal tha dad mos pa sna tshogs dang / /ye shes sgyu 'phrul byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus/ /gang 'dul sku dang dus dang 'khor dang zhing / /mdzad pa dam chos mtha' yas cig char snang / /kun kyang ye shes sgyu ma'i snang bar zad/ /bden rdzun med de chos dbyings gcig gi ngang / /dam chos padma dkar po gsung ba'i ring / /bar gyi bskal pa lnga bcu 'das pa ni/ /dus byin brlabs pas phyi dro gcig go snyam/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'dus pa thams cad ni/ /ljags kyi cho 'phrul mdzad ring de snyed 'das/ /dus byin brlabs phyir yud tsam gcig go snyam/ /'di 'dra dpag yas gsungs pa rnams stos la/ /sangs rgyas byis ba'i chos su ma sdud cig /de bzhin sku tshe'i tshad kyang sna tshogs su/ /snang ste bskal chen grangs mang bdun brgya ni/ /shā kya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad yin zhes/ /seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags 47

pa'i mdo las bshad/ /gzhan yang gdul bya dpag yas du ma yis/ /cig car nyid du rang rang skal ba ltar/ /la las dga' ldan gnas narnga 'pho bar mthong/ /de bzhin lhums zhugs bltamang bzo rol rtsed mdzad/ khab nas byung dang dka' spyod 'tshang rgya dang / /chos gsung mya ngan 'das dang ring srel 'ged/ /bka' sdud bstan pa'i gyes pa ston la sogs/ /mtha' yas bsam mi khyab pa cig car snang / /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gis/ /byams pa'i rnam par thar pa mthong bzhin no/ 4 /theg chen dbang byas myang 'das mdzad pa yang / /snying rje pad dkar mya ngan 'das mdo dang / khye 'u bzhi yi mdo sogs las gsungs ltar/ dpag yas bstan rnams skye bos dpag mi nus//thun mong byis pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /kun dga' bo yis zham ring byas nas ni/ /yul gyi dbus dang byang phyogs phal mo che) /zhabs kyis bcags te sngon byung du ma bstan/ kha che li yul bod sogs lung bstan mdzad/ /slar yang lag na rdo rjes zham ring byas/ /yul khams mtha' yas myul zhing dul bar mdzad/ /mdor na dgung lo nyer dgu khab tu bzhugs/ /lo drug dka' spyad rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur nas/ /wa ra ḍā si yangs pa can dang ni/ /sa dkar can dang lha gnas byis pa gsod/ /ko shambi dang 'brog gnas mchod rten gnas/ /bya rgod phung ri 'od ma can gyi grong / /sgra bcas dang ni ser skya'i grong khyer ste/ /bcu gnyis po ru lo re lo re bzhugs/ /mnyan du yod par lo grangs nyi shu bzhi/ /sman gyi nags tshal du ni lo bzhi ste/ /'bar ba'i phug gi gnas su lo lnga bzhugs/ /de ltar dgung lo brgyad bcu bzhes pa'i tshe/ /gang gis rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi po la/ /bsten zhing goms pa mang du byas pa de/ /'dod na bskal pa'am de bas lhag par yang / /'tsho zhing sdod do de bzhin gshegs pa yis/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsten goms mang mdzad phyir/ /bzhed 48

na bskal pa'am de bas lhag par yang / /bzhugs zhes kun dga' bo la lan gsum du/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs bskul kyang / /bdud thibs kyis non ci yang mi smrar gyur/ /sdig can bdud kyis 'da' bar gsol ba btab/ /skyo ba skyed phyir sku tshe'i lnga cha btang / /sku tshe'i 'du byed zla gsum byin gyis brlabs/ sa g.yos phyogs 'tshig skar mda' lhung bar gyur/ /mchog zung la sogs nyan thos chen po ni/ /mang zhig phung po'i lhag spangs mya ngan 'das/ /grong khyer chen po rtswa can du gshegs te/ /lam du rdo ba /'phangs pa'i mdo sde yis/ /gyang rnams btul te sā la'i tshal gyi dbus/ /tha ma'i gzims khri la bzhugs mgar ba'i bu/ /tsunda zhes bya sangs rgyas sdong po yi/ /tha ma'i bsod stoms 'bul por smon pa las/ /bsod stoms bzhes te nga ni 'das pa'i 'og /'od srung gis ni ston pa'i bya ba byed/ /nga yi bka' rnams legs par bsdu bar gyis/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ /zhes pas gnas dus 'khor sogs gleng gzhi dang / /bar du mtshams sbyor tha mar thun gyur brjod/ /mes pa ral pa can dang shākya las/ /gzhan pa'i mu stegs rab tu 'byin mi bya/ /bslab pa phran tshegs 'dod na bag yangs byos/ /rgan pas gzhon pa phan pas bsdu bya zhing / /gzhon pas rgan la ming nas bod mi bya/ /zhes gsungs dgra gcan zin dang kun dga' bo/ /dge 'dun la btang sku yi stod g.yogs bsal/ /dge slong dag rnams bde gshegs sku la stos/ /de la 'di ni bde gshegs sku lta ba'i/ /tha ma yin no re zhig cang ma smra/ /bden pa bzhi dang rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /bslab pa gsum la the tshom yod na zhus/ /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa yin no/ /zag bcas sdug bsngal myang 'das zhi ba ste/ /chos kun bdag med pa 'o de la 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi tha ma 'o/ /zhes gsungs bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med 49

dang / /'gog stoms rnams la lugs 'byung lugs zlog gis/ /yang yang stoms zhugs bsam gtan bzhi pa las/ /tha mar zag med dbyings su mya ngan 'das/ /nyan thos che rnams chos nyid la rtog byed/ /tshangs sogs lha mi'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho kun/ /mya ngan smre sngags sdug bsngal sna tshogs byed/ /lha rdzas mchod pa dpag yas 'dzam gling gang / /sku gdung dam pa snam sbyar lnga brgya dang / /ras zung lnga brgyas dkris te 'khor sgyur gyi/ /gdung ltar lcags snod 'bru mar gyis bkang bar/ /bzhugs te dri zhim shing spungs zhugs la ni/ /bzhen par brtsams tshe me sbar ma nus nas/ /lha mig ldan pa'i mchog gyur ma 'gags pas/ /bltas te 'od srung chen po stobs bcu pa/ /sku gdung ma nyams pa la phyag bgyid 'dod/ /de mthus yin gyi de srid zhogacig zer/ /'od srung chen pos ltas chen rnams mthong bas/ /ston pa 'das par shes te kye ma 'o/ /'dus byas rnams kyi chos nyid 'dir zad mod/ /mchog tu dad ldan rgyal po ma skyes dgras/ /thos na khrug skyugs mod la 'chi 'gyur bas/ gde zlog pa yi thabs shig bya 'o snyam/ /mdun na 'don pa bram ze dbyar byed la/ /thabs bstan rings par sā la'i tshal du byon/ /bsod nams chen po de yis ma nyams pa'i/ /gdung la phyag byas chos gos ras zung gzhan/ /lnga brgya phrag res gsar du yang dkris nas/ /dri zhim tsan dan la sogs shing spungs tshe/ /thugs ga'i dbus nas rang byung ye shes mes/ /sku gdung bsregs te yungs 'bru lta bu yi/ /ring bsrel gyis ni kun nas gtams par gyur/ /de la ras zung gnyis ni ma tshig pa/ /nang ma shos dang phyi ma shos yin no/ /de tshe ma skyes dgra yi mdun na 'don/ /dbyar byed kyis ni 'od srung gis bstan ltar/ /rgyal po skyed mos tshal du spyan drangs te/ /ston pa'i mdzad pa bris pa'i thang sku bstan/ /'di ni dga' ldan gnas nas glang chen gyi/ /rnam pas bab ste lhums 50

su zhugs pa 'o/ /zhes sogs go rim bzhin du brda sprad de/ /tha mar 'di ni grong khyer rtswa can gyi/ /sā la zung gi tshal du shing zad pa'i/ / me ltar mya ngan 'das shing tsandan gyi/ /zhugs kyis sku gdung sbyong ba'i mdzad pa 'o/ /de skad smras pas rgyal po skrag gyur te/ /ci ga ston pa mya ngan 'das gyur tam/ /dbyar byed kyis ni lha nyid de skad gsungs/ /bdag ni de skad brjod par mi spro 'o/ /zhes smras thos pas rgyal po sa la 'gyel/ /yun ring brgyal tshe snga nas bshams pa yi/ /til mar gzhong pa bdun las rim pas drangs/ /tha mar tsandan sa ma—chog gi khu ba'i/ /gzhong pa'i nang nas drangs pas sos par gyur/ /de nas sdig can yul gyi gyad rnams dang / /rtog g.yo'i yul gyi rgyal rigs pu lu ka /grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi ni kro dha dang / /khyab 'jug gling na gnas pa'i bram ze dang / /ser skya'i shākya yangs pa can pa yi/ /li tsā wir bcas sku gdung len du lhags/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgras kyang glang chen bzhon/ /dpung tshogs bcas pas 'gro bar chas pa'i tshe/ /ston pa dran pas brgyal te lhung gyur nas/ /'gro bar ma nus dbyar byed dpung bcas btang / /gdung skal len pa'i sde tshan bdun lhags te/ /re re zhing nas rtswa can gyad rnams la/ /ston pa 'di ni nged la ring mo nas/ /'phangs shing sdug la bla mar gyur pa yin/ /de ni khyed kyi nye 'khor du 'das kyis/ /nged la sku gdung skal ba byin par gyis/ /nged kyis rin chen mchod rten byas nas ni/ /mchod pa bgyid ces smras tshe gyad rnams kyis/ /nged kyang de ltar byed kyis sku gdung ni/ khyed la mi sbyin zhes smras de rnams kyis/ /'o na dmag gis dbrog zhes dmag dpung sdud/ /gyad rnams kyang ni g.yul du chas par gyur/ /de tshe bram ze bre bo dang mnyam pas/ /ston pa de ni bzod pa'i bsngags pa gsung / /bzod la dgyes na de yi sku gdung phyir/ /gcig gis gcig ni gsod par mi rigs kyis/ /bdag gi sku gdung 51

cha brgyad mnyam par bgo / bum pa 'di ni bdag gis mchod par bya/ /zhes smras kun kyang dga' zhing mthun gyur nas/ /cha brgyad bgos pas yungs 'bru lta bu yi/ /ring bsrel ma ga dha yi khal re byung / /so sor byin nas gdung gi sol ba rnams/ /bram ze nu gro dha skyes kyis blangs te/ /bcu po so so'i yul du mchod rten byas/ /'on kyang ma skyes dgra yi skal ba ni/ /mdo sde 'di dang lhan cig grong khyer gyi/ /phyi rol sa gzhir za ma tog bcug nas/ /rgyal po mya ngan med pa'i don du sbes/ /de 'das nas ni lo brgya lon pa na/ /mya ngan med ces bya ba'i rgyal po 'byung / /de tshe dge slong dbang po'i sde zhes pas/ /phyung ste mdo sde 'di yis rgyal po 'dul/ /de nas stado 'di byang gi phyogs rol tu/ /'jog kyang su yis shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /mya ngan med kyis ring bsrel de blangs te/ /'dzam gling khyab par ring bsrel ldan pa yi/ /mchod rten brgyad khri bzhi stong byed 'gyur zhes/ /byang chub sems dpa'i thabs kyi spyod yul gyi/ /rnam 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las lung du bstan/ /sgra sgrogs pa yi ring bsrel skal pa ni/ /klu yi rgyal pos khyer te mchod pa byed/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i tshems kyi mche ba bzhi'i/ /gcig ni brgya byin gyis khyer lha yul mchod/ /gnyis pa tshig 'dzin grong khyer yid 'ong na/ /gsum pa ka ling rgyal po'i yul na ste/ /bzhi pa sgra sgrogs klu yi rgyal pos mchod/ /de bzhin tshems dang ring bsrel sku gdung gzhan/ /du mas lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang / /mi'am ci dang mi sogs 'gro ba'i ris/ /dpag med gnas na so so'i don chen mdzad/ /chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs las ston pa'i mdzad pa khyad par du bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /62

le'u gnyis pa bka' bsdu ba khyad par bshad pa/ gang tshe mchog zung mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe/ /dgra bcom brgyad khri dang ni bdun khri 'das/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das tshe dgra bcom pa/ khri dang brgyad stong phung po'i lhag ma spangs/ /dbang thob dge slong nyung ngur gyur pa yis/ / tshe tshad bskal mang thub pa'i lha rnams ni/ /dbang yod dge slong rnams kyang 'das pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i gsung rab dud pa tsam du gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum po sgrog par mi byed ces/ /'phya zhing mya ngan byed pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'od srung chen po yis/ /bsgos te lha mig ldan mchog ma 'gags pas/ /smon nas shes pa'i ting 'dzin la zhugs te/ /srid rtse'i bar du bltas nas garnyi brdungs/ /dgra bcom lnga brgyar gcig gis ma tshang 'dus/ /ba lang bdag ni rtsa gsum lha yi gnas/ /shi ri shi ya'i gzhal yas stong pa na//'gog soms la gnas de yis thos ma gyar de nas 'od srang che bos kan///ste ri ring / / rigi rterdotā/ bsgo ba dga' bo/ /chu yi zhal lta par bskos slob pa gzhan/ /ldog ste dang po'i lam nas yul dbus song / /dge 'dun dang ni kun dga' bor bcas pa/ /ljongs rgyu bzhin pas ma ga dha ru byon/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi kun spyod ni/ /rta dang shing rta glang chen la sogs pa/ /zhon tshe ston pa'i nyan thos mthong ba na/ /cig car 'phyongs te zhabs la mgos phyag byed/ /'on kyang bde bar gshegs pas rtag dgongs pas/ /mi gnang dal bus sa la bab ltar gyur/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan la gus pa yin/ /skabs 'dir 'od srung chen pos ma ga dhar/ /byon pa rgyal po glang chen bzhon pas mthong / /steng nas 'phyongs pas 'od srung chen po'i mthus/ mkha' las bzung ste dal bus sa la bzhag /ston pa rtag tu 53

mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i phyir na sngon gyi dus/ /khyod la lhung ba'i nyes par ma gyur to/ /ston pa de ni mya ngan 'das zin zhing / /dge 'dun la ni skye 'phags gang yang yod/ /dgra bcom rnams kyang rtag tu mnyam bzhag min/ /de bas phyin chad 'phyong bar ma byed ces/ /'od srung chen pos dam bca' byin nas ni/ /lha yi gnas 'dir dam chos bgro bya zhes/ /bskul bas rgyal po dga' zhing mgu gyur nas/ /yo byad ma lus legs par sbyar nas ni/ /nu gro dha yi phug tu lnga brgya yi/ /dge slong 'dus pa'i dge 'dun bzhugs nas ni/ /dbyar gyi snga mar ngal dang 'grums pa bcos/ /phyi ma'i dbyar gyi zhal bzhes mdzad par gyur/ /kun dga' bo ni rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas te/ /gzhan kun dgra bcom rnam thar brgyad ldan yin/ /de tshe 'od srung chen pos kun dga' bo/ /spyo bas 'dul bar mkhyen nas nyes pa brgyad/ /glengs te ji srid dgra bcom ma thob bar/ /dge 'dun gnas nas phyung ste bri dza'i grong / /byon tshe rang gi slob ma'i gdam ngag las/ dgra bcom thob ste dge 'dun gnas su byon/ /ma 'gags pa ni 'phags pa ba lang bdag /'bod par bsgos te ri rab rtser song nas/ /'gog stoms las 'a ngas zhi bar 'dug pa la/ /'od srung la sogs dge 'dun gyis 'bod ces/ /bskul tshe ston pa 'das sam zhes dris nas/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te mya ngan 'das/ /rang byung me yis lus tshig me phung gi /phyogs bzhi nas ni tshigs bcad re re grag /lhung bzed chos gos khyer nas dge 'dun la/ /phul ste de yi bsam pa bzod gsol byas/ /'od srung chen pos bka' bsdu ma zin bar/ /su yang mya ngan 'da' bar mi byed pa'i/ khrims bcas dang por 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ /gsol gnyis las kyis bskos nas seng ge'i khrir/ /dgra bcom lnga brgyas snam sbyar bting ba la/ /bzhugs te byang chub snying por kha 54

bltas nas/ /ston pa yid la dran pas skyo bzhin du/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ /zhes pa brjod pa tsam gyis lha rnams ni/ /mya ngan ldang gyur kye ma bcom ldan 'das/ /da ni thos pa'i lam du gshegs par gyur//sngon tshe chos ston bdag gis mngon sum mthong / /da ni 'di skad bdag gis thos ces gleng / /'di yang deng dus thos pa tsam du zad/ /kye ma 'dus byas thams cad 'di 'dra zhes/ /shugs 'byin mchod pa'i las la brtson par gyur//dgra bcom lnga brgyar gcig gis ma tshang ba'ang / /'di ltar thams cad mi rtag par mtshungs zhes/ /skyo ste rang rang khri las bab ste 'khod/ /ston pas dge slong lnga la bka' bstsal pa/ /ces sogs bzlas pa rnam pa gsum bzlos pas//mdo sde'i sde snod legs par bsdu bar byas/ /kho bos bzung ba'i mdo sde 'di lags kyis/ khyed cag rnams kyi de cam yin nam dris/ /kun gyis nged kyi mdo sde de tsam ste/ /tshe dang ldan pa'i de tsam yin nam gsungs/ /'di kho na ste de bas lhag pa med/ /ces smras seng ge'i khri las bab ste 'dug /de bzhin nye ba 'khor gyis 'dul ba bsdus/ /bslab gzhi dang po gar bcas su la bcas/ /zhes sogs dris lan tshul gyis gtan la phab/ /de nas 'od srung ma bskos rang 'dzegs te/ /ma mo zhes bya bdag nyid kho nas smra/ /zhes brjod mngon pa'i sde snod bsdu bar byas/ /gzhung gi tshad ni 'bum phrag re re yin/ /dgra bcom re re'i thugs la yod pa'i gzhung / /thams cad mthun nam mi mthun brtag pa'i phyir/ /'don la bka' yi bsdu bar grags pa ste/ /'di ni thub pa'i bka' bsdu dang po yin/ /sbyangs yon ldan dang dgon par gnas pa'i mchog /ston pa nyid kyis stan phyed bstabs pa'i phyir/ /sngon nas ston pa gnyis par grags pa yi/ /stobs bcu'i stobs ldan 'od srung chen po de/ /bdag gi sa sde snod gsem po bsdus pa na/ /tshangs pa mtshungs spyod sus kyang ma 55

ldog cing / /mthun par bka' yi gnang ba byin pa'i phyir/ /'di ni chos so 'di ni 'dul ba'o/ /'di ni ston pa'i bstan pa 'o zhes dgongs/ /snying rje pad ma dkar po'i mdo las ni/ /'od srung dang ni kun dga' bo khyod gnyis/ / nga 'das lo ni bzhi bcu lhag cig tu/ /ston pa'i mdzad pa byed ces lung bstan ltar/ /lo 'gar bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzad/ /ston pa de la byas pa gzo byas te/ /de'i gsung ci nus tsam zhig bsgrubs zin gyis/ /ma lus sgrub par sus kyang mi nus la/ /rnag gi lus 'dis skyo phyir mya ngan las/ /'da' 'o zhes dgongs kun dga' bo bos te/ /ston pas bdag la bstan pa yongs su gtad/ /bdag gis kyang ni khyod la gtad par bya/ khyod kyis sha na'i gos can rgya mtsho las/ /'ongs te rab tu phyung la gtod cig gsungs/ /'od srung mya ngan 'da' tshe ma skyes dgra /spron par sngon tshe zha'4 gyis bzhes pa'i phyir/ /pho brang mdun byon chab sgo ba la bos/ /'od srung rgyal po lta 'o zhes smros shig /de yis rgyal po gnyid kyis log gyur te/ /gtum pas gnyid las slong mi nus zhes zhus/ /'o na gnyid las sad tshe 'od srung ni/ /mya ngan 'da' phyir spron zhes smros shig gsungs/ /ston pa'i mchod rten mche bar bcas rnams la/ /tha ma'i phyag mdzad lho yi phyogs kyi ri/ /bya gag rkang gi sbo la 'dzegs byas te/ /ri gsum dbus su rtswa yi gding ba la/ /ston pa'i snam sbyar phyags bdar khrod pa bsgos/ /seng ge'i stabs bzhin g.yas ngos phab ste gzims/ /bdag nyid chen po byams pa der gshegs nas/ /bye ba dgu bcu'i 'khor tshogs ma btul bar/ /sku gdung nyams pa med par byin brlabs te/ /mya ngan 'das tshe sa chen rir bcas g.yos/ /lha yi me tog char gyis sku gdung yog /gnod sbyin rnams kyis ri bo gsum gyi dbus/ /bkab ste steng nas byil por byas par gyur/ /ma skyes dgra yis rmi lam don mthong nas/ /sad nas spron par thos tshe 66

sa la 'gyel/ /gal te sku gdung dngos su ma mthong na/ /rgyal po khrag dron bskyugs te 'chir rig nas/ /kun dga' bo yis bya rkang ri la khrid/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis ri bsal sku gdung bstan/ /zhabs la phyag byas sreg par brtsams pa na/ /kun dga' bo yis 'di ni 'di ltar du/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir bskal mes kyang mi 'jig /ma 'ongs rgyal ba byams pa sangs rgyas nas/ // dge slong bye ba dgu bcus yongs bskor te/ /tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su byung ba yi/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i nyan thos mchog /'od srung chen po'i sku gdung 'di yin te/ /'di lta'i yon tan thob pa 'khor 'dir med/ /ces gsungs phyag gi mthil du bzhag nas ston/ /lus 'dis de lta'i yon tan thob pa zhes/ /'khor de kun nas skyo zhing yid 'byung 'gyur/ /'di ni ston pa de yi snam sbyar zhes/ /bstan pa'i mod la 'khor tshogs de thams cad/ /dgra bcom 'thob 'gyur ston pa'i bya ba byed/ /de ltar gdul ba'i bya ba byas zin tshe/ /sku gdung 'di nyid mkhar 'phags sna tshogs pa'i/ /cho 'phrul bstan nas rang byung me yis 'tshig /de bas mchod pa gyis la zhog cig gsungs/ /sngar bzhin ri bkab steng du mchod rten byas/ /rtsa ba med pa'i dad ldan rgyal po de/ /kun dga' bo yi zhabs la mgos btugs nas/ /ston pas bdag ma sbran par mya ngan 'das/ /'od srung 'da' ba'ang bdag gis ma mthong gis/ /khyod kyis bdag ma sbran par mya ngan las/ /mi 'dar gsol zhes zhus shing zhal gyis bzhes/ /thos pa 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur kun dga' bos/ /ston pa nyid ltar bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad/ /khye 'u gser mdog mdzangs shing bag ldan pa/ /rab gtum blon po'i g.yo rgyus bsad shing la/ /bskyon tshe 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs kyis/ /bsad shing steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor byung / /dgra bcom mtha' yas mang po'i 'khor ldan pa/ /zla ba kham pa lta bur mkhadi 57

la gshegs/ /khye 'u de ni rab byung dgra bcom gyur/ / ('di la gser mdog gi rtogs brjod ces pa yod/) skye bo'i tshogs mang byang chub gsum la bkod/ /sha na'i gos can rgya mtsho'i don grub pas/ /dgra bcom khri phrag mang po'i 'khor bcas la/ /lo lnga'i bar du dus ston chen po byas/ /khyod kyis bstan la zang zing gis bsdu byas/ /da ni chos kyis bsdu bar gyis shig gsungs/ /rab byung rig grol ldan pa'i dgra bcom bkod/ /khyod kyis spos tshong sbas pa zhes bya'i bu/ /nye sbas la ni bstan pa gtad par byos/ /ston pa gnyis par rgyal bas lung bstan no/ /zhes gsungs bstan pa gtad de rgyal po sbran/ /mya ngan 'da' phyir gaṅgā'i chu dbus byon/ /rgyal pos gdugs kyi yu ba chag rmis nas/ /sad tshe sbran par thos nas dpung dang bcas/ /gaṅgā'i lho yi 'gram du phyin te 'khod/ /yangs pa can pa rnams la lhas sbran nas/ /de dag dpung bcas gaṅgā'i byang 'gram 'khod/ /gnyis gas lus phyed 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /'phags pa'i mchog de gaṅgā'i dbus na gnas/ /de tshe drang srong rdzu 'phrul ldan pa zhig /lnga brgya'i 'khor ldan rab tu byung phyir 'ongs/ /chu dbus gling sprul nyin gung bsnyen rdzogs tshe/ /gsol ba byas pas phyir mi 'ong ba thob/ /brjod pa gsum pa'i tha mar dgra bcom gyur/ /chu dbus pa 'am nyi ma'i gung par grags/ /mkhan po'i stun du 'da' bar zhus pa na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon nas khyod lung bstan/ kha che'i yul song bstan pa zhog cig gsungs/ /mya ngan 'da' phyir nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa mdzad pa na/ /ma ga bha pa rnams dang yangs can pa/ /gnyis ka phan tshun snying rjer ngu zhing 'bod/ /mgon po tshur gshegs sku gdung 'dir 'od zer/ /ye shes mtshon gyis sku gdung phyed du btang / /gnyi gas so sor thob par byin brlabs nas/ zhi ba'i dbyings su mya ngan 'das par gyur/ /gnyi gas gdung 58

gi mchod rten byas nas mchod/ /nyi ma gung pa 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /kha che'i yul ni mtsho ru gnas par byon/ /nyi ma'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pas mtsho de bskams/ /klu rnams 'khrugs nas phyags bdar mtshon cha yi/ /char phab lha yi me tog char du gyur/ /mtshon dug me yis gnod par ma nus tshe/ /ngo mtshar skyes nas ci bzhed dris pa na/ /ston pas gnas 'di nga yi lung du bstan/ /skyil krung gang gi sa zhig slong ngo gsungs/ /skyil krung gcig gis lung pa dgu non te/ /'khor tshogs ji snyed mnga' zhes zhus pa na/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya yod gsungs klu yis kyang / /de las dgra bcom gcig tu ma tshang yang / /yul 'di slar la dbrog ces dam bcas phul/ /gang na gtong po yod na len po yod/ /de phyir khyim bdag gzhug par bya 'o gsungs/ /rang gis grong khyer bkod nas mi rnams bcug /'phel phyir spos ngad ldang ba'i ri bo nas/ /gur gum sa bon blangs pas ri de yi/ /klu rnams 'khrugs pa btul nas ji srid du/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gnas pa de srid bar/ /gur gum phul te yul der bskrun par byas/ /de phyir gasmi ra'am kha cher grags/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya rtag tu bzhugs pa yin/ /'dzam gling ston pa'i bstan pa nub pa na/ /yul de'i gur gum skye ba rgyun chad cing / /dgra bcom lnga brgya gcig gis ma tshang tshe/ /yul de slar yang mtsho ru 'gyur ba yin/ /sha na'i gos can gyis kyang bstan pa yi/ /bya ba rgya cher mdzad de nyer sbas kyis/ /sde snod gsum rig dgra bcom thob gyur tshe/ /bstan pa gtad nas mya ngan 'das par gyur/ /sngon tshe ston pa'i drung du bram ze ni/ /smra ba'i mchog zhig 'ongs te 'di skad du/ /gal te shā ri'i bu dang mtshungs pa ru/ /lung ston mdzad na bdag ni rab byung bgyid/ /ces gsol ston pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ji ltar bka' bstsal gzhan du 'gyur mi srid/ /shes rab ldan 59

mchog gnyis pa mi 'byung zhes/ /gsungs pas rab tu ma byung log par gyur/ /ston pa'i zhal nas da lta'i bram ze de/ /ma 'ongs dus su nga 'das lo brgya na/ /nyer sbas zhes 'gyur bstan la rab byung nas/ /ston pa gnyis pa'i bya ba byed do gsungs/ /'di ni khyim na gnas pa'i dus su yang / /gzugs tshong bzang mos bslu bar ma nus te/ /phyi nas rgyal po'i chad pas smad tshong de/ /rkang lag rna ba sna btubs 'chi kha'i tshe/ /bdag gis khyod blta'i dus ni 'di yin zhes/ /chos bstan rgyun zhugs gnas la bkod pa yin/ /dgra bcom gyur nas 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /chos ston tshe na bdud kyis dkrug pa'i phyir/ /res 'ga' me tog res 'ga' rin chen sogs/ /char phab pa yis yid rab g.yengs par byas/ /de phyir slob ma rnams kyis chos ma rtogs/ /phyi nas lha yi bud med mdzes ma dag /sprul pas g.yengs tshe 'phags pas bud med de/ /lhung bas shi nas lus myags rul ba dang / kha cig nang rol la sogs mi gtsang ba/ /phyi nas shel ltar mthong bar byin brlabs pas/ /'khor rnams skyo zhing mi sdug 'du shes thob/ /dgra bcom zag pa zad pa nyid du bkod/ /'phags pa'i phyir 'brang lhung bzed lhag ma za/ /dam chos nyan pa'i khyi zhig yod pa de/ /shi tshe chos thos pa yi dge ba des/ /sdig can bdud kyi stan phyed dbang bar skyes/ khyi yang bdag dang mnyam par bkod pa 'dis/ /bla na ma mchis bdag la brnyas so snyam/ /'phags pa la ni mtho 'tsham bgyid blo skyes/ /bdud kyis khyod la mchod pa bya 'o zhes/ /dbu la me tog phreng ba bcings pa las/ /bdag gis lan du me tog sbyin no zhes/ khyi ro me tog phreng bar sprul nas ni/ /bdud kyi mgul btags sprul pa bshig pa yis/ /lha lus gtsang zhing dag pa'i mgul pa ru/ /khyi ro rul myags 'bus gzhigs dri nga ba/ /thogs pas sdug bsngal mi bzad ldan par gyur/ /rang gi nus pa rdzu 'phrul lta zhog gi'u0

tshangs dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa/ /lha gzhan kun la gsol ba btab gyur kyang / /sus kyang de ni 'dor bar yong ma nus/ /dgra bcom byin brlabs gzhig par mi nus kyis/ /de nyid la ni gsol ba thob cig skad/ /'phags pa'i drung 'ongs 'dor bar gsol ba btab/ /bdag gis sngon tshe rdzogs sangs rgyas de la/ /gnod mang bgyis kyang nam yang lan ma mdzad/ /nyan thos khyed rnams 'di ltar gdug pa ste/ /rtsed mo'i lan kyang 'di ltar bgyid la stos/ /'phags pas smras pa bdag dang ston par ni/ /rdul dang ri rab lta bur bsgrun mi nus/ /de lta mod kyi bdag gis ston pa de'i/ /chos kyi sku yi phyogs ni mthong mod kyi/ /gzugs kyi sku yang bdag gis ma mthong ngo / /sdig can khyod kyis rgyal ba'i sku gzugs su/ /sprul par nus zhes grag gis bdag la ston/ /'phags pas phyag mi 'tshal bar dam bcas nas/ /bdud kyis thub pa'i sku gzugs su sprul te/ /gser gyi ri bo lta bur lhang nge 'dug /'phags pas ston pa dngos su 'du shes te/ /phyag 'tshal brtsams tshe sprul pa mi snang gyur/ /phyin chad dge la bar chod mi byed na/ /'di ni me tog phreng bar byin gyis rlob/ /gdug pa'i bsam pa nam skyes khyi yi ro/ /rul par gyur cig ces ni bden stobs brjod/ /de phyin skrag pas sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /bdud kyis bar du gcod par mi nus skad/ /u shi ri yi brag gi phug pa ni/ /mchu zheng dpangs zab gzhu 'dom nyi shu par/ /slob ma dgra bcom thob pa re re yis/ /so shing sor bzhi pa re 'phangs pa yis/ /so shing tshogs kyis phug de byur bu ru/ /gang tshe mya ngan 'das te dgra bcom pa'i/ /so shing tshogs des gdung zhus lha yis mchod/ /de yis dhi dha ke la bstan pa gtad/ /de yis nag po de yis legs mthong che/ /bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun zhes lung las bshad/ /ston pa 'das nas lo grangs brgya dang bcu/ /lon zhing 61

rgyal po mya ngan med pa yis/ /rgyal srid byas nas lo bcu 'das pa'i 'og /lnga brgya'i 'khor ldan dgra bcom grags pa yis/ /yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang byon tshe/ /de na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge slong tshogs/ /rab mang rnyed pa bgod pa'i skal ba byung / /dris pas rung min gzhi bcu spyod par shes/ /thub pa'i bstan la chu bur byung ba 'di/ /bdag gis yal bar dor na mi rung snyam/ /thams cad 'dod dang nor ldan la sogs pa/ /dgra bcom mkhas pa du ma grogs su btsal/ /zla sbur 'gog stoms las ni langs ma thag /lhas sbran 'ongs te 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i/ /slob ma sha stag dgra bcom bdun brgya 'dus/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis sbyin bdag byas/ /a la la yis rung ba rung ngam ci/ /mi rung tsam par drug sde la bcas so/ /zhes sogs dris lan tshul gyis gtan la phab/ /rung min gzhi bcu de dag sus spyod pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyis dor zhes mthun par smras/ /sde snod gsum po lhag chad med par bton/ /'di ni bdun brgyas yang dag brjod pa 'am/ /bka' yi bsdu ba gnyis pa zhes par grags/ /bka' bsdu gsum pa lung na med pa'i phyir/ /'dod tshul mi 'dra du ma snang mod kyang / /rtog ge la 'bar dbu ma'i gzhung lugs las/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mdo las lung bstan ltar/ /rgyal po dga' bo dang ni pad chen dus/ /sdig can bdud kyis bzang po zhes bya ba/ /dge sbyong cha byad 'dzin pa cig tu byas/ /rdzu 'phrul du mas skye bo'i yid bsgyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dge 'dun rnams dkrugs shing / /de yi slob ma klu dang yid brtan gyis/ /dar bar byas pas lta spyod ma mthun te/ /nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad gyes par bshad/ /'di tshul cung zad bdag gis brjod par bya/ /de yang dbyig bshes kyis mdzad pa/ /sde pa tha dad bklag pa yi/ /'khor lo zhes bya'i gzhung chen byung / /phyi nas mkhas mchog dul ba'i lhas/ /62

de don bsdus pa'i bstan bcos brtsams/ /de las ji skad byung ba ni/ /shar dang nub dang gangs ri dang / /btags par smra ba'i sde pa dang / /'jig rten 'das par smra ba ste/ /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /gzhi kun pa dang 'od spung sde/ /sa ston pa dang chos srung sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs byed gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas pa ste/ /gnas brtan pa yi sde pa gsum/ /sa sgrog ri dang srung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu yi sde pa ste/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /yul don slob dpon bye brag gis/ /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad nyid/ /ces bshad mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i mchog /ka tyā na yi rjes bzhin du/ /dge slong phal mo che 'dus pas/ /phal chen pa yi sde par grags/ /rang bzhin skad kyis mdo sde 'don/ /snam phran nyi shu rtsa lnga nas/ /bdun gyi bar 'dod dung gis mtshan/ /ka ra la sogs ming mthar byed/ /'di la sde tshan lnga yod pa'i/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba yi/ /grub pa'i mtha' ni 'di skad brjod/ /thub pa 'jig rten las 'das te/ /rdzas yod sku dang tshe mtha' yas/ /mnyam gzhag skad cig gis kun mkhyen/ /zad mi skye blo rtag tu mnga'/ /chos 'khor bskor ba tshig yin no/ /byang sems rnams la nyon mongs dang / /nur nur sogs las skye ba med/ /bden pa rnams ni cig car mthong / /mig la sogs pa'i sems kyis kyang / /'dod chags bral bar 'gyur ba yin/ khams gong gnyis na'ang dbang shes yod/ /'on kyang dbang pos yul mi 'dzin/ /mnyam par bzhag tshe'ang tshig smra'o/ /sems ni gzugs can rang rig pa'o/ /dgra bcom rnams la'ang mi shes dang / /som nyi yod de bstan dgos so/ /'bras bu gzhan gyis brda sprad dgos/ /sdug bsngal smos tsam gyis lam skye/ /de bzhin du ni 'jig pa'ang yod/ /brgyad pa 63

la yang ring gnas dang / /chos mchog las kyang nyams pa yod/ rgyun zhugs dgra bcom nyams mi srid/ /rgyun zhugs ca/tshams med ma gtogs pa'i/ / mi dge bcu ka byed pa srid/ /'jig rten pa la yang dag pa'i/ /lta ba'i dbang po yod ma yin/ /ma srungs pa la bcos su med/ /drang ba'i don zhes bya ba med/ / gzugs med pa yi skye mched bzhi/ /'dus ma byas gsum lam rten 'brel/ /de ltar rnam pa dgu yod do/ /sangs rgyas mang po cig car 'byung / /sems gnyis lam dang nyon mongs dang / /sa myug cig car 'byung ba'ang yod/ /lus ni sems kyis khyab pa ste/ /sems ni 'od gsal ba yin no/ /phra rgyas mi ldan pa yin te/ /kun dkris mtshungs par ldan pa yin/ /zhig pa dang ni ma skyes dang / /bar de'i srid pa zhes bya med/ /rgyun du zhugs pas bsam gtan thob/ /drug pa shes dang shes bya min/ /de ltar gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i/ /grub mtha' mang phyir dang por bshad/ /'jig rten rnams dang mi mthun phyir/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba zer/ /gnyis pa btags par smra ba rnams/ /skyes bu byed pa'i rtsal dang ni/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba med/ /lam ni mi 'jig bsgom bya min/ /de ni bsod nams kyis thob smra/ /shar gyi ri dang nub kyi rir/ /gnas pa'i sde pa rnam gnyis ni/ /byang sems ngan 'gro las ma grol/ /mchod rten mchod pas 'bras bu ni/ /mtshog tu 'gyur ba ma yin zer/ /lnga pa gangs rir gnas pa rnams/ /phyi rol pa la mngon shes dang / /lha rnams lam sgom med ces smra/ /phyi ma bzhi po thun mong du/ /thub pa'i dbang po kun btags pa'i/ /sgo nas slob pa min zhes mthun/ /'dul 'dzin mchog gyur u pa li'i/ /rjes 'brang shes bya'i gzhi kun ni/ /rdzas kyi gzhi lngar yod do zhes/ /smra phyir thams cad yod smrar grags/ /mdo sde legs sbyar skad du 'don/ /snam phran dgu nas nyer lnga'i bar/ /rin chen 64

uphrol padma dang / /shing lo yis ni mtshan par byed/ /dpal lam bzang po'am srung ba'i ming / /'di la sde tshan rnam pa bdun/ /dang por gzhi yod smra ba rnams/ /'dus byas thams cad ming gzugs dang / /dus gsum gyis ni rnam par bsdus/ /'dus ma byas ni rnam gsum 'dod/ /mi ldan pa dang 'dus byas rnams/ /shes bya rnam par shes bya'ang yin/ /nyon mongs rnams ni mtshungs ldan te/ /thub pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /de yi gzugs dang dbang rnams ni/ /gzugs can la yod gzhan la min/ /mchod rten mchod pa 'bras bu che/ /byang sems ngan 'gro spangs pa ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su 'dod pa yod/ /bsod nams tshogs su 'gyur mi 'dod/ /gnyis pa 'od srung sde pa rnams/ /yongs su shes pa gang yin de/ /ma spangs pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyu las 'byung ba 'gar yang med/ /thob pa rnam par 'jog pa ni/ /chos kun rnam smin yod do zhes/ /gsungs pa'i gzhung la bsten to zer/ /gsum pa sa ston sde pa rnams/ /ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa med/ /bden pa cig car kho na mthong / /phyi rol nyon mongs zad pa med/ /lha yul pa la lam med cing / /bar ma do yi srid pa med/ /dgra bcom bsod nams skye ba med/ /phra rgyas sems las tha dad do/ /'dus ma byas dngos dgu yin te/ /mi g.yo ba dang ldan pa gsum/ /dge sogs gsum dang gnyis pa dang / /lam dang rten cing 'brel 'byung ste/ /'di rnams rtag tu gnas pa yin/ /dge 'dun nang du ston pa 'dug/ /de phyir dge 'dun mchod pa mchog /sangs rgyas dang ni nyan thos rnams/ /lam gcig rnam grol gcig par smra/ /bzhi pa chos srung sde rnams ni//rgyal ba dge 'dun nang mi 'du/ /de phyir rgyal ba mchod pa mchog /rgyal dang nyan thos lam tha dad/ /phyi rol pa la mngon shes med/ /dgra bcom lus ni zag med zer/ /lnga pa mang thos sde pa rnams/ /mi rtag bdag med stong pa 65

dang / /lam dang mya ngan 'das pa rnams/ /thub pa'i 'jig rten 'das chos yin/ /lhag ma rnams ni 'jig rten pa'o/ /dgra bcom la yang som nyi yod/ /ces sogs rgya cher smra bar byed/ /drug pa gos dmar slob ma rnams/ kho na 'pho bar smra ba ste/ /sems can rnams ni 'pho ba 'o/ /phung po bzhi ni rang bzhin gcig /lam gyis phung rngogabakag go zer/ /bdun pa rnam par phye nas ni/ /smra ba'i sde rnams 'di skad du/ /gang zag don dam nyid du yod/ /'bras bur ma smin pa las gzhan/ /'das pa zhes bya yod ma yin/ /'bras bu las gzhan ma 'ongs med/ /rigs mi mthun pa'i chos rnams ni/ /de ma thag pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur/ /gzugs ni 'dra ba'i rgyu ma yin/ /gzugs kyi 'dra ba'i rgyu yang med/ /de skad smra zhing lta bar byed/ /ston pa gnyis pa stobs bcu ldan/ /'od srung chen po'i rjes zhugs te/ /gnas brtan rgan rabs dag 'dus pas/ /gnas brtan pa yi sde par grags/ /mdo sde sha za'i skad du 'don/ /snam phran lnga nas nyer gcig par/ /rtags ni me tog so tsi ka /skyong ba la sogs ming gi mtha'/ /'di la sde tshan rnam pa gsum/ /rgyal byed tshul dang 'jigs byed ri/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas pa ste/ /gnas kyi dbang gis tha dad kyis/ /gsum ga lta ba'i rnam pa mthun/ /thub pa legs sbyar tshig mi gsung / /byang sems bskal pa grangs med pa/ /bcu nas sum bcu'i bar gyis 'grub/ /thar pa 'ba' zhig 'dus ma byas/ /yin gyis 'dus ma byas gzhan med/ /mi shes pa dang log shes med/ /phra rgyas sems las tha dad do/ /'gog stoms na yang sems yod ces/ /mthun par grub pa'i mtha' smra 'o/ /bslab la gus mchog ston pa'i sras/ /dgra gcan zin gyi rjes zhugs te/ /rgyal rigs bram ze'i rigs la sogs/ /rigs mthon 'dus phyir mang po yis/ /bkur ba'i sde pa zhes grags pa/ /mdo sde zur chag skad du 'don/ /66

snam phran gnas brtan pa dang mtshungs/ /rtags ni dpal gyi be 'u ste/ /sbas nga/ la sogs ming gi mtha'/ /'di la sde tshan rnam pa gsum/ /ku ru kulle'i phug gnas phyir/ /sa sgrogs rigs kyi sde zhes grags/ slob dpon srung ba pa dang ni/ /gnas ma bu yi rjes 'brang phyir/ /so so'i sde pa'i ming du grags/ /gsum ga grub pa'i mtha' mthun te/ /gang zag phung po ma yin la/ /phung po las gzhan kyang ma yin/ /phung po rnams ni brtan par 'dug /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa yis/ /'dod chags skye bar mi 'gyur la/ /bral bar yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /mthong lam sems kyi skad cig ma/ /bcu gnyis tshun no de phan chad/ /'bras bu dang ni bcas par gnas/ /shes bya brjod du yod pa dang / /med pa gnyis su gnas so zer/ kha cig don dang la la gnas/ /gzhan dag slob dpon tha dad phyir/ /sde tshan rnam pa bco brgyad gyur/ /'di ni sde pa tha dad pa/ /bstan pa bsdus pa ji bzhin bshad/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /dge tshul lo drir gyes pa'i tshul/ /rnam pa gzhan du yang bshad de/ /'od srung sa ston chos srud dang / /gzhi kun pa ste yod smra bzhi/ /shar nub dbus gnas rnam paṃr phye/ /btags dang 'jig rten 'das smra ste/ /phal chen sde pa rnam pa drug /sa sgrogs gos dmar srung ba la/ /mang thos gnas ma bu pa ste/ /mang pos bkur ba rnam pa lnga/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs byed ri/ /gtsug lag khang ste gnas brtan pa'i/ /sde tshan gsum ste bco brgyad bshad/ /gyes tshul rnam pa gzhan du yang / /bshad pa yod de 'dir ma brjod/ kha cig yod smra sde pa gzhan/ /'byung ba'i gzhi yin ston pa'i sras/ /dgra gcan zin gyi rjes su 'jug /'od srung rjes 'jug phal chen pa/ /mang bkur nye ba 'khor rjes 'brang / /'phags pa'i rigs smra gnas brtan pa/ /ka tu ya na'i rjes 'brang zer/ /bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyur tshe/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og 67

rdu yang / /gdul bya'i don phyir bstan pa ni/ /rnam pa bco brgyad gyes gyur ces/ /smon lam chen po lnga brgya yi/ /rnam pa gcig ni 'di yin phyir/ /ston pa'i 'phrin las nges pa yin/ /'di tshul bdag gis mdor bsdus nas/ /brjod dges thub bstan dar rgyas shog /de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad gyes pa'i tshe/ /'di ni bstan pa yin gyi gzhan min zhes/ /so skye'i mkhas pa rnams ni rtsod par gyur/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das nas lo yi grangs/ /sum brgya 'das tshe kha che'i yul khams su/ /rgyal po ka ni ska yis sbyin bdag byas/ /dgra bcom byang sems lnga brgya phrag re dang / /so skye'i paṇa chen khri dang drug stong 'dus/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yi bsdu ba gsum pa byas/ /kṛ gi'i rmi lam lung bstan mdo drangs nas/ /gyes pa bco brgyad kun kyang bstan par bsdus/ /de yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi/ /bu mo ma ga dngha yi bzang mo yis/ /grong khyer chen po bu ram shing 'phel du/ /ston pa spyan drangs mu stegs pham byas tshe/ /da ltar ma zad sngon yang bu mo 'dis/ /mu stegs thabs kyis btul ba nyon zhig gsungs/ /skye rgu'i tshe lo nyi khri'i dus kyi tshe/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung zhes pa byung / /de yi sbyin bdag rgyal po kṛ ki la/ /rmi lam ngo mtshar rnam pa bcu rmis pa/ /bram ze mtshan mkhan rnams la dris pa dang / /de dag rnams kyis de don ma shes kyang / /rgyal po'i bu mo gser phreng can zhes pa/ /rnam dpyod ldan zhing sangs rgyas bstan la gus/ /de la mu stegs can rnams spa gong bas/ /'di lan glan pa'i dus ni 'di yin snyam/ /rgyal po'i g.yar lam de dag shin tu ngan/ /rgyal po nyid kyi thugs ltar gces pa cig /srog gi blud du btang na zlog go zer/ /snying ltar gces pa gser phreng can yin mod/ /'di ni blud du gtong bar mi phod zer/ /'di nyid srog gi blud mar ma btang na/ /'grongs sam rgyal srid 'jig par nges so zhes/ /smras pa 68

bdag nyid gces phyir khas len byas/ /bu mos shes te yab la 'di skad smras//yab la phan na bdag srog 'dor spro yang / /'di dag rnams la shes pa 'ga' yang med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du zhus shig zer/ /rgyal pos thub pa'i gtso la zhus pa'i tshe/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas rmi lam de dag ni/ khyod la ngan par 'gyur pa ma yin te/ /ma 'ongs skye rgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe/ /shākya thub pa zhes bya'i sangs rgyas 'byung / /de yi bstan pa tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar 'byung ba'i mtshan ma yin gyis nyon/ /sdom ni glang gnyis spre'u gnyis tsandan phye/ /ldum ra khron pa thab mo ras/ /glang po che zhig skar khung nas byung ste/ /lus thon mjug ma thogs par mthong ba ni/ /de tshe rab byung rnams ni khyim spangs kyang / /gtsug lag khang la khyim gyi 'du shes kyis/ /'dor bar mi nus chags par 'gyur ba'i ltas/ /glang chen phal pas spos kyi glang po che/ /gnas nas skrod pa mthong ba de yang ni/ khrims 'chal rnams kyis bslab gsum dag pa mchog /gnas nas 'byin par 'gyur ba'i snga ltas yin/ /spre 'us spre 'u'i tshogs la dbang bskur ba/ /rmi lam nang du mthong ba de yang ni/ /mkhan slob la sogs bla ma'i gnas rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid mi ldan bzhin du bla ma'i gnas/ /byed cing slob ma sdud par 'gyur ba'i ltas/ /mi gtsang ba yis gos pa'i spre 'u zhig /spre 'u kun la mi gtsang skud byed pa/ /de ni tshul 'chal rnams kyis tshul ldan la/ /nyes pa gleng zhing bsgo bar 'gyur ba'i ltas/ /tsan dan gotrīṣa yi sdong po dang / /phal pa'i shing sdum mgo stom byed pa ni/ /sgra tshad rtsis sogs mu stegs gzhung rnams dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' rnams mgo stom byed pa'i ltas/ /phye bre gang dang mu tig bre gang zhig /brje bar mthong ba de ni ma 'ongs tshe/ /zang zing ngan ngon phye dang 'dra ba'i ched/ /mu tig lta bu'i dam chos 'tshong ba'i ltas/ /dge 'dun rnams kyi ldum ra phun tshogs 69

rnams/ khyim pa mang pos spyod pa mthong ba nge/ /ma 'ongs de tshe dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo/ /phal cher gnyen dang yul phyogs la sogs pas/ /bsdus pa'i khyim pas spyod par 'gyur ba'i ltas/ /rab tu skom pa'i mi zhig chu 'tshol phyir//mya ngam thang la rab tu rgyug byed cing / /yan lag brgyad ldan chus gang khron pa cig /mi de'i rjes su 'breng la mi des kyang / /mthong bzhin mi 'thung 'on kyang chu 'tshol bar/ khyod kyis rmi lam nang du mthong ba de/ /ma 'ongs de tshe chos 'dod chos 'tshol zhing / /dam chos bstan na don du mi gnyer la/ /'on kyang 'tshol bar byed rnams 'byung ba'i ltas/ /gzhan yang rgyal po khyod kyi rmi lam na/ /mi rnams sde tshan sde tshan bcad nas ni/ /rtsod cing 'gyed la 'khrug par mthong ba de/ /de tshe lta dang grub mtha' sna tshogs pa/ /so sor sde sder bcad nas rtsod pa'i ltas/ /rgyal po khyod kyi rmi lam nang7 rol na/ /mi ni bco brgyad kyis ni ras yug gcig /bgos pas mi res ras yug re re thob/ /'on kyang rtsa ba'i ras yug ma nyams par/ /mthong ba de ni shākya thub pa de'i/ /bstan pa rnam pa bco brgyad du gyes 'gyur/ /re res bstan pa yongs rdzogs re re 'thob/ /rnam par grol ba'i ras kyang nyams pa med/ /de ltar khyod kyi rmi lam rnam pa bcu/ /ma 'ongs de tshe 'byung ba'i ltas yin gyi/ khyod la gnod par 'gyur ba med ces gsungs/ /de ltar gser phreng can gyi rtogs brjod mdo/ /drangs te gyes pa bco brgyad bka' ru bsdus/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i bka' bsdu gsum pa yin/ /mkhas pa chen po sa skya paṇḍi tas/ /lha chen zhes bya mtshams med gsum byas pas/ /rang zhugs rtags blangs dgra bcom du grags te/ /'khor mang bsdus pas bstan pa dkrugag byas te/ /sangs rgyas 'das 'og so skyes 'khor bsdus pa/ /'di las mang ba med ces bshad snang ba/ /'di yi khungs ni gang yin dpyad par 'os//70

('di la gnas brtan pa kho na sde pa'i rtsa bar 'dod pa dang thams cad yod smra rtsa bar 'dod pa sogs bshad lugs mang du yod kyang gsang sngags su dgyes rdor dang sasbya ṭar rtsa 'khor lo bzhi la sde pa bzhi'i ming du gsungs pa dang dus 'khor du zhal bzhi las sde pa bzhi spros pa sogs yod pas rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi kho nar 'thad pa yin no )rjes 'brang 'ga' yis rtog ge 'bar ba las/ /bshad pa'i bzang po dang ni gcig pa ste/ /de yis bzang po yin par khas blangs so/ /zhes sogs thob pa'i phyir zhes bris mod kyang / /bdud kyis sprul pa bzang po'i ming can des/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas so skye rnams/ /yid bsgyur mgu tshe lam gzhan ston par bshad/ /lha chen de la rdzu 'phrul mi ldan phyir/ /da nang rdzu 'phrul nyams zhes rdzun rib kyis/ /'khor rnams bslus par rab dbye nyid las byung //sprul pa la ni sems med par gsungs phyir/ /sprul pa yin na so skyer yang mi rigs/ /des na rdzu 'phrul med pa'i lha chen de/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i bzang po ma yin no/ /de ltar bka' bsdu rim pa gsum po ni/ /thun mong theg pa'i bka' yi bsdu ba ste/ /'di la bka' bsdu gsum pa phan ma grags/ /theg chen kho na'i bka' yi bsdu ba ni/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs ri/ /bi ma la sā bhā wa zhes bya bar/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'bum phrag bcu 'dus te/ /'jam dpal byams pa phyag rdor rnam gsum gyis/ /mdo sde 'dul ba ma mo bsdus par grags/ /'di tshe sde snod re re lta ci smos/ /chos kyi rnam grangs re re'ang tshad med de/ /chos kyi rnam grangs kun nas mig gcig bu'i/ /tshad kyang gzung mi nus par gsungs phyir ro/ /'di la bsdu ba gnyis pa sogs ma grags/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho rnams/ /zhu ba po dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bsdus te o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing la sogs/ /nub pa med pa'i zhing na rtag par gnas/ /drang ba'i don gyis gdul bya'i snang ba bzhin/ /71

bka' yi sdud po'ang du mar snang ba ste/ /cung zad nges pa'i don du bka' ma lus/ /sdud po gsang bdag phyag rdor kho na ste/ /mdo las smon lam mthu yis yin par bshad/ /dus kyi 'khor lor rgyal ba kun gyi snyan/ /gcig bsdus sems dpa' phyag rdor yin par gsungs/ /shin tu nges pa'i don du ston po dang / /sdud po bstan bya'i chos rnams thams cad kyang / /ye shes gcig las rnam dbyer med pa ste/ /thams cad lhan cig skyes dngos gcig tu bstan/ /de ltar bsdu bya'i bstan pa rin chen ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis 'od srung chen por gtad/ /kun dga' sha na'i gos can nyer sbas dang / bhi dhi ka dang de nas bhi snyi ka /bu ha narti butta me ta dang / /rtsibs dang su na sha ta rta skad dang / /shi ba la dang klu sgrub 'phags pa lha/ /rā hu la dang saṅgha narti dang / /dgra bcom ga ya sha dang ku ma ra/ /sha ya ta dang ba su baju dang / /ma ne ta dang ha ka li ka ne/ /seng ge'i bar du rim gyis gtad do zhes/ /laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdo yi 'grel par byung / /thun mong theg pa'i bstan pa'i gtad rabs yin/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i bstan pa ni/ /'jam dpal gyis ni 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang / /byams pas thogs med rjes su bzung mdzad de/ /zab mo lta dang rgya chen spyod pa'i rgyud/ /dpal ldan a ti sha yi bar nyid du/ /'phags pa'i 'byung gnas rgya gar de nyid du/ /bstan pa'i gtad rabs rgyun ma chad pa ste/ /jo bo'i rnam thar lam yig chen mo las/ /dpal ldan na ro pa yis jo bo la/ /bstan pa gtad nas lho phyogs byon zhes bshad/ /na ro zhabs kyis mnga' bdag mar pa la/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /lung bstan rgyal tshab bskos zhes gsal bar byung / /de phyir dpal ldan na ro'i zhabs de yis/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rnam pa gnyis phye ste/ /thun mong theg pa'i bstan pa rgya mtsho ni/ /jo bo a ti sha yi phyag tu gtad/ /72

yang snying rdo rje theg pa'i sgrub pa'i bstan/ /mar pa chos kyi blo gros la gtad nas/ /gnyi gas byang phyogs 'dul bar lung bstan mdzad/ /rgyal bas shes phyin mdo las zab mo'i don/ /byang gi phyogs su rgyas par lung yang bstan/ /bka' phyag gnyis ku'i brgyud pa'i chu bo ni/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las lung bstan pa'i/ /dpal ldan sgam po pa la gcig tu 'dres/ /de las byung ba'i bstan pa rin chen ni/ /dngos dang yan lag du mar bcas pa yis/ /deng sang du yang cung zad tsam zhig gnas/ /bka'i bsdu ba khyad par du bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// // le'u gsum pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten byung tshul/bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya'i tog /'di yi sku gsum rten mchog byung tshul ni/ /sgra sgrogs rgyal po u tra ya na dang / /gzugs can snying po phan tshun ma mthong ba'i/ /mdza' bor byas te skyes kyis 'grul ba'i tshe/ /rin thang med pa'i nor bu'i khrab bskur bas/ /gzugs can snying pos skyes lan ma rnyed nas/ /ston par gsol bas ras la rgyal ba'i sku/ /mdor bsdus bkar bcas bris la skur zhig gsungs/ /ston pa'i gzi byin nyi 'od ltar 'bar bas /bzo bo rnams kyis 'bri bar ma nus nas/ /khrus rdzing steng bzhugs chu nang shar ba yi/ /sku gzugs ji bzhin ras la ri mor bris/ /steng dang 'og tu rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog /gsum la skyabs 'gro bslab pa'i gzhi lnga dang / /phan yon bcas bris gser dngul zangs ma yi/ /dong bur bcug ste glang chen steng bzhag nas/ /'di ni 'jig rten gsum las 'das pa'i skyes/ /shed mthan dgyes pa khyod la bdag gis bskar/ khyod kyis dpung tshogs yan lag mi / ri shu 73

rnam bzhis gsus/ /go skabs yangs par spos chu me tog gtor/ /gdugs bcas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs gsol nas/ /dad cing gus pas 'dud de zhal phye zhes/ /phrin yig bsrings te rgyal pos zhal phye tshe/ /tshong pa kun gyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /thos pas rgyal po spu langs mchi ma g.yos/ /bka' yi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bklags pas/ /skyabs su song ste dge bsnyen nyid du gyur/ /bden pa mthong ste chos mig thob par gyur/ /thub pa'i bris sku chu lon ma zhes grags/ yang ni ser skyar dam chos gsung ba'i tshe/ /shākya ming chen gyi ni mchis brang gis/ /bran mo mu tig do shal len par bskul/ /kye ma bran mo'i dngos po sdug bsngal te/ /dam chos 'di 'dra nyan pa'i skal med snyam/ /dad cing gdung shugs bcas pas la gor song / /ston pas de yi dad pa dgongs nas ni/ /dam chos tshigs bcad gcig cig bris te bskur/ /dga' mgu dang ba'i sems kyis song ba de/ /lam du ba drus shig gis brdungs te shi/ /de ma thag tu siṅgha la yi yul/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo mchog gi mngal du zhugs/ /btsas tshe mkha' las mu tig char pa bab/ /ming yang mu tig can zhes bya bar gyur/ /cher skyes tshe na yul dbus tshong pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la kha ton byas pa thos/ /bzang po'i glu de da dung long zhig skad/ /'di ni glu min sangs rgyas bka' yin smras/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya thos pa tsam gyis ni/ /ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa yis/ /slar dris tshong pas yon tan ci nus brjod/ /bdag ni srid pa'i gnas las drang gsol zhes/ /rang gis lag bdar 'phrin yig bris te bskur/ /ston pas bzhes nas ras kyi ngos la ni/ /'od zer btang bzhin rig byed pa yis bris/ /bka' yi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas bskur/ /mthong ba'i med la bu mos bden pa rtogs/ /gling de'i mi kun rgyal ba'i bstan la btsud/ /drin lan dkon mchog gsum la mu 74

tig mchog /ma ga dha yi bre chen re re phul/ /thub pa 'od zer ma zhes grags pa yin/ /'di dag bstan 'di'i bris sku'i thog ma yin/ khyim bdag/dad ldan rnams kyis gdugs tshod la/ /dge 'dun spyan drangs ston pa ma gshegs tshe/ /gral gyi thog ma mi brjid gyur mthong nas/ khyim bdag chen po mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ /ston pas gnang na bdag gis rin chen las/ /ston pa'i sku bgyis gral gyi thog ma la/ /bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol btab gnang ba thob/ /rang nyid gter kun mthong ba'i mig ldan yang / /snying rjes gzhan don kho nar zhugs pa des/ /glang chen la bzhon gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /dung dkar la sogs rol mor ldan pa yis/ /dbul po'i srang sogs grong khyer kun zhugs te/ /sku gzugs phyir du kun las slong mo bslangs/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mang du byas par gsungs/ /de rnams sku gzugs 'bur dod thog ma yin/ /de dag 'dul ba'i lung las yang dag bshad/ /gsung rten thog ma 'khor lo bar pa'i tshe/ /brgya byin gyis ni gser gyi glegs bu la/ /bee dūrya sngon bzhus pas shes phyin bris/ /lha yi gnas su mchod cing bkur bar gsungs/ /gzhan yang rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sogs/ /glegs bam byas te rgyal mtshan rtser btags pas/ /lha ma yin gyi g.yul las rgyal ba sogs/ /gzungs sngags chen po du ma dag las byung / /khyim bdag mgo reg shi ba'i bdog pa kun/ /dge 'dun rnams la phul nas bzhes pa'i tshe/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yi glegs bam 'tshong mi gnang / /mu stegal can gzhung 'tshong du gnang ngo zhes/ /gsungs phyir bka' yi glegs bam yod par grub/ /bka' bsdu'i tshe na sdud pa po rnams kyis/ /rang rang yul du so so'i skad rnams kyis//bris zhes dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel par bshad/ /u pa zhes bya ma skyes dgra yi bus/ /nga yi bka' kun glegs bam 'bri 'gyur zhes/ /ston pa nyid kyis sngon 75

du lung yang bstan/ /ser skya'i grong du sku bltams mchod rten dang / /ma ga dha ru byang chub chen po nyid/ /wa ra ṇa sir chos 'khor mchod rten te/ /mnyan du yod par cho 'phrul mchod rten dang / /ka shi'i grong du lha las babs pa nyid/ /rgyal po'i khab tu dge 'dun dbyen bsdums dang / /dze ta'i tshal du sku tshe brtan pa nyid/ /rtswa can grong du myang 'das mchod rten te/ /mdzad pa so so'i skabs su rim par byung / /'di dag mdo las zhar byung tsam du gsal/ /da ni bod yul sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyi/ /bka' chems ka bkol ma las byung rnams 'chad/ /ston pa mya ngan 'da' bar nye ba'i tshe/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad gsol/ /da lta khyod zhal lta zhing dam chos nyan/ /mu stegs 'dul zhing bsod nams zhing mdzad na/ /mya ngan 'das nas de rnams sus bgyid 'gyur/ /ston pas bka' bstsal nyan thos mchog rnams kyis/ /bka' rnams sdud byed the tshom de yis gcod/ /bsod nams nga yi dge 'dun rnams la sogs/ /drug sde rgyal ba'i sprul yin ngang gis dul/ /bstan pa gnas shing mu stegs 'dul ba'i phyir/ /nga yi sku tshab bzheng bar gyis shig gsungs/ /zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer gsum spros te/ /tshangs dang brgya byin rā hu la la phog /so sor spobs pa skyes nas phyag btsal te/ /so sos sku gsum rten mchog bzheng bar zhus/ /bee shā thams gzo bor khas blangs shing / /byams pas dkon gnyer phyag rdor sku srung dang / /gtsang ris bdun bcus srung mar khas len byas/ /tshangs pas lha yi rin chen sna tshogs spungs/ /bzhu btul blug pas mchod rten zlum po ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'dom gang kha dog du ba 'dra/ /phyi nas rgyal ba'i ring bsrel gyis bkang ste/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul du spyan drangs bzhugs/ /lan bdun bskor bas mchog dngos 'grub bo skad/ /chos sku'i rten 'dis lha dang mkha' 'gro 'dul/ /rā hu la yis klu yi rin chen tshoṭa/ /76

spungs pa bzhu btul blug pas longs sku'i rten/ /rnam snang gangs chen mtsho rgyal zhes bya ba/ /dpag tshad brgyad bcu mchu zheng gab pa'i sku/ /sku mdog mthing ka phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag can/ /dbu gtsug zla ba'i chu shel gyis spras grub/ /bzhugs gnas phyi yi rgya mtsho'i nang du bzhugs/ /lte ba man chad chu yi nang du nub/ /de yis chu nang gnas pa'i 'gro don mdzad/ /lte ba yan gyis lha dang dri za sogs/ /skam dang bar snang gnas pa'i 'gro don mdzad/ /bya rnams dbu yi steng dang dpung khar sdod/ /bya thal bdal nas gangs ri lta bur bzhugs/ /bco lnga'i mtshan mo chu shel zla 'od kyis/ /reg pa'i chu rgyun mtshan ma med pa yis/ /sku khrus gsol te bee ṭurya mdog 'gyur/ khrus chab de 'thungs phan yon mtha' yas 'thob/ /nor bu len pa'i gzings chen bskyod pa na/ /rgyab mdun re la dro skad re re dgos/ /gru mo'i nang la gzings bcug mchod pa phul/ /de yis ci 'dod nor bu lon par 'gyur/ /gsol ba btab na sā li'i 'bras kyi char/ /nyin mtshan bar med bcu gnyis 'bebs so skad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi rten mchog yin/ /de nas brgya byin lha yi dbang po yis/ /intu nī la ma ra ta ka dang / /mthon ka mthon ka che dang bkod mdzes te/ /sum bcu rtsa gsum lha yi rin chen lnga/ /gser dngul mu tig mu men byu ru ste/ /'dzam gling mi yi rin chen rnam pa lnga/ /bar ma'i mching bu lnga brgya rtsa gcig sogs/ /spungs pa bzhu btul blug nas sku yi tshad/ /bzheng bar rtsom tshe ston pa'i sku tshad la/ /lha dang mi rnams mthun par ma gyur nas/ pi shā kurmas zhabs kyi the'u chung la/ /thig skud btags nas 'jal bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ /ji tsam bsrings kyang tshad lon ma gyur nas/ /'od mdangs dga' ba zhes bya'i 'jig rten na/ /sangs rgyas dga' dpal bzhugs pa'i drung du slebs/ /da dung dbu yi gtsug dang ma mnyam tshe/ /'di 77

nas mi 'byed zhing du tsam mchi zhes/ /gsol bas rgyal ba de yis 'di skad du/ /lha yi rdzu 'phrul lta zhog nyan rang dang / /byang sems kun gyi rdzu 'phrul gcig bsdoms kyang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku yi tshad mi rtogs/ /'di nas mi 'byed bar du 'jig rten khams/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed du ma yod pa ste/ /ston pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu yis ni/ khyod nyid skad cig tsam gyis 'dir phyin mod/ /gzhan du khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul mthus phyin pas/ /shin tu dma' ba ma gir tshe 'dzad 'gyur/ /de bas sku yi tshad la rtog pa zhog /rang gi ston pa yid la gyis shig gsungs/ /skad cig de la ston pa'i drung du slebs/ /ngo mtshar chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sku la tshad 'dzin brtsams pa bshags so zhes/ /ya mtshan gtam gyis 'khor rnams mgu bar byas/ /ston pas zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i snang ba ltar/ /dgung lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis nyer lnga pa'i/ /tshad kyi sku gzugs rnam gsum gyis shig gsungs/ /sngon gyi ma ma gnyis shig 'khor du 'khod/ /de la spyan gyis gzigs pas spobs byung ste/ /pang du 'tsho ba'i ma mas 'di skad du/ /rgyal bu lo brgyad lon tshe lumbi ni'i/ /tshal gyi gri dang mtho dman mnyam mo zer/ /rgyan 'dogs ma mas rgyal bu bcu gnyis tshe/ /nga yis rtse ba'i don du ded pa na/ /ser skya'i sgo mo che yi sgo skyes dang / /mtho dma' med par gcig tu mnyam mo zer/ /nyer lnga pa ni mi rnams thun mong du/ /snang ba'i sku tshad dngos dang mtshungs par byas/ /gsum ga'ang rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang bstun/ /sa gnon mnyam bzhag spyan gyis 'khor la gzigs/ /phyag zhabs 'khor lo gtsug tor rin chen spras/ kha dog sna tshogs 'ja' 'od lta bur 'dug /snyan khung khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pas brgyan/ khri stan seng ge brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bteg /rgyab yol mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur du byas/ /'od skor bde gshegs sum bcu rtsa lnga bkod/ /zin 78

nas ston pa'i drung du phul ba'i tshe/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho tshogs pa'i dbus/ /ston pa'i zhal nas 'od zer sna tshogs bkye/ /'jig rten kun bkang sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /snang bar byas shing bskul nas thugs dgongs bkang / /slar log sku gsum 'od kyis khyab par mdzad/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs rab tu gnas gyur te/ /'od de ston pa'i zhal gyi sgo ru nub/ /ston pas ched du brjod de bka' bstsal pa/ /sku gsum rten 'di gang du bzhugs pa der/ /dgra bcom dang ni sa thob sems dpa'i tshogs/ /nyi zer rdul tsam rtag tu bzhugs nas ni/ /mchod cing bkur sti rim gro phu dud byed/ /'di rnams gang na bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs der/ /theg pa chen po'i bstan pa 'byung ba ste/ /nga yi bstan pa tha mar bab pa'i tshe/ /byang phyogs gangs can srin po gdong dmar yul/ /spyan ras gzigs dang sku gzugs gnyis kyis 'dul/ /de skad bka' bstsal nyer lngari sku tshad ni/ /brgya byin nyid kyis lha yul spyan drangs mchod/ /brgyad pa dang ni bcu gnyis pa yi sku/ /lha yi yul dang nub phyogs o rgyan du/ /lnga brgya phrag re bzhugs nas 'gro don mdzad/ /de nas sa 'og bdag pos spyan drangs te/ /gdengs can klu rgyal rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ /de tshe ma ga dha yi rgyal po ni/ /he manta zhes bya ba'i mchod gnas su/ /phyag rdor sprul pa shu lasgri ti dang / /byams pa grub pa dkar rgyal bya ba yod/ /gnyis pos phyag rdor dang ni byams par sprul/ /byams pas klu rnams bdud rtsi'i char gyis brid/ /phyag na rdo rjes klu rnams gzir zhing bsdigs/ /byams pas bskyabs te ston pa'i khrus rdzing nas/ /sku gnyis spyan drangs ma 'ongs 'dzam gling gi /bstan pa nub tshe sku gnyis gtsor byas pa'i/ /sku gsung thuṭa kyi rten kun klu yul du/ /spyan 'dren bgyid pa'i gtsigs chad bzung bar gyur/ /lo grangs lnga brgyar rdo rje'i gdan du bzhugs/ /de nas lo grangs lnga brgya lhag 79

'das pa/ /rgya gar rgyal po de wa pa la'i dus/ /dgung lo bcu gnyis pa yi sku tshad kyi/ /rgyab yol bzhag pa'i khrir bcas rgya nag gi /rgyal po'i bsod nams sog pa'i rten du bskur/ /brgyad pa'i sku tshad bal po'i rgyal po yis/ /rin thang med pa'i skyes bskur gsol btab pas/ /bal po'i rgyal po'i mchod pa'i zhing du byin/ /yul gru de gnyis rab tu btul mdzad nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /sku gnyis bod kyi yul du byon pa yin/ /bka' chems gzhan las brgyad pa'i sku tshad ni/ /sngon tshe mi rnams tshe lo nyi khri'i dus/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung byon tshe sbyin bdag mchog /rgyal po kṛ kis dad pa'i rten du bzhengs/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung nyid kyis byin brlabs nas/ /da ltar nga yi sku tshab bzhengs pa 'di/ /ma 'ongs tshe lo brgya pa'i dus tshod du/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'byung ba de'i/ /dgung lo brgyad pa yi ni tshad 'gyur zhes/ /lung bstan mdzad pa de nyid yin zhes snang / /deng sang jo bo mi bskyod rdo rjer grags/ /bcu gnyis pa yi sku tshad 'di nyid kyang / /byams pas bzhengs par 'chad pa'i lugs kyang snang / /ser skyar shākya'i rgyal po gzhu brtan tshe/ /rgya nag ci 'u rgyal po zhes pa byung / /de nas gdung rabs bzhi 'das lnga pa ni/ /ci 'u dbang rgyal rgyal srid byed pa'i tshe/ /nub kyi phyogs nas sgra dang 'od zer sogs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bltams pa'i ltas rnams mthong / /rtsis pas rtsis byas nub phyogs rgya gar du/ /gang zag zla med gcig ni skyes par 'dug /lo stong 'das nas de yi chos lugs ni/ /rgya nag yul du 'ong zhes lung bstan skad/ /de ltar ci 'u'i rgyal po so drug soṭa/ /rigs rus tha dad lnga las rgya nag gi /rgyal po drug bcu rtsa gnyis 'das pa'i 'og /pri ti dza ya si chon rgyal po'i dus/ /jo bo shākya rgya nag yul du phebs//de nas rgyal rabs bzhi yi 'og rol du/ /rgya nag yul du thang gi rgyal 80

po dang / /bod rgyal gnam ri srong btsan dus mnyam ste/ /de sras chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yin/ /de ltar sku gsum rten mchog grub byin brlabs/ /mdzad pa rdzogs nas thub dbang mya ngan 'das/ /de nas lo grangs brgyad bcur nye ba'i tshe/ /sngon tshe bu mo'i dus na ston pa'i zhal/ /mthong zhing chos nyan bsod stoms phul ba zhig /bram ze chen po zhig gi mchis brang gyur/ /de las mtshan dang ldan pa'i bu gsum btsas/ /che ba gnyis ni phyi rol pa la mos/ /tha chung nang pa'i chos la rab tu dad/ /chos lugs gang bzang mi 'cham rtag tu rtsod/ /ma yis khyed gsum zas gos phongs pa med/ /ci phyir rtsod ces dris pas phyi nang gi /chos lugs gang bzang ma 'cham gang bden zer/ /ma yis byang phyogs ti se'i gangs ri la/ /lha chen dbang phyug yod kyis der dris zer/ /lham la rkang mgyogs rdzas byugs btang ba las/ /skad gcig gis slebs ma dros mtsho 'gram na/ khyu mchog bzas la yan cing bu mo'i tshogs/ /rin chen sgod du me tog 'thu ba mthong / khyod su me tog ci phyir 'thu dris pas/ /nged cag lha mo u ma'i bran mo yin/ /me tog dgra bcom mchod phyir 'thu 'o skad/ khye 'u gsum gyis 'grogs te pho brang phyin/ /bco lnga'i tshes nyin gdugs tshod la bab tshe/ /ma dros mtsho nas dgra bcom dge 'dun rnams/ /byon te pho brang nang du stan la bzhugs/ /lha chen 'khor bcas kyis mchod mchod ston gsol/ /me tog gis gtor zhabs la phyag byas nas/ /chos nyan smon lam mang po btab par gyur/ /de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mkha' la gshegs/ /chos lugs nang pa bzang bar gsum gal go /'on kyang the tshom bcad phyir dris pa na/ /dbang phyug na re nang pa bzang ba yin/ /phyi rol pa la thar pa'i lam ma mchis/ /phyi pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug nga yin mod/ /gnas skabs dngos grub 'dod na nga myur yang / /nga yang 81

thar pa 'dod phyir nang pa la/ /brten nas dgra bcom mchod pa yin no zer/ /the tshom sel te ma yi drung du log /gsum ga nang pa'i bstan la 'jug par zhus/ /legs kyis lha khang re re rtsigs shig zer/ /rtsig pa'i gnas dang rgyu rnams so sor bstan/ /chos 'khor bskor gnas wa ra ṇa si ru/ /che ba ma hā ma sas lha khang brtsigs/ /rin chen rigs kyi rdo las sku gzugs byas/ /bstod pa'i dam pa khyad par 'phags pa brtsams/ /slob dpon mtho btsun grub rje zhes su grags/ /'bring pos rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal/ /ka larta kha'i gnas su lha khang brtsigs/ /gnal chen brgyad kyi sa las sku gzugs byas/ /tha chung bde phyed bdag pos rdo rje gdan/ /byang chub shing drung phyi dbyibs mchod rten la/ /nang dbyibs lha khang gasto la ru byas/ /gaṅgā'i 'gram gyi ston pa'i khrus rdzing 'gram/ /tsan dan gonī ṣā yi sdong po ni/ /'gyel ba sa 'og nas blangs rigs btsun zhing / /'dod pas ma gos bu mo bzhi yis bdar/ /rin chen phye ma dang bsres phung por grub/ /de tshe ded dpon rgan po zhig gi bu/ /rgya mtshor 'jug la pha yis bu khyod kyis/ /mi gzhan mi nyo'i zong zhig nyos shog skad/ /rgya mtshor gru yi nang du mi sngon po/ /sngon med cig byung5 kun gyis gsod pa'i tshe/ /ded dpon gyis ni nor gyis blus te btang / /mi de rgya mtsho'i nang du cab kyis song / /gru thon tshe na nga ni klu zhig yin/ /bdag srog bskyabs pa'i lan du 'di 'bul zhes/ /rin chen marka ta yi sdong po ni/ /ljang zhing sngo la gnag pa'i 'od 'tsher ba/ /dbyibs ni nya yi sto 'dra zhig byin no/ /ded dpon de ni 'di 'dra gnyis yod na/ /sku de'i spyan 'bras bgyid snyam longs pa'i tshe/ /lag nas lhung ste gnyis su gas nas bye/ /spyan 'bras bgyid pa'i don du phul bar gyur/ /ji skad ma yis lung bstan de bzhin du/ /tsan dan lde gu rin chen marka ta/ /bzo bor bcas pa 82

lha khang nang du bcug /sgo la lcags kyi gzer btab zla drug dang / /zhag drug bar du 'jog par byas pa las/ /zla ba drug dang zhag lnga lon pa'i tshe/ /ma de byung nas lta 'o sgo phye zer/ /da dung zhag gcig ma thim zhes smras pas/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs dus dngos su mthong ba'i mi/ /da lta 'dzam bu'i gling na nga bas med/ /nga ni sang gi gdugs la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /nga yis 'dra 'am mi 'dra blta dgos kyi/ /da lta phye zer lcags gzer bkrol ba na/ /gzo bo de ni nam mkhar 'phags te yal/ /ston pa dgung lo so lnga lon pa'i tshe/ mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i sku yi tshad/ /rin chen maṅka ta yis spyan 'bras byas/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpes brgyan par grub/ /ma yis smras pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /ljags kyis gdong khebs tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs ldan/ /na bza' sku la sor bzhis mi reg cing / /'od zer 'dom gang khor yug 'bar ba yod/ /de dag sku gzugs 'di la mi snang ngo / /ston pa spyod lam rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad/ /'di la bzhugs pa'i spyod lam gcig pu yod/ /ston pa'i dbu gtsug lta bar mi mngon la/ /'di yi dbu yi gtsug 'khyil lta bar nus/ /ston pa'i dbu skra bung ba lta bur gnag /'di ni cung zad sngo ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /ston pa'i mdzod spu sum bcu rtsaraganyis ni/ /dkar zhing 'od ldan ngang gis g.yas su 'khyil/ /'di ni de bas cung zad mi gsal tsam/ khyad par brgyad po 'di dag ma gtogs pa/ /ston pa dngos dang khyad par mi snang ngo / /ma 'ongs phyi rol pa dang rten 'gran tshe/ /yon tan brgyad kyang 'di la snang bar 'gyur/ /sus mthong dbang med phyag 'tshal ltar mi ngoms/ zas skom brjed cing dus ring thung ngur tshor/ /rgyab kyis lta bar mi phod phyi 'gros byed/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nad sos sdug bsngal brjed/ /gdon dang bral zhing nyon mongs ngang gis zhi/ /gnas skabs mthar 83

thug yon tan dpag med 'byung / /zhes smras ma de phyi nang tshe dus byas/ /ring srel phung po bu yis mchod rten bzhengs/ /sngon tshe zhag gcig ma thim nyes pa ni/ /zhabs ga yas the chung ma tshang phyis bcos zer/ /da lta rgya gar yul na grags pa ni/ /zhag gcig ma thim pa las dbu skra'i tshogs/ /tshom bur g.yas su 'khyil ba ma tshang skad/ /deng sang 'dzam bu gling na rten gyi mchog /rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi zhes/ /'gran med mkha' la nyi ma lta bur snang / /('di sngon gyi grags pa ltar bris pa yin kyang bstod 'grel gnyis la brtags na bstod pa mdzad po gnyis phu bo gnyis su snang la/ rdo rje gdan bzheng ba po 'di'i mtshan dang rab tu byung ma byung sogs gsal bar mi snang ngo /) phyi nas chos rgyal mya ngan med sogs kyis/ /sku gzugs mchod rten gtsug khang mtha' yas mdzad/ /ston pa'i rten ji ltar byung tshul mdo tsam bstan pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /yi ge pa ni tshe dbang bstan pas bris/ /kos kyi rig byed smyal gyi sgang rgyud nas/ /tshe dbang dar po bkra shis tshe dbang bkos/ /dge bas bla med byang chub thob par shog / le'u bzhi pa rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs/ston pa mchog la slar yang gus btud nas/ /de yi bstan la bya ba byed pa yi/ /'phags pa'i yul du sa skyong mang byung ba/ /de las ji tsam thos pa brjod par bya/ /rtsa ba med pa'i dad par ldan pa yi/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal po ma skyes dgras/ /ma ga dha dang aṅga yangs pa can/ /ko sa la yi rgyal khams chen po dang / /wa ra ṇa si la sogs dbang byas te/ /thams cad gdugs dkar gcig gis khebs pa ltar/ /ston pa'i bstan la gcig tu mchod par gyur/ /de sras u pa zhes pas rgya — ba'i bka'/ /mtha' dag yi ger bris 84

te glegs bam byas/ /rgyas par byed cing shi 'phos lha yul 'gro/ /nges par byang chub thob ces lung du bstan/ / (ma skyes dgras rgyal sa byas nas lo lnga na ston pa mya ngan las 'das/ spyir rgyal sa lo so gnyis byas/ de nas rgyal po bcu 'das pa na chos rgyal mya ngan med byon par li yul gyi rgyal rabs las bshad/) ston pa mya ngan 'das nas lo brgya na/ /'dzam gling bdag po mya ngan med pa byung / /shākya ri brags pa yi rgyud yin zhes/ /bod rje'i bka' chems 'ga' zhig dag las byung / /(sprin chen po las/ sngon sangs rgyas klu rigs sgron ma'i drung du blon po dam chos dkyil 'khor gyi mdzod kyis shākya'i bstan pa 'byin pa'i rgyal por smon lam btab pa de ni da lta bram ze rkarnyi nu 'di yin te nga 'das nas lo brgya nyi shu na morya'i rigs su rgyal po mya ngan med ces phyed kyi 'khor sgyur du 'gyur ro zhes lo brgya nyi shu na 'byung bar lung bstan yang snying rje chen po pad dkar du/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na grong khyer skya snar gyi bur rgyal po mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba morya'i rigs su skyes pa chos can chos kyi rgyal po zhig 'byung ste zhes dang / des dus gcig tu nyin gcig la nga'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brgyad khri bzhi stong byed par 'gyur ro zhes dang / mdo gzhan las kyang lo brgya na 'byung bar gsungs pa du ma yod pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/nga ni sa steng mya ngan 'das/ /lo brgya dag ni 'das pa na/ /snang ba med cing nyes par bcas/ /mi shes mun pas rab tu bsgribs/ /de tshe sa ni stong pa ste/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis spangs pa nyid/ /de tshe mi bzang chen po'i dus/ /grong khyer me tog can du ni/ /mya ngan med ces bya ba yi/ /rgyal po sa ni skyong byed pa/ /sogs dang / /de ltar rdzu 'phrul che bdag nyid/ /de tshe stobs kyi 'khor sgyur 'byung / /zhes dang / 'dzam bu'i gling 'di ma lus pa/ /mchod rten gyis ni brgyan pa dang / /zhes mchod rten gyi grangs ma gsungs shing /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /zhes tshe tshad dang / lo ni brgyad bcu rtsa bdun du/ /sa steng mchod rten mchod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / bka' bsdu bar pa'i sbyin bdag yin la de lo brgya dang bcu ma byung bar gsungs pas rgyal po mya ngan med kyis dgung lo drug bcu rtsa gsum gyi bar du sdig pa spyod pa gtum po mya ngan med kyi dus dang / re 85

gsum nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung ba phyin chos rgyal mya ngan med du graṭa pa yin no/) modma'i rigs zhes ston pas lung du bstan/ /sngon tshe ston pa grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /khye 'u gnyis shig rgyal blon tshul du rtse/ /bye ma'i tshogs las pho brang bang mdzod byas/ /de yis ston pa gshegs mthong dad gyur te/ /bang mdzod du bsngos bye ma'i phung po las/ /snyim pa gang zhig khye 'u rgyal pos bcus/ /thub pa'i lhung bzed nang du dbul bar brtsams/ /ma stobs gyur pas khye 'u cig shos kyis/ /skur por byas pa'i steng du 'dzegs nas phul//ston pas de yi dad pa'i bsam pa dgongs/ /phyag gi lhung bzed dpangs dmad gyur pas bzed/ /ma yis rgyal la 'di 'dra 'bul ba zhes/ /spyos pa ston pas zlog par mdzad nas ni/ /kun dga' bo la bsam pa bzang po yis/ /phul 'di chud ma zos par bya ba'i phyir/ /sa sbyin ba byung dri dang sbyar ba yis/ /ston pa'i dri yi gtsang khang skus shig gsungs/ /nga 'das nas ni lo brgya lon pa na/ /khye 'u steng ma 'di ni 'dzam gling gi /rgyal po mya ngan med ces bya bar 'gyur/ /bye ma phul 'di'i 'bru grangs dang mnyam pa'i/ /nga yi ring bsrel ldan pa'i mchod rten ni/ /'dzam bu'i gling kun khyab par byed par 'gyur/ /khye 'u gcig shos de yi blon por 'gyur/ /'dzam gling rnal du 'god par byed do gsungs/ /sngon tshe bye ma phul ba'i sa yin zhes/ /nā lerdo na de yi mchod rten yod/ /ston pa 'dal nas lo ni so bdun na/ /rgyal po cig la rgyal bu bcu bdun dang / bran mor btsas pa gcig ste bco brgyad yod/ /yab kyis rgyal bu kun bsdus rgyal po'i mtshan/ /su la ldan pa mtshan mkhan gyis rtog tshe/ /bcu bdun po ni zas gos rgyan bzang pos/ /bsnyems shing so sor khri stan dag la 'khod/ /nam yang rgyal srid mi 'thob bsam pa yis/ /bran mo'i bu ni ma song 'dug pa la/ /blon pos nges pa med kyis song zhig skad/ /rasda rnying gyon zhing 86

'bras chan khengs pa cig /zos te sa gzhi nyid la 'khod par gyur/ /bram zes 'di dag rnams las zas mchog zos/ /gos mchog gyon te stan mchog la 'dug pa/ /de ni rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ /so sor bdag gi 'di mchog zer zhing song / /blon pos mchog de gang yin dris pa na/ /zas mchog 'bras chan gos mchog ras gos te/ /stan gyi mchog ni sa gzhi yin no zer/ /tha chung bran mo'i bu de lung bstan no/ /rgyal po nad kyis 'chi bar nye ba'i tshe/ /rgyal bu gzhan kun dmag gi g.yul du song / /blon pos bskul bas tha chung a sho kur/ /cod pan bcings te re zhig 'di byos la/ /de nas phu bo zhig ni skos shig skad/ /phu bo bcu bdun g.yul ngor shi nas ni/ /a sho ka nyid gtan gyi rgyal por gyur/ /dmyal ba'i gcod btub yi dwags bkres skom dang //dud 'gro'i bkol spyod mi yi brel phongs dang / /lha min 'thab rtsod lha yi longs spyod de/ /kun la re mos tshul gyis 'bangs rnams sbyar/ /ming yang gtum po mya ngan med ces grags/ /de tshe shar phyogs bya gag kun ra na/ /'phags pa kun dga' bo yi slob ma ni/ /dge slong dbang po'i sde 'am grags pa zhes/ /dgra bcom rnam thar brgyad dang ldan pa bzhugs/ /de yi slob ma dge tshul gzhon nu zhig /bsod stoms spyod mthong rgyal pos bzung nas ni/ /'di 'dra'i cha lugs sngon chad gsod ma myong / /gshed ma rnams kyis zangs su tshos shig zer/ /bdag gis rab tu byung ba'i don ma grub/ /zhag bdun sgom du chug ces zhus pas gnang / /zhag lnga'i bar du ci yang ma rtogs tshe/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo zhig la chad pa phog /dge tshul de yi mdun du bsad cing btubs/ /lus mdzes skye bo dga' bar byed de nyid/ /rgyu sto 'jan 'jin rab tu mi gtsang ba/ /'di ltar gyur snyam mi sdug 'dra shes thob/ /skyo bas skad cig de la dgra bcom gyur/ /zhag bdun lon tshe kha sbyar zangs kyi nang / /87

yungs mar blug par nyin gcig btsos nas phye/ /ci yang ma nyes zil pa phrom me 'dug /ngo mtshar skyes te de yi rgyu dris pas/ /zhag bdun bsgoms pas dgra bcom thob ces zer/ /dus ring sdig pa mang po bsags snyam nas/ /rgyal po 'gyod de sdig sbyong gsol ba btab/ /nga ni dge tshul cang mi shes pa ste/ /mkhan po'i drung du gsol ba thob cig zer/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te mya ngan 'das/ /sa der de yi gdung gi mchod rten bzhengs/ /rgyal po nyid kyi grong khyer dngos de ni/ /rdo rje'i gdan nas shar du dpag yod bcu/ /'das pa gaṅgā'i chu dang nye bar yod/ /dgra bcom grags pa'i drung du pho nya btang / / bdag gi sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs 'tshol phyir/ /bdag der mchi 'am 'phags pa 'dir gshegs zhes/ /gsol bas gzhan la gnod par gyur dogs nas/ /'phags pas rgyal po'i drung du myur bar byon/ /sdig pa sbyong phyir ring bsrel ldan pa yi/ /mchod rten bye ba phrag gcig gyis shig gsung / /rgyal pos de tsam mi 'grub ces smras pas/ /khyod ni rgyal bas sngon du lung bstan gyi/ /mi dang mi min kun la bka' sgos dang / /ring por ma thogs 'grub par nges so gsungs/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi gdung skal gyi/ /ring bsrel bre bo che yi khal gcig ni/ /'od ma'i tshal na gter du sbas so zhes/ /gsungs nas de yi sa gzhi brus pa na/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo byung ste btsal ma nus/ /bud med cig gis gaṅgā'i chu phran zhig /drangs nas yod ces thos kyis chod cig zer/ /rnyed de chu rgyun bkag pas 'khor 'phro chad/ /sku gdung brus pas ma 'ongs rgyal po ni/ /dbul po zhig gis gter 'di rnyed 'gyur zhes/ /rin chen yi ge byung bas ma rangs te/ /nga lta bu la dbul po zhes zer ba/ /mi rigs zer te sku gdung 'tshol 'phro bcad/ /rgyal ba'i gdung phyir nga rgyal ma byed ces/ /bskul nas slar btsal rin chen sgrom bur bzhugs/ /phyogs bzhir 88

nor bu rin chen re re bzhag /de yis rtag tu mar me'i bya ba byed/ /rgyal po a sho ka yi rgyal srid kyis/ /nor bu re re'i rin du'ang ma chog nas/ /rgyal po'i nga rgyal chag cing dul bar gyur/ /de nas ring bsrel bre chen bzhi spyan drangs/ /bre 'u chung gi khal gcig tshad du byung / /lhag ma sngar bakhyin rgyas btab sbas te bzhag /steng du mchod rten ngo mtshar ldan pa byas/ /dzambha la dang gnod sbyin shing rta grub/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs chen ldan pa'i gnod sbyin zhig /bya ba thogs med sgrub pa'i blon por gyur/ /de yis grogs byas 'dzam gling rnal du phab/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa kun bskul nas/ /sa steng kun tu rdo yi srog shing bsgrengs/ /'dzam gling khyab par rgyal ba'i mchod rten byas/ /mchod rten grangs ni bye ba snyed yod phyir/ /deng sang bye ba mchod rten zhes su grags/ /gsum dang brgyad dang bye ba la sogs pa/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyis bshad pa'ang 'di nyid yin/ /kun na rgyal ba'i ring bsrel re re bzhugs/ /mdo las mchod rten brgyad khri bzhi stong zhig /byed par 'gyur zhes lung bstan kho na snang / /sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba rgya chen byas/ /mtshan yang chos rgyal a sho ka zhes brjod/ /gzhan 65nga gnas chen brgyad la sogs pa ru/ /gtsug khang mang byas dge 'dun mtha' yas mchod/ /bka' yi bsdu ba bar pa'i sbyin bdag byas/ /rgyal po de sras ku na la yi mig /yab kyi btsun mo skar rgyal srung ba yis/ /'dod cing chags pas bslu bar ma nus tshe/ /gya gyus mig phrogs slong mos 'tsho ba'i tshe/ khro ba med pa'i bden pas mig rab sos/ /bstan la rab byung dgra bcom dam par gyur/ /('di la ku na la'i mig gi rtogs brjod ces pa yod/) 'dzam bu'i gling nas rgya mtshor 'dong ba yi/ /tshong pa'i tshogs shig lan lngar gru chen zhig /nor rdzas chur shor rang rang rkyal te thar/ /mi de rnams kyis rgyal po'i spyan sdar 89

'dus/ /khyod kyi bka' lung kun gyis nod na yang / /rgya mtsho'i klu yis khyod kyi bka' ma nyan/ /bdag cag lan lngar nor rdzas kun dang phral/ /nge bas khyod kyis rdzas rnams dgug du gsol/ /de skad mgrin gcig brjod de ngud mo 'byin/ /rgyal po gdong dmar ngo tsha ldan gyur te/ /'di la ji ltar bya snyam the tshom gyur/ /dgra bcom grags pa la ni zhus pa na/ /zangs ma'i glegs bur rgyal po'i bka' yig bkod/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du dor zhig gsungs/ /de ltar byas pas klu yis ma blangs te/ /rlabs kyis tshu rol rgyang ring zhig tu 'phangs/ /de tshe dgra bcom grags pa'i zhal na re/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las rgyal po yi/ /gzugs dang klu yi gzugs shig tshar mnyam gyis/ /lhan cig khrus kyi rdzing bur dor cig gsungs/ /de tshe klu yi gzugs ni gzi 'od 'bar//chu la ma byings steng du 'phags shing gsal/ /rgyal po'i sku gzugs mog zhing chur byings nas/ /de yi mdun du phyag byed tshul gyis bub/ /dgra bcom zhal nas da lta rgyal po bas/ /klu rgyal bsod nams lhag par ldan gyur gyis/ /rgyal po chen po bsod nams gyis shig gsungs/ /dgra bcom 'bum phrag mang po spyan drangs te/ 7rgya chen bsnyen zhing bkur bas rab tu mchod/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten rgya cher byas/ kha na ma tho med pa'i mchod sbyin che/ /spo gtan ma bcug rgyun mi 'chad par byed/ /zhag bdun lon tshe rgyal po'i sku gzugs de/ /mi nub phyed tsam chu bo'i steng du byung / /bdun gnyis lon tshe gzugs gnyis mtho dman dang / /bzang ngan med par chu steng mnyam par 'dug /zhag grangs nyer gcig lon tshe rgyal po'i gzugs/ /gsal zhing 'od 'bar chu bo'i steng du 'phags/ /klu gzugs lcags las byas ltar 'od mi gsal/ /phyag byed tshul gyis bub ste chu bor nub/ /'phags pa'i zhal nas 'phrin yig srings shig gsungs/ /zangs ma'i glegs bur bkod pa'i bka' 90

yig ni/ /rgya mtshor 'phangs pas dbu ba'i phung pos bteg /sgra chen sgrog cing rgya mtsho/ri dbus su nub/ /klu dang gnod sbyin srul po lus srul sogs/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba mang po yis/ /tshong pa rnams kyi zong rnayo sa ma lus dang / /klu yi rin chen dpag med khyer nas ni/ /kun gyis mthong bar rgyal po'i mdun du phul/ /sri zhu phu dud mchod bstod rgya cher byas/ /mi skye'i bzod thob byang chub lung bstan pa'i/ /klu rgyal rgya mtsho'i bsod nams zil non pa'i/ /mi yi rgyal po mya ngan med pa de/ /lhag par bsod nams mthu la yid 'ches te/ /dge 'dun la ni gser srang bye ba brgya/ /'bul ba'i yi dam brtan po bzung bar gyur/ / ('di la chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis klu btul ba'i le'u zhes bya ba'i rtogs brjod yod cing dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab don gsum pa yang 'di yin/) rgyal po de yi kun tu spyod pa ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun mtha' yas nyin re zhing / /pho brang spyan 'dren mchod pa rgya chen byed/ /gdugs tshod rnyed pa bstabs nas dam chos nyan/ /de ltar rtag tu rgyal ba'i bstan la mchod/ /gser srang bye ba go drug phul zin nas/ /bye ba bzhi yis ma longs gyur pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po dus kyi bsnyun nad drag pos zin/ /rgyal po'i tsha bo rgyal tshab byed pa la/ /bka' yis bsgos kyang 'grongs par shes pa yis/ /mdzod la ser sna byas te gser ma phul/ /dge 'dun rnams kyang rgyal por thugs rje bas/ /spyan ma drangs kyang nyin re bzhin du byon/ /rgyal tshab de yis gdugs tshod ma sbyar nas/ /dam chos bstan nas lhung bzed stong pa yis/ /pho brang phyir byon bsod stoms spyod par byed/ /rgyal pos rang gi sman dang gsol zas dang / /gos dang rgyan las phri ste ci nus 'bul/ /de dag rnams kyang rgyal bus srung bcug pas/ /tha ma'i nyin par dbul bya gzhan ma 'byor/ /khrus rtsi'i skyu ru ra yi phye ma ni/ /phul gang bdog pa de nyid kho na phul/ /de tshe rgyal po'i chos blon chen po cig /skyo 01

bar gyur te rgyal po chen po lags/ /khyod la yo byad gzhan dag mi bdog kyang / /sa gzhi bdog gis 'di nyid 'bul bar gyis/ /gser srang bye ba bzhi yis blu ru chug khyod kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes/ /gsol bas rgyal po chen po rab tu mnyes/ /sa gzhi ma lus dge 'dun rnams la phul/ /rgyal tshab de yis bye ba bzhi yis blus/ /de nas rgyal po dus kyi chos ldan pas/ /dga' ldan lha yi rigs su gshegs par gyur/ /mthar ni rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar lung du bstan/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las/ /rgyal po lung bstan mdor bsdus brjod byas na/ /mya ngan med 'og mya ngan bral zhes 'byung / /gos dkar mo grub chos kyi ngang tshul can/ /lo ni bdun bcu rtsa drug mchod rten mchod/ /de yi 'og tu dpa' bo'i sde zhes 'byung / /dpal chen mo grub gtsug lag khang chen byed/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar thug mchod rten du mas brgyan/ /lo ni bdun bcur chos kyis rgyal thabs byed//gnyi ga'ang lhar skye byang chub che 'thob 'gyur/ /de 'og rgyal po dga' bo zhes bya 'byung / /sha za pi lu'i sngags grub longs spyod ldan/ /de yi grogs po bram ze pā ṇi zhes/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags grub brda sprod byed/ /braca/ ze mchog sred ces bya'ang de tshe 'byung / /rgyal po'i tshe tshad lnga bcu rtsa drug ste/ /grogs bcas nyan thos byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po zla ba sbas pa zhes/ /dzambha la grub rgyal srid longs spyod rgyas/ /shi 'phos las kyis yi dwags 'jig rten song / /de nas lhar skye nyan thos byang chub 'thob/ /de yi bu ni snying po thig le zhes/ /sngon dus byis par gyur tshe rtsed mo'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten bye ma las byas mthus/ /skye ba lnga brgyar lha yi bde myong nas/ /de nas shi 'phos mi yi rgyal por gyur/ /byis pa'i dus nas rgyal por cod pan bcings/ /'jam dpal dang ni sgra yi rig pa grub/ /chos bzhin rgyal srid lo 92
