ni bdun bcur byed/ /de yi blon po bram ze tsa na gas/ /gshin rje'i gshed grub khro bas zil mnan te/ /rgyal po gsum gyi ring la mngon spyod kyis/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig chen byas par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi mthu yis lha ma yin bkug nas/ /lus des lha min bsten ste yun ring 'tsho/ /shi 'phos mnar med dmyal pa'i gnas su skye/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad mtha' yas myong bar 'gyur/ /de nas shi 'phos klu yi rgyal por skye/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma rungs dug 'dzin pa/ /mi bzad sdig pa'i las lam byed par 'gyur/ /de nas shi 'phos rdzu 'phrul chen po yi/ /yi dwags gshin rje'i rgyal por rab tu 'gro /de ltar sdug bsngal stong phrag yang yang myong / /mthar gyis mir skyes yon gnas mchog gyur pa'i/ /rang sangs rgyas la bsod stoms phul nas ni/ /smon lam btab nas shi 'phos mtho ris song / /mthar gyis dman pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de bas sngags sgrub mngon spyod yong mi bya/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis mngon spyod bkag /snying rje mchog dang rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa'i/ /sras bcas rgyal bas sngags kyi las rnams ni/ /mthu bstan ched du gsungs kyi gsang phyir min/ /de bas mngon spyod mi bya zhes lung bstan/ /'di dus dge slong ma khol 'byung bar gsungs/ /dge slong dga' bo'i 'og tu sa yi bdag/tsardon skyong 'byung lo ni sum brgyar 'tsho/ /gegs med byang chub chen po bde blag 'thob/ /de nas mi dge'i bshes gnyen go mi shan/ /bdag nyid ngan pas yongs su bslus pa yi/ /sdig pa'i rgyal po btsun pa zhes bya ba/ /nag po'i rtsa lag zhig gis shar phyogs nas/ kha che'i bar du lha khang mchod rten 'jig /rab byung rnams gsod de tshe dkar phyogs kyi/ /lha kun 'khrugs nas byang phyogs la brten par/ /rgyal po de ni ri yis bcom ste 'chi/ /'og nas 'og 'gro mnar med dmyal bar 'tshed/ /nam zhig rnga ngas rgyas bstan la 'jug bar 33

'gyur/ /de 'og rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs zhes pa/ /grags chen gtong ba che zhing bstan la gus/ /de nas rgyal po thams cad mngon dga' zhes/ /padma 'chang grub ston pa'i bstan gtsor byed/ /kun dga' ra ba mchod rten gnas dang ni/ /mtshe 'u rjing khron mtsho dang lu ma sogs/ /kun tu ston pa'i gzugs brnyan rgya cher byed/ /sngags kyi mthu yis lo ni sum brgyar 'tsho/ /lha yi gnas skye myur du byang chub 'thob/ /grong khyer lnga len du ni de yi bu/ /zab mo'i phyogs zhes bya ba'i rgyal po 'byung / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yi ge drug pa grub/ /mchod rten gtsug khang gnas khang rgya cher byed/ /sngags kyi mthu yis longs spyod rgya chen ldan/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /bya ba cher byas myur du byang chub 'thob/ /skabs 'dir bod dang rgya yi rgyal po sogs/ /lung du bstan mod so so'i skabs su 'chad/ /byang phyogs rgyal po tu ruṣka zhes 'byung / /skra can ma grub sde chen brtson 'grus ldan/ /shing shun gyon yul ma gtogs kha che dang / /ka shi'i mthar thug dpag tshad bdun brgya dang //'bum phrag gnyis kyi sa skyong bstan la mchod/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten stong dang brgyad khri byed/ /de yi yul du theg chen shes phyin rgyas/ /lo ni sum brgyar sngags kyi mthu yis 'tsho/ /lus zhig mtho ris 'gro zhing sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de 'og mang bskur tu ruṣka zhes 'byung / /sgrol ma'i sngags grub phyogs chen dpung chen po/ /grags chen gnyen dang rgyal po kun gyis bskur/ /rtsa brgyad stong gi gtsug lag khang byed cing / /chos kyi bdag nyid de mthar rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /de yi yul du gsung rab mang gnas par/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba dag gis kyang lung bstan/ /dgra bcom dang ni klu dang 'jig rten skyong / /bstan srung gnod sbyin mang po de tshe 'byung / /nub phyogs 'phags rgyal pha rol la ṭa'i yul/ /pu ṭi'i rgyal rigs ngang tshul zhes bya ba/ /dge slong zhig las shi 'phos 94

rgyal po 'byung / /mchod rten sku gzugs mchod cing gtsug khang byed/ /chos rgyal chos la gnyen gshin sngagal kyang grub/ /lo ni sum bcur srid bskyangs dga' ldan du/ /byams pa'i mdun 'gro mthar gyis byang chub 'thob/ /de nas g.yo ba zhes bya'i rgyal po ni/ /lo grangs nga lnga zla ba lnga ru 'tsho/ /de yi nu bo bstan zhes skye rgu skyong / /ngang tshul 'og du zla mdzes gzhu dang tog /me tog gzhu dang 'od chen stobs rnams ldan/ khyab 'jug bar du ba la'i grong dang ni/ /res ldan grong du rgyal po mtha' yas 'byung / /de nas drang srong dmod pas bcom gyur te/ /la ṭa'i yul kun chu yis gang bar 'gyur/ /byang phyogs ri dang ri zhol sna tshogs par/ /nyi shu gcig dang sum bcu la sogs pa/ /sngags grub rgyal po mang du 'byung bar gsungs/ /lho phyogs mtsho'i 'gram gañtsi pu ra'i gnas/ /dkar dang sa bdag sā la'i ljon pa sogs/ /rgyal po stong phrag bgrangs pa 'byung bar bstan/ /dpal gyi ri bo'i phyogs dang 'beegs byed zhol/ /ka liṅga dang yon tan gsum pa dang / /kla klo rgya mtsho'i nang dang 'gram dag dang / /ka ma rū dang o ṭa'i yul sogs su/ /rgyal po bstan la dad pa mtha' yas 'byung / /de bzhin shar gyi phyogs su rgya mtsho dang / /rnam gnon dbang chen la sogs bstan pa la/ /dad pa'i rgyal po du ma lung du bstan/ /goṭa'i yul du gzhon nu zhes bya sogs/ /mchog dman rgyal po sna tshogs 'byung bar bstan/ khyad par shar phyogs mtshor brten 'brog gi bar/ /byang du lo hi ta klung kha ba can/ /nub tu ka shi'i grong la thug pa'i bar/ /dbang byed rgyal po seng ge lnga par gsungs/ /('di rngog lo chen po'i lung bstan du grags kyang de min/) gzhan yang yul dus ma nges rgyal po'i tshogs/ /mang du gsungs mod mdor bsdus brjod pa ste/ /rgyas par 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid stos/ /sngon byung gtam gyi grags pa ltar bshad na/ /chos rgyal mya 95

ngan med 'das ring zhig na/ /rgyal po tsand+ra bdun rgyud ces pa byung / /(ha ri tsasdu/ de wa tsardzu/ the tsant+ra/ a khe tsastu/ dharma tsant+ra/ bee kra matsantu/) /bdun pa go mi tsand+ra zhes bya ba/ /dzā landha ra pa yi slob ma ste/ /thun mong dngos grub brnyes par gyur pa yin/ /de 'das 'og tu btsun mo mdzes ma zhig /klu bdud gdug pa cig gis bdag gir byas/ /rgyal por gang bskos dang po lo gcig dang / /de 'og zla gcig de phyin zhag re la/ /re re zos te grong gi skyes pa kun/ /re mos kyis bsko thams cad sdug bsngal ldan/ /de tshe 'od zer can ma grub pa yi/ /rgyal rigs rnal 'byor pa zhig der 'ongs nas/ /ba lang rji bo zhig la gnas bcas 'dug /de dag ngu zhing do nub rgyal po yi/ /re mos bab pas sang ni mi ldog zer/ /snying rjes nga yis tshab ma bya 'o smras/ /rgyal por bskos te rin chen khri la bsdad/ /srod la dug sbrul nam gung stag dang ni//tho rangs dus su seng ger byas nas ni/ /skyes bu dman 'bring mchog la gnod byed ba/ /de dag lha yi nga rgyal gyis tshar bcad/ /mdze mo mi bzad 'jigs pa zhig snang ba/ /nad bral lha yi lus ltar gyur nas ni/ khyod ni kun la bka' drin mtshungs pa med/ /bdag gi lus kyang rtag tu khyod la 'bul/ /snying rjes rgyal srid mdzod ces zhabs la gtugs/ /nang par grong khyer pa rnams khyogs la sogs/ khyer ste rgyal po'i sku gdung dur khrod du/ /spyan 'dren 'ongs tshe rgyal po ma nyams mthong / /klu bdud gdug pa de ni ngas btul gyis/ /da ni rgyal po sus byas nyam nga med/ /su 'dod skos shig zer ste khri las langs/ /kun gyis de nyid gtan gyi rgyal por zhus/ /snying rjes khas blangs rgyal srid chos bzhin mdzad/ /ba lang rdzi bo'i tshab ma yin pa'i phyir/ /ba lang skyong dang go pā la zhes grags/ kha cig phyugs rji mo la shing gi lhas/ /spyad pas ba lang skyong byung ba de yis/ /nor bu byin pas sa la dbang bsgyur te/ /nā lerdo yi 96

gtsug khang bzhengs zhes zer/ /sngon tshe 'phags pa shā ri'i bu yi yul/ / nā lardo yi grong zhes grags pa ste/ /'dam bu can zhes nā landa ru brjod/ kha cig mi yi dbang po'i gtsug khang zhes/ /nā rend+ra zhes bya bar 'dod pa dang / /rin chen nal gyis khebs pa'i sa yin phyir/ /na lend+ra zhes bya bar sgrog pa'ang yod/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs byon pa'i sa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'byung khungs chen po yin/ /rgyal po chen po go pā la de ni/ /shar phyogs snyi ga la tsam mnga' ris 'dus/ /btsun mo lnga brgya re re la yang ni/ /dge slong ma tshogs lnga brgya'i mchod gnas yod/ /btsun mo tha chung rgyal por ma phrad nas/ /dge slong ma zhig gis ni dbang byed kyi/ /sman sbyar rgyal po'i zhal du ma thongs nas/ /rigs lad dogs pas mtsho yi nang du pho/ /mtsho de'i klu rgyal dbang du gyur nas ni/ /rgyal por sprul te btsun mo'i gam du 'ongs/ /rgyal pos thos nas klu de 'dzin bcug pas/ /bdag la dbang med sman de'i nus pa yin/ /btsun mo'i bu 'di rgyal po nyid la 'bul/ /sman de bton na phyin chad mi 'ong zer/ /bu de bsod nams ldan par rtogs nas ni/ rgyal pos mnga' mdzad nyirma pā lar btags/ /rgyal po 'das nas rgyal srid mnga' dbang bskur/ /sa bdag chen po dpal ldan chos skyong des/ /gtsug khang bzheng phyir ltas mkhan la dris pas/ /dka' thub lha gnas nas blangs kong bu ru/ /bram ze'i ras la sdong bu byas nas ni/ /tshong dpon las blangs mar la me spar nas//mchod rten gang du phul na chos skyong gi /sprul pas kong bu gang du bskyur pa der/ /brtsigs zhes rmi lam nang du bstan mthong nas/ /dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin pa rgya cher byas/ /mar me phul tshe kong bu bya rog gis/ khyer te mtsho chen zhig tu dor bar gyur/ /rgyal po yi chad sdug bsngal ldan pa na/ /klu rgyal sbrul mgo lnga pa cig 'ongs te/ /nga ni khyod kyi pha yin mtsho bskams la/ /97

rtsig tu gzhug gis zhag ni bdun re zhing / /dkon mchog mchod sbyin rgya cher gyis shig zer/ /bdun gsum 'das tshe mtsho de bskams gyur nas/ /gtsug lag khang byas mtsho yi shul yin phyir/ /rgya mtsho sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya/ /gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge slong rnams la ni/ /grang ba'i nad kyis btab pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /shing rtas tsha ba gsum gyi sman bskyas nas/ khron par blug pas tī gastu ka 'am/ /tsha ba gsum pa'i gtsug lag khang du grags/ /seng ge bzang po'i brgyad stong 'grel chen yang / /sbyin bdag dpal ldan chos skyong gis byas nas/ /tī gastu ga'i gnas su sbyar bar gsungs/ /(kha cig 'di o ryarta pu ri yin zer yang o ryarta pu ri ni mu stegs kyi rig 'dzin gyis ro langs gsar du grub pa las byas pa de yin no) de tshe shar phyogs ba rend+ra yi yul/ /mu stegs lha rten mang du yod pa la/ /nyin bzhin srog chags mang bsad mchod pa byed/ /sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor pa zhig mchis pa des/ /snying rjes phyi pa'i rten rnams 'jig par bsams/ /rgyal po de la zhus zhes yi dam gyis/ /lung bstan thob nas sa te btsugs te zhus/ /rgyal pos gnang nas dpung tshogs rnam bzhis chas/de tshe mi nag 'jigs shing che ba zhig /ha cang mi ring sngun du 'gro mthong nas//dris pas mgon po ma hā kā la yin/ /mu stegs rten rnams khyed kyis mi shigs skad/ /de la grogs su gsol ba btab pa na/ /'o na bye ma'i phung po 'di sol la/ /'og na sngon gyi sangs rgyas 'od srung gi /gtsug lag khang yod de la mchod pa gyis/ /nga ni gtsug lag khang 'di'i bstan srung yin/ /lha rten 'jig tshe rol mo'i sgra chen sgrogs/ /de nas nga yis gdong grogs bya 'o skad/ /bye ma bsal bas 'od srung gtsug lag khang / /ma nyams pa zhig byung ste mchod pa byas/ /sngon tshe dus kyi 'phen pa ma btang bar/ /'gog par zhugs rnga4'i dgra bcom zhig kyang langs/ /ston pa 'od srung gang na bzhugs zhes zer/ /de 98

'das 'di ni de yi bstan yang min/ /shākya'i rgyal po'ang 'das zhes brjod pa na/ /mkhar 'phags cho 'phrul bstan te mya ngan 'das/ /rgyal pos gtsug lag khang de rgya cher brgyan/ /so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang zhes grags/ /bstan pa'i 'byung khungs chen po zhig du gyur/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i paṇa chen bzhi'ang / /sgo srung tshul du rtag par gnas so skad/ /de nas dbang phyug chen po'i lha rten rnams/ /dmag gis bskor te rol mo sna tshogs pa'i/ /sgra chen bsgrags pa'i mod la rang zhig gyur/ /ba rend+ra kun rgyal po'i chab 'og gyur/ /rgya gar rgyal po dharma pā la'i dus/ /bod rgyal mjing yon sad na legs bzhugs par/ /yar lung bang so'i rdo ring yi ge la/ /yod ces o rgyan pa yis gsungs par snang / /de tshe nā lenda yi gtsug khang na/ /slob dpon chen po kaX pa la zhes pa/ /mchog dngos grub nges gaṅgā'i chu 'gram na/ /brag ri de 'u zhig yod de steng du/ /gtsug khang byas na bstan la phan par dgongs/ /de yang rgyal po'i lus kyis 'grub par mkhyen/ /dharma pā la'i sras su 'khrung par bzhed/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa'i rmi lam du/ /rnam sbyar lhung bzed mkhar sil ldan pa yi/ /dge slong zhig 'ongs nga la gnas g.yar zhes/ /mtshan mo drug rmis rgyal po la bzlas pas/ /do nub byung na gtong bar khas long zer/ /lhums zhugs btsas nas de wa pā lar btags/ /rgyal srid che la mnga' dbang byas par gyur/ /sngon gyi gaṅgā'i 'gram gyi brag steng der/ /gtsug khang chen po ngo mtshar ldan pa byas/ /rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i sde pa re re la/ /rab byung nyi shu bdun re'i sa tra btsugs/ /sgra dang tshad ma gtor ma'i sa tra soṭa/ /gnyug mar gnas pa'i sa tra du ma dang / /glo bur lhags pa bcu phrag gnyis re yi/ /sa tra la sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad sbyar/ /de la phyogs bzhir ming bzhi grags so skad/ /byang phyogs pa rnams bi kra ma shrī la/ /zhes grags rnam par 99

gnon pa'i tshul khrims yin/ /la la gnod sbyin mnan pa'i gtsug khang zer/ /kha cib/ rnam par gnon pa'i rdo can zhes/ /sngon gyi brag ri'i ming du 'dod pa yod/ /(kha cig rgyun ster gyi gtsug lag khang zer/) mkhas pa'i paṇa chen sha stag gis gang ba/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'byung khungs chen por gyur/ /rgyal po de sras ta ma pā la ste/ /de dus pa tshab lo tsā tshul rgyal gyis/ /mdo sde dran nye'i 'gyur chad bsabs te bsgyur/ /de 'og nyi ma pā la zhes bya byung / /de sras rgyal po ma hā pa la yis/ /rdo rje gdan nas jo bo a ti sha/ /bee kra ma ni pu rir spyan drangs te/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzad par gyur/ /de sras dārya pā la'i rgyal srid tshe/ /jo bo bod yul 'gro ba 'dul phyir byon/ /jo bos zhal gdams 'phrin yig mdzad pa yod/ /tsand+ra bdun dang pā la bdun gyi ring / /rgya gar mkhas pa phal cher byung ba ste/ /rgyal po de kun tsanda'i grub thob yin/ /de nas blon po rgyal por gyur pa na/ /se na bzhi rgyud ces pa byung bar grags/ /(bā la se na/ ka sa ra se na/ ma ṇi se na/ ma hesdu se na'o/)gzhan yang kaX po tse gling mgon po'i rgyud/ /bzhugs las lo ni stong dang brgyad brgya na/ /rgyal po ma ṇi de wa zhes bya ba/ /ti ra hu ti'i grong du 'byung bar gsungs/ /de nas rgyal rabs drug na ram shing ste/ /brgyad pa bha khar kha ti'i dus su ni/ /gi po tse mi gling du 'khrungs pa yi/ /nag po spyod pas ral gri grub gyur te/ /wa ra ṇa sir pho brang bcas nas ni/ /'dzam gling dbang byed rdo rje theg pa dar/ /grub thob nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam 'byung bar/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na sgrog go zhes/ /o rgyan grub thob rin chen dpal gyis gsungs/ /(mgon po'i rgyud kyi lung bstan gyi rgyal bo de sngar byung zin pa'am da tsam yod dgos par snang /) de dang ram shing rgyal bo mjal bar snang / /de dag la sogs dbus 'gyur 'chang dang ni/ /ha ri puñdza ha ོba 100

ti dang / pukkaX la sogs shar dang de bzhin lho/ /kusmi ra dang kā ma rū pa sogs/ /nub dang byang ste rgya gar yul khams su/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i sa skyong mang byung ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyin byed rab brdal bas/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar thug sa chen khyab par byas/ /(deb sngon na rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ni su la'ang yod par ma thos la zhes snang ba ni mdzes pa ma min no/) chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs las rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o/ /par 'di'i sbyin bdag lho rgyud bya yul nas/ /nor 'dzin dbang mo tshogasaX gnyis grub ma yis/ /bsrungs ba'i dge tshogs byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /maṅgal// 101
yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs la le'u bcu las dang po thugs rje chen pos bod bdag gir mdzad tshul bzhugs/ /

le'u dang po thugs rje chen pos bod bdag gir mdzad tshul/rgyal dang rgyal sras kun gyi brtse chen ni/ /mngon sum gzugs kyis zhing kun na gsal bas/ /'gro kun phan bder byed po spyan ras kyis/ /rtag par kun nas gzigs la gus phyag 'tshal/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs mtha' 'khob gangs ri'i khrod/ /theg chen dar ba gdong dmar bod kyi yul/ /chu bo lo hi ta yi rgyud 'di ru/ /rgyal bstan byung tshul da ni brjod par bya/ /ston pas byang chub brnyes nas stong gsum dang / /shar nub rgya mtsho'i bar du zhabs kyis bcags/ /ti se'i phyogs bzhir ston pa'i zhabs rjes yod/ /de phyir lha sogs mchog gi snang ba ru/ /bod yul 'di yang ston pa'i zhabs kyis bcaṭa/ /tshu rol mthong ba mi yi mthun snang du/ /dngos su gshegs pa'i mdzad pa ma bstan phyir/ /ston pa'i zhabs kyis ma bcags 'od kyis khyab/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul zhes grags pa yin/ /ri mtho sa gtsang chu bsil tshad pa med/ /sbrul gdug stag gzig ce spyang dug sbrang med/ /'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo gangs can gnas/ /ba/ las lcags ris rin chen sna lnga 'byung / spang ljongs mtsho dang chu rgyun rab tu mang / /mu stegs mi rgyu mi kun theg chen mos//sprul pa'i chos rgyal lha yis mi rje mdzad/ /longs spyod dman yang 'dzam gling yul gzhan las/ /de lta'i khyad chos du mas khyad par 'phags/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas gsum gyis ma thul zhing / /da lta rgyal bas chos 'khor ma bskor ba'i/ /yul 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar bstan/ /sngon tshe ston pa 105

'od ma'i tshaska bzhugs tshe/ /'dzum pa mdzad pa'i 'od kyis bod yul bkang / /sgri/ba sel gyis ni 'dzum pa'i rgyu zhus tshe/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdul byar ma gyur pa/ /'dre srin gdug pa du mas gang ba'i yul/ /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der/ /ma 'ongs dam chos nyi ma shar ltar rgyas/ /sems can de rnams thar pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /mtha' 'khob de yi 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni//spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug kho na yin/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas stong gi spyan snga ru/ /mtha' 'khob gdul dka'i sems can de dag kun/ /bdag gis thar nga 'i lam du 'dul gyur cig /'dre srin gdug pa'i sems can de rnams kyi/ /skyob pa'i pha ma sgrol ba'i ded dpon dang / /mun pa sel ba'i sgron mer bdag gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dam chos gsung rab kun/ /mtha' 'khob yul der dar rgyaja/ gnas gyur cig /sems can de rnams rgyal ba'i mtshan thos pas/ /lha mi'i lus thob dad cing skyabs su song / /dam pa'i chos la longs spyod nyid gyur cig /bdag gis gang la gang 'dul thabs rgya mtshos/ /semal can de kun smin zhing grol byas nas/ /mtha' 'khob de ni rin chen gling lta bur/ /dam pa'i chos kyis kun nas 'byor bar shog /de kho na ltar shog ces smon lam btab/ /de phyir rgyal ba gzhan gyis ma thul ba/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis thul ba'i rgyu de yin/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /pad dkar lta bu'i 'od zer byung / /bde ba can gyi zhing song ste/ /'od dpag med kyi thugs kur thim/ /de nas byung ste bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /pad ma can du zhugs par gyur/ /bde ba can gyi zhing de ni/ /mnyam zhing shin tu rnam par dag /bee ṭurya yi sa gzhi la/ /gse ra gyis mig mang ris su bris/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'khyil zhing 'bab/ /ye shes gsal ba'i me 'od 'bar/ /rin chen byang chub shing gis gtams/ /padma'i sbu bas las brdzus te skye/ /bsam gtan zas kyis rtag tu /06

'tsho/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i gos kyis bklubs/ /rang lus 'od kyis 'jig rten snang / /thams cad bzod pa'i stobs dang ldan/ /kun kyang myang 'das bde ba che/ /rdo rje'i tshe la mnga' dbang thob/ /de phyir phal pa'i 'byung bzhi dang / /rtsi shing gzhan gyi ming yang med/ /ma dag skye ba rnam bzhis dben/ /bkres skom 'thab rtsod ga la yod/ /nyi zla sgron mes ci zhig bya/ /na tsha sdug bsngal rga shi med/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bral/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /chos kyi longs spyod rgyun mi chad/ /de tshe pad can mtsho dbus nas/ /pad ma gzhan kun zil gnon pa'i/ /pad ma'i rgyal po gzi 'od ni/ /nyi zla 'bum phrag bsdoms 'dra byung / /kun nas bye zhing rgyas pa'i khongs/ /mchog gi sprul pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /gangs ri'i phung po bye ba ltar/ /dme rdo zhing 'od 'phro 'dzum bag can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rgyan kun ldan/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs ga'i dbus/ /thal mo sbyar zhing zhi bar gzigs/ /g.yas kyi 'og mas shel dkar gyi/ /phreng ba 'dren zhing skye 'gro 'dul/ /g.yon gyi 'og mas pad dkar 'dzin/ /snyan gyi thad du bye zhing rgyas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ma lus bkra/ /e tu'i lgags pas phrag g.yon bkab/ /ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /'gro kun snying rje'i gsung dbyangs 'byin/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer ma gtogs pa/ /'od gzhan ma lus zil gnon pa'i/ /'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba zhig /sprin rum phye ba'i nyi bzhin byung / /rgyal po bzang po'i mchog gis blangs/ /de tshe 'od dpag med mgon gyis/ /'di ni mi 'byed 'dzam gling gi /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul/ /'dul ba'i sprul pa'i sku mchog ces/ /spyi bor phyag gis byugs mdzad de/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdul byar ma gyur pa/ /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi sems can rnams/ /smon lam mthu yis khyod kyis 'dul 'gyur 1 07

ba/ /legs so legs so rigs /kyi bu khyod legs/ kha ba can gnas 'gro kun gyis/ khyod mthong yig drug sgra thos nas/ /mod la ngan song las thar te/ /mtho ris lus mchog thob gyur cig /'dre srin gdon bgegs sha za'i tshogs/ /gzhan gyi mdangs 'phrog srog gcod pa/ /kun gyis khyod mthong yig drug thos/ mod la khro spangs byams ldan gyur/ /gcan gzan ma rungs gdug cing gtum/ /gzhan gyi sha khrug gis 'tsho rnams/ khyod mthong yig drug thos pa'i mod/ /bu la ma ltar byams ldan 'gyur/ /bkres skom gyis gzir nyam thag rnams/ khyod mthong yig drug thos tsam gyis/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis lus sems tshim/ /ting 'dzin zas mchog thob par 'gyur/ /dbang po ma tshang nad kyis mnar/ /mgon med rnams kyis khyod dran pas/ /nad bral dbang lus phun tshogs pa/ mthu stobs ldan pa'i lus gyur cig /khyod lus mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /'chi ba rnams kyi tshe sring zhing / /nad ldan nad las thar gyur cig /mgon med rnams la skyabs mchog gyur/ /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul khams der/ /yi dam lha yi skal ba khyod yin te/ /yi dam khyod la brten nas ma 'ongs dus/ /yul der sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'byung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /chos skal snying po yig drug 'di yin te/ /snying po 'di la brten nas ma 'ongs dus/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i gsung rab dam chos kun/ /yul der dar rgyas mi kun chos spyod 'gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad me sbyo/ /gzungs sngags rgyal po yig drug 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa'i mchog /gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid yin/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong po/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i snying po yin/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin rnams kyi/ /yang snying bsdus pa'i gzungs sngags yin/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dngos grub 108

kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam chen yin/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/chos kun snying po yig drug 'di/ /lan gcig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob ste/ /'gro kun sgrol ba'i ded dpon 'gyur/ /ngan song gsum du lhung bas kyang / /thos na lus de bor ma thag /bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /lan gcig tsam zhig dran pas kyang / /gangs la nyi 'od phog pa ltar/ /las ngan sdig sgrib srab mor byed/ /reg na rgyal ba sras bcas kun/ /gcig bsdus dbang bskur 'thob pa yin/ /lan gcig rnal 'byor byas pas kyang / /chos kun rnam sangs rgyas rtogs te/ /'gro ba sgrol pa'i 'phrin las byed/ /bris te lus la bcangs pa na/ /de lus rgyal ba'i ring bsrel yin/ /nad gdon kun las rnam par rgyal/ /gzungs sngags rgyal po yig drug 'di/ /rin po che dang dar zab nas/ /tha na rdo ba'i bar bris kyang / /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong ma lus bris pa ste/ /tshe gcig gis kyang byang chub 'thob/ /ri rab srang la gzhal bas grangs kyang chod/ /rgya mtsho'i bye ma 'bru nas bgrang bar nus/ /rgya mtsho skra rtses gtor bas zad nus mod/ /'di lan gcig bzlas bsod nams bgrang mi nus/ /mchu zheng dpag tshad lnga brgya til gyis bkang / /lo brgyar til re phyung yang zad par 'gyur/ khor yug nang khongs zhing gcig tu gyur pa'i/ /'bru kun re re nas kyang bgrang bar nus/ /'dzam gling chu bo lnga brgya chu bran bcas/ /rgya mtshor 'bab bzhin 'di yi dge ba 'phel/ /chu bo de kun thigs pas bgrang nus mod/ /lan gcig brjod pa'i bsod nams tshad mi zin/ /dud 'gro kun gyi spu tshogs re rer 'grongs/ /ka shi'i ras kyis rdo rje'i ri rab la/ /bskal rer lan re phyis kyang 'dzad 'gyur mod/ /'di lan gcig brjod mthu yang de lta min/ /skra rtse'i brgya chas rgya mtsho 'ching gnam che/ /thigs par byas pa'i tshad kyang 109

grangs kyis zin/ /lo gcig char bab char thigs grangs kyis chod/ /yig drug lan gcig bzlas pa'i mthu mi rtogs/ /gling bzhi'i mi rnams ring song sa thob pa/ /de kun bsod nams phung po gcig byas pa/ /de las gang gis yig drug lan gcig tsam/ /brjod pa'i bsod nams ches cher khyad par 'phags/ /sangs rgyas bye ba 'dus pas bskal pa'i bar/ /bstan yang phan yon phyogs re'ang mi rdzogs na/ /bde bar gshegs pa re res lta ci smos/ /snying po'i dam pa yi ge drug 'di yis/ /'gro ris drug gi sdug bsngal so sor sel/ /dri ma drug bsal pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po gcig gyur pa'o/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /'dus ste dbang skur dam pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs mchog de dbang bskur/ /'gro kun 'dul ba'i 'phrin las la/ /dbang phyir snang mtha' 'od dpag med/ /gtsug gi nor bu lta bur mdzes/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /mgrin gcig bsngags shing shis pa brjod/ /rgyal sras kun gyis 'dud cing mchod/ /slar yang 'od dpag med mgon gyis/ /phan yon dpag tu ma mchis shing / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las gcig tu gnas pa yi/ /snying po yi ge drug pa 'dis/ kha ba can gyi mtha' 'khob der/ /'gro kun smin zhing grol bar gyis/ /dam chos dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /de ltar dbugs dbyung lung bstan tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug de/ /pus btsugs thal sbyar 'di skad du/ /gsol zhing rang dam rang gis bcas/ /bdag gis sems can gcig kyang ma lus par/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu gzud par bgyi/ /'gro kun byang chub che la ma 'khod par/ /rang nyid zhi bde'i bsam pa skyes pa na/ /sangs rgyas ma lus bdag gis bslus pa'i phyir/ /mgo bo a dzha ka yi dog pa ltar/ /tshal pa bcur gas pad ma'i 'dab ma ltar/ /lus 110

kyang rnam pa stong du bye gyur zhes/ /snying rjes bden tshig smon lam mdzad par gyur/ /de yi 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha'/ /dpog nus 'jig rten kun na med/ /'on kyang rang gi dad pa'i rgyus/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po za ma tog /bkod pa las byung phyogs 'ga' zhig /mdor bsdus cung zad brjod par bya/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i lcags kyi khang / /'bar ba'i me spung gcig gyur kyang / /mun pa'i rang bzhin snang ba med/ /'gro tshogs grangs med sreg cing 'tshed/ /lhun po'ang thal bar byed pa der/ /lha rnams dga' ba'i tshal 'jug ltar/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po ni/ /snying rjes tsham tshom med par zhugs/ /yi ge drug pa'i sgra chen bsgrags/ /de ni nye bar song tsam gyis/ /dmyal ba'i me rnams rang sar zhi/ /tsandan lta bur bsil bar gyur/ /chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing / /padma utpa la yis khebs/ /dmyal ba'i snod rnams gas shing zhig /dmyal ba pa rnams sdug bsngal zhi/ /de nas lus sems tshim bzhin du/ /stos shig skyes bu 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /lta bas mi/ ngoms 'di mthong bas/ /bdag cag dbugs phyin gyur to zhes/ /phan tshun smra zhing skad cig gis/ /rtsa gsum lha yi nang du skyes/ /phyir mi ldog pa thob par gyur/ /dmyal srung gshin rje'i skyes bu kun/ /skrag cing 'jigs pas mtshon bor nas/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i drung song ste/ /lha gcig dmyal ba'i gnas 'dir ni/ /sngon med mi dge'i ltas byung ba/ /skyes bu lta na 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /rgyan kun gyis brgyan cod pan 'phyang / /de 'dra zhig ni 'ongs ma thag /dmyal ba'i za ma tog rnams gas/ /me zhi bsil ba'i rdzing bur gyur/ /srog chags de rnams mi snang ste/ /bdag cag rnams kyi las kyi sa/ /'di pa mkhyen bar mdzod ces so/ /gshin rje'i rgyal pos 'di lta bu/ /su yi mthu snyam brtags pa na/ /tshangs sogs lha rnams kun gyi nang / /de 'dra'i mthu yod ma mthong 111

nas/ /dmyal ba'i nang du bltas pa na/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs par mthong / /gshin rje'i rgyal pos lus btud de/ /de zhabs yang yang gtsug blangs nas/ /yon tan mchog gis rgya cher bstod/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po/ /dbang phyug chen po/ /dam pa la dgyes pa/ /dam pa stsol ba dbang du mdzad pa/ /sa'i spyan dam pa mdzad pa/ /dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa/ phyag brgya phrag stong pa/ spyan bye ba phrag brgya stong pa/ /dbu bcu gcig pa rgod pa'i bzhin/ lta ba'i mthar phyin pa'i chos la dgyes pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su thar bar mdzad pa/ rus spal dang chu srin dang nya rnams dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi phung po dam pa la mnga' mdzad pa/ dga' ba stsol ba rin po che'i dpal dam pa/ mnar med pa kun skem par mdzad pa/ye shes kyi dpal gyis brgyan pa ye shes la dgyes ba/ lha thams cad kyi mchod pa phyag 'tshal ba bkur sti bgyid pa/ mi 'jigs pa stsol ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug ston par mdzad pa/ nyi ma lta bu'i spyan mchog mdzad pa/ chos kyi sgron me mdzad pa/ ji ltar dgyes pa'i gzugs kyi gzugs mchog dri za'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ gser gyi ri'i gzugs dang mtshungs pa/ rgya mtsho 'ching gnam gyi khongs bzhin du zab pa/ don dam pa'i rnal 'byor rjes su thob pa bdag gi zhal ston par mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa mngon par dgyes par mdzad pa/ sku brgyan pa skyes bu khyu mchog khung sgo dang khong sgril dang 'phrul 'khor gyi lam las yongs su thar bar mdzad pa/ srid pa thams cad dang ma 'brel ba/ 'khor mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las bsaṭa pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che mdzad pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ston par mdzad pa/ yi dwags kyi grong khyer skem par mdzad pa/ skye bo la gdugs su gyur pa/ nad las yongs su thar bar mdzad pa/ klu'i rgyal po 11ཿ

dga' bo dang bsnyen dga' bos mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ don yod par 'gyur ba'i zhags pa ston par mdzad pa/ sngags brgya phrag du ma dang ldan pa/lag na rdo rje skrag par mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum po skrag par mdzad pa/gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po dang sha za dang phra men pho dang phra men mo dang ro langs dang grul bum dang rjed byed rnams skrag par mdzad pa/ spyan utpal sngon po lta bu/ rig pa'i rgyal po nyon mongs pa thams cad las grol bar mdzad pa/ lam sna tshogs las zlog pa thar pa dam pa la gzhug pa sku la byang chub kyi lam bsagal pa yi dwags yongs su thar bar mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin rdul phra rab lta bu brgya stong dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog de yang / /yi dwags grong khyer chen por song / /keng rus bsgrengs 'dra mgal dum lus/ /sto chen mgrin pa phra ba yi/ /yi dwags dpag med mdun na rgyug /'bar ba'i grong khyer bsil gyur zhing / /rdo rje'i ser ba rab tu zhi/ /srung ma rnams kyang byams pa thob/ /phyag sor zhabs sor nyi shu las/ /bdud rtsi'i chu bo re re ngab/ /ba spu'i khung bu kun nas kyang / /yan lag brgyad ldan chu byung ste/ /yi dwags kun gyis 'thungs tsam gyis/ kha dang mgrin pa yangs par gyur/ /lus yongs rdzogs shing bkres skom zhi/ /yi ge drug pa'i chos thos pas/ /'jig lta'i ri bo bcom nas ni/ /bde ba can du song bar gyur/ /de ltar skad cig re res kyang / /ngan 'gro'i gnas kun stongs par mdzad/ /de tshe shākya'i dbang pos bsngags mdzad de/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i spobs pa gang / /de 'dra de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la'ang med/ /sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhag mthong las/ /nga ni khye 'u spos kyi bzhin gyur pas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan brjod pa thos/ /mig gnyis las ni nyi ma zla ba byung / /dpral ba'i dbyes nas lha chen dbang phyug 1 13

ste/ /phrag pa'i lhun las tshangs pa chen po byung / /snying las khyab 'jug mche ba las lha mo/ kha las rlung lha rkang las sa yi lha/ /lto ba las ni chu yi lha byung tshe/ /rgyal ba de yis dbang phyug che bos nas/ /ma 'ongs pa na ngan pa'i dus byung tshe/ khyod ni 'jig rten byed por grags par 'gyur/ /sems can de dag byang chub lam spangs te/ /nam mkha' 'di ni dbang phyug chen po'i rtags/ /sa ni khri yin sems can kun gyi gnas/ /de ni zhi zhing rtag ces lta ngan 'dzin/ /byis pa blun po du ma bslu 'gyur gsungs/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba gtsug tor can gyi tshe/ /nga ni byang sems sbyin pa'i dpal du 'gyur/ /zhing de gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lta bur 'gyur/ /sa chen g.yo zhing padma'i char mang 'bab/ /bde ba can gyi 'od dpag med drung nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang zhing 'dir 'ong ba'i ltas/ /sems dpa' che de gang du 'ong bar yang / /chos nyid kyis ni 'di ltar snang ngo gsungs/ /de nas dkar zhing zhi ba'i gzugs can zhig /gser gyi padma rgyas pa 'dzin pas lhags/ /rgyal la phul nas bsnyun gsol smed par byed/ /mnar med la sogs tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ / shal ma li sogs nye 'khor gnas pa dang / /grang dmyal brgyad dang yi dwags 'gro ba kun/ /bdag gi las kyi sa ste der skyes rnams/ /sgrol zhing smin byed byang chub cher 'god ces/ /mchid lan gsol te glog bzhin mi snang gyur/ /spyan ras gzigal de'i bsod nams pha mtha' yas/ /de 'dra de bzhin gsheṭa pa rnams la'ang med/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bgrang bar yong mi nus/ /de yi mtshan tsam rjes su dran byed na'ang / /de dag bde ba kun dang ldan pa yin/ /rga nad 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal kun las thar/ /de dag lus de 'khor ba'i mtha' ma yin/ /gos gtsang dkar ltar yon tan tshon gyis 'jen/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po rab tu mgyogs pa dang / /rlung gi shugs ltar bde ba can du 'gro/ /de 114

bzhin ba/shegs pa snang ba mtha' yas mthong / /dngos su chos thos 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spong / /dug gsum mi 'gyur rga shir mi 'gyur ro/ /bkres srom mi 'byung phyin chad mngal mi gnas/ /chos kyi ngos bskyod zhing mchog de nyid du/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi yi dam brtan po ni/ /yongs su rdzogs dang 'gro kun ma thar bar/ /dag pa'i 'jig rten de na 'dzin zhing gnas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dam pa de/ /'khor ba'i sems can rgya mtsho ma lus pa/ /yongs su smin byed byang chub lam rab ston/ /gang gang gzugs kyis de de 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de dang de la gzugs des chos ston te/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis 'dul la sangs rgyas gzugs/ /de bzhin rang rgyal dgra bcom byang sems dang / /dbang phyug chen po mthu chen tshangs brgya byin/ /nyi ma zla ba me dang rlung gi lha/ /chu lha klu dang bgegs rgyal gnod sbyin dang / /ngal sos po dang rgyal po pha ma sogs/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i gzugs des chos ston to/ /der yang sems can yongs su smin byas nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sa rab ston par byed/ /re zhig 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid na yang / /rdo rje'i mngal zhes bya ba'i phug pa yod/ /lha min bye ba khrug khrig brgya stong gnas/ /de na spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po ni/ /lha min gzugs kyis theg pa chen po'i mdo/ /dkon mchog rgyal po za ma tog 'di 'chad/ /de dag byams dang zhi bas dam chos nyan/ /mdo sde'i dam pa 'di thos bde dang ldan/ /thos pas mtshams med lnga dag zad par byed/ /'chi ba'i tshe yang sangs rgyas bcu gcig 'byon/ /rigs kyi bu khyod tshur shog ma 'jigs shig khyod kyis za ma tog gi mdo sde thos/ /bde ba can gyi lam yang lta gon byas/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rna cha se mo do'i/ /rnam grangs dag kyang 'dir ni lta gon byas/ /tshur shog ces gsungs dbugs 'byin mdzad par 'gyur/ /de lta'i ltas 'byung 'chi ba'i dus 115

kyi tshe/ /bar chad med par bde ba can du 'gro/ /de ltar lha min chos kyis 'dul ba yod/ /gtsug tor can gyi rgyal ba de 'das nas/ /thams cad skyob ces bya ba'i sangs rgyas byung / /de tshe nga ni bzod pa smra bar gyur/ /rgyal ba thams cad skyob des spyan ras gzigs/ /dbang po'i yon tan rgya cher brjod pa thos/ /de ni gser gyi sa gzhir song / /sems can spyi'u tshugs rnams la/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa bstan/ /dngul gyi sa gzhir song nas kyang / /skyes bu rkang bzhi pa rnams la/ /mdo sde za ma tog bstan pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la bkod/ /gang na lcags kyi sa gzhi ni/ /lha min stobs ldan gnas par song / /rgyal la bsod stoms phul ba yi/ /bsod nams phung po'i chos sgo bshad/ /de tshe lha min dbang po de/ /ngud mo 'byin bzhin gsol bar byed/ /stobs ldan bdag ni slas bcas pas/ /dus min sbyin pa byas pa yis/ /tshe 'di nyid du bcings pa thob/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la dmigs nas/ /snyim pa gang gi sa gtor yang / /'bras bu bdud rtsir 'grub gyur na/ /bdag gis zhing ngan la byin pa'i/ /'bras bu myong 'di lags pa lta/ /bdag gis mchod sbyin bkad sa bshams/ /shing rta ba lang rta yi theg /rin chen dpag med kyis g.yogs pa/ /re re'ang stong phrag du ma bshams/ /bu mo gzhon nu re re yang / /rin thang med pa'i rgyan 'chang ba/ /lta na mdzes pa stong phrag bkod/ /rin chen khri dang khri 'u dang / /sna tshogs rin chen gos dang rgyan/ /re re'ang ri ltar spungs pa bkod/ /lha yi zas skom rgya cher sbyar/ /bram ze 'bum phrag du ma dang / /rgyal rigs 'bum phrag 'dus gyur te/ /sa chen 'di ni gdugs gcig bzhin/ /bdag gis rgyal po bgyis par gyur/ /bdag gis sdig par ma 'tshal nas/ /rgyal po yi ni chung ma rnams/ /snying gar dral te khye 'u dang / /bu mo gzhon nu mang srog bcad/ kha sha ban dha pa la sogs/ /116

rgyal rigs che rnams khung sgo dang / /lcags sgrog gis ni yan lag bcings/ /rgyal rib/sa 'bum phrag du ma rnams/ /zangs kyi brag phug nang du bstsal/ de la chab sgo bdun mchis te/ /dang po shing las bgyis pa lags/ /de bzhin seng ldeng 'khar ba dang / /zangs lcags dngul dang gser las bgyis/ /sgo 'phar de dag kun bcad de/ /gser gyi sgo der ri bo bdun/ /brtsegs ste bzhag pas rnam par bkag /thog ma'i sgrib pa de kun ni/ khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags/ /da dung bdag gis mthu bo che/ /shing rta bcu pa'i bu 'tshol phyir/ /gdugs re zhing du sbrang bu dang / /bong bu phag dang mi sogs su/ /gzugs bsgyur 'jig rten ku na btsal yang / /de ni mthong bar ma gyur nas/ /mchod sbyin bgyid par brtsams pa'i tshe/ /shing rta bcu pa'i bu 'ongs nas/ khya rnams dral te ri bdun bor/ /rgyal rigs btson du bcings rnams bkrol/ /bdag ni pho brang khrir 'khod tshe/ /zla ba'i gling nas slong ba'i phyir/ /'ongs zhes bram ze mi 'u thung / /spyig ma'i 'khar ba can zhig 'ongs/ /de tshe drang srong pa ba sangs/ /bdag gi mkhan por grags pas gnas/ /pa ba sangs kyis bdag bos nas/ /'dir ni dus kyi skyes bu 'ongs/ khyod kyis shes par gyis shig zer/ /bram ze des kyang de ma thag /bdag khar sā ra su sti bcug /ci 'dod slongs zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ /sa ni gom pa gnyis gsol zer/ khyod kyis gom pa gnyis bslangs na/ /bdag gis gom pa gsum sbyin mri sa/ /des kyang bdag gis bsgang ba bslangs/ /bkra shis so zhes brjod byas nas/ /chu rgyun til dang gser bcas bslangs/ /pa sangs bdag la 'di skad du/ /rgyal po drang srong khyod kyis ni/ /bdag gi tshig 'a/ ma nyan pas/ /las de'i 'bras bu myong gyis zer/ /de ma thag du khyab 'jub des/ /mi 'u thung gzugs mi snang byas/ /lus ni chen por bsgyur ba dang / /nyi zla de yi 117

phrag par gnas/ /lag na mtshon mang thogs par mthong / /de yis gom pa gnyis bor bas/ /sa chen 'di ni rab tu mnan/ /gom pa gnyis sna 'di yis tshang / /da ni gsum pa byin cig zer/ /gsum pa ma mchis zhes smras pas/ / kho bos bslang ba bslangs zin gyis/ /nga yis gang du bzhag pa der/ /lha min khyod ni 'dug cig lo/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal dran nyams te/ /bka' bstsal de bzhin bgyid ces smras/ khyab 'jug mthu bo che de yis/ /bden pa'i zhags pas bdag bcings te/ /'jig rten gyi ni byed po bzhin/ /bdag ni sa yi 'og du bzhag /mchod sbyin gnas bshig yo byad rnams/ /rgyal rigs de dag rnams kyis spyad/ /de bas lha min stobs ldan bdag /thabs ma 'tshal bas gnas min gyi/ /sbyin pas bcings pa thob par gyur/ /kye ma las la phyag 'tshal snyam/ /rang gi las la sems shing 'dug /de bas bdag gis ngan pa yi/ /zhing la byin zhes gsol lags te/ /phyag na padma bzang po thogs pas skyabs mdzod cig padma'i dpal gyis brgyan pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ /thams cad mkhyen pas dbu brgyan 'gro kun dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /dman dang phongs la thugs brtse pad ma'i spyan bzang po/ /sa yi spyan mchog sman pa'i rgyal po'i mchog gyur pa/ /sems can shin tu dag pa rnal 'byor rab thob cing / /thar mchog thar pa la dgyes yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /chos mdzad yongs su skyong mdzad pha rol phyin drug ston/ /bsam pa legs par byed pa khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang khyod mtshan gang gis dran byed pa'i/ /sems can de dag bde ba dam par ldan pa lags/ /dmyal ba kun dang yi dwags grong khyer du skyes pa/ /gang dag khyod mtshan rjes su dran byed de dag ni//ngan song sdug bsngal che las yongs su thar ba lags/ khyod mtshan rjes su dran byed sems can de dag ni/ /bsam pa legs ldan bde ba can gyi 'jig 118

rten 'gro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas las chos nyan 'gyur/ /de ltar bstod cing 'dud pa yi/ /lha min dbang po dbugs 'byin phyir/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan pa/ /khyod ni bde gshegs rdzobang sangs rgyas / /lha min dbang po'i dpal zhes 'gyur/ /lha min thams cad byang chub 'dul/ /khyod 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing de na/ /dug gsum sgra med yig drug gi /rig pa'i rgyal po 'thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar lung bstan lha min dbang po yis/ /chos kyi dgab par ma tig se mo do/ /stong phrag 'dom ldan rin thang med pa dang / /༄cod pan rin chen kun gyis brgyan pa phul/ /slar yang spyan rarnga gzigs kyis chos bstan pa/ /lha min rgyal po chen po khyod nyon zhig /mi rtag pa yi rang bzhin dngos rnams la/ /rtag tu len sems longs spyod yid la byed/ /bran dang bran mo las mi nor dang 'bru/ /mdzod dang bang ba bu dang bu mo dang / /chung ma dang ni pha mar zhen pa yi/ /sems can de dag mi shes gti mug ste/ /de dag rmi lam mi shes 'khrul ba 'dra/ /'chi ba'i tshe yang skyabs byed su yang med/ /srog bral tshe yang 'dzam gling log par mthong / /chu chen po yang rnag khrag gis gang mthong / /ljon shing la yang 'bar ba'i phung por snang / /mthong nas skrag 'gyur gshin rje'i skyes bu yis/ /zhags pas bcings nas ngan 'gror 'khrid par 'gyur/ /spu gri'i so yi lam gyis rkang pa chad/ /bteg tshe rkang pa gsar pa gzhan 'byung 'gyur/ /bya rog bya rgod ku ra ra dang khyi/ /du mas za zhing dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong / /spu gri'i so yi lam chen de 'das nas/ /rkang pa re re la yang bcu drug gi /sor tshad lcags kyi tsher ma lnga brgya 'dzug /bdag gis sdig pa ci zhig byas zhes 'khang / /de tshe gshin rje rnams kyis 'di skad sgrog sngon tshe rgyal la mchod pa ma byas shing / /yon gnas rnams la bsod stoms ma phul lo/ /gaṭi brdung ba'i sga yang ma thos so/ /sku gzugs mchod 119

rten skor ba ma byas zhes/ /spyos shing brgyad bkag slar zhing sdug bsnga' bas/ / kye ma bdag cag ma dad sdig pa can/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis spangs par gyur to ces/ /smre sngags 'don tshe gshin rje'i skyes bu yis/ /las de'i 'bras bu 'di yin myong gyis zhes/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i drung du khrid pa'i tshe/ /deng la las kyi sa rnams 'di la ston/ /rnam par smin pa yod med ltos shig bsgo/ /de nas thig nag dmyal ba chen por bcug /shag ti brgya dang sum brgya btab pas kyang / /shi bar ma gyur de tshe me 'obs 'dzud/ /de nas lcags tho bsregs pa khar bcug pas/ /mchu tshig so chag rkan gas nang rol kun/ /'ur 'ur gcig tu 'bar zhing lus kun 'tshig /de bas rgyal po 'jig rten 'di na ni/ /skyabs su gyur pa gzhan yod ma yin te/ /nan tan du ni bsod nams gsag par gyis/ /de ltar bstan nas spyan ras gzigs dbang de/ /gang na sa phyogs mun pa mun nag gnas/ /lha dang mi rnams mi rgyu'i phyoṭa su song / /gling der nyi ma zla ba mi snang ste/ /nor bu mchog sbyin zhes byas snang ba byed/ /de na gnod sbyin srin po brgya stong gnas/ /de dag za ma tog gi mdo sdes btul/ /mdo 'di'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig kho na/ /nyan 'dzin sems pa'i bsod nams gzhal du med/ /rgya mtsho'i chu thigs sa gzhi'i bra rab rdul/ /grangs kyis zin mod mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa'i/ /bsod nams dam pa gzhal du yod ma yin/ /gling bzhi'i khyim gyi rnam pa ji snyed ba/ /de snyed lha rdzas gtsug lag khang byas te/ /re rer rin chen mchod rten ring bsrel can/ /stong stong nyin rer bgyis pa'i dge ba ni/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa'i bsod nams cha gcig 'gyur/ /gaṅgā bcu gnyis bye snyed rgyal ba yis/ /bcu gnyis bskal par mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa'i/ /bsod nams phung po rjod kyis mi lang na/ /nga gcig 'di na gnas pas smos ci dgos/ /mdo 'di yi ger bris sam 'brir 120

bcug pa/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bris pa ste/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bde ba du mar myong / /mdo 'di'i ming tsam 'dzin yang srid las thar/ /ga la ga lar skye ba de kun du/ /tshe rabs dran 'gyur de yi lus la ni/ /tsandan rgyal po sa mchog dri ngad ldang / kha nas utpal sngon po'i dri bsung spro/ /lus yongs rdzogs shing stobs chen shugs ldan 'gyur/ /de ltar bstan pas mun khams 'gro de kun/ /phyir 'ong dang ni phyir mi 'ong la bkod/ /spyan ras gzigs de skad cig yud tsam gyis/ /gnas gtsang lha yi gnas su song bar gyur/ /de na rna cha'i mchog ces lha yi bu/ /shin tu dbul ba zhig gnas de drung du/ /bram ze'i gzugs kyis bsod stoms slong mo spyad/ /de yis bdag la cang ma mchis zhes smras/ /bdag la cung zad stsol zhes smras pa na/ /lha des bdag gi gzhal med khang song ste/ /ci bdog lta bar brtsams tshe snod thams cad/ /lha yi nor bu rin thang med las gang / /snod gzhan ro mchog ldan pa'i bdud rtsis gtams/ /g.yon phyogs khang pa gos rgyan gyis gang mthong / /bdag gis deng dus 'di lta'i dpal thob pas/ /bdag gi sgo na snod bzang bdog go snyam/ /bram ze bos te bdud rtsi'i zas mchog byin/ /lha yi rin chen du ma bstabs pa las/ /de yis bde legs bkra shis byas par gyur/ /lha des bram ze khyod ni ga las 'ongs/ /sa de ci 'dra khyod ni su zhig dris/ /nga ni dze ta'i tshal nas 'ongs pa ste/ /sa de dga' byed yon tan dpag tu med/ /rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa zhes bya bzhugs/ /nga ni lha min mi dang lha min min/ /phongs dang dbul la lhag par brtse ldan pa/ /byang chub lam ston byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /lha des nor bu'i cod pan dang / /rna cha phul te ched brjod pa/ /e ma ho yono tan dag gi zhing / /nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /de ring nyid du sa bon btab/ /de ring nyid du 'bras bu grub/ /121

spyan ras gzigs dbang de yang ni/ /srin mo gnas pa'i gling zhig song / skyes bu lta na mi ngoms pa/ /'dod pa'i gzugs su bstan byas pas/ /srin mo de rnams rab chags te/ /bdag cag lus dang longs spyod kun/ khyod la dbul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /bdag cag mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gling / /rten gnas mdzod ces gsol ba 'debs/ /des kyang bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin/ /byed na dang du blang ngo brjod/ /de dag bka' bzhin sgrub par byas/ /yan lag brgyad ldan lam bstan zhing / /zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzhi dag kyang / /kha thon byed du bcug pa yis/ /de dag 'bras bu'i gnas la bkod/ /phyin chad srin mo'i tshul spangs te/ /dam pa'i sdom pas bsdams te gnas/ /de nas wa ra ṇa si'i 'gram/ /bshang gci'i gnas na srin bu'i rigs/ /brgya stong du ma gnas par song / /bung ba'i gzugs su sprul nas ni/ /sgra ni bung bung phyung ba las/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod/ /de dag rna bar thos tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran gyur te/ /'jig lta'i ri bo bcom nas ni/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten song / /spos dri zhim pa zhes bya ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpar ming mthun gyur/ /de nas ma ga dha 'das pa/ /dgon pa chen po'i gnas su song / /de na lo grangs nyi shu'i bar/ /dgon par gnas pa'i sems can tshogs/ /gcig gis gcig za mang gzigs te/ /thog mar lha yi chu yi char/ /phab pas rab tu ngoms par byas/ /lha yi zas kyi char phab pas/ /tshim tshe 'bru dang 'dod rgu'i char/ /phab pas rab tu tshim pa'i tshe/ /de dag 'dus nas gcig la gcig /'di 'dra lha gang zhig gi mthu/ /de tshe de na ches rgan pa/ /rgur po ba lang sna ltar gyur/ /brgya stong lo lon zhig gnas pas/ /bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /ma gtogs lha gzhan gang gi yang / /mthu 'di 'dra bar rmi 'gyur ro / /mun par gyur la 122

sgron me nyi mas 'tshig la gdugs/ /skom gyis gdungs la chu ste skrag pa'i dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /nad kyis gdungs la sman pa nyam nga'i pha mar gyur/ /mnar med skyes pa rnams la mya ngan 'das lam ston/ /spyan ras gzigagade'i yon tan rgya chen de lta yin/ /de yi mtshan tsam sus dran pa/ /de ni 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /de ni 'khor ba'i mtha' ma yin/ /bcom ldan 'das de la dmigs nas/ /rtag tu me tog spos 'bul ba/ /de ni byang chub sems dpar 'gyur/ /maṭaṃl phul na 'khor sgyur 'thob/ /me tog phul bas dri zhim zhing / /mdangs bzang lus yongs rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de ltar bstan te rang gnas song / /spyan ras gzigs dbang dam pa yang / /'ong ba'i ltas chen ngo mtshar ba/ /rgyal sras gzhan la med pa'i chos/ /dpag yas phul byung ngo mtshar gyis/ /dze ta'e tshal kun bkang byas nas/ /rgyal ba thams cad skyob drung song / /rgyal shā sa bsngags shing rlabs chen gyi/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho de thos pas/ /rgyal sras ma lus ngo mtshar gyur/ /'di ni rnam par snang byed 'dod byed la sogs pa/ /ting 'dzin mtha' yas gzhal du med pa ldan pa ste/ /spu khung re na'ang ting 'dzin brgya stong du ma gnas/ /'di yi bsod nams ye shes de ltar dpag tu med/ /tshogs chen de lta de bzhin gshegs la'ang ma mchis na/ /byang chub sems dpar gyur pa dag la lta ci smos/ /legs par nyon zhig sngon byung tshe/ /nga ni tshong dpon zhig du gyur/ /de tshe tshong pa lnga brgyar bcas/ /siṅgha'i gling du tshong la song / /thong mang bzhon pas bskyas byas te/ /grong dang grong khyer grong brdal ljongs/ /tshong 'dus mang po rnams brgyud nas/ /rgya mtsho'i gru bo che la zhugs/ /gru yi gdos pa 'dzin pa la/ /ci ko rin chen gling logs sam/ /nas kyi gling ngam siṅgha'i gling / /'on te srin mo'i gling du'am/ /gang gi phyogs su rlung langs dris/ /des kyang siṅgha'i 123

gling logs su/ /gser ma langs kyis lha khyod kyis/ /mkhyen par mdzod ces bdag la smras/ /de nas gru chen du zhugs te/ /dar chen rab tu 'phyar nas song / /'dir gzhan dag gis smras pa/ /gnam sngon zhu ba 'khyil 'dra bee ḍūrya/ /sngon po'i gur gyis phyogs kun gtams pa bzhin/ /dbu ba'i do shal chil chil sgra ldan pa/ /mu tig do shal kun nas bkram pa bzhin/ /nya chen sna tshogs 'phyo nga zhing 'khyug pa ni/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos sprul pa byas pa bzhin/ /mi brtan pa rnams 'di ko rmi lam mam/ /4ngon sum nyid ces som nyi'i khyogs la 'phyang / ra ba yangs pha mtha' mi mngon mtsho chen de/ /yangs pa'i mkha' dang dbyer med gyur pa'i nang / /nyi zla gza' skar 'khor ba snyam du byed/ /de steng gru chen nang na gzhal med khang / /rgyan mang gis spras rgyal mtshan ba dan 'phyar/ /rta mchog mtsho chen brgal ba'i dbyibs kyis 'gro/ /res 'ga' rlabs kyi ri bo'i rtser/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su phyin pa snyam/ /res 'ga' rlabs kyi gshong bu ru/ /gting du nub pa snyam du byed/ /res 'ga' nya chen rus spal che/ /ri bo 'dra bas 'degs pa snyam/ /'dis ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /mi yi gru bzang rnyed dka' ba/ /rnyed pa'ang sna tshogs rkyen mang pos/ /mi brtan g.yo 'di mtshon nam snyam/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /de tshe siṅgha'i gling gnas pa'i/ /srin mo gdug sems ldan rnams kyi/ /re ba'i rgyal mtshan g.yos pa las/ /'dzam gling tshong pa 'ong ngo zhes/ /dus min rlung chen btang ba yis/ /gru de dum bu dum bur lhags/ /tshong pa de rnams brkyal ba yis/ /chu yi 'gram du phyin par gyur/ /de tshe srin mo lnga brgya zhig /bud med gzhon nur gzugs bsgyur nas/ /der 'ongs ca co'i sgra 'byin zhing / /ras kyi bla gos byin te blangs/ / tshong pa de dag rang rang gi /gos btsir skam par gyur pa'i tshe/ /tsam pa ka yi shing drung gnas/ /'dir 124

smras pa/ /dus min rlung chen mun pa 'khyil 'dra drag tu 'tshub pa kun nas langs/ /rgya mtsho'i chu kun srog chags bcas pa nam mkhar skas la 'dzeg pa snyam/ /chil chil 'ur 'ur chem chem sgra ldan dbu bar bcas pa'i chu'i phung po//ke la sha yi ri bor 'gran pas gru chen mkhar 'degs gting du 'dor/ /tshong pa'i tshogs rnams ci bya gtol bral pha ma phu nu gnyen bshes 'bod/ /brtan por 'dod rnams tshangs dang brgya byin phyugs bdag sogs la 'bod cing gsol/ /de tshe skyob pa su yang med de gru chen tshal pa tshal par lhags/ /'di ni mi lus gru bzang 'di/ /mtho ris yon tan rgyan du mas/ /mdzes shing spa bar byas na yang / /'chi bdag srin mos btang ba yi/ /rga nad rlung dmar drag g.yo bas/ /lus kyi gru dang sems kyi mi/ /so sor 'byed pa mtshon nam snyam/ /skyabs min skyabs su 'khrul ba rnams/ /ri shing mtsho dang gnyen dang ni/ rgyal po lha dang lha min sogs/ /skyabs su gsol mod rang nyid kyang / /mtshor lhung de yis su zhig skyob/ /rga nad shi ba'i 'jigs chen la/ /skyabs gyur dam chos las gzhan med/ /gting mtha' mi mngon chu gter du nub mi de rnams/ /brkyal ba'i shugs kyis pha rol 'gram ngogs phyin par gyur/ /de tshe'ang srin mo'i tshogs la sdug pa'i 'du shes 'dzin/ /lcags kyus nya bzhin g.yo yib/ bslus la phan par 'khrul/ /'dis ni lnga par gyur rnams kyang / /pha mtha' mi mngon bar ma do'i/ /srid par 'khyams shing las kyis brkyal/ /de tshe'ang srid pa'i btson ra la/ /chags dang sred pas bcings pa yis/ /skye ba'i 'dam du 'tshud gyur pa/ /'di nyid mtshon nga ra byed dam snyam/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /de nas tshong pa de rnams kyis/ /bdag cag 'dzam bu'i gling phyin pa'i/ /thabs ci yod ces dris pa na/ /bud med de dag bdag cag la/ /thabs ma mchis zhes kha rog 'khor/ /slar yang bzhin gyi 125

mdangs phyung ste/ /zur mig g.yo bas bslu bzhin par/ /bdag cag bud med gzhon nu ste/ khyim thab dang ni gnas rten mdzod/ /'di rnams khyed cag rnams kyi ni/ khab dang skyed mos tshal lo zhes/ /zer zhing tshong pa re re khrid/ /de dag rnams kyi gtso mo des/ /bdag khrid lha yi kha zas kyi/ /ro yi mchog gis tshim par byas/ /de nas rtse bar rtsom pa la/ /mi yi reg pas tshim byas te/ /de ltar zhag bdun 'das par gyur/ /de nas re zhig bud med de/ /gnyid kyis log bzhin gad mo'i sgra/ /rab tu snyan pa rgod pa thos/ /ngo mtshar skyes nas dris pa dang / /de yis 'di ni siṅgha la'i/ /gling gi srin mo'i gnas lags te/ khyod srog bcad par gyur ta re/ /zhes zer rgyu mtshan ci zhes dris/ /des kyang khyod thugs mi 'ches na/ /g.yas kyi lam srang zung la bzhud/ /de na lcags kyi grong khyer ni/ /mtho zhing ra bas bskor ba la/ /skar khung rta babs med pa cig /mchis par tshong pa brgya stong ni/ /bstsal zhing bor nas la la gson/ /la la gum ste gnas kyis gzigs/ /zhis zer ngas kyang glen pa yi/ /dra ba zhes bya'i gnyid stug gis/ /bud med de ni non byas nas/ /bdag nyid 'tsho bar byed pa yi/ /ral gri zla ba ltar snang thogs/ /g.yas phyogs lam srang bzung ste phyin/ /lcags kyi grong khyer chen po de/ /kho ra khor yug tu bskor yang / /de la bu ga yod ma mthong / /de drung me tog tsam pa ku'i/ /sdong po cig ni 'dug pa la/ /'dzegs te lu ba'i sgra byas pas/ /tshong pa mang po de kun gyis/ /tshong dpon chen po mkhyen par mdzod/ /'di ni srin mo'i gling yin te/ bdag cag lcags kyi khang par bstsal/ /'dzam gling tshong pa 'ongs pa rnams/ /phyi ma rtse dgas brid byed cing / /snga ma lcags khang 'di ru 'dzud/ /nyin re bzhin yang mi brgya brgya/ khrid de zos nas rus pa rnams/ /lcags kyi grong khyer 'di ru 'dor/ /zhes te sngon bzhin smras par 126

gyur/ /ngas kyadzirnga myur bar slar log tshe/ /snyan par rgod cing de na re/ /gzigs sam rtags la bab bam zer/ /thabs ni gang gis thar zhes dris/ /rta mchog rgyal po bā la ha/ /zhes bya snying rjer ldan pa cig /bco lnga'i zla ba nya tshe 'byung / /rta mchog cang shes dam pa des/ /the ta thams cad ces bya ba'i/ /sman gyi rgyal po zos nas ni/ /beeṭurya yi bye ma'i dbus/ /chu rgyun yan lag brgyad pa 'thungs/ /gser gyi bye ma'i ngos la ni/ /phan tshun 'gre zhing sprug par byed/ /'di nas pha rol su 'gro zhes/ /mi yi skad du smra zhing 'tsher/ /de tshe khyod kyis rta rgyal mchog /bdag ni pha rol 'gro zhes smros/ /de skad bsgo ba mnyan byas nas/ /mal du lhan cig nyal ba dang / /bud med de yang sad gyur te/ /'phags pa'i sras khyod lus re grang / /zhes zer grong gi phyi rol du/ /bshang gci'i ched du phyin zhes brjod/ /de nas gdugs shar gyur pa'i tshe/ /tshong pa'i tshogs rnams grong khyer gyi/ /phyir khrid dben par song nas ni/ /mchis brang ji ltar mdza' zhes dris/ kha cig bdag la mdza' zhing gus/ /rtse dgas yongs su 'dzin to zer/ /de bzhin lha yi zas skom dang / /gos dang rgyan dang dri sogs kyis/ /yid rab 'dzin zhes so sor smras//kha cig bdag la ci yis kyang / /brel ba med pas skyid do zer/ /nga yis bdag cag srin mo la/ /chags par bya ba mi rigs smras/ /de dag myos nas ci lags ko /srin mo lags pa mad dam zer/ /ngas kyang dkon mchog gsum bden na/ /nges par srin mo 'o zhes smras/ /de kun da ni skyabs su yod/ /ci yis thar par 'gyur zhes 'dri/ /rta mchog rgyal po'i tshul brjod de/ /da ni bco lnga'i mtshan mo'i tshe/ /bud med de rnams myosu byed kyi/ /sman gyis so sor myos par gyis/ /myos tshe gser gyi bye ma'i steng / /rta mchog drung du 'dus zhes smras/ /de nas bco lnga'i zla ba ni/ /rab gsal dkar ba'i 127

'od bkye tshe/ /rta mchog de ni zla ba yi/ /zer dang 'grogs te gling der 'ongs/ /sman zos chu 'thungs 'gre zhing sprugs/ /de tshe siṅgha'i gling kun 'gul/ /'dzam bu'i gling du su 'gro zhes/ /lan gsum smras tshe bdag cag ni/ /sgro/la bar mdzod ces kun gyis smras/ khyed cag sus kyang gling 'di la/ /phyi mig lta bar mi bya'o/ /gang la'ang chags par ma byed cig /ces smras thog mar nga yis bzhon/ /de nas gzhan kun bzhon byas te/ /nyi zla bzhin du mkha' la chas/ /de tshe srin mo de dag rnams/ /sad de phyi bzhin bstegs byas nas/ snying rje'i skad du smre sngags bton/ /de tshe nga yi tshong phrug rnams/ /chaṭa te slar log bltas pa dang / kha bub lhung ste chu nang nub/ /bud med de rnams sprul pa bshig /ral pa gzings shing mig dmar la/ /mche ba'i dbal can srin mo yi/ /rang gzugs bstan te mi de rnams/ /chu nas drangs te yud kyis zos/ khrag thigs bo ba'i sa rnams kyang / /mdzub mos drud cing za bar byed/ /rta mchog 'dzam bu'i gling phyin tshe/ /lhung ba'i tshong phrug rnams la ni/ /mya ngan byed cing mchi ma phyung / /nga la lan gsum bskor byas nas/ /rta mchog de ni mi snang gyur/ /ngas kyang rim gyis khyim du phyin/ /pha ma gnyis ni mya ngan gyis/ /mig ldongs gyur pas bdag 'ongs par/ /shes te mgul nas 'jus te ngus/ /bslangs pas mig kyang dag par gyur/ /bdag cag nor ni mi dgos kyi/ /bu khyod gson par rnyed do zer/ /nye dur bcas pa kun dga' gyur/ /'dir smras pa/ /srin mos mdzes par bsgyur ba yi/ /gzugs dang lang tsho bza' btung dang / /rgyan dang rtse dgas brid pa ltar/ /tshe 'dir 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi/ /snang ba yud tsam 'di yis 'brid/ /mtha' mar srin mos rang gzugs nyid/ /bstan nas za bar byed pa ltar/ /'dus byas rang sor mdzes na yang / mtha' mar mi rtag 'jig pa dang / /sdug bsngal las 128

kyang sdug bsngal ba'i/ /rang gzugs mngon sum gsal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar srin mo'i gtso mo des/ /gya gyus bslu bar brtson na yang / /gnyid ni 'thibs pochu/ non pa'i tshe/ /rang mtshang rang gis bsgrags pa ltar/ /'dus byas snang ba 'di kun yang / /brtags na rang mtshang rang gis ston/ /lcags khang bor ba'i tshong pa yis/ /srin mo'i ngang tshul mngon sum du/ /rig ltar gshin rje'i rgyal po'i drung / /bgrod tshe kun gyis las 'bras mthong / /lcags khang sra ba der 'tshud nas/ /shes kyang bya ba'i thabs zad ltar/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhir bzos pa'i tshe/ /las 'bras go yang 'phyis pa yin/ /srin mos zin rnams 'don pa'i phyir/ /rta mchog rgyal pos brtson pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /'gro kun gnas na gzhan don brtson/ /'on kyang zla ba nya tshe las/ /gzhan du rta rgyal mi snang ltar/ /dge ba'i cha shas ma rdzogs par/ /bshes gnyen dam pa 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /gting zab rgya mtsho'i nang gnas pa'i/ /nyam nga srin mo'i gling de nas/ /gzhan gyis thar bar mi nus kyang / /rta rgyal stobs chen la brten nas/ /yud kyis 'dzam gling bgrod pa ltar/ /'jigs rung srid pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /gting mtha' mi mngon phyogs zhakhrul ba/ /'di las thar thabs gzhan med kyang / /dge ba'i gshes gnyen dam pa la/ /bsten na thar par yud kyis bgrod/ /rta rgyal phan par dga' ba de'i/ /tshig bzhin ma byas srin mo yi/ /lus dang longs spyod la chags pas/ /phyi mig lta ba'i tshong pa rnams/ /bzhon yang lhung nas srin mo yis/ /zos ltar yongs 'dzin bsten gyur kyang / /de yis bstan pa'i gdams ngag bzhin/ /blang dor legs par ma byas te/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa la zhen na/ /lhung ste ngan 'gror thug med 'gro/ blo gros brtan zhing rab tu zab/ /rta rgyal tshig la yid 'ches pa/ /srin mo'i gling gi tshul rig pas/ /nges par 'dzam gling 'gro 129

'dod pa'i/ /ded dpon bde blag thar ba ltar/ /srid pa'i ngang tshul yongs rig pas/ /thar pa'i grong du 'gro 'dod pa/ /yongs 'dzin srog ltar bsten pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog du bde blag 'gro /ded dpon des kyang pha ma yi/ /mya ngan bsal zhing mig phye nas/ /nye du dga' bar byas pa ltar/ /byang chub thob nas mar gyur pa'i/ /'gro kun bde ba'i gnas la 'god/ /de ltar sngon byung gtam 'di yis/ /chos tshul rgya cher bstan pa snyam/ /bar skabs kyi tshags su bcad pa'o/ /sgrib pa rnams sel nyon zhig nga ni ded dpon tshe/ /de lta'i sdug bsngal 'jigs rung mi bzad myong ba las/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po ni/ /rta mchog stobs chen gyur pas 'chi ba'i 'jigs las bsgral/ /spyan ras gzigs de'i bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs ni nga yis bgrang mi nus/ /ba spu'i khung bu re re'i gtam/ /cung zad bshad kyis nyan par gyis/ /gser zhes bya ba'i spu khung na/ /dri za khrag khrig brgya stong gnas/ /kun kyang 'phags pa'i chos la gnas/ /snang ba'i yid bzhin nor bu las/ /dgos 'dod ji ltar bsams pa 'grub/ /nag po zhes bya'i spu khung na/ /mngon par shes ldan drang srong tshogs/ /gser gyi ri dang rin chen gyi/ /ljon pa la brten mtha' yas gnas/ /spu khung rin chen rna cha na/ /chags bral dri za'i bu mo'i tshogs/ /gzugs/ mchog ldan pa mtha' yas gnas/ /spu khung de kun nam mkha' bzhin/ /bzung dang reg par mi nus so//kun du bzang pos lo bcu gnyis/ /song yang spu khung de ma mthong / /ba spu'i khung bu re re na/ /gnas pa des kyang ma mthong na/ /rgyal sras gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ /nga ni g.yo med sgyu spangs phra bar snang zhing blta ru med / /gzugs med gzugs che lag pa brgya stong dbu ni bcu gcig ldan/ /bye ba brgya stong spyan mnga' rnal 'byor chen po rnal 'byor mchog /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam 130

gnas dpe med thugs mnga' shes rab che/ /srid las rgal byed dbang po ltar mi snang zhing chos ston mkhas/ /chos rnams thams cad kun tu sgrib pa med par gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po sus kyang mi mthong ste/ /de yi rang bzhin nyid kyi lus ni rgyal bas mi gzigs na/ /kun tu bzang sogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis lta ci smos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang de ni cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab ston/ /bye ba khrug khrig brgya stong du ma'i sems can yongs smin byed/ /de kun byang chub lam 'jog bde ba can gyi 'jig rten 'gro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med mthong dam chos nyan pa 'thob/ /gzhan yang ba spu'i khung bu ni/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa ces bya yod/ /sar gnas lha sras tshogs kyis gang / /dri za'i glu dbyangs kyis gang ba'i/ /rin chen ri bor ngal gso la/ /theg chen chos kyi gtam bgro zhing / /byams ldan 'chag par brtson pas gang / /de nas spu khung rdo rje'i sgor/ /rin chen ri dang ljon pa dang / /rjing bu khang bzang bsam las 'das/ /rgyal sras yon tan che ldan pa'i/ /mi 'am ci tshogs de na gnas/ /phar phyin drug gi gtam byed cing / /rin chen 'chag sa rnams na 'chag /rtag par spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan/ /rjes su dran par byed pa ste/ /de tshe yo byad ma lus 'byung / /de 'das nas ni ba spu'i khung / /nyi ma'i 'od ces bya ba yod/ /re re'ang rtse mo khri nyis stong / /ldan pa'i gser gyi ri bo khri/ /re re'i ngos kyang lha rdzas kyi/ /skyed tshal khang bzang rdzing ljon shing / /brgya stong bye ba du mas brgyan/ /rin chen sha ri ti ga las/ /yo byad ma lus thams cad 'byung / /rgyal sras bye ba brgya stong ni/ /yig drug rjes su dran pa'i mod/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sa rtogs shing / /rgyal ba bdun dang spyan ras gzigs/ /kun nas gshegs te dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /gzhan yang ba spu'i khung bu ni/ /dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya 131

yod/ /rgyal sras phyir mi ldog sha stag /bye ba brgya stong mang po gnab// /'khor b.ri du kha'i ming yang med/ /lha yi gser khri brgyad khrir 'khod/ /padma ltar snang nor bu las/ /ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du 'grub/ /de nas ba spu'i khung bu ni/ /rtsi sman chen po zhes bya yod/ /thog ma'i sems bskyed ldan pa yi/ /rgyal sras khrag khrig mtha' yas gnas/ /srid pa'i du khas yid skyo zhing / /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la/ /mnyam par 'jog pas 'da' bar byed/ /de nas sna tshogs rgyal zhes pa'i/ /spu khung na ni rang sangs rgyas/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gnas/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston par byed/ /rin chen ri rgyal sna tshogs la/ /gnas shing rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /chos kyi gtam chen bgro bar byed/ /de sogs brjod du med pa yi/ /ba spu'i khung bu 'das nas ni/ /kun gyi mtha' mar spu khung ni/ /rgyal mtshan rgyal po zhes bya yod/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin te/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong ldan/ /rin chen ri dang nor bu yi/ /ljon shing khang brtsegs tshogs kyis gtams/ /zla ltar bzang ba'i rin chen gyis/ /rtag tu snang ba'i bya ba byed/ khang brtsegs rnams na rgyal ba'i sku/ /'dzam gling 'di la zhal phyogs nas/ /phar phyin drug gi chos ston pa/ /re re bzhugs shing 'gro ba 'dul/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong las/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi byung ste/ /re re'ang gting dpagami nus so/ /rgod ma'i kha yi gdong 'drar 'bab/ /de tshe thal ba'i lhag ma ltar/ /skad cig gis ni mi snang 'gyur/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug gi /yon tan rnam 'phrul de 'dra 'o/ /spyan ras gzigs de'i mtshan tsam zhig /gang gis 'dzin par byed pa dang / /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngas/sa kyi/ /rgyal mo rjes su dran byed pa/ /de dag ba spu'i khung bu yi/ /zhing mchog de dag rnams su skye/ /slan chad srid par mi 'bor 132

te/ /ba spu'i khung nas ba spu yi/ /khung bu gzhan du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mtha' yi bar/ /zhing mchog de dag rnams su gnas/ /de ltar ston pas bka' bstsal to/ /rgyal sras sgrib pa rnam sel gyis/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi/ /rgyal mo ji ltar btsal gsol pas/ /slar yang rgyal bas bka' bstsal pa/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi mkhyen na/ /byang chub sems dpar gyur pas lta ci smos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang snying po rab mchog ste/ /gang gis snying po 'di shes thar pa shes/ /rnal 'byor dpag tu med phyir sgrub par dka'/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di yi phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams bskal pa bcu drug tu/ /'jig rten khams rnams kun du gshegs mdzad na/ /byang chub sems dpar gyur pas smos ci dgos/ /su zhig yig drug rig sngags chen mo 'di/ /rtag tu 'dzin zhing zlos par brtson pa yi/ /sems can de dag bsod nams pha mtha' yas/ /yig drug rig sngags gang du zla ba der/ /sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed/ /dgu bcu rtsa dgu de ru 'du bar 'gyur/ /phra rab rdul grangs snyed kyi rgyal sras 'du/ /phar phyin drug gi sgo na gnas par 'gyur/ /lha yi sde ris sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /lha yi bu rnams 'du zhing mchod par byed/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi yis phyogs bzhi srung //klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho mching nam dang / /ma dros 'jog po la sogs bye ba ni//khrug khrig brgya 4stong du mas yongs su srung / /de ni bla gab med par gnas tshe yang / /sa bla'i gnod sbyin dag gis srung bar byed/ /de yi ba spu'i khung bu re re la'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag re bzhugs/ /de dag kun gyis khyod kyis 'di 'dra ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor mchog thob pa thob gyur te/ khyod kyis rus kyi rigs kyang bdun brgyud tshun/ /thar par byas kyis legs so leṭa par byas/ khyod kyi stor gnas srog chags thams cad kyang / /phyir mi ldog 133

pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'thob/ /legs so legs zhes mgrin gcig gsung bar 'gyur/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo 'di/ /la la zhig gi lus la 'chang byed na/ /de lus rdo rje'i lus su rigs par 'gyur/ /de ni rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchod rten nyid/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gnas par rig par bya/ /su zhig rig sngags chen mo 'di zlos pa/ /de yi spobs pa zad pa med par 'gyur/ /ye shes phung po rnam par dag pa 'thob/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje chen por 'gyur/ /de ni nyi ma re re bzhin du yang / /pha rol phyin pa drug po yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug 'thob/ / yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di 'dzin pa/ /su zhig byams sam zhe sdang gis kyang rung / /dbugs phyir 'byung dang nang du rngub pas kyang / /rgyal ba'i sras po phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ /bla med byang chub mngon rdzogs myur 'tshang rgya/ /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di la su zhig gis/ /lag gis reg kyang srid mtha'i sems dpar 'gyur/ /skyes pa bud med khye 'u bu mo dang / /bya dang ri dgas la sogs sus kyang rung / /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di mthong na/ /de kun thams cad rgyal sras srid mtha' 'dzin/ /mi yi sdug bsngal brgyad po med par 'gyur/ /de yis rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab 'thob/ /de ltar yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di/ /zlos par byed na bskul bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ /sgrib sel gyis ni 'di skad gsol/ /de ltar phan yon tshad med pa'i/ /rig sngags dam pa'i rgyal po de/ /bdag gis gang las 'thob par 'gyur/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags gang / /bdag la su zhig stsol byed pa/ /de la rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /'dzam gling bkang ste dbul bar bgyi/ /'bri ba'i yo byad kyis 'phongs na/ /bdag gis lpags pa shog bur byas/ /rkang gi rus pas smyu gu dang / khrug gis gnag tshar byas nas ni/ /rig sngags de ni 'bri bar 134

bgyid/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis slar yang bka' bstsal pa/ /yi ge drug pa'i rigs sngags 'di yi phyir/ /'jig rten khams kyi phra rab rdul snyed kyi/ /'jig rten khams su song bar ngas dran te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig tshogs/ /brgya stong du ma bsnyen cing bkur byas kyang / /rig sngags mchog 'di ma thos ma thob nas/ /sangs rgyas dmar po'i mchog gi spyan snga ru/ /nga yis mchi ma phyung ste dus pa dang / /rgyal ba de yis bdag gi dbugs phyung ste/ /de ltar snying rjer mchi ma ma 'byin par/ /bde gshegs padma'i dam pa zhes bya ba/ /de yis rig sngags chen mo 'di mkhyen gyis/ /rgyal ba de yi spyan sngar song zhig gsungs/ /ngas kyang phyin te gus par gsol ba btab/ /ming tsam dran kyang sdig pa kun 'byang zhing / /byang chub dam pa rnyed dka' 'thob 'gyur ba/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'tshol ba'i ched/ /'jig rten du mar bdag phyin nyon mongs kyang / /don ma mchis kyis khyod kyis bdag la stsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i mchog de yis/ /rdul kun re res bgrang bar nus pa sogs/ /bcu gnyis dpe yis yon tan rgya cher bshad/ /yi ge drug pa'i phan yon bgrang mi lang / /bsam gtan spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /nga ni sgom par nan tan brtson ma yin/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i chos de yang / /phra zhing mi gsal shin tu snying po'i chos/ /de ni dge ba la gnas de bzhin du/ /rig sngags chen mo 'di ni thabs mkhas pa'o//ngas kyang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags ched/ /zhing khams bye ba khrug khrig brgya stong phrag /du mar 'khyams shing song yang ma rnyed nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /spyan sngar thal sbyar chos la gus pa yi/ /shugs kyis mchi ma phyung ste sangs rgyas des/ /yig drug rig sngags chen mo'i rig pa'i rgyal/ /sgom pa'i brtson 'gruX bya bar bzhed dam gsungs/ /bcom ldan 135

'das 'tshal bde gshegs bdag 'tshal te/ /skom pa chu 'tshol ji bzhin zhing mang mchis/ /sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya stong bsnyen bkur kyang / /rig sngags rgyal mo 'di ni ma thob kyis/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod mgon skyabs rten dang gnas/ /dbang po nyams la mig dang lam stor lam/ /nyi mas gdungs pa rnams la skyob pa'i gdugs/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor gnas kyi sā la ste/ /chos kyis phongs pa rnams la mtha' yas ston/ /sems rab brtan pa'i go cha nyid gyur cig /de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas des/ /ka la piṅka'i dbyangs snyan gsung phyung bas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bos te bka' bstsal pa/ /rigs kyi bu khyod stos shig legs par ltos/ /de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i mchog 'di ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gyur bzhin du/ /yi ge drug pa'i sngogs chen 'tshol ba'i slad/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yi/ /zhing khams du mar kun nas gshegs mdzad kyis/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags dbul bar gyis/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po des/ /ras bris cho ga dkyil 'khor 'jug tshul dang / /gsang bar gdams pa la sogs rgya cher bstan/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ rig pa'i mchog 'di spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nga la byin ma thag /sa chen g.yos shing rgya mtsho rnam par 'khrugs/ /bgegs rnams skrag cing 'gro la 'tshe byed pa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen po sha za du ma dang / /nag po chen po bud med bcas par bros/ /ngas kyang mu tig mchog gi se mo do/ /brgya stong ri ba spyan ras gzigs la phul/ /des kyang spyi bor blangs te bde bar gshegs/ /snang ba mtha' yas del gus pas phul/ /de yis blangs nas slar yang nga la byin/ /nga yis rig sngags rgyal po 'di rnyed nas/ /padma'i zhing khams nyid du gshegs so zhes/ /bde gshegs padma'i mchog las nga yis thos/ /gang gis rig sngags mchog 'di 'bri 'am 136

'brir bcug na/ /de yis chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bris par 'gyur/ /rgyal sku phra rab rdul mnyam lha yi gser las byed/ /byas nas ring bsre la bcug pa nyin re bzhin byed na/ /de yi rnam smin yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di'i/ /yig 'bru gcig gi 'bras bu'i rnam par smin pa tsam/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab thar par shin tu gnas/ /rigs kyi bu 'am bu mo gang zhig 'di zlos na/ /des ni ting 'dzin dam pa 'di dag thob par 'gyur/ /nor bu rin chen 'dzin dang dmyal dang byol song skem/ /rdo rje'i go cha rkang pa rab gnas kun thabs mkhas/ /'thor dang chos rnams kun la 'jug pa bsam gtan rgyun/ /chos kyi shing rta la 'dug mtha' yas pe 'u dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang kun las yongs su thar bar byed/ /pha rol phyin drug 'chang dang ri rab chen po 'dzin/ /sems can srid pa las 'grol sangs rgyas zhing kun ston/ /de bzhin gshegs kun gzigs dang shin tu gnas pa'i gnas/ /de dag la sogs ting 'dzin dam pa brgya rtsa/ brgyad/ /yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'dzin des thob par 'gyur/ /de bas sgrib pa rnam sel khyod/ /'khor mo 'jig gi grong khyer na/ /rig sngags chen mo 'di 'dzin pa'i/ /chos smra yod kyis de'i gan song / /rig sngags mchog 'di 'dzin pa'i chos smra de dag dkon/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs dang mnyam par blta bar bya/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams chen po'i grong dang phung po dang / /phyin ci ma log gsung dang rin chen phung po bzhin/ /'dod rgu sbyin byed yid bzhin nor bu lta bu dang / /chos kyi mdzod dang 'gro ba sgrol ba'i mnyan pa bzhin/ /lta bar bya yi dam chos smra ba de dag gi /spyod pa mthong nas the tshom skye bar mi bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa'i sa bor nas/ /ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzad nang du skye sa re/ /chos smra de ni tshul khrims zhig cing spyod pa nyams/ /chung ma dang ni bu dang bu mos yongs su 137

bskor/ /ngur smrig gos kyang bshang dang gci bas gos gyur pa/ /spyod lam ma bsdams pa yin khyod kyis shes par gyis/ /de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/ /rgyal sras sgrib pa rnam sel de/ /rab tu byung dang khyim pa dang / /khye 'u dang ni bu mo yi/ /gzugs can byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /brgya phrag du mas bskor te song / /lha yi gdugs dang cod pan dang / /rgyan cha gos bzang me tog sogs/ /mtha' yas mchod pa'i tshogs khyer te/ /wa ra ṇa si'i grong du song / /spyod lam ma bsdams pa de la/ /the tshom med pa'i dad pa yis/ /rkang par mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ /mchod pa de dag kun gyis mchod/ /mdun du thal mo sbyar nas bstod/ /e ma ho/ /chos gter myong byed bdud rtsi'i gter bsags pa/ /rgya mtsho che dang mnyam pa khyod la dpag mi nus/ /mir gyur kun dang lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba kun/ khyod las chos nyan de kun thams cad 'khor du 'du/ /khyod ni rdo rje che mtshungs chos kyi rnam grangs 'chang / /sems can 'khor bas bcings pa mang po yongs thar mdzad/ /grong khyer 'dir gnas khyod kyis rtag tu yongs sdud cing / /khyod mthong de dag bsod nams dam pa ldan pa lags/ /mthong ma thag tu sdig pa kun 'phrog mdzad/ /zhugs kyis nags tshal myur bar sreg pa bzhin/ khyod ni bde gshegs kun gyis rab tu mkhyen/ /byang sems bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang / /tshangs dang khyab 'jug dbang phyug nyi zla rlung / /chu bdag me lha chos rgyal gshin rje dang / /rgyal chen bzhi mdo khyod la mchod phyir brtson/ /chos smra de yis slar smras pa/ /grogs po nyon mongs pa rnams ni/ /'phags pa min par spyod pa'o/ /de ni 'khor ba'i mtshan ma ste/ /skye rgu'i 'khor lo skyed par byed/ /yig drug rig sngags sus shes pa/ /dug gsum dag gis mi gos te/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzang po/ /nam yang dri mas mi gos bzhin/ /rig sngags rgyal mo 138

'di ni dkon pa'i chig yin te/ /rdo rje'i tshig dang mi phyed bla med ye shes tshig /mi zad pa yi ye shes ltag na med pa'i tshig /thar par 'jug byed bde gshegs ye shes rnam dag tshig/ dug gsum dang ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yongs spong tshig /thabs mkhas kun ldan chos rnams kun la 'jug byed tshig /bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin kun la 'jug pa'i tshig /rtag du lha rnams 'dod par byed pa'i tshig yin no/ /'di na gang zhig thar 'dod kyang / /thar pa'i thabs la rmongs pa rnams/ /dbang po'i sgo dang dkar po'i sgo/ /de bzhin snyan pa'i bsgo ba sogs/ /gos kyi bsgo ba sna tshogs dang / /nyi ma rgyu skar brtags byas nas/ /dbang phyug 'jug sred nam mkha' lding / /gcer bu pa dang ri mi sogs/ /sna tshogs gnas las rab 'byung yang / /de dag la yang thar pa med/ /mgon min brtul zhugs can yang min/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug dbang phyug dang / /lha dbang nyi zla rlung lha chu/ /me dang gshin rje rgyal chen bzhi/ /de sogs lha rnams mang po yang / /rtag tu yi ge drug pa yi/ /rig sngags rgyal mo 'di nyid slong / /ji ltar shes rab pha rol phyin ma ni/ /rgyal ba kun skyed yum du grags mod kyi/ /de yang rig sngags rgyal mo 'di nyid la/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal 'dud byed na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems bcas pa smos ci dgos/ /'di ni 'bras ltar snying por gyur pa ste/ /'di la cung zad tsam zhig bzlas pas kyang / /theg mchog gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis dang / /zhi dang thar pa dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor gzhan kun phub ma lta bu ste/ /'di ni 'bras kyi rme 'u lta bu yin/ / /rgyal ba'i sras rnams phar phyin drug po las/ /re re'i phyir yang dala' tshegs cher 'byin mod/ /'di nyid gcig po bzlas pas phar phyin drug /lhan cig dka' ba med par yongs su rdzogs/ /la la 'di la lag gis reg byed kyang / /de yang phyir mi ldog pa thob par 5 139

'gyur/ /de yi ming tsam 'dzin pa'ang dkon pa ste/ /'di ming lan gcig bzung yang rgyal kun la/ /yo byad kun gyis rtag par bstabs par 'gyur/ /de nas chos kyi mkhan po de/ /cung zad sems shing 'dug pa las/ /steng gi mkha' las yig drug gi /rig sngags byin zhes sgra byung ngo / /sgra 'di gang las byung sems tshe/ /slar yang mkha' las rgyal sras 'dis/ /dka' ba du mas brtson byas kyi/ /yig drug byin zhig zhes thos nas/ /steng gi mkha' la bltas pa dang / /'dam bu'i mdog ltar kun nas dkar/ /ral pa'i cod pan mdzes pa 'chang / /thams cad mkhyen pa dbur bzhag pa/ /phyag na padma bzang po thogs/ /padma'i dpal gyis brgyan byas pa/ /de 'dra'i gzugs bzang mthong gyur nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yis/ /yi ge drug pa byin par gnang / /tshur shog gus par blang bar gyis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūṃ/ /'di ni byin par gyur ma thag /sa chen g.yos shing rgya mtsho 'khrugs/ /mod der sgrib pa rnam sel gyis/ /mi zad pa yi chos nyid dang / /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /rnal 'byor spyod dang thar bar 'jog /thams cad snang byed bkod pa'i rgyal/ /chos 'dzin pa sogs ting 'dzin ni/ /mtha' yas du ma thob par gyur/ /rin chen bdun gyis gling bzhi ni/ /bkang nas yon du dbul rtsom tshe/ /chos kyi mkhan po des smras pa/ /'dis ni yi ge gcig nyid kyi/ /yon gyi char yang yong med na/ /drug gi yon tu lta ci smos/ /'on kyang nga ni khyod cag las/ /ci yang len par 'dod pa med/ khyod kyang byang chub sems dpa' ste/ khyod ni 'phags kyis mi 'phags min/ khyod ni nga yis 'dul bya nyid/ /de nas rgyal sras sgrib sel gyis/ /brgya stong ri ba'i mu tig gi /phreng ba de la phul ba dang / /mkhan po 'di ni nga'i tshig gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /shākya thub la phul zhig gsungs/ /rgyal sras sgrib pa 140

rnam sel gyis/ /chos smra'i gong par byas byas nas/ /de ni rnyed pa'i ngam pa rnyed/ /bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar gus pas song / /mkhan po'i tshig gis skyes kyang phul/ /ston pas kun nas rdaga' bar mdzad/ /de nas sgrib pa rnams sel gyis/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ltar 'tshal zhes/ /gsol tshe dze ta'i tshal 'di ru/ /nga la lta dang mchod pa dang / /dbang phyug chen po lung ston phyir/ /myur du 'ong bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ /de nas bde ba can gyi zhing / /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs pa nges/ /'od zer sna tshogs bkye ba yis/ /dze ta'i tshal kun snang byas te/ /lan gsum bskor nas 'od de ni/ /dmyal ba'i gnas song gsal bar byas/ /dze ta'i tshal kun lha yi gser/ /las byas bkod pa mtha' yas snang / /skar tshogs dbus na zla ba ltar/ /rgyal sras kun las phul byung ba/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po de/ /sprin phung nang nas glog phreng ltar/ /skad cig tsam gyis der 'ongs te/ /ston pa'i 'od zer ma gtogs pa/ /'od gzhan thams cad zil gyis mnan/ /bstod cing phyag 'tshal g.yas su bskor/ /ston pas bka' bstsal rigs kyi bu/ /ngal lam chad dam nyon mongs sam/ /'gro mang yongs su smin byas sam/ /des kyang bdag gis sems can rnams/ /smin par byed pa'i las bsgrubs so/ /zhes gsol slar yang legs so zhes/ /rgyal bas dbugs 'byin dam pa mdzad/ /des kyang gser gyi padma mchog /de bzhin gshegs la phul nas ni/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis/ /me tog 'di dag skyes su bskur/ /skur gsol gsung bar mdzad ces gsol/ /ston pis phyag gis bzhes nas ni/ /sku yi g.yon logs su bzhag go /de nas dbang phyug chen po yis/ /ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /byang chub lung bstan stol zhes gsol/ /ston pa'i zhal nas spyan ras gzigs/ /'di yis 141

khyod la lung ston 'gyur/ /zhes gsung dbang phyug chen po yis/ /'phags pa'i zhabs la mgos btud nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dam pa dbang phyug chen po chos 'dzin la/ /padma'i zhabs mnga' padma la dgyes phyag na padma bzang po mnga'/ /padma'i dpal dang ldan pa yongs su bskor ba 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /sa yi spyan mchog mdzad pa tshim par mdzad la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos bka' bstsal pa/ khyod ni 'jig rten che ba zhes bya bar/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lha mi'i ston pa ni/ /dbang phyug zhes byar rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ /de nas lha mo u ma yong nas ni/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod pas bstod par brtson/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug mchog /srog sbyin mdzad pa sa yi spyan mchog ldan pa padma bzang po mnga'/ /padma'i dpal dang ldan pas yongs su bskor ba myang 'das sa ston pa/ /legs par dgang bar mdzad pa chos sbyin pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bud med dmad pa'i lus las yongs su thar bar mdzod/ /mngal na gnas shing sha mas gang ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /rtag tu 'dzin pa las ni bdag yongs thar bar mdzod/ /bla med byang chub mchog dbugs 'byin mdzad du gsol/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos bka' bstsal pa/ /sring mo khyod ni 'jig rten gangs ri yi/ /g.yas logs phyogs su u ma'i dbang phyug ces/ /mngon par rdzogs 'tshang rgya zhes lung bstan to/ /ston pa'i zhal nas sgrib pa rnam sel stos/ /spyan ras gzigs 'dis 'di rnams lung bstan te/ /dbang phyug chen po'i le 'u 'di bshad do/ /sgrib sel dga' zhing rangs pa yis/ /ston pa'i gtso la 'di skad gsol/ spyan ras gzi gas dbang mthong ba yis/ /long ba yis ni mig thob ltar/ /de ring bdag gson 'bras bu mchis/ /bsam grub bsam rdzogs byang 142
