chub kyi/ /lam la bar chad med par gyur/ /legs par dgongs pa chos kyi sku/ /mya ngan 'das pa da ston to/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan tshogs/ /slar yang nyan par 'tshal lo zhes/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar gsol bar gyur/ /rgyal bas bka' bstsal dper na ri rgyal khor yug dang / khor yug che dang muñtsi li nga nag po che/ /gsus gzhol mi/ ston kun tu gtogs dang 'bar ba'i kha/ /rtse mo brgya pa khang pa'i ri dang nor bu che/ /ston pa'i ri dang dus ma yin par ston pa sogs/ /ri rgyal de kun srang gcig la ni tshad gzhal na/ /srang gi grangs de ma lus nga yis gzhal nus kyis/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bsod nams phung po bgrang mi nus/ /phra rab rdul tshad bzung nus rgya mtsho thiṭa pas drongs/ /shi sha'i tshal gyi 'dab ma re re nas bgrang nus/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bsod nams tshogs ni bgrang mi nus/ /gling bzhi'i mi kun yig mkhan gyur pas ri rab ni/ /gro ga'i phung por gyur la rgya mtsho mching nam che/ /gnag tshar byas pas zad pa'i bar du bris byas pa'i/ /yig 'bru re re nas ni nga yis bgrang nus mod/ /rgyal sras 'di yi bsod nams tshad ni zin ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅga'i bye snyed bcu gnyis la/ /yo byad kun gyis bskal mang mchod pa'i bsod nams de/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i skra rtse gcig la gnas/ /rgyal sras 'di ni ting 'dzin brgya phrag mang ldan te/ /rab 'joms rgyan byed rgyan mi byed dang glog gi sbyin/ /bzod byed gzi chen rnam byed rdo rje'i phreng mchog sbyin/ /mthu brgya bkod pa mtha' yas spobs pa'i phung po dang / /rgyal dbang rnam mang rdo rje'i sgo dang rtag mchog sbyin/ /dbang yongs thar byed zhe sdang yongs thar dbang mchog mig /nyin byed mchog spyan chos mngon dang ni rdo rje'i mngal/ /shin tu ston pa mya ngan 'da' byed 'od mtha' yas/ /rnal 'byor byed dang 'thor ba 'dzam gling dag pa'i mig /rgyal 143

zhing mchog spyan byams dang 'gro gnas mi zad byed/ /mnar med skem dang rgya mtsho ltar zab 'khor brgya pa/ /de sogs ting 'dzin gzhan yang brgya stong mang ldan nyid/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba log par dad sel byung ba'i dus/ /nga ni byang chub sems dpar gyur pas rgyal de las/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan brjod pa de lta thos/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs dang / /'di 'dra'i tshul du ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gyed pa'ang mthong / /gang tshe kun bzang rdo rje gyen 'phags ting 'dzin zhugs/ /de tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang mthong ba'i ting 'dzin 'jug /kun bzang zla ba mchog can ting 'dzin la zhugs tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang nyi ma dam pa'i spyan la 'jug /gang tshe kun bzang byug pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhugs tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang nam mkha'i mdzod la stoms par 'jug /kun tu bzang po rnam par byed la stoms 'jug tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje'i lcags kyur gnas/ /gang tshe kun bzang bzang po'i 'gros la stoms zhugs tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rgya mtsho ltar zab ting 'dzin gnas/ /kun tu bzang po seng ge'i glal gyis rtse ba'i tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge rnam rol gyis zil gnon/ /kun bzang mchog sbyin ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mnar med skem pa'i ting 'dzin byed/ /kun tu bzang po ba spu'i khung bu kun 'byed tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang spu khung ma lus 'byed par byed/ /de nas kun tu bzang po ngo mtshar thob gyur te/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang khyod kyi spobs pa phul byung ba/ /de lta legs so legs so zhes smras sangs rgyas des/ /kun bzang khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs dbang spobs pa ni/ /cung zad tsam zhig mthong du zad de rgyal sras 'di'i/ /spobs pa ci 'dra de 'dra de bzhin gsheṭa la'ang med/ /de skad sangs rgyas de las nga yis yongs su thos/ /de ltar 144

yon tan rgya chen bka' bstsal nas/ /mdo 'di yongs su gtad par bya ba'i phyir/ /su zhig theg chen mdo sde za ma tog /bkod pa'i rgyal po 'di yi ming thos kyang / /de dag sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa 'byang / /mtshams med lnga sogs dmad pa'i las byed pa'i/ /sdig can rnams kyang mdo sde 'di 'dzin na/ /mi zad sdig pa kun las yongs su thar/ /'di na ri rab ri yi rgyal po'i g.yas ngos na/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs drub/ gis dri ma med pa yi/ /mtha' ru brtags pa yod de da ltar ngas kyang brtags/ /gang zhig gos dkar kha dog sngon por 'gyur pa dang / /sngon po'i gos ni kha dog dkar por 'gyur ba'o/ /de las snga ma shos ni sdig pa'i phung po ste/ /phyi ma shos ni chos kyi phung por blta bar bya/ /de bzhin mdo sde rgyal po za ma tog bkod 'dis/ /sdig pa'i phung po thams cad sreg cing dkar por byed/ /dbyar dus rtsa dang nags tshal shin tu sngo gyur pa/ /de tshe kha brgya pa zhes klu yi rgyal po cig /gnas nas langs te de dag thams cad sreg par byed/ /de bzhin mdo 'di sdig pa'i nags tshal sreg byed yin/ /mdo sde 'di thos sems can de dag bde dang ldan/ /de kun so so'i skye bo min par rig par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog dang 'dra bar stos/ /'chi ba'i tshe na sangs rgyas bcu gcig mngon gshegs te/ /ma 'jigs ma 'jigs khyod kyis mdo sde'i rgyal po thos/ /slan chad mi 'khor skye rga na 'chi mthong mi 'gyur/ /mi sdug mi 'phrad sdug cing 'dod pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu khyod bde ba can gyi zhing du song / /bde gshegs snang mtha' yas las dam chos thos 'gyur zhes/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad mthong de dag bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /(bka' chems kha cig las spyan ras gzigs dze ta'i tshal tu 'ongs nas ston pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa'i tshe nga'i gdul bya rdzogs so zhes gsung ba na da dung kha ba can gyi sems can ma thul lo 145

zhes zhus pas de ni khyod kyis gdul bar bya ba yin no zhes kha ba can dus der gtad par yang gsungs so)de ltar rgyal dang rgyal sras kun gyi bla/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i rgyal po des/ /bod yul 'di ni thugs rjes bdag gir mdzad/ /yul 'di'i 'gro rnams longs spyod dman na yang / lha skal thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ /chos skal snying po yi ge drug ma ste/ /de phyir yul gru gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /bod yul du chos byung tshul gyi skabs las za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las byung ba'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par thar pa phyog4tsam dang des bod yul ji ltar bdag gir mdzad pa'i tshul bka' chems ltar bstan pa'i skabs ste dang po'o// //sā sti/ /ljon shing ngos la sprul pa'i gzugs 'char 'di/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas gnyal gyi sgang rgyud nas/ /rig byed pa ni tshe dbang dar pos gtsos/ /dpon slob dgu yis legs par gzab ste brkos/ /mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin bdag ni/ /bya yul dpon sa tshogs gnyis grub mas mdzad/ /dge tshogs ma lus byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo/ / 146
yan 'ag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/ chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs la le'u bcu las skabs gnyis pa bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhags/ /༄

le'u gnyis pa bod kyi rgyal rabs/na mo ke shā ra ya/ /de ltar rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus las/ /thugs rje rmang byung spyan ras gzigs dbang des/ /mtha' 'khob bod khams 'dul ba'i khur bsnams te/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir byon tshe/ /stod kyi mnga' ris bskor gsum rdzing gi tshul/ /bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra/ /smad du mdo khams sgang gsum zhing lta bu/ /kun kyang chu yi rgya mtshor gyur ba'i nang / /mtha' yas srog chags sdug bsngal spyod par gzigs/ /kun la yi ge drug pa'i chos bstan nas/ /ma 'ongs gdul byar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs//de nas kha ba can gyi yul gyi dbus/ /dbu ru shod chen dmar po'i ri rtser byon//mthil kun chus gang ngan song 'gro mang gnas/ /logs kun mun pa sros 'dra'i nags tshal stug khro gtum gcan gzan sna tshogs gsod gcod byed/ /khyad par 'o thang mtsho ni mnar med kyi/ /dmyal ba'i sgor gzigs sdug bsngal bzod thabs med/ /rang byas las kyi 'bras bu spyod gzigs pas/ /thugs rje'i shugs drag mi bzod rab tu g.yos/ /pad ma lta bu'i spyan ras g.yas g.yon las/ /spyan chab bdud rtsiri thigs pa re re lhags/ /jo mo khro gnyer can dang sgrol mar gyur/ /bu khyod mtha' 'khob 'gro rnams 'dul ba la/ /sgyid lug sdug bsngal ldan par ma byed cig kho mo gnyis kyis 'gro don grogs byed ces/ /gsung ste spyan 'bras so so nyid la thim/ 5 /de nas dmyal mtsho'i dbus su byon nas ni/ /yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad tshad med pa'i/ /snying rjes bden tshig smon lam 'di skad btab/ /thog med dus nas las ngan 149

bsags pa'i mthus/ /gting mtha' med pa'i dmyal ba chen po 'dir/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal bye bas gtses pa rnams/ /rnam grol thar ba'i gling la 'khod par shog /dug mtsho 'khol ma'i nang du 'tshed byed cing / /dmyal ba'i me yis rtag du bsregs pa yis/ /skyabs med nyam thag smre sngags 'don pa rnams/ /phan bde'i char gyis rtag du bsil bar shog /tsha grang bkres skom du khas gzir ba yi/ khri phrag dpag med mtsho 'dir gnas pa rnams/ /lus 'di bor nas bdag gi zhing khams su/ /rigs bzang chos ldan rnams su skye bar shog oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ /zhes gsungs mtha' yas 'od zer bkye ba yis/ /dmyal ba'i sems can de rnams sdug bsngal zhi/ /bde bas rgyud brlan thar pa'i lam 'khod gyur/ /mtsho de 'khol ba zhi zhing rab tu bsil/ /kong gi chu brlag zhes bya'i zoms bye bas/ /ru bzhi chu yis gang ba de ru thim/ /chu gzhan dag kyang de ltar thim pa yis/ /bod khams yul gyi rnam pa gsal por dod/ /mnga' ris skor gsum sha rkyang ri dwags gling / /bar gyi ru bzhi stag gzig gcan gzan gling / /smad kyi sgang drug 'dab chags bya yi gling / /kun la chos bstan dpag med smin grol mdzad/ /de ltar dus ring mtha' yas rgyun mi 'chad/ /sna tshogs thabs tshul bgrang bar mi nus pas/ /mtha' yas 'gro rnams smin grol mdzad pa yis/ /dub pa bsal phyir 'dzam gling lho yi phyogs/ /po ṭa la zhes gru 'dzin ri bo'i spor/ /sems nyid ngal gso'i ting 'dzin mdzad par gyur/ /de las bzhengs nas khams gsum sems can dang / /khyad par kha ba can pa la gzigs pas/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi /cha shas tsam yang grol bar ma gyur zhing / khyad par ma rungs rgyud rtsub gdul dka' ba/ /snyigs las rab tu snyigs mar gyur gzigs nab// /zhi bde'i bsam pa skad cig skyes pa'i mod/ /sngon gyi dam bcas dmod pa bor ba 150

yis/ /dbu ni tshal pa bcu ru gas cing gyes/ /sku lurnga dum bu stong du bye bar gyur/ /'od dpag med mgon skad cig yi/sa byon nas/ /dbu ngang sku lus zhig zhing bye ba rnams/ /chun por phyag gis bcings nas 'di skad gsung / /chos rnamyo/sa thams cad rkyen bzhin ste/ /'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de ni de lta nyid tu 'gyur/ /gang gi smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab tu bsngags/ /bden pa de yis skad cig la/ /nges pa nyid tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu khyod sdug bsngal ma byed cig khyod kyi dbu ni tshal pa bcur gas pa/ /'di ni zhal ras bcu ru byin gyis brlab/ khyod lus rnam pa stong du bye ba ni/ /phyag stong spyan stong ldan par byin gyis brlab/ /slar yang 'gro don snying stobs skyed cig gsung / /de tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras kun 'dus nas/ /zhal ras bcu po pha rol phyin pa bcu/ /bcu gcig dbu la 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams kun mdzad pa/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul bar rgyal bas lung bstan nas/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod mchod cing shis pa mdzad par gyur/ /bod khams yul du rung bar gyur nas kyang / /dang por mi ma yin gyi yul du gyur/ /gnod sbyin la sogs bcu yis dbang byas skad/ /lo rgyus chen mo sogs las dang por gnod sbyin nag pos dbang byas ste/ /yul gyi ming yang bzang yul rgyan med zer/ /mtshon cha mda' gzhu de yi dus su byung / /de 151

nas re te mgo g.yag bdud kyis byas/ /ming yang bdud yul kha rag rong dgur btags/ /sta re dgra sta de yi dus su byung / /de nas srin po gnya' rengs khrag mig byas/ /yul ming srin po nag po dgu yul zer/ /srin mo rkang dang rgyags gnyis lag char byung / /bzhi pa dmar 'jam lha yis dbang byas ste/ /lha yul gung thang lag char chu gri byung / /lnga par rmu rgyal kho rje zhes byas bzung / /da 'phrang cang 'phrang lag char zhags pa 'phen/ /drug par krog krog 'dre yis dbang byas ste/ /lang tang ling tang bar kha 'ur rdo 'phen//bdun pa ma sangs rus dgus dbang byas ste/ /gnya' g.ya' spang skyes/1gar ting nam tsha/3 gle ngan lam tsang skyes/ri rsha tho gar skyes/4 she do ker ting nas/5 me pad skyes/༄ gsad ge 'phrul po che/4 drang ba drangs ma mgur/ra bkod stor nam tsha/ yul gyi ming ni bod kha nya drug zer/ /lag char dong ral go cha phub chung byung / /brgyad pa klus bzung bod khams gling dgu btags/ /dgu pa rgyal pos dbang byas ngam po ce/ /bcu po 'gong po dbun dgus dbang byas ste/ /yul gyi ming yang stong sde bco brgyad zer/ /zhes grag go /de nas mi yi 'gro ba byung tshul ni/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dbang des/ /bod yul yi dwags dud 'gro'i 'gro bkun//mi lus thob tu rung ba'i dus gzigs nas/ /po ṭa la yi ri la gnas pa yi/ /spre'u zhig sprul yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen byin/ /ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul ldan par byin brlabs nas/ kha ba can gyi yul 'dir sgom du btang / /de yis brag ri rog po cig du bsgoms/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems skyed sbyangs//stong pa nyid la mos pas sbyong pa'i tshe/ /lha mo sgrol mas sprul pa byas pa yi/ /brag srin mo zhig der 'ongs chags pa'i brda/ /nyin zhag 'ga' byas spre'u'i sems ma g.yos/ /phyi nas mi mo mdzes mar lus bsgyur nas/ /bdag gi khyim 152

loca rmas blta ru phyin pa'i tshe/ /de las mi min spre'u min bzhi brgyar 'phel/ /shing thog zad cing bkres pas 'thab cing rtsod/ /yi dwags lta bu snying rje'i gnas su mthong / /rang gis gsos pas ma sos rab tu ngal/ / (ka bkol ma las dang po phru gu gcig du bshad la bka' chems spyi las drug du snang zhing gang na'ang phyis mang du 'phel ba dum bu bzhir chad de rtsod pas bod kyi mi bu rigs bzhi zhes se dang rmu sdong dang stong gi rus tshan bzhi byung bar grags shing yang dbra dang 'dru bsnan nas mi bu rigs drug du'ang grag go) rdzu 'phrul mthu yis po ṭa la ru song / /'phags pa'i drung du thal sbyar gsol btab pa/ /kye ma khyim thab 'khor ba'i btson ra dang / /bud med bdud kyi pho ltar ma shes la/ /'dod pa dug gi lo mar ma rtogs pas/ /bu tsha 'khor ba'i 'dam du bdag tshud do/ /snying rjes chags par gyur pas bdag bslus te/ /'dod pas bsdams cing sdug bsngal ri yis non/ /nyon mongs dug zos las ngan rims kyis btab/ /sdug bsngal phung pos bdag nyid bslus par gyur/ /kye hud da ni bu tsha ji ltar gso/ /'phags pa'i bka' bsgrubs bdag ni 'di ltar gyur/ /da lta yi dwags grong khyer dngos su 'dug /phyi ma dmyal bar skye bar the tshom med/ /byams mgon bdag la skyob par mdzod ces gsol/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal nas rigs kyi bu/ /sdug bsngal mi dgos khyod kyi spyod pa legs/ /khyod kyi rigs brgyud de rnams mir gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /de kun nga yis chos dang zang zing gis/ /kun nas skyong zhes bzhengs te bod yul gziṭa//ri rab zom nas 'bru sna lnga(nas gro sran bra so)blangs ste/ /bod du gtor bas ma rmos lo tog byas/ /rin chen sna lnga phyag gis bcus nas gtor/ /smon lam mdzad pas ma 'ongs skabs skabs su/ /rin chen gter kun(gser dngul zangs lcags bsha')sa las rim gyis 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa'as rang gi rigs 154

brgyud rnams/ khrid de ma rmos pa yi lo tog bstan/ /('di zo dang zhes smras pas zo dang / gong po ri dang 'dir rtse mo rtses dang byas pas rtsed dang du ming chags ces grag go)lo tog zos pas de kun mi nyid gyur/ /ma rmos 'bru za gos su shing lo gyon/ /nags na ri dwags lta bur gnas pa yi/ /klo dang mon ltar spyod pas bod yul gang / /kun kyang pha rigs ma rigs gnyis su gnas/ /spre 'u byang sems pha yi rigs byung rnams/ /dad brtson brtse ldan gtong phod dag la dga'/ /rgyud 'jam tshig btsun smra mkhas ngang tshul bzang / /'on kyang sems chung lus sems yang ba yin/ /brag srin ma yi rigs gyur gtso che rnams/ /nyon mongs che zhing 'gran sems phrag dog rgyas/ /zas nor la sred khro gtum gzhan skyon sgrog /'on kyang lus shed snying stobs che ba yin/ /gnyis ga sprul pa yin pas mi kun kyang / /chos kyi snod tu rung ba mang ba yin/ /de ltar bod yul mi yi 'gro ba dar/ /de tshe rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis dang / /mtha' mar rgyal phran bzhi bcus mnga' dbang byas/ /mchims yul gru shul na/ /mchims rje ni gu yod/ blon po snang dang deng /1 zhang zhung yul na ni/ rgyal po legs snya shur/ rma dang ra sangs blon/3 de bzhin du myang ro phyong dkar na gtsang rje thong dkar blon po gnang /3 gnubs yul gling dgu na snubs rje dmigs pa blon po rme'u dang 'bro/4 nyung ro sham bor lo rngam rje 'brom blon po she sung gnyis/5 kyi ri ljon sngon na kyi rje rmad po blon po ngam dang 'bro/༄ ngam shod khra snar zings rje khri 'phrang gsum blon mgar dang gnyan/4'ol phu spang mkhar du zing rje thon phreng blon po rngog dang sbas/ra sribs yul gyi ral gong du brang rje gong nam blon po sprad dang zhugs/'a kong yul bre sna kong rje kur po tug dang mkhar pa blon/10 nyang yul rnam gsum na nyang btsun glang rgyal blon po phug dang ngo rje/11 dgas yul gru bzhi na dgas rje mang po 15du

rgyal blon po rlangs skam gnyis/13 sil ma bzhi bcu ni/ /yul ni 'brog mo rnam gsum na/ /rgyal po se mir khrid bzhugs/ /de yi blon po ka re na /zhes sogs te/ /g.ye mo yul drug na g.ye rje mkhar ba blon po rba dang stug /se mo gru bzhi na gnyags rje gru 'phrang se dang nyang gnyis blon/ /zhes sogs grag go /rgyal phran de rnams 'thab rtsod gsod gcod dga'/ /legs nyes mi rtsi bkyon 'bebs btson rar 'dzud/ /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal pos rtag tu mnar zhing gtse/ /rgya nag rgyal po shing la sbrul ltar 'khri/ /rgya gar rgyal po lug la spyang ltar 'jab/ /stag gzig rgyal po bya khyur khra ltar rgyug /ge sar rgyal po shing la rta ltar 'tshab/ /ces skad to/ /'thab tu mi thub bod la dmag grangs nyungs/ /yul gzhan 'gro ru rgyal phran gyis mi ster/ /thang la mi chags brag ri btsan po 'dzin/ /bza' btung mi rnyed bkres skom sdug bsngal che/ /bod yul mi rnams rab tu sdug bsngal che/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ /gnya' khri btsan po bod yul rjer gshegs nas/ /bod 'bangs bde zhing skyid par mdzad pa yin/ /'di nyid mi yi yul du byon tshul ni/ /gnam gyi rim pa bcu gsum steng zhes pa/ /gzugs khams 'od gsal gyi ni lha ris nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus/ /thugs rjes sa steng gshegs ste mi rje mdzad/ /'di la bsgrags pa bon lugs ces grags kyang / /phya dang gnam la dga' zhing blun pa yi/ /bod yul gna' mi spyi mthun gzung phyir bstan/ /spyir yo ga lha gyes can gyi lugs la rtsibs kyi lha /rla yol sdes spyan drangs pa dang / /lha glang ru dkar sogs dkon nor brdzangs tshul sogs dang / /srid pa'i lha phal cher gyi byung tshul dang bcas pa snang ngo / /mi rje lhas mdzad 'dzam gling yul gzhan las/ khyad tu 'phags par 'chad phyir dmad mi bya/ /yang gsang mi min lugs zhes zer ba ni/ /156

mthong snang tha dad tsam la 'gal ba med/ /gzhan du rigs mthon rnams kyi rigs mi dmad/ /gsang ba chos lugs 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /li tswa blu yi rigs byung zhes gsungs phyir/ /rigs mchog go tam shākya'i brgyud par bsal/ /'di dag du li tswa le'i brgyud pa gzugs can snying po dang ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal yin bya ba dang / /gtum po rab snang gi bu shar pa zhes bris pa dang / /ston pa shākya'i rgyal po byon pa'i 'og tu skya seng bu lnga sogs byung bar byas nas ru pa ti lung bstan gyi mdo yod bya ba dang / /kun mkhyen bus stod 'grel gyi lung gis bod spyi mi rnams ru pa ti las 'chad pa dang / /bod sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed dam/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal lam/ /gzugs can snying po'i sras chung ba stobs chung gi sras lnga tshigs cig sor mo dra bas 'brel pa sogs mtshan ldan zhig byung ba ltas ngan du dogs pas zangs su bcug chur bskyur ba zhing par brnyed nas gsos pa phyis skyo bas bros pa bod kyi rjer bcol zhes sogs mang du snang yang dag par ma mthong ste skya seng bu lnga ni ston pa las ches snga ste ston pa dga' ldan nas gshegs tshe 'dzam gling gi gang du skye bar rigs zhes lha rnams 'gro ba na lha'i bu kha cig gis skya seng gi rgyud glang po'i grong gi rgyal po 'di 'os so zhes zer ba la gzhan rnams kyis 'di ni rgyud rnam par 'khrugs pa yin te 'di ltar g.yul ngor brtan pa chos kyi bu/ /'jig sde la rlung gi bu/ /srid sgrub la dbang po'i bu/ /ris med dang lhar bcas la tha skar gyi bu zhes zer te rgyud rnam par 'khrugs pas na mi rigs so zhes bsgrags par rgya rol las bshad de/ /gzugs can snying po sogs kyang shākya'i rigs su mdo las bshad pa ma mthong la/ /spyir gzugs can snying po/ gsal rgyal/ rab snang / shar pa bzhi po ston pa'i dgung mnyam bzhi'i re re yin zhing phal cher ston pa'i gong du 'das par 'dul ba lung las gsungs pas ston 157

pa 'das nas byung ba 'dra ba'i lo rgyus de rnams mi 'grig cing / spyir rgyal po de rshams kyi tshe bram ze rig byed kyi smreng dang mtshan brtag pa la mkhas pa'i mdun na 'don sogs mang zhing skye bo gra ma rnams kyang sgyu rtsal drug bcu rtsa bzhi po slob pa'i phyir bu mtshan dpe dang ldan pa btsas na ltas ngan du dogs pa ga la skye/ lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel shes rab go chas mdzad par sngon skya seng gi bu lnga dang sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thab pa na rgyal po ru pa ti ces pa 'kho ra brgya dang bcas la bud med kyi chas su zhugs nas ri kha ba can gyi khrod du bros pa 'phel ba la deng sang yang bod ces grags so/ /zhes byung ba yang bod mi mtha' dag gi khungs ni ma yin te ru pa ti gnya' khri btsan por byed na de'i gong du mi mang du yod par grags pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang /min na yang bod yul na shākya'i rgyal brgyud gzhan yod par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na de dag ni bod dang nye ba mon yul kha cig la bod kyi sgrar byas pa du ma snang ba'i de lta bu zhig du zad to/ /yang sngon rabs pa mang po zhig rgyal po skya seng dang dmag brgya pa gnyis dus gcig la skyes phyis rgyal srid rtsod pa na dmag brgya pa la bu brgya yod pas dmag brgya par grags shing skya seng gis lha mchod pas drang srong zhig gis mi ma yin gyi bu lnga byin/ de rnams la yon tan ci yod dris pas so sor smras cing srid sgrub kyis dmag brgya tham pa thub byas pas/nyam sad pa'i phyir 'o na dmag brgya pa thul zhig byas pas des pha dang go dgu po bsad/ tha chung ru pa ti mtshan dang ldan pa de btson du khrid nas 'ongs/skya seng gis gsod par 'phangs nas zangs nang du zas skom dang gos dang bcas te chur bskyur ba zhing pas rnyed nas gsos/ phyis bod yul du byon nas rje mdzad zer yang lha sa'i bka' tshigs chen mor gnya' khri btsan po nas tho tho ri'i bar lo lnga brgyu song / tho thos brgya dang nyi shu thub/ de nas srong btsan 15 8

kyi bar gyi bzhi la brgya dang bcu gcig song bar bshad pas ston pa 'das nas lo mang zhig na bod rje byon par gsal la/ dmag brgya pa'i bu ru pa ti sogs ston pa ma byon pa'i gong du byung bar nges so/ /des na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas ring zhig lon pa na shākya li tsā wi'i rgyud pa mtshan dpe dang ldan pa cig bod du byon nas rje mdzad par gsal la de mtshan ru pa tir gcig pa tsam byung ba ni mi 'gal lo/ /'on kyang de nyid kyi lo rgyus nges pa can bod du sngon grags mi snang ngo / /ka bkol ma las shākya ri brags pa'i rgyud pa ces snang yang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ li tsā li rnams rigs su byung / /zhes lung bstan pas yi ge nyams par zad ste ka bkol ma'i phyi mo nub nas phyis lha sa'i dkon gnyer gyi ngag las bris zer ba sogs du ma snang ba'i phyir ro/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis byin brlabs rnam par sprul/ /shākya li tsā wi las 'phel ba ni/ /mtshan dpe rdzogs pa skyes bu chen po cig /lha yis spyan drangs bod rje'i thog ma mdzad/ /'od gsal lha las bab dang shākya yi/ /rgyal rgyud yin pa'ang 'gal ba ma yin te/ /zas gtsang sras dang dga' ldan lha gnas nas/ /babs pa 'gal ba med pa ji bzhin no/ /dang por lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la bab/ /lha ri rol po btsan thang sgo bzhir byon/ /de tshe bod mi skal ldan 'ga' yis mthong / /btsan pa lho dang gnyags/ btsun pa khyung dang snubs/ gnyan pa se dang sbo ste yab 'bangs rus drug dang lha bo lha sras/ se bon rma bon/ cog la bon/ zhang zhung bon/ tshe mi bon sogs shes pa can bcu gnyis kyis mjal/lta bas mi ngoms gzugs la ngo mtshar skyes/ /dris pas phan tshun ma go brda ma 'jal/ /mdzub mo nam mkhar ker ba mthong ba yis/ /lha yul gnam nas 'ongs pa'i btsan por 'dug /'di la bdag cag rje bo zhu dgos zer/ /gnya' bar khri la bteg nas spyan drangs pas/ /mthong thos thams cad 'dud 159

cing ngo mtshar skyes/ /mtshan du gnya' khri btsan po zhes byung grags/ /sku mkhar thog ma yum bu bla sgang mdzad/ /sum pa'i bon po o yong rgyal ba btul//snubs ji srid pa rgyal phran 'bangs su 'dus/ /rgyal po de sras mu khri btsan po ste/ /de nas ding khri so khri mer khri dang / /gdags khri sribs khri btsan po ces bye ba/ /'di rnams gnam la khri bdun zhes su grags/ /yon gyi mtshan gnam mug mug zer/ /de las skyes pas mug khri btsan po/ de bzhin du sa ding ding / so tham tham/ dog mer mer/ gdags lha dkar mo/ sribs lha sngon mo rnams yum yin pas so so'i mtshan btags ces kyang grag go /ri brag mi thogs mkha' la gshegs bzhud byed/ /nyin bzhin sar byon mtshan bzhin mkha' la gshegs/ /sras kyis chibs kha thub par gyur pa na/ /rmya thag la 'jus nam mkhar gshegs so skad/ /lha la ro med 'ja' tshon ltar yal bas /grongang kyi bang so gnam la btab ces grag /de yi btsun mo sa btsun klu rje'i sras/ /'di 'khrungs tshe a phyi gdags lha dkar mo la mtshan cir gsol dris pas bla spang dang ma ding mes ma tshig gam/ /bla mtsho sngon mo ma skams sam/ /bla brag dkar po ma nyil lam/ /zer ba la de rnams ma nyams smras kyang rgan mo rgan ches dbang po nyams pas log par go ste 'o na rgyal sa mi zin zer nas mtshan log par btags ces grag /phyi mos mtshan du gri gum btsan por gsol/ /de yi btsun mo glu sring mer lcam la/ /sha khri nya khri bya khri gsum yang bltames/ /de tshe rgya gar yul dang stag gzig mtshams/ /gu ra wa ta ces bya'i yul khams nas/ /mu stegs bon po 'a zha zhes pa byung / /gnam la 'phur zhing kha nas mngon shes smra / /shing la 'breng 'dra rdo la lhu gzug 'dral/ /rtag du sha chang gis ni 'dre mchod byed/ /de la rgyal pos bla mchod bkur sti mdzad//g.yu yi g.yung drung dpa' ba'i stag slog dang / /'gang ba'i ral khas bstod 160

cing mnga' thang sbar/ khu dang nu bas che zhes a yang bos/ /mu stegs lta log bon gyi byin rlabs chungs/ /rgyal po'i thugs su/bdud ris gdon gsol gyur/ /nga la gri gum du 'dogs pa tsug yin zer ba la mthar grir gum zer nas btaṭa byas pas cis kyang grir 'gum na nga gzhan dang 'thab zer nas 'bangs lo ngam rta rdzi la 'thab zlar bcol yang zer/ ka bkol ma las kha che'i rgyal po dang g.yul sprad nas bod rgyal nas log pa'i lam du kha che'i mi lus pa cig na re/bod kyi dpa' bos gzhu ka ba tsam la mda' phya ma tsam 'phen pa byung / pha gi na zer nas pha bong la ldem me 'dug pa dmag mi tshos mthong bas la la na re rgyal po yin zer/ la la na re 'bangs lo ngam rta rdzi yin zer bas de gnyis gang yin brtag pa'i snyan phra bcug pas rgyal pos rtsal 'gran zer ba la lo ngam gyis ngas ma thub na nga la chad pa 'ong snyam nas gya log smras zer/ gang na'ang nyang ro rtsibs kyi thal ba tshal du skar ma sa ri sa ga la 'thab dus btab/ rgyal pos khyi mo nyan gyi rna gsang bya ba nyan po byed du btang ba khos go nas/ rgyal po dbu la dar nag gi thod bcings/ dpral bar me long btags/ phrag pa g.yas la wa ro dang / g.yon la khyi ro bkal ba dmar glang dmar brgya la thal sgro sums pa bkal/ ral gri glang bya pho klad la skor zhing byung na mi thub ces smras pas rgyal pos de thams cad byas 'thabs pas sa ri sa ga rlung skar du song bas rlung dmar chen po byung / bso btab pas ba lang 'drogs te thal sgro rnams ral thal tshub kyis mig 'gribs/ dar nag gi thod dang wa ro dang khyi ros rje'i mgur lha dang dgra lha pho lha gsum po yal/ ral gri bskor bas rmya thag dang rmu skas chad/ lo ngam gyis dpral ba'i me long la mda' 'phangs nas bkrongase skad/ /rgyal phran lo ngam rta rdzi bya ba la/ /'thab zla bcol te 'thabs pas gri ru bkrongs/ /zangs kyi ga'ur spur bcug lcags gzer btab/ /nyang chu skya 161

mo'i nang du bor bar gyur/ /rgyang mkhar pa tshab yul du dgung bdun chags/khri 'thang dgur mor dgung zhag bcu gsum chags/ /kong por khyer ste klu srin ho te re'i/ /bran mo bye ma lag ring zhes pas zin/ /mdzod nang dkor gyi dam pa byas ces grag /lha sras mched gsum yab kyi dkor mdzod nas/ /lha yi glang bu ce 'u ru dkar zhes/ /'phur shes bzhon nas kong po'i yul du bros/ /gcen po sha khris kong gi rje bo mdzad/ /'bring po bya khris po bo'i mnga' dbang mdzad/ /chung ba nya khris nyang po'i rje mdzad skad/ /lo ngam gyis ni lha gcig chung mar bzung / /lcam sring bzhi yi yum la rta rdzi bcol/ /rta 'tshor phyin te gnyid log rmi lam du/ /mi dkar mdzes pa cig dang bshos pa rmi/sa/ /sad tshe g.yag dkar zhig ni song ba mthong / /zla ba tshang nas khrag rlangs 'gul ba btsas/ /'brong ru dron mor bcug nas 'o mas bran/ /drod kyis btsos pas de yi nang nas ni/ /khye 'u mdzes cing lta na sdug pa byung / /ru las skyes dang ngar sos po ces btags/ /lo bcu lon tshe pha dang phu bo 'dri/ /rgyal po'i gdung dang spun zla 'tshol du phyin/ /rgyal po'i sku gdung kong nas rnyed na yang //bslangs pas ma ster rku bar ma thob nas/ /spur 'dis klu rnams mkha' lding 'jigs las bskyabs/ /de phyir nor gyi dam pa yin mod kyang / /mi mo bcu drug lon ba bya mig can/ /de mar byung na blu ru btang ngo skad/ /de btsal bas g.ye'i gangs bar yur gong nas bu mo dge yum bya ba zhig rnyed ste pha na re gser bu mo tsam zhig 'dod zer/ ma na re srid kyi bu yong ba'i thab su spur de la mtshar gyi lcag brgya dang mtshal gyi thig brgyad bcu 'debs su chug zer nas des blus skad/ bon tshe co gnyis kyis gri brtul yang ma thul nas pa ra'i bu skyi rgyal mang po rjes gri srid brtul ste spur yar lungs su spyan drangs skad/162

blus nas spyan drangs spur zangs phye pa'i tshe/ /spur des nga ra ra zhes sgra bsgraṭa pas/ /yul de'i ming yang ngar pa thang du thogs/ /'bangs bskor zhag ni sum brgya drug bcu byas/ /drang mo drang chung ri yi zom du bzhugs/ )de tshe gnam nas gser gyi thig gu byung / /spur la thim pas gnam lha gser thig grag /deng sang yul de'i lha ru bzhugs so skad/ /ru las skyes kyi 'phrul dang mthu stobs kyis/ /lo ngam 'khor bcas brtul zhing tshar gcod byas/ /ru las skyes kyis lo ngam gyi nang mir zhugs te sha khyi dkar mo'i spu rtsar dug byugs pa bkor du phul ba la lo ngam gyis byil byil byas pas de ma thag du lus thams cad srangs/ g.yog rnams kho na ba'i sar 'dus pa'i bar la nyang ro sham po mkhar gyi pha ri la bya rgod kyi tshang yod pas bya rgod kyi gseb tu zhugs te nyang ro sham po mkhar rtse nas phab/ lo ngam pho brgya mo brgya bsad skad/ /sras rnams rgyal sar spyan 'dren byas pa'i tshe/ /thog mtha' gnyis ni gshegs su ma bzhed nas/ /po bo'i yul nas 'bring po bya khris byon/ /rgyal sar bton tshe yum gyis sras la 'jus/ /bu khyod rgyal brgyud ma nyams yin nges na/ /rgyal srid brtan zhing rgyas par shog zhes smras/ /de tshe bar snang gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ khyod kyi bu de kun las rgyal 'gyur zhes/ /brjod pa thos pas de nyid mtshan du chags/ /'bangs kyis sgra nyams pu de gung rgyal grags/ /rgyal po'i sku mkhar 'ching ba stag rtse brtsigs/ /sham po mkhar gyi rtsi phab nas rmang rdo byas/ /lha gcig gis nga'i lus la lo ngam gyi bu yod pa rmang du gnon zhig zer nas srog dor bas yul de'i lha sman zhig byung bar grag rgyal pos mi mchog ru las skyes khyod kyis/ /nga yi yab kyi go bgyis gyil sar bton/ /sras kyi go bgyis yab kyi sku mtshal gnyer/ /che chung med pa'i mi kun khyod la smon/ /ming yang khu bo lha bu smon gzung zhes/ /btags shing drin du gzo ba rgya cher byas/ /163

rgyal pos kha bor khar bas kha'i rus su thogs skad/ /bod yul 'phral blon ring rigazi ring ra sgo mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi/ /thog mar gyur pa ru las skyes 'di yin/ /mdzangs pa'i las su shing bsregs sol ba byung / /de yis rdo bzhu gser dngul zangs lcags phyung / /shing la mig phug gshol dang gnya' shing byas/ /sa gzhi brkos nas phu chu yur du drangs/ /rmon pa dor bsdebs spang thang zhing du rmos/ /brgal bas mi thar chu la zam pa btsugs/ /rmos pa'i lo tog thog mar 'di nas byung / /ma 'ongs sngags dang 'dul ba 'byung ba'i ltas/ /gnam bon gshen po che dang bon gzhung byung / /gshen yul bon mo lung ring zhes zer ba dbus kyi 'on du rus gshen gyi byis pa bong bu'i rna ba can byung ba lo bcu gnyis lon tshe 'dres khrid nas lo bcu gnyis su mi khyur ma tshud/ lo bcu gnyis 'das nas log byung tshe yul 'di na 'dre 'di yod pa 'di ltar mchod thams cad shes pa cig byung nas bong bu'i rna ba sgrib pa'i phyir bal thod bcings ste 'dre mchod pa'i rdol bon dar zhing gzhan yang 'bras bu'i bon rigs lnga g.yung drung bla med kyi theg pa zhes 'bras bu bde 'gro mtho ris thob par 'dod pa dang / rgyu'i bon rigs bzhi skad pa snang gshen bal thod can gyis phya g.yang 'gugs mi nor rgyas par byed/ 'phrul gshen bal mtshon can gyis yas dang mdos gtong 'gal rkyen sel/ cha gshen ju thig can gyis legs nyes ston zag bcas kyi mngon shes 'chad/ dur gshen mtshon cha can gyis gson gshin gyi rtsis byed/ thams cad rnga gshang gi sgra 'khrol/ 'jim pa'i sha ba nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / rnga la bzhon nas 'gro ba sogs zag bcas kyi rdzu 'phrul mang po yod skad/ mdo sde 'byung ba'i ltas su sgrung rnams dar/ /ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang ma sangs kyi sgrung dang / mchil pa'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad dang /mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ltas lde 'u sprod/ /srang la them gnyer lnga ba che ci 164 ‘

yin/ por mgo mgo can skyed cing rgyags ci yin zhes 'dri ba sogs ste bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyi tshul lha sa'i gdung rnams la bris nas yod skad/ cade yis bod rnams cung zad blo kha bye/ /rgyal po yab sras 'di gnyis sto da kyi stengs4 /stengs gnyis bang so rdza dang g.ya' la btab/ /de dang btsun mo 'om thang sman mtsho'i sras/ /legs drug thog ma i sho legs ces bya/ /de yi blon po lha bu mgo dkar zhes/ khu khu ru las skyes kyi bu yis byas/ /'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gnyis pa yin/ /mdzangs pa'i las su zhing la dor kha brtsis/ /'brog la thul rtsis phu chu yur du drangs/ /mda' ru chu ma rmo ba 'di nas dar/ /rgyal po de shogs legs dang thi sho legs/ /gong ru legs dang lnga nga/ 'brong gzher legs/ /sho legs rnams ni sa la legs drug zer/ /yum rmya lcam bra ma/ klu lcam mer ma/ mtshan mo gung sman/ mtsho sman 'brong ma/gnam sman bu mo rnams yum yin zer/ 'di drug ring la 'ching ba rtse drug brtsigs/ stag rtse/ rgod rtse/ yang rtse/ khri rtse/ rtse mo khyung rgyal/ khri brtsigs 'bum gdugs drug yin/ legs drug bang so g.ya' spang mtshwams su btab/ /spang la 'ja' tshon rgyas pa 'dra 'o skad/ /de nas rgyal po lde brgyad ces pa byung ka /yum rmya lcam rmang legs/ mtsho sman khri dkar/ se gnyan mer mo/ klu mo mer mo/ 'o za te mo mtsho/ khri sman rje mo/ khri se btsun gnyan mo/ sman btsun lug skong rnams kyi sras/ za nam zin lde/ 'phrul nam gzhung btsan lde/ se snol nam lde/ se snor po lde/ lde nor nam/ lde snol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sbrin btsan ste brgyad do/ /lde brgyad bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab/ /mtsho la kha ba bab pa 'dra 'o skad/ /btsan lnga'i thog ma to re long btsan yin/ /yum nye btsun mang ma rje/ blon po thon mi 'bring po rgyal/ snubs sman da re/ stong 'dar rje rnams kyis byas skad/ 'di yan yum rnams lha mo 165

klu mo yin/ /btsun mo'i rten dog la mi 'tsher zhes spur mi yong skad/ de phyir lha sras lde sras ces par grags/ /'bangs dang gnyen bsres man chad lde sras bzhag /de yi dod du lha sras btsan po zer/ /de dang 'o ma lde za khri btsun byang ma'i sras khri btsan nam/ blon po snubs gnya' dor gtsug blon dang sras khri zung mong khong gis byas/ rje de dang sman za khri dkar gyi sras khri sgra spungs btsan/ blon po mgar sgra dzi mun dang thon mi glu mang dred pos byas/rje de dang sman gsum klu steng gi sras khri thog rje thog btsan/ blon po mgar gnya' btsan ldem bu dang snubs skyes thog rje mor btsan gyis byas/ bzhi pa thog rje thog btsan sku ring la/ /lha yi rol mo gling bu cag par byung / /'di yan gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun du/ /chab srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gyis bskyangs/ /de nas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa/ /rgyal sras kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul ni/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po tho tho ri gnyan btsan/ /yab thog rje thog btsan dang yum ru yong za stong rgyal mo mtsho'i sras te phyag rdor gyi sprul par bshad pa'ang yod kyang mi 'gal te kun du bzang po sngags su dbang bskur ba ni phyag na rdo rje yin par phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi rgyud las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /lde ston gyi chos byung du sa snying gi sprul pa ces kyang snang / dgung lo drug bcu bzhes pa sku mkhar che/ /yum bu bla sgang rtse la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /nam mkhar 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogakhag bkra /me tog char dang lha yi rol mo byung / /gdugs shar tshe na nyi zer dang 'grogs nas/ /gser shog ngos la bee ḍū ryas bris pa'i//pang kong phyag rgya mdo sde za ma tog /yid du 'ong ba'i glegs bam rnam gnyis dang / /gser gyi mchod rten mu dra'i phyag rgya dang / /tsinda ma ṇi'i skos phor rnam drug bab/ /'di la g.yu'i mchod rten bang rim bzhi pa ces kyang 'byung / tsinda ma ṇi'i skos phor zhes pa'i bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin nor bu'i gzugs kyi skos 166

phor zhig dang / mu dra'i phyag rgya zhes tshad khru gang tsam gyi nor bu'i rigs kyi rdo la yig drug rang byung can yod skad/ de'i phyir mdo la snga ba za ma tog /gzungs la snga ba tsenda ma ṇi zhes bod du grags pa yin no/ /ka bkol mar chos rgyal mya ngan med gyi gdung rgyud rgyal po dza zhes bya bas ma ga dhar sngon mes po mya ngan med kyis sku dang thugs kyi rten rgya cher byas 'dug kyang gsung gi rten ma byas par 'dug pas ngas gsung gi rten byed zer bas blon po cig gis chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis byas pa ltar khyed rang yang lung bstan gyi rgyal po yin srid pas dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i dmod tshugs zer nas de ltar byas pas rdo rje sems dpa'as nam mkha' nas glegs bam gyi char phab/ /de rnams rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la so sor btags te ste mchod pa byas pas rlung g.yos pas rgyal mtshan gcig mi snang bar khyer ba de bod tu bab pa yin zhes bshad nas mdo gnyis ma gtogs gzhan phyag rgya bzhi pa ma bshad/ 'di yang ma ga dha ni yi ge nyams par zad pas spyir za hor gyi yul du byung bar snang la/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud phyi ma'i lung yin zer ba/ /nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni bgyo dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa cig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa ste/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i ri bo la/ /thugs rjes mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po rje zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rje snang bar byed/ /ces 'dren par snang zhing / bod du chos byung ba ni lha mo dri ma 'id pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdor/ lo stong dang lnga brgya na dam pa'i chos gdong dmar can gyi yul zhes pa bod du 'byung bar bshad pas dus mi mtshungs par snang mod/ dza'i khang thog nas mi snang bar gyur pa dag pa'i zhing du gnas nas phyis bod tu bab pa lta bu la ni 'gal ba med to/ /bod du chos 'byung tshul 'di la'ang lo nyis stong 167

lnga brgya zhes zer ba mang bar snang yang stong dang lnga brgya 'chad pa rnams 'grig par snang zhing 'di ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus la dgongs so/ /kun mkhyen bus rba bzhed nas gdong dmar gyi yul rgya nag la bshad gsungs kyang rba bzhed na sang shi rgya nag du chos len par btang dus ju zhag mkhan mkhas pas byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa byed 'di 'dra ba pho nyar 'os zhes 'bag byas nas sleb pa'i tshe rgyal pos bya dga' cher byin/ /gdong dmar can yul du chos kyi khungs 'byin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'byung bar lung bstan pa de khyod yin nges zhes chos bam po stong tsam bskur zhes gdong dmar can gyi yul bod la ngos bzung ba ches gsal por yod do/ kha cig tu lo dang po la gser gyi ljang pa la bai ḍūrya zhun mas bris pa'i glegs bam gnyis po bab/ gser skyems dang g.yu sngon gyis mchod pas sang phod lo dus su phyag rgya gzhan rnams byung zhes kyang snang / spyir theg chen gyi mdo sngags gnyis dang lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi mtshon byed tu rten de rnams byung la gsang ba chos lugs la lar mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho bod kyi don du 'khrungs pa des khri srong lde btsan yin nam snyam nas mdo sde gnyis po bod rje la skyel du btang ba rgyal po thugs sgam pas bon blon rnams gnam la dga' ba gdul phyir gnam nas bab bo zhes gsungs bar yang bshad/ de nas rgyal po'i sku gshen rmu bon skyo ngo mtshar bya bas 'a di bon dar ba'i rtags yin pas bon lugs ltar mchod cig zer nas sha khrag gis mchod pas nad dang than pa byung / rgyal po'i rmang lam du 'di chos dar ba'i rtags yin pas spos dang me tog dang mar mes mchod cig mi rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes par 'gyur ro zhes byung nas chos bzhin mchod pas bkra shis skad/ chos sam bon du mkhyen tshul ma bstan yang / /gser skyems g.yu sngon la sogs kyis mchod de/ /gser skyems zhes btung bar gser blug pa 168

dang / g.yu sngon sgog pa yin zer yang ma dag pa ste bza' ba'i steng du g.yu bzang po bzhag par snang ngo / /gnyan po gsang ba zhes par mtshan gsol nas/ /rgyal pos phyag bskor bkur sti rgya cher byas/ /tshe gcig skye ba gnyis la mnga' brnyes zhes/ /dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon shar gyur/ /slar yang dgung lo drug bcur sku tshe srings/ /mi lo brgya dang nyi shu'i bar du bzhugs/ /nga yi thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba la/ /mchod pa gyis shig bsams dgu 'grub bo zhes/ /bod 'bangs spyi la yang yang zhal chems gsungs/ btsan lnga man chad bang so 'phying yul btab/ /btsan lnga'i mchad pa sa phung sbra 'drar yod/ kha cig btsan gsum las mi 'dod pa dang /btsan lnga ma dag zhes 'chad pa la snying po ci yang med de gsang ba yang chung sogs las/ btsan lnga'i mchad pa sa phung sbra 'dra yod/ /phul med mchad pa gru bzhi mi shes skad/ zhes sogs sngon nas cher grags pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig phyis lha'i snyan shal ltar snyan ring por gyur pas tho tho ri snyan shal byung zer ba'ang blun skad bcos ma ste gnyan po gsang ba zhes pa lta bu bka' gnyan pa'i don yin gyi rna ba la zhe sa bcug pa'i snyan min no/ /des na tho tho ri gnyan btsan yan la btsan lnga zer ro/ /de yi btsun mo rno za mang dgar la/ /lha sras khri gnyan gzungs btsan zhes pa 'khrungs/ /sras kyis rno la zhang du bos pa yis/ /zhang du no lnga rus la der ming chags/ /de yan la zhang po la jo bo zhes 'bod skad/ rgyal po 'di'i blon po sbas snang gnyer lha btsan dang mgar khri 'bring gis byas/ khri gnyan mchad pa don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /de yang phul med sa phung brdal pa 'dra/ /rje de dang yum 'bro za mo dur yang bzhin gyi sras/ /de nas rgyal po 'brong gnyan lde ru ste/ /rtob pa'i nad kyis sku la snyun 'dze byung / /dwags po nas mchims za klu rgyal bya ba mdzes pa cig khab 169

ma ri //// //re/ //lnga( /sdeX/ thob ri ////tu bzhas/ sa ma sa par gyur nas rgyu sa pas nga rang ga yul na zas ga yod pa de med pas lan nam zer nas len bcug pas g.yog mos sbal pa mar btsos mang du slangs te mdzad du spras nas zos pas mdzes par gyur nas rgyal pos nga rang yang bza'o snyam nas lde tshab kyis sgo phye bas sbal ro mthong bas rtog pa zos ste bsnyun nad byung / de dus bod gzhan na nya mi za bar dwags po sbal zan gyi yul zhes de na nya za zhing nya la sbal par grags pa yin skad/ dwaṭa mos sras dmus long zhig bltams pa la khyod 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos la mig phyis rgyal sa gyis/ mig ma byung ba'am gdung chad pa 'dra na sum pa'i yul na bon po'i chung ma rgya mo rgya lcam bya ba la nga'i bu sum ri ring po bya ba yod bos la khyod rang gshegs rdzu thob la rgyal sar chug zer nas yab yum gnyis blon po snyags thang pa yar rje dang bcas pa gdung rgyud la bsnyun mi 'byung ba'i phyir gson por dur du zhugs skad/ mi chos rtog pas phung gis rtog pa bskyungs/ /bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin gyis nyon/ /ngan pa rnams kyang me dang 'dra bar gsos/ /rgyal srid zungs zhes sras la zhal chems mdzad/ /rje 'bangs gsum ni gson bzhin bang sor gshegs/ /zhang mda'i bang so gson mchad blum por grags/ /lha sras dmus long bkon pa bkra de yis/ /gnyan po gsang ba mchod pa'i byin rlabs dang / /'a zha'i yul gyi sman pas spyan phye ste/ /stag mo'i ri la ri dwags gnyan gzigs pas/ /mtshan yang stag ri gnyan gzigs btsan du thogs/ /rgyal phran 'a zha rje bya ba sman pa mkhas pa cig bos pas spyan phye/ rgyal bu'i phyags sgo klad du btags pa'i 'og du 'a zha rjes 'dzul/ log nas mas gtam dris pas/ /bod kyi rgyal po ni ma mthong / sgo gong na g.yu'i lham chung zhig btags 'dug pa'i 'og la phyin pas byis pa dmus long zhig 'dug pa'i mig phye nas log go smras pas ma na re/ gtam ches sod 170

ni bod kyi chab 'og tu tshud pas thabs ci yang med do zer/ rgyal phran rnams kyi suca/ gnyis mnga' 'og 'dus/ /ban po rje 'u zha rje drang gar rje/ zin po rje/ zhang zhung rje rnams btul/ nyang sbas gnon gsum 'bangs su chud skadra/'di dus khri ngor snang btsun mong gi bus/ /bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad kyis bcal/ /dga' gnyis tshong byas mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs/ de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med/ /de phyir mdzangs mi bdun gyi gsum par graṭa/ /gzhan yang sna nam mang gnya'/ spra khri zung lan pa rnams kyis blon po byas/ /yab sras 'di gnyis bar gyi stengs zhes grags/ /sras spyan ma bye ba'i bar zhag nyer gcig rgyal po med pas gdung stongs skad/ gdung gi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni khru gzungs bang so'i g.yon na yod/ /de yang phul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra/ /de yi 'og na btsun mo 'bro za smun btsan dang mon bu rgyal mtshan gnyijashe kyi bang so sa phung gnyis yod/ de sras rgyal po gnam ri srong ba/ tsan yin/ /yum stong btsun 'bro dkar las 'khrungs/ /blon po dbas snang bzhed/ tshe grong na gnag ser/ nyang tseng gu/ gnon 'phan lnga sum rnams kyis byas/ /rgya nag yul nas rtsis dang sman dpyad blangs/ /mtha' yi rgya dang gru gu 'og tu btul/ /lo sar sgang la lug sha'i lag pa rlon pa brtsigs pa la 'dzegs nas rgya'i mkhar phab/ /mchil pa'i ske la sba me btags pa btang bas rgya yul mer btang skad/ de bas bod la bka' drin che bar grags/ sku mkhar khri brtsigs 'bum gdugs bya ba ba dmar mo'i 'o ma'i 'jim pas brtsigs/ dmus te long ba khrid nas brag gsum deng ma'i mtsho 'gram nas rta mdo ba cang shes rnyed nas rgyal po'i chibs pa byas/ sbrang dga' bo dang rmya dpung ri bya ba'i gyad gnyis kyis zhabs tog byas te phung g.yag thal ka ru ring bya ba'i byang 'brong smyon pa bsad nas sha rta sga la btags pa lhung ba 171

la tshwa 'gos pa'i bro ba tshor bas lan tshwa ngo shes te byang gi tshwa len pa'i srol byung skad/ /bang so gru bzhir brtsig pa de nas byung / /gral ni khri gzung bang so/ri g.yas na yod/ /phul che dbyibs ni gru bzhi sog ka ris/ /ming du gung ri sog gar btags so skad/ /de ltar bod rje gnya' khri btsan po nas/ /thog ma'i gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun la/ /mi lo drug brgya dang ni drug bcu song / /de nas tho tho ri sogs gdung rabs lngar/ /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu lon no zhes/ /bka' btsigs la sogs yig rnying da mar bshad/ /de tshe bod ༄yul 'gro rnams smin gzigs nas/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po'i mdzad pa dngos su bstan/ /de yang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas par/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes bya/ /li tsā li rnams riṭa su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyis don grub ste/ /longs spyod che dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod che ldan zhes/ /mi yis bdag pos de yang grub/ /lo ni brgyad bcur rgyal srid byed/ /des ni rkun ma rnam par spangs/ /rgyal po de yi srog spangs nas/ /de yis sngags ni myur grub ste/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i las byed pa'o/ /'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo da/nga ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan don brtson/ /rtag du yid ni mi skyo ba'o/ /de la sogs pa gsungs pa yi/ /de bzhin rgyal po mang po ni/ /rnam pa du ma mang po dag kha dog sna tshogs sna tshogs gzugs/ kha ba can rnams kla klo'i rgyal/ /der yang ston pa mchod byed pa/ khyu mchog khyu mchog bzang po dang / /sa 'og de bzhin sa 'og bzang / /de bzhin pha rol gnon nyid dang / /rkang pa'i 'gres zhes bstan pa yin/ /sa srung dang ni be 'u dang / /'od ldan nyid ni 172

phyi ma yin/ /mtha' mar 'tshang rgya'i ngang tshul ste/ /kla klo rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ /de 'og lugs ni rnam gcig cing / /phyi rol skye rgus nye bar spyod/ /ces lung bstan pa'i lha ldan gyi yul skyi shod lha sa/ /rgyal po mi'i lha chos rgya la srong btsan sgam po/ /sgrol ma dang gos dkar dang dkar chen mo sogs btsun mo rnams/ khyu mchog mang srong mang btsan/ khyu mchog bzang 'dus srong mang po rje/ sa 'og mes ag tshoms/ sa 'og bzang khri srong lde btsan/ pha rol gnon mu ni btsan po/ rkang pa'i 'gros sad na lags/ sa srung khri ral/ be 'u glang dar/ 'od ldan 'od srung gi bar dang / de phal cher 'tshang rgya ba dang /de nas kla klo rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ zhes pa'i smad sil chad/ de 'og phyi rog skye rgus spyod pa mthar mi nyag hor rgya ljang tu ru ṅka rnams kyis rim pas dbang byed pa'o/ /de tshe bal yul bdag po ni/ /mtshon gyis mtha' ma rnam par 'jig /sa bdag du ma gsungs pa rnams/ /sna tshogs lha dang bram ze dga'//zhes bal rje 'od zer go chas shing kun mchod rten gyi rmang khong seng lha khang du yod pa'i nang du grub thob mang po tshogs 'khor la spyan drangs te bde mchog drug bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs dngos su sprul nas tshogs 'khor mdzad pa na bdag ma 'ongs kyi bar du rnam sprul mi bsdu bar bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas pho brang du byon te sras la 'dir glang dmar po cig 'ong ba sod cig zhes bsgos nas glang bu gzugs bsgyur ba bsad pas gdung phal cher bde mchog gi lha tshogs su gyur te grub chen rnams kyang da lta sprul pa ma bsdus par dngos su bzhugs zhes grag cing de'i sgo sha nta pu ri zhes deng sang lha khang gnyan po yod pa dang / de 'das pa na gri'i 'khor lo yod ces 'gro mi nus pa yod skad pas/ bal yul gyi bdag po mtshon gyis 'jig pa ni 'di dang / de phyin phyi rol pa sogs lugs sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'i bal rje 'byung bar lung 173

bstan nam snyam mo/ /lung bstan 'di bdag gis mthong nas 'di skabs su bris pa yin yang 'di brtsams nas zla ba lnga drug zhig lon pa'i tshe 'gos lo tsā ba'i deb ther sngon po mthong ba na bris 'dug cing / mtha' mar 'tshar rgyal ngang tshul can/ /zhes bton nas hor rgyal po'am nyang stod shar kha bar 'bru bsnan du rung zer ba 'dug kyang dpe ma dag pa cig gzigs pa 'dra ste bdag gis 'di ltar bris pa kho na mthong la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi lung bstan de rnams la gang zag de mthar theg gsum gang du nges pa de bstan pa kho na snang bas bod rgyal rnams phal cher theg chen du rigs nges par bstan pa yin la/ hor rgya sogs ni phyi rol skye rgus nye bar spyod/ /ces bstan pas zlos mi dgos cing shar kha sogs brjod pa ni brjod bya dka' bas 'tshol dgos pa cig byung bar snang ngo / /de sogs rgyal bas gsal bar lung du bstan/ /de yang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /bod kyi mi rnams gdul ba'i dus gzigs nas/ /sku lus 'od zer rnams bzhi dus gcig spros/ /ngan 'gro'i khams rnams rnam par sbyangs nas ni/ /spyan ras g.yas kyi 'od zer bal por song / /grong khyer kho phom klu yi pho brang du/ /'od zer go cha'i btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs/ /spyan g.yon 'od zer rgya nag zim shi'i yul/ /tha yi dzung gi btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs/ /zhal gyi 'od zer bod yul dbu ru'i ljangs/ /gya re'i yar phreng brag la phog pa yis/ /chos ska'i sing po yig drag ring // dpa rang byung shar/ /thugs ku'i 'od zer yar snron sbra stod tshal/ /pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling zhes par/ /rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan 'khor bcas kun/ /'od kyis khyab par mdzad de slar 'dus nas/ /btsun mo 'bri bza' thod dkar lhums su zhugs/ /sngon med dga' dang bde bas lus tshim ste/ /bkra shis ltas kyis phyogs kun khyab par gyur/ /lhums su 'gro mang smin dang 174

grol mdzad nas/ /me mo glang lo rgyu skar rgyal gyi tshe/ /spru9sga pa'i chos kyi rgyal po yab yum gsum/ /so so'i pho brang chen por dus gcig bltams/ /bod yul pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur du/ khyad du 'phags pa 'gran zla med pa'i sras/ /gser mdog dbu skra thon mthing ltar mi ngoms/ /phyag zhabs 'khor los bkra ba mtshan dpe rdzogs/ /dbu gtsug 'od dpag med zhal dngos su bzhugs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sprin las grol ba ltar/ /bltams tshe sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs mdzad/ /byang sems kun gyis shis pa'i tshigs bcad brjod/ /lha rnams thams cad mchod pa'i las la brtson/ /lha rdzas me tog nam mkha' yog par gyur/ /de la mthong lugs rnam par gsum du byung / /rgyal ba rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /bod yul mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston par gzigs/ /byang sems rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rgyal por sprul nas gang la gang 'dul gyis/ /bod yul 'gro rnams smin grol mdzad par gzigs/ /bod 'bangs skye bos 'gran zla bral ba yi/ /lha sras dam pa cig ni 'khrungs par mthong / /yab kyis a mi tā bha'i zhal sbed phyir/ /leb rgan dar gyis dbu la thod du mdzad/ /nang 'khor las sgrib srab pa rnams kyis ni/ /rigs lngas dbu brgyan bcu gcig zhal du mthong //mgar dang thon mi bya ba'i khye chung gnyis/ /blon po zhe sa 'bul ba'i phyir 'brengs pas/ /a mi tā bha'i zhal mthong phyir bsnyad pas/ /rgyal bu dbu gnyis ldan par grags so skad/ /dga' ston dpag yas lo zla du mar byas/ khri srong btsan zhes mtshan du gsol ba las/ /yon tan kun ldan shin tu thugs sgam pas/ /mtshan yang srong btsan sgam por chags par gyur/ /bal yul dang ni rgya nag pho brang du/ /lha gcig khyad du 'phags pa re re 'khrungs/ /bal po'i lha gcig khro gnyer can ma dngos/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan tsandan dri ngad bro/ /bstan bcos kun 175

mkhas lha gcig khri btsun btags/ /rgya rje'i sras mo sgrol ma'i spru94 pa ste/ /sngo dmar mdangs ldan utpal dri ngad bro/ /rig pa'i gnas mkhas 'jig rten thams cad las/ /rmad byung zhig 'khrungs 'un shing kong jo zhes/ /bod skad mtsho yi padma zer ro skad/ /lha sras dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i tshe/ /yab kyis rgyal po'i chab srid mnga' dbang phul/ /bcu gsum lon dus yab gshegs nas sras rgyal sar bskos ces grags kyang zhal gdams kyi skor las yab gnam ri srong btsan gyis rgyal srid phul nas zhus pa sogs gsungs pa'i yab bzhugs dus rgyal srid phyal bar nges so/ /rin po che yi khri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha'i mthongs nas dbang gi lha rnams byon/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel bas cod pan bcings/ /kun tu bzang pos bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ /'od dpag med pas spyi bor phyag bzhag zhing / /lha rnams kun gyis mchod pa'i sprin tshogs spros/ /de tshe rgyal po'i sku las 'od zer tshogs/ /dpag med byung ste phyogs bcu'i khams kun khyab/ /'od re'i rtse la longs sku'i zhing re chags/ /zhing re'i rnam snang drung rer rgyal po re/ /rnam snang kun gyis rgyal po'i spyi bo la/ /phyag gis byugs tshe rgyal po re re las/ /'od zer tshogs spros 'od re'i rtse mo la/ /rgyal po rta mchog chibs pa re re byung / /de re las kyang 'od zer dpag med spros/ /'od re'i rtse la sprul sku'i zhing re chags/ /zhing khams re na rgyal ba shāka thub re/ /re re'i mdun na srong btsan sgam po re/ /thub pa'i dbang pos rang rang drung 'khod pa'i/ /rgyal po'i dbu la phyag gis reg ma thag /rgyal po re las 'od zer mtha' yas spros/ /'od re'i rtse la spyan ras gzigs dbang re/ /de re las kyang 'od zer sprin gyi tshogs/ /re res nam mkha' thams cad khyab pa spros/ /'od re'i rtse la phyag stong spyan stong can/ /thugs rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu re/ /re res kyang ni sems can ma lus 176

pa/ gang la gang 'dul sprul pas 'dul bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis rgyal po dbang bskur ba'i tshul 'di khra 'brub/ gi rgyal po'i lha khang na gser gyis bris nas yod skad/ de ltar chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur nas/ /bod 'bangs lhar bcas kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /yang mes tho tho gnyan btsan gyis bstan pa/ /dbu ru shod chen lha sa dmar po ri/ /gnas der bdag gi 'gro don 'byung ngo zhes/ /dgongs nas pho brang nas ni gdan bteg ste/ /nang par gye re'i yar phreng gro btab tshe/ /zhang blon 'phrul gyi sna tshogs zhes bya bas/ /chu nang 'od zer sna tshogs khra chem mthong / /ngo mtshar skyes nas 'di rgyu ci lags zhus/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas zhang blon chen po nyon/ /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul 'di ru/ /sems can thams cad smin grol 'god pa'i lam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa gcig bsdus pa/ /phan bde yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mtha' 'khob skye bo 'dul ba'i gnyen po mchog /bod yul kha ba can pa'i chos skal ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yang snying 'dus pa'i mchog /gsang ba 'bru drug chos sku yig 'bru'i tshul/ /brag gi ngos 'dir yig drug rang byung yod/ /'dis kyang sems can mang po'i don byed gsungs/ /mchod pa mdzad pas brag las 'od zer 'phros/ /pha ri'i brag la phog pas phan tshun kun/ /'ja' tshon bkra ba'i mdangs kyis gcig tu 'brel/ /gong gi ming yang 'ja' mdangs su chags skad/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang khradma pa ṇi dang / /'phags ma sgrol ma dpal chen rta mgrin sogs/ /rang byung byon pa bal po'i gzo bo yis/ /rnam pa gsal stong lha khang tshul du mdzad/ /de nas dmar po ri la pho brang btab/ /chos rgyal 'gro ba'i don la g.yel med bzhugs/ /ka bkol ma las khrims bcas rten spyan drangs pa'i 'og tu dmar po ri thigs pa 'dra bar snang / /de tshe rgya gar rgya nag khrom ge sar/ /stag 177

gzig la sogs mtha' yi rgyal po gan/ /spral pa'i rgyal po shin ta gzhon na rig ra ra sirshayis/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba'i ngo mtshar thos/ /re re bzhin nas dpya skyes lo tang du/ /'bul zhing dkor sgrom phrin yig rgya cher phul/ /ka bkol mar mtha'i rgyal po lo bzhi lon pa cig gis rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong zhes thos nas mtha' bzhi'i rgyal pos dpya dang skyes lo tang du 'bul ba la zhabs tog 'di dang 'di yod do zhes yi ge phul ba la/ bod kyis skyes lan la ngag phrin las ye ge mi shes ces snang zhing ka bkol ma'i dngos bstan dgung lo bzhi la yab gshegs nas rgyal sa mdzad pa 'dra bar snang / /yul gru gzhan gyi yi ger ma stes pa/ /bod la rang gi yi ge dgos par gzigs/ /blon po blo gsal du ma rgya gar du/ /btang yang yi ge'i bzhed pa ma 'grub nas/ /bod kyi blon po blo rno ba bcu drug la gager bskur nas rgya gar du yi ge slob tu btang bas la la thang 'dre can rnam pa gsum la brdugs nas 'gro ma nus/ /la la tshad pas shi/ la la rgya skad ma shes par log skad/ de nas blon chen thon mi a nu'i bu4 /thon mi sasto ṭa zhes mkhas shing mdzangs/ /yid gzhungs blo rno dbang po skye mched gsal/ /yon tan du mar ldan pa cig la ni/ /bka' bsgos gser dang yo byad bskur ste btang / /thon gyi lug ra kha nas thon mi a nu ra ka ta'i bu thon mi sasto ṭa bya ba'i mi chung blo gsal ba zhig la gser phye bre gang bskur ste btang skad/ /de yis rgya gar kun myul lho phyogs phyin/ /sgra dang yi ger mkhas pa phul byung ba/ /bram ze chen po li byin yin par thos/ /der phyin gus pas btud cing gser phul nas/ /bdag ni mtha' 'khob bod kyi blon po yin/ /bdag gi rgyal po thugs rje chen po lags/ /'bangs rnams chos kyis tshim par mdzad pa dang / /dge ba bcu yi rgyal khrims 'cha' ba la/ /bdag gi yul na yi ge'i srol med pas/ /rgya gar yul du yi ge slob tu 178

mchis/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i bka' drin mdzod ces zhus/ /mkhas pa li byin dgyes pas lan gsungs pa/ /bden gnyis don rtog blon chen rig pa can/ khyod la yi ge sgra dang snyan ngag sogs/ /yon tan ngo mtshar can kun slong bo zhes /yi ge'i rigs rnams kun la ma rmongs bstan/ /rig pa'i rtsal phye shes rab sgron me bteg /rnam mang du ma'i yi ge khong du chud/ /lha rig seng ge la sogs paspyi ta/ /mkhas pa gzhan yang bsten nas sgra tshad dang / /rig pa'i gnas mang khong du chud par byas/ /theg pa chen po'i gsung rab mang du sbyangs/ /bod tu 'byon tshe mkhan po li byin gyis/ khyod ni rig gnas kun la rtse mor son/ /da ni sprul pa'i rgyal po'i dgongs pa sgrubs/ /bod yul 'gro kun yi ge sgra tshad dang / /lung rigs man ngag rnams kyis tshim par mdzod/ /thon mis yon phul gtang rag tshig brjod pa/ /thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras/ /bka' drin che 'o ngo mtshar che/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can//rig pa dri med kyi nam mkha' la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyu skar shar/ /smon lam dag pa'i rlung gis drangs/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i nyi zla shar/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bde gsal yid kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rig pa blo yi chu phran 'khor/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu bya sding / /sgra tshad yi ge'i nor bu bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel bar byed/ /sgyu lus dri med kyi sdong po la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi yal ga rgyas/ /bslabs shes yon tan gyi me tog shar/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i 'bras bu smin/ /bdag bod kyi blon po thon mi la/ /ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags/ /rgya gar yul du phyin pa yin/ /mkhas grub khyed dang mjal ba yin/ /yon tan gzhi ma yi ge yin/ /ma lus khong du chud pa yin/ /bod yul dbus su 'gro ba yin/ /rgyal pos dga' ston mdzad pa yin/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yin/ /rgyal pos dbu mdzad blon 'bangs la /179

sgra tshad yi ge spel ba yin/ /ku'o la rgyas par byed rgayin/ /thugs la btang/sa so rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes gsol zhabs mthil gtsug tu blangs nas ni/ /theg chen dam chos du ma dang bcas ste/ /bod yu'/ du phebs gus ba dga' ston mdzad/ /nā ga ra dang kha che'i yi ge la/ /dpe blangs sku mkhar ma rur yig gzugs brtsams/ /lha yig la rtsi dpe byas dbu can dwang / /klu yi wartu la ltar zur can byas/ /rgya skad yi ge lnga bcu yod/ /de yi dbyangs yig bcu drug po/ /i u e o bzhi ru bsdus/ /log pa'i sde dang thug po bor/ /ca cha ja dang zha za la/ /rgya na med pa de drug bsnan/ /dbyangs gsal thun mong i yig bcas/ /gsal byed yi ge sum bcur bsdus/ /gtso bo ming gzhi nyi shu dang / /kun la 'jug pa mtha nge rten bcu/ /med du mi rung sngon 'jug lnga/ /med kyang rung ba wa yig gcig /ra la sa gsum 'dogs pa'i ma/ /ni ro gi gu 'breng po gsum/ /kun gyi steng na zhwa ltar lding / /zhabs kyu kun gyi gdan du mdzes/ /pho mo ma ning yi ger phye/ /rnam dbye bdun dang 'byed sdud sgra/ /lhag bcas la don dgar bsnan dang / /dgag sgrub la sogs sgra sna tshogs/ /tshig zur bsgyur pas thon par mdzad/ /thon mi mdo rje'i sgra mdo dang / /sum rtags la sogs brda sprod kyi/ /bstan bcos brgyad kyang mdzad ces grags/ /legs sbyar rkyen dang rnam dbye sogs/ /sgra re'ang du mas sgrub dgos pas/ / rtoṭa dka' rgya che grangs mang yang / /bod kyi sgra la de rnams kun/ /byings rkyen gzhan la mi stos par/ /tshig zur bsgyur bas grub pa'i phyir/ /rtogs sla nyung zhing khyad par 'phags/ /'di gzigs rgya gar paṇa chen rnams/ /ngo mtshar cher mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dngos zhes bstod bkur mdzad do skad/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen las/ /bka' yi sdud po rnams kyis ni/ /theg pa gsum po bod yul du/ /bod kyi skad kyis bri la sogs/ /yul gru so sor 180

rang rang gi /skad kyis bris zhes gsangs pa'i phyir/ /'di ni bod kyis sngad ni ཿ ra shā por gsal/ /bod phrug mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi/ /bzhi par thon mi bgrangs mod kyang / /de kun mtshungs pa ma yin te/ /mkhan po lo tsā'i thog ma 'di'i//bka' drin bod kyis ji ltar khyer/ /gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs//mngon sum mi yi tshul 'dzin pas/ /bod yul rgyal ba'i bka' sdud po/ /sasto ṭa la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de nas rgyal po dga' ston khri la phebs/ /dbyarngos yig nges pa bya dka'i sgra rgyan du/ /sbyar nas thon mis yig phud phul ba ni/ /zha/la ras gsal la rang mdangs gang ba bzang / /gdams ngag zab lam ma chad tha dad rang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa lags/ /bde gshegs bden nges ye shes ste/ /ting 'dzin zhi nyid rig cing gzigs/ /nyon mongs tshogs bcom mgon po mchog /dug gsum bdud 'dul kun tu thul/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi sras/ /srong btsan sgam por mtsharma gsol ba'i/ /chos rgyal khyed la phya ga 'tshal lo/ /(thon mi'i yig phud 'di 'bur stong jen khog snang rdo'i lha khang gi brag la brkos skad)ces phul rab tu dgyes pa'i bya dga' bstsal/ /sgra dang yi ge rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /bod 'bangs gzung phyir sprul pa'i rgyal po nyid/ /lo bzhir bslab sbyangs nan tan mdzad do skad/ /blon 'bangs ku na kyang yi ge 'bri klog dar/ /thams cad blo gros padma rab tu rgyas/ /de tshe mkhas pa chen po thon mi la/ /rgyal pos bkur sti sri zhu cher mdzad pas/ /blon po 'ga' yi yid du ma bab nas/ /rgyal pos 'bangs la 'di ltar mi 'os zhes/ /bsgrags tshe thon mis nga rgyal glu blangs pa/ nga drin can gyi blon po thon mi ngas/ /lam bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du/ /lus tsha grang che yang dka' ba spyad/ khong mkhas pa bram ze li byin la/ /yid gus pa'i tshul gyis 181

mos gus byas/ /nor rin chen gser gyi phyag rten phul/ /don rnyed par dka' ba'i yig 'bru bstan/ /blo the tshom sel ba'i mdzub khrid byas/ /tshig dbyangs yig rnams la mkhasnya par sbyangs/ /rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa de/ /bod yig sum bcur gtan la phab/ /rang mkhas pa'i nges shes blo la shar/ /'phral yon tan thams cad khong du chud/ /dus da lta dga' la phyi ma skyid/ /yul mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi mkhas pas sleb pa'i sngon ma yin/ /nga mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ /rje rgyal po nyi zla'i tshul du bzhuṭa/ /grogs blon po'i khrod na nga tsam med/ /bod kha ba can ba'i mi rnams la/ /nga thon mi bka' drin mi che'am/ /de skad blangs pas 'gran sems phrag dog zhi/ /blon 'bangs kun gyis gtsug du bkur bar gyur/ /rgya bal mkhas pa du ma spyan drangs te/ /gsung rab du ma bsgyur cing dar bar mdzad/ /rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra dang bram ze shang ka ra dang / kha che ta nu dang / bal po shī la mañdzu dang / rgya nag ha shang ma ha de wa che rnams byon/ lo tsā ba thon mi sasto ṭa dang / de'i mchan bu dha rma ko ṣa dang lha lung rdo rje dpal sogs kyis 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs/ zla ba sgron ma/ dkon mchog sprin sogs bsgyur cing sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa yang bsgyur bar grags/ gtso bor thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgyur te bka' chems kyi lo rgyus chen mo las/ za ma tog bkod pa/1 phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs/mi padma snying po'i mdo/ri zhal bcu gcig pa'i mdo/4 bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/nga don yod zhags pa/༄ don zhags phyi ma/4 padma mchogaradabang bsgyur 'khor lo/khya cho ga sngags kyi rgyud/10 yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs/11 snying rje chen po mi gshol pa/1ri 'od zer rnam bkod/13padma cod pan gyi rgyud/14 yi ge drug pa'i mdo/15 dam chos pad dkar/1༄1nyi2

puṭaṃ ri ga'i mdo/14 chu klung sna tshogs pa'i mdo/18 snang pa rol ba'i mdo1khya mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad nga /30 mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa'i mdo31ste/ nyer gcig po yin /ra 'di las don 'di ltar bshad pa'ang bka' chems lo rgyus na yod do/ /'di las 'od zer rnam bkod/ chu klung sna tshogs/ snang ba rol pa/ mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa rnams deng sang gi bka' 'gyur na mi snang la gzhan don zhags cho ga zhib mo la cho ga sngags kyi rgyud ces pa lta bu 'gyur khyad ma gtogs deng sang bzhugs la mdo rgyud nyer gcig po 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kho na yin no/ /yang rgyal pos thon mi la thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba der ci 'dug klogs dang gsungs pas pang kong phyag rgya dang mdo sde za ma tog byung skad/ la la nas tsinda ma ṇi'i gzungs/ za ma tog pang kong /mdo sde las rnam 'byed de bzhi byung zhes kyang snang / de ltar sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po des/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma bris klog gis/ /bod yul rmongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal te/ /chos dang srid kyis rgyal khams bde bar mdzad/ /bka' yi blon po chen po brgya phrag gsum/ /kun kyi gtso bo 'phrul blon bcu drug gis/ /rgyal po'i bka' sgrub rgyal srid bde bar skyong / /de yang thang yig chen mo nas/ 'phrul gyi gna' chen rigs bzang dang / /zhang po rgyal gyi khrom bzang dang / /cog ro rig pa'i kong bzang dang / /lha gzigs shog po bstan bzang dang / /ka yi snyag ston 'phel bzang dang / /sbas cang dpal gyi legs bzang ste/ /nang bzang po rnam drug zer/ /de la sogs pa brgya phrag gcig /rgyal po'i sku yi zhabs tog dang / /nang gi bya ba thams —cad byed/ /byang gi khyung po pun zung btsan/ /lam khri bde blag khri btsan dang / /mu khri rdo rje rnams btsan dang / /thing gi byang chub mchog btsan dang / / thar pa klu yi 183

dpal btsan dang / /rong po 'phru' gyi lde btsan ste/ /phyi blon btsan po rnam drug zer/ /de la sogs pa blon po brgyas/ /phyi yi bya ba thams cad byed/ /shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag nas/ /bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe rnams len/ /lho phyoṭa dkar po'i rgya gar nas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgra rnams bsgyur/ /nub phyogs sog po bal po nas/ /zas nor longs spyod gter kha 'byed/ byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas/ /khrims dang las kyi dpe rnams len/ /de ltar phyogs bzhir dbang bsgyur nas/ /mtha' yi longs spyod dbang du sdud/ /'dzam gling phyed la kha lo bsgyur/ /mkhas pa thon mi sasto ṭa/ /mgar gyi stong btsan yul bzung dang / /'bri yi si ru gung ston dang / /nyang gi khri bzang yang ston ste/ /med thabs med pa'i blon po bzhi/ /de la sogs pa'i blon po brgyas/ /bar gyi khod stom khrims gnyis skyong / /zhes bshad do/ /thon mis bod yig thog ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ /bod phrug mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi par grags/ /gzhan yang khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus/ /mdzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klungs su phab//spo mthos mkhar du brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos/ /'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod/ /de phyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga pa yin/ /de nas rgyal pos bod 'bangs kun bsdus te/ /lugs gnyis bka' khrims chen po bca' bar bzhed//rgyal pos lo bzhir mtshams mdzad nas yi ge la sogs pa'i rig gnas sbyangs pa'i 'bangs rnams na re rgyal po lo bzhir pho brang nas phyir mi 'byon pa glen pa cig yod par 'dug bod bde ba blon po rnams kyis byas zer ba gsan bas nga glen par brtsis na bod mi thul dgongs te 'bangs rnams bsags nas nga 'pho bskyas ma byas par pho brang gcig na 'dug na 'bangs rnams bde ba yin te rgyal po glen par 'dug rgyal khams bde ba blon pos byas zer ba 'dug pa de ma yin/ blon po ngas bsgo ba yin/ da ni ngas rgyal khrims chen po bca' 184

dbo/la / sngon yang khrims med pas rgyal phran rnams so sor 'khyar ba yin/ da dung khrims med na nyes byed dar zhing nga'i 'bangang rnams sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas khrims bca' bar bya'o gsungs nas bcas skad/ bka' yi khrims yig chen po rnams drug mdzad/ /thog mar bod yul ru chen lnga ru phye/ /yul gyi dbang ris rnam pa bco brgyad bcad/ /rgod kyi stong sde drug bcu rtsa gcig phye/ /g.yung gi mi sde kheng dang yang kheng 'byed/ /zhang gsum blon bcas dbus kyi 'dun sa 'dzin/ /dpa' sde gsum gyis mtha' yi so kha srung / /de la bod kyi khos drug zhes su grags/ /de yang khrims yig drug ni/ khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims/1 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/〈 rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims/3 mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims/4 dbang chen bcad kyi spyi khrims/5khab so nang pa'i khrims༄te drug go dang po khri rtse 'bum bzher nas srid pa dang khos ston pa las rgyal pos blon po rnams so sor bkas bsgos te bod kyi khos dpon mgar stong btsan yul bzung / zhang zhung gi khos dpon khyung po bun zung ce/ sum pa'i khos dpon hor bya zhu ring po/ chibs kyi khos dpon dbang btsan bzang dpal legs/ mthong khyab kyi khos dpon cog ro rgyal mtshan g.yang gong rnams bskos/ skyi shod sho ma ra/ khyung lung rngul mkhar/ nam ra zha don gram pa tshal/ ri bo g.ya' dmar rnams su bcad skad/ mgar gyis bod kyi khod bca' ba'i phyir rde'u dang shing bu gtsigs su gsol te byang bu mdzo khal drug ldeng bar bris pas byang khram ma thebs par 'khrugs nas 'phan yul dar rgyal na byis pa mang po rje bya ba 'phrul che bar thos nas blon po bzhis 'tshol du phyin pas ne gsing chen po gcig gi mthar byis pa dang phrad/ na 'di'i gzhung gcod dam mtha' bskor dris pas dal na gzhung chod rings na mtha' bskor zer/ blon po bzhis gzhung bcad pas 'dam du tshud nas yun ring 'argar/185

byis pa de la pha ma gar song dris pas pha gtam 'tshol du song ma mig 'tshol du song zer/ dar cig na phas chang khyer mas me khyer byung skad/ byis pa de khrid nas khod shom bcug pas kyang ma shoms/ dar rgyal mang po rjes mchims mang bzhir ngan pa rgya ba mdzangs par thos nas blo rku ba'i phyir ri la chang sbas/ sha skam tshwa chu byugs pa khyer nas mchims lug rdzi'i res byed pa'i phyi na yar phyin ste bod kyi khod dar rgyal mang po rjes bshom skad na shoms sam byas pas rtsom pa des mi shoms/ nga min pa shoms pa med de nga mi shom zer/ sha skam byin pas kha skom ste da lta skom ster ba byung na ci zer nyan par byas nas chang gis gzir bcug nas dris pas ru mtshams 'byed pa/ yul bgod pa/ rgod g.yung gi sde 'byed pa sogs zhib par smras nas kho gnyid du btang nas bros ste khos zer ba bzhin mgar dang dar rgyal gyis bshams skad/ de yang dang por ru mtshams phye ste/ shar 'ol kha'i shug pa spun bdun lho rma la la brgyud nub gzhu snye mo byang prags kyi glang ma gur phub dbus tshad lha sa ra mo la byas pa dbu ru/ shar kong yul bres sna lho sha 'ug stag sgo nub kha rag gangs rtse byang rma la la brgyud dbus tshad yar lungs khra 'brug la byas pa g.yo ru/ shar prags kyi glang ma gur phub sto gnya' ni g.yag po'i sna nub bye ma la dgu byang smri ti chu nag shangs kyi zhong pa tshal la phyas pa g.yas ru/ shar 'jam na bkra lho bal po glang sna nub la kem g.yag mig phyang bye ma la sngon dbus brad kyi dur pa sna la byas pa ru lagashar gnye yul bum nag lho smri ti chu nag nub yel zhabasar sdings po che byang nags rkod gzi 'phrang dbus tshad rgya shod stag pa tshal la byas pa'i sum nga 'i ru ste gtsang la g.yas ru dang ru lag dbus la dbu ru dang g.yo ru/ yan lag gsum pa'i ru ste lngar phye'o/ /de rnams la yul gyi dbang ris ni/ dbu ru shod chen btsan po mnga' bdag yul/ /pho brang sne che btsan po rgyal 'bangs yul//186

yar lungs sogs kha khu dang gnyags kyi yul/ /ya 'brog gangs khyim ku rings sde lnga'i yul/ /'ching nga 'ching yul mgos dang snubs kyi yul/ /bya 'ug sa tshigs drang rje pha lnga'i yul/ /brad dang zhong pa sna nam yul du bcad/ /brag rumalhad smad che spong yul du byas/ /gtsang stod gtsang smad 'bro dang khyung po'i yul/ /klungs shod nam po 'dru dang phyugs mtshams yul/ /'phan yul stong sde sgro dang rma yi yul/ /nyang ro grom pa 'bre dang lce yi yul/ /shangs dang gle phyi ri dang gle yi yul/ /yung ba che chung bran ga'i yul du bcad/ /zha gad sde gsum blon po sbas kyi yul/ / nam ra chag gong 'bring dang chag gi yul/ /'dam shod dkar mo phya dang rwa yi yul/ /mdo khams mdo chen rgod stong sde brgyad yul/ /zhes bco brgyad du phye'o/ /rgod kyi stong sde ni/ /ru re la stong sde brgyad/ stong bu chung re/ sku srung gi stong sde re dang bcur phye ste/dor sde sde mtshams gnyis/ phyugs mtshams 'brang mtshams gnyis/ com pa 'phri mtshams gnyis/ skyid stod skyid smad gnyis/ yel rab stong bu chung sku srung shar phyogs pa dang bcu ni dbu ru'i stong sde bcu'o/ /yar lung 'phying lung gnyis/ yar mtshams g.yu 'bangs gnyis/ dwags po nya gnyi gnyis/dmyal dang lho brang gnyis/ lo ro stong bu chung / sku srung byang phyogs pa rnams g.yo ru'i stong sde bcu'o/ /stong chen shangs chen gnyis/ lang mi phod dkar gnyis/ nyen gar 'brang mtshams gnyis/ spo rab gzong sde gnyis/ zhangs stong bu chung / sku srung nub phyogs pa rnams g.yas ru'i stong sde/ /mang kur khri phom gnyis/ grom pa lha rtse gnyis/ myang ro khri 'thad gnyis/ khang sar gad phram gnyis/ mtsho ngos stong bu chung / sku srung lho phyogs pa ste ru lag gi stong sde bcu/ /bod dang gru gu'i mtshams na 'o co mang ma gnyis/ gnye ma tsa mo gnyis/ ba ga stong bu chung ste zhang zhung stod kyi stong sde lnga/ bod dang sum pa'i 187

mtshams na gug ge cog la gnyis/ spyi gtsang yar gtsang gnyis/ ci de stong bu chung ste zhang zhung smad kyi stong sde lnga ste zhang zhung gi stong sde —bcu'o/ /rtse mthon pho mthon gnyis/ rgod tshang stod smad gnyis/ 'jong stod 'jong smad gnyis/ dre stod dre smad gnyis/ kha ro kha zangs gnyis/ nags shod stong bu chung ste sum pa'i ru stong khyab rgya ldan gyi stong sde bcu gcig go /de rnams la rgod kyi stong sde drug bcu rtsa gcig zer te rgod ni 'bangs rab tshan dmag gi las byed pa'i ming ste de rnams la stong dpon yang drug bcu rtsa gcig go /dbu ru stod smad kyi dmag dpon sna nam rgyal rgan dang sbas skyes bzang stag sna/de'i dpa' zla gnon 'phan gsum dang shod bu khod btsan/ ru rta ze dkar rta skya dang mtshal bu gzig ring / ru dar dmar po lce khra dang dpal dar dmar po/ dmag gi bzhed ni mtsho la gangs bab 'dra skad/ g.yo ru stod smad la ru dpon myang stag gzig g.yu btsan dang mchims rgyal gzigs shud ring / dpa' zla g.yas mang bzher dang so gad gnyen bzher ru rta sog ro bun bun dang mtshal bu rting dkar ru dar seng ge dmar po dang dar dkar snying nag mtsho la sbrang char bab pa bzhin du 'grim skad/ ru lag stod smad la ru dpon 'bro rgyal mtshan seng ge dang khyung po g.yu'i zur phud/ dpa' zla gnam sde gur tshab dang mchims btsan zher lha gzigs/ ru dar seng dkar gnam 'phyong dang dpal dar nag po/ ru rta ngang pa phung dmar dang rag pa rngog nag gangs la ser ba 'grim pa bzhin du 'gro skad/ g.yas ru stod smad la ru dpon khyung po stag bzang stong dang mgos khri gnyen yang 'phyos/ dpa' zla ba tshab mtsho zher tsad lod dang lang pa mgon ne/ ru rta mtshal bu me stag dang sngon po g.yu rta/ ru dar dar nag snying dkar bya khyung bris pa dang skyar kha gong khru/ spang la me mched pa lta bur 'grim skad/ g.yung gi mi sde 'byed pa ni g.yung ngam kheng zhes 188

pa 'bangs las byed kyi ming yin la yang kheng zhes pa yang bran dang nying gre/og gi ming yin no/ /de la yang sdubs rje sris pa la sogs rje dgu/ lo ngam rta rdzi sogs rdzi bdun/ ga rod sga mkhan sogs mkhan drug rgya ja tshong pa la sogs tshong pa lnga/ gdags spra 'dzin sogs 'dzin gsum ste 'di rnams kheng dang yang kheng dang nying khang du phye bas dgos nga thams cad4 sgrub la/ nam pa lde rgyal/ bal po li rgyal/ sum pa lcags rgyal/ mon rtse rgyal zhes phyogs kyi rgyal po bzhis dpya bsdus nas 'bul bas 'bangs la gtogs so/ /stod na 'bro smad na mchims bar na sna nam blon po sbas rnams la zhang gsum blon dang bzhi zhes sku zhang dang blon chen gyi bya ba byed do/ /dpa' ba'i sde gsum ni ri brang stag pa gong yan chad mon 'bral kha bzhi man chad na 'bro khyung mgar snubs gnyan te gug cog sde lngas dpon byas/ gru gu gser mig can gyi chung ma hor mo bang mdung can nu ma g.yas pa me btsas bsregs nas mda' par gsum lde 'u khyi mgo tsam rdo leb la cur 'byin pa 'phen pa la kha bltas nas/dpa' mtshan du stag gi spyil po phub/ 'og rta g.yul du bsad/ gdong khrag gis byugs ste slar mi ldog pa'i rtsis su byas nas rgol bas gru gu btul ba'o/ /bar gyi dpa' sde ni ri pe nam lung yan chad cha skor dar bas man chad yul de na sbas rgya sde bcu gnyis gnas pas nags shod kyi dpon byas te ljang mo thag mdung gi rtse mo btsugs nas dmag gseb tu rgyug pa la rgol ba'i tshe dpa' mtshan du ral gri la ri mo bris dur rgyags stor zos tshe slog rgyab tu gon ste mi sdug pa'i chas su byas na rgol pas ljang btul lo/ /smad kyi dpa' sde ni rma pom ra man chad ka thang klu tshes yan chad na mthong khyab srid sde dgu dang 'a zha stong sde drug gnas pa la/ rgya'i so mkhar gyi lcags ri'i steng du rta pa dgu bsgrigs rgyug pa'i nang nas mi mkhar thung tsam gyis dgra sta'i kha khru re tsam pa 189

thogs pa la rgol pa'i tshe/ stong stong gi ba phyags mtshams kyis dpon byas ༄ ༄dpa' mtshan du ral gri'i shubs bcag kha chems nye ba la phog bu smad nye drung la bcol nas mi ldog pa'i rtsis kyis rgol pas rgya thul bas smad kyi dpa' sde'o//gzhan yang dpon bdun la yul dpon gyi las su yul chung khrims kyis 'tsho/dmag dpon gyi las su dgra 'dul/ chibs dpon gyis gshegs pa'i bshul mtshon/ rngan dpon gyis 'bru dang gser dngul gyi gnyer byed pa la rngan bgrang ba mang bas rngan dpon du thogs/ phru dpon gyis 'bri mdzo phru ma'i gnyer byed/drang dpon gyis zhal lce gcod pas dpon bdun no/ /gzhan yang bka' gros chen po drug yig tshangs drug bka'i phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug de rnams kyi steng du khrims yig drug po bsnan pas bod kyi khos sum bcu rtsa drug zhes bya ste rje'i sku 'tsho zhing zho sha slar dbul/ rgod kyi gnya' mnan zhing yang kheng gi rgyab brten kheng rgod du mi btang zhing mo btsun bka' la mi gdags/so mtshams srung zhing 'bangs kyi tshal zhing rta dkyus kyis mi bcad/ dgra 'dul zhing 'bangs bskyang / dge bcu sgrub cing mi dge ba bcu spang ba rnams bka' gros chen po drug go /yig tshangs ni rab gser g.yu gnyis 'bring dngul dang phra men tha ma zangs yig lcags yig ste drug po re re la che chung gnyis phye bas bcu gnyis so/ /de yang gung blon chen po la g.yu yig chen mo gnang /gung blon 'bring dang nang blon chen po la g.yu yig chung ngu gung blon tha chung dang nang blon 'bring bka' yo gal 'chos pa chen po gsum la gser yig chen po/ nang blon tha chung dang bka' blon 'bring la gser yig chung ngu / bka' blon tha chung la phra men gyi yi ge gnang / gzhan yang chos gra'i slob dpon sku'i sngags mkhan stod smad kyi dbang blon rnams la dngul gyi yi ge chen po byin/sku ritsho ba'i bon po gzims mal brtsigs khab byang thang gi sa mkhan mtha'i so 190

kha srung ba dang sku mkhar gyi rtse srung sogs la dngul yig chung ba/ ya ba 'bangs rus drug sogs la 'khar ba'i yi ga stong dpon ru dpon sogs la zangs yig g.yul du dpa' ba la lcags yig yang tha shing skya chu ris kyi yi ge ni 'bangs phal pa rnams la gnang skad/ phyag rgya drug ni bka' btags kyi phyag rgya sgrom bu khrom rtags kyi phyag rgya ru mtshon yul rtags kyi phyag rgya sku mkhar chos rtags kyi phyag rgya lha khang dpa' rtags kyi phyag rgya stag slog mdzangs rtags kyi phyag rgya yig tshangs su bcad do/ /rkyen drug ni dpa' ba'i rkyen du gung dang stag sdar ma'i rkyen du wa zhu ya rabs kyi rkyen du lha chos/ g.yung po'i rkyen du thags dang bon/ mdzangs pa'i rkyen du yig tshangs/ ngan pa'i rkyen du rkun ma'o/dpa' mtshan drug ni stag stod stag smad gnyis zer chen zer chung gnyis gam ras stag slog dang drug go /gzhan yang gung blon che 'bring chung gsum nang blon gsum bka' yo gal 'chos pa'i mi gsum ste dgu po la blon po che dgur mdzad de gung blon gyi las thabs khyo dang 'dra bar phyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod nang blon gyis bud med mdzangs ma ltar nang gi chis byed/ bka' yo gal 'chos pas legs na dgra'i bus legs kyang bya dga' gsol nyes na rang gi bus nyes kyang chad pas gcod pa'o/ /de rnams khri rtse 'bum bzher zhes bya ba/ /bka' yi khrims yig drug las dang po yin/ /bre srang phul khyor zho nam se sran sogs/ /bka' la btags pa khrims yig gnyis pa ste/ /'bum gyi gser thog sha ba can zhes grags/ /gsum pa rgyal khams dper blangs khrims zhes pa/ /bya bar 'os dang mi 'os ston pa ste/ /dgra btul rgyal khams bde bar mdzad//nang gi tshis mdzad 'bangs 'khor skyong / /phyi mar phan phyir dam chos bya/ /ya rabs rgyu rkyen lha chos ni/ /sgod min kheng po la mi bshad/ /gsang sngags rdzogs 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu/ /nor du mi btsong snying la bcang / /ngan pa bstod 191
