na gnyi ga phung / /de bas kheng po rjer mi dbyung / /dpa' la stag gis ma bstod na/ /dpa' ngar byas pa'i ru ma med/ /mdzangs la yig tshangs ma bstod na/ /phyin chad mdzangs ngan shan mi phyed/ /legs la bya dgas ma bstod na/ /slan chad legs pa su yis byed/ /sdar ma wa zhus ma dmad na/ /dpa' dang sdar ma shan mi phyed/ /ngan la nan tur ma byas na/ /nam yang dran shes rem mi 'gyur/ /nyes la chad pa ma bcad na/ /phyi nas nyes byed rgyun mi chad/ /lus skyed pha ma mnar ba na/ /'phral phugs gnyis gar la yogs sdig/rang gi mchan gyi bu mnar na/ /phyi rol dgas kyang zhe kha 'byed/ /bza' groṭa mnar na phyi nang gi /tshus dang so nam yal bar 'chor/ /de rnams la mdzad pa gsum mi mdzad pa gsum bstod pa gsum dmad pa gsum mi mnar ba gsum ste rgyal khrims bco lngar grags la g.yul du dpa' ba la dpa' mtshan drug gis bstod sdar ma la wa zhu bkon ste dmad skad/ mi chos chen po gtsang ma bcu drug dang / khyad par mi dge bcu spong bka' khrims mdzad/ de yang srog mi gcod pa'i khrims gshin stong dang gson stong / ma byin par mi len pa'i khrims dkon mnog gi nor brkus na brgya 'jal rgyal po'i nor la brgyad bcu 'jal 'bangs kyi nor la brgyad 'jal du bcas/ log par mi g.yem pa'i khrims smad 'jal dang byi chad/ brdzun spong ba'i khrims lha srung dpang du byas nas mna' spob pa/ chang la tshod zin pa ste chos kyi gtan khrims lnga la dpe byas pa lnga'i steng du kheng mi ldog pa dang bang so mi 'dru ba bsnan pas khrims chen drug gam bdun du yang grags shing / spyir mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i steng du ma la mar 'dzin pa pha la phar 'dzin pa dge sbyong dang bram ze la dge sbyong dang bram zer 'dzin pa rigs kyi rgan rabs bkur ba byas pa drin du gzo ba gzhan la ngan g.yo spang ba ste mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug khrims su bcas/ gzhan yang /192

dkon mchog skyabs bzung dad cing gus pas mchod/ /pha dang ma la drin gzo bkur sti bya/ /drin can yi mi gcod cing bzang lan 'jal/ /mthon po rnams la mi rgol smras na nyan/ /las spyod thams cad ya rabs rjes su 'brang / / chos dang yi ger blo 'jug don shes bya/ /rgyu 'bras yid ches sdig pa'i las la 'dzem/ /gzhan la bsam ngan mi bya phan pa gdaṭa/ /ci byed rang sems dpang bzhag drang por bya/ /zas dang chang la tshod zin khrel 'dzem skyed/ /skyin pa bu lon la sogs dus su gzhal/ /bre dang srang la sogs la g.yo zol spang / /ma bcol las la don med kha gtogs spang / /rang tshugs bzung nas bsgyur kha lci bar bya/ /mna' dang dam bzhag srog ltar gces par 'dzin/ /de la sogs pa bka' yi dril bsgrags te/ /ya rabs bzang po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / /phyi mar phan bde'i go 'phang dam pa la/ /bod 'bangs thams cad bkod de bde zhing skyid/ khrims yig gsum ni bden rdzun zhal lce ste/ /kha drag rnams la ma skyengs tsam du bcad/ /gnyi gas lan la dbyug pa can bzhin dang / /gnyi ga bden la rigs gnyis pa ltar bcad/ kha drag zhan gnyis rtsod na bden rdzun brtags pa'i mthar kha drag pa ma skyengs shing zhan pa yi mi 'chad par gcod pa mdo lon zhu chad kyi khrims yig gnyi gas lan pa la bram ze dbyug pa can gyis khyim bdag gi glang g.yar nas gtod tu phyin pas glang khyim bdag gi ra bar btang ste ci yang ma smras par log khyim bdag gis glang bskyal byung ba mthong yang ma btags par bzhag pas glang phugs kyi sgo nas thon te stor ba rgyal po rma lung gdong la zhal lce zhus pas bram zes glang btang yod do zhes ma smras pas lce chod/ khyim bdag gis mthong yang ma btags pas lag pa bregs zhes zhal lce bcad pa la dpe byas nas chad pa gnyis mnyam du gcod pa dbang chen bcad kyi spyi khrims/ gnyi ga bden na khyim bdag zhig gi bu skyes /93

ma thag chur lhung ba nya zhig gis mid pa ri'i 'og gi grong na gnas pa'i khyim bdag gzhan zhig gi g.yog gis nya de zin nas bshas pas khye 'u zhig ma shi bar byung ba khyim bdag des bur gsos pa khyim bdag gong mas thos nas rtsod de rgyal po la zhal lce zhus pas gnyi gas khye 'u re mos su gsos la bud med re re long / /ba byang na khyim bdag so sos khyer zhig zhes byang nas khye 'a rigs sa shā ri shu ri shu ri shu gnyis par ming chags/ /bu re re so sos khyer phyis rab tu byung bas dge slong rigs gnyis par grags pa de la dpe blangs nas gnyis bden dang dga' gsum du gcod pa khab so nang pa'i khrims yig du grags skad/ de ltar shar rtsa mi shing mi lho nas klo dang mon nub nas zhang zhung dang gru gu byang nas hor dang yu gur rnams 'bangs su 'dus/ 'dzam gling gi phyed la kha lo bsgyur/ dge bcu'i khrims btsan bde skyid lha dang mnyam pa yin no/ /de ltar 'di phyi kun tu phan pa yi/ /bzang po'i btsan khrims gnya' shing dam par bsdams/ /ri dwags rnams ni rgyal po'i dkor nor mdzad/ /ra lug be'u la sogs rang yin gtong //la la btsas brtsigs chu chen gru yis bcad/ /rje yi bka' btsan 'bangs rnams bde zhing skyid/ /rgyal po'i chab srid dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ /pho dpa' rta mgyogs longs spyod lha dang mnyam/ /blo gtad chos la byas pas 'di phyir skyid/ /thams cad pha mar shes pas 'thab rtsod med/ /bri klog dar bas mi kun chos la 'jug /sdig pa'i grogs med dge bcu'i nor bu rnyed/ /sprul pa'i mdzad pas khral dang 'u lag med/ /char chu dus 'bab rtsi bcud 'bru tshogs 'phel/ /ljon shing thams cad yal ga lo 'dab rgyas/ /bya rnams bag phebs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin/ /bod yul mi rnams bde skyid lha dang mtshungs/ /de tshe bkra shis nyams dga' brag lha'i tshal/ /ljon shing tar ka sdong po'i grib gsil la/ /chos kyi rgyal po gser khri'i steng 194

du bzhugs/ /dpa' mdzangs 'phrul ldan blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /bod 'bangs skye bo rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/ kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba 'ja' yi gur/ /rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mkha' la gdugs ltar 'khyil/ /lha rnams me tog char pa rab tu 'bebs/ /ro brgya ldan pa lha yi zhal zas tshogs/ /nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin zad pa med par spyod/ /'bag dang seng ge stag gseng g.yag gseng dang / /rnga bro brdung dang zlos gar mkhan la sogs/ /sku yi skyo gsang tshogs ni bltar mi lang / /lha yi rnga chen nam mkha'i dbyings nas grag /pi wang gling bu rol mo'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /dri zhim bdug spos sprin gyis bar snang gang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lhab lhub dang / /dar 'phan tshogs kyis nam mkha'i khyon kun khyab/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i na chung gzhon nu rnams/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan mchod rdzas thogs pa yi/ /glu dang gar gyis kun nas mchod par byed/ /dga' bde skyid pa'i bka' khrims dril chen sgrogs//dam pa'i chos kyi rnga chen rab tu brdung / /de tshe blon 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal po yi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mthong bas bstod cing bsngags/ /so sor dga' bde'i dga' ston bsam las 'das/ /bod yul bde skyid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ /dge bcu'i khrims la mi kun gnas gyur pas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgod du gyur par gzigs/ /de la bod 'bangs bsod nams gsog pa dang / /byin gyis rlob phyir yi dam rten zhig bya/ /de rgyu ci las bya zhes dgongs rnga4'i tshe/ /mkha' las lha tshogs rnams kyis lung bstan te/ /tsandan sprul snying mchog las rang byung ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang spyan 'dren bgyid par bskul/ /chos kyi rgyal pos smin mtshams mdzod spu nas/ /'od zer rtse la sprul pa'i dge slong sprul/ /siddha'i gling dang yul dbus bal po nas/ /ngo mtshar rten mchog rnam mang spyan drangs gyur/ /de yang rgyal po'i dgongs pa la bod 195

'bangs 'dul phyir gsol ba gdab pa'i rten nga'i yi dam zhig bya dgos pa rgyu rin po che las byas na ma 'ongs pa mi rnams longs spyod nyams pa'i dus su bshig 'gro sa rdo las byas na ngan grags/ shing las byas na 'gas pas ci las bya dgongs tshe gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis nam mkhar sprin gyi dbus nas rgyal po la mchod nas mgrin gcig tu/ sprul pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems/ /mgo nag yongs kyi rje khyed kyi/ /mos gus bsod nams gsog pa'i rten/ /yi dam lha zhig spyan 'dren na/ /rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs su/ siṅgha la yi rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /rang byung khrarla pā ṇa'i rgyab/ /glang chen nyal ba'i bye ma'i 'og /tsandan sprul gyi snying po las/ /grub pa'i rang byung spyan ras gzigs/ /ngo mtshar can zhig de na bzhugs/ /de ni rgyal po'i yi dam yin/ /zhes zer ro/ /de lta bu mis mi rnyed pas sprul pa cig btang bar dgongs ma thag smin mtshams nas 'od kyi rtse la sprul pa'i dge slong a kur ma ti shī la zhes pa dbu gtsug na a mi tā bha bzhugs pa cig byung ste rgyal po chen po'i dgongs pa bdag gis sgrub bo zhes gsungs nas 'od zer dang 'grogs nas rgya gar du song ste shar phyogs grong shing thags can du song ste a mi tā bha'i zhal bstan byams snying rje'i chos bstan nas smin par byas pas mdun du sa las jo bo yi ge drug ma zhig 'bur gyis rang byung du byung bas yig drug 'khor lo bskor ba'i sar grags/ de nas siṅgha la'i gling pho brang ke tu bya bar rgyal po u ma ta ke sa da zhes pa mye rna nang pa'i sbyin bdag yin pa la des phyi rol pa byas te chos bsnubs gtsug khang mang po bshig mi dge ba'i khrims bcas/ ra'i rke bcad pa'i khrag gis dbang phyug mchod pa cig 'dug pa 'dul ba'i phyir de'i pho brang gi drung na mchod rten padma'i 'khor lo can bya ba sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rab gnas mdzad pa cig yod pa'i bum pa'i thad kyi mkha' la skor ba mdzad pa rgyal pos 196

mthong bas dad de ci gsung nyan par khas blangs nas mchod gnas su spyan drangs/ rgyal pos dge slong la me tog gtor bas dbu'i nam mkha' la gzhal yas khang du chags/ lhag par dad pas mchod gnas su gsopha ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te slar sangs rgyas pa gyis lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du sprul snying dang go nī ṣa las byas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs brgya rtsa brgyad gyis/dge bcu'i khrims chod cig gsungs pas gzhan bka' bzhin bgyid/ tsandan sprul snying 'og min las gzhan na med cing gosnyi ṣa ma la ya dug sbrul gyis gtaṭa pa las gzhan na med pas blang mi nus zer/ dge slong gis sbrul gyi snying po rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yod/ gonī ṣa po na la'i byang phyogs shug pa'i gseng na tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mo me tog dmar pung gis 'char ba de yin no/ /de yang don chen po 'grub pa la bsod nams dgos/ de la tshogs bsag dgos pas thog mar mchod rten padma'i 'khor lo can la mchod pa gyis shig gsungs nas mchod pa cher byas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas khrid de rgya mtsho'i 'gram bye ma'i gling na khrarla rpā ṇi rang byung che ba zhig bzhugs pa'i rgyab na glang po che'i khyu zhig nyal 'dug pa'i dbus na glang po che shin tu che ba mche ba drug pa sna li khri ltar dmar zhing gi wang gi zar bu 'dzag pa 'di'i 'og na yod kyis rkos cig gsungs skad /glang po che bkrogs nas bskos pas tsardon sbrul snying gi sdong po chen po cig byung / de la bu ga gnyis sam srubs bzhir 'dug pa las dri bsung dang 'od zer mtha' yas pa byung nas dri bsung gis dpag tshad bcu gnyis su khyab cing 'od zer gyis 'jig rten thams cad khyab pa slar 'dus te thim pa rang dal bus chod cig zhes nang nas sgra byung ngo / /dal bus bcad cing gshags pas nang nas tsandan de nyid las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig rtsa phyag bcu pa 'od dang ldan pa snum lhang nge ba zhig byung skad/ rgyal pos tsandan mi yul 197

'dir 'byung ba ci tsug yin zhus pa sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig klu'i yul na chos ston tshe 'og min gyi rig 'dzin mang pos mchod pa byed du 'ongs pas lam khar rang byung khrarla pā ṇa la mchod pa'i phyir tsandan sbrul snying gi me tog zhig phul/ de sar lhung pa'i steng du phra men mas khrarla pā ṇi'i phyag gi bdud rtsi la sus thob byas pa nas thigs pa gcig phog pas de'i tshe myu gu skyes/ sangs rgyas gser thub byon tshe lo 'dab rgyas/ 'od srung byon tshe me tog shar/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa byon tshe 'bras bu smin/ mya ngan las 'das tshe rtsa ba 'gyel nas bye mar nub pa yin la glang po che tshad pas 'jigs pas tsandan yod sar nyal ba yin gsung / ka bkol mar 'di ltar bshad la gzhan du 'khor ba 'jig gi nyan thos dgra bcom pa cig gis 'og min nas tsandan gyi 'a bru gang bu zhig khyer ba na 'bru bzhi 'dug pa'i gsum sangs rgyas dang gcig khrarla pā ṇi'i dbu thog du bzhag pa las byung zhes kyang snang / glang po che'i gtso bo de khrol pas smon lam log par btab pas phyis glang dar byung bar grags/ po ṭa la nas gotrī ṣa yang blangs shing lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du sku rnams bzhengs/ yul khams de chos la bkod nas dge slong gis der sprul pa cig bzhag ste rang byung bcu gcig zhal dang tsandan gnyis kyi tshal pa re bsnams/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi bye ma dang 'jag ma thams cad rin po che'i sbu gu can de'i steng na lha mo 'bum 'bum chos la spyod pa sprul sku dngos dang 'dra bar mkhyen nas bye ma bre gang dang 'jag ma phon gcig bsnams/ mchod rten padma'i 'khor lo can gyi nang nas sangs rgyas rabs bdun nas gsum gyi gdung mkha' 'gro ma'i skal ba rnams sbas te rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab pa sus kyang mi rnyed par byas pa mkhyen nas rgya bkrol/ gser gyi bang mig bdun nam gsum kha phye ste rin po che'i sgrom bu so so nas gdung khyor ba re re spyan drangs te lhag ma sngar bzhin rgyas btab/ de 198

nas rgya gar gyi yul dbus ma ga dhar byon pas rgyal po dad de bsus shing rgyal po'i lha gcig gnyis kyis glu gar gyis bsus/ byang chub shing la spyang mo nyug byas pas yal ga me tog can chag ste phul ba de'i me tog gi phreng ba bsnams/yal ga de la mchod sdong re re byas pas sangs rgyas kyi gdung so so bzhugs/byang chub shing gi rtse mo nas 'dom gang ba cig kyang bsnams/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi snying po'i bye ma 'bru re'i steng na sprul pa'i sku 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas pa re bzhugs pa sprul pa'i sku dngos dang 'dra bar gzigs te bye ma bre brgyad kyang bsnams/ chu bo ni rañdza ra'i 'gram bde bar gshegs pas lhung bzed kyis chu gsol ba'i sa na byang chub sems dpa' 'bum bzhugs par gzigs te de'i bye ma bre gang yang spyan drangs/ de ltar mchod gnas ngo mtshar can bcu spyan drangs te rgyal po'i phyag du phul bas da ni gzhan don ji ltar bsam pa bzhin 'grub bo zhes dgongs te shin tu mnyes te mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad pa na rang byung thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros te bal po'i yul du song ba la gzigs pas nags tshal chen po'i dbus tsandan gyi sdong po'i nang na thugs rje chen po mched lnga bzhugs par gzigs te sprul pa'i dge slong de btang bas grong khyer chen po bzhi na yams nad dang 'dze nad dang steng gdon dang gdon drag pos glo bur du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa so so yod par gzigs/ ma he mo zhig nyin re bzhin nags tshal der phyin nas 'o ma zad par byas nas 'ong ba rdzi bos rjes bsnyegs pas tsandan gyi sdong po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig la skor ba byed cing 'o ma gtor bas lam yang 'o ma'i dreg pas khebs te 'dug pa ngo mtshar du bzung nas gda' skad/ sprul pa'i dge slong gis tsardon de bcad pas gnas lnga nas 'od zer chen po byung ste ma snang par dal bus chod la dang pos nga mang yul gyi rong du zhog cig bya ba sogs so sor gsung byung ste 199

tsandan bkas pa'i nang nas thugs rje chen po gzhengs pa g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa lnga byung ste ba/nas so sor bzhag pas 'phags pa wa ti dang u khang bhu kaX 'ja' ma li dkar po zhes grags te dus min du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa de rnams zhi bar gyur te deng sang gi bar bzhugs/ lnga pa des nga ni bod kyi rgyal po'i yi dam du 'gro'i zhes gsungs nas spyan drangs te rgyal po la phul nas sprul pa'i dge slong yang rgyal po'i smin mtshams su thim par gyur to/ /ston pa'i dgung lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis pa'i/ /sku tshad gar bzhugs theg chen dar ba'i phyir/ /de dag bod kyi yul du spyan 'dren slad/ /rang byung rten la mchod cing gsol btab tshe/ /thugs ka nas ni 'od zer rnam gnyis byaXng / /rgya nag dang ni bal po'i yul du song / /sprul pa'i lha gcig rnam gnyis bzhugs par gzigs/ /de gnyis khab tu bzhes na sku gzugs gnyis/ /dam chos dang bcas spyan 'dren nus par dgongs/ /nang par blon 'bangs phyag byed bsnyun rmed tshe/ /brnal ba'i g.yar lam skad du zur gyis bstan/ /blon po'i mchog rnams blo gros gcig du mthun/ /bslang thabs ji ltar bgyi ba gsol ba'i tshe/ /thog mar bal po'i lha gcig spyan 'dren phyir/ /thon mi mgar sogs blon po'i mchog brgya la/ /rin dang bka' yi sgrom bu rnam gsum bskur/ khro gnyer can la gsol ba 'debs shing song / khyod kyi 'dod don 'grub par 'gyur ro gsungs/ /bal po'i rje la skyes dang rin phul nas/ /lha gcig slongs pas bka' 'phrin gsum gsungs pa'i/ /lan du bka' yi sgrom bu re re byin/ /mngon shes thogs med rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas par/ /shes pas 'jigs dang dad pa dus gcig gyur/ /ston pa'i dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / /byaca/sa pa chos 'khor tsandan sgrol ma dang / /beeḍūrya yi lhung bzed la sogs pa/ /gzhal du med pa'i skal rdzongs dang bcas ga/ /sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po mchod phyir 200

phul/ /bod du phebs te dga' ston rgyal sar mjal/ /btsun mo'i dam pa mchog du mnga' dbang bskur/ /de yang rgyal po'i dgongs pa la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sku tshad gsum po gar bzhugs par bstan pa spyi dang khyad bar theg chen dar ba yin la so lnga pa'i sku tshad spyan mi 'drongs kyang brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad spyan drang dgos dgongs te rten rang byung la gsol ba btab pas thugs ka nas 'od zer sgra dang bcas pa byung ste bod kyi sems can rnams spre'u dang brag srin las mched pas 'dul dka' bas sprul sku gnyis spyan drangs la 'dul dgos zhes pa'i sgra byung / yang sprul sku gang nas spyan 'dren zhes zhus pas thugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis byung ba bal po dang rgya nag tu re re song ste sprul pa'i lha mo re bzhugs par gzigs te de gnyis spyan drangs na sku tshad gnyis dang rgya bal gyi chos thams cad bod du 'byon par mkhyen nas nang par blon po rnams phyag 'bul du 'ongs nas bka' mchid mdzad pa'i tshe yengs ma gtam du rgyal po'i zhal nas mdang nga'i rmi lam du nub phyogs bal po'i yul na bu mo dkar mo snying du sdug pa cig dang shar rgya nag gi yul na bu mo sngon mo yid du 'ong ba zhig 'dug pa la rmis gsungs pa dang g.yas nas mgar stong btsan yul srung dang g.yon nas thon mi sasto ṭa mi chung gnyis 'bras chang bee ḍūrya'i phor pa re rgyal po la stob cing mnal lam de su la yang mi gsung bar zhu/de gnyis nged rnams kyis khab tu bsu'o zhes zer nas song ste de khab tu bsu'am zhes glengs pas grong khyer bdun nas gtso bo mi bdun la gros 'dri bar kha 'cham ste nang par 'tshog rkyen re khyer la 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram ne sing dang gla ba'i tshal tar kha sdong po'i rtsar 'dus cig ces byas te blon po rnams dang gtso bo mi bdun tshogs pa'i mi bdun gyi 'tshog chas bsdus pas sha khog ma nyams pa gcig du 'grig ste thon mi na re 'dun ma 'dun rkyen gyis bcad pa bya ba shin tu 201

bkra shis ci bsam 'grub pas 'dun ma rgya ma chung zhig ces zer/ mgar gyis rgya bal gyi rgyal po'i sras mo mchog gnyis yod par 'dug pa rje'i btsun mor bsu'am zhes bgros pas legs der gyis byung / slong ba'i thabs dris pas rgyal po nyid thugs zab la rgya che gzhan gyis khong du mi chud pas rgyal po nyid la zhu bar kha 'cham/ blon po rnams kyis phyin te mgar gyis ji ltar spyan drang zhus pas thon mis sna drangs pa'i blon po rta pa brgya ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal dang ldan pa la pho brang dmar po ri la nyi ma shar ba dang song / lam thams cad du jo mo khro gnyer can la gsol ba thob/ bal rje la phyag rten du gser gyi dong rtse stong / zhu rten gser phye bre gang / rin du mi'i rin po che la lha'i rin po che'i phra btab pa'i dra ba gcig rnams khyer/ rgyal po de bka' lung mi 'dra ba gsum bstud mar 'ong gis de'i lan du sgrom bu 'di rnams go rim ma nor bar gtod cig gsung skad/ blon po rnams kyis de ltar du phyin te phyag rten phul nas phyag byas/ zhu rten mdun du bzhag rin po che'i dra ba sku la gsol te nged bod yul na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa chos kyi rgyal po cig bzhugs pa'i blon po yin/ khyed kyi sras mo lha gcig khri btsun de nged kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor zhu'o byas pas rgyal po yun ring du mig btsum nas ma phye/ ci zhig nas bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po nga'i gnyen zlar mi 'os/ nga sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus nas dam pa'i chos rgyun ma chad sku gsung thugs kyi rten yod/khyed la de lta med/ 'on kyang thag ring po nas 'ongs te 'dug pas bod kyi rgyal pos dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzheng nus sam de nus na ster bas de dris la shog zer bas mgar gyis 'phrin re'i bar du bod bal du phar tshur 'gro dgos na lha gcig spyan mi 'drongs/ de'i lan du sgrom bu dang po 'di bskur ba gzigs shig byas nas gser gyi sgrom bu gtad pas mthing shog la gser gyis 202

bris pa bal po'i yi ger byung ste/ mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan gyis bal po'i rgyal po la bka' bstsal pa/ khyod sto bal na chos yod/ nga la chos dang mchod gnas med de de la dga' bas lha gcig ster na ngas nyin gcig la sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong sprul nas lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs te sgo thams cad bal po'i yul du bstan la bzhag gis de ngo mtshar mi che'am bya ba byung / yang bal rje na re dge bcu'i khrims 'cha' nus na byin gyis de dris la shog zer ba la dngul gyi sgrom bu gtad pas/ de lta na sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong sprul nas nyin gcig la dge bcu'i khrims 'cha' yi/ zer ba byung ba cung zad skrag ste ster bar sems kyis bsams kyang da dung sgam pa'i phyir/ bod rgyal kha tsho che bar 'dug ste nga sangs rgyas 'od srung tshun nas thab du ba ma chad pa'i longs spyod yod pa yin/ 'dod yon gyi longs spyod nga dang mnyam pa byed nus na ster bas dris shog zer ba la zangs kyi sgrom bu gtad pas/ ngas sprul pa lnga stong gis sgo lnga'i yul re rer gzugs dri ro reg bya mi 'dra ba stong stong la spyod du yod par bya/ rin po che'i khung thams cad kha phye/ phyogs kyi las sgo rnams phye ste khyed lho bal gyi gser thams cad nga'i rgyal khams la rag lus par bya'i de ngo mi mtshar ram/ des kyang mi ster na sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas bal yul brlag par byas te lha gcig 'khyer ro zhes byung bas shin tu skrag cing sprul pa'i rgyal por yang shes pas cung zad dad par yang gyur te sbyin par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas rgyal pos lha gcig khri btsun la khyod bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gro dgos gsungs pas lha gcig na re yab kyi bka' mi chogs pas 'gro dgos na/ bod kyi rgyal po de dad pa can zhig yod par 'dug kyang mchod gnas kyi rten tsam med zer bas mchod gnas su jo bo mi skyod rdo rje/byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsandan gyi sgrol ma rang byung dang gsum po skur zhig203

bod yul longs spyod chung zer bas rin po che glang po che'i rgyab khal bdun yang skur zhig zhes zhus so/ /yab rgyal pos kyang zhal gyis bzhes te sku ngo mtshar can gsum/ rin po che stag sha de wa ratna de wa/ baiḍūrya'i lhung bzed rnams dang rin po che gzhan glang po che'i gya ba khal bdun rnams gnang / bod blon rnams la dga' ston cher mdzad/ bslab bya snying gtam du bsnyad nas glang po che mchog cig gi ze bar lha gcig gis tsandan gyi sgrol ma rang byung phyag du bsnams/ rten gzhan gnyis glang po che'i rgyab tu gsil khang la spyan drangs/rin po che glang rgyab bdun dang bcas te rgya la blon rnams kyis bal yul dang mang yul gyi bar ljon shing gi tshal yangs pa'i bar du bskyal nas bod kyi rgyal khams su bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig zhes smon lam btab nas rgyal blon rnams log glang po che rnams 'phrang la mi thar bas phyir slog 'phrang bgrod dka' ba rnams la rin po che rnams 'breng skyed byas/ lha gcig dang sku gnyis kyang zhabs kyis byon skad/ mang yul nas sku gnyis mdzo mo dkar mo res gdan drangs/ lha gcig dre'u dkar mo zhig bcibs/ rin po che rnams rta brgya po la bkal te lha mo khro gnyer can gyi mtshan nas brjod cing yong bas shing pho rta'i lo pho brang du phebs/ rgyal po dang mjal ste btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /bka' chems gzhan las dris lan gyi tshigs bcad sogs yod kyang ka bkol mar 'di tsam snang ngo / /lha klu gnod sbyin tshogs rnams bran du bskol/ /pho brang khri rtse dmar po ces bya ba/ /'dzam bu gling na 'gran zla bral ba bzhengs/ /de yang rgyal po dus rtag du yi dam gyi drung du bzhugs nas mchod pa dang ting nge 'dzin mdzad/ skyo sang dang rtse dga' mi mdzad pa la bal mo bza' 'di snyam du rgyal po 'di gzugs dang yon tan rmad du byung ba zhig 'dug pa la pho brang gi phyir mi 'byon pa 'di pha rol gyi dmag tshogs shig la 204

'jigs pa yin te 'ong bas dmag gis mi brdzi ba'i pho brang zhig bya dgos snyam nas bee ḍūrya'i lhung bzed la gsol ba btab pas zas skom zad pa med pa byung ba dang rin po che rnams la cha rkyen byas te gnod sbyin pho mo sogs bran du bskol te dmar po ri khongs su bcug so phag gi lcags ri logs rer rgyang grags re re dpangs gyang phreng su.a bcu rtsa drug gi tshad bskor/ sgo bzhi sgo spe rta bab dang bcas pa dang sgo chung khang pa shar bu mda' yab sogs rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa dang dngul gyi bang chung gis bskor/ mu tig gi dra ba dang dra phyed las dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol pa rnga yab dang ba dan gyis brgyan pa byas/ de'i nang du mkhar dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa dgu yang rtse dang mkhar dmar stong du tshang ba/ de'i rtser yang dar dmar rked khra can btags pa'i mdung dmar bcu re btsugs cing mtshon cha sna tshogs pa gzings pa dar gyi chun 'phyang sna tshogs pa bres pa byas/ lho'i lcags ri'i nang du sog po'i mkhar la dpe blangs te brag lha bkra shis kyi gzhal yas khang bya ba thog dgur brtsigs pas rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang mnyam pa'i btsun mo'i pho brang brtsigs te rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang de gnyis kyi bar dngul zam skar khung bkra zhing rgyan mtha' yas pa can gyis spel ba la yab yum phan tshun du gshegs bzhud mdzad pa/ dmag dung byur lhags kyang srung ma mi lnga'i thub pa rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang ltar legs shing ltar mi ngoms pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od zer 'bar zhing ltar mi bzod pa/ srin yul laṅka pu ri ltar 'jigs shing rngam pa zhig brtsigs so/ /de'i shar sgo'i phyir rgyal po'i chibs dkyus kyi sa 'dom dgu brgyar ring zhing zheng 'dom bco brgyad pa zab 'dom do brus par shing dang so phag gis phub ste steng zangs mas g.yogs pa/ logs la dra ba dra phyed dang bkra shis kyi ri mo sna tshogs pa bris cing 'bur du btod pa tshon sna tshogs pas byugs te phyi nang 205

gser lta bur 'dug pa/ de'i nang du rgyal pos chibs dkyus pa'i rmig sgra re re la yang rta pa 'bum gyi rmig sgra dang 'ur thug dang sil khrol gyi sgra skad rol mo sna tshogs par grag cing bden bzhi'i tshigs bcad dang bka' btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i chos kyi tshig 'bru 'byung ba de lta bu zhig byas so/ /pho brang brtsigs tshul 'di ra sa'i klu khang gi nub logs la bris nas yod skad/ slar yang sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /bka' lung lci zhing gnyan pa'i zil dang ni/ /blon po rig pa can gyi 'phrul thabs kyis/ /sgrol ma'i sprul pa lha gcig kong jo ni/ /'dzam gling rten mchog shākya mu nir bcas/ /rgya nag yul nas spyan drangs bod tu phebs/ /phyogs bzhi'i mi rnams so so'i snang ba ru/ /rang rang phyogs nas gshegs mthong bsu zhing skyel/ /'o thang mtsho 'gram nags tshal bye ma'i dbus//shing rta bying zhing sa g.yos khal rnams nyal/ /gyad chen lha dga' klu dgas stobs bskyed kyang / /thub pa'i sku gzugs g.yo bar ma nus tshe/ /klu yi pho brang mnan par gzigs nas ni/ /sa gzhi de nyid du bzhugs mchod pa mdzad//sprul pa'i lha mo 'un shing kong jo ni/ /btsun mo'i dam pa gnyis par mnga' gsol te/ /dga' ston rgya chen nam mkha' mnyam par spyad/ /de yang mgar gyis sna drangs pa'i blon po brgyas phyag rten dong rtse brgya/ zhu rten gser pang mig bdun/ rin du lha'i gos rin thang med pa 'di khyer la bya kha ta'i skad kyis ma non par phar tshur du sgrol ma la bsol ba 'debs kyin song zhig gsungs nas blon po rnams phyin te rgya nag zim shing bkra shis khri sgor slebs te rgyal po thang tha'e dzung ngam kong tse 'phrul rgyal zhes pa de dang mjal/ phyag rten zhu rten btang rin phul te lha gcig zhus pas rgyal po dgyes te gnang bar dgongs pa la sras rgyal bu the ba na re bod kyis rgya'i yul mang po bcom/ rgan po rna mas bsad pas bod la mi ster khrom ge sar dmag dpung che bas de la ster 206

zer/ yum gyis bod longs spyod chung bas mi ster stag gzig gi rgyal po longs spyod che bas de la ster zer/ lha gcig rang rgya gar dam pa'i chos dar bas rgya gar la 'gro zer te gnye po rta pa bzhi brgya yang tshogs skad/ der bod kyis nged kha snga bas nged la zhu zer/ khrom dang stag gzig dang rgya gar rnams rim pa ltar nged la mi ster na dmag 'dren/ mes bsreg rgya yul chus 'gengs zer skad/ der rgya nag khrims dam pas gang rung la sbyin dbang med de rgyal po'i zhal nas gnye bo rnams rig pa su rno ba zhig la ster zer te gnye bo brgya re la lug brgya re dang chang tshod brgya re btang ste nyin gcig la sha chang yog ba pags pa thul ba/ khang pa gtsang mar su byung ba de la ster bya ba dang / yang g.yu 'od chen phub chung tsam pa mig gcig dbus dang gcig mtha' na yod pa bar gyi mig phub kyi spa sgor bzhin yod pa cig dang dar yug cig gtad nas g.yu mig du dar yug sus tshud de la ster zer ba dang / bya ma brgya bu brgya dang / rta ma brgya bu brgya ma bu so sor sus shes pa la ster ba dang / shing sdum brgya btang ba'i rtsa rtse sus shes la ster ba dang / phyi dro pho brang du ston mo byas nas bzi ba dang srod la btang ste sgo ma 'khrul bar rang gi gnas khang sus rnyed la ster bar byas pa la gzhan rnams kyis gang yang ma byung / blon po mgar gyis lug rnams gud du bsad/ sha gzugs re nas brims te tig ga chung chung re bcad cing tshwa la bsgres te zos nas bskor chang hub skor du byas/pags pa gral la 'grims te phur tsam re byas pas sha chang yog pags pa 'thul/ma bzi ma skyugs te khang pa gtsang mar byung / rgya grog zhig zan dang 'o mas gsos te dar skud kyis dar yug gi sna bsdus te btsems/ dar skud grog ma'i rked pa la btags te mtha'i mig nas bcug phu btab pas dbus su thon te g.yu mig tu dar yug tshud/ thang la sbang skam gtor nas bya rnams btang bas ma bu 207

gnyis gnyis stabs sa zos ) rke'i 'og nas za zhing sod pa 'tshab pa 'di ba4 rig ri ri'i ///spru ri ri ri rin yin zhes ngo shes/ rta rnams rte'u phyogs gcig tu bzung ste zhag gcig chu ma byin par gsos te skom du bcug nas nang par ma khyu'i gseb tu btang bas rang rang gi ma btsal te 'o ma 'thungs pas ma bu so sor shes/ shing sdum rnams chu la bskyur bas rtsa ba thur du bying ste ngo shes/ mar me'i chas sbas te khyer khar rams dang mtshal bcug nas sgo sum brgya drug bcu tsam yod pa la mtshan ma 'debs kyin phyin/ chang la tshod zin par byas nas srod dus mar me spar mtshan ma lta gin yong bas gnas khang du ma 'khrul bar slebs pas de thams cad la rig pa bod rno yang brnyas pa byas nas ma byin skad/ da ni sang nyin lha gcig bu mo brgya'i gseb tu gtong bas sus ngo shes pa la ster ro zer bas mgar gyis gnas mo de snga nas zas chang gis brid mdza' bar byas nas lha gcig de khyod rang mdza' bar yod 'dug pas ston dgos byas pas/ mos rke la 'brardo kyi sog ma btsugs te chad pa yong zer ba'i brda byas/ mgar gyis rtsis kyis mi thig pa shes zer ba'i brda byas pas 'dzum mul byung ste 'o na smra yib/ zer skad/der sgyid po gsum gyi khar zangs chus bkang ba bzhag kha phub kyis bcad pa'i steng du bu mo de bzhag steng du rdza zhig g.yogs pa dra bas bkab/ rdza'i bug pa nas kha la lcags mchu gtad de smrar bcug pas/ kong jo la g.yog mo bcu drug yod pa'i thugs ches pa gcig nga yimyo/ sang nyin lnga bcu phar thal zhe dgu tshur lus pa'i dbus ma de legs pa mi che mi chung ba/ kha nas utpa la'i dri snam pa/ ber bdun brtsegs kyi phyi ma dri ma chags tsam gsol ba/ g.yu'i sbrang ma the bong tsam zhig nam ma kha' mda' gang gi sar lding ba zhig yod/ des kyang dpral mtshams la mtshal gyi g.yung drung ris shig bris la 'thag gi zer/ nang par gnye po gzhan rnams sgo na bsgugs/ bu mo brgya po rim par byung ba la 208

gnye po gzhan rnams kyis gang mdzes dang chas gang bzang gnyis gnyis khrid nam lha ga cig nged kyis thob po zer nas song / blon po mgar gyis lag pa dar gyis dril mda' rgod sgro ma gcig thogs nas sgo bar du bsdad de lha gcig byung ba dang mda' stong gis gong pa nas dril te 'then pa dang he zer te kha log byas byung bas utpa la'i dri ngad chil gyis byung / g.yu'i sbrang ma dang mtshal gyi g.yung drung yang gda' skad/ de nas gnye po gzhan rnams so sos bdam pa'i bu mo bskur te phyir log lha gcig la bod la 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ 'o na gser gyi lha shākya mu ni nga'e mchod pa'i rten du zhu/ bzo sna bco brgyad kyi dpe/ sman dpyad chen mo/ rtsis kyi por thang brgyad bcu rnams bskur bar zhus te rgyal pos kyang de rnams dang rin po che dang dar zab sogs mtha' yas par brdzangs/lha gcig gis mgar la bod na la nyungs dang / sa khams pa/ rtsa dres ma/ rdo sri na zan/ shing se ba rnams yod dam dris pas gzhan yod la nyungs med zer bas 'o na yul bzung du btub kyi zer te la nyungs gi sa bon khyer/ blon po mgar gyis lha gcig ring du ma byin pa la snying na nas lug nag po'i mcher khrag bre gang / dar zab kyi thal ba bre gang / sol ba'i mdung shing 'dom gang rnams rdzongs su bskur na bod rnams ngo mtshar skye ste 'ong byas pas lug thams cad bsad/ dar zab bsregs/ nags la me btab de rnams ma byung / rgya yul ngan por song skad/ skyel thung gi sar 'bri se ru gung ston gyis mgar la phrag dog byas te lha gcig gi tshab du blon po rig pa can zhig rgya nag du bsdad na bod rgya mdza' bar 'ong ste ces mgar la cher bltas pas rgya rjes blon po rig pa can mi tshab tu sdod dgos gsungs/ blon pos kyang 'bri se ru gung ston gyi phrag dog du go nas ngas bsdad la bod rgya mdza' bar bya'o zhes zer ste bsdad/lkog du bod blon gzhan rnams la ngas rgya nag du gnod pa bskyal la myur du 'ong 209

gis brdzus ma'i sprang po cig nga'i rtsar thong zhig zer/ jo bo shākya shing rta la bzhugs te gyad lha dga' dang klu dgas shing rta drangs/ kong jo dre'u dkar mo zhig la bcibs te dar rgyal mang po rjes sne khrid/ rigs bzang gi bu rma bcu drug gyad rtsal can mi brgya/ bod blon go dgu dang bcas pa bod la chas so/ /de yang bya kha ta'i skad kyis ma non pa la gdan bteg snga dro sa phyogs bde bar gdan phab/ dar dkar gyi gur du rin po che'i khri dang za 'og gi 'bol la jo bo shākya bzhugs te 'bras chan dang mchod pa sna lngas mchod cing lha gcig gis dngul dkar gyi pi wang dang tasbu ra'i sgras ram bteg ste/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /sogs kyis bstod cing lha la gsang 'u 'dren/ /pham babs g.yog mo bcu drug dang gzhan rnams la ster/ la la mchod pa dang bstod pa byed/ la la rtse dga' dang glu bro sogs 'dod yon lnga spyod/ de lta bu snga dro bzhin lan re byed cing 'ongs skad/ de nas lha gcig gi smra mchu ba su yin brtag pa'i rtsis byas pas ri chen po gsum gyi steng na mtsho steng thang gis chod pa bar nas me 'bar ba thang gi steng na bud med rdza ma'i dbyibs la mig gis khengs pa lcags kyi mchu ring po byas pa cig gis bshad 'dug ces kha mthun pas rgyal bu the ba khros te de lta bu mi srid zer nas spor thang sum brgya bo mer bsregs pas rgya yul gyi rtsis nyams/ mgar gyis rgyal po la bod na sa bon cung zad brngos te btab pas ljang pa legs byas pas sa bon thams cad de ltar 'debs su bcug de'i mna' chad srung zer nas da lta lha sar stag gi zla ba la bong bus rmod cing sa bon yos 'debs skad/ mgar gyis na rdzu chen po byas te nad 'di lta bus shi na shul du ltas ngan pa bco brgyad 'ong ba yin/ nga zhag bdun na shi ba bzod de shul du rgya yul 'phung ba 'di ma legs byas pas nged kyi rtsis yig rnams bsregs zin/ khyed rang rig pa can yin pas thabs ci yod 210

zer ba la/ de na nga la ro rta ro gos ro zas dang bcas te khyed rang gi dgra snying na ba bod kyi phyogs su skyol la phyi mig mi lta bar log na mi la nyes pa mi 'byung / lo tog la gnod pa cig 'byung yang kham chung zhig zer nas bskyal skad/ 'di rnams ka bkol ma las ji ltar byung ba tsam yin la/ thang yig sogs las ba ta hor gyi rgyal po dang bcas pa'i gnye bo brgya tshan bzhi bod kyi blon po dang lnga brgyar 'tshogs/ bod la rgya nag gis brnyas te ring du ma mjal/ mthar phyi rol tu byon pa'i zhar la mjal nas rin du beeḍūrya'i khrub phul/ bal po dang 'dra ba'i bka'i sgrom bu gsum rim par gtad/ rig pa 'gran nas mthar bu mo sum brgya'i gseb tu thang la bsgrigs nas 'jog pas sus ngo shes pa la ster zer ba la lha gcig gi khol mo la gser bre gang byin ste thabs kyis dris pas/ lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de/ /bu mo gzhan pas che rgyu med/ /skye gzugs gzhan pas legs rgyu med/ /de la mo yi khyad chos ni/ /sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs chags/ /zhal nas utpal dri ngad bro/ / g.yu sbrang zhig ni steng na 'khor/ /khur tshos g.yas steng cho lo ris/ /g.yon na me tog padma ris/ /dpral dbus li khri'i thig le'i steng / /ārya tā re nas tsam yod/ /so dkar tshags dam so zho yod/ /lkog ma 'jam legs og zho yod//bu mo sum brgya bsgrigs pa yi/ /g.yas dang tha mar mi 'ong ste/ / g.yon nas bsgrigs pa'i bu mo bdun/ /bzhag pa'i gong du lha gcig yong / /zhes sogs bslabs pa dang / /mgar gyis g.yon gyi mtha' nas mda' stong btsugs te/ /'di ni bshas pa'i bu mo 'dra/ /lag pa 'di yi dmar lugs sam/ /zhes sogs rdza mkhan dang / shing mkhan dang / g.yos mkhan dang / phyes mkhan dang / mgar ba dang / dar 'thag rnams su ngos bzung nas brgyad pa la/ /lha gcig kong jo yin pa 'dra/ /sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs chags/ /ces 211

sogs brjod nas mda' stong gis bzang ste then pas nga zhing rjes sa 'brangs pa ring rang ring la 'bri se ru dang dar rgyal gyis ram bteg nas mgar gyis/ e ma ngo mtshar che/ /lha gcig kong rdze khyed/ /bdag gi tshig la gson/ /bkra shis nyams su dga'/ /bod kyi rgyal khams na/ /rin chen sna las grub/ /rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad/ /srong btsan sgam po de/ /rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid/ /mthong nas sems yid 'phrog /thugs rje chen po lags/ /ces sogs rgyal po dang yul gyi yon tan brjod pa'i glu blangs pas cung zad dga' ste phyir 'brangs/ rgya rjes kyang blon po de'i 'phrul la stos/ rgyal po de mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul du ldan par 'dug khyod ma byin na sprul pa'i dmag gis khyod 'phrogs yul 'joms par 'dug pas 'gro dgos zhes bka' gnang / phan bde kun 'byung jo bo rin chen dang / /rin chen bang mdzod mang po nor gyi gter/ /gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i yig tshangs chen mo dang / /gtsug lag yi ge sum brgya drug bcur bcas/ /gces pa'i rin chen gser g.yu rgyan gyi tshogs/ /g.yos sna zas skom sbyor thabs dpag med dang / /gser ka g.yu yi ka leb can dang ni/ /za 'og gos stan seng ge bya brgyad ma/ /ljon shing cho long nor bu ris la sogs/ /khyad nor dpag med ngo mtshar ldan pa rnams/ /rgyal po ya mtshan skyed phyir khyod la brdzang / /bzo yi rig byed drug bcu tham pa dang / /brtag thabs brgyad dang dpyad lnga sbyongs drug dang / /sbyor sde bzhi sogs sman dpyad ma lus bskur/ /rgyan gos khyad 'phags stong phrag nyi shu dang / /ltar mdzes sems mthun bu mo nyer lnga brdzang / /khyod kyi bya ba spyod lam 'di bzhin gyis/ /lta ba yangs shing spyod pa zhib par mdzod/ /phyi nang bya ba kun la mkhas par mdzod/ /ngag 'jam smra mkhas gzhi ma legs par mdzod/ /rje la gus shing 'khor la byams par mdzod/ khrel yod ngo tsha bag 212

dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces sogs gdams cing mgar mi tshab tu bsdad pa la gzhis rab bud med dang bcas pa byin yang / mgar sems gnag pa ma sel nas nad rdzu byas pa la sman pa btang bas mtshan mo mgo mjug ldog par bsdad pa dang byi la khyim bya rang 'thag rnams la thag gu btags te thag gu la rtsa bltar bcug pas rtsa thams cad 'khrugs 'dug bya ba dang gcan gzan tha chung dang / bya tha chung / rdo'i rtsa las mi 'dug ces byung bas rgyal po thugs ma bde nas khong rang la dris dus nga shi nas rgya yul du mi shis pa chen po 'ong /bod rgyal pos mngon par mkhyen te sprul pa'i dmag 'ong zhes sogs kyis skrag par byas te rim gror lug gi mtsher khrag sogs gsum dang / ro rta sog ro mgo dmar dang bcas bod kyi ri mthong sar lha gsol du 'gro zer nas blon po bros kyi dogs gyad mi bzhi dang bcas btang ste gyad rnams bzir bcug nas mtshon bcag rta'i rmig pa bcad nas blon po bros/ gyad rnams chad pa la skrag pas ldog ma nus par blon po'i rjes su 'brangs pa las rgya'i rus byung / blon pos/ dar zab me la bsregs pa'i thal ba de/ /rgyal po nye ring can de'i na bza' mdzod/ /snye ma 'bru med thal ba nag po de/ /btsun mo ser sna can de'i rgyags phye mdzod/ tsardon nags bsregs sol ba'i mdung shing de/ /rgyal bu dmag la dpa' de'i lag cha mdzod/ /lug la mtsher khrag med par bsad pa de/ /yi dam lha yi drung du gshags pa byed/ /ces glu blangs pa sogs bshad la/ rgyal rabs la lar rgyal pos jo bo shākya bzhugs pa'i lha khang du byon pas zhal sngar shar du gzigs pa nub tu 'gyur 'dug pas gshegs par go ste ster bar khas blangs bya ba dang / kong jos bdag bod tu phyin na legs shing jo bo gdan 'drongs na bdag gi mdzub mo'i rtse la spyon zhig zhes dmod bor bas mdzub mo g.yas pa'i rtse la yel gyis byon pas yid ches te kong jo 213

bod du byon bya ba sogs snang ngo / /spyir kong jo bod kyi don kho nar byon pa yin zhing sprul pa'i lha mo'i yab yum mched zla'ang byang chub sems dpa' yin pas 'khrul ba mi 'byung na'ang / bu la nus pa ci yod mi shes pas/ /gzhan la brnyas pa mi bya sems mi sreg /nam zhig su la re dgos cha med pas/ /su'i yang sems sun mi dbyung dgrar mi slong / /rdzun pa'i rgyab rten lhas kyang mi thub pas/ /ci byed kun la drang zhing phan bde sgrub/ /ces pa'i ya rabs kyi lugs sgrub dgos kyi/ ha cang brnyas pa dang nye ring ches na 'di lta bu 'byung ngo zhes phyi rabs la bstan pa'i phyir rgyal pos nye ring byed pa dang blon po'i 'phrul gyis rgya yul 'phung par byas pa ltar bstan la/ dkon pa'i 'du shes skyed pa'i phyir spyan 'drongs dka' bar bstan gyis rang rgyud pa ni ma yin no/ /de nas kong jo dpon g.yog gis khams su phebs nas mgar sgug pa'i phyir brag logs la rgyas pa'i dbu dum dang bzang spyod brkos/ rdo sku khru brgyad bcu pa brkos/ sha ba bzung nas zhing rmos/ chu skor btsugs/ nags khrod la brdus pa ltar byas/ rgya mo 'phred lam bcos shing se ba sogs bltar 'gro zer nas kong jos yul thams cad tu byon pas blon po ma dag pa la las lam du ci 'gor byed par mthong / tha mal pa rnams kyis shing se ba sogs blta bar mthong / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sgrol ma dang thub pa'i skus bod thams cad zhabs kyis bcags te byin gyis rlob par gzigs so/ /de nas sgo dong sgo mo'i rtsar phebs tshe rgya nag gi phywa ga yang nyams pas rgya'i lha spung 'khrugs te kha ba tshad med du bab pas nags thams cad phan tshun 'jings pa ltar bsgyel bas lam 'gags te zla ba gnyis lus pa'i tshe blon pos slebs te bsangs dang phud gtor te rgya'i lha la mchod pas kha ba chad/ nags ma rnams langs te lam dod pa la byon/ bod tu nye bar slebs tshe pho nya mngags nas bsu ba dang 214

dga' ston zhus pas rgyal po'i zhal nas sgrol ma'i sprul pa lha gcig de yin par 'dug pas 'phrul che bas gang nas 'ong mi shes kyis phyogs bzhi kur du bsu ba'i dril sgrogs shig gsungs/ me pho sbre'u'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin phyogs bzhi'i bsu ba pa rnams la kong jo shākya mu ni bod blon brgya gyad mi rta brgya dang bcas pa phyogs so so nas byon pa'i snang ba byung ste shar phyogs pa rnams kyis mkhar sna gdong gi rab brgal nas byon pas rgya mo rab khar btags/ lho phyogs pa rnams kyis grib se sgro'9gyi pha nas byon te khyag ༄pa la dngul gyi rta lcag gtsugs nas dung g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra ste bzang gsung ba de dus byung zer/ nub phyogs pa rnams rkyang thang gi mgo nags tshal gyi dkyil nas rgyal po'i pho brang la sa dgra'i gnod pa gnam sgo bye ba ral gri shubs nas phyung ste nam mkha' la 'phangs pa 'dra ba yod/ sa sgo bye ba sbal pa tshal gyi brag phag sna 'dra ba la mgon po lcam dral bris la gnon zhig gsungs te rgya nag gi gzo bos 'bur du brkos pas phag gdong snar grags so/ byang phyogs pa rnams kyis sgo la la byon pa la lha la bsu ba byas pas lha bsu gdong du ming chags te phyogs bzhi ga'i mi la dus gcig du mthong snang shar te 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram nags tshal dang bye ma'i gling ne chung gi stod na chu mig yod par phebs tshe jo bo'i shing rta bying / sa g.yos/ khal thams cad nyal/ gyad lha dga' klu dgas bteg kyang ma thag pa'i tshe spor thang bting nas brtsis pas spyir dzaspu'i gling na yul gru chen po bzhi ste ri bo 'bigs byed kyis shar du bcad pa'i byang na glang po che'i rgyal khams padma kha phye ba 'dra/ ri gangs can gyis shar du bcad pa'i byang na bod kha ba can yod de srin mo gan rkyal du bskyel ba 'dra/ ma la ya'i tshal gyis bcad pa'i byang na yul dbus yod de rin po che'i gling 'dra/chu bo mdzes ldan gyis bcad pa'i byang na glang chen gyi gling yod de me tog gi 215

gling 'dra'o/ /de nas kha ba can gyi yul srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba 'dra ba'i dbus na srin tshe da snyi/nga ga yod de 'o thang gi mtsho snying khrag du mkhyen / thang gi ri bogs chad gnyis 'dug pa'i srin mo'i snying gi rus pas sems can gyi srog za bar 'dug ste rgyal po'i pho brang gis non nas 'dug de'i phyogs bzhi na ri rus sbal lam sdigs pa 'dra ba re 'dug pa srin mo'i 'khor du mkhyen/ ri sna de thams cad dbus su zug pas lha sa de jag rkun gyis gang ba mi spyod ngan pa 'ong bar gzigs/ sa dgra rnam pa lnga 'dug pa'i klu'i pho brang de jo bo shākya mu nis mnan par mkhyen nas phyogs bzhir ka ba btsugs dar dkar gyi yol ba bres te gyad mi bzhis bsrungs te de nyid tu bzhugs su gsol lo/ /pho brang du dga' ston gyi rnga bo che brdungs/ mi thams cad rgyan gyis brgyan nas 'phrul gyi srang kha'i steng na phar 'ur sgra sa g.yo pa tsam byas te rgyug kong jo 'khor bcas pho brang gi shar sgor phebs pho brang sog po mkhar nas khri btsun gyis gzigs pas jo bo shākya bzhugs sa ya gi'i gnad kyis lha khang zhig rtsig par nges/ rgya nag sa dpyad la mkhas lha khang gzhan yang rtsig tu 'ong / nga chen ma la lha khang med par mo la lha khang sngon la rtsig tu 'jug pa mi 'ong snyam nas kong jo bos te/ khyed la lha 'dug ste nga la yang rten ngo mtshar can gsum yod/ nga chen ma yang yin chos kyi 'byung gnas nas kyang 'ongs/ lag ris su pho brang chen po 'di lta bu yang byas pas lha khang ma brtsigs par khyod kyis ma rtsig cig ces bka' nan che bar byas pas kong jo na re/ de tsug lags so/ /khyed lha khang rtsig na mtsho ma gi'i khar rtsigs shig thang khod stoms ya gi 'dra ba la ngas kyang lha khang 'byongs mchi zhes dngul dkar gyi rta lcag 'o thang gi mtsho dang jo bo bzhugs sa la btsugs pas khri btsun skyengs pas lan ma byung ste rgyal po dang kong jo mjal du ma ster zhes ka bkol mar bshad la/ gzhan las/ /nga dang 216

khyed gnyirdo khyad par che/ /nga ni them pa snga brga' yin/ /bal rje'i sras mo nga yang yin / /chen ma rgyal po'i btsun mo yi na/ /chun ma btsun mo'i g.yog mo yin/ /zhes sob/sa kyi glu dang / kho mos sdod pa'i༄ gnas kyang ma rnyed cirnga / /them pa ma brgal rje dang ma mjal bar/ /btsun mo khyed kyi 'gran tshig sngas pa yin/ /chen chun byung ba ming gi khyad par yin/ /mthun por 'grogs na tshe 'di'i spun las lhag /chags sdang byed na rang mgo su grung yin/ /zhes sogs lan gyi glu dang / mgar gyis kong jo spyan 'dren dka' ba'i snying nad du yo byad sogs ma bskyal/ rje dang mjal du ma bcug par zla ba gcig bzhugs pas kong jo phyir ldog par dgongs pa mgar gyis gros btab bya ba sogs snang ngo / /de nas rgyal po dga' ston gyi khri la phebs/ kong jo btsun mor dbang bskur/ de ltar sprul pa'i lha mo gnyis phebs tshe/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / khro gnyer can dang sgrol ma'i sku las ni/ /'od zer bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas 'phros/ /nam mkha'i mthas klas 'gro kun la phog pas/ /nyon mongs ma lus skad cig gis gcod pa'i/ /rdo rje'i ting 'dzin bde ba thob par gzigs/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis sprul pa'i sku gsum pos/ /bod khams thams cad byin gyis rlob pa dang / /mtha' yas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug par gzigs/ /bod 'bangs phal pa rnams kyi mthun snang du/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug spyod pa ston par mthong / /bla bon gyis phywa g.yang 'gugs/rgyal po dang btsun mo dbu skra sbrel/ skud khel stod mdzad/ sha khu dang skyems gsol res dang g.yang ril dang mar khu'i skyu rje len byed skad/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang lha sras skyed pa'i phyir zhang zhung gi rgyal po'i mig skya'i sras mo zhang zhung bza' li thig dman dang / mi nyag gi rgyal po'i bu mo ru yongs bza' rgyal mo btsun dang / stod lungs mong nas zhang blon gyi bu mo 217

mong bza' khri lcam ste spyir btsun mo lnga khab tu bzhes so/ /de nas lha gcig kong jos sa dpyad mdzad/ /bod yul srin mo gan rkyal 'gyel ba 'dra/ /de yi tshigs chen brgyad dang mthil bzhi po/ /gnon pa'i lha khang re re dang por thob/ /'o thang mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying gi khrag /ngan song sgo yin bsubs la lha khang rtsigs/ /sa dgra brgyad la rang rang gnyen pos gnon/ /de rjes sa gzhi padma 'dab brgyad tshul/ /dgung gi nam mkha' 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbyibs/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad la bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang / /dpyad bzhi ma nyams rin chen sna bzhir ldan/ /yon tan thams cad dus gcig 'char ro ba/sungs/ /rgyal po'i thugs ga'i 'od zer mtshor phog pas/ /dbus su 'od kyi mchod rten chags pa ltar/ /byin gyis rlabs dang 'phrul las rdo sgo byas/ /rdo rje klu 'byim byugs pa'i shing— gis phub/ khro chu'i gzhi 'a/ so phag bkram pas g.yogs/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi lta bur grub pa'i steng / /rtsig rmang gting ba mi ma yin gyis bshig /de tshe rgyal po nyid kyi sku 'bag cig /thog mar bzhengs zhes mkha' las sgra byung bas/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rdzas mchog du ma der/ /tsandan sbyar ba'i lde gu phung por byas/ /rgyal po'i dbu sngas su bzhag gzims pa na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyi zer rdul tsam lhags//thim par gzigs nas nang par dgung sangs tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po bcu gcig zhal/ rtsa ba'i zhal gsum dkar po rab tu 'dzum/ /de steng zhal gsum ser mdog bzhad pa yi/ khro zhal rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad pa yin//de steng zhal gnyis bye ru'i mdog 'dra ba/ /gtsigs pa'i khro zhal dbang gi phrin las mdzad/ /de steng zhal gnyis khro zhal nag po ni/ khros shing gdangs pa drag po'i phrin las mdzad/ /de steng a mi tā bha li khri'i mdog /de man rgyal po'i sku tshad nyid dang mnyam/ /chos sku rtsa ba'i phyag bcu'i dang po gnyis/ /218

thugs ku'i dbus su thal mo mnyam par sbyar/ /bgrang phreng 'khor lo mchog sbyin 'od dpag med/ /g.yas kyi lhag ma bzhi na rim pas 'dzin/ /pad dkar ril ba spyi blugs rin po che/ /mda' gzhu lhan cig g.yon pa bzhi na 'dzin/ /phyag zhabs gser gdub dang ni sprul gyis brgyan/ /rin chen rgyan mdzes 'od zer nyi ltar 'bar/ /sku stod ri dwags pags pas nu g.yon bkab/ /mtshan dpe kun ldan rang byung nyid du byon/ /slar yang 'od zer du ma 'phros pa yis//tsarnan rang byung sku dang ring bsrel sogs/ /spyan drangs phyag gis dar sham cung zad tsam/ /brjes pa nas zhugs thugs ga'i dbus su ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs par gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs sgu'i yan lag so brgyad dang / /sprul sku'i nying phyag stong phrag spyan stong can/ /phyi nas bal po'i gzo bos phul bar grags/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs 'khor brgyad byas/ /bod tu bzhengs pa'i rten gyi thog ma yin/ /rang byung sku las me yi 'od zer dang / khro bo gnyis byung thog ltar babs pa yis/ /zla ba tshal gyi 'dre yi 'dun phung gtor/ /nye ba'i sa dgra gzhan rnams so sor mnan/ /dpung mgo dpyi gnyis gnon pa'i mtha' 'dul bzhi/ /gru mo pus mo gnon pa'i yang 'dul bzhi/ /yan lag mthil bzhi gnon pa'i ru gnon bzhi/ /shar du nyi zla gza' skar gtan 'bebs gsum/ me chu rlung gi kha gnon gnyis gnyis te/ / sa gzhi gnon pa'i lha khang thams cad mdzad/ /bod kyi gtsug lag khang la snga ba yi/ khru 'brug grub tshe rab byung gtam gsan pas/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug ngur smrig gi /rtags 'dzin tsam la'ang gus phyag 'tsha'/ lo gsungs// de tshe bandhe hrul po cig gzigs la/ /gus phyag mdzad de ngo mtshar che'am gsungs/ /des kyang mchod rten rtse lnga mkha' ma bteg /rgyal pos thod phud a mi tā bha bstan/ /des kyang rang gi snying ga'i sgo phye ste/ /'dus pa'i lha —— 219

tshogs bcu dgu gas/la bar byas/ /rab byung hrul yang yon tan 'di 'dra yis/ /phyin chad phyag mchod bkur sti byos shig zhes/ /bod 'bangs kun la bka' yi dril chen bsgrags/ /bod yul rdo rje'i lte ba lha sa yi/ /srog rtsa lha ri rang byung yer pa ru/ /sa rdo'i phud las lha khung mchod rten mdzad/ /lha sa'i rten 'brel yer par sgrigs zhes gsungs/ /de yang khri btsun gyis dngul zam la byon nas kho mo lha khang rtsig pa'i sa gzhi zhig zhu'o byas pas rgyal po'i zhal nas khyed rang gang 'dod par rtsigs shig gsungs/ der khri btsun gyis rta pa mang po'i khrom khrid/ gnod sbyin pho mo bran du bkol te la dong gi ne thang /ba rag phug yar lungs sogs yul bzang ba thams cad du rmang bting yang lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar nub mo lha 'dres rjes med du bshig pas sa dpyad brtag dgos par go ste g.yog mo la gser phye bre gang bskur te kong jo jo bo shākya la mchod pa byed pa'i rtsar btang ste na ning gi de skad ma gsung bar nga'i lha khang rtsig pa'i sa dpyad legs par ston par zhu/ nga'i lha khang zin nas khyed kyi yang rtsig du gzhug gis ces 'phrin bsrings/ kong jos spor thang bkram ste brtsis pas bod yul 'dir lha khang gi sa gzhi btsal na spyir sa'i dbye ba sum brgya drug bcu/ sa brtag pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ ngos bzung ba bdun bcu don gnyis/ nor ra re bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ sa dgra ngos bzung ba/ de'i skyon bsal ba/ yon tan gyi 'bras bu chud mi 'dza' ba rnams ston pa las mdor bsdu na mang po 'du ba grong dang grong khyer gyi sa/ dbang phyug dang mnga' thang 'phel ba rgyal po chen po'i sa/ drang srong 'du ba'i gnas dgon pa bas mtha'i sa/ re zhig bde bar gnas pa skye bo tha mal ba'i sa ste bzhi las 'di rgyal po'i sa dang gcig pa yin/ de yang bod kyi rgyal khams 'di srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gzugs su 'dug pas dpung mgo gnyis dpyi gnyis gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis 220

rtsis gzhi rnams gnon pa'i lha khang re re dgos/ ma grub kyang lcags kyi phur pa re thob/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag yin ngan song gi sgo zhig yang 'dug pas bslabs nas lha khang rtsig dgos/ sa dgra brgyad 'dug ste lho nub na 'dre'i 'dun sa 'dug pa gtor zhig nub byang na klu bdud nag po'i nyal sa 'dug pa phrogs la lha khang rtsigs shig lho byang na btsan gyi 'gyu srang 'dug pa mchod rten gyis chod cig ra mo che'i klu'i pho brang jo bo bzhugs pa 'dis non 'dug shar na ba lam grum pa ri chu srin de'u'i khar thon pa 'dra ba la dung dkar ston/ shar lhor byang stod se phug srin mo 'doms bzed ba 'dra ba la dbang phyug chen po ston/ lho nub yug ma'i shar ri sdigs nag gzan la rub ba 'dra ba la bya khyung ga ru ṭa ston/ nub na shun gyi brag bdud nag po bya ra byed pa lta bu dang ri srin mo ral pa gzings pa 'dra ba 'dug pa la rdo'i mchod rten zhig ston/ byang na nyang bran dog sde'i dbul ri glang chen g.yul du zhugs pa 'dra ba la rdo yi seng ge zhig ston/ sa dgra de rnams non pa dang yon tan thams cad dus gcig la 'char te/ shar na ban khos gung bu ri mchod rten lta bu/ lho na grib ri rin po che spungs pa lta bu/ nub na stod lung brang phu'i ri na mañdzi'i khar dung phor bzhag pa lta bu/ byang du dog sde lha ri padma kha bye ba lta bu ste yon tan gyi ri bzhi 'dug pas phyogs thams cad nas dad pa can gyi skye bo 'du zhing ston pa'i ring bsrel la mchod pa rgyas chos byar btub/ rang bzhin gyi yon tan mang po 'byung ba'i sa yin/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi sa dbyibs padma 'dab brgyad/ nyang bran 'phan dkar gyi ri la dbu gdugs/ mal grong gi rgyab rir spyan nya/ gdong mkhar gyi brag la ljags padma/ grib phu'i chab rom la gsung dung / rdzong btsan gyi ri la mgul bum pa/ yug ma'i ri la thuṭa dpal be/ 'phan dar gyi ri la sku rgyal mtshan/ brang phu'i spang la phyag zhabs 221

'khor lo ste logs bkra shis rtags brgyad du tshang / gar ba'i jo mo ze ze la lcags/ ra kha la dong la zangs dang dngul/ lcags ka ri la gser te rin chen sna bzhi'i gter yod/ shar gyi stag skya bo dga' gdong 'og ma/ lho'i g.yu 'brug sngon mo skyi chu/ nub kyi bya dmar po shun gyi brag dmar te gdong / byang gi rus sbal nag po nyang bran pha bong kha ste dpyad bzhi tshang bas bkra shis/ de ltar sa dgra rnams mnan pa dang yon tan thams cad kyi nus pa dod 'byung /gter rnams kha 'bye/ thugs dam gyi lha khang yang dod rtsig du btub pas ra dkar mo la 'phan yul nas sa bkal bas rten 'brel du mtsho gsubs la der lha khang brtsigs na legs rgu cog kyang dod 'byung nyes rgu cog 'grib par 'gyur ro zhes lan bskur ro/ /der bran mos phrin go rim nor te dang por ra la sa khol la mtsho gsubs bya ba smras pal khri btsun gyis de ltar mdzad kyang mtsho rnyog long gis song ste bye ba'i cha yang ma subs nas yid ma ches te rgyal po la zhus pas ngas yi dam la 'dri yi gsungs te thugs dam rang byung la mchod pa mdzad gsol ba btab pas de'i zhabs mtheb g.yas pa nas 'od zer byung ba 'o thang gi mtshor thim mo/ /der nang re bzhin rgyal po chibs dkyus su 'chag pa'i 'ur khrol gyi sgra byung tshe skye bo rnams blta ba las de'i nang par khri btsun gyis sna drangs chibs dkyus su gshegs te 'o thang gi mtsho khar btol ba na rgyal pos sor gdub phud ste 'di gar lhung ba der rtsigs cig ces mkha' la 'phangs pas mtsho nang du song ba dang rgyal pos kyang kong jo dang gros mdzad do snyam nas khri btsun spyan mchi mas gang / rgyal pos mchi ma phyis la stos cig gsungs pas rgyal po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba mtsho nang du song ba mthong / kong jo yang phrag dog min par nga la cha yod/ 'dir rtsigs shig ngas grogs bya'o gsungs pas khri btsun rab tu dgyes te bka' bzhin du nyan no zer ro/ /rgyal 222

po'i zhal nas mtsho 'gram 'dir nga'i pho brang zhig rtsigs shig gsungs te pho brang gsum thog zhig brtsigs par pho brang gi bskyas mdzad de mchod gnas rnams kyang spyan drangs te mchod pa chen po mdzad/ khri btsun gyis klu nag po klong rdol dang / rgyun brdal dang / zur phud rkyang tshal gyi klu sogs la las bcol te skyi chu lho ngos dkar chung lhu ba gdong du bsgyur bas mtsho gud du lus/mtsho nang gi phyogs bzhir rdo spe byas te gla ba'i shing gis phub pas dbus su ma slebs nas rgyal pos rten rang byung la mchod pa phul nas gsol ba btab pas sku'i spu nas 'od zer byung ba mtsho la dra phyed du bres/ rtsa zhal nas 'od zer byung ba mtsho steng du sprin ltar 'khrigs pa las 'od zhags pa lta bu mtsho la char pa ltar bab pas mtsho nang du 'od tam sbu ba mchod rten bang rim gsum pa'i rnam par chags pa'i tshe rdo rnams mtsho dkyil gyi 'od zer la rgyob cig gsungs te bal po'i rdo bzo bas gsang phu nas drangs pa la bzo byas te blon po rnams kyis yig drug gi sgra dang bcas te dbus su bskur bas mkhar gyi rnam pa gru bzhi pa cig byung / de'i dkyil du gter ba(ga de la sna gtad de phub pas mtsho mi mngon par subs te lte ba de deng sang gi dkyil 'khor yin no/ /klu'i yul nas rdo rje'i 'dag pa blangs te shing thams cad la byugs pas shing thams cad mi bangs mi rul ba rdo rje pha lam ltar byas/ de'i steng du khro chu'i pha gu bting ba khro zhun gyis bsdams/ slar so phag dang / spang leb dang rdo leb dang / bye ma/ sa bzang po rnams bting bas sa gzhi dang dbyer med par byas te rtsig rmang bting bas mtshan mo lha 'dres bshig de nas nam mkha' las rgyal po nyid kyi sku 'bag cig thog mar bzhengs na bar chad mi 'byung ngo zhes sgra byung bas bal po'i lha bzo ba la khyod kyis nga'i sku 'bag du ming btags pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig bzheng shes sam gsungs pas kho bo sprul pa'i bzo bo 223

yin nga/sa shes mchi zer te sngon sprul pa'i dge slong gis spyan drangs gnas chen po brgyad kyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang na rañdza ra'i bye ma dang tsandan sbrul snying dang sa mchog bu mo gtsang ma du mas ba spos zan ma'i 'o ma dang dar ba'i lde gu dang bsres/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phye ma btab pa'i lde gu rgyal po'i dbu sngas su spungs/ byang chub shing gi srog shing / tsandan sbrul snying gi zhabs dar/ sku'i dbyibs gtod pa'i phyir rgya mtsho'i gling gi 'jag ma/ ze ma ru'i gzer/ rin po che'i spyan 'bras/ 'jam byed pa'i lde pan/ kha bsgyur ba'i tshon rnams sta gon byas te dbu sngas kyi mgor bzhag go/ tho rengs kyi dus mthongs ka na mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyi zer gyi rdul tsam byon te 'jim pa la thim par gzigs pas byin rlabs can zhig 'ong bar 'dug phyag stong spyan stong zhig bya'am/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ yi ge drug pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyugayid bzhin 'khor lo/ don yod zhags pa/ hya shrī ba/ brla pa ṇi zhig bya'am zhes spyan ras gzigs kyi bye brag lnga bcu rtsis la btab nas gzims pa las nam langs pa'i tshe dbu sngas na rgyu de rnams kyi shul na bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin nor bu chos sku'i rtsa phyag bcu gcig tu khrong nge byon par gzigs so/ /de ma thag lha bzo yang lha bzo ba'i ched du 'ongs pa la rgyal pos lha myur zhing legs par zin 'dug kyang tsandan sbrul snying gi sku rang byung dang mchod sdong gsum po 'di nang rdzongs yang snying du bzhugs rgyu yin te gsungs pas bzo po na re bdag ni lha bzheng dgos snyam nas nga gdod mchis pa lags te 'di ni rang byung du byon gda'o zer/ de ma thag du sku de g.yos nas phyag g.yas kyis dar sham pus gong du brdzes te zhabs g.yas nas 'od zer byung bas rten de rnams spyan drangs te thugs kur chags pas sku shin tu sbrum par gyur la g.yon du cung zad 'gying ba de dus byung la dar sham pus gong du lus pa da dung du yod 2 rte4

do/ /'di la rgyas pa'i zhal mthing ga gsum/ ngabang gi zhal kham pa gnyis/mngon spyod kyi zhal dmar po gnyis/ zhes dang / phyag mtshan g.yas lhag ma bzhis sprul sku mda' 'khor lo sa gnon/ g.yon bzhis phreng ba/ nor bu/gzhu/ bum pa zhes bris pa yang snang ngo / /de nas bar chu khar mchod rten ke ru brtsigs te bod kyi sngags rbatsun dang sgrub pa la mi gnod pa'i phyir grib nas nyang bran gyi phur btsan gyi 'gyu srang yod pa bcad/ rang byung thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa brag logs la phog pas brag lha klu phus gi klu bdud dang ma mo'i nyal sa phrogs te rnam snang kun du zhal dang 'jam dpal khro bo sogs brag la rang byon du byung / rgyal po gnam stong gi nub mo 'o thang gi chu la khrus mdzad tshe lho nub zla ba tshal gyi brag rtsa na me 'bar ba zhig 'dug nas der byon pas kha ba can gyi 'dre thams cad dug shing gi sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsar 'dus te gros byed pa gsan pas 'dre rgan po cig na re kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhabs kyis ma bcags gsung gis ma khyab pas nged rang mi ma yin rnams la dbang ba yin pa la rgyal po mgo gnyis pa 'dis lam bcad/ nyal sa phrogs/ chos khrims byas/ da nged rang rnams kyang nus pa skyed la dkon mchog gsum la dad pa byed pa'i srog chod/ dge ba byed pa la mi rung ba thong / lha khang rtsig pa la rdo char phob las shig de snga yang bal bzas lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rmang bting ba bshig pa de yang legs so zer nas gyes song / phyi nub rgyal pos rten rang byung la gsol ba btab pas khro zhal las 'od dmar ljang gnyis kyi rtse la khro bo rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis byung /de gnyis kyi zhal nas me phung byung ste gnam lcags kyi thog ltar 'dre'i 'dun sa'i dug shing gi sdong po la phog pas 'gyel zhing 'thor/ dug khol ba rlung gis gtor te 'dre'i 'dun phung thams cad 'thor zhing brgyal/ khro bo gnyis dang 225

bskal pa'i mes ded ste rgya mtsho'i mthar bskyal/ khro bo gnyis dang me phung zla ba'i brag la phog pas 'od dpag med/ khrarla pā ṇi/ dpal rta mgrin gsum rang byung du shar/ sang nyin rgyal pos der byon te mchod pa mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon/ /thub pa'i dbang pos spyi gtsug brgyan/ /sku mdog dkar gsal gangs ri 'dra/ /nyon mongs ma gos padma bzhin/ /thugs rje che zhing mthu ldan pa/ /sems can nyam thag phongs gu yi/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod nas sku rang byung 'od kyi rnam pa de slar bal po'i bzo bos 'bur dod du gsal bar brkos pa brag lha btsan gdong du grags so/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas 'od zer gyi sne la byung ba'i khro bo de gnyis khyod kyis mthong ngam zhes bzo bo la dris pas mthong lags zer/ de gnyis kyi gzugs gyis shig gsungs te rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis byas/ thugs rje chen po'i 'khor nyung bas da dung gyis shig gsungs nas 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / khrarla pā ṇi/ sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ 'od zer can/ dbyangs can ma rnams byas/ rang byung thugs rje chen po la longs sku yan lag gi phyag so brgyad kyi g.yas bcu dgu na/ rin chen zhags pa lhung bzed dang / /ral gri rgya gram man shel dang / /chu shel mda' zhu st+yag ma dang / /rnga yab phub bum dgra sta phreng / /pad sngon spyi blugs nyi ma dang / /pad dkar 'bras kyi snye ma 'o/ /g.yon bcu dgu na/ sprin dkar spyi blugs padma ser/ /gri mdung dbyug pa phreng dril bu/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'khar sil dang / /sprul sku lha khang glegs bam dang / /'khor lo sku gzugs shing thog dang / /pad sngon rin chen 'dzin pa 'o/ /sprul sku'i nying phyag stong mchog sbyin gyi rnam pa'i mthil du spyan stong dang bcas pa yang phyis phul lo/ /nub phyogs su mchod rten ke ru brtsigs nas nub kyi sa dgra gnon pa sogs sa dgra 226

bzhi mnan/ de rjes lha khang gi rmang bting pas yang zhig nas srin mo'i dpung pa g.yon gno na pa'i phyir yar lungs su byon te mtsho sogs kha mi che ba zhig la klu gdug pa can gnas pa de skam pa'i shul du rtsig dgos par dgongs te bod 'bangs bsags nas klu 'di sus 'dul nus pa la bya dga' cha thang du ster ro zhes bka' bstsal bas sngags pa cog la tsug sgra tsug snang dang bon po tshe mi snang grags 'byung grags bya ba gnyis kyis 'dul bar zhus/ zo dang gong po ri la dgra bcom pa 'gog pa la zhugs pa brgya rtsa brgyad yod pas der khong gnyis kyis nam mkha' lding bsgrubs nas rgyal po la zhus te mi kun yang klu 'dul ba'i thabs lta zer nas tshogs pa'i tshe bon po na re sngon la ngas btul gyi gal te ma thul na khyod kyis brtson pa skyed cig zer te cho ga byas mnyam par bzhag pa dang de ma thag bya khyung chen po cig byung ste mtsho steng du lding ba dang mtsho 'khol klu sbrul mgo lnga pa cig rong byung bas bon po na re ngas ni ma 'thul lo cog la khyod kyis brtson 'grus skyed cig zer te sngags pas cho ga byas mnyam par bzhag pa dang gnam ral pa skad sa grum pa skad du sgra chen po grag skye bo thams cad byer/ sa gzhi 'gul/ 'dab chags thams cad kyang 'phur te nam mkha' nas bya khra 'dra ba la skad 'brug ltar 'don pa cig byung nas bya de'i gshog pa spu gri lta bus sbrul mgo lnga skad cig gis bcad de mtsho khrag tu nyog song nas bye ma la chu pho ba ltar skam pa'i shul na rin po che'i khron pa 'dug pa'i dbus su rin po che dbang gi rgyal po sbas/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa la mchod pa phul/ gtsang khang khro chu'i pha gus phub/ phyogs bzhir gsang khung bzhi sgrom du byas pa'i sgrom khar mchod rten brtsigs/ gnod sbyin pho mo bran du bkol te de'i steng du brtsigs te gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha bcu dgu pa'i lugs su bzhengs/ gtso bo gsum ni rdo sku rang byung zo dang gong po ri 227

nas spyan drangs pa slar bzo bos rnam pa dod par brkos pas rdo phye rnams ring bsrel du song slad/ 'khor sems dpa' rnams li yul gyi sprul pa'i bzo bos li las lugs su blug pa rin po che'i phra can bal yul nas zhabs /kyis byon/ 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang bal yul du bzhugs pa'i tshab rdo sku rang byung zhig byon/ gser bre brgyad/ bdun/ drug lnga/ bzhi rnams la gnod sbyin gyi bzo bos blug ste rim par rnam snang / rdor sems/ rin 'byung /snang mtha'/ don grub rnams cha lugs mi 'dra bar bzhengs te 'od dpag med rin po che'i gter khang na bzhugs/ gzhan bzhi dang rgyal po'i sku 'bag gtsang khang na bzhugs/ bod 'bangs kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba zlog pa'i phyir lha mo yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / rin po che'i gter kha dbye ba dang las sgo rnams 'du ba'i phyir gnod sbyin chu dbang gi sku byas/ rgyal po'i dkor mdzod chen po gcig kyang gter khang du sbas/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la gnyer du gtad/ sngags pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba dang klu de'i don du mchod rten rtse lnga pa bzhengs te klu de lhar skyes/ byams pa mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang zhes mtshan btags la klu btul ba'i bya'i ming gis spyir khra 'brug du grags te bod kyi lha khang brtsig pa la snga zhing 'jig pa la 'phyi ba yin la rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi snying po gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no/ /tshe spong btsan 'dra dong chung bya ba blon po cig gis kyang lha khang glo 'bur zhig byas so/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i thugs dam gyi lha khang 'di 'dzam gling na byin che ba yin/ 'di la dad can gyis mchod pa phul te gsol ba btab na ci 'dod kyang mi 'grub pa mi srid/nyi khang thams cad kyi yang snying yin yang 'di le rgyan srungs pa cig med ces bka' bstsal bas bal po'i bzo bo na re nged kyi lho bal na bha danta zhes bya ba dbu reg/zhabs rjen ngur smrig gi na bza' can de bzhin gshegs pa'i cha lugs 228

su bzhugs pa lha mi'i mchod gnas mang po yod/ de lta bu yod na rgyan srung ba 'ong pa la zer bas rgyal po phyag thal mo sbyar ste rab tu byung ba de lta bu'i gzuṭa 'chang ba tsam la yang nga spyi bos btud de bya'o zhes phyag 'tshal bar mdzad do ces dam bca' mdzad do/ sang nyin rgyal po 'khor bcas phyi rol tu byon pa dang mchod rten rtse lnga'i 'gram na dge slong gi cha byad can mgo bo che ba dpral ba 'bur ba sna nyag zhing mig tshag pa stod chung zhing smad che la tshang ra 'bur ba zhig tshem bu 'tshem zhing 'dug pa gzigs pas ngas rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa la yang phyag 'tshal bar dam bcas na 'di rab tu byung ba dngos la ci'i phyir mi bya dgongs la/ 'on kyang 'di gzugs byad ngan pas blon po rnams dad pa ldog ste 'ong dgongs nas mchod rten gyi phag du de'i zhabs la btugs te phyag mdzad nas bzhengs te/ nga sa bdag gi rgyal pos khyed dge slong gi zhabs la mgos btugs nas phyag byas pa 'di ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs pas dge slong de na re/ de ngo mtshar che ste nga'i rdzu 'phrul 'di yang ngo mtshar mi che'am zer nas mchod rten rtse lnga lag pa g.yas pas nam mkha' la yer gyis bteg rgyal pos de yang ngo mtshar che ste nga skye bo tha mal pa'i mgo la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa 'di ngo mtshar mi che'am zhes la thod phud de a mi tā bha'i zhal bstan pas de na re rgyal po la lha gcig las mi 'dug nga la 'di tsam yod zer nas lhan pa 'dra ba'i gri gus brang kha phye ste 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bcu dgu lam gyis bstan pas rgyal po rab tu dgyes te rab tu byung ba rnams la yon tan 'di lta bu yod kyis nga'i 'bangs thams cad kyis rab byung gi rtags 'dzin tsam 5mthong na'ang zhabs spyi bor long zhig zhes dril bsgrags so/ /'dis ni dge sbyong gzugs byad ngan yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas brnyas pa spang dgos pa dang rgyal pos kyang spyan ras gzigs su don gyis zhal bzhes pa dang 229

spru/la pa'i dge slong de sa kyang rgyal po'i lha khang dang nga mnyam bya bar bstan pa yin no/ khra 'brug gi yan lag du tsam thang btab/ srin mo'i dpung mgo g.yas gnon pa la tse ne gdong du sgrub pa byas nas dbu ru ka tshal dang yan lag tu gser shang gir ti bzhengs/ dpyi g.yas g.yon gnon pa la rtse phug dang brgyad phug tu sgrub pa byas te g.yas rur gtsang 'gram dang yan lag tu dge drung gi lha khang / ru lag tu grom pa rgyang dang yan lag tu 'bri lha khang rnams bzhengs te mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'o/ /gru mo g.yas pa la shar stag gi mgor kong po bu chu/ g.yon pa la lho 'brug gi ze steng du sto brag kho thing / pus mo g.yas pa la nub bya dmar po'i skas steng du dge rgyas/ g.yon pa 'a byang rus sbal gyi dpral steng du pra dan tse'i lha khang btab ste yang 'dul bzhi'o/ /lag mthil g.yas gnon pa la mi nyag gis lag dpon byas te khams klong thang sgron ma/ g.yon la tho gar gyis lag dpon byas te mon skyer chu/ rkang mthil g.yas la hor gyis lag dpon byas ste mtshal rigs sgron ma/ g.yon la bal pos lag dpon byas te tshangs pa rlung gnon gyi lha khang bzhengs te ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'o/ shar du sa'i kha gnon nyi zla gza' skar gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir ka chu kum chu gling chu gsum/ lhor me'i kha gnon snang gro dang glong thang gnyis/ nub tu chu'i kha gnon gu lang dang shing kun gnyis/byang du rlung gi kha gnon dge ri dang dpal ri gnyis te 'byung ba'i kha gnon gyi gtsug lag khang dgu'o/ /yer pa'i dkar chag la stod dmar po'i gter ma las/ rgyal po'i zhal nas bod mun pa'i smag rum gdong dmar srin po'i yul lha 'dre mthu che bas sa rdo thams cad bdag tu bzung / kha ba dang ser ba mod/btsa' dang mu ge bzan/ nyon mongs che/ tshe thung / legs pa slob pa la dgrar blta// nyes pa slob pa la ngo so bstod/ 'di 'dra ba'i sa phyogs ya nga bar 230

bdag gi lha thugs rje chen po ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi skyob pas khyod rang nga'i rjes 'jug kun dar cig gsan dang a pi gsungs pas bal mo bzas kyi ho lha thugs rje chen po khyed rang ma lags sam/ sems can gyi don la cang sun nam/sems can rnams drongs/ dam chos kyi sgron me sbor/ lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/bdag kyang gzhan don las yengs pa med kyis gang mos kyi thabs kyis 'dul lo gsungs/ kong jo'i zhal nas kye ho lha thugs rje chen po ka khyed rang lags mod/ 'gro don la thugs ma g.yel/ bdag gis kyang 'phrin las thams cad sgrub bo ces sgrol ma phyag stong spyan stong du gyur nas bod 'od zer gyis bkang /bdud rtsi'i char phab pas rtsi thog smin/ me tog thams cad kha bye/ rtsi shing naṭa tshal ne gsing chu bo thams cad rgyas/ thams cad lus sems bde ba rnyed do/ /de nas ra sa rtsig par brtsams pas lha 'dres rtsig tu ma ster/ sa rdo bzhag tshad nam mkha' la 'phangs/ rlung gis brdabs/ sa gzhi g.yos/ mi thams cad dpa' 'khums/ lha srin thams cad so sgra dang cha sgra sgrog pa'i tshe sprul pa'i rgyal pos yi dam la mchod pa bshams/ dpang btsugs dam brdar bas spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong zhig nam mkha' la byon nas spyan yer pa'i ri la gzigs thugs yer ba'i brag la gtad/ khro gnyer can dang sgrol mas yer pa zhabs kyis bcags/ chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes/lha 'dre thams cad kyis rgyal po la phyag 'tshal te bka' 'bangs su khas blangs/lha'i me tog dang spos kyi char byung / yer par brag lha mgon po rang byung du byon/bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnams rang byung du brdol bas lha sa'i sa phud shing phud rdo phud sogs las yer pa'i brag rdo rje rtse lnga rang byung gi rmang du sku'i rten spe'u dmar ser gnyis/ gsung gi rten yig drug 'bum/ thugs kyi rten mchod gsum bzhengs/ chos skyong gi rten shug pa'i nags tshal btsugs/ ting nge 'dzin sgom 231

pa la 'od kyi brag phug brgya rtsa brgyad sprul/ 'phrin las kyi rten du ri bo sgrol ma'i skur sprul/ dbang du sdud pa'i phyir spang ri khro mor sprul/ nad sel ba'i phyir chu rnams bdud rtsir bsgyur/ de'i tshe rgyal po nyid spyaca ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong par gyur nas 'od zer gyis sngags phyi nang gi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs nas bstan pas sa rdo thams cad lhar byin gyis brlabs/ khro gnyer can dang sgrol ma'i thugs ka nas me tog gi char phab/nam mkha' nas bkra shis kyi sgra sgrog rol mo rnams ma dkrol bar sgra 'byin/lha 'dre rnams kyis bka' srung du khas blangs/ der 'dus pa thams cad bde ba can du skye bar lung bstan to/ /gzhan yang mtha' 'dul sogs kyi lha lang thams cad kyi sa phud kyang yer par bskyal lo/ /zhes byung ngo / /de ltar bod yul sa gzhi byin rlabs nas/ /sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen rmang bting ste/ /dge rtsa yongs su rdzogs phyir gru bzhi pa/ /byang chub phyogs chos re mi ga sum bcu bdun/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur brtan pas g.yung drung ris/ /mthar thug 'bras bu ston phyir dbus dkyil 'khor/ /rgya yi hen khang bi har ji lta bar/ /rgya mtsho'i gru gzings 'bring po'i tshad du bting / /rgyal pos sku yi bkod pa lnga stong sprul/ /rtsig pa shing bzo thog dbub la sogs pa/ /'og khang nyin zhag gnyis kyis tshar bar mdzad/ /bod 'bangs snang ngor char zim 'bab pa yi/ /na bun gseb na skye bo las byed kyi/ /sgra skad sna tshogs sgrog pa tsam du snang / /ma mgon klu srin gnod sbyin dri za yis/ /gtsug lag khang gi srung mar khas blangs shing / /so so'i gzugs kyang bgyid par gsol ba btab/ /sgo ni nub phyogs bal po'i yul du gtad/ /dga' bzhi 'phrul gyi lha khang ra sar gags/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam rang byung bcu gcig zhal/ /gang du bzhugs zhes gtsang khang rnams gzigs tshe/ /gtsang khang dbus mar 'gro skyob gtso 'khor bcu / /232

gro/ bo gnyis dang bcas te bzhugs par gzigs/ /g.yas mar snang mtha' gtso 'khor bcu gcig dang / /g.yon na byams pa mchod pa'i sta mos bskor/ /gtsang khang lho na thub dbang gtso 'khor dgu /kun kyang dam chos ston zhing bgro bar gzigs/ /gtsang khang byang ma legs shing ngo mtshar ba/ /de na lha gzhan su yang mi snang bas/ /nang par yi dam rang byung gtso 'khor rnams/ /spyan drangs dgongs pa'i nub mo lha rnams kun/ /rang rang zhabs kyis gshegs te de na bzhugs/ /ri mo bri bar bka' yis bsgos pa'i tshe/ /khrarla pā n-i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang / /gang la des 'dul gling gnyis rang byung shar/ /lhag ma be bum brgya rtsa'i tshal bzhin bris/7 /de nas sprul pa'i lha gcig khri btsun gyis/ /sku gzugs rnams dang ra sa'i steng khang mdzad/ /sgrol ma'i ngo bo lha gcig kong jo yis/ /rgya stag ra mo che yi lha khang bzhengs/ /gzhan yang btsun mo gsum gyis rang rang gi /thugs dam lha khang re re so sor brtsigs/ /de tshe sprul pa'i rgyal pos bod 'bangs kun/ /bsod nams bsag zhing sngon tshe rgya bal la/ /zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chad mdo btsan pa'i phyir/ /sku yi sprul pa lnga stong so sor bkye/ /shar nub sgo bstan lha khang brgya rtsa re/ /tha ma yongs rdzogs rab dga'i lha khang bar/ /bod 'bangs yul gru phal cher khyab par mdzad/ /dge bcu'i bka' khrims btsan zhing dam par bsdams/ /rin chen gter phyung sa rdo bzhin du spyod/ /'dod yon rtse dga' lha dang 'dra bar gyur/ /de yang rgyal po yab yum gsum dgung lo bcu drug lon pa chu pho 'brug lo la bal bza' phebs/ nyi shu pa me spre la rgya bza' phebs/ nyer gnyis pa sa khyi la 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs/ nyer gsum pa sa mo phag lo la rmang bting ba ste/ de yang rgyal po'i zhal nas bod 'bangs rnams nga'i gtsug lag khang bzheng ba'i grogs bya dgos so zhes bka' bstsal bas thams cad yul gru 233

so sor 'dus nas lha khang rtsig pa'i 'dun ma byed do/ /de'i tshe rgyal pos〉 sku'i bkod pa lnga stong bkye nas rgya'i nyen khang bi har la dpe blangs rgya mtsho'i gru gzings 'bring gi tshad du rmang bting ste rab byung gi don du 'dul ba'i lugs dri gtsang khang dang bcas pa byang phyogs so bdun mtshon pa'i re mig so bdun du mdzad/ skye bo spyi'i don du chos gang byed lam gyi sgros tshang bar byebadagos pa'i brdar phyi gru bzhir mdzad/ bon po'i don dang chos nyid mi 'gyur ba mtshon phyir zur bzhi g.yung drung ris/ sngags pa'i don dang 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa mtshon pa'i phyir dbus su ngag gi dbang phyug drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshal du mdzad ste skye bo spyis mi mthong ba'i phyir na bun 'khrig cing char zim bu 'bab pa'i gseb na co 'dren pa sogs khu di ri ri mang po byung ba gzhan rnams kyis thos te sprul pa rnams kyis so phag gis ra sa'i 'og khang nyin gcig la brtsigs te na bun sangs nas blon 'bangs rnams kyis rtsig tu phyin pa na rtsig pa zin 'dug skad/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nang par bod 'bangs rnams kyis nga'i lha khang gi shing chod cig gsungs nas de'i 'dun ma byed pa'i tshe sprul pa lnga stong gis nub mo de ka la lha khang shing gis bkang nas 'dug nang par bzo bo sprul pa sum brgya bkye ste shing bzo rnams mdzad pa'i tshe lha gcig khri btsun skra 'khru bas rgyal po'i bsang bu 'dren ma khom ste bran mo la dngul gzhong du sha sar dang mar sar la sogs pa g.yos sna bcu gsum dang 'bras chan dang rgun chang sogs kyi bsang bu 'dren du btang bas ngo mi shes pa'i bzo bo sum brgya bzo byed pa mthong bas rgyal po ngo ma shes te log der lha gcig khri btsun rang 'dren du song ba'i phyir g.yog mos bltar phyin pas lha gcig sprul pa'i bzo bo rnams la 'gongs shing song ste dbus kyi dkyil 'khor steng na rgyal po ber nag gyon pa la thod dmar po can 'phrul thig gi sna nas phyag gis bzung ba zhig la 234

drangs/ des bsang bu blangs pas 'phrul thig lhod song ste bzo bo sum brgya po 'gyel nas 'jag ma nyug nyug thi gu zing nge byung ba mthong nas bran mos rgyal po'i bzo bo 'phrul du snang ba byas bgad pas rgyal po spyan yangs pas ste'u gcig thal/ gsor kha gcig thal/ sog le gcig thal bas bzo bo brgyas seng ge brgya'i sna chad/ bug pa brgya phug ka ba brgya'i zur nyams so/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas 'bangapo/ mo ma tshugs pas nga'i sprul pa ngo shes so gsungs nas sprul pa bshig pas gzhan rnams kyis rgyal pol shing dang 'dag pa'i mi la sta re brgyab pas shi bar mthong / blon po rnams kyis shing bzo bo rnams rtsig phug na phar rkang pa nyug nyug song bar mthong / thun mong du shing bzo dang brkos dang tshon rtsi thams cad tshar bar mthong ngo / /der nyi ma rgas sa sros pa na blon po mgar na re sprin 'khrigs glog 'gyu char chen po 'bab par snang bas shing rtsi rnams byi dogs pa'i khebs dgos zer nas las kyi rnga bo che brdungs pas grong khyer rnams rgyal pos de tsam brtsig pa la las rnga ma brdungs na da mtshan mo brdung ba ci yin zer/ der grong ba'i re phyar thams cad bsdus nas shing la 'gebs su phyin pas srod de ka la sprul pa lnga stong gis ra sa'i thog phub zin 'dug ste steng na sprul pa'i mi lag na pha gu thogs pa yad yud 'dug pa blon po rnams kyis mthong bas ngo mtshar skyes te re phyar rnams mthongs ka la bkab nas log go de ltar zhag gnyis pos ra sa'i 'og khang gi phyi thams cad legs par zin nas nang par gtsang khang de rnams gang legs pa cig tu nga'i yi dam rang byung thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor dgu po bzhugs dgos dgongs nas gzigs su byon pas gtsang khang dbus ma'i sgo phye bas gung la sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad bzhengs pas bskor ba khro bo gnyis kyis sgo srung ba/ dbus na mi 'khrugs pa skyabs spyin can bzhugs par gzigs/235
