gtsang khang g.yas na 'od dpag med la byang sems brgyad skyil krung can gyisabaskor ba dang /kho sgo 'gram phyi'i g.yas na phyag rdor dang g.yon na rme brtseg sa bye ru'i mdog can grib sel gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa bzhugs par gzigs/ gtsang khang g.yon na byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo chos 'khor bskor ba'i phyag rgya can la sgrol ma brgyad kyis bskor nas chos kyi bgro ba mdzad par gzigs/ gtsang khang lho ma na jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje la 'khor stong chen rab 'joms phyag bzhi ma dang so sor 'brang ma phyag drug pa/ gshin rje ca/thar byed zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug pa mthing nag/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad/ padma mthar byed dmar po phyag bzhi/ bgegs mthar byed mthing ga phyag bzhi pa rnams dang gnod sbyin gyis bskor nas kha ba can gyi 'dre srin 'dul thabs ston zhing bzhugs/ de na rnam sras dang dzambha la gter gyi bum pa stob pa cig kyang 'dug go /gtsang khang byang ma shin tu leg/sa shing nyams dga' bar gzigs nas de na lha su yang mi snang bas nga'i lha rnams 'dir bzhugs par bya'o dgongs nas phyir byon pa dang phyi sgo'i rtser klu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dkar po mig gsum pa sprul mgo nyi shu rtsa gsum pa cig gis zhabs la btugs nas phyag byas sprul zhags dkar po cig phul nas rgyal po chen po khyod kyi lha khang 'di stong gsum gyi stong chen por ngas rgyas par bskyang gis nga'i gzugs cig kyang mdzod cig zer mi snang bar gyur/ de bzhin du klu dga' bo dmar po sbrul mgo dgu pas stong gnyis bar ma'i bar dang / klu nyer dga' dmar ser sbrul mgo bdun pas stong chung ngu'i bar bskyang ngo zer/ de bzhin du gnod sbyin nā ga ku pe ra dmar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pas gser gyi thag bzang zhig phul nas ngas me'i 'jigs pa las srung zer/ dri za zur phud lnga pa de 'dra bas me tog phul te mi ma yin gyi gnod pa las srang ngo zer/ srin po lang ka mgrin bca thing ri shu ri shu 236

ga mgo dgu steng na rta mgo dpangs bstod pa cig gis gser gzhong pa ོgang phul te mi'i gnod pa las srung ngo zer/ dpal lha mos lcags kyi bre so zhig phul nas chu'i 'jigs pa las srung ngo zer/ dpal mgon pos mtha' dmag gi 'jigs pa las srung ngo zhes khas blangs te thams cad kyis gus pas zhabs la btugs te rang rang gi gzugs mdzod cig par gsol ba btab/ rgyal pos kyang zhal gyis bzhes so/ /rgyal pos 'khor rnams la nang par rten spyan drang ba'i bka' bsgos te gcig khri btsun gyis dga' ston gyi yo byad sbyar/ blon po rnams kyis shing rta sogs sta gon byas te nang par bu mo bcu drug pos mchod pa byed du 'ongs/ blon po rnams dang btsun mo rten spyan 'dren du 'ongs tshe lha rnams mi bzhugs par spos dang me tog tho re 'dug khong rnams brang ste tab di ri ri byas pas yang thog na ne tso smra mkhan zhig yod pa na re khyed rnams thugs ci la tab par byed zer/ lha rnam sa gar gshegs cha med par gshegs byas pas ne tso na re mdang nam phyed tsam na lha rnams gcig la gcig phyag byas spos dang me tog gis mchod nas pho brang gi mthongs na yar song nas byang phyogs bye ma'i gling na phar zhal gtad nas song bas nga yang re ma dga' zhig byung zer/ khong rnams kyis bltar phyin pas bye ma'i gling la lha rnams kyi zhabs rjes la padma dmar lam lam 'dug der rlung 'tshub byung bas zhabs rjes rnams ma gsal/ mig rdul gyis gang ste phar cam tshur cam byed pa'i tshe dre'u dkar mo de ra sa la skor ba byed cing skad 'don sna sa la sgom zhing song ba'i phyir phyin pas gtsang khang byang ma na thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor dgu gdan khri med par gral byas te bzhengs cas 'dug pas rgyal po dgyes shing blon po rnaca/sa ngo mtshar che zer nas phan tshun gcig la gcig blta zhing thal mo sbyar nas mos gus byed/ bu mo bcu drug ngo/sa mchod pa dang bstod pa byed do/ /de nas rgyal pos bal po'i lha bzo 237

ba la bka' bsgos te ka ba shing lo can gyi 'gram du tshon rtsi dang pir sogs lta gon byas te sang nyin lha ji ltar bri ba bgro ba'i phyir rgyal blon dang bzo bor bcas pa lha khang du byon pa dang lho ngos kyi logs la khrarla pā ṇi 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi gling dang gang la gang 'dul der ston gyi gling dang gnyis kha dog rdzogs pa bris pa las lhag par rang byung du byon nas 'dug ste thams cad ngo mtshar te phyag mchod mdzad/ de nas sprul pa'i bzo bo des gzhan rnams bris so/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal pos lha gcig khri btsun la bka' bstsal ba/ khyod kyis nga dang yab kyi thugs dgongs bkong ba dang chad btsan pa'i phyir spyir sems can thams cad dang khyad par kha ba can pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi phyag dang mchod pa'i rten mang du btsugs/ nga'i chos kyi bka' srol gtod pa'i bya ba yang thog mar khyod kyis byas/ slar yang nag po'i phyogs 'grib cing dkar po'i phyogs dar ba'i phyir lha khang 'di tshar bar gyis shig lha gcig khyod kyi yab rgyal po dang gnye bo rnams chad byas nas ngas bod yul du lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa'i sgo bal yul du ston par chad pas nga de rnams bzheng ba'i phyir 'gro'o zhes bka' bstsal bas lha gcig mnyes te bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes gsol nas bar khang sogs lhag ma thams cad mdzad/ de yang thil zhal thams cad beeḍūrya sngon po ltar ngang pa chu'i ri mo can la steng gi nya dang chu srin dang bya la sogs pa'i ri mo dang 'phrul gyi gzugs snang ba/ ka ba thams cad rdo rje phur bu'i dbyibs/ ka gzhu gdung gdung khebs sogs brtsegs legs shing dbyibs sna tshogs pa can/ steng 'og gi mthongs ku'i phyam sna thams cad la seng ge dkar mo g.yu ral can brgya rtsa brgyad 'phyong ba ltar gnas la/ rtsig pa thams cad kyi so phag kha dog lngas bar khru re lhag tsam du bzhag nas phyi nang lnga rim du brtsigs te skabs su thog phub cing yang brtsigs pas gzhal yas khang 238

gi tshul can/ steng du pha gu dang mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed dang g.yu bang sngon po shin tu mdzes pa mda' yab dang shar bu can/ thams cad la rin po ches brgyan nga/ dar gyi cod pan dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / rnga yab dang khor yug lcags thag gis bskor ba dang bcas pa las dril bu'i tshogs chos kyi sgra chen 'khrol ba/ gser gyi garnyir 'od 'bar bas spras pa byas so/ /gtsang khang gi lha rnams tsandan gyi lde gu dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phye ma dang dar zab sbyar nas rgyal pos ji ltar zhal gzigs pa bzhin so sor bzhengs te sgo dkyil 'khor ris kyi sgo 'gram g.yas su gnod sbyin khang pa dang g.yon du klu'i khang pa mdzad/ shar lho'i g.yung drung khugs su lcog steng khang gru skas dang bcas pa byas te dpal ldan lha mo'i rten btsugs/ lho phyogs la rang byung gi rimo'i gling gnyis kyi khar 'jam dbyangs dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ lho nub tu rigs gsum mgon po/ nub phyogs la rigs lnga dang sprul pa'i rgyal po'i rnam thar/ nub byang du dus gsum sangs rgyas/ byang dang byang shar la thub pa'i mdzad pa rnams/ shar logs la sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs thub pa bdud 'dul sems dpa'i tshogs bcas/ shar lhor sman pa'i rgyal po'i lha tshogs/bar khang du rta mgrin dkar po dang jo mo sgrol ma sogs 7bris/ gdung rnams la mngon pa'i rgyud ris/ gdung rtsar mdo sde'i rgyud ris/ ka ba —la 'dul ba'i rgyud ris ste ma 'ongs pa'i dbon sras dang rab byung gi don du sde snod gsum gyi rgyud ris bris/ phyi rabs rnams kyis rig pa'i chos go bar bya ba'i phyir gag spang dang ka gzhu dang gdung phran sogs la sgrung dang lde'u dang bon sha ba nam mkha' la 'gro ba sogs bris/ bon gyi dpe phal cher ka ba'i 'og tu sbas ri mo rnams ma 'ongs pa nyams pa gso ba'i ched du phyi mo be bum du byas te dkor mdzod dang ke'u tshang du bzhag go ra sa'i lha khang rmang ma things kyi bar kong jo 239

la lha khang rtsig pa'i dbang meng nas ra mo cher ka ba'i bar shing dang /ma cha/sa brtsigs nas sgo shar du phye bas zhal dang po nub tu gzigs pa de shar du rang 'gyur du byung / phyis sa phag gis legs par brtsigs te rgya phibs stag ltar bkra bas rgya stag ra mo che'i lha khang du grags/ zhang zhung bza' li thig sman gyis them bu bkog pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ de'i tshe sum pa ki gang rdos ngan sngags kyis shig lid phya ra tsam btang bas shig phug ngon tsam byung ba rgyal po'i mthus ma tshugs skad/ ru yongs bzas brag lha klu phug i rang byung rnams gsal bar brkos te tshwa la brgyad bcu sde'i dus brag phye bre re phed pa la tshwa bre re byin nas brag la skor khang brkos/ mong bza' khri lcam gyis yer pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ kha cig du ru yongs bzas mig mang tshal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ mi nyag bzas lha sa mkhar brag bzhengs ces sogs snang yang btsun mo lnga zhes yang yang bshad pas mi nyag bza' dang ru yongs bza' gcig par snang la mkhar brag ni 'di nas rgyal rabs bzhi'i 'og du byung ba yin no/ /de nas sprul pa'i rgyal pos blon po chen po bcu drug dang bcas te bod yul thams cad du sku'i snang ba so sor bstan te nub phyogs bal po'i yul du sgo bstan pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad dang / rgya'i so kha phyir 'phul ba dang rgya rje la zhal gyis bzhes pa chad btsan par bya ba'i phyir rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i bar du lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad sgo rgya nag la bstan pa mdzad cing thams cad kyi mtha' mar mi nyag rab sgang du yongs rdzogs rab dga'i lha khang mdzad de mtha' 'dul nas 'di'i bar gyi lha khang re re la yang ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod par snang ngo / /de rnams lo bcu gsum gyis thim ste rgyal po pho brang du phebs/ ra sar spyan drangs pas mthil zhal chu 'dra ba'i nang na 'phrul gyi gzugs brnyan rnams g.yo ba gzigs te mtsho de brdol nas snang ba gsung skad/ bal bzas 240

mtsho ma lags byas pas slar rgyal pos chibs lcag bor bas kyang chu steng na lding ba 'dra ba zhig byung nas thugs ma ches/ der phri/ btsun gyis rin po che'i sor gdub bor bas sing khra la la dkyil 'kher gyi rtsar song bas dod thugs ches te lha khang rnams su byon ste gzigs pas sprul pa'i sku dngos su mkhyen/ steng khang du gzigs nas khyod kyi shing bzo la so gas pa 'di rnams shin tu legs te nga'i 'phrul gyi bzo dang khyad mi snang gsungs pas 'phrul snang du mtshan thogs shing dang por ra la sa bskyal pas ra sa 'phrul snang du mtshan chags shing lha klu mi gnod sbyin dga' bas dga' bzhi 'phrul gyi lha khang zhes kyang grags so/ /kong jos kyang ra mo cher spyan drangs te rab tu dgyes pa thob / btsun mo gzhan gsum gyis kyang rang rang gi thugs dam gyi lha khang gzigs su phul lo/ /de nas mchod pa'i yo byad rgya cher bshams/ /rgyal po dkyil 'khor steng byon me tog bzung / /phyag gnyis thal sbyar bden pa'i tshig brjod pa/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang shākya'i sras/ /grangs med sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa la sogs pa/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bde legs stsol/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjer ldan pa'i chu rgyun gyis//gang la gang 'dul smin zhing grol bar mdzad/ /rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang la sogs pa/ /byang chub sems da pa' rnams kyis bde legs stsol/ /rnam dag dri ma med pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ /bsdu ba nam bzhis dam chos rgya sa par mdzad/ /rgyal sras gnas brtan rab 'byor la sogs pa/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams kyis bde legs stsol/ /gzhan yang phyogab/ bcu'i zhing khams thams cad kyi/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub secha /sa dpa' thams cad kyis/ /gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsom/ /de ltar sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /bden pa'i stobs brjod 241

shis pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras yi dam chos skyong kun/ /nyi zer rdul tsam sprin dang na bun ltar/ /'thibs te sangs rgyas kun gyis me tog gtor/ /byin brlabs rgyal sras rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ /tshangs sogs lha yis me tog char chen phab/ /lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas kun gyis mchod/ /lha yi rol mo'i tshogs kun mkha' la 'khrol/ /dri zhim spos ngad go mtshams med par khyab/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs/ /dam tshig pa la dbyer med brtan par gyur/ /lha rnams bstod pa'i dbyangs snyan rnam mang gis/ /chos kyi rgyal po mngon par bstod de song / /de ltar gtsug lag khang mchog rnam gnyis la/ /rab gnas bkra shis lhun gyis grub par mdzad/ /me long gzugs brnyan bzhin du kun gyis mthong / /glu gar ltad mo la sogs bod 'bangs dang / /mthun pa'i dga' ston lo zla du mar spyad/ /de tshe rgyal pos dgyes pa'i glu gsungs pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum/ /thar pa'i lam ston spyan ras gzigs/ /gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /bkra shis pa'i glu la dgong su gsol/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sprin phung lta bur bzhugs pa mthong / /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams kyis/ /sil snyan rol mo'i sgra yang 'khrol/ /me tog mandha'i char phab pas /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /nag po'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /bdud dpung bcom pa'i mthu dpal gyis/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rnga chen brdungs/ /dug lnga gti mug rang sar zhi/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rnga sgra yis/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /de ring skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /rang dbang med pa'i dga' sems skyes/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod char bzhin 242

bab/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /yi dam lha yi bkra shis kyis/ /srong btsan sgam po bkra shis pa/ /bkra shis glu ru blangs pa yin/ /nga'i bod 'bangs rnams la bkra shis shog /de ltar tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dgyes glu gsungs/ /lha mir bcas pa'i 'gro kun yi rangs gyur/ /de tshe lha mo yi ge drug ma dngos/ /btsun mo chung ma mong bza' khri lcam las/ /lha sras gung srong gung btsan zhes bya ba/ /nor bu 'dzin dbang mngon sum mi gzugs su/ /brag lha bkra shis gzhal yas khang du 'khrungs/ /btsas ston cher mdzad bod 'bangs dga' mgur gyur/ /de ltar thugs dam lha khang mthar phyin nas/ /dge bcu'i rgyal khrims btsan zhing brtan pa'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i khrims ra dngangs shing 'jigs pa bcas/ /mi dge bcu la spyod cing mi ldog pa/ /de dag gshed ma 'jigs rung gis bzung ste/ /mgo dang yan lag nying lag gcod cing btub/ /lce dang mig 'bru khro chus pags pa brnyil/ /mgo dang yan lag mig sogs phung por spungs/ /de lta'i khrims ra mthong bas skyi g.ya' ba/ /lha sa khru 'brug la sogs bod yul gyi/ /yul ljongs pho brang kun na cig char snang / /ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul thabs drag po yis/ /mi dge spyod nub kun kyang dge bcur gnas/ /de tshe li yi yul gyi dge tshul gnyis/ /bod yul spyan ras gzigs dbang drung song zhes/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum lung bstan nas/ /bod yul 'ongs pa'i mi mos zlog pa'i phyir/ /de kun sprul pa'i khrims ra yin no zhes/ /se gol brdabs pa'i mod la mi snang gyur/ /spyi bo'i 'od dpag med zhal mngon sum bstan/ /skal par 'tshams pa'i chos kyis smin mdzad ste/ /skad cig li yul phyin par byin gyis brlabs/ /phyi mar dgra bcom go 'phang nyid la bkod/ /de yang li yul du dge tshul gnyis kyis spyan ras gzigs bsgrubs pas nam mkha' la 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon te khyed 243

gnyis spyan ras gzigs lta bar 'dod na da lta bod kyi yul na rgyal ngo/ra sprul nas bzhugs kyi der song la stos shig ces lung bstan te mi snang bar gyur/ de ma thag du gseg shang dang lhung bzed thogs te bod du 'ongs/ thog mar khra 'brug tu phyin pas chad pa gcod pa snga ma dang thug ste mgo'i ra ba dang mig gi phung po sogs 'dug pas 'di lta bu ci yin sus byas dris pas rgyal pos khrims mdzad pa yin zer bas ma dad ste 'phags pa 'jam dpal ma yin bdud du 'dug pa zer nas log ste mgo'i ra ba la dbu rar ming chags/ yang lha sa dang nye bar sleb ste bon po zhar ba rta zhon pa cig byung ba la li yul du 'gro ba'i lam dris pas nga rgyal po'i lha khang rtsig pa'i pho nya la rings par yod/ ston mi khom zer nas song / stod lung mda'i chu 'gram na mi ro mgo med dang mig med sogs mang du 'dug lha sar slebs pas nub phyogs kyi lcags ri'i kha na chad pa gcod pa rgyun mi 'chad par mthong bas spyan ras gzigs ga la yin zer nas phyir log dan 'bag gi thang la slebs tshe rgyal pos mkhyen te blon po cig la rta gu rub nag po bskyon nas dan 'bag gi thang la mi nged rang dang cha byad mi 'dra ba skra bregs pa gos ngur smrig gru bzhi gyon pa gnyis 'gro zhing yod de khrid la shog gastsangs te spyan sngar khrid phyin pas rgyal pos de gnyis kyi zhabs la phyag mdzad de khyed gnyis gang nas 'dir ci byed du 'ongs gsungs pas de gnyis na re bdag cag gnyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis lung bstan nas spyan ras gzigs bltar mchis pa lags te zer/ 'o na khyed gnyis spyan ras gzigs blta bar 'dod dam gsungs pas de dang 'tshal de zer/ der nub phyogs bye ma'i gling la khrid de la thod phud nas a mi tā bha'i zhal bstan zhal bcu gcig pa dngos su bstan yang zer/ khyed spyan ras gzigs sems can 'di tsam gsod pa tsug lags zhus pas bod mi 'di rnams zhi bas mi 'thul bas sprul pa byas pa 244

yin gsung〈) te se gol brdabs pas khrims ra dang gshed ma sogs mi snang bar gyur/ de gnyis yid ches nas gdam pa zhus pas/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum spongs la phyag dang skor ba byed cing mtho ris kyi gzhi rten tshul khrimab/ bsrungs la bslab gsum dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi spongs la sangs rgyas dang dam chos thams cad kyi snying po yi ge drug pa zlos shig yid kyi mi dge ba gsum spongs la dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ste byams pa dang snying rje drag pos bdag gzhan brje ba'i blo sgoms shig chos bzang po las bsam pa bzang po lhag pa yin no/ /'di gsum dang ldan na byang chub 'grub la mi ldan na mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad blo nas 'don du yod kyang snying po med do zhes gdams shing gzhan yang thugs rje chen po'i chos skor du ma gsungs so/ /de nas de gnyis kyis/ kye ma chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku/ /ārya pa lo thugs rje can/ /yul du 'gro bas skyel ma zhu/ /zhes zhus pas khyed gnyis yud tsam gyis phyin par 'dod dam gsungs/ 'tshal lo zhus pas thu bar bye ma bre re blug ste spyi bor phyag bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mdo la rang yul du slebs te bye ma gser du gyur nas snang / de phyin li yul thams cad du bod kyi rgyal po ni spyan ras gzigs dngos so zhes grags/ de gnyis phyi mar dgra bcom pa thob ste the tshom zos pas dngos grub phyi mar 'gyangs pa'o/ /'di la 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas nga dang las 'brel med kyis spyan ras gzigs kyi drung du song zhes kyang snang ngo / /gung ri gung btsan rgyal sar dbang bskur te/ /de yi lha sras mang srong mang btsan 'khrungs/ /gung srong chab srid lo lngar mnga' mdzad nas/ /bco brgyad bzhes tshe po ṭa la ru gshegs/ /gung srong 'di yab kyis nga gsum bzhes pa lcags mo sprul la 'khrungs/ lo bcu gsum na rgyal sar bskos/ btsun mo 'a zha bza' mong rje khri dkar khab tu bzhes pa la sras mang 245

srong mang btsan 'khrungs/ blon po myang mang po rje zhang snang dang snubs btsan to res byas/ chab srid lo lnga mdzad de bco brgyad la gshegs/ gung srong bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni gnam ri srong btsan g.yon na yod/ /ming ni gung chen gung ri lags so skad/ /slar yang yab kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin mdzad/ /bod yul bde skyid phun tshogs 'byung ba'i slad/ /dgos 'dod stsol ba'i gter mang sbas pa ni/ /ka ba bum pa can dang nye bar sar/ /dam chos gter sbas de yi phan yon gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi ma shar 'dra 'byung / /thams cad dam pa'i chos la spyod par 'gyur/ /shing lo can la gser dngul rin chen sbas/ /rin chen la spyod mtha' nor ma lus 'du/ /sbrul mgo can la drag sngags mthu gter sbas/ /mtha' dmag bgegs dang log 'dren zhi bar 'gyur/ /seng mgo can la phyugs kyi g.yang yig sbas/ /bzhon phyugs 'phel zhing dkar thog bcud ldan 'gyur/ /ratna de wa dzam la'i 'og tu sbas/ /rgyan gos nor 'bru gang la ci 'dod 'byung / /stag sha de wa klu khang nang du sbas/ /lo legs char 'bab klu yi gnod pa 'jil/ /bee ṭurya lhung bzed zas sna'i tshogs kyis bkang / /gnod sbyin khang sbas bza' btung ma lus 'byung / kha zas lhag par bcud dang ldan pa yin/ /zangs chen gser dang rin chen tshogs kyis bkang / /dkyil 'khor 'og sbas mchod dang zhig gso'i rgyur/ /skal ba can la smon lam btab ste sbas/ /gzhan yang rin chen sna tshogs du ma rnams/ /nang skor du mar dpag med sbas pa yis/ /sa phyogs 'od ldan char chu dus su 'bab/ /than pa sad ser gtsa' dang mu ge med/ /nad dang mtha' dmag mi 'byung bkra shis shing /bde legs yon tan dpag med 'byung bar 'gyur/ /cung zad zhib par bka' yi thang yig blta/ /thang yig nas 'di ltar bshad cing gter sgo sogs re zhig snang la ka bkol mar 246

shing lo can la chos gter/ seng mgo can la phyir ldog bum pa can la rin po che'i gter/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'og du stag sha de wa/ klu khang du ratna de wa/ beḍū rya'i lhung bzed them pa la sbas zhes kyang snang zhing spyir kha byang sogs shin tu rgyas par yod 'dug pa ma dpe la lar snang ngo / /kong jos kyang sa dpyad legs par mdzad pas bod 'bangs la drin che'o zhes rgyal po dang khri btsun gyis drin du gzo bar mdzad do/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas nga yi lha khang 'der/ /rgyal ba'i rten mchog rmad du byung ba rnams/ /rin chen dpag med dang bcas bzhugs pa'i mthus/ /ji srid sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas kyi bar/ /rin chen gling ltar yon tan dpag med ldan/ /mchog gi sprul sku dngos su bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' skyes chen re/ /zag pa kun zad 'phags pa dgra bcom re/ /ye shes mchog dngos grub pa'i dbang po re/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes ma'i mkha' 'gro re/ /nam yang rgyun mi 'chad par rtag tu bzhugs/ /sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin phal gyis rtogs par dka'/ /bod yul lha khang kun las mngon par mtho/ /yon tan kun ldan longs spyod zad pa med/ /mtha' bzhi las rgyal grags pas gling bzhi khyab/ /dzaspu'i gling na 'gran zla bral lo gsung / /'di la 'dul bya zhabs tog mtha' nas rgyas/ /mtha' mi dbang 'dus dpal 'byor mkha' dang mnyam/ /ma 'ongs dus na nga yi dbon sras sogs/ bod yul lha khang bzheng bar 'dod pa rnams/ /sa phud rdo phud ra sa'i gnas 'dir skyol/ /rab gnas lhun grub bgegs dang bar chad med/ /bkra shis yon tan kun ldan 'gyur ro gsung / /de nas chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku de yis/ /dbon sras mang srong dbu la phyag bzhag nas/ /pang skong phyag rgya pad dkar zla ba sgron/ /thugs rje chen po'i chos skor bshad rgyud dang / /sgrub skor don rgyud thams cad rdzogs par gnang / /'og min gnas 247

mchog ra sa'i gtsug khang la/ /mchod ngang skor ba mthong thos dran reg dang / /rags dang zhig gso'i phan yon bya thabardo sogs/ /rgya cher bstsal ba chu dar la bris nas/ /gnod sbyin khang pa la sogs du mar sbas/ /ma 'ongs skal bar ldan la smon lam btab/ /gzhan yang nga nas gdung rabs lnga pa na/ /nga yi ming la lde btags rgyal po 'byung / /de dus paṇa chen mang po bod du 'byon/ /gtsug khang mang bzheng bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /ngur smrig gos 'dzin rab byung mang 'byung bas/ /nga yi dbon sras rnams kyis spyi bor khur/ /mchod pa'i gnas kyis 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor/ /phan bde dge legs ma lus 'byung ngo gsungs/ /de 'phral mgar gyis zangs kyi glegs bur bris/ /mchims phu'i dkor mdzod nang du bzhag par gyur/ /gzhan yang btsun mo phyi blon nang blon dang / /bod 'bangs byis pa yan la zhal gdams gsungs/ /thams cad yi ge drug pa'i chos la bkod/ /de rnams thon mi sogs kyis yi ger bris/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan don du gter du bzhag / sprul pa'i rgyal po'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa rnams/ /ka ba bum pa can la nye bar sbas/ /bka' cho sa zab mo'i gdams pa de rnams kyis/ /ma 'ongs bod yul 'gro ba'i ngon byed par/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis byin brlabs smon lam mdzad/ /de yang gab pa mngon phyung las/ bka' chos rnams rin po che'i gter du bzhugs nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus 'gro ba la phan par gyur shog gi smon lam btab par 'tshal nas dkon mchog la mchod pa mdzad/ 'khor 'bangs la bza' btung bkye/chos skyong dpang du gsol nas da lta bdag gis dkon mchog la mchod pa dang skye bo la bza' btung byin pa 'di la brten nas bdag gi bka' chos kyi shog dril dus kyi phyi ma la dgongs pa 'di rnams snyigs ma'i dus su skal ldan las 'phro can rnams dang 'phrad nas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams thams cad 248

'phags pa'i bka' la thogs par gyur cig thogs nas kyang ris drug gi du kha thams cad de nyid du zad nas bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig de'i tshe bdag gi gtsug lag khang 'di rnams su 'phags pa rnams 'khur zhing zhabs tog gi 'os mang bar gyur cig de'i byin rlabs kyis bod 'bangs —thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig de kho na 'grub par gyur cig ces bka' bstsal pa dang thams cad dga' bdes khyab ste ca co dang rtse 'jo mang po byas pa dang rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang snang gzhi med du 'dug go /blo 'das byar med cig 'dug go /ji bzhin pa'i ngang las ma bcos par glod la zhog cig ces gsungs pa dang thams cad kyi rgyud la gnyis 'dzin zhig ste ji bzhin pa'i ngang la gnas par gyur to/ /zhes byung ngo / khyad par dbon sras dam pa mang srong la/ /thugs kyi gsang mdzod gab pa mngon du phyung / /gzhan yang ma 'ongs rgya cher lung bstan mdzad/ /de nas nang par nyi ma shar ba dang dbon sras kyis dbu rtse'i yang thog tu rang gi na bza' la stan byas te zhal zas mang po drangs te phyag byas nas/sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las dang / /snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje las/ /bde ba can nas pho nyar byon/ /bod 'bangs yongs kyi skyabs gnas mdzad/ /bdag cag kun la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang tha mal mjal/ /zab mo'i thugs dgongs gnang mod kyang / /chos nyid don gyi thugs rje de/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la mi gab par/ /gab pa mngon du phyung nas ni/ /rang snang yul med bstan du gsol/ /blo 'das byar med bstan du gsol/ /ma bcos ngang nas bstan nas kyang / /byar med ngang la gnas pa las/ /sku gsum shugs las 'char pa'i tshul/ /dngos cag blo la sbyar du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ lha sras chen po nyon zhig bdag 249

ni sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas drung du dam yang bcas/ /byang chub sems kyis bod 'bangs don la yong / /nga dang rgyal ba gnyizhwa su med/ /'gro kun nga yis 'dul ba yin/ khyed kun 'phags pa'i byin brlabs yin/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs rgyud zab mo rnams/ /'phags pa'i lam stegs yin mod na'ang / /chos nyid don gyi thugs rje de/ /blo dman rnams la bstan mi 'os/ /brtse bas gab pa mngon phyung 'di/ /ma rtogs sgro dang skur ba'i gzhi/ /skal med rnams la ye gsang chod/ /tsitta snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /chos nyid zad sar skyol ba yang / /nga yis bstan gyis legs par nyon/ /sna tshogs dag kyang rang snang yin/ /yul med de ni blo las 'das/ /blo 'das de ni byar med yin/ /ji bzhin pa yi ngang gnas yin/ /gnas pa med pa glod pa'i mchog /de ltar go ba'i gang zag gis/ /mtha' bral spros pa chod pa la/ /lta ba'i ming du btags pa yin/ /rang gsal 'dzin pa stor ba la//sgom pa'i ming du btags pa yin/ /don dang 'bral ba med pa la/ /spyod pa'i ming du btags pa yin/ /spang blang 'dzin pa zhig pa la/ /'bras bu'i ming du btags pa yin/ /rtsol med 'gro don byed pa la/ /thugs rje'i ming du btags pa yin/ /de la skyo dub med pa la/ /chen po'i ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro don mdzad kyang skyon ma gos/ /'phags pa'i ming du btags pa yin/ /snying rjes dbang du 'dus pa la/ /rgyal po'i ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro ba'i kha lo snyoms pa la/ /srong btsan ming du btags pa yin/ /blo la gang phan bshad pa la/ /gdams ngag ming du btags pa yin/ /rjed thor shul du bzhag pa la/ /bka' rgyud ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro ba dang ba 'dren pa la/ /gtsug khang ming du btags pa yin/ /rnam rtog rang sar grol ba la/ /sangs rgyas ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro ba lam du 'jud pa la/ /dam chos 250

ming du btags pa yin/ /byar med blo la 'byor ba la/ /dge 'dun ming du btags pa yin/ /rtsol med rang lugs glod pa la/ /byar med ming du btags pa yin/ /tha mal rtog pa bsgyur pa la/ /skyed rim ming du btags pa yin/ /blo yi 'khrid thabs sna tshogs la/ /chos spyod ming du btags pa yin/ /rtsa bral nang du shes pa la/ /rtogs pa'i ming du btags pa yin/ /don go gcig las med pa la/ /nyag gcig ming du btags pa yin/ /du ma ngo bo gcig pa la/ /chos sku'i ming du btags pa yin/ /rang snang lha ru shar ba la/ /longs sku'i ming du btags pa yin/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dren pa la/ /sprul sku'i ming du btags pa yin/ /rtog med rang sa zin pa la/ mngon 'gyur ming du btags pa yin/ /btags pa thams cad ming yin gyi/ /ming gi 'dzin pa med par zhog /bsams pa thams cad blo yin gyi/ /blo yi byed pa zhog la thong //zhog ces bya ba tshig yin gyi/ /tshig gi 'dzin pa bor la thong / /thong zhes bya ba blo yin gyi/ /blo yi byed pa dbyings su sbos/ /sbed pa bya ba bzang rtog yin/ /bzang ngan med par khad de ba/ /gab sbas med par lhang nge ba/ /'gro 'ong med par sa le ba/ /spang blang med par lhug ge ba/ /phyogs ris med par cham me ba/ /btang bzung med par khyil le ba/ /gsal 'grib med par lhan ne ba/ /brjed yengs med par cha le ba/ /btang bzhag med par wal le ba/ /blo las 'das pa'i yul la stos/ /tshig las 'das pa'i don la ltos/ /bzang ngan med pa'i dbyings la stos/ /phyi nang med pa'i sems la stos/ /pho mo med pa'i rgyud la stos/ /gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i don la stos/ /don zhes bya ba blo las 'das/ /'das pa'i rjes su ma 'brang bar/ /brjod tshig bral ba'i ngang la stos/ /bltas pas mthong ba'i yul med kyi/ /ma bltas bzhag pas chos nyid mthong / /ma bsgrubs bzhag pas sems nyid 'grub/ /ma 251

bzung glod pas rang sar grol/ /de ltar mthong ba'i gang zag la/ /9rnakhor 'das gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /dge sdig bzang ngan rtag chad dang / /pho mo bde sdug yin min dang / /nye ring mtho dman gnyis ma mthong / /gang5la 'grib gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /mthong ba med pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /sna tshoṭa shar ba rang nyid yin/ /sna tshogs 'gag pa med par zhog /'dzin med spang blang med par zhog /sna tshogs 'dzin bral chos sku yin/ /ma 'gags gsal ba longs sku yin/ /sna tshogs grol ba sprul sku yin/ /tha mal rtog med chor sku yin/ /chos nyid 'dod pa tha mal yin/ /blo las 'das pa de nyid yin/ /'dod pa bral na don dang 'phrad/ /gnyis 'dzin grol na gnas su gtol/ /spang blang med na dngos grub thob/ /'gro ngon byed na 'phrin las rdzogs/ /blo thag chod na 'gro sar phyin/ /phyin sa med na gtol ba yin/ /de lta bu yi gang zag la/ /rig pa thams cad rang rig yin/ /shes pa thams cad rang shes yin/ /grol ba thams cad rang grol yin/ /gsal ba thams cad rang gsal yin/ /stong pa thams cad rang stong yin/ /'dug pa thams cad rang 'dug yin/ /gnas pa thams cad rang gnas yin/ /bde ba thams cad dang bde yin/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rang sdug yin/ /thams cad rang rig rang snang yin/ /sgom du med pas bsam du med/ /rgyud la byar med yongs su med/ /bzhag rgyu med de btang rgyu med/ /brjed rgyu med de nor rgyu med/ /ye shes de la rgyun chad med/ /ting nge 'dzin la thun mtshams med/ /dmigs pa la yang btang bzung med/ /rnam par rtog pa bzang ngan med/ /yid kyi yul la phyi nang med/ /dngos po med la pho mo med/ /re dogs spangs pas skyon dang bral/ /'dod pa med pas thob pa med/ /rtsol ba med par skyon rnams spangs/ /'bras bu la re ba med pas sangs rgyas kyi 'dod pa zhig bsam brjod blo las 252

'das pas smra ba'i ngag dang bral/ de ltar du rang dbang thob tsam na rgyud pa rang gis zin/ grol cha nang nas rnyed/ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma zhig snang srid bka' rgyud du shes/ byed spyod chos su 'gro/ mthong thos sku gsum du byon/ye shes nang nas brdol/ nyon mongs rang sar dag dad gus rang la tshud/'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang rig tu shes/ skyid sdug gsal 'debs su shes/bdag 'dzin chos skur grol lo/ /gzhi mthong bas lta ba med/ rtsad chod pas sgom du med/ rang sa zin pas sgrub tu med/ rang sems ngo shes pas sangs rgyas med do/ /shes rab rang rdol du byon pas wal po rjes med du 'dug pa/sna tshogs 'gag med du grol bas tshor ba rjes med du sangs pa/ rig pa bslan sar chags pas chos sku gcer mthong du grol ba/ rig pa rkyang 'ded du 'dug pas gnyis su med pa'i sku rang snang chen po'i ngang la lus so/ /rang byung yin pas lhun grub tu byung / rang gsal yin pas gting gsal du shar/rang snang yin pas 'od gsal du snang / /rang rig yin pas chos skur byung /rang grol yin pas zang thal du byung ngo / /de yang rang gis ma byas par gzhan gyis byed dam/ rang la bsam du med par gzhan la mtshon pas rnyed dam/ rang ma rig par sems can thul lam/ 'du 'bral med pa btsal bas rnyed dam/phyin pa med pa bdas pas zin nam/ dngos po med pa lag tu lon nam/bstan rgyu med pa mig gis mthong ngam/ rang la yod pa gzhan la 'tshol lam/gsal ba'i rting la lta'am/ grol ba'i rting la bshig gam/ ngag pa'i rting la 'khru'am/ 'grangs pa'i rting la za'am/ ngoms kyi rting la 'thung ngam/ dros pa'i rting la gon nam/ shes pa'i rting la 'thoms sam/ de ltar sems la rgyu rkyen bral bas rtsol sgrub kyi blo dang bral te dngos med la gnyen pos bcos su 'dug gam/ yod med kyi blo dang bral bas rtag chad rang sar dag gnyis 'dzin 253

rang sar grol bas re dogs kyi mtha' spangs/ zhen 'dzin rang sar grol bas skye med rang sar zin/ rtog med nang nas mthong bas dgra bgegs rang sar 'thul/ 'o 'di ltar rig pa rgya yan gnyen po med pa la ye shes rang snang gi spyod pa zer ba yin no/ /rtog med rang lugs gnas pa la spang blang med pa zer ba yin no/ /ye shes nang nas shar ba la rnam rtog rang grol zer ba yin no/ /yin min blo las 'das pa la dgag sgrub bral ba zer ba yin no/ /'bad rtsol med par zin pa la chos nyid klong rdol zer ba yin no/ /lhun grub skye ba med pa la 'bras bu rang shar zer ba yin no/ /de ltar go ba dang rtogs pa dus mnyam/ shes pa dang grol ba dus mnyam/ gsal ba dang mthong ba dus mnyam/ 'byar ba dang reg pa dus mnyam/ brlan pa dang gsher ba dus mnyam/'o de ltar shes pa'i gang zag gis lta ba la phyogs ris med kyis nam mkha' gon/ sgom pa la gsal 'grib med kyis nyi zla khur/ /spyod pa la thogs brduṭa med kyis rlung la zhon/ /'bras bu la blang dor med kyis gser gling ltos/ de ltar rtogs pa'i gang zag gis lta ba la blta rgyu gda' ye/ sgom pa la sgom rgyu gda' ye/ spyod pa la spyod rgyu gda' ye/ 'bras bu la sgrub rgyu gda' ye/ rig pa gshis thog tu skyol/ mtshan ma rang grol du thong / phyi nang gi 'dzin pa shigabazang ngan gyi blang dor spongs/ chags zhen gyi 'dzin pa khrol/ bzang 'dod kyi nga rgyal chog 'gran sems kyi phrag dog shol/ zhe sdang gi me chen sod/ gti mug gi mun pa sol/ byar med kyi ngang la yengs med tu zhog gnyis 'dzin gyi blo nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyas thob/ don la sgom rgyu med kyis rig pa rang sar zhog 'o de lta bu'i gang zag gis/ skyed rim bsgoms na snang srid lha ru 'gyur/ /rdzogs rim dran na gnyis 'dzin mtshan ma zhig /zung 'brel 'dod na bar snang 'ja' tshon stos/ /don go mthong na tha mal chos med sdod/ /ma mthong 254

bar du bla na bka' rgyud bsten/ /chos spyod byed na rang 'dod zhen pa spongs/ /mi 'jigs go cha 'dod na sgo gsum lha ru bsgyur/ /gzhan don byed na 'gro la phan sems skyed/ /rang don sgrub na 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba spongs/ /dgra bgegs 'dul na rtsa bral snying rje skyed/ /phyi ma bde 'bras 'dod na da lta dka' ba chod/ /'gro ba dbang du sdud na bdag pas gzhan gces kyis/ /stom las le lo dran na 'chi ba mi rtag sgoms/ /chags zhen 'dzin pa byung na rmi lam sgyu mar sbyongs/ /bar chad bdud kyis bred na rang sems gtan la phob/ /lha chos tshul bzhin byed na chos min thams cad spongs/ /nga dang yun du 'grogs kyang de las med/ /sangs rgyas gzhan dang mjal yang de las med/ /ces chos kyi rgyal pos thugs kyi brnag pa gab pa mngon du phyung ba dang dbon sras dus de nyid du chos thams cad chos nyid rang shar rang grol chen po'i klong du 'bad pa dang rtsol ba med par grol lo/ /dus de nyid du bde sdug la spang blang med/'khor 'das la bzang ngan med/ 'di phyi la gdam ka med par 'phags pa rnams kyi zhal mthong bya mthong byed med par mi la mi lta ba bzhin du gzigs so/ /'khor thams cad kyang rig pa rang gsal gyi dgongs pa la gzhag bya 'jog byed med par gyur to/ /dbon sras rjes su thugs rangs te phyi nang gi mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing bka' drin ches gzo yang 'jigs pa ci yang mi mnga' 'o/ /de nas rgyal po dar cig dgongs pa la bzhugs te ci yang mi gsung ngo / /de nas spyan nam mkha' la khral khral mdzad nas/ /e ma rgyal sras chen po pa/ /nga yi lha sa'i gnas gzhi 'di/ /nya 'dra ljong 'dra sbal 'dra pir yang 'dra/ /rim pa bzhin du chu yis gcod par byed/ /nya 'dra rgyal ba yul gyi rang bzhin yin/ /ras bris phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra/ /rgyal bas rgyal ba'i zhabs tog byed pa yin/ /nya 'dra'i kha ru sems can sus 255

'ongs pa/ /rgyal ba'i yul la reg dang khyad par med/ /de yang sngar sbyangs las 'phro yong ba yin/ /'khor ba'i du kha mtha' ru phyin pa yin/ /'bad pa don can yin no bod 'bangs rnams/ /sa 'am rdo 'am 'byim pa bya sgong tsam//gang gis de yi phyogs su spungs byed pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams la sman pa byed pa yin/ /de yang bde ba'i lam la tshud pa yin/ /nga yi rigs can rnams la bskul ba ni/ /nya 'dra'i dus su shog ltar spron pa yin/ /ljong 'dra'i dus su zhwa ltar bkon pa yin/ /sbal 'dra'i dus su gdan ltar 'dings pa yin/ /pir 'dra'i dus su gyur tsa na/ /rgya chen mchod pa bshams nas ni/ /mos gus gsol 'debs gces pa yin/ /de ltar byed na cung zhig gnas par gyur/ /nang gi lha sos phyi yi rags la phan/ /phyi yi rags sos nang gi lha rnams rgyas/ /mchod pa bshams shing gsol ba btab pa na/ /bod 'bangs bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dus kyi mtha' la sdig spyod mang 'byung yang / /nga yi lha sa mthong thos reg pa yi/ /'gro ba phal cher 'khor ba'i gnas las thar/ /de yang 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rje ste/ /nga yi bod 'bangs rnams kyi bsod nams yin/ /de phyir nga yi skyabs gnas pho mo rnams/ /rtsol ba ma zhan sing stobs skyed mdzod la/ /nga yi ra sa mthong thos rig par mdzod/ /nyade yang thar pa'i lam la tshud pa yin/ /skyon rnams sel zhing yon tan sgrub 'dod na/ /nga yi ra sar zhabs tog mos pa gyis/ /bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa rgyal ba rnams la zhus/ /zhes bka' bstsal zhing / nga'i lha sa'i gnas 'di chus nyen gso dgos pa'i skabs cig 'ongs pas de'i cha rkyen rnams gter du sbos/ shig gsungs te lha sras kyis kyang zhabs tog bya thabs dang dkor cor mang po dus de nyid du gter du sbas te skal ldan la smon lam btab bo/ /gzhan yang da ste bdung rabs lnga na rgyal po 256

lde zhes bya bachi ring la ngam pa'i chos rgyas par 'byung / /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi rjes su rab tu byung ba dbu reg zhabs rjen ngur smrig gi na bza' gsol ba lha mi'i mchod gnas mang du 'byung gis de las rang bzhin gyi 'di phyi'i bde ba thams cad 'byung bas nga'i dbon sras rje blon rnams kyis 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor/chab 'og nas phyung la bde ba byin/ dbu'i mchod gnas su khur zhig ces bka' bstsal te de ma thag mgar gyis zangs kyi byang bu la bris te mchims phu'i dkor mdzod du bzhag go /de lta'i chos kyi rgyal pos rjes bzung bas/ /dus de'i 'gro ba'i bsod nams gzhal du med/ /ston pas mdzad bcu bstan pa'i sa min yang / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos su bzhugs/ /ri bo po ta la dang khyad par med/ /so skye ngur smrig rtags 'dzin med na yang / /sar gnas byang chub sems dpa'as bod yul gang / /'og min chos kyi pho brang gnyis pa yin/ /nyan thos rang rgyal dman pa'i sgra med kyang / /theg chen lam la skye bo thams cad spyod/ /de phyir kun gzigs rgyal po'i zhing khams dngos/ /rtog ges dregs pa'i mkhas rlom med na yang / /chos kun rtogs pa'i 'phags pa bgrang las 'das/ /de bas bde ba can gyi zhing khams 'dra/ /gsang sngaṭa bon gyer zas 'tshol med na yang / /skyed rdzogs dngos grub thob pa bgrang las 'das/ /de bas lcang lo can gyi zhing khams dngos/ /dge bcu'i khrims la skye bo thams cad gnas/ /gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chab 'og bzhin/ /ci dgos longs spyod 'bad pa med par grub/ /de phyir rdzogs ldan dus kyi bskal ba 'dra/ /thams cad yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog /skyed rdzogs dbyer med 'khyer so gsum la spyod/ /tha na srin bu grog ma'i bar dag kyang / /'di nas shi 'phos ngan song 'gro mi srid/ /bstan pa'i snying po rab mchog de dus dar/ /dus de'i bod kyi bsod nams a la la/ /'dzam gling kun las lhag 257

nga 'a ngo mtshar stos/ /ya mtshan rgyas pa'i gtam gyi cha shas tsam/ /dus ngan deng yang rna ba'i dga' ston gyur/ /ngo mtshar gtam la rangs shing yid ches pa/ /'di yang chos rgyal de yi 'phrin las kyi/ /lhag mar nges snyam mi bzod gus pa 'phel/ /des na lha sa bsam yas sogs la bkra shis tsam la rab gnas su btags pa las cho ga med par rab gnas med la jo bo rjes rab gnas kyi srol gtod pas rten rab gnas med pa la rab gnas mdzad ces bka' drin du byed do zhes dang / de dus nyan thos kyi sdom khrims med pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med cing dge ba rnams kyang legs spyad tsam gyi bar ma'i dge ba ma gtogs sdom pas bsdams pa'i dge ba med do zhes zer ba sogs ni 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa ste spyan ras gzigs kyis rab gnas mi nus so zhes smra nus pa ni snying stobs che la spyir glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pas srol nyams pa rnams slar jo bos gsal par mdzad pa yin gyi sngon med pa ga la yin te jo bo nyid kyang khri srong lde btsan gyi dus kyi bstan pa lta bu rgya gar du yang ma byung bar 'dug ces yi rangs mdzad par bshad cing dman lam gyi sdom pas ma zin pas sdom pa'i dge ba med par 'dod na theg chen kho na ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na sdom pa'i dge ba med par 'dod dgos la sngon nas then chen du rigs nges pa ni mchog yin gyi dman lam sngon du song ba'i rgyal sras ni de la stos te dbang brtul du bshad pa yin no/ /des na log rtog la rnam dpyod tu 'khrul pa rnams kyi gtam rna bar bzhag par mi bya'o/ /de ltar chos rgyal spyan ras gzigs dbang des/ /rgyal srid dkar po'i chos kyis ring du bskyangs/ /so sor phan bde'i zhal chems bka' bsgos te/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus/ /de tshe rab kyis mkha' 'gros spyan drangs te/ /shar phyogs padma'i gling du gshegs par mthong / /nang 254)

'khor rnams kyis sprul pa'i lha gcig gnyis/ /padma dang ni utpa lar gyur te/ / rgyal po'i skur thim rgyal po 'od du zhu/ /rang byung bcu gcig zhal la thim par mthong / /bod 'bangs tha mal yid ches bya ba'i phyir/ /bsnyun dang gshegs pa skad du dril bsgrags te/ /sku yi snang bsnyan shing rtar spyan drangs nas/ /yar lungs 'phyong po'i nang du bang so brtsigs/ /che chung tshad ni dpag tshad mda' rgyang gang / /nang na lha khang lnga yang bzhugs so skad/ /bang so nang rgyan can zhes kyang grags shing / /spyir du smu ri smug po zer ro skad/ /bang so gru bzhir rtsig pa de nas byung / /de yang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum mdzad pa mthar phyin nas shar phyogs me tog padma'i gling du mkha' 'gros spyan drangs te gshegs par gzigs/ nang 'khor rnams kyi snang ba la sprul pa'i rgyal po des dgung lo bcu gsum la chab srid mnga' mdzad pa nas lo don gnyis su chab srid chos bzhin du bskyangs te dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa sa pho khyi lo'i smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin dbon sras mang srong gi spyi bor phyag bzhag ste bka' bstsal pa/ rigs kyi bu/ ngas ni rgyal khrems chos khrims su bsgyur nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas/ /bod 'bangs dge ba la bkod pa yin no/ /khyod kyis kyang nga'i rgyal srid 'di ma nyams par chos bzhin du skyongs shig nga'i gtsug lag khang 'di gnyis kyi zhabs tog khyod kyis gyis la dar du chug cig nga'i pho brang lha'i gnas dang 'dra ba 'di'i 'dzin skyong gyis shig nga'i btsun mo dang blon po dang bod 'bangs re zhing gtad pa'i pha ma lta bu gyis la phan pa dang bde bas khyab par gyis shig da nas gdung rabs lnga pa na/ /nga yi ming la lde btags pa/ /chos skyong pa yi rgyal po 'byung / /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa ste/ /de yis dam chos rgyas par byed/ /mtha' mar mngon par 'tshang yang rgya/ /de nas 259

gdung rabs ga nyis nga/ la/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ste/ /rgyal po khri zhes bya ba 'byung / /des kyang dam chos rgyas par byed/ /de nas bdud kyis byin brlabs pa/ /rgyal po dud 'gro'i ming can 'byung / /dam chos ma lus snub par byed/ /tha ma mnar med dmyal bar 'tshed/ /de nas yer pa'i brag khung nas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ste/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i dge slong gis/ /sdig can rgyal po dgrol bar 'gyur/ /de nas lo skor brgyad kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa med par 'gyur/ /de nas lnga brgya mtha' ma la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i me ro zhig /mdo khams sgang nas langs par 'gyur/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su/ /dad can mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gzugs brnyan yang / /rang byung nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ston pa'i ring bsrel mchod par byed/ /nga yang ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'gyur/ kha ba can pa'i sems can la/ /mar me 'chi gar gsal ba bzhin/ /bstan pa shin tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /zab mo'i chos rnams shin tu dar/ /nga'i dam chos zla ba sgron me dang / dkon mchog sprin dang / pang kong phyag rgya dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang / las che/ma par 'byed pa dang lnga po 'di khyod la gtad kyis khyod kyis chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan la rim par gtod du chug cig ces zhal chems su mdzad do/ /ka bkol mar lung bstan gyi zhal chems 'di rten la thim kur blon po sna chen po la gsungs par bshad la ka bkol ma thang yig gab pa mngon phyung mya ngan 'das chung rnams na tshig zur dang mang nyung mi 'dra bar snang ngo / /de nas rgyal po chen po 'phrul snang du gshegs te dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khri la bzhugs nas khyed blon po bcu drug po las bzhis mgron bos shig bzhis sha 'tshol/ bzhisal chang 'tshol/ bzhis g.yog gyis shig sna chen po nga'i sku srung la sdod cig gsungs te blon po gzhan rnams sodze ba'i tshe btsun mo gsum byon 260

te lha gcig khri btsun gyis gser phye bal sder gang / kong jos gser dngul gzhong pa gang / mong bza' khri lcam gyis gser phye bre gang rnams phul te phyag byed bsnyun rmed cing rje blon lnga po bka' mchid 'bel bar mdzad pa las re zhig na rgyal po bzhengs te 'o cag rje blon rnams nga'i lha thugs rje chen po la phyag dang mchod pa bya'o zhes gsungs nas thugs rje chen po'i gtsang khang du byon/ phyag dang mchod pa mdzad/ rgyal po nyid thugs rje chen po'i mdun na bzhengs pa'i g.yas su khri btsun/ g.yon na kong jo/ sku rgyab na mang bza' rnams bzhengs/ blon po sna chen po them pa kha na rkang pa phyi na bzhag lag pa sgo'i skyes bu gnyis la brgyangs/ glo la ral gri btags/ mgo bo nang du bcug nas 'dug pa'i tshe rgyal po zhal phyir log mdzad nas/ sna chen po bod kyi blon 'bangs nye ba dad pa che ba rnams na re nged rgyal po dang ma mjal zer nas 'ong gi de rnams la nga la dad gus byed na nga'i lha thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob cig bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang phrad pa dang khyad par med do gsung ngo / /lha gcig khri btsun zhal phyir log mdzad nas bod 'bangs nye ba rnams nged lha gcig khri btsun dang ma mjal zer na lha thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob cig gsung / yang kong jo zhal phyir log mdzad nas rgya dmag gis spyan mi 'dren pa'i phyir lha gnyis brjes la jo bo shākya sto sgo me long can du bzhugs/ sgo brtsigs zhal ba gyis la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris shig bod 'bangs blo nye ba rnams lha gcig kong jo dang ma mjal zer na nga'i lha thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob cig gsung ngo / /ka bkol ma dang gab pa mngon phyung las 'di skad byung la gzhan las jo mo gnyis kyis khro gnyer can dang sgrol ma la gsol ba thob cig nged dang phrad pa dang khyad par med do zhes byung ngo / /de nas rgyal pos lha gcig gnyis kyi spyi bor phyag bzhag pa dang bal cho/ bza' 261

khri btsun padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa cig du gyur/ /rgya mo bza' kong jo utpal sngon po 'dab ma bcu drug pa hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa cig tu gyur te rgyal po'i phrag pa g.yas g.yon la thim rgyal pos dbu'i thod phud de spyan nam mkha' la cher gzigs nas rang byung thugs rje chen po'i drung du nye bar gshegs pa na dbu'i a mi tā bha gnyis po mtho dman med par mnyam skad ste gda' skad/ de nas phyag thal mo sbyar te bstod pa mdzad pa/ chos sku stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa'i sku/ /zhi ba'i zhal bzhi khro zhal bdun/ /bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i zhi zhal dkar po gsum/ /rab tu 'dzum zhing mdzes pa ste/ /las dang nyon mongs zhi mdzad pa/ /chos sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng btso ma'i gser mdog can/ /rngam zhing bzhad pa'i zhal gsum pos/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor gsum/ /rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng byu ru ltar dmar ba/ /dbang gi las mdzad zhal gnyis po/ /rnam par gtsigs pa'i khro gnyer can/ /longs sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng drag po'i las mdzad pa/ /dud sprin mdog 'dra zhal gnyis po/ /'jigs shing rngam pa'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /sprul sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus li khri'i mdog /'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba yis/ /gtsug rgyan mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma'i 'dab 'dra dang po yi/ /phyag gnyis thugs gar thal sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje rnams/ /bskul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas kyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /bgrang phreng 'khor lo mchog sbyin dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /legs par bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon gyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /pad dkar spyi blugs rin po che/ /thabs shes zung 'jug mda' dang gzhu/ /legs par 262

bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas kyi yan lag bcu dgu na/ /rin chen zhags pa lhung bzed gri /rdo rje me shel chu shel gzhu/ /lcug ma bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnga yab phub dang bum pa bzang / /dgra sta phreng ba padma sngo/ /spyi blugs nyi ma chu skyes dkar/ /snye ma bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon gyi yan lag bcu dgu na/ /sprin dkar spyi blugs padma gri /dud thod phreng ba dril bu dang / /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tsha' lo/ /lcags kyi 'khar sil sprul pa'i sku/ khang bzang glegs bam 'khor lo dang / /sku gzugs shing thog ke sa ra//rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku'i rtsa phyag rnam pa bcu/ /longs sku'i yan lag sum bcu brgyad/ /sprul sku'i nying phyag stong mnga' ba/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /padma lta bu'i phyag mthil la/ /utpa la 'dra'i spyan mig ni/ /rgyu skar bzhin du rnam bkra ba'i/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /dbu la rgyal ba'i gtsug rgyan can/ /phyag zhabs gser gyi gdub bu 'khrol/ /sku lus dri zhim spos ngad ldang / nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud//sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis spras/ /lta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /ri dwags paṭa pas nu ma bkab/ /yan lag rigs bzhi'i sbrul gyis brgyan/ /mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /gangs ri'i ngos ltar mdzes pa la/ /cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i 'od dkar 'phro ba'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /lha rgyal gtsug gi nor bu ni/ /legs par bzhengs pa'i zhabs gnyis po/ /pad zla'i steng du mdzes pa'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi sprul pa rin po che/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa khyod/ /sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /'gro ba du ma'i skyabs 263

gnas khyod/ /sdug bsngal du mas rnam gtses pa'i/ /nyam thag phongs pa'i sems can la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams/ /las ngan bsags pas lus ngan blangs/ /ngan song gsum du lhung ba rnams/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol/ /zhes gsungs nas thugs kur dbu btugs te/ 'phags pa khams gsum 'khor ba na 'khyams pa'i sems can nyam thag pa rnams la gzigs shig ces thugs rje drag tu g.yos pa'i rlabs 'byin zhing gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i mod la rgyal bo 'od kyi gong bur gyur te bye ma la chu thim pa ltar rang byung bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kur thim pas phyag thal mo sbyar ba cung zad kha bye ba dang sku cung zad yo ba de'i dus byung ngo/ /de nas blon po sna chen po dang jo mo mong bza' khri lcam gyis rgyal po yab yum gsum bstangs zhan no kha ba can gyi sems can rnams su la re ji ltar bgyi zer zhing gsol ba btab pas rgyal po yab yum a tsa ma 'di rnams mi bden par 'dzin mi rtag pa rtag par 'dzin snyam nas thugs ka nas rgyal po dbu nyug mdzad de/ kha ba can gyi sems can rnams sngar skyes pa la ma shi ba med pa dang gcig lus 'dus byas yin pas 'chi nges pa dang gnyis/ tshe skad cig kyang mi sdod par myur du 'chi ba dang gsum yin no/ da lta'i spyod pa 'di rnams rmi lam lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs so/ /nu ma g.yas nas lha gcig khri btsun dbu nyug byung ste tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha med pa dang gcig 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bas nam 'chi mi shes pa dang gnyis/ lus la snying po med pas nam ༷chi mi shes pa dang gsum yin no/ da lta'i lus 'di me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shig ces dang / kong jo nu ma g.yon nas dbu nyug mdzad nas 'chi ba la nor gyis mi gtongs pa dang gcigaganyen gyis mi phan pa dang gnyis/ rang gi lus kyi mi gtongs pa dang gsum yin 264

no/ /da lta'i lus 'di sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs so/ /yang blon po sna chen pol rgyal po yab yum bstangs zhan no khyod de ltar bzhud du bzhed na nged shul na yod pa rnams ji ltar bgyi zhus pas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ ser sna'i sa gzhi brdal yang sbyin pa'i rgyags dang ma bral bar gyis shig phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs kyang tshul khrims kyi rgyan dang ma bral bar gyis shig le lo'i sgrog tu tshud kyang brtson 'grus kyi rta dang ma bral bar gyis shig g.yeng ba'i dmag gis bskor yang bsam gtan gyi mkhar dang ma bral bar gyis shig dug lnga'i jag pa bkye yang bzod pa'i go cha dang ma bral bar gyis shig ma rig pa'i mun pa 'thibs kyang ye shes kyi spyan dang ma bral bar gyis shig de ltar byas na thugs rje chen po dang rtag tu 'grogs pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /jo mo mong bza'as lha gcig gnyis kyis bdag la zhal chems re zhu dang byas pas yang dbu nyug ste khri btsun gyi zhal nas/ mkha' la nyi ma shar tsa na/ /mun pa dag la sdod dbang med/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs zhugs tsa na/ /dug lnga dag la sdod dbang med/ /sems la rtogs pa shar tsa na/ /ma rig pa la sdod dbang med/ /sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes bskul tsa na/ /'jig rten dag na sdod dbang med/ /rang lus dngos med du 'dod na lha thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob cig gsungs nas mi snang ngo / /kong jo'i zhal nas de ltar go tsa na 'phags pa'i thugs rje mi bden ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi bden sems can gyi las mi bden rang sems sangs rgyas la tshe 'di'i snang ba mi bden rang lus dngos med du 'dod na lha thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob cig gsungs nas mi snang ngo / /de nas jo mo mong bzas rgyal po sprul pa'i sku yab yum bdag cag kha ba can pa'i sems can la thugs rjes mi skyob par de ltar gshegs nas bdag cag rgyal sras ma tshar yang tshe'i dus byed kar 265

khye/da ltar bzhud pa cig zhu 'tshal zhes smre sngags bton pas/ rgyal po yab yum gsum sku mi snang bar 'phags pa'i sku stod dang nu ma so so'i thad las gsung byung ste/ ag sam sems zhes nang du ma 'dzin snang ba zhes phyir ma 'bor/sems snang bdag med yin gyis snang sems dbyings su zhog gzung 'dzin rol pa yin gyis chos nyid rtsal sbyong gyis/ 'khor 'das gnyis med du 'dug pas nga dang khyod la dbye ba med kyis 'di phyi gnyis su med par 'grogs zhes gsungs/ khri btsun gyis khyod nang du ma 'dzin nga phyi ru ma 'dzin rgyal po dbyings su ma sgom nga dang khyod dang rgyal po dbyer med yin/ khyed ni nged kyi dbyings na yod/ nges kyi sems nyid chos nyid gnyis med dang / dus gsum gcig par rang la gnas/ nang thong phyi shig gnyis med shes pa chos sku yin no ag sam gsungs so/ /kong jo'i zhal nas rig pa nang du ma 'dzin/ tshogs drug phyir ma spro/ gnyis 'dzin mun par ma gzhug dgag sgrub bral ba chos sku gsal la 'dzin med longs sku sna tshogs 'gag med sprul sku nga gsum gcig ste ma lta ma sgom 'gag tu gnas med zhog ag sam gsungs so/ /der jo mo mong bza' khri lcam gyis rgyal po yab yum dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal dus de nyid du mthong ste skye ba la mi 'jigs 'chi ba la mi dogs pa'i chos la mnga' brnyes par gyur to/ /bstod pa mdzad pa thang yig las byung la gzhan zhal chems 'di rnams ka bkol ma gab pa mngon phyung mya ngan 'das chung gsum tshig mthun par snang ngo/ /de nas blon 'bangs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshul rgyas pa ni mya ngan 'das chung las da ltar yab yum gsum gyis bka' chos kyi gdams pa mang du bsungs nas mi snang bar gyur pas blon po sna chen po ma dga' nas smre sngags bton pa/ kye ma kye hud 'di 'dra'i dus byung ngo / /chos skyong rgyal po chen po ni/ /lta ba'i mig pas 'phangs pa'i rgyal po de/ /cung 266

zad snyung yang kun gyis mi bzod na/ /nyi ma de ring 'di 'dra'i dus byung ngo / /rmi lam yin nam bden rdzun ngo ma shes/ /rang gi snying las gces pa'i rgyal po de/ /na bza' rgyan rnams mos pa'i rten du bzhag /'di 'dra mthong bas bdag ni 'o dod 'bod/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang nas thugs rjes gzigs//kye ma rgyal po mnyam med rin po che/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ngo / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin skyong mi mdzad par/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab srong btsan gong du gshegs/ /bod 'bangs lam sna drongs shig bstan pa'i bdag/ /chos nyid 'od gsal ngang du ma g.yos kyang / /gzugs sku mthun snang sna tshogs dpag med kyis/ /snang ba dbang ba'i bye brag ston mdzad pa/ /'gro mgon srong btsan sgam po gang du gshegs/ /mig med mun par ma btang rgyal ba'i sras/ /mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /chos dbyings zab cing spros bral rtsi sman gyis/ /mtshan ma'i zug rngu ma lus sel mdzad cing / /mthar thug nyams rtogs rgyud la skyed mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po srong btsan gang du gshegs/ /bu rnams 'khor bar 'khyams so sprul pa'i sku/ /mnyam nyid ngang nas thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ /ma rig mun par 'thoms pa'i sems ca na rnams/ /dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ /gnyes snang 'khrul ba'i mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma rgyal po gang du gshegs/ /ma rig mun pa'i grong du nyi ma nub/ /bu rnams long khrid mdzod cig rgyal ba'i bshes/ /chu chen bzhi yi rba rlabs chen po las/ /thabs dang shes rab gru chen rab bcas nas/ /skye 'chi med pa'i skam sar 'dren mdzad pa/ /mnyan pa'i rgyal po khyod ni gang du gshegs/ /nyam thag mgon med gyur to chos kyi rje/ /chos sku zhi ba'i ngang nas bskyab tu gsol/ /chos dbyings zab mo'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ /thabs mchog mi g.yo'i gzings 267

gang du gshegs/ /kye ma kye hud drin can chos kyi rje/ /kye hud nyam thag sdug bsngal mgon med do/ /kye hud bdag cag bod 'bangs 'gro ba rnams/ /kye ma kye hud 'di 'dra'i dus byung ngo / /'gyur med rdo rje'i sku mchog brgyad brnyes kyang / /bsnyung dang 'das grongs gzhi nas ston pa de/ /'jig rten mthun par 'jug pa lags mod kyang / /bdag cag mgon skyabs su zhig mdzad par 'gyur/ /theg pa rim dgu rgyud sde chen po bzhi/ /bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs 'grel man ngag kun/ /don bsdus gsung ba'i rgyal po mi bzhugs na/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gang gis sel bar 'gyur/ /rang sems rig pa'i ngang du 'bral med kyang / /chu bur mig gi yul du mi snang bas/ /sgyu ma'i dpe dang mtshungs par byung 'gyur na/ /thugs kyis bzod dam chos rgyal brtse ba can/ /bdag cag rgyal po brjed par ma mchis so/ /skye med mngon sum ston pa'i rin po che/ /bsams kyin tshugs pa med do ji ltar bgyi//rang gzhan bde ba ster ba'i rin po che/ /chos kyi rgyal po khyod dang bdag cag rnams/ /'chug med lhan cig rten 'brel 'dzom gyur nas/ /rtag du mi 'bral ci gsung bka' sgrub cing / /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las rnams//rgyal po khyod dang dbyer med gcig par shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nam mkha' gar khyab tu/ /mi mthun rkyen gyis g.yo ba ma mchis par/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du gnas par shog /ces smre sngags bton te gsol ba btab pas thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka na tshur rgyal po yab yum gsum dbu nyug gis byon pa la jo mo mong bza' dang blon po sna chen pos bzhugs par zhus pas ma gnang ngo / /der blon po sna chen pos rje nyid mi bzhugs na spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji tsam gnas/ nub pa'i snga ltas ji ltar 'gyur/ khyad par bod yul du bstan pa 'dzin pa'i byang sems dang rgyal po la sogs pa ji ltar 'byung / dam chos 269

ji tsam du gnas/ rgyal po gang gi ring la chos lugs gang dang gang nub de'i rkyen cis byed/ mi rnams dang chos pa'i spyod pa dang nyams len ji lta bu/rab byung dang sngags pa rnams kyi dar gud spyod lam dang bud med rnams kyi spyod pa ji lta ba mchis/ gtsag lag khang ji lta ba 'byang / phyi rabs kyi rgyal blon ring rang ring ring ji lta bus bstan pa skyong / rgyal po gang du 'tshang rgya blon po rnams skye ba 'di'i 'og rol du ji lta bur 'gyur/ dus ji tsam na byang chub 'thob/ lha sras dang btsun mo rnams ji ltar 'gyur/ bstan pa'i mjug tu chos gang dar/ chos mjug gang gis sdud/ ces sogs zhib tu zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas e ma ho/ /bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab tu bsngags/ khyad par can gyi gnas su bstan pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas gdung rabs bzhi na rgyal po ni/ /so so skye bo'i byang chub sems dpa' 'byung / /de yi sras po byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'phags pa'i rigs can gang zag rgyal po 'byung / /chos gzhi gtsug lag khang ni mang du rtsig /mtha' 'khob rgyal khams mang po dbang du sdud/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad nas dpya khral mang po sdud/ /rgya gar gsang mdzod dam chos mang po bsgyur/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' des/ /lo paṇa spyan drangs dam chos rgyas par byed/ /sbyangs pa can gyi skyes bu mang du 'byon/ /de ltar chos skyong ba yi rgyal po des/ /bod 'bangs bde skyid dga' bde'i lam la sbyor/ /rgyal po'i mdzad spyod phun sum tshogs pa des/ /'bangs rnams bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'byung / /zhes khri srong lde btsan gyi dus dang / /de yi dbon sras byang chub sems dpa' gnyis/ /gcig ni bdud ris rgyal po dag du 'gyur/ /de ltar bdud ris rgyal po de yis ni/ /bod 'bangs yongs kyi bsod nams zad pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams par gyur pa 270

yis/ /nag po'i ris kyi lha 'dre rgyal gyur nas/ /gnam the dkar po'i sprul pa blon por 'byung / /bod la gnod pa bya phyir 'gong po dang / /de nas gnam the dkar po'i sprul pa dang / /'dre yi sprul pas sngags pa gsod par 'gyur/ /de nas dkar po'i phyogs kyi lha 'dre 'khrugs/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis/ /bdud ris rgyal po de yi dpung byas nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' gnyis ni de dag gis/ /gcig ni sprugs zhing gcig ni gsod par byed//de tshe nag po'i phyogs rnams dar gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di ni nub par byed/ /gtsug lag khang 'jig phan tshun chad pas gcod/ /dge sbyong rnams la log pa'i bka' chad 'bebs/ /sdig pa spyod la log pa'i bya dga' ster/ /dgon gnas rnams su ri dwags rngon pa byed/ /gtsug lag khang du ra lug phyugs rnams 'dzud/ /dge sbyong rnams la khur po bskur nas 'khol/ /sngags pa rnams ni las byed rngon par bkol/ /kye ma kye hud sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams shin tu dar bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen nyam dmas pas/ /nga yi yi dam sku gzugs gter du sbed//rgyal po de yang gri ru bkum par 'gyur/ /de ni bkra mi shis par shes nas su/ /bde gshegs sku gzugs de yang gter nas 'don/ /de sras ring la bka' chad dbu yogs kyis/ /rje rgyal rnams la 'bangs kyis kheng log byed/ /dus mtha' ngan pa'i mu yang de nas zug /sa yi bcud nyams sman gyi nus pa chung / /ro rnams mi zhim dus log sad ser mang / /'bru rnams skye zhan phyugs rnams zho she chung / /sa gzhi sgang gshong mang zhing tsher ma rtsub/ /g.yang sa ngam grog la sogs ma rungs 'byung / /cong rong chu brag mi bde nyam nga zhing / /rtsi shing skam zhing sa rdo ri brag nyil/ /gza' skar rgyu log char chu mi stom zhing / /nad mang tshe thung mu ge mang du 'byung / /'dre gdon mang zhing 27 1

'dre chos mang du 'byung / /'byung po spun dgu mi yul bab pa yis/ /phyugs kyi g.yang nyams 'bru rnams sris mi rme/ /'thab rtsod mang zhing zhe 'gras mang du 'byung / /go cha dar zhing rgyan cha mtshon la byed/ /dgra rkun dang ni slong 'phrog mang bar 'gyur/ /rgyal khams 'dir ni mi bde sna tshogs yong / /rgyal khrims dang ni chos kyi khrims kyang nyams/ /bod khams thams cad mtha' nas mi bde zhing / /mi dge'i spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung / /zhes glang dar gyi dus dang smad sil chad/ /de nas byang sems sprul pa byung nas su/ /chos kyi me ro mdo khams smad nas slong / /de nas dge 'dun sde pa mang du 'phel/ /der yang byang chub sems dpa' mang po yis/ /nga yi ra sa'i sku gzugs 'di dag la/ /mchod dang zhabs tog mang po byed par 'gyur/ /phyogs rnams kun du gtsug lag khang skyong zhing / /dam pa'i spyod pa tshul bzhin byed par 'gyur//zhes dbus gtsang gi mi bcu'i bstan pa dang / /de nas bdud ris sprul pa mang po yis/ /sde rtsod byas nas sde pa nyams dmas 'gyur/ /gnas dgon 'thab ra dge slong mdung kha byed/ /gtsug lag khang la 'phrog 'joms byed pa 'byung / /mchod cha rnams la thob sha byed par 'gyur/ /kye hud sangs rgyas bstan pa thal bar brlags/ /de tshe nag po'i phyogs rnams dar 'gyur zhing / /gang zag rnams kyi shes pa 'gyur nas kyang / /mi dge'i spyod pa sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /'tsho ba lha 'dre rnams dang thun mong byed/ /sa gzhi de yang shin tu rtsub par 'gyur/ /chom rkun mi rgod mang po 'byung ba dang / 'dre dang 'dra ba'i mi ngan mang du 'byung / /'di la mchod byed kun la 'tshe bar byed/ /ces bstan pa bar dar gyi sde nyams pa'i tshul dang / de tshe nub phyogs dag du sku bltams pa/ /dge slong bya yi gdong pa can zhig 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros sgrub par ldan/ /ratna bha dra zhes su grags pa yin/ /272

'di la ca/chod bstod bsnyen bkur mang du byed/ /bskor ba phu dud rim gro byed par 'gyur/ /zhes lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / /de tshe rgyal po 'od kyi ming can ni/ /byang chub sems ldan blo gros can zhig 'byung / /zhes lha bla ma khu dbon/ /de yis byang chub sems dpa' paṇḍi ta/ /rnam dag tshul khrims gsum dang rab ldan zhing / /mkhas shing sgrub la mngon par brtson pa ni/ /rigs gsum yon tan ldan pa spyan drangs nas/ /sku gzugs 'di la mchod cing phyag mang byed/ /bsnyen bkur bsngags pa phun sum tshogs par brjod/ /de yis bstan pa shin tu rgyas par byed/ ces jo bo rje dang / de yi slob ma tshul bzhin rab zhugs pa/ /dge slong dam pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ni/ /'di la bkur sti phu dud byed par 'gyur/ /'khor ni stong phrag phyed dang gsum dang ldan/ /byon nas 'di la bkur sti byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rgya ma'e sangs rgyas dbon ston dang / /byang chub sems ldan ston pa mang po skyong / /rigs par smra ba rnam dag mang du 'byung / /e ma ho/ nga yi lha sa'i rten dang brten pa la/ /byang chub sems ldan skyes bu du ma yis/ /lo na nyis brgyar bsti bstang byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me ni/ /ston pa rnams kyis gsal par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes po to ba dang rngog lo'i bshad rgyud rnal ma rnams dang / de nas bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa po/byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i dge slong ni/ /yon tan ldan pa'i dam pa dpag med 'byung / /gsang sngags mngon par grub pa'i dge slong ni/ /dam pa mang pos 'di la bsnyen bkur byed/ /ces sogs dwags po'i bka' rgyud spyi dang /de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur byed pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' shar lhor sku bltams pa/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes bu dam pa des/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa 273

mdzad/ /ces khyad par du dwags po sgom pa tshul khrims snying pos lha sar bya ba mdzad pa dang / de nas rigs pa tshul bzhin smra ba yi/ /ston pa rnams kyang nam langs skar skya 'dra/ /de tshe dkar po'i phyogs rnams mthu chung zhing / /bdud kyi tshogs rnams rgyas par gyur pa yis/ /bdud kyis byin rlabs gang zag mang po 'byung / /gzi brjid che zhing stobs kyang che ba dang / /nus pa che zhing mthu yang che ba dang / /mngon shes phra mos bden tshig dag sgrub cing //de rnams rtog chos mang po byed par 'gyur/ /zhes mkhas par grags pa du mas sngon sus kyang ma shes pa'i lta ba yin zhes rang gzo'i rtog chos la ngo mtshar du byed pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa lha 'dre mang pos dkrugs/ /'dra min chos lugs mang po ston byed cing / /blo gros phyin ci log du sgyur bar byed/ /med par lta ba'i phyogs kyi cha bzung nas/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod par byed/ /lus ngag chos spyod 'god par byed pa 'byung / /phyogs med ris med byar med zer ba dang / /rgyu zad rkyen zad lhun grub zer ba dang / /lung ma bstan gyi lta ba mang du 'byung / /rgyal bas ma gsungs mkhas pas ma —bgyis pa/ /da lta lha yis bstan zhes 'dre chos byed/ /de rnams 'byung po'i 'idre yi chas gu gyon/ /ra slag khyi slag re ba ze mon gos/ /rtsid zhwa 'be log gos ngan lus la gyon/ /ber ka dbyug pa sna tshogs thogs pa 'byung / /bsod stoms pa ces grong kha 'grim par byed/ /sto rgyab ched tu bka' thub drag po yis/ /rang gi lus la gnod pa byed pa 'byung / /mngon mtshan can gyi grags pa 'dod phyir du/ /sngags kyi theg pa glu ru len ru 'byung / /dge ba'i chos spyod glu dang bro la byed/ /bsam gtan dran pa nyams la byed pa 'byung / /med par lta la lta ba rtogs par byed/ /smyon thabs can la rtogs ldan byed pa 'byung / /the tshom can la dam par 'dzin pa 'byang / /smra ba mkhas la gdams ngag can da byed//ring ri 274

rmongs nga/ rnams la zhig po zer ba 'byung / /log spyod mkhan la rnal 'byor pa zhes zer/ /lung ma bstan la chos kyi sku zhes zer/ /snyan grags 'dod la chos bshad mkhas zhes zer/ /chos lugs yin zhes bab col mang po smra/ /'dre yis brlams la ye shes phebs zhes zer/ /bdud kyi spro skyed byin rlabs che zhes zer/ /gdams ngag zer zhing log chos mang du smra/ /gdams pa zer nas mu stegs gsang tshig ston/ /de sogs log pa'i lta ba rgyud la zhugs/ /bud med pho spyod tho co byed pa 'byung / /rang lugs mang zhing 'jig rten chos lugs nyams/ /de yis rang nyid ngan 'gror 'khrid par byed/ /rgyu 'bras bden par mi shes mi dge sna tshogs spyod/ /chos dang chos min mi shes ngo tsha med par spyod/ /log chos rnams la shin tu dad par 'gyur/ /byas pa'i chos kyis byang chub mi 'thob pas/ /ma byas lhun grub chos shig dngos zhes zer/ /byed mi nus rnams de la dad par 'gyur/ /dge ba'i bshes ltar snang ba yid 'phrog 'khrid/ /sngags pa kha cig sngags la rtsing chos byed/ /dam chos yon gyi ched du gsang ba sgrog /gser chos zer zhing chos la rin thang gcod/ /'ga' zhig ma thos rgyud kyang 'chad par byed/ /la la dbang ma thob par dbang bskur byed/ /la la dbang bskur zer nas yon yang sdud/ /la la rnyed bkur chags shing 'dod la zhen/ /rang gi rlung sems dbang du ma 'dus par/ /gsang dbang shes rab ye shes mngon sum ston/ /de dag smad 'tshong bsten dang khyad par med/ /la la dge slong shes rab ye shes ni/ /bud med dang sbyor dbang ni skur bar byed/ /sdom khrims gzhig nas dmyal ba'i gnas su 'phen/ /de dag log pa'i chos la spyod pa yin/ /rnyed bkur grags 'dod dam chos 'chad par byed/ /thos bsam sgom pa byed pa de rnams kyang / /'du shes phyin ci log du btang nas ni/ /chos dang gang zag 'dzol nas ngan song 'gro /tshul khrims 275

nyams dang dam tshig nyams pa dang / /cho ga nyams dang spyod pa nyams pa rnams/ /log pa'i lam zhugs de ni ngan 'gror skye/ /btsun pa la la chos gos tsam 'dzin zhing / /bslab pa nyams shing tshul 'chos byed pa dang / /dad rdzas longs spyod byas nas rang gzhan bslu/ /rang gis rang nyid ngan song gnas su 'khrid/ /la la dge 'dun dkor 'bags ngan song 'gro /la la gnas bzhi'i dkor 'bags ngan 'gror lhung / /'ga' zhig sngags btsun zer nas khyim thab byed/ /la la btsun gzugs tshul gyis khe bogs byed/ /cha lugs bzang pos chos brku rdzun chos byed/ /kye ma kye hud sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /bsten nas rang nyid ngan 'gror lhung byed pa/ /de 'dra'i bcos ma bab col mang du 'byung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rim gyis 'jig par 'gyur/ /da ni ring por mi thogs de dag 'byung / /zhes stong pa'i tshig tsam kha chos su khyer nas rgyu 'bras khyad tu gsod pa dang / tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur gyi ched tu grub rdzu dang zhig rdzu dang mkhas rdzu 'debs pa dang / chos kyi gsang ba'i mthar thug dga' rab dbang phyug la sogs pa'i dbang sdud la byed pa dang / sngags kyi snod min 'dus pa'i dpon slob kyis gsang sngags skad du 'chos pa dang /rab byung gi gzugs brnyan chos min spyod pa'i tshul la sogs da lta ji ltar snang ba 'di rnams lung bstan pa'o/ /e ma ho/ ma 'ongs dal 'byor thob pa'i lus can kun/ /sems stobs skyed la rtsol pa ma zhan mdzod/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa bsten/ /de yi ngag la nges par tshad mar zungs/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa long la legs par dpyod/ /mi rtag 'chi bar nges kyis dam chos sgrub par mdzod/ /nam 'chi nges pa med kyis brtson 'grus myur par rtsoms/ /'chi tshe cis kyang mi gtongs dam chos snying nas mdzod/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel yin pas dge ba'i las la 'bod/ /sdag bsngal sdig las byang bas rin ri 276

mi dge'i las rnams spongs/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras yin gyi tshul khrims gtsang ma srungs/ /'khor rgyu nyon mongs spongs la nges 'byung sems bsten bya/ /lus dang srog gi phyir yang sdig spongs dge ba sgrubs/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la nges 'byung skyo shas skyed/ /sems can rnams la byams dang snying rje skyed/ /de dag don du byang chub sems skyed la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ma nyams srungs/ /chos kun rang bzhin spros bral bdag med sgoms//don dam kun rdzob bden gnyis zung 'jug gis/ /bla med byang chub lam du chud par mdzod/ khyim pa dang ni rab tu byung ba kun/ /rang rang spyod tshul nyams pa med par bya/ /de nyid ma bcos 'gyur med rnal ma stos/ /mngon tshan mu stegs spyod pa dang bral bas/ /rang sems rang gis brtags la dpang du tshugs/ /stong pa'i tshig la ma zhen bden gnyis srol du chud/ /dam chos kha la ma g.yeng de nyid rnal mar spyod/ /gzhan la sgro skur ma 'debs rang sems dpang por tshugs/ /chos la bzang ngan med kyis thams cad gcig du slobs/ /de ltar byas na 'di phyi kun du bde bar 'gyur/ /ces bslab bya dang / gzhan yang / nga yi ra sa'i gtsug lag khang 'di la/ /bsnyen bkur mchod bstod byed pa de dag ni/ /'phags pa'i gang zag dam pa sha stag go /de phyir de dag kun la gus pa skyed/ /de dag ci phyir 'phags pa yin zhe na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa chen po mdzad/ /de phyir de dag 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams 'byung zhing / /'khor ni legs gnas ston pa'i gsung rab dang / /ston pa'i sku gzugs dngos su zhugs pa dang / /ri bo yon tan can yang 'di la yod/ /tsā ri tsā gong bde mchog rang byung gnas/ /rdo chu rin po che yang de na yod/ /ti se'i gangs la dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi'i chu yang ri bo de na yod/ /gye re'i brag la yig drug rang byung bzhugs/ /277

mkha' 'gro'i phyag rgya ri bo de na yod/ /ma pham mtsho la klu rgyal byang chub sems/ /chu bo yon tan can yang de na yod/ khri shod rgyal mo'i klu sman byang chub sems/ /chu bo chen po kun la phan par mdzad/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo'i nang na byang chub sems/ /thang lha'i brag la dgra bcom lnga brgya yod/ /snubs mtsho'i gling na klu rgyal byang chub sems/ /ha bo'i gangs la dgra bcom lnga brgya yod/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyis bskor/ /sgra dag skad snyan saṃ skṛ ta dang mtshungs/ /mi skad chos la sbyar du btub pa'i sa/ /yangs shing mtha' legs yon tan kun ldan pa/ /de ltar kha ba can gyi yul dbus su/ /skyes pa'i dal 'byor mi lus thob pa kun/ /yon tan slob la rtsol ba ma zhan zhig /sngon gyi smon lam dag pas zhing 'dir skyes/ /dad gus mos pa yod par gyur pa yis/ /gzhan bya mi dgos 'di la mos pas chog /phyag mchod skor ba dag la 'bad pa gyis/ /mchod cing gus par byed pa thams cad ni/ /phyir mi ldog par rgyal bas lung bstan pas/ /'di la gus par mdzod cig bod 'bangs rnams/ /bdag ni khyod la de skad 'doms byed pa/ /rnyed phyir ma yin grags pa'i phyir ma yin/ /snying rjes kun nas blangs pa'i tshig yin pas/ /gus pas yid kyis spyi bor blang bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs nas thugs shar thim mo/ /spyir lung bstan rgyas par yod 'dug pa gter du slar zlog nas ma dpe la gsal bar snang ngo / de ma thag rang byung thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer tshes bco lnga'i zla ba tsam zhig byung ste 'phrul snang gi phyi nang thams cad khyab cing khyad par da byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje ༄ste li ma gnyis/ gtsang khang dbus kyi mi 1rekhrugs pa/ g.yas kyi mar me mdzad khro bo rme brtsegs te dar sku gsum/ shar sto'i g.yung drung khugs kyi sman rgyal/ bar khang nub logs kyi rta mgrin dkar po dang lho ngos kyi sgrol ma 278

ste bris sku gsum ste brgyad kyi thugs gar phog pas 'od zer phog pa'i lha brgyad ces grags shing de'i mod la bar khang gi rta mgrin dkar po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dung gi phreng ba lta bu byung / bar khang gi sgrol ma las 'od zer ljang gu rin po che'i mdog 'dra ba byung / byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo las 'od zer gyen la khyab pa nyi ma 'dra ba byung / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje las 'od zer gser gyi mdog lta bu byung / sman rgyal las 'od zer beḍūrya'i mdog lta bu byung /khro bo rme brtsegs las 'od zer lcags kyi ral gri lta bu'i sna la khro chung dpag du med pa byung / mar me mdzad las 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bur byung /mi 'khrugs pa las gser btso ma lta bu byung ste de rnams la 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad tu yang grags/ 'od zer de re res kyang ra sa'i phyi nang thams cad khyab cing 'od kyi dra bar 'brel/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gang ste glu gar dang rol mos mchod/ lha'i me tog dang rol mo'i mchod pas kun nas gang zhing sa gzhi dang nam mkha'i 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur te lha sa gnyis kyi gsang ba'i rab gnas lhun grub tu byung ngo / /der grong khyer pa rnams ra sa thams cad 'od kyis khyab pa'i ltas 'di lta bu ra sa'i mnga' gsol mdzad par nges zhes dga' spro byed/ blon po bcu drug pos kyang yo byad dang bcas te slebs nas phyag byed par phyin tsa na rgyal po yab yum mi snang bar na bza' rgyan gos phud de mthong / mong bza' dang sna chen po ngom zung gnag par mthong nas dar rgyal sna chen po khyod rgyal po'i sku srung la bzhag pa yin pa rgyal po yab yum gsum gar gshegs zhes lan gsum dris kyang sna chen pos lha la thim byas kyang yid ches mi skye'o snyam nas smra ma nus/ kha rog bsdad pa dang spas sgyid thag ring mo na re zhang blon chen po 'dis lan gsum du dris kyang lan mi ster ba sna chen po khyod kyi rke gcod zer nas ral gri phyung ba 273

dang btsun mos sna chen po bsad na dbon sras chung bas bod nang 'khrug gis 'jig snyam nas rgyal po yab yum gsum thugs rje chen po la thim mo zhes smras pa dang sna chen pos da ni smras pas chog snyam nas ngas sku srung byas pa yin te rgyal pos lha gcig gnyis kyi spyi bor phyag bzhag padma dang utpalar byas te nged rnams dang ma mjal zer na nga'i lha thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob cig 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub bo gsungs nas lha la thim nas thal lo/ /rgyal po sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dngos yin/ nga la chad pa bcad par mi rigs so byas pas khong rnams na re dpang po su yod zer/ sna chen pos rgyal po'i na bza' ber nag dang jo mo gsum gyi phyag rten yang mngon sum/ jo mo mong bza' yang mngon sum mo byas pas thams cad yid ches te ngo mtshar re che na rgyal po ni sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin nges par 'dug sngon rgya rje dang bal rjes ji skad zer ba yang khong gis shes nas bka' 'phrin gyi sgrom bu bskur zer/ thon mi na re rgyal po ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dngos yin te dbu la 'od dpag med dngos su bzhugs/ li'i yul nas kyang spyan ras gzigs su lung bstan zhes khra 'brug gi bandhe'i dang li yul gyi bandhe'i byung ba brjod pas thams cad dad pa skyes te spyan ras gzigs dngos su byon 'dug pa/ rgyal po yab yum gsum bzhugs dus mos gus chung 'dug pa/ ārya pa lo zhes 'bod cing la la ni lus sa la rdeb cing 'gre ldog byed/ la la ni mos gas kyi gsol ba 'debs so/ /de'i tshe thon ༄mi sasto dras gdung shugs kyis gsol ba btab pa/ kye ma kye hud sdug bsngal lo/ /rgyal po srong btsan sprul pa'i sku/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes gzigs/ /sprul pa'i rgyal por dngos su byon/ /gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngo ru/ /'da' tshul ston par mdzad pa de/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur sprul pa'i brda/ /lha sa skyong bar bskos nas kyang / /rgyal po gshegs 280

pa ji ltar yin/ /thugs rjes gzhan don mi mdzad par/ /thugs mkhyen pa can de ci dgongs na/ /sku mdzes pa'i phyag rgya nam yol na/ /'phrul snang stongs kyis mi dogs sam/ /pha rin po che de ci dgongs na/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas shāka thub kyi/ /zhing khams mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir/ /khyad par kha ba can gyi ljongs/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags pa'i/ /srong btsan rgyal po sprul pa'i sku/ /ra sa 'phrul snang pho brang du/ /'gro ba'i don la mi bzhugs par/ /rgyal po chen po ci lags pa/ /pha rin po che de gar gshegs na/ /bod 'bangs su la re lags pa/ kye hud kye hud 'jig rten stongs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab phyag rgya che/ /'od gsal chen po'i don rtogs pa/ /'gro 'ong med par gzigs nas kyang / /rgyal po gshegs pa ji ltar lags/ /pha rin po che de gar gshegs na/ khyab rdal chen po chos kyi sku/ /gnyug ma'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes gzhan don mdzad pa yi/ /dus la mi gzigs ci dgongs pa/ /sku gzi mdangs can de gar gshegs na/ /kye hud sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams/ /rtsa ba gnad kyi gdams ngag gis/ /skal ldan 'gro ba mi 'dren par/ /bod 'bangs gdul bya mi gzigs sam/ /rje rin po che de ci dgongs na/ /zhal mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor nam yol na/ /kye hud rgyal po gshegs pas brlag /mdzes pa'i sku lus rin po che/ /dngos su 'gro don mi mdzad par/ /rgyal po gshegs pa ji ltar lags/ /kye hud bod 'bangs ji ltar bgyi/ /byin rlabs brda yi rgyud pa dang / /brtul zhugs spyod pa rten 'brel gyis/ /'gro ba'i mun pa mi sel bar/ /rgyal po gshegs pa ji ltar lags/ /thugs mkhyen pa can de gar gshegs na/ /kye ma bod 'bangaru/ su la re/ /skal ldan bod 'bangs pho mo kun/ /rtag tu 'chi ba rjes su dran/ /mos gus dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /spyi bo'i rgyan du mi 281

bzhugs par/ /brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal po'i lo/ /lon nas rgyal po 'gro gsungs te/ /da lta 'jig rten stong par bzhag /kye hud bod 'bangs stong par lus/ /dus kha sang gdugs kyi snga dro la/ /brda dang cho 'phrul bkye nas kyang / /bod kyi rgyal khams ma lus tshogs/ /kun yang brod nas 'ongs tsa na/ /sgra dang rol mo 'ja' dang gur/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su khengs/ /bod 'bangs gling bzhi stong par bzhag /nyi ma'i 'od zer mkha' la bsdogs/ /bod 'bangs mi rig gling du tshud/ /chos kyi rgyal po mi bzhugs pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa lan gcig nub/ /lha sa'i bstan pa'i srog shing chag /kye ma rgyal po rin po che/ /'bangs gdung ba'i smre sngags gsan lags sam/ /lus 'dre ldog byed pa gzigs lags sam/ /gzigs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ma rig mun pas gtibs pa yi/ /'khrul pa rtsad nas bcad du gsol/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /pha khyod dang rtag du mi 'bral shog /zhes gsol ba btab pas rgyal po dngos su byon te/e ma ho/ /sku gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo las/ /'bad med 'khor 'das thogs med cir yang 'char/ /'das grongs gshegs pa bdag la med pas na/ /'bral med rgyun du gus pas gsol ba thob/ /sems can kun la thugs rjes rtag tu gzigs/ /nga yi zhal mthong gsung thos smos ci dgos/ /kun gyis gsol ba thob cig bod 'bangs rnams/ /zhes gsung ba'i snang ba byung ngo / /der thon mi 'o skol gyi rgyal po 'di ni thugs rje chen po dngos yin te da ltar rgyal pos gsung byon pa dang mkha' la 'ja' 'od 'khrug cing lha dang mkha' 'gro 'dus pa 'di dang / sku bltams pa na zhal bcu gcig pa sogs du mar mthong ba dang / bod 'bangs la chos ston pa'i tshe kho bo sku gsum gyi bdag nyid yin zhes dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams du ma'i bkod pa gsung zhing 282
