nga'i 'phrin las dang rnam 'phrul khyed rnams kyis mthong thos dran tshod 'di las med pa ma yin gyi thams cad kyang nga'i 'phrin las so zhes bka' bstsal ba sogs kyis ārya pa lo yin par mngon sum gyis yid ches pas btsun mo mong bza' dang blon po sna chen po la the tshom ma za zhig ces smras pas thams cad yid ches te rtse gcig du gsol ba 'debs so/ /de'i tshe blon po mgar rgya'i so kha srung ba'i dpon la yod pa'i sems kyis tshor te bod yul du myur bar 'ongs pa na rgyal po gshegs pa thos te 'phrul snang du gdung ba'i smre sngags bton pa/chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan khyod/ /sku mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og rol du/ / 'bangs 'khang ba'i smre sngagal cung zad mchis/ /rje mi mngon dbyings nas snyan gson 'tshal/ /yong phyi skor lho yi dzaspu'i gling / /nang skor pur rgyal bod kyi yul/ /ru bzhi sa bcad mchims yul smad/ /yul la g.yang babs dbus kyi mthi9sha/ /chu lo nyi ta yi byang phyogs na/ /dpal gtsug lag bkra shis lha sa ru/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos shig bzhugs pa ni/ /mtshan la srong btsan sgam po zer/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mos gus skye/ /zhal mthong ba tsam gyis sgrib pa 'byang / /rje de lta bu yi sprul sku de/ /snyan pa rgya gar yul du sgrogs/ /ba ra'i rgyal po shing rta can/ /thal mo sbyar ste satā brjod/ khyod kyis che ba'i yon tan rnams/ /rgya nag yul gyi rgyal pos gsan/ /phyogs su zhal gzigs 'dud par mdzad/ /mi nyag tsa mi'i rgyal po yang / khyod kyi mtshan thos rkyang phyag 'tshal/ /mtshan brjod mkhan de la bya dga' ster/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal po yang / /khyod kyi mtshan thos dad gus byed/ /zhabs drung skye par smon lam 'debs/ /mi rje byang chub sems dpa'i brgyud/ khong de lta bu yi rgyal po de/ /sku 'khrungs sa dbus kyi lung par 'khrungs/ /cho sa nyid bden pa'i don rtogs shing / /thugs dam zhal gzigs sprul pa'i sku/ /dang yan chad 388

dngos su zhal bzhugarnga pa/ /sprul skus 'gro don mthar phyin mdzad/ /dus rnyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung / /bde gshegs sprul sku mya ngan 'das/ /rje mnyam med rgyal po rin po che/ /grangs med bskal par tshogs bsags nas/ /smon 'jug sems skyed 'phan pa yis/ /ma dag snyigs ma lnga dus ldan/ /gdul bya'i rtog pa tha dad la/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i don bstan nas/ /sems nyid gtan la 'bebs mdzad pa/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po gar gsheṭa na/ /mnyam nyid thugs rje chen po de/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon mi mdzad dam/ /byin rlabs ye shes 'khor lo de/ /snod ldan sems la mi bskor ram/ /rje sprul pa'i sku de gar gshegs na/ /kye hud kye hud rgyal ba'i sku/ /mdzes pa'i sku lus rin bo che/ /zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dad mos skyed/ /gsung rgyang nas thos kyang byin rlabs 'jug /phyag skor ba byas na tshogs rdzogs phyir/ /gdul bya'i don du mi bzhugs par/ /sku yal bar dor ba ci lags pa/ /gu leng dar zab kyi na bza' de/ /zin chu rgya yi tshong dus su/ /dar gzhan pas khyad par rin thang che/ /rgyal po dbang bskur gyi thod tu 'ching / /de rgyal po'i sku la mi gsol bar/ /bcoms nas 'jog pa ji ltar lags/ /kye hud bod 'bangs stong par bzhag /chibs rta nag po khrung gshog de/ /byang phyogs tsa ma'i yul nas bton/ /byol song gi lus la mi yi sems/ /gyi ling gi yag tshangs kho la rdzogs/ /bshul ring du gshegs na mi chibs par/ /gsos nas 'jog pa ji ltar lags/ /yang dben gyi bzhugs gnas ra sa de/ /phyi ltar mdzes pa gdugs kyi dbyibs/ /nang nyams su dga' ba'i gtsug lag khang / /gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'phrul snang der/ /skye med ngang la mi bzhugs par/ /drung du 'tshogs pa'i bod 'bangs rnams/ khyod min mgon skyabs su la bgyi//bod 'bangs dbang po rab 'bring la/ /yi ge drug pa'i gdams ngag gi /284

gsung don bdud rtsi mi gsung bar/ /'bangs yal bar dor pa ji ltar la4/sa//thugs mkhyen pa can de ci dgongaca/ na/ /thag ring gi 'bangs po yu la srung bdag /dgra yul so mtshams gshags gshags nas/ /sha phu bar song zhing khong khrag skam/ /tsha grang gi dka' ba spyad spyad nas/ /dus da lta gdong du mi bzhugs pa/ /'bangs yi thag gcod pa ji ltar lags/ /pha rin po che de gar gshegs na/ /sku mdzes pa'i phyag rgya nam bsdus na/ /zhal gzi mdangs can de gar yol na/ /gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs de nam chad na/ /kye hud/yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dam du bying / /da dgos 'dod re ba su la slong / /yan lag dang po mgo bo chad/ / mgo med lus po ji ltar bgyi/ /dbang po'i dwangs ma mig yong long / /mig med mdongs par gyur pa la/ /long khrid mdzod cig rgyal ba'i sras/ /ri bo mchog rab rtse nas nyil/ /sum bcu gsum pa dngangs shing skrag /rgyal chen bzhi yi pho brang zhig /gser gyi ri bdun rmang nas 'gyel/ /rol pa'i mtsho bdun gting nas skam/ /klu chen brgyad po gang du sdod/ /lcags ri nag po mtha' nas zhig /skye 'gro'i sems can dud mor song / /nyi ma nam mkha'i mthongs su nub/ /dus kyi so nam ji ltar byed/ /bco lnga'i zla ba gza' yis zin/ /mtshan 'gros pa la ci ma srid/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du gzings thag chad/ /ded dpon tshong pa ji ltar bgyi/ /sdum ra'i me tog ha lo skam/ /bung ba'i sbrang rtsi gang nas 'tshol/ /rgyal po 'og min gnas su gshegs/ /nged bod 'bangs kyi mgon skyabs su la re/ /kho bo rgya nag gi so mtshams su/ /rmi lam ngan zhing rgyal po dran/ /zhal mthong bar 'dod nas yar la 'ongs/ /lam du zhugs nas 'ongs tsa na/ /chos skyong rgyal po dgung du gshegs/ /mya ngan 'das so skad pa la/ /'bangs da dung bden rdzun ngo ma shes/ /mi su la dris kyang bden no zer/ /gtam thos pa tsam gyis 285

glo snying 'dar /skam sar thon pa'i nya bzhin du/ /lus 'gre ldog byed pa gzigs lags sam/ /'bangs da dung yi thag ma gcod cig /kye hud 'jig rten stong par bzhag /thar pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan nub/ /mnga' ris bod la ci ma srid/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i re sa gshegs/ /bod kyi rgyal khams su la re/ /sdug phongs kyi pha ma grongs lags pas/ /bdag dwa phrug rnams la ci ma srid/ /rje sangs rgyas gnyis pa mya ngan 'das/ /nged bod 'bangs rnams kyi dran pa stor/ /dus kha sang rgyal po'i khab tu slebs/ /gnas dbu ru lha sa yer gyis mthong / /rje rgyal po dran te cung zad brgyal/ /'bangs rang dbang med par mchi ma shor/ /snying yang ma dga' phyad ma phyod/ /lus kyang bye phrug bzhin du 'dar/ /dran pa res gsal res ma gsal/ /gdung pa'i shugs kyis mya ngan dgyid/ /'bangs la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drongs/ /gdung ba'i sems kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /'bangs bzhin mdangs log pa gzigs lags sam/ /smre sngags 'don pa gsan lags sam/ /rje 'bangs la thugs thag ma bcad cig /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /kye hud 'di 'dra'i dus cig byung / /chos kyi rgyal po gshegs pas brlag /gnam sa gnyis kyi ka gdung 'gyel/ /mi yul gling bzhi stong par bzhag /lha yul nam mkha' 'od kyis bkang / /mi 'gyur chos kyi bstan pa zhig /shākya thub pa'i gdung rabs chad/ /mgon po byams pa'i bstan pa stongs/ /bod 'bangs gnam sa slar gyis 'khrigs/ /mun pa'i gling la mar me brnal/ /chu bo'i gzhung du gru gzings chag /'jigs pa'i 'phrang la skyel mas bor/ /kye hud mi yul stong par bzhag /lar bsam gyin chos kyi rgyal po dran/ /rje dran pas ci phan dgung du gshegs/ /gtam mi snyan thos pas snying rlung 'jug /'bangs mchi ma'i sngas la mchi ma'i stan/ /zas za ba ma dran lus 286

stobs shor/ /gos gon pa ma dran ngo tsha shor/ /gdong la mchi ma rgyun chad med/ /ngag smre sngags bton pas gre ba 'dzer/ /'bangs dus kyi nyes pas bsgribs pa'i phyir/ /zhal dngos su mjal ba'i skal med kyang / /dus do nub gnyid kyi rmi lam du/ /phyag bzhes tsam zhig mjal bar zhu/ /gsung lan tshig gcig gnang bar zhu/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos thugs rjes gzigs/ /kye hud drin can chos kyi rje/ /rje sprul pa'i phyag rgya brtul ba des/ /spyir 'dzam gling byang phyogs smag tu sros/ /sgos dbu ru lha sa 'od dang bral/ /las can gyis byang chub ji ltar sgrub/ /lar bod 'bangs rnams kyi thug sa 'das/ /tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i zhing sa 'das/ /yod 'byor phyug po'i 'bul sa 'das/ kha drag po la gnya' gnon med/ kha zhan po la rgyab rten med/ /rje sprul sku dbyings su gshegs pa des/ kha sang dus kyi rgyal po la/ /phyi rabs brod pa'i skyed pa'i phyir/ /'od dang 'ja' dang sgra la sogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshoṭa rnams kyang / /nam mkha'i khams su khengs par byon/ /rgyal po'i mdzad spyod tur gyis dran/ /'bangs sems kyi tsha grang bzod blags med/ /'bangs yi thag ma gcod sprul pa'i sku/ /lus la chags snyam mi bgyi zhing / /'bangs 'di tsam gdung sems che ba la/ /rjes 'bangs la thugs rjes mi gzigs sam/ /phas bu la phyi thag mi lta'am/ /lar rgyal po sprul sku'i rang bzhin la/ /sku 'das dang ma 'das mi mnga' yang / /nged bod 'bangs kyi nyi ma sgos su nub/ /byang khog stod kyi khong snying bton/ /rje chos nyid ngang du gshegs ba de/ /stong nyid ngang du cha la la/ /zag med kyi bde bar phri li li/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun na ra ra/ /'od gsal gyi nyi ma ta la la/ /rje sku dang gsung dang thugs dang gsum/ /'bangs mos pa'i lus ngag byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di la mi mjal kho thag chod/ /dus skye ba 'di yi 'og rol du/ /rje rgyal po bzhugs 287

pa'i zhabs drung du/ /mdzes pa'i spyod lam sna tshogs kyis/ /rgyal bo shin tu mnyes gyur na sa/ /rtag tu zhabs tog byed par shog /zhes smre sngags drag pos gsol ba btab pa / der 'khod pa rnams la las dag ma dag gi bye brag gis snang ba du ma byung ste la las rgyal po la mkha' 'gro dang lha'i tshogs kyis mchod cing spyan 'dren par mthong / sna chen pos rgyal po shin tu sku che ba zhig gi phrag gong g.yas g.yon la snang ba mtha' yas dang spyan ras gzigs bzhugs par mthong / mong bzas me tog gis ra sa gang bar mthong / blon po mgar gyis rgyal po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams nas der 'khod pa rnams la byin rlabs mdzad cing khyod smre sngags ma 'don par gsol ba thob cig mthong snang gi bye brag bzang po ribyung ngo gsung bar mthong ngo / /de nas blon po mgar na re rgyal khams gzhan gyi mis bod kyi blon po gdug pa can rnams kyis rgyal po yab yum gar gshegs med pa byas zer du 'ong gis spur sbyong ba'i tshul ma byas na mi rung ngo zhes bgros te lha la thim pa gsangs nas 'phan yul zal mo'i sgang 'od zer dam pa'i pho brang du bzhugab/ pa na mgur cham byung ba log ste tshad par shor zhabs tog lha gcig gnyis kyis mdzad pas lha gcig gnyis kyang bsnyung ste sku 'das song bar bsgrags nas dar sman dang sa sbyin la rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi sku bcos na bza' gsol te sku 'bag stag pags kyi steng du bzhag nas shing rta la gdan drangs/ yar lungs 'phyong po'i nang du bang so btab ste re mig dbus mar bzhugs su gsol te tsandan gyi mes sbyangs pas 'dus pa rnams la mthong snang gi bye brag dpag tu med pa byung te blon po mgar gyis du ba'i gseb nas rgyal po nyid byon te khri la bzhugs nas chos ston par mthong /sna chen pos me'i nang nas 'od dkar po cig byung nas der 'khod pa rnams la thim pa dang rgyal po'i sku'i bkod pa mang po dang thugs rje chen po dang a mi tā 288

bha mthong / dar rgyal mang po rjes rgyal po dngos su byon pa dang bstan pa'i bdag por mthong / thon mis rgyal po yab yum rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa dang 'khor lo bde mchog tu mthong / 'bri se ru gung ston gyis bstan pa'i bdag po la byang chub sems dpa' mang pos bskor bar mthong / sbang/ sgyid thag ring mos thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dpag med du mthong / dbon sras mang srong gis bstan pa'i bdag po ra dgra bcom pa mang pos bskor bar gzigs/ jo mo ru yongs bzas sgrol ma'i lha tshogs su mthong / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'as gang ba dang / kun tu bzang po'i mchod sbyin gyis nam mkha' gang ba dang / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyal po spyan drangs te 'gro ba dang seng ge'i khri la rgyal po dngos su bzhugras pa dang /g.yas g.yon du gzigs pa dang chos gsung pa dang spur sgrom gzhal med khang du gyur pa'i zur bzhir dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa gnyis dang mchod pa'i lha mo mang pos mchod pa dang / sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba dang spos kyi ngad ldan nam mkha' 'od kyis gur du 'khrig cing me tog dang ring bsrel char du 'bab pa dang / 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyis mchod cing me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang / dpa' bo rnams gar byed cing mkha' 'gro ma rnams gdung dbyangs len pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang sems sprin ltar 'thibs pa dang / me'i dbus na sangs rgyas kyi sku 'ja' tshon gyis bskor ba la thab ku'i mi rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro glu gar byed par snang ba dang / rgyal po'i dbu'i gtsug tor gyen du 'phags cing gser mdog sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag mdzad pa dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa byu ru ltar dmar ba dang / longs sku rigs lnga'i tshogs su snang ba dang / me'i sgra las chos thams cad bdag med do zhes pa'i sgra grag pa dang / nam mkha' thams cad dpa' bo mthing nag gri thod dang kha 289

ṭaṃ can gyis gang ba'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad 'od du zhu nas bdag med mar gyur te chos thams cad bdag med cing rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag go zhes sgrog pa dang / gdung khang gzhal yas khang gi dbus na rgyal po 'dzum zhing 'gying bar bzhugs pa'i thugs padma kha bye pa'i steng na dgyes rdor lha dgu bzhuṭa pa dang / pad nyil 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan bsnol ba'i steng na rgyal po chos 'chad can rig ma bcu drug gis bskor ba 'od kyi rnam pa can dang / rgyal pos phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams te a bhi ṭī ñtsa ces der tshogs pa thams cad la dbang bskur ba dang / me las 'od zer dpag med 'phros pa'i re re'i rtse la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag med gar bsgyur zhing nam mkha' sprin bzhin du 'khrigs nas skye med rdo rje'i glu len pa dang / rgyal po'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bde mchog lhan skyes kyi tshogs 'phro ba dang / spyan ras gzigs zhi khro dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis/ chos kun gdod nas lhan cig skyes/ /thams cad bde stong zung 'jug la/ /spang blang 'dug pa ma mthong ngo / zhes sgrog pa dang / sprin gseb nas lus stod thon pa'i lha'i bu me tog gi char 'bebs pas nam mkha' gang ba dang / rgyal po la 'khor sangs rgyas longs sku dpag med bzhugs nas bstod cing 'dud pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su gnas pa mang pos mchod pa thogs te spyan 'dren pa dang / me lce dpa' bo mkha' 'gro du ba lha'i bur snang ba dang / me'i dbus na pad sdong yal ga grangs med pa'i dbus ma'i steng na rgyal po mchog gi sprul skur bzhugs shing yal ga rnams la sangaja rgyas byang sems dpag med bzhugs nas bstod cing 'dud pa dang / spur khang nas rgyal po byon ste khri la bzhugs pa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer bkye bas sa dang nam mkha' thams cad 'od gcig tu 'khrigs pa dang / rtsi shing nags tshal dang sa rdo ri brag thams cad spur khang la 290

skor ba byed pa dang / zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra thams cad skye ba med pa'i chos kyi sgrar grags pa zhag bdun du bar ma chad pa dang / me lce rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang spyan ras ngakazigs dang rgyal po nyid snyan shal shin tu ring ba la shākya thub pa dang spyan ras gzigs bzhugs par mthong ba dang / rgyal po dang sangs rgyas rnams chos kyi dgongab/ pa bsdur ba dang / byams 'jam dbyangs chos bgro ba dang / spur khang nas rje btsun ma gsum du mdzad nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / rgyal po'i ba spu re re bzhin sangs rgyas mang po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / rus rgyan can gyi mkha' 'gros bskor ba dang / gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / rnal 'byor nam mkha' dang / ye shes mkha' 'gro dang / ma hā mā ya dang / sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dang / sgrol ma 'jigs pa rgyad bskyob dang / phyag rdor zhi khro dang / sman bla mched brgyad dang / zhi khro rigs brgya'i lha dang / padma dbang chen dang / badzra he ru ka ke sing gis bskor ba dang / gshin rje'i gshed dang / che mchog dang / phur ba la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor so sor snang ba dang / kun bzang la rig 'dzin gyis bskor nas chos rnams rang bzhin nyid kyis dag bzung 'dzin rang bzhin dag pa'o/ /zhes chos 'chad pa dang / ma mgon dang phyogs skyong bcus bskor nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad pa sogs bod 'bangs rnams la snang ba tha dad du byung zhing zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bde bas tshim ste thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zhing dbugs phyin par gyur to/ /de nas bang so'i nang du lha khang lnga byas te phyi ri bo ltar byibs nas lo gcig tu rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pas skor ba byas cing phyis kyang lo dus su mchod pa dang skor ba mdzad do/ /mang srong bcu gsum bzhes pas rgyal sa mdzad/ /rgya dmag bod du 'ong zhes gtam gsan nas/ /ston pa'i sku tshad dgung lo bcu gnyis pa/ /ra sa'i sto sgo me 291

long can du bzhugs/ /sgo la zhal ba byas te 'jam dbyangs bris/ btsun mo 'bro bza' /bri phong khab tu bzhes/ mgar stong btsan yul srung dang5 mchims mang gnyer gyis blon po byas/ lo ni bco lnga rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ /dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa na/ /gtsang gi bar snang sgang du 'das par gyur/ /de yi bang so snga ma'i g.yon du brtsigs/ /rin chen nor bkang sngo zher hral por grags/ /de tshe rgya dmag lha sa'i bar lhagang pa/ khro rgyal rme brtsegs thugs ka phye ba yis/ /sprul pa'i dmag tshogs bkye bas zlog par mdzad/ /mgar gyis rgya yul phung par byas pa'i zhe gnad du chos rgyal srong btsan gshegs ma thag du dmag mang du brtsams kyang blon po mgar gyis dmag dpon byas nas lan mang du pham par byas/ phyis blon po yang dmag thog du 'das/ rgyal po mang srong gshegs tshe rgya dmag 'bum phrag lnga bod du byung /pho brang khri rtse dmar po bsregs/ jo bo shākya dang po ma rnyed phyis de na bzhugs par shes kyang 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris pa 'jig ma nus/ /jo bo mi skyod rdo rje khyer/ de'i tshe ra sa'i rme brtsegs phyag gnyis khu tshur bsnol ba grib sel gyi phyag rgyar bzhugs pa'i khu tshur gyis thugs ka kha phye bas sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'thon te rgya dmag rnams shin tu skrag pas 'thor/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje shar phyogs 'o ma'i thang du zhag bdun lus pas jo bo 'o brgyal thang du grags/ rgya'i deb ther nas blon po mgar gyi bu che bas dmag dpon byas te rgya pham par byas zhes byung bas khong rang rnams la mi'i dmag gi mthong snang byung bar gda'/ yab 'das zhag bdun lon pa chu byi'i lor/ /'dus srong mang rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal/ /sbrags phur 'khrungs te de 'phral rgyal por gsol/ /btsun mo mchims bza' btsan mo tog blon po mgar gyi bu gnya' btsan ldem bu dang dbas ta ra khong lod kyis blon po byas/ rtsal po che yi blon 'bangs mi 292

bdun byung / rngog ring la nag pos glang po che theg rngog gling khams kyis g.yag brus po che theg gnon rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste kha mas bya khra rked par bcad/ spas rgod mdongs can gyis mig rgyang gsum la mda' rgyang res sleb/mgos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i blud bu bye mas bkang ste klad la skor/ cog ro 'brong gshor gyis 'brong 'thur du rgyug pa gyen du 'then nus/ gnon khri bdun g.yu byin gyis rta bzang po g.yang la 'phyongs ba gyen la 'dren nus pa rnams byung ste phyis rnga dang rol mo'i rnam grangs mang du 'byung ba'i ltas yin skad/mnga' thang lha 'dra mthu rtsal pha mtha' yas/ /mtha' yi rgyal po dbang du 'dus par gyur/ /lha sar mes kyi dgongs dus mchod pa btsugs/ /snga gong bod rgyal byon las mnga' thang che/ /byang phyogs skar ma smin bdun 'char ba'i mtha' sngon nags shod gzig phreng las ma mchis pa la ga gon dang / hor dang /sog po btul te da shab hab kyi la rgyud la gtugs par mnga' mdzad do/ /dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgur srid bskyangs te/ /ljang gi yul du gnam du gshegs par gyur/ /de yi bang so yab kyi g.yon du btab/ /bang so lha ri can zhes grags pa ste/ /lcags ris bskor ba hor gyi mi sdes brtsigs/ /de sras khri sde gtsug brtan zhes bya ba/ /lcags pho 'brug la pho brang ldan dkar 'khrungs/ /btsun mo ljang mo khri btsun/ blon po sbas skyes bzang stong btsan/ mchims rgyal gzigs shu ting / 'bro chu bzang 'or ma gsum gyis byas/ sma ra dang bgres nyams che bas rgyal po mes ag tshoms su grags so/ /lha khang lnga bzhengs mdo sde du ma dang / /sman dpyad sogs bsgyur pho brang 'phang thang brtsigs/ /lha sras ljang tsha lha dbon 'khrungs pa la/ /rgya rje'i sras mo blangs tshe lha sras 'das/ /mes kyi bang so'i drung du zlum por brtsigs/ /de yang rba bzhed las mes srong btsan gyi bka' chems kyi yi ge mchims phu'i dkor mdzod 29 3

nas blon po mgar gyis zangs kyi byang ba la bris nas sbas pa de bltas pas/༄nga'i dpon sras rgyal po khri dang zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i lha chos 'byung ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dbu reg zhabs rjen sku la ngur smrig gi na bza' gsol ba lha dang mi'i mchod gnas mang du 'byung gis de las rang dang gzhan gyi tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i mtho ris dang thar ba'i bde ba thams cad 'byung bas nga'i dbon sras rje blon rnams kyis 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor la chab 'og nas phyung la bde ba byin dbu'i mchod gnas su khur zhig bya ba 'dug pa gzigs pas lde zhes bya ba de nga yin snyam du dgongs nas bran ka mu le ka ḍa dang gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra gnyis rgya gar du chos 'tshol du btang bas parnyi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti se la sgom mo zhes thos te spyan drangs pas ma 'drongs/ de gnyis kyi thugs nas mdo sde las rnam 'byed dang / gser 'od dam pa dang / kri ya dang u pa shas tsam zhus/glegs bam spyan drangs nas rgyal po'i mchod gnas su phul bas de'i bzhugs khang du lha khang lnga bzhengs te lha sa mkhar brag brag dmar mgrin bzang /mchims phu nam ral/ brag dmar ka ru/ ma sa gong gi gnas te lnga bzhengs/chos mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyis nub phyogs zla ba tshes pa'i mtha' sngon la kem g.yag mig las ma mchis pa la tang tang dang si gur btul te spa stag shad dung gi sgo mo la gtugs par mnga' mdzad do/ /de'i tshe zhang blon kun rtse bro chag brel bas ma dga' nas nged kyi btsan po 'di ni dad pa che ba chos la dga' byad mi mtshar bas bram ze yin nam zhes gleng de rje'i snyan du gsol bas nga bram ze yin par gyur na nga'i khab ljang mo khri btsun 'di la bu nga bas dad pa che ba byad mi sdug pa cig shog zhig nga btsan po ma nor ba yin na bu zhang blon rnams kyis bcas mi thogs pa shog cig ces dmod btsugs pas khri btsun la sras lha'i 294

bu 'dra ba sna'i gzengs mtho ba dpral ba'i dbyes che ba shin tu mdzes pa gcig btsas pas nang blon rnams na re bod kyi btsan po yang dag nga/ zer/ sras la mi min lha'i dbon po yin no zer nas ming yang ljang tsha lha dbon du gsol lo/ de la khab ran pa na bod kyi mi spre'u brag srin gyi rgyud pa 'di jo mor mi 'os/ mes srong btsan sgam po'i lugs su bya zer nas rje li khri bzher mang ma'i sras mo gyim shang kong jo bya ba yod zer ba de blang bar 'cham/gnyags khri bzang yang ston la 'khor sum bcu dang bcas nas gnye bor btang nas rgya rje la sgrom bu phul bas rgya rjes bu mo la bsgo bas bu mos rang gi 'phrul gyi me long srid gsum mthong ba zhig yod pa la bltas pas grogs skal bod na yod par shes/ rgyal bu lha'i bu 'dra ba mthong nas 'gro bar byas nas bod tu 'ongs/ shul du rgyal bus mtshan la rta bcags pas 'phang thang dge rar sngags pa'i zor mda' 'phangs pas phog ste grongs/ zhes bshad la/ kha cig du gtsug lag khang brgyad tsam bzhengs zer yang khungs ma rnams las lnga kho na bshad/ la lar gnyags khri bzang yang ston gyis kho ngang gi bu mo ma blangs pas khros nas rgyal bu bkrongs zhes kyang snang / rgya'i deb las rgya rje 'khor dang bcas pas kong jo la mkhar chen po zhing pheng nyen gyi bar du skyel thung mdzad/ mkhar de'i nyes pa can thar du bcug dmag dang ldab nor lo gcig med par byas/ rgyal bus bod du rta brgyugs pas rtas bskyur te 'das/ zhes snang ngo / /kong jo yab kyi btsun mor mnga' gsol te/ /jo mo spyan drangs zhal mthong mchod pa dang / /gshin po'i don du dge ba'i srol bzang btsugs//lcags pho rta la sprul pa'i rgyal bu bltams/ /chen ma sna nam bza' yis phrogs nas bston/ /phyi lo rgyal bu zhabs 'dzugs dga' ston che/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan zhes/ /rang mtshan rang gis btags te yum ngos bzung / /295

rgyal rabs gzhan las kong jo rgya bod kyi mtshams su slebs tshe blo bur du sems la zug rngu chen po byung nas me long bltas pas rgyal bu de med par rgan po bzhin mi mdzes pa byad spus khengs pa cig mthong nas sdug bsngal ba'i tshe bod rgyal pos pho nya mngags nas khyod kyi skyes pa'i 'os nga'i bu lha 'dra ba de 'das/ khyod rang nga la bltas nas 'ong ngam phyir ldog pa gang mos gyis shig ces byung bas bu mo'i 'dun ma lan cig yin zer nas bod du 'ongs zhes byung la/ rba bzhed las ljang tsha'i bang so kyi 'u can rtsig pa'i tshe kong jo pho brang 'phang thang du byon pas rgyal po yin zer ba'i rgan po ag tshoms can zhig las mi gda' nas nyin bzhin dngul gyi tasbu ras ram bteg mtshan bzhin mchu sbrang gis ram bteg nas yid ma dga' ba'i glu len pa rje la gsol bas 'o na mo rang skyes cher bskur la pha yul du skyol gsungs/ de skad kong jo la gsol bas rgyal bu byad legs pa cig yod pa de nga rang dang las ma mthun pa yin/nga pha yul du mchi bar mi spro yis mes dang 'du 'o zer nas btsun mor mnga' gsol/ nga'i ne ne mo kong jo'i lha gser gyi shākya mu ni lta zer nas lha sar byon pas ra mo che na jo bo mi bzhugs par 'dug mchod pa byed cing thams cad tu btsal bas ma rnyed nas 'phrul snang du mchod pa la byon pas kong jo'i zhal nas gtsang khang sgo lnga'i bcos rabs 'dug pa la bzhi las med 'di na gtsang khang zhig yod par 'dug zer nas glo 'bur lha'i ya klad kyi 'og du phyag gis brdungs pas ser ka cig byung / de brkos nas sgo phye bas shākya mu ni bzhugs par mthong nas ne ne mo'i lha zhal kun la bstan du gsol zhes zhal mthong gi mchod pa btsugs/ sngar blon po shi ba la zan skal med pas nged rgya nag chos dar bas mi shi ba la bdun tshigs yod bod chos ma dar bas blon po snying re rje zer nas mi shi ma thag du lha mi stong la 'tshal ma bstsal te bod kyi 296

tshe zhes bya ba gshin dge'i srol btsugs zhes byung ngo / /de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan sku bltams pa'i tshul la rba bzhed las yos lo la bltams nas 'o/ brgyad la rgyal sa mdzad par bshad kyang yab lcags 'brug la 'khrungs nas lo drug bcu rtsa gsum la 'das pa'i tshe sras kyi me yos la 'khrungs na lo bcu drug sa yos la 'khrungs na lo bzhi las mi 'gro zhing brgyad song ba dag na shing phag la 'khrungs dgos pas yi ge nor ba zhig byung yod par snang la/ yig tshangs shas che bar lcags pho rta la 'khrungs nas lo bcu gsum na rgyal sa mdzad pa shas cher snang bas 'di dag pa snyam la bu ston gyis sa rta la 'khrungs par mdzad kyang lo bcu gsum gyis sngas par snang ngo / /rba bzhed las ni kong jo la yos bu'i lo la rgyal bu chags de'i dus na rgyal po pho brang brag dmar 'om bu tshal na bzhugs/ yos bu'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gsum la bab pa na rgya'i ha shang mngon shes can zhig na re rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo la sras byang chub sems dpa' zhig btsa' bar nges pas de la rim gro skyed cig ces zer/ rim gro la mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ 'jim pa lhag ma la nga'i sku tshab byed gsung nas mchod rten dres thag can yang brtsigs/ nang par pho nya byung ste kong jo la sras cig bltams so zhes zer/ rgyal pos yar lung 'phang thang du sras bltams pa gzigs su byon pa'i tshe kong jo'i bu sna nam bza' zhi steng gis phrogs nas nga la skyes pa yin zer/ der blon po kun gyis brtag pa bya ba'i phyir thang zhig gi bug par bu bzhag nas sus thob byed du bcug pas kong jos sngon la zin pa sna nam bzas shi na'ang shi snyam nas phrogs pas kong jos bu shi dogs nas lhod kyis btang ste yin dang nga'i yin te gri mo khyod khyer zer nas btang bas bu kong jo'i yin par shes/ lo gcig lon tsa na zhabs 'dzugs pa'i dga' ston byas ste sna nam pa rnams ber chung re lag na thogs nas zhang 297

po'i pang du shog zer bas rgyal bu na re/ khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha lags/ /sna nam zhang gis ci dgyi 'tshal/ /gsungs nas rgya'i pang du song bas ming yang rang gis btags ces byung la/ sku rim gyi mchod rten brgya rtsa bzhengs nas da dung 'jim pa lhag ma la mchod rten che ba gcig byas pas 'byim pas gzugs ma thub nas sres thag gis bcings pas glang por shor bas bzhad gad du gyur te gleng po sres thag can zhes ming chags shing rgyal bu sku tshe ring bar rtogs snang /thang yig sogs las kong jo'i sras phrogs pa'i tshe smre sngags bton nu ma bstan yang sna nam bzas nu ma la rdzas byugs nas 'o ma phab pas ngo ma shes te rgyal bu sna nam bza' la shor/ yum gyis bu 'dis bdag la da ni mi phan pas bod yul phung bar bya dgos snyam nas rje'i gdung rabs 'chad pa'i phyir bla ri seng ge gnam du 'phyong ba 'dra ba'i rtse mor mngal khrag gis 'khor lo bris te mchod rten gyis mnan/ blon po rig pa can rgyan 'chad pa'i phyir blon po'i bla ri sog ༄po khros pa 'dra ba'i sna bcad/ bod nang 'khrug 'byung ba'i phyir stag ri seng ri mjug ma 'brel ba bcad/ mu ge 'byung ba'i phyir mi sna'i ri 'bras kyi ljang pa 'dra ba'i rtsa ba bcad/ klu'i gnod pa 'byung ba'i phyir mong mkhar gyi ri khyung nam mkha' la lding ba 'dra ba'i mchu bcad/ de nas sras kyis lo 'khor zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston gyi tshe rgyal po gung la gser khri la bzhugs/ sna nam pa rnams g.yas gral byas/ rgya'i blon po rnams g.yon gral byas/ yab kyis gser skyogs 'bras chang gis bkang ba sras la btad de/ ma gnyis las skyes pa'i bu gcig po/ /lus chung yang lha yi rnam 'phrul can/ /snod gser skyogs chang gis bkang ba 'di/ /bu khyod rang gi zhang po'i lag tu gtod/ /ma gang yin gyi yid ches de la byed/ /ces dmod bor nas btang bas sna nam pa rnams kyis byis pa dga' ba'i rgyan gos bstan te bos kyang ma 'ongs par sngar ltar smras te 298

sras gom pa thub tsam des gser skyogs rgya'i blon po la gtad nas pang du song bas yum dgyes ches te glu blangs pa/ tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /nga rgya nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo la/ /rje 'gran med rgyal po'i sras gcig 'khrungs/ /las gang yang srid pa'i rngan chen la/ /bu rang las skyes pa gzhan gyis phrogs//gtam bden pa'i tshig la ma nyan zhing / /brang nu ma bstan yang ma phan pas/ /nga rgya mo'i lus sems gzhob tu thal/ /sems khong khro'i na tsha ma bzod pas//yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams su bcug /dus de ring lha yi nyi ma la/ /bu khyod kyi zhang ngo shes pa legs/ /a ma'i lus sems mal du bde/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams pa de/ /ri de rnams la skyon med bcos su yod/ /ces smras par bshad la/ kha cig tu mtshan cir gdags bgros pas sras nyid bzhengs te gnam lha babs kyi bdag po sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdag 'greng mgo nag yongs kyi rje sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan zhes bya ba lags so zhes rang gis mtshan btags zhes kyang byung ngo / /sras lo lnga bzhes pa na yum gnam du byon pas sa dpyad rnams phal cher gso ma thub par lus/ stag ri seng ri'i bar gag ni sa sbrel pa tsam dang me sna'i ri'i rtsa ba rtsig pa cung zad byas 'dug go /rba bzhed las de nas rgyal bus lo bzhi bzhes pa pho brang 'om bu tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe rgya rjes rgyal po la skyes chen po bskur pho nya ba 'ba' de'u la bu rgya phrug gar mkhan bya ba yod pa rgyal bu'i rtsed zlar phul/ yab rgyal po dam pa'i chos mdzad pa bzhed nas skyes dang pho nya ba 'ba' de'u rgya gar du brdzangs pas bshul dong phabs kyi 'phreng du khu 'phang dgung bdun bab 'tsho ba chad nas gnam du bltas pas phyag gis phug ron lnga 'phur ba la mda' bzhi dus gcig la 'phangs nas bzhi dus gcig la bkum/ de sdig che bar kun gyis gleng ba de rgyal bu brag dmar rdzing gong na rtse bas gsan/ rtse zla khyung po 299

dum tshugs/ cog la smon lam 'bad/ rgya phrug gar mkhan dang lnga rdzing na rtse ba'i 'dam khrod rkang pa'i 'og nas srin bu dmar nar byung bas rgyal bu'i zhal nas pho nya ba 'ba' de'us phug ron bsad pa de sdig che'o mchi na srin bu 'di kun bsad na sdig che'am mi che zer/ khyung po dum tshugs kyi mchid nas 'di lta bu'i ma nyes pa bsad na shin tu sdig che tshur la gnod pa byed pa dang nya bsad na phyugs 'phel zer/ rgya phrug na re rgya'i hur bya ba'i gtsug lag las 'di lta bu bkum na nye por sdig che mchi zer/ hur las ji skad 'byung gsungs pas rgya phrug gis hur las dge ba bcu'i chos yod ces gsol pas rgyal bus rtag tu de gleng pa zhang blon kun gyis tshor te rgyal bu chos la dga'am zhes dris par shin tu dga' zer/ rgyal bu'i phyir yab kyis sgrom bu bskur nas sang shi dang mi bzhi rgya'i gtsug lag len du pho nyar btang / bka' bzhin bsgrubs na bya dga' sbyin no ma bsgrubs na gsod do byas te btang / de nas ke'u le'i 'phrang la phyin/ de'i dus na rgya rje'i bum bzang dbang po'i drung na ju zhag mkhas pa cig na re da ste zla ba gsum na nub phyogs bod nas 'dir byang chub sems dpa' zhig pho ltar 'ong / de'i sha tshugs dang rtags 'di 'dra'o zer nas 'bag zhig bris/ dbang pos de rgya rje'i snyan du bsrings pas rgya rjes pho nya de der sdod du ma zhajug par rim gro skyed la nga'i drung du thong bya ba byung / pho nya de dus su byung nas rgya'i hā shang gis phyag byas/ bsgo ba bzhin mar btang pas rgya rje dang mjal ste btsan po'i sgrom bu phul/ rgya rje na re khyod rgya de'u'i bu yin na 'dir nga'i zhang blon dgyir mi rung ngam gsungs/ de la bsams pas nga 'dir 'dug na tshe 'di la skyed na bod yul du chos bzang po khungs 'byung ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sde sdod kyi dpe tsam zhig btsan po'i phyag tu phul la slad kyis thabs bya bar snyan du gsol snyam ste/ bdag 300

'dir sdod par gnang ba ni bka' drin che na bod kyi btsan po'i bka' nan cher bstsal bas bdag gi pha las kyis bkum na glo ba la bcags/ slar bod tu mchis la pha dang gros su bgyes te thabs kyis 'bangs su mche'o zhes zhus pas rgya rje na re nga'i snying du mi khyod las sdug pa ni ma byung na khyod bya dga' ci 'dod gsungs/ pho nya'i mchid nas bya dga' gnang na sangs rgyas kyi gsung rabs bam po stong zhu'o zhus pa dang rgya rje na re/ ke'u le gcan gzan gyi 'phrang song tsa na'ang gnod pa ma byas par rim gro cher byas byung / bum sangs dbang po'i ju zhag mkhan na re'ang khyod byang chub sems dpa'i sprul par 'ong zer/ hā shang mngon shes can gyis kyang khyod la phyag byas/ khyod kyi spyod pa dang sbyar na'ang sangs rgyas kyi lung na lnga brgya'i mtha' ma la gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos khungs 'byin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong bar lung bstan pa de'ang khyod yin par gor ma chag ngas kyang grogs bya yi gsungs te mthing shog la gser chus bris pa'i chos bam po stong gnang / bya dga' gzhan yang che thang du gnang nas pho nya lnga slar bod yulca du 'gro ba'i lam na pha bong mgron po rgyu mi phod pa sus mthong ba de rbab grir 'chi ba yod pa de grong khyer eg chu'i ki ya ha shang nus pa can stag la ga sha 'gel nus pa mngon shes yod pa de la kho rang gi mkhan pos bka' bsgos nas zhag gsum bsgoms pas pha bong bkrum nas btul/ shul du lha khang zhig brtsigs/ lung pa de yang zhing du rmos/ lha ris bcad de eg chur 'ongs pa la bod kyi pho nya bas sgom lung mnos/ ci 'gyur gyi lung zhus/ nga'i pha dang phrad dam/ ngas bod du sangs rgyas kyi chos tshugs sam/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bsgrags na bod kyi bgegs srin srog la sdo ba mi 'byung ngam/ btsan po yab sras bde'am zhes dris pas/ der ha shang gis mngon shes kyis bltas pas 301

btsan po sku gshegs/ rgyal bu sku nar ma son pas blon po nag po la dga' ba rnams kyis khrims bu chung byas nas chos bshig brag dmar mgrin bzang bya ba'i thugs dam zhig 'dug pa rmang nas bsgyel/ da chos dar bar byed na khyod kyis btsan po'i zham ring ba mdzod la slad kyis rgyal bu de sku nar son pa dang de'i zhal nas mu stegs rig byed kyi chos shig gleng du 'ong gis de tsa na 'di snyan du gsol cig dang des rgyal bu dad pa skye 'o/ de'i rjes la 'di snyan du gsol bas dad pa cher skye'o/ /de'i rjes la 'di snyan du gsol bas rgyal bu chos byed par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te glegs bam gsum bskur/ bod la chos kyi skal ba yod/ mthar chos rgyas par 'ong / de'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen za hor rgyal po'i bu dge slong shānta raṇi ta zhes bya ba de khyod bod kyi 'dul skal yin no gsung nas zla ba gnyis zan drangs/ de nas nyin lam gnyis su bskyal nas gcig la gcig rkang pa la phyag byas te gyes so/ /de nas sang shi brag dmar mgrin bzang bshig pa glo ba la chags te pho nya ba mi lnga pos rgya'i ri de'u shan zhes bya ba'i rtse na mi ma yin gyis gtibs pa'i khrod du zhag bdun gyis tshar bar brtsigs pa'i ārya mañdzu'i pho brang yod pa las dpe len du mchis pa'i tshe mi gcig gis ri la 'dzegs ma shes/ gcig gis rtse la phyin yang ci yang ma mthong / gcig gis lha khang mthong yang sgo ma rnyed/ gcig gis sgo mthong yang dra ba 'dra ba zhig gis bkab ste nang du ma tol/ sang shis nang du phyin nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sogs byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas mchod pa phul/ dgra bcom pa kun la'ang phyag mchod byas/ 'phags pa kun dang gtam byas te de'i 'dug lugs dper bya ba'i phyir yid la bzung ste phyir don pa dang ri de'i gcan gzan kun gyis phyag byas nas ri sgab tu bskyal te bod du 'ongs so zhes byung ngo / /ri de ni ri bo 302

rtse lngar grags pa de yin no/ /sprul pa'i rgyal bu sku nar ma son par/ /yab rje khri lde gtsug brtan gnam du gshegs/ /de yi bang so mu ra ri la brtsegs//gral ni 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i g.yon na yod/ /ming ni lha ri gtsug nam bya ba lags/ /de ma thag du rgyal bu dbang bskur te/ /bod yul rgyal khams kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /'on kyang nag po'i sdig blon 'dus pa yis/ /dam chos byar mi gnang ba'i khrims chung byas/ /jo bo sar bcug mtha' mar mang yul bskyal/ /de tshe bod la mi shes du ma byung / /rgyal po nar son chos kyi bsam pa 'khrungs/ /mgos kyi blon chen padma gung btsan sogs/ /chos blon du mas rgyal po'i dgongs pa bsgrubs/ /bstan dgra'i sdig blon 'ga' la bka'achad phab/ /jo bo spyan drangs gtsang khang sto mar bzhugs/ /de yang rba bzhed las yab rgyal po lo drug bcu rtsa gsum bzhes pa na ya 'brog sbra tshal du chibs sgron pas grongs/ rgyal bu chab srid bzhes ma thag du sku nar ma son pas zhang blon ma zhang grom pa skyes na re rgyal po sku tshe thung ba chos byas pas lan ste bkra mi shis/ tshe phyi ma skye ba len zer ba rdzun yin/ tshe 'di'i rkyen zlog bon gyis byed/ su chos byed pa pho reng du mthar sprug go zhes khrims bu chung bcas/blon chen chos la dga' ba mang 'bal gnyis la bkyon phab ste bod nag por btang / ra mo che na gser gyi lha shākya mu ni rgya'i lha yin pas slar rgya yul du bskyal bar bya zer ba las lha de dang po rta pa mi gcig gis bang du theg pa las ma theg par 'breng pa'i dra bar bcug ste mi sum brgyas sgor phyung / de nas mi stong gis mkhar brag gdong gi thad kur phyin pa dang mi stong gis kyang ma theg ste de nyid tu bye ma'i dong du sbas nas rba rje khol la gtad nas bzhag rgya'i hā shang rgan po cig dkon gnyer byed cing yod pa de slar rgya yul du bskrad pas ha shang gis rgya bod mtshams su phyin pa dang ha shang gi mchid nas nga'i lham ya gcig 303

khar sang gi 'gro lam du lus pas da dung bod yul du dam pa'i chos me stag tsam zhig 'byung zer skad/ ces byung ngo / /'di la brten nas rba bzhed lhad can kha cig du ston rtsen rtsod pa'i tshe hā shang ma hā ya na'i lham ya gcig rtsod pa'i grar lus pas da dung bod du nga'i chos lugs 'dzin pa 'ong zhes smras shing phyis kyi mkhas pa dag hā shang de chos mi shes kyang rtags mtshan cung zad shes pa cig ste phyis sems ngo mthong bas 'tshang rgya zer ba 'di rnams kho'i lugs su 'dug ces gsung ngo zhes lhad bcug pa 'ga' zung snang zhing rtog ge pa theg chen gyi chos rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyus med pa la blon po'i nang du mkhas pa'i ming khrul bab pa du mas 'di rgyu mtshan che che skad du sgrog par snang yang rba bzhed khungs ma las de med cing gsar du bcug pa yin min phyis kyi mkhas pa dag ces sogs kyis gsal bar shes la/ spyir bden pa mthong ba dang chos mthong ba dang sems ngo mthong ba sogs hā shang gi chos su byed na sangs rgyas kyi chos phal cher ha shang gi lugs su 'gyur zhing / sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes bsgom par bya'o zhes sogs la dngos su rgol ba yin pas rtog ge la chos rgyus chung la chags sdang che ba chos spong la mkhas nyams re ba ngan song gi lam du rdo rta 'dren pa rnams kyi gtam gyi bag chags tsam yang rna bar bzhag par mi bya'o zhes pa ni zhar las 'ongs pa'i dogs dpyod do/ /rba bzhed du snga ma'i 'phror/ mkhar brag gi lha khang ni rmang nas bsgyel/ mgrin bzang gi lha khang ni bshig ste cong ni mchims phu'i g.ya' la bskyal te de nyid phyis bsam yas dge rgyas kyi cong lags/ lha sa bee har du bzo gra bgyis/ bshas byas nas lder tsho la pags pa g.yogs/ phyag na nang cha dang lug khog bkal/ phyin chad mi shi ba la tshe dgyid du mi gnang / rgya'i lha chos bgyid pa mchis na pho reng du rtag tu sprug go zhes pa'i khrims bu chung 304

bcas pa'i tshe zhang khri thog rje thog la 'bar ni thang la brgyal brgyal nas ā ā ā zhes lan gsum 'bod kyin rgyab gas nas shi/ cog ro skyes bzang rgyal 'gong ni lce rkan dang rkang lag ril gu gu thul du song nas gum/ bla 'og gi mi dang ltas mkhan kun mthun par rgya'i lha sa thams su bcug pas rgya lha khros zer nas rgya'i lha'i mes po dang po rgya gar yul nas 'ongs pas rgya gar dang nye ba mang yul du bskyal bar mo bzang nas bye stongs nas bton te mang yul du dre'u gnyis kyis khyogs bgyis te bskyal ba'i dus su yul ngan chen po byung / tshe mi dgyid pa'i khrims bu chung byas pa'i 'og tu ba lam glag tu rba gsal snang gi bu ming sring gnyis dus gcig la gum pa'i tshe lha'i yab mes kun na re chos bden zer ha shang la 'dri snyam nas nyen khang na ha shang mngon shes can rgan po cig yod pa bos te zhus pas/ tshe snga phyi yod chos bden zer bas sgor ni bon bgyid du bstsal/ nang du ni gyod dang bsdos te lha mi stong la 'tshal ma bstsal nas tshe bgyis/ ra mo che nas hā shang rgan po de bkug nas bu ming sring gnyis kyi bdun tshigs zhus pas hā shang na re lhar skye pa dga'am slar khyed rang gi bur skye ba dga' gsung / pha ni lhar skye ba dga'/ ma ni rang gi bur skye ba dga' nas hā shang gis bu'i rus pu la cho ga byas te gdung sha ri ram du song bas lhar skye bar lung bstan/ bu mo'i khar mu tig sran ma tsam mtshal chus bskus pa 'dan pa g.yon du bcug ste yid ches pa'i rtags su cho ga byas nas rdza khog tu bcug ste ma'i mal 'og tu sbas nas sang phod khyod rang gi bur skye 'o zhes lung bstan pas sang phod gsal snang gi khab la bu zhig skyes te kha nas mu tig 'dan yon dmar po byung bas mal 'og gi rdza kha phye bas shul nya re 'dug btsas nas lo gcig lon pa dang ma bslabs par zhing dang ne ne mo yang ngo shes te sngon bzhin du 'bad pa la sogs pa byung bas tshe phyi ma yod par shes/ de nas rgya'i hā shang 305

de la gsal snang gis sgom lung nod de gzhan la gsangs nas rtag tu bsgoms pa'i rjes la sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'tshol ba'i slad du rgya gar dang bal yul du mchi mchi bar rje'i snyan du gsol ba las/ rje'i thugs la 'di chos la dkar bas rgya gar dang bal yul du 'gro bar nges snyam du thugs dpag mdzad nas 'o na ngas mang yul gyi kha blon du bsko'o gsungs nas bskos te mang yul du mchis/ zhang gis khrims bu chung bcas pa'i lung bcag nas thal byung rgya gar du mchis/ ma hā bo dhi dang nā lentar mchod pa byas yon phul bas dgun zla 'bring po la char bab/ byang chub shing las 'o ma byung / bal yul du ston mo sarba wa se bgyis/ nyen khang du yon phul nas mchod pa'i tshe dge'o zhes pa'i sgra dang 'od byung / bal yul gyi rje la ngo chen zhus nas mkhas shing gsal ba yon tan mang po mnga' ba'i shāsta rakṣa ta bod du bo dhi sa twa zhes grags pa de mang yul du spyan drangs nas gtsug lag khang gnyis brtsegs/ bal yul du bal rje'i 'bangs byas rkyen ris bcad/ rgya bal gyi mkhas pa kun las chos bslabs/gsal snang gi khyim du bshos gsol te yon phul chos zhus pa'i rjes la/ bod kyi rgyal po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad de gshegs par ci gnang / bdag la sems skyed cig zhu zhes gsol ba las/ mkhan po'i zhal nas sems skyed zhu na yon phul zhig gsungs/ der gser dngul sogs rin po che dang / zo ring dang / zab dar dang / ber dang / ja skyogs dang / gu rub dang / snal gos sogs rung ngo 'tshal ma lus par phul/ da dung phul zhig gsung bas cang med kyang lus la 'tshal ba'i rke rags dang ral ka yang phul bas sems skyed gnang nas nga bod kyi 'dul skal yin te bod kyi rgyal po shri btsan po dang khyod gnyis ma skyes pas bod kyi rgyal po gdung rabs dgu brjes kyi bar du nga rgya gar za hor yul dang bal yul gnyis phar 'gro tshur 'gro la sdod kyi 'dug da bri 306

btsan po dang khyod gnyis nar son te dus la bab pas yul byan dkar du chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram has po ri'i drung du yul brag dmar du bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya'o/ /khyod ni tshe 'di la ngo shes shing sems skyed pa ma yin te tshe rabs du ma'i sngon rol nas sems bskyed pa'i chos kyi bu rab yin te ming yang ye shes dbang por gdag go gsungs nas spyi bor phyag gis byugs te byil byil mdzad/zhus pa rnams bkas gnang / de'i tshe nam mkha' las kyang dge'o zhes sgra lan gsum dang 'od byung / yon phul ba rnams slar gnang nas gcig kyang ma bzhes par mkhan po ni slar bal yul du gshegs/ gsal snang mar 'ongs/btsan po'i zhal mjal du tshes gcig la mchi ba'i pho nya ba btang ste snyan du gsol bas gnang ste pho brang rlung tshubs su mchis nas rje la zhe sa phul/ rje'i zhal nas gsal snang khyod lha chos sha stag byed cing 'dug zer na khong gis khyod sprugs ma dogs sam zhes bka' bstsal pa dang lan du mang yul gyi stod na mchis pas sgyugs pa dang yang 'dra zhes gsol lo/ /bzhes pa 'dren pa'i tshe sa dben par song ste rje la lha chos bzang po mdzad par rigs pa dang / mkhan po bo dhi sa twa mkhas pa btsun pa mngon par shes pa mnga' ba la sogs yon tan du ma yod pa cig dge ba'i bshes gnyen du zhu ba gsol ba las mkhan po 'di skad du gsungs zhes zhib tu zhus pas/ rjes zhal nas zhang blon gyis khyod bsad par 'ong gis ngas zhang nye bzang la lkog tu bsgo ste zhang blon 'dun sar khad kyis gsol du gzhug go khyod re zhig yul du song la yib la sdod cig zhes bka' bstsal nas gsal snang yul du mchis te sgom mo/ /de'i tshes sang shis rgya nag tu phyin pa'i pho nya'i sug las grub nas slar bod du mchis pa dang rgya rje'i lan dang skyes btsan po'i phyag tu phul/ blon chen po'i thabs bstsal ming yang 307

rgya phrug mdzangs pa por btags/ rgyal po sku nar ma son pas rgya'i chos rnams phu'i rdza gseb tu sbas so/ /yang rgyal pos zhang zhung yul gyi dkor gnyan po yod pa blangs te dkor mdzod du blug pa'i phyir pho nya mang du btang ba las snga phyi gcig kyang ma log pas rgya phrug 'di btang na lon 'ong zer nas dkor blug pa'i pho nyar btang ba las lam du zhang zhung gi lha mu tsa men dang mjal ste lha mo de ro smad g.yu'i na bun gyis 'khrigs/ ro stod mu tig gi se mo do dang rin po ches brgyan pa cig sang shi la thal mo sbyar phyag byas te rin po che'i rgyan gyis mchod de smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khyod mkhar nag po'i dkor blug tu gshegs na bdag gi rta ser po rngog nag 'di la bcibs la khyung lung gi sgor phyin pa dang gya rta'i lcag 'di snga ru chings la dod nang du dkor blug cig dang nye zho ma mchis par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas mi snang bar song / sang shis de ltar byas dkor gnyan po ril blug ste mkhar nag mchis pa'i khang pa cig sgo phye bas nang na mi 'dom bcu gnyis pa cig nyal nas mchis na sang shi gda' nas langs te thal mo sbyar phyag 'tshal te sngas na gser skyogs bdun chang gis bkang ba dang mdun na g.yu 'od me ltar 'bar ba zhig 'dug pas sang shi la phul/ de nas yang glan gyi mdzod na g.yag skad ni ngur/ rta skad ni 'tsher/ ra skad ni sbre mi dag zhig yang yang yud gda'/ sgrom bzhi'i nang na glan gyi me long mchis pa'i zur mo khab kyi mig tsam zhig kha phye bas rgyal po'i pho brang dang / snang srid thams cad dang / bdag gi glo snying nang rol kun kyang de na gda' nas slar sbas te sgor byung ba na rta lcag phyed tshal du gas nas gda' skad/ sang shi dngos bod yul du 'khor te/ de nas rgyal po sku nar son pa dang yab mes kyi yi ge gzigs nas zhang blon rnams dang gros mdzad de/ nga'i yab mes kyi yi ge na 'bangs bde ba'i tshis rma'i le'u tshe dang sbyar na nga'i yab mes kyis rdzu 'phrul 308

b.res pa 'dra gsangs/ blon po dag na re yab mes kyi le' tshe de ci 'dra ba 4//na sa ring rdo gyezhig bdog zer/ der btsan pos rgya bzang me mgo la gsungal pa/ nga'i yab kyi sku ring la rgya'i gtsug lag le'u ke tse ces bya ba zhig byung zhes grag na de ji lta zhes gsungs pa dang / me mgos le'u tse ji ltar lags pa yi ge bklags pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas gtsug lag de ni te por bzang ngo nga'i yab mes kyis chos lugs bzang po cig sku nyams su bzhes so/ /da 'jig rten gyi spyod pa bzang po ci 'byung na blta zhes gsungs pa dang sang shis bsams pa/ha shang mngon shes can gyis nam rgyal po mu stegs kyi chos gleng ba'i dus su lha chos snyan du gsol zhig bya ba de ni 'di yin pa 'dra zhes bsams nas rgya'i lha chos bzang po byung na le'u tse de dag de'i phru ma'i sgor yang mi tshud do ces gsol ba dang / btsan po'i zhal nas rgya'i lha chos bzang po'i gtan tshigs khyod la yod dam zhes bka' gnang ba dang / bdag cag rgya la mchis so zhes gsol nas rje 'bangs dben par gsangs te dharma mchims phu'i rdza la sbas pa blangs te kim ha shang gi lung bzhin du brims pa ni/ dang por dge ba bcu'i mdo bklags/ de la rgyal po dad pa skyes spyod pa dag bar go de nas rdo rje gcod pa bklags/ des lta pa dag par go rgyal po dad pa cher skyes/ de nas sā li ljang pa bklags/ lta spyod zung 'brel du go nas chos la yid ches/ la la nas dang po dge ba bcu dang phung po lnga spyan sngar brims bzang rab ces gsungs/ de nas sā li ljang pa brims pas chos thams cad rgyu rkyen las byung bar thugs ches nas kyang zer/ btsan po'i zhal nas 'di lta bu'i chos bzang po 'di nga'i sku ring la rnyed pa gnam byams sa byams lha thams cad la gtang rag gtang ngo / /gsal snang yang nga la lha chos mi spyad du mi rung zer ba yang bden/ lha chos 'di lta bu phyag tu phul ba 'di las dga' ba med kyi/gsam 309

snang la dngul g.yung drung gi steng du gser chen po sbyin no /sang shi la phra men g.yung drung gi steng du gser chung ngu sbyin no/ khyod kyis spyan drangs pa'i rgya yul gyi dharma kun dang mang yul gyi chos rnams rgya me mgo dang / rgya gar ā nanta dang / rgya las skad mkhas pa su yod pas bsgyur zhig zhes bka' bstsal nas de gsum gyis has po ri'i bya khung du chos bod skad tu bsgyur ba'i drung du gzhan blon po dam ta ra klu gong dang / zhang ma zhang sogs mchis te gri bo khyed gsum de na ci byed/ ma zhang gi khrims bu chung las mi shi ba la tshe byed na pho reng du gtan du sprug sto bal gyi lha mchod du mi gnang ba ma thos sam/ bya ba mang 'dug mi phod pa de ni chos kyi skad 'dra na rje'i snyan du ma gsol ba la bye ma'i nang du subs la zhog phyis khrims bu chung dang sbyar te shags gdab bam/ zhes bka' yo gal 'chos pa'i mdun sa nas mchid nan drag po brdas pa dang / sang shis rje la gsol bas gsal snang slar ma 'ongs kyi bar du dar cig ma bsgyur zhig gsung / zhang blon chos la dga' ba rnams kyis rje la sang shi stod kyi pho nyar gsal snang gi grogs su btang bar zhus pas btsan po'i zhal nas sang shi lta bu rgya phrug mdzangs pa zho sha phul te dam pa'i chos blangs pa'i steng du stod du mngags nas shi na 'phangs so stod nas slar ma log na bu yang med rabs 'chad do/ zhes gsungs pas/ sang shis gsol ba/ rje lha sras dang / bo dhi satwa dang / sba gsal snang dang / bdag cag smon lam gcig pas chos bzung ba la bdag kyang rten tsam du 'tshal bar bas kyi bdag rabs mi 'gum/ stod du mchis kyang rgya gar yul nas dge slong khrims ma nyams pa gnyis shig tshe 'das ma thag bdag gi bur mchi'o zhes gsol/ de nas rje blon zhang nya bzang blon chen mgos sogs chos blon kun tshogs nas chos bya bar mol gtam byas pa la zhang nya bzang gis snyan du gsol ba/ mes srong btsan gyis lha 310

chos mdzad pas bod legs rgu byung ba dang lha sras yab kyis kyang mdzad pa las yab nongs pa'i 'og du zhang ma zhang gis bshig rgya'i lha de dang po rta pa gcig gis pang du theg pa la rgya yul du bskyal bar chad pa'i tshe mi stong gis kyang ma theg mang yul du bskyal ba'i tshe dre'u gnyis kyis theg chos bshig pa'i zhang blon 'ga' zhig yang had por gum/ bla 'og gi phyag sprin pa dang ltas mkhan kun kyang rgya'i lha khros pa las byung zer ba dang sbyar na sku dang chab srid la mi gnod par glo bar chud/ rgya'i lha yang slar blangs la mchod cing sngon lha sras yab kyis chos mdzad pa bzhin mdzad na legs pa 'dra yis kyang zhang ma zhang ro ngan la chos la mi dga' bas thugs dgongs mi 'grub ste mchi zhes gsol ba dang /blon po mgos na re de la thabs bgyi bar rngo thog gis kho bo'i rjes su rting gnon mdzod cig slad kyis rje'i dgongs pa sgrub po ces chad byas/ mgos kyis bla 'og gi phyag sprin pa dang mo ma dang ltas mkhan kun la skog du bya dga' bstsal nas rgyal po sku chags che chab srid la gnod pa 'ong bar lung mthun par smra bar bstsal/ de la ji ltar bya ba'i lung smrar bstsal pa la rje'i sku rim du zhang blon su che ba zung zhig dgung lo gsum mchad pa'i nang du dal du bcug na rje'i sku tshe dang chab srid 'phel lo zhes lung phog de skye bo 'du ba kun na mang du gleng ba dang yang mgos kyis bshul lam 'grim pa'i mgron po rnams la zhang ma zhang la bsnyun po gda' pa'i gleng ba de bden no zhes thos tsam du smrar bcugam zhang gis thos pas glo ba la bcags par gyur/ nub phyogs kyi rgan mo zhig gis kyang ma zhang gi ngo la cer bltas te zhang ma zhang ni rje'i gdung sob pa bod 'bangs yongs la gces bsnyun chen pos thebs zer ba bden nam zer bas ma zhang bden nges snyam ste khyim du bub nyal byas ngus pas nang 'khor ba na re ci nyes zer ba la nad chen po byung zhes rgyal khams kur/ na gleng zer/ rgyal khams kyi 311

kha la gtad ra med mi bden zer yang zhang gis me long bltas pas rgas 'dug pas rgyal khams kyi kha la ye shes kyi spyan yod zer ba bden zer nas mya ngan cher byed do/ /de mgos kyis thos nas rje 'bangs kun tshogs pa'i dus su zhang nya bzang gis rgyal po sku chags che ba'i rim gro bya bar rigs so de la rje'i zhabs tog pa su che ba khas long zer bas mgos rgan langs te rje'i zhabs tog tu nga che bu tsha'i dge dang yig tshangs su de che blon nga las che ba su yod/ gcig ngas byed zer/ ma zhang yang 'gran pas langs te blon nga las che ba ni med na rje'i zhabs tog ba gcig ngas byed zer/ da mchad pa gar brtsig ces glengs pas mgos na re phag rir bya'am yang na 'ju'i spang bzang du bya zer/ ma zhang na re sna nam brang bur rtsig go zer nas rmang bres pas ma zhang gis 'phrigs nas rdo dga' mo sna nas skyes shig zer/ chus mi brel ba'i thabs rwa 'thud pa'i nang du chu 'ongs nas phyir 'gro ba byas/ mi stogs pa'i zas mi 'khyag pa'i gos mi subs pa'i gseng la sogs pa byas/ mchod pa 'byongs nas blon po gnyis nang du mchir mi rung bas rjes mgos rgan thon zhig par bka' bsgos/ mgos dang lo te gu snang gong gnyis gros byas nas mgos kyis rkang pa la bya rgod kyi lham gon lus la pha ba go go'i thul ba gon nas blon chen po dang zhang ma zhang nang du chud pa dang 'dir zhang gi gzims mal bya/ 'dir nga'i bya/ 'dir chu zhog zer zhing phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa dang ma zhang yang phyir kri le le 'bra 'breng /de'i 'phro la mgos kyis thal mo brdabs nas pha gi na ci yin na zer nas bros pa'i rkang pa nas bzung pas rgod spu sbar gang lag na gda'/ pha ba go go 'thul bas mig gis ci yang ma mthong / lo te gus sgo pha bong gis bkag mgos rgan gyi lto 'og du song ba zhes nang na 'khun/ ring zhig na khyim bya'i skad grag nas chu shor snyam dre'u yos zan lag pa brdung ba'i sar brkos pas chus mi 312

brel ba'i rwa 'thud pa mthong nas bshig nang nas mda' la yi ge bris nas sna nam pas brus zhes pa phyir 'phen skad/ ces byung ngo / /de tsho rgya gar za hor rgyal po'i sras/ /dzasbu'i gling na mkhas shing btsun pa'i mchog /shāsta ra kṣi ta zhes zhi ba'i 'tsho/ /bod yul 'dul skal kho nar sku bltams pa/ /yon tan dpag yas sems dpa' chen po de/ /smon lam dag pa'i pho nyas spyan drangs te/ /rgyal pos gtsug gi nor bu mchod du bsten/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /bod yul 'dre srin gdug pa kun khros te/ /nad dang mu ge ma rung du ma byung / /bod 'bangs rnams kyi sems srung bgyi ba'i slad/ /mkhan po slar yang bal po'i yul du byon/ /o rgyan rgyal po'i sras las rab byung ba//dge slong padma sambha wa zhes bya/ /dzasbu gling na nus mthu che ba yi/ /sngags mkhan mchog de spyan 'dren gyis cig dang / /bod yul lha srin 'thul bar 'gyur ro gsung / /slad nas mkhan po rnam gnyis spyan drangs te/ /padma'i sbubs las brdzus te sku bltams cing / /tshe yi rig 'dzin mthar phyin mchog dngos grub/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis thang lha sham po sogs/ /lha srin dregs pa can rnams ma lus btul/ /nyi tshe'i dmyal ba mang du stongs par drangs/ /bye ma thams cad tshal dang ne sing dang / /gram pa thams cad zhing sa gshin por bya/ /ri kun nags dang spang du bsgyur ba yis/ /bod yul shin tu bzang por mdzad dgongs tshe/ /bod 'bangs bsod nams dman pas ma theg ste/ /blon po rnams kyi glo bar chud ma gyur/ /de yang rba bzhed las ma zhang chos la mi dga' ba la skyon phab pa'i las de grub pa dang rje blon tshogs pa'i dus zhang nya bzang gis sngar ltar gsol ba dang / rgyal pos bka' bstsal pa zhang zer ba bden nga yang de ltar dgongs pas zhang blon dag gros bya'o zhes bka' bstsal nas slad kyis rje blon mang po 313

tshogs pa dang bka' bstsal pa/ nga'i yab mes kyis lha chos mdzad pa ma zhang gis bshig ba de te por ma legs/ zhang nya bzang yang 'di skad zer bas rgya'i lha yang slar spyan drangs/ der rang yang chos byar rung bas bya gsungs nas chos bya bar gros 'chams/ da chos byed pa la rgya gar dang bal po'i mkhan po las chos mkhas pa'i lo rgyus can su yod dam smra dgos so zhes glengs pa dang /rje'i zhal nas ba lam glag na rba gsal snang yod de nga'i drung du bos gsungs nas pho nya btang bas sba gsal snang spyan sngar mchis te sngar bzhin bka' bstsal bas gsal snang gis gsol ba/ sngon ni rgya gar za hor na mchis de lta ni bal yul na mchis te za hor gyi rgyal po'i bu dge slong shāsta rakhri ta ces bya ba gtsug lag la mkhas pa cig mchis lags zhes gsol ba dang / de mi dgug tu mi rung gis khyod yul du ma 'gro bar bal yul du song la bal rje la nga'i bka' 'phrin dang sgrom bu byin la za hor gyi bandhe ci khugs su sgrubs la khyer la shog cig zhes bka' bstsal ba dang / thal byung du bal yul du mchis te bka'i sgrom bu bal rje la phul/ gnyi gas mkhan po bod yul du gshegs par zhus pas gnang nas bal po'i lo tsā ba zham ring du khrid de byon/ mang yul du spyan drangs nas pho brang du pho nya btang ste mkhan po sku dngos mchis te mang yul du bzhugs nas mchis zhes gsol bas/ nang 'khor ba lang gro snang ra dang / gnyer stag btsan gdong gzigs dang sbrang rgyas legs gzigs dang gsum mang yul du bsu bar btang ste khyed gsum gyis rim gro gyis la hen khang bee har du phyags phob cig ces bka' las byung ba bzhin bsus nas mkhan po dang lang gro ra sa bi har du bzhugs su gsol/ gsal snang pho brang du mchis te sku gnyer khums par gsol ba dang / zhang blon chen po dag gis sto bal gyi bandhe chos log pa dang ngan sngags phra men gyi dag dgyid dam mi bgyid la rtog du gsol bas 314

mchims me lha dang seng mgo lha lung gzigs/ sang shi dang gsum rtog du btang bas brtags na skad ma go dar chags sgo gseb kyi tshong dus na kha che skyes bzang gi bu ā nasta lo tsā slob 'phro la chad pa byung nas tshong byed pa de la lo tsā bcol/ ā tsārya ci 'dra dris pas/ spyod pa legs so cog la mi bya ba med/nyes so cog la mi btang ba med/ lhar dkon mchog gsum mchod/ gtso bor sems can la phan pa bya bar mchis zhes sam/ ngan sngags phra min mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni mi bgyid/ khong rang gi lha sangs rgyas ni srog chags kun la phan par bgyid pa zhig mkhan po dngos ni spyod lam nyes so cog dang gzhan la gnod pa'i bag mi bgyid/ legs so cog dang srog chags kun la phan pa ni lhur bgyid pa cig ste thugs 'phrig bzhes pa'i bag ma mchis zhes gsol bas spyan drangs te pho brang brag dmar du zhal sngar mjal ba dang la nye brtag go gsung / btsan po'i gser phye bre gang gi phyag rten byas te phyag 'tshal ba dang mkhan po'i zhal nas nga ngo mkhyen nam gsung / btsan po'i zhal nas bdag gis de snga zhal ma mjal gsung / mkhan po'i zhal nas sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la gtsug lag khang rgyan srung gi byis pa gsum mchis pa'i tshe bye ma'i mchod rten byas te ngas paṇḍita dang / khyed kyis rgyal po/ gsal snang gis pho nya byas te mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos spel bar smon lam btab pa ma nges sam zhes gsungs pas btsan pos sgom yun thungs pas ma dran gsung /rgyal pos ā tsārya la nye brtags sam zhes zhus pas zhal nas brtags lags te rgyal po khyed kyi dbu la thod bcings pa dang spyar na stod du mnga' ris zhwa tsam zhig 'chags/ zhabs la phyags gsol ba dang sbyar na smad du mnga' ris lham tsam zhig 'chags/ sku la ske rags ma bcings pa dang sbyar na bar 'dir rgyal khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul bas dam 315

pa'i chos byar btub gsungs/ de nas pho brang rlung tshubange — su ā cornyas lo tsā bgyis te dge ba bcu dang / khrims bco brgyad dang / rten 9)brel bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i chos bshad de zla ba bzhi'am gnyis lon pa dang 'dre srin nag po la dga' ba kun khros nas pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer/ dmar po ri la thog rgyab/ mi nad dang phyugs nad dang lo nyes byung bas bod 'bangs thams cad kha log nas btsan pos chos byas pas lan ā tsārya yar sprugs shig zer te chos bgyid du ma ster ro/ /der ā tsārya rnga khang steng na dar dkar gyi yol ba'i nang na sgom byed pa la rgyal pos rba gsal snang dang / sang shi dang / zhang nya bzang dang / seng mgo dang / gnyer stag btsan lnga zham ring du khrid gser phye bre gang khyer nas phyag dang skor ba lan bdun byas te spyang slog nas gser thum mkhan po'i mdun du bor te byon/ de lta bu nub gsum mdzad pa'i rjes la btsan pos/ bdag skal pa chung la bod nag po la zhen pa'i skabs su skyes pas de las ldog par dka'/ thabs mi mkhas na lha chos mi 'grub par glo bar chud/re zhig mkhan po slar bzhu da la bal yul du bzhugs shig slad kyis thabs bgyis te btub ma thag tu spyan 'dren btang ngo zhes zhus pas ā tsāryas bal rje dang 'khor la gser phye khyor gang bsnams/ gzhan rnams slar rgyal po nyid la phul te mkhan po'i zhal nas sngar yab mes kyi sku ring la lha klu gdug pa can dma'og du ma bstsal bas bod khams gdon ma non pa mthu che ba chos la mi dga' ba'i dbang du song bas chos mdzad pa'i tshe gzigs ltas ngan pa byung ba dang /chos ma tshugs pa dang rgyal po'i sku tshe thung ba yang 'di las gyur pas slad kyis nga yang chos mdzad na lha klu gdug pa can rnams dam 'og tu bstsal 'tshal te o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i sras dge slong padma sambha wa zhes bgyi ba dzaspu'i gli nga na sngags mkhan 'di pas mthu che ba mi bzhugs te bdag gis de spyan drangs la bod —316

khamab/ su chos 'byung ba lnga brgya'i mtha' ma la bab pas mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi mchi na nang pa sangs rgyas pa nyid dam gzhan zhig 'gran zla 'tshol ba zhig byung na rdzu 'phrul ni padma sambha wa dang 'gran/ gtan tshigs ne bdag dang shaṭa su bkye la padma sambha was dam 'og tu bstsal na rgyal po'i dgongs pa yang 'grub/sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang slad nas rjes su brtan par 'gyur bas de bzhin bgyid par rje 'bangs dang chad byas/ ā tsārya bskrad pa ltar byas nas yar bzhud pa'i tshe seng mgo lha lung gzigs sngon sha mi 'tshal ba'i sdom pa blangs te srung ba las slan chad mar 'tshal pa'i sdom pa blangs te ā tsārya glang sna gru tshugs su bskyal/ de nas lang gro snang ba dang gsal snang gnyis kyis mkhan po bal yul du bskyal/ slar pho brang du log nas btsan pos rgya yul du pho nyar bka'as gnang ste bla nas dgongs pa 'grub na dngul chen po bla thabs su bu chen po la 'tshal bar gtsigs bcas/ btsan pos chos mdzad par zhang blon mtha' dag la thabs kyis bka' bstsal bar rje 'bangs chad byas te pho nya'i khang dpon sbran gtsang gzher 'og dpon du sang shi chos kyi spyan pa rba gsal snang bskos dpon g.yog sum bcu tsam mchi bar chas pa'i tshe/ rgya'i pho nya bum sangs dbang po'i drung na ju zhag mkhan mkhas pa nyin bzhin ju zhag brtsi ba zhig mchis pa des dbang po la gsol ba/ nub phyogs nas pho nya ba zhig de ring sang lam du zhuṭa te zla ba drug zhag drug gis bum sangs su phyin par mchi/ pho nya'i nang na byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gnyis shig mchis te de'i rtags dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra'o zer nas 'bag gnyis bris/ dbang pos rgya rje la pho nya btang ste gsol ba dang bka' 'a na du byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis 'ongs pa dang rim gro phu dud skyeng la der sdod du ma gzhug par mar thong zhig zhes byung / zla ba'i dus bzhin pho nyas bum sangs su phyin tshe spyan pa dang 'og dpon 'bag bris pa dang mi17

mthun nas dar gyi lding khang du bcug nas rim gro dang phu dud bskyed de shing rta la bskyon/ pho nya gzhan rnams rta la bskyon nas keg shir phyin pa'i tshe sngar byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gnyis mchi bar grags pas ming yang dar khang dar khang zer/ bshul thog thog du ha shang dang rgya 'bangs dad pa can sprin bzhin du 'dub te pho nya lding khang can gnyis la mchod pa cher bgyis nas keg shir bskyal/ rgya rjes kyang rtsig ngos dang nam mkha' kun dar gyis g.yogs te bkab nas bdung spos dang rol mos bsus te mchod nas ci dga' bar rang nyams su gnang / rba gsal snang khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' yin nges sngar 'bag bris pa yang 'di yin/ ha shang mngon shes can na re khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' rta skad rgya ba'i sprul pa yin no yang zer/ nga'i thugs su khyod las 'thad pa ma byung na khyod la bya dga' ci 'dod pa byin no zhes bka' bstsal ba las gsal snang gis gsol ba/ rje'i zhal mthong ste glo ba dga' ba'i steng du bka' lung snyan pa de las bya dga' che ba ma mchis na gzhan ci yang mi 'tshal te sgom lung 'bogs pa'i hā shang zhig dang sprad par ci gnang zhes gsol ba dang rgyal pos gnang chen nyung ngu zhig rgya rje'i gu rub la bskyon nas btang ba og chur phyin te ha shang bkug ste mchis pa de las sgom lung dang man ngag nod de 'gro khar gsal snang la rgya bye'u shog srang brgya pa cig dang / dar yug lnga brgya/ phra men gyi bya dang phra men gyi gzhong pa srang brgya pa zhig mu tig sran ma tsam 'dom gang ba phreng bcu/ za 'og be'u ben tse han yug gcig ste bya dga' gzhan pas lhag par dpags te btsal/ bod kyi btsan po'i bka' shog gi sgrom bu dang bstun pa'i chad byas/ btsan po la skyes su dar yug khri/ phra men gyi zhwa dang bla gor gyi sder ma 'dom gang pa zhig bskur/ pho nya gzhan rnams la'ang bya dga' che thang du bstsal nas mchid 'a na dang bcas te slar bod yul du mchis/318

bod yul du btsad pos zhang blon rnams la sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad par bka' bgrordo ma thag du gsal snang slebs te skyes tsho phul nas phyag byas te sug las grub po zhes gsol lo zhes byung ngo / /kun mkhyen buri chos byung du hā zhang mngon shes mkhan gyis pho nya 'ong thes 'bag byas zhes snang yang ju zhag ni rtsis mkhan yin gyi ha shang min la hā shang ni rgya nag gi rab byung bsam gtan pa'i ming yin no/ o ṭun gyi mkhan po spyan drangs tshul la mkhan po nyid kyi rnam thar dang lo rgyus mang dag las/ mkhan po bodhis twas sngon bya rdze ma'i bu spun bzhis mchod rten bya rung kha shor bal yul du bzhengs nas mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams 'dul ba'i phyir rgyal po dang / 'dul 'dzin dang / sngags mkhan dang /pho nyar smon lam rim bzhin btab ste da lta rgyal po nyid dang / nga dang / padma sambha wa dang / rba gsal snang rnams yin pas smon lam gyi mthus spyan 'drongs so zhes lung bstan/ rgyal po thugs sgam pas rmi lam du byung ba skad bgyis te rba gsal snang dang seng mgo lha lung gzigs gnyis la g.yog tu rna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ lce dzha na siddhi mchims shākya brabha brang ti dza ya rakṣi ta/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge dang lnga slob dpon spyan 'dren du btang bas slob dpon gyis mkhyen te bal yul yang le shod nas rdzu 'phrul gyis mang yul gung thang du byon/ pho nya ba rnams kyis mjal bas sku la mos pa thob/ phyag rten gyi gser phye bskur ba phul ba gtor nas ma 'ongs par der gser kha 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs/ pho nya rnams 'phangs sems skyes pas rdo dang gseg ma la 'khar sil bsnun pas thams cad gser du gyur/ mang yul gyi ri g.yas g.yon spo ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pas dad de gshegs par gsol bas da lta 'dre rnams 'dul zhing phyi la 'ong / mngal skyes kyis lha 'dre'i zer mi thub pas sngon la song zhig gsungs te byin gyis brlabs nas btang / zhang zhung gi lha mu tsa men gyis 319

ri bar du bcar bar byas pa gseg shang gi yu ba bsnun pas ri phan tshun du bye ste slob dpon steng gi nam mkha' la byon/ kha la rong sgor bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis thog phab pa phyag mthil du chu blug pa ltar bzed de khrug mi thigs pa sran ma tsam du song / 'u yug du rdo rje legs bas bsus shing mchod/ gangs dkar mas tho btsams pa slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas gangs zhu ste dpal mtsho'i nang du bros/ sdigs mdzub bstan pas mtsho'i khol te keng rus su lhags song / mtsho khar yer byung ba la rdo rje bsnun pas mig gcig zhar te sha med gangs dkar rdo rje spyan gcig ma zhes btags/ gnyan chen thang lharnga sbrul chen po'i gzugs kyis lam bkag pa phyag 'khar bsnun pas dri za zur phud lnga par byas te gdugs tshod drangs/ gnam sman dkar mo dang byang sman ting lo btsun gyis sku la lhags pa btang bas ma tshugs par zil gyis mnan/ g.yar mo thang la sogs par rdzu 'phrul gyis byon ste mdo khams kyi lha 'dre btul/yar lha sham pos g.yag dkar po ri tsam du sprul te tho btsams pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas sna nas bzung / zhags pa dang lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas bsdams/dril bu'i phyag rgyas btsogs pas7bka' nyan/ rma chen sbom ra btul/ lha 'dre de thams cad kyis so sor srog sing phal dam la btags/ mal gro gzi can la nya ༄klu gter bcug zhab smad thang lha'i mtsho mal gro'i sogs na dmyal ba nyi tshe ba'i gnas chu thams cad zangs zhun ltar 'khol zhing sa gzhi lcags bsregs pa 'dra ba nam mkha' la bya rgyu ba yang 'tshig zhing lhung ba de lta bu mang du yod pa rnams su dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdzad de gzungs chu dang bye ma gtor bas dmyal ba pa rnams dag pa'i zhing du drangs/ dmyal ba'i me zhi ste sa gzhi yul du rung bar gyur/ pho brang rlung tshubs su btsan po dang mjal ste zhabs la btugs/bsam yas kyi sa'i dpyad mdzad/ phyogs kyis spos pa bzhi la gter ka dang 320

mtshams kyi 'grams pa bzhi la me btsa' mdzad/ nam mkhar rdo rje'i gar mdzad pa'i grib ma gang byung du btsags pas lcags ri zur mang rdo rje 'gros su byung / mi ma yin thams cad bran du bskul te rgyal chen bzhis lag dpon byas nas brtsigs pas nyin mo mis brtsigs pa las mtshan mo lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho zhing shing gzo la sogs pa thams cad legs par byung / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang yongs su rdzogs pa rgyal po'i thugs dgongs mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /'di dag tu mkhan po bo dhi sa twas rgyal po la phyag byas pa de bzhin du slob dpon yang mdzad de 'ong snyam nas rgyal pos phyag ma mdzad pa la mgur bzhengs bya ba sogs 'dug pa ni phyi rabs su lhad bcug par dogs te rab byung gi gzugs tsam la yang 'dud dgos pa sogs sngar gyi bka' khrims yin la/ rgya gar na sangs rgyas kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i rab byung lta zhog phyi rol pa'i kun tu rgyu dang bram ze sogs kyang rgyal po la phyag mi byed de rgyal po dang phrad na rgyal ba dang tshe dpel ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug par byed la/rgyal pos de dag la phyag byed par bshad cing / bod du rab byung rnams khyim pa'i dpon la phyag byed pa ni rje sa skya paṇḍita hor go dan gyi nad sel ba la 'byon pa'i tshe sa skyar dpon checa shākya bzang po bskos nas 'u yug pa dang shas rin pa ma gtogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal du bcug pa phyin nas dar ba yin pas phyi rabs kyi 'dra bzo byas nas bcug par snang la/ gzhan yang gter bton re/ gangs kyi seng ge re/ khyung re/ u dusmra ra'i me tog re rnams dus mnyam skye la gter bton rgyal rigs sogs rigs bzhi po gang du skye bar u dusmra ra'i me tog dkar ser dmar sngo tha dad pa rer skye par bris pa sogs lhad mang du bcug snang ste mdo las u dusmra ra'i me tog ni rdzing bu dal 'bab kyi 'gram na u dusmu ra'i tshal yod pa las gzhan du mi skye 321

la der u duslu ra'i shing lo mang ba can rtag du skye yang me tog ni sangs rgyas dang 'khor lob/ bsgyur ba nam 'byung ba'i tshe ma gtogs mi 'byung zhing de 'das pa na me tog de bskams par gsungs la/ 'dul ba lung las kyang kun tu rgyu rab bzang gis tshal der rtag par gnas pa las me tog de mtshan mar bzung nas de skams su nye bar mthong ba na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' bar shes te phyin nas rab tu byung bar bshad la/ sngags las kyang / u dusmra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'gazha zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo //zhes 'chad pa yin no/ /des na gter bton re la u dusmra ra'i me tog skye na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang skyes bu ngo mtshar ba thams cad la yang skye dgos pas mdo sngags gnyis ku'i sgrom 'jig cing mi shes pa rnams kyis lhad 'di lta bu btab pas chos kyi rnam grangs chud zos par byas te dpyod ldan rnams dogs pa'i gnas su gyur cing chos spong la ji mi snyam pa rnams gsang sngags rnying ma mtha' dag la skur ba 'debs pa 'di byung ba yin no/ /rba bzhed las ni mkhan po bo dhi sa twas spyan drangs par 'dod par snang ste de nyid las/ gsal snang rgya nag nas 'khor ma thag du btsan pos da ni bo dhi sa twa spyan drongs zhes bka' bstsal nas gsal snang gis kyang bo bhi sa ta spyan 'dren du bal yul du mchis pa dang bo dhi sa twas kyang padma sambha wa dang lha khang rtsig pa'i phya mkhan dang gnyis mang yul du spyan drangs te bsdongs 'dug pas mkhan po gnyis ka gsal snang gis mang yul nas gzings bcas nas chu klung na spyan drangs 'u yug gi thad kur gshegs pa dang padma sambha wa'i zhal nas sang gi gro lam ni nyi tshe ba'i dmyal khams shig yod kyis snying rje zhig bya dgos gsungs nas gzings las bab ste 'u yug du gtor ma dang dgongs pa mdzad pas chab 'jam tsam du gyur/ de nas gnam gyi chu khol du byon nas der snga dro 322

gcig dgongs pa mdzad pas chu yang 'jam tsam red ste rlangs pa chad pa yang zhag gsum tsam bgyis/ de nas gal te la yang zer gshe chu la bshul phyung nas gshegs pa dang / bod khams su chos mdzad du mi ster ba'i klu dkar po'i phru gu mi srun pa cig yod pa de dam 'og tu gzhug cing 'dul de'i drung na yang nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba zhig yod pas der yang snying rje zhig bya dgos gsungs nas 'dam snying drung du byon pa dang / klu tshangs pa bya ba'i mi tshan gcig na re mkhan po la gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i thabs blta zhes zhus pa dang mkhan pos zangs khal tshad ma zhig phyung nas der lung bong gi ro zhig bcos nas zangs la zhabs bsnun nas spub pas thang lha khros te dgun zla 'bring po la gangs rtse la tug com byung / sprin nag po zhig yang chags nas ser ba bab/ glog dang 'brug sgra drag po byung / de phyin chad yul phyogs de dul te thab kyang sngon pas g.yung bar gyur/ de nas de nyid tu dgongs pa mdzad pa dang snying drung gi chu khol ba'i rlangs pa chad nas 'jam tsam du red pa zla ba gcig bgyis so/ /yang thang lha dam 'og du gzhug par dgongs pa dang thang lha'i gangs la sprin nag po chags glog dang 'brug dang ser ba bab pa dang mkhan po'i zhal nas klu phru gu mi srun pa cig rgya mtshor bros gsungs nas zhag gsum dgongs pa mdzad pas thug chom yang ma mchis/ yul yang 'jam par gyur/ klu dam la thogs te thang lhas bka' nyan du khas blangs gdugs tshod drangs so/ /de nas ma le shor byon nas 'phan yul gzigs pas yul ngan rta ro dmar po kha phye ba 'dra ba 'di la mi 'gro gsungs nas stod lungs ya ral na yar byon/ btsun mo phreng gi brag la a tsa ra 'gro 'phro la rengs pa 'dra ba 'di'i gong ma bcad na mu stegs can gyi rigs bod du 'chor gsungs nas bcad/ gzhong par gro thob gsungs nas chu ma mchis byas pas chab dbyung bar bya gsung nas gseg zhang gi yu ba sa 323

la thams thams brgyab pas chu kha ba~X byung ste gzhong pa'i lha chur grags/ snye 'phreng du nga'i gro ran gsung ba dang mkhar nag gi mtsho 'di la klu btsan drab/ po 'dug pas 'dul lo gsungs/ 'di shin tu thu ba zhig 'dug pas 'drodel byed cig bya gsungs nas brag la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sku zhig bskyed pas rang byung du byung / bal po'i rdo mkhan na re bod kyi rdo la ཿgzo btub mi btab blta'o zer nas brag la sha ba'i gzugs cig brkos so/ /de nas ngam shod la byon zur mkhar 'phrang la rdo'i mchod rten lnga mdzad/ za hor gyi mkhan po pho brang du gshegs nas btsan po la brda sbyar/ btsan po bsus te phyag mdzad pas slob dpon gyis bsnyun rmed/ slob dpon gyis pha bang zhig la phyag g.yas pa'i thal mo phyir mdzad pas pha bang shags kyis gas/ da phyags gar 'bebs ces pa la/ sang shis de'i bar brag dmar mgrin bzang 'khor sa sgo ma mchis pa zhig la nang lha khang rgya'i de'u shan la dpe blang sa pa zhig bzhengs tshar nas der phyags phebs par zhus/ de dus ā tsabyabo dhi sa twas btsan po la gsol ba/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i tshe lha ma srin dam 'og du ma tshud pa ma mchis par rigs pa la bod yul na dam 'og du ma tshud pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can mang du mchis pas btsan po chos mdzad du mi ster ba la da lta 'dir dzaspu3 gling na nus pa che ba'i padma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di spyan drangs nas bzhugs pas sngon chos mdzad du mi ster bar 'phang thang du chu bo che gtong ba dang / sham po'i gangs bsnyil/ bod khams su mi nad phyugs nad dang mu ge lo lngar 'bebs pa/ lha sa'i mkhar du thog 'bebs shing mes gtong ba sogs gzigs ltas ngan pa gtong zhing bar chad bgyid pa'i bgegs rnams ri rab ngos kyi rgyal po chen po bzhi mi la phab ste de'i than las byung ba bzhin dam la 'dogs pa'i cho ga ni sngags mkhan 'dis rngo thogs/ btsan po 324

chos mdzad pa /ga rtsod cing rgol ba byung na phyi rgol gyi gtan tshigs smra ba ni kho bo las mkhas nga ma mchis/ gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i ltas dang bkra shis mi shis dang chos tshugs mi tshugs rtog pa'i phya mkhan mkhas pa 'di tsam du gzhan na med pas khrid de 'ongs pa yin/ de ltar mdzad na rgyal po'i dgongs pa yang 'grub bo ces gsungs so/ /der sang shis mgrin bzang gi mnga' gsol ba slob dpon padma la zhu'o ces zhus te rgyal po'i gnang chen gzims mal ba kun yang mchis/ slob dpon padmas lha mnga' gsol bas lha thams cad nas nang nas bkad sar byon/ nam phyed na blon po rnams kyis mar me khyer nas bltas pas nang na 'jim gzugs gcig kyang med de stong bar 'dug nang par bltar phyin pas 'jim gzugs thams cad snga ma kho na bzhin nang na bzhugs nas slob dpon padmas mchod pa byed/ lha rnams gtam smra ba dang bshos gsol ba mthong / mar me thams cad rang 'bar rol mo thams cad rang 'khrol spos thams cad rang bsregs cing 'thul/ 'phan lnga btags pa lnga brgyar 'phel/cong rang brdung zhing 'khrol/ rgun 'brum rdog po snyim pa tsam pa de sus kyang 'tshal bar rngo ma thogs/ de'i nang par slob dpon padmas dkyil 'khor bris te gzims mal ba lha lung 'tsho bzher snyan legs la pra rten byas te pra se na ta phab ste smrar bstsal bas bod kyi klu mi srun pa ril gyi ming smras te 'phang thang du chu phab pa sham po/ lha sar thog 'bebs pa thang lha/ mu ge dang lo nyes dang mi nad gtong ba bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa kun smras/ de'i sang rigs bzang po'i bu tsha pha ma mes phyi tshang ba bcu tsam bsags te pra rten bgyis nas rgyal po chen po bzhi'i pra phab/ gnod sbyin me lhas zhal mngon sum du bstan/lha klu ma rungs pa dngos su mi la phab nas padma sambha was bsdigs shing gzer/dkar po la chos bshad nas dam la 'dogs pa ni bo dhi sa twas mdzad/ des 325

ma thul ba padma sambha was sbyin sreg mdzad nas ma mchis par byas/ de 'dra ba lan gnyis bgyis te slob dpon padma'i zhal nas lha klu dam 'og du tshud lags te da dung de 'dra ba lan gcig bgyid 'tshal/ slan chad lha chos ci bder mdzad pa dang gtsug lag khang dgongs pa bzhin du rtsigs shig gsung / /zur phud rkyang du tshal du klu btul bas gzi can dngos su byung nas sa'i steng na rgyal po khri srong lde btsan che/ sa'i 'og na rgyal po nga che bas nged cag grogs po byas la rgyal po lha khang rtsig pa'i gser phye khal bcu bzhi byin gyis gser khung glang po snar len du thong zer nas phul/ sham po btul bas slob dpon gyi thog du chu phab/ slob dpon gyi sbas sna nas rdo rje gdengs pas chu gyen la log ste lha rdzing du ming chags/ rdo rje brgyab pas chu khol/ sham po kho rang gangs zhu ba'i rtse la bsdad nas slob dpon nga la de tsam du tho 'tsham zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod nga la de bas de tsam du tho 'tsham pa/ da nga'i dam 'og du ma zhugs na khyod sreg go gsungs pas/ nga nag po'i rigs yin chos bgyi ba'i skabs ma mchis da man chad gnod pa mi bya'o nga'i drung du ser chags ma btang zhig zer nas dam bcas/ de nas da dung sbyin sreg zhig bgyi'o gsung ba dang /btsan po dbu 'khru bar bzhed pa la bo dhe sa twa'i zhal nas bod kyi btsan po dbu bsil zer na chab gang nas len gsungs pas bzheng bla na re 'om bu tshal nas len zhes gsol/ mkhan po'i zhal nas ri rab kyi byang ngos na chu mig rta rna bya ba yod/ de nas chu blangs te dbu bsil na rgyal po sku tshe yang ring / lha sras rigs rgyud kyang 'phel/ chab srid kyang che/ dgos rgu yang 'grub pas chab de sus len nus gsung ba rgyal po'i snyan du gsan nas bsgrags pa'i sar mkhan po padma sambha wa'i zhal nas de ngas rngo thogs gsungs nas ga sha'i 'og nas bkra shis kyi bum pa gser las bgyis pa cig phyung ba la kha dar dkar gyis 326

bcang bzhir blas rgyas btab ste mkhan pos sngags btab nas nam mkha' la 'phangs bas je mtho je tshutho la mi snang bar song / dar cig nas dzapra khang du rma bya'i spros byabs pa dang zan za yun tsam na bum pa nam mkha' la ser rgyang gis slob dpon gyi pang du byung / kha phye bas chu 'o ma 'dra bas gang 'dugades dbu khrus zhes blon po kun la gtad nas 'dun sar brims pa las 'dun sa chung ngu nas lung gsal ba/ 'di mon gyi smyo chu yin te sku'i rim gror mi sman pas pho la thong zhes ma mchis par bgyis/ gzhan yang slob dpon padma'i zhal nas bod byin skyid par bgyi pas be shu wa ṇa las nor bslangs te nor med pa la nor sbyin/ dzasbu gling gi dkor khung srid do cog kyang bod khams su 'byung bar bya/ ngam shod gra dol stag la phu sogs chu dkon pa dang chung ba rnams su chu phyung la gram pa thams cad zhing du byas la zhing gis bod kun 'tsho bar bya/ gtsang po dang mtsho kun sgroms su bcug la mis 'phyong du rung bar bya/ ngas o rgyan du gtsang po 'di bas che ba zhig sbubs su bcug gsungs/ngam shod kyi bye ma thams cad tshal dang ne gsing du bsgyur/ bod yul ngan pa kun bzang por byas te thams cad nyams dga' bar bya'o zhes de ltar mkhan pos rgya chen por gsungs pa dang / 'grub bam mi 'grub 'dun sa chung ngu nas rje blon sol te bka' gros mdzad nas de ltar 'ong mi 'ong nyam sad pa las o rgyan gyi mkhan pos snga dro gcig bsgoms pas mtsho mo mgur gyi bye ma'i zhabs nee gsing du sngo phyur la btang / de'i phyi 'breng brag dmar gla ba tshal gyi smad nags su btang / klu rdzingal su chu byung / da dung nyam sod dang byas nas snga dro gcig bsgoms pas zur mkhar nas chu rjen nar gyis byung ste chu mig byung ba dang 'ong nges par 'dug pas blon po dag na re bod yul bzang por byas pa'i sngags mkhan gyi mthu dang sbyar na chab srid rgya gar gyis phrogs te 327
