'gro zhes 'dun sa chung ngur gros byas nas 'phro 'gum par chad de slob dpon gyis da zhing bya'o gsungs pas zhing yar lungs kyis cho ga zer te sngags mkhan la phyag byas te bya dga' chen po phul nas slar rgya gar du bzhud par zhu ba phul bas rgyal po ma dgyes nas slob dpon la gser phye bre gang phul phyag dang bskor ba byas te sngar ltar zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas nga gser 'dod pa ma yin he bod mtha' 'khob tu 'dre srin gdug pa can btul la btsan po chos byar btub par bya/ bod yul bzang por byas la 'bangs bde ba la dgod pa'i phyir 'ongs kyi gser 'dod na 'di tsug byas pas chog gsungs nas mkhan pos rdo dang shing dang rtsa dang bye ma sogs phyag gis bzung tshad reg tshad gser phyer red de btsan po'i thugs srung ba'i ched du gser phye khyor gang bsnams/ lhag ma btsan po rang la phul te brag dmar 'om bu tshal du rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa gcig la man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad nas/ rgyal po chen po nga'i gsang sngags 'di lta ba chos kyi sku dang bstun/ spyod pa byang chub kyi phyogs dang bstun/ lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor bar mdzod/ shor na dge med sdig med du song nas chad par lta ba skyes nas phyis gsor mi rung / spyod pa'i phyogs su lta ba 'brengs nas dngos po'i mtshan mas bcings nas grol bar mi 'gyur/ nga'i sngags sems phyogs 'di lta ba shas che ste ma 'ongs pa na tshig gi don mi shes/ rgyud la 'khel ba'i lta ba'i gdeng ni med cing ma rnyed nas mang po cig ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lta spyod ya ma bral ba 'ga'as sems can mang po'i don yang byed par 'gyur/ spyir gang zag gis bcos te 'dra min mang bas byin rlabs nyams pas rtogs pa can nyung / 2 ma bslad pa 'di kun sbas na nam zhig las can 'ga' zhig gi don du 'gyur gsungs nas dpe mang po cig rdza la sbas so/ /btsan po la dbang rim mdzad nas theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi lung gnang /328

phur bu 'bum sde bshad nas smon lam 'og min gyi gnas su gdab gsung ste/bdag dang gtan pa med pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud gar skyesdo kyang / /'og min zhing mchog dag par lhan cig tu/ /rnal 'byor theg chen 'bras bu spyod par shog /ces gsungs nas sbyin sreg gi 'phro ma grub par slar gshegs/ skyel mis chibs khrod nas yar la spyan drangs/ mkhan po rgya gar yul du skyel mi btang ba dang / blon po kha cig na re sngags mkhan de ma bsad na de nus pa che ste bod la byad byas par 'ong bas 'dun sa nas bcad de gsod mi bco brgyad btang zer nas dong phabs kyi 'phrang la bsgugs pa dang slob dpon dpon g.yog mang yul du slebs te byon pa'i dgongs mo sang ni 'o cag la gnod 'tshe byed pa 'ong ngo zhes skyel mi rnams la gsungs/ 'phrang du byon pa dang stag snar gsod mi bco brgyad po rnams kyis la las mda' bkang /la las mdung mnan/ la las gri phyung ste slob dpon la rdeg par byas pa'i tshe slob dpon gyis phyag rgya bcings pas mi bco brgyad pos smra yang ma shes brdeg pa bas 'gul yang ma nus te 'jim gzugs dang gyang ris bzhin du rengs pa'i nang nas gshegs te mang yul gyi la khar byon nas skyel mi kun brdzangs pa las mkhan po'i zhal nas bod khams su lha klu 'dre srin dam 'og du lan gsum bcug na btsan po yang sku tshe ring / dbon sras chab srid che/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang yun ring du gnas pa cig na 'phro lus pa yid la gcags/ chos 'khor gcig ni 'byongs nas 'ong ste spyir sangs rgyas kyi chos gang byung sar mu stegs kyi 'gran zla re byung nas rtsod pa byed dgos pa la bod khams su chos byung ba lnga brgya'i tha ma la bab pa las chos ma byung bas mu stegs kyi rgal ba ni mi 'byung na sangs rgyas pa nyid nang rtsod pa cig tu 'gyur/ chos la yang rked nyag phag re 'ong / bod khams su 'khrug pa chen po cig kyang 'byung zhes bka' 329

bstsal te skyel mi rnams la yungs dkar par gang gtad nas nga la mda' 'phen pa rnams la thob cig dang dod 'gro nus par 'gyur ro gsungs nas skyel mi mir la ldog da re zhig mi yul na nga la gdul bya med gsungs nas lho nub mtshems su srin po 'dul du 'gro gsungs te chibs kha nas 'phur nas sprin gyi gse/ba na phar chos gos spur re gseg shang khrol le bzhud/ skyel mis gsung bsgon du dong phabs kyi gsod mi 'bag bris pa bzhin song ba rnams la yungs dkar btab pa dang 'gro nus cing smra shes par gyur to/ /skyel mi rnams pho brang du phyin nas ji skad gsung ba bzhin lo rgyus snyan du gsol bas btsan po yang thugs la rab tu bcags par gyur to/ /ces byung ngo / des na rba bzhed las bsam yas kyi rmang ma bting bar slob dpon srin yul du gshegs pa 'idra ba zhig snang ba 'di ni slob dpon chen po'i lo rgyus rnams phyogs gcig du bsdebs nas bris pa cig yin pa snyam ste bsam yas rab gnas la slob dpon chen po nges par bzhugs pa 'khor sa'i ri mo la gsal ba dang / bka' gtsigs chen mor/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lha 'dre zil gnon zhes pa blangs//ces byung ngo / /spyir slob dpon chen pos btsan po la nang gi skyed rdzogs ste gsum bstan nas smin grol du mdzad/ btsan pos kyang btsun mo mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal dbang yon du phul bas blon po rnams ma rangs te sngon du btsun mo phrogs da ni rgyal srid 'phrog par nges so zer nas slar gshegs par bgro ba zhig byung bar snang bas blon po rnams kyis zhus par slar gshegs pa ltar byas nas rgyal po dang bka' bgros te bod kyi tsā ri tra dang mkhar chu la sogs pa'i gnas rnams daja g.ya' khrod dang gangs khrod sogs mi ma yin gyi gnas rnams su spyan drangs te gtso bor mi ma yin gyi don mdzad nas slar bsam yas su gshegs par snang la sa skya bla ma dam pa'i chos byung las kyang de 'dra 330

bar bshad do/ /chos dang bon du rtsod de bon rnams bsnubs/ /lci zhing btsa)na ba'i bka' yi 'dems kha bod/ /kun gyis lha khang mthar phyin sgrub par zhus/ /la gzhi gser gzhong gur gum bkang 'dra bar/ /yos bu'i lo la lha khang rmang bting nas/ /o 3spu ri'i gnas la dpe blangs te/ /dbu rtse rigs gsum dbus kyi ri rab mchog /phyogs rer gling gsum gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /nyi zla'i tshul du yag sha ltag 'og gnyis/ /mthil kun dkar zhal rgya mtsho'i ri mo can/ /phyi rol khor yug tshul du lcags ri'i rtser/ /ring bsrel can gyi nachod rten stong rtsa brgyad/ /ri rab lhun po'i rwa rtse'i tshul du ni/ /'byung ba'i kha gnon mchod rten rnam bzhir bcas/ /phyi ltar gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams kyi tshul/ /nang ltar zhing khams chen po gcig gi tshul/ /gsang ba pho brang dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul/ /byang chub phyogs chos so bdun yongs rdzogs pa/ /dzaspuri/ gling na 'gran zla bral bar bzhengs/ /rang byung ma hā bo dhi la sogs pa'i/ /rten rnams mchog gi sprul sku dngos su bzhugs/ /btsun mo gsum gyis lha khang re re bzhengs/ /spyi yi bka' srung gang 'thad bgros ba na/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma'i zhal snga nas/ /rje la zhal ngo bdud kyi sprul pa 'byung / /dam chos bsnubs pa'i dbang gis rgyal khrims 'jig /de tshe gnam the dkar po'i sprul pa yi/ /hor gyis bod khams dbang byed sdug bsngal 'god/ /de bas hor gyi pho lha shing bya can/ /gnam lha byang chub srung mar bskos pa na/ /'jig mi nus pas de nyid dgug go gsung / /bai har gling du rgyal po'i rten bcas te/ /ta ra klu gong la sogs dmag dpung gis/ /hor gyi sgom gra bcom nas rten rnams khyer/ /o rgyan chen po phyag rdor dngos su bzhengs/ /rgyal chen rnam sras bran du bkol nas ni/ /de yis gnod sbyin dmag dpung kun bskul te/ /lha yi dge bsnyen bdud kyi dmag dpon che/ /331

sde brgyad dbang byed skye 'gro'i dbugs len pa/ /be har rgyal bo las mkhan bcas pa bkug /dam la btags te chos 'khor gnyer du btad/ /'di yi bkod pa'i gsi thang 'byung ba la/ /rnams sras 'jang yul ma zhes grags pa yin/ /de ltar chos 'khor chen po dpal bsam yas/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / /yid kyis dpag par dka' ba'i bkod pa can/ /'dzam gling tsam na 'gran zla bral ba de/ /yos kyi lo la rmang bting yos los 'byongs/ /lo bskor gcig gis rdzogs par tshar ro skad/ /de yang bsam yas kyi dkar chag chen mor grags pa rba bzhed las/ de nas chos kyi 'dun sa ni brag dmar mtsho mo mgur du phub/ gsal snang ni chos kyi tshugs dbon blar bskos nas dus der bon po dang bon blon rnams kha log ste chos mi byed bon bya'o zer bas bo dhi sa twa'i zhal nas rgyal khams gcig tu chos lugs gnyis byung na shin tu sdig che/ 'o cag rtsod pa byas la khyed rgyal na nga 'gro bon spel/chos rgyal na bon bsnubs la dam pa'i lha chos bya gsung / slad kyis chos dang bon 'gran par chad na de la dpang po med/ de nas phag gi lo la pho brang zur phud rkyang bu tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe chos kyi kha 'dzin zhang nya bzang dang /gnyer stag btsan gshong gzigs dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / nyang sho ma dang bzhi bo bhi sa twa'i kha 'dzin dang shags 'debs su bskos/ bon gyi kha 'dzin ngam ta ra klu gong / rtsis pa chen po khyung bo dum tshugs/ khyung po rtse ba che mi dang cog la sogs bskos te rtsod pa las bon khungs ngan la gtan tshiṭa chung / lha chos khungs bzang la gtan tshigs rgya che zab la gting ring shags bzang la rno ste ma thub nas 'phan yul gyi byi bon pos bsgyur ba'i gshin khugs pa thams cad kyang bse rags su gyur pas phyin chad bon bgyid du mi gnang bar chad/ gshin gyi phyir gnag rta dang srog chags gsod pa dang sha 332

'debs su mi gnang / rje'i sku rim dang bar chad sel ba la 'dre srin la dus bon re byed na tshe mi dang zhang zhung ma gtogs gzhan bgyid du mi gnang bar bcang ste bon gyi dpe kun chu la bskur/ lhag ma phyis mchod rten nag por mnan no/ /de nas slan chad chos bya ba dang lha khang rtsig par chad pa dang / blon po mgos bshums pa la btsan pos bka' bstsal pa/ khyod lha chos bya zhing lha khang rtsig par mi dga' 'am/ blon pos gsol pa/ lha chos ni bzang na nga tshos byed yong rtsa na rgas gtugs pas mi len te blo ba la bcags mod/ rje lha gcig dam chos/ de yang gting re zab/mon bu de yang smra re mkhas/ ces gsol ba dang 'o na blon chen 'or che gsungs nas sho la ges so/ /de nas shākya mu ni slar mang yul nas spyan drang bar byas te rta pa gcig gis pang du blangs nas spyan drangs te ra mo cher bzhuṭa so/ /de nas yos bu'i lo'i dpyid bsam yas kyi rmang 'dings par chad tsam na gsal snang gis bla'i gtsug lag khang ma brtsigs par slas kyi lha khang bzhengs su gsol/ rba pha tshan bon bgyid du mi gnang bar chos la bkod/ rba lha gzigs kyis grogs po nyang ro kong gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas nas chos bslabs dge bsnyen gyi khrims lnga phog nyang ro kong gis kyang pha tshan phu nu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas te nyang ril dkar por bsgyur/ de nas yos bu'i lo de nyid la bsam yas rtsig par chad de bka' bgros pa las blon po mgos kyi mchid nas/ rje gcig lags thabs kyis ma mdzad na bod 'bangs kha log nas chos bgyir mi btub thugs dam bzheng ba'ang mi 'grub pas gdam ka bor ba zhig bgyi bar mchi zhes lkog tu chad nas bod 'bangs kun tshogs te 'dus pa na rjes bka' bstsal ba/ dzasbu gling na bod kyi rgyal po che/ bod kyi rgyal po la nga bas che ba ni sngar ma byung na nga la phyag ris med pa 5 da nga phyag ris che ba 333

zhig byed pas khyed bod 'bangs mdzangs pa rnams glengs ces gsung pas blon chen mgos rgan na re/ /rje'i bka' bstsal ni 'dud pas gnyan/ khrims kyi la rtse ni dgung bas mtho/ /phyag rjes gang mdzad pa bka' lung zhu'o zhes gsol ba dang rje'i zhal nas nga'i mkhar po che zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba zhig rtsig gam/ /shel gyi mchod rten shar ri tsam pa zhig rtsig gam/ /wa lung grog po gser phyes 'gengs sam/ /has po ri zangs kyis btums nas gzer mgo thams cad nang du bstan pa zhig bya'am/ gtsang po 'di zangs kyi sbubs su bcug la 'phyong du rung ba zhig bya'am/ /ka chu'i thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa 'bru'am/ /lha khang bre tsam pa zhig rtsig gam de rnams gang byed 'doms shig ces bka' bstsal bas rje'i bka' lung che la sgrub dka' bas gdam ka gang yang khas len par ma phod de 'bangs kun bred pa dang / zhang nya bzang na re/ rje gcig lags mkhar po che de lta bu 'phros na 'jig che na mi 'byongs/ shel rin po che dka' bas mchod rten de tsam yang mi 'byongs/ /wa lung grog po gser phye bas bye mas kyang mi khengs/ /has po ri bzar bu tshun zangs su song yang mi 'thums/ /gtsang po sbubs su dgun chud kyang dbyar 'khyer/ /ka chu'i thang la khron pa 'dom gang brus pas chu rdol 'ong na dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gcig ji ltar bru/ lha khang bre tsam pa zhig bya/ de las 'os cang gda' 'am zer/ bod 'bangs dga' nas de la 'or che btab/ ta ra klu gong chos la gnag pas sba lcag sa la brdabs nas lha khang rtsig pa de chos yin pas nga mi dga' nged rang bon bya zer bas/ rjes zhal nas nga'i bka' gcog pa ta ra byang du sprugs shig gsung bas 'bangs sgab mi gnyis kyis rtswa thag gis btags te tsher lcag gis 'brab cing byang du sgyugs so/ /des 'bangs kun bred nas cang mi zer ro/ /de nas lha khang gi sa brtag pa'i 334

phyer mkhan po dang / btsan po dang / gsal snang dang / gnyer gdo ra gzigs te bzhis has po ri'i rtser phyin te bltas pa las/ de tsam la bsam yas kyi gzhi de skya ba thor re ba rtsi skya can 'jag skya phyod de mchis pa las gong bcad de slob dpon gyis sa dpyad mdzad pa ni/ shar ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ has po ri btsun mo dar dkar gyi go zu gyon pa 'dra/ ri nag lcags phur btab pa 'dra/ me yar dre'u chu 'thung ba 'dra bas bzang /sa gzhi 'di 'khar gzhong gur gum gyis bkang ba 'dra bas thugs dam 'dir bzhengs na bzang bar lung bstan/ phyag 'khar gyis phyag bris mdzad/ chibs bres kyi ra ba zhig rtsig ces bsnyad btags nas rtswa'i spyi bo bsdus te mdud pas tho yor ltar bskor nas phyi ra sngon la brtsigs zhes byung ngo / /rgyal rabs gzhan las rgya'i rtsis mkhan gyis sa'i dpyad 'di byas par yang bshad la/btsan pos lcags ri la nga rang gi mda' rgyang gang byed gsung ba la blon po rnams kyis de ni phal ba'i mda' rgyang gsum las ring bas mda' de blon po'i mda' la mdzad par zhu dgos zhes mda'i nang dngul chus bkang ste phul ba 'phangs pas sngar gyi sum cha tsam du lus/ blon po'i 'phrul du mkhyen nas bod kyi bsod nams la de bas ma shong gsung ste phal ba'i mda' rgyang phyed dang gnyis logs re la yod do/ /thog mar sa phud rdo phud yer par phul te mchod rten bzhengs/ lha sar sa phud la 'phrul snang gi gtsang khang dbus ma'i sgo srung rgyal chen bzhi byas/ shing gi phud las sgo mo che rta babs kyis brgyan pa phul lo/ /brtsigs tshul dngos ni rba bzhed las/ /de ltar sa brtag pa'i cho ga bgyis/ /de nas sa chog byas te ya rabs zhang blon gyi bu tsha pha ma mes phyi tshang ba bzhi btsan po dang lnga'i btsan pos gser gyi nan ri gsol gser gyi 'byor phyag tu bsnams/ bu tsha rnams rgyan gyis brgyan te rin po che'i snod du 335

sbog sngon 'tshal kha rgyags smra zhing thig 'then/ btsan pos thebs gsum brkos/ /de nas bu tsha bzhis re mos kyis brkos/ khru gang gru bzhir phyin pa dang 'bras dkar mo dang nas dkar mo phul do tsam ma 'dres par 'dug gram pa dang gyo mo sogs ni ma byung / /sa zhag skya nar zhig byung nas 'byor bzhag de la bo dhi sa twa rab tu dgyes te btsan po'i dbu la byugs te pha la pha la sidzhai siddhi gsungs/ de btsan pos ma go nas lo tsā ba la dris pas bzang ngo bzang ngo grub po grub po gsungs zer/ gzhan yang bgegs mnan dgos gsungs te mchod rten bzhi'i bla phur btab/ de nas rmang 'dings par zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yang jo mo sgrol ma las bskyed pa yin/ mthar sangs rgyas nas rdo rje'i gdan du chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba yang jo mo sgrol mas byed/ da lta thugs dam bzheng pa'i bar chad kyang jo mo sgrol mas sel ba yin pas sngon la jo mo'i sgrub khang rtsigs shig par lung phog ste rgyal pos kyang thog mar lho ngos su ārya pa lo'i gling brtsigs te thog phub pa dang / slob dpon khang pa legs te gzugs mkhan med ces btsan pos g.yol bas yo byad sogs shig gzugs mkhan 'ong gis gsung / hen khang bi har na tshur la rgya mtshal bu can nam rgya mtshal na mkhan yang zer ba zhig tshon rtsi'i kong bu kong tse gang khur/ pir chags gcig thogs te 'jim gzugs dang ri mo byed pa la dzasbu'i gling na nga mkhas te bod kyi rgyal po lha khang rtsig zer na ngas gzugs shes zer ba de bkug nas lha bzo na re lha rgya gar dang rgya'i lugs gang bgyi zer/ gros bgyis pas mkhan po'i zhal nas sangs rgyas rgya gar du byon pa yin pas rgya gar lugs su gyis gsung / btsan po'i zhal nas bod kyi lugs su bgyis na bod nag po la zhen pa rnams dad pa skyed re ba lags pas lha bod lugs su 336

bya bar ci gnang zhes zhas pas 'o na bod 'bangs gan bca ga shig bod ༄ ༄ bulugs su bya'o gsungs/ bod mi'i gzugs su bgyid pa'i dpe bod 'bangs tshogs pa las de'i nang nas gzugs bzang ba khu stag tshab ma bgyis te gtso bo ārya pa lo kharla pā ṇi bzhengs/ /thang bzang stag lod la dpe byas te yi ge drug pa g.yas su byas/ /rma gsang kong la dpe byas te rta mgrin sgo srung du byas/ /lha mo'i dpe bud med la mdzes pa cog ro bza' lha bu sman la dpe bgyis te sgrol ma g.yas su byas/ /cog ro bza' nu chung la dpe byas te 'od zer can ma g.yon du byas/ /lha kun char nas yo byad lta gon mdzad de nyi shu dgu'i gdugs la zhal sros pa'i tshe slob dpon gyis mchod pa bshams de nam sros pa dang lha khang gi steng ārya pa lo'i thog nas 'od nyi ma shar ba tsam zhig je che je cher gyur nas brag dmar phu mda' 'od kyis khyab/ /de'i rgyu zhus pas mkhan po'i zhal nas a mi tā bhas bod la dgongs pa'i 'od yin pas sang nyin lha khang dbus kyi steng du a mi tā bha'i lha khang yang thog zhig rtsig dgos gsung nas a mi tā bha gtso 'khor lnga'i lha khang zhig mod la brtsigs te zhal bsros/ /ārya pa lo'i zhal sro chen mo mdzad pa'i tshe gzugs mkhan la bya dga' bstsal bar bgyis te beg tse yang dar las byas pa gnyis bting bas gzugs mkhan gar song gtol ma mchis te sprul pa yin pa 'dra zhes so/ /de nas mkhan po'i zhal nas btsan po khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo mo sgrol ma yin pas thog mar sgrol ma la gsol ba thob bsnyen pa gyis shig gsungs/ slob dpon las lung nod nas ārya pa lo'i gling du bsgoms pas rta mgrin gyi skus rta skad nyin mtshan lan gsum du phyung ba rtse rgod rnams dang zham ring nang pa dang lha khang srung ba kun gyis thos/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas rgyal pos grub pa brnyes te rta mgrin gyis rta skad lan gsum du bton pa de dzaspu'i gling sum gnyis su thos te 337

rgyal po'i chab srid mnga' ris kyang de tsam mo gsung / de nas yos bu'i lo la dbu rtse'i rmang 'dings par zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa dzasbu'i gling na byin rlabs che ba zhig byed pas mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa ste mtshan nyid kyi sde snod thams cad dang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde kun dang mthun zhing mi 'gal ba 'gran gyi do med cig bgyi 'tshal gsungs/ slob dpon gyis de lta bu mkhyen tam zhus pas ngas shes te de lta bu zhig o ryarta pu ri na yod/ de ci 'dra zhus pas de ni sngon mu stegs kyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos ro sgrub byed pa la dngos sgrub len pa'i sgrub g.yog mtshan rtags dang ldan pa cig kun tu btsal pas ma rnyed pa la ma ga dha'i dge slong sgrub pa po la nye gnas shig yod pa de de'i mtshan rtags dang ldan nas dge slong la gser gyi maṭaṃl nye 'u bkram pa yang yang phul bas khyod nga las gdams ngag nod dam zer/ rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ khyod kyi nye gnas dpa' bo'i rtags can zhu'o byas pas des de la phul rṣa/ /de nas sgrub khang du phyin pa dang ro sog phon tsam pa zhig dkyil 'khor gyi steng na 'dug go /dge tshul khyod ro la dpa' ba'i rtags yod pas ma 'jigs par de'i lce chod cig lce de gser gyi ral grir song ba de gar gtad sar 'gro nus pa yinu te nga 'og min du rig 'dzin sgrub tu 'gro ba yin/ ro gser du gyur pa de khyod la rngan par sbyin no zer nas des mnyam par bzhag dge tshul ro la zhon nas lce gcod du bcug pa dang ro 'gul zhing mig 'phrul kha tab tab byed pa dang lce dar sham tsam zhig nyug nyug byung ba lan gnyis su ma zin pa dang / da res lce ma zin na dang por nged rang gnyis gsod/ de nas stong gsum gyi sems can gsod du 'ong ba bsgrims la chod cig zer/ de nas ro dang kha sprad de bsgrims pa dang sos lce zin nas bcad pa dang ral grir gyur nas nam mkha' la g.yugs pas dge tshul 338

nam mkha' la 'phur ba la rig 'dzin na re khyod nang pa sangs rgyas pa la pham pa 'ong ba yin pas ral gri 'di nga dpang na mar la shog cig zer/ de lta yin mod ngas ltad mo lta yis zer nas ri rab kyi khar song / gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar lcog bzhi sum bcu rtsa gsum bkod pa dang bcas pa bltas pas legs par mthong / de nas mar 'dzam gling ngos su ral gri g.yugs pas rig 'dzin gyi drung du byung / rig 'dzin na re ro las gser du grub pa 'di dge tshul khyod gyis shig 'dis dge slong lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba ldeng ste rus pa la ma bcad cig bcad na log 'tshor 'gyur te phyis mi skye'o/ /gzhan du na bcad kyang nub mo skye'o/ /zhes zer te ral gri g.yugs nas 'og min du song ngo / /dge tshul des slob dpon la smras pas 'o na dge slong lnga brgya'i bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang zhig dgos pas mgon po la sa gzhi zhu ba'i gtor ma bya'o zer nas ba lim byas pas bya rog gis khyer nas mtsho zhig gi dkyil na de'u yod pa'i khar bzhag go /de 'u de'i khar gtsug lag khang brtsigs te gling bzhi ri rab gling phran nyi zla dang bcas pa la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang o tusta bu ri bya ba yod/ de la dpe bya'o gsung ngo / /de nas stod bal yul nas gzugs mkhan dang phya mkhan bkug ste sa brtag pa'i cho ga sngar bgyis pa las yang lan gcig byas pa'i tshe shar ri has po ri nas pha bang drangs te gzhi dbu rtse'i rmang bting / sa yar lungs gad pa thog nas blangs/ shing shug pa dang tsardon las byas te brtsigs nas khang pa ni tshar/ sku gzugs ci lta ba zhig bgyi dgongs pa las btsan po mnal ba'i mang lam du mi dkar po zhig na re/ rgyal po khyod sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ci las bya bar sems zer slob dpon la 'dri byas pas/ de na re sa gzhi 'di jo mo sgro' mas byin gyis brlabs tā re dngos kyis zhabs kyis bcags pa yin/ has po ri'i rtse mo la shākya thub pa gtso 83phyi

'khor bcu gsum sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yod kyis de spyan drongs la gyis zer/ de ga na yod ston dang byas pas ba dmar po 'bus 'debs pa'i sa na yod/ 'dong zhes khrid de has po rir phyin pa dang brag kun bltar bcug nas 'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'di dang 'di zhes kun gyi mtshan yang smos nas lha bcu dgu 'dug khro bo dang bcas pa kun bstan te rgyal po dgyes ches nas he he byas pas mnal sad de rmi lam du red nas nam nangs ma thog du blon po gnon khams khrid de rmang lam du bstan pa'i sa der gshegs te gzigs pa dang ci yang mi 'dug 'di na 'dug pa yin pa la byas te btsan pos bye ma la zhabs sug byas pas rde 'u bya mchu tsam zhig 'dug go de bsal bas rdo sgu the 'u'i rjes med pa gtsug tor nag po ldem me ba spyan khru hrig ge ba'i byang chub chen po cig gda'/ rmang lam du byung ba dang mthun par brag la 'ol byi tsam gda' bas dgyes ches nas bal po rdo mkhan 'gugs su btang / sku gzugs de nyid du bgyis nas shing rta la bzhag pa'i tshe sa lan gcig g.yos/ dri gtsang khang gi nang du phyin pa'i tshe sa lan gcig g.yos/ de nas khri la bzhugs pa dang btsan po dgyes te man dhi dang gser rka gsol na bza' dang rgyal po nyid kyi gser gyi rka rags sku la bcings so/ /de'i steng 'jim pas g.yogs/ gzugs mkhan na re btsan po'i lha khang dang sbyar na lha chung zer nas 'jag ma bkris nas g.yogs 'dag ba byugs/ de la gser gyi gyim bag gsol nas bzhag go rgyu rdo las byal gzo gong lugs su byas pa lho ngos kyi g.yas gral la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po/ byams pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ sa'i snying po/ dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang drug go byang ngos g.yon gral la kun bzang / phyag rdor/'jam dpal/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dge bsnyen chen po/ dri ma med par grags 340

pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba dmar po dang gtso 'khor bcu gsum mo/ /gsang 'das la 'grel ba brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa las slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lha bcu dgu la drug ma shong nas byang chub chen po'i rgyab tu gyang logs la ri mor bris nas yod do/ /lte ba'i rgyud ris ni sku gsum 'byung ba'i mdo bris/lte ba'i kha phyir blta la mdo sde padma dkar po'i rgyud ris nang blta'i skor khang la 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs/ rnga khang la rje'i thugs dam mdo sde dkon mchog sprin gyi rgyud ris bris/ 'og khang gi srung ma mkha' 'gro ma seng ge khri'i ral pa can ma gtad do/ /bar khang gi shing thams cad gla pa seng ldeng las byas lder tsho'i rgyu ba men gyi ko ba bzo rgya nag po'i lugs su byas/ gtso bo dpal rnam nga ra snang mdzad/ g.yas na 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/g.yon na ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mgon po/ mdun na stong gi lha shākya thub pa/ tshes brgyad kyi lha sman bla bee ḍūrya/ nya'i lha snang ba mtha' yas byas/ nyi shu gsum gyi lha jo mo sgro'/ ma ri mor bris/ g.yas g.yon gyi lha byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad dge bsnyen dri ma med pa dang dga' ba'i dpal khro bo gang king gnyis te rgya nag gi skad yin don 'og khang dang mthun/ kṛ ya'i lha tshogs bco lnga dang bstun/ nang la yum rgyas pa'i gleng gzhi'i rgyud ris/ gdong la rgyal chen bzhi/ skor khang kha phyi blta la mchod rten brgyad pa mngon par byung ba'i mdo/ nang blta la sprin chen po'i mdo/ rnga khang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs dang bsam yas na gnas pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi 'bag bar khang rgyal po shing bya can la gtad do/ /steng khang gi shing thams cad thang ma dang gsom/ lder tsho'i rgyu ras dang 'jag ma/ bzo rgya gar gyi lugs/ gtso bo rnam snang kun tu rig pa zhal bzhi ngo bo gcig pa re re la 'khor gnyis gnyis te nye ba'i sras brgyad/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs phyoṭa 341

bcu nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khro po mi g.yo ba la sogs pa bzhi phyag rdor sogs bzhi ste budhe'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su byas/ rgyud ris mdo sde sa bcu pa bris/ rgyal po zangs ma'i 'be log can la gtad do/ /thog thams cad rgya phubs za 'og ris/ lcog bzhi na steng gi zhing khams mdangs dga' ba can gyi sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i byin pa sogs pa'i rgyud ris bzhi/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can bzhi la gtad/ garji ra gser la shel gyi tog can btsugs/ de nas 'khor sa bar pa brtsigs te lho phyogs rol mo mchod rdzas kyi bang mdzod gsum na rol chas bkang / gnod sbyin lag na dbyug thogs mched gsum la gtad/ nub ngos mdo rgyud chos kyi bang mdzod gsum na rgya dpe bod dpe rgya nag gi dpe'i glegs bam rnams kyis bkang a tsa ra lag na gri thogs mched gsum la gtad/ byang ngos rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod gsum na gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pas bkang ste gshin rje lag na dbyug thogs gsum la gtad/ rgyud ris mdo sde rgya cher rol pa bris/ bar gyi se rgyongs la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong dang / de nas mun bskal drug bcu'i rjes la sangs rgyas khri 'byung ba bris te ma shong ba gru skas kyi rtsig logs la bkod nas yod/de nas 'khor sa chen po bskor te rnam snang ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs/ mda' yab kyi ngos gsum la rigs lnga'i lder tsho phyir blta ba/ nang du sdong pos brgyan pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa bsten pa bris/ des ma khengs pa 'phags pa snang brgyad kyis bkang nas yod/ chos skyong klu'i rgyal po a nasta u li la gtad do/ /rgyab tu rdo ring padma can la bka' btsigs rdo la brkos/ steng du seng ge bzhag nas chos skyong sidha mu kha la btad/ dbu rtse'i sgo gsum bradzñā pā ra mi ta rnam par thar pa'i sgo 342

gsurjen stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa gsum dang bstun/rtsig pa dang shing bzo brkos te rmang btsugs chu khung gtod/ nang du ka ba'i rmang byas/ de'i steng du ka ba ka lo gdung phyam spang leb so phag bkram/ kha lan kun gyis bskor/ logs la sum cha'i 'og du skar khung phyi rub la nang yangs pa rgya mtsho lta bu byas/ bya mi 'jug pa'i phyir dra ba/ sbrang bu mi 'jug pa'i sgo glegs/ rlung gis mi phyed pa'i 'khor gtan/ de 'byed pa'i dbyug gu skam kha byas/ steng du 'dzeg pa'i gru skas drug gi 'og ma rdo bar ma so phag steng ma shing las byas/ lag 'dzin gyi gdang bu byas/ mi 'gul ba'i lcags gzer btab/ de ltar bya ba 'dul ba dang bstun rgyud ris mdo sde dang lder tsho gsang sngags dang bstun/ lder tsho bdun bcu don brgyad/ mdo'i rgyud ris bcu bzhi/ ka ba stong dang rtsa gnyis/ sgo mo che sum bcu so drug sge'u chung bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ gru skas chen po drug cong chen po brgyad dang dang dang chen po gsum gyis brgyan pa byas so zhes byung la/ slob dpon chen po padma'i rnam thar las ni dbu rtse'i 'og khang rgya nag lugs/ bar khang rgya gar lugs/steng khang li'i lugs su bzhengs par gsungs la/ spyir brten gtso byang chub chen po ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po dang sku tshad mnyam pas ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyi thun mong gi snang ngo'i sku tshad yin zhing phyis jo bo rje la sogs pas kyang ma ha bo dhi dang khyad par mi 'dug ces gsungs pas ston pa dngos dang khyad par med do/ /spyir khru 'brug dang bsam yas gnyis ku'i gtsang khang gtso bo gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs lha bcu dgu par gsungs shing der 'jam dpal rdo rje gtso bor yod mod kyang / gtso bo 'phos shing gsang ba'i kha sbyor gyi sku sbas nas sprul sku dang rgyan can tsam bstan par snang ngo / /gling gzhan rnams bzhengs tshul ni rba bzhed las/ mngon pa dang bstun 343

pa'i gling bcu gnyis nyi zla dang bcas pa bzhengs te dang por shar lus 'phags po gling g.yog dang bcas pa la dpe byas te zla gam du byas/ dbus su rnam dag khrims khang gling lder tsho thub pa'i sku gtso 'khor lnga zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i rgyud ris rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can la gtad/ spyir gling bcu gnyis po la lte ba la sgo re dang 'khor sa la sgo gnyis re yod/ g.yas g.yon gyi gling g.yog gnyis las mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling na ko ba las byas pa'i 'jam dpal gtso 'khor bdun sgo srung gshin rje'i gshed gnyis 'jam dpal sangs rgyas pa'i zhing bkod dang phal po che'i rgyud ris gshin rje me'i 'khor lo can la gtad/ brda sbyor tshang mang gling na thub pa gtso 'khor bdun rgyud ris rin bo che sna tshogs pa/ phyi btsun pa'i g.yos sa rgyal po 'brug gi slog pa can la gtad/ lho'i gling sogs kha gsum las bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling na thub pa bdud 'dul lugs 'khor lder tsho bzhi/ lte ba la mdo sde sa bcu pa/ 'khor sa la gtsug na rin po che'i mdo dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad gtad/ ārya pa lo'i gling sngar ltar las glo 'bur na sku'i rten du tsandan gyi rus pa 'a gu gul gyi sha dngul gyi pags pas g.yogs pa'i rgyal po nyid kyi sku 'bag zhig bla 'bum yum chen mo zhig phra men gyi mchod rten zhig rgyud ris za ma tog bkod pa/ bse'i lha mo stong rtsa gnyis 'khor sa la sa bcu pa'i mdo drang srong dharma ra tsa 'khor sde brgyad dang bcas pa la gtad/ rgya gar gling na jo bo shākya rgya gar lugs gtso 'khor lnga/ tshe dpag med dang 'dus pa rnam par dag pa'i rgyud ris/ mdun myo/ lo paṇa sgra bsgyur gyi khang pa sgo so sor lta ba gnod sbyin rā hu la la gtad/ nub kyi gling zlum po gsum las bee ro tsa na'i gling na rnam snang zangs las byas pa 'khor gsang ba'i yum bzhi/ rgyud ris rnam snang mngon byang / gnod sbyin glang mgo can la gtad/ dga' ldan byams pa gling na byams 344

pa gtso 'khor bdun/ gshin rje'i gshed gnyis/ rgyud ris mi dge ba spyad pas shākya'i bstan pa mar 'grib pa dang tshe lo bcu pa nas byams pas dge ba byed du bcug pas yar 'phel ba dang / sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bsam yas kyi dpe ris/ zhang rgyal tsha lha snang gis lag dpon byas pa'i las thabs dang lhung bshags kyi lha tshogs bris/ mkha' 'gro ma gung gi gos can la gtad/ mi g.yo bsam gtan gling na rnam snang yab rgyal po'i thugs dam gnyan po byin rlabs can rigs lnga/ 'khor nyan thos bcu drug rgyud ris gser 'od dam pa nges don snyi lugs/ rgyal po dngul gyi mgo can la gtad/ byang gi gling gru bzhi gsum las rin po che sna tshogs gling na thub pa gtso 'khor la rgyud ris dga' ldan du yum la chos bshad pa dang / drin lan bsab pa'i mdo/ rgyal po g.yi'i sbar can la gtad/ sems skyed byang chub gling na phyag rdor gyi pho brang ri po mchog rab kyi steng na phyag rdor/ rdo rje phur pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsum gyis bar chad srung / sangs rgyas ma chags padma can nam mkha' la byon pa la byang sems sgrib pa rnam sel gyis zhus te sa bcu'i byang sems rdo rje snying po la sogs pa budha'i lha bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyis sems kyis zhus pa de'i bar bar na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis de dag la byin gyis brlabs pa bris/ rgyud ris dkon mchog sprin 'khor sa la rtag ngu shes phyin tshol ba rgyal po gse gab dang mkha' 'gro ma gse'i 'gros can la gtad/ dkor mdzod bee har gling na thub pa gtso 'khor dgu/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo/ rgyud ris glo 'bur rnams na bsam yas 'byongs pa'i dkor lhag ma 'di na 'di yod kyi rtsis yig srung ma khrum gang gi rgyal po/ spyir rgyal po pe kur la gtad/ yakṣa gong ma gang ba bzang po'i khang pa na thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris sangs rgyas stong rtsa/ gang ba bzang po la gtad/ yakṣa 'og ma nor bu bzang po'i khang pa na lder tsho dang 345

rgyud ris mtshungs shing nor bu bzang po la gtad de nyi zla'i dod yin no/ /shar phyogs kyi logs gling dang bcas pa kha dog dkar po shel/ lho mthing ga be ḍūrya/ nub dmar po padma rā ga byang ser po gser gyi rang bzhin rnams logs zhal gnyer ma chu gnyer 'dra ba/ thang la dkar zhal phyi'i rgya mtsho la dpe byas pa yang byas so/ /gzhan yang nub na tshang mang ke ru gling gi steng khang slob dpon bo dhe sa ta'i gzims mal dang ba so lha khang / 'og khang dkar thab gnod sbyin myu gu thogs pa la gtad/ lhor dag byed khrus kyi khang pa tsarnan gyis gang ba/ 'og so phag logs la rab tu byung ba skyo ba skye ba'i phyir keng rus kyi rnam pa 'dul ba nas gsung pa ltar bris/ gnod sbyin dbyug thogs la gtad/ byang na mthu rtsal gling na se ba phung po gcig sbyin sreg byas pa'i yal ga brgyad la klu chen po brgyad byas/ da ༄sa na phyag rdor dkar po zhi ba 'dul byed du bzhengs/rgyud ris nya sbal chu srin sogs bris/ srung ma sa bdag rgyun 'dal gnyan bu rang chas su yod cing / nang chu shel gyis khyab pa sus kyang lta bar rngo mi thogs pa zhig mchis/ de nas mchod rten dkar po byang chub chen po'i mchod rten seng ges brgyan pa nyan thos kyi lugs su bzhengs/ shud bu mi rgyal to res lag dpon byas pa gnyan pas shi ste yang shud bu khri 'breng kheng btsan gyis byas/gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong la gtad/ mchod rten dmar po sku tshe brtan pa byang chub sems dpa'i lugs padmas brgyan pa sna nam rgyal tsha lha snang gis bzhengs/ gza' mig dmar la gtad/ mchod rten nag po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gis brgyan pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lugs ngan lam ta ra klu gong gis bzhengs/ gnod sbyin lcags mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po chos kyi 'khor lo de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs sgo phacu drug gis brgyan pa mchims rdo rje spre chung gis bzhengs/ gnod sbyin nyi ma'i gdong can la gtad/ de'i tshe ཿ46

'dre mo 'od can mas mi rnams nyal ba'i mgo mjug ldog pa sogs 'tshe ba mang du byas pas byams pa gling du mchod rten 'od 'bar brtsigs te mnan/ mchod rten lnga po la nang rdzongs ma mchis nas rjes slob dpon la zhus pas ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mdun na dha ru tse do bya ba'i mchod rten zhig gi nang na rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i skal ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel ma ga dha'i bre'i khal gcig bzhugs par grags so gsungs/ rgyal bos de spyan drangs pa'i phyir bod kyi rta rngog chags sga mnan ma ga gcig yan chad ma lus par chad pa la bsngos te mgos kyi phag rir dus btab/ slob dpon gyis lam rgyus mdzad nas mtha' 'khob bod kyi rta pa'i dmag phyin nas dpal mo dpal nga la dmag grang btab pas rta pa bye ba phrag bcu phazhi byung / rgya gar mtha' 'khob tu slebs pa dang yul de'i rgyal po bred nas ma 'a 'khob kyi rgyal po'i rta pa 'di 'dra na dpung bu chung dang shing rta pa dang glang po che pa'i tshogs ci 'dra bar 'gyur zer nas pho brang gi sgo'i ya klad la bod rgyal po'i lham btags nas de'i 'og na phar 'khor dang bcas pas 'dzul te nga'i rgyal khams ni btsan po khyod kyi 'og du 'dzul zhing dpya dang skyes lo thang du 'bul lo zer zhing mngar 'dus so/ /de nas chu gaṅgā brgal nas ma ga dhar dmag drangs pas ma ga dha pa thams cad nor rnams o dusta pu rir bskyas/ mi rnams rgya gar shar phyogs su bros te g.yul sprod ma dgos par dpal rdo rje gdan dang byang chub kyi shing la mchod pa byas/ mchod gnas spyan drangs/ de nas mchod rten kha phye ba'i nang nas/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'khor ba'i dkyil na rin po che'i bum pa 'dug pas sus kyang blang bar rngo ma thogs/rgya gar gyi rgan po cig 'dug pa na re nga la sngon gyi mis gling ba'i lo rgyus yod/mchod rten 'di'i byang ngos na rdo leb chen po'i dkyil gyi bug pa na mar rnga mang gi thag pa la bum pa btags te btang bas bum pa de chus gang ba 'byung / de 347

nas yar la gzhal bas mchod rten gyi rked pa dang thad kur mnyam pa na rdzing bu'i gseng khung gi bar chu 'gro ba rtswa dang bye mas bkag ste cha bsgags na chu chad nas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rdig zer te 'khor 'phro chad pa yin zer nas de ji skad zer ba ltar byas pas bden par byung nas rin po che'i bum pa nas sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i ring bsrel bre drug spyan drangs/ yang sngar ltar rtsi shing bsal chu btang bas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo snga ma ltar 'khor te sngar ltar rgyas btab po/ de nas tshur byon ste chu bo gaṅgā 'i 'gram du bod kyi mi bzhi bskos nas 'di tshun chad bod kyi sa bcad yin pas 'dir rdo ring gis shig ces bka' bstsal/ mi mang pos bye khung du lcags kyi ka ba btsugs te phyes bru sha'i dmag gis de bshig pas ma shigs nas mes bzhu pa'i 'phro yod skad/ de'i lu 'bugs na 'dzugs mkhan gyi mi bzhi po chags pa sto dratha sku ra'i rigs bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig yang yod do/ /rta dmag rnams bod da log pa shin ta ra ri nyung nas rgyal po la zhus pas rgya gar yul bzang pas bsdad pa min nam gsung ste slob dpon la zhus pas rgya gar cham la 'bebs pa'i phyir btsan pos sprul pa mdzad pa yin gyi dmag dang po nas 'di bas med gsungs te sngo bgrang byas pas mi gcig kyang ma lus rta gcig kyang ma chad par tshang bas btsan po khri srong lde btsan sprul par grags so/ /de nas chos 'khor du byon te ring bsrel gyi sdod dang za ma tog bzhi sprugs pa'i bar ring bsrel 'phel te snyim pa gang ma shong ba mchod rten gyi tog la bzhugs/ mes tho tho'i thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba dang mes srong btsan gyi thugs dam lnga/ yab kyi thugs dam gnyis rnams bzhugs pas mchod rten dkar po lhag par byin rlabs che'o/ /lho phyogs kyi mchod rten la srog shing dang thon ka dkar po'i 'khor lo bal po'i shing mkhan dang / rdo bzo dang / mgar bas bgyis te has po ri'i rgyab tu bal po bzo byed pa'i drung du 348

bzhag ste drangs nas 'dzugs par chad byas/ blon po rnams kyis 'breng zhags dang shing rta grabs su btsud/ bzo pos dgung sangs ma thag bzo 'phro la phyin pas srog shing sogs shul ha re stor/ rje'i snyan du gsol/ pho nya btang ste bltas pas srog shing mchod rten la btsugs pa mthong / pho nya des mchod rten nyid la 'khor lo btsugs lags zhes gsol/ shing mkhan dang mgar ba kun gyis bltas na gtsugs legs par mthong ste snyan du gsol ba dang / rjes kun bsags te nga'i 'bangs la stobs che ba 'di su yin bya dga' cher gnang ngo gsungs pas khas len pa su yang ma mchis/ phya mkhan bal po na re mdang nga'i rmi lam na mi bzhis 'khor lo khyer nas 'ongs te btsugs/ khyed kyis mchod rten bdun bcu btsugs na legs rab/ mchod rten 'di yang legs rab/ mchod rten 'di dzasbu'i gling na byin che ba yin te 'di la sus phyag dang skor ba byed pa de bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub pas bya dag ra gser gyi ya lad cig byin te 'di khyer zhig zer/ gnyid sad tsa na mi bzhi ni mi gda'/ ya lad ni 'di yin zer nas gser khrub cig gda'/ de gsol bas phya mkhan 'khor bcas la bya dga' che thang du bstsal/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas de skad du ston pa rgyal po chen po bzhi yin pas de'i gzugs kyang bya gsungs nas bum pa'i steng du 'bag bzhi byas nas bzhag go de nas mgon khang bzhi'i nang du phugs na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor gsum/ mdo na mgon po lcam dral gnyis/ de'i sgo dra ba byas/sgo'i phyi na rta bab kyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo gser las byas pa dang / sha rambha dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa bgyis te rgyal po chen po bzhi la gtad/ lcags ri zur mang rdo rje'i 'gros la mchod rten stong rtsa brgyad kyis bskor/ re re la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re bzhu gas/ rgyal po sde bco brgyad la gtad/ bsam yas spyi'i chos skyong dpal mgon po la gtad do/ /de 349

ltar dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang de ni gzhi che la dpangs mtho/ rgyu bzang la bkod pa legs/ dung phor gzis bkang ba 'dra ba/ rje'i thugs dam/ 'bangs kyi mchod gnas/ sangs rgyas dang chos dkon mchog gi zhing khams/ dge 'dun gyi bzhugs gnas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang de yos bu'i lo la rmang brus nas yos bu'i lo la 'byongs pa lags so/ /btsun mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa la mchims bza' lha mo btsan dang / mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gnyis sgrub pa mdzad pas phyag ris med/ 'bro bza' khri rgyal mo btsan phyis rab tu byung nas byang chub rjer mtshan gsol ba de'i phyag ris dge rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang lags te snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor dgu gzhung gi lugs stod du lugs btab nas chab la spyan drangs pas 'khor gnyis chab la shor/ g.yas na rigs gsum mgon po g.yon na sman bla sangs rgyas kun du bzang po mi g.yo ba rnams bzhugs/ sras mi mnga'/ yab ming 'bro yul thag ring bas phyis gso mi mi 'ong zhes mchi nas lha lugs ma byas/ rtsig pa so phag zha nye'i chus spyar/ zangs kyi thog bkal/rol mor cong btags/ yon chab tsandan gyi khron pa byas/ sgron mer rin po che 'od 'bar ba gtso bo'i gin mtshams sa phrar btab bo/ /jo mo tshe spong bza' /)pa ri shu me tog sgron la sras mnga' bas khams gsum zangs khang gling yab kyi dbu rtse la dpe blangs nas bzhengs/ 'og khang gi ka gdung rnams zangs kyis btums so//pho yongs bza' rgyal mo btsun yum tshe 'phos pa khab tu bzhel na lan lon par slob dpon gyis lung bstan pas khab tu bzhes te lha lcam la sras mi mnga' bas lha khang nyis thog tu gnang bas bu tshab gser khang rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te bzo bo la zas sna bcu gsum re drangs pas bzo khyad bcu gre/sum byas te/ steng khang gi phyi la rtsig pa med pa/ nang na ka ba med 350

pa/ ba/ gzhi ra gan las byas pa/ g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta rgyug cing gser gdung la g.yu 'brug rgyug pa/ mthing gi rgya phubs phyir blta nang blta gnyis yod pa/ chu thams cad 'dril nas seng ge'i kha nas rus sbal gyi rgyab tu 'bab pa/ gotrīṣa sgo yod pa/ sgo 'byed gcod la gser gyi bye chung 'phar zhing skad 'don pa/ nang gi yo ga'i lha tshogs la spyi gdugs re dang sgos gdugs re phub pa/ khyams na mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur du dod pa/ rgyu skar gyi lha mo nyer brgyad kyis rgya phubs 'degs shing nang zur bzhi na gser gyi seng ge lug thong tsam brgyad yod pa/ rgya phubs kyi sham bu la mchod pa'i mo lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'bur du dod pa/ lha'i bus khyung gi sgo nga las bdud rtsi'i chus sku khrus gsol ba ste bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig bzhengs su gsol lo zhes byung ngo / /lo rgyus gzhan las btsan po yab yum gnyis la thugs shin tu bcags pas slob dpon padma la bdag gi pha ma gar skyes zhus pas yab ni rgya gar na skyes te da lta slob sbyangs byed/ paṇḍita mkhas pa cig du byas te khyod kyi dbon sras kyi dus su bod du byon/ yum ni zur mkhar na dbul po bza' mi'i bu mor skyes so zhes gsungs pas yum la thugs brtse pas btsun mo bzhes te gser gyi bdag mor bskos/ yab ni da na shrī la yin zhes kyang byung ngo / /rba bzhed na dkor bdag sbyan drangs tshul mi snang yang slob dpon padmas ma 'ongs pa gnam the dkar po'i sprul pa hor yul du byung bas bod khams dbang byed cing lha khang phal cher 'jig par 'gyur bas hor gyis mi 'jig pa'i phyir rgyal po gnam lha byang chub la gtad do gsungs nas rgyal pos ngan lam ta ra klu gong dmag dpon du bskos pas hor gyi sgom gra bcom/ rten rdzas dang yo byad thams cad khyer/ slob dpon chen po padmas phyag rdor gyi ting nge 'dzin mdzad de rnam sras 'khor bcas kyi dmag gis bkug ste pe kur dkor 351

mdzod gling gi lco ga du rten btsugs dam la btags te bsam yas spyi'i bka' srung du bskos shing phyis bod yul gyi dkon mchog gsum gyi rten phal cher yang gtad par sngon gyi yi ge mang po las byung zhing slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar dang rgyal po nyid kyi dam bzhag rnams las gsal lo/ /ta ra klu gong shi 'phos nas mi ma yin chen por gyur pa rgod po ta rar grags te mchims phu'i bka' srung du bskos par grags so/ /yig tshangs mang po zhig na me yos la rmang bting nas sa yos kyis tshar zhes pa 'dug kyang me yos nas lo bzhi lon pa lcags rta la khri srong 'khrungs pa'i phyir dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes pa lcags yos la mang bting nyer drug pa shing lug la sad mi rnams rab tu phyung / so bzhi pa chu yos kyis bsam yas tshar ba 'di nges par snang ngo/ /de ltar gtsug lag khang chen yongs rdzogs nas/ /gser gyi yon phul rab tu gnas par zhus/ /bo dhi sa twas gsang ba 'dus pa ni/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs/ /slob dpon padmas yo ga rtsa ba'i rgyad/ /zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi ting 'dzin ༄mdzad/ /gnyi gas rab tu gnas cing spyan dbye ba'i/ /cho ga rmad du byung ba lan brgyad mdzad/ /re re la yang ngo mtshar dpag med byung / /brag dmar mtsho mo mgur du pad sdong skyes/ /sna tshogs 'ja' dang 'od zer sprin du 'khrigs/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro'i me tog char du 'bab/ /de tshe bod yul lha mi thams cad 'dus/ /glu gar rtse 'jo dga' ston bsam mi khyab/ /bod yul bde skyid dga' ldan lha las lhag /skyid pa'i dga' ston lo skor gcig du byas/ /de yang rba bzhed las/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis na lha khang tshar ba las de nas slob dpon la mnga' gsol gyi gser phye bre drug phul nas zhus pas bod 'bangs mnga' ris thams cad la dpya dang khrul bsdus la yo byad lta gon gyis shig ces lung gnang / slob dpon ke ru gling na mtshams bcad nas sgrub pa la 352

bzhugs pa las rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi thugs dam mdzad/ btsan pos mnga' 'og gi 'bangs kun bsdus te yo byad tshogs nas mnga' gsol ba'i dus bzang po la bab pa'i tshe brag dmar skye bo'i tshogs kyis khengs/ slob dpon gyis ke ru gling nas mkhar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon te mchod rten dkar po'i gong du byon pa dang btsan pos 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa phyag na rin po che'i me tog thogs pa zhig du gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse'i thog gi lha phyir spyan drangs nas mchod rten dkar po la bskor ba byas te zhal shar phyogs su gzigs nas 'khor sa'i logs na phrog zhu zing nge 'dug pa la me tog gtor/ lha rnams dus gcig tu gshegs te sngar gyi gral rim bzhin du 'khod/ khro bo gnyis kyis rgyab nas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas sa gzhi tshig pa la slob dpon gyis dri chab kyis bsad gtor mdzad pas me shi ba'i shul sor chud/ btsan pos me tog tu gser gzhong pa gang phul lo/ /zhal sro chen po'i dus phyi'i lcags ri'i steng mchod rten gyi bar thams cad bzhes pa dang thud rkyal gyis bkang ste ltad mo ba rnams la 'tshal ma bstsal bas skal ba gnyis gsum re thob/ chad pa ni ye ma mchis/ de'i rjes la kun ltad mo che thang re byed/ sman ril lan ka brag chung nyi ma 'de ba'i drung du sha ba byung ba la zhags pas bzung nas khrom bskor/ ltad mo dang po byas lugs 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab tu bris nas yod do/ /sang nang bar yang slob dpon ke ru gling nas 'khar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pas btsan pos dge slong rigs lnga'i da bu rgyan can zhig tu gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse'i bar khang gi lha spyan drangs te 'khor sa'i logs la zhal shar du gzigs pa la me tog gtor/ lha rnams dus gcig la nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod/ gser gzhong pa gang yon du phul/ zhal sro'i dus 353

lta da mo ba la 'tshal ma sngar bzhin du bstsal/ de'i rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/ rngog pha la bya bas rnga mong bdun la zhon res byed cing byung / la la gu/ rub ste rta rgyug pa'i steng na phar na ral gri'i sgong 'phan/ la la mi nyis brtsegs kyis 'phan 'phyar ba la sogs ltad mo bar pa'i byas lugs 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab tu bris yod/ yang slob dpon gyis ke ru gling nas 'khar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pa de btsan pos dge slong 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can zhig du gzigs/ dbu rtse'i steng khang gi lha rnams bang smug bo'i khar ting nge 'dzin gyis spyan drangs nas me tog gtor/ lha rnams dus gcig la nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod/ gser gzhong pa gang yon du phul/zhal sro phyi ma'i dus su ltad mo ba la 'tshal ma sngar bzhin du bstsal/ rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/ 'jang dga' bo bya bas seng ldeng gi gdung bdun thod la btsugs nas dbu rtse'i thang la bang brgyugs te lho sgo'i them khar por/de re re la yang mi res mi theg so shing stag shing rtse na phar rgyug shing rtse la sgyu ma mkhan lus la me chen 'bar/ thang shing la bye chung spyang mo nyug pa sogs ltad mo tha ma'i phyas lugs 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab na bris nas yod/ spyir slob dpon bo dhi sa tas bsam yas kyi chos 'khor ma bu la mnga' gsol rab gnas lan brgyad byas so/ /rab gnas lan bdun byas pa'i rten ni sprul pa'i sku dngos dang byin rlabs mnyam pa lags so/ /de'i rjes la btsun mos gsil khang gi mtsho nang du padma'i sdong po skyes pa'i steng du bzhugs nas thugs dam lha khang 'byongs pa la gzigs te shin tu dgyes nas/ nga'i dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra ste nga re dga'/ bya ba la sogs pa'i dga' glu bcu gsum mgur du bzhengs so/ /blon po rnams kyis kyang so so'i nga rgyal gyi glu re blangs te mchims kyi nga che rgyang grags la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar lo 354

bskor gcig gi bar du skyid kyi bro mo che brdungs/ mi res glu re blangs/ rta res bang re brgyugs/ bya res skad re bton/ dus de tsam na bod bde skyid mnga' thang dar ba lags te de yang dbu rtse'i sgo rgyab byang ngos na bris nas yod do zhes byung ngo / /slob dpon chen po padmas rab gnas mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar rba bzhed na mi snang yang nyid kyi rnam thar las ya mtshan 'di dang mtshungs pa la rdo ring gi seng ges skad phyung ba dang pe kur gyis 'phyams pa sogs bshad la/ brag dmar mgrin bzang gi rab gnas kyi ngo mtshar ltar na de bas ches rmad du byung ba du ma yod rgyur snang yang yi ge ma mthong ngo / /dga' ston ji ltar byas pa ni bka'i thang yig chen mo las 'di ltar bshad ste/de ltar dpal gyi bsam yas la/ /rab gnas dga' ston mdzad pa'i dus/ /mtsho mo mgur gyi skyil krung der/ /padma'i sdong po skyes pa'i gnas/ /rgyal po gser khri'i steng du bzhugs/ /yid 'ong btsun mo lnga po yang / /mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas te bzhugs/ /mchod gnas lo paṇa thams cad kyang / /dgyes shing chos kyi 'gro gleng mdzad/ /chos blon gtso bo thams cad kyis/ /rgyal po bzhugs pa'i tha ma bskor/ /de ltar mnga' 'og skyid pa'i 'bangs/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris thams cad nas/ /ma tshogs bya ba gang yang med/ /bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs kyis/ /gang la ci 'dod thams cad tshim / dga' ba'i bro brdung skyid pa'i glu/ /nyin re bzhin du rgyun chad med/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /dgung la nyi ma 'grib pa tsam/ /'dab chags bya la 'phur sa med/ /mgo nag mi yis sa gzhi gang / /gyi gling rta la rgyug sa med/ /sil snyan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir/ khye 'u bu mo thams cad kyang / /chas brgyan lag na rnga ma thogs/ /rnga brdung glu len gar stabs rgyu/ /g.yag gseng dar gseng stag gseng dang / /'bag dang seng spug gar mkhan dang / /355

spa mdzes rnga thogs 'phyam po sogs/ /rgyal po'i sku la mchong par 'bul/ /de ltar rje 'bangs thams cad kyi/ /dga' ba'i lus la rang dbang med/ /bro brdung nam mkha'i char pa 'dra/ /skyid pa'i sems la dran 'dzin med/ /rang rang mo sa pa'i glu re len/ /de ltar mi rje lhas mdzad pa/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan des/ /rin chen khri las bzhengs nas ni/ /rgyal po dgyes pa'i glu blangs pa/ /nga yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di/ /rin chen sna las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong pa tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ /lus 'phags gling la dpe blangs nas/ /shar gyi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /dzaspu gling la dpe blangs nas/ /lho yi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /ba lang spyod la dpe blangs nas/ /nub kyi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub ste/ brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /sgra mi snyan la dpe blangs nas/ /byang gi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi yakṣa gong 'og 'di/ /mkha' la nyi zla shar ba 'dra/ /nga yi btsun mo gling gsum 'di/ /g.yu yi maskyol brgyan pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten dkar po 'di/ /dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten dmar po 'di//me lce gnam la snyeg pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten sngon po 'di/ /g.yu yi ka ba btsugs pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten nag po 'di/ /lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten ngo mtshar che/ /de la sogs pa dgyes pa'i glu/ /sum bcu rtsa gsum lha dbang gi /lha yi glu la dpe blangs nas/ /g.yu khang gser khri zhes pa blangs/ /lha sras mu ne btsan po yes/ /'jig rten sgron ma 356

bya ba blangs/ /lha sras mu ne btsan po yis/ /seng ge 'gying ba bya ba blangs//btsun mo rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /g.yu mtsho 'khyil pa bya ba dang / /g.yu lo lhug phran bya ba blangs/ /mchod gnas rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /mkhan po bo dhe sa ta yis/ /sgom phreng dkar po zhes pa blangs/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lha 'dre zil gnon zhes pa blangs/ /mkhas pa bee ro tsa na yis/ /dbyangs yig khug pa bya ba blangs/ /snubs ban nam mkha' snying po yis/ /mkha' la khyung lding bya ba blangs/ /ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis/ /rta mgrin 'gying dbyangs bya ba blangs/ /cog ro dpal gyi bzang po yis/ /skyed pa'i dpal dgu mamam/ /blon po rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /chos blon chen po mgos rgan gyis/ /drang shing dkar po ramam/ /de sras khri bzang yab lhag gis/ /mdzangs yig 'phrul gyi lde mig blangs/ /shud bu dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /dung chung g.yu ring mamar/ /dmag dpon lha bzang klu dpal gyis/ /zar chen zar chung snumam/ nyang bzang zhang po khri rgyal gyis/ /seng ge 'grel chen rarar/ /sbas kyi brtan bzang dpal legs kyis/ /'dod pa re brgyad mamar/ /mgar gyi khyung po dum tshugs kyis/ /bya rgod lding ba ramar/ /mchims kyi rdo rje spre chung gis/ /mchims kyi brjed glu mamang/ sna nam rgyal tsha lha snang gis/ /lha shug gong ma mamar/ khri 'bring lha 'od khu lod kyis/ /mdo chod rab 'bring tha gsum blangs/ /gnyags kyi khri bzang yang ston gyis/ /zla 'od khyab brdal mamar/ /ngan lam stag ra klu gong gis/ /lcags sbrel gdong drug mam〉/ /gtso bo rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /ya mtshan gser gyi me tog blangs/ /stag shar rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /stag ri dgu brtsigs maram/ /mo btsan rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /me tog phreng ba marar/ /sman shar rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /grong zer ring mo bya ba blangs/ /gzhan yang brjod 357

kyis mi lang ste/ /lo bskor gcig gi bar du ni/ /mi res glu re blangs pa yin/ /rta res bang re brgyugs pa yin/ /shing re'i rtse la dar re phyar/ /skyid pa'i dpal gyi 'dom brkyang ste/ /dga' bde'i dpal la longs spyod byas/ /ces byung ngo / /gzhan yang mnga' bdag rgyal pos bka' bstsal pa/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid rmi lam tsam 'dis bslu/ /de bas gtan 'dun byang chub sgrub dgos gsungs/ /khye 'u blo gros rno zhing gsal ba rnams/ /brda sprod skad gnyis lo tsā slob tu bcug /yod smra'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te/ /dang por dad pa che ba'i rba khri gzigs/ /bo dhi sa twas mkhan po mdzad nas ni/ /rab tu phyung bas mngon shes lnga ldan gyur/ /bod kyi rin po che zhes rgyal pos bkur/ /bod mi rab byung kun gyi thog ma yin/ /de sogs bod la rab byung btub bam zhes/ /sad pa'i mi drug dang por bsnyen par rdzogs/ /phyi nas dge slong dge tshul rgya cher 'phel/ za hor kha che yul dbus rgya sogs nas/ /paṇa chen tshad ldan mang du spyan drangs te/ /mkhas pa'i lo tsā du mas rgya gar nag /li yul sogs nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab ni/ /ji snyed bzhugs pa phal cher bod du bsgyur/ /rab byung rnams kyi 'tsho za bla nas sbyar/ /chab 'og nas phyung dbu yi gtsug du bkur/ /bslab gsum yongs dag sde snod gsum la ra/khas/ /theg chen shin tu rgyas pa khong du chud/ /rig grol ldan pa'i skyes chen mtha' yas byung / /yer ba'i ri la grub thob brgya rtsa brgyad/ /chu bo ri la grub thob nyer gcig sogs/ /sgom gra rnams su rig 'dzin sde sdod las/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob pa rab tu mang / /gang la ci 'tshams dam chos ston pa yis/ /bod 'bangs thams cad dam pa'i lam la sbyar/ /de dus bod du dar ba'i thub bstan lta/ /'dzam gling gzhan du sngon chad ma byung zhes/ /phyi dus rgya gar paṇa chen du mas bsngags/ /de yang rba bzhed che ba'i dngos 358

bstan ltar bsamyo/ yab/ dga' stoca tshar nas ba/da mi rnams rab tu byung ba ltar bshad cing rba bzhed 'bring ba las bsam yas tshar nas zhal sro ma byas pa'i bar der rab tu byung bar bshad zer yang lo rgyus rnams so so sde tshan du bsgrigs te snga phyi'i go rim la ma brtsis par zad kyi thang yig las dga' ston gyi dus bee ro tsa na sogs gral du bzhugs par gsungs shing gzhan phal cher gyi mkhan po rba ratnas byas par bshad la bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu ma lon na mkhan por mi rung ba'i phyir bo dhi sa twa bod du phebs nas ring po ma lon par sad mi rnams rab tu byung bar gsal lo/ /des na lang gro snang bzher/gnyer stag btsan gdong gzigs/ seng mgo lha lung gzigs/ mchims me lha rtsa/mas mngags nas bṛ ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs/ lug gi lo dpyid zla ra ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la pho brang du phebs te bo dhi sa twas mkhan po mdzad nas sad mi rnaco sa rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs te rim gyis rab byung mang du 'phel lo/ /mkhan rgyud ni shā ri'i bu/ dgra ga can zin/ klu sgrub/ legs ldan byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ bo dhi sa twa rnams bsam yas kyi gyang ris la yod do/ /rba bzhed che ba las ni/ dus der rje blon rnams rtse bro la g.yengs pa dang de yan chad bod la dge slong ming yang med pa las bsam yas kyi rtsig rmang thams cad byi khung byas te 'dug lha khang dang rten rnams la mchod pa dang zhabs tog byed pa med pas btsan po thugs ma bde nas 'bangs rnams la chos bya bar rigs so gsungs nas lug gi lo dpyid zla ra ba'i ngo la slob dpon gyis thams cad yod smrari sde dbus pa bye brag du smra ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs nas zhang blon gyi bu rnam/sa la slob dpon gyis rgya skad bslabs pas mchims a nu'i bu shākya pra bha dang / pa gor hen 'dod kyi bu bee ro 359

tsa na dang rba khri bzher gyi bu khri gzigs sam sang shi ta dang / zhang nya bzang gi bu lha bu lha btsan dang / shud bu khong leb rnams kyis skad lobs/mchims legs gzigs sogs mang zhig gis ma shes so/ /blon po mgos rgan na re nged blon po rnams la long ma mchis pas a tsa ra'i skad slob mi khom pas rgan po'i chos zhu'o zer bas slob dpon gyis a pha dang a ma'i skad don thog du phebs te rgya skad dang mthun par bod skad mkhyen zhing byang ba saX kṛ ta'i skad med kyang bod byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i skad yin pas chos byar btub gsungs te sgom lung phog go /btsan po'i zhal nas nga'i bod la dge slong med pas nga'i zhang blon dag la dge slong btub bam zhus pas slob dpon gyis btub bam sad cig gsungs te skad bslabs pa tsho las thog mar bod la dad pa che ba'i rba khri gzigs rab tu phyung ste dge slong byas/ mtshan dpal dbyangs su btags/ lnga'i mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas btsan po dgyes te de'i zhabs spyi bor blangs te khyod bod kyi rin po che yin zhes bka' bstsa la mtshan yang rba ratna zhes thogs/ bod kyi rab byung la snga ba de yin no/ /da dung rab tu phyung zhig zhus pas/ sad cig gsungs nas rba gsal snang dang /pa gor bee ro tsa na dang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / rma ā tsar rin chen mchog dang / las gsum rgyal ba byang chub dang lnga dge slong byas te gsal snang la sngar sems skyed zhus pa'i tshe btags pa'i ming ye shes dbang po btags/ de la sogs pa btags nas sad mi drug rab tu byung ngo zhes byung ngo / /'di dag du yi ge ma dag pa 'phel ba las sngar gyi rgya phrug gar mkhan de la yang rba sang shi zhes bris pa sogs snang yang rba ratna ni rba khri bzher gyi bur bshad la rgya phrug sang shi ni rgya nag gi pho nya'i bu yin pas rba'i rus su mi 'ong la/ yang bya khri gzigs zhes bris pa du ma yod kyang yi ge nyams pa ste 360

rus de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun mi srid do/ /bo dhi sa twa'i mtshan shānta rakṣi ta'i zur gyi rakṣi ta 'di rnams gyi ming mthar ldan pa ste bee ro tsa na rakṣi ta ces sogs yod par snang ngo / kha cig rba bzhed kyi sad mi drug po'i legs gsum gyi tshab tu gtsang legs grub brjes/ ngan lam gyi 'og tu khon klu'i dbang po bcug pa la sad mi bdun byed par snang ngo / /bu ston chos byung du'ang par brko dus zhus dag pas nyams pa yin nam kun mkhyen bu ston lta bu 'di tsam la mi 'khrul mod kyang thog mar bya khri gzigs rab tu phyung bas mngon shes lnga dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas rba gsal snang / rba khri bzher/ sang shi ta/ pa gor bee ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal mchog khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ rma rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub dang bdun rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes dbang po dang dpal dbyangs la sogs pa yin/ sad mi bdun yin zer ro zhes rba khri gzigs dang po dang gsum pa gnyis /ra lan re grangs/ khri bzher gyi bu sang shi ta zhes pa'i bu dang rnam dbye chad/ gcod mtshams nyams pas ming gnyis su song / dgu'am brgyad grangs nas mi bdun yin zhes pa dang /rba rasta'i ming ye shes dbang po yin pa 'dra ba sogs nag nog che bar snang ngo / /snga rabs mang po zhig ni rba mañdzu thi warma('jam dpal go cha)/ rtsangs de we (lha dbang srung ba)nd+ra raspyi ta bran ka mu khand+ra(ra kṣita) (sgo'i dbang po srung ba)/ste rgan gsum/ bar pa rlangs khams pa go cha/ gzhon pa (klu'i dbang po)khon na gisdu/ pa gor (rnam snang )bee ro tsa na/ rma ā tsar rin chen mchog ste gsum rnams sad mi bdun du 'chad do/ kha cig rba rarti mchims shā kya bra bha/gtsang legs grub/ bee ro tsa na/ zhang lha bu/ shud bu khong legs/ ye shes dbang po dang bdun no zhes sogs 'dod lugs mang du snang yang rba bzhed kyi lugs gtso bor bzung ste lo rgyus chen mo las kyang / dge slong sdom pa snga ba 361

rba yi bandhe gnyis/ /btsun pa'i rab ni ngan lam lha lung gnyis/ /blo rno rab mchog rma ban rin chen mchog /thos pa che rab las gsum byang chub rgyal/ /mkhas pa'i yang rab bee ro tsa na yin/ /zhes rba bzhed kyi drug po'i steng du lha lung rab 'byor dbyangs bsnan pa la sad mi bdun dang / de'i khar na sku mthu'i rab ni nam mkha' snying po ste/ /bsod nams che rab khri srong lde btsan yin/ /zhes de gnyis bsnan pas bod yul na rab kyi mi dgu zhes 'chad par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rba bzhed las/ dus der btsan po'i zhal nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sgrub par byed na rab tu 'byung dgos pa yin pas da dung btsun mo srid ma zin pa dang zhang blon gyi bu dad pa can thams cad rab tu phyung zhig ces gsungs pas blon po rnams na re rab tu byung na 'tsho ba med do zhes mchi bas/ btsan po'i zhal nas ngas 'tsho ba bla nas sbyar zhig gsungs/ dmag dang khral ma byas na chad pa 'ong zer bas/ de la ngas zhabs 'og nas bton la bde ba sbyin dbu'i mchod gnas su bya'o gsungs/ sde snod gsum ga slob mi nus zer bas dge ba nyam dang dpang/sa la spyod cig ces bka'as gnang ngo / /de nas lug gi lo'i dgun zla 'bring po'i ngo la bsam yas bzhengs su gsol zin pa'i zhal bsros nas pra ti ha ra'i dus kyi mchod pa chen po mdzad pa'i tshe jo mo gcen khri rgyal mo btsan dang sru btsan mo rgyal la sogs pa brgya rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po rba ratnas bgyis/ spyir de dus su mi sum brgya rab tu byung nas dbu rtse'i bya 'dab dang mchod rten chen po bzhi'i rtse mo lcags thag gis sbrel/ de la 'phan mgo btags te nam mkha' dar la bgyis/ sa gzhi gyi ling gi rtas khengs/ gser phor dngul phor thams cad chab tsha dang / 'bras chang dang / nas chang gis bkang / dus 'di phan chad bka' shog chen po btang ste chos khrims bcas/ slan chad chab 'og gi 362

'bangs las pho mig mi dbyung mo sna mi bcad/ mtshang can mi skum par gnang /skye bo thams cad kyis rje'i bka' nyan zhing rje 'bangs thams cad kyis rab tu byung ba dbu'i mchod gnas su phyung nas phyag dang mchod pa dang bkur stir bya ba sogs chos kyi bka' khrims chen po bstsal ba bkar btags/ de ltar bya ba'i ched du btsan po yab sras dang sna chen po ma gtogs pa blon chen man chad nas sna la gtogs pa ril gyis bro bor ro/ /chos gtsigs mdzad bka' gtsigs kyi rdo ring btsugs/ rab tu byung ba'i chos gra'i slob dpon dang nya ma'i slob dpon bskos/ deng phan chad dkon mchog gsum dang dge 'dun gyi bshos ni khab so chen mo las sbyar/ sngar ye shes dbang po dang slob dpon bo dhi sa twas gsol ba bzhin chos la 'jug par chad nas sgra bsgyur btsugs te lo tsā ba chen pos ni rgya gar gyi lo tsā byas/ rgya nag po'i lo tsā bran ka legs kong dang / lha lung glu gong dang / 'og gom dbus gong dang / khyung po rtse rtse sogs kyis byas/ rgya'i hā shang ma ko le spyan drangs nas chos bsgyur ba las/rba rartas shes rab 'bum thog mar bsgyur ba'i tshe/ bod khams su 'bum sde rgyas par 'gyur/ de'i bsod nams dang byin gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su theg pa chen po spyod pa sha stag skye 'o zhes rmi lam du lung bstan/ rba bran mkhan po mañdzus shes rab 'bum btsan po khri srong lde btsan rje 'bangs la bshad pa'i tshe btsan po mnyes nas phyag dbu la byugs te bya dga' che thang du gsol/ rgyud kun las btus pa yang mañdzus bsgyur/ zham ring dge slong dang skye bo kun na re chos mkhas rab ste gsol zhes grags/ jo mo lha rgyal gyi zhal nas kyang de ltar chos mkhas pa zas su ci gsol gsungs/ nus pa yod pa kun gyis rgya dpe rnyed tshad bsgyur/ 'tsho ba thams cad bla chen po nas sbyar te tshang mang ke ru gling nas g.yos sa byas te rab tu byung ba sum brgya la zas sna bcu gsum re 'dren 363

pa'i lag dpon jo mo byang chub rjes mdzad/ gdan non pa dang rgyas pa bam po re la shog dril re byas nas 'don te na ma re la 'bum tshar re bka' sgrog gozhes byung ngo / /chos bsgyur tshul gyi na yams kyang du ma da lta'i rba bzhed na 'di ltar bris snang ste/ rba bzhed rgyas shos lugs gcig la rgya nag po'i chos rnams thog mar bsgyur/ rgya dkar po'i chos la nang rgyud sde gsum sha chang la yengs te bod la mi 'tshams pas ma bsgyur/ thams cad yod smra'i sde bye brag du smra ba rgyu 'bras ston te bod la 'tshams par mkhyen nas bsgyur/ ye shes dbang po la gsol te dang po lung sde bzhi las lung ring po dang gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung du zhig bsgyur/ mngon pa la nyan thos kyi ko ṣa bskyur/ kha cig na re 'dul ba la dge 'dun phal chen sde ni khrims yangs ches pa dang gnas brtan pa mang bkur ba gsum ni ma bsgyur/ nyan thos kyi 'dul ba dang mdo sde dang theg chen gyi mngon pa'i bstan bcos ril bsgyur/ tand+ra las ma hā yo ga mu stegs dge ba la gzud pa'i slad du gtsang dme med par bstan pas ma bsgyur/a ti yo ga chos kyi dbyig lta bu ni ma rtogs par log par 'jug bar 'gyur bas ma bsgyur/ sngags yo ga nus pa can yang bod la nus pa mi 'byung bas ma bsgyur/ kṛ ya bram ze rnams dge ba la gzud pa'i phyir gsungs pa bod gtsang sbra chung bas ma bsgyur/ a nu yo ga rme bag can la bstan pa bod rtog pa che bas ma bsgyur/ u pa ya bod la ran par brtsis nas ye shes dbang pos bsgyur/ mdo sde dang gzungs rgya gar du ma lus pa tsam zhig bsgyur/ btsan po'i zhal nas rgya gar dang rgya nag gi cho sa dpe phal cher bsgyur ba las chos dpe thams cad shri nā len na yod pa mes tshig deng ma tshig pa shas cig ma bsgyur bar yod pa ngari yid la gcags so gsungs zhes bris snang mod dpyad pa'i gzhi'o/ /bu ston chos byung las ni/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi slob dpon bi 364

ma la mi tra dang sangs rgyas gsang ba dang shānti garba dang bishuddhā sidha la sogs pa dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba sad mi bdun dang / chos kyi snang ba dang / badzhai nam mkha' dang / sgro rin chen sde dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / shākya 'od la sogs pas lo tsā byas te chos mang po bsgyur/ sngags 'chang dharma kirti zhes pa spyan drangs te yo ga rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du dbang bskur/ kha che'i paṇḍita dzi na mi tra dang da na shī la la sogs pas rnam dag khrims khang gling du khrims 'bogs/ rgya'i ha shang la sogs pas mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du bsam gtan byed/ brda sbyor tshangs pa'i gling du brda sbyor/ dkor mdzod pe /ra gling du nor 'jog be ro tsa na'i gling du chos 'chad pa la sogs pas bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa dar bar byas te 'brug gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i ston sgra bsgyur gyi bandhe dpal brtsegs dang bandhe kluri dbang po la sogs pas bod khams su dam pa'i chos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi mtshan byang bam po dang slo ga'i grangs su mchis par gtan la bab nas dkar chag du bris so zhes byung ngo / /gzhan yang yer pa dang chu bo ri la sogs la sgom gra chen po btsugs pa la grub thob mang du byung ste yer pa'i dkar chag bla ma zangs ri bas yer pa bsos pa'i spe'u ser po nas thon pa las/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje ni 'brom stod gung mo cher 'khrungs/skya ming stag nya bzang zer/ rgya bod kyi mtshams bsrungs te rgya rnams btul/lan gcig go cha phud pa'i rmog gi nang na tog gi gzungs bzhugs pa bgrags pas/ bra nye la ni gang skyes pa/ rkang mthil rme ba dmar po can/ /shi nas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /zer ba mthong / rkang mthil bltas pas rme ba dmar po cig 'dug klog mkhan la klog du bcug pas kyang de bzhin du 'dug zer/ der yab mched gnyis khong rang spun gsum dang bcas pa bsam 365

yas su paṇḍita bzhugs pa'i rtsar phyin/ bee ma la mi tra las rab tu byu nga /padma sambha wa las byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs/ rab 'byor dbang po dbyangs/ dpal gyi rdo rje/ btsun pa dpal gyi dbyangs te mched gsum po grib kyi dkar mo rong du bsgoms pas dpal gyi rdo rje'i chos gos lhags pas khyer ba bsnyegs pas yer pa lha ri snying por shug pa bya phong tsam zhig la bkris nas 'dug khong sa dpyad la mkhas pas ri de jo mo sgrol ma'i bzhugs tshul 'dra ba g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa/ shar gyi ri spungs pa 'dra ba nub ri rin po che bstar la brgyus pa 'dra ba/ lho gzhol ba byang bskyabs pa brag bya rgod spungs pa 'dra ba/ shug pa'i nags smyug lo rgyas pa lta bu/ yar gyi gnam sgo bye bas grub pa thob pa'i gnas su bzang bar gzigs nas yab mched rnams tshur spyan drangs/ brag lha brag phug brus pas brag srin mo langs pa dang rnal 'byor phug gi mchod rten bzhengs/ mas kyi klu gnyan langs pas zhing kha mchod rten bzhengs/ phar nas brag srin langs pas brag gu dkar po'i mchod rten bzhengs/ 'bangs sbal gnyos sogs byang tshwa khar btang ste drug bcu sde'i tshwa dang brag phug brus pa'i brag phye brjes nas byin/ chos don du gnyer pa rnams der tshogs te mchod gnas tsho gsum gyi rab la so sor skyel/ 'bring la 'byon par zhu/ tha ma rnams phug ron sna nas dung bus te khyams khra mor 'tshoga'abangs rlangs mi che chung / sog mtha' bzhi/ 'a zha sha ra/ g.ye rma sum pa rnams kyis sgom chen rnams kyi g.yig byed/ de ltar rtse gcig du sgom pa'i tshe snubs nam mkha' snying pos nam mkha' phug tu grub pa thob ste nyi zer la chos gos bkal nang gcig nyi zer la chibs nas bzhud/ btsun pa dpal gyi dbyangs seng ge gdong sngon zhig tu byas te sgang khar bab pas seng ge sgang du thogs/ mchod rten bzhengs te dbyar zla 'bring po nya'i nyi shar la tog gi grib 366

so phog sar yab kyi spur bzhugs/ zla ba phug tu rab zla ba grags pas zla zer la chos gos bkal/ zla ba'i zer la 'chibs te lha ri snying po'i rtser gshegs/ smyal dge rigs kyis thun mong gi dngos grub thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'khar bum dang lha la chags pas sa la lhung / mthu chen gyis nam mkha' la 'gro shes/ 'dre 'phrang phug sgrub chu'i phug brag rtsa phug rnams su skye dmar pho/ zhang srid rum/ bag yangs seng ge g.yung drung rnams kyis grub pa thob/ 'bri yas rgyang chupha gzhon nu/ rdo rje dpal 'byung / gad las byang chub gzhon nu/ lha kun du bzang po/ lcags rdo rje snying po/ so rdo rje snying po/ dbyig rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ ra byid rdo rje snying po/ rbas rab mchogangan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ myang ting 'dzin bzang po/ sog po dpal gyi gzhon nu/ rbas rdo rje brtan/ 'brom dpal gyi snying po/ 'phrul snang gnas brtan/ shing mi go cha/ mtshur nag dpal gyi ye shes/ rnal 'byor rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ hor shākya byang chub sogs skyes bu dam pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyis grub pa thob ste bzhugs gnas la 'bri yas phug nas hor tshang phug gi bar so so'i mtshan thogs/ khon klu'i dbang pos bde mchog dril bu pa'i grub pa thob/phyag dril nam mkha' la bzhag pas dril bu phug du thogs/ gnyags dzha na ku mar dang ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gnyis kyis slob dpon padma la dbang bskur dang gdams ngag zhus nas/ gnyags kyis gnyags phug tu bsgoms/grub pa thob nas bya rog tu byas te 'phur bas bya rog skyabs su thogs/ ngan lam gyi rtsar phyin pas ngan lam gyis grogs por shes te stabs su bsdad pas yang rnga mong chung ba zhig tu byas nas bskor ba lan gsum byas nas ngan lam la spyang rab 'dug zer skad/ de ltar grub thob brgya rtsa brgyad la btsun pa dpal gyi rdo rje dang 'bangs rnams kyis zhabs tog byed/ de'i tshe 'bangs rnams 367

tshang mang ring mo la bad g.yam gtong tsam na lha lung rab 'byor dbyangs bang sa phug na bzhugs pas sor rdo 'phangs pa bang la phog pa dang / lha lung dpal rdor gyi thugs dgongs la rab 'byor dbyangs 'di nged spun gsum gyi che shos yin/ nga'i dge ba'i las 'di tsam la za ma cig kyang mi byed par sor rdo 'phen pa snyam pa dang / rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mkhyen nas skad cig de la mdun du yer byung ste phyag yug mdzad cing 'o skol sgom par chad dam mkhar las byed par chad gsungs pas lan ma thebs/ 'o na khyod kyi mkhar las ji tsam tshar gsung bas/ mkhar las tshar/ rab gnas dang lha gzo'i rdzongs ma tshar bas 'bangs sbal gnyos kyis mgo byas tshwa kha la btang snyam byas pas/'o na khyod nga la za ma re bar 'dug pas tshwa la ma gtong bar sgod rnyed tshad khrus la tshes gcig nas brgyad kyi bar du kha ma 'byed par zhog de dus lha bzo dang yon bdag rnams kyang bos/ dpal chen chu bo ri la grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs pa spyan drongs la rab gnas zhus/ za ma ngas byed kyi gsungs/ nge bzhin byas pas tshes brgyad kyi dro ran ran ci la cang med/de nas spyan sngar phyin nas phyag byas pas ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas spyan ma phyed/ yang phyag gsum byas pa dang spyan hur mdzad de de bzhin byas sam gsung / bgyes lags zhus pas chos gos smad lnga mnabs nas ye shes phug na dbyangs mdzad de/ dad pa can la gtong ba'i nor mi phongs/ /rgya mtsho'i chu la bcus kyang zad pa med/ /de phyir dad ldan khyod la bsod stoms slong / /gsung nas mkhar sil gyis brag brdungs pas sdod thams cad lha'i zhal zas dang rin po ches gange ste de tsho la longs spyod cig gsungs/ kho bo lho phyogs dpa' gyi ri la 'gro gsungs nas bzhud/ brjed pa gcig byung gsungs nas phyi phyag mdzad pas phyag 'tshal sgang du thogs/ dpal gyi rdo rje dang g.yog po 368

gnyis la khyed rang gnyis kyang dpal gyi ri la 'dong gsungs pas me snyedegro zer/yang mi 'gro'am gsungs pas kyang ma nyan/ kham pa'i sgyid po gsum snad du bcug nas yer par ma slebs par ma lta zhig gsungs/ gnyis jog po phur bltas pas kham par 'dug gcig yer par kha phye bas gser du 'dug pas de las g.yog pos mchod rten gong na med bzhengs te ring bsrel lhung bzed gang bzhugs/ chu bo ri'i grub thob rnams kyis lha la rab gnas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig mdzad/ bsam grub dang dpal gyi lha mor lan gsum gsum/ brag lhar lan nyi shu rtsa lnga mdzad de sprul pa'i sku dngos dang khyad par med gsungs nas nas 'bru dkyil 'khor la btab/ mi gzhan gyi rdog pa bzhag du mi rung gsungs nas ma skyed ma phri bar dpal gyi rdo rje nyid kyis sgom zhing bzhugs/ thugs dam du sku'e rten shākya thub pa/ gsung rten bla 'bum/ smon lam gyi rten phal chen mtshal yig can khradma pā pāṇi rnams bzhengs/ dpal gyi rdo rje'i slob ma sog po dpal gyi gzhon nu dge slong rma sha ri buddhā sogs bcu gsum gyis grub pa brnyes so/ /dus tha ma la smyal gyi dge ri the rang gis dbang byed dpal chen chu bo ri klus dbang byed/ yer par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi sgom sa yin no/ /zhes byung ngo / /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro snying thig las slob dpon chen po padma'i zhal nas da lta kho bo ni gdug pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa yin/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po mngon sum snying thig gi bstan pa ni bi ma la mi tra'i phrin las dus la bab pa yin zhes ma spel bar gter du bzhag par gsungs pa ltar bi ma la mi tra spyan drangs nas chos mang du gsungs/ rgyal po dang gnyags dzñā na sogs la snod brtags pas snying thig gi snod du ma rung nas myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la sgod brtag pa'i phyir kho bo a tsar rgya gar du ldog pa la gser mang po dgos pas khyod kyis yul gzhis sogs ci yod gser 369

du dril la nga la phul zhig gsungs pas shin tu dga' ste gang yod gser du phul bas mnyes nas nga la gser gyis dgos pa med/ khyod kyi snod brtags pa yin gsungs te mnyes nas man ngag rdzogs par gnang / dam can rdo rje legs pa bkug ste khang pa'i mthongs khung chung ngu zhig la smyug ma'i zhwa mthil btol ba bkab ste khyod kyis 'di nas kyis gang bar gyis cig ces gsungs pas yul mang por ser ba phab ste nas blug pa 'og khang nas phyung ste lha khang brtsiṭa pas dbur stod zhwa'i lha khang zhes grags shing legs par zin nas dam can la gtad/ yul gru de yang myang ban dbang bar rdo ring la bka' gtsigs brkos so/ /sngon ma zhang grom pa skyes la sogs pas chos bshig pa thugs la bcags nas phyin chad de lta bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir bod sus kyang chos mi bshig pa'i bka' gtsigs bcas/ dbu snyung bzhes mna' bsgags te de 'dra ba lan gnyis mdzad pa'i bka' gtsigs dang po ni/ dmya/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/ shog bu mthing ga la gser gyis bris nas/ gser gyi sgrom bur bstsal ba'i bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkor mdzod du bzhag pa las dpe bgyis te bris pa/ bcu/dkond cog gsum nam du yang mi btang ma zhig bar dgyi ba'i gtsigs sgrom bu nang na mchis pa'i dpe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' las byung ba don thog tu sbyar na yang dag pa nyid khong du ma chud pas khams gsum yang sdug bsngal gyi gnas su gyur/ thams cad kyang gna' nas ma skyes pa med/ skyes nas ni don dang don med par spyod/ de nas kyang shi bar 'gyur/ shi nas kyang gnas bzang ngan du phyir skye/ de la legs su ston pa ni sangs rgyas/ mngon par dmigs pa ni chos kyi yi ge dge bar mtshon pa ni dge 'dun rnams te/gtan gyi skyabs dang gling du bzang ngo / dkond cog gsum ni byin du cher che 370

ste/ yab mes snga ma kun gyi ring la yang gdung rabs re re zhing lugs su mdzad de/ gtsug lag khang gsar rnying dngos yod pa yin/ btsan po yab dgung du gshegs pa'i phyi na sa/ pan pun khyer ba'i dpe tshul yod pa nas/gtsug lag khang lhun gyis 'grub tu/ lug gi lo la dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun la rten btsugs pa'i tshe/ da nas phan chad/ bod yul du dkond cog gsum rten bcas te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa mi gzhig par btsan po yab sras dang sras kyi yum gyis dbu snyung bzung zhing yi dam bcas pa dang / phyi nang gi zlon po che phra mtha' dag bro stsal ba'i gtsigs kyi yi ger bris pa'o/dmya/ ra sa'i 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang / rgya tags ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang dang / brag dmar gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub kyi gtsug lag khang dang / khams gsum mi ldog sgrol gyi gtsug lag khang la stsogs te/ bod kyi rigs su bla nas/ dkond cog gsum gyi rten btsugs te/ bod las kyang thar par gzud cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa 'di nam du yang / mi gtang ma zhig bar bgye'o/ /bod las kyang thard par gzud do/ btso/ gtsug lag khang de rnams su dkond mchog gsum gyi yo byad sbyor ba'i rkyend kyang ran pa 'ong bar dpags te bla nas phul ba las/ nam zhar kyang mi dpra mi bskyung bar bgyis so/ /da phyin chad gdung rabs re re yang / btsan po yab sras 'di bzhin du yi dam bca' zhing zhal gyis bzhes par bgyi'o/ /blon po thog thog kyang bro stsal bar bgyi'o/ bcu/ 'di ltar yi dam bcas pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / dam pa'i chos thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos thams cad dang / gnam sa'i rim pa lha 'o cog dang / bod yul gyi sku lha dang /lha dgu thams cad dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang mi ma yin pa thams cad ཿ71

dbang du gsol te/ gtsigs 'di 'a/sa mi /3gyur bar mkhyen par bgyis so/ /de la gtsigs ltar ma bgyis te/ dkond cog gsum gyi sku bslus sam mna' kha dpung bgyis na/ sems cad dmyal bar skyes shig /'di bzhin du mdzad cing bgyis na/ thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas par shog cig bcu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bod yul du/ snga phyir ji ltar byung ba'i bka' mchid kyi yi ge gcig kyang zla la bzhag go bcu/ dpe 'di 'dra ba bcu gsum brisu te/ gcig ni phyag spal na bzhag go /gnyis ni phyag rgyas btab ste/ ra sa'i 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang / brag dmar gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub kyi dge 'dun la re re bzhag go /bcu ni mthar phyag rgyas btab ste/ ra sa'i 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang / khra 'brug gi bkra shis lha yul gtsug lag khang dang / pho brang 'khor gyi dge 'dun dang / ra sa'i rgya btags ra mo che dang / brag dmar gyi khams gsum mi ldog sgrol dang / bru sha yul dang / zhang zhung yul dang / mdo smad dang / sde blon ris dang / 'di rnams kyi gtsug lag khang gi dge 'dun pa dpe re re 'chang du stsald to/ dgye/ bro stsald pa la/ dgye/ dbon 'a zha rje/ dbya/ zhang blon chen po bka' la gtogs pa la/ bcu/ blon chen po zhang rgyal gzig4sa shu theng / blon stag sgra klu gong / zhang rgyal mtshan lha snang /blon rgyal sgra legs gzigs/ blon btsan bzher mdo lod/ zhang rgyal nyen zla gong / blon khri gangs rgya gong / gcen mtsho btsan/ zhang rgyal tshan le gong /go༄9/ nang blon la/ blon gra 'dzi zhang rams shags/ zhang a srin/ zha snga khri gnyen/ blon klu gong / 'ong ka lha mtsho/ blon shang btsan/ blon srin skyugs/ blon 'dus ston/ zhang stag tshab/ zhang legs 'dus/bcu/ phyi‘blon la/ zhang bal bu stang / zhang lha gzigs/ blon la 372
