kun rtse/ blon spra bzhin/ blon stong thub/ blon zla gong / blon gtsug khyung sling / blon lhos po/ zhang rgyal snang / blon byin byin/ blon long po/ blon rtsang lod/ blon gnyan kong / stod smad kyi dbang po dang dmag dporna la/blon skyesabazang stag snang / blon snang kong / blon khyi chung / blon klu bzher/zhang mar bu/ blon lha mtsho/ blon par mi/ blon shang rdzong / blon mig khyung chud/ blon tang bu/ khu rgya brtsan/ khu g.yu brtsan/ blon mdo gzigs/blon khong khri/ blon khong legs/ blon rmang la skyes/ blon mdo bzang / blon khri gong / chos bod yul du snga phyir ji ltar byung ba'i bka' mchid kyi yi ge gcig kyang zla la bzhag go /brang ti shrī la warmas brim/ zhes byung ngo / /bka' gtsigs gnyis pa ni/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/ chos 'byung ba'i lo drung gi yi ge zla la bzhag pa/ phra myen gyis bris te gser gyi sgrom bur bstsal nas/ dpal bsam yas kyi dkor mdzod du bzhag pa las dpe bgyis nas bris pa/ bcu/ gna' da 'chad bod yul du dkond cog gsum gyi rten bcas te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa'i lo drung gi yi ger bris pa/sgrom bu'i nang na mchis pa'i dpe/ dmya/ btsan po bzhi mes khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la/ ra sa'i pe har brtsigs te sangs rgyas kyi chos thog ma mdzad tshun chad/ btsan po yab khri lde gtsug brtsan gyi ring la/ brag dmar gyi kwa chur gtsug lag khang brtsigs te sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad phand chad gdung rabs lnga lon no/ /bcu/ btsan po yab dgung du gshegs kyi 'og du zhang blon kha cig gis hur 'dums kyi blo zhig phyung ste/ yab mes kyi ring tshund chad/sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa yang bshig go /de nas yang snyad ni lho bal gyi lha dang chos bod yul du bgyi ba'i myi rigal shes/ gzhan yang phyind chad bgyid du mi gnang bar bka' khrims bris so/ bcu/ de nas btsan po zha snga nas lo 373

nyi sha bzhes pa na/ thog ma ni phyag spring dang lhas shig ngan te/ cho ga ci mdzad ༄pas bshad kyang / dgung zla du mar phyag spring dang ltas ngan nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bgyid du mi gnang ba'i bka' khrims kyang khrims su mi bgyi bar dor/ dkond cog gsum gyi mchod pa yang bgyi zhes bgyis na gzod bzang por gyurd to// dmya/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstangs te chos kyang gsan/ yi ge yang spyan sngar brims nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos spel zhing mdzad par sgroms so/ /de na bod kyi chos rnying pa ma lags la/ sku lha gsol ba dang cho ga myi mthun pas/ kun kyang ma legs su dogs te/ la la ni sku la dmar yang dogs/ la la ni chab srid gong gis kyang dogs/ la la ni mi nad phyugs nad byung gis kyang dogs/ la la ni mu ge langs bab kyis kyang dogs so// bcu/ chos nyid kyi nang du brtags na/ chos las byung ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams su myed pa na/ sems can gyi khams grangs med pa/ skye ba rnam bzhi'i nang du skye zhing 'khor ba la gtogs so cog dang po'i thog ma med pa nas/tha ma'i mtha' myed pa'i bar du/ rang gi las kyis de bzhin du srid pa las/lus dang ngag dang yid gsum nas legs par spyad do cog ni dge bar 'gyur/nyes pa spyad do cog ni sdig par 'gyur/ legs nyes med pa ni lung du myi ston par 'gyur/ gzhan la phar byas pa'i 'bras bu ni bdag la smind te/ gnam gyi rim pa'i lhar skye ba dang / sa'i stang gi myi dang / lha ma yin dang / yi dwags dang / byol song dang / sa'i 'og gi sems can dmyal ba dang / 'di drug du skye 'o cog kyang rang gi las kyis 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten las 'das te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang byang chub dang / nyan thos kyis rim par 'grub pa kun kyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rang gis bsags pa las 'gyur ro zhes 'byung ngo / /dge ba gang 374

zhe na dge ba bcu la bsags pa'o/ /mi dge ba gang zhe na/ mi dbe bcu la sogs pa'o/ /lung du mi ston pa gang zhe na/ spyod lam bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gang zhe na4 dge bcu'i steng du bden pa bzhi dang / rkyen dang 'du ba tshogs ste byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum bcu rtsa bdun dang pha rold tu phyin pa bcu la sogs pa'o/ /de'i 'bras bu ni mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /so so yang dag par shes pa bzhi dang / stobs bcu dang / ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad dang / thugs rje chen po sum bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs par 'gyur tu/ gtan tshigs zhib tu ni chos kyi yi ge'i nang na mchis so// bcu/ chos kyi nang nas byung ba 'di rnams rjes bcad na/ kha cig ni legs nongs kyis dmyigs 'phral du mngon pa yang mchis/ kha cig 'phral du mi mngon pa yang mngon par gda' ba rnams kyi tshul las dpags na/ nges par gzung du rung ba yang mchis te/ mdo de rnams dang sbyar na/ chos 'di gtang ngam mdzad dam ci rigs zhes/ 'bangs su mnga' ba rgyal phran 'a zha rje la sogs pa dang / phyi nang gi blon po rnams la bka'as rmas/ bka' gros su mdzad nas/ gcig tu na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' lung la bsten/ gnyis su na yab mes kyi dpe lugs la 'tshal/ gsum du na dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mthus bstangs pa dang yang sbyar nas mdor brtags na/ myi dge ma legs par dogs pa'i rnams kyang da ltar myi 'gyur gyi steng du/ ched che bar bka' gros mdzad do/ /de lam legs par ni ji ltar myi 'gyur ched ni ji ltar che zhe na/ chos kyi mdo ni legs su bgyi bas/ bla na med pa'i don bsgrub pa lags te/ legs pa'i mtha' nongs par mi 'gyur gyis gcig thams cad la yun du dben pa 'di lta'o/ /tshod dpags tsam gyis dgos pa gzhig du myi rung gis gnyis/ yab 375

mes gdung rabs du ma'i bar du mdzad kyang / ma legs pa ma byung ba dang gsum gyis da yang nongs par myi 'gyur la ched che'o zhes/ /mdzad par bka' gros btul te mdzad do/ /de lta bas na sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa yang gcig du na yong gis bzang la gces/ gnyis na sngon bshig pa'i dpe byung bas thugs yid dogs te brtan du mi gzhig par dbu snyung bro mna' bor ba yang yi ger bris so/ /phyin chad kyang gdung rabs gcig cing / yi dam mdzad pa dang blon po man chad kyang bro stsal bar bgyis so/ /zhes byung ngo / /'di dag ni rgyas pa dkor mdzod du bzhag pa yin la/ mdor bsdus bsam yas kyi rdo ring la brkos pa'i gtsegs yig ni/ da༄re/ ra sa dang brag dmar gyi gtsug lag khang la sogs par dkond cog gsum gyi rten btsugs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa 'di nam du yang myi gtang ma zhig par bgyi'o/ /yo byad sbyar pa yang / de las myi 'bri myi skyung bar bgyi'o/ /da phyin chad gdung rabs re re zhing yang / btsan po yab sras kyis/ 'di bzhin yi dam bca'o/ /de las mna' kha dbyung pa dag kyang myi bgyi/ myi bsgyur bar 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten gyi lha dang myi ma yin pa thams cad kyang phang du gsol te/btsan po yab sras dang rje blon kun gyis dbu snyung dang bro bor ro/ /gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo gcig ni gung na mchis so/ /zhes byung ngo / /de ltar dam chos rab tu rgyas mdzad nas/ /dgung blon chen po mgos kyis gsol ba ltar/ /rje'i gdung rabs 'bangs kyi sa bcad dang / /ya rabs rnams la phyag dang zhe sa'i tshul/ /gtam dang lo rgyus bzang po'i las thabs dang / pha mes dge dang yig tshangs la sogs pa/ /ya rabs bzang po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos la/ /bod 'bangs thams cad bkod de bde bar mdzad/ /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar du mnga' mdzad de/ /rgya nag rje bskos lo yi ming la sogs/ /bod ltar 376

bya ba'i 'ja' sa chen po bsgrags/ /sto phyogs skar ma me bzhi 'char ba'i mtha'/ /rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram la thug /dzasbu'i gling gi sum gnyis mnga' dbang mdzad/ /mgos kyi blon chen khri bzang yab lhag gis/ /mdzangs༄'i las su gsos thang stong thang bcad/ /phyi rabs blon po g.yar khral chung bar byas/ stag btsan gdong gzigs blon po gnyer gyi bus/ /mdzangs pa'i las su dbyar rtsa dgun du bskams/ /mdzangs mi bdun las tha ma gnyis su graṭa/ /gzhan yang zhang blon tshe dgur grags pa byung / /rje yi bka' lung khri gdugs brdal ba 'dra/ /bod 'bangs thams cad bde skyid chos la spyod/ /de yang rba bzhed las/ dus der blon po mgos kyi mchid nas lha chos ni rgyas par mdzad lags te da skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus kyang bya bar ci gnang zhes zhus pas/ rje'i gdung rabs dang 'bangs kyi sa bcad/ dkon cog la phyag dang mchod pa/bla dang ya rabs la zhe sa/ gtam dang lo rgyus/ bzang po'i las thabs dang lag rjes/ pha mes kyi dge dang yig tshangs sogs ya rabs kyi lugs rgyas par mdzad do ces byung ngo / /gzhan yang dpon zhang ma dum par zhang rgyal tsha lha snang sogs kyis dmag dpon byas te chu mo yos kyi lo la rgya cham la phab/ tha'i dzung rgyal po shen chur bros nas rgya'i rgyal khams la dbang mdzad/ thang ga'u dbang zhes pa gyim shing kong jo'i mched zla zhig rgya'i rgyal por bskos/ rgya nag gi lo'i ming spos cing 'ja' sa bsgrags te shar skar ma smin drug 'char ba'i mtha' kem shing khri sgo la thug lho me bzhi 'char ba'i mtha' chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du rdo ring btsugs pa la thug ste dzaspu'i gling sum gnyis la mnga' mdzad do/ /de'i tshe blon chen mgos rgan gyi sras mgos khri bzang yab lhag gis sngar zhal ce dang gsos thang stong thang khrigs su bcad pa la khrigs su bcad nas byang bu cha dgur bcos te/ mi stong sogs kyi zhal ce'i dus shags kyi mgo rgyangs ma yig 377

tshangs stong thang bden yus dang bcas bris te bla'i grar sreng pa la byang zas zer/de'i lan gyi byang bu la sbrul mgo yang lon la smig nag zer te de gsum gsos dang stong gi byang bu'o/ /gnyen bye bral gyi zhal ce'i dus gnyen sdebs dang dgra sdebs ji ltar byung ba'i mgo rgyangs dang bcas thog mar bsrings pa la then byang zer/ smyon thol dkar mi'i zhal ce'i dus bsrings pa la byang bu mchu smyung zer ste spyir blo yus kyi byang bu lnga'o/ /blo yus kyi shags dang sbyar nas drang por gcod pa la zang yag zer/ yon por gcod pa la rked khre zer/ bden rdzun gyi kha dmar 'dogs pa la byang bu kha dmar zer te zhal ce'i byang bu gsum mo / /nyes pa'i skyon thams cad bzang po'i rgyas btab nas byang bar byed pa la rgya byang zer te spyir rgyug pa'i byang bu'o/ /de yang dgung blon chen po ni 'gran gyi zla med de bsad na stong thang khri chig stong / dgung blon 'bring po dang nang blon chen po gnyis mnyam ste khri/ dgung blon chung ngu nang blon 'bring po bka' yo gal 'chos pa chen po gsum mnyam ste dgu stong / nang blon tha chung dang bka' yo gal 'chos pa 'bring mnyam ste brgyad stong / bka' blon chung ngu la bdun stong ngo / /de bzhin du 'bangs yang tha'i bar du rim pas bcad de khrims yag tu bkod pas blon po phyi ma rnams la shin tu drin che bas bod phrug mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi drug par 'dren no/ /gnyer stag btsan gdong gzigs kyis kyang 'bangs mi khyim re la rta re mdzo re ba re glang re la sogs pa bsrel bar bcas/ dbyar gyi rtswa sngon dgun du skem pa sogs byas pas mdzangs pa'i mi bdun par grags so/ /yang btsun mo 'bro bza' byang chub kyi khrims bu chung zhes skyes pa la pho phyag bud med la mo phyag bslabs/ phyug pos bun gtong ba zhing la mo rdo btsugs pa ston dpyid kyi bar kha mnyam pa rnams byas skad/ gzhan yang zhang blon che dgu zhernga / sbas snang bzher lha btsan la dpa' 378

mtshan du stag gi gong slag yig tshangs g.yu yig dang g.yung drung chen po dkor nor ke ke ru rnams kyis che/ 'bro khri zungs ra shags seng ge dkar mo'i gong slag gis che/ mchims rgyal gzigs shud ting za 'og gi bye can dang bran dgu khri yod pas che/ sbrang g.yu pa rgya ra legs gzigs gser yig gis che/ sna nam khri bzungs nya bzang chos kyi bla mkhyen yin pas che/ co ro stag can gzig can mtha'i so kha bsrungs pas che/ cog ro khong btsan 'bangs dgu brgya dgu bcu yod pas che/ myang zhwa 'o che g.yu'i zhwa mda' gang yod pas che/ snubs dpal bo che dngul gyi 'bo chen dgu 'phang yod pas che/ de re re la yang dpa' mtshan re/ yig tshangs gser g.yu gang rung / dkor nor re/ byas pa lag ris re so sor yod pas rgyal pos dpangs bstod pa ste/ zhang blon che dgu btsan po ring dang bcu zhes grags so/ /de nas rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas ni/ /lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad du gshegs/ /mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tshos/ /bod yul srung ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis po/ /slob dpon padmas dam la btags pas na/ /bod du mu stegs phyi pa mi 'byung mod/ /lo 'ga' zhig nas dbu ma'i lta ba la/ /mi mthun rtsod pa byed 'gyur de yi tshe/ /nga yi slob ma ka ma la shī la/ /spyan drongs rtsod pa chos su zhi 'gyur zhes/ /gsungs nas mi rtag mya ngan 'da' bar bstan/ /sku gdung mchod rten byas te rgyal pos mchod/ /chos kyi ring lugs ye shes dbang por bskos/ /rab byung re la 'bangs khyim gsum gsum sogs/ /dkon cog gsum gyi lha 'bangs rgya cher bcad/ /ye shes dbang po mkhar chu'i brag la sgom/ /dpal dbyangs chos kyi ring lugs mdzad pa'i tshe/ /hā shang ma hā ya na'i slob ma dar/ /dge bas mtho ris sdig pas ngan 'gror 'khor/ /lus ngag dge sdig yid byed kun bkag nas/ /cig char dran med 'jug pa lam du smra/ /bo dhi 379

sa twa'i rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig tsam/ /gzhan dag phal cher ha shang lugs su spyod/ /ston min brtse min gnyis ces rtsod par gyur/ /de tshe ye shes dbang po spyan drangs pas/ /nga yi sgrub pa bar chad ma byung na/ /btsan po sku tshe ring zhing bod yul du/ /dam chos yun ring gnas par 'gyur pa zhig /zhes gsung mkhan po'i zhal chems mnyel bsos te/ /mkhas pa padma'i ngang tshul spyan drangs nas/ /btsan pos dgung mnan rtsod pa'i gra bshams tshe/ /lung dang rigs pas hā shang pham par mdzad/ /rtsod pa dam pa'i chos su zhi bar gyur/ /phyin chad lta ba klu sgrub lugs su zung / /spyod pa dge bcu phar phyin drug ldan spyod/ /sgom pa zhi lhag zung du 'brel bar gyis/ /lo tsās ma bsgyur paṇḍitas ma bshad/ /rgyal pos bka' btags sbyin bdag ma byas pa'i/ /chos la spyad du mi gnang bka' khrims bsgrags/ /de yang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padmas rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba rdzogs pa chen po gsungs/ rje 'bangs nyer gcig pos dngos grub re re thob ste grub pa'i mtshan ma rdzu 'phrul snang re bstan/ gzhan yang snubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyus nag bde gshegs/ mgos rdo rje dbang phyug la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang du smin par mdzad/ bod yul thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ gter kha mang du sbas shing ma 'ongs pa dus dus su las can gyi skyes bu res thon nas 'gro ba'i don 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs te slar sto nub rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon la gshegs te mya ngan las 'da' ba med par bzhugs shing phyis bla ma rdo rje gdan pas grub thob rnams tshogs 'khor la spyan drangs pas grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi byon pa'i nang du gshegs te/ dge slong lus la phyag rgya bsten/ /sto nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad/ /380

padma kā ra zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa mdzad do/ /mkhan po gshegs pa dang ston rtsen rtsod pa'i tshul ni rba bzhed las/ de nas ring zhig na mkhan po bo dho sa twa pho brang rim dgu'i 'og du rtas phra ba rgyab ste zhal chems ye shes dbang po la bzhag ste sku gshegs/ de'i spur khang has po ri'i rgyab tu bzhugs nas mchod rten gcig kyang bzhengs/ der btsan pos ye shes dbang po chos kyi ring lugs su bskos te/ slad kyis ye shes dbang po mngon par shes pa dang yang ldan/ nged rje 'bangs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags pas sangs rgyas kyi zhal dang 'dra bas 'dun sa yang bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs su bkas bskos te bla'i gong du bton/ chos kyi bka' la btags/yig tshangs gser gyi yi ge chen po byin nas gral yang zhang blon chen po'i gong du 'dug cing / lha chos kyi 'dun sa yang 'dun sa chung ngu'i gong du phul la bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyis zhang blon chen po'i 'dus sa chung ngu ba gyis shig ces rje blon tshogs pa'i tshe bka' zhal gyis bstsal te bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs su bskos/ dkon cog gsum gyi rten brtan pa nam du'ang mi gzhig pa'i slad du dkon cog gsum dang dge 'dun gyi bshos cha las rje 'bangs rnams kyis mi gsol bar rkyen rigs bkum khrims bcas na slad nas legs zhes ye shes dbang pos snyan du gsol te/ btsan pos ni ban rnyi gcig la 'bangs khyim bdun du rkyen rigs bcad par dgongs pa dang ye shes dbang pos gsol ba/ ring lugs la smra na mi pha tshan 'ga' brlag pa dang lung pa ral 'ga' phung pa dang gnang chen kha cig sna'u 'phrang gis btugs te bstsal ba dang / mi gcig gi sgor bran khyim dgu brgya bstsal pa dang sbyar na sangs rgyas kyi chos bzang po 'di sku dang chab srid la sman par 'tshal te mtha' yun du rje 'bangs kyis bshul bzang po phye ngan song ga sum gyi sgo ni bkag pa la sogs pa 381

yon tan smos kyis mi lang ba zhig mdzad pa'i rkyen bkas bskul ba bzhin mdzad na ma nongs mod kyang / slad rjes su thugs nongs chen po cig bstud mar byung ngam/ mi phyugs la nad chen po byung ngam/ nyi 'og gi dgra zhig dbus su byung ngam/ mu ge chen po zhig bstud mar byung na dgongs pa mthar mi phyin pa dang /dkon cog gsum gyi rten mi gnas pa dang / dbon sras rje 'bangs la dngos sdig chen por 'gyur ba la sogs pa mi legs pa mang po zhig mchi bas dkon cog gsum la 'bangs khyim nyis brgya gang zag ban dhe re la 'bangs khyim gsum gyi thang du bcad de dbang dge 'dun la bskur nas lha ris kyi 'bangs mi zhing la bla nas dbang mi mdzad par bgyis na nam du yang brtan zhing legs zhes gsol ba dang / ye shes dbang pos gsol ba bzhin du bstsal bas ban dhe myang gi ting 'dzin la sogs pa ye shes dbang po'i g.yar mi nyan pa kun mi mchi dgu mchi mi zer dgu zer skad/ rkyen ris kyi 'bangs ni rgod dang rang rje dang khab so'i nang yig can dang thugs gnyen dang gzhi bzang po 'tshal las su sa bzung / rje'i zhing ni gang zag do 'tshal las gnang chen 'bri khri 'jam gung ston gyis bus bzung ba bzhin du bcad/ de nas myang la sogs pas sdig pa bsags pa des ye shes dbang po sgom par gsol te bros nas dben pa lho brag mkhar chu btsan gyi brag phug tu mchis pa'i slad nas shul du rba dbal dbyangs ring lugs su bskos/ ye shes dbang po sto brag du sgom pa las ltag la ga sha bkal ba'i 'og tu sba zam btsugs te btsan gyi brag phug du mchis nas ri bya la sogs pa kun kyang rdo dang shing la 'bab pa bzhin du ye shes dbang po'i lus la gnas/ khrims zla dag la ni nyer yang mi btub/ de'i tshe rgya co/ga gi hā shang ma hā ya na bya ba zhig brag dmar du mchis pa las/ des lus ngag gi chos spyod mi dgos/ lus ngag gi dge bas 'tshang mi rgya/ dran pa med cing yid la byar 382

med pa bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya zer nas sgom bslabs pas bod kyi ban dhe ril po thal gyis /yo ri chos la bslabs te bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang la mchod pa 'phro chad / slo ba gnyer dang lub/ ngag gi dge ba rgyun chad/ rba ratna dang bee ro tsa na la sogarnga nyung shas cig bo dhi sa twa'i chos slob bo/ der lta ba ma mthun nas rtsod de 'khrugs pas btsan pos rgya'i ston pa'i chos 'di bag tsam min nam gsungs pas ston min pa bya bar grags/ gcig shos na re drang srong bzod par smra ba sa lus la me btang nas kyang mcho da pa phul bas sems can la brtse ba'i bsam pas tshogs bsag pa gal che zer bas/ rgyal po na re lus la me gtong ba'i brtse ba de yang chos min nam byas pas brtse min pa bya bar grags/spyir lta ba dang spyod pa 'dzom pa'i chos shig yin pa la brtse min pa'i ltar yin gsungs pas ston min pa yid chad nas ma hā ya na'i slob ma nyang sha mis rang gi sha btub/ snyags bye ma la dang rngogs rin po ches rang gi pho mtshan brdungs/rgya'i ha shang ma mgos rang gi mgo la me btang ste 'das/ gzhan ma rnams chu gri rnon po re bsrel zhing brtse min pa ril bsad la nged kyang ril phru ma'i ngos la 'chi'o zer nas de rgyal po'i snyan du bdas pas gsan te/ rgyal pos ban dhe ston rtsen gnyis kyi bar gnya' g.yon bsgor bsgor nas 'dir ban dhi kun lta ba ma mthun bar 'khrugs ba la ji ltar mdzad kyang ma mkhyen pa dang ji ltar bya zhes ni bka' phrin springs nas ye shes dbang po 'phral du shog cig ces pho nya du ma zhig brdzangs pa las ma 'khugs nas nang blon gnon khams pa btang ste khyod kyis ye shes dbang po 'khugs na khyod la zangs chen po bya dgar byin/ ma 'khugs na khyod gsod do zhes bka' bstsal te sgrom bu bskur nas btang ngo / /gnon khams pas mkhar chur phyin/ bka'i sgrom bu brag phug du bskur te zhal mjal bar ci gnang zhes zhus pas mja' nas bdag dngos rkang btsugs te 383

'ongs na byon na shin tu thugs la btags te bdag la yang bya dga' gnang bar bdog ma byon na bdag gsod par yod pas brag g.yang 'di la bdag 'phyongs te 'gum mo zhes zhus pas ye shes dbang po'i zhal nas/ 'di nga'i dge sbyor la bar chad byed pa'i bdad chen po zhig 'ong na 'on kyang khyod kyi srog ༄dbyung gis nga 'ong bas rta khrid de shog cig gsungs nas dga' ches te pho brang du log 'phral du zangs chen po dang bya dga' che thang du bstsal/ chibs gu rub bcu drug btang bas ye shes dbang po pho brang du 'ongs nas spyan sngar mchis pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas ban dhe dag 'di ltar 'khrugs na zhes lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs nas da ji ltar bya zhes gsungs pa dang / ye shes dbang pos gsol ba/ de la bdag 'dir dgug mi 'tshal/ bdag 'dir ma mchis te sgom pa'i bar chad me byung na btsan po'i sku tshe dang bdag gi tshe yang yun ring du gnas/ lha chos kyang byams pa gshegs kyi bar du gnas par 'gyur ba zhig na bod skal ba ma mchis pas lan/ mkhan po 'da' khar 'di skad gsungs te yong ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gar byung bar mu stegs kyi rgol ba re 'gran zlar 'ong na yang bod yul du bstan pa lnga brgya'i tha ma la byung bas mu stegs kyi rgol pa ni mi 'byung / sangs rgyas pa nyid lta ba ma mthun te rtsod par 'gyur gyis de lta bu byung na nga'i slob ma ka ma la shī la bya ba zhig bal yul na 'dug pa spyan drongs la de dang shes pa 'gyed du chug la rgyal pos bsdums gyis shig rtsod pa chos phyogs su 'dum par 'gyur ro zhes gsung gi de yang de ltar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba dang / btsan pos ka ma la shī la 'gugs su pho nya btang ba dang / ston min pa dpon g.yog sum brgyas shes rab 'bum blangs te bsam gtan gling sgo bcad nas zla ba bzhi'i bar du shags bslabs/ chos bya mi dgos nyal bas chog ces ston pa bsam gtan nyal chog gi 'khor lo/ de 384

la rtsod pa spong ba bsam gtan gyi lon dang yang lon gnyis/ rigs pas sgrub pa lta ba'i rgyab sha dang lung gis sgrub pa mdo sde brgyad bcu khungs la sogs pa byas/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel rdog pas dril te 'di chos minaḥzer nas bor/ der ka ma la shī la ma byon gyi bar du ye shes dbang po'i ha shang gi lta ba dang bo bhi sa twa'i lta ba rtsen min gyi lugs ji ltar lags pa ril snyan du gsol ba las lha sras kyi dgongs pa yang 'khrol te dgyes ches nas dbu btud de ye shes dbang po ni nga'i ā tsarya zhes yang yang gsungs te ye shes dbang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas phyis ka ma la shī la rlung tshubs kyi gru la 'thon zhes pho nya ba byung te rje blon yos chab khar gsu ba la byon pas hā shang 'khor dang bcas pa yang chab khar byon/ ka ma la shī las hā shang la sgra tshad 'dri gsungs nas khams gsum du cis 'khor bya ba'i brdar phyag shing dbu la lan gsum du bskor bas ha shang gis chu tshur kha nas go ste gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis lan bya ba'i brdar ber gyi thu ba nas lan gnyis sprugs/ha shang na re 'jiṭa po zhig 'dug zer skad/ de nas ka ma la shī la byon pa dang byang chub gling du seng ge'i khri bcas te btsan po dgung la bzhugs/ hā shang g.yas su seng ge'i khri la bzhag mjug la ston min gyi slob ma rnams dngar te jo mo byang chub dang /sru yang dag dang / bandhe laṅka la sogs pa mang ste gral ring po byung / ka ma la shī la g.yon du seng ge'i khri la bzhag rjes la brtse min gyi slob ma rba dpal dbyangs dang / bee ro tsa na dang / ye shes dbang po la sogs pa dge slong mi mang ba zhig ste nyung shas shig las ma byung / btsan pos mkhan po gnyis dang ston rtsen gyi bandhe kun la me tog dkar po'i phreng ba re re lag du phul nas bka' bstsal pa/ nga'i mnga' ris kyi 'bangs bod nag po la zhen pa rnams kyi don du rgya gar nas bo dhi sa twa spyan drangs te bod mi nyung shas shig chos la 3ti5

bkod/ dad pa can shas shig rab tu byung / lha khang 'ga' zung bzhengs te dkon cog gsum gyi rten btsugs nas 'bangs kun la lha chos slob tu bcug pa las dad pa can nyung shas shig rab tu byung ba'i 'og du hā shang ma hā ya na 'dir mchis pa las bod kyi bande phal che ba cig ha shang la slobs/ cig ni bo dhi sa twa'i slob ma yin pas hā shang gi lta bar slob tu ma btub ste ston rtsen gnyis su chad/ de gnyis ma mthun par 'khrugs pa la nga'i zha/la ces ha shang gi slob ma rnams ma rangs te nyang sha mi rang gi sha btubs nas shi/ hā shang me mgo ni rang gi mgo la me btang nas shi/ rngogs rin po che dang snyags bye ma las ni rang gi pho mtshan brdungs nas shi/ gzhan rnams kyang chu gri re bsrel zhing brtse min pa ril gyis bsad la bdag cag kyang phru ma'i ngos la 'chi zer ste ngas de ltar byed tu ma gnang bar gnya' g.yon bskor ba yin/ brtse min pa'i mkhan po bo dhi sa twa yin/ de'i slob ma ka ma la shī la yin pas khyed 'dir 'ongs pa dang hā shang dang gnyis kha bdur la gtan tshigs gang bzang ba la su gtan tshigs ngan pa des nga rgyal ma byed par chos lugs bzhin du me tog phreng ba phul zhig zhes bka' bstsal ba dang / hā shang na re nga gzhi la snga bas ngas dri'am lan gdab gsungs ka ma la shrī la'i zhal nas khyod kyi dgongs pa'i lta ba la shags thob cig gsungs pa dang / ha shang na re/ thams cad sems kyi rnam par rtog pas bskyed pas las dge mi dges mtho ris dang ngan song gi 'bras bu myong zhing 'khor ba na 'khor ro/ /gang zhig ci la yang mi sems zhing ci yang mi byed pa de 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na ci yang mi bsam mo/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa'i chos spyod rnam pa bcu la spyod pa ni skye bo dge ba'i las 'phro med pa blo zhan pa dbang po brtul bo rnams la bstan pa yin/ sngon blo sbyangs pa dbang po rnon po dag la sprin dkar nag gnyis gang 386

gis kyang nyi ma sgrib pa ltar dge sngig gnyis gas kyang sgrib pas de bas na ci la yang rma se mas/ ci la yang mi rtog ci la yang me dpyod pa na mi dmigs pa cig car du 'jub/ pas sa bcu pa dang 'dra'o zhes smras pa dang / ā tsarya ka ma las gsungs pa/ de ltar ci yang mi bsam zer ba de ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spangs pa yin no/ /chon/ thams cad kyi rang bzhin chos da byingarnga rnam par mi rtog pa de ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis rtogs dgos pa yin/yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rtsa ba ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab yin na de sbangs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes sam shes rab kyang spangs par 'gyur ste so sor rtog pa'i shes rab med par rnal 'byor pas thabs gang gis rnam par mi rtog pa la gnas par 'gyur/ gal te chos thams cad dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa yin na nyams su myong ba rnams mi dran zhing yid la mi bya bar mi nus so/ /gal ste bdag gis chos gang yang dran pa mi bya yid la mi bya 'o snyam na she de nyid dran pa shin tu yid la byas par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa dang yid la bya ba med pa tsam la byed na med pa ni rgyur mi rung ste dran pa med pa tsam gyis rnam par me rtog par 'gyur na brgyal ba dang ra ro ba dang bog pa'i dus su yang dran pa med pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med par rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i thabs chad do/ /dran pa tsam po bkag kyang yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med na chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la ji ltar 'jug nus/ ngo bo med pa stong pa nyid ca/ rtogs na sgrib pa spong bar mi /3gyur ba kho na'o/ /stong pa nyid ma rtogs kyang dran pa med pa tsam gyis thar pa thob pa dang grol bar 'gyur na khams gong ma'i lha thams cad thar ba thob pa dang grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa ci yang med pa'i rmongs pa'i sems kyis yang dag pa'i lam rnal 'byor du ji ltar 'gyur/ de ni 387

gnyid stug po'i rmongs pa'i sems dang 'dra'o/ /dran pa bzhin du yang mi dran byar mi rung ngo / /dran med dang yid la byar med pas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang thams cad mkhyen par ji ltar 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa yang ji ltar spong / de bas na yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis phyin ci log gi snang ba rgyang sring ba yin no/ /de bsrings cing spangs pas yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i snang ba rnal ma'i don je gsal je gsal rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i don nges par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bas dus gsum phyi nang thams cad stong par rtogs te rtog pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur lta ba ngan pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu de brtan tsa na thabs dang shes rab gnyis la ma rmongs pas sgrib pa thams cad de nyid tu bsal nas spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /der btsan po'i zhal nas ston chen shags gang rgyal ba'i 'khor kun yang mchid shaṭa thob cig zhes gsungs pa dang dpal dbyangs na re/ khyed rgya'i bzhed pa ltar na cig char du 'jug cig rim gyis mchi na pha rol tu phyin pa drug mi mthun pa'i phyogs las gdags par gsungs te 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i slad du sbyin pa'i ming btags te bdog pa btang nas yongs su 'dzin pa med na sbyin pa btang ba yin/ sgo gsum chags sdang bkag na tshul khrims yin/ khro ba med na bzod pa'i mchog yin/ le lo 'dor ba la brtson 'grus kyi ming btags/ sems la g.yeng ba ma mchis na bsam gtan/ chos rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes na shes rab yin/ ston pa 'das nas ring zhig du lta ba la mthun pa ma mchis/ slad nas dbu ma rnam gsum ma mthun te rtsod par gyur/ da lta ston rtsen gnyis lta ba ma mthun ston min cig char du 'jug zer te yang dag pa ma rtogs ma 'jal bas de ltar gyur/ 'jug sgo tha dad kyang sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod par cig ces 388

'bra8 2 bu 'dod pa la spyi mthun pa skad du smras/ ye shes dbang pos smras pa/ cig char 'jug bya ba dang rim gyis 'jug bya ba gnyis dpyod dgos te rim gyis 'jug na rtsod rgyu ma mchis te nged dang 'dra'o/ /cig car du 'dzug na khyed da dung ci byed dang po nas sangs rgyas na ci nyes/ de bas na ri la 'dzeg pa yang gom pa re re nas 'dzeg dgos te gom pa gcig gis bgrod mi nus pa ltar sa dang po thob pa yang rab tu dka' na thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa lta ci smos/ ci yang ma byas par 'tshang rgya ba ni khyed la bstan pa'i khungs dgos/ston rtsen mi 'dra ste nged brtse min gyi lugs kyis gsung rab kun la bslabs/thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rnam gsum la brten nas don ma nor bar shes nas chos spyod bcu las bslabs te bsgoms pas sa dang po la bzod pa yang 'thob/ yang dag pa'i skyon med par yang 'jug de nas sa dgur yang dag pa'i shes rab rim par sbyangs pha rol du phyin pa bcu la bslabs/ rgyud sbyangs tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas brnyes pa lags na/ khyed ltar gyi tshogs ma bsags blo ma sbyangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba yang mi shes na thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa dang shes bya thams cad la 'jug par ji ltar 'gyur/sangs rgyas rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa de'i rgyu ci las grub na tshogs gnyis las grub pa yin/ stong pa gcig bus rang la yang ma phan na gzhan gyi don ga la 'grub/ tha na lus srog 'tsho ba la yang zas dang skom dang gos la sogs pa rtsol sgrub bya dgos pa la brten ste 'tsho dgos la de dag la ma brten na 'gum ste zas ma myong na zhag bdun na ltogs te 'chi na thar pa sgrub pa la chos spyod rnam pa bcu bya dgos pa lta ci smos/ de ltar khungs med cing thabs shes ya bral ba'i chos kyis sangs rgyas la skur ste bslus pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don du sems bskyed nas nga/zhan don lhur byas 389

bsod namyo/sa kyi tshogs bsags te shes bya thams cad la mkhas par bslabs/shes rab gsum blo sbyangs te ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs/blo'i dri ma thams cad spangs nas mthu rdzogs pa dang sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba lhun gyis grub pa yin par lung du ma nas gsungs so/ /ci yang mi sems pa ni sgo nga dang 'dra'o/ /ma brtags par gom pa bor yang brdab 'chos te 'gro na chos ga la rtogs/ ci yang ma byas par nyal bas zan yang mi myong bar ltogs te 'chi na sangs rgyas ga la 'grub/ de bas na nangs la mdo sde byang chub par bklags/ dben par zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yid la byas/ rtogs pas yid la myong ba shar/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i don du tshogs gsag ste sems ji lta bu zhe na kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu la don dam par de ma skyes par rtogs te chos thams cad chu shing gi snying po lta bur ma bcos par rtogs na dus gsum mi dmigs par 'gyur te chos dang gang zag la bdag ma mchis par rig pas bying rgod ma mchis par zung 'brel du ngang gis 'jug pa lags te sgom pa yang de ltar lags/ zhes mchi ba dang ston min pas shags lan smra bar ma spobs te me tog gtor nas pham par khas blangs so/ /de'i tshe gzims mal ba co rma rma rang gi dbang po brdungs nas lcebs so/ /de nas btsan po'i zhal nas/ ha shang gi chos ston min pa cig car du 'jug zer ba de ni chos spyod rnam pa bcu la skyon bkal te mi bgyid/ sems pa ni bying /bdag dang gzhan gyi blo sbyong bi sgo bkag ste 'phro bcad na sems bying zhing chos nub par 'gyur bas 'phro chod la de lta bu ni khyed rang sgoms shig gzhan khyed kyi 'khor rnams dang bod rnams da slan chad lta ba nā gasbyo na'i lugs zungs/ spyod pa pha rol du phyin pa drug la gyis la chos spyod rnam pa bcu nyams 390

su longs/ slom pa shes rab rnam pa gsum la blo sbyongs la thabs dang shes rab zung du chud cing 'brel ba zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la sgoms shig da slan chad 'o skol bod rje blon 'bangs bcas kyis kyang chos bya ba rnams kyis 'di ltar bya ste/ spyir bod mtha' 'khob du gyur pa dang rig pa blun zhing rang ga ba mang la chos 'di rtogs par dka' zhing zab pas/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rab tu gyur par grags pa rgyal pos spyan drangs te yon bdag byas/ lo tsā ba mkhas pas gtan la phab pa'i chos de la 'jug bar bya'o/ /rgyal pos yon bdag ma byas lo tsā ba mkhas pas gtan la ma phab pa'i chos la 'jug bar mi bya'o/ /zhes bka' nan drag tu bstsal nas bka' gtsegs kyi yi ge zhib mo gsum du mchis te gse'i sgrom bur bcug kha la sgo lcags bstsal te rje'i phyag dbal na mchis te gnod sbyin dam rgya nag po la gtad/ che long zhig ni zhang blon rnams la dar bar byas/ de nas hā shang ma ha ya na gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs nas slar rgya nag du gshegs/ sngon rgyal po gdung rabs lngar chos ma tshugs pa lha sras khri srong lde btsan dang / za hor rgyal po'i sras bo dhi sa twa dang / rba ye shes dbang po dang / sang shi ta bzhis dkon cog gi rten mchod gnas pa btsugs/ dam pa'i chos bod khams su rgya cher bsgrags so/ /der rje btsan po'i thugs dgongs 'grub nas 'bangs thams cad chos la btsud cing lha chos mi bgyid du mi gnang ba'i phyir dbus mtha' thams cad du slob dpon bskos/ zhang blon gyi bu tsha dang btsun mo thams cad kyang ka wa li re re thogs nas chos slob tu bcug go /de nas slob dpon ka ma la shī la la btsan pos chos thams cad thos bsam sgom gsum gyis bdag med par gtan la phab pa'i chos de ji ltar lags pa yi ger 'god par zhus pas sgom rim dang po brtsams nas gnang / rjes gzigs pas don dgongs te da de'i don stan thog 391

gcig tu sgom na ji ltar sgom zhus pas sgom rim bar pa brtsams nas gnang /de la 'bras bu ji ltar mchi zhus pas sgom rim tha ma 'bras bu bstan pa brtsams nas gnang / 'bras bu bstan pa'i zhar la hā shang gi lta ba nor ba de sun phyung nas snang / de la shin tu dgyes pas de'i don 'grel du bo dhi sa twa'i dgongs pa la rgol ba byung gis dogs pa'i don du lung dang rigs pa 'brel bar dbu ma snang ba brtsams nas btsan po la gnang ngo zhes rba bzhed khungs thub las byung ba ji lta ba bkod pa'o/ /bu ston chos byung las ni ston min brtse min ni rgya nag gi skad de cig char pa dang rim skyes pa zhes zer ro zhes byung ngo / / spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la chos dang chos ma yin pa bya ba na gang chos ma yin pa'i phyogs de ni zhe sdang drag pos khro ba dang 'khrugs par byed cing mtshon cha'i sbyor bas pha rol gsod pa'i bar du brtson par byed la/ gang chos kyi phyogs de ni pha rol po ji tsam du 'khrug shing khro ba tsam gyis snying rje dang bzod pa 'phel zhing dus la bab na lung rigs dang ldan pa'i 'bel ba'i gtam gyis pha rol gyi log rtog zlog pa la brtson par byed kyi/ srog dang zang zing 'joms pa ni gzhan gyis byed pa yang zlog na rang gis bgyi ba lta ci smos te des na deng sang dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyang rung ste bstan pa bye ba na gang chos kyi phyogs dang gang chos ma yin pa'i phyogs su gnas pa ni 'di kho nas shes par nus so/ /chos ma yin pa'i phyogs rnams ni lta ba dang grub mtha' yang nya 'brid pa la lcags kyu'i rtse'i zas ltar skye bo chos ltar snang bas slu pa'i phyir dang por smra ba tsam du zad kyi/ gang khas len pa'i lta spyod de la yang rang nyid gnas pa ma yin te dper na ha shang 'khor bcas kyang ci yang dran par mi bya zhing dge sdig gnyis ka mi byed pa rang gi lta grub tu smras mod kyang brtse min gyis de ltar mi rigs so zhes smras pa na de ma thag khro ba dang 'khrug pa rtsa nyon 392

dang nye nyon thams cad dran zhing yid la byed la chu gri bsrel nas gsod 'dod kyi mi dge ba drag pos rgyud khengs cing ldog par mi byed pas de ma thag rang gi lta grub rang gis bshig pa'i phyir ro/ /chos bzhin gyi lta ba dang grub mtha' ni de 'dra ba ma yin te/ gnod byed sogs rkyen drag po dang thug pa na go cha ltar rang rgyud la mi gnod pa dang mtshon cha ltar nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i byed las gnyis ka lta ba des lhan cig du 'grub cing bud shing bsnan pa'i me ltar lta ba'i bsos 'debs pa zhig 'byung ba yin no zhes bya ba ni 'phros pa'i don do/ /rba bzhed la lar sngar gyi me tog gtor nas pham par khas blangs so zhes pa'i 'og tu yang lugs gcig la rgya nag gi dge slong byung nas kho na re tshig la snying po med/ tha snyad kyi chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya/ sems rtogs na dkar po chig thub yin pas des chog zer nas dkar po chig thub 'di bod thams cad 'phel lo zhes sogs dang / mkhan po'i zhal chems kyi skabs su nga 'das pa'i 'og du rgya nag gi mkhan po gcig 'byung ste des thabs dang shes rab la skur pa 'debs pa dkar po chig thub bya ba sems rtogs pa 'ba' zhig gis 'tshang rgya'o zer ba 'byung ste mdo las snyigs ma lnga'i nang nas lta ba'i snyigs ma zhes bya ba stong pa nyid la dga' ba yong bar gsungs pas bod kho nar ma zad snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gang zag thams cad de la dga' ba chos nyid yin/ de'i chos lugs de 'phel na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gnod pas ka ma la shī la spyan drongs zhes dang / khyed brtse min ba skyabs 'gro sems skyed nas rim pas byed pa spre'u ltar mas 'dzeg yin/ nged bya byed kyi chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya bas sems rtogs pa nyid kyis 'tshang rgya ste khyung shing rtser bab pa ltar yas bab yin zer ba la ka ma las dpe mi 'thad de khyung dang po nas 'dab gshog rdzogs sam tshar nas rim par rdzogs nas shing rtser bab/ dang po mi srid la phyi ma rim gyis 39 3

po'i dper rung gi cig char bar mi rung ngo / /don mi 'thad de/ rnam par mi rtog pa sgom pa de rtog pa phyogs gcig bkag pa yin nam thams cad bkag pa yin/ dang po ltar na gnyid dang brgyal ba sogs kyang sgom yin par 'gyur/ mtha' dag bkag dgos na mi rtog pa sgom pa'i tshe sgom snyam pa'i rtog pa sngon du btang dgos sam mi dgos/ mi dgos na sems can thams cad la sgom skye bar thal te sgom blo med kyang sgom skye ba'i phyir/ dgos na de nyid rtog pa yin pas mi rtog pa sgom pa'i dam bca' nyams te smra bcad byas pa yin no byas na smra bcad shor ba bzhin no zhes gsungs pas rgya nag mkhan pos mgor thog brgyab pa dang mtshungs pas lan mi shes so zhes smras so zhes dang / deng sang chos rnal ma rnams bor nas sems ngo 'phrod pas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dkar po chig thub tu 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsung / zhes sogs dang / co rma rma lcebs pa ma na sngar bshad pa dang mthun no/ /de nas yang sngar gyi 'phror zhugs te btsan po'i zhal nas ha shang gi chos ston min cig car du 'jug ces zer ba de ni zhes sogs bris snang mod/ 'di 'dra ba mkhan po'i gsung dang mkhas pa ka ma la'i rigs pa ga la yin te spyir sangs rgyas phal cher snyigs ma'i dus su mi 'byung yang 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di thugs rje rmad tu byung bas byang sems gzhan gyis spangs pa'i snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams kyi nang du 'tshang rgya bar smon lam mdzad de snying rje pad dkar las rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi smon lam chen po lnga brgya'i gcig 'di yin la/ dus kyi snyigs ma rtsod ldan/ lta ba'i snyigs ma 'jig tshogs su lta ba drug bcu rtsa gnyis sogs tshangs pa dra ba'i mdo las bshad pa'i mu stegs kyi lta ba rgyas pa nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma sems can rnams dug gsum rab tu rgyas pa/ sems kyi snyigs ma shin tu gdul dka' ba/tshe'i snyigs ma tshe lo brgya pa ste snyigs ma lnga'i dus la gzigs nas dga' ldan 394

nas 'pho ba tshos sangs rgyas pa dang chos 'khor bskor bar bstan te ti/ ba'i snyigs ma bcom nas byang grol la 'god par gsungs kyi/ sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pas lta ba'i snyigs ma byung zer ba'i sangs rgyas la skur pa 'di 'dra bdud sdig can gyis kyang sngo na ma btab bo/ /stong pa nyid ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod yin te mdo rgyud phal cher las a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o zhes dang / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang /bzhi stong ji snyed gsungs pa kun/ /stong pa nyid la gzhol zhing 'bab/ /ces dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas ji snyed thams cad kyis/ /chos rnams mang po rab bshad pa/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid/ /mi gang don la mkhas pa dag /tshig 'di bslabs par gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dkon ma yin/ /zhes dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las/tshangs pa/ gnas gcig du thams cad yang dag par 'du'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na stong pa nyid ni gnas te stong pa nyid du chos thams cad yang dag par 'du'o zhes so/ /mdo sdud par/ chos kun skye med stong pa'i tshul du rab shes pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes sogs bgrang las 'das par gsungs shing / /mkhan po bo bhi sa twa ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi luṭa 'dzin pa yin la des ni dbu ma rtsa bar/ rgyal ba rnams kyis stong pa nyid/ /lta kun nges par 'byin par gsungs/ /zhes stong nyid ni lta ba'i snyigs ma sel ba'i bkru sman lta bur gsungs cing rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las kyang /lus can rnams la yod pa yi/ /lta ba rnam par spang ba'i phyir/ /stong pa nyid kyi tshul bstan to/ /ces bshad to/ /'phags pa klu'i rjes su 'brang ba rgyal sras zhi ba'i lhas kyang / rmongs pa sdug bsngal can don du/ /'khor bar gnas pa 'grub 'gyur ba/ /'di ni stong nyid 'bras bu yin/ /de bas stong pa 395

nyid phyogs la/ /sun 'byin pa ni 'thad ma yin/ /des na the tshom mi za bar//stong pa nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen po stong pa nyid/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /de ni ji ltar sgom mi byed/ /dngos gang sdug bsngal skyed byed pa/ /de la skrag pa skye 'gyur mod/ /stong nyid sdug bsngal zhi byed pa/ /de la 'jigs pa ji ltar skye/ /ces bzhed pa yin la slob dpon ka ma la'i sgom rim gsum dang dbu ma snang bar stong pa nyid lta ba'i snyigs ma yin no zhes bris pa 'dug gam stos shig des na stong dang sgyu ma lta bu dang sprul pa lta bu sogs la sdang zhing smod par byed pa de ni dmigs pa can zhes bya ste dad pa'i rdzas chu phor gang yang ma gnang zhing de nga'i nyan thos ma yin nga yang de'i ston pa ma yin zhes 'jig rten 'dzin gyi mdo dang tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa'i mdo las rgyas par gsungs so/ /ha shang gi lugs de ni 'khor ba dngos por zhen pas der lhung gis dogs pas dge sdig gnyis ka mi byed pa dang myang 'das dngos por zhen pas ci yang ma byas pa des thog tu re ba'i phyir dmigs par lta ba stug po yin no/ /sems ngo rtogs na grol bar 'chad pa rnams kyang / shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas/ /ces sogs bshad pa ltar mthar skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis de kho na nyid mthong bas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa dang / sbyor lam chos mchog gi mthar skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis mthong ba'i lam rtogs pa dang / de dang rjes su mthun pa rang sa'i shes rab kyi mthong bas drod rtse bzod mchog gi mthong bskyed pa sogs /3/ sems ngo rtogs pa zhes ming byas par zad la shes rab kyi mthong ba des zin pa'i tshogs gnyis zung 'jug du spyad pas 'tshang rgya bar 396

'dod pa yin la hūṃ shang gi sgom pa de ni 'du shes bkag pa'i sgom pa ste 'du shes med pa par gol ba'i cha mthun yin yang de'i gol sa dngos ni ma yin te bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi thob nas 'du shes dang tshor ba bkag ste bsgoms na der 'gyur ba yin yang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yang 'thob dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /hā shang gi dpe don dgag pa de dag kyang nus pa dman te nam mkha' lding gcig char du 'dab gshog rdzogs pa los yong ste 'jig rten gdags pa las nam mkha' lding brdzus skyes kyis klu skye gnas bzhi ka za ba sogs mkha' lding brdzus skyes bshad pa'i phyir don yang ma khegs te rnam par mi rtog pa sgom pa ni rang lugs la yang 'dod dgos la de'i tshe sngar gyi thal 'gyur tshur ldog na 'khor gsum ga la lan gyis dben pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rgya gar gyi mkhas pa nyi zla lta bu la de 'dra'i rigs pa'i mu ge gar ldang / de dag ni phyis kyi rtog ge pa zab don la sdang ba chos spong la mkhas nyams dang phrag dog la khyad nor re ba rnams kyis bcug par go sla'o/ /ston rtsen gyi rtsod pa zhi nas slar bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul ni rba bzhed las/ de nas chos 'khor gyi rkyen nyis brgya lnga bcu bla nas gnang ste bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs la lo re'i zla ba gcig la nas khal bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ na bza' ni mang ste 'phan gyi brungs la sbyor/ na bza' phrugs re re/ spod mar srang stong dang brgya/ chibs dngog theg pa re re/ shog bu deb bzhi/ gnag tsha yug gsum/ lan tshwa zad len/ mchims phu'i sgom chen nyi shu rtsa lnga la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ spod mar srang brgyad brgya re/ chibs pa re/ na bza' drug phrugs re/ chos gra'i slob dpon du bsko ba bcu gsum la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/ na bza' phruṭa re/ chab mar srang brgyad brgya re/ mtshams kyi bandhe rang ga ma rnams la gang zag re re la nas khal brgyad re/ shog bu deb gnyis re/ snag tsha yug re/397

slob gnyer ba nyi shu rtsa lnga la re re la nas khal nyi shu rtsa lnga re/ gos sum phyaṭa re rgyun du gnang nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten yun ring du gnas pa'i ched du dkon mchog gi rten la 'bangs mi khyim brgya bandhe re re la 'bangs mi khyim gsum gsum du bcad/ 'bangs lha ris la bla nas dbang mi bya bar chad naca/ dbang dge 'dun la bskur/ lha chos dar bar mdzad pas rje lha sras bka' drin che ba lags so/ /slad kyis btsan po slob dpon padma sambha wa'i chorngag kyang 'phro la lus pas thugs ma tshim nas bee ro tsa na dang gtsang btsun legs grub gnyis 'tshol du btang / slar log pa la paspyi ta ma byon pas go ba ma che ste rgya gar gyi snyan phra'i dbang du thal nas bee ro tsa na tsha ba rong du bskrad/ ka ma la shī la mu stegs kyis gshed ma btang nas nub mo sgra bsgyur gyi khang par gzims man du mkhal ma mnyes nas bkrongs so zhes byung ngo / /de nas lha sras mu tig btsan po yis/ /zhang blon dbu rings bsad pas byang du sprugs/ /mgos kyis zhal lce dga' gsum bya bar bcad/ /ye shes dbang pos kham gyi zas spangs te/ /'das nas ring bsrel mchod rten brgya rtsa byas/ /sprul pa'i chos rgya'/ khri srong lde btsan des/ /lha sras thu bo mu ne btsan po la/ /rgyal srid gtad ste chos kyi rgyal por bskos/ /zung mkhar smig ma'i tshal du sgom du gshegs/ /sku yi bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ /gral ni yab kyi rgyab ngos g.yas na yod/ /yab kyi 'od pa srung ba yin no skad/ /nang du dkor nor rin chen sna tshob/sa bkang / /ming du 'phrul ri gtsug snang bya bar btags/ /rtsa bar rdo ring yi ge can zhig btsugs/ /'di ni bon blon rnams kyi sems srung phyir/ /rgyal po bzhugs dus nyid du brtsigs so skad/ /mu ne btsan pos mchod chen bzhi btsugs cing / /bod 'bangs stogs phyug lan gsum bar du bsnyams/ /lo gcig zla dgu srid mdzad yum gyis bkrongs/ /ag tshoms bang so'i g.yas 398

ngos mdun du brtsigs/ /bang so'i ming la skya ri ldem bu zer/ /mu tig btsan po sna nam pa yis bkrongs/ /don mkhar mda' ru bang so skya ldem brtsigs/ /de yang rba bzhed las/ rba ratna 'da' kur jo mo yid bzhin 'kho ra los bsgyur ba'i sku gzugs kyis spyan chab phyung / ye shes dbang po tshe 'da' gar mi ma yin dag ji/sa bsu ba'i sgra byung / nam mkha' la yang mchod pa dpag med byung / 'phags pa la ye shes dbang po the tshom zhu zhing mchis pa'i drung du btsan po lha sras gshegs nas 'bras thug drangs pa gsol nas/ rje lha gcig gi pham phabs 'di 'tshal nas deng slan chad kham gyi zas spangs so/ ting nge 'dzin dang zas su brje'o/ /chos dang zas su brje'o zhes mchis nas sku 'das so/ /de'i tshe nam mkha' nas sgra byung / bya thams cad gdung ba'i skad 'don/gdung khang has po ri'i yar snar brtsigs na legs bya ba byung ste brtsigs/ ye shes dbang po'i bu mo spyan ras gzigs dang dge ldem gnyis las spyan ras gzigs la pha'i mchod rten rtsar mchod rten brtsig pa'i sa bzang po klus bstan te rje 'bangs mi mang po'i bsod nams kyi rten du brag dmar mas gong du mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs/ mchod rten ma tshar gyi bar du chu mig dang sa bzang po klus btang / rdo ba rgya gar gyi yi ge can byung ste brtsigs pas lha mo bco bco brgyan brgyan ba gsum gyis bskor ba byas te su bde ba can du 'gro 'dod pa de mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di la bskor ba gyis shig zer/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rtsi/ lam du khyed spun snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing khams su 'gro bar 'dod na mchod rten 'di zhal sros shig zhes pa byung / chab 'og gi 'bangs sum pa las chos la gnag pa ma mchis nas chos la gnas par dmigs kyis btul nas dge ba la gzud pa'i slad du rba bza' lha ldem zhang blon khri sum brtsigs la bstsal/ bla'i bka' lung bzhin sum pa khri lde bzhi dge ba bcu la 399

btsud/ slob ma yang badzhai rlangs su ga ta dang / dpal gyi seng ge dang / ārya la sogs pa ste bla nas slob ma gang bzang gang mkhas gang mang nyang sha mi dang ring lugs bsgrun pas lha ldem stangs bzang nas bya dga' che thang du bran khyim bcu gnyis la sogs pa bstsal/ rlangs ril dge ba la btsud/ rlangs klu rgod dang stag tsha ba ni chos bgyed du ma nyan pas stag tshab rgyas mgo bcad ste bkum/ klu rgod ni rba bza'i nang na dad pa che ba rba bza' legs btsun blangs nas mna' mar bstsal te bon bcad lha chos bgyis dad pa skyes pas phyin chad legs pa mang / dharma mdzangs blun mthong bas klu rgod rab tu byung ste sum pa blon dpogs 'di phan chad chos la dga' bar gyur to ces byung ngo / /mdor na sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan de ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa ste phyag la utpa la'i ri mo mnga'/ rgya gar nas ring bsrel len dus rta dmag sprul pa sogs rdzu 'phrul dang ldan/ gtsug lag khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzheng pa'i thugs dam bcas te ston rtsen ma mthun pa'i dus cung zad chag kyang phyis mthar phyin par bzhengs/ sngar yab mes kyi ring bka' khon byung ba'i rgya hor ljang gsum dang 'thab pas rtsang ma tshod bsad pas mi ma zad nas blon po khri sum rje stag snar gyis mjal dum bgyi bar glengs pas rgya na re nyi zla gza' skar nga'i thog nas 'char te gnam gyi mgo bo nga dbang bas sdum nga'i mdun du bya dgos zer/ hor na re skar ma smin bdun gnam gyi gzhung phur yin/ de'i 'og na nga 'dug ste gnam gyi gzhung nga dbang bas sdum nga'i go khar bya dgos zer/ ljang na re dgu tshigs skya mo gnam gyi gzhung thig yin/ de'i 'og na nga 'dug ste gnam gyi gzhung thig nga dbang bas sdum nga'i sar bya dgos zer/ slad nas mjal ba'i dus byas te de res gyes/ khri sum rjerba/ 'phrul bshams te dbyar ma thang du tshogs thing shun tu bcug pa'i thag pa nam mkha' 400

la brkyangs pa la lhang tsher gyi nye zla gza' skar gyi gzugs btags/ thing shun bskyil ba'i 'og tu me bus te rlangs pa na bun du chags par byas/ ngang pa gser gyis byugs pa rol du khrid nas/ nyin mo gnam la skar ma 'tshar ba'i yul/ /nyi zla gza' skar dus gcig 'char ba'i yul/ /lo gsar sgang la na bun chags pa'i yul/ /gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten chags pa'i yul/ /mi rje lhas mdzad gser bya rol du khrid/ khyed thams cad las nga khyad tu 'phags pas sdum nga'i mdun du byed dgos zhes smras pas lan ma thebs te bod rgyal po'i drung du mjal dum byas skad/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin mdzad de btsan nyid kyis kyang bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma bam po bdun/ de mdor bstan pa bam po gcig de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad brda bam po lnga/ byams pa'i bstod chen bam po gcig lhag pa sogs bstan bcos gzhung tshan che ba dang / grub pa'i mtha' dgrol ba/ dbu ma'i gzer bu/bsam gtan gyi dogs pa brgyad bsal ba lha btsan po'i bkas bcad sogs dang / 'phags pa rnam snang dang / shākya thub pa dang / 'jam dpal dang /byams pa dang / mi g.yo mgon dang / byang chub sems dpa' brgya la bstod pa sogs gzhung tshad chung ba'i bstan bcos du ma mdzad do/ /dkar chag 'phang thang mar yum stong phrag brgya pa'i 'grel chen bam po don brgyad pa khri srong gis mdzad par bshad kyang dkar chag mchims phu ma dang ldan dkar ma gnyis su de gnyis rgya gar mar bshad pas taXṣṭa se na'i 'bum ṭīka de yin no zhes kun mkhyen bus bshad do/ /gzhan yang dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo'i 'grel pa mu tig btsan pos mdzad pa dang / jo mo byang chub rje'i smon lam sogs lha sras dang btsun mos mdzad pa dang / bee ro tsa nas mdzad pa'i don gsal sgron me/ rigs pa drug bcu pa las btus te mdor bshad pa/ snang 401

mtha'i mtshan brjod la sogs dang / dpa 4 dbyangs kyis gces pa bsdus pa'i 'phrin yig ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis gsung rab rin po che'i gtam/ phyi'i yul dran rgyud du yod par 'dod pa sel ba/ mtshan nyid gsum mdor bstan/zhang ye shes sdes lta ba'i khyad par/ bzang spyod kyi 'grel pa bzhi'i don bsdus/'jig rten pha rol sgrub pa/ dgongs ldem dgongs bzhi'i brjed byang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi rgya cher 'grel bam po bzhi bcu/ nges pa'i don dbu ma/ sher phyin mdor bsdus/ phreng ba'i rgyan/ chos gtan la dbab pa'i gal/ dpal brtsegs dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi brgal lan bzhi phrags/ slob dpon shes rab sing po'i dgongs 'grel byams le'i brjed ri gye ////byang / pra sha se na'i sher snying ṭā / slob dpon bkra shis kyi dbu ma rgyan gyi brjed byang bam po bcu dang sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ dpal gyi lhun po'i dge slong ma'i so thar gyi 'grel pa/ a tsarya ka la ya na dang / rin chen zla 'byung dang / kong utpal ko ṣa sogs kyi drin lan/ lce khyi 'brug gi sgra'i gnas brgyad rtsa 'grel dang / ma byin len gyi skabs nas mkhan po bzhis dpyad pa sogs lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis kyang bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing / bee ro tsa na/ ldan ma rtse mang / kha che ā narta ste lo tsā ba rgan gsum/ gnyags dzha na ku ma ra/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ rma rin chen mchog ste bar pa gsum/ ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde ste gzhon gsum ste lo tsā ba rab dgu dang phyis brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar byung zhing rab 'bring tha gsum du phye nas rab kyis zhus chen/ 'bring gis bar zhus/ tha mas mchan bu'i lo tsā ba byed skad/ sras la chab srid bsko ba sogs mdzad tshul ni rba bzhed las/ ye shes dbang po 'das pa'i tshe btsan po'i zhal nas ā tsarya chen po tshe 'da' ba dang sbyar na kho bo'i 402

tshes kyang ring po mi thub bo gsungs/ yang btsan po'i zhal nas/ bar du ston min gyi tshig nyan te chos slob pa dang dharma'i dpe len du yang mi kun ma btub/rgya gar gyi chos dpe yid la ma bcags pa tsam du blangs te bsgyur zin na shri nā lendar rgya gar gyi starma mes tshig ste ma tshang ba rgya yul du chos byung nas lo stong nyis brgya lon te gsung rab kyi dpe tshang bar bzhugs na rgya'i chos ma bsgyur ba yid la bcags so zhes gsungs nas thugs ngan mdzad/ dge 'dun la chos slob kyi gra btsugs pa las ye shes dbang po 'das nas bu mo spyan ras gzigs kyis jo mo khro mo legs la chos slob kyi gra gzugs par gsol ba dang jo mos btsan po lha sras kyi snyan du gsol te btsan pos chos slob kyi gra btsugs so/ /de nas btsan po lha sras kyi zhal nas/ a tsarya'i gsung dang sbyar na kho bo'i tshes kyang yun ring po mi thub gsungs nas thugs las chung ngu gzhol bar bzhed nas paṇḍi ta zhig spyan 'dren du btang bas a tsarya bi ma la mi ta byon pa la slob dpon padma sambha wa'i chos 'phro zhus nas sgom mdzad par bzhed de/ sras mu ne btsan po chab srid la bsko ba dang / blon po zhang dbu ring blon po la bsko ba'i gros dbu rtse na byed cing bzhugs pa jo mo me sgron gyis mthong ste thugs gtum pos chab srid sna nam pa ster nges snyam ste mu tig btsan po la gsol bas lha sras kyis sgo bar du chu gris bkum/ yab kyis btsur bzher gar song zhes gsungs pas gri khrug can de bor nas dbu ring rgyang ring por song zer te bar khang du bros/ rje'i thugs ngam 'gyangs nas g.yar mchu byung bar dogs thugs ma bde blon mdzangs ba kun gros byas te blon chen po mgos kyis zhal ce dga' gsum du bcad/ chab srid mu nee btsan po mnga' bar gyis zer nas/ mi chos thun bcugs ltar mdzad nas btang / yab zur mkhar du sgom du gshegs si zhes byung ngo / /yi ge gzhan —las 'dzam gling sum gnyes mnga' 403

'og du 'dus nas sum gcig bsdu ba'i phyir zhang rgya tsha lha snang gis dbu rtse bar khang du rgyal po la gros zhus/ zhang gi bu dbu ring sgo srung ba na lha sras mu tig btsan po nang du 'byon rings pa bkag pas khros te dbu ring bsad/ dbu ngang ring ring po de rgyang ring ring por btang yod gsungs pas zhang la ngo nag pa tsam yang ma byung zhes snang / zhal ce dga' gsum ni mgos kyi mchid nas zur mkhar mchod rten gyi rtsar zhal ce len du shog cig zer te rta bzhon nas song /der phyin pas rdo'i mchod rten 'og ma la yi ge bris nas rjes 'bangs bsad na mas brdung ba dang 'dra ste thabs med da dung mchod rten bar mar dris zer ba byung bas rgyal po yab sras mnyes/ bar pa la 'on kyang re re nas bsad na 'bangs kyis mi lang rgyal po 'bangs la mig ches te 'gro da dung gong mar dris zhes pa mthong bas 'bangs rnams dga'/ gong ma la rgyal po nyid kyis khrims ma bsrungs na 'bangs la khrims mi 'chags pas lha sras lo dgu byang du sprugs la zhang la stong du yul gru gcig byin zhes byung bas sna nam pa dga' ste dga' gsum du grags skad/ rje khri srong lde btsan de dang btsun mo tshes spong bza' me tog sgron gyi sras bzhi las che ba mu khri srong po sku chung ngu la gshegs pas bang so med/ gnyis pa mu ne btsan po yab kyi dgung lo so bzhi pa chu pho stag la 'khrungs/ de'i phyi lo chu yos la mu tig btsan po 'khrungs/ de'i phyi lo shing 'brug la khri lde srong btsan rnams rim par 'khrungs/ yab kyis nga lnga bzhes pa shing pho byi bgī lo la zung mkhar smyug ma tshal gyi pho brang du sgom par gshegs te sras mu ni dgung lo nyer gsum pa rgyal sar bskos/ btsun mo pho yongs bza' yum gyi skye ba thugs brtse bas sras la gtad gnyer mdzad/ mu nis btsun mo ru yongs bza' mdo rgyal khab tu bzhes/ b.lam yas su dril phreng dang ba dan dang 'phan chen po mang du phyar/ lha sa dang khra 'brug du 404

'dul ba dang mngon pa'i mchod pa/ bsam yas su mdo sde dang mngon par byang chub pa'i mchod pa ste mchod chen bzhi btsugs/ mchod pa'i rgyur 'bangs rnams kyis yo byad phul zhig gsungs pas la las gser g.yu dang zab chen sogs phul/ dbul po rnams kyis gos hrul sogs phul bas nga'i 'bangs rnams dad pa'i khyad 'di lta bu 'ong ba ci yin gsungs pas blon po rnams kyis 'byor pa che chung gi khyad par yin zhus pas nga'i 'bangs phyug dbul mi mnyam pa mi 'os gsung nas stogs phyug bsnyams/ yang de ma thag sngar ltar phyug dbul khyad zhugs pas yang lan gnyis su stogs phyug bsnyams/ yang de ma thag phyug dbul gyi khyad sngar ltar zhugs pas 'di lta bu 'ong ba ci yin gsungs pas mchod gnas lo paṇa rnams kyis sngar gyi sbyin shugs yod med kyi khyad yin zhes rgyu 'bras snyan du gsol bas shin tu thugs ches te dkon mchog la mchod pa cher mdzad/ yab kyi btsun mo pho yongs bza' la byams par mdzad pas yum me sgron khros te dug can gyi zas drangs pas dgung lo nyer bzhi pa shing glang la pho brang yum bur gshegs te chab srid lo gcig dang zla ba dgu bskyangs so/ /de nas lha sras mu tig btsan po chad pa 'khel ba byang nas spyan drangs te bsko bar byas pa lam du sna nam bas chibs bkrogs te lhung nas rta grir 'das/ rgyal rabs khungs thub snga phyi thams cad las 'di ka byung la/ slob dpon chen po padma'i rnam thar thang yig le'u brgya dang gcig pa sogs na/ do zhag drug bcu rtsa gcig glang gi lo/ /rgyal po nyid kyang mi rtag mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes sogs chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan glang lo pa drug bcu rtsa gcig la lo gsar la mtshan mo rta brgyugs pas chibs kyis bskyur nas 'das/ de gsangs nas lo gsum slob dpon gyis rgyal srid bzung nas mu tig btsan po bskos/ de'i dus slob dpon srin yul du gshegs pa la thams cad kyis gshegs skyel byas zhes snang 405

yang 'di skabs phal cher na bod phyi rabs kyi rtsom rigs kho na snang bas lhad bsres pa cig yin par dogs la/ rgyal sras lha rje khrid shog gsungs nas lung bstan mdzad zer ba la dpags na sad na legs dang mu tig btsan po nor ba sogs kyis dpyad mi bzod pa cig snang la/ gter mar grags pa kha cig las khri srong gi sku tshe'i tshad lnga bcu rtsa lnga las med pa la slob dpon gyis tshe sgrub mdzad pas bcu gsum bsrings te drug bcu rtsa dgu la gshegs zhes kyang snang zhing /bu ston chos byung las kyang drug bcu rtsa dgu la gshegs par bris so/ /rgyal rabs snga ma phal du lnga bcu rtsa lnga la gshegs pa nyid byung /ma rba bzhed tu nga lnga la sgom du gshegs zer ba las ma byung yang ā tsarya chen po tshe 'da' ba dang spyar na kho bo'i tshes kyang ring po mi thub gsung ba sogs ye shes dbang po dang rgyal po sku tshe tshad mtshungs par bzhed pa yin pas sgom du gshegs pa'i lo de nyid la gshegs par don gyis grub la bang so ni sngon nas brtsigs zin pas sku gdung mchod rten zhig tu sbas thabs kyis bzhugs pa snyam mo/ /mu ne btsan po lo nyer dgu bzhugs bya ba dang / bcu bdun la yum gyis bkrongs zhes dang /sad na legs lo bzhi pa la rgyal sar bton zhes bris pa rnams kyang dag par ma mthong ngo / /be ro'i 'dra 'bag chen mo las ni bee ro tsa na tsha ba rong du sprugs pa'i bka' chad kyis de nas zla ba gsum lon pa/ bi ma la mi tra ma phebs tsam der chos rgyal khri srong sku gshegs/ phyi lor mu ne btsan po yang gshegs nas de'i gshed kyi chos 'khor gyi dus g.yu sgras la yogs dor du 'ongs nas rgyal blon rnams kyis bee ro la yang dag bcu gcig dzi/ bstod pa phul te sad na legs kyi dus bee ro bod du byon par bshad do/ /de nas khri lde srong btsan rgyal sar bskos/ /'jing yon sad na legs zhes mtshan du grags/ /dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ /lo paṇa mang mchod dam chos du ma 406

bsgyur/ /nam yang sangs rgyas bstan pa mi bzhig par/ /bro bor ba yi bka' gtsigs yang yang bstsal/ /lo grangs sum bcu rtsa gnyis srid bskyangs te/ /dgung lo nga bzhi pa la thi gas phur 'das/ /de yi bang so 'phrul rgyal mdun na yod/ /yum gyis chag gang bskongs pas nangs kyis mtho/ /rin chen nor bkang rgyal chen 'phrul ring grags/ /de yang sras bzhi pa khri lde srong btsan nam lding khri dgung lo nyer gsum bzhes pa me pho stag lo la rgyal sar bskos/blon po rnams kyis dang por btsan po thu chung 'dis rgyal po 'ong mi 'ong sad na legs zhes bgros pa dang sku 'gyong bag du bzhugs pa cig yod pas sad na legs 'jing yon zhes mtshan du grags/ skabs de shed du bsam yas cung zad nyams pa zhig yang byung bar snang ste rba bzhed las/ bar du bsam yas kyi dge 'dun bshos chad nas kha shugs su btang khab so ni zhig gtsug lag khang gi rmang byi brun gyis gang / gnas khang kun gyi sgo yang rkun mas khyer skad/ de 'gem shārti khams na 'dug pas thos nas mi dga' ste gsol byang bris gseg shang thogs nas bod du mchis/ jo mo khri legs kyi snyan du 'das nas byang bu spyan dar brims te bka' bstsal pa/ bsgri spyir dad pa che zhing chos gzugs par dgongs pa ni ma nongs na rlangs chigs bsdos pas chad pas bcad na ma legs so zhes byung ba thos nas shānti ma dga' ste nyal ba'i rmi lam na bud med dkar mo bco bco ba zhig na re/ khyod bsam yas khab so gzugs par 'dod na chos dang po bod khams su rba ye shes dbang pos btsugs te de'i sras mo gnyis shig has po ri'i drung na 'dug gis de dang 'phrod la dkon mchog gi mchod pa gyis cig 'on tang bsams pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes thos nas brag mar du mchis nas btsal bas bu mo spyan ras gzigs shārti la phyag 'tshal du/mchis pa dang rdzing gong du mjal nas gnyi ga 'grogs te dge ldem btsal te 407

shārīs rmi lam bzlas nas khab so tshags zhing tshes brtan par dgyi ba'i slad da 3te/ sa ri ri sgo byams pa dang mngon par byang chub pa gzugs pa'i yod byad shārtis ni tshogs la bslangs dge ldem gyis sgos su sbyar te mchod pa bgyid par chad pa las/ ring lugs bandha laṅka'i mchid nas 'di ltar mchod pa byed cing dge ldem cha bar nos kyi chad pas bcad do zhes bsgo nas gnas brtan gnyis kyang skrag ste yo byad 'ga' yang g.yar ma ster/ shārti dang spyan ras gzigs sogs yon bdag stod rim kun skrag ste mchod pa gtang bar bgyi ba las dge ldem gyis jo mo byang chub rje yon bdag tu gsol nas jo mos kro nas khal bdun mar pha lam gcig 'thud nas mchod pa ma shor bar bgyis/ bsam yas kyi sku gzugs lder tsho re re la lha bshos bre thag pa'i rkyen/ bag phye gsum gsum gyi rkyen thang du drangs te mchod/ dge 'dun dang skye bo kun la chos ston gsol/ sde blon chen glu mas gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ske rags g.yus spras pa gcig dar yug gnyis/ras yug gsum phul/ dge ldem gyis 'bru sna lnga las khal sum bcu rtsa gnyis phyal/ bandhe spyan ras gzigs kyis 'bangs khyim gcig phul/ rgyal blon klu skyes kyis nas khal bcu gcig sogs bus pa yan gyis ral gu yan chad phul/ jo mo spal gyis chibs gcig gro nas khal nyi brgya/ za 'og yug gcig dar yug gcig phul/ dge 'dun gyis kyang byams pa dang mngon par byang chub pa la yon bsnan nas jo mo lcam pho yongs bza' mched dang mkhan po shārti dang dge ldem rnams kyis byams pa dang mngon par byang chub pa snga ma bzhin du btsugs so/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs rang gis rang 'gum ba'i dus btsal te mchims phu na sgom zhing mchis pa las tshe 'das so zhes byung ngo / /'di rba bzhed kyi dkyus la rje khri srong sgom du ma byon pa'i gong na 'dug mod kyang mngon byang gi mchod pa mu ne btsan pos btsugs pa de nyams nas slar bsos par 408

snang bas sad na legs kyi dus yin par gsalo/ /rgyal po 'dis rgya gar gyi slob dpon bi ma la mi tra/ dzñā na se na/ bal po hūṃ ka ra sogs spyan drangs/chos mang du bsgyur/ skyi shod du dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/blon 'bangs thams cad la dam pa'i chos mi gzhig cing dkon mchog gsum dbang btsan par bya ba'i bka' khrims bsgrags shing mna' bor du bcug pa'i bka' gtsigs ni/ bci3/ sras khri lde srong btsan gyi sku ring la shog bu mthing ga la gser gyis bris te 'phra myen gyi sgrom bur bstsal nas/ bsam yas lhun gyis 'grub kyi gtsug lag khang du yab kyi zla la bzhag pa las dpe bgyis te —bris pa/ ba༄ba/ dam pa'i chos nam du yang mi gzhig par/ btsan bo khri sde srong btsan gyis thugs dam bshes te/ dbu snyung bor nas/ gtsigs kyi yi ger bris pa/ bcu/ gtsigs ji ltar gnang ba'i gtan tshigs mgo nan labris pa/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di/ bzang zhing ched che ste/ mi mdzad du mi rung ni ngan rtags dang gtan tshigs/ yab khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ringal/ chos nam du yang myi gzhig par gtsigs mdzad pa'i blang nan dang / chos ji ltar brnyes pa'i gtam gyi ye ge las smos cing / chos kyi yi ge nyid zhib tu 'byung ba yin no/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di bzang zhing cher che ste/my-i mdzad tu my-i rung bar/ dang po mes srong btsan gyis mkhyen nas/ lha sa'i dpe har brtsigs pa tshun chad/ yab khri srong lde btsan gyis/ chos rgya cher thugs su tshud nas/ bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa la stsogs te/ bod khams su gtsug lag khang mang po brtsigs pa dang / btsan po khri srong lde btsan nga'i zha snga nas/ chos thugs su chud de mdzad pa phan chad/ gdung rabs bdun gyi bar du mdzad kyis kyang / my-i dge ba dang ma legs pa med pa las/ chos khong du ma chud pa kha cig gis mes khri lde gtsug btsan gyi ring la/ brag dmar gyi kwa 409

chur gtsug lag khang brtsigs nas/ chos mdzad pa las/ yab khri srong lde btsan sku chung ba'i tshe bshig ste/ phyin chad chos byed du my-i gnang bar/ bka' khrims su yang bris pa las/ yab khri srong lde btsan gyi sku la dngo' bar gyur nas/ slar sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pas sman par gyurd te/ chos kyang rgya cher mdzad de/ nam du yang chos my-i gzhig par/ gtsigs kyang dam du bris pa las/ phyis yab dgung du gshegs pa'i rjes la/ nged rje blon gyi snyan du mo dang rmis ltas las dkris te/ chos mdzad pa 'di/ btsan pho'i/ sku dang chab srid la yang dngo' ste ma legs kyis/ btsan pho'i/ pho brang na dkond cog gsum gyi rten btsugs pa yang gud du spags te/ bskar zhing chos mdzad pa'i my-i rigs ces gsold pa dag kyang byung nas/ mo dang rmis ltas lta bu brdzun pa'i tshig gis/ dkond cog gsum gyi rten dang chos lta bu don chen po spangs par gyurd na/ mtha' yun du yang my-i dge zhing ma legs/ rje blon snga rabs kyil dam gtsigs bzhes pa'i dbu snyung dang yang 'gal nas/ snga rabs kyi ring la gdung rabs re re zhing chos myi gzhig par thugs dam bzhe so zhes 'byung ba dang sbyard te/ yab kyi ring la dbu snyung gtsigs mdzad pa' rnams dang /nga'i thugs la dgongs te/ gtsigs gser du bsnan nas/ yi ge 'di las byung ba'i rnams/ nam zhar 'di bzhin du myi mdzad re zhes/ nga'i zha snga nas dbu' snyung por te/ thugs dam bzhes/ phyi nang gi blon po che phras kyang mna' por te gtsigs kyi yi ger bris pa'o/ dbya/thugs dam dang dbu' snyung bzhes te gtsegal su mdzad pas/ chos mdzad pa 'di gces spras ci la yang sdig go zhe nam/ ma legs so zhes mo dang rmis ltas las sogs te ci'i phyir yang rung ste/ dkond cog gsum gzhig re spang re/ de skad ces che chung su gsold kyis kyang de ltar mdzad re/ btsan pho/ dbon sras sku chung ngur bzhugs pa 410

yan chad/ chab srid kyi mnga' bdag mdzad pa man chad kyang dge slong las dge ba'i bshes gnyen bskos te/ chos thugs su ci chud chud du bslab cing /bod yongs kyis kyang chos slob cing spyad pa'i sgo bcad de/ nam du yang bod ya rabs mnor cing bod 'bangs las thard par gzung ba'i sgo mi bgag par/dad pa'i rnams las thar par btsud de/ de'i nang nas nus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs rtag tu bsko zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs byed pa'i rnams/ chos 'khor nas bya 'o cog gi bka' la yang gtogs te/chos 'khor gyi las dang dbang byed cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen byed par mi bsko re/ rab tu byung ba'i rnams gzhan gyi bran du mi sbyin/ nan gyis mi dbab/ khyim pa'i khrin la btags te gyod la mi gdags shing / nged yab gras kyis mchod gnas su gnang ba bzhin du byas te/ btsan pho'i/ pho brang na dkond cog gsum gyi rten btsugs cing / mchod pa yang gud du spang zhing bskar re/ mchod gnas su myi bya re/ mdor na/ btsan pho'i/ pho brang dang bod khams na/ dkond cog gsum myed pa dang spang ba'i thabs ci yang bya re/ yab mes dbon sras gang gi ring la yang rung ste/ dkond cog gsum gyi rkyen bcad pa'i rnams kyang / ma dmas ma zhig pa'i chos su mi bya re/ 'di ltar rje blon man chad kun gyis mna' bor ba las/ btsan pho'i/ gdung rgyud las dbu' snyung bzhes dgos pa'am/ phyis jo mo'am/ chab srid kyi blon po la stsogs pa gsar du bskos shing chud pa zhig yod la/ mnangs bsgag pa'i rigs pa las/ mna' ma bor ba zhig yod na/ de bzhin du mna' my-i bsgag re/da༄)/jo ma mched bro stsald pa/ jo mo 'bro bza' khri mo legs/ jo mo mchims rgyal bza' legs mo brtsan/ jo mo cog ro bza' brtsan rgyal/dbya/rgyal phran bro bstsald pa/ dbon 'a zha rje dud kyi bul zhi khud bor ma ga 411

tho gon kha gan/ rkong gar po mang po rje/ myang btsun khri bo/ bcu/chab srid kyi blon po man chad blon po che phra bro stsald pa la/ ban de bka' chen po la gtogs pa/ ban de bran ka yon tan/ ban de myang ting 'dzin/ bcu/chab srid kyi blon po bka' chen po la gtogs pa/ blon chen po zhang 'bro khri gzu ram shags/ zhang mchims rgyal btsan bzher legs gzigs/ dba' blon mang rje lha lod/ dba'as blon khri sum bzher mdo btsan/ 7 zhang mchims rgyal lha bzher nee shags/ rlang blon khri sum rje speg lha/ dbya/nang blon la/ zhang sna nam khri sgra rgyal/ zhang tshe spong mdo bzher phes po/ zhang tshe spong lha bzang klu dpal/ zhang sna nam rgyal legs dge tshug zhang sna nam lha bzher spe btsan/bran ka blon rgyal bzang 'dus kong / myang blon khri bzang legs 'dus/ le'u blon lha bzang byin byin/ tong blon stag slebs/ zhang mchims rgyal mdo gzigs/ rlang blon bsam skyes/ zhang tshe spong lha lung sto/ zhang sna nam gnyan 'od/ 'ong ka lha sbyin/ 'bring yas blon stag rma/ rtsang rje blon khye 'u cung /'bal blon 'bro ma/ snya shur blon da tsug snyam/ dmya/snam phyi pa la/ khar ba rje blon btsan slebs/ khu stag tshab/ zha snga gcan stag lod/ byung bo blon rgyal 'byung / shud pu blon khong khri/ le'u blon klu gzher/ zhang tshe spong klu mtsho sto/ pa tsab blon 'tsho gzigs/ myang blon legs btsan/ rlang blon gsas slebs/ dbang blon lta bo btsan/ bran ka blon bsam pa/ nyi ba blon ldon kong / shud bu blon stag slebs/ zha snga gsas btsan khu thog btsan/sna nam lha 'bangs/ bcu/dbang po dang dmag dpon dang / phyis blon bka' la gtogs pa la/ lho blon khri bzang g.yu brtsan/ dbas blon khrom bzher/ zhang mchims rgyal stong snya smon btsan/ zhang tshe spong khri gzigs spung re tsung /zhang mchims rgyal stag bzher rgyal slebs/ zhang sna nam btsan sgra khri slebs/418 ——

'brom blon rgyal bzher khar tsi/ lha lung blon mang po rje skar kong / zhang 'bro stag bzher pra bal stang / dbangs rgyal to re stag snya/ cog ro blon sto gong /lang gro blon khrom legs/ dba' blon mdo btsan/ le'u blon ku rma/ zhang 'bro stag dang / mang sgra blon klu rma/ zhang mchims rma btsan/ rtse 'brom blon sga 'gu khung po blon mas kol/ pa tsab blon spe ma/ 'brom se ri stang /dba'as blon 'phan legs/ dbas blon khrom legs/ ska ba blon mtsho lod/cog ro blon gong keng / dbas blon mye slebs/ khu mye gzigs/ zha snga mu gnyen/ zhang 'bro gung stang / zhang mchims rgyal ma rmyan brtse/ zhang tshe spong ma btsan/ cog ro brtan kong / gnang yul bzung / cog ro khyi btsan/sbrang mo rma/ 'bro ldog srong ston/ 'brom yang gzigs/ ces byung ngo /bka' gtsigs gong 'og 'di rnams sdebs phul rten sogs kyang rnying pa ngos bshus yin la dam pa'i chos la bka' ba 'di lta bu mdzad do zhes chos kyi che ba dang / rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan shes shing res dang ba 'phel ba'i dgos pa mthong nas bris pa yin no/ /de ltar lo sum bcu so gnyis rgyal sa mdzad/ rgyal khrims chos bzhin du bskyangs pas bod 'bangs bde ba la bkod de dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhi pa me mo bya'i lo la sbrags kyi phur 'das so/ /sa skya dpal ldan bla ma'i chos byung du sad na legs kyi lo bcu dgu bzhes pa na btsun mo lha rtse la sras ldeng khri bltams/ lo bcu gsum na yab 'das nas rgyal sa mdzad pa'i sras gtsang ma mched lnga yin no zhes sad na leṭa dang ral pa can gyi bar du ldeng khri gdung rabs gcig du byas pa dang / rgya'i deb las khri srong lde btsan nga gcig bzhes pa lcags spre la gshegs nas mu ne btsan po bskos/ lo bco brgyad srid bskyangs nas me glang la 'das te ju tse btsan po bskos/ lo brgyad srid mdzad nas shing spre la 'das te sad na legs 413

bskos/ zhes mu nee btsan po dang sad na legs kyi bar du sku mched 'bring po ju tse btsan pos rgyal sa byas pa sogal cung zad mi mthun par snang yang bod kyi rgyal rabs phal cher dang tshal ba la sogs yig tshangs la mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad pa ltar bris so/ /rgyal po de la sras lnga ste lha sras gtsang ma/ khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can/ khri dar ma u dum btsan/ lha rje/ lhun grub ste lnga'o/ /kun mkhyen bus lha rje lhun grub ces gcig du byas khri chen po bsnan nas lngar mdzad snang / 'di rnams btsun mo che ba'i sras snga ma gsum dang chun ma'i sras phyi ma gnyis zhes kha cig 'chad la/ ji ltar na yang sras chung ba gnyis sku chung ngur gshegs pas bang so yang med do/ /lha sras gtsang ma rgyal srid rtsa ltar spangs/ /thub pa'i bstan la rab tu byung ba mdzad/ /dar ma sdig la dga' bas rjer ma 'os/ /bar pa khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can/ /me pho khyi la sku 'khrungs bcu gnyis dus/ /yab 'das lo de nyid la rgyal sar bton/ /bka' yi blon po bran ga dpal yon yin/ /btsun mo cog bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul /sogs/ /che chung lnga bzhes dge bcu'i bka' khrims btsan/ /'di ni phyag na rdo rje'i rnam sprul yin/ /rgya yul cham la phab nas gtsigs bzung ste/ /bod rgya'i mtshams su dbon zhang lha khang brtsigs/ /gnam la che ba nyi zla zung gcig ste/ /sa la che ba btsan po dbon zhang grags/ /bka' gtsigs yi ge rdo ring gsum la brkos/ /phyin chad bod rgya rang rang yul na bde/ /dmag mi bya bar gtsigs bzung bro yis bstsal/ /ma 'ongs bod kyi rgyal khrims 'jig mkhyen pas/ /spyan rgyang bsrings nas sman yon mdzad pa ste/ /rje 'di'i bka' drin bod mi su yis khor/ /bka' drin can gyi lo paṇa gsum sogs kyis/ sngon chad bsgyur ba'i dam chos ma lus pa/ /lhag chad spang phyir dam chos dkar chag bkod/ /thams cad gsar bcad skang kyis gtan la phab/ /bka'as bcad 414

chen po rnam pa gsum gyis bsdams/ /sgom gra bshad gra 'dul gra sum bcu btsugs/ /rgyal po'i dbu ral tshan gnyis byas pa la/ /dar yug btags te g.yas g.yon bting ba'i steng / /dge 'dun bzhugs pas dbu sde gnyis zhes grags/ /thugs dam rten du lha khang 'u zhang rdo/ /dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gtsug lag khang / /gtsang khang dgu thog bya 'dab dgu yis mdzad/ /pha gu do shal shar bu mda' yab dang / /rta babs la sogal rgyan rnams kun gyis bkra /rtse mor rgya phubs gser 'phru g.yu 'brug bcas/ /rlung gis bskyod tshe mkha' la gdugs ltar 'khor/ /gser gyi garji ra yi tog gi rtse/ /rgyab ri'i lcog dang mtho dman med par mnyam/ /'dzam gling tsam na 'gran zla bral bar bzhengs/ /lugs gnyis bka' khrims chos bzhin gtan la phab/ /dge bcu'i khrims dam sdig spyod ming mi grag /mkhyen pas 'phrul chags mdzad pa lha las lhag /mnga' thang dpal 'byor sa la brgya byin bzhin/ /stobs dang mthu yis dga' rab dbang phyug skrag /mtha' bzhi kun las rnam par rgyal gyur te/ /'dzam gling gsum gnyis las lhag mnga' dbang mdzad/ /de yang gcen lha sras gtsang ma ni chos la dgyes ches pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste dge 'dun gyi nang na bzhugs/ gnyis pa khri dar ma u dam btsan sdig la dga' bas rjer ma 'os te/ gsum pa khri gtsug lde btsan dgung lo bcu gnyis lon pa me mo bya'i lo la rgyal sar bskos/ rgya nag gi rgyal po dang dbon zhang dums bya bar ma mthun nas bod ru re nas dmag stong sde bco brgyad re dar tshan khrig ge ba khrid ste rgya'i gen bo rnams bkum/ rgya cham la phab/ dpon po mnyes pa'i skyes phul/ bod kyi mchod gnas lo paṇa rnams dang rgya'i ha shang rnams kyis dpang po mdzad/ rgya'i gong gu rme ru zhes bya bar bod rgya'i sa mtshams byas te der bod btsan po'i gtsug lag khang zhig dang rgya rje'i katsug 415

lag khang zhig brtsigs/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la btsan po dbon zhang las med do bar bgros nas pha bong la nyi zla'i gzugs byas/ phyin chang bod bod yul na bde/ rgya rgya yul na bde/ so mtshams rme ru man la bod kyi dmag mi drang / gal te drangs na rgya rje'i pho brang gi mdun gyi rdo ring yi ge lan gsum klog pas bod thams cad 'phung bar 'gyur/ rme ru yan la rgya'i dmag mi drang / gal te drangs na lha sa'i rdo ring gi yi ge lan gsum klog pas rgya thams cad 'phung bar gyur cig ces btsan po dbon zhang gis bden pa btsugs te dmod bor/ bod rgya'i pho brang gi mdun so mtshams rme ru dang gsum du rdo ring re re btsugs te ngos che ba gnyis la btsan po dbon zhang gi gtsigs yig dang bro tshig ngos chung gnyis la bod rgya'i blon po bka' la gtogs pa rnams kyi gtsegs yig dang bro tshig bris te/ dkon cog gsum lha klu gza' skar sku lha thams cad dpang du btsugs te btsan po dbon zhang gis dbu snyung mdzad/ btsan pos lo bcu bdun bzhes shing rgya rje mu dzung gis rgyal sa byas nas lo bcu bzhi pa chu pho stag gi lo la chad mal bro bor pa rnams byas shing bod kyi mna' chad ni chu pho stag gi lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes drug la dkyil 'khor la 'dzegs te bod kyi gtsigs bzung ngo / /lha sa'i rdo ring gi yi ge bshu bar nus na bar 'dir chug cig sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la chos kyi brda bod skad la ma grags pa mang zhig byung zhing rgya nag dang li dang yul dbus dang za hor dang kha che sogs sna tshogs nas bsgyur bas brda mi 'dra ba mang pos mi go zhing slob dka' bar gzigs nas/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po a tsarya dzi na mi tra dang / su rend+ra bo rti dang / shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po dharma rakṣa ta dang / dharma tā shī la dang / lo tsā pa mkhas pa dzñā na se na dang / dza ya raṇi ta dang / mañdzu shri warma dang / rarnend+ra 416

shī la la sogs pa rnams la theg pa che chung las byung ba'i chos rnams rgya gar gyi yul dbus las byung ba'i brda dang mthun par bsgyur zhing kun gyis slob tu rung la nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi bsgyur ba dang / chad lhag spang pa'i phyir dkar chag kyang bris shig ces bka' bstsal te/ zho paṇa de rnams dang khyad par drin can gyi lo paṇa gsum zhes grags pa dzi na mi tra dang da na shrī la dang /zhang ye shes sde gsum gyis sngar bsgyur ba thams cad dag par byas shing gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste gna'i brda go dka' ba rnams dor nas yul dus dang mthun pa'i go sla zhing 'don bde bar byas/ yi ge nyung ba'i ched du ma mya da drag rkyang pa'i 'a brten sogs dor te gzhung tshad rnams kyang bam grangs soṭa nges par dkar chag tu bsnan te spyir khri srong gi dus kyi dkar chag pho brang ldan dkar ma dang / phyis mchims phu ma dang 'phang thang ma ste gsum du byung la dkor mdzod du— bka' gtsigs kyi zla la gces spras su 'jog go /rgyal pos bkas bcad rnam pa gsum mdzad/ gzhi thams cad yod smra las gzhan pa'i sde pa mi gzugs shing de dag gi sde sdod mi bsgyur/ sngags ma rgyud rnams ma sgyur zhig ces bka' bstsal/ bre srang dang zho cha tshun rgya gar gyi dbus 'gyur tshal dang mthun par bcos/ rab tu byung ba re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ dbu skra gsil ba sogs la mi mnyes pas dbu skra ral par chags te btsan po ral pa can du mtshan thogs/ rgyal po dgung la bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon la dge 'dun gyi stan bzang po bshams/ dbu ral tshan gnyis su byas pa'i sna la dar yug btags pa dge 'dun gyi stan gyi steng du bkram pa la dge 'dun bzhugs te dbu gtsug tu 'khur bas dge 'dun dbu sde gnyis zhes grags/ thugs dam gyi rten du 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ de'i sa phud la lha sar byams pa chos 'khor gyi sgo 417
