srung tshangs pa dang brgya byin bzhengs/ shing phud la gnam yangs ka ba bzhi rin po ches brgyan ste phul/ bris phud du be bum brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs/lugs ma'i phud la cong dril chen phul/ yang phud la yer par mchod rten bzhengs/ rgya bal gyi gzo bo mkhas pa mang pos lha khang dngos thog dgu ldan 'phrul snang gi tshad tsam du bzhengs te/ 'og gi thog gsum rdo las brtsigs te de na rje blon rnams bzhugs/ bar thog gsum so phag gis brtsigs te lo paṇa dge 'dun rnams bzhugs/ steng thog gsum shing gi 'phrul gyis bteg ste thugs dam gyi rten rnams bzhugs/ sku'i rten thams cad rgya gar gyi yul dbus kyi lha la dpe byas li dkar dmar las lugs su blug pa dzambha chu bori gser gyis g.yogs pa 'ba' zhig du mdzad/ thog re re zhing mthing gi bya 'dab dang pha gu dra phyed/ sham bu/ mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/ bya 'dab kyi bar re re zhing lo paṇa rnams kyis chos bsgyur ba dang 'chad rtsom byed pa/ thog re re zhing glo 'bur gyi sgo dang / sgo khyams dang / rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ yang rtse'i bya 'dab kyi rtser gser gyi snyasnyi ra rtse mo rgyab ri mdun ma'i rtse dang mnyam pa'i g.yas g.yon du g.yu 'brug gis sbas ba/ yang rtse'i rgya phubs rlung gis bskyod pa na mkha' la gdugs ltar du 'khor ba/ rlung ha cang che ba na zur bzhir lcags thag gis rdo'i seng ge la gtod pa'am mchod rten chen po bzhi'i ngos su 'dogs kyang skad/ rin po che'i phreng ba dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dar 'phan dang / gser gyi dril phreng gis kun tu 'khrol ba/ lta bas chog mi shes pa dzasbu'i gling tsam na 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhengs so/ /spyir 'di yan la bod kyi rgyal po rnams kyis gtsug lag khang stong dang brgyad bzhengs bar 'dod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe blon po 'ga' dang myang ban sha'i spyan can la sogs pas lha sar shar du dkar ru dang dmar ru gnyis/ stor dga' ba dang 418

dga' ba'i 'od/ nub tu bran khang dang bran khang tha ma 'a sogs pa'i lha khang byas te bod 'bangs thams cad dge bcu la longs spyod bde skyid lha dang mtshungs/ chab 'bangs rgya che ste sngar yab mes kyi sku ring la ma 'dus pa shar skar ma smin drug 'char ba'i 'og rgya nag so lon shan gyi ri rgyud dar dkar gyi yol ba 'dra ba la gtugs/ byang hor gyi so mtshams bye ma sgang ring nya rmang ma'i rgyab 'dra ba la gtugs/ nub stag gzig gi so mtshams spa stag sha dung gi sgo mo la gtugs/ lho phyogs bram ze'i yul las brgal bar gtugs te/ 'dzam gling sum gnyis las ches lhag par mnga' mdzad do/ /lha tho tho ri nas rgyal po 'di'i bar la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum zhes mu ne btsan po yun thung bas phyed du byas/ mang srong ma bgrangs par de ltar grags la/ mes ag tshoms nas 'di'i bar la shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga zhes snga rabs grags so/ /lo tsā ba ka cog zhang gsum yang 'u shang rdo —tshar ba'i skabs de shed du mya ngan las 'das nas mchod rten has po ri'i skor du brtsigs so/ /de ltar chos rgyal 'gro kun gnyen gcig rnams/ /gzhan gyi don la rtag du brtson pa ni/ /byis rnams rang gi don la brtson pa yis/ /bye ba'i char yang bsgrun par ma nus so/ /blun zhing shes zhan dud 'gro'i gnas lta bu'i/ /bod 'bangs rnams la chos kyi blo skyed pa/ /ngo mtshar nang na shin tu rmad byung ste/ /rgyal kun phrin las gcig bsdus yin par go /ngan 'gro las ldog mi yi skye bar bkod/ /thabs kyis blo sbyangs 6 nga dag lam rab bstan/ /chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams kyi/ /bka' drin bdag cag bod mis ji ltar khor/ /byas shes byas gzo byas pa'i nang na dkon/ /dam pa rnams ni phan btags lan mi bzhed/ /bka' drin dran sda'i bod mi yod srid na/ /de dag dgyes pa'i dam nga 'i chos la 'bungs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad to/ /de 419

nas bong yul 'gro ba'i bsod nams ni/ /sos ga'i chab rom bzhin du zhu zhing —gtugs/ /bdud kyi bran gyur blon po du ma byung / /dge bcu'i chos kyi khrimus kyis skyo gyur te/ /chos khrims gzhig par lkog tu bgros nas ni/ /log pa'i thabasta dang snyan phra gsol ba yis/ /lha sras gtsang ma sgyugs te bzhugs ma ster/ /bran ka dpal yon nyes med skyon phab bkum/ /rgyal po'i sku la nongs pa bgyis nas bkrongs/ /don mkhar mda' yi g.yon phyogs bang so brtsigs/ /ming du khri steng rmang re lags so skad/ /de yang 'bangs kyi bu byis pa spre'u'i mgo 'dra ba rna ba la stag ris yod pa dba'as rgyal to zhes pa zhig byung ste byis pa mang po'i khrod na rtse zhing yod pa'i tshe blon chen po bran ka dpal yon gyis rta zhon te phyin pa na byis pa de dag rtse pa las char byung bas gzhan thams cad bros/ de gos phud nas bye ma'i phung bor sbas/ gcer bur chu nang du zhugs/ zhib ma mgo la bkab ste bsdad pa blon chen pos mthong bas ma rungs pa cig tu shes te nas su ma smin par srubs su bcar dgos pa cig de na 'dug zhes pa kha nas shor skad/ pha tshad slebs pa dang de skad ngag tu shor ba byis pa des dran nam blta dgos snyam nas phyir log ste rta lcag bor ba ltar byas nas mthong ngam dris pas de na re/ khyed rang srubs gcor zer tsa na lag na 'dug zer skad de the rang gi sprul pa yin pas shes nas zhe bzhag byas/phyis de blon por tshud nas dpa'as stag rna can du grags/ chos khrims shin tu dam pas blon po sdig la dga' ba rnams skyo ste rang cag 'di tsam du gu dog pa cis len zer ba la 'ga' zhig gis rab tu byung ba la sdang mig bltas mdzub mo ker te 'di rnams kyis len zer ba rgyal pos gsan nas dkon mchog la de ltar byed pa mi rigs kyis de'i mig phyung mdzub mo chod ces bka' bstsal to/ /de nas nang blon gdug pa can 'ga'as chos khrims bshig par bgros pa la rgyal 420

po ma bkrongs na chos khrims gzhig par mi nas zer/ la la na re rgyal po ༄bkrongs kyang lha sras gtsang ma dang btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang ban chen po rnams yod pas bshig mi nus zer/ der 'ba'as stag rna can gyis sngon du de dag med par byas la de nas rgyal po bkrong zer nas mo ma phya mkhan rnams la rngan pa byin te lha sras gtsang ma 'dir bzhugs na rgyal khrims 'jig pas spyug dgos zer du bcug de kun du grags pa'i tshe rgyal po'i snyan du gsol nas mon yul du sgyug par byas/ dge 'dun lo paṇa rnams kyis gtsang po'i chab kha bar bskyal bas/ rgyal blon thams cad bka' yis bgros pa lags/ /bdag la sdod pa'i dbang med sa mthar 'gro /nyes pa med par skrod la thabs ci yod/ /dge 'dun thugs bde 'di nas ldog par zhu/ /sems thag chad zin gru yi nyag thag thong / /gsung lho brag kho thing gi bar du byon/ /der sna nam bza' mang rjes dug gis bkrongs skad/ de nas btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang bran ka dpal yon mdza' 'o zhes snyan phra gsol bas khrims la sbyor zhig ces gsung ba na btsun mo ngang tshul ma shin tu sdug bsngal te rang lcebs nas shi/ blon chen po bran ka dpal yon gyis kho rang bsad na rgyal po yang dgrongs kyis dogs te byangaXdu bros nas sa 'og du lcags kyi srog ba rtsa bsgrubs/ spyi bor sor bzhi ma gtogs grub pa'i tshe dmus te long ba zhig long khrid dang bcas pas phyogs der slebs nas long bas yul 'di gang yin dris pas long khrid kyis lung stong yin zhes smras pas 'o na du ba'i dri bsnam pas mi yod par nges kyis tshol zer nas long bas sa la mnams nas 'di na 'dug zer ba bltas pas ser ga la du ba byung ba'i rjes mthong / long bas dri la brtags pas sgo brnyed nas zas skom slong / mi smra ba'i rngan par gos re byin pas long ba'i gos rtsub par shes nas khos smras te dbangs stag rna can la sogs pas blon chen po bzung nas mtshon ci 421

btab kyang ma phed/ shin tu sdug yun ring ba na skyo ste spyi bo na sor bzhi ma grub par yod pas der khab tshugs la song zhes khong rang gis smras pa ltar byas pas ltag pa sgur gyis song ste shi/ pags bra rlud bur bshus te gsob tu brgyangs/ nye du rnams kyis ro lhag ma bsdus te yer par bsregal pas du ba'i nang nas 'od dkar po rdza ma tsam zhig nam mkha' la je mtho je mthor song bas khong rang gi sring mo zhig gis ngus shing bos te blon chen po khyed gar 'byo na/dgras nyes med du bsad pa la lan mi 'jal lam zhes bos/ 'od de je dmar babs pa dang rlung dmar chen po zhig tu gyur te sa rdo ri brag ldeg pa tsam du byung ste de ma thag las kyi gnod spyin chen po 'jigs su rung bar skyes te phyis jo bo rjes btul nas yer pa rdzi khang gi srung ma byed cing gsob kyang snye thang rgya ring na 'phyams skur yod cing yul lha byed do/ /de nas mnga' bdag khri ral pa can dgung lo so drug bzhes pa'i lcags mo bya'i lo la mal gro zham pa'i pho brang na rgun chang myos par bzhes te gser khri la gzims pa la dba'as stag rna can dang / cog ro lha lod dang / legs sdug btsan te sdig blon gsum gyis dbu ltag tu bskor nas bkrongs so/ /kye ma srid pa 'di na ci yang snang / /'gro kun skyob pa'i pha dang skyong ba'i ma/ /snang byed nyi ma brten pa'i sa gzhi bzhin/ /yid bzhin nor las srid par 'byung dka' ba'i/ /chos rgyal yon tan kun tshang de dag ni/ /—rang srog lan stong btang nas bsten 'os la/ /thugs su byon pa'i nang 'khor par byas pas/ /mi rigs gnod byed 'di 'dra'i dus kyang byung / /bod 'bangs bde skyid thams cad cig car bshig /sprul pa'i chos rgyal thos pa'i lam du bskyal/ /byams pas bskyangs pa'i drin lan log par gzhal/ /de dag mngon sum mnar med cis ma song / /da lta'i skye bo'ang mi ltung 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /sa 'di dpyod pa med par da gzod go /de lta'i dus 422

kyang yal bar 'dor ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten skyong rnams gtam du grags par zad/ /sdig blon de dag mchil mas mi 'debs pa/ /bod 'bangs skye bos blun po'i rnam thar bstan/ /'jig rten lha la skyob pa'i nus med ces/ /sku lha rnams kyis rang mtshang bsgrags pa snyam/ /bzod par dka' ba'i yul dus de mthong ba'i/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyi gnas skabs ci zhig 'dra/ /'on kyang leṭa par brtags na rang rang gi /ma dag pa yi las snang mthong bar zad/ /sa thob tsam yang 'jigs pa lnga med na/ /phyag na rdo rje su yis dgrong bar nus/ /skye 'chi bral yang skye 'chi ltar ston pa/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi ngo mtshar slar yang rmad/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas bod 'bangs yongs kyi bsod nams ni/ /snum zad mar me lta bur yal la thug /rje yi mnga' thang dgun kha'i chu bzhin bri/ /rgyal khrims sog rul phon thag bzhin du zhig /chab srid phan bde nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin yal/ /nag phyogs spyod pa dpyid kyi rlung bzhin langs/ /bzang byed bsam pa rmi lam bzhin du brjed/ /lo paṇa mchod gnas rnams la zhabs tog med/ /dam chos mang zhig bsgyur ba'i 'phro la lus/ /lo paṇa phal cher rang rang yul du bzhud/ /blon 'bangs dad pa can rnams shugs ring 'byin/ /dar ma u dum btsan la rgyal srid gtad/ /lo gnyis 'das nas thugs su gdon gsol te/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ma lus 'jig par brtsams/ /jo bo rnam gnyis byams pa chos 'khor bcas/ /chu bor 'dor brtsams blon pos thabs kyis sbas/ /ra sa'i sgo srung phyag rdor gzhig pa'i phyir/ /mgul la thag pa btags pas 'dogs mkhan de/ khrug bskyugs gum pas skrag ste 'jig 'phro bcad/ /ra sa 'jig pa lan re bskyabs pa'i phyir/ /sgo srung 'di gnyis byin rlabs lhag par che/ /bsam yas gzhig phyir mchod rten chung ngu zhig /bshig pa'i mod la thog bab 'jig mkhan shi/ /423

skrag ste lhag ma ma bshig lus par gyur/ /ra sa bsam yas wa tshang spyang tshang bcas/ /sku gsung thugs rten lha khang mang du bshig /gsung rab phal cher mer bsregs chu la bskur/ /chos pa rab bsad 'bring sprugs tha ma bkol/ /btsun pa rnga gshang bskur nas lings la gtong / /la la rta yi zhon stegs 'bab stegs byed/ /de tshe dkar phyogs srung ma kun khros te/ /bod rgya'i mtshams su bod kyi bla ri 'gyel/ /klu chu zhag gsum bar 'khyil chu nang nas/ /'od dang sgra byung thogs bab sa yang g.yos/ /phyogs tshig skar mda' sna tshogs 'khrug cing lhung / /rgyal khrims 'jig pa'i ltas ngan sna tshogs byung / /de tshe snubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyi/ /sngags kyi nus pas rgyal po skrag par byas//dge slong byang chub sems dpa' rtse gcig tu/ /sgrub pa mdzad pa lha lung dpal rdor gyis/ /snying rje chen pos byang chub thugs bskyed de/ /rgyal po ngan 'gro'i gnas las ldog phyir dang / /dam chos lhag ma gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /bdud kyi chas zhugs rgyal po mtshon gyis bkum/ /lha yi chas zhugs bros pas ma zin ste/ /tha dad mthong snang sprul pa re re byung / rgyal po bsgral nas mdo khams yul du byon/ smar g.yo gtsang gsum mdo khams smad du bros/ /dar ma'i bang so 'phrul dang rgyal chen bar/ /bang rim 'khor lo can brtsigs rtsig 'phror lus/ /rgyal po 'di la smad kyi stengs ces zer/ /phyi lo gdung brgyud yum brtan 'od srung byung / /stag rna can la sogs pa'i sdig blon rnams/ /dkon mchog bka' chad mi 'tsham du mas brlag /dam chos bsnubs pas lan par kha 'cham nas/ /jo bo mched dang byams mgon la sogs pa/ /rang rang khrir bzhugs lha khang zhig pa bsos/ /bstan pa med kyang mchod pa tsam zhig dar/ /dgra bcom gtsug phud can gyi chos lugs dang / /sngags la sgrub gzhung bon du gyer pa byung / /dka' bas bsgrubs pa'i dam chos bsnubs pa 424

las/ /rje 'bangs kun la dkon mchog dbu yogs byung / /yum brtan 'od srung mnga' ris gnyis su chad/ /dbu g.yor gnyis sogs bod yul kun na rtsod/ /mtha' yi so shor 'dun sa che chung zhig /rgyal khrim sa chag zhing chos khrims dar mdud grol/ /mi kun rtag du khral dang 'u lag rtsi/ /gtsa bo thams cad sgrib shing mna' la za/ /de yi chad pas pha tshan sder bcas brlag /sad ser yams nad mu ges rtag du mnar/ /gser khung la sogs rin chen 'byung khungs nub/ /de nas bran ka dpal yon smod ba'i mthus/ /'bangs rnams kun gyis rje la kheng log byas/ /'od srung bang so 'phrul rgyal rgyab na yod/ /ming du skye 'u lha rten lags so skad/ /de phyin btsan po'i bang so rtsig pa nub//rje kheng khyad med bod khams sil bur song / /bang so rnams kyang bgos te phal cher brus/ /rje yi mgur lha rnams kyi g.yar ngo las/ /rje tshan rnam dgu rje lhus bcu ru chags/ /de yang khri ral 'khrungs pa las lo gsum gyis snga ba'i chu mo lug la khri dar ma u dum btsan 'khrungs/ ba lang gi sha tshugs 'dra zhing mkhyen pa chung la rgyud gyong bas 'bangs rnams kyis glang dar mar btags/ so dgu pa lcags bya la rgyal sar bton/ btsun mo che chung gnyis khab tu bzhes/blon po dba'as stag rna can gyis byas/ de'i tshe paṇḍi ta dā na shī las ra sa dmer rur mtshams bcad nas/ dzambha la bsgrubs pas yun ring du ma grub pas paṇḍita khros nas lcags kyi rdo rje yinā yang zer gseg shang gi bsham yin yang zer te dzambha la'i 'jim gzugs kyi sto bar bsnun pas gser dngul gyi 'od pa chen po byung ste des rgyu byas nas khrarla pā ṇa dang / gser gyi nyi khri/ dngu/ma bya khun bu can la sogs pa mang du bzhengs/ de'i nye gnas kha che zhu tpalas gser dngul byams pa mched bzhi bzhengs/ de'i tshe sad ser dang lams nad byung bas chos byed pa bkra mi shis so zhes de la bsnyad btab/rngag nas sdagangarba/ rgyas kyi 425

bstan pa bsnubs/ lha sa gzhig pa'i phyir mar me mdzad kyi sgo srung phyag rdor gyi mgul la thag pa btags pas de ma thag 'dogs mkhan khrag bskyugs nas de gar shi bas 'jig ma nus/ des na rme brtsegs dang 'di gnyis kyis lha sa 'jig thebs re bskyabs pas byin rlabs lhag par che'o/ /jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams pa chos 'khor chu la skyur zer ba la blon po chos la dga' ba 'gas bskyur zin pa skad du thabs byas nas so so'i khri 'og du sbas/ gtsang khang gi sgo brtsigs nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i ri mo bris te bzhag bsam yas gzhig par bsgos nas mchod rten 'od 'bar yin yang zer/ khams gsum dang dbu rtse'i bar na mchod rten nag po chung ngu zhig yod kyang zer te de bshig pas thog bab nas bshig mkhan rnams shi bas 'jig 'phro bcad/ lha sa bsam yas gnyis kur dang por bshas khang byas/ phyis wa tshang dang spyang tshang bcas/ gzhan lha khang mang du bshig gsung rab gang rnyed mer bsregs la chur bskyur/ la la sa'i 'o3 du sbas/ paṇḍi ta bros ma thar ba la la mon du btsongs/ rma rin chen mchog dang myang ting 'dzin bzang po sogs skyes bu dam pa mang du bkrongs/ rab tu byung ba phal cher sa mthar bros cing ma thar ba rnams khyim par phab/ ma nyan pa bsad/ la la khrid nas rgyal blon rnams kyi rta 'babs 'dzeg gi tshe sgur du bcug nas stegs byed/ la la rnga gshang bskur te rngon pa la gtong skad/ de'i tshe lha srin thams cad 'khrugs nas rgyal khrims 'jig pa'i ltas ngan sna tshogs pa byung ste/ sa cher g.yos/ phyogal tshig ste nam mkha' khrag mdog tu gyur/ skar mda' 'khrug bod rgya'i mtshams si ha ci 'u la thang dkyil na bod dbang ri brtsigs yod pa 'gyel bas klu chu zhag gsum 'gags te bskyel nas gyen du log chu nang nas 'od dang sgra chen po dang thoṭa 'bab pa byung / de'i tshe lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yer pa brag lhar rtse gcig du 426

sgom pa'i tshe 'od dang sgra dang sa g.yos mang pos the tshom du gyur te phyir gzigs pas btsun pa rnga gshang thogs te khyi khrid nas lings byed pa mthong bas rgyal pos bstan pa bsnubs par shes te snying rje khyad par can skyes/ dpal mgon po dang ma gcig dpal lha dang grib kyi rdzong btsan gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i phyir rgyal po sdig can dgrol zhig bdag cag gis grogs bya'o zhes yang yang du bskul/ phod ka dang zhwa nang dkar phyi nag po gyon/ phu thung du lcags mda' lcags gzhu bcug rta dkar sol ba byugs pa la zhon nas phyin/de'i tshe blon 'bangs chos la dga' ba thams cad 'dus nas ngu 'bod dang mya ngan byas/ rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'di lta bu mdzad par mi rigs/ yab mes thams cad kyi yig tshangs dang dkor mdzod kyi sgrom bu rdo ring gi yi ge thams cad gzigs shig ces mgrin gcig ngu 'bod chen po byas/ rgyal po nub phyogs gla ba'i tshal na mig mang rtse zhing yod pa 'bangs rnams kyi ngu 'bod thos pas sems ma bde ste rdo ring gi yi ge klog gin yod pas mthong ste mgon po nag po byung zer skad/ der rta bab rgyal po rdo ring gi rus sbal la sgu stegs su 'dug pa la phyag byed pa ltar bcos te phyag dang po la phu thung gi nang du mtheb ltong sprad gnyis pa la mda' bkang / gsum pa la 'phangs pas smin mtshams su phog ste mde'u ltag par phyung / yang na lo gsum gyis sngas yang na lo gsum gyis 'phyis zhes pa kha nas shor te phyag gnyis mda' la 'jus nas grongs/ der rta la bzhon te nga bdud yab bzher nag po bya ba yin/ rgyal po sdig can gsod na de ltar gsod pa yin zer nas bros/ blon po thams cad kyis rjes bsnyegal pas mi nag mtsho la rta gzhan/ ber dang zhwa phyi nang zlog ste nga lha gnam the dkar po bya ba yin zer nas bros pas mi ma yin par rdogs nas 'ded mi rnams 'tshoms/ 'on kyang rgyang de nas ded pas 427

phyogs bzhi kur 'ded rgyu re byung ste shar 'a/ 'ded mi rnache/sa dga' mo gdung nas sa sros te zin la khad tsam na shor zer skad/ lho pa rnams grib chu 'gram/ nub pa rnams shun gyi 'phrang / byang pa rnams mong mkhar gdong nas sa sros te shor zer skad/ der gros bgros pas 'di rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par 'dug pas yer pa'i lha lung dpal rdor yin nges/ zer nas blta bar byas/ lha lung dpal rdor gyis kyang yer par log ste sgrub khang du phug ron gyi rkang pa nas bzung ste 'phur stangs byed bcug pas rdul phab/ mug ma sbar gang gtor te 'gro 'ong gi rjes med par byas nas bzhugs paja/ lta mkhan rnams 'di la mis phar tshur du ma phyin par 'dug zer nas log mi rig pa can zhig nang du go le byung nas khong gi snying gar lag pa bzhag pas skrag ste snying 'phar ba shes nas nag can gyi mi 'di na 'dug ste spyi'i tha pa la sgos kyi gshol mi gcog zer nas song bas skrag ste mdo khams su bros nas sgom zhing bzhugs so/ /yig tshangs rnying pa kha cig las rgyal pos da ni chos thams cad ngas bsnubs so zhes nga rgyal du mu cor smras pas btsun mo chen ma na re da dung gtsang rong snubs yul na snubs sangs rgyas ye shes bya ba'i sngags pa nus pa can 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa dang /yer pa'i brag khung na lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa po dngos grub thob pa yod ste rgyal pos sngar bsad spyugs phab pa thams cad las de gnyis lhag go zhes smras pas khros te gnyi ga la pho nya btang ste bkug pas snubs sangab/ rgyas ye shes bya ba la khyod su yin las su ci byed pa yin dris pas/ nga dkon mchog sngags pa bya ba las su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba yin byas pas/'o na bstan pa ngas /thashig zin gyis khyod la da nus pa ci yod zer bas ngas sngaṭa tsam bzlas pa'i dus pa 'di la gzigs 'i/ga ces sdigs mdzub gnam du 'phyar bas sdingasha/sa mdzub kyi steng na lcags kyi sdig pa nag po g.yag grus po tsam dgu 428

brtsegs su 'dug pa mthong bas rgyal po skrag ste dkon mchog sngags pa'i sku la mi bsdo'o chos mdzod cig zer/ da dung nus pa 'di la gzigs shig zer nas sdigs mdzub kyis thog phab ste pha ri'i brag la bsnun pas tshal bar song / der rgyal po 'jigs shing skrag nas khyed 'khor bcas la gnod pa mi byed do zer nas btang / khong gis yer par phyin te ngas rgyal po sdig can skrag par byas yod kyis khyod kyis dgrol zhig zer nas bskul te dgrol zhes kyang byung ngo / /yer pa'i dkar chag phyi ma las ni de'i tshe bsam yas dang lha sa kun du wa tshang bcas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje la khyod mar shog la rngon pa dang nya pa'i dpon gyis zer zhing 'phrin bskur byung ba la ma phyin par yi dam gyi gnang ba byung nas mar gnon du 'bangs g.yog lnga la rgod ma dkar mo zhig dbyar ril gyis leṭa par gsor bcug phye mar sgyi'u gang / gzhu gcig mda' bya rgod ma gnyis bzung nas phyin/ de rnams sbas nas stong par lha sar phyin pas khol mo zhig chu len pa dang 'phrad rgyal po sku khams bde 'am phyag byed pa1yin te byas pas/da lta gro rting la phyir 'byon/ yer pa'i dpal gyi rdo rje chab gsol zer/ de nas log ste mi nag rta nag can zhig du byas nas yong / lha sa'i ne thang du rgyal po gsus pa nyi ma la bstan nas bzhugs 'dug pa la mda' snga bsar gcig dang phyi bsar gcig brgyab pas sna bug la zug ste dkar lhug gis byung / sngags pa rnams kyis mthu brubs pa yin nam yang zer/ rgyal po'i chibs rgod kyi bya dmar bya ba zhon nas ded pas/ ma yong nga bdud yab rje nag po yin no byas pas cung zad 'artoms/ grib kyi mtsho la rta nyal byas pas mi dkar rta dkar can du song bas de mi min nges zer nas log rgod ma sgrags su bskyal bas rgod ma thang du ming thogs/ de nas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ spe'ur bya rgod kyi thul pa rdul tshom me gsol nas bzhugs pas mi rnams kyis 'di lha lung dpal gyi rdo 429

rje yin nges zer nas snga mas yer pa gang tsa na phyi ma mjug ma rdzogs pa byung ba la/ nam mkha' nas rgyal po glang dar ma gru gu hor gyis bkrongs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sangs rgyas zang ma yin no bya ba'i sgra byung bas log zhes snang ngo / /de ltar btsan po glang dar mas rgyal sa lo drug byas te zhe bzhi pa me stag la 'das/ spyir chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos rgyal sa lan gnyis mdzad pa so sor bgrangs te 'di yan la rgyal po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis song ngo / /'di man la bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ma byung bas smad sil chad du 'chad pa zhes grags so/ /phyi lo me mo yos la btsun mo chun ma tshe spong bza' btsan mo 'phan la sto bor gyi sras gcig byung ba chen mas bsad dam phrogs kyis dogs nas 'od dang ma bral bar bsrungs pas gnam lde 'od srung du thogs/ de'i tshe chen ma sna nam bzas kyang bu chung so skyes pa cig nga la mdang skyes so zhes bstan pas blon po rnams na re mdang skyes kyi bu chung so ni tseg ge tseg 'on kyang yum gyi bka' brtan du chug zer bas khri lde yum brtan du thogs zhes yi ge mang po las 'byung zhing yum brtan gdung rgyud ma yin par grags na'ang rje tshan dgu po phal cher yum brtan yin la gdung rgyud min na rje'i so kha gtor bar mi 'gyur bas chen chun gyi sras gnyis gdung rgyud khyad med du snang la yi ge de dag kyang 'od srung la zhen pa rnams kyis bris par zad do/ /de'i tshe mu ge dang yams nad byung / chos bshig pa'i blon po rnams kyang bka' chad mi 'dra ba mang pos gum pas chos bshig pas lan par kha 'cham nas jo bo mched gnyis byams pa chos 'khor rnams khri thog du spyan drangs nas mchod pa byas/ rtags rang gis blangs nas sham thabs gong ba can gon/ skra gzhan bregs gtsug phud bzhag pa dbyar zla gsum dbyar gnas byed zer nas gtsug lag khang du bsdad nas gtan khrims lnga srung / de nas dgag dbye byed zer ste grong du khyim thab 430

byed/ ming dgra bcom gcub/ phud can zer ba mang po byung nas skye bo'i mchod gnas byed/ mi dar ma shi na 'bum/ gzhon pa la nyi khri/ byis pa la brgyad stong pa 'don/ klog mkhan shes rab che ba 'ga' zung gis ṭīka bklabardza nas dmar po 'di don bsdus pa de yin par 'dug nag po 'dis de rgyas su 'chad par 'dug yig chung 'dis de la dogs pa dpyad par 'dug zer nas rtsal bshad byed pa bag re byung / sngags pa phal cher yang sgrub thabs 'chad pa dang sgom pa med par bon po'i cho ga la mig ltos byas te sgrub/ gzhung ngag 'don du gyer nas grong chog 'grim/ sbyor dgrol dang bam sgrub dar bas mi la gson dgrol byed pa cig byung / de nas btsun mo gnyis so so'i phyogs blon 'bangs tha dad kyis bzung ste yum brtan gyis dbu ru/ 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung nas dbu g.yor 'khrug pa byas/ de'i phyogs bod yul phal cher la khyab ste yul gru re rer yang che srid chung srid mang tshan nyung tshan gser pa g.yu pa sha zan tsam zan zhes sde gnyis gnyis su chad de rtsod/ btsan po gnyis lo nyer gsum re lon pa'i sa glang nas bzung ste 'bangs kyi kheng log rnams rim par byung ste de yang bar snang gi bya gcig la kun rub pa mthong ba la dpe byas dang po dba'as kho bzher legs steng gis lag dpon byas te mdo khams su kheng log byas/ de nas dbu rur 'bro sbas 'khrugs pa la bsten nas dpa'as lo pho lo chung gis lag dpon byas te kheng log de nas g.yo rur zhang rje gsas sne btsan gyis dbon g.yu sne bsad/ ri mgul la yur ba bcos/ 'be bza' 'a mo skyid btsun mor ma gsus pas des ri mgul las mi mgul gcod pa sla zhes smras te mchims kong mi drug gis lag dpon byas/ tar ku'i me tog srod la 'char pa blta bar bsnyad nas 'od 'bar kheng ldog du grags pa byas/ de nas kong yul bres sna 'be mo'i g.yo sgyus phab bo/ /de thams cad kyang gnod sbyin bran ka 431

dpal yo na gyis byas skad de/ kheng log byed pa'i phywa mkhan mes po ni/ /bran ka dpal gyi sdon tan kho yis byas/ /mi bas sas kyang rje ru ma theg nas/ /spyir na lha 'dre pha tshan kun gyis byas/ /mna' tho 'ug pa thang du 'dun ma tshogs/ /de tshe bran ka dpal gyi yon tan kho/ /lcags kyi spyang ki sngon po bzhon nas ni/ /lcags kyi ber gas sa la brdung bzhin du/ /lha 'dre kun la zhu ba 'di skad gsol/ /rje dpon gcig kyang ma lus bsad par zhu/ /yang na so kha brgyad du gtor bar zhus/ /de tshe yar lha sham po la4sogs pas/ /dpal gyi yon tan kho la zhu ba phul/ /lha ri'i rtse ru rje dpon tshan re zhus/ /lha 'dre pha tshan 'dun ma de la 'cham/ /gtsang lha bu dar lha yis zhu ba byas/ /grom pa lha rtse btsan pa'i mkhar la bsten/ /'bro dang cog ro gnyis kyis ma phyar byas/ /gtsang stod yul du rje dpon tshan gcig chags/1 kha rag khyung btsun lha yis zhu ba byas/ /'brang mkhar bye btsan btsan pa'i mkhar la bsten/ /byang dang snang gis ma phyar byas nas ni/ /ru mtshams gzhu snyer rje dpon tshan gcig chags/3 /thang lha ya bzhur lha yis zhu ba byas/ /thā dang dom pa btsan pa'i mkhar la bsten/ /sgro dang rma yis ma phyar byas nas ni/ /'phan yul za gang rje dpon tshan gcig chags/3 /yar lha sham po lha yis zhu ba byas/ /sna mo yar rtse mar rtse gnyis la bsten/ /mchims gnyags gnyis kyis ma phyar byas nas su/ /yar lungs stod du rje dpon tshan gcig chags/4 /gtam lha spun dgu lha yis zhu ba byas/ /bya tshang gung snang btsan pa'i mkhar la bsten/ /snye ba shud pus ma phyar byas nas ni/ /gtam shul sto brag rje dpon tshan gcig chags/5 /'chos lha dkon pa lha yis zhu ba byas/ /phu gud co mkhar btsan pa'i mkhar la bsten/ khu gnyags gnyis kyis ma phyar byas nas su/ /'chos su rje dpon tshan gcig chags so skad/༄ /ces sogs nas/ de 432

ltar rje dpon rje tshan rnam pa dgu /chos 'khor rkyen du rje lhu gcig dang bcu/ /lha yis zhu ba byas nas chags pa yin/ /de nas bran ka dpal gyi yon tan gyis/ /snyi ba bsam por sprul nas rje 'bangs bsdums/ /zhes lo rgyus chen mo las snang ngo / kheng log nas lo dgu pa me bya la shud pu stag rtse sogs bzhis gros byas nas bang so rnams bgo bsha' byas phal cher brus te/ gnyags kyis don mkhar mda' yi bang so brus/ /shud pus seng ge can gyi bang so brus/ /'phrul rgyal bang so greng 'phyos khu yis brus/ /sngo bzher snyi bas thob ste 'bru 'phror lus/ /srong btsan 'bro cog gnyis kyis thob ste lus/ /ces snang ngo / /mnga' bdag 'od srung sras po dpal 'khor btsan/ /lha khang 'ga' bzhengs stag rtse gnyags kyis bkrongs/ /de sras mched gnyis stod kyi phyogs su byon/ /mnga' ris bskor gsum la sogs mnga' mdzad de/ /stod tu rgyal khrims zhwa tsam chags zhes grags/ /de yi gdung rgyud 'ga' zhig smad du chad/ /mdo smad tsong kha'i yul chen mnga' mdzad pas/ /smad du rgyal khrims lham tsam chaṭa so skad/ /bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi sil bur gyur/ /yum brtan 'od srung las gyes rje phran ni/ /yul gru rer yang mang du gnas par gyur/ /'on kyang rgyal rgyud ma nyams yin nges rnalas/ /gzugs dang blo gros gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /ya rabs spyod bzang skye bo mgu bar byed/ /de phyir dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i gnas/ /de yang khri lde yum brtan gyi sras khri lde mgon mnyen/ de'i sras khri lde rig pa mgon dang nyi ma mgon/ nyi mgon gyi sras nyi 'od dpal mgon/ de'i rgyud klung shod 'phan yul mdo stod na mang ngo //gcen rig pa mgon gyi sras lde bo rdo rje 'bar/ lde po'i sras lha bug pa can dang thang lha brag pa rnams so/ /rdo rje 'bar gyi sras khri dbang phyug btsan/de'i sras tsha la ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras khri pa yab sras 'di gnyis kyis 433

bsam yas kyi zhabs tog mdzad/ de'i dus dbus gtsang gi mi bcu khams nas byon no/ khri pa'i sras a tsa ra/ dge slong / bla ma bodha rā dzā'o/ /dang po'i rgyud phreng bo ba/ lcang rgyab pa/ blag pa lam pa/ grib pa/ snye thang pa/lum pa rtsad po sogs so/ /dge slong gi rgyud spel zhi ba/ bodhi rā dzā'i rgyud lha btsun sngon mo/ smyug rum pa/ lha 'bri sgang pa sogs te/ 'on/ rdo/ chab thang / bsam yas rtsang po sogs te mang du 'phel ba yum brtan gyi rgyud do/ /mnga' bdag gnam lde 'od srung zhes bya ba rgyal rgyud rtsod pa med pa de ni pho brang yum bu bla sgang du 'khrungs/ so dgu pa shing sprul la pho brang 'phang thang du 'das/ de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan yab kyi bcu dgu pa shing bya la 'khrungs/ lo nyer gcig la yab 'das nas rgyal sa mdzad/ sman lung la sogs pa lha khang brgyad bzhengs/ so gcig la 'das/ de'i btsun mo chen ma'i sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ chun ma'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal lo/ /'di gnyis kyi srid phal cher yum brtan gyis khyer bas stod du byon te bkra shis brtsegs ba dpal la stod du bzhugs/ nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su byon pa na/ blon po zhang ba tshab rin chen sde dang cog ro legs sgra lha legs gnyis kyis bye ma g.yung drung du bskyal nas pa tshab kyis spyang thul gyi na bza' dang cog ros dre'u gcig phul nas ngus/ rjes nga mnga' ris su rgyal srid 'dra zin srid na khyed gnyis kyi bu mo re brdzang par zhu zer nas byon/ rigs ni spyod pas ston par byed/ ces grags pa ltar spyod pa legs shing blo gros che bas mnga' ris bskor gsum gyi mi rnams mgu ste rje zhus/ spu rangs su sku mkhar nyi bzungs brtsigs/ blon po gnyis kyis bu mo re btsun mor phul/ cog ro bza' la sras stod kyi mgon gsum du grags pa las che ba dpal gyi rig pa mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyis spu rangs 434

bzung / chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / lde gtsug gi sras srong nge dang khor re gnyis/ srong nge dang por khab bzhes pa'i sras nā ga rā dzā dang de wa rā dzā gnyis yin/ phyis yab mes kyi yig tshangs gzigs pas thugs skyo nas rab byung mdzad pas lha bla ma ye shes 'od du grags/ mtho ling dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ khye 'u blo rno po nyer gcig rgya gar du brdzangs pas lo chen rin bzang dang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab gnyis log ste bstan pa la shin tu phan/ paṇḍita shī ka ra wa rma dang / dharma pā la dang / pradzñā pā la spyan drangs/ dharma pā la na stod 'dul dang / lha bla ma 'dis jo bo rje spyan 'dren pa'i phyir sku lus gar log gi rgyal po la btang nas 'das/ gcung khor res kyang kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha ldes paṇḍita su bha ṣi ta spyan drangs/ de'i sras 'od lde dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od/ btsun pa byang chub 'od gsum las/ lha byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rje spyan drangs/ blon po sa 'og gi gter mthong ba'i mig can zhig kyang yod de des jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i yo byad gser ling ba gcig la shing srang bcu drug yod pa cig la sogs pa zad med du phyung / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa gsos te shin tu rgyas par mdzad do/ /'od ldes kha che dzñā na shrī spyan drangs/ de'i sras rtse ldes paṇḍita zhi ba bzang po sogs spyan drangs/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan rgya gar du brdzangs te bstan par shin tu rgyas so/ /rtse lde'i sras 'bar lde/ de nas rim bzhin bkra shis lde/ lha lde/ na ga de wa rnams nas mnga' ris kyi btsan po phal cher byung / na ga de wa'i sras btsan phyug ldes ya tse'i mnga' bdag mdzad de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i sras grags btsan lde/ de'i sras grags pa ldes gser bre bdun bcu la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dang dngul bre stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis byams pa sogs gser dngul gar blugs dang ljang brdungs kyi lha chen dang 435

mchod rten du cha/ bzhengs/ de'i sras a sog ldes rgya gar rdo rje gdan du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis phul ba'i grong bzhi bcu zhe gnyis sog po la nyos nas phul/ de'i sras 'dzi thar smal dang a nan smal gnyis kyi phu bos dngul gyi dgyes rdor bzhengs/ nu bos rdo rje gdan bsos/ 'di yan 'bri khung pa'i sbyin bdag yin/ a nan skal gyi sras re'u smal gyis rgya gar gyi rgyal khams mang po'i bdag byas/ dngul las bde gshegs brgyad bzhengs/ lha sar gtsang khang dbus ma'i gser thog phul/ de'i sras sam bha smal yin/ 'ji thar skal kyi bu a 'dzid smal gyis sa skyar lha btsun byas/ phyis rgyal sa byas shing gdung rabs gnyis nas ya tse'i rgyal rgyud chad/ spu rangs nas bsod nams lde spyan drangs pu ṇa skal du grags/ de'i bu pri ti smal dang blon po dpal ldan grags pas sa skya'i chos khri dang / lha sar bcu gcig zhal la gser thog phul lo/ /'di rnams bu ston chos byung dang yar lungs jo bo'i chos byung ltar bris kyi/gzhan las lde gtsug mgon gyis mang yul bzung zhes sogs dang / bkra shis mgon gyi sras khor re dang srong nge zhes sogs snang ngo / /dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la sras dpal lde dang / 'od lde/ skyid lde ste smad kyi lde gsum du grags/ dpal lde'i rgyud sngon po tshon por thug ste khab gung thang pa/ klu rgyal pa/ spyi pa lha rtse ba/ glang lung rtsad skor ba sogs yin no/ /gcung skyid lde 'jad rta nag du phog sras drug las lnga byang du gshegs te g.yas ru dang ru lag gi btsan po rnams yin/ 'bring po 'od lde la sras bzhi las pha ba de ses rgyud gtsang rong snubs yul dang nyang stod sogs na yod/ gnyis pa khri lde mdo khams su byon te tsong kha yul chen bco brgyad la sogs mdo smad phal cher la mnga' mdzad pas smad du rgyal /brims lham tsam chags zhes grags shing spyan snga don chen la sogs pa'i rgyal rgyud byung /436

gsum pa nyag lde'i rgyud ga yas ru'i skyi mkhar btsan po la thug bzhi pa khri chung gis yar lungs su byon/ 'bangs kyis pho brang brtsigs nas phul ba'i 'bangs brtsigs dang sku mkhar mching nga stag rtse bzung / de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/de la sras bdun gyi gcen zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar/ gcung gtsang tsha spun drug ces pa lha spyan g.yu spyan gnyis/ da ra lhun po gnyis/ 'od btsan gung btsan gnyis te drug go gcen la sras drug gi g.yu thog gi rgyud sna mo ba/ mching nga ba/don mkhar ba/ thang khor ba rnams so/ /bye chung lha sgom/ gung lde/ khri thog thag gsum gdung chad/ zla ba'i rgyud rta shags pa dang pra sna ba'o/ /bzhengs can 'bar gyi rgyud mon mkhar ba/ zhang mda' ba/ spun bdun thang pa/ lha ston dkar mo'i rgyud byi chung ba'o/ /gtsang tsha drug gi phyi ma bzhi las khra 'brug bying byar gyi btsan po rnams 'phel lo/ /btsan po g.yu can gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis bya sar spyan drangs/ de'i sras jo dga'/ de'i sras gsum gyi che ba bya sa lha chen gyis bya sa'i lha khang so ma bzhengs/ rgya ma'i dbon ston gyis rab gnas mdzad/ dpal phag mo gru pa bla mar bsten/ gcung po'ang rab tu byung ste lha zhi bar grags te lo mo sgom khang du bzhugs/ bar pa khri dar ma gtsug lde/ khri gtsug lde/ rnal 'byor/ smon lam ste sras bzhi las khri gtsug gis bya sa dang do sngon sogs bzung ste yar mda'i btsan po rnams byung /smon lam rab tu byung ste pu gu do'i gzims khang dkar po brtsigs te chos khrims dang bstan pa'i bya ba du ma mdzad/ jo bo rnal 'byor gyis 'bangs brtsigs su rgyal sa bskyangs te mched 'di rnams kyis rje spyan snga dang rgyal ba thog brdugs pa'i sbyin bdag byas/ rnal 'byor gyi sras gsum las bar pa rab tu byung nas lcil bu'i gdan sa mdzad de lha chen po'am lha lung gi daḍā 5 ṇang phyug tu grags/ gcung po 'bri khung gcung rin po che las lha btsun 3/dza da de lha 437

ngam shod par grags/ gcen jo 'bag gis rgyal sa mdzad pa'i sras lnga las gnyis pa rab tu byung ste lha 'gro mgon du grags te lcil bu'i gdan sa mdzad de ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa mnga'/ gsum pa lde bos 'bangs brtsigs bzung ste de'i sras shākya rgyal gyis g.ye che chung la dbang mdzad/ de'i sras shākya dpal gyi blo gros bzang po bla ma 'phags pa las rab tu byung ste nye gnas mdzad/ bzhi pa lde chung gzhon nur gshegs/ lnga pa jo rgyal bu lur phog de'i sras jo 'phel/ de'i sras chab lha zur khang pa ste lcil bu bzung / gcung po'i rgyud khrom po ba rnams yin/ jo 'bag gi sras che ba shākya mgon gcung rnams so sor phog pho brang gnas chung btab/ sa skya paṇḍita'i sbyin bdag byas/ de sras shākya bkra shis kyi pho brang rnying ma btab/ de'i sras che ba lcil bu'i lha brag kha ba yin/ chung ba grogs pa rin chen gyis rgyal ba thog brdugs pa'i nye gnas mdzad/ phyis bla ma 'phags pa'i nye gnas mdzad/ se chen gyi dam kha blangs te pho brang brag kha sogs btab/ sku gsung thugs rten 'ga' bzhengs/ jo ston tshogs pa'i chos bzhi gtan du 'degs pa'i srol mdzad/ dgung lo nga gsum pa la sras shākya mgon po la rgyal sa gtad nas thugs dam mdzad de bdun bcu rtsa bzhi la gshegs/ de'i sras bzhi'i che ba lcil ba blo gros 'od yin/ gsam pa sku shu ri shā phag mo grur rab tu byung ste lha btsun tshul khrims bzang por thogs/ bzhi pa 'bal gzhon nur 'das/ gnyis pa shākya mgon pos rang gi srid bskyangs te yar lungs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan bsten/ pho brang yum bu bla sgang la gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ chos 'khor du ma'i sbyin bdag mdzad nas bstan pa la phan par mdzad do/ /phyi ma 'di rnams yar lungs jo bos bsgrigs pa'i chos byung las bsdus pa ste 'di phyin yang dpyod ldan rnams kyis stod smad bar gsum gyi rgyal brgyud las bstan pa la bya ba byas pa dang phan bde'i srol gtod 438 4

pa mthong na rang rang gi phyogs bzung ba ma yin par gzu bor gnas pa'i blos 'di skabs su bsnan par byos cig /de ltar rgyal brgyud sil chad 'di rnams rje'i sku lha so so'i bsten yul du bgos pas rje chen rnam pa dgu/ chos 'khor bsam yas kyi rkyen du rje lhu gcig dang bcu zhes grags pa yin la rgyal brgyud ma nyams pa yin phyin yon tan du mas khyad par du 'phags la/ jo bo bod du phebs dus kyang bod kyi rā dzā bo dhi sa tā'i brgyud pa gsung nas btsan po thams cad la ldang ba dang bkur sti cher mdzad pas 'bangs rnams jo bo lta bu 'di ltar mdzad na rang cag 'bangs rnams bkur sti cis mi byed zer nas gus par gyur zhes bshad pa ltar chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi yon tan dang sku drin la bsams nas mnga' thang yod dam med kyang rung ste bkur sti dang sri zhu cher bya ba'i gnas yin no/ /rigs kyi nang na dam pa rmad du byung ba/ /'khor los bsgyur dang sangs rgyas byung ba'i rigs/ /gdung gi dam pa rga tam shākya'i brgyud/ /babs pa'i khungs bzang 'od gsal lha las babs/ /longs spyod rmad byung nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang / /blo gros yangs pas ji lta ji snyed mkhyen/ /thugs rje kho nas sprul pa'i skur bstan pa/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal las ches lhag par/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal gdung rabs bzhi bcur byon/ /bod yul skye 'gro byung dang 'byung 'gyur kun/ /nyes skyon kun bsal gnas skabs mthar thug gi /yon tan bde legs kun la bkod pa yi/ /bka' drin de lta gzhal gyis ga la 'khor/ /lha 'am drang srong pha ma mdza' bshes sogs/ /'di lta'i sman yon sbyin mdzad su zhig yod/ /brgya byin gyis kyang mi bsgrun dbang phyug de/ /deng sang dus na ming gi lhag ma tsam/ /chos rgyal de dag rnams kyi rigs sras phal/ /phyi dus 'di na 'bangs dang yang 'bangs spyod/ kheng dang yang kheng mang po dregs pas 'gying / /439

rang rang rigs rus che ba smra bzhin du/ /kun gyis rtsod med rigs mchog smad pa mtshar/ /kye ma srid pa 'di yi ngang tshul stos/ /grogs dag kun la snying po ci 'dug soms/ /skyes pa'i mtha' 'chi 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral/ /bsags pa'i mtha' mdzad mthon po'i mtha' lhung zhes/ /mngon sum nyid du bstan par mi gda' 'am/ /'khor los bsgyur lta'i dpal 'byor de dag rnams/ /sbrang tshang zhig shul ltar gyur 'di mthong nas/ /gnag rdzi tsam gyi longs spyod kyis 'tsho ba/ rang rang dbang phyug 'di la su zhig chags/ /dzasbu gling bdag po rnams kyi mnga' thang yang / /mi rtag snying pos dben pa 'di 'dra na/ /dus ngan da lta'i skye bo 'ga' yi dbus/ /tshangs ltar bsnyems pa ngo tsha'i gnas min nam/ /lha dang mtshungs pa'i longs spyod de rnams kun/ /ston ga'i sprin bzhin yal ba 'di mthong bzhin/ /da lta'i zing zing ngan don kham 'ga'i phyir/ /'di phyi kun 'dor 'di rnams ci zhig dran/ /srid pa 'di yis rang gi ngang tshul rnams/ /rab tu gsal bar rtag tu bstan na yang / /da dung tshe 'di'i rnyed grags lhur len ba'i/ /sde snod 'dzin par khas 'che 'di 'dra ci/ /'dod pa'i rnam rtog cung zad kha ma bri/ /rnyed bkur sgrub phyir mi byed ci yang med/ /de dag sprul pa'i lus can yin par rlom/ /sa steng 'di 'dras gang bas rab tu skyo/ /rang sems gdul phyir dam pa'i chos gsungs mod/ /deng dus chos la bsten nas dregs cing khengs/ khyim pa kun las lhag par chags sdang 'phel/ /kye ma 'di lta'i gnas skabs sngon byung ngam/ /rgyal po glang gis rab byung phab pa sogs/ /bstan la gnod par kun gyis shes mod kyang / /phyi dus mdza' ba ltar bcos rab byung kun/ /thabs brgyas 'bebs 'di de 'drar go ba med/ /rab byung ma lus rtag du dmag la 'ded/ /rtog chen rdzong bslu dug ster sogs kyi glar/ /sdig can rnams las dge 'dun gnas brtan 440

bsko/ khyim pas chos pa kun gyi phyag mchod len/ /mkhas par khas len blun po kha brdar kun/ /ja chang gral gyi bzhad gad mkhan por 'bebs/ /gsang sngags tshig re 'dzin pa yan chad kyang / /ngan sngags mthu gtad ser gsum byed la 'god/ /'di 'dra'i ngang tshul gzhan yang bgrang mi lang / /rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa des/ /bye ba'i cha yang 'di dag la mi phod/ /de tshe bstan pa med par go ba yis/ /slar yang bstan pa'i me ro bslang du byung / /deng sang bstan min 'di 'drar bstan zhes grags/ /'di 'drar 'god la bstan pa 'dzin po dang / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag ces byar sgrog pa'i phyir/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug byon na yang / /da ni bstan pa dngos cig ji ltar gzugs/ /rgyal po glang gi dgongs pa da rdzogs sam/ /kye ma dpyod ldan yod na dus 'dir dpyod/ /sems yod mchis na sangs rgyas bstan la soms/ /mkhas pa yod na dam chos gang yin stos/ /zhig po yod na 'khrul pa'i rjes ma 'brang / /dad ldan yod na zog pos bslus dogs gyis/ /shes rab can 'ga' yod na rgyal bstan dngos/ /gang yin gzu por stos la gtsug du long / /thub bstan 'di ltar gyur pa'i dus skyes phyir/ /bdag cag skal dman phyogs gcig 'dus par go /dam pa'i don du dus la bzang ngan med/ /rang rtog phyi rol yul du 'khrul pa skyes/ /de la nyid 'khrul bzang ngan zhen pas bcings/ /sgyu ma'i dmag dpung bden par zhen ltar zad/ /mnga' thang longs spyod rmi lam nor brnyed 'dra/ /rigs rus mchog dman zhen pas btags pa tsam/ /'di dag thams cad snying pos dben no zhes/ /sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po de rnams kyis/ /dam chos rnam thar tshul du bstan pa nyid/ /'dod pa'i 'dam na padma ltar ma gos/ /bdag gzhan ma dmigs 'gro ba sgrol la brtson/ /sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po de rnams kyi/ /bka' drin dran pas slar 441

yang phyag bgyid do/ /phyi dus 'dir dmag mi nam dgos 'byung ba kho na la dmigs nas chos sder ming btagal pa re 'debs/ de dag gi bla ma'i gnas rnams kyang rgyal po dang blon po dag rngan pas mgu bar byas pa'am/ g.yul gyi tshe bya ma rta dang nyan sna pa dang rtog chen du phyin pa'am/ gzhan gyi rdzong slu dug ster sogs byas pa'am/ tha na'ang kha gsag gis mgu ba tsam gyi skye bo zhig bsko/ skra bregs ming brjes re ma gtogs sdom pa 'bogs pa'i srol med/slob dpon dang rgan par byas pa rnams kyis chags sdang dang chos min gyi mig stos 'ga' zhig bslabs/ sngar khyim pa'i dus las brgya stong gis sems ma rungs shing rtsub pa/ 'khor ba'i skyon rnams mthong yang skyo ba cung zad med/sangs rgyas yon tan thos kyang dad pa cung zad med/ khrel med ngo tsha med cing snying rje cung zad med/ sdig pa lhag par spyod la 'gyod pa cung zad med/med drug 'dzom la sangs rgyas skal ba med/ /ces 'phags pa thogs med kyi rigs chad kyi mtshan nyid du gsungs pa de thams cad tshang ba brgya stong sogs 'dus shing thos pa sna re byas kyang shes tshad nga rgyal dang chags sdang gi rgyur song / sngags kyi nus pa phra mo re brnyed na byis pas btsan dug zos pa ltar slar la sdug bsngal mtha' med kyi rgyu byed/ chos kyi bsam pa skad cig yang mi skye ba sha stag 'dus pa la dge 'dun gyi sder grags nas nyam chung thams cad la brnyas shing 'joms/ dmag gi g.yul du 'jug pa la tsham tshom cung zad kyang med pa 'di rnams dang / rje dpon rnams kyis kyang rab byung thams cad tshe 'dir khral dmag 'u lag thams cad la sbyar nas chos dang phral te phyi mar ngan 'gro la 'god pa'i gnod pa dgra bo 'bum phrag gis kyang mi nus pa 'di lta bu byas te 'di phyi gnyis ku'i bde pa dang phral ba la gnod par go ba yang su yang med kyi/ steng du rje dpon 'di nged kyi sbyin bdag go zhes de'i ched du srog 442

dang tsham tshom med par 'dor ba 'di lta bus bod yul thams cad gang zhing de dag 'a/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan par grags pa 'di lta bu ni sngon rgyal po glang gis bstan pa bsnubs pas 'bum gyi cha yang do bar mi snang ste sman ma rnyed pa tsam ni sla'i sman gyi dod por dug ha la ha la chen po byin pa ni de lta ma yin pa bzhin no/ /rgyal sras rin po ches phag gru'i khri dpon chen po byang rgyal la bandhe rnams la khral dmag 'u lag 'gel ba mi 'thad gsungs pas khong na re chos tshul bzhin byed pa rnams la ni zhabs tog byed cing yod/ gzhan phur 'brog 'dzin mdar zhing 'debs nyo tshong dang khyim thab byed pa 'di rnams la khral dmag 'u lag mi 'gel na gzhan su la 'gel du btub par gda' zer bas 'o skol gyis lan ma thebs zer ba bris 'dug yang de'i lan sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las ston pa nyid kyis btab zin pa yin te mdo der tshangs pa lha'i snying pos zhus pa'i lan du bka' bstsal pa/ rgyal po dang blon po sogs kyis rab tu byung ba tshul khrims sna gcig med pa la yang chad pas gcod du mi gnang ste glang chen dang gla ba'i ro dang tsam pa ka brnyings pa dang spos tshig pa rnams dngos po nyams kyang gi waX dang gla rtsi dang dri bsung yod pas gzhan las lhag par ltar rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam mthong bas kyang sangs rgyas dran zhing mu stegs la mi bsten pa dang tshul khrims dran nas sdig pa spong pa dang / sbyin pa dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab dang rab tu 'byung ba rnams dran nas de la sbyor zhing dge ba bskyed pa'i phyir ro zhes rgyas par gsungs cing / tsam pa ka yi me tog brnyings gyur kyang / /me tog gzhan pa rnam pas shin tu lhag /dge slong tshul khrims nyams shing sdig spyod kyang / /mu stegs can dag thams cad kun pas mchog /zhes sogs dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid sngon slob ba'i tshe glang po che'i rgyal po mche ba drug par skyes pa na 44 3

lus 'phags kyi rgyal po'i bu mos de'i mche ba don du gnyer nas rgyal pos rngon pa cig btang ste des glang po che de rang sangs rgyas rnams la bag 'bebs pa mthong nas ngur smrig bsgos mda' gzhu sbas te glang po che de mi dogs par bag phab pa'i gnad tu bsnun pa na glang mo bzang mo sogs glang chen gyi khyu thams cad khros pa las mi de glang po'i rgyal pos rang gi brang 'og tu sbas nas bskyabs/khyu rnams dong ba'i 'og du rgyu mtshan dris pas mche ba'i phyir te ma rnyed na rngon pa thams cad rgyal pos gsod do zhes smras pas de rnams bskyab pa'i phyir dang ngur smrig 'di ni 'phags pa thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan no zhes ngur smrig gi gos la gus pa lhur byas te ma4che ba drug rang gis phyung nas sna zhags kyis bzung ste byin pa dang / yul pañtsa lar rgyal po dgra las rgyal bya ba'i chad pa gcod pa'i mi thams cad dur khrod chen po kha lam pa ces pa 'jigs su rung bar skyel zhing srin mos za ba las nam zhig mi zhig la nyes pa byung nas chad pas 'jigs te skra dang kha spu bregs nas chos gos kyi chal bu zhig rnyed pa mgul du btags pa las gshed mas dur khrod du shing la bcings te bzhag pas srin mo mtshon cha'i mig bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa lhags te srin mos phyag dang bskor ba byas te/ skyes bu khyod ni ma bsnyengs bde bar bzhugs/ /khyod la bdag cag gnod pa mi bgyid do/ /skra bregs chos gos gyon pa khyod mthong nas/ /bdag cag sangs rgyas rjes su dran par gyur/ /zhes bstod pa byas/ srin mos bu rnams kyis mi 'di bdag cag bzar stsol zhig zhes smras pas mo na re/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /rnam par grol ba'i rgyal mtshan gos gyon pa/ /'di la mi dge sdig pa'i sems bskyed na/ /nges par mtshams med sems can dmyal bar lhung / /zhes sogs smras te zlog de bzhin du srin mo bong bu'i so dang khro gnyer dpral skra can dang mtshon cha'i gdong rnams re re bzhin 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa re 444

lhags te snga ma bzhin gnod pa spangs te phyag bskor dang ngur smrig la bstod pa byas/ tha ma des bcings pa las bkrol te btang bas rgyal po des thams cad du rtags can la bkur sti byed pa'i dril bsgrags pa'i sngon byung dang / ma 'ongs pa rgyal po gdol pa dang bram ze gdol pa dang blon po gdol pa sogs kyis dge 'dun gyi 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog rab tu byung ba la chad pas gcod pa sogs byed pa de rnams lhas mi srung zhing yan lag chad pa dang lce skugs pas shi ste mnar med par lhung bar gsungs shing rdo rje snying pos de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa na lan du/ rab tu byung ba la la ni lhag pa'i spyod pa nyams la mos pa ma nyams pa yod/ la la ni mos pa nyams la lhag pa'i spyad pa ma nyams pa yod/ gnyis ka nyams pa dang gnyis ka ma nyams pa yang yod/ tshul khrims nyams la lta ba ma nyams pa dang lta ba nyams la tshul khrims ma nyams pa dang gnyis ka nyams pa dang gnyis ka ma nyams pa dang / de thams cad ma nyams shing sdig grogs kyi dbang du gyur pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bstan yang lug ltar skugs pa yang yod la de dag la thabs de dang des gdul ba yin par rgyas par gsungs cing mdo gzhan las kyang seng ge'i rgyal po yi dam brtan pas rngon pa'i ngur smrig la gus pa bskyed de yig 'bru brgyad smras te pags pa btang ba dang /nga'i bstan pa la ngur smrig tsam gyon te bu dang bu mo'i lag pa nas bzung te chang skyogs gang gi phyir chang ma'i khyim nas chang ma'i khyim du 'phyan par byed pa de rnams kyang bskal pa bzang po 'di la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' 'o zhes gsungs shing ston pa nyid kyang lhas sprul ba'i rab byung gzigs pas rkyen byas te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gshegs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rtags can gyis nyes pa cher byas kyang chad pa gcod du yang ma gnang na dpya khral dang dmag dang bran du bskul ba ni ga la rung ste rab byung la 'di ltar byed /45

pa rnams ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la brnyas pa mi bzad pa yin no/ /gal ste rgyal po la sogs pa de dag rang nyid kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa cig yin na ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa//phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod/ /dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa/ /gnyis par thub pas gsungs pa yin/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dge slong la'ang / /ngur smrig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang / /btson rar 'jug par byed pa dang / /rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang / /srog bral byed pa gsum pa 'o/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang / /log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang / /grong la sogs pa 'joms pa dag /sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu/ / zhes bslab btus las rgyal po dang blon po'i rten can gyi byang sems la rtsa lhung du bshad pa de rnams phal cher cig car du 'byung ba yin la ngur smrig gi tshal bu 'dzin pa la'ang ston pa'i 'du shes skyed ces pa'i skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang yang 'gal ba yin no//phu 'brog mda' zhing sogs 'dzin pa yang thun mong gi 'dul ba las gang zag la de lta bu ma gnang yang dge 'dun la gnang zhing / theg chen gyi byang chub sems dpa' dge slong gi rten can la gzhan don du gnang ba yang yod pas bsam pa kun slong gtso yi yo byad bsnyungs pa tsam gtso ba yang ma yin no/ /de ltar chad pas bcad du ma gnang yang tshul khrims dang mi ldan pa de rnams dge 'dun gyi nang du bzhag par bya ba ni ma yin te lnga phrugs dang ldan pa'i dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi nang du gnang ba dris te byin na nyes pa gleng zhing gnas nas 'byin par bya la de rgyal po sogs la brten bas 'byin ma nus na dge 'dun rnams gnas gzhan du 'gro bar gsungs shing / des na so skye 'ching ba kun ldan rgyal po dang blon po dang dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan sogs bla ma'i gnas dang zhal ta pa bcu gnyis dang khyad par deng sang chos khrims par 446

grags pa'i mdzes chos pa rnams byed pa ni dkon mchog gi dkor len pa dang /chos spong dang / gang zag dam pa la brnyas pa sogs nyes pa du ma'i 'byung gnas su mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' mang pos bdag bzod pa ma thob kyi bar du nam yang rgyal por ma gyur cig blon por ma gyur cig sogs nas dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan sogs su ma gyur cig ces smon lam btab par sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa nyid las rgyas par bshad do/ /bod kyi rgyal khrims sil bur gyur pa'i 'og /mkhas grub skyes chen dpag med byon gyur te/ /bstan pa'i srog shing ra sa bsam yas sogs/ /nyams pa bsos shing bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ /de yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi rnam gzhag gzhan du 'chad la skyes bu dam pa phyis byon pas ra sa bsam yas la bya ba byas tshul ni/ kheng log gi 'og tu ra sa gnyis zhabs tog med par sprang tshang bcas te lha khang thams cad du thab bcas pas du bas mog por byas pa ring zhig byung / de'i tshe zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab dang mdol chung bskor dpon gyis sprang khang zur du brtsigs/ dmag sbas/ phyogs gcig tu 'gyed ston btang ba la sprang po rnams 'dus pa'i shul phrogs te sprang tshang bton/ gtsang khang dbus ma'i rten rnams sku chungs pas mi mdzes par mthong nas steng khang du gdan drangs pas mi 'khrugs pa'i skus kho bo gzhan du mi 'gro gsungs pas jo bo mi 'gro gsung 'byon du grags/ slar thub pa gangs chen mtsho rgyal sems dpa' sems ma sgo srung dang bcas pa bzhengs/ zhig gso dang zhabs tog cher mdzad/ phyis mdol chung bskor dpon gyis lus snum ras kyis bcings pa la spyi bo nas rim pas mar mer spar te jo bo'i drung du phul nas 'greng bzhin du bzang spyod smon lam gnyis bton nas gsum pa'i/ mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i skabs su nyams 'ur nas bkrabs te skad cig de la 447

spyi bo nas thod pa gog pa'i shul nas 'od chen po zhig nam mkhar song / de ma thag sa g.yos me tog gi char chen po bab skad/ ra sar klu mes rba rag 'bring tsho ste smad 'dul gyi sde bzhi chags nas bshad nyan dar/ phyis rba 'bring gi sde 'khrug byung bas gtsug lag khang thams cad dmag gis zhig nyam mas pa'i tshe chos rgyal gyi lung bstan ltar rje sgom pa tshul khrims snying po ma mgon dang rdzong btsan gyis spyan drangs te byon nas sde 'khrug bsdums pas shin tu dka' nas 'byon par brtsams pa'i tshe jo bo las spyan chab byung / 'khrug pa 'di khyod kyis mi bsdum nas sus bsdum zhes gsung ba sku 'khor thams cad kyis thos/yang shin tu dka' ba na bla ma lha rje nyid byon nas sgom tshul khyod kyis nga 'jog phod dam gsung ste jo bo dang rje sgam po pa tha mi dad par 'dug gsung ste de ma thag 'khrug pa dum/ slar khyams khru bar bskor sogs kyi thog rtsig pa ri mo sogs thams cad gzhi nas bcos/ jo bo gtsang khang lho mar bzhugs pa dbus mar spyan drangs te sngon zhal bsgyur bar lung bstan pa de yin/ mchod pa dpag med mdzad/ bstan pa bzhi bzhengs su btang / snying rje pad dkar gyi mdor/dge slong 'tsho byed des nga'i mchod rten gser gyis brgyan pa sogs lo lnga pa byed tu 'jug par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa de rje sgom tshul lo lnga lon pa zhig rje sgom po ba'i zhabs phyir byon pa de la dgongs pa yin zhes dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos gsungs/ de nas ra sa'i gtsug lag khang gnyis slob ma dam pa zhang rin po che la gtad/ de'i nye gnas tshal dpon dar ma gzhon nu la sogs pa rim par byung ba rnams dang phyis blon po mgar gyi mi brgyud tshal dpon sangs rgyas dngos grub phyin mi brgyud la 'jags pa rnams kyis chos rgyal yab yum gyi sku bzheng pa dang sgo khang phyi ma sgo srung ma mgon seng ldeng gi sgo glegs dang bcas pa phul/ chu rags chen mo sogs zhabs tog dpag med byas/ gzhan 448 ོ

yaje lha rje dge ba 'bum dang de'i lcam mo ye shes mchog dang zhig po bdud rtsi la sogs pa mang pos chu rags dang zhabs tog mdzad/ ya tse'i rgyal po re 'u skal gyis mkhas shing yon tan dang ldan pa'i ston pa rin rdor dang mdzod pa ar dzu la sogs pa mngags te zangs khal bco brgyad la dos rer byas pa'i zangs dos brgya dang bzhi gser srang lnga brgya rnams las lcags pho khyi lo la jo bo'i dbu thog du gser thog phub/ lhag ma la gser thog chung ngu zhig bcu gcig zhal gyi dbu thog du phub pa phyis ya tse'i rgyal po pu ṇa smal gyis gser thog che bar bkyed/ de phyin yang 'gro mgon dung mtsho ras pa/ grub thob mgon ye shes/ snel pa yon mchod la sogs pa mang pos rnying gso gsar bzheng du ma byas/ rje garla pa rol pa'i rdo rje dang rje de bzhin gshegs pas mchod pa'i khyad par mang po dang jo bo'i sku la mu tig gi snam sbyar rin thang med pa gsol bar mdzad do/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang la phyis sa skye dpal ldan bla ma dam pa kho na bka' drin che ste zhig gso dang zhabs tog mtha' yas par mdzad do/ /sngon chos rgyal srong btsan nyid kyis thugs dam rnams la mdo skor dang sgrub skor dang zhal gdams kyi skor gsum du phye zhing mdo skor gyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig po dbon sras la dar du bcug mdzad pa lo rgyus kyi skor du ma dang skyes rabs kyi tshogs dang / sgrub skor che phra bcu gsum/zhal gdams kyi skor las bka' chos thog tha bar gsum gyi shog dril bsdoms pas zhal gdams che tsho'am rgya che ba gzhan don du gdams pa'i chos skor brgyad bcu rtsa lnga/ zhal gdams chung tsho'am zab pa rang don du gdams pa'i chos skor bdun bcu don bzhi rnams sprul pa'i rgyal pos gsungs/ thon mis yi ger bris dbu rtse byang gi rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og dang gdung khol dang gnod sbyin khang pa rnams su sbas/ phyis slob dpon padmas gter kha phye ste chos rgyal khri 449

srong la bstan nas slar rgyas btab/ phyis grub thob dngos grub kyis bton nas chos rgyal khri srong gi sprul pa myang nyi ma 'od zer la gnang / thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal po'i mngon rtogs dang gab pa mngon du phyung la sogs logs su bka' rgya btab pa lnga po gnod sbyin na ga ku be ra'i brla g.yas pa'i dar sham 'og du sbas pa gter bton shākya bzang pos phyung ste lha rje dge 'bum la gnang /de rnams nas rim par las can mang po la 'phel zhing rgyas te smin grol gyi gzhir byas so/ /de ltar bod yul skye 'gro snod ldan rnams/ /dngos dang brgyud nas byang chub la bkod de/ /'di nas ma 'ongs ring zhig 'das pa na/ /'gro ba'i rtag par 'dzin blo zlog pa dang / /rnam dag rdzogs pa'i rim pa ston pa'i ched/ /mchog sprul mya ngan 'da' ston ji bzhin du/ /ra sa 'phrul snang sprul pa'i pho brang gi /sgod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa yang / /rnam 'phrul chos dbyings zhi ba'i dbyings su sdud/ /de tshe rab kyis mkha' 'gros spyan drangs te/ /'og min stug po'i dbyings su gshegs par mthong / /thun mong mthong snang 'ja' 'od gur gyis dkrigs/ /lha klu kun gyis mchod pa byed bzhin du/ /chu bo'i gzhung las rgya mtshor gshegs par snang / /sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel bar mdzad/ /bsam yas pho brang chen po'i sprul pa yang ye shes me yis bsregs pa'i tshul gyis sdud/ /de bas gtsug lag khang chen 'di rnams la/ /me chu'i gnod pa bskyab phyir sus brtson pa/ /de yi bsod nams nam mkha'i khams las brgal/ /rdo rje'i gdan mchog 'byung bas mi shigs kyang / /byis pa'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug spyod ston pa/ /bdag cag bod 'bangs sdig sbyong dge skyed pa'i/ /thabs kyi mdzad pa thugs rjes bstan pa nyid/ /de yang ra sa 'phrul snang dang bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di gnyis ni bde ba can gyi zhing khams ltar sprul pa'i rten 450

brten pa dngos yin pas mthar yang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mya ngan las 'da' ba ston pa ltar sprul sku sdud pa'i snang ba ston pa ste slob dpode chen po padmas lung bstan pa kho thing gi gter ma las/ slob dpon gyis/ gtsug lag khang rnams bzheng ba'i tshe/ /sems can bsod nams yar ldan yin/ /gtsug lag khang rnams bskor ba'i tshe/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams 'bring po yin/ /gtsug lag khang rnams 'jig pa'i tshe/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams mar 'grib yin/ /khyed kyi gdung rabs gsum pa nas/ /rgyal sa stongs shing rgyal khrims 'jig /bod 'bangs 'khrugs pas lha srin ga yo/ /lha srin g.yos pas 'byung ba 'khrugs/ /nam zhig dus kyi tha ma la/ /lha sa chu yis 'jig byed cing / /bsam yas me yis 'jig par byed/ /lar na sems can bsod nams yin/ /thabs kyis cung zad sring thabs yod/ /ces gsungs pa la/ rgyal pos/ spyir ni mchod rten bsam yas dang / /lha sa bod kyi srog shing yin/ /'di la zhig thabs ga la yod/ /kye hud bod 'bangs snying re rje/ /thos pas chog pa'i gtsug khang yin/ /dran pas chog pa'i gtsug khang yin/ /'di la zhig thabs ga la yod/ /kye hud bod 'bangs nyon re mongs/ /mkha' la nyi zla lta bu yin/ /'di zhig mun pa gang gis sel/ /gshed ma gri thogs lta bu'i dgra /me chu gnyis las skyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsol bas slob dpon gyis bka' bstsal pa/ /kwa ye chos rgyal ma bshum zhig /'khor ba sgyu mar mkhyen par mdzod/ /rkyen ngan las su mkhyen par mdzod/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rtag pa ma yin thugs khrul skyungs/ /chad pa ma yin thugs ma mug /dag snang can gyi gang zag la/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa med/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams stongs pa med/ /sems can 'khor bar 'khyams pa med/ /'khor ba bden par gnas pa med/ /'byung bzhi rtsub 'gyur snang ba med/ /bsam yas lha sa 'jig mi mnga'/ /sgrib g.yogs 451

'khrul pa'i sems can rnams/ /bsam yas lha sa'i rtsar skyes kyang / /de yi gtsug khang mthong ba med/ /'gro ba tshogs bsag sgrib sbyong phyir/ /me chu gnyis ni brtson 'grus lha/ /thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin yin/ /'di dag dgra min log lta spongs/ /chos rgyal chen po thugs dgongs glod/ /thabs kyi rgyal po nga yis bstan/ /gsungs nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya mdzad pas klu rgyal 'jog po byung ste rin po che chu shel phul ba bsam yas kyi srog shing du bcug nas 'di dang ma bral gyi bar du gtsug lag khang mes mi 'tshig par 'ong / nam zhig 'byung ba brnyigs nas gtsug lag khang nyams 'ong pas de'i dus gso ba la brtson 'grus gyis shig de'i tshe 'khor zhing zhabs tog byed pa dang mchod cing bskor ba dang tha na ser ka la 'dam phra tsam zhig sbyar nas gso ba thams cad kyang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad la bsti bstang byas pa yin/ chos thams cad bsgrubs pa yin/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la bkur sti byas pa yin/gtsug lag khang gsar du brtsigs pa'i bsod nams 'thob pa yin no/ /de tshe 'phos nas bde ba can du padma'i sdong po las skye bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te gtsug lag khang gso ba'i dkor nor du ma yang gter du sbas so/ /yang bka' bstsal pa/ sngon gyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni thugs rje chen po dngos yin mngon par mkhyen pa dang ldan pas lha sa'i gtsug lag khang 'di gtsang po'i 'gram du bzhengs pa yin no/ /gtsang po 'di gtsug lag khang gi rtsar 'ong pa yin la phyi ma'i dus kyi mi rnams de'i ched du chu rags byed do/ /des ni 'gro ba rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong zhing byang chub kyi sa bon 'debs te de'i ched tu thugs rje chen po'i sprul pas gtsang po 'di slar nye bar ston to/ /de'i tshe 'gro ba gang chu la rags byed cing gtsug lag khang skyob pa'i phyir lus 'khol ba rnams ni sprul pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /ngag gis kha /bkod byed pa rnams 452

ni gsung longs sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis sems khral byed cing gtsub/ lag khang skyob par sems pa rnams ni thugs chos sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe lus ngag yid gsum gas 'bad de chu rags dang bskor mchod dang yi rang skyes pa de thams cad sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa byang / theg pa chen po 'thob pa la the tshom med do zhes gsungs te phan yon 'di rnams ni chos rgyal nyid kyi bka' chems las byung ba dang yang tha dad mi snang ngo / /yang bka' bstsal pa/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang 'di yang / /phyi ltar 'gro ba dang ba 'dren/ /nang ltar tha mal zhen pa ldog /gsang ba rang snang rig pa'i rtsal/ /gtsug khang 'jig rkyen gtsang chab 'di/ /phyi ltar rten gsum gdan 'dren klu/ /nang ltar 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyong chu/ gsang ba rang byung rnam dag khrus/ /gtsug khang sku skyob mchod me yang / /phyi ltar lam la brtson 'grus can/ /nang ltar 'phags pa'i sprul pa dngos/ /gsang ba byang chub thob pa'o/ /e ma ho/ ma 'ongs dus kyi 'gro ba kun/ /skal ldan gsan 'tshal thabs mchog bshad/ /lnga brgya'i tha mar shāka thub sku/ /ma dros klu dbang gdan 'dren tshe/ /gtsang chab sa rgya gcod tshul ni/ /gtsang chab g.yas lag kyong ba'i tshe/ /'ur thog steng du rdo bzhag 'dra/ /klu rgyal dung mgrin zhu 'bul dus/ /de dus bsnyen rags byed pa kun/ /'khor ba ngan song bdud ris kyi/ /g.yul ngo bzlog par smos ci dgos/ /gtsang po'i g.yas lag rags kyis bcad/ /rags khar mchod rten sgo mang rtsigs/ /des ni klu rgyal dung mgrin zlog /gtsang chab phyed du gyes pa'i tshe/ /pags rlon steng du bre bzhag 'dra/ /klu rgyal glang sna'i gsu ba yin//de dus gtsug khang rags byed kun/ /rnam smin las sbyangs bde chen thob/ /chu rags gong skor lta bur rtsig /stobs ldan gag ni zur gsum pa/ /rags khar brtsigs na glang sna zlog /gtsang chab skor ba byed pa'i tshe/ /rang thag 453

phub steng bzhag pa 'dra/ /klu rgyal ma dros gdan 'dren yin/ /de tshe mi yi gang zag gis/ /gtsug khang mchod skor rags byed kun/ /smon lam ci dang ci btab 'grub/ /chu rags gtsug khang gru bzhir bskor/ /zur bzhi kun du mtho re rtsigs/ khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po dang / /rta mgrin dang ni bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /stobs po che bzhir mnga' gsol bya/ /de ltar bgyis na cung zad phan/ /klu rgyal gsu ba byung ba'i tshe/ /ko ba mtsho la byed 'dra'i dus/ /rgyang nas mchod cing gsol ba gdab/ /smon lam rgya chen dpag med thob/ /de tshe 'dus tshogs 'gro ba kun/ /thugs rje chen po dngos yin no/ /de soṭa dag dang ma dag gi /mthong snang rab tha 'di ltar 'byung / /dag snang can la gtsug lag khang / /'og min gnas su gshegs mthong srid/ /tha ma'i snang bar gtsug lag khang / /sbrul gyis dkris nas chab la ni/ /'ja' 'od gur bcas gshegs mthong 'gyur/ /lar na mthong thos reg pa kun/ /thar pa 'thob pa'i gnas yin no/ /zhes gsungs nas rdzu 'phrul gyis rgyal po khrid de lha sa'i gter rnams dngos su bstan/ gab pa mngon phyung sogs kha cig thugs dam gyi rten du bshus nas phyis bsam yas su rnam snang gi phyag tu phul zhes byung la 'di dang chos rgyal nyid kyis lung bstan pa mthun pa ste/ gtsang chab g.yas lag brkyang pa lha sa gnyis kyi bar chu rgyas pa ni skam sa nya 'dra ba'am 'ur thog gi mthil 'dra ba nar mor gnas pa ste klu dung mgrin gyi spyan 'dren yin la de'i tshe nya 'dra'i dus su gzhog ltar spron zhes g.yas lag rags kyis bcad nas rags khar mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang brtsig go gtsang po phyed du gyes nas skam sa thur gsum du gnas pa ni 'jong 'dra'i dus te chu rags zhwa ltar bkon zhes gnya' nas zur gsum du bskor te gtsug tu gag ni zur gsum du brtsigs pas klu'i rgyal po glang sna'i spyan 'dren bzlog go /de nas skam sa 454

gru bzhi khol bur song zhing chu bskor 'khod pa ni klu'i rgyal po ma dros nga/ nyid spyan 'dren du 'ongs pa ste de'i tshe chu rags gdan ltar 'dings pa zhes lcags ri lta bu gru bzhir byas te zur bzhir mtho'am mchod rten re brtsigs pa khro bo bzhir bskyed cing mnga' gsol na cung zad phan la de nas skam sa gru bzhi'i zur nyams te sgor mo rnga 'dra bar gyur pa ni pir 'dra'i dus te de'i tshe mchod pa bzang po bshams nas gsol ba drag tu btab na cung zad bzhugs pa srid do//spyir 'di rnams la so so'i byed pa smon lam gyi mthu can re yong bar gsungs so/ /de nas ko ba mtsho la bying 'dra ni gshegs pa nyid kyi dus te snang ba tha dad pa du ma 'byung zhing mi rnams ri logs nas bltas te smon lam 'debs skad do/ /ra sa bsam yas sogs gtsug lag khang phal cher nyams pa'i 'og du khra 'brug gi rin po che'i gter khang kha 'bye zhing srong btsan bang so'i sgo bye nas nang gi lha khang lnga po rnams dang bcas pa la bskor ca/chod byed cing rang byung gi rten kha cig kyang gsar du 'ong zhes gtam rgyud pa las thos so/ /de slad phyin chad dad ldan skye bo rnams/ /bstan pa'i srog rtsa lha sa bsam yas sogs/ /nyams pa gso zhing ma nyams spel ba dang / /rgyal blon sprul sku rnams kyi thugs dam rten/ /lha khang kun la mchod cing dad par gyis/ /phyag dang skor ba maṭil byas pa dang / /me tog sbos dang mar me phul sogs kyi/ /phan yon bsam mi khyab par mdo las bshad/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge bar ma bkol na/ /mi lus thob kyang mun bskal skyes dang mtshungs/ /dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin la mi 'bad na/ longs spyod 'byor yang mdzod srung khyi dang mtshungs/ /dkar nag las 'bras bden par mi shes na/ /'phral du bsgrin par snang yang spre'u bzhin/ /dgos pa'i dam chos rgyud la ma 'khel na/ /mi lus thob kyang don med stong log yin/ /sgyu ma'i longs spyod skye 'gro'i spyi rdzas 455

las/ /nam zhag gtan rgyags sus thob byed dus yin/ /snying po med pa mi gtsang chu bur 'dra'i/ /lus la snying po len skabs da lta tsam/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam tsam 'dis slu/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i chos la dril/ /thar pa dge ba'i bshes la rag las kyi/ /tshad ldan yongs 'dzin 'tshol la srog bzhin bsten/ /tshig gi lo ma mang pos dgos dus slu/ /gdams ngag snying po sems kyi gnad du dril/ /sang bya gnangs bya'i ngang la 'chi bas sleb/ /da lta nam dran de kur nyams len 'bungs/ /ci byed dge la rang 'dod ma 'khris pa/ /mkha' khyab pha ma'i gtan don kho nar gyis/ /bdag gzhan 'khor 'das la sogs sgro btags te/ /shes rab dri med mdun na de mi gnas/ /de ltar ma shes rmi lam ltar 'khrul ba'i/ /mar gyur 'gro 'di snying brtse las brtse'i yul/ /de ltar stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje tshad med thabs/ /mi phyed ro mnyam zung du chud pa yis/ /rdzogs smin sbyang phyir phar phyin bcu la 'bad/ /chos kun gzod nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /rdzogs byang chub par yang dag mthong nas ni/ /srid zhi bdag gzhan la sogs mi dmigs bzhin/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las mkha' mnyam rgyun mi 'chad/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang sdug bsngal kun sel zhing / /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i 'phrin las can/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug de'i/ /bka' drin dran ched go 'phang 'thob par gyis/ /des na gtsug lag khang yun du gnas pa'i phyir blo gros can rnams kyis 'bad par bya zhing / nang gi lha dang phyi'i rags gso ba la 'bad par bya la khyad par lha sa'i srog shing yer pa yin pas der rten 'brel sgrig pa gal che ste yer pa'i dkar chag snga ma las/ sprul pa'i rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga'i sgrub gnas dang rten mchod kyi phyogs su 'bungs pa ni rgyal ba'i zhabs tog rgyal bas byas pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 456

la rim gro dang bsnyen bkur byas pa'o/ /stong gsum mi 'byed kyi zhing thams cad khyab pa'i mchod rten bzhengs pa bas yer pa'i sā tsha zhig byas pa'am zhig pa bsos pa stobs che'o/ /stong gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa 'bum phul ba bas yer par mchod pa tshar gcig byas pa stobs che'o/ /gzhan du lo brgya bsgoms pa bas yer par zhag gcig bsgoms pa stobs che'o/ /lha sa bod kyi srog shing yin/ /lha sa'i srog shing yer pa yin/ /yer pa'i mchod rten ma zhig na/ /lha sar bstan pa rgyun du gnas/ /sa g.yos byi ba me chu dang / /rlung gis lha sar mi gnod do/ /yer pa mi zhig na lha sa gso mkhan re yang rgyun du 'ong / gso mkhan de yang rgyal ba'i zhabs tog rgyal bas byas pa yin no/ /yer pa ma zhig gi bar du lha sa'i 'dun ma zhig dogs med do/ /lha sar gso mkhan dang dkon gnyer tshe ring bar 'dod na yer pa'i rten dang thigs tshags dang zhal ba gsos shig thigs sa dang zhal ba'i gseb tu spos dkar gtong ba gces so/ /'di phyin lha sa dang yer pa zhes so sor sbyar te 'dun ma zhig na nas phyes ser ga gsub cing ka ba yo ba srong / sa g.yos byung na mantul la rin po ches chag chag gdab/ me'i gnod pa byung na wa chu gso zhing ser ga dar mthing nag gis 'khyig rlung gi gnod pa byung na sgo gso zhing sgo'i ser ga ba dmar mo'i rnam lngas bsub/ mi'i nad byung na dam rdzas bdud rtsi lngas dkyil 'khor gso/ phyugs nad byung na brag lhar khrus dang chag chag 'debs/mtha' dmag dang mtshon gyis 'jigs na rten mchod gso zhing dar lcags kha'i cod pan dang mda' dar 'dzugs/ gting rdol dang chus nyen na mchod khang dang spos khang me khang gso/ jo bo la rgyal po'i gdan 'edren byung na lha dang mchod rten gyi gdan khri gso/ rgyal po'i chad pa byung na rol cha dang dril bu dang rnga gso/ 'khrug pa byung na g.yag shing gso zhing spyin dang thang chus sbyor/ mi 457

smyon dang khyi smyon byung na shing stag pa dang shug pas thog gso/ mu ge byung na g.yos khang gso zhing 'bru sna'i phyi'i zhal ba bya/ jag pa dang chom rkun dang mi rgod kyi gnod pa byung na gyang ris kyi dbu dang phyag gso/ lo thog dus su ma smin na chu mig gso zhing dkar gsum dang mngar gsum gyi gtor ma btang /'bru nyung na khri dang gtor snod gso zhing 'bru'i gtor ma btang / char ma bab na klu khang gso zhing klu gtor gtong / tshe thung na mchod rten gyi srog shing shug pa'i sdong po la rin po che lnga sman 'bru tsandan a ga ru sogs dang dar sna dang tshon skud kyis dkris pas gso/ nor ma 'phel na nor khang gi sgrom gso zhing ser ga rin po ches bsub pa dang tshogs 'khor gtong / bsris ma rme na thab khung gso zhing rin po che dang zas sna tshogs kyi sbyin sreg bya/ gos stan gyis phongs na sku dkar dang rgyab yol gso zhing dar sna dang ras snam gyis zhal ba bya/ sbrang bu chag ras nyen na sgo'i gzer dang sgo lcags dam la 'grig par gso/ sdom sdigs sba' sprul gyis nyen na them pa gas chag med par gso/ shig sro dang mug mas nyen na gsung rab kyi sku rags gsar par gso/ mig rims kyis nyen na logs dkar dang skar khung gso zhing dkar rtsi skya ha re ba bya/ klu dang sa bdag gis nyen na cong gso zhing dreg pa dang gtsa' med par bya/ pho gdon mo gdon gyi nyen na lam 'phrang mkhrung la brtan par gso/ byis pa'i gdon byung na skas ka grum mthud med par gso/ 'dul khrims zhig na dge slong gtsang ma ngo lkog med pa'i bzhi sde gzugs/ nyan bshad chad na mkhas btsun dam tshig gtsang ma'i chos gra gzugs/ mi rnams ngang rgyud rtsub na ma yengs sems la lta ba'i sgom gra gzugs/ bkra mi shis na sngags pa dam tshig gtsang ma'i sgrub pa gzugs/ zhig gso mkhan gyis nyen na snying rus che zhing ngang rgyud ring bas zhig gso bya/ lha sar dkon gnyer gyis phongs na yer par 458

gisung rab sgrog de yang gsal la dag pa gces/ lar na lha sari gang 'dod kun yer pa gsos pa las 'byung ngo / /'on kyang lha jo bo rnam gnyis kyi thugs rjes bskul nas yer pa gso ba yang mang dag yod/ de yang rgyal ba'i zhabs tog rgyal bas byed pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rgyal pos gsungs nas jo mo kong jos dkar chag du btab bo zhes byung ngo / /de la sogs pa mtha' 'dul ru gnon sogs thams cad kyi nyams pa gso ba gal che zhing / de thams cad la yang ma nyams pa mi gzhig phan tshun mi sbo/ zhig gso'i rgyu dang chos gter 'don dgos nges ma gtogs spyir gter dang khyad par nor gter mi dbyung / bgegs dang dam sri mnan pa mi gdon/ thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab/ mchod pa dang tshogs gsog byas nas ma bkag par shes na bya ba yin zhing / bstan pa dang sems can gyi spyi don ma gtogs rang gi grags 'dod dang sa 'dzin pa'i ched sogs tshe 'di'i rang 'dod ma zhugs pa kho na gal che'o/ /de ltar 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /thun mong min par gdul ba'i khur bsnams nas/ /gang la gang gis gdul ba'i skur bstan pa/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa rim par byon rnams kyi/ /bka' drin yang yang dran pas ma bzod de/ /dad pa'i gdung shugs zlog par ma nus pa'i/ /rkyen gyis bdag rgyud ring mo zhig nas bskul/ /rtsom pa'i 'dun pa yang yang 'phel na yang / /kye ma gtam rgyud sbun pas ci zhig bya/ /snying po'i dam chos rgyud la sgrubs shig ces/ /rang gis rang la gdams nas gnas pa'i tshe/ /tshogs gnyis gzi 'bar blo gros yangs pa yi/ /skal bzang du mas lan 'gar bskul ba las/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba brjod pa dang / /dam pa'i bka' drin mi brjed dran phyir dang / rgyal po rnams la gdams par bya ba'i ched/ /legs bshad kun las btus pa 'de brtsams so/ / 'di ni 'jig rten snang byed nyi ma 459

ste/ /yang dag lam rab ston pa'i snang ba yin—/ /mkhas rnams dga' byed legs bar bshad pa'i skyes/ /yid kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bum bzang yin/ /gser gyi ri las dum bu blangs pa ltar/ /cha shas res kyang yid kyi mun sel na/ /rdzogs par khong du chud na lta ci smos/ /de bas 'di lta'i legs bshad rnyed par dka'/ /'di ni rnyed dang grags pa'i phyir ma yin/ /snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor gyis ma bcings/ /yid 'ches lung rnams dpang por byas nas ni/ /skye bo kun gyis go bar sla phyir bshad/ /'di'i khungs ni chos rgyal srong btsan gyi bka' chems spyi dang mya ngan 'das chung / gab pa mngon phyung / jo bo'i gter ma ka bkol ma/ bsam yas kyi dkar chag chen mo'am rgya rabs dba' bzhed che 'bring / khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gi lo rgyus chen mo'am log non chen mor grags pa/ lde ston gyi chos byung / kun mkhyen bu'i chos byung / yar lungs jo bo'i rgyal rabs dang tshal pa'i deb dmar dang po sogs dpang du byas te phyis yig cha re re'ang rnyed dka' bar mthong nas yig tshogs la ma bsams par rang skabs kyi lung de tshang bar bris pa yin no/ /'dir 'bad dge ba mkha' ltar yangs pa des/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i yid mun kun bsal nas/ /thams cad dam pa'i lam la rab gnas pas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dgongs pa yongs rdzogs shog /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa legs par bshad pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i bod yul gyi skabs las chos rgyal rim par byon pa dang ra sa bsam yas las 'phros pa bstan pa snga dar gyi tshul rgyas par bshad pa'i skabs ste gnyis pa'o// //dbya/oṃ su sti/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che/ /ji ltar byon pa'i lo rgyus chos kyi mdzod/ /dpal ldan gtsug lag phreng ba'i gsung 460

gi rgyun/ /chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhis bya ba'i/ /'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan nas/ /bod yul chos rgyal rnams kyi mdzad pa'i bar//chos sbyin mi zad spel ba'i chu rgyun 'di/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sto stod yar phyin nas/ /chos kyi rgyal po khu dbon yab sras kyis/ /thugs bsam rnam par dag pas sgrub par mdzad/ /rkos la mkhas pa rgang rgyud sprul sku ba/ /tshe dbang dar po la sogs rnams kyis bsgrubs/ /zhus dag byed po byams pa don grub yin/ /'di yi dge ba rnam dkar dri med des/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad kuXn zhi nas/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'thob par shog / /maṅga la/ / 461

yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba las yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs la le'u bcu las gsum pa 'dul ba'i chos byung bzhugs so/ /

le'u gsum pa 'dul ba'i chos byung /bod du thub bstan phyi ma dar stol yang / /dang por bstan rtsa 'dul ba'i sde snod ni/ /sdom brtson du ma khams su bros pa las/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa la gnas pa yi/ /mu gzu gsal 'bar rab tu byung ba ni/ /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal zhes byar grags/ /de yi mkhan bu sdom brtson mang du 'phel/ khyad par dbus gtsang mi bcus bka' drin mnos/ /gtsang na lo tsho tshong tsho rnam pa gnyis/ /dbus na klu mes 'bring tsho rba rag gsum/ /re re'ang yan lag du mar bcas pa yis/ /bod yul kun na 'dul bstan mchog tu dar/ /bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams nas gsos pa/ /smad 'dul zhes byar mtshan du grags pa yin/ /drin can paṇa chen gnyis kyi mkhan bu ni/ rgya gar paṇa chen dharma pā la las/ /zhang zhung rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis drin mnos/ /de yi slob ma dpal 'byor la sogs byung / /'di la stod 'dul zhes byar grags pa ste/ /rnam par dag kyang mang du ma 'phel skad/ /phyi dus bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa gang / /rab gsal shākya'i bstan la tshangs spyod pa/ /kha che'i mkhas pa shākya shrī zhes pa/ /'phags pa'i yul na rtsod med sdom brtson pa/ khro lo'i dad brtson mkhyen pa zla med pas/ /dbang du mdzad de bod yul spyan drangs pa/ /de las byang rdor rnam gnyis bsnyen rdzogs te/ /rtsa ba'i sde pa rnam bzhi'i rten 'brel bzhin/ /'dul ba'i sdom rgyun rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /de ltar skyes bu dam pa mang po yis/ /'dul ba'i bshad rgyun sgrub rgyun rgya cher spel/ khyad par mkhas pa chen po mtsho sna pa/ /mgon po ṭa2da kyis ni bskul 465

ba las/ /'dul ba'i bstan bcos du ma mdzad pa ni/ /phyi dus bstan pa'i mig 'bras lta bur gyur/ /de ltar dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims dri med bslab pa dang / /'dul ba'i sde snod dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /deng dus kyang ni gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang / /dgag sgrub bcas pa rgyal ba kho na'i yul/ /ston dang bstan pa gcig gyur so sor thar/ /ji bzhin gang gi rgyud la gnas pa yi/ /bstan rtsa 'dul 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang sangs rgyas nyid rang byung gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas slar lnga sde ye shes khong chub kyis bzang sde'i tshogs drug bcu skyabs su 'brongs 'od srung chen po ston par khas blangs pas/ phal cher zhig tshur shog gis/ legs byin dri bas mnyes pas/ skye rgu'i bdag mo lci ba'i chos brgyad khas blangs pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs sngon gyi cho ga sangs rgyas nyid dang gsol bzhis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge 'dun dang 'brel ba'i las kyis sngon chog gi yul rnams bsnyen rdzogs su mdzad la/ sangs rgyas nas lo bdun pa'i sngon nas da ltar gyi cho ga gnang zhing brjod bya don gyi 'dul ba'i rgyun ma chad pa'o/ /brjod byed kyi 'dul ba so so thar pa'i mdo gnyis lung sde bzhi phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa bka' dang / bstan bcos la nyer sbas sogs dgra bcom pa mang pos mdzad par grags pa bye brag du bshad pa'i nang tshan 'dul ba bye brag du bshad pa dang / dri med bshes gnyen/ khyad par bshes gnyen sogs kyis so thar mdo bkral/ slob dpon dge legs bshes gnyen gyis lung ma mo'i rgya cher 'grel dang / dul lhas rnam 'byed 'grel pa/ dge ba'i gnyen gyis lung zhu ba/tshul khrims bskyangs kyis phran tshogs rnams bkral zhing / phyis dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa yon tan 'od kyis mdo rtsa ba dang las brgya rtsa gcig pa bsdus rang 'grel mdzad cing chos bshes kyis rgya cher 'grel mdzad 466
