pa sogs nas gzhi thams cad yod smra'i sdom rgyun mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho'i bar 'dul ba'i bshad sgrub kyi rgyun ma chad cing des bod yul du dar bar mdzad do//de yang bstan pa'i me ro smad nas ji ltar bslang ba'i tshul la mi mthun pa du ma snang ba las/ lo rgyus chen mo las ni/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i dus dbus nas zhang mnga' 'jam dpal dang yang gong shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis khams su byon/ de'i tshe yang gong gis khungs bstan nas zhang mnga' 'jam dpal las bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i mkhan bu cog ro dpal gyi dbang phyug dang grum phying slag can gnyis yin/ de tshe gtsang pa lo tshong gnyis dbus pa klu mes dang 'bring ste bzhis cog grum la mkhan slob zhus te blangs/ mkhan slob na re lo ston mthu che bas bstan pa srungs/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong ge blo rno bas chos ston/ 'bring pho sbo mtho bas gnas brtan gyis la bzhi gar bsdoms pas gnas gzhi gcig zung zhig gsungs kyang mkhan slob kyi gsung bcag nas so sor bzung bas sde bzhi byung /de yang glang dar gyis chos bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas lo ngo gsum pa chu mo glang la khu gzhon nu rin chen/ gnyas yon tan snying po/ mchims lhun grags dang mchog grub gnyis te bzhis klu mes mon mkhar 'bras phur spyan drangs/ phyi lo stag lo la ka chu gsos te bzung / spyan 'dren bzhi po yang rab tu byung /de nas lo bzhi pa'i me sbrul la thang po che btab/ de'i 'og tu 'bring ye shes yon tan smyal pa de byon te bo dzhai rā dzās khams gsum phul nas bzhugs te gangs bar lha khang dang gnyal gyi bzang ru sogs gyang skor dgu bzung / de nas rag shi tshul 'byung khams su sdom pa blangs nas byon te snang gsal lha khang bzung / /de'i gong tsam du rba btsun blo gros byon te sdom pa ma blangs sngon gyi dgra bcom gtsug phud can la gtsug phud rang gis dor ba yin/ des na dbus 467

kyi bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma klu mes yin la de'i gong du dbu ma mdzod mkhan dang glan ston shes rab rdo rje bya ba khams nas byon yang bstan pa ma tshugs zhes bshad do/ /yang dbon ba cis bris pa deb sngon na snang ba ni/ smar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis mdo smad sro gu lung du byon/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i chos blon 'bro stag snang khri gsum rjes bstan pa gsal nus par smon lam btab nas so lnga pa lcags phag la tshe 'phos te tsong kha bde khams su chu byi la 'khrungs/ nar son nas non 'jam dpal la bzlas lung blangs/ khang rin rdor zhes spyan ras gzigs zhal mthong ba zhig la sems bskyed/ skyi rgyal ba'i btsug tor la dbu tshad/ nam dga' ldan byang chub la yo ga gsan/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal nas thar ba yi/ /bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi byed pa'i/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /dang por bdag gis rab tu byung bar bya/ /zhes gtsang gis mkhan po/ g.yo smar gyis slob dpon byas te rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas byang phyogs su mi nyag lha'i yul du go rong seng ge grags la 'dul ba gsan pas lung sde bzhi bstan bcos dang bcas pa byin nas bstan pa gsal bar gyis shig kho bo ni yun ring du mi 'tsho'o gsungs/ de nas dbus su zhang chen po dge ba la chos nyan du 'byon bzhed pa na klong thang sgrol mar dbus nas rgyal po'i pho nya ba mngar g.yu mtsho bya ba zhig 'dug pa na re dbus su mu ge chen po byung bas btsun pa khyod kyis bshul yang mi phyed bka' 'od mchog grags pa lho bal du chos bslabs nas khams su byon zer bas log ste lha rtse bhig tig gi gnas gzhir bka' las 'bum ṭīka dang sa sde sogs mngon pa'i theg chen lo bcu gnyis gsan/ rmang lam na glang po che bcibs nor bu bsnams nas tshong 'dus rnams su byon pas mi kun na re btsun pa khyod kyi nor bu bzang ste re zhig nyo ba yang med rin yang mi theg zer ba rmis pas/468

bstan pa rin chen sgrom phye ste/ /yon tan mchog gi nor byin yang / /dman rnams don du mi gnyer bas/ /re zhig nags su gnas par bya/ /zhes dgongs tshe ri dan tig gi the'u rang spun dgus/ bdag cag gis phyogs gang dang gang na dgon pa chen po dngos grub brnyes pa mang du byung ba rtsa ba dang 'bras bu la sogs pa rnyed sla ba der 'byon par ci gnang / bdag cag gis kyang bran dang dge bsnyen du bgyi'o zhes zhus te der byon nas mchod gtor rgya chen po mdzad de/ bstan pa srung ba skyob pa'i spyan snga ru/ /thugs dam bzhes pa rgyal sras dpa' rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pa/ /skyob la gus rnams bdag la gdong grogs mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las bskul lo/ /de na gcig car 'jug pa ces dge ba'i phyogs mi byed pa mang bas de'i ched du lha khang dang mchod rten mang po bzhengs pas yul der tshon rtsi yang byung / bzo yang rang gis mdzad/ der pa gong ye shes g.yung drung 'khor mang po dang bcas pa dan tig du byon pa na bla chen pos 'dul ba'i bslab gzhi brjod pas dad cing rang gi spyod pas 'gyod de rab tu byung / de bzhin du par grags pa/ja pa grags pa dang btsun chen sher 'byung / gzhang dpal rdor dang srags rgya mtsho/ 'al rdor dbang dang snubs dpal dbang / zong mchog chos skyong dang mtshur shes rab mchog ste gnyis re nye bar rab tu byung bas/ pa bar gnyis/ja cog gnyis/ gzhang grags gnyis/ 'al snubs gnyis/ zong mtshur gnyis zhes bya la mtshur gyi mkhan bu klu mes sogs dbus gtsang pa rnams yin no/ /der yang dag 'jog la rtse gcig du brtson pa las ci zhig na brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha rnams mtshan mo snang ba chen pos chos nyan pa'i phyir lhags te chos kyi gtam gyis yid tshim nas btsun pa khyed ni bzang na mi ma yin pa'i 'khor 'di dag ni ngan no zer nas song / 'khor rnams kyis mdang snang ba 'di lta bu gda' 469

ba khyed nges par sprul ba lags sam zhus pas/ kho bo ni sprul pa ma yin gyi theg chen sbyor lam pa snang ba thob pa'i ban ndhe dge ba gsal lo zhes gsungs/ yang skabs gzhan du/ dang po bud med sgog tshong ma/ /bar du stag sna khri sum rje/ /da lta mu zu dge ba gsal/ /zhes kyang gsung skad/ de lta bu'i bla chen pos lo zhe dgu la dan tig du byon/ sum bcu rtsa lnga der bzhugs/ brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi phag la gshegs/ 'phags pa thogs med dang btsun pa mche ba'i sde gnyis kyis yu ma don mi 'dra bar bkral ba de kho bos byams pa la zhu dgos slob dpon de gnyis kyang da lta dga' ldan na bzhugs pa yin/ yang 'jig rten 'dir da lta 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon yang bskrad de gtong na'ang kho bo ni byams pa ma byon gyi bar du 'dzam gling 'di thams cad tu skye ba brgyad tsam re len dgos zhes gsungs te dga' ldan du gshegs/ zhes dpon bi cis bris par snang / sa skya bla ma'i chos byung las ni bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe dang por smar g.yo gtsang gsum/ de nas bka' 'od mchog grags pa dang rong po lhun gyi dpal gnyis/ de nas lha lung rnams rim par bros/ bon po'i bu smu gsal 'bar rab tu phyung ste shākya dge ba gsal du btags nas mkhas par gyur/ de nas bal rdo rje dbang phyug snubs dpal gyi byang chub/ yang gong ye shes g.yung drung / sbar rin chen/ lcang ye shes seng ge cog ro sher byang /shod chung pa sher grags/ an 3bar ba byang chub/ grum ye rgyan/ snubs dpal byang / sgro mañdzu shrī sogs mkhas btsun mang du byon/ chos bsnubs nas lo drug bcu na 'phan yul zhogs pa bon po smu gsal gshen 'bar gyi bu smu za 'phen bya ba'i byis pas snang gsal lha khang du phyin pas gyang ris la rab byung chos nyan bshad byed pa'i gzugs mthong nas dris pas rgan mo zhig na re rab tu byung ba bya ba'i gzugs yin zer bas byis pa dad de ngus nas da ga na yod 470

dris pas nga bu mo'i dus na yong ste phyis bsnubs nas med/ da lta khams na yod par 'dug zer bas byis pa des lus srog la ma bltas par phyin te rab tu byung bas bla chen dgongs pa gsal du grags/ dbus gtsang gi mi bdun zhes klu 'bring lo tshong gi steng du sum pa ye blo rgya ban blo she gzhon ban chos mchog ste bdun phyin pa grum dang cog ro las sdom pa mnos nas log de nas mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags/ rag shi tshul 'byung / rba btsun blo gros/ nyang bran chos skyabs/ grum shing sher smon te lngas de'i rjes su grum cog las blangs zhes 'chad par snang yang cung zad ma dag pa cig ste/ de'i lugs la byis pa khams su phyin pa de kho na la shākya dge ba gsal du btags pa phyis mkhas par gyur nas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags pa yin pas lan gnyis su bgrang mi 'os la dbus gtsang mi bcu sus kyang bla chen dang de'i slob ma la'ang ma thug na des bstan pa'i me ro gsos par ji ltar 'chad/ des na rje rang byung rdo rje dang kun mkhyen bu ston sogs bzhed pa ni 'di yin te/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe 'jang gi gyel mi gtsang rab gsal/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung / stod lugs pa smar shākya mu ni dang gsum chu bo ri la sgom zhing yod pas btsun pa khyi ra byed pa mthong nas dris pas chos bsnubs par shes nas 'dul ba drel khal gcig bkal nas skad ris mi gcig pa'i sar bstan pa spel snyam nas gar log dang hor yul du phyin yang dar bar ma nus te mdo smad lho ngos kyi be ro tsha chon tshur thon rma chu'i rgyud rma lung rdo rje brag ra an chung gnam rdzong yang zer ba dan tig shel gyi yang dgon na sgom zhing yod pa rma chu pa'i phyugs rdzis mthong ste mi rnams la smras pas mos spyod kyi sa ba mu zu gsal 'bar bya bas bltar phyin pas dad de rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas 'dul ba'i po ti gtad nas 'di stos dad na rab tu dbyung ngo gsungs/ bltas pas cher dad de mchi 471

ma byung / der smar gyis mkhan po g.yos slob dpon byas te rab tu phyung /mkhan slob las ming sbyar ste shākya dge ba rab gsal du btags/ phyil thugs rab che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /bsnyen rdzogs zhus pa dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi 'ong gsungs nas sngar lha lung dpal rdor ba gsum klong thang na 'dug par thos nas btsal bas khong na re ngas rgyal po bsad pas kha skong 'ong gzhan btsal gyi gsungs te rgya'i hā shang ke wa ja dang gyi phan gnyis btang ste lngas bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba lo bco lnga gsan zhes rje rang byung pa bzhed/ rdzogs nas lo lnga lon pa dang dbus nas glag pa lam pa klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ smyal pa 'bring ye shes yon tan/ g.yo ru pa na tshul khrims blo gros/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes blo gros ste lnga/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug zhab sgo lnga'i tshong btsun shes rab seng ge/ mnga' ris pa 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u dkar de wa dang lnga ste dbus gtsang gi mi bcus khams su byon/bsam yas kyi mnga' bdag tshan ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis khams su brdzangs zhes kyang grags/ bka' gdams kyi yi ge 'ga' las rnyed 'tshol la phyin pa 'dod pa bzhin ma 'grub nas rgya srang la lhung ba'i tshe'u cag rnams zang zing gi ched du 'di ltar dka' ba spyod pa bas 'di phyi thams cad du bde ba'i chos bya'am zhes mol nas rab tu 'byung bar 'chams/ phyag rten med ces glengs pas khong rang chos rgyus che ba 'gas gros bton me tog mang du 'thus nas bla ma 'byon pa'i mdun du me tog gtor/ phyag gus par byas pas khyed rnams ni ga nas yin nam mi mthong ba can 'ga' 'dug gsungs nas mnyes zhes snang / bla chen la mkhan po zhus pas ngas bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mi btub gsungs/ smar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis nged rgas pas mkhan bu mi 'khyongs 472

dmigs bsal la gang zag khyad par can gyis btub pas khyod kyis gyis gsungs te bla chen gyis mkhan po mdzad de stan thog gcig tu tshigs gsum rim nod du sgrub pa chig rdzogs su bsnyen par rdzogs/ byin po tsho yar 'ongs/klu mes kyis grum la 'dul ba nyan zhing bsdad do/ /de'i dus rag shi'i gcung dang rba'i gtsung phu bo bsur 'ongs pa dang klong thang du mjal bas gcung gnyis dad de los mkhan po byas phu bo gnyis kyi slob dpon byas te rab tu byung bas de phyin rba rag gnyis gcig tu sdeb bo/ /de nas lo ston na re khyed rnams 'dir bzhugs/ ngas tshong pa dang 'grogs te dbus gtsang du phyin la bstan pa dar bar nus na bsdad kyi khyed rnams yang byon/ mi nus na log la 'ong gsungs nas 'dan ma'i tshong pa dang 'grogs te byon pas tshong pa sngar sum 'phrang nas ldog pa la/ lo ston gyis 'di nas ma ldog par gtsang du song tshong legs par 'ong / mgur mo rab kha na lo nad gtsug na bya ba yod/ de la khyod kyi bu rab tu byung nas dbus na yod gyis shig byas te btang bas tshong legs par byung / de phyin mgur mor tshong 'dus chags/ phyi lo klu mes kyis mkhan po la kho bo dbus gtsang du 'gro bas mchod gnas shig zhu byas pas bon po'i zhwa 'obs zhu phog nas sa ser btab pa gsol 'phro zhig gnang nas 'di gon la nga rjes su dran par gyis gsungs te gsol nas phyis dbus su tshad pa tshabs rgyab bltab ste gsol bas zhwa sna rings su grags pa byung la dbus gtsang mi bcu las mched pa phal cher gyi zhwa yin/ phyis bka' gdams kyi gzhung man ngag pa gnyis la'ang 'di las gyes pa'i zhwa cung zad mi 'dra ba re yod cing dwags po sgom tshul gyis 'di'i rgyab bltab ste gsol bas slob dpon sgom tshul gyi zhwa zhes sgom zhwar yang gragagu so/ /de nas khong rnams kyis bsam yas su byon te klu mes kyis ka chu che mched kyis bu tshal dang dbu rtse/ rag shi mched kyis dge 473

rgyas/ 'bring gis zangs khang bzung / de nas dbus pa lngas gnas gzhi so so rtsig par byas/ klu mes kyis dbu rur la mo chag de'u btab/ mi chos kyi sa khul du ba lam gnas brtsigs/ sa bya la mor 'gyel brtsigs/ phyi lo glan rdog rab tu phyung / de'i phyi lo yer pa ba rang btab/ gru mer sogs bco brgyad rab tu phyung / tshong 'dus gnas bzhengs/ phyis tshe spong gi se ra phug par bzhugs nas thang du byon pa'i lam du grongs te klu mes dang gru mer gnyis ga'i gdung mchod rten 'od 'bar na ma nyams par bzhugs/ klu mes kyi mkhan bu zhang rdog glan gru mer te ka ba bzhi yam shud sogs mang du byon/ de la zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug ni byams pa'i sprul par grags/ sna nam jo sras dang zhang lcaca/ sgrol ma'i sras su nyams dga' mor 'khrungs/ lo bco brgyad pa la ra ba zlum por klu mes las rab tu byung / dang por ra chag btab/ so bdun pa chu byi la rgyal lug lhas kyi lha khang bzhengs/ rgya gar du byon rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal nas 'dul ba gsan zhing rgya gar du yang 'dul ba bshad/ gya lnga pa lcags byi la gshegs/ gdan sa glan tshul byang gis bzung ste pu to ba'i mkhan po yin/ zhang nas mkhan rabs bcu drug la lo nyi brgya nyer brgyad 'das pa na hor dmag gi thog ma dor tog gi dmag byung bas rgyal lha khang bsregs/ btsun pa so ston sogs lnga brgya tsam bkrongs/ slar dor tog gis gser bre dngul bre mang po rgyur sbyar te gsos/ 'di las mched pa zhang skor zhes grags/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis yer pa bzung / g.yu sgro khang dmar/ bzad kyi lding pa/ chu shul na bo/ sbus sde lho gong / yol thang / lab so/ gral ma thang / kha rag so gcig gzhu kun ra/ tsha mig sogs brtsigs/ rngog gi mkhan bu zhig gis lho nub tu lha mdo brtsigs pa las 'bre cho zhes mang du mched/ de rnams rngog skor du grags/ glan ye shes shes rab kyis rgya sar 474

sgang / blag mda'/ mtshal chung bzung ste glan tsho'o/ thang po che rtsig pa la khu'i bandhe mi gsum sogs phyed dang brgyad du grags kyang gtso bor gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis btab ste klu mes nyid kyis kyang bzhugs/ 'di las mched pa la thang sgor du grags shing gru mer gyi mkhan bu khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis bzung / de nas khu 'byung rgyan khu sher brtson sogs nas khu rgyal tsha'i bar byon/ de nas chag lo'i slob ma bla brang pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan nas bla brang pa dang / lo pa'i sangs rgyas jo bo'i slob ma gser khang pa dang /khu mdo sde 'bar gyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa khu pa ste gsum du gyes so/ /yang khu'i bandhe mi gsum gyi khu shud pu tsha gzhon nu grags pas khu tshes kyi so mtshams su 'ju ma bzhengs/ de nas yugs kyi shud pus spyan drangs te ba shi btab/ rgya gar gyi shing ba she ru las byas pa'i rten zhig yod pa'i ming chags nas ba shi ru'i lha khang zer/ de nas yar stod du bar yul bzhengs so/ /yam shud rgyal ba 'od kyis g.yu rtse lha khang khrab la kha phug bo che gad pa thog lcang tshags sogs bzung / de'i mkhan bu mgar srags gnyis gra pa mngon shes sogs las smyal pa mgar srags gnyis kyi byar yur 'og dang rtsi 'or bzung nas smyal gyi klu mas rnams byung / gra pa mngon shes ni mngon pa la mkhas pas der grags/ mchims rdo rje spre chung gi rgyud pa yin la bar cig nas zhang du 'bod/ 'khrungs yul rag ma pa la mtshan dbang phyug 'bar du dod pa dang / 'khrungs yul gra mtshan shes rab rgyal bar 'dod pa gnyis snang / khu bo las zhang blon gyi sgrub lung blangs pa tsam gyis zhal mthong ste nus mthu che mkhas pa chen por gyur te dam pa rgya gar las zhi phyed sgron ma dgu dang kha tsha zla mgon las sbyor drug gsan te mkhyen rtogs 'dzom/ lha bug pa can pa la bde mchog gi dbang bskur bas lo dus su bu byung bas 'bul ba cher byas shing sku bsod rgyas te g.ye yar lungs 475

sogs su gnas gzhi mang du mdzad/ spyan yas dang gra skyid ru btab/ btsun mo dpal gyi ngang tshul ma'i lha khang rong skam gsos te sde btsugs/ skyid ru nas mkhan bu bzhi'i sha ston gyis gnas sgor/ rngan chung ston pas sga 'dra/ lhab kyis bso thang bandhe byang sems kyis ri phug btab/ rna shud kyi so mtshams su gnod sbyin gyis lung bstan te gra thang brtsigs/ spyir lha khang brgya rtsa brtsigs par grags/ dgung lo don dgu la mkhan bu cig gis snying thur brgyab pa thal nas gshegs/ dbon po 'byung shed dang 'byung tshul gyis lhag rnams bsgrubs/gra pa'i gdan sa don stangs pa chos skyabs kyis mdzad de khong rog dmar zhur ba'i slob ma yin/ spyir 'jug pa sems skyed la bka' dog kyang khong gi rmi lam na dga' ldan du byams pa dang mjal tsam pa'i me tog snyim pa gang gtor bas dbu thog du me tog gi khang brtsegs su gyur/ byams pa'i zhal nas khyod kyis mi yul du 'gro ba mchog dman thams cad la 'jug pa sems skyed ma byin na nga'i bka' las 'gal lo gsung ba thos nas yangs par mdzad pa la rog gis bkyon pas bdag la 'di mi byar ma btub pa yin zhes lung bstan zhus pas 'o na khyod kyi de nga la yang gyis dang gsungs nas gsan sems skyed rmi lam ma zhes pa de yin no/ /spyir thang po che lag bcas la mtshan nyid kyi sde zer/ phug po che gra thang sogs la sngagal sde zer/ gra pas dbu ra gong ma bzung / khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung sbar gra pa'i slob ma yin na'ang phyis phrag dog gis mthu rgyas byas/ gra pas rog pa rtsa'i gces phrug mi bzhi rab tu phyung nas bye ma lha khang gi 'khris su ma bkod lha khang btab/ nye gnas rga bran nag pos khu ston zur phud kyi klu la gtad tshe sngags mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa byung / de sdum tshe ma bkod mda' rgyang gang du bsnur bya ba sogs byung bas bsnur te bye lung btab nas rtsod pa zhi skad/ de ltar klu mes la zhang skor rngog skor glan skor thang skor 476

la sngags mtshan nyid gnyis te bzhi'am lnga'o/ /sum pas 'bro sa thang du dme ru brtsigs te sde ma 'phel/ spyir klu sum gnyis gcig du sdebs nas gdung gnyis zer la/ de'i tshe sngar gyi ka ba bzhi/ klu gsum gyi mkhan bu glan ye byang /tshal chung gi gnyos tshul rgyal/ 'phangs dbang rgyan/ gzi rlung gnyis/ klu mes kyi gcung dge ngom 'dis mon mkhar 'gan bzhengs/ mkhan bu min yang mi che bas grangs su bgrangs pa bhe ston rdo rje shes rab 'dis gzhung sgre mkhar btab/ de la sogs pa ni phyam so gnyis/ de bas chung ba la gral ma dpag tu med pa zhes grags shing / rgyal dkor nor/ gzhu kun ra bza' mi/ thang po che dge bshes/ gra thang lha khang gis khyad par 'phags pas khyad 'phags kyi sde bzhir grags so/ rbas yungs 'gur brtsigs/ lan pa'i lcil bu bzung /mkhan bu mal sems dpa' shes rab kyis stod lungs cha thog brtsigs/ thag ma lha khang dang mon gra bzung / rba'i gcung gis gye re'i mda' grong brtsigs/gzho'i 'cha da kha bzung ste de rnams rba tshor grags/ rag shis phrang 'og gi lha khang brtsigs/ ka tshal dang zhwa bzung / gcung pos dge rgyas bzung de'i mkhan bu mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags yin/ de'i mkhan bu zhang shes rab 'phags kyis lan pa rta bres brtsigs te de rnams la rag tsho dang rag shi'i gcung tsho zer ro/ /'bring gis ngan lam spyi mo brtsigs pa las 'bring tsho stod pa mched/ de nas dkar chu dang snye thang brag sna bzung / de'i lam stegs su brang ra mo che brtsigs/ de las 'bring tsho smad pa mched/ klu gong nas 'bring tsho bar pa byung ste de rnams la 'bring sde zer te dbus pa lnga las ji ltar gyes pa'o/ /gtsang du lo ston la mkhan bu nyi shu rtsa bzhi zhes grags kyang sde zin pa la/ rgya shākya gzhon nus la stod mar la thang brtsigs/ de las 'bring mtshams kyi bul tog lha khang sogs gyes/ spyo shes rab rdo rjes don mo ri brtsigs/ stag lo 477

///sne ///) /rdo11 ///na za rig rternga ri tho ring smyo byug na brtson sa stag lha khang ba gas/ a mas zhu gcag gas mas phrang dang brag dmar bzung / 'dar shākya yon tan gyis gzus po bzung / li blo gros gzhon nus jo mo brtsigs/ glag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chu mig brtsigs/ de rnams mched pa la rgya mtsho nas glag tsho'i bar so sor grags shing 'ga' shes rab bla mas bsnyems brtsigs/ rngog ye shes 'byung gnas kyis spang dkar lha lung brtsigs kyang de gnyis ka glag tshor thim/ glang btsun byams pas 'om phug brtsigs/ de nas gtsang 'gram bzung ste bum thang / chag sa/kri gong / mgos ston/ khrol ma sogs glang tsho stod smad du gyes/ mgo ba ye shetho g.yung drung gis sbre lha khang bzung / de'i mkhan bu lce btsun shes 'byung gis zha lu'i ma brtsigs te rgya gar du phyin/ sdom pa bskyar nas blangs/ paṇḍi ta gcig gi gsol zhal la mchod yul gyi gtso bor byed/ phor pa la zhal bur yul de na grags pas gtsug lag khang gi ming zha lur chags/ slob ma ka bzhi gdung drug tu grags pa byung ste zha lu brgya skor mched/ kyi ye shes dbang pos shangs mkhar lung dang gye re glang ra de'i las stegs su mu shangs kyi ro skam brtsigs/'di nas kyi tsho stod smad par gsum du gyes te glang ra nas mched pa la glang skor dang nyug gi u lung nas gyes pa la u tsho zer ste bsdoms nas kyi tsho smad par grags/ kyi'i slob ma a me de'i mkhan bu rnams las spang gis 'khris dang zhang tshul 'phags kyis bya rgyus bzung / kong pho thar ba rin chen la mkhan bu bzhi'i gzu ston 'phan grags kyis sgre'i lce mtshams dang rgyan mkhar stag lung bzung / de las mched pa gzu tshor grags/ lce btsun dkar pos ang yig dang / g.yung ston dza ka ris ba 'or bzung yang mched pa med/ shab rtses shab rtse lha khang brtsigs te de rnams la kong tsho zer zhing spyir de thams cad la kyi tsho bar par grags/ yang a mes kyis la bris kyi kha chad nas sad kyi la steng 478

bzung / der stod kyi mkhan bu rnams bzhi byung ba'i khri ston brtson 'bar gyis shong snar bzung / sa rbad btsun chung gis brang chung bzung / rgya ston ārya de was spo ru sna bzung / 'dar shākya gzhon nus sar phug bzung ste/ khri tsho/bra tsho/ rgya tsho/ sar tsho zhes khral tsho bzhi byung ba la kyi tsho stod par grags/de las gyes pa gzhon nu 'byung gnas kyis rgyan mkhar thur la bzung bas thur tsho dang kyi btsun dpal yes 'brung kun ra bzung ngo / /tshong tsho'i sde ni tshong btsun shes rab seng ges sdo gling bzung / de'i mkhan bu las khral tshong gur gyes te tshong tsho stod pa la skal sgor dang rgyan skor gnyis/ bar pa la gnas gsar dang gnas rnying gnyis te bzhi byung / smad pa la rba tsho/ nyan tsho skor/bya chos skor/ smon gro skor/ dwo tsho ste khral tsho lnga yod/ de yang a mes tshong btsun gyis rtsis kyi yang dben bzung / de la rtsis lha khang nyan tsho stag tshal gyi bya chos mkhar po che smon gro gser gyi sgong thog rnams phul nas bzung / rang gi mkhan bu la so sor gtad pas tsho lnga byung ste de la rtsis lha khang rba yon tan blo gros la gtad de bskyangs pas rba tshor grags/ rba'i mkhan bu yol chos dbang gis skyegs gnas rnying bzung nas rba tsho stod pa mched/ yol thog 'bebs kyis lcang ra dang stag pa jo btsun gyis ce te bzung nas rba tsho bar par grags/ rtsis nas rba tsho smad pa mched do/ /nyan tsho rwa blo gros bzang po dang khams pa la gtad/ rwas ngur mig bzung bas rwa tsho byung / khams pas lcags mkhar bzung bas khams tsho zer te de gnyis nyan tsho skor ro/ /bya chos mkhar po che rgya tshul seng la gtad des kong po ye 'byung la gtad des da mu'i gnas mo che dang mnyam du bskyangs pas bya chos skor ro/ /smon gro mar pa rdo rje ye shes la gtad/ des mkhan bu sne po grags pa rgyal mtshan la gtad nas slar dong mkhar phug bzung / phyis stag tshal dkyus thang bzhengs nas a mes la 479

phul/ mar pas bran ma sgang brtsigs/ de gsum dang lan 'gro ba'i stag tshang dang bzhi la smon gro'i ma dang mnyam pa'i bu bzhir grags te smon gro skor ro/ /gser gyi spong thog zhang tshor khrod pa la gtad/ des ser gyi brag shod brtsigs/ btsan po sdings/ rtsis kyi yang dben ra sog mtshar la/ stag tshal mkhar po che bzung nas mkhan bu rba dge mthong la gtad/ des rong ba do bzung nas/mkhan bu 'bre btsun sngon mo la gtad/ de rnams la do tsho zer te khral tsho 'dus nas 'dun ma byed pa na de dag gi btsun chung gsum byung ba la dpon po gar song dris pas 'das zer bas 'o na dwo phrug du 'dug pa zhes byas te der chags skad/ de ltar dbus gtsang gi mi bcus phyin kyang dbus nas sum pa dang gtsang nas 'od brgyad spun u dkar te bzhi la mched pa med pas dbus gtsang mi drug du grags shing de'i yang rba rag gcig tu bsdebs nas mi lngar yang graṭa so/ dbus gtsang mi bcu la mi the ba 'a 'bre'i sde gnyis byung ste 'a zha mgo bo che'i bu 'a ye shes g.yung drung gis khams su sdom pa len du 'gro ba'i lam lha sar phyin pas steng khang du 'gro ba'i skas kyi zur logs la mgon po'i sku ri mor yod pa yar res ri mor 'dug pa las mar 'ongs tsa na mgon po dngos thod pa'i nang na mi'i snying dang khrag bsres pa mi rtsib kyi thur mas gsol zhing 'dug ste ngas khyod kyi chos skyong bya yi zla ba gcig la 'khor bar shog zer te 'a tsho mthu che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ der khams su bla chen gyi mkhan bu kre po mchog bla la bka' drin zhus pas ngas chu gtor btang la 'ong gi gsung tsa na de khar 'das/ mkhan po'i gsung de ka la sdom pa thob par bzung bas dge tshul chu gter ma zhes pa byung / 'a zha des sna nam 'dre brngas dang 'u yug mda'i ra shag dang de'i lam stegs stag gi gnas po che bzung / de'i mkhan bu she 'u sna nam pas lhan gyi ba so thang / 'khor re skyi sgang / nyang ro bud mdo/ 'khor 480

re ba khor/ ldan gyi dre shod rnams bzung / de'i mkhan bu sog tshul khrims bla mas kyang ba so thang bzung / de'i mkhan bu spang 'dul 'dzin gyis stag gi spen can bzung / de'i mkhan bu snubs rin chen grags kyis khu lung lha gral dang 'u yug gsal sgang sogs bzung ste 'a tsho'i skor ro/ /yang 'bre gzhon tshul gyis khams su phyin khri kha mkhar snar bla chen gyi mkhan bu ya zi bon ston la bka' drin zhus pas der bas gsungs te de kur 'das/ de la sdom pa thob par byas pas der bas kyi bsnyen rdzogs su grags de phyir log nas rta nag phu'i bya tshang dang shangs kyi bye phug bzung / de nas 'jad kyi gnas brgyad mched de de rnams 'bre tsho yin no/ /de ltar dbus gtsang gi mi drug 'a 'bre dang bcas pa las gyes pa ni smad 'dul du grags pa yin la/ sdom rgyun ni/ ston pa/ shā ri'i bu/ dgra gcan zin/ klu sgrub/ legs ldan byed/ dbal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ bo dhi sa twa rnams yin/ de phyin la 'dod lugs du ma snang ste mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/ rba ratna/ li sangs rgyas ye shes/ ka ba 'od mchog grags/des g.yo smar gtsang gsum zhes 'dod pa dang / kha cig zhi ba 'tsho'i mkhan bu ka ma la shī la/ des g.yo dge 'byung zhes 'chad pa dang / rba ratna'i mkhan bu smar g.yo gtsang gsum yin par 'chad pa yang snang la/ kha cig dzi na mi tra'i mkhan brgyud du 'dod kyang bo rtis twa bod kyi gdul skal yin pa'i rten 'brel las de'i sdom rgyun du gor ma chag go lha lung rab 'byor dbyangs la bla chen gyis thug zer ba'ang dag par ma mthong ngo / /bstan pa snga phyi'i bar du dbus gtsang du bstan pa med pa thang sde'i lugs la lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ bu lugs la bdun bcu/ 'brom lugs pa lo don brgyad song bar 'dod do/ /stod 'dul ni mnga' ris stod tu mnga' bdag srong de bstan pa la cher dad kyang mkhan slob ma rnyed pas yab sras gsum dkone mchog gi drung du rang gis 481

rtags blangs te khong rang gi mtshan ye shes 'od du bsgyur/ paṇḍi ta dharma rpā la spyan drangs te sā bhu pā la gu ṇa pā la pradzha pā la ste pā la gsum sogs mang du bsnyen par rdzogs/ pradzha pā la'i mkhan bu zhang zhung rgyal ba'i shes rab/ 'dis paṇḍi ta mang du bsten zhing mkhan po dang bal po'i 'dul 'dzin pre ta ka las 'dul ba'i lag len thams cad sbyangs/ kha che dzña na shri las so thar mdo'i 'grel pa 'dul ba bsdus pa mnyan te 'gyur bcos/ kha che shrī su bhū ti shānta la sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel mnyan te dge blo dang gnyis kyis dag par bcos nas lha byang chub 'od la bshad/ 'grel pa slob phan yang bsgyur/ sa manta shrī dzā na la kā ri ka lnga bcu pa zhus nas rgya gar kha che bal po ste dpe gsum dang gtugs nas bcos shing bshad/ dge tshul gyi lo dri dharma pā la'i rgya dpe las kha che na ra ya de wa la zhus nas bsgyur zhing bshad/ dge slong gi lo dri jo bo rje dang nag tsho'i 'gyur las gsan/ zhang zhung pa'i slob ma lo tsā ba dpal 'byor/ 'dis bal po dza ya ka ra las dge slong gi kā ri ka dang kha che pa ra he ta dang ma hā dzi na las dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi mdo gsan/ de ltar na dharma pā la dang pre ta ka lag len gyi rgyud pa dang gzhan rnams bshad pa'i rgyud pa ste 'dul ba'i bshad sgrub kyi brgyud pa gnyis ldan yin zhes zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ges bris pa'i tshigs bcad lhug par bkrol ba yin la sdom rgyun ni/ dgra gcan zin/ zag zad sde/ chos kyi sde/ dharma pā la/ zhes 'dod par snang la stod 'dul 'di shin tu dag par grags kyang / mkhan rgyud 'di la bar nas kha yar chad pa cig yin par dogs so/ /spyir 'dul ba'i bshad rgyud ni/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyi 'og tu phyir mi 'ong glos mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gnyis/ seng ge gdong can/ des dā na shī 9spru dang dzi na mi tra gnyis zhes stod 'dul smad 'dul gnyis mthu na par 482

khas len par snang la ston pa 'das nas lo dgu brgya na thogs med byon pa'i lo tshigs dang sbyar na glos mi 'bebs dang yon tan 'od kyi bar du 'ga' zhig chad par dogs so/ /dzi na dā na gnyis la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ de la g.yo smar gtsang gsum/ de nas bla chen po/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan te smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyud do/ /stod 'dul ni dzi na dā na gnyis la shākya se na/ de nas dharma pā la/ de la gru mer gyi mkhan bu gra phyi'i klubs lo tsā dang skyogs 'dul 'dzin gnyis/de gnyis la gzus kyis thug ste de phyin stod 'dul smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyun gcig tu gyur pa yin no/ /gzus la bu bzhir grags pa/ 'dzims pa shes rab 'od dang rong mkhar phug gi sne bo grags pa rgyal mtshan ste gtsang du bu gnyis/ ka chu'i spo chung tshul khrims bla ma dang rgyal gyi glan tshul byang ste dbus su gnyis so/ /de la 'dzims pa ni mnga' ris pa yin/ mkhas pa chen por gyur nas gzus la 'dul ba nyan/ des 'dzims su 'dul gra btsugs spo ba ma stod du zhang zhung rgyal she/ 'dzims su gzhon tshul/ dbus su 'bro seng dkar stod pa ye shes/ bla ma/ 'dis 'dam ko khyim btab pas ko khyim pa chen por grags/ sne po grags rgyal ni rong lho rtsa ba yin/ mkhar phug dang dmur 'dul gra bskyangs/ de'i slob ma sog tshul khrims bla ma yul lha ri rtsa brgyad pa yin/ lhan gyi ba so thang dang bye gling sogs bzung / glan tshul byang yul rgya ri mo can pa yin/ 'phan yul rgyal du bshad gra bskyangs/ slob ma rgyal ba g.yung drung dbang phyug go /spo chung yul g.yor po 'bum gling pa/ tsan thang ro skam/ka chu rnams bzung / slob ma myang mtshan pa rin chen bla ma/ de'i slob ma gam gsal ba'i snying po'o/ /rgya 'dul 'dzin chen po dbang phyug brtson 'grus ni yul nyang stod mdar ba yin/ chung ngu la yum 'das nas gnas gzhi bya rog 483

tshang du phyin pas gzugs byad la brnyas nas ma tshud/ dga' ba gdong du thal nyal byas nas klog bslabs/ mdo rtsa la klog dar byas pas gzhung zhar la zin te sog la 'dul ba bslabs/ gzhan yang sne glan spa gsum/ sog myang ke gsum ga dang bcas pa la sbyangs/ so bzhi nas brgyad bcu gya lnga'i bar dga' ba gdong dang chu mig lung du bzhugs nas 'dul gra bskyangs te gya lnga pa lcags phag la gshegs/ slob ma 'dar 'dul 'dzin/ mtha' bzhi brtson 'bar/ jo stan nag po dar tshul/ rma tsho byang chub rdo rje ste ka ba bzhi/ snar rgya tshul yom/ snang rgya rin tshul/ spyi ther pa rin tshul/ kha ru me ston/ 'dzims pa me ston/ 'dzims pa klog snying / ldog pa ye grags/ mnga' ris pa dpal 'byor shes rab/ smyal pa dar ma 'od zer sogs te gdung ma bcu rnams snga tshar yin/ bar tshar la skya bo tshul 'phags/ myang 'dul 'dzin/ phyi tshar la brag dmar rdo rje phur bu/ brda 'dul 'dzin sogs byon zhing gzhan yang skyi shod pa tshul 'phags dang bya 'dul sogs byon pa las 'dar gyis shab/ lca par/ ra sa/ bu dong sogs su bshad/ mtha' bzhis myang ro 'um phug bzung ste mkhas pa rin skyabs sogs byung / jo stan nag po dar tshul lo drug bcu la rab tu byung / klog yig bslabs/ sde sdod gsum dang khyad par 'dul ba la mkhas par gyur te yar klungs tsha rong dang lu gu dor bshad pas tsha rong par grags/ slob ma sha mi 'dul 'dzin sogs byung / sha mi la bu bzhi ste klubs dkar 'dul 'dzin jo stan pang tshul wa la ti jo sras thag ma rdor gzhon/klubs dkar gyis rgya dur pang tshul gyis yang dben btab ste lhag ru dang rtsibs dkar ba sogs yar lungs su 'dul gra mang du byung zhing g.yam bzang chos rjer grags pa snubs 'dul 'dzin dang grab mi dang ma tshul khrims kyang 'di'i mkhan bu yin/ wal tis skyor mo lung btab thag ma bas 'bri khung gi mkhan 484

po yang mdzad wal tis kyang thug slob ma thog ma ka chen rnal 'byor byang sing / gzhub ston ye shes sogs kyi byang seng gis 'phan yul gro sa btab ste phyis su'ang dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen dang dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen sogs kyis 'dul ba'i bshad pa'i srog bzung ngo / /byang seng gi slob ma ka ba ston nam gyis phya'i phur grags tshab btab/ ka chen las jog po dgon sar sogs dbur stod dang 'phan yul du 'dul gra du ma byung / wal ti dang klubs dkar gyi slob ma grab mi 'dul 'dzin/ de'i slob ma rgya ngur ba dar ma ye shes dang zangs chen pa dar ma bsod nams yin/ mkhan slob de gnyis kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa mtsho sna pa chen po ste lha ri sde snod 'dzin pa'i skye bar mtsho sna stod tu 'khrungs/ lo brgyad la nga'i bla ma'i drung du 'gro zer nas zangs chen pa'i drung du bros nas nga'i pha mas sleb par med pas rab tu 'byin par zhu zer nas rab tu phyung ste mtshan shes rab bzang por btags/ phyis rgya dung bas mkhan po byas te bsnyen par rdzogs/ gsung rab mtha' dag dang khyad par spyod pa'i phyogs sa sde yan lag dang bcas pa la 'di las mkhas pa bod du ma byung bar grags/ mnal lam du slob dpon yon tan 'od la 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ zhi ba'i lha la spyod 'jug dbyig gnyen la mdzod/ phyogs glang chos grags la tshad ma mdo dang rnam 'grel/ zla ba grags pa la gsang 'dus/ rje btsun byams pa la mngon rtogs rgyan gsan/ sgang thog dang gling chen phul nas bzhugs pa'i tshe mgon po traklud kyis khyed kyis 'dul ba'i 'grel pa mdzad par zhu/ de la thos bsam nyams len byed pa thams cad ngas bu bzhin du skyong zhes zhal gyis bzhes gnyos chen po'i gdan sar gra 'ong du bzhugs te 'dul ba'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer dang mdo rtsa'i mchan 'grel sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing /thig phyi ba rgyal sras bzang po/ mon khrub pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ sgu rab pa 485

gong ma chos rgyal bzang po/ sogs kha ba dge 'dun bzang pho/ khang gas nga steng pa bzang po rgyal mtshan/ ri steng pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/ mkhan chen chos skyabs dpal bzang sogs slob ma mang du byung / dgung lo don gnyis sbrul zla'i nyer drug la dge 'dun bsdus te rab byung rnams kyis bstan pa'i khur chen po bzhes dgos/ bstan pa'i khur bzhes na las 'bras khyad du ma gsad/bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar yin pas bslab pa rnams 'dul ba nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin srungs/ de'i steng nas nyin re la gso sbyong chag med byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa chag med du len zhing blo sbyong thun drug du sgom dgos/ de'i steng nas sde sgod gsum dang khyad par byang chub sems dpa'i spyod phyogs kyi gzhung a ti sha'i gdams pa rnams la thos bsam dang nyams len nyin mtshan 'da' bar 'bungs/ so thar dang byang sdom srung ba la pang pa'i mi 'dor ba lta bu'i gnyen po bsten/ de rnams ji lta bar bsgrubs na sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs/ nga la bla mar bzung ba yin/ nged rang chos par khas len pa rnams la 'jig rten gyi bya ba skad cig ma gcig kyang ma mngags so zhes yang yang gdams te sku 'das/ skyes bu dam pa 'dis ni phyi rabs su 'dul ba'i bstan pa mig phye ba ltar mdzad pa yin te 'dis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i bstan bcos rnams kyi drin las deng sang yang cha tsam gnas shing bstan pa ris med du tshad mar gyur pa yin la bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba kurma pa brgyad pa'i zhabs kyis kyang 'di'i yig cha tshad mar mdzad nas mdo rtsa'i ṭīka chen 'dul ba'i chu bo mtha' dag gcig tu 'du ba'i rgya mtsho 'di mdzad pa yin no/ /rma tsho byang rdor gyis rgya'i gra pa lnga brgya tsam khrid nas dbus su bshad/ de'i slob ma bya 'dul chen po brtson 'grus 'bar yin te gtsang rong gi g.yung du lcags lug la 'khrungs/ 'bre shes rab 'bar las rab tu byung /486

thog mar sog dang phyis rgya dang rma cho zla zur du byas pa la 'dul ba sbyangs/rgyal tsha zhang ye la dbu tshad/ zangs dkar lo tsā la yo ga stod lung pa la bka' gdams gsan/ zul phur 'dul gra bskyangs/ pe kur gyis ba tsun chung du sprul nas zhabs tog byas pas 'dul ba dang 'gal ba na bza'i spu phyir bstan pa gcig las ma mthong bas dad de bya ṭīkri 'dzin pa rnams la grogs byed par zhus/ phag gru pa'i dge slong gi mkhan po mdzad/ lo dgur tshogs pa bskyangs nas mthar sgrub pa snying por mdzad de don drug pa la zul phur gshegs/ slob ma 'gro don nus pa don drug tsam byung / de las rtsibs pa gzhon sang gis nyang stod mkhar lung du 'dul gra bskyangs/ dbon po chos dbang la sogs pa tshar rtsibs pa'i mkhan bu dpal ldan gros kyis snar thang bzung / ba phyar stod nag gis lhas mo che/ stag tshal/ smon gro rang mkhar phug sogs su bshad/de'i slob ma mnga' ris dgra bcom gyis pa gro brag nag dang zam tsher btab/de'i slob ma mchims nam mkha' grags dang gyang mo che ba sogs brgyad byung /gyang mo che ba la seng ge zil gnon gyis thug gtsang rong ba lce 'dul 'dzin gyis dur mig la sogs par bshad/ dpal chen ye shes g.yung drung dang de'i slob ma gnyan ston dga' ba gdong pa sogs byung / sangs rgyas gzhung pa/ar dge ba/ ri zan rdog pa/ nags mo ba/ bkra shis sgang pa sogs kyang zul phu'i yan lag go bya 'dul gyi snag dpon rog chos dbang gis zul phu'i gdan sa mdzad/ de nas chos byang na za phreng gsol/ 'di la byang rdor gnyis kyis 'dul ba nyan zhing / 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dge tshul gyi slob dpon yin/ de'i slob ma chos kyi brtson 'grus/ de'i slob ma chos grags rin/chen dpal ste gnyis gas gdan sa bskyangs/ de'i slob ma ka bzhi pa/ de'i slob ma bsod nams grags pa dang grub pa dpal/ de gnyis la bu rin po ches 'dul 487

no/ba gsan no/ /rgya'i bar tshar skye bo tshul 'phags kyi bu che 'dar tshul khrims rgyal po/ de nas rim bzhin stod tshul khrims 'bum/ )lteng pa blo gros grags/rgyal tshul khrims grags/ sne mo ba grags pa smon lam/ nel pa paṇa chen sogs nil pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa byung / phyi tshar brag dmar rdo rje phur bu la stod pa dharma zhes grags pa des grom pa brag dmar du bshad pa'i slob ma zhang zhi mdzes sogs byung / brda 'dul gyi slob ma bshes gnyen shākra grub dang brda 'dul phyi mas shab stod sogs su bshad/ chu mig gi rngog btsun dkar mos zhus nas chu mig sde skor gyi mkhan po mdzad/ brda'i slob ma skyi ma grags tshul gyis drang po lung / chag nyi mas shangs sreg shing / mtha' ston gyis myang ro bla ring du gra bskyangs/ shākya grub kyis brda'i gdan sa mdzad pa la klog skya dpal 'byor gyis gsan nas don mo rir bshad/ slob ma skyel nag zhang sher 'od/ dbon po khri brtan seng ge shā rdor dang bzhi byung / phyis shes rab 'od kyis gdan sa mdzad de chu mig 'dul gra ba rnams byung / yang kha che paṇa ched gyis snar klas mo cher dbyar gnas mdzad/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud gsungs pa la seng ge zil gnon dang shangs pa jo stan gyis gsan nas so sor ṭīka mdzad/ seng ge zil gnon la/ madma'i skyes bu/ de la bu rin po ches gsan te gling 'bum ṭīka chen sogs mdzad do/ /'dul ba me tog phreng brgyus 'di la phyis kun mkhyen rong po sogs kyis dgra bcom pas brtsams pa dang tshigs bcad bzang por yod pa dang gleng gzhi rtsa bas zin pa ste khyad chos gsum yod ces rtsal du bton yang dgra bcom pa las byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa rgya che ba'i rten 'brel gyis da dung mdo rtsa kho na dar ro/ /paṇa chen sdom rgyun ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba tshul khrims shes rab rnam thos sras bran du 'khol ba des kha che bsod stoms pa spyan drangs te/ paṇa chen de ni nub phyogs kha 488

che'i yul khri brtan gyi grong pra wa su rar yab rgya mtsho'i ded dpon dzam nag grub pa sam ka ya'i sras gu/ 'khrungs/ mtshan dza sho dha rar btags/ lo bcu nas sgra tshad gzo gso mtha' dag la sbyangs te gzhan lugs tshar bcad nas rgyal pos cod pan bcings/ dgung lo nyer gsum la rab tu byung tshe rnal lam na byang chub kyi shing lo spyi bor spungs te byung / rab tu byung ma thag byang chub chen po dang byams pa dang sgrol ma gsum la byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pas zhag re la chos spyod bcu ma chag par byed pa/ nor rdzas ci yang bdag du mi 'dzin pa/gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa/ rkyen ci byung yang thabs gzhan mi 'tshol bar pha rol tu phyin pa'i don sgom pa ste bzhi'i dam bca' mdzad/ byams pas shar phyogs su song la rig pa mthar phyin par gyis shig par lung bstan/ zhi 'byung sbas pa dang dbyangs snyan dang blo sbas sogs bsten nas gsung rab thams cad sbyangs te dbyig gnyen ltar til mar gyis zangs bkang bar sku dpyings te zhag du mar 'bum sde du ma zhal thon mdzad/ phar phyin gsan pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i tshe mdun gyi sprin phung las stong nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa gsan te ting nge 'dzin mi mtshams pa dpag med skyes/ sum bcu pa la mkhan po zhi 'byung sbas pa sogs bco brgyad kyi tshogs las bsnyen par rdzogs te stan gcig dang bsod stoms pa'i sbyangs yon bzung / paṇa chen de wa putram̐s rdo rje'i theg par smin grol du mdzad de bde mchog dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bstan/ tsardona'i nags su 'jam dbyangs dang rta mgrin dang sgrol ma'i gsung thos/ sangs rgyas rim gro pa zung dang bcas pas klu'i rgyal po la bsod stoms mdzad pa dang byams pa la rgyal po dge dbang gis bsil yab g.yob pa gzigs shing chos bdun gsan/mar me'i rtser byams pa dang sgrol ma dang thub dbang gzigs/ rdo rje gdan du mchod pa mdzad pa las spos sprin gyi dud pa sprin du 'khrigs pas zhag bdun du 429

(nam mkha' khyab pa las glog dang zung 'jug sgrub pa'i chosnyokyi sa byung zhing ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyes/ ri mo'i bud med kyis 'o ma'i bsod stoms phul ba 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa sbrang rtsi lta bu'i bdud rtsir gyur pa dang / 'brog pas 'o ma'i bsod stoms phul ba'i7bris ma la bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad shar/ wa ra ṇa si'i gnas su sangs rgyas ngang pa'i gzugs kyis ma he la gnas pa zhig gis/ sgyu ma lta bur gzung don med/ /rmi lam lta bur 'dzin don med/ /tshogs gnyis dbyer med lam gyi mchog /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /zhes gsungs pa gsan te sems skyed kyang zhus/ byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs chen yang gzigs/ chos de dag rang gi khrag gis pags pa la bris te sgod ldan la bsgrags/ nyi sbas dang zla sbas la byams chos gsan pas theg pa sna tshogs kyi don dgongs/ byams pa las rnam kun gyi skabs kyi chos bdun gsan/'jam dbyangs rta mgrin sgrol ma gsum rang rang gi rtsa sngags zla ba gsan/ wa ra ṇa si'i 'dam bu'i khrod na rten byin rlabs can zhig yod pa mjal bas des dngos su chos gsungs/ de'i tshe lngas rtsen gyi bus glu blangs shing rnga brdungs/oryanta bu rir byang chub chen pos zhal 'dzum pa dang sgrol mas mchod rdzas dngos su bzhes/ mu stegs pa dang rtsod tshe nyin mo rtsod lan ma thebs pa mnal lam du sgrol mas lung bstan nas rgyal/ rtsod pa las rgyal ba'i yon rgyal pos phul ba rnams las rten khyad par can gsum bzhengs/ mchod rten mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can la gdugs sus 'khel ba kun gyis bla mar 'dzin pa las khro gnyer can gyis byin gyis brlabs pas bya rog gis grogs byas te chos rjes 'khel/ lus kyi bya ba re/ ngag gis gzhung rtsom pa/ yid kyis dri ba dgu'i don sems pa rnams dus der nus pas yongs su grags pa'i paṇa chen du gyur/bee kra mar dbang bskur mdzad pa na bum chu bdud rtsir gyur pas bum pa gang ba 490

nyin phyed du longs spyad pas ma zad/ rgya nag gi rgyal po'i pho nyas spyan drangs tshe dge slong dkar zhing dul ba zhig gis da lta 'gro ba'i dus ma yin ma 'ongs pa na song zhig zhes bstan/ kha cher grogs po cag gis grang ba'i tshe bsod stoms mdzad pa 'o brgyal/ 'tsho ba ngas 'bul zer ba na sgrol mas khyod sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi 'dzin nam gsungs pas bsod stoms mdzad/ tho rengs kyi brda sgras rkyen te dga' ldan gyi gnas gzigs shing byams pa las dad pa snying rje shes rab brtson 'grus te chos bzhi gsan/ rdo rje gdan du cung zad bsnyungs nas gzims pa na don zhags dkar po phyag brgyad pa la sgrol ma khro gnyer can rta mgrin nor bzang rnams kyis bskor ba gzims pa cig gzigs/ bzhengs pa na de rnams kyang bzhengs par gzigs nas sgrub thabs mdzad pa ni don zhags kha che mar grags/ rdo rje gdan la rgyal po bha mi de wa'i dmag yong zer nas bltar byon nas rgyang grags tsam du bsod stoms mdzad nas phyir log tshe ma hā bo dhi mdun na byon 'dug lhung bzed bzhag la phyag bya snyam pa na de phyi 'gros kyis je ring la song / phyi bzhin byon pas byang chub chen po'i spyan sngar slebs/ slar byon pas nags na'ang snga ma bzhin 'dug ste mtshan nyid ni mi shes gsungs/ de'i tshe ri bya rkang la grub thob mang du yod pa dang siṅgha gling na dgra bcom pa bzhugs pa la rgyal pos bsnyen bkur mang du skyel ba na de dag tshig mthun par nged la thag ring du bsnyen bkur ba bas khyed rang gi ma ga dha na paṇa chen shākya shrī bya ba ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rab gsal bzhugs pa la bsnyen bkur ba bsod nams che zhes bskul zhing o rgyan nas mkha' 'gro mas kyang lung bstan/ rgyal po sogs thams cad kyis gtsug gi nor bur bskur/ ma ga dhar bzlas sgom byas la tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya dgos snyam pa na mnal lam du mi thob ces byung / yang yang gsol ba btab pas da 491

lta'i spyod pa 'di dor nas bsgrubs na 'grub ces byung gsungs te spyod pa 'di las lhag pa mchis sam zhus pas 'di kun gzhan dang bstun pa'i tsab tsub tsam yin/ sngags kyi spyod pa khyad par can mang gsungs/ dza yan gar rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad pa na mnal lam du sgrol mas phyag g.yas brkyangs pa'i mthil na gser dang dngul dang beeḍūrya'i yi ge tī gsum snang ba byin nas rgyal po'i 'khor longs spyod pas 'di dga' ba yin no go'am gsung bas mchod gnas bor te 'on kyang rgyal pos nan gyis zhus pas sa phyogs der bzhugs/gar log gi dmag gis yul dbus brlag tshe rje btsun mas rigs kyi bu khyod shar phyogs su song zhig gsungs te byon/ 'jigs pa che zhing lam ma shes pa na nyin mo mi dkar po cig dang mtshan rma bud med dmar mo res sna drangs/ ma hā kā las dge bsnyen nag po cig tu byas te mar me bteg skar ma pa wa sangs kyis me tog gtor zhing lam mtshon nas tshegs med par btol/ dza ga dha lar bsod stoms dka' bar byung tshe rig 'dzin gyi lha mo bzhis gdugs tshod drangs pa rmi ba nas rnyed sla bar byung / de ltar rgya gar byang phyogs su phebs pa bod du khro phu lo tsā ba chen pos gsan nas shing pho byi ba khra zla'i bco lnga la gdan 'dren du 'byon par chas pa'i phyi nub paṇa chen dza ga bi har na bzhugs tshe mchod rten gyi rtse nas lha'i bu gsum 'ongs te dang pos gtsug gi nor bu phul nas/ kho bo ni gtsug tor can bya ba mi yul gyi chos pa rnams la phan 'dogs pa yin zer yang kho bo bsod stoms pa yin pas nor bu mi 'dod gsungs te ma bzhes/ yar lungs jo bo'i chos byung na 'di la sangs rgyas gtsug tor can zhes 'khrul snang / gnyis pas gser gyi me tog gsum phul te kho bo gser mdog can bya ba rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i lha'i bu thams cad la phan 'dogs pa yin zer te blangs nas dkon mchog gsum la re re phul/ gsum 492

pas kho bo rnam thos)kyi bu zhes bya ba lha mi dge ba su byed kyi grogs byed pa yin zer ste 'bras chen lhung bzed gang bsod stoms su phul/ gsum gas mgrin gcig du byang phyogs kha ba can yi dwags chos 'dzin gyi yul du byams pa'i sku tshad bzheng pa'i grogs la 'byon par zhu zer/ sku ji lta bu dris pas 'di 'dra zhig yin te phyag mgo zhabs mgo las mtshar zer te lder tsho chen po zhig bstan/ byams chen gyi sku'i spar gyi phyag zhabs kyi mgo byas pa'i skabs su 'dug lder tsho de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas 'jig rten snang bar byas te 'di la 'brel pa bzhag tshad byams pa'i bstan pa la 'khor ba las 'thar zer ba'i sgra gsan/ sgrol mas kyang byang phyogs su song zhig par lung bstan te byang phyogs nas spyan 'dren do gal can yod pas 'gro gsungs te tshong 'dus la dru bar byon nas zla ba phyed bsgugs/ 'khor rnams skyo nas ldog par rtsom pa na da dung zhag gsum sdod cig gsungs/ lo tsā ba chen pos mon gyi lam rnams su tsha grang gcan gzan du ma be to ma sogs kyi 'jigs pa dang lam 'khyams pa sogs kyi dka' ba cher spyad nas gro mo'i gting rgya gar byang gi beeḍūr tshong 'dus su bzhugs/ spyan 'dren pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa la yul gru shin tu che yang dkon mchog gi rten ma rnyed nas gnas khang gi khyams na byis pa'i rtsed mo byed sa ston pa'i 'byim sku cig dang shing gi mchod rten zhig 'dug pa la mchod pa byas gsol ba btab ste sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya'i bstan la shākya'i sras bltams shākya'i mtshan/ /lnga rig gtsug nor dri med brtul zhugs brtan po 'dzin/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid ngo mtshar chos bzhis khyad 'phags gang / /paṇa chen dam pas bdag sogs rjes 'dzin skyong gyur cig /ring zhig dus nas khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /rab dad dga' skyes spu ldang mchi ma 'khrug 'gyur ba/ /rigs ldan bu zhig 493

gangs can khrod nas nyin mtshan du/ /thal sbyar spyis 'dud gdung bas gsol 'debs mkhyen par mdzod/ /ma ga dha sogs rig /3byung gnas ni sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcom au rgyan kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khebs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs skyod zhu/ /sems pa gzhan btang khyod la yid byed gcig pu yis//cir yang ma chags dka' ba du ma khyad bsad cing / /'dod pa'i yul spangs bshul ring bgrod dka'i lam zhugs te/ /ngal brgyas mchis so re ba ma lus mchis par mdzod/ /rgyal sras khyed la don 'gyur gdul bya rjes 'dzin las/ /gzhan lta ci mchis nus yod bzhin yang byams pa'i phas/ /bsad sar bu khrid ci dgar yal dor 'drar gyur na/ /kye ma khyed thabs thugs rje gang lags bdag la gsungs/ /zhes pa'i zhu yig sam kṛ tar bris gser gyi sher snying bod yig ma gcig dang mi nyag bha'i dar chen gyi na bza' zung ju zab kyi bla res bzang po dang bcas kha che'i paṇa chung la sogs pa bzhi mngags/ chos rje la dru bar zhag gsum 'then pa'i phyi nyin 'khor rnams phyir 'gro ba'i chas byed pa'i tshe pho nya ba bzhis slebs te zhu yig phul/ chos rjes paṇa chung dgu po la bka' bgros pa na gnas skabs 'di 'dra bdag cag gis ga la shes chos rje nyid mkhyen par zad do zer sgrol ma la zhu'o gsungs nas zhag lngar mtshams mdzad/ltas bzang po byung nas 'byon par dgongs tshe dza gaddhā la'i gnas brtan chen po gnyis kyis dge 'dun stong phrag gsum khrid rgya gar na ngo chen gal can la rten gdan 'dren pas klu sgrub kying rab gnas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po dang paṇa chen gye thugs dam yin pas sgrol ma'i sku yang dgos zer nas tsand+ra go mi tar spyan drangs pa slebs/ chos rjes kyang lugs bzhin gsu ba dang 'dud pa mdzad/paṇa chung gis dkon gnyer la gsud byin te sgrol ma zhal phyir bsgyur shing rta'i 494

gzer lcag 'on kyang rten gyi ngo chen la mi nyan pa'i srol med nas re zhig phyir byon/ lo tsā bas de mnal lam du mkhyen nas rnam sras gnad la bor/ chos rje zhag kha cig byon nas zhag bdun du skor mchod mdzad kyang thugs ma phebs/mnal lam du lha gsum po des rtag tu bskul/ rje btsun mas dge 'dun ni nor 'dod kyi chos mi 'dod pas mgron bus tshim/ nga'i gzugs ni khros nas kha phyir log thugs rje chen po'i sku'ang shing rta'i gzer chag ste zhabs gong por song / 'dir ci byed byang phyogs su song zhig song zhig gsung bas slar dge 'dun la zhus te phyir chas tshe lo tsā ba'i mnal lam du rnal 'byor skyid kyi ming pos yi ge zhig phul ba gzigs pas dge slong bee shu wa ṇas springs pa da ste zhag bcu gsum na byams pa shākya shrī 'byon par yod te der ma 'dug par sngon du ldang ba byed pa la grong khyer ka ru khor shog bya ba 'dug yi ge rgya yig tu 'dug pa bklags pas bod yig tu song / sang ste dgyes ches nas te te brdungs pas zhabs la chu 'brum gan ṭā ba zug can gyis bzhengs mi mkhyen pa yod kyang zhar la rdol bas gzhi med du dwangs/ dga' ston gyi dril sgrogs pa la tshogs chen por byed pas paṇa chung ba gnyis sngon la 'ongs pa rkang pa na nas mnal lam gyi dus nyid la rnal 'byor skyid kyi ming pos bka' shog khyer te phul ba bsgyur bas/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs rgyud gnas bde gshegs bstan pa'i sgron 'dzin pa/ /ma lus 'gro dpal bya dka'i rgyal sras spyad pa spyod/ /dge slong mkhas pa khro phu lo tsār rab grags gang / /byams chen 'phrin las yid bzhin nor ltar 'grub gyur cig /dge slong bsod stoms pa shākya dpal bzang pos khro phu lo tsā ba la thugs dgyes pa'i sgo nas shis pa brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa dang byang chub shing lo 'dab ga gsum sha khar phul gang bskur 'dug lo tsā ba dang mjal tshe lo tsā ba ngadmekhyen rtogs 495

mtha' dag rdzogs zin yang dgung lo so gsum pa spyir sku mdzes shing gzhon sha ches chags pa'i na tshod gzigs pas 'di btsun chung lta bu zhig 'dug pas chos sgyur mi nus sam lha yang bzheng thub ste mi 'ong kho rang la sems skyed dang yi dam zhig byin nas phyir ldog par bya'o zhes gsungs tshe paṇa chung des khyed kyi na tshod la brnyas par 'dug pas rang gi yon tan ston zer nas bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang su ga ta shrī sogs paṇa chung dgu la rang gang la mkhas zer ba'i sgra tshad sde snod mdo sngags la dri ba gsum gsum mdzad pas gung tshigs snga ba nas nam phyed 'das par song / chos rje'i thugs dam nar ma rnams chu tshod so so'i dus las thugs brel cis kyang 'dar med na'ang ji mi snyam par gsan zhing 'di lta bu'i chos thos pa bsod nams che gsung zhing paṇa chen dpon slob thams cad ha las te bod la 'di lta bu'i chos smra ba 'ong ba ngo mtshar che/ 'di'i mdun na lo tsā ba gzhan rnams dig par 'dug gsung zhing mtshan yang ma hā lo tsā ba 'ba' zhig nas brjod/ de phyin lo tsā ba byon pa'i tshe paṇa chung dgu po langs nas rgyang ring por bkyed/ thal mo sbyar te ma hā paṭi ta ma hā lo tsā ba pha la pha la zhes phan tshun rig rig por blta skad/ chos rje yang thugs bteg ches pas sang rang 'gro gsung ba na bstan bcos shig gi thugs rtsom zhus/ rgyal phran zhig la lam dka' ba'i thabs 'phrul gyis thugs ngang bsrings/ paṇa chen thugs rje che bas mgon med mang po sku la 'khor ba sogs sku 'khor phal cher la mdo li dgos pa dang mdo li mi thar ba'i sa la 'dzeg ru bsgyur dgos pa sogs gzhan gyis lo zlar sgrub mi nus pa rnams lo tsā bas bde blag du bsgrubs/de ltar lo tsā ba chen po yon tan brjod par dka' ba de'i dad pa dang mkhyen pa dang nus pas paṇa chen dbang du 'dus pa ltar gyur te ci bzhed par bod du spyan drangs nas chos mang du bskyur/ gtsang dbus sto brag gnyal byar rnams 496

su bsdoms par lo bcu tsam bzhugs/ dpyal lo zhang lo sa lo chag lo sogs lo tsā ba mang du phyags phyir yod kyang khro lo kho na dang zla med pa'i lo paṇa zung gcig mdzad de bab ma yas kyi yu 'bog chos khri sogs la lo paṇa bsgrigs nas chos gsungs/ 'bul ba mtha' yas pa byung ba thams cad khro phu'i byams chen kho na'i rgyur phul/ byams chen zangs gser las grub pa khru brgyad bcu ba pho brang dang bcas pa grub nas rab gnas la phyogs pa'i tshe dgra bcom pas bsrung ba'i me tog dang ring bsrel kha phye nas de'i lo rgyus paṇa chen ji ltar gsung ba lo tsā bas bsgyur pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum par 'gyur nges pa chos rje paṇa chen shākya shrī'i mtshe mar gyur pa'i mched zla kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po budhe tsand+ra/sangs rgyas zla ba)zhes bya bas dzasbu'i gling gi gling phran siṅgha la (saddhi gling pa)dī pa zhes bya ba sngon srin mo gnas pa'i gling phran zhig jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sprul pa rta'i rgyal sdo bā la ha (stobs chen)zhes pa'i 'phrin las kyis btul nas da lta nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i gnas su gyur yod pas der ratna tsundha ma ṇi spa ra na (rin chen gtsug gi nor bu 'phro ba )zhes bya ba'i pho brang na dgra bcom pa dngos su bzhugs so zhes bya ba thos nas kha che grib brtan gyi pra wa su ra (rab mchog )zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang nas dpal rdo rje gdan du brgyud de ma hā bo dhi la mchod pa phul nas dka' ba du ma spyad de sidha gling gi dgra bcom pa'i zhal yang bltas dgra bcom pa yin nam ma yin gtan la 'bebs pa'i brtag dpyad mang du byar yod pa legs par byas nas yid 'ches te de nyid tu dbyar zla ba gsum tshul du zhugs so/ /dgag dbye thon nas ljongs rgyu ba'i dus su dgra bcom pa de nyid kyis de bzhin gsheg pa'i ring bsrel yod pa ba so'i za ma tog phra rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa zhig dang me tog padma dkar po lnga kha che'i paṇḍi ta de la 497

gtad nas ring bsrel gyi za ma tog 'di dang ze'u 'bru yod pa'i me tog thog ma kho nar dge slong shākya shrī bha dra la phul/ me tog lhag ma bzhi po 'di khyed kyi lhung bzed du khyer la khyed rang gi mched zla ka smi ra pa (kha che ba )de'i phyag tu re zhig gtod cig de ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun pa yin pas bsod stoms sam yon cung zad phul na 'bras bu dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /siṅgha gling gi dge slong pi ha ra ga sa ('dod chags dang bral ba kun nas 'byung gnas sbas pa) manta kā ra gupta zhes bya bas bskur ro khri ma ku sha la(sku khams bzang ngam)smros shig de nas me tog gcig byang phyogs gangs can gyi yul du tī bha ṣi mi thu shri (skad gnyis smra ba byams dpal )zhes bya ba zhig 'byung bar 'gyur la de paspyi ta'i slob mar 'gyur te de la paṇḍi ta chen pos byin la sa twa thika ra(sems can gyi don gyis shig)zhes smros shig de nas me tog gcig bod yul gyi 'bri zhes bya bar dhu yi/ bi kṣu radha shri (sgom pa'i dge slong rin chen dpal/)bya bas parnyi ta la nor dang na bza' mang po 'bul du 'ong ste der spron yang ma gshegs par skyes lan chos kyi tshigs su bcad pa gcig dang me tog padma zhig skur zhig de ni thub pa chen po 'das nas lo bzhi brgya na byung ba'i 'phags pa klu sgrub bstan pa bsnyigs shing yang bsnyigs su gyur pa na 'gro ba ma rung pa gzhan gyis gtan 'dul bar mi nus pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du byon pa yin pas de'i chos ston pa por khyed cag mi dgos par shes par gyis byug ces smros shig de nas bod yul dbus kyi ratna ku ṭi(rin chen byung ba )zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang nas dhya yi paṇḍi ta zhig gis 'khor dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur rnam pa du ma byas nas spyan 'dren du 'ong bas de ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba yin/ de la me tog 'di phul la dbyar gnas pas theg pa che chung gi chos mang du ston zhig paṇḍi ta rang gi lo grangs dang mnyam pas phyir mi ldog pa 'thob par 498

'gyur ro/ /de nas paṇḍi ta chen po de dang de'i slob ma nor bzang zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'gro ba ma bsgral ba'i lhag ma rnam sa sgrol ba'i don du sangs rgyas mi pham pa'i sku tshad gzhengs du gsol nas de'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa zhag bcu gsum gyi bar du byed par 'gyur zhing lha'i ris bcu gsum gyis kyang mchod pa'i ris bcu gsum byed par 'gyur bas de'i dang por me tog 'di dbu la zhog cig me tog lnga po 'di yang zas kyi bya ba nam byed pa'i tshe ring bsrel gyi za ma tog 'dir chug la mchod pa dang ma bral ba gyis/ me tog de rnams rang rang gi mchod pa ji srid ma tshar ba'i bar de srid brnyings pa dang stor ba la sogs par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs yod do zhes gsung ngo / /de nas kha che paṇḍitas lhung bzed du me tog dang za ma tog bcug nas siṅgha gling nas dzasbu'i gling du 'ongs te yang dbus 'gyur tshal gyi byang chub chen po ma hā bo dhi la gtang rag gi phyag 'tshal du byon pa'i tshe ma hā bo dhi'i pho brang gi them skas la 'dzegs pa dang chos rje paṇa chen ma hā bo dhi la phyag 'tshal nas phyir gshegs pa'i don du rdo rje'i them skas la 'bab pa dang lhan cig 'dzom par gyur nas them skas de nyid kyi steng du sngar gyi gsung gleng rgyas par mdzad de phan tshun gnyis ka gshegs bzhud mdzad do/ /gtam rgyud 'di dag ni khro phu'i gtsug lag khang chen po dga' ldan gyi pho brang du khru brgyad bcu pa'i byams chen mgon po mthar phyin nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su gdams ngag dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs shing za ma tog kha phye bas ring bsrel gcig las lngar 'phel 'dug gsungs nas za ma tog ring bsrel gsum dang ba/cas pa lo tsā ba la gnang / dung chung g.yas su 'khyil ba gsum gyis brgyan te byams chen gyi thugs /ra bzhugs/ ring bsrel gcig chos rje nyid kyis tshags mdzad/ gcig lo tsā ba la srung ba'i rten du dgra bcom pas bskur ba'i me tog 499

dang lhan cig dus de nyid du gnang / de nas dgra bcom pas sngar bskur ba'i me tog dkar po de byams chen gyi dbu la bzhag de nyid kyi nang par nas chu pho spre'u 'i lo bre'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum la rab gnas chen po mdzad do/ /zhes byung la sku de ni byams pa dngos su bzhugs pa yin no/ /me tog padma spyi la ze'u 'bru'i tshab tu 'dab ma brgyad chung ngu lte ba sbubs can dang yu ba shin tu mnyen zhing 'bol ba chu nang du 'gyel ba zhig las mi 'byung bas padma ze'u 'bru can dang sdong po can ches dkon pas na ze'u 'bru can mchog tu byas pa'o/ /byams chen gyi don du dgun la chen po sogs la shin tu grang ba na yang 'o brgyal zhus pa na sku 'o brgyal thugs 'o brgyal ba med gsungs/ slas po cher bzhugs dus sgrol ma'i bris sku gcig gis khyed skye ba mang po'i gong du paṇḍi ta cig dang bgro gleng byas pas khyod rgyal rung zhig byung nas de la ngan smras mang po byas/de yul shin tu gnyan pa cig yin pas de'i rgyus skye ba mang por tshig rtsub dang khro ba byung ba yin gsungs/ de'i rgyu mthun sbyang phyir gnyen po drag po bsten pa yin yang tshig rtsub bag tsam da dung 'chor bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i tshe dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i 'jig rten gyi chags lugs lam pa cig gzigs/ srin por ri rab gnas cig gi sbyin sreg gi tshe sreg rdzas g.yon pas phul zer ba byung / chos zab mo gsung ba'am sngags bzla ba'am dben par gnas pa'i dus 'jam dpal thugs rje chen po byams pa byang chub chen po tsho'i snang ba shar nas 'ong de'i tshe mi gzhan ma 'ongs na ma bde ba'i chos kun drir btub par 'dug gsungs/ de dag la sogs dag snang dang yon tan bag tsam 'char ba 'dug ste mi la bsgrags na sdig gsog cing g.yeng bar 'gro gsungs/ da lta thugs dam ji ltar mdzad zhus pas/ nga dang por skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas/ skad cig gis lhar gsal 'debs/ de nas byams snying rje gtso bor byas nas yan 500

lag bdun pa byed/ de nas 'khor lo bde mchog la yi dam du byas te skyed rdzogs zung du chud tsam yod/ de nas bla ma la maskyel phul nas sgrol ma'i rtsa sngags bzlas pas yi dam lha'i dag snang 'char te de la dri rgyu yod/ de nas dzi la'i chu sbyin byed/ byams pa'am yum chen mo'i nga rgyal gyis sems skyed gsol ba btab ste sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa bya snyam pa'i don zhig sgom/nyi ma dros nas 'dul ba'i bsod stoms byed/ de nas thun gsum gong ltar byas te spyir thun bzhir sgom/ gnyid bro tsam na thib thib pa dang lha'i snang ba gnyis 'dres mar 'ong zhing gnyid tshe dus 'khor gyi rmi lam gyis gdams pa cig gis dus 'dar 'jug dge sbyor gyi mjug tu bzang spyod dang dgyes rdor smon lam bdun bcu pa 'debs shing smon lam gal che gsungs/ 'bri khung pa la lus kyis ma mjal ba'i dod por yid kyis yang yang mjal lo gsungs/ mdor na bod du lo bcu bzhugs te mthar kusmir don chen po gsungs nas sus kyang gshol ma thebs te kha cher thegs nas der bstan pa gzhi bzhengs su gtad nas lo bcu gsum na yul thams cad 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char gyis khyab pa'i ltas dang bcas dga' ldan du gshegs/ gdung bzhu ba'i tshe nam mkha' las lha'i rol mo dang bde mchog gi lha tshogs dang sil snyan bdun pa'i tshigs bcad 'di byung ste/ gcig gis ma tshad lo brgya'i dus/ /bya lo'i dkar phyogs zla ba ni//spen pa'i nyi ma'i tshes lnga la/ /'gro ba'i nyi ma nub par bstan/ /kye ho tshur gshegs tshur gshegs longs/ /ma 'jigs dpa' bo chen po kye/ /'chi ba rnam rtog tsam yin no/ /zhes bya mkha' la sgra chen sgrogs/ /rab mdzes rnam mang gzhal yas nas/ /thod pa'i dum skyes ma la sogs/ /thal sbyar gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs/ /gzhan dag sna tshogs rol mo byed/ /bstod bkur bsngags dang glu rnams len/ /gang na dpal ldan bde mchog che/ /sku bzhi'i 501

rgyal po bla na med/ /mthong zhing thos la mngon gyur stos/ /'jig rten khams kyi dbang phyug po/ /rang gi tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas/ /lha dang dri za klu dbang rnams/ /'ongs te mchod pa'i sprin tshogs gtibs/ /lha yi me tog char bab cing / /dri zhim sgra snyan lha mo dang / /klu mo gzhon nur bcas rnams der/ /mchi ma 'byin zhing mchod pa byed/ /de tshe sa dag rnam drug g.yos/ /brgya phrag gnyis bcas paṇḍi tas/ /mthun par mkha' las chos sgra 'di/ /thos nas ting 'dzin mchog reg gyur/ /zhes grags pa paṇḍi ta nyis brgyas mgrin gcig du thos shing ting 'dzin skyes/ so sos yi ger bris te phyis lo tsā ba chen pos chos rjes sngon nas nga 'das pa'i 'og tu bod na rje btsun byams chen bzhugs par nga'i rus pa dang ring bsrel rnams chug ma hā lo tsā bas mchod rten grub kyang legs so zhes pa'i phyag bris bkod de paṇḍi ta su bha ma shrī ('jug rogs dpal)dang tri lo kyā narta(srid gsum kun dga') gnyis la yi ge 'di dang nga'i rus pa ma hā lo tsā ba la bod du skyol zhig ces bka' bab nas dbu'i gdung dang ring bsrel paṇḍi ta gnyis kyis bka' bzhin ma hā lo tsā ba la phul te mchod rten chen po mdzad do/ /paṇa chen 'di lcags sprel 'khrungs pa'i re lnga la bod du phebs par grags kyang sil snyan 'dun pa nyid yid 'ches kyi gnas yin pas me lug la 'khrungs/ don brgyad pa shing byi la bod du phebs/gya bdun pa chu bya la kha cher byon/ go dgu pa shing bya la dga' ldan du gshegs pa yin no/ /deng sang paṇa chen 'di'i mtshan la bsten nas 'tsho zhing rgyud 'dzin du khas 'che ba rnams la'ang lo paṇa 'di gnyis kyi chos dang rnam thar gang gi'ang rgyus mi snang zhing spyir yang paṇa chen gyi rnam thar deng sang grags cher mi snang bas ma hā lo tsā ba'i dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing dang / khro dpyal gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar thor bu mkhas pa bsod namang dpal gyis bsdus pa las 502

rang gzo med par mdor bsdus pa yin ro/ /paṇa chen de'i slob ma rgya bod na mtha' yas kyang 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun ni paṇa chen dbus su phebs dus chu shul phrog ma dgon par mi bcu gcig gis bsnyen rdzogs nyin gcig la bsgrubs pa'i nang nas gru shul 'khor gang byang chub dpal dang gtsang pa rdo rje dpal gnyis kyis phyags phyir 'gro bar zhus pas zul phu'i na bza' 'phred gsol la 'dul ba nyon la shog gsungs nas 'dul ba bslabs/ paṇa chen gyi bla mchod jo bo stan gcig pa gtsang so ba bsod nams mdzes kyi phyags phyir bzhag 'di ni paṇa chen bod du phebs pa'i lam du la stod pa'i stan gcig pa bzang po cig gis bdag gis bsnyen par rdzogs nas lhung bas skad cig kyang ma gos par bgyis bdog pas de byang chub tu bsngo bar zhu zhus pas paṇa chen phyag thal mo sbyar te dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa bsngo rgyu bzang khyed nga'i mchod gnas su bzhugs par zhu gsungs nas mchod gnas kyi gtso bo mdzad pa de yin/ paṇa chen rgya gar la thegs dus byang rdor gyis phyags phyir 'gro bar zhus pas rgya gar du tshad pa mi thub/ bod du gtsang so ba la bsten la 'dul ba shod/ dge slong bzhi sde re dang ma bral ba gyis gsungs/ de ltar mdzad/ gtsang so ba gshegs nas slob ma so sor bskyangs pas mkhan po rdo rje dpal gyi rjes su sangs rgyas dpal/'od zer dpal/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sangs rin/ bsod nams dpal/shes rab mgon po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dbang phyug bkras tshul ba sogs te snye mo tsha mig tu bzhugs pas tsha mig tshogs pa zer la phyis tshogs chen par grags/ mkhan po seng rgyal yan gyi nang rten yang zul phur bskyal lo/ /mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal gyi grogs mched gzhu pa dkon mchog bzang pos tshogs bskyangs te gzhu'i bye rdzing du bzhugs/ de nas thugs rje dpal/ dar ma dpal/ kun dga' dpal/ tshul khrims dpal/ sangs gzhon/ dar ma ོ 503

bzang po/ tshul khrims mgon/ bsod nams 'od zer/ rin chen tshul khrims/bsod nams shes rab/ shes rab mgon po la sogs pa ste bye rdzing pa'o/ /mkhan po byang chub dpal sa skya ba 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i mkhan po la gong du gdan 'dren byung bas gtsang pa dbang phyug grags gdan sar bskos te hor yul la byon pas 'dam du phebs pa'i tshe 'phags pa bsnyen rdzogs mdzad zin pa gsan nas slar log ste tshogs pa gsar du bskyangs pas sde gnyis byung ste mkhan po gtsang pa'i rjes su dbon po gzhon byang / 'dul tshad pa byang chub bzang po/ don grub dpal/ yon tan rgyal mtshan/ dpal grub pa la sogs pa byon te gzhu'i dge 'dun sgang du bzhugs pas dge 'dun sgang par grags/'di'i mkhan po la gnas brtan bcu drug gang rung re byon pa'i tshe /rma pa na rim re'i mkhan po mdzad pa paṇa chen gyi lung bstan yod cing nges pa can yin zhes snyag dbon bsod nams bzang po'i rnam thar na gsal bar snang zhing snyag dbon chen po la kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ dol tshal min phul nas sde chen po btab ste bzhugs/ de'i slob ma 'phags chen bsod nams dang thog brdugs pa des bsnyung gnas pa'i sde bskyangs pa 'phags sder grags/ khong gi slob ma bzhis sde so sor bskyangs pa la 'phags sde bzhi byung ste dge 'dun sgang pa'i yan lag go mkhan chen byang chub dpal gyis tshogs gsar du bskyangs pa la/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags gzhon/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ bsod nams bzang po/ gzhon nu mgon/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ grags pa bshes gnyen la sogs pa byon te sbar stag pa jo stan du grags shing snubs chos lung btab pa phyin chos lung par grags so/ /'di rnams yar lungs jo bo'i chos byung dang tshal pa'i deb dmar dang po las 504

gang bshad pa bris pa yin la deb sngon las tshogs pa bye rdzing ba ni darkan mchog rgyal mtshan/ thugs rje dpal zhes sogs dang / chos 'u/nga pa ni dbu mdzad bsod nams stobs zhes sogs snang ba ni cha ma 'tshal la chag lo gsum pas dus 'khor chos byung du paṇa chen shing byi la khro phur phebs dbyar gnas mdzad/lho brag pa byang chub dpal bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas slas mo cher bzhugs dus gtsang so bas mjal der dbyar gnas mdzad/ rgyan gong du rdo rje dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang zhes byang chub dpal bslab pa sgres par bris snang zhing deb dmar ba sogs ni dkyil 'khor gcig par 'dod par snang la/ yang byang rdor gnyi ga 'phags pa rin po che'i mkhan slob la spyan drangs nas byon yang bsnyen par rdzogs zin par gsan nas lam nas log ste phyis so sor bskyangs pa chos lung pa dang bye rdzing pa yin zhes bris pa'ang snang ngo / /des na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ shā ri'i bu/ sras dgra gcan zin/ bram ze dgra gcan zin/ klu sgrub zhabs/ yon tan blo gros/ rin chen bshes gnyen/ dharma pa la/ gu ṇa pa ti/ chos kyi phreng ba/ zhi 'byung sbos pa/ kha che paṇḍi ta chen po ste phyis bod yul du sdom rgyun rnam par dag pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni paṇa chen gyi sdom rgyun tshogs sde bzhi 'di kho na yin pas bka' drin gzhal du med pa yin la rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i rten 'brel yin no/ /legs par bshad pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bod yul gyi bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs las— bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun dang bshad rgyun ji ltar dar ba'i skabs te gsum pa'o/sā sti/ kyi glegs bu'i ngos la se gcod 'gros mkhas pa/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas gnyal gyi chos lung nas/ /tshe dbang dar po tshe dbang don grub dang / blo gsal rnam rgyal bsam pa legs grub dang / /kun dga' bas ma 505

'igrab gan dga' rgyal mtshan zhes/ /bsam 'grab mgon po bkra shis dgos ༄ ༄ 4 ༄tsho dar sogs/ /da mas 'bad de bsgrabs pa' dge — gas dang / /bstan —na ༄ ༄dpal mo tshogs gnyis grab ma yis/ /sto rgyad byar gyi zhag yal stag rtse ra/ /༄ ༄༄ ༄legs par bsgrabs dge byang chub mchog ta bsngo/ /shu bhaX / /ོ ༄ 506

yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba las yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs la le'u bcu las bzhi pa lo paṇa chos byung bzhugs / /

le'u bzhi pa lo paṇa chos byung / sprul pa'i chos rgyal dam pa de rnams kyi/ /gzhal du med pa'i thugs rje'i bka' drin las/ /'phags pa'i yul dang khyad par dbus 'gyur tshal/ /kusmi dang za hor bal po dang / /rgya nag la sogs thub bstan dar ba'i sa/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs che rnams nas/ /thun mong rig gnas gzo gso sgra tshad byung / khyad par sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i tshogs/ /nang don rig pa'i gnas la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /paṇḍi ta dang rig pa grub pa'i tshogs/ /mang zhig bod kyi yul du byon nas ni/ /skal ldan skye 'gro mtha' yas smin grol mdzad/ /rgya bod yul gru'i skad gnyis la byang zhing / /legs sbyar brda sprod gnas kun khong chud pa/ /'jig rten mig gyur lo tsā rnams kyis ni/ /'dzam gling yul gru du ma myul mdzad nas/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos ngo mtshar rnyed dka' rnams/ /sang skṛ ta dang yul gru sna tshogs pa'i/ /skad dang yi ge brda dang tha snyad tshogs/ /rnam mang rgya mtsho lta bur gnas pa las/ /rang cag bod yul skye bo'i yi ge dang / /bod kyi skad du bsgyur te go slar mdzad/ /slar yang rgya dpe'i bye brag du ma dang / /paṇḍi ta la gtugs te dag par bcos /bshad rgyun sgrub rgyun man ngag rgyun ldan pa'i/ /bshad nyan tshul bzhin spyod pas gtan la phab/ /de phyir lo paṇa dam pa de rnams kyi/ /bka' drin khrag khrig bye ba'i cha tsam 0/nga / /rang cag bod yul skye bo thams cad kyi/ /lus srog longs spyod bcas pa lan stong du/ /tshang bar phul yang cha tsam ga la kher/ /bod yul rmong pa'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /yang dag chos kyi snang ba rgyas 509

mdzad pa/ /bod yul byon pa'i lo paṇa thams cad la/ /bka' drin dran pas rtag tu phyag bgyi'o/ /rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra bram ze shi ka da/ kha che ta nu/ bram ze ā narta/ bal po shrī la mañdzu/ ha shi ma hā de wa che ste chos rgyal srong btsan gyi dus byon ba rnams dang / buddhā gu hyas sangs rgyas gsang ba/buddhā shānta sangs rgyas zhi ba 'di gnyis gangs ti ser byon nas bzhugs/ rgyal po mes ag tshoms kyis spyan drangs kyang ma byon/ mdo sde lnga bskur nas phyis bstan pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i drin can yin/ zhi ba 'tsho ni rgya gar shar phyogs sa hor za hor gyi chos rgyal gyi sras/ gzhi thams cad yod smra 'i sde pa/ sde sgod rig gnas thams cad 'dzin zhing bod kyi don kho nar smon lam btab ste byon pa lo dgu brgya 'das ste bod yul du byon nas bod yul du lo bzhi bcur zin pa bzhugs te bsam yas su mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ padma 'byung gnas ni bod kyi mi ma yin 'dul ba'i don du padma las brdzus te skyes pa rig 'dzin mtha' dag grub pa/ yo ga'i phyag rgya'i sgo nas lha srin thams cad btul/ da lta rnga yab gling na srin po'i rgyal por bzhugs pa'o/ /yo ga'i slob dpon dharma girti 'di bsam yas kyi rab gnas mkhan por bu ston bzhed/ bee ma la mi tra dri med bshes gnyen 'di dga' rab rdo rje'i dngos slob ste phyag rgya rgya chen zhes bī ma la mu tra dag par klong chen pa 'chardo/ deb sngon pas 'di bī ma la snga mar byas nas rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad can yin zer yang khungs med pas paṇa chen du sku 'dra rnying ma rnams la yod/ shāsti garbha zhi ba snying po/ bi shuddhā sidha rnam dag seng ge rgya nag gi hā shang ma ko se dang rba ratna 'di shes phyin 'bum thog mar bsgyur ba'i lo paṇa yin/ ka ma la shrī la padma'i ngang tshul 'dis hā shang ma hā ya na rtsod pas chos su btul te de rnams khri srong gi dus kyi paṇa chen no///lpa mi tra dus kyi bshes gnyen/ dzi na mi tra rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen/ su reddhā 510

bo dhi lha dbang byang chub/ shī lend+ra bo dhi tshul khrims dbang po byang chub/ dā na shī la sbyin pa'i ngang tshul/ bo dhi mi tra byang chub bshes gnyen/ mu ne warma thub pa'i go cha/ sarba dzñā de wa kun mkhyen lha/ dī nu pra bha rig byed 'od zer ste bstan pa snga dar gyi paṇḍi ta'o/ /shrī ka ra warma dpal 'byung go cha/bharma pā la chos skyong 'di nas stod 'dul dar/ pradzñā pā la shes rab skyong /buddhā pā la sangs rgyas skyong / kha che dzñā na shrī zhi ba bzang po/ shāddhā kur warma dad byed go cha/ padma gupta padma sbas pa/ murti mi tra grol ba'i bshes gnyen/buddhā shārta shrī dpal sangs rgyas zhi ba/ su bha'i ta legs gsungs/ pradzñā warma shes rab go cha/ smṛ ti dzñā na ki rti dran pa ye shes grags ste 'di dang paṇḍi ta phra la ring ba gnyis lo tsā ba bal po padma ru ces bod du spyan drangs/ mu stegs kyi bskrad las byung yang zer ste mnga' ris su lo tsā ba pho log gis shi/ paṇḍi ta gnyis bod du skad mi mkhyen pas 'khyams/ smṛ tis rta nag tu rdzi bo mdzad/phyis dbyal lo ye tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis paṇḍi tar mkhyen te sman lung du spyan drangs nas chos zhus/ phyis bod skad byang bar mkhyen khams su byon/'don slong thang du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa btsugs/ bden bzhi dang 'jam dpal gsang ldan sngags don rnam gzigs gnyis med rnam rgyal chen mo sogs rang 'gyur mang po mdzad/ li chu gser khab tu byon nas bod la nye bar mkho ba'i sgra'i bstan bcos smra sgo mtshon cha mdzad/ gling yul du gshegs sku 'bum byas te yul de la dran pa thang du grags so/ /phra la ring bas gtsang rong du rdzogs chen pa rong pa chos bzang grongs pa la grong 'jug byas pas rong pas chos mang po tol shes su byung ste gzhan phan mdzad ces bu ston bzhed do/ /sunu shri legs rig dpal/ kha che dzñā na shrī/ tsand+ra rā tu la dgra gcan zla ba/ dhi ra pā la bstan skyong zhes bya ste 'bum phrag gsum par grags pa rngog lo chen 511

po'i bla ma 'dis ba dong da byon/ 'bam gser bris shig la rab gnas zhas ring ri rgyu ra zi ri tshipas bgegs chen po 'dug gsungs nas chos la stegs mdzad de bzhugs/bzhengs te bltas pas yig 'bru gcig kyang mi 'dug slar me tog 'thor rim gyis yig —'bru khra lam lam byung ste de la rten gyi gtso bor byas te bu dong gi sde chags shing sa gru gsum skye gnas ltar yod pas bu mo'i dong ngam e zhes btaṭa/kha cig sngar 'dul 'dzin gzhan zhig gis btab ste paṇa chen la phul zhes kyang zer ro/ /der bu dong rin rtse la sogs mkhas pa dpag med byung ngo / /a tu phye da sha mnyam med bcu pa/ pu ma tikilha blo mchog grags pa/ a ma nga tsand+ra 'chi med zla ba/ thig le bum pa gzhon nu bum pa/ ka na ka warma gser mdogadam pa rgya gar/ dza ya ānarta 'dis bod du byon/ pa tshab kyis lo tsā byas te phya ba dang dbu ma thal rang la rtsod pas paṇḍi tas ma thub/ slar rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas 'jam dpal bsgrubs/ ri bo rtse lnga'i 'dabs su 'jug pa'i rgyas 'grel rtog ge tho ba mdzad nas slar rtsod pa la byon dus phya ba gshegs/pa tshab kyi bu bzhi sogs nas dbu ma thal 'gyur ba bod du dar bar mdzad do//gha ya dha ra ni na ro me tri sogs grub thob mang po'i slob ma yin/ rten khyim par bzhugs/ bod du lan mang por byon te re re la mtshan tha dad tu thogs shing thengs cig ā tsarya dmar po zhabs su yang grags/ phyis 'brog mgos kyi bla ma byas so/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje/ ye shes rdo rje/ shes rab gsang ba/ ma hā dza na/ mantu ka la kū/ kurma badzra/ dzā ma ri/dpa' bo rdo rje 'di bod kyi gangs ri lta ba la yong gsungs nas 'brog mi'i sar byon te chos bstan nas slar rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhud skad/ rā hū la bupta badzra 'di ri nag po'i khong seng na bzhugs/ mi rta pa'i slob ma yang yin/ khyung po rnal 'byor 'phan yul chad dkar na bzhugs dus bod ri rong dog kho bos rdo 512 —

rje gdan gyi nyi ma shar ma thog 'ongs pas 'dir nam langs las ma slebs gsungan/ rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan/ chos mang du gsungs nas bal por bskyal te bod du rdo rje'i sa gzhi med pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa dang sgyu ma sgrub mi btub pa yin/ nga'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la bzhon rgya gar du 'gro tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa sgrub bo gsung ba la the tshom skyes pas rtog pa'i thum po khyod mi 'gro bar 'dug gsungs nas nyi zer la chibs te bzhud do/ /bee ro tsa na badzra 'di dngul chu'i bcud len grub pa yin/ rgya nag tu byon pas rgyal pos nyam sad pa'i phyir dngul chu dkar yol gang drangs pa cig car gsol/ 'on kyang rgyal pos nyams sad byas pa la ma mnyes nas chos ma bstan par bod du byon te rje dus mkhyen dang zhang tshal pa sogs la gdams pa bstan/ ngam shod smad du bzhugs so/ /bal po a su skye med bde chen 'di me tri pa'i chos la mkhas/ bod du byon nas do ha dar bar mdzad/ ras chung pas rgya gar du phyag rgya chen po la su mkhas dris pas bla ma bal po bod du song nas rgya gar du phyag rgya chen po rtsad gcod pa'i bod glen pa zer skad/ phyis su 'phrang du bzhugs sras rgyud mang du byung ngo / /radmā kā ra shārti 'di mkhu pa sgo drug shānti pa chen po de yin/ grong 'jug gis lus lan lnga 'phos pa'i rting ma la thang chen po zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang bya bar bzhed nas nor btsal ba'i phyir rgya nag la 'byon pa'i lam bod tu byon/ rje dus mkhyen zhang tshal pa slob dpon snye mdo ba rnams las kyang mchog gyur gyi gdams pa gsungs so/ /mañdzu sto ṣa/ snyurya girti nyi ma grags/ ga ga na star na mkhas 'dzin/ nor sbas/ sa marta shrī kun nas dpal/ ni lha laṅka de wa/ dza gadma tra ā nasta 'di ni spyan ras gzigs kyi spyan g.yas pa'i spyan chab las byung / wa ra ṇa sa'i rgyal po'i btsun mo chun ma 'od zer kun nas mdzes ma'i sras su 'khrung sa/ khrom chen po'i dbus su yab dang mjal bas lha 51 3

mi thams cad dga' 'o zhes dza gta ā narta skye 'gro kun dgar btags/ chen ma'i sras rnams kyis mtsho nang du bskyur bas klus mchod de chos bstan/ chur bskyur ba gsangs nas spun zla rnams kyis bdag ma rnyed do brjod pas gcen rnams mgu ste 'di ni bdag cag gi bshes gnyen zhes mi tra ānarta ces thogs/yab yum la chos kyi phyir gyi gsol ba nan gyis btab mthar bros te rdo rje gdan du rgyal ba'i lha las rab byung bsnyen rdzogs nod e ka dzā ṭis lung bstan te rdo rje gdan du spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i lha khang du thugs rje chen po lo drug bsgrubs/ slar kharna pa ṇa'i gtsug lag khang du lo drug bsgrubs/ o rgyan du dngos grub thob par lung bstan thob nas byon te spyan ras gzigs kyi spyan chab g.yon pa las byung ba mkha' 'gro ma de wa ṭā ki nis ku suta'i gnas su mngal gyi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam smin gyi lus dag ste cha zla lta bu'i sku brnyes/ o nunta pu ri gar log gi dmag gis skor ba la zhi bas chos gsungs/ rgyas pa'i 'phrin las sa rdo rin po che byin gyis brlabs pa'i char phab/ dbang gi sgo nas nam mkha' la byon ste rdzu 'phrul bstan/ drag pos sba lcag klad la bskor bas nyin gung la mun sros shing rdo'i char phab pas zlog yab rgyal po la mu stegs gyi ra tsa grags pa sde'i dmag gis bskor ba rengs par mdzad ste zlog thugs rje chen po'i maṭaṃl shing stan mdun du bzhag ste 'di bsgul nus na gser srang stong ster nang pa thams cad mu stegs la 'jug go /bsgul ma nus na mu stegs thams cad nang pa la zhugs shig gsungs pas gyang dang glang chen dang sgyu ma bshig sngags sogs kyis bsgul ma nus te rje btsun nyid mer bsregs pas ma gnod/ zangs su bcug gaṅgār bor bas gaṅgā char pa'i bar du zangs bzhag ste gaṅgā gyen du log pas pho brang 'jig tu cha ba'i tshe gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' la byon ste gaṅgā thog ma'i shul du song gsungs pas shar gyis song / ra tsa des mngan 514
