ris thams cad phul te yab kyi mnga' 'bangs dang gnyi ga lha 'bangs su bsgyur te bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ gnod sbyin ka la dang bhi ka la bya ba gnyis kyis yul gru chen po cig stongs par za ba btul te zham ring du 'brang zhing chos skyong byed/ sngar thugis rje chen pos phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa tshan gsum du gsungs pa rnams ogun gyi yul gyi dur khrod chen por thugs rje chen po dngos su bzhengs nas rig 'dzin dgu la gsungs shing khyad par slob dpon padma la byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul na da lta spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal po cig gis sems can gyi don mdzad cing yod/ 'di nas gdang rabs lnga ༄na 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyal po cig 'byung / des mkhas pa mang po spyan 'dren zhing khyod kyang spyan 'dren par 'gyur bas song la mi rnams thugs rje chen po dang gsang ba ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis thul zhig mi ma yin rnams khro bo rta mgrin gyi ting 'dzin gyis thul zhig ces gsungs nas slob dpon padma nyid la thim pa'i snang ba bstan/ sku dngos ni nam yang 'da' ba med par lho phyogs dpal gyi ri dang li kha ra shing 'phel gyi nags la sku 'di nyid kyis bzhugs shing skal ldan du ma'i don mdzad/ phyis ring mo zhig la khyad par du mkhas pa shrī rnam gnyis la rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag bstan/ de'i skabs cig na khro phu lo tsā ba chen po dgung lo nyer drug pa bal por bzhugs pa'i tshe chu stod zla ba la rje btsun mi tra dzo gi bhu khaX du byon zer te sgra che bar byung yang) yid ma 'ches/ de nas khye'u mi 'dra ba lha'i rnam pa can zhig 'khor mang pos bskor nas shing kun skor ba la byon/ gu lang du mu stegs kyi rten phyugs bdag rang byung gi gser gyi bha ṭu ra'i rtse mor skyil krung bcas te nu/ stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa nus pa can rtsod pa dang nus pas pham par mdzad/ tsakra warti che chung bya ba ta pa si gnyis kyis phyugs bdag la phyag 'tshal bar bsgo bas phyag thal mo 515

brdabs pan sgo rang bye ste sku de 'dar zhing ga yos/ me tog dmar po'i char byung / paṇa che na buddhā shrīs de rā dzā gu ru yin na nga'i bla ma yin gsungs nas mjal te gnyi ga shin tu mnyes/ khro los mjal du byon pas nags mthongs shig na skye bo mang pos mchod pa dang bcas zhal byang phyogs su gzigs te lha dngos yin snyam pa sku smad la ras khra po g.yogs shing shing stan mchan khung g.yon na 'dzin pa cig mthong bas rje btsun mi tra yin min gyi the tshom rang sar zhig ste dga' ba mtha' yas pas zhabs la yang yang gtugs/ go la gsol 'phro zhig zhal nas phyung ste gnang ba zos pas byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/khrom rnams kyis mi tshor gsungs nas ma zhus kyang drug tshan gsum pa'i chos de nyid du gsungs/ rje paṇa chen gyis chos kyi nang byan pa mdzad de sems nyid ngal gso dang rdo rje sbas pa'i gsang lam gsungs/ shin tu thugs brtse ba pha bu phrad pa ltar gyur/ bod du gshegs par zhus sheng yi dam chos skyong la ngo chen zhus/ rje paṇa chen gyis kyang gnod sbyin gcig gis grogs byed kyang gcig gis gegs byed par snang bas ka la la khrag sna'i gtor ma skyol gsung ba ltar byas pas nga ni bod du gshegs chas byed pa'i mi ma yin gyi zang zing ngo gsungs te rje btsun gyis kyang 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes tsag tsig byung / la stod chu mig ring mo na dge ba'i bshes gnyen brang po lung pa zhes pa don 'gas pa chen po cig wa po zla ba'i tshes brgyad la bsnyung gnas mdzad pa'i tho rengs sang res thugs rje chen po ras ser pos dril ba zhig khro phur 'byon no zer ba'i sgra byung ba dpon slob lngas thos/ la stod gtsang so'i srin po gdong gi gnas su ston pa dad pa bya ba la rje btsan mi tra dzo gi gnas khang g.yar du 'byon gyis khyim byi dor gyis bya ba nub gsum du byung / mjal nas lo ngo gnyis song ba na lā ra ṇa si'i rgyal po dzā ya tsand+ra bya ba 'dzam gling na che ba de dang de'i mag pa dbus 'gyur 'chang gi rgyal po shing rta can bya ba de gnyi gas ti ra hur ti'i rgyal po la 516

bka' phab nas des rje btsun spyan 'dren pa'i phyir pho nya ba ral skor mkhan la sogs pa'i dmag dpung chen po slebs te spyan drangs nas pham thing du gshegs/rgya gar ba'i bsu ba mtha' yas pas slebs/ bod kyis ci byar yang med par song ba'i tshe lo tsā ba chen pos kyang skyel thung gi tshul du byon/ rje btsun pham thing gi khang brtse gas cig gi yang thog bsil khang na bzhugs pa'i drung du btol nas grub thob 'di lta bu dang mjal rjes su bzung / bod du gshegs par zhal gyis bzhes nas spyan ma 'drongs par slar gshegs pa ni bdag dang bod rnams bsod nams shin tu dman/ nga ni da lta lus srog dor te shi ma thag po ṭa lar rje btsun nyid kyi drung du skye bar bya'o snyam du tsham tshom med par gyur te gser gang yod sku la gtor nas g.yang chen po la rgyang gis 'phyongs pa dang rje btsun gang nas byon cha med par bar snang la rgyang byon te lo tsā ba chen po'i phyag nas bzung ste a ha ha de tsug ma byed khyod kyi 'dod pa ngas sgrub bo gsungs te rgyal po zla ba la 'phrin yig mdzad/ rgya gar ba rnams zang zing gis mgu bar mdzad de bslog nas de phyin lo tsā ba chen pos zhabs tog mdzad nas thun mong gi chos kyis skye 'gro mang du btul/ khyod nga spyan 'dren pa la dka' ba de tsam du byed pa dgos pa ci yod gsungs te bstan pa dang sems can la bsams pa kho na las grags 'dod sogs rang 'dod kyi rtog pa rdul tsam yang ma 'dres par mkhyen nas shin tu mnyes/ sku 'khor stong lhag pa'i yo byad lo tsā ba chen po nyid kyis sbyar te bod phyogs su rim par phebs/ skal ldan rnams dad pa'i dbang gis 'dus kha cig de lta bu mi srid zer nas brtag dpyad byed grags pa dang ltad mo dang dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul ba'i skye bo'i tshogs zla lam tsam nas sprin bzhin 'dus te zang zing gi 'bul ba ri spungs pa lta bu rgyun mi chad pa thams cad skyi rong gi 'phags pa sogs dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang dge 'dun gyi 'du ba'i sgo 'khrug rtsod kyi sdum lam 'phrang gso ba sogs la de ma thag 517

gnang ste cung zad kyang bdag gir mi mdzad/ lo tsā ba chen pos kyang snga 'phrul gyi bu lon sogs kyis yo byad blor mi chud pa rgyun du dgos pa rnams kyang nor rgyun ma dang rnam thog sras bran du bkol bas sgrub pa ma gtogs rje btsun gyi 'bul ba ma sha ka gcig kyang longs mi spyod/ gar phebs kyi yul gru thams cad du ltad mo dang zang zing dang chos kyi longs spyod la thug pa med/ skye bo 'dus ches pas khyim thams cad thog khrol tshags ltar song / thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ sgo thams cad thal byung du gyur/ bza' btung la 'dod pa med/ 'thab rtsod dang che chung brtsi ba'i minge mi grag par skye bo che chung thams cad snying po bzlos pa dang skyabs 'gro sems skyed kyi 'ur dir du song skad/ kha la bya la gseb la gsum gang nas bzhud pa'i kha zin la yul pa rnams so sos gsol ba btab pas lo tsā bas la phyi rgyab kyi gnas legs pa cig g.yor zhig gsungs te dpal thang yas mig na dge bshes mod po bya ba stod zur gyi dge bsnyen tshangs spyod pa khyad pa can zhig bzhugs pa la gnas g.yar du btang bas rje btsun nyid chibs pa mdzad de 'khong su yang med par la la mjal bar bsgug pa'i skye bo sus kyang ma mthong bar la gang la byon yang phebs mi gsha' ba'i snga bar gdan phebs/ de rnams su skye bo mtha' yas pa 'dus pa la/ rmi lam grong khyer yangs pa na/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu longs spyod pa/ /longs spyod dus na longs spyod med/ /snang sems de ltar shes par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs/dge bshes de la snying rje chen po dang gnas lugs kyi sgom don sbyar ba zhig gsungs pas gegs sol/ rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs te chos des skye 'gro mang po smin grol la bkod/ de nas lam la stod byang la byon/ srin po gdong du dge bshes mang ches pas kha cig la bzhugs gnas med par phyir lus pa na rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga'i gnas 'di rnams la phul gsungs te tsham tshom med par thal byon te ston pa dad pa'i sgo phye nas a tsa ra la gnas byin gsungs pas 618

rmi lam dang mthun pas dga' ches te gser g.yu 'khar sder gang la sogs yod rgu cog phul/ snying po don gsum gyi gdams ngag gnang bas grol ba zhig byung /de sogs gzhan phan mtha' yas pa mdzad nas khro phur phebs te zla ba drug tsam du bzhugs/ yo byad thams cad lha sar mchod pa skyel du btang / bod tha dad nas spyan 'dren pa zad pa med kyang rdo rje gdan la gar log gi dmag yong ba zlog dgos gsungs nas zang zing la stos pa rdul tsam yang med par phyir gshegs/ rgyud grol ba dang smin pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing phal cher la chos kyi las 'brel bzhag 'u skol gyi lugs kyis sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs dge ba ci byed kyang mgon med skyabs med kyi sems can 'di rnams 'khor ba las drang dgos snyam pa'i snying rje dang / de nus pa'i sangs rgyas la 'god dgos snyam pa'i sems skyed dang / shi ma thag dga' ldan du skyes nas chos nyams su blang ba la 'god pa ste 'di gsum dang ma bral bar byed dgos gsung zhing lo tsā ba chen pos kyang chos de'i yon du rta bzang ba gsum phul bas chos re la yon re 'bul ba bzang gsungs te de phyin lo tsā bas de gsum dang 'bral med du mdzad/ khrom ches pas lam ma shogs pa na nang du rtog pa'i 'du 'dzi la ma shogs pa'i rtags yin/ rtog pa thams cad rang ngo shes na ngo bo med pa la bshag dgos pa mi 'ong / bshag rgyu nang du grol na phyi rol 'dra skad cig gis phyal 'gro yi gsungs/ /'o na phyi rol ji bzhin de bzhin nang / /bgyi ba mang par gda' zhus pas/ /mang ba mad de de skad kha nas 'don mkhan tsho rang ce re long du 'gro bar 'dug gsungs te lam 'phrang nam dka' ba na sus kyang ma mthong bar pha gar gshegs pa sha stag byung / khro phur byams chen pho brang dang bcas pa'i rten 'brel mdzad de rab gnas kyi dus kho bo'ang 'od kyi phung po'i rnam par 'ong gsungs te phyis skal ldan mang pos mthong ba byung / 519

bal por spyan drangs nas rgya gar ba sum brgya tsam gyi zham ring byas te rgya gar la thal gyis bzhud/ ro byad thams cad rang sar don ldan du bkye nas ma bsnams kyang dad ldan gyis gsol ba btab ba'i gser nyung shas shig bsnams pa las mi tra yo gis gser mi khur mang po khyer yong bya ba rgya bal du grags nye gnas gnyis kyis ma ga dha dang wa ra ṇa si'i rgyal po bsu ba la spron zhus kyang gnod sbyin gnyis dang chu ki ma gsuca/ sbran chog gsungs te ma gsan par gshegs pa'i tshe/ 'khor ma dag pa kha cig gis nang byan byas te gaṅgā'i 'gram dang nye bar go si ma sa li bya ba dang ti tir ku ra bya ba'i grong pa gnyis kyis yul log byas te mi tra yo gi 'di sngar yang bsad pas yang yang log zer bas da res mi ldog par bya zer nas sku stod smad phral dbu bye ma'i gseb tu sbas/sku stod khyer sku smad gaṅga la bskyur/ yo byad rnams bgos pas zhag bdun na sku stod sku smad dbu dang bcas pa 'dus te gcer bur byon nas jag pa rnams la zas slong pas jag pa'i lag nas nor rnams cha med du song ba khong rang gi phyag du 'dus nas gso phad du btums dbyug pa'i ngos gnyis su bkal/ mi tra dzo gi sgyu ma'i mi/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'phrul 'khor bshig /'phrul 'khor bshig pa'i ro la stos/ /mgo bo ko ṭa'i ral gris bcad/ /mgo bo gti mug dag pa'i ro/ /ro de bye ma'i rlom du sbas/ gti mug rnam par mi rtog zhing / khog stod ti shi li yis bcad/ khog stod zhe sdang dag pa'i ro/ /ro de ma sa li bas khyer/ /zhe sdang 'od gsal me chen 'bar/ khog smad ro nyi khyud 'dras bcad/ khog smad 'dod chags dag pa'i ro/ /ro de gaṅgā'i chu la bskyur/ rwa /'dod chags bde ba chen por dag /mi bzad mtshon gyis dral ba'i tshe/ /zug rngu stong pa'i ngang du 'bar/ /zug rngu tshor ba tshor bas stong / /gnyis med ye shes 'u ru ru/ /zhes glu len zhing byon skad/520

bkrongs zer ba'i zer sgra las bal bod dad pa ma thob pa kha cig the tshom du yang gyur/ de nas ring po ma lon par rgya gar gyi glu mkhan gyis glu de len pa bal bod du mang bar byung bas slar thams cad yid 'ches shing ma mjal ba rnams kyang 'gyod/ phyis paṇḍita don yod rdo rjes bsnams pa las lo tsā ba chen pos glu dag par bsgyur ro/ /de nas rje btsun gyis rdo rje gdan du byon te rten 'brel gyis dmag zlog dpal gyi ri'i phyogs bzhi na sgo re yod pa'i mtshams na 'brog dgon pa yang mang po yod pa de rnams su lha khang dang mgron khang mang du btsugs/ o to'i yul du thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad kyi lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/ rje btsun phyir thegs nas lo lnga lon pa na bal po'i rnal 'byor pa gnyis dang ya tha su khe gnyis kyis rdo rje gdan du phyin pas rje btsun dang dngos sru mjal/ grags pa ngan pa dang la la'i the tshom sel ba'i phyir thengs cig bal yul du cis kyang 'byon par zhu zhes zhus pas da ste zla ba gcig na bal yul dang nye ba'i ka ma tsar cir 'ong gis gsungs te de bzhin du byon nas bal po'i slob ma rna/mas kyis mjal/ khro phur yang bka' 'phrin gyis sleb bo/ de nas phyi zhig na o rgyan gyi paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje la bka' bsgos te lha sar mchod pa dang mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang rgyun spel bar bod yul du btang / de nas lo nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam 'das pa na paṇḍi ta shrī pu tra dpal gyi sras kyis rje btsun mjal/ thugs dam lha drug gi man ngag gnang ste bod du song las rnal 'byor pa sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs pa cig yod pa de la byin gsungs te kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i slob ma mi nyag grags pa rin chen la paṇa chen des lha sar gsungs/ spyir shākya'i bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'gro don mdzad cing lha sa chus ma zhig gi bar lha sar lo re la lan re 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /rje btsun 'di 521

dang slob dpon padma las lhag pa'i grub thob ni bod yul du gzhan ma byon par snang bas rnam thar cha tshang zhig bsdus nas bkod pa'o/ /buddhā shrī dzñā na 'di ni bal yul kho phom du yab kha che ba zhig dang yum rgya gar mo zhig 'dus pa las 'khrungs/ rgya gar du byon te bi kra mar rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs/phal chen sde pa las rab tu byung ste bu slob kyang rgyas par gyur/ khyad par rdo rje gdan pa bee khya de wa slong mo pa'i lha zhes pa paṇa chen grub thob cig rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten zhing rje mi tra dang mjal nas rdo rje theg pa'i bdag por gyur/rdo rje gdan dang ba kri ma3 bzhugs pa'i tshe rdo rje gdan pa de la bal yul gyi kho bom rgyal po dang hang du dang ta pa si rnams kyis bal yul gyi chos ston pa po dang ra gha bi ha ra la sogs gtsug lag khang gsar pa cha gsum gyi rab gnas la gshegs par zhus pas nga rgas ches pas mi slebs/ nga'i 'og na mkhas shing bzang ba bu'i dam pa 'di yin pas gtong gsungs te rje 'di srings/khro phu lo tsā ba chen pos paṇa chen 'di lo lngar bsten ste sgra'i bstan bcos chen po rā dzā shrī dang ka tsan dang tshad ma slar yang sbyangs/ sde snod gsum gyi don dril ba'i bstan bcos rgyal ba'i lam 'jug dang / mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa shes rab sgron me la sogs pa rtsom par zhus te brtsams/ mdo sngags mtha' dag gi dogs pa bcad nas bod du gshegs par zhus pas rje mi du phebs te paṇa chen nyid kyis thog mar rje btsun 'di spyan drongs/ khyod lha chen po bzheng pa sogs la sa gzhi 'dul ba dang mi rnams byin gyis rlob pa la 'di mngags pa yin/ rje btsun 'di byon nas thams cad 'ur langs pa'i skabs su ngas 'ongs nas mdo sngags gang la gang 'os bstan no gsungs/ me mo sbrul lo la rje btsun phebs nas lo bzhi pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo paṇa chen nyid lo drug bcu rtsa gcig bzhes pa la bod tu spyan drangs/ byams chen 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mang tu2ཿ

du mdzad/ chag lo tsā ba la btang nas smyal la sogs par spyan drangs/ mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsungs nas slar bal bor bzhud cing yo byad kyi phud rdo rje gdan du gser srang brgya dang bi kra mar chos khri'i phyogs bzhir glang chen gyis bteg pa'i seng ge zangs gser las byas pa ngo mtshar ba phul zhing de 'dra ba zhig sthā bi har na yang yod/ paṇa chen 'di'i sku skye pa khro phu sems dpa' chen po yin no/ /shākya shrī bha dra ni rnam thar 'dul ba'i skabs su bstan zin la de'i phyags phyir paṇa chung dgu byon pa las khri bhū ti tsand+ra rnal 'byor zla ba ni sgra dang mngon pa la mkhas shing dpal sha war la yang dngos su thug ste sbyor ba yan lag drug pa gsan/ dpyal a mo bha la gsungs pas dzo nang sbyor drug pa rnams byung / paṇa chen la 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po dang rgya ma'i sangs rgyas dbon ston gyi gdan 'dren 'doms nas gros mdzad pa na bee bhū tis nor 'bri khung pa mang zer te phyag rgya pa 'di rdzun che zer byas pas rje paṇa chen gyis nā gabhū na nā gasbyo na de skad mi btub bo/ 'bri khung pa'i slob ma khams pa cig gis nga la chos gos slongs/ snam bu byin pa ma 'dod par nga'i chos gos nas 'then/ jo sras nyi mas de la phul brdeg byas pas brdabs nas sna khrug byung / de nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma zhag bdun du nga'i yan lag bdun pa'i yul mdzad du ma bzhed/ nan gyis gsol ba btab pas kyang sku rgyab bstan nas zhal ston du ma bzhed rgyu mtshan zhus pas khyed kyi 'khor gyis nā ganghru na'i slob ma sun phyung / bshegs par bandhu chos gos med pa brgya la chos gos byin gsungs/paṇḍi ta yang der song la ngag gi las bshegs pa gyis/ gang mos pa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs shig gsungs/ der bee bhū tis 'bri khung du byon nas bshegs pa phul bstod pa mdzad/ phyis srin po rir paṇa chen gyi sku tshad kyi bde mchog gi lha khang bzhengs te nam mkha' la bzhugs pa byin rlabs can du grags/ bod 523

du yun ring du bzhugs shing phyis sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbye brtsams nas sdom gsum gnas gyur du bshad pa gzigs nas/ deng sang bstan pa'i zhabs 'di ru/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag la/ /mkhas pa'i rgyu skar 'ga' zhig gis/ /phyogs re'i cha tsam rtogs gyur mod/ /sogs nas/ bdag blo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /phyogs las rgyal bar byas te 'god/ /ces dang / gsum ldan gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /zhes sogs kyi sdom gsum 'od phreng brtsams shing rang 'gyur mang du mdzad do/ /su ga ta shri bde gshegs dpal dbu ma dang phar phyin la mkhas/ dza ya dabha rgyal bas byin sngags dang 'dul ba la mkhas/ dā na shī la tshad ma rgyan dang chos mchog la mkhas/ 'di dang saṅgha shrī la sa skya ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sgra dang tshad ma bslabs/ /rje paṇa chen las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad de paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ rgya gar na dā na shrī la sgra tshad la mkhas par 'dug pa de nga'i rtsar kor gyis 'khor byung zhes gsungs skad/ rgya gar ba yi dam gsang bas sa paṇa gyis 'di'i yi dam ma mkhyen nas dha du ra dkar po'i rdzas drangs bsnyung ba la sman pas 'grangs par kha mar btags nas da ji ltar mdzad zhus pas 'o na yi dam la 'pho ba byed pa yin gsungs nas na bza'i gong pa'i bar nas gshed dmar gyi sku chung ngu zhig bton nas de la 'pho bar bzhed de spyi bo nas 'od khra chem byung ba dang ku re bgyis pa yin mi 'pho bar zhu zhes yang yang zhus pas ma 'phos kyang shin tu ma mnyes nas mthar sa paṇa rang gi lcam mo zhig las rgyar phul bas thugs sos te gshed dmar yi dam du gnang zhes thos shing phyis dā na shī la sku 'da' kur nga lta bu'i mkhas pa bod mtha' 'khob tu 'chi dgos pa gsungs nal 'dar ma bzhed pa la mkhan po bo dha rnga/ tā dang jo bo rje dang dam pa sangs rgyas rnams kyang bod du 'das zhus pas beeku sdom pa gtsang ma yin a tsa ra sems bzang po yin dzo gi 524

man ngag mang po shes gsungs skad/ paṇḍi ta smi ti yang bod du 'das byas pas de lta bu mkhas pa chen po yin/ 'o na kho bo'i 'chi sa los btub gsungs nas gshegs skad do/ /sadha shrī sgra tsand+ra pa dang mngon pa mdzod la mkhas/ su ma ti sā gar blo bzang rgya mtsho mngon pa gong 'og la mkhas/ ka la tsand+ra dus kyi zla ba dus 'khor la mkhas/ dzi na gupta rgyal ba sbas pa byams chos la mkhas/ ma hā bo dhi byang chub chen po phar phyin dang spyod phyogs la mkhas te paṇa chung dgu po'o/ /phyis paṇa chen gshegs kur lo tsā ba chen po la bka' yig phyag bris mdzad de ring bsrel skyel ba la paṇḍi ta dza bha ma shrī 'jug ngogs dpal dang tree lokya ā nasta 'jig rten gsum kun nas dga' ba gnyis la bka' phab ste bod du byon/ sil snyan bdun pa'i tshigs bcad sogs bsgyur ro/ /longs spyod rdo rje/ raṅgashrī/ bal po ma hā pa na/ bal po badzra girti/ bal po kā ya shrī/ bal po grags pa dpal/ su mā ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal/sulhu kirta/ bi na ya shrī/ maṅga la shrī/ brla na ā tsarya/ dza ya de wa/ la smi kā ra/ ratna shrī/ ā nasta shrī/ rā hu la shrī/ zangs gling pa/ kirti paṇḍi ta la sogs pa dang / shā ri bu tra dang / phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta shrī pā ratna nags kyi rin chen zhes bya ba sangs rgyas dbyangs kyi slob ma sha wa ris rjes su bzung nas bod yul du song zhig rgyal po cig la brten nas skye bo rnams kyi log rtog ldog par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te bod du byon/ lha gzigs graṭa pa 'byung gnas kyis sbyin bdag byas te chos mang du gsungs bod kyi mkhas pa dang dpyod ldan mang zhig gi lta ba drang por mdzad nab/ balnga por gshegs te paṇḍi ta tshad ldan bod du byon pa deng sang yan la 'di rting mar snang ngo / /sgyur byed kyi lo tsā ba bka' drin can ji ltar byon pa ni/ lo tsā ba la snga ba thon mi sasto ṭa/ dharma koṣṭha/ lha lung rdo rje dpal/ bran ka mu la ko ṣā rnams chos 525

rgyal srong btsan gyi dus kyi lo tsā ba'o/ kha che ā nanda/ khri bzher sang shi ta/sbrang rgya re legs gzigs/ seng ma gong lha lung gzigs/ rba ye sheb/ dbang po/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ dba'as mañdzu shrī/ nga gor bee ro tsa na/rba mang rje gsal snang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gnyags dzña na ku mar/ce dzha na siddhi/ mchims shākya pra bha/ brang ti dza ya rakhri ta/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge/ rtsangs de wend+ra rakṣa ta/ bran ka mo ti ka/ khon nā gend+ra rakṣi ta/rma rin chen mchog rtsangs/sa la'i bu rin chen legs grub/ ttarma ā lo kadran pa nam mkha'/ sgro rin chen sde/ rma rnam par mi rtog pa/ rma shākya 'od/ce khyi 'brug rlangs khams pa go cha/ gnyags de wa ko ṣa/ zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang / mgos chos grub/ stong chos grub/ stong ā tsarya/ dharma ta shrī la/cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ ka ba dpal brtsegs srung ba/ zhang gi baddhā ye shes sde/ ranā rakhri ta/ dza ya rakhri ta/ mañdzu shrī warma/ randend+ra shrī la/ bzang skyong / lha'i zla ba/ dpal gyi lhun po/ dpal 'byor/ ye shes snying po/ rgyal ba shes rab/ shākya bshes gnyen/ dge ba dpal/ legs pa'i sde/ snubs nam mkha' snying po/ yi ge pa dgon gling rma/ gzhon nu srung ba/ nam mkha' skyong rnams ni bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā ba yin no/ /phyi dar la lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis mnga' ris su khye'u kun bsags nas blo rno nyer gcig rgya gar du brdzangs te rab bdun nas rin chen bzang po dang 'bring bdun nas grags 'byor she sa rab gnyis ma gtogs pa shi/ rin chen bzang po mkhas pa'i mthar thug par gyur te mtshan nyid theg pa dang rgyud sde bzhi gnas bsgyur zhing khyad par yo ga dang gsang 'dus kyi phyogs bsgyur/ sngags log sun 'byin mdzad de sbyor grol dus min du spyod pa bkag lo tsā ba chen por mtshan grags so/ /mnga' ris su sangs rgyas skar rgyal yin zer ba ston pa'i sku ltar snang ba rdzu 'phrul can 526

zhig gis nam mkha' la 'phags te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'dra min du bstan pa la skye bo thams cad 'dus pa na lo chen gyis 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad de skyed rim brtan pos de'i rtsar byon pa na lo chen gyis gzigs pa tsam gyis de sa la lhung ste rdzi bo tha mal pa cig du gyur/ des bstan pa'i chos las rdor gcod kyi phan yon ma gtogs bsnubs skad/ de ni nag phyogs kyi klu skar rgyal zhes bya bas rji bo zhig la brlabs te bstan pa la bar chad brtsams par snang / phyis jo bo rje las sgrub pa'i gdams ngag gsan te sgrub khang rim pa gsum gyi sgo re re zhing 'di tshun la chos min gyi rtog pa dang / ra nga don yid byed kyi rtog pa dang / tha mal gyi rtog pa skyes na mgo bo khos shig ces bris nas nye rgyu'i sgrub pa mdzad de dgung lo dgu bcu go brgyad bzhes pa jo bo thegs pa'i phyi lo shing lug la sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de'i lo chung grags 'byor shes rab kyis kyang tshad ma dang ma rgyud bde mchog gi skor bsgyur zhing 'phrin las che'o/ /bal po chung 'gar chos bzang gis kyang lo tsā'i chos drug ces grags pa bsgyur nas ri bo rtse lngar gshegs/ dge tshul khyung grags/ bal po padma ru tse/ pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan 'dis dran pa nyer bzhag gi 'gyur chad bsabs/ dpyal se tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rong pa chos bzang / 'bro seng dkar shākya'i 'od/ khyung po chos brtson/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug rma dge ba'i blo gros/ byi jo zla ba'i 'od zer 'dis dus 'khor thog ma ra bod yu/la du bsgyur/ de nas lo bcu drug pa la jo bo rje bod du phebs so/ /lha zhi ba 'od/ khu dngos grub/ chos kyi shes rab/ mar thung dad pa shes rab/ ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ 'brog mi shākya blo gros/ta27

'brog mi shākya ye shes 'di'i bka' rgyud dpa' ldan sa skya pa'o/ /stag po gzhon brtson/ lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros 'dis sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa spel lo/ /mgos khug pa /lha btsas 'dis rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ paṇa grub bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bsten ma rgyud mang du bsgyur/ sngags lo gsum 'byin brtsams so/ zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab ni mnga' ris zangs dkar du 'khrungab// kha che dgon pa ba dang kha che dzñā na shrī sogs bsten/ rnam sras kyi skor spyan drangs lha sa'i sprang tshang bton/ lha sa bsam yas dang mtha' 'dul phal cher te gtsug lag khang bco lnga tsam la zhig gso phul phyin mdzad/ snur nyi ma dang sbal ti sems dpa' chen po sogs zangs dkar gyi bu bzhi byung / rwa los 'phags skor bsgyur yang blo ka lnga tsam las ma 'gyur ba lnga 'gyur tsam myur du bsgyur bas phrag dog skyes te reg dug btang bas snyung / phyis chu mig ring mor 'das zhes rnam thar na snang / gnyan dar ma grags kyis rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ chos mang du bsgyur/ khyad par du mgon po zhal bzhi pa spyan drangs/ phyis rwa lo dang mthu 'gran pas gnyi ga gshegs skad/ rwa rdo rje graṭa kyis ba ro phyag rdum sogs bsten/ gshed skor sogs gtso bor bsgyur/ rgya /bod du zang zing gi dge ba mang du mdzad mngon spyod mang du mdzad skad/ 'di la rje 'jig rten mgon po sogs ni/ ba ro de mu stegs yin zhing rwa lob/ khong rang gi slob dpon mthus bsad pa yin zhes 'di las brgyud pa tsam gyi chos la mi mnyes kher gang 'khor lo grags/ la chings yon tan 'bar/ spong zho gsal ba grags/ mgar chos kyi bzang po/ she'u badzra de wa/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug 'di ya 'brog do nang du 'khrungs/ bde mchog gi skor mang du bsgyur ro/ /de'i lo chung legs pa'i shes rab kyis kyang bde mchog gi skor mang du spyan drangs sgrub pa rtse gcig 528

mdzad de ska las 'dis mkha' spyod da byon no/ /spyir lo chen rin chen bzang ring ring ring gi slob ma lo chung ste gnyis ka la spu rangs lo chung zhes grags ming gnyis ku'i mtshan legs pa'i shes rab tu 'dod pa du ma byung yang snga ma'i mtshan ni grags 'byor shes rab dang phyi ma'i mtshan legs pa'i shes rab yin la sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod tu gshegs pa ni phyi ma yin par snang ngo / /zu dga' ba rdo rje/chos kyi yon tan/ chos kyi rin chen/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ ba ri rin chen grags 'di khams su 'khrungs/ rdo rje gdan pa la sogs bsten/ don zhags la gtso bor mdzad nas thugs rje chen po zhal gzigs/ rgya gar du mu stegs kyi rgyal pos mi brgya phrag blud du gsod pa gser gang yod kyis blus/lan gcig thugs rje chen po bshum zhing 'dug ci nongs zhus pas nga'i bu mang 'or lo tsā ba'i gser zho do nga'i bu smyal pa lo tsā bas brkus nas ngu zhing 'dug gsungs/ ma ga dha'i grong du btsal bas de ltar 'dug ste bla ma grub thob cig la dbang bskur zhu ba'i chas 'tshol du bod du phyin pas gser zho do rnyed pa stor/ da dbang bskur mi thob zer nas sdug bsngal bar 'dug pas ba ri bas gser zho bzhi byin/ 'dis sa skya'i bla ma yang mdzad chos mang du bsgyur/ gtso bor don zhags kyi 'phrin las che'o/ /pa tshab nyi ma grags/ lha btsan po mu ni rā dzā/ ding ri chos grags/ rgyus smon lam grags/ mang 'or byang chub shes rab/ mal gyi blo gros grags 'dis mgon po'i skor du ma spyan drangs te mgon po'i dngos slob rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ṇḍa pa la gsan pa gri gug lcaṭa par ma smya/la pa nyi ma 'bar la gnang nas phyis ber nag can du grags/ bram ze mchog sred nas shāddhā ka ra/ lo chen rin bzang / brag steng pa yon tshul la gsan pa gri phug cer bu ni sa chen kun snying la gnang ste phyis gur mgon du grags so/ /gyi ljang dbu dkar ni ma mgon gyi grub thob yin/ 'gro shes rab 529

grags 'dis dus 'khor 'bro lugs rnams bsgyur/ ba reg thos pa ngaga'/ rma chos 'bar/ mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan 'di gsum gyis rgya gar phyag na bsten nas grub snying dang do ha'i skor bsgyur/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa 'di mdo khams smad mi nyag gi yul du 'khrungs/ rgya gar du mkhas shing dngos grub thob nas rdo rje gdan du ston pa'i rgyal tshab mdzad/ dus 'khor tsa mi'i rgyud gsum 4 sogs bsgyur/ nā lo gzhon nu dpal 'di mdo khams su 'khrungs/ rus rga yin pa rgan gzhon gnyis phyin pas rga chen rga chung du grags/ rgya gar du su mkhas dris pas tsa ni kho na mkhas zer bas rgya gar du yong nas bod gcig gis gcig la nyan pa mi yong bsams nas gzhan dris pas a bhu kā ra dang o rgyan gyi paṇḍi ta lā gi shā ra mkhas zer te de gnyis kyang tsa mi la chos nyan zhing 'dug pas slar tsa mi dang a bhu la chos zhus/ bde mchog gi bsnyen pa byas pas yi dam gyi lung bstan byung nas spyod pa la dur khrod gsil ba tshal du phyin/ der las mgon bya rog mas srog snying phul/ bar chad med par log pas bla ma gnyis kyis kyang bkur sti mdzad/ ma ga dha'i rgyal pos spyan drangs skye bo'i tshoṭa sa gzhi gang ba 'dus te me tog gtor ba la pus mo nub pa tsam byung ste sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das rjes chos smra ba la me tog gtor ba de las mang ba ma byung bar grags/ chos du ma bsgyur zhing khyad par mgon po bya rog ma spyan drangs te rje dus mkhyen/ zhang rin po che/ khams pa a seng gsum la gnang zhing khams pa a seng la dpal phag mo gru pas gsan te mgon po kur lugs tshal lugs 'bri gdan gyi lugs rnams byung ngo / /rga lo la srog gegs byung ba gzhan gyis ma sol nas sa chen gyis bsal zhes bod na zer yang gzhan zhig dang 'khrul ba te de lta'i gnas med pas nā lo'i rnam thar stos shig kre bo shes rab dpal/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje/ rwa chos rab/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/530

zhang grub pa dpal/ sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'dis tshad ma rnam 'grel dar bar mdzad/ glo bo shes rab rin chen/ sto brag pa 'u ru dar ma seng ge mi mnyam bzang po/ o rgyan pa rin chen dpal/ shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shong blo gros brtan pa/ khams pa blo gros rgyal po/ 'dan ma tshul seng / ra ba gzhon brtson/ shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dpang blo gros brtan pa/ sgra tshad pa rin rgyal/ dbus pa blo gsal 'dis rgya nag dang yu gur nas 'dul ba lung gi lung rgyun spyan drangs/ stag lung pa shākya bzang po/ legs pa'i blo gros/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ jo nang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang blo gros dpal/ 'bri khur lo tsā ba/ kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/yar lo grags pa rgyal mtshan/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ bo dong grags pa rgyal mtshan/ snar thang ba si bha shrī/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang / chos 'khor snang ba shes rab rin chen/ mgos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal/ khrims khang ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag gi mkhan po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te zha lu lo chen chos skyong dpal bzang po 'dis ni mdzod 'grel gnam lcags thog gzer dang mdzod kyi gnas dgu pa sogs 'gyur mang po mdzad/ phyi dus brda sprod yan lag da nga bcas pa'i bstan pa rmang nas gsos te dar bar mdzad do/ /de ltar lo paṇa de rnams kyis mdo rgyud man ngag bka' bstan bcos mang du bsgyur zhing 'gyur bcos dang zhus dag sogs mdzad pa'i drin las deng sang du'ang bstan pa'i cha shas tsam gnas pa yin no/ /'di phyin rang rang gi phyogs gzhung nas mching bu nor bu'i grel du 'dzud pa ma yin pa'i lo paṇa tshad ldan mthong na bsnan par bya zhing snga ma rnams phal cher bu'i chos byung ltar yin zhing cung zad kha bkang ba yin yang 532

—bdag 'dra bas ma thos pa mang ba'i phyir 'dir ma chud pa'i tshad ldan gyi lo paṇa gzur gnas kyis mthong na bsnan par bya'o/ /legs par bshad pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bod yul gyi skabs las lo paṇa ji ltar byon pa spyir bstan pa ste skabs bzhi pa'o/ /nor 'dzin dbang mo tshogs gnyis grub ma yis/ /par 'di byar gyi gzhag yul /ga rtser bsgrubs/ /shu bhaX/ /533
yarnga lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs /chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gsum pa bod yul gyi skabs la le'u bcu las skabs lnga pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos byung bzhugs so/ /

le' lnga pa gsang sngags rling ma'i chos rgyang /ra ba / sna rang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings gzod nas ye rdzogs kun tu bzang / /lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs pas/ /dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i gdul bya la/ /rtsol med lhun grub theg pa bla med che/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba dus bzhir ni/ /dus med bstan pas gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ /rgyal sras bla med byang chub chen por bkod/ /de lta'i chos kyi rnam grangs nam mkha' yi/ /tshad kyis klas pa gzhal du med pa las/ /rtsa mchog bu ga tsam zhig 'dzam gling 'dir/ /dga' rab rdo rje shrī sidha dang / /dzñā na snyu tra mkhas pa bī ma la/ /padmā kā ra la sogs mchog dngos kyi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa du mas snang bar mdzad/ /skyed rim ston pa'i rgyud sde snga 'gyur tshogs/ /du mas skal ldan mang zhig smin grol byas/ /rdo rje phur bu padma dbang chen sogs/ /drag sngags grub pa'i nus ldan dpag med kyis/ /bod yul sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu bsrungs/ /de bas bod la gcig tu bka' drin che/ /de ltar rdo rje theg pa snga 'gyur gyi/ /lha tshogs rnams dang rtsa rgyud bla mar bcas/ /mchog gi rig pa grub pa thams cad la/ /dang pa'i yid kyis rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi phyogs la 'gos khug pa lha btsas sogs kyis mdzad do bar grags pa'i sngags log sun 'byin du 'dod pa du mar bka' bstan bcos khungs ma min par smra ba byung ba rnams ni bdag gis kyang gzhan du lan btab zin cing spyir lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sngags log sun 'byin dang lha zhi ba 'od kyi 'jam yig sogs ni 537

gsar rnying gang gi'ang rung ste sbyor dgrol la sogs pa'i sngags spyod so skyer/ sgra/ ji bzhin du spyod pa 'gog pa yin gyi gsang sngags rnying ma'i rtsa ba 'gog pa ma yin la/ jo bo rje la sogs nga rgya gar gyi paṇa grub de tsam khri ga bod du byon pa thams cad kyis ma bkag pa'i phyir dang / gal te klu dkar rgyal gyis bka' brdzus ma bstan pa lta bu yin na bstan pa la shin tu sel che bas lo chen rin bzang gis klu dkar rgyal btul ba ltar rnying ma smra ba 'dul byed kyi skyes bu dam pa rdzu 'phrul dang nus par ldan pa byon nas btul te phyin chad thams cad kyis yang dag ma yin par shes nas su yang mi 'jug pa zhig nges par 'ong dgos pa las de lta bu ma byung ba'i phyir dang / gal te bka' brdzus ma yin na paṇḍi ta mkhas pa bod du byon pa rnams kyis mi mkhyen pa mi srid cing mkhyen na bstan pa'i dben de lta bu la btang stoms su 'jog pa ga la srid pa'i phyir dang /bka' gdams glegs bam tshad mar byed na de las jo bo rje nyid sngon slob dpon padmar mdzad de bod kyi lha srin btul ba'i dus kyi chos bla mas da lta sngags pa rnams la dar ba 'di yin zhes gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen shākya shrī dang khro phu lo tsā ba chen pos bsam yas nas gsang snying gi rgya dpe rnyed de rta ston gzi brjid kyi phyag tu byung ba sha gang lo tsā ba la phul/ des bcom ldan ral gri la bskur bas thugs 'ches te gas/nga snying grub pa rgyan gyi me tog brtsams te der gsang 'dus kyi 'grel chen bee shā mi tras mdzad pa las/ ye shes sems dpa' gang reg pa/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ gsang ba snying po las log min gyi gnas mtha' dang mu med pa na gzhi tshang med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba la ye shes rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang rgya phyogs bcur yongs su ma chad pa zhes drangs pa sogs gsang snying gi mtshaca smos nas lung gsal bar lan brgyad dgur bgrangs pa smos shing / log pa'i 538 —

skyon bzhi brjod pa 'di skad bdag gis bshad pa zhes mi rigs pa dang / gzhi tshad med mi/ rigs pa dang / dus gsum la dus bzhir bshad pa mi rigs rnga/ dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpas byas pa mi rigs pa bzhi la/'di skad bdag gis bshad pa'i dus gcig na zhes pa ni ston pa nyid sdud pa por bzhed pa'i lugs te/ 'dus ba'i 'grel pa mtsho skyes rdo rje'i gsang ba grub par/ slob dpon phal cher 'di skad brjod/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa mdangs chen gyi/ /rgyud kyi sdud par byed pa po/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten dbang phyug zer/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sdud pa po/ /gzhan dag yod pa ma yin zhes/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed/ /rgyud mdzad po ni thugs rdo rje/ /zhes ston pa nyid kyis bsdus par bzhed pa yin la/ gzhi tshad med kyang mngon pa nas 'og min tshad med du bshad pa dang / dus bzhi yang pi sha mi tra'i 'grel par/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid du de bzhin rig par bya/ /zhes dang / phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i mgon po kun gyi zhes bshad la sangs rgyas gsang bas dus bzhi bskal pa bzhi la bshad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbus su 'byung ba ni gtso bo 'pho ba ste gsar ma nas kyang bshad do/ /ti kra ni shes rang ming du smra/ /zhes thig la ti kra ru byas pa ni gsang snying gi rgya dper sru taX pradzñā tikra nyuti zhes yod pa la snyu traX thig gi skad dod yin la thig la ti kra ces 'don pa brda rnying yin la rgyud gzhan du kha 'phangs pa ni dgyes rdor sogs kyang de nyid 'dus par kha 'phangs pa bzhin no zhes dogs pa bsal snang zhing / sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad dang gsang snying gi 'grel pa nyi 'od seng ges byas pa rnams padma ru ci ras bsgyur pa dang /gsang snying gi sangs rgyas gsang ba'i 'grel pa bee ro tsa natho bsgyur bar dkar chag 'phang thang mar bshad ces dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum lce bkra 539

shis kyis bsgyur bar dkar chag 'phang thang ma dang ldan dkar ma gnyis kur bshad ces dang / smṛ ti dang lo chen rin bzang gis yang dag me gcig dang yang dag gi 'grel pa kun snying gis mdzad pa dang rdzogs chen kha cig bsgyur bar yang bcom ral bas bshad do/ /gzhan yang rdo rje bzhad pa'i 'dus pa'i 'grel chen dang mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa brgya byin sdong pos mdzad par yang gsang snying gi lung mang du drangs yod par snang la/ phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu shangs sreg zhing nas slob dpon padma'i rgya dpe dngos rnyed nas sa skya paṇḍi tas bsgyur zhing thar los bal por yang rgya dpe cig gzigs par gsungs so/ /rdzogs chen sems klong man ngag gi sde rnams ni rgya gar nyid du yang spyod pa blang dor med par bstan pa'i don ma rtogs na chad lta dang nye bar 'gyur bas shin tu sbas te sngags la mkhas pa'i paṇḍita rnams dang rgyal pos rgyas btab ste longs spyad du med pa shrī sidha dang bī ma la mu dras bee ro tsa na dang gtsang legs grub la lkog tu bshad pas paṇḍi ta thams cad kyi rmi lam 'khrugs te man ngag gi chos bod du shor bar shes nas slar dpe rnams rdo rje'i gdan du sbas nas mi thon par byas par bai ro'i 'dra 'bag lhad med rnams las mthong bas da lta rgya gar na paṇḍi ta la ma grags pa yin la/ jo bo rjes bsam yas su rgya dpe'i dkor mdzod gcig kha phye nas gzigs pas sngar gsan gzigs med pa'i rgyud shin tu mang bar gzigs te ngas 'dzam gling na grags pa'i rgyud rnams su ma zad mkha' 'gro mas bstan pa kho na yang mtha' yas par mthong ste de kun la yang rgyud 'di rnams mi gda'/ phal cher slob dpon padmas rdzu 'phrul gyis srin ngo 'i yul nas blangs pa yin mchi theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di la mtha' med pa rang du 'dug ces sngags la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal ma lus pa der chag par bshad pas de kun ni phal cher rdzogs chen gyi rgyud rnams su gor 540

ma chag snyam la/ 'dung pa mdo ni lhas zhus pa'i mdo'am mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po ces grags pa/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu'i chos kyi/ /sogs kyi khungs de nyid yin par 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal ba sogs 'chad do/ /spyir sangs rgyab/ kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gtso bor lha klu sogs 'gro ba'i gnas gzhan kho na na bzhugs pa las sher phyin 'bum pa sogs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis klu yul nas blangs/ mdo sde sa bcu pa sogs mang zhig 'phags pa thogs med kyis dga' ldan nas blangs te dar ba na nyan thos pa kun gyis skur pa btab pa las theg chen bkar bsgrubs/ gsang sngags rnying ma rnams slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje dang slob dpon chen po padma la sogs kyis 'og min dang srin po'i yul sogs nas spyan drangs/ dgyes rdor bde mchog 'dus pa la sogs pa 'phags pa klu sgrub dang rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi dang slob dpon la ba pa dang rta mchog bi na sa la sogs pas spyan drangs te dar ba'i tshe mtshan nyid theg pa ba rnams kyis sgro skur byas pa na gsang sngags bkar sgrub dgos pa byung ba yin/ des na bod yul pa dag rgya dpe yod na yang dag yin la med na yang dag min par 'chad pa 'di la yang de tsam gyi snying po ci yod de rgya dpe rgyang 'phen gyi gzhung la sogs pa mu stegs kyi chos rnams la yang yod la dga' ldan dang 'og min dang klu la sogs pa'i gnas nas blangs pa'i glegs bam rnams rgya gar gyi tā la'i lo ma kho na la lo paṇa la grags pa'i yi ge kho nas bris pa cig yod par dka' ste de rnams kyi bri gzhi snag tsha yig gzugs sogs gang du yod shes dka' bas gal te mthong na khyed cag yang dag ma yin par lta ba'i blo skye yang srid la/ yang sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab kyang yul dus kyi gdul bya de'i khams dang dbang po dang 'tshams par de'i skad dang tshig tu go bar 'gyur ba ltar zhing gzhan nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus chos kyi glegs bam 541

'byung ba na yang yul dus de'i skad dang yig gzugs su 'byung bar yang mi 'gal bas slob dpon padma lta bus bod kyi gdul bya'i don du 'og min sogs nas glegs bam spyan drangs pa na yang bod kyi skad dang yig gzugs su mi 'byon par yang ma nges pas nyan rang dang byang sems rnams kyis kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas 'di dag la bdag cag byis pa rnams kyis tshad 'dzin pa'i ngal bas ci bya ste bag yod par spyod cig des na rgyal ba byams pas/sngar lung ma bstan lhan cig byung / /spyod yul ma yin grub pa dang / /yod dang med na yod med dang / /gnyen po dang ni sgra gzhan phyir/ /zhes pas theg chen bkar bsgrubs pa'i rigs pa 'di kho nas gsang sngags rnying ma yang bkar sgrub nus te/ gal te rnying ma bka' min na ma 'ongs par gsang sngags rnying ma'am rdzogs chen bya ba bka' ma yin pa bka' ltar bcos pa 'byung zhes lung rton rigs pa las de ltar bstan pa mi snang ba'i phyir dang / de lta bu 'byung ba ma mkhyen pa mi rigs te sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum gyi spyan can yin la dus la'ang ye shes ma bsgribs pa'i phyir/ mkhyen kyang ma bstan pa mi rigs te bstan pa dag kyang srung bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ bde dgyes la sogs pa rnaca/sa kyis kyang rgyud rgyas pa 'bum bdun dang 'bum lnga mngon brjod 'bum pa chen po sogs rnams dang snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sde chen po 'di rnams ni sngon rdzogs ldan la sogs pa'i dus su mtshungs par gsungs pas rgyud de dag lhan cig du byung ba yin na de las gang yang dag dang gang ltar snang du 'jog mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi rgyud lhad med 'di lta bu rtog ge pa la sogs pas rtsom par ga la nus te 'di lta bu nyan rang gi yang spyod yul ma yin na gzhan gyis lta ci smos pa'i phyir/ gal te ston pa las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas zhig gis gsungs so snyam na de ltar na bka' yin par grub pa dang / yang gsar ma'i rgyud sde 'di dag 542

las gzhan pa'i gsang sngags yod dam med/ med na gsang sngags ni mtha' mi mngon par bshad pa dang 'gal zhing / yod na snga 'gyur 'di dag kyang sangs rgyas pa'i gsang sngags yang dag ci'i phyir ma yin/ sngon slob dpon padma la chos rgyal khri srong gis btsun mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal phul ba bzhes pas blon po rnams btsun mo yang phrogs pas rgyal srid 'phrog nges zer nas gshegs par gsol ba btab snang bas rgyal po la ma rgyud kyi gdams pa gnang bar gdon mi za la/ dge slong lus la phyag rgya bsten/ /zhes slob dpon padma dngos rig gi lam par yang snang ba de dus bde dgyes sogs ni ma bsgyur/ rnying ma ni bka' min pas slob dpon padmas rgyal po la gsungs pa dang snubs na mkha' snying pos las rgya las sgrub pa mdzad par grags pa'i dbang gsum pa'i lam de dag gzhan gang zhig yin te rnying ma'i gsang sngags nyid las 'os ci mchis/gal te gsar ma'i rgyud dang mi mtshungs pa du ma yod pas so zhe na/ 'o na rgyun mi chad pas rgyud du bshad pa sogs mtshungs pa de bas kyang mang bas des yang dag tu yang cis sgrub mi nus/ rdzogs chen du las 'bras med pa dang 'khor 'das gang yang med pa'i sngon du kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas pa sogs bshad pas yang dag ma yin no snyam na/ las 'bras med pa ni las 'bras la gcig tu zhen pa'i gnyen po'i 'dzin pa gzhig pa'i ched de mdo las kyang mtshon cha thogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pa dang / rgyal la sogs la chags ba phra/ /zhes bshad pa ltar yin gyi gnas skabs gzhan du ma yin la/ 'khor 'das gang yang med pa'i sngon ni chos dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la 'khor 'das gang yang mi dmigs pa dang / de rang ngo shes pas kun bzang tshogs ma bsags sgrib pa ma sbyangs par sangs rgyas pa ni/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed/ /ces pa ltar chos dbyings rang ngo shes na de 543

nyid du grol ba dang / de'i 'od lnga ye shes lnga dang sku lngar shar ba sogs rtsi lhan skyes kyi sku 'od gsal de nyid longs sprul gyi rnam pa thams cad du 'char zhing sems nyid dri ma med pa 'di las ci yang snang du rung ba'i don la sogs par gleng gzhi lta bu'i sgo nas gzhi lam 'bras bu brjod pas sgra gzhan du bstan par bya ba yin gyi lo rgyus brjod pa ma yin la/ 'di ni gsar ma'i rgyud sde la yang 'di skad bdag thos sogs yi ge'i don du tshig 'di skad ston pas gsungs pa sdud pa po bdag gis dus der 'khor de dag dang lhan cig par thos pa'i dus cig na zhes lo rgyus ltar yod mod kyang / sbas don du e yig dmar cha dang waṃ yig dkar cha dang a yig bar srid gsum tshogs pa e waṃ gnyis med las skyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi lus grub pa sogs su 'chad cing /mthar thug gi don du e shes rab dang waX yig thabs thig le gnyis su med pa ste gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med du ston par bshad pa yin no/ /des na gsar rnying gi rgyud 'dzin po su yin yang rung ste rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang 'khor 'das kyi byung tshul 'di dag sngon byung gi lo rgyus kho nar rtog par ni mi bya ste lo rgyus kyi tshul gyis nyams su blang bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston par rig par bya'o/ /des na rdzogs chen las 'khor 'das kyi thog ma'i mtha' bshad do snyam na nges pa'i don 'di mtshon byed yin gyi bskal pa chags 'jig bshad pa lta bu zhig ma yin no/ /nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po yang byed de skyed rim dang rdzogs rim chags lam dang grol lam gnyis kyis lam sbyong par gsar ma'i bla med rnams dang tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na skyed rdzogs kyis rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa 'dul pas rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba la snang / dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i rang gi sems nyid 'od gsal ba la 'jug pas sngags kyi mdo sde la 'jug chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin cir yang 544

ma grub cing gang du yang 'char rung ba dang mi 'gal ba'i phyir chos nyid dang mi 'gal bas na bka' yang dag pa ste/ ston pa nyid kyis nga mya ngan las 'das nas 'dul ba la snang mdo sde la 'jug chos nyid dang mi 'gal na bka' yin par zung la de las ldog na ma yin par zung zhig zhes gsungs la rgyal ba byams pas/ rang gi 'dul la snang phyir dang / /zhes theg chen nyid la sbyar ba bzhin no/ /'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na zhes dang rdzogs so'i dod du nam du yang ma rdzogs so zhes 'byung ba sogs kyang / brtag gnyis las/'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan po nga / /'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga / /'jig rten 'jig rten /3das pa nga / /zhes chos thams cad ston pa nyid du gsungs pa dang khyed med la/ rjod byed tshig gi rgyud kyi mthar rtogs so sbyar ba ni re zhig glegs bam de rdzogs pa'i don yin gyi rgyud rdzogs pa'i don min la/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud las brtsams na nam yang ma rdzogs pa'i rgyun chad med pa cig ma bzhag na rgyud du ji ltar 'jog des na don la rton par bya'i tshig tsam la brtsad pas ci zhig bya/ dus thams cad kyi mchog ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos nyid kyi dus yin la dus gsum ni 'jig rten gyi gdags pa tsam ste des na dus bzhir bshad pa la 'gal ba ci yod/ rdor sems lha'i gtso bor mi rigs nas mthar rdor sems gtso bor byas pa'ang 'gog dgos so/ /spyir rdor sems kyi mtshan rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang la 'jug pa'i skabs dang rigs lnga pa'i mi bskyod pa la 'jug pa dang gsang sngags kyi byang chub sems dpa' spyi la 'jug pa dang rdor rigs kyi sems dpa' spyi la 'jug pa dang rdor rigs kyi sems dpa'i nang tshan rnal 'byor rgyud kyi shar gyi sems dpa' bzhi'i dang po la 'jug pa sogs mang bas skabs thob ma phye ba'i ming tsam la rtsod pa ni bod phyi rabs pa rnams kyis mkhas nyams su byed par snang da7/5

mod/ dpyod ldan gyi mdun du brim par bya ba ca/ yin no/ /btags grol dang mthong grol dang myong grol sogs kyang gdul byed dang der rigs sad pa las 'phro bzhag pa kha cig la ni de dag gi de ma thag du grol ba yang yod 'a spyir phan yon gyi sgo nas dus gzhan la dgongs pa yin yang gang zag des da lta nyid la go nas 'jug pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin la/ za ma tog gi mdo las yig drug gi phan yon bshad pa dang so sor 'brang ma'i mdo las gzungs de lus la bcangs pa'i phan yon bshad pa sogs gsar ma'i mdo rgyud la ches mang zhing sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa 'thob par gsungs pa dang yang mtshungs so/ /lung rigs kyis grub par ma zad dam pa rgya gar gyis rdzogs chen yang dag tu gsungs pa dang / dam pa'i bla ma pha rgyud g.yo ba rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi bla ma bcu gcig gi nang nas yo ga la mkhas pa gsum gyi gcig buddhā guhya ste sangs rgyas gsang ba yin la de'i skabs su/ de la rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud 'di la rtsa rgyud gsang snying sogs rgyud 'grel gdams pa lag len dang bcas pa dpag med bzhugs kyang nyams len tshig gsum po 'dis chog ste/ dag snang yid la byas pas dngos 'dzin yid kyi spu ris subs nas snang ba sprul skur 'char ba 'di ni buddhā gu bya'i gdams pa yin zhes sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rnam thar dang bcas te gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen shātrī'i khyad par gyi bla ma bzhi las gdams pa khyad par ba bzhi zhes pa'i gcig slob dpon padma las rdo rje phur pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag gsan pa la byas pa dang / rje mi la sogs mar pa'i bka' rgyud kyi grub chen phal cher gyis phyag rdzoṭa gcig tu sbyor zhing 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po dang thams cad mkhyen rang byung rdo rje sogs kyis rtsa 'khor lo lnga la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rigs lnga dang rtsa phran la gzhan gsum bkod pa dang / rje rgod tshang pas dzā landha rar byon dus 546

de'i skor du rdzogs chen gyi grub thob mang po mjal ba dang rje yang dgon pa'i thugs dam rdzogs chen las 'khrungs pa dang zhang g.yu brag pa'i 'chims phu bka' rgya ma zhes slob dpon padma bo ddhi sa ta bī ma la mi tra zha mas la dngos su gsan pa'i rdzogs chen gyi gdams ngag yod pa sogs gsar ma nyid kyi yang skyes chen mtha' dag gis mngon du mdzad cing / bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas drug par rtsod pa med pa grub thob garma pag shis sngon rdzogs ldan gyi mtha' ma mang bkur rgyal po'i dus rdo rje 'chang ind+ra bo dhi ye shes sgrib pa med pa'i skur bstan pa'i tshe shākya'i rigs mthong na yid 'ong gi mdun du kho bo yang rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'od ye shes dbyings su gyur/ rgyal po dza'i khab tu chos kyi char bab pa'i tshe rgyal po'i tsha bo badzra shrīr gyur/ lha'i bu kun dga' snying po dga' rab rdo rje byas te rdzogs pa chen po ston pa'i tshe tog ce rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pas rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa bzhi thams cad rtogs pa nas da lta'i bar gsang sngags gsar rnying thams cad ji lta bar mngon du gyur zhes sngon gnas rjes su dran pas gsal bar bstan zhing phyag rdzogs dbyer med pa'i sku bzhi gnad kyi ngo sprod gdams ngag gi snying por mdzad pa dang / rje rang byung pas bī ma la rang gi mdzod pur thim par gzigs te snying thig gi don ji lta ba mngon du gyur te yig cha mdzad/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje kurmar bzhugs dus kun bzang gi dgongs pa mthar thug rdzogs chen thod rgal gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur nas/ rang gsal snying po stong gsal kun tu bzang / /gdod nas dag pa rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings/ /gzhi lnga'i gdangs la rang gsal kun tu khyab/ /'od lnga'i gdangs la ma btsos mnyam par bzhag /zhes sogs kyi rdo rje'i mgur mdzad/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rjes gu ru mtshan brgyad zhang sku brgyad /rma pa rabs brgyad rnams dbyer med du gzigs nas 547—ོ

de'i bla ma sgrub pa mdzad/ jo nang kun mkhyen gyis jo nang gi sku 'bum gyi srogashing o rgyan gyis btsugasopar gzigs shing lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gcig o rgyan gyi lha khang du mdzad pa sogs skyes chen mtha' yas pa phyogs 'dir dgongs pa gcig pa yin la/ gter ma yang spyan ras gzigs kyis/ nga dang khyod gnyis khyad par med/ /skyer pa sgang 'di po ta la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dbon ston skyer sgang pas mnal lam bzung ste o rgyan du byon/ slob dpon padma las rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi man ngag zhus tshe rta mgrin gyi skur bzhengs nas lan gsum gsungs te rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'di ngas bod du lha srin 'dul du 'ongs pa'i tshe snye mor sbas pa da lta sngags pa cig gis thon nas yod pas zhus shig gsungs nas snye mor sngags pa de la zhus/ phyis slob dpon gyi drung du zhus dag byas pas da dung 'khor lo ma byin par 'dug pas zhus shig gsungs te slar 'bul ba byas nas 'khor lo byin par bshad pas slob dpon gyis sdod ldan gyi don du sbas pa'i gter yod par grub la/ zhang rin po ches 'phrad po'i brag nas lung bstan gyi shog ser rnyed/ jo nang kun mkhyen dang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bsku la'i sku'i bkod pa gnyag dbon chen pos grub thob 'dar bya ru ba'i gter ma rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa la thugs dam gtso bor mdzad/ dpal ldan sa skya pa na rim gyi yi dam gyi gtso bo phur pa bka' ma la mdzad pa sogs yang dag pa'i shes byed bgrang ba las 'das pa yin no/ /'on kyang phyi dus rang bzo sna tshogs dang chos sna tshogs bsres shing de thams cad gter brdzus byas nas rnyed pa 'tshol zhing blun po mgo bskor/ de la brten nas yang dag pa'i dpyod ldan rnams yi chad/ dpyod ldan du rlom pa'i rtog ge pa rnams de mthong bas rnying ma thams cad la skur ba 'debs shing ra gan gser brdzus gcig gnyis mthong ba'i rtags kyis gser 548

thams cad la skur pa 'debs pa ltar snang mod kyang shākya'i bstan pa tha ma la phal cher bdung dbang du gyur nas log pa'i tshul mang du 'byung bar gsungs pas 'di dag ni rdo rje theg pa rnying ma'i bstan pa la bar chad byed pa'i gdon gdug pa can zhig gis dang por lung bstan sna tshogs dang lha 'dre'i nor phra mo re gnyis rnyed du bcug pas rlom sems skyed rgyud chos min du bsgyur nas phyis rdzun rgyab tu rdzun gyi 'khor lo bskor bas gter chos yang dag rnams kyang dri ma can du byed pa zhig yin par snang la/ bdag gi slob ma bsam gtan pa mang po la yang thog mar rmi lam dang nyams su gter gnas ston pa dang kha byang gi lung ston pa sogs mang du byung snang ba rnams skyon yon dang bden rdzun du ma bzung bar nyams len par bskyangs pas phyis gdon gyi rtags re bstan nas de phyin mi 'byung ba mang du byung bas phyis 'byung rnams 'di la gzab par bya zhing / 'di rigs dang lha sku zhal mthong sogs thams cad la spyir lam 'bras las brdas brtag bar bshad kyang 'di rigs kyi skad cig de rtog med la 'byung bas de'i tshe brda dran bar dka' la sprul sku zhal mthong ba sogs yang dag yin na the tshom tsam skyes pas kyang dngos grub ring du byed cing ltar snang yin na dad pa tsam skyes pas kyang bar chad cung zad re mi 'byung mi srid pas 'di thams cad la bden rdzun gyi rlom sems med par nyams len bskyangs pa'i tshe yang dag yin na je gsal je brtan du 'gyur/ nyams rtogs kyang gong du 'phel/ mos gus dang snying rje cher rgyas par 'gyur la/ yang dag min na rang la rlom sems dang nga rgyal skye/ bla ma dang gdams ngag la the tshom za ba zhig 'byung / 'on kyang bar chad kyi rlom sems su yang ma bzung bar bskyangs bas mthar cho 'phrul ston pa'am rang bzhin gyis zhi bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /des na rgya gar na gsar rnying tha dad pa med kyang bod du 'gyur snga phyi'i dbang gis ming tha dad thogs shing tha 549

snyad mi 'dra ba cung zad 'byung ba ni dgyes rdor gyi rgyud nyid la'ang brtag gnyis dang phyag thig dang ye shes thig le rnams tha snyad mi 'dra ba yod 1 4 bzhin yin la/rog gi mkhas pa shes rab 'od kyi grub mtha' chen mor gsar rnying la khyad yod med gsum byas pa'ang khyad yod par 'dod pa gzhan lugs kyi na yams bkod/khyad med par 'dod pa rang lugs kyi lan dngos bshad/ khyad par che bar 'dod pa rnying ma'i che ba dbyung ba ste ston byed paṇḍita'i khyad par sngon gyi slob dpon padma la sogs pas bstan pa dang phyis kyi paṇḍita gser 'tshol ba'i ched du bod la gang brin gyi chos byed cing chos re la yang dum bu mang por bcad nas re re la gser gyi yon tha dad pa len pas bshad pa mi 'dra/ sgyur byed lo tsā ba'i khyad par sngon gyi lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad sogs rgya dpe las bod skad dang bod dpe las rgya skad du bklag nus pa rnams kyis bsgyur zhing zhus pa dang phyis kyi lo tsā ba dbyar mang yul du bsdad dgun bal por phyin sngon bsgyur ba rnams la 'gyur bcos su ming btags nas bcos bslad re byed pa chos bsgyur ba mi 'dra/ spyan 'dren yon bdag gi khyad par chos rgyal byang sems rnams kyis spyan drangs pa dang da lta dzo gi'am lo tsā ba re tsam gyis khrid nas 'ongs pa mi 'dra/chos gzhi bzhugs gnas kyi khyad par sngon bsam yas la sogs par gdan phab pa dang deng sang dgon bu cag cog rer sdod pa mi 'dra/ zhu rten gser phye'i khyad par sngon gser phye sha ba'i rlud bu bkang nas 'bul ba sogs dang phyis zho re zho gnyis 'bul ba mi 'dra zhes rnying ma'i che ba 'don phyir brjod par zad de/jo bo rje dang paṇa chen shā kshi sogs gser dang bong bar mnyam pa'i dam pa 'di dag ni phyis—gdul dka' ba'i dus su yang 'phrin las 'di lta bu mdzad pa las na sangs rgyas gnyis par snang la/ lo tsā ba yang lo chen rin chen bzang po/rngog lo tsā ba chen po/ khro lo byams pa'i dpal rnams ni mkhyen pa dang 'phrin 550

las gnyi ga sngon gyi lo tsā ba mtha' dag bsdus pas kyang mi do bar snang la/spyan 'dren kyang lha bla ma ye shes 'od lta bu chos phyir srog bta nga ba blori ra ba las brgal ba de lta bu byung bas gcig tu nges pa ni ma yin la/ spyir paṇḍita kha cig bod rab byung la tshis che bar thos nas kyi rong tu jo bo'i mdun du rtags rang blangs byas nas bod du mkhan po byed pa lo tsā ba kha cig gis mthong zer ba sogs kyang du ma snang bas spyir du ni de dag la yang bden pa'i cha shas yod do/ /de ltar gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnams bka' yang dag du bsgrubs nas de yang de ni de dag gi dam pa'i chos ji ltar byung ba brjod par bya ste/gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos kyi gtso bo ni sems phyogs sgyu 'phrul 'dus pa mdo ste mdo sgyu sems gsum zhes grags pa yin la de las de yang sems phyoṭa rdzogs pa chen po ji ltar byung ba ni 'khor 'das gang gi yang rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa ngo bo stong rang bzhin 'od gsal thugs rje 'gag med du bzhugs pa ni gzhi de bzhin nyid de 'khor 'das su shar ba na yang de nyid las g.yo ba med do/ /gal te 'khor 'das su 'dogs pa na ni kun bzang nas 'jag mig gi srin bu'i bar khyad med par shes bya'i gshis gnas lugs kyi 'dug tshul rang bzhin bden gnyis dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen por ye sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ste/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas par/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rang bzhin ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ces so/ /de la 'khor 'das kyi gdags pa med pa ni ngo bo'i cha nas yin la btags pa ni 'dogs 'dod kyi cha nas yin pas mi 'gal te bum pa la ming gang yang mi gnas pa dang gang yang 'dogs su rung ba mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /de las rang bzhin tha mi dad pa'i ye shes kyi rlung g.yo ba med par g.yos pas rang bzhin go 'byed pa'i cha las rang rtsal lhun grub kyi snang ba shar dus ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje tha mi dad pa de nyid rang ngo 551

rang gis shes pas gzhi thog de nyid du 'bras bur rang grol ba ni thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i kun tu bzang po gzhi thog nas byang chub kho ste spros bral chen po gzhon nu bum pa sku'i zhing khams zhes bya ba chos sku'i zhing khams rgya tshad las 'das pas na lhun grub kyi dbyings na dus bzhi 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' ji srid bar phun tshogs lnga ldan du bzhugs zhes bya la 'on kyang rten brten pa dang dbyibs kha dog gi rnam pa ni med do/ /de ltar sangs rgyas dang sems can 'khor ba dang myang 'das thams cad kyi gzhi tha mi dad pa de nyid las rang rtsal lhun grub kyi snang ba shar ba'i tshe rang ngo shes par ma nus pa ni ma rig pa yin la de las las kyi rlung g.yos te ngo bo ma rtogs bzhin du rang bzhin la bdag dang rang rtsal la gzhan du 'khrul bas gzung 'dzin srid pa'i 'khor lor snang ba ni 'khor ba ste 'di'i tshe yang gzhi las g.yos pa ni med do/ /de ltar rmi lam ltar mi bden kyang bden pa ltar 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams la 'bad pa dang rtog pa dang mtshan ma med bzhin du mkhyen zhing brtse ba thugs rang byung gi ye shes lnga'i rnam par g.yos pa las chos kyi sku de nyid las g.yo pa med bzhin du 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mthas klas par rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho dang rigs drug pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mtshan dpe mtha' yas pa can longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs te rang nyid kyi phung khams skye mched la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams las 'khor gyi rnam par snang yang gcig pa dang tha dad pa gang yang ma yin pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul phra ba snyed la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa chos thams cad gzod nas ye sangs rgyas pa lhun grub yongs rdzogs su ston pa bya rtsol dang bral ba'i theg pa nyid smra bsam brjod pa dang bral bar ci yang 552

mi ston nga'i tshul gyis thog ma med pa'i dus nas bstan cing da ltar ston la phyi ma'i mthar nga/zhal bar mi nus pa nam mkha' ji srid pa dang sems can ji srid pa de srid du ston par 'gyur bas skad cig kyang rgyun chad pa med la sku nam mkha' gang ba de rnams kyi ba spu'i sgo nas spos chu'i rgyun gangs chen mtsho 'bab pas nam mkha' kun gang la phyag mtshan 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin chen dang padma dang rgya gram rnams so so'i khong seng las skyes pa'i padma nyer lnga la zhing gi gtso bo nyer lnga dang de thams cad kyi go na 'byung bzhi'i rdul phra rab ji snyed pa re re'i khongs na yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dbyibs rgyu tshad kha dog 'gro ba'i ris tha dad pa bsam par mi nus pa zhing thams cad kyi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa yod la de rnams kyang chags 'jig stongs gnas sna tshogs pa nyi zer gyi rdul g.yo ba lta bu yin la phar phyin theg par rnam snang gangs chen mtsho zhes pa tsam las med kyang theg pa 'dir rigs thams cad kyi gangs chen mtsho'i ston pa gsungs pa 'di ni nam yang mya ngan las 'da' ba med pa ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dngos bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar nam mkhas khyab tshad na zhing gis khyab pa'i zhing so so'i 'gro ba rnams kyi chos sku mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba nyid longs sku rigs drug gi rnam par bzhengs pa de dag la snang ba dag pa rnams kyis mdo'i sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pa dang sngags kyi sangs rgyas he ru ka kha sbyor gyi sku zhi ba dang khro bo sna tshogs su snang bar 'gyur la rang dang 'tshams pa'i chos theg pa de dang de gsung bar mthong nas lam de dag sgrub par 'gyur la/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par mthong mi nus pa rnams kyis grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du snang la/ lha rnams kyis rang rang gi gtso bor snang bas bag med las ldog pa dang lha min gyis thag bzang ris su snang bas rang gi srid srung bar mthong la/ dud 'gros seng ge la sogs pa rang 553

rang gi gtso bor mthong ste skrag pas des bstan pa las 3gong mi nus pa dong /yi dwags rnams kyis gtso mo kha 'bar ma lta bur snang ste ser snari nyes pa ston pa dang / dmyal ba pa rnams kyis gshin rje'i rgyal po dang dan+ya nga spu nga du snang bas las 'bras lung ston pas lasha rgyu 'bras la yid 'ches bskyed pa so gas ga nga 'dul der snang ba ston pa ste/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /zhes sprul sku 'byung ba'i go rim du bstan pa nyid kho na yin la des na mi'i thub pa shākya seng ge zhes bshad pa'ang bstan pa 'di'i gtso bo'i dbang du spyir bstan gyi bye brag du rang nyid gang gis 'dul ba de kho na rang skal gyi thub pa yin pas rang cag gi thub pa dang kun bzang dang rdo sems ni rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di kho na yin par rig nga/ra bya'o/ /de yang chos sku'i zhing ni 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams zhes bstan te longs sprul gyi zhing gnyis ka 'dir chud do/ /longs sku'i zhing ni tshangs pa rnga sgrari zhing khams zhes bya ste sprul sku'i zhing thams cad 'di'i khongs su chud do/ /sprul sku'i zhing ni tshangs chen gyi zhing zhes bya ste dag ma dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'dir chud do/ /de ltar 'khor 'das spyir bshad nas zhing 'dir ston pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i tshul ni/ thog ma'i mgon po de nyid zhing 'di 'dul ba'i phyir ris mthun gyi sems can mir gyur pas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing lam bgrod nas sangs rgyas par snang ba ste/ kha cig thog ma'i mgon po las rgyud tha dad pa'i sems can gyis sems skyed par 'dod pa la ni/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje las/ dang po'i rgyal ba sa rgyal ba/ /sems dpa' che dang 'joms pa che/ /zhes dang / 'di ni ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhes mkhas pa klong chen pas bshad do/ /de yang sngon bskal pa mtha' yas pa na zhing khams rang bzhin rnam par bkod par sangs rgyas me tog mdzes pa chen po la gser 554

gyi rdo rje zhig phul nas dang por thugs bskyed/ de nas ci zhig na bram ze leṭa byin du gyur pa'i tshe mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te chos sku'i dgongs pa la bzhugs pa las longs skur rang byon te mdzad pa sum bcu rtsa drug dang ldan par thugs rje phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i ngang las rigs lnga 'khor grangs med brjod du med pa chos nyid kun tu bzang po'i longs spyod du 'dus shing rdzogs pa chen po'i skur 'od 'bar to/ /de'i tshe 'od khyim rnam dag bkod legs kyi khang brtsegs su ston pa rang shes rig gi rgyal po rnam snang gangs chen mtsho zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu 'byung ste sku gsung thugs byas pa med pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i ngang las mi g.yo mi 'byung mi gnas mi len mi 'dor mi skyod pa nyid du rang byung la gdul bya ma yin la 'dul byed du gyur pa'i 'khor tshom bu 'bum phrag grangs med pa yang nyid kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las las 'phros shing 'dus te thams cad kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ma yin pa stug po bkod pa rang snang dag pa rang shar gyi zhing dag par 'od gsal to/ /de'i snang cha la mtshan dpe phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje 'chang gi skur byung ste sngon rdo rje phul nas sems bskyed pa'i rgyu las so/ /mdor na chos sku'i dus na gnas chos dbyings dmigs pa med par ston pa kun bzang rang bzhin gyis mdzad pa ma lus pa rdzogs pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul ji snyed kyi sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang lhan cig bstan pa dngos rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po dus chos nyid la mthong ba rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul te phun tshogs lngar rtag du bzhugs pa de mtshon byed chos sku rdzogs pa chen po'i byin rlabs las rang shar ba rin po che brgya rtsa gcig gi rgyu las rang 'khrungs pa'i rdo rje tshe lo dpag med nas bcu pa'i bar yul dus de'i mi rnams kyi chag gang ba na mkha' la lhun gyis grub pa ste bstan pa'i btsas dang po'o/ /longs sku'i 555

bstan pa'i dus na ston pa gangs chen mtsho'i spos chu'i mtsho dang padma dang 'od kyi rdul re re la zhing gzhal du med par ston 'khor tshad med par gnas shing bya rtsol dang bral ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa mtshon byed gsung rang byung gi yi ge sus kyang ma byas pa bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig gi glegs bam rin po che brgya rtsa gcig las rang byung ba chos kyi rang sgra sgrog pa nam mkha' la shar ba ni bstan pa'i btsas gnyis pa'o/ /longs sku'i snang cha nyid las gnas ris bcu gnyis su ston pa bcu gnyis su snang bas sems can rnams 'dul bar mdzad de de mtshon byed sprul sku'i byin rlabs las rang byung ba rin po che brgya rtsa gcig las sus kyang ma byas par grub pa'i sku gzugs 'gro ba'i lus bongs dang mnyam pa cig nam mkha' la rang byung ba ni bstan pa'i btsas gsum pa ste 'di dag sku gsung thugs kyi bstan pa gar yod du gnas la/ thugs kyi rten rdo rjes 'gro ba'i re 'dod thams cad skong / gsung gi rten glegs bam de dang phrad pa dang sgra thos pa tsam gyis grol bar byed de 'di'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni btags grol gyi rgyud/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na/ mtho dman phyi nang med gnas su/ /ston pa kun tu bzang po yis/ /ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /yab kyi dgongs pa kun tu bzang / /a ti rang shugs tshig du byin/ /e ma 'di 'dzin skal ba che/ /'di ni rang byung chen po'o/ /zhes sogs yab dang yum dang gnyis med kyi dgongs pa kun tu bzang po btags grol gyi rgyud yin no/ /sku'i rten de gang gis mthong ba'i lus 'od gsal du grol bar byed do/ /de ltar bstan pa'i btsas de dag ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gar yod du gnas pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/bka' gsang nges pa bcu bdun dang / /bstan pa'i gzer dang 'phrul yig bcas/ /sprul sku'i zhing khams thog ma la/ /ston pa kun tu bzang po yis/ /556

stug po bkod pa'i gnas su bzung / /de nas lcang lo can gyi gnas/ /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /'di nyid bzung bas rigs lngar smin/ /de 'das nga yis bzung ba yis/ /rtan pa'i srog shing dam pa yi/ /sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis ni/ /'di la brten nas nges par 'byung / /zhes sogs kyis zhing re rer yang snod kyi dbang gis snying po ldan dang rdzogs ldan chen po rdzogs ldan dang gsum ldan dang gnyis ldan rtsod ldan dang rtsod ldan chen po ste 'byung ba'i dus bdun de dag gi bar rnams la mi 'byung ba'i dus bdun te sgron bskal bdun dang mun bskal bdun zhes kyang bya la/ de ltar dar nub bcu bzhi po rdzogs pa na zhing de'i chos 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs pas zhing gzhan du 'pho ba yin la de yang sngon stug po bkod par kun tu bzang pos bzung / de nas lcang lo can du rnam par snang mdzad kyis bzung / de nas zhing 'di chags nas gnas bskal gyi dang po ston pa bcu gnyis las thog ma'i tshe btsas gsum po 'dir bab cing de nas ya thog ring mo'i mtha' ma'i tshe lo bcu pa 'di'i bar la zhing khams 'dir bstan pa ji ltar 'phar tshul yang / byang gi phyogs ni g.yo ba ldan/ /bstan pa'i sgron me der gnas te/ /dpal ldan skyong zhes bya ba yi/ /dge slong dag gis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de yi yon bdag rgyal po ni/ /dzi na mi tra zhes bya bas/ /bstan pa gsal ba'i gzhi ma byed/ /lo ni stong dang sum brgyar gnas/ /de nas mun pa'i bskal pa ni/ /drug bcu'i bar la gnas pa'o/ /de nas sto phyogs 'tshal pa skyob/ /ces sogs lung bstan pa ste/byang phyogs g.yo ldan du dge slong dpal ldan skyong sbyin bdag rgyal po dzi na mi du dus lo stong dang sum brgya mun bskal drug bcu'o/ /de nas lho phyogs 'tshal pa skyob tu dga' ba'i dpal dang khyim bdag dge ba'i dngos grub kyis lo brgyar 'dzin te mun pa'ang lo brgya dang nyi shu'o/ /de nas shar phyogs rdo rje 557

'byung ba'i ri rtser rgyal po su tase na dang bram ze dza ya a ka ras stong dang bzhi brgyar 'dzin te mun pa lo lnga stong ngo / /de nas nub phyogs bha ti se lir dge slong bde ba skyod dang dpa' bo 'jigs kyis lo stong 'dzin la lnga stong du mun pa'o/ /de nas 'di nyid du babs te lo lnga brgya lnga bcur blo gros bzang po dang mkha' 'gro ma gsal byed mas 'dzin la/ /'di'i tshe lo bcu pa rdzogs nas 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan da 'pho ba'o/ /blo gros bzang po ni 'di 'dzin ri pa thams cad dang lo lnga brgya ni lo chen te lnga brgya lnga brgyar longs pa'o zhes klong chen pas bshad pa ltar na lnga brgya phrag re la lo rer brtsi ba yin nam snyam mo/ /de tsam zhig zhing de'i mi rnams la snang la gzhan du mkha' 'gro'i don byed pa'o/ khyad par 'dzam gling 'di nyid kyi dus bcu bzhi ni/ thal 'gyur las/bstan pa 'jig ba'i nye rgyu ni/ /de dag so so'i gnas dag tu/ /gang zag log sred can zhes bya/ de de dag ni bstan pa kun/ /'jig par byed pa'i nye rgyu yin/ /zhes mun par byed pa'i gang zag spyir bstan nas/ 'di nyid dang po mun pa'i dus/ /dzaspu gling gi nub phyogs su/ /rgyal po lag pa sor mo drug /mdun na so lhag sngon po yod/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i gru mo la/ /rme ba nag po sdig pa'i dbyibs/ /rab tu 'jigs pa yod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mun par 'gyur/ /lo ni drug bcu'i bar la 'byung / /de nas dpal 'dzin dad pos 'dzin/ /zhes sogs kyis bye brag tu bstan te/ dpal 'dzin dang pos sgron me stong dang sum brgya/ de nas byang phyogs su gzi ldan gyi ri rtser dge slong gzi brjid can g.yas pa la rna ba gnyis dang mig zur gsum stas 'gebs pa cig gis mu stegs dang rtsod nas mun pa lo drug bcu/ de nas brda ba'i lhas snang ba lo brgya/ de nas byang shar chu bo rab med kyi rtsar rgyal po mig gcig pa gyad kyi stobs can gyis lo drug bcu mun par byed/ de nas rang rgyal gyi 558

gzugs can rdo rje gdan nas nub tu 'byung bas sgron me lo brgya dang nyi shu/de nas yul dbus su grong gser du gnas brtan lce rtse gnyis pa lus thung bas sde pa rtsod de mun pa lo drug bcu/ de nas shar sto ki tari chu 'gram du dpa'/ gyi seng ges sgron me lo stong bzhi brgya/ de nas gaṅgā'i 'gram du rgyal po dpung pa ljang gu la rab byung gi gzugs sor bzhi yod pas lo drug bcu mun pa/ de nas bra ka ma la'i gtsug lag khang gi bdag po gzhon nu'i mgon gyis sgron me lo stong / de nas lho phyob/sa tshangs pa'i grong du dmangs rigs seng ge'i mgo can skyes nas zla gsum lon pa nas mun pa lo drug bcu/ de nas bya rgod phung rir dge slong mdzes byed gzhon nus/ sgron me lo lnga brgya lnga bcu/ de nas kha che sgra ldan gyi grong du rigs ngan gyi nang du bya lus mi gdong can skyes nas lo bcu nas bzung ste mun pa lo drug bcu/ de nas yul dbus nas shar du dpag tshad lnga 'das par dge slong shākya dzi gas lo bcu 'dzin te 'di'i dus tshe lo bcu pa rdzogs nas zhing 'di'i dar nub bdun tshang ste de srid chos 'dis khyim pa dang rab byung gi mi ji snyed grol ba yang / bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ da ni 'di nas mi gnas nas/ /tshe lo drug bcu yan chad la/ /'bras bur grol ba stong phrag gcig /'byung bar da dengs dag tu ste/ /zhes sogs te khyim pa de snyed rab byung de'i phyed dang lhag ma byang sems tshe lo lnga bcu pa'i bar du skyes pa nyis stong dang spyir bud med shas che ba 'bum phrag gnyis grol/ sum bcu pa'i bar du bud med 'bum phrag gcig dang skyes pa stong phrag lnga grol ba ste 'di thams cad ni sems chos sku dang lus 'od kyi skur grol ba'i grangs bstan pa'o/ nye /sgron me'i bstan pa mtha' ma da lta'i 'di nyid 'dzin pa po lung bstan pa ni thal 'gyur las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /nub phyogs o rgya na dag gi yul/ /dha na ko shari lha lcam la/ /pha med bu ste ba dzra he/ /559

'dis ni dam pa'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /zhes dga' rab rdo rje dang / /de yi rjes 'dzin nub kyi phyogs/ /bram ze'i phru gu skal ldan pa/ /mañdzu shrī pa ti zhes/ /lo ni bdun bcu rtsa lngar 'dzin/ /zhes mjam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /de'i rjes su skal ldan la/ /so sha gling zhes bya ba ru/ /khyim bdag rigs skyes shri sibha/ /zhes bya ba yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes shri sidha dang / de rjes 'dzin pa gdol pa'i rigs/ /dzā na sā tras 'di nyid 'dzin/ /zhes dzā na sā sna ring me ring tra dang / de rjes 'dzin pa khyim bdag rigs/ /phyag rgya rgya chen ngag gis 'dzin//zhes bī ma la rgya chen dang mu dra phyag rgya ste 'di ltar na bī ma la mu dra dag par klong chen pa 'chad do/ /de yi rjes la rgyal po'i rigs/ /sprul pa phyag brnyan bcas pas 'dzin/ /zhes chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang / nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ g.yu sgra snying po/ pangs mi pham mgon po sogs su snang / de yi rjes la dge sbyong gzugs/ /lhun gyi rgyal mtshan dag gis 'dzin/ /zhes ldang ma lhun rgyal/ de rjes sidha shu ras 'dzin/ /zhes lce btsun seng ge dbang phyuga'adi man nas dge slong dpal ldan rig 'dzin ku ma rā dzā yin par dngos su bstan nas blo gros chen po klong chen pa nyid du bzhed par 'dug kyang bar de dag go rim mi 'byor bar snang la/ lce btsun gyi 'og tu/ de rjes sa la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' dag gis 'dzin/ /zhes snang ba 'dis snying thig 'dzin pa'i dam pa mang po khyig lhan cig tu lung bstan pa snyam ste mkha' 'gro snying thig las/ sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i bar du spel bar byed/ /ceb/ rje rang byung pa lung bstan pa dang yang mthun par snang bas rje rang byung pa dang zhang ston la sogs mang po lung bstan par go'o/ /de 'og lag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa badzā pha las 'dzin/ /de 'og rgyal po seng ge ste/ /bzang po dag gis 'dzin pa'o/ /de 'og sgra mkhas dpal 'dzin no/ /560

de 'og lo gi pu bas 'dzin/ /de 'og rgyal po khri 'od do/ /de 'og dge slong dpal dang ldan/ /de nas blo gros mchog gis 'dzin/ /de nas mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin mas/ /bstan pa 'di nyid bzung nas ni/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i dus la dar/ /de nas mi gnas rang sa na/ /zhes pa 'di rnams las phal cher slar 'ong dgos pa snyam la/ babs lugs chen mor lo brgya brgya na bī ma la'i sku'i bkod pa re 'byung bar lung bstan dang sbyar na ldang ma man chod bī ma la nyid 'byon pa snyam la/ 'on kyang lo brgya mi spyir brtsis nas sbyar ba zhig yin pa snyam du skyes te des na chos rgyal khri srong dang nyang dus mnyam yin mod kyang nyang dang ldang ma'i bar du mi rabs gsum bzhi yod pas spyir brtsis na lo brgya re la re re 'grig pa zhig du dgongs par gdon mi za la sgra mkhas dpal 'dzin ni klong chen pa nyid du go'o/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i 'og tu 'di'i gdul skal rdzogs pas bstan pa'i btsas dang bcas te mdzes ldan bkod pa'i zhing dang / yangs pa skyob pa'i zhing dang / gtsug phud dbyangs ldan gyi zhing rnams su rim par 'phar zhing de rnams kyi bstan pa bdun tshan re rdzogs nas sprul sku'i zhing gangs chen mtsho'i thugs dpal be'i thad kyi 'jig rten stongs te rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdzad pa skor gcig rdzogs la slar de'i 'jig rten 'og ma la bskal pa sa ya drug 'bum du 'phel 'grib med par gnas pa sogs nam mkha' skye 'gag med pa la sprin skye 'gag dang bcas pa mi 'gal ba'i tshul gyis nam mkha' ji srid pa de srid du 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'o/ /de yang spyir tshe lo dpag med nas tshe lo stong gi bar ni sku'i bstan pa'i dus/ de nas ba dun bcu'i bar gsung gi bstan pa/ de nas bcu pa'i bar thugs kyi bstan pa'i dus ni spyir btang yin la/ bye brag tu bstan pa dngos kyi tshad ni sku'i bstan pa lo lnga brgya lnga stong phrag gsum/ gsung dang thugs ni lnga brgya lnga stong phrag re'o/ /de la sku'i bstan 561

pa'i dus na rdo rje ni o rgyan gyi yul gyi lan tshwa'i rgya mcho la yod de skabs su 'od dang sgra dang dge slong rdzu 'phrul can mang po'i sprul pa 'byung ngo / /yi ge dang sku ni rdo rje gdan gyi dpag tshad lnga brgya'i nam mkha' la bzhugs te mkha' 'gro mas 'dzin zhing mchod do/ /gsung gi bstan pa'i dus na rdo rje ni ri ma la ya lag na rdo rje'i gnas na gnod sbyin rnams kyis phyag byed do/ /yi ge ni rdo rje gdan gyi steng gi nam mkhar gnas so/ /sku ni 'dzam gling thams cad du 'phar zhing 'gro la skabs su bstan pa la gnod pa byung tshe zhal nas hūṃ sgra dang spyan las me byung bas zlog go /thugs kyi bstan pa'i dus na rdo rje gdan gyi nam mkhar gnas la yi ge rab tu khros pa drang srong gi phug na gnas/ sku ni sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi gnas lag na rdo rje'i khang brtsegs zhes bya ba'i yang thog na gnas te de ltar rang byung gi rten 'di gsum gyis 'dzam gling 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags so/ /de la spyir thun mong sde snod gsung ba'i cha nas bskal bzang 'di la ston pa stong yin mod kyang 'bras bu gsang sngags rdzogs pa chen po ston pa'i dbang du byas nas ston pa bcu gnyis te/ rig pa rang shar chen po'i rgyud las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /de yi nor bu rin chen stor/ /nor bu stor ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /snang mun gnyis kyi mtshams nas 'ongs/ /rkyen bzhi dmigs pa ma dag pas/ /dga' ldan brtsegs pa'i yul du 'ongs/ /rten ni padma dag pa yin/ /gsang sngags rgyud chen bstan pa btsugs/ /nye ba'i 'khor ni mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po thal 'gyur bshad/ /ces sogs dang a ti bkod pa'i rgyud bī ma 'a/sa g.yu yig can du drangs pa ltar/ dang po tshe lo dpag med kyi dus yul dga' ldan brtsegs par sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas ston pa khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba padma gser gyi mdog can stong gi dbus ma las brdzus te 'khrung sa 562

shing padma stong par nga dang 'dra ba'i sprul sku stong snang ba ni bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i ltas dang nam mkha' 'khor gyi skar ma 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa bzhi snang ba rdzogs chen gyi rgyud de tsam 'byung ba'i ltas su byung pa 'od cher gsal ba'i skar ma bcu bdun byung ba ni rgyud kyi gtso bo bcu bdun gyi ltas so/ /de ltar 'khor lta bur snang ba'i sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis la/thal 'gyur gyi rgyud lha'i bya'i mchu 'gyur gyi skad kyis bstan te lha'i bu nyi ma rab tu snang byed dang dga' byed dbang phyug ces bya ba sems dpa' gnyis kyis bsdus so/ /gnyis pa tshe lo bye ba gcig gi tshe ston pa khye'u 'od mi 'khrugs pa nyid 'od lnga'i sgo nga las 'khrungs te 'khor mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag gnyis la sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rgyud lnga khyab 'jug zur phud lnga pa'i skad kyis bstan te chos 'dis grol ba'i bud med de tsam zhig 'byung ba'i ltas so/ /gsum pa tshe lo 'bum gyi tshe gnas drod gsher 'dus pa 'od dkyil spungs par ston pa 'jigs pa skyob pa'i yid kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag drug la rlung gi sgra ma ra sha shu las drangs nas 'khor ba dong sprugs la soṭa pa'i rgyud gsungs te skyes pa de snyed cig 'dis grol ba'i ltas so/ /bzhi pa tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i tshe gnas chags 'byung mngal du snang bar ston pa gzhon nu rol pas rnam par rtse bas 'khor gnod sbyin stong la sems sde rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga dang yan lag gi rgyud drug ste bcu gcig bstan/lnga pa ni tshe lo bdun khri pa'i tshe sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi gnas 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i ldum rar drug pa rdo rje 'chang gis 'khor sangs rgyas rabs bdun du snang ba rang bkod nas 'bad bcas 'bad med gnyis ka dang ldan pa ste phar phyin drug gsum bco brgyad kyi chos gsungs/ 563
