drug pa tshe lo drug khri pa'i tshe ri rab byang shar gyi bang rim steng dur khrod me ri 'bar bar ston pa gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan zhal gsum phyag drug na rigs drug gi grong khyer 'dzin pa cig gis byang sems sprin gyi shugs can sogs bdun dang mkha' 'gro dang lha klu dpag med la rig pa rang shar chen po'i rgyud la sogs pa gsungs/bdun pa ni tshe lo khri'i dus ston pa drang srong khros pa'i rgyal po phyag gnyis mdab bzang gi bu 'dzin pas srin po'i yul du lu'i sgra dang ldan pa'i phug tu srin po bye ba gcig la 'dul ba'i rgyud bcu la sogs pa bstan/brgyad pa tshe lo lnga stong ba'i tshe bya rgod phung po'i rir ston pa dgra bcom pa gser 'od dam pas nyan thos grangs med pa la 'dul ba khri phrag dpag med gsungs/dgu pa tshe lo stong gi dus sog po g.yu'i smin ma can gyi yul du ston pa brtse bas rol ba'i blo gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' dpag med la phra rgyud bdun la sogs pa gsungs/bcu pa tshe lo lnga brgya ba'i tshe bya rgod phung rir ston pa 'od srung sgres pos skar ma 'od bzang sogs bdun la lung a nu sogs khri phrag brgyad bstan/bcu gcig pa ni tshe lo sum brgya ba'i tshe rdo rje gdan du ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal pos rigs gsum mgon po la nges pa'i don 'ba' zhig gsungs/bcu gnyis pa ni tshe lo brgya pa'i dus wa ra ṇa si la sogs par ston pa shākya'i dbang po nyid kyis theg pa'i rim pa rnams gsungs pa ste ston pa bcu gnyis so/ /ci bskal bzang 'dir sngon byon pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jigs la sogs pa mi 'dren par ma grags pa de dag 'dren pa ci zhe na/ 'dus pa sogs kyang sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang mtha' ma mos pa ma gtogs pa bskal 564

bzang gi sangs rgyas gzhan la thun mong gi gdul bya sngags kyi theg pa mi 'byung bar bshad pa nyid dang khyad med par rdzogs pa chen po nyid gdul bya la ji ltar snang ba brjod pa yin la 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud sngon tshe lo dpag tu med pa'i dus gtsang ma'i gnas su gsungs par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sku gsum po re re la yang sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa gsum re dang de re re la phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi mdzad pa bzhi re yod pas sku gsum po re re la so so'i mdzad pa so drug rer rnam par 'jog la/ ston pa bcu gnyis la phun tshogs lnga re sbyar bas chos kyi rnam grangs drug bcu zhes bya la spyir chos kyi rnam grangs dgu bcu rtsa drug dang ldan na bstan pa'i gtso bo zhes bya zhing mi ldan na khol bu'i ston pa zhes bya la/ de yang gnas mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis su ston pa sku mdog dang phyag mtshan mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis su byon te gdul bya ris mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis kyi ngor mdzad pa mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis snang ba sku'i bstan pa dang / des chos mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis bstan pas gdul bya'i ngag gi 'ching ba bcu gnyis 'grol ba gsung gi bstan pa dang / thugs kyi dgongs pa mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis kyis gdul bya'i rtog pa mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis 'grol ba thugs kyi bstaca pa ste de ltar bcu gnyis tshan brgyad kyis chos kyi rnam grangs dgu bcu rtsa drug go /de ltar sku gsum dang ston pa bcu gnyis la sogs dang slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa la sogs pa rnams kyang rnam pa tha dad par bstan yang rang bzhin tha mi dad pa'i phyir rgyal ba dgongs pa'i rgyud pa zhes bya'o/ /ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya dang drug bcu na o rgyan gyi yul dha na ko sha'i gling bkra shis bde brtsegs kyi gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba gtsug lag khang stong dang drug brgya'i 'khor dang ldan pa yod pa na rgyal po u pa rā dzā dang btsun mo 'od ldan cha/'i sras mo mi'i lus las 'das pa'i dge slong 565

ma gzhon nu ma zhig rgya myo/tsho'i gling na bsaco gtan byed pa na mi dkar po 'od dang ldan pa cig gis shel gyi bum ba yig lnga—/ spras pa zhig oX āXhūṃ swā hā zher/ spyi bor bzhag ste dbang skur bas lus bde bas gang 'od kyis khams gsum dus gcig la gsal bar rmis te sad nas bshad pa na g.yog mo mkha' 'gro ma bu ṇimi lus bzung ba de na de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa zhig 'khrung ba'i rtaṭa lags so zer te rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i bkod pa snye'i bu kun dga' snying po nyid lhums su zhugs te ci zhig na khye'u 'od dang ldan pa cig rtsib ma'i go bar nas btsas pas skrag ste thal khung du bor bas 'od dang sgra dang me tog gi char byung bas phyung ba na ma nyams par 'dug pas khrus gsol bas lha dang mkha' 'gros mchod cing bstod nas dga' rab rdo rje zhes grags shing myur bar sku rdzogs te lo bdun pa la paṇḍita lnga brgya dang rtsod pa byas pas sus kyang ma thub ste sprul par rig nas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ de nas byang phyogs nyi ma rab tu snang byed kyi ri brag yi dwags drag po gnas par 'jag spyil du lo gsum bcu rtsa gnyis ting 'dzin mdzad pas sa g.yos shing mu stegs kyi bstan pa nyams ba ra byas zhes pa'i sgra byung / phyugs rdzi rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin las slong ma nus pa mu stegs kyi rgyal pos thos te gshed ma btang bas sku nyi zhur ltar snang bas gnod ma nus te slar nam mkha' la sprin gyi gseb tu gshegs pas dad pa gyur te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod/ sngon gyi ston pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i sde sgod dang rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa bzhi thugs la mnga' ba de rdo rje sems dpas mngon sum du gnang ba byin nas ma la ya'i rtser rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang yon tan mtha' yas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang gsum gyis gleb/sa bam du bkod/ mkha' 'gro ma sems ldan ma ca chod pa por rjes su gnang ste mkha' 'gro mngon byung gi phug tu bzhugs so/ /de nas slob 566

dpon nyid rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar dpag tshad lnga na dur khrod gsil ba'i tshal yod par khyab dejug gi bu mo gcer bu la chibs te byon nas dbus kyi mchod rten gyi rtsar mkha' 'gro ma rnams la chos ston to/ /de'i tshe rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyo gas rim pa gnyis pa'i grong na bram ze'i rigs 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya ba rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin pa cig la 'jam dpal rnon pos lung bstan te gsil ba'i tshal du byon nas lo don lngar chos mnyan te sangs rgyas mya ngan khu/sa 'das nas lo lnga brgya dang bzhi bcu lon pa'i tshe chu bo dan tig gi ca/gor dga' rab rdo rje 'od phung du yal te 'od kyi dkyil nas 'das rjes kyi glegs bam babs pa gzigs pa tsam gyis 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nyid dga' rab rdo rje dang rtogs ḍa4 mnyam par gyur te rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag rtsa bzhi bsdus nas gnas pa sems kyi sde/ bya bral klong gi sde/ gnad man ngag gi sde dang gsum du phye/ gnad las zab pa snying gi thig le'i skor la bshad rgyud dang rnar rgyud gnyis su phye nas rnar rgyud mchan du btab/ bshad rgyud snying gi thig le spel ba'i gnas ma rnyed nas rdo rje gdan du sbas/ slob dpon nyid rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs dur khrod so sa gling du lo brgya dang rtsa dgur bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgya nag gi yul du khyim bdag gi bu shrī sidha zhes bya ba rig gnas la mkhas pa cig la spyan ras gzigs kyis 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi drung du song zhig par lung bstan/ des kyang myur du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gsang sngags mtha' dag sbyangs shing rab tu byung / slar yang thugs rje chen pos bskul te tshe'i rig 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs nas 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ngang mjal te lo nyer lngar bsten/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad brgya sum bcu 'das pa'i tshe slob dpon 'od phung du yal te 'dasgyu5 rjes shrī sidha'i phyag tu babs pas rtogs pa mnyam par gyur/ de nas lo brgya dang nyer 567

lnga na 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nyid nub phyogs su padma las brdzus te skyes nas 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi mar grags te 'dis slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la gsang sngags mtha' dag bstan zhing / ārya de wa la gdams pa snying thig bstan pas 'od du yal lo/ /'dis sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs rjes su bzung ste 'jam dpal zhal lung ni rdzogs pa chen po dang tha mi dad par 'gos gzhon nu dpal 'chad do/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen 'das pa'i 'og du shrī sidhas man ngag gi dpe phyung nas thig le'i skor la phyi skor nang skor gsang skor gsang ba bla na med pa'i skor te bzhir phye nas snga ma gsum gter du sbas/ gsang ba bla na med pa ni nyid kyi thugs la gab pa las slar mkha' 'gros lung bstan te de nyid da sbas/ nyid gsil sbyin gyi dar khrod ta bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgya gar ring ring ring nub phyogs su khyim bdag gi bu las rab tu byung ba bi ma la mi tra dang shar phyogs su gdol pa'i rigs las rab ta byang ba dzña na sā tra ces bya ba mkhas pa ༄ ༄ 'a ༄mthar phyin pa gnyis rdo rje'i gdan na paṇa chen lnga brgya'i gtso bor bkur zhing sngon spun du gyur pas gnyi ga thugs shin tu gcugs par gnas pa las skyo seng la byon pa'i sar nam mkha' la rdo rje sems dpa' byon te khyed gnyis skye ba lnga brgyar paṇḍitar gyur nas chos spyad kyang ci yang ma thob kyis tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na rgya nag byang chub shing drung gi lha khang du song zhig par bskul ba na bī ma la brtson 'grus che bas de ma thag byon te rna rgyud dang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi man ngag nyan nas tshim ste rgya gar du log dzñā na sru tra dang mjal bas lung bstan dran te sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa de da lta bzhugs sam dris nas de ma thag byon te byin rlabs kyis nyin gcig la zla ba dgu'i lam bgrod de slebs pa na bud med mdzes ma chu'i bum pa khur ba zhig gis bkra shis khri sgor song zhig par lung bstan/ der phyin pa na mkha' 'gro ma spyod mas dur khrod gsil 568

sbyin du song zhig par lung bstan te phyin pa na shrī sidha thod pa'i khang brtsegs kyi nang nas khyab 'jug gi stan las bzhengs te phyag sor mo gsum gyen la phyar bas lo gsum na gnang bar go ste de'i bar bla ma'i khol po mtha' dag byas/de nas lo dgur rna rgyud dang phyi nang gsang gsum gnang ste 'di la dpe zhig yong thang snyam pa na dpe rnams phyung ste gnang / thugs tshim nas 'gro bar chas pa na tshim mam gsungs/ tshim lags zhus pas gtad pa med gsung bas slar gdams pa khyad par ba yod par shes nas gsol ba btab pas spros bcas kyi dbang rdzogs par bskur nas gsang ba bla med kyi gdams ngag lo gsum du gnang / 'di rnams kyi glegs bam ni dus la bab pa'i tshe khyod nyid la snang bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ gdams ngag thob pas da ni nyams su blang bzhin pas bla ma'i zhabs tog bya'o snyam pa na slar spros med kyi dbang rdzogs par bskur te lo gcig tu 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa tshar phyin shin tu spros med kyi dbang bskur bas nges shes khyad par can skyes/ rab tu spros med kyi dbang rdzogal pa na brtan pa thob ste lo bcu drug du bla ma'i mdzad spyod lta zhing nyams su blangs/ de'i dus shrī sidha nyid brtul zhugs su rlung 'dzin gyi spyod pa dang khro bo dang he ru ga'i cha byad kyis dur khrod nyul ba dang 'byung bzhi'i rten 'brel sogs ma nges pa'i spyod pa mdzad do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po dpal byin gyis spyan drangs nas seng ge dkar po yan lag drug ldan la bcibs te gshegs/ zhag bdun na sa g.yo ba dang sgra dang 'od byung ste mya ngan las 'das par shes nas gsol ba btab pas zhal chems gzer bu bdun pa dzñā na snyu tra'i phyag tu babs te gsang ba'i man ngag rnams bkra shis khri sgo'i ka ba'i khong nas long la dur khrod ba sing gi nags la song zhig par lung bstan thob ste 'di'i tshe 'das lo dgu brgya dang brgyad bcu bzhi lon no/ /de nas glegs bam rnams 569

phyung ste rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs thag ring po na dur bro/ da ba sing yod par byon nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams la chos ston to/ /de'i tshe bī myo/—la dur khrod gzhan zhig tu spyod pa la byon pa na mkha' 'gro ma dpal gyi blo gros kyis snga ma las ches zab pa gsang ba snying thig gi man ngag yod kyis ba sing du song zhig par bskul nas skad cig gis byon pa na dzñā na snyu tra bzhugs shing gda' nas the tshom med par rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas mdzod pu nas 'od zer mtha' yas pa bkye spyan gyen du ldog pas longs sku'i zhing khams dpag med bstan te yid 'ches skyed nas spros bcas kyi dbang bskur bas bī ma la'i mdzod pu'i sgo bye/spros med kyi dbang bskur bas ba spu'i sgo nas 'od byung / zla ba drug gis 'khor 'das kyi ru shan phye ste shin tu spros med kyi dbang bskur bas nyams myong khyad par can skyes te shangs kyi rtser a dkar po 'khrig la khad pa byung / rab tu spros med kyi dbang bskur bas sems nyid zang thal du song / gdams pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs te 'di'i tshe slob dpon gnyi gas lo brgya dang gsum re lon/ de nas lo bcu na dzñā na snyu tra zag bcas kyi lus mi snang bar yal te bī ma la'i phyag tu 'das rjes babs pas rtogs pa mnyam par gyur te 'di'i tshe 'das lo dgu brgya go bzhi'o/ /bī ma la nyid ni ka ma ru'i rgyal po dang nub phyogs kyi rgyal po dharma pha la'i mchod gnas lo nyi shu re mdzad nas dur khrod rab tu snang byed tu mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad cing gsang ba mchog gi dpe rnams tshar gsum du bris nas o rgyan gyi yul rgya mtsho gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i gling dang kha che'i mtha' 'khob rigs ngan gyi grong gser gling gi brag skyibs dang dur khrod de nyid rnams su re re sbardo so/ /spyir 'dzam gling na mkha' 'gro nges par 'du ba'i dur khrod brgya dang bcu gsum las spyod pa'i gnas drug nyams sbyong ba'i gnas bcu bzhi/ ngamu 570

tshig skong ba'i gnas brgyad/ 'dod cing 'dun pa'i gnas bzhi ste so gnyis rgya gar na yod la o rgyan na brgyad/ kha che na bcu/ li dang hor na lnga/ mi nyaba'idang za hor na bcu/ rgya yul na so gcig bod na gnyis/ lhag ma yul gru gzhan na kha 'thor du yod la de rnams kyi nang nas dur khrod chen po brgyad ni rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo gnas pas mchog yin la de dag na mchod rten re chu re lha 'dre drag po re ma mo re grub pa'i slob dpon re dngos grub re yod cing lha dang ma mo de dag la sgrub thabs zab mo re yang yod la dur khrod dngos de rnams su sus kyang ma bskyal bar gling bzhi ga'i sems can gyi ro rang bzhin gyi 'du zhing mchog gi dngos grub 'thob la/ dur khrod dngos de dag ni rnyed par shin tu dka' la ro mis skyel ba'i dur khrod rnams ni mi ma yin gdug pa dang sha za mkha' 'gro'i gnas te bar chad kyang mang / thun mong gi dngos grub kyi gnas tsam du zad cing dur khrod gtso bo brgyad po dang ming gcig pa tsam ni shin tu mang la bod kyi gnyis ni gzho'i til sgro mkha' 'gro res 'ga' 'du ba'i gnas dang tsā ri ni mchog gi dngos grub 'thob pa'i gnas yin par lam yig cung zad dang bcas bshad cing 'di'i yang gnas kyi snying po ni mkha' 'gro ma khrus byed kyi mtsho 'o ma lta bu la sngo dmar gyi ri mo yod pa'i dbus na shel gyi mchod rten sgo bdun bcu rtsa bdun pa lha tshogs thams cad kyi pho brang du bzhugs par bshad la/ 'dzam gling gi grub pa'i gnas de thams cad du bī ma las spyod pa mdzad la tsā ri na yang mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa btul ba'i bī ma la'i zhabs rjes yod do/ /'di yan ni mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i rig 'dzin brda dang byin rlabs kyis grol ba'i phyir rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa ces bya'o/ /'di phyin ni gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa zhes bya ste sprul pa'i gang zag chos rgyal rje blon lta bu dang lam la dbang ba'i gang zag sa lam thob pa 971

dang mos pas spyod pa'i skal ldan gyi sgrub po rnams rna ba'i dbang por ming tshig gi rnam pa'i gdam sa pa btab pas rgyud grol te bla ma'i rtogs pa slob ma'i rgyud la 'pho bas gdams pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad pa'i don no/ /de'i tshe bod yul du 'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs tha mi dad pa'i sku'i bkod pa chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan du bstan te bsam yas la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs dam pa'i chos bsgyur nas dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshe rgyal pos gsang sngags kyi chos khyad par ba yod par mkhyen zhing thog mar rgyal bu'i dus kyi sku rji phyis rab tu byung ba myang ting 'dzin bzang po ces bya ba lo bdun du ting nge 'dzin gcig la mnyam par bzhag pa sha'i spyan gyis gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten thams cad gcig car gzigs pas myang ban sha'i spyan can zhes grags pa des kyang bskul te bī ma la rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bzhugs pa la spyan 'dren par ka cog gnyig mngags te bī ma las kyang gdams ngag gi mchog thams cad bsnams a tsa ra sa'i snying po g.yog du khrid nas bod du byon/ rgya gar ba thams cad kyi rmi lam 'khrugs shing shing rtsi dang me tog thams cad kyang kha bod du bltas/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad gyis cho nges btab/ chu tshod kyi rtsis thams cad kyang 'khrugs pas cis lan brtags pa na bud med mkha' 'gro ma zhig na re paṇḍita mkhas pa cig 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi snying po thams cad dpe tsam yang ma bzhag par bsnams te bod du byon pas lan zer ba dang rgya gar ba rnams kyis bod the tshom skyed pa'i phyir rkang mgyogs pa btang ste bī ma la'i sdun du bod du slebs par byas nas phra men gyi ngan sngags mkhan po cig khrid song ngo zhes bsgrags pas paṇḍita bsam yas su phebs kyang bod rnams the tshom zos te rgyal po dang ma mjal/ dbu tshal du lder tsho la phyag mdzad pas lder tsho sa phung du zhig pas slar la the tshom cher skyes/ yang bī ma las sa phung 572

gi spyi bor phyag bzhag cing dbu'i zhwa bkon pa tsam gyis snga ma las ches legs shing 'od dang ldan par gyur/ the tshom sel phyir skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa yang mdzad pas yid 'ches te rgyal pos phyag mdzad pa'i tshe rgyal po'i thugs kur rigs gsum mgon po bkra lam me bzhugs pa bī ma las gzigs shing sdod dag pa gzhan 'gas kyang mthong / bī ma las oṃ āXhūX swā hā zhel se gol brdabs pas dbu zhwa rin po che'i prog zhur gyur te rigs lnga'i sku lam gyis byung ba rgyal po la sogs pas gzigs/ 'di la deb sngon du bī ma la snga ma 'di rnal 'byor pa ral pa can du yod pas phyi rol par dogs pa skyes pa sel phyir yan lag drug pa brtsams zer ba snang yang yer pa'i dkar chag las lha lung rab 'byor dbyangs spun gsum bī ma las rab tu phyung bar bshad pa dang / sku 'dra rnying pa'i slob dpon padma rgya gar ma lta bu'i baṇa zhwa mdab ring mdab ma'i rgyab sgor mo pad ris can gsol ba kho nar thos pas rab byung du gor ma chag la rgyal blon gyi the tshom sel ba'ang rkang mgyogs pas ngan par bsgrags pa las byung ba'i the tshom sel phyir nyid do/ /'di'i tshe bī ma las lo sum brgya bzhes shing spyir 'das lo stong dang brgyad bcur 'chad do/ /der phar phyin dang dbu ma gsung ba'i tshe bee ro tsa na tsha ba rong du bzhugs pas bod kyi rgyal blon la la yogs 'dor du g.yu sgra snying po btang ba des slob dpon grol bzhud pa'i shul du chos khri la/ nyan thos byis pa'i chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya/ /pho rog rdo rje 'gros kyis sa mi chod/ /bya ba bris pa gzib/sa nas dris pa na da ci sprang po cig 'di na 'dug zer nas btsal bas g.yu sgra snying po rnyed de sems smad lnga la mkhas par gzigs nas slar khong la 'tshams pa'i phyi 'gyur bcu gsum po bstan pas sems smad bco brgyad du grags/ spyir sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa'i chos du ma gnyags la sogs pas bsgyur/ gsang ba bla med kyi rgyud man ngag ni 4 — 573

gzhan su la yang cha med par rje blon gnyis kyis thugs dam mnog chob / su mdzad nas srod dang tho rengs kyi tshe bsgyur zhing rje blon gyis shin tu zab pa'i chos 'di lta bu blor mi chud tshul bzhin du spyod pa mi 'byung bas ma 'ongs pa'i skal ldan gyi don du sba par bkas bcad/ bī ma las gsang ba snying thig gi skor rnams mchims phu'i dge gong du bod yig tu bsgyur nas sbas/ thig le'i skor gyi rgyud man ngag gi rgya dpe rnams ma 'ongs pa na tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar bslad cing nyams 'gro bar gzigs nas zhus dag gi thebs su sbas/ de ltar lo bcu gsum bod yul du bzhugs nas sum brgya dang bcu gsum bzhes tshe rgya nag tu gshegs te bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar la sku de nyid ma bsdus par bzhugs pa yin la lo brgya brgya na bod du sku'i bkod par 'byung la 'dib/ ni dga' rab rdo rje nyid la lan bdun du mjal nas gsan zhing ma 'ongs pa bstan pa'i btsas 'jig rten gzhan du 'phos pa'i tshe rdo rje'i gdan du 'od kyi skur yal bar 'gyur ro/ /a tsa ra sa'i snying po mchims phur grongs pas ltas khyad par can byung ste bī ma la grongs par nor ba byung ngo / /bī ma la bzhud nas lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga na myang ting 'dzin bzang po de rgyud rnam par dag nas rdo rje legs pas khams su ser ba phab nas nas rnga mo'i khal rgyab brgya bkal byung ba la rdo rje 'phangs pas dam tshig dran te nas phul ba la zhwa'i lha khang bzhengs nas gdams pa rnams ke tshang ris gsum sgo'i steng ka ba'i khong gseng rnams su sbas shing snyan rgyud tshig gi rim pa 'bro rin chen 'bar ba la brgyud pa'i srol mi nyams pa'i ched du gtad/ babs lugs chen mo na 'di tsam las mi snang yang 'dra 'bag lhad med dang snying thig gi lo rgyus sogs su bī ma las gzhan la snod brtags pas ma rnyed/ myang la nga a tsa ra rgya gar du 'gro ba la gser mang po dgos par khyod kyis yod tshad gser du dril la nga la phul zhig gsungs pas 574

rgyal po dang gnyags sogs la mi gsung bar bdag la de lta bu gsung ba bsod nache/sa che snyam nas gser mang du phul ba na nga la gser gyis dgos pa med sgod brtagab/ pa yin gsungs nas snying thig rdzogs par gnang bar bshad la zhwa'i lha khang yang bī ma la dang myang thun mong du bzhengs shing gter rnams kyang gtso bor bī ma la nyid kyis sbas pa yin no/ /'bros sbas blo gros dbang phyug la bshad/ des gzho'i ldang ma dge mchog gi bu gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal la bshad/ 'di bī ma la'i sku'i bkod pa yin/ 'di la zhwa'i mgon pos lung bstan nas gter rnams phyung / sgod ldan btsal bas gzhan ma rnyed nas nyang ro nga/nyan mtsho'i lce thub pa'i bu lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug ces bya ba chos mang du she/sa pa zhig la bstan pas zhar la bal po sgom chung bya ba zhig kyang 'dis grol/dpe 'di dag par bris la khra'i zla ba la skyol zhig gsungs nas gyes/ 'bul ba chen po khyer nas dpe skyel du phyin pas snye thang du slebs tshe nyang bka' gdams pa bya ba dang phrad pas ldang ma khru'i zla ba la gshegs/ sngar gnas brtan yin pa tsam las bzang por mi rtsi pa 'dug ste gshegs pa'i dus mkhyen rtags ngo mtshar ba mtha' yas byung bas phyis thams cad 'gyod pa skyes 'dug khyed 'bul ba 'di tsam skyel ba gdams ngag khyad par can zhus par thag chod pas de bdag la zhu zer te byin pas ti sgror lo so gnyis bsgoms te zag pa zad yon tan cher skyes/ lce btsun gyis bī ma la dngos su mjal te lo du mar bsten/ mchims phu'i gter lung bstan te mkha' 'gros phye nas byin/ slob dpon padma'i gter dang snubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gter yang thon/ sgod ldan ma rnyed pas phal cher snod ldan la smon lam btab ste sbas/ lo brgya dang nyer lnga la 'od lus su yal te 'das rjes mkha' 'gro'i phyag du babs/ de nas lo sum bcu na rong snar mnga'i lce sgom nag pos phyi nang gsang gsum gyi skor bton te dar 1 nya7541

rgyas su gyur/ rdes zhang ston bkra shis rdo rje la bshad de ya 'brog gi do nang du 'khrungs/ mdo sngags la mkhas par sbyangs rdor legs kyis lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pas grogs thams cad byas te 'u yug gi brag nas kha byang brgya rtsa brgyad dang man ngag mang po thon/ tshogs bskyangs pas 'od lus ma grub kyang 'das rtags bzang po byung / de'i rigs kyi sras mkhas pa nyi 'bum ni phyag rdor gyi sprul pa badzra pha la yin par 'chad/ yab dang / rgya ston lung dro ba dang / zhang g.yu brag pa/ rngog rgyal tsha rdor seng sogs bsten 'phrin las shin tu che'o/ /de'i slob ma chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber ni mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gcung gi sras shes bya thams cad la thogs brdugs med pa'i shes rab mnga' gtso bor snying thig gi bdag por gyur/ de'i slob ma 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa ni dbus kyi grar 'khrungs/ rkyen re la bsten nas gzhan la mtho 'grogs dang khyad gsod mi byed/ shig dang 'ji ba dang long sprang kho na la byams pa sogs byis pa'i dus nas dam bca' mang po byas/ chos ma nyan kyang sems stong par go ste snying po'i don rtogs/ le sgang pa las rab tu byung snying thig las chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba shar/ bzhugs sa'i ming gis seng ge rgyab par grags/de'i slob ma me long rdo rje ni sgrags kyi phur 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas chos phyir dka' sbyad mang po byas/ grub thob za lung pa dang / mtshur phu'i mdo bo ras pa/ 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa ste rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum bsten zhing 'khrul zhig pa las rgyud man ngag gi snying po rnyed/ sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad de drug bcu rtsa gcig la mkhar chur 'das te gdung khang 'od kyi dra bas g.yogs pa byung skad/de'i slob ma rig 'dzin ku ma rā dzā yin te g.yo ru 'on gyi bar sar rdzing khar jo sras su 'khrungs/ phag mo grur spyan snga grags ye ba las rab tu byung /tshar steng pa dang mtshur phu'i gnyan ras dang grub thob o rgyan pa sogs bla ma nga576 ོ —

mang du ‘sgyusten nas chos mtha' dag gsan/ khyad par me long pa las rtogs pa skyes shing dbang gdams ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs te mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes/ mtshur phur chos rje rang byung rdo rje la snying thig gi chos tshul/ g.ye dwags kong po rnams la lam rgya mdzad/ shangs la a'i ri mo yod cing sngags bdag gza' dam can gsum dang mi bzhin du lab/ snying thig gi zab gnad rnams gzhan dang phye nas ston pas bī ma la'i sku'i bkod par grags/ bdun bcu rtsa brgyad pa ston zla 'bring po'i nyer lnga la grongs pa las shul pas sle sngaṭa bton gsol ba btab pas bzhengs te bsnyung ba med par zhag bcu bzhir bzhugs nas chos dang zhal chems mdzad de ston zla tha chung gi tshes brgyad la 'das/ de'i slob ma ni kun mkhyen tshul blo yin te g.yo ru gra'i stod grong du jo sras su 'khrungs/ mkhan po bsam rin las rab tu byung zhing gsang phur sde snod mtha' dag la sbyangs/ shes rab kyi lha grub ste blo gros thogs pa med pas klong chen rab 'byam du grags/ garma pa rang byung rdo rje las gdams pa mang du gsan/ rig 'dzin pa dang mjal bas mdang lha'i bya yin zer ba ngo mtshar can zhig byung ba khyed du 'dug gsungs nas chos dang brgyud pa gtad/ chos nyan pa sgrub pa gang gi skabs su yang zas gos dang gnas kyi dka' ba cher spyad/phyis 'bri khung pa dang ta si byang rgyal sogs mi chen dang dge bshes thams cad kyi bla ma rtsod med du gyur/ zhwa'i lha khang gso ba'i zhig ral gyi dus mnan pa'i thod pa mang po 'phar zhing byung ba na za g.yabs pas bzung ste sdigs mdzub kyis slar mnan/ dbu rtse'i rgyab nas lha khang gso ba'i thebs gser 'gu rtse gang bcus pa la skud gser byas/ gter mang du 'dug pa la 'ga' tsam las ma blangs/ dam can pa byis pa g.yu rna can zhig tu byas nas nyin re bzhin bzo bo'i grogs la byung / rdo ring chen mo gnyis yod pa gtsug lag khang zhig pa'i 577

tshe 'gyel nas su/sa kyang ma lhongs ba la gtor ma dang bden tshig brjod nas sku chos brdabs pas lhongs pa'i ngo mtshar bstan/ thod pa sna tshogs su dam sri mnan 'dug pa rnaca/sa kyi nyams pa gsos nas slar mnon par brtsams pa'i tshe rlung nag g.yos sa rdo'i char bab pas mi thams cad bros te grogs ma byung ba la nyid kyis drag po'i gar mdzad pas thod pa rnams 'phar nas phan tshun rdab cing 'khrol thod pa che shos cig nam mkha' la 'chor bar byung ba sdigs mdzub kyis phab ste zhabs kyis mnan pas gu ru drag po dngos su mthong ba byung thod pa rnams phra men mchod rten gyi zhabs su mnan/ rab gnas kyi dus ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa byung / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi dag snang ni mtha' yas par gzigs/ sa phag gi rtsod pa 'byung bar mkhyen nas lho mon phyogs su byon nas chos kyi srol gtod/ slar lho 'brog dbu g.yor thams cad du 'phrin las shin tu che bas thams cad phan bde la bkod/ chos khral mi len/ dad rdzas chud mi gzon/ yo byad chos phyogs su bsngos pa rnams gang du yang bsngos bsgyur mi mdzad/ bkur sti dge 'dun la dgos pa yin sdig can la mi dgos gsungs nas khyim pa'i mi chen la stan dang bkur sti mi mdzad/ 'bul ba la 'dab lan mi mdzad/ tshogs gsog yon bdag gi bya ba yin mchod yon gyi bya ba go log pa ma bzang gsungs/ sprang po sogs snyoms chung gis ci drangs kyang zhim zhim ltar gsol zhing mdo dang bsngo ba rgyas par mdzad/ de la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa la gnas/ khyad par du chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sras mo padma gsal la slob dpon padmas dbang bskur mkha' 'gro snying thig gi chos bdag tu btang ste skye ba rim par brgyud pa'i padma las 'brel rtsal zhes gsang mtshan du 'bod pa dpa' lung pa rin chen rdo rje'i skye ba yin te/ mchims phur mkha' 'gro snying thig gi chos b.la' phye ba'i mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi 57྅

dra bar rnal 'byor ma zhig la rdo rje phag mo ye shes su babs te gdams pa'i lhag chad bsal/ slob dpon rin chen rdo rje gar yod dris pas khong 'di na zer nas bla ma la mdzub mo btsugs/ bla mas khong de'i rjes la bum thang du skye bar bshad pa yin mod nga gar yin gsungs pas/ longs sku'i zhing myul nas bum thang du skye bar gsungs pa yin khyed rang da lta chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba la spyod pa 'di longs sku'i zhing myul ba yin zhes bstan/ chos bka' che ba'i ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa byung bar snang / sgra tshad snyan ngag so/gas rtog ge'i skor dang / byams chos dbu ma 'dul mngon spyod phyogs kyi yig cha dang / sngags gsar rnying phyag rdzogs zhi gsum gyi yig cha mang po dang /khyad par mkha' 'gro snying thig gi snying po mkha' 'gro yang thig dang bī ma la snying thig gi snying po bla ma yang thig dang zab mo yang thig sogs bstan bcos tshad du longs pa mang bar mdzad pa'i dkad chag rin po che'i mdzod khang zhes bya ba snang / nga drug bzhes pa'i chu yos la/ da ni mi sdod padma las 'brel rtsal/ /'chi med bde chen btsan sa 'dzin du 'gro/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbang dang / /rgya mtsho'i don yongs grub pa'i tshong pa dang / /bsam gtan grub pa'i dga' bas ches lhag go /zhes sogs kyi zhal chems mdzad de bsam yas mchims phur gzugs sku bsdus te ltas ngo mtshar ba bstan to/ /bu slob mang du byon pa las snying thig gi bka' ni mkhas grub dharma girti/ sprul sku nyi ma 'od zer/ byang sems kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku chos dbyings grags pa'i bar du rim par bka' babs so/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dngos su byon pa garma pa rang byung rdo rjes bī ma la mu dra rang gi mdzod pur thim pa'i mod la snying thig gi dgongs pa ji lta ba mngon du gyur kyang gsang sngags bla ma la bstos pa'i mig stos bstan pa'i ched du rig 'dzin ku ma rā dzā 579

la gsan/ slob dpon padma la brgyud pa cig 'ong thang dgongs pa'i tshe slob dpon padma las dngos su gsan yang slar sho'i rgyal sras legs ldan pa spyan drangs te tsā ri dgon gsar du gsan par bstan nas phyis slob ma rnams la gsungs te 'di lta bu'i chos nub tu phangs pas slob dpon rgya ba g.yung ston rdo rje dpal gyis gtsang phyogs dang ye rgyal bas khams kong / ye shes rgyal mtshan pas hor dang rgya nag sprul sku bas dbus su dar bar gyis ces sman lung pa shākra gzhon sogs la rjes su gdams te/ sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i bar du spel bar byed/ /ces lung bstan pa mngon du gyur pa'o/ /kun mkhyen pa la mkhas grub bde legs pa zhes bya ba mkhyen pa dang snying brtse dang rtogs pa dang nus par ldan zhing spyod pa shin tu dag pa cig gis kyang sems phyogs mtha' dag gsan nas de'i slob ma 'phan yul pa blo gros rgya mtshos sman rtse'i dgon pa btab cing rim pas nyan pho ba yon tan dpal/ sprul sku bsam rgyan la sogs pa rim par byon/ yang bī ma las rma rin chen mchog dang gnyags dzñā na ku mar la bshad/ gnyags la sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ gra dpal gyi snying po/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu/gnyan dpal dbyangs/ mtshur nag ye shes 'bar/ u pa bde gsal/ thang bzang dpal rdor/ sgyer 'phags pa shes rab/ busu ku mchog gi byang chub rnams kyis zhus shing sog po dpal ye la snubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsan pa yang sgyu 'phrul dang sems phyogs gnyis ga'i bka' babs gcig go bee ro tsa na las brgyud pa ni 'dra 'bag chen mo las 'di ltar du bshad ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas na lha de wa bzang skyong la bu lnga brgya yod pa'i thu bo lha'i bu kun dga' snying po ni bag med pa las log ste rtse gcig du sgom pa las lha'i bu sems lhag can zhes ming du gyur cing de las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer 580

spyi gtsug du thim pa dang / tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang gu lang gsum khyur mid byas pa dang / nyi zla gnyis lag tu bzung ste 'jig rten snang bar byas pa dang / sprin rid po che'i mdog can las bdud rtsi'i char bab pas sa thams cad skyes pa ste ngo mtshar gyi rmi lam bzhi rmis pa na lha'i dbang pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa rtogs pa dang / bdud 'thul ba dang / rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i rtsol med kyi theg pa rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / des skal ldan gyi don byed pa'i ltas su bstan to/ /der lha'i bus phyogs bcur bltas te/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag thams cad kyis/ /rtsol pa'i theg pa mthar bton nas/ /rtsol med theg pa mi ston pa/ /thugs rje chen po yal lam ci/ /skal ldan gdul bya mchis pas na/ /lhun grub theg pa gsung du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas thams cad nam mkha' la 'dus te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin khyod yin pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad par shar/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag thams cad kyi/ /ye shes rang bzhin khyod yin pas/ /thams cad byang chub sems su gsal/ /bde gshegs ma lus thams cad kyi/ /sku yi ngo bo dang ldan pas/ /rmad byung rol pa'i sku ru shar/ /tshig gcig don du rdzogs pa'i bdag /rin chen 'phrul gyi snying po'i don/ /skal ldan rnams la bstan du gsol/ /zhes mgrin gcig du rdo rje sems dpa' la bskul bas rdo rje sems dpas/ rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che/ /tshig gi spyod yul ma yin pas/ /bdag gis sgrogs par shin du dka'/ /ma rtogs pa la tshig sgo nas/ /mtshon zhing rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /ci rigs par ni rnam par dgrol/ /zhes gsungs te thugs ka nas phyag na rdo rje phyung / /des shar phyogs rdo rjes rnam par gnon pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje gsang ba dang / sto phyogs rin chen snang ba'i sangs rgyas rin chen zhal dang /581

nub phyogs padma brtsegs pa'i sangs rgyas padma'i 'od dang / byang phyo4/sa rnam dag grub pa'i sangs rgyas grub par snang ba dang / dbus phyogs mtha' da/ nga bral ba'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad rnam/sa la gsol ba btab pas gzod nas skye 'gag med pa dang yon tan ye rdzogs dang byang chub kyi sems 'khor bas ma gos pa dang / de rtogs na phrin las rang las 'char ba dang / ye shes gsang ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab/ /ma rig ye shes tha dad med/ /ma rtogs rtogs pa'i rgyan du gcig /ye shes gsang ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rang rig 'od gsal rnam par dag /rnam rtog ye shes nyid du gnas/ /gzhi bzhag rang lugs rin chen 'od/ / rang byung ma btsal gdod nas dag /ces sogs gsungs pas sems dpa' rdo rje rtsol med a ti'i don mngon du gyur te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su byon nas lha'i bu kun dga' snying po la rgyal thabs spyi lugs la sogs pa'i dbang bskur/ lhun grub rnam gsum la sogs pa'i lung phog nas/ rmad byung bstan pa'i snying po 'di/ /lha gnas gsum du grags gyur nas/ /yang sprul gang zag thugs sras kyis/ /'dzam gling dbus su rgyas par shog /ces lung bstan bstan pa gtad do/ /lha'i bu de nyid dge slong ma me tog gsal las pha med par rtsib ma'i go bar las btsas te rgyal srid skyong ba na phyag na rdo rjes klo nga dgu bam po nyi khri dang bcas pa'i rgyud man ngag skad cig gis khong du chud par dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs te rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la sangs rgyas nas skal ldan la ston to/ /de'i tshe bram ze snying po grub pa zhes bya ba 'jam dpal bshes gnyen rgyal po ngu na tā la da po ra dzati/ sras mo me tog gsal/ bla 17 ra zur 'a ra rgyal dga' po mi'i lus gdol pa'i rigs bzung ba na ga tsārya dang lag na rdo rje ri sus mo gnod sbyin cho/ byang chub ma rnams la chos bstan pas 'jam dpa/ra 582

bshes gnyen spangs rtogs mthar phyin la gzhan rnamal snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi che/'i don byas so/ /de nas gzugs tshong ma sa ra ni/ kha che'i gnas brtan rab snang / o rgyan gyi dge slong ma hā rā dzā/ sras mo go ma de wa/ ā tsārya ā lo / ku ku rā dzā snga ma/ drang srong ba shi/ smad tshong ma bdag nyid ma/ nā gā rdzu na/ ku ku rā dzā phyi ma/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi ma drang srong de wa rā dzā/ bhā ti ku nā/ shrī sidha/ de la bī ma la mi tra dang dge slong ma kum/ dga' mo ste rim par rjes su bzung bas rtogs pa skyes pa na ched du brjod pa re byas so/ /dge slong ma kun dga' mos man ngag tshig mang pos bslad nas bshad/ rtsod pa yang byas pas 'jig rten na nad mug mtshon gsum byung ste mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta mi dgus pra la sogs pas brtags pas man ngag sgod min la 'phel bas lan par shes te lhad can rnams bsregs/ rgyud man ngag gtsang ma rnams rgyal po dang paṇḍi ta'i rgya gnyis ldan byas te rdo rje gdan du mi spel bar khrims su bcas te bzhag kun dga' mo bka'i chad pas lus dor nas sems phyag rdor gyi thugs gar thim ste sngags kyi che ba dbyung ba'i ched do/ /de'i tshe rgya gar gyi dge slong a ba dhu ti tshe 'ophos pa bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan du gyur te bstan pa btsugs/ sngon gyi bag chags las rgya gar na rtsol med kyi theg pa yod par shes nas len par 'dod de spro pa dris pa na gzhan ma rnyed nas/sngon o rgyan du rgyal po pā la de wa/ kha cher tsand+ra gi ta/ sing nga'i yul du dge slong legs pa'i blo gros/ de tshe mkhan po la ma gus pas phyi mar tsha ba rong gi phyugs rdzi/ de nas a wa dhu ti/ de nas tsha ba rong gi dge slong pu rṇa las bod du skyes pa pa gor bee ro tsa na mkhyen pa che zhing rdzu 'phrul thob ༄pa de dang / tshul khrims srung phyir rang srog btang ba'i dge slang bha hu ra'i skye ba gtsang legs grub dang gnyis rgya gar du chas te ārya pa lo'i gling du gnas 583

spags pas be ro la bu mo zhig gis khog pa dral nas snying gi chu ser btsir ba dang / mi snying nyer gcig zos pa dang / mi dkar po cig gis snyi bor a cig bzhag pas a mer 'bar te lus tshig pa dang / byang chub kyi shing rtsa ba bton nas bod du khyer rshangs pa dang / nam mkha' nas nyi zla gnyis shar ba zla ba nam mkhar nub cing nyi ma has po ri la shar ste yang nub nas tsha ba rong du shar/yang bod du shar ba rmis pas/ sgrib pa dag pa dang / mkhas pa nyer gcig gi dgongs pa lon pa dang / rnam smin gyi lus 'dag pa dang / man ngag gi chos lon pa dang / legs grub sngar 'das shing nyid kyang tsha ba rong du sprug pa dang /slar bod la phan par shes so/ /be ro la lam du khang pa rdib pa/ mtshon zug pa/ me chu dug sogs kyi gnod pa sogs shi la thug pa lnga bcu rtsa bdun byung yang ma gnod/ gcan phreng pas gsod par brtsams pa rdzu 'phrul bstan pas ldogargya gar du btol te gser rnams sa la sbas te man ngag gi chos la su mkhas thams cad la dris pas slob dpon shrī sidha zhes bya ba mkhas pa nyer lnga'i thugs sras paṇḍi ta stong gi slob dpon 'jam dpal dang dngos su mjal ba zhig dha ne ko sha'i gnas sang ldeng bsil byed kyi tshal tsandan dri zhim gyi nags rin po che za me tog spungs pa'i khab bya bar bzhugs zhes thos nas btsal te rgyal po cig gis gtsug lag khang de 'di yin te 'di na ke tshang chen po dgu las thog ma na ston pa dga' rab rdo rje chos nyid skye 'gag med pa'i dngos grub thob pa rig pa klong du shar ba'i skyes bu de'i spyan sngar mkhas pa dgongs rgyud rnam par dag pa bcu drug bka'i lung nod cing bzhugs pa las dgongs pa klong du gyur te smra bsam tshig las 'das par bzhugs so/ /mkhas pa phyi ma bdun da dung tshig la chags pas la ma zlos te ke tshang gnyis pa na bzhugs so/ /gsum pa na bī ma la mi tra la sogs pa bzhugs so/ /gnas de na bram ze mo rgan mo zhig yod pa 584

la dris zhig zhes bstan/ bram ze mo la dris pas des pra se nas mi rtogs pa'i thabs byas te man ngag gi chos bod du 'khyer ba'i ltas su paṇḍi ta rnams kyi rmi lam log pa bshad de man ngag 'thob par lung bstan/ bram ze mo shel gyi blo gros chu len du 'ong ba la 'phrin srings shig par bstan to/ /'di ltar na nor bzang gi rnam thar gyi tshong dpon rin chen gtsug phud kyi rnam thar gyi khang brtseṭa bcu'i bcu pa na sangs rgyas rnams chos bgro ba dang dgu pa nas bcu pa pa rnams gnas pa sogs bshad pa ltar gnas 'di yang dag pa'i snang ba'i gnas phal pas mthong bar mi nus pa cig yin par snang la ke tshang zhes pa'ang khang brtsegs kyi /3gyur khyad du snang ngo / /chu chun ma la 'phrin du mar bsrings kyang ma grub pas bee ro tsa nas lta stangasakyis chu bum sa la sbyar bas 'khur ma nus nas khyod kyang rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par gda' ste bdag la'ang 'di lta bu yod zer nas mos rang gi byang khog phye bas rdo rje dbyings kyi lha so bdun bkra lam me bstan/ thabs kyis nang du btol bar gyis la bī ma la la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams bzhugs pa la phyag gis brda 'di bstan pa la lan 'di gyis bslabs/skabs btsal nas sgo'i gseng cig la nang du btol te phyag byas/ brda lan gyis mnyes/ nang par shrī si dhal shog 'phrin phul bas mjal te gser dpag med phul/ rtsol med kyi theg pa ston par zhus pas do nub mtshan ma brtag gi gsungs/ nang bar mtshan ma bzang / bod la phan thogs nges/ de yang sgron bskal mun bskal grangs med 'das pa'i sngon du bskal pa dga' ba la sangs rgyas stong phrag drug bcu byung ba'i mtha' ma mngon rdzogs rgyal pos man ngag rnams thugs kyi sras bdun la gtad pas de dag rim par sangs rgyas/ de nas mun bskal lnga brgya'i 'og tu bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i shākya'i bstan pa la rgyu 'bras la zlo ba'i theg pa 'di 'byung ste dang po rgya gar du dar 585

nas o rgyan gyi yul du 'khor ba lan gsum stongs par byed/ de nas gosang ba dam pa 'di/ /mtha' 'khob yul du rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes brgyate pa'i byang sems gcig gis blangs te mtha' 'khob rgyal po spyan ras gzigan9kyi sprul pa la ston/ der gzhan 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab ste tsha ba'i yul du sa bdun pa'i byang sems lkog ma na rme ba yod pa cig dang rang rgyal gyi sprul pa cig la ston/des sa bdun pa'i byang sems cig la ston/ de nas rim par sa lnga pa dang brgyad pa dang bdun pa dang gsum pa pa dang / de nas brgyad pa dang bdun pa pa spel ba bdun rgyud la bstan nas grub pa 'thob par 'gyur la/ de nas sa brgyad pa pa cig la bstan te des thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i tshogs la bstan te la las ni go la las ni ma go la la nyams/ la la grol zhing bka' nyams nas glegs bam mang po bris te snod min gyi lag tu 'grims nas des man ngag nyams lha srin rnams 'khrugs te bskal pa phra mo 'jig go /man ngag 'di dang phrad pa'i skyes bus bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du mthong bar byas te gsangs te spyad na mya ngan las 'da'o/ /bskal pa 'di'i 'og tu mun pa'i bskal pa lnga brgya 'byung / de nas sgron me'i bskal pa bzang ldan bya ba la gsang ba'i snod ldan gyi gang zag mos pa'i rdo rje/ stobs kyi rdo rje/ shugs 'chang ba'i rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dang bzhis grub par 'gyur ro/ /des na dus la bab pas na khyed la bskur bar bya ste bskur thabs ma legs na 'u cag gsum ga'i srog la 'ong / yul 'dir yang gang dgar spyad du med de rgyal pos tshor na man ngag rang yang med par byed pas khyed gnyis chos gzhan nyan pa ltar gyis la paṇḍi ta brgyad la gser phul la rgyu 'bras kyi chos nyon zhig mtshan mo man ngag gi chos bstan gyi gsungs te de ltar byas/ mtshan mo pra se nas mi zin ba 'i thabs byas te man ngag bshad cing dar dkar la ra dkar mo'i 'o mas bris te dud pas 686

bdugs na yi ge gsal ba byas/ rdzu 'phrul dang 'phrul thabs kyis man ngag gi dpe bam po brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi phyung ba'i tshe gtsang ris kyi mgon po sum brgya drug bcu dang sngags phyi nang gi srung ma thams cad lhags te phyag darnga skor ba byas nas bdag cag chos srung rnams ni bka' 'di rnams kyi rjes su mchi'o khyad par man ngag snyan rgyud kyi rjes su mchi'o rab tu yang mchi'o/ /snod dang mi ldan pa thob lo shes lo mkhas lo btsun lo nyan lo thos lo sgom lo sgrub lo tsam gyis chog pa/ dad pa gting nas med pa/ zhen pa ma log 'dzin chags ma khrol ba/ chos dang 'bul ba la pham rgyal rtsi ba'i mi lag 'grims tsa na dam nyams su song ba yin pas de tsa na bdag cag rnams mi dga' shin tu rab tu yang ma dga' ste bdag cag la la ni pha ma bsad pa snyam byed/ la la ni bu gcig stor ba snyam byed/ dpral ba'i mi/ga phyung ba snyam khong gi snying phyung ba snyam nor bu rin po che stor ba snyam byed de de'i tshe nad dang mu ge dang 'khrug pa dang sa g.yos dang rlung nag dang bu yug dang mi shis pa sna tshogs pa 'ong / na rag chen po yang yongs su 'phel/ slob dpon yang tshe thung nad mang / slob ma rnams phongs shing dug dang grir 'chi/ chos pa rnams mthu chung / bon dang mu stegs dang srin po bdud du ldang / de'i tshe la las man ngag 'di rnams sregal las rul du 'dzud/ la las ni 'tshong / la las ni bsres cing bslad de/de la bsten nas 'di 'chad cing thugs la 'chang ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid yin kyang de la la las skur pa 'debs/ la las smod/ la las sun 'byin/rkyen des sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /des na shin tu gsang bar sbos shig shin tu gsangs la spyod cig shin tu gsang bas chongs shigagasang bar yid la gyis cig ces mgrin gcig tu bsgrags nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de mang res nags tshal gyi dbus/ res ri bo'i rtse/ res nam mkha'i 587

mthong sa/ res rgya mtsho'i nang du bshad de thog mar bod du man ngag 'arghaṃng ba'i rtags su rig pa'i khu byug tshang zhing rdzogs pa'i rtags su rtsal chen sprugs pa/de bzhin du bsam gtan ston pa thig le drug pa/ theg pa thams cad kyi lta skyong khongs su chud pa khyung chen theg pa/ thams cad las khyad 'don pa mi nub rgyal mtshan ste che ba lnga/ grub mtha' thams cad 'dus pa yid bzhin nor bu/ chos dang gang zag gi che ba dbyung ba che btsan dam pa/ theg pa gong 'og gi skyon yon 'byed pa spyi sbyong rgyal po shes rab gsum la bsten pa kun 'dus rig pa ste chung ba bzhi/ gdams pa la rags par ston pa bde 'byams/ 'bras bu sku gsung thugs ston pa srog gi 'khor lo/ dpe don rtags gsum ston pa sems ti kra dang nam mkha' rgyal po ste 'bring bzhi/ drang nges dbye ba bde ba phra bkod/theg pa'i shan 'byed pa spyi chings rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba rdo la gser zhun/spyod pa dang dam tshig ston pa rtse mo byung rgyal ste che ba'i phyogs bzhi/ 'chal pa tshar gcod pa rmad byung bshad de sems sde bco brgyad do/ /de'i tshe bee ros sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal mthong chos thos te bee ro tsa nar ming btags so/ /spyir sad mi bdun rab tu byung tshe bee ro tsa na rakṣi ta zhes rnam snang srung ba'am rnam snang 'tshor ming brjes pa yin kyang slar yang rnam par snang mdzad nyid du btags pa'o/ /des legs grub tshim ste rgyal po la ngo so 'dod pas bod du song ba gcan 'phrang bas bsad do/ /bee ro tsa na ma tshim ste yid mi bde bar 'dug pa na bla mas khyod na'am gsungs te/ mthong ste ma phrad rang sems na/ /myangs te ma tshim rang sems na/ /nad gzhil sems sde bco brgyad pos/ /gdeng ma rnyed par 'dod pa rnyed/ /mthar phyin gyi sman zhig da gtong 'tshal/ /zhus pas/ ngas thams cad bstan zin na khyod ci la brdugs gsung ba na/ lta ba phyogs ris med pa de/ /las dang rtog pa'i 'phrang la 588

brdugs/ /spyod pa blang dor med pa de/ /'dod rtsol gnyis kyi 'phrang la brdugs/ /lam la sgrod du med pa de/ /lung dang rigs pa'i 'phrang la brdukas/ /rang byung ye shes chen po de/ /bag chags stug po'i 'phrang la brdugs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa de/ /bying rgod gnyis kyi 'phrang la brdugs/ /'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub de/ /brda don phrad pa'i 'phrang la brdugs/ /rdzogs chen bya bral lhun grub de/ brda don dbral ba'i 'phrang la brdugs/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul rang dbang de/ /spyi blugs tshangs pa'i dbang la brdugs/ /cha la sems sde bco brgyad pos/ /'phrang brgyad skyel ma ma shogs pas/ /bdag rang bai ro tsa na yang / /yul du 'gro ba 'phrang la brdus//zhus pas slob dpon gyis kyang khyad par ba ston par dgongs/ paṇa chen rnams kyi rmi lam gnyis pa log ste chu thams cad bod du bab pa dang rtsi shing thams cad bod du song ba sogs rmis/ rgyud sde drug bcu dang dbang man ngag gnang /khyad par du 'bras bu rang chas su ston pa rgya mtsho'i klong bstan pas rtogs pa'i mthar phyin kyang sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i phyir/ sku gsum ston pa mchog gi sras//thams cad mkhyen pa bdag gi pha/ /blo yi re dogs bcad pa'i phyir/ /dbu smyung bzhes pa'i chos shig zhu/ /byas pas/ chos kyi dbyings la zad med kyang //de bzhin nyid ni gcig shes na/ /ma lus de la yongs su rdzogs/ /de las yod na siddhi kun/ /gsung ngo / /de nas bla ma'i zhal nas gdams pa 'di la btsa' lugs gsum byin pa bzhin mi sbyin pa bzhi yod de 'khor 'das thams cad gsal bar byed pa'i phyir mig 'bras ltar btsa'/ theg pa kun gyi bcud yin pas khong snying ltar btsa'/ chos kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas srog ltar btsa'o//dad ldan 'jam ring yun brten la/ /dpe dang 'grel ṭīka man ngag rnams/ /grangs btab bsdebs te byin par bya/ /dpung bzang yun ring snod ldan la/ / 589

sba sri med par tshang bar byin/ /dad pa can la mi zhu yang / /nan gyis byen zhing gtad gnyer bya/ /dad can shes rab chung ba la/ /yid dang sbyar la byin par bya/ khong khro che zhing dad med la/ /tshig 'gas brid la mi sbyin bskrad/ /dad brtsen shes chung tshig la dga'/ /bshad rings dpe 'grel 'dod pa la/ /phyogs tsam gyis brid mi sbyin bskrad/ /mi sgom yi ger bri rings la/ /chos gzhan gyis brid mi sbyin bskrad/ nor phyir chos 'tshol dad med rigs/ /dang po nyid nas brtags te spang / /'on kyang bod kyi rgyal po la ston cig gsungs nas rjes su gnang / dga' rab rdo rje dang mjal bar lung bstan nas btsal bas mkha' 'gros o rgyan du song zhig nga/ra lung bstan te o rgyan gyi dur khrod du 'od kyi khye chung du bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag bcu bzhi bstan te nam mkha' la 'od du yal/ slar shrī sidha'i drung du 'ongs pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rang sem sa ye shes rdo rje 'di/ /yod med dbus su'ang mi dmigs shing / /rtag chad mtha' la mi gnas pa/ /sgro skaXr med pa'i chos nyid la/ /blang dor med par blo bzhag ste/ /'di zhes sgom pa'i 'du shes bral/ /de ni dgongs pa'i mthar thug go /sems ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /sems kyis sems la lta ba na/ /sems kyi skyon dang gol sa brtag /de nas nyams dang drod tshad skye/ /rang snang dkyil 'khor rang la 'char/ /sems ni kha dog cir mi dmigs/ /dbyibs kyi rnam pa gang yang med//sems ni rgyu las ma skyes te/ /rkyen gyis rnacha/ par 'jig pa med/ /thog mar ma byung mthar mi 'gro /dus gsum kun tu stong zhing dben/ /'di 'dra zhes su bstan du med/ /bdag gzhan gzung 'dzin btang stoms dang / /rgyu rkyen gang gi'ang spyod yul min/ /bying rgod gnyis po 'di la med/ /ji bzhin pa yi ngang du zhog /yig 'bru phyag mtshan skur mi dmigs/ /sgra dang tshig las 'das 590

par sgom/ /snyam byed blo'am 'jigs pa'i blo/ /kun la re dogs med par bzhag /cir yang rtog par mi bya'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos na/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba mi tshor zhing / /phung po yod par mi mngon te/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /rig pa ye shes shar ba'i drod/ skar ma'i 'od 'dra klog 'byung 'dra/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'drar gsal/ /gcig go kun rdzogs maca ngag yin/ /zhes gnad kyi zhal chems thugs kyi mdzod btol te rlung gis /ji kyang thos su mi rung bar mdzad nas bai ro nyid la gdams te slob dpon 'od du yal ba'i tshe rkang mgyogs grub pa'i mchog ku ma ra dang ku ha ra dhā tu bya ba gnyis yod pa las be ngos ku ma ra dang grogs por byas gser byin nas rkang mgyogs bslabs pas gtan gyi rkang mgyogs phas bu la yang mi ster bas bod du ma slebs bar gyi rkang mgyogs byin no zer nas cung zad byin te re ma ti'i rkang mgyogs bsgrubs pas spyir glag gzan la 'jums pa ltar mgyogs pa yod kyang go bo ri rtsibs gcod pa tsam bee ros grub/ rkyang mgyogs kyi gtso bo gcig shos la yang rngan pa bcug ste bod mi ma mthong gnod sbyin sha ba'i ru can song ngo bar sgrogs su bcug ste chas de lta bur zhugs te byon/ lam du yang skal ldan 'ga'i don mdzad/ bod du myur bar phebs te rgyal pos zhabs mthil gtsug tu blangs pas rgyal po la nyin mo rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang mtshan mo rdzogs pa rtsol med kyi theg pa bstan/ bee ro bod du zhal phyogs nas byon pa'i nub nas bzung ste rgya gar ba'i rmi ltas gsum pa log pas man ngag gi chos bod du shor bar shes te rdo rje gdan du bltas pa na rgya ru spod zhig cing chos ma tshang bar shes pas rgyal po dang paṇḍi ta gcig la gcig yid ma 'ches te rgyal pos paṇḍi ta rnams la gsangs nas rdo rje gdan nam a su ra gsang ba'i brag phug gam bya rgod phung por sbas sayoyang zer te ma snang bar byas/ bod the tshom skyed phyir 59/

phra me/na gyi ngag sngags khyer song bas bod mi brlag pa'i thabs gyis zhes rkang mgyogs pa btang ste ru bzhi thams cad tu bsgrags pas bod blon rnams kyis gcugs la nyan te 'di mi gsod na rgyal khrims bshig par bgros te rgyal po la gsol ba btab/ btsun mo tshe spong bzas kyang bai ro tsa na slu bar ma tshugs pa'i sems nad byas te blon po rnams bslad/ rgyal po la nan gyis zhus pa na thabs ma rnyed nas bsad par zhal gyis bzhes te sprang po zhig la bee ro'i chas bcos nas mi rnams kyis ma slebs tsam la zangs su bcug ste chur bskur/gdan khri'i 'og du gnam sgo sngo them can las babs par bai ro bzhugs te rgyal pos nam phyed na chos nyan pa las nang 'khor ba zhig gis mthong / de nas rgyal po'i gdugs khang bya ba'i phyir ka ba khong stong sgo can du byas par slob dpon bzhugs pa na btsun mos shes te blon po rnams la bsnyad de bod 'bangs gyis nan gyis gsol bas thabs ma rnyed de sprug par zhal gyis bzhes/ slob dpon gyis kyang tsha ba rong du sngon gyi las 'brel zhig yod pas der 'gro'o gsungs nas rgyal blon thams cad kyis bskyal/ dka' ba bco brgyad la sogs pa'i mgur mang po mdzad de gshegs/ rgyal mo rong pa'i yul mi rnams kyis bod kyi rtog chen par dogs nas sbal dong du zhag bdun dang shig sna tshogs pa'i dong du zhag bdun bskyur/ skye ba mang po'i gong du yul de'i ne ler gyur tshe sbal pa bzos pa dang / yul der dge slong zhig tu gyur tshe shig dor ba byas zos pa'i rnam smin gyi mtha' mar zhal gyis bzhes te dge slong purṇa'i sngon gnas dran pa gsungs pas gru dang mdo gnyer la sogs pa rgyal blon rnams kyis rgyal po'i mes su gtogs pa'i dge slong purṇa yin par shes nas bshags pa dang bkur sti byas/ thugs mi bde ba ltar mdzad pa'i rgyu dris pas nga sgyugs pa'i rkyen gyis rgyal po khri srong lde btsan 'di tsam na 'grongs par 'dug pas des mi dga' 592

gsungs te 'di la zla ba gsum dang drug dang lo gsum dang lo skor gcig zer ba sogs yi ge mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dug 'on kyang rgyal po de'i sras g.yu sgra snying po ma dad nas bu gcig shi ba'i pha ma dang rgan rgon 'chir gtugs pa deng skyes pa bud med lang tsho can rtse ba rnams rim par btang ste chos byas na bu dang phrad dam/ rgas pa gzhon nur ldog gam/ rtse dga' 'di las lhag pa'i bde skyid chos la yod dam bya ba rim pas 'drir bcug pas/ bu bas rang nyid kyang 'chi ba dang / rgas dus chos dran kyang 'phyis pa dang / thams cad mi rtag pa rnams rim par gsungs pas de dag kyang dad cing g.yu sgra yang cung zad dad nas 'og rta phul te chos zhus pas ma gnang ba dang / yang khrus la gdan drangs nas chu'i nang du gdams pa mi gnang na chu la bkrong ngo zhes bsdigs pas/yon dang dad pa gnyis med par/ /nan tshir byas pas chos 'khugs sam/ /'chi na gnyi ga 'chi mod de/ /nga shi 'og min gnas su 'gro khyod shi ngan song gsum du 'gro khyod kyis phod na nga yis phod/ /gsungs pas skrag ste bzod gsol byas/ /yang dpe cha brkus nas kun byed kyi rgyud bris te nga la yang chos yod zer bas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab 'jam dpal gyi/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i man ngag nges pa'i don/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu gting zab la/ /yig nag tshig gis byang chub rnyed pa min/ /zhes gsungs pas dad pa drag du skyes te ngus nas rjes su bzung bar zhus pas rgyu 'bras kyi chos gsungs pas ma tshim ste tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa zhus pas/ lus kyi sgo nas bran g.yog ci dgos byed pa/ bla ma'i sku dgra 'dul ba/ phyag skor gyis sgrib pa sbyong ba ste lus kyi sbyang ba gsum/ ngag gis zhe sa dang gsong por smra ba/ sku dgra la drag sngags kyi smod pa 'bebs pa/ rtag tu gsol ba 'debs pa ste ngag gi sbyang ba gsum/ yid kyis rtag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa/ ci gsungs 593

mos pas sgrub pa/ lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul ba ste yid kyi sbyang ba gsum dang de ltar sbyang ba dgu khyim dang nye 'brel spong bar phod pa sogs phod pa bcu gsum byed nus na bstan no zhes gsungs pas ci gsung sgrub par dam bcas pa na/ 'o na o rgyan gyi yul rdo rje'i gdan rnams su song la dga' rab rdo rje dang mkhas pa nyer lnga rnams la gser 'di 'bul du song zhig de rnams kyi gdams pa ngas gdab bo zhes gser mang po bskur ba dang bka' nyan te o rgyan du 'gro khar khong rang gi yab yum blon 'bangs dang bcas pas o rgyan du phyin rung dga' rab rdo rje mi rnyed/ de bas slob dpon bai ro nyid la gtugs pa bzang zer nas gros btab pas srog la bab kyang bla ma'i bka' sgrub zer nas 'gro bar chas pa'i tshe slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod de tsam du bla ma'i bka' sgrub na o rgyan du 'gro mi dgos/ 'di nyid du rjes su bzung gis nyams sad byas pa rnams la bshags pa gyis shig ces gsungs nas g.yu sgras lus longs spyod thams cad phul te gdams ngag du ma gnang / spyir yi ge snga zhing bar du yig mkhan gyi skyon brgyud pa du ma dang padma bka' thang dang sre ba la sogs pa sre bslad mi 'dra ba mang du snang bas 'dra 'bag lhad gtan med deng sang mi rnyed par snang yang lhad can gyi gseb nas lhad med kyi don go bar snang la/ des na kha cig rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying mo zhes rten rgyal po'i sras mor 'dod pa dang / yang rgyal po'i sras po yin pa la bee ros dong nas nam mkha' che'i rgyud kha thon mdzad pa blo la zin nas phyis bee ros yab yum las bslangs bya ba dang / gtsang legs grub kyi skye ba'i sprang phrug tu 'dod pa dang / de yang bud med du 'dod pa sogs mang du snang yang lo rgyus kyi babs rnams bsgrigs na rgyal mo ni yul gyi ming dang rigs rgyal po'i sras yin la mtshan g.yu sgra snying po yin pa dang / nyams sad byas pa dang / mkhas par gyur nas bī ma la bsam 594

yas su byon zo5 'i dus rgyal blon la la yogs dor du btang nas bong 'bangs thams cad 'byod de skye ba snga phyi dran pas byang chub sems dpa' yin thang dag man ngag gi chos khyad par can rnyed pas sprul sku yin yang dag sogs lha'i spyan thob/ rkang mgyogs grub/ bzod pa thob bden pa mthong / sgrib gnyis byang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa ston pa'i zhal skyin sa brgyad pa thob pa yin yang dag zhes bee ro la yang dag bcu gcig gi bstod pa phul nas bee ro spyan 'dren du btang bas thugs gting nas mnyes te gdams ngag tshang sprugs su der rdzogs pa 'di dag par snang la/ bī ma la bod du byon pa yang chos rgyal khri srong gi dus dang mu ne btsan po'i dus dang sad na legs kyi dus yin par bshad pa gsum snang yang sad na legs rgyal por gyur nas mu ne btsan po'i gshid mdzad dus bī ma la byon pa dang / gtsang legs grub kyi skye ba ni phyis bee ro li ji~X/la du spyan 'dren pa mo li bza' tshul khrims sgrol mar bshad pa'i phyogs 'di dag par snang ngo / /slob dpon bee ros kyang rgya nag du byon te grub thob dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dgongs nyams bsdur/ khams su yang gzhan don mdzad/ slar bod du byon pa'i lam du tsangs mi pham mgon po lo brgya lon pa cig la rgad po mdzub tshugs kyi gdams pa btab pas cig car du grol te rang rgyal gyi lus kyi bkod par bshad pa de yin/ bod du byon nas rgyal blon thams cad la chos gsungs/ slar li yul du gshegs te phyis ba sing gi nags su 'od kyi skur yal lo/ /g.yu sgras kyang pangs sangs rgyas mgon po/rgya blo gros gzhon nu/ sbas rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs smin grol du byas so/ /yar lungs pa snyags dzha na ku ma ras bī ma la dang bee ro dang g.yu sgra ste gsum ga la bsten nas bla ma so so las kyang nga rang mkhas snyam pa'i blo lan gsum skyes pas gsodajas kyi btson du lan gnyis tshud/ phyis sbrul chen po cig gis 595

rke la 'khril ba la sog po dpal gyi ye shes kyis lus srog dang bsdos nas thar bar byas/ sbrul gyi mgo nas zos pas gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang ste 'di sngon mgar ba beg tse bya ba khro bo'i dbyibs su yod pa cig snod ldan du mkhyen nas gdams ngag gis kha brid de sog po dpal gyi ye shes su ming spos pa yin/de la snubs sangs rgyas rin po ches zhus so/ /shrī sidha dang dga' rab rdo rje sogs bee ro tsa na dang dus mi mtshungs so snyam du dogs par mi bya ste grub chen de rnams ni skal ldan la da ltar yang mjal du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar sems phyogs kyi bka' babs gnyis bshad nas bdag nyid chen po padma 'byung gnas las ji ltar byung ba ni/ spyir thang yig le'u brgya dwang gcig par 'dod pa tshig bcad lhug gnyis snang ba 'di la lhad ha cang mang ches pas bdag gis mthong ba kho na yang mi 'dra ba lnga bcur zin pa snang bas yid rton mi nus par snang la/ 'on kyang skye bo ma brtags par 'jug pa rnams kyi dad pa 'phel ba'i rgyur snang bas 'di rnams la yang skur pa gdab par mi bya ste chos bstan pa'i dgos pa ni gdul bya dad pa la 'god pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sngon gyi mkhas grub du ma'i gsan yig na slob dpon gyi rnam thar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum zhes dang / rgyas pa nyang ral gyi gter ma le'u zhe brgyad pa ces snang bas 'di'i phyogs dag pa snyam la 'di la'ang lhad cung zad skabs skabs na yod pa 'dra na'ang sa bon tsam brjod na/ o rgyan gyi rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi la sras mi mnga' nas dkor mdzod sbyin par btang ste rgya mtsho nas yid bzhin nor bu klu mo mdzes ldan ma las blangs te tshur lam dha na ko sha'i gling nas khye'u padma las 'khrungs pa rnyed te spyan drangs nas mtsho skyes rdo rjer mtshan gsol te sras su bzung / nor bu'i mthus rin po che'i khri stan dang khang bzang byung zhing zas gos dang rin po che'i char gyis skye bo tshim par byas/ sras kyis 596

rgyal srid spong ba'i phyir rtsed mo'i gar mdzad pa'i mtshon shor ba'i tshul gyis blon po'i bu bsad de khrims kyis sprugs/ dur khrod du byon te dur khrod kyi rdzas la longs spyod cing mkha' 'gro rnams dbang du 'dus te sbyor dgrol gyi spyod pa mdzad pas srin po sha na rākṣar grags/ mkha' 'gro ma bdud 'dul ma dang zhi 'tsho mas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ 'khrungs sa'i mtsho gling du byon te gsang sngags mkha' 'gro'i brda skad kyis bsgrubs pas rgya mtsho'i gling gi mkha' 'gro bzhi dbang du 'dus te phag mo'i zhal mthong byin gyis brlabs te rgya mtsho'i klu dang bar snang gi gza' skar rnams dam la btags te rdo rje drag po rtsal du grags/ slob dpon pra ha sti las rab tu byung ste shākya seng ger grags/ yo ga'i rgyud rnams tshar bco brgyad mnyan pas de nyid du lha rnams zhal mthong / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba btab pas ngas khyod 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab dge slong ma kun dga' mo la dbang zhus shig gsungs te mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes dge slong mar bsten pa dang mjal ba na hūṃ yig tu bsgyur nas des zhal du mid padmar bton nas sgrib pa gsum sbyangs nas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgo nas phyi tshe'i rig 'dzin/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas nang phyag chen gyi rig 'dzin/ gsang ba rta mgrin gyi sgo nas dregs pa can thams cad 'dul bar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal bshes gnyen las phyi nang gi chos du ma mnyan te 'jam dpal gyi zhal mthong / slob dpon hūṃ ka ra las yang dag shākya de wa las phur pa/ na gārdzu na las padma —ོ gsung / sangs rgyas gsang ba las sgyu 'phrul/ rdo rje mi 'gyur las bdud rtsi yon tan/ dha na saX skṛ ta las srid pa ma mo/ shrī sidha las sems phyogs/gu hya tsantu las dmod pa drags sngags rnams tshar re gsan pas lha so so'i zhal gzigs te blo ldan mchog sred du grags so/ /de nas za hor gyi rgyal po gtsug 597

lag 'dzin gyi bu mo me tog madhe ra ba dbang du mdzad de ri bo po ta la'i 'dabs su khar ti'i gnas su tshe'i rig 'dzin grub ste yab yum gyi tshul gyis za hor gyi yul du bsod stoms le byon pas me phung du bsregs pa na til mar mtshor 'khyil ba'i dbus na padma'i sdong po la yab yum bzhugs te padma 'byung gnas dang padma sambha war grags shing za hor gyi rgyal khams btul/ o rgyan du byon te bsod stoms mdzad pas 'bangs kyis ngo shes nas mer bsregs pas sol ba'i gur khyim na padma'i sdong po la bzhugs te sems can 'khor ba las bsgral ba mtshon pas thod skam gyi phreng ba gsol bar mthong ste padma thod phreng rtsal du grags/ sngon rgyal po'i sras yin pas padma rgyal por yang grags te o rgyan gyi rgyal khams btul te rgyal po 'khor bcas 'od lus su yal/ rgya gar du mu stegs kyi ston pa lnga brgyas bstan pa snub pa'i tshe byon nas rtsod pa mdzad pas slob dpon rgyal/ mu stegs kyis mthu byed pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma bdud 'dul mas bse'i sgrom bu zhig phul nas bdud dang mu stegs thul cig par gsol ba na sgrom bu nas srog ser thog dang bcas pa'i ngan sngags byung nas thog phab ste mu stegs rnams nags su bsregs/ lhag ma sangs rgyas par btsud de seng ge sgra sgrog tu grags/ rgya bal gyi mtshams yang le shod kyi brag phug du bal mo shā kya de wa la sgrub rten mdzad nas yang dag gi sgo nas mchog bsgrubs pas klu ging po/ gnod sbyin rgod ma kha phra men/ glog ma srin gsum gyis bar du bcad de lo gsum du char ma bab pas nad mug rgyas pa'i tshe bar chad du dgongs nas rgya gar gyi bla ma rnams la bar chad 'dul ba'i chos rdzong bar zhus nga/sa slob dpon pra hasti la phur pa'i chos zhus shig par gzhan rnams kyis lung bsta na te pra hastis phur pa 'bum sde'i nang nas dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i skor mi khur gnyis brdzangs pa phebs pa tsam gyis bar chad zhi char bab nad mug chad/ yang 598

phur gyi lha tshogs thams cad zhal gzigs mchog gi dngos grub thob ste yang da ga tshong pa 'dra/ dngos grub che yang bar chod mang bas phur pa skyel ma dang 'dra ba dgos par gzigs nas yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ srod la shā na ma mched bzhi/ gung la re ma ti mched bzhi/ tho rangs bse'i lha mo mched bzhi/ bse'i skyes bu bzhi/ dung gi skyes bu bzhi/ lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi ste pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad kyis srog snying phul nas dam la btags te phur pa'i bka' srung du bzhag go /bod kyi lha srin thams cad dam la btags pa na rdo rje khro lod du mtshan grags te sngon med pa'i khro bo 'jigs rung du snang bas khro bo 'od po'am 'chol pa'i khro bo zhes bya ba'i don yin la bsam yas rgyal po 'dul ba'i phyir gu ru drag por bstan nas bran du bkol lo/ /gzhan yang rgyal po mya ngan med 'dul ba'i dge tshul de yang slob dpon gyi sku'i bkod pa yin la dge slongo dbang po'i sde nyid kyang slob dpon las tha mi dad par mi 'gal te spyod yul rnam 'phrul gyi mdor/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i skal ba'i nga'i ring bsrel dang mdo 'di lhan cig tu rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs su ma 'ongs pa lo brgya na rgyal po mya ngan med ces bya ba 'byung ba de'i don du sbed par 'gyur la de'i tshe dge slong dbang po'i sde zhes bya bas phyung ste mdo 'dis rgyal po 'dul zhing rgyal po des ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten brgyad khri bzhi stong byed par 'gyur zhing dge slong des mdo 'di byang gi phyogs su 'jog par 'gyur mod kyi sus kyang shes par mi 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pas dge slong des mdo de bod yul du sbas pa snyam mo/ /de bzhin du mu stegs kyi rgyal po nor bu 'od ldan gnas spar te rgyal por mdzad nas bhaṅga la btul/ bram ze'i bu grub pa brnyes pa ḍisti he ru ka yang o rgyan gyi yul 'dul ba'i phyir sku'i bkod pa yin/yang mu stegs kyi rgyal po klu'i khyab 'jug ces bya bas bstan pa 'jig pa'i tshe 599

bde mchog dus kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i khye'u dang sprul pa'i nyar byas te btul/mdor na grub pa'i slob dpon 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang gdul bya 'dul tshul ni bsam par mi nus pas ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar 'di dag las ches bla lhag pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod/ des kyang gdul bya rnams kyi skal bar ma 'tshams pa zhig gis deng sang mi snang la sa bon tsam snang ba 'di dag la yang rgyal po bka' thang / snying thig gi babs lugs gser 'od dam pa sogs bsres shing grong tshig mi mdzes pa mang du bsnan pas nog nog por byas snang ngo / /lha 'dre mthu bo che rnams kyi zhud zer mngal skyes kyi mis thub par dka' bas gdul bya mi ma yin gtso bor 'dul ba'i phyir brdzus skyes su/ byon pa yin la/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pas/ bla med don rdzogs 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'i lung /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni bzhi gnyis lon pa na/ /zhes dang / lo ni bcu ru gnyis chad na/ /'jig rten kun gyi dpal dang ldan/ /o rgyan yul du nga nyid 'byung / /padma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ /sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa 'dren pa ltar na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad na 'khrungs par snang la/ mang zhig tu/ lo ni sum stong drug brgya lon/ /las kyis bod yul dbus su 'ongs/ /zhes dang / bod du lo brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs par 'chad kyang grangs kyi nges bzung dngos ma yin kyang mang du lon pa'i tha tshig tsam yin nam/ spyir rgya gar na bgrod pa la lor 'dren pa yang yod skad pas de lta bu zhig yin grang zhes sems so/ /bod du spyan drangs tshul ni rgyal rabs chen mor na yams gnyis kyis bshad pa nyid yin la lha 'dre thams cad bran du bkol nas bsam yas la sogs pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad bka' 'og du lan gnyis bcug nas gsum pa ma tshar ba la blon po rnams ma dad pas gshegs par gsol ba na bod 6 00

yul gyi g.ya' ri gangs ri brag ri mtha' dag sgrub gnas su byin gyis brlabs te mi ma yin rnams kyi don mdzad de sku dngos kyis rnga yab gling du gshegs nas srin po'i kha gnon du bskal pa 'di ji srid par bzhugs so/ /thang yig lhad can du srin po'i yul de 'dzam gling sog pa'i dbyibs kyi yu ba la yod par bris pa ni lhad btab par snang la srin po'i yul de ni 'dzam gling gi gling g.yog 'dzam gling nas nub na yod pa de yin la slob dpon gyis srin po'i rgyal por bzhengs te ma btul na srin po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dzam gling du lhags par 'gyur bas kha gnon mdzad pa yin zhing gu ru chos dbang gi rmang lam zhwa nag mar yang 'di nyid shin tu gsal bar gzigs snang ngo / /'on kyang zangs mdog dpal ri cig ni 'dzam gling nyid na'ang yod de mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/gangs can nas dpag tshad lnga brgya na yod la sngags grub pa rnams gnas par bshad pas der yang sku'i bkod pa cig bzhugs par snang ngo / /phur pa'i lo rgyus rnams las ni o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i sras mched gnyis yod pa las che ba rgyal sar bton/ yul chos kyis chung ba shārta rakhri ta dmangs su phab pas ri la bros te sbyor dgrol byas nas sgrib pa sbyang phyir pra hasti las phur pa'i chos tshar bco brgyad du mnyan te tshe dang las dang sa 'og gi rig 'dzin gsum grub/ bod kyi spyan 'dren pa mi ngal ba'i phyir byon pas a su ra'i brag phug tu slob dpon gsum tshogs pa na bī ma las chu bo la phur pa gdengs pas gyen la log bal po shrī la mañdzus brag la btab pas jim pa la btab pa ltar song / slob dpon gyis nags la me shor ba la gdengs pas tsandana'i nags su song / yang le shod du bse'i lha mos bar chad byas pa phyag rgya bzhis bcings/ dbu zhwa'i 'og tu mnan te nang par gzigs pas lha'i bu mo 'dra ba bzhi 'dug nas phur pa'i chos bod du khyer ba na bdag cag mkha' 'gro rnams snying bton pa snyam byed nas 601

'ongs pa yin te da ni 'bangs su mchi'o zhes srog snying phul te༄ rdo rje yang sbyin la sogs par ming btags pa sa bdag chen mo bzhi/ der sgrub pa zhag gsum mdzad pa'i mtha' ma'i srod la nag mo dre'u bzhon pa srid pa pho rgyud kyi lcam mo bzhi byung ste dam la btags pa bdag nyid chen mo bzhi/ nam smad la lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum/lcags kyi khyi mo rkang gsum rnam dam la btags pa shā na ma mched bzhi'o/ /de nas bsam yas su byon te rgyal po la phur pa'i chos gsungs te bzhugs par ma gnang bar rgyal pos gtsang yab la gong du bskyal te srin yul du bzhud ces snang la/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyalab cog ro za mchod gnas ma/ a tsa ra gsal le gsum la dkyil 'a/bor mdun gyi nam mkhar sprul te dbang lha dang bla ma gang la zhu dris pas cog ros lha la 'dems/ mkhar chen bzas bla ma la 'dems/ sa les bla ma'i thugs dang sbyor bar zhus pas lcog ro la mi zab par gsungs pas phur pa dang yang dag dang bdud rtsi rnams lcam lugs su grags/mkhar chen bza' la rgyud man ngag snying por dril nas gnang ste sa le la khyod kyis shod gsungs/ mdor rlangs/ rngog khon/ rog mgos/ dbang so zur/ snubs/ rgyus/ 'o bran la sogs pa'i gdung rigs las rdo rje phur pa grub pa ni bod yul du shin tu mang bas gsar ma rnams ma dar gyi bar du bod du yi dam dang bstan srung gi srog rtsa yang phur gyis bzung ba yin la brgyud pa byin gyis rlob par nus pa'i sngags 'chang de rnams kyi gdung rigs shas che ba las gsar ma'i skyes chen rnams kyang byon pa yin no/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig ni mtsho rgyal la gsang chos su gdams nas gter du sbas shing sems phyogs dang skyed rdzogs gzhan rnams kyang gter du sbas te skal ldan la smon lam btab nas dus 'ga' 'ga' na 'byung ba yin no/ / 602

de ltar sems phyogs kyi byung tshul bshad nas/ gnyin/ pa sgyu 'phrul dang /gsum pa 'dus pa mdo'i phyogs ji ltar byung ba ni rgyal ba g.yung gi gsang snying 'grel pa'i don bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang gsang snying las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa las rig pa'i skyes bu thub pa drug de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes las 'thon to zhes pas dpal kun tu bzang po las thub pa drug 'phros te rigs drug tu skus don mdzad/ gsung gis chos bstan/ thugs kyis mngon par mkhyen pas 'dul bar mdzad la/ de las theg pa rim pa dgu'i lha mi'i theg pa nas nyan rang byang sems kyi bar ni rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa yin la/bla na med pa'i theg pa dang / zhes pas 'bras bu gsang sngags la phyi kri ya u pa yo ga gsum ni bya spyod rnal 'byor dang gcig la/ nang ma hā a nu a ti gsum ni pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud las gtso bor de kho na nyid ston pa rnams dang don gcig go zhes rgyal ba g.yung bzhed do/ /de las ma hā yo ga mdo dang sgyu 'phrul ni/ kun tu bzang pos gsungs/ rgyal tshab rigs lngas bsdus/ rgyal sras sems dpa' rnams kyis nyams su blangs shing bkral ba ni rgyal ba dgongs rgyud do/ khyad par rigs gsum mgon pos lta spyod sgrub pa gsum gyi don snying por dril te gdul bya lha klu mi gsum rjes su bzung ba ste/'jam dpal rdo rje rnon pos lha'i bu grags ldan mchog skyong rjes su bzung la/de nas rim par rin chen 'od 'bar/ tshangs pa skyes rgu'i bdag tshangs pa kun grol/ tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin/ brgya byin/ des lha'i rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sde btul te rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob par gyur to/ /spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsis sman gye sku can gyis klu dug can rnams kyi dug bcil/ snod ldan du mdzad nas klu rgyal mgrin nag po rjes su bzung / de nas rim par klu 603

mo kha 'dul/ klu mo 'dul tshangs ma/ klu yid rong dga' ba/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ des klu'i rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sde btul to/ /phyag na rdo rje 'jigs pa'i gzugs can gyis gtso bor gnod sbyin tshom bu 'bum sde btul zhing khyad par du ri ma la ya'i rtser lha grags ldan mchog skyong / gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po 3ṅka mgrin bcu/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ li tsā wi dri ma med par grags pa ste dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga dang rig 'dzin rgya mtsho lta bu la gsungs pa ni rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa'o/ / de'i tshe phyag rdor gyis byin gyis brlabs las rgyal po dza la rmi ltas bdun shar zhing glegs bam gyi char bab pa ste/ de yang rgyal po dza la rmi ltas bdun shar ba ni mdo dgongs 'dus kyi 'grel pa las/ sku gsung thugs rtags thim pa dang / /chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa dang / /chos sgra chen po sgrogs pa dang / /bdud rtsi char du bab pa dang / /rin chen char du bab pa dang / /pū dza rgya chen byas pa dang / /zhes pas phyag rdor nam mkhar byon te sku las 'od zer spros gdul bya'i rtog sgrib sbyangs/gsung gis chos bstan ste go bar mdzad/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'bar ba byung rgyal po'i thugs kur thim/ spyi gtsug nas nyi ma shar te rgyal po'i thugs gar thim pa ni rmi lam dang po'o/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dpag med nyi zla la chibs/ gser gyi 'khor lo bsnams nas chos ston pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /nam mkha' la sprin gser mdog can chags/ snang srid gsal ba'i glog 'byin/'brug sgra chos sgrar ldir ba ni gsum pa'o/ /de las bdud rtsi'i char bab sa thams cad chag chag btab skye 'gro rnams bkrus te rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes pa'i sngags sgra sgrog pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /sprin gseb de nas rin po che'i sgrom nang nas thing shog la gser yig rang byung ba'i glegs bam gyi char bab pa ni lnga pa'o/ /de rnams la rig 'dzin dang byang sems thams cad kyis mchod bstod phyag skor 604 —

byed pa ni drug pa ste sngar gyi tshig rkang so so'i don no/ /de nas nam mkha' la gzugs mi mngon pa'i sgra zhig grag pa ni/ las dang skal bar rab ldan pa/ /bsod nams chen po dra ma khyod/ /sprul pas ji ltar lung bstan bzhin/ /rgyal bas 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /skal ldan khyod la sgrog par bya'o/ /zhes grag pa ni bdun pa ste de ma thag sad nas dga' zhing ngo mtshar bas pho brang gi yang thog tu byo na pas 'ja' 'od dang me tog lang long du 'bab cing phyag na rdo rje'i sku rin po che smug po las rang byung ba khru gang pa cig 'dug nas spyi bor blangs te/ e ma ngo mtshar mchog gi sku/ /'dren pa mchog gi dpal lags gang / /mos pa'i yid kyi sgo nas ni/ /sngon tshe gong nas bsgrubs pa yi/ /las kyis 'brel ba'i lha mchog khyod/ /bskal pa brgyar yang mi gtong ngo / /zhes brjod nas zla ba bdun bsgrubs pa na rmi lam du byung ba'i po ti rnams mngon sum du babs te gzigs pa tsam gyis rtogs kyang gzhan gzu lum dang ras gcod kyis 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir ma mkhyen pa ltar bstan nas 'di rnams kyi don dri dgos pas 'dzag gling na mkhyen pa su che ོ dris pas/ rgyal po u pa rā dzā dang rin chen mang gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge slong ku ku rā dzā gnyis mkhyen pa che'o zer te spyan 'dren btang bas brda ma 'phrod kyis dogs nas glegs bam tshur skur zhig zer nas mchod pa dang bcas te shing rta la spyan drangs pa na snga mas brda ma mjal/ phyi mas sgyu 'phrul stong phrag brgya pa'i nang nas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u shes te bsgrubs pas zla ba bdun na grub ste bstan pa 'di dag rtogs pa'i dngos grub zhus pas phyag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur ro gsungs te zla ba bdun bsgrubs pas phyag rdor byon te rdo rje lan gsum gsor nas/ spong len brtul zhugs spyod pa 'i dbang / /dge bas bskur na sdig pa med/ /ces gsung zhing don sdi bstan pa 605

thams cad rdzogs par bskur nas tshig gi bstan pa de dag dge bsnyen li tsā wi dri ma med pa la zhus shig ces lung bstan pa ltar mnyan nas dge slong ku ku rā dzā des sgyu 'phrul stong phrag brgya pa las tantu sde bco brgyad du phye ste/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ glang chen rab 'bog glang chen mtshor zhugs te sku'i rgyud gsum/ zla gsang thig le gcig las 'phros pa du ma 'phros pa ste gsung gi rgyud gsum/ gsang ba 'dus pa ri bo brtsegs pa rtse gcig tu 'dus pa ste thugs kyi rgyud gsum/ dpal mchog dang po bdud rtsi mchog dang po yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud de yon tan gyi rgyud gsum/ garma mā la sgron me 'bar ba ki la ya yig 'bru bcu gnyis te 'phrin las kyi rgyud gsum/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba dam tshig bkod pa thabs kyi zhags pa ste spyi'i rgyud gsum dang bco brgyad du phye nas rgyal po dza la bshad/ de nas rim par rgyal po sidha ra dza/ lha gcig go ma 'a 'apa la/ ku ku rā dzā phyi ma/ ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ za hor gyi mkhan po pra ha sti/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ des bī ma la la sogs pa paṇḍita lnga brgya la bshad/ bī ma la bod du byon te snyags dzñā nas mdo dang sems phyogs bsgyur/ rma rin chen mchog gis mtshan nyid dang sgyu 'phrul bsgyur/ de yang thams cad rang snang du ston pa rgyud gsang ba snying po/rol pa mngon par brjod pa lha mo sgyu 'phrul/ dkyil 'khor ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad pa/ 'phrin las ston pa sgyu 'phrul bzhi bcu pa/ dbang gtso bor ston pa sgyu 'phrul bla ma/ yon tan mthar phyin par ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad bcu pa/ sde snod yongs la khyab par ston pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po/ dam tshig gtso bor ston pa sgyu 'phrul le lag ste sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad/ grol lam rim gyis ston pa ye shes snying po/ cig car ston pa rdo rje me long / thabs lam rim gyis ston pa rdo rje thal ba/ cig car ston pa rdo rje rgya mtsho ste bshad rgyud sde bzhi zhes 606

bya'o/ /de las sde brgyad ni bī ma las rma rin chen mchog des gtsug ru rin chen gzhon nu dang gye re mchog skyong gnyis/ de gnyis la dar rje dpal gyi gragang pa dang zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan gnyis/ de'i dar rje la bka' yongal graṭa pa dang zhang 'a bka' mchims phu mar grags te sgyu dra ma gtogs pa snubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsan no/ khyad par du 'dus pa mdo ni rtsa ba'i rgyud kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo dang bshad pa'i rgyud mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa gnyis yin te de ni rgyal po dza nas sras ind+ra po dhi dang nā ga bo bhi gu hya po dhi ste gsum la bsha/da/ nā ga bo dhi ni klu ba su rigs drug gis lo dgur bshad du ma ster/ ind+ras ku ku rā dzā/ de nas rim bzhin ku ku rā dzā/ ro langs bde ba/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ pra ha sti/ des shākya seng ge shākya pra bha/ shākya mi tra gsum la bzhad/ shākya seng ges dha na rakṣi ta/ des sbrir ma ti/ des bde ba gsal mdzad/ des dharma bo dhi dang / ba su dha ra dang / bru sha mkhan po/de gsum la snubs sangs rgyaja/ ye shes so/ /po ti'i char bab pa'i lo rgyus 'di dag la sa skya pa kha cig de ltar na gsang sngags rang nyid len par 'gyur zhing bla ma med par mi 'grub par bshad pa dang 'gal bas rdzun gtam yin no zhes zer yang rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rjes bstan pas bla ma'i go mi chod na ha cang thal zhing lha'i byin rlabs kyis glegs bam ched du bab pa la thub chod du blangs par yang ga la 'gyur/ shes phyin gyi tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel par yang / gsung rab 'di'i lo rgyus bshad na sngon sangs rgyas mi yul na lo brgyad bcu bzhugs pa'i tshe na sarba bud dhas ma yo ga dang gu hu sa ma ya la sogs pas 'dul zhing de nas theg pa de dag gi sdod du gyur pa dzaspu gling gi mi yul na med pas rgyal chen ris bza pa'i gnas na lha rnams dang bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' la sogs ga snod du gyur nas de'i tshe mdo sde de na 607

bzhugs so/ /slad kyis sangs rgyas mya ngan lase 'das pa'i 'og rte za hor gyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa ngo mtshar du gyur te chos la dad pa dag zhig 'dus pa theg pa de'i 'dul skal du gyur zhing snod du gyur nas sarba budhes ma yo ga la sogs pa mdo sde chen po bco brgyad phyag na rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyis za hor gyi yul du gshegs pa dang za hor gyi rgyal po ind+ra bo dhis mdo sde dag bltas pas brda ma 'phrod nas gang gis shes mngon shes kyis bltas pa na/ yul dbus su slob dpon ku ku rā dzā nyin re zhing khyi stong la chos 'chad mtshan re zhing khyi de dag dam tshig du longs spyod mdzad pa cig bzhugs pa de'i theg pa'i snod du yang gyur la bdag gi 'dul skal du yang 'gyur ba 'dra nas rgyal pos pho nya patang ste slob dpon spyan drangs pa dang slob dpon gyis mngon shes kyis brtab/sa pas bdag gi 'dul skal du yang bab la bdag kyang mdo sde de'i snod du 'gyur bar shes mod kyi/ 'on kyang mdo sde de dag sngar ma bltas na brgya la rgyal po'i the tshom dag ma sol bar gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas mdo sde tshur blangs mas bltas pa na mgo mjug gar lta ba'i cha ma mchis nas de nyid tu lus brdabs te mgon med do skyabs med do zhes bos pa dang / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mngon par gshegs te khyed ci 'dod dris pas bdag mdo sde zab mo 'di bltas pa tsam gyis shes par 'dod ces gsol ba dang de bzhin du gnang ngo / /de nal sarba budhas ma yo ga la sogs pa'i glegs bam rnams ma phye bar de dag gi don yid la mngon sum du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas slob dpon de za hor gyi yul du gshegs nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la chos de dag bshad do/ /dpal rdoja sems dpas lung bstan nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ltar bkod nas sgom du bcug pas rim pa ltar rgyal po 'khor bcas dang de'i sras 'khor bcas dang 608
