sras mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin du grub bo/ /de nas sras mo des rgyal bu la man ngag bzhag pa las 'phel ba ni deng sang 'dilags te zhes dang / mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa las kyang de ltar du bshad pa dang / lo tsā ba zu dga' rdor gyis nā lend+ra na po ti'i char bab tshul ri mor bris pa mthong bar bshad pas 'gog par mi bya la/ 'on kyang yul 'di ri ma la ya'i 'dabs su 'chad pa byung yang / ri ma la ya ni sisnyi la'i gling gi dbus na yod par grags la 'di ni 'dzam gling nyid yin zhing o rgyan gyi yul du 'dod pa'ang rgyal po'i ming gis 'khrul ba ste za hor gyi yul kho nar rig par bya la/ku ku rā dzā 'di dag kyang khyi stong gis bskor ba che ba dang khyi lnga brgyas bskor ba chung ba ste ḍā ki rnams gzugs gzhan du bsgyur ba'o/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lo rgyus bee ro tsa na'i mdzad byang yod pa myang ral gyi gter ma las ni/bcom ldan 'das chos kyi sku gnyam pa nyid du bzhugs pa la yum kun tu bzang mos dbyings rnam dag gi klong nas rdo rje dam tshig chen po'i glus bskul nas longs sku zhi bar bzhengs te zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bstan no / /zhi bas mi 'thul ba rnams la khro bo che mchog du bzhengs te khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gsungs so/ /de yang bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phyi ma mngon byung gi rgyud/ phyi ma'i phyi ma sngags kyi rgyud/ ma tshang kha skong gi rgyud/'byed pa lde mig gi rgyud de zhi khro spyi'i rgyud lnga/ de rnams kyi rtsa rgyud gsang 'dus zhi ba 'dus pa che mchog 'dus pa sogs 'dus pa brgyad dang / zhi khro lhan cig pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa ste bye brag gi rtsa rgyud bcu/ de nas 'jam dpal gshin rje sogs so so'i gtso bor sprul te gsungs pa yan lag gi rgyud la 'jam dpal gsang rgyud gsang ba grub pa brjod pa glur blangs sogs dang rme brtsegs 'jigs byed gshed dmar nag dang bcas pa ste 'jam dpal sku'i rgyud ོ 609

so bzhi/ rta mchog rol pa/ rngog ma leb rgan la sogs pa padma gsung gi rgyud bcu gnyis/ he ru ka gal po che chung / rijig rten las 'das pa'i mdo snga phyi kun 'dus rig pa/ mnyam sbyor gsang snying ma bu drug sogs yang dag thuṭa kyi rgyud bco brgyad/ bdud rtsi rol pa bam po brgyad pa sogs bdud rtsi yon tan gyi rgyud dag phur pa'i rgyud la byi to ta ma la 'bum sde pha rgyud rnal 'byor dam pa gsang chen mo rgyud ki la ya bcu gnyis gnyi ga'i rgyud de phur pa'i spyi rgyud dang bye brag tu phur pa ma rgyud la rdo rje ye shes sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rtse mo ste rtse mo bzhi de'i yan lag zlog phur bcu gnyis/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi srung ma bcu gnyis kyi rgyud do/ /phur pa pha rgyud la yang snying sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rgyud lnga/ snying po'i rgyud gsum/ yan lag khro bo bcu'i rgyud bcu/ lo ma'i rgyud bzhi/ me tog gi rgyud bcu/ 'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi/ ma tshang kha skong kyi rgyud lnga ste rtsa ba'i rgyud gsum la yan lag gi rgyud mthe' yas pa ni phur pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud do/ /ma mo rbod gtong la ma mo gsang ba gtan tshigs kyi rgyud srid pa'i klong chen mo 'bum phrag gcig ste rtsa rgyud le'u brgya rtsa brgyad rgyud phyi ma le'u gcig dang bye brag tu shel mtsho dwangs pa sogs dkar mo sku'i rgyud dag tsitta gdong zlog sogs spug mo gsung gi rgyud bzhi/ smug nag 'khyil pa sogarnga nag mo thugs kyi rgyud bdun/ ser mo yon tan dang ljang mo 'phrin las la rgyud re re gzhan mkha' 'gro'i sgor rgyud mtha' yas pa'o/ /'jig rten mchod bstod la dregs pa 'dus pa sogs sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rgyud lnga yan lag gi rgyud sde dpon sum bcu'i sgos rgyud sogs dang rmod pa drag sngang/sa la sku gsung thub/sa yo na tan 'phrin las kyi rgyud lnga dang sde da pon bco brgyad so so ri sgos rgyud so gas mang po'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba dgong sa/ pas bka' bstsal ba de kun tu bzang po nyid dang tha mi dad pa'i byang 610 —

chub sems dpa' ngo rje chos saca/ phyag na rdo rje'am rdo rje sems dpa' 'am rdo rje drag po rtsal lam mi'i thod pa can zhes kyang bya ba des tshom bu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du rang nyid ston pa po dang rig 'dzin gzhan rnams 'khor du byas te rang nyid kyis bstan par mtshaca/sa sbyar nas bsdus te gser gyi glegs bu la be ḍūrya zhun mas bris te kun tu bzang mo'i thugs kyi sprul pa mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi gtso mo las kyi dbang mo che la gtad de khyod kyis spyi bye brag gi rgyud rnams tha dad du phye la rin po che'i sgrom so sor zhog la skal ldan rjes su zung zhig par gdams so/ /mkha' 'gro ma des spyi rgyud lnga bye brag gi rgyud bcu gnyis rnams rin po che sna tshogs pa'i sgrom bur bcug yan lag gi bka' brgyad so so rnams lcags zangs dngul gser g.yu gse mchong gzi rnams kyi sgrom bu so sor rim pas bcug ste dur khrod gsil ba'i tshal gyi rang byung gi mchod rten gyi drung du phyi mchod rten la nang gzhal med khang par byas de der bzhugs nas rgyas btab ste mchod do/ /dur khrod de yang nyin bzhin thog ser 'bab cing mtshan mo me 'od du 'bar mkha' 'gro dang lha srin gyis mchod pa'i glu dang rol mo rtag tu 'byung ba las phyi zhig na grub chen brgyad dur khrod brgyad po re re na so sor bzhugs pa las thugs kyis gzigs te dus gcig du mchod rten de'i rtsar 'dus te ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas zhag bdun na mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che 'khor bcas dbang du 'dus te bka' ci bstsal zer ba na khyed rnams kyi mchod pa'i yul gyi sgrom 'di rnams nged rnams la byin zhig gsungs pas mkha' 'gro ma des rgya bkrol nas slob dpon brgyad po la sgrom so sor gtad de/'jam dpal bshes gnyen la 'jam dpal sku/ nā gardzu na la padma gsung / hūṃ ka ra la yang dag thugs/ bī ma la mu dra la bdud rtsi yon tan/ slob dpon padma la phur pa 'phrin las/ dha na saXskṛ ta la ma mo/ gu hya de wa la mchod 611

bstod/ shīrtaX garbha la drag sngags gtad de so sor bka' babs/ tha dad du byon pa las slar slob dpon padmas byon te mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus pas dbus kyi rin po che thod pa'i sgrom bu nas rgyud man ngag thams cad phyung ste gtad rgya bkrol nas skal ldan la ston zhig par rjes su gnang ngo / /de nas yang le shod du byon te zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pas rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du zhal gzigs te tshe'i rig 'dzin grub/ de nas khro bo rol pa bsgrubs pas bdag nyid dang gnyis su mi phyed par grub ste phyag chen gyi rig 'dzin tho ba/ rgyal po khre srong lde btsan gyis bod du spyan drangs nas lha srin btul te bsam yas kyi rab gnas mnga' gsol ba'i bar mdzad/ rgyal pos dka' ba med par myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa zhus pas mchims phu gri gur rje 'bangs brgyad la dbang phyi nang gsang gsum rdzogs par bskur ba las gser srang bcu las byas pa'i me tog re so sor dor bas rgyal po nyid dbus che mchog la babs/ nam mkha' snying po badzra he ru ga sangs rgyas ye shes 'jam dpal gshin rje/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal phur pa/ dpal gyi ye shes bla med he ru ga rlangs dpal gyi seng ge dregs pa kun 'dul/ bdag bai ro tsa na stobs ldan nag po'i dkyil 'khor la babs so/ /de nas khro bo'i lha tshoṭa bdun brgya nyi shu'i zhal me long la gzugs brnyan ltar bstan nas dbang phyi nang gsang gsum lta ba spyi 'byam dang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur zhing ngo sprad/ sgo gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs su gnas gyur cing smin par mdzad pa de yin no/ /de nas bdag cag rnams la rgyud sde yang so sor bshad de mkhas pa mi bzhi'i gdams ngage dbang dang bcas pa ni rgyal po nyid dang gnyags la gnang ba yin no/ /rgyal pos sku tshe de la nyams su ma longang5 kyang sku tshe phyir bsring sa/612

nam mkha' snying pos nyi zer la zhon/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis nam mkha' la 'phur/ ngan lam gyis spyi gtsug tu rta mgo dang rta skad phyung / mkhar chen bzas bsad pa gso nus/ 'brog mi dpa tha yes kyis ma mo dngos su rbod/rlangs dpal seng gis sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ bdag gis kyang 'jig rten sni dregs pa dbang du 'dus shing las 'chol bar nus/ gzhan yang drag po mthu'i skor mtha' yas dang rtsis sman dpyad gzo'i yan lag dang bka' rdzogs pa chen po dgongs pa'i gting phyung ba rnams kyang rgyal po'i don du zhus shing bdag la gnang / gdams pa 'di rnams gang zag la brgyud na bka' lad cing chos bsnubs pa'i tshe nyams par 'gyur bas rgyal po nyid kyi phyir lo brgyad dang bcu gcig bod yul du bzhugs nas zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gtsug lag khang dang brag dang sa rdo mtshan ma can rnams la mi brlag pa'i tshas kyis sdoms mi shigs pa'i rgyas thob la gter du sbos shig zhes gsungs shing brag dmar mgrin bzang la sbas/ ma 'ongs pa dbon sras kyis cos bsnubs pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis khyer te mtha' 'dul gyi rnam snang gi sku lus la gter du sbed cing rgyal po nyid dang 'phrad par 'gyur ro zhes snang ngo / /'dir lo brgyad dang bcu gcig zhes sneng bas brgya dang bcu gcig ni yi ge ma dag pa ste slob dpon padmas rgyal po'i mchod gnas su lo brgyad dang bod yul gyi sgrub gnas rnams bsdoms par lo bcu gcig bzhugs pa yin par go'o/ /chos dbang gi gter ma mkhar chen bza'i zin bris las phal cher 'di dang mtshungs pa la/ dbang gi tshe lho nub nas 'od zer lnga 'phros na sa mkhar chen bza'i me tog la lan drug thim/ mnga' bdag gis dkyil 'khor dgu yongs su rdzogs pa zhi khro'i lha tshoṭa thams cad zhal gzigs/ gzhan brgyad kyis me tog babs pa'i lha so so'i zhal gzigab// mkhar chen bzas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje slob 613

dpon las ca/ 'das par mthong / de'i dus bod spyi tsam la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub ri rtse thams cad nas chu 'bab pa/ lha srin thams cad ar la gtad pa/ ri thams cad nags dang lung thams cad nar 'gyur ba/ rgyal po'i sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa sbyin par dgongs pa la bod spyi'i bsod nams kyi skal bar ma gyur pas dngos grub la slong ba ma byung ngo zhes snang ngo / /'jam dpal sku'i bka' babs kyi sangs rgyas ye shes de ni sgrags pa sangs rgyas ye shes su snang la snabs sangs rgyas ye shes ni ral pa can gyi dus byung nas bod dang bal po dang rgya gar dang bru sha'i mkhas pa mang po bsten zhing bru sha'i lo tsā ba che btsan skyes las mdo dgongs 'dus gsan/ spyir mi ma yin bran du 'khol lo/ /brgya dang bcu gsum du bzhugs te slob dpon 'di la mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bka' thams cad gcig tu babs pa yin no/ /de la slob ma lnga las so ye shes dbang phyug la lta ba sgang dril/ pa gor 'phags pa la 'grel pa/ ngan yon tan 'phags la tar ka gegs sel/ sru legs sgron la tshig snyan pa'i rigal kyi sras/ khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho la bzhi ga bshad/ de'i sras ye shes rgya mtsho dang padma dbang rgyal/ dang po'i sras lha rje hūX chung ste rje mi la'i bla ma de yin/ de'i slob ma myang ye shes 'byung gnas/ yang so ye dbang nas ngab thung byang chub rgyal mtshan/ kong btsun sher ye/ rwa thung shes tshul/myang shes rab mchog myang ye 'byung zhes g.yung gis bshad la/ kha cig ngab kong rwa gsum so'i slob bur 'dod pa'ang snang ngo / /myang la thur po ches gsan zhing sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dngos slob stong tshab 'phags pa la yang gsan no/ /de la zur po che ni gdung rus zur/ yab sras bzang mig po che/ mched bzhi'i che ba ste tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen du bzhugs/ myang ye 'byung lce shākya mchog rog shākya 'byung gnas sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas mdo sgyu sems gsum la 614

mkhas pa'i mthar phyin/ rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud 'grel pa sgrub thabs so ngo ra phye ste bshad/ lta dgongs kyi rtse mo zur chung shes rab grags/ sgyu 'phrul gyi rtse mo mi nyag 'byung grags/ mkhyen rgya'i rtse mo zhang 'gos chung pa/ sgom/ sgrub kyi rtse mo bzang sgom shes rgyal te rtse mo bzhi/ rtsags bla ma la sogs pa rtse lkog brgyad/sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i slob ma byung / 'ug pa lung gi lha khang shangs mda'i dpal chen sogs bzhengs/ klu bkug ste chang rdzar bcug kha bcings nas chu nus tshad brgyab cing btsags pas klu des yul gyi chang bsdus pas chang zad med zhag mang por byung / rab gnas kyi ston mo la grong pa'i phyugs g.yar nas bsad de sha bkye/ dgong mo phyugs rnams gson por gtad skad de bsad gso nus/ 'brog mis gser gyi 'bul ba bslangs ba na mi ma yin las gser slong pas srog chags kyi gzugs ma byung gi bar long zer te gser khung bu nas brdol ba'i mthar sbal pa'i gzugs can byung bas 'phro bcad de gser srang brgya phul nas bsam mi khyab zhus te 'brog mi'i ston las kyi dus ber gyi thog du zhor ma khur nas bskyas/ mthar sgro phug gi lha khang brtsigs/ drug bcu rtsa gcig la gshegs/ zur chung pa ni pha btsun rgan zhig bur yod pa chung ngu nas zur chen gyis bsos/ mtshan shes rab grags/phyis brag rgya bo dgu 'dus su sgrub pa mdzad pas bde gshegs rgya bo bar thoṭa/bla ma'i gsung gis sgom ma phyug mo ma smad cig gi bdag byas te yo byad rnams phul nas chos zhus dpe bris/ phyis sems can gyi don byed dgos pas de la ma chags par bros shog gsungs te bka' bakhyi/na bsgrubs/ mdo dgongs 'dus bshad pa'i thog mar dpe 'grems sum brgya byung / chung ngu'i dus skor ba byas pas zhapas sa la mi reg par bla mas gzigs/ 'bangs rtse mo bzhi dgongs pa 'gran pas dgongs pa ri bo ltar g.yo 'gul med pa thams cad la byung / yang 615

zur chung pa tā la gang tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags/ ru lu'i dzāpa dpyangs bzla ba na drung dang4 rgyang grags kyi pha rol la gsung che chung gi khyad par mi mngon/ khyed gsum gyis 'chad nyan gyis gsungs te sgrub pa la gshegs/ de gsum gyi 'go bya tshas gsang snying gi thabs lam gyi skabs su ma rgyud dgol par 'dug zer nas 'gos lha btsas kyi sar song / meg chung dbang seng gis dkyil 'khor slong ba la yo ga dgos par 'dug zer nas sum pa ye 'bar gyi sar song / 'gos chung dbang nges grub mtha'i rgyab tu tshad ma dgos par 'dug zer nas pang ga dar chung gi sar song bas go ma chod mi gsum du grags/ sgrub pa mdzad pas cho 'phrul mtha' yas kyang nyam nga ma byung / snang grag rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du shar/ 'di yang bzang rtog gi mthu brtas pa tsam las snying po med dgongs nas rdzogs chen rtsol bral gyi ngang la bzhag pas rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa shar/ snod bcud la thogs med zang thal du 'byon/ mtshan nyid kyi mkhas pa cig gis rtsod pa btsugs te ka ba chos can byade pas/ nga rdzogs chen rang snang ris med kyi mdun na ka ba mi gda' gsungs nas phyag ka ba la g.yugs pas nyi zhur la brgyab pa ltar song bas dad de slob mar gyur pa ni ma thog byang 'bar yin zer/ de nas lha rje 'ug pa lung pa ma gshegs tsam la gdan sa mdzad de tshogs bskyangs/ de'i tshe khyung po grags se zhes bya ba mtshan nyid kyi mkhas pa des slob ma mkhas pa bzhi lha rje sun 'byin du btang ste skyo ston shākra yes kyis khyed rdzogs chen pa sgom gtso bor byed dam byas pas nga dmigs pa gang la gtad 'dug gsungs/ 'o na mi sgom mam dris pas nga gang la yengs 'dug gsungs pas dri rgyu zad/ glan ston shākra bzang gis khyed sgya 'phral ba snang srid la'i dkyil 'khor da 'dod dam dris pas riring sa spyod //// ri shu yul rang rgyud par mngon sum du snang ba sus khegs gsungs/ 'o na mi 'dod 616

dam byas pas ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang sbyong phyir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ngang 'gal bar ci nus gsungs pas spobs pa zad/ yang kheng bla ma dang mnga' ti jo shākra gis kyang dri rgyu zad de dad nas slob mar gyur pa la sems phyogs sgyu 'phrul mdo 'phrin sgrub kyi ka ba ste ka ba bzhi byung / ma thog byang 'bar la soṭa gdung brgyad/ sgom chen mi gnyis/ yul po che mi gcig ta gur mi gnyis soṭa dpag med byung / 'gos lha btsas kyis kyang dpal chen po'i 'du shes skyes te phyag btsal/ yang kheng bla ma la longs spyod kyi rten 'brel mdzad pas sku bsod rgyas/ khyung po grags ses zur chung pa 'dra ba'i log chos mkhan bsad na 'tshang rgya nges byas pa gsan pa na chos grar bzhad cing chos bya ba nga'i gsang sngags 'di yin par 'dug dgrol ba lam byed 'di sngags lab/ gzhan la med snyam tsa na zur chung pa lta bu bsad na 'tshang rgya zhes khyung po grags se lta bu'i mtshan nyid pa chen po yang blo phugs nga'i chos la gtod par 'dug pas dga' rab zhig byung gsung skad de phrag dog rtsa ba nas zhi/ drug bcu rtsa gcig la gshegs/ de'i sras sgro phug pa chen po ni mnga' tikra bza' gtsug tor lcam las btsas/ skyo ston shākra ye'i rmi lam na yum gyi srin lag la ston pa'i sku rmis pas shākya seng ge dang mnga' cha hor por grogs/ ka ba bzhi sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ phyag rdor gyi sprul par grags/ 'phrin las shin tu che ste sto brag bya ze'i mar pa shes rab 'od sogs slob ma gdugs thogs stong dang gtso bo bcu gnyis sogs byung / ri rtser tshogs 'khor mdzad mgur gsungs nas nam mkha' la je mthor mkha/'a spyod tu 'byon par chas pa slob mas ngus pas ngas lus ma bzhag na shul du bkra shis pa yin te da cung mi legs gsungs/ re gcig pa shing stag la thegs/ spur bzhu tshe mi ma yin gyis phul ba mi la med pa'i nor sna bzhi byung / slob ma'i mchog lte ston rgya nag ni mes po 'phangs byang brtson 617

gyis skyil mkhar lha khang bzhengs/ shing pho khyi /be di/ thungs/ de'i dus mkhas pa she khyung gnyis 'ban 'bre gnyis rgya stag gnyis bya ba yo/da pa'i phal cher la gtugs te dbu tshad sde snod la mkhas pa'i mthar son/ sgro phug pa la rgya brtson seng dpon g.yog gis rtsod pa btsugs pa na khong rab tu pham par byas pas mnyes nas gdams ngag thams cad rdzobs ba ra gnang bas slob ma gzhan las chos zab/ dgung lo bzhi bcu la gshegs btsun mdzad gzhan don bskyangs te lnga bcu rtsa drug la gshegs/ de'i slob ma dbus pa ston shāka gis se brag btab pas dam pa se brag par grags/ dbus pa zhig po ni gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa zhig ste grub thob chen por bzhugs/ lce ston yon tan gzungs ni rgya nag gi dbon por 'khrungs/ se brag pa sogs bsten te lha rje lha khang par grags/de'i slob ma zhig po bdud rtsi ni/ sangs rgyas dwags chung bya ba dbus kyi bzad pa dwags po rgya ras kyi phyir byon pas mtshan chags pa zhig sto brag gi phur mong sgang na bzhugs pa bzad pas spyan drangs te lha gdong dang bya skad dgon pa sogs phul nas bzhugs/ de'i sras snga rgyud la mkhas pa jo nam sogs byon zhing phyi tshar wang chung ma la zhig po bdud rtsi bltams/ yab dang lho bal gyi rnal 'byor ma mngon shes can sogs kyis gzhan don 'byung bar lung bstan/ 'ongs phud gtor bas 'ongs cher 'phel bas yum gyis kyang sprul skur shes/ zhang po dam pa se brag pa dang bla ma lha khang pa bsten/ zhang g.yu brag pa'i snyan pa thos nas spyan drangs te chos 'khor btsugs pas chos lha khang pa la nyan nas zhabs tog tshal pa la byas zer nas skye bos shes pa na lha rje lha khang pas nas dang sha mar bskur te khyod bla ma bzang po spyan drangs chos 'khor byed pa la ngas kyang 'thud bya dgos te 'di las ma 'byor gsung bas dad pa lhag par skyes/ gzhaca gyi yang zer lo chang / rtogs pa'i mthad phyin/ snang ba la thogs brdugs med/618

bod yul thams cad du byon ri rgya lung rgya la sogs gzhan phan mtha' ya sa mdzad/ lo paṇa su byon kyang 'degs/ rgya gar nag sogs nas slob ca/ mtha' yas pa 'dus/ rdo rje gdan la mchod pa lan gsum bskyal/ lha sar chu raṭa dang zhig gso rgya cher mdzad/ phyis lha sa nas thegs pa'i skyel chang gis gra pa rnams bzi nas 'thab mo byas pas thugs skyo ste nga gcig pa sa yos la gsang phu'i rgya ra gad logs su gshegs/ gdung chab gzhung la spyan drangs nas thang skyar bzhu bas sa g.yos/ yon chab kyi nang nas 'ja' tshon gyi padma skyes pa zhag gsum du bsdad/ gdung khang gi mchod rten byas/ de'i gdan sar dmigs te thang skya'i gtsug lag khang byas so/ /de'i slob ma ma hā lhun po/ mkhas pa jo nam/ dbus pa jo bsod la sogs byon zhing slob ma'i mchog ni rta ston jo yes te mes po rta ston dbang grags/ yab rta ston jo 'bum yin gcung po rta ston jo bsod/ mched gnyis gas chos mang du mkhyen zhing gtso bor zhig po bsten/bla ma shin tu mnyes/ yul gzhis thams cad btsongs pa'i spong dag chos 'khor lan bzhi byas/ gsung sgros thams cad yi ger bkod pas phyi rabs la drin che/ri khrod 'grims pa bas kyang bla ma'i zhabs tog 'di rang stobs che bar 'dug gsungs/ bla ma gshegs nas mya ngan byung ba na rmi lam du zhig po byon te chos gsungs pas sdug bsngal rang yal te de phyin sdug bsngal rang rgyud pa dang bral/lha sar zhabs tog mang du mdzad de re brgyad pa lcags stag la 'das so/ /gzhan yang rta ston gzi brjid la sogs pa mkhas pa mang du byung ngo / /sgro phug pa'i slob ma ji ston nye ston gnyis la gtsang nag 'od 'bar gyis thug de nas rim par g.yu nga ston sangs rgyas/ rgya khab gong pa/ pakki shākra 'od dang g.yung chos mgon/ de gnyis la rba ston gzi brjid/ de la rgyal ba g.yung ston pas gsan no/ /yang na gtsang nag la me ston mgon po bla ma spo/ pakki shākra 'od/619

rta nag pa bdud 'a~Xl/ mda' shākya 'phel dang zur byams pa seng ge rgyal ba g.yung ngo / /rgyal ba g.yung ni mkhas pa chen po gsar rnying gnyi gari grub thob rtsod pa med pa'o/ /yang yar lungs rgya sman du gnyal ston sang sa rgyas grags ces bya ba zhig gis dzambha la bsgrubs pas zhing chung zhig yod pa chus khyer te rgyal khams la byon pas pu gu dor phyug po 'dze can zhig shi ba'i ro lus pa la snying brtse nas dor bas mal 'og nas gser dpag med byung bas dbul ba bsal lo/ /sgro phug pa'i slob ma bya chen po'i dpon po dang myang nag mdo po sogs la chos gsan/ yang dag gi zhal gzigs/ 'khrungs yul du rdo thog thel btab/ de'i slob ma skyi chos kyi seng ge ste hor yul du byon pas rgyal po se chen gyis mchod rten zhig tu bcug nas sgo brtsigs te bzhag lo 'khor nas bltas pas rdo rje phur pa'i skur gyur 'dug nas bshegs pa la rngo thog pa la dar ring chen mo sogs dang las ka cher gnang nas bla mchod mdzad/ skyi chos seng gi slob ma sman lung pa ste yul yar lungs pa/ yab pha jo bdag nyid chen po/gdung rus myang / mched lnga'i che shos/ gzhan bzhi ni chos ldan pa/ skal ldan pa/ dur khrod pa/ dbang rgyal ba'o/ /mtshan shākya 'od/ gsang mtshan mi skyod rdo rje spyir yar lungs sprul skur grags/ gu ru chos dbang gi yab ston nyi'i skye ba yin pas bka' brgyad kyi bka' babs gtad cing myang ston dbon po zhes chos dbang gi skyes rabs zhu ba po yin/ gsang snying gi khog dbub tī ka rgyud don rnam nges la sogs pa mdzad/ de la dwags po'i sangs rgyas gong la bas gsan zhing dwags po nyid du gnyan ston la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du byung ste dar rgyas su mdzad cing de las khams su mang du dar ro/ /yar lungs sprul sku'i sras rin po che shākra 'bum pa dang skyi chos seng gi gdan sa pa rgya ye shes mgon po sogs kyis kyang dar rgyas su mdzad/ yang sgro phug pa chen po'i slob 620

ma 'dzam ston 'gro ba'i mgon po zher/ bya ba mkhas grub chen po cig byon te 'di ni rje dus mkhyen gyi snga slob cig gi skye bar sngon du lung bstan zhing phyis ngos 'dzin mdzad pa 'dzam skye ba gsum pa zhes /'dzam yul tsam na sgom bzang ba byung zhes pa de yin pa snyam la de'i slob ma rje phag mo gru pa dang 'khrungs yul gcig cing ma spun du gyur pa mtshan shes rab seng ge dang spobs pa mtha' yas zhes bya la spyir ka dam pa bde gshegs su grags pa dang / gtsang du 'khrungs pa'i gtsang ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gnyis byon la/ 'di gnyis kyang grogs mched las dpon slob tu gyur/ ka thog gis der mi ma yin gdug pa can zhig gis mngon sum du gnod pa cher byed pa cig yod pa la de gnas pa'i pha bong sku chos kyis bcings te gtsang ston gyis khrid dam pas phreng lcag gis ded de ka rong gi thag ring por bskyal bas pha bong la phyag phreng sogs kyi rjes gsal bar dod pa da lta yod/ yi ge ka 'dra ba'i sa thog du dgon pa btab pas ka thog tu grags/ dam pa bde gshegs de ni sngon kṛ gi'i bu mo bdun gyi dang po dang / gnas brtan bar dngha dza/ phal chen pa'i gnos brtan/ mu steṭa kyi mkhas pa phyis nang par gyur pa/ wa ra ṇa si'i chos rgyal/ lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog la sogs pa'i skye ba mang du dran/ khyad par du skye ba snga ma de bal po bha brta bya ba'i rnal 'byor pa cig mi nyag gi rgyal po'i bla cha/ra gyur te dad ches pas de'i dbu'i dbyibs byas nas phreng ba'i mdud 'dzin la brgyud par 4mi nyag gi yul thams cad du bkar btags/ phyis phyi'i rgya mtsho gzigs su byon te rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phru ma btab ste bzhugs pa na mtshan mo dus min gyi rgya ma tsho'i rlabs 'khrugs pa'i sgra 'brug stong 'ur ba lta bu byung ste gzhan rnams bros/ bla ma khri thog tu bzhugs pa rlabs kyis gshegs nas rdzu gdung slar mtsho 'gram du phul ba rgyal pos spyan drangs nas mchod pa byed pa dang / rgya 621

gar nub phyogs kyi ri brags chen por da lta sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi byang phyogs kyi tshal na gnas pa'i lha'i drang srong gzhon nus byin phyi mar bde ba can du 'byonapa 'di nyid de'i tshe drang srong ga ga ti bya bar yod pa'i drung du ne tsor skyes te rig 4sngags bslabs pas nus pa can du gyur/ de'i tshe ri'i shar ngos na dkar po'i klu cig dang / sto ngos na nag po'i klu stobs cazha zhig gnas pa las nag po'i klu des nam mkha' la thog ser dang sprin nag gis khyab par byas/ sa gzhi la sbal sbrul 'jong sdig sogs srog chags sna tshogs pas khyab pa'i dmag dkar po la drangs pa na/ klu dkar po des ne tso la skyabs su song bas ne tsos rig sngags bton gshog pa brdabs pas nag po'i klu bros sprin yal srog chags rnams kyang med par gyur te dkar po'i klu stobs rgyas pas rgyal khams thams cad tu 'bru bcud 'phel zhing bde bar byas pa dang / khyad par rgya gar du mu stegs zhi ba pa dar te bstan pa nub tu cha ba'i tshe slob dpon zhi ba'i lhar gyur nas sngon du zhi ba'i grub mtha' sbyangs nas phyis bsnyil/ spyod 'jug gsungs/ mu stegs mkhas pa cig dang yun ring du rtsod pa na nyin cig slob dpon ma bzhugs pa'i shul du slebs pa'i tshe slob dpon gyi khri'i nam mkhar 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhugs par mthong bas dad de rjes su bzung ba rnams gsal bar dran/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa rgyun du gzigs/ sngon rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe blon po cig gis mchod yon dbyen byas pa'i lce gcod tu bcug pas da lta ngag mi bde ba yin gsung zhing rgyu 'bras la rtsis su mdzad/ yon tan nam mkha' dang mnyam gzhan phan mtha' yas/ 'dul ba gtso bor ston pa'i sgo nas gsang sngags dar bar mdzad la/ phyi mar bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa' blo groca/ snying por 'gyur zhing ma 'ongs pa bskal pa skar ma bkram pa lta bu la tshe dpag med ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par 'tshang rgya bar dgongs 622

so/ /rin po che gtsang ston pa des kyang mi bskyod pa'i zhing rtag ba ra gzigs te byang chub se/mas dpa' nor bu'i snying po khyod ma 'ongs pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya'o zhes lung bstan thob/bka' srung bran ltar du 'khol/ zag med mngon du byas pa'i rtags rdzogs/de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi rgyal po'i zhing du byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyi rgyal por gyur pa dang / lo tsā ba ka ba ye shes mchog dang / rgya gar phyag na la sogs pa'i sngon gyi gnas mang du dran/ 'phrin las mtha' yas shing phyi mar bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i snying por 'gyur ba dang /bskal pa skar ma bkram pa lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dkyil tsam du dam pa bde gshegs 'tshang rgya zhing de nas bcu'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro bar 'tshang rgya bar gzigs/ 'gro mgon ras chen gyis kyang dag snang mtha' yas pa gzigs nas chos mang du gsan no/ /de'i slob ma spyan snga byams pa 'bum ni slob dpon dzāladdhā ra pa'i slob ma nag po spyod pa chen po yin te rje mi tra dzo gis so ma dzo gi zhes bya ba thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa zhig la khyod bod du 'gro na yul ka thog bya bar slob dpon shārta de wa dang badzra pā ṇi bod du skye ba bzung ba'i gdan sa na ka tna pa chen po yod kyis de la phyag gyis /ma po gnas nang dang 'jang yul du yang lan re song zhig zhes lung bstan te bod du 'ongs nas 'di'i zhabs la gtugs lung bstan pa bshad do/ /gzhan yang kurṇa ri pa'i slob ma ā narta shrīr gyur te rdo rje'i gdan du gnas brtan byas/ sa ra ha'i slob ma dā na kirtir gyur te paṇḍi ta thams cad kyi bla mar gyur/ rgya gar sto phyogal kyi chos rgyal dhi pā la rā dzār gyur te grub thob brgyad bcu phal cher mchod gnas su rtag par bzhugs pa la lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhir mchod cing so ma pu ri/ dza gta pā la ko ṭa la/ orgyan la sogs pa'i gtsug 623

lag khang chen po bdun bzhengs pa sogs kyi sngon gnas dran/ phyi mar bde ba can dang slar dpal ldan 'bras spungs su byang chub sems dpa' ka ma la shī lar 'gyur bar gzigs/ grub thob kurma pakṣis kyang 'di las rab tu byung zhing rdzogs pa chen po'i bka' thams cad gsan zhing spyir 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam mo/ /de nas kyang grub thob karma bka shi dang 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bla ma tsa ti spyan snga mang phu ba bsod nams 'bum la sogs mkhas shing grub pa sha stag byon te da ltar yang dar zhing rgyas la/ ka thog pa 'di rnams ni gzhi 'dul ba'i tshul khrims gtso bod mdzad pas dgon pa gtsang zhing dag spyod 'jug sogs spyod phyogs dar bas theg chen gyi lam gyi gzhung bsrongs/ sngags mtshan nyid mtha' dag dar zhing khyad par mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa dngos gzhi 'dir gnas pa yin no/ /spyir zur che chung las 'phros pa'i sngags pas bod khams gang zhing bshad nyan shin tu dar bas sngon bod du mdo sgyu sems gsum las dar ba'i chos ma byung snyam ste zin bris kho na'ang mtha' yas par snang la cung zad zhib pa deb sngon na snang ngo / gsang sngags snying ma bka' ma'i skabs bshad zin to/ /gter ma'i phyogs slar bshad par bya ste/ de yang bod kha cig gter ma'i chos mi srid do snyam du byed pa de ni chos spong gi las chen po yin te/ mdo las bsnyen gnas dang skyabs 'gro'i dpe ka ba las byung bar bshad pa dang / ston pa bram ze chen pos spyan drangs pa'i lam du phyags bdar gyi phung po las 'od zer dang sangs rgyas shākya thub pa byon pa legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra byung bas ston pas phyag mdzad spyan chab phyung na bza' phud nas gsol te sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ring bsrel 'dir bzhugs so zhes gsang ba ring bsrel gyi gzungs gsungs pa'ang de bzhin gshegs pa gzungs kyi dpe la bstos mi dgos pas ma 624

phyu rnga ba ma gtogs don gyis gter mar so/nga ba'i phyir dang / rgya gar du yang chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi don du dgra bcom pa grags pas sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel phyung ba dang / rgyud bla sogs byams chos phyi ma gsum mnga' bdakamirta pas mchod rten gyi ser ga nas rnyed pa sogs dang / grub thob shib pas chu mang po drubs pa'i dngul chur byin gyis brlabs pa bal po'i klu sgrub phug rapar 'phags pa klus sbas pa a tsa ra zhig gis bton zhing gser 'gyur byas pa byung nas ring po ma lon par paṇa chen nags rin gyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gter ni gsar rnying thams cad la yod pas rnying ma kho nar yang ma nges la/rnying ma'i gter la'ang nor gter dpag med yod pa ni phyi rabs rgyal rgyud kyi don dang lha khang rnams gso ba'i rkyen du sbas nas kha byang rnams rgyal po'i dkor mdzod du 'jog la/ rgyal srid nyams pas tshang ma med mod kyang bsam yas gtsang po'i mdzod na'ang mang bar yod pas khro phu lo tsā ba chen pos lha chen po'i yo byad ma ldang nas khong rang gi 'bul ba phyir bslog ste kha byang 'ga' zhig bslangs pa na/ gtsang po na re sems can gyi bsod nams dman pa 'bras rul ba dang byi bas zos pa sogs kyis chud zos pa mang bar snang / 'on kyang 'ga' zhig 'bul zer ba na paṇa chen gyis de khong la'ang gnod pas khyod rang 'di sgrubs gsungs nas dzam nag gi sgrub thabs gnang ba ltar yin la/ chos gter la'ang slob dpon padma'i gter dang / 'tsho rgyal dang chos rgyal khri srong dang mu tig gtsan po dang snubs nam mkha' snying po dang snyags dang bee ro tsa na dang sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang snubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs kyis sbas pa mang du yod pas thams cad slob dpon padmas sbas pa yang ma yin no/ /chos gter la'ang skal ldan gyis rnyed par smon lam btab pa tsam las bdag po ma nges pa ches mang zhing chos bdag nges pa can yang du ma yod do/ /de yang padma 625

bka' thang gi bter 'dir sbas bshad pa rnathu rad/ mi lha da med yen par snang la/gter sto/na lung bstan 'di bar skabasi su lhad sna cho gas bsres te sa paṇa la skur pa gdab par 'dod nas/ rgya gar che/ phyirtsa kun snyi/nga 'o tsā khyes/ /zhes sogs log pa bris pa dang / lha'i bu rab rtsal lung bstan pa'i mdo las zhes bar du yig nor byung ba tshun bris pas dpyad mi bzod cing gter ma la skur pa 'debs pa'i gzhi chen por gyur snang la/ /spyir gter rtags sogs la brtags na 'di la rtsa ba yang dag cig yod par 'dug pa de deng sang ma rnyed kyang gter rtags dang 'don pa po'i mtshan gter gnas rnams rags pa tsam 'di ka yin nges snang bas dgod par bya ste/ rgyal po'i gdung rabs brgyad dam bcu na la stod du nad mug gis mi thog bud pa byung tshe gter bton sangs rgyas bla mas glo bo ge sar gyi gter 'byin/ bal bod kyi mtshams su nags la me shor bas skye bo kha btag tshe rgya lo tsās pu na rdza ri'i 'byin/ bya khyi lha khang 'khrugs pa'i tshe khams klong thang sgron ma'i gter sna nam pas 'byin/ la stod gcung pa dril che chung 'khrug tshe rgya zhang khrom gyis g.yo ru rdza phug gi 'byin/ mang yul nam mkha' khrag mdog tu 'gro ba'i bsad shi byung tshe byams pa sprin gyi gter stod gter gyi bdag po nyi ma seng ges 'byin/ shong gsum 'jag skyar 'phyur tshe byang gi gter phran rnams g.yo ru ston shākra gis 'byin/ pa gro gnam thang dkar por sog po lhags tshe bum thang rtse lung gi gter bon po bag tshal gyis 'byin/'ug pa lung sogs su mdo sngags gnyis 'khrug pa'i tshe shel brag gi gter snye mo zhu yas kyis 'byin/ 'jims kyi mdar sde dgon za 'og 'dra ba byung tshe gtsang ri —bo che'i gter grub thob dngos grub kyis 'byin/ rgya nag gi rgyal sa rta rdzis phrogs tshe bal yul e'i gtsug lag khang gi gter gtsug lag dar la dges 'byin/ la stod du mtshon gyi so nam byed pa'i tshe lho gter phran rnams ku tsha ston 626

pas 'byin/ byang phyi gong ru brlag pa'i tshe ru mtshams gyi gter bon po lha 'bum gyis 'byin/ lta log gsar pa zhig shin tu dar ba'i tshe bum thang gi gter khyung po bu dpal gyis 'byin/ sde 'khrug mang po dang dmar po ri la lha khang byung tshe has po ri'i gter sha mi rdor rgyal gyis 'byin/ gter brdzus mang po byung tshe ldang ma lhun rgyal gyis bī ma la'i gter 'byin/ bying sogs kyi yul zhig tshe gra pa mngon shes kyis jo mo'i gling gsum gyi gter 'byin/ slob dpon nyid dwags po lha rjer byon pa'i tshe ra shag gter bton gyis mchims phu dang kho thing gi gter 'byin/ 'khrug pa dar zhing sku dang gsung rab mi stong du 'jal ba'i mgo tshugs tshe myang ral pa can gyis kho thing dang srin po sbar rjes kyi gter 'byin/ pu rangs rgyal pos bod la gser 'dod pa byung tshe dpon bsam khyung thog gis grom pa rgyal gyi gter 'byin/ hor bod kyi 'brel thog mar byung tshe ra mo shel sman gyis shel phug gi gter 'byin/ hor dmag dang po byung tshe chos kyi dbang phyug gis gnam skas can dang mkhar chu'i gter 'byin/ myang smad bya rog rdzong du hor dmag lhags tshe gu ru jo rtses zang yag brag gi gter 'byin/ gzho lung du me'i 'jigs pa byung zhing dpal mo dpal thang du g.yul ngo chen po byung tshe gangs bar phug mo'i gter padma dbang phyug gis 'byin/ sil ma la khar 'jag ma'i mi byung zhing smon mda'i la khar shel gyi pha bong byung tshe spa ma gong gi gter de ban rgya mtshos 'byin/ bod rnams hor gyis mnar zhing gnas brtan rnams hor chas byed pa'i tshe rngo bod mtshams kyi gter rag shi ston pas 'byin/yul mang du stongs pa'i tshe lho mon gyi gter sman pa nyam dpal gyis 'byin/ nang rme dang dug dar ba'i tshe bu tshal gyi gter grwa sgom chos kyi rdo rjes 'byin/ dug bzo thabs sogs dar ba'i tshe 'u yug dang g.yag sde'i gter g.yag char sngon mos 'byin/ khyim pa kun chos skad byed tshe pa gro'i gter grub thob mkhar nag 627

gis 'byin/ mi thub lnga byung zhing nad sngo na ma grags pa mdwa po 'byung tshe 'oca/ ljang rdo'i gter lha btsun sngon mos 'byin/ dge rgyas kyi ri mo brjes pa'i tshe srin mo rdzong gsum gyi gter khams pa nyi ma grags kyis 'byin/ sa nang 'jigs brgyad sha ba'i rwa lta bu byung zhing mi rgod dbus su dib tshe ldang lha brag gi gter rin chen tshul rdor gyis 'byin/ rdo'i mchod rten gdugs dang chos 'khor nyams tshe mon kha chu phug gi gter tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis 'byin/ dbus mdun byas te hor khrims 'jig tshe ko ro brag gi gter rin chen gling pas 'byin/ phag gis sa rlog tshe shel brag gi gter o rgyan gling pas 'byin/ mtha' dmag dbus su dib 'bri phag 'thab dbus gtsang sil bu dang phag khyu tshal par song tshe rdo rje khro 'od kyis stag tshang zab lung gi gter 'byin/ sa hor zhig mchod rten nas thod pa khyis g.yeng tshe dri sdeng 'od zer gyis mchims phu'i gter 'byin/ bdud kyi gang zag sa steng g.yo nus pa tsam zhig byung tshe rdo rje gling pas yun bu bla sgang gi gter 'byin/ chos log gis yul gang tshe sha 'ug stag sgo'i gter gter bdag gling pas 'byin/ kha rag gi lar so pas rtag tu srung tshe kun spyod gling pas mchod rten dkar po'i gter 'byin/ myang smad nyi ma mdor rdzong byung zhing dmag dpon brgya dang bcu drug tshogs tshe g.yas ru gtsang 'phrang gi gter mdo sngags glirnga pas 'byin/ ya 'brog mtsho gling dgu la dmag sgar byung zhing stag 'thab tu gtsang pa sum gnyis 'chi tshe stan gnyis gling pa rtsis kyi lha khang gi gter 'byin/ stod lungs su phag tshang byung zhing bod sil bu khyus 'tsho ba'i tshe rdo rje gling pas gnam lcags brag dang bu chu'i gter 'byin/ ru lag du phag khyu byung ba na kong po mchims yul gyi gter rin chen gling pas 'byin/ 'gos phag rir gnas gzhi rdzong la bkab pa dang la stod du dug gi tshong 'dus byung tshe padma gling pas me 'bar mtsho'i gter 'byin/ paṇḍita du ma bod du lhags nas jo bo 628

la mchod pa byed tshe las 'phro gling pas sto kong byang kong gi gter 'byin/ bod rgyal po brgya rtsa brgyad tu gyes tshe byal gyi brag gi gter bsam gtan gling pas 'byin/ sdubs sreg pa lung du mu ge byung tshe khyung tshang brag gi gter zhig po gling pas 'byin/ rta rgod thang la dbus dmag 'tshog cing has po ri'i rgyud du me 'bar rdzong byung tshe kha rag gi gter bde chen gling pas 'byin/ rnal 'byor pa nus ldan rdo rje zhes bya bas khams kyi gter 'byin pa thang yig gcig kho na snang / gzhan 'di rnams phal cher mthun par 'dug la/ mtha' dmag dbus dib 'bri dang phag pa 'thab/ dbus gtsang sil bu phag khyu tshal par 'gro /stag tshang zam lung sbas pa'i gter kha 'di/ /mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas 'byung / /zhes pa 'di phal cher na mi snang yang rnying pa gcig gnyis na snang pa 'di ni da lta'i dus yin pa snyam mo/ /'di la pu rangs rgyal pos bod la gser 'dod 'byung ba ni lha bla mas bod btsun la sham thabs khrul bsdus nas jo bo rje la gser mang du phul ba dang / bya rog rdzong du hor dmag lhags pa ni dpon chen kun bzang bsud pa'i dus dang / gzho lu4 du me'i 'jigs pa 'byung ba ni 'bri khung gling log dang / sa nang 'jigs brgyad sha ba'i rwa co ni sa skya pa'i zhal ngo nang zhig dang / phag gi sa rlog pa ni ta si byang rgyal gyis khri skor rnams bshig pa dang / mchod rten nas thod pa khyis g.yeng ba has po ri'i rgyab tu mkhan po'i sku gdung bye ma labazhugs nas steng na mchod rten yod pa las dbu thod thon pa byis pa mang pos rnyed de mkhan po'i dbu thod byung ngo zer nas rtsed mo'i rol cha byas gos kyi 'do li la spyan drangs pa thang po che pa'i tshong btsun zhig dang phrad pas mdzo khal bcas byin nas blus te khyer/ bsam yas pa rnams kyis phyi bsnyegs byas te dbu thod blangs dbu ma la byin pa 'di yin par snang / 'on kyang me yar rdzong byung nas yun re zhig 629

lon pa sogs kyis 'di la la go rim dang la la dkrugs pa cig yin par snang la/ pa gror sog po lhags pa sogs mang zhig da 'byung 'gyur du snang zhing /rgya gar gyi paṇḍita du ma zhig lha sar mchod pa byed pa ni lha sa'i sprul pa sdud par shes nas 'byon par 'dug pas phal cher gyi mtha' mar 'byung la/ gter bton 'di rnams kyang grags pa tsam kho na 'byung bar ma nges te shas cher sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa skal ldan 'ga' zung gi don mdzad pa mang ba snyam mo/ /de las gtso bor grags che ba mnga' bdag myang ni lho gtam shul btsan gro'i 'jong po gser gyi dgon par myang ting 'dzin bzang po'i rigs myang ston chos 'khor dang yum padma bde rtsal gyi sras su shing 'brug la 'khrungs/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi sgrol ma slob dpon padma rnams kyis chos la bskul/ lo bcu gsum pa la thugs rje chen po dang phur pa grub ste 'jong phu'i brag la phyag zhabs kyi rjes dang zangs kyi phur pas rta skad 'tsher pa byung / rang gi yab dang slob dpon 'dul 'dzin rgyal sras kham bu ya le gu ru khro bo chen po grub thob dngos grub rnams las gsar rnying gi chos mtha' yas gsan/ mkha' 'gros brag rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dra ba'i gnas su song zhig par lung bstan te smra bor byon/ nyi shar gyi dus bu stos shig bya ba'i sgra byung nas phyir bltas pas rnal 'byor pa rus rgyan can zhig 'dug pa bos te tsha ba drangs pas de na re/ /nga ni nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dbang phyug rdo rje bya ba yin/ /bu khyod las dang skal bar ldan/ /padmas dbang dang lung gis skyob/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i chos rnams kun/ /da lta mkha' 'gro'i lag na yod/ /gsol ba thob la myur du long / /zhes kha byang yang byang gnad yig gsum gtad de 'ja' ltar yal/ ra shag gter bton dang gra pa mngon shes kyis kyang kha byang btang ste srin po sbar rjes nas thugs rje chen po dang ma mgon skor dam rdzas gdan drangs/ ye shes mtsho rgyal 630

gyi spru'/ nga/sa stag sgrom chos gter gyis gang ba dngos su gtad pa nas mkha' 'gro'i sprub skor sogs byon/ kho thing gi gnang yig ma byung ba lha'i phyag mdzub chad pa tshong pas khyer te phul ba nas shog dril byung ste sgrom myi ga sgrom skya gnyis nas bde 'dus dang rta mgrin bka' srung dang rta mgrin gyi sku sogal byin rlabs kyi rten dpag med byon/ gzhan yang mchims phu sham po gangs lha sa sogs bcu gsum nab/ gter mang du byung ste gter byung tshangs pa'i dra par gsal/ bde 'dus kyi sman bsgrubs tshe sman gyi lha mos dngos su a ru ra rlon pa phul/ mtsho rgyal gyis dngos grub ci 'dod gsung ba la chos zhus pas mkha' 'gro lung bstan gyi skor dang zhus lan brgya rtsa'i dpe dngos su gtad/ dur khrod gsil ba'i tshal du khrid de slob dpon padmas bu tshangs pa lha'i me tog sleb bam zhes gsung zhing keng rus kyi khri la bzhag ste grub chen dgus bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag gi dbang thams cad rdzos/sa par gnang / yi dam dbang du 'dus chos skyong bran du 'khol/ 'phrin las tshad med pa rgyas/ bka' brgyad dang thugs rje chen po srong btsan lugs dang pad skor lugs dang gsang skor dang byin rlabs dbang rnams kyi bka' rim par babs pa gnyos grags rgyal zhig po bdud rtsi sras mi skyodo rdo rje sman 'on pa se ston khri mchog ste bka' babs kyi bu lnga dang /sras chung ba spyan ras gzigs zhi khro'i sprul pa mnga' bdag 'gro mgon nam mkha' dpal ni smin grol yongs rdzogs kyi bka' babs cing thugs gter chen po gtad de dgung lo re dgu pa shing byi la sras chung gdan sar bskos te zhal gdams dang rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan te chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshe thugs ka nas hrīX yig dkar po zhig bde ba can du gshegs par bstan la/ slar sku'i sprul pa rgya gar shar phyogs su rnal 'byor pa bkod pa sna tshob/sa su ston pa dang / gsung gi sprul pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dang / thugs kyi sprul pa mtsho 631

ma dros pa dang nye bar ḍā ki buddhā dzñā na'i sras yul nye bzhir rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa ste gsum cig char du 'byung bar bstan/ lo tsā ba chag gis gdung bzhu bas me sbar bar ma nus/ slar rang byung du 'bar te me las 'ja' tshon byung ba nub phyogs su zug 'ja' dkar po zhig lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs ka dang gdung khang 'brel bar zug pa mthong / gdung khang na khye'u lo brgyad pa rgyan can ha ri ni sa sgrog pa mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor ba zhig kun gyis mthong / thugs ljags dbu skra rnams ma nyams par byon zhing rten ring bsrel mang du byung / de nas mnga' bdag 'gro mgon gyis sku rten rigs gsum mgon po mi tshad bal yul du bzhengs te spyan drangs/ gsung rten mdo mang dang gsar rnying gi rgyud 'bum bzhengs/ thugs rten du gdung 'bum mthong grol chen mo bzhengs te paṇa chen shāshrī rab gnas la spyan drangs nas chos 'khor btsugs/nyid kyis gtsug phud phul/ 'on kyang 'phrin las 'di ka che gsungs nas rab tu 'byung bar ma gnang / yon tan gyi rten bal ris kyi thang ka thog tshad ma brgya dang brgyad bzhengs/ 'phrin las kyi rten rdo rnams sham po gangs nas nam mkha' la lug khyu ltar ded skad de gang nas drangs cha med par lha sar rdo skya chag gis chags pa la chu rags mdzad/ paṇa4chen gyis spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lung bstan/ gu ru chos dbang sogs slob ma mang po'i don mdzad/ de'i sras mnga' bdag blo ldan ni 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa dang de'i sras mnga' bdag bdud 'dul ni phyag rdor gyi sprul pa ste gdung rgyud la rigs gsum mgon po 'byung bar lung bstan pa de yin la/ mnga' bdag myang nyid ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku'i skye ba dngos yin no/ /gter kha 'og ma par grags pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug ni gdung rus pang / sngon snyags bon ༄gnya' rings bya bas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la thol phab ste dgrong bar khas blangs pa na/63 paṃ

slob dpon padma dang bīm la dang bee ro'i slob ma pad rje btsan khrom bya ba'i sngaṭa pa nus pa can zhig la dris pas pho brang yang thog du nga'i gdan shoms shig zer te khri bshams/ sang nyin phyed na thog smad lnga dus gcig la phab byung ba sdigs — mdzub kyis blangs te bon grong la 'phangs pas grong bsregs te brlag rgyal pos khyad nor mang po dang yul gyi 'ud bdun phul te mchod gnas su bkur/ de'i sras che ba pang rig 'dzin snying po ni yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi'i mchod gnyer mdzad nas lo skor re na mchod pa la 'byon pa las kho thing du mchod pa la byon tshe la yag rdza bar gyi dpon chen sprad pas byal lha khang gi sa 'dul dang phyis rab gnas zhus te nor gzhis mang du phul bas tshe snga ma'i yul yin gsungs nas bzhes te de'i sras che ba kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal po nas mkhyen ldan nus can bar ma chad du byung ba'i mkhas ston nyi rgya ba mkhan po bal ston pa'i slob ma de'i jo mo sa ma grongs nas slar len par 'gro ba'i tshe rmi lam du sring mo zhig na re/ mkha' 'gro gar gyi dbang mo la jo mor gyis shig zer/ de su yin byas pas/ 'khrul pa nub phyogs ri 'dab na/ /'gro 'dul 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /bud med dkar mo snying ga na/ /yi ge he yis rab tu mtshan/ /de nyid bsten gyur nyi ma 'char/ /bdag ni tā re tu tpā re/ /lung la the tshom khyod ma za/ /zer nas sangs rgyas 'od srung dang byams pa chos bgro ba'i mdun du shad kyis song ba rmis nas 'phur chen 'phur chung sogs 'phur nus pa'i grub thob kyi brgyud pa dkar ston chos 'od kyi lcam mo dkar za mgon skyid yin par shes nas blangs pa las/ yum la nyi zla kha sbyar du spyi bor thim/ lha'i bdud rtsi blud/ rab byung sku mdog dkar ba zhig gis mda' dar gtad de/ 'jig rten dpal mgon skyed byed ma/ /nyi zla'i dbang po khyod la yod/ /bod ni mun pa'i smag rum 'dra/ /ye shes sgron gsal da theg cig /zhes pa rmis /yum gyi 633

khong nad zhi lhums nas a yig gi sgra yang yang gsungs/ spre'u'i lo dpyid ra'i bco lnga'i nyi shar la bltams/ mtshan brjod gser ma zhig 'bri zhing yod pa'i tshig mtshams kyi rten 'brel brtags pas/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal bya ba dang thug pas mtshan der btags/ yum gyis nga lo dgu lon dus bla ma se gro chen pos khyod la bu zhig skye pa de la ming 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las dras pa cig thogs gsung ba yod zer nas 'jam dpal rdo rjer btags/ mig mthong ba rnon po cig gis lha 'dre thams cad kyis mchod cing 'dug zer nas 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gsol/ sngon yab kyis bla ma sangs rgyas snyi sgom la bdag gtsang sgom bgyi bar zhu byas pas/ khyod khyim gyis shig byang chub sems dpa'i gdung mi chad pa yin/ dge slong gi sde brgya las byang chub sems dpa' gcig 'gro rdon che gsungs/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po la phur pa rtsa rgyud nyan tshe khyod kyi bu chung mtha' cig la chos slobs shig des 'phrin las 'byung ngo zhes dang / mal ka ba can pas dge bshes lho pa kho de mda' lnga gzhu gcig tshags gyis dang de las dgra snying la phog pa'i mda' gcig 'ong zhes dang / zhang rin po ches dge bshes lho chung pa khyod kyi bu ngas bya'am mad kyang ku re yin khyod la nga 'dra ba'i bu zhig 'ong zhes dang / gra pa ma ngon shes kyis zab mo thugs kyi gter gcig ma 'di sto brag 'jam dpal bya bas thon par bshad ces sogs dam pa mang pos lung bstan/ lo bzhi nas yab la bris klog smra sgo mtshon cha/yi ge'i mdo rig bklag sde lnga bi warta chen mo sogs sgra yig gi bstan bcos bcu gsum tsam dang / skye bo gso thigs sogs lugs kyi bstan bcos bcu/rgyal rabs sde bdun/ lde rgyud chen po'i sgrung 'bum sogs glu gar gyi bsta na bcos brgya dang bzhi/ bon gyi gzhung chen bdun bcu don lnga/ nam/ ma ba/ 'a pra khrid kyi rgyud che chung sogs mdos gzhung bcu la mdos chen brgya phra ga brgal ba/634

tra ta ka la'i thig rtsa sogs sngags phyi nang gi thig rtsa kun/ phur pa'i skor po ti mda' tshang ma bzhi la sog/ sa pa mang po dgung 'o/ dgu yan la dpyis phyin par gsan zhing mkhyen/ bcu la gsar ma'i phyag rdor lugs drug gsan te bsgrubs pas dgun bum chu 'khol/ gshin rje'i gshed dang phur pa'i bsnyen pa tshad du phyin/ bcu gcig la sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad dang / bcu gnyis la ka ka ni gra lnga sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa mkhyen zhing yig brgya'i sgrub pa mdzad/ bcu gsum la yaje dag ma gshin thugs rje chen po lugs gnyis dang rta mgrin sogs gsar rnying du ma gsan zhing bsgrubs/ de thams cad yab mkhas pa ston nyi kho na las gsan la/ bcu gsum pa'i dus nyams snang la jo mo sgrol mas khrid de shel mkhar dgu thog gi rtser bskyal bas rdo rje sems dpa' dang mjal/ de na ṭāka gdong bzhi pa cig 'dug pa'i mdun zhal dkar po nas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis zungs/ /g.yas ser po nas/ dam chos dar bar khyod kyis gyis/ /rgyab dmar po nas/ dge 'dun dbu 'phang khyod kyis stod/ /g.yon sngon po nas/ dus ngan gdul dka' khyod kyis thul/ /zer nas mda' dkar po sgro lnga pa cig gtad nas rgyal ba'i lung thams cad chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsdus/ bod la nyi ma shar gsungs nas 'od dmar por gyur nas snying gar thim/ yab la smras pas de 'dra la dga' brod ma byed bdud yin pa'ang srid de min na bus 'gro don 'ong ba 'dra gsung skad/ bcu bzhi nas brtsams te se gro gyang sar ba la tshad ma rigs thigs mngon pa kun las btus spyod 'jug dgyes rdor la sogs pa'i gzhung chen dang / phyags rdzogs zhi byed chos drug la sogs pa'i man ngag dang / slob dpon mtha' skor ba la dbu ma bden chung sogs dang / mtshur ston yab sras la a ti'i skor sogs mdo sngaṭa gsar rnying gi bshad sgrub kyi bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ slar yab las zhi 635

byed phyag rdzogs gcod yul mtha' dag gsan nas nyams su blangs shing / nag rtsis snga phyi bar gsum gyi skor mtha' dag dang yan lag brgyad pa sogs sman dpyad bka' gter lugs mi 'dra ba bcu gcig sogs sbyangs te mkhas par mkhyen/ bcu bdun pa la mnga' bdag 'gro mgon mjal phyis myang gi gter chos thams cad gtad de chos bdag du bskos/ bco brgyad pa la sa skya paṇḍi ta la gnas gzhi sgang por sems skyed dang gyang sar du chos 'brel lha lung gi mchod rten rtsar rab gnas thob/ de nub rgya nag ri bo rtse lngad me tos/ u du sla ra 'tshol du phyin pas utpal sngon po gdugs gan kyal tsam zhig gi steng na 'jam dpal bzhugs pa'i zhal nas/ dzñā na kā ya ttarma dhā tu/ chos kyi dbang phyug nga yin no/ /de ni khyod kyi sems rtog go sems rtog ni chos kyi sgo mo bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /chos sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don ni rang byung ye shes thig le nyag gcig go chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don khyod la bshad zin gyis de'i don la dpyod cig ces thos pa na gnyid sad de chos thams cad thob snyam pa byung / bcu dgu pa la yab kyis gdams ngag ngo sprod kyi gnad dang bstan srung gi drag sngags thams cad gnang / mdor na theg pa rim dgu la sbyangs tshul nyid kyi gsung las dang po bden bzhi'i sgor zhugs gang zag gi bdag med rtogs/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu la smon rgyal mkhan ltar rang don bag tsam byas/ de nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgor zhugs chos kyi bdag med kyi phyogs gcig rtogs/ yid zhi bde la smon bse ru lta bur yang bag tsam bsdad/ de nas phar phyin bcu'i sgor zhugs bdag med gnyis ga'i don rtogs/kun tu 'od kyi sa la yid smon mnyan pa ltar rang gzhan gnyis ga'i don yang bag tsam byas/ de nas bya ba drug gi sgor zhugs skye 'gag med pa'i don rtogs/rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la yid smon bram ze lta bur gtsang sbra yang bag tsam byas/636

de nas phyi nang gnyis ga'i sgor zhugs skye 'gag gnyis lhar rtogs/ rigs bzhi'i rdo rje 'chang la yid smon rje rigs ltar phyi nang gnyis ga'i spyod pa bag tsam spyad/ de nas yo ga'i sgor zhugs rgyal mchog rnam pa gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su smon rgyal po ltar tshogs dpon yang bag tsam bgyis/ de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyi sgor zhugs snang srid lha'i dkyil 'khor du rtogs/ padma can gyi sa la yid smon mngal skyechu/ ltar rim gyis sa lam sbyangs/ de nas skad cig lhar gsal gyi sgor zhugs yab yupoganyis med rang byung du rtogs/ 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la yid smon brdzus skyes tshul gyis rig pa'i rtsal sbyangs/ de nas bya bral rtogs pa'i sgor zhugs 'khor 'das gnyis med rang sems su rtogs/ kun bzang dbyer med kyi sa la smon/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor ngo mtshar che/ /rang byung nyi ma'i snying po bzhin/ /pang ban gyi nyams drod bde bar gda'/ /zhes gsungs te theg pa'i spyi chings shin tu che bar snang / 'di la u pa'i zhugs tshul gyi smad dang yo ga'i zhugs tshul gyi stod nas chad snang bas phyi mo ma rnyed kyang don la bsams nas chad pa bsos pa yin/khams klong thang sgron ma'i gter ma shog sngon dngul yig can las/ dus kyi mtha' ma la bab pas bod kyi bsod nams byang nas lhor 'grib pa'i tshe bsam yas kyi lho g.yo ru'i nang du thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa 'jam dpal gyi gsung sprul phyag na rdo rje'i dngos grub brnyes pa cig gis thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar rgyas su byed par 'gyur gyi de ni dbugs 'byin chen po zhes bya'o zhes soṭa gzhan las lung bstan pa ches mang bar snang / khyad par du gra pa mngon shes kyis bsam yas nas thon pa gter kha thams cad kyi nang na zab pa thugs kyi gter gcig ma'i kha byang sprad pa lha bzo 'jam dpal bya bas zhus te 'don par brtsams pas shi/ phyis sngags pa mang pos 'don par brtsams pas kyang 637

thog ser byung ste byer/ kha byang de brgyud nas dgung lo bcu gsum pa la phyag tu byung ba yab la gzigs phul bas thams cad brlag pa'i brlag shog ser po des ci byed khyod 'chi ba nyo'am zhes phrogs nas sbas/ phyis brkus nas rtogs ldan gcod yul ba zhig gis grogs byas nas chu sbrul nag po'i lo dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la gnam skas can nas gzhan kha byang dang lde mig thon nas slar rmi lam brtags pa na ke tshang sgo lcags can zhig la mi nag po cig gis reg ste khyod rang gi nor long zer/ mkha' 'gros kyang mar byas te gtad rgya bkrol/ sgo phye bas bya khyung zhig byung ba'i kha nas me 'bar bas sku lus bsregs te sems thugs rje chen por lam byung ba de bya de la bzhon pas 'ja' sprin rim pa bcu gsum gyi rtser rdo rje sems dpa' shel gyi khye chung gi rnam par snang ba thugs ka dang spyan 'bras dang bar snang la a dkar po re yod pa cig gis spyi bor bum pa bzhag zhal du bdud rtsi blug pas rdor sems thugs ga'i a la thim/ a gsum gcig la gcig thim ste rang gi thugs gar thim pas 'dzin med kyi dgongs pa shar/bum pa de phyag na gda' nas khyer phyin pas khri chen po'i steng du slebs te bu yin zer ba bcu drug dang bu mo yin zer ba brgyad la byin/ skya ser dpag med la bkye ba rmis/ de nas brag rked kyi gter gnas dngos nas khro chu'i klu bdud kyi gzugs dang zangs kyi sgrom bu nas bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyis gtsos pa'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa byung / spyir gu ru nyid kyis/ gnam skas can dang brag phreng rta mgrin zhabs/ /mon mkhar steng dang rta mgrin dben rtsa'i sgo/ /kho yi gshed dmar rta mgrin sgrom chos dang / /sras mkhar skya bo phug ring phyag theb ma/ /bsam yas ārya lcags phur mon bum thang / /rtsis kyi lha khang rong brag ha bo gangs/ /rang gab don gyi gter dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes mdor bstan pa'i gter kha chen po bco brgyad phye ste gter byung chen mo ngo mtshar smad 638

du byung ba yod do/ /gter 'di rnams kyang gter bdag bkug nas dam la btagarnga te 'don mkhan gzhan btang ba kho na shas che la rang gis 'don pa na yang skal ldan gyi gter dpang yid ches kyi mi dpang du bzhag nas bton pa kho na yin pas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags so/ /de nas gter thon pa shin tu gsangs kyang thams cad du grags nas yab kyis khyod kyis gter thon zer ba thon pa rang ci thon khyer shog gsungs/ zangs sgrom phyag tu phul bas mang po yod par 'dug dkar chag klogs gsungs nas bklags pas/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rtsa rgyud gcig shes kun grol yin nam de klogs dang gsungs/ bklags pas da go go des chog khyod la sngar gros ma thungs pa btab zin/ phyis gyod bsnan kyang gtam ro las mi yong bas khyod la mi 'bar ro/ da gter des 'phung 'tshengs gang yin kyang zin no/ /dus gsum rtsod med o rgyan gyi bka' yin mod zab kyang nga khyod kyi chos la mi re/ da rang gi 'dun ma lo bzhi bcu'i bar du ru bzhi'i bla ma mkhas grub thams cad kyi dgongs pa bsdus spros pa chod 'khor 'das kyi gzhi rtsa sems nyid gcig pu 'di'i la zlos zin/ da yang khyed nga'i kha la phal cher mi nyan/ nyan par song na bla rdzogs thugs gsum 'di'i chos mgo ci thon gyis/ de min pa'i mthu sad sud sman dpyad rag reg mo rtsis shab shib rdzu 'phrul bzo sna skyag skyog yang na min pa'i rgyogs dang dpag chen sogs de 'dra thams cad chos mgo ma thon bar du khar zur tsam yang ma 'don/ shes shes mang la mthar thon med na mthar sprang por 'gro ba yin no/ /spyir gter chos la nga gnag pa ga la yin/ sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud kun tu gter lung gsungs/ rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes yin/ sngar yang gter mang po brdol te gter 'don mkhan blo chung res chos la dag ma thon par zas nor la mig nye byas pas 'gro don de tsam ma byung ba shas che ba 'di lta ste/ rgya zhang 639

khrom gyis snubs kyi gter mang du thon yang sngun la ngan sngags spel bas 'gro don rgya btul/ ku tsha sman pas slob dpon padma'i shog ser sgrom chung gang thon yang sman dpyad byas pas 'gro don rgya chung / ya 'brog gnyan gyi ra shag gter bton gyis kho thing nas sgrub thabs stag sgrom gang thon yang sngon la mdos chog byas pas phyis mdos mkhan du song / bon po brag tshal gyis bum thang nas chos bse sgrom gang thon yang sngon la dpe dkar bsgrubs pas mthu mkhan las ma byung / de 'dra la zad pa med/ rig 'dzin gong ma tshos gzhan don du dmigs kyang chos mgo ma thon par gzhan don du ma song ba'i gter bton tsho go ma chod rang yin no bsams gzhigs la chos mgo thon cig chos byung na zas nor zhor la yong chos skyong rnams ma bsgrubs kyang 'khor nas mthu zhar la yong chos skyong kho rang chos byed skyong bar dam bcas pa yin pas kho rang dam nyams doṭa nas skyong ba yin/ blo rtsab rtsub ma mang bar bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi sgrub pa la dril zhig da lta mnga' bdag myang sras mis 'khur ba 'di khos thugs rje chen po bskyangs pas byung ba yin gter bton gya ma brdugs tsam kho yi na rirno/ /ngas lo drug gi gong nas 'gro byas pa'i dus tshod de da zla ba gnyis kyis them pas de tsam na 'gro'o de la mi tshos gter sdur yin zer ba 'ong ste rtog pa bya mi dgos/ nga yan chad mi rabs bcu bdun song ste nang gi grub rtags ma byung ba med/ ngas kyang zhan shos min tsam yong gsungs te lo rgyus 'di dag kyang gang zag 'ga' res gter thon pa dang spyod pa kun la phan par gda' nas bkod pa'o zhes gu ru nyid kyis gter byung du bkod do/ /mnga' bdag 'gro mgon gyis gter gyi nyam nga che gsungs nas gzigs pas mnyes te ched du brjod pa mdzad/ mkha' ri lung bstan las hor dmag 'byung ba sogs thos pas slob dpon mtha' skor ba sogs mang pos hor da lta yul na med pa la bod thams 640

cad 'ded pa ga la 'ong zer nas skur pa btab pas thugs chad nas gdams pa rnam sa slar sbed par dgongs pa na bu mo gnyis kyis rta dkar po bya'i gshog pa can la bskyon nas rnga yab gling du slob dpon padma'i drung du btol te yodas rdzogs kyi dbang bskur nas/ kye ho/ lam gyi lam mchog gzhan don yin/ /'di la sgyid lug su skyes pa/ /de yi byang chub rgyang thag ring / /sngon yang 'phags pa'i dbu bcu gcig /rnam smin des gyur phyis 'gyod bshags/ /thugs bskyed mdzad nas zhal bsgyur bzhin/ /bu khyod sems skyed ma gtong zhig /da ste lo bdun 'das pa na/ /nub byang mtshams nas 'gro don 'byung / /'di nas lo ni lnga brgya na/ /lha sa'i jo bo bod mi 'dzin/ /lo ni sum brgya'i nang khongs su/ /bsam yas rta mgrin o rgyan 'byon/ /zhes sogs lung bstan/ 'dir ma zhen zhig zhen na 'phos nyen yod do gsungs nas 'od phub lta bus bteg ste skad cig la slebs gter dang po 'di bton nas lo bdun pa'i shing byi la hor dmag dang po dor tog gi dmag 'phan yul du lhags pa yin/ mon mkhar steng nas o rgyan gyi sku bton nas phyis zhal bstan pas ring bsrel gyi char pa bab pas nya mig gtor bar 'dug zer nas skur pa byung yang phyis lus las rdul 'bab pa ltar phram phrom du bab pas rtsod med du yid 'ches/ gter gnas rang sems la chos nyid rang chas su gnas pa ni gter gyi mthar thug ste mdo rgyud rnams kha byang man ngag kyang byang bla mas ngo sprad pa lda mig ste rang ngo ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa gter thon pa/ rang gzhan mnyam nyid du grol ba gter gyi 'gro don du gsungs/ dngos nyams rmi lam du bla ma yi dam chos skyong gzigs pa bgrang las 'das/ khyad par du skye ba gtan gyi bla ma rig 'dzin padmas rtag par mngon sum du zhal bstan zhing / bsam yas bzheng mkhan 'o skol rang yin mod/ /ces chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang de'i phyi ma 641

sum bcu rtsa gsum du lha'i bu 'od mtha' yas dang / de'i phyi ma rgyal po khri ral pa can rnams yin par lung bstan/ dngul dkar gyi me long bstan nas byin gyis brlabs pas de phyin gyi skye ba bcu gsum dran te/ shar phyogs bhaX ga lar rgyal po chos ldan du gyur pa na phyi blon zhig smyo nas bu smad gsum bsad pas khrims la sbyar te mer bsregs pas kho rtsal che bas nags la bros te nags mer mched pas skyo nas rab tu byung zhing gnas brtan chen por gyur/ phyis zhang po bram ze bzang skyong gis sngags kyi sgor bcug ste thugs rje chen po grub nas yul khams dge ba la bkod/1 de nas zangs gling du rgyal por gyur skyu ma mkhan gyis bstan pa las thams cad sgyu mar rtoṭa te yul pa de grol bar byas/3de nas lho phyogs su rgyal bur skyes tshe nu bo sprug pa'i gros thos pas ma dga' ste chu bor mchongs pas ma shi ste sos nas paṇḍita 'khor stong dang ldan par gyur tshe rngon pa rag sha rgod kyis phag rgod mo zhig gson por bshas pas phag phrug bcu byung ste phag ro'i nu ma la 'jib pa mthong bas snying rje skyes te brgyal/sangs tsa na rngon pa de phyag na rdo rje dang phag phrug khro bo bcu phag mo'i khong pa srin po ru dra'i khog pa'i gzhal yas su snang ste/ snying rje med na rigs chad yin/ /sogs nas/ phag pa ma bsgral nyan thos bsgral/ /gsungs nas shar phyogs su gshegs pa'i phyi bzhin phyin pas 'jam dpal gshin rje dang de'i slob ma sbas pa'i mi lnga dang mjal te rgyud grol nas rgyal khams de btul/ri de nas bal yul du rgyal bu dharma rā dzār skyes mkhas par gyur te mu stegs 'gro bzang dang rtsod pas slob dpon rgyal/ mu stegs kyis zhag bdun gyi mthu khas blangs/rgyal pos kyang dmag byed par bzas pa na mtshan mo bud med dmar nag gnyis kyis khyer te mu stegs de'i drung du slebs pa na khyod rgyal po yin pas mi gsod kyi nga'i bu mo 'di mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin pas bsten/ nga la gnod pa byed ri 642

bro bor zer nas de ltar nyan/ bu mo gud cig tu bzhag pa na gar 'gro zer/nga tshad ma'i 'phro nyan du 'gro byas pas/ chos rgyal khyod ci col re chung / /tshad las 'das don ma rtogs na/ /tshad ma nyan pas 'tshang mi rgya/ /lhan skyes shes rab nga bzhag nas/ /rang byung ye shes ga nas 'tshol/ /zer bas rnal 'byor mar shes te gsol ba btab pas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dngos su bzhengs te rgyud man ngag bstan nas bsgrubs pas 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa grol lo/4de nas li yul gyi rgyal por gyur te rgyal srid chos su bsgyur/5 de nas mdo smad tsong khar e snang 'od du gyur te lo chen rin chen bzang po dang sngags kyi bla ma drug bsten mdo khams btul/༄ de nas pu rangs su 'khrungs te mdo sngags la sbyangs/ zur chen gyi slob mar gyur/ pha dam pas gnad kyi ngo sprad/ 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad do/4 de nas li yul gyi rgyal phran du skyes nas bu smad dang srid rgyas pa'i tshe du ru gari rgyal po'i dmag byung bu smad thams cad bsad yul thams cad brlag pas ral skor byas te rgyal po de gsod du phyin pas de na re/ phas 'khor mas 'khor bu tshas 'khor/ /dgras 'khor gnyen 'khor rang gis 'khor/ /pha sod ma sod bu tsha sod/ /dgra sod gnyen sod khyod rang sod/ /thams cad bsad na rang grol bde/ /zer ste gang yang mi snang bar gyur/ yul dang bu smad kyang ma nyams par 'dug ste tshigs bcad kyi don go nas ri bo'i rtser bsgoms pas grub pa thob ste yul de btul to/8 de nas rgya nag rtsis kyi rgyal po'i sras sho dha ra gar gyur te rgyal srid bskyangs/ 'jam dpal gyis lung bstan te bī ma la dang mjal bas smin zhing grol te yul khams de btul to/khya de nas rgya gar shar lhor drang srong nyi 'od kyi bur gyur/ na ro pa dang nag po pa las man ngag thob ste grogs bu mo bco lnga khrid nas spyod pa la phyin pas spyod pa sngar zhugs kyi rnal 'byor pa tsod ru khyed ba zhig dang dug 643

mtsho'i 'gram du phrad pas khyed tsho spyod pa pa yin nam zer/ bud med rnamangog kyis yin no zer bas 'o na dug chu 'thung zhig zer/ sngon la khyod kyis /'thung zer bas des dug chu ka pā las bcus nas phyed 'thungs te lhag ma bud med rnams la gtor bas bud med bco lnga po 'dze mo mi bzad par gyur nas/ 'di ltar bgyid pa ma legs so byas pas/ 'o na med par bya yis zer te bud med de'i snying gar tsod ru de reg pas bco lnga po skad cig la shi/ der thod rgal gyi spyod pa de lta bu ma byed nga la yang bar chod che byas pas/ rnal 'byor pa de na re/ bud med dug gi rang bzhin te/ /dug gis dug bcom ye shes che/ /ye shes che la rab sbyor bas/ /sbyor dgrol spyod pa ma gtogs pa/ /gsang sngags bya ba gang la bya/ /bar chod bya ba ci la zer/ /zer bas nges pa rnyed de phyag byas pa na/ e ma/ gsod par nus pa dgrol ba min/ /gso bar nus na dgrol ba che/ /chags pas sbyor pa sbyor pa min/ /chags pa med na sbyor ba che/ /zer nas se khol gtogs pas bud med rnams snga ma bas ches mdzes par gyur/dur khrod rnams su spyod pa mthar phyung ste rnal 'byor pa mtha' yas pa grol bar byas so/10 de nas za hor gyi rgyal bu si dha shrīr gyur te yab ngang pa'i rgyal po la chibs te dga' ldan du gshegs rjes rgyal sa mdzad/ slar rgyal srid sras thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa la gtad de sgrub pa mdzad pas 'jam dpal dang thuṭa rje chen po grub ste yul khams de btul to/1 1 de nas ma ga dhar rgyal por gyur te mkhas shing skyed rim gyi grub pa brnyes mu stegs btul/ rgyal sa mdzad pa'i sras snga tshar brgyad de'i sras bcu drug rnams rab tu phyung / phyi tshar kha che'i rgyal po'i sras mo la sras gtsug tor dgu pa cig btsas te btsas ma thag nas chos rang byung du gsung ba la rgyal sa gtad de mkha' spyod tu gshegs so/1 3de nas mnga' bdag myang ral ste bcu gsum mo/ /de rnams gsal bar 644

dran te zhus lan mang du byas pa'i mthar nam mkha' la bltas pas srid pa'i 'khor lo'i steng na shel gyi mchod rten bang rim brgyad pa bum pa la nyi ma'i sgo gcig yod pa'i 'khor lo'i steng na mu stegs mi gnyis skor ba byed/ bang rim mas rim gyis/ rgyal mkhan gse ru grub pa dang / /bram ze rje rigs rgyal po dang / /mngal skyes mi dang brdzus skyes lha/ /de rnams gnas te re re zhing nga mtho zer ba la bum pa'i logs nas bya khyung zhig gis thams cad pas kyang nga mtho zer/ de tshe mchod rten de las thams cad nga'i cho 'phrul yin no zer tsa na slob dpon padma nyid bzhengs nas sems chos dbyer med rang dwangs su zhog cig gsungs te nyi ma'i sgo bye ba'i nang du gshegs par gzigs so/ /gzhan yang ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar mtha' las 'das shing gtso bor ma ṇi 'ba' zhig gis 'phrin las mdzad de bod yul thams cad yig bdun gyi rgyun gyis bkang /brgya byin dang nyi zla'i lha'i bus mchod bstod byas/ bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis bla mar bkur zhing snyan grags kyi dngos grub phul/ tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i lha khang dang / khyad par dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga tshun la bsam grub bde ba chen po'i lha khang tshar bar mdzad/ gra ma lung pa'i jo stan rnams kyis gasnyir phul lcags thag brkyangs/ nga bdun sa 'brug la ha bo gangs bzang nas bstan gtso'i sku gdan drangs te 'di ni dang por 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis ri btang bzung nas spyan drangs te 'gro don mdzad/ bar du slob dpon padmas snab stod sa tham yang dben nas spyan drangs te 'gro don mdzad nas gter du sbas pa yin la/ 'di ni sems can gyi bsod nams kyi zhing lha sa'i jo shākya dang mtshungs pa yin te dngos kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa da lta bzhugs la ma 'ongs par klu yul du spyan 'dren par gsungs so/ /spyir chos gter zab mo mang zhig snod ma rnyed/ rgyud man ngag mang po rgya ches/ drag sngags rnams gzhan 645

la gnod par dogs nas mang du ma bton/ bton pa rnams las kyang bka' babs kyi bu la gtod par bshad pa rnams ma gtogs phal cher slar sbas shing sku dang dbang bum sogs kyang gter gnas snga ma dang lha khang nyid du sbas pa phyis 'phrin las 'byung bar gsungs so/ kho bo chos kyi dbang phyug la/ / sems can rnam rtog tha dad kyis/ /la la chos dbang bde na dga'/ /la la chos dbang bde yis dogs/ /sogs nas/ chos dbang sems nyid re dogs bral/ /chos dbang sems la zug rngu med/ /bde na dga' tshod gyes par mdzod/ /chos dbang zug rngu spangs pa med/ /sdug na dag3 tshod gyes par dgongs/ /chos dbang sems la skye shi med/ /shi yis dogs tshod gyes par mdzod/ /chos dbang sems nyid chos dbyings shi/ /ma shi dogs tshod gyes par dgongs/ /chos dbang sems nyid 'pho 'gyur med/ /rtag du re tshod gyes par dgongs/ chos dbang sems la rang bzhin med/ /rtag gis dogs tshod gyes par mdzod/ /chos dbang sems kyis ma btul med/ /rgyal du re tshod gyes par mdzod/ /chos dbang sems la mtho dman med/ /rgyal gyis dogs tshod gyes par mdzod/ /ces gsungs shing re dogs rtsad nas zad/ snang srid dbang du 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen por bzhugs la/ kun bzang bde chen chos dbyings gzhal yas su/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu chos dbang da ni sdud/ /ci phyir lus 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs rdzogs 'dra/ /las ngan zad pa'i rtags kyang lus la smin/ /rmi lam mi gzugs chos dbang yal nas 'gro /zhes sogs dang /dpon slob kun bsdebs nor bu'i tshong len rmis/ /nga dang 'brel tshad gtan bde 'thob pa'i rtags/ /ces sogs dang / 'di nas mi rabs bdun nam bcu gsum na/ /dharma mi tra cig gis longs spyad nas/ /bdag gi sha rus sran tshad yungs 'bru re/ /stor song thams cad lam 'gro don chen 'thob/ /ces 646

dang / nga nas brgyud pa bdun nam brgyad dus su/ /'u sa skyed rigs kyi brgyud pa mi chad kyang / /gter chos yongs rdzogs bka' lung tsam por lagro /bstan pa'i gtso bo 'di yi rten 'brel gyis/ /brgyud pa'i gdul bya gtsang du skyon med tsam/ /zhes dang / bsam grub lha khang gsang sngags bstan pa'i srog /bu slob dam ldan bu yis zhabs tog 'bungs/ /gtsug lag nyams rkyen bu yis byas kyang thon/ /lha khang zhabs tog sprang pos byas kyang khur/ /zhes lha khang gi zhabs tog gal che ba sogs kyi zhal chems khyad par ba mdzad de dgung lo nga dgu pa la mya ngan las 'das/ slob ma'i dam pa bal po bha ro gtsug 'dzin ni bal yul yam bu ba yin/ bod nas gser btsal te rgya gar du 'gro snyam nas bod du 'ongs pas rmi lam du bu mo zhig gis lung bstan te gu ru dang mjal bas zhag bdun gyi bar bla ma o rgyan dngos su mthong / de phyin bla ma'i sku thun mong bar snang / gsung gleng byas pa tsam gyis rtogs pa shar/ nub cig dbang mdzad pa na khyod kyis nga cir mthong gsungs yi dam dngos su mthong zhus pas/ 'o na tshogs gtor gzhan du 'bul sa med gsungs nas rna ba'i sha bubs phyed la sogs pa'i tshogs rdzas thams cad skad cig gis bzhes/ yang nga cir mthong gsungs sangs rgyas dngos su gda'o byas pas/ 'o na dbang bskur bya'o gsungs te mchod rdzas bsdus dkyil 'khor bshig nas shul du bro brdungs te dri chen dor nas spyi bor bzhag pas lus shun po dor ba lta bu'i nyams shar/gsang chab blud pas bde ba bzod med du skyes/ snying gar phyag mdzub btsugs nas nga bya ba 'di ngos zung zhig gsungs pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes mthong / nga mthong don la ma yengs cig sgom rgyu spu tsam yang med do gsungs pas rtogs pa'i mthar thug ste dbang bzhi rim can du ngo sprad/ da ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byon yang dbang zhu snyam pa mi gda' rgya bar du 'gro ba'i spros pa yang chod 647

gda' zhus pas/ 'khor bar mi 'khyam pa'i sangs rgyas byung na mu stegs pa yin/ khyod rgya gar du song las bla ma rnyed na bla ma 'tshol slob ma rnyed na slob ma 'tshol zhes lung bstan/ 'di dad pa shin du che bas gu ru'i sta zur la khro bori spyan mnga' ba dang mkha' 'gro dang chos bgro ba sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa mthong / drag sngags rtags thon pa mchis sam zhus pas/ mang po shes te ma ṇi 'dren nas sgrub ma khom gsungs/ gyen de na ri bong zhig song ba la sa la ri bong gi gzugs bris te khab la sngags lan bdun bgrangs te gzugs la brgyab pas ri bong thur la 'dril byung / nga sgrib pa sbyang dgos long shog gsungs nas drod ma yal ba la btags grol btags tshogs gtor dang bsngo ba mdzad/mi la de 'dra 'ong ngam zhus pas mi dang phyi ba 'dra gsungs nas phyi ba'i gzugs zhig la khab btsugs nas bton pas dmar nar gyis byung ste da phyi khung ma gir stos shog gsungs nas ltar phyin pas phyi ba zhig khrag lhud kyis shi 'dug nas sngar ltar gnas spar/ 'di 'dra ba mtha' yas shes te sems can la gnod pas su la yang mi ster/ dgra la yang 'tshang rgya ba'i mthu las gzhan mi byed/'di pa dud 'gror song gas drangs pa yin mod/ mi lus 'thob pa ni shin du dka'/ srog bcad pa'i sdig pa ni mtha' yas/ gcig shi bas mi chog de'i nye 'khor thams cad sdug bsngal ba yin/ des na dgra la mthu mi byed slar snying rje skye dgos pa yin gsung zhing rang don du mthu ngan sngags mdzad ri'i zhe mna' mang po mdzad/ rgya gar du bar chad med par gtol ba'i byin rlabs zhus pas bha ro rang gis gser zho drug bcu phul ba'i phyed phye dang bsres sbyin sreg mdzad nas 'phangs sems ma byed par thal ba chu la pho lam du zas ster ba zhig yong ba khyer shog gsungs/ thal ba sbyangs nas bu mo zhig gis nyung ma zhig byin pa phul bas ras khob la tshos shig gsungs te shar gyur nas ro mngar la 648

shum pa cig 'dug khyong/ kyi don des grub gsung zhing nga'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa mthong ba rnams gzhan la ma bshad cig par bka' rgya btab/ rgya gar du 'gro dus skyel thung mdzad gser zho gsum phul ba 'bab chu la gtor te me la bsregs pas mkha' 'gro mnyes na chur dor na de bas kyang dgyes mchi gsu nga ngo / /gzhan yang sgod ldan gyi bu dgu la sogs skal ldan mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad cing chu zhal mgur gsum la sogs pa'i bla chen mi dpon thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs/ grub thob pa ṇi rin chen zhes bya ba la khyad par thugs rje chen po'i bka' babs te khams su pang ston 'od zer bla ma la sogs pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mang du spel te thugs rje chen po sgrub pa'i srol dang / rigs chos gnyis ga'i sras kyi mchog padma dbang chen dang smyal du 'khrungs pa'i sras nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyis rigs chos gnyi ga'i brgyud pa bzung ste bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ sras padma dbang chen ni sngon lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi skye ba yin la phyis ratna gling par gu ru nyid kyis lung bstan no/ /de ltar gter kha gong 'og 'di gnyis dang snying thig gong 'og gnyis ni rnying ma'i gter chos kyi rtsa ba yin la 'di dag las don gnyis grub pa ches mang du byung ngo / /de rnams su ma zad sto brag kho thing du ra shag rnal 'byor pa chen po zhes bya ba lo brgya dang bcu lon pa thugal ka na snying po 'bru bzhi rang byung du byon pa yod la rje mi la bla ma'i mkhar las byed pa'i skabs cig mjal du phyin pas lha khang nang du nyal ba'i tho rengs bud med dkar mo zhig gis sbrang chang ka pā la gang byin te khyod bal bod kyi mtshams su bsgoms na lam myur/ nga yang khyod kyi yul phyogs pa zhig yin te khyod kyi lus dang grib ma ltar mi 'grogs ka med pa cig yin zer/ gnangs nyin bla ma de dpon slob nyer gcig sman sgrub dam po la bzhugs kyang rje btsun sgrub pa'i grar bos/649

mjal ma thag dbu sngas nas sgro ba zhig gi nang nas pod chung zhig phyung ste 'di khyod rang la snga nub nas bsu ba de kun gyi sgrub thabs lags/ khyod la ster dgos par lung bstan pa yin zhes tshe ring ma'i sgrub thabs sprad par bshad la 'di dang mdos la mkhas pa'i ra shag tha dad du snang zhing / rje sgam po pas kyang o rgyan gyi lung byang dang sems khrid kyi kha byang lhan cig par dung mtsho ras pa'i don du sbas pa sogs gter ma tshad ldan bgrang gis mi lang ba yod la/chos dbang gi gsung gi rnam thar skabs brgyad ma las/ gter min gter 'dra rdzun gter mkhan/ /pe the'i byin rlabs zhugs pa brgyad/ /da lta bod na nges par yod/ /khang zhus lung zhus bstan pa'i bdud/ /de rnams kun dang 'brel mi bya/ /skur pa yang ni mi gdab bo/ /de rnams kun gyis chos rnams dkrug /khyad par gter chos bstan pa snub/ /'on kyang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad kyis/ /rgyu 'bras nges par smin par byed/ /rang la bstos pa'i 'khor kun la/ /de skad gsangs te bsgrags nas su/ /'gong po'i bstan la mi gzhug go /zhes gsungs pa ltar skye bo bslu ba'i rdzun gter ni ches mang bar snga phyir snang la/de dag mang ches pas yang dag rnams mi gsal ba rlung tshub kyi nang gi mar me ltar snang yang chos kyi mig ldan la sgrib med tu gsal zhing spyir ra gan mthong ba'i rtags kyis gser rag gan du sgrub pa dang / dzasbu'i gser mthong ba'i rtaṭa kyis ra gan gser du sgrub pa gnyi ga spangs te log lta'i bdud ma zhugs shing dus min gyi dag snang rgya 'byams pa yang ma yin pas gter ma'i phyogs 'di dag shes par bya'o/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bod yul gyi skabs las rdo rje theg pa snga 'gyur ji ltar byung ba bshad pa ste skabs lnga pa'o/ /par 'di'i sbyin bdag sa skyong nor 'dzin dbang / bya yul dpon sa tshoṭa 650

gnyis grub pa'i sa/ /dad ldan bla ma rig dbang thob kyis bsgrubs/ /dge ba byang chub mchog gi rgyu ru bsngo/ /e ma ho/ bka' brgyud gdan sa gnas chen sras khar du/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan phyir dang / /mtha' yas 'gro la chos sbyin spel slad du/ rnying ma'i brgyud kyi chos byung par du bsgrubs/ /brkos kyi byed po gnyal gyi spangs brgyud nas/ /rig byed mkhas pa tshe dbang dar po dang / /tshe dbang don grub kun dga' bsam 'grub dang / /kun dga' rgyal mtshan bkra shis tshe dbang dang / bsam 'grub mgon po bkra shis dgos dar thogs/ /dpon slob bdun gyis sor mo'i gar stabs bsgyur/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid 'byung phyir bsngo/ /shu bhaX mastu sarba dzag tam// //651
yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bod yul gyi skabs la le'u bcu las drug pa bka' gdams chos byung bzhugs/ /

le'u drug pa bka' gdams chos byung / sngon tshe rgyal sras gtso bo bzang skyong ni/ /za hor rgyal po'i sras 'khrungs sngags spyod grub/ /slar yang phar chen sde las rab tu byung / /rig gnas sde snod mdo rgyud ma lus mkhyen/ /byang chub sems kyis 'gro kun dbang du 'dus/ /grub thob rnal 'byor dbang phyug du ma'i mgon/ /'dzam gling kun na phul byung a ti sha/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal ye shes de/ /lha btsun byang chub sems dpa' khu dbon gyis/ /dka' ba chen pos nan gyis spyan drangs shing / / lhag pa'i lha tshogs du mas bskul ba las/ /byang phyogs gangs can khrod 'dir gshegs mdzad de/ /chos kyi rtsa ba las 'bras blang dor bstan//thams cad dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gror bkod/ /rab tu byung rnams tshul khrims gnas la sbyar/ /thos ldan rnams kyi lta ba drang por mdzad/ /bsam gtan pa rnams zhi lhag gnyis la sbyar/ /sngags la zhugs rnams dam tshig dag par bkod/ /kun kyang byang chub sems kyi theg pas khrid/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa kun nub ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyin byed rab tu gsal/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i shing rta chen po ni/ /rgyal bas bstan pa 'dzin par lung bstan pa/ /dge bsnyen chen po 'brom ston rgyal ba yi/ /'byung gnas dam pa'i phyag du bzhag mdzad de/ /dga' ldan du gshegs nam mkha' dri med ces/ /mi pham mgon gyi 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur/ /rigs gsum mgon pos rnam par sprul pa yi/ /sku mched gsum sogs skyes chen mtha' yas kyis/ /gzhung dang man ngag rab tu rgyas mdzad nas/ /mtha' 655

yas 'gro ba ngal gso'i stegs su gyur/ /de bas bod yul bstan pa phyi dar la/ /bka' drin 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi gra chen po/ /bslab gsum tshags kyis bsdams pa legs bshams te//3gro kun sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol brtson pa/ /jo bo yab sras rgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /de yang bstan pa phyi dar la bod la bka' drin che ba jo bo a ti sha ni rgya gar shar phyogs bhaX ga la'i yul gyi bye brag za hor zhes bya ba mi khyim 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa'i grong khyer gyi dbus na pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rgya nag stong kun dang longs spyod mnyam pa der sngon mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho byon pa'i gdung rigs yab rgyal po dge ba'i dpal dang btsun mo 'od zer can la sras gsum las che ba padma'i snying pos rgyal srid bzung /chung ba dpal gyi snying po rab byung mdzad de dge slong bīrya tsand+ra zhes bya ba skyed rim brtan pa cig byon/ 'bring po zla ba snying po ni jo bo 'di yin te 'khrungs nas zhag bdun na sgrol ma zhal gzigs de phyin chad ci 'dod sgrol ma la gso'aji ba btab pas dngos su chos mi gsung yang spros pa nang nas chod de 'ong ba yin gsungs/ /lo bcur sgyu rtsal drug bcu rtsa bzhi dang bzo dang gso ba sbyangs/lo bcur phyi nang gi sgra tshad bslabs/ rā hu la gubha badzra la dbang zhus pa'i tshe dgyes rdor zhal gzigs rtogs pa rgyud la skyes te gsang mtshan ye shes gsang ba'i rdo rjer btags/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa chang 'o mar bsgyur zhing gaṅgā la gding ba bting nas 'byon pa ka ma la rakṣi ta las gsang sngags kyi bka' drin phal cher brnyes/ bla ma de sems tsam rnam rdzun pa yin/ jo bo dbu ma bzhed pa la mi mnyes/ gsang sngags kyi sgo nas tshogs bsags pas phyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob nas rjes thob la gzigs pas chos rnams kyi rang bzhin khyod kyi ltar 'dug gsungs nas dbu ma bar 'gyur/ a wa dhū 656
