ti pa lo dgu bsten/ de tha mal gyi gtam mi gsung res gser gyi mantul phul nas chos zhus kyang mi gsung / res long med pa'i dus na yang ma zhus par gsung / dpon slob gnyis zam pa dog mo ya nga ba zhig la 'byon 'phro la zhal log mdzad nas bu bdag 'dzin dang ma bral bar du las 'bras phra ba la yang 'dzems shig paṇḍi ta dang nus pa can 'di dang 'di 'dra yang las 'bras phra mo la ma 'dzems pas ngan song gi sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba myong zhing 'dug go gsungs/ chos kyi phyir rgya mtsho chen por yang lan gsum zhugs te bsod stoms pa chen po sogs las dbang rgyud gdams pa mang du gsan/ spyod pa'i tshad du longs te rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa lo drug mdzad/ shar phyogs bha du ra'i grong na bzhugs pa na ro ba'i slob ma a wa dhū ti pa mngon shes can la bṛ ka ma lar yang dbang gsan te gsang mtshan snga ma de kho na btags/ bud med gcer bu rus rgyan can res ngu res rgod pa cig gzigs nas yid kyis gsol ba btab pas nga res ngu res rgod pa'i don shes sam gsungs/ ma 'tshal zhus pas sems can rnams rang rgyud kyi ye shes ma rtogs par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyod pas ngu ba yin/ rtogs na da lta nyid sangs rgyas yin pas rgod pa yin gsungs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang tshegs chung la don che ba byin rlabs kyi lugs bya ba bskur nas rnal 'byor ma'i zhal ji lta bar gzigs gdams ngag ma lus par zhus/ de'i tshe sti ga lar phyi nang gi rtsod pa chen po byung nas bstan pa phal cher mu stegs la shor nas rtsod pa zlog nus pa med pa'i tshe bu mo gcig gis jo bo'i sku las 'od 'phro ba mthong nas gnas brtan la sprang po 'od 'phro ba zhig 'dug rnal 'byor pa yin te 'ong rtsod pa zlog par zhus zer nas zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes/ mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad nas sngar shor ba'i gnas dang paṇḍi ta thams cad tshur thob phyi rol pa thams cad nang par bcug gnas brtan 657

des rab tu 'byung ba dang bzhugs par zhus pas kyang ma gnang / gsang sngags kyi mkhyen pa dang nus pa la nga bas che ba med snyam du thugs rgyal cung zad byung ba na mnal lam du mkha' 'gro rnams kyis nam mkha' la glegs bam dpag med btser rgyud 'di ji skad bya ba yin/ 'di khyod kyis shes sam zhes dris te sngon mtshan yang ma gsan pa'i rgyud mtha' yas pa 'dug logs shig na po ti nag chung kha shas 'dug pa la 'di khyod kyis shes pa'i rgyud rnams yin zer/ yang jo mo sgrol ma byon nas khyod paṇḍita sngags mkhan yin nam gsungs/ lags zhus pas 'o na sgrub thabs 'di dang 'di mkhyen nam gsungs/ de kun dpe yang mthong ma myong zhus pas 'o na khyod sngags la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal che na/ khyed mi'i yul na rta'i spu rtse gcig tsam las med/ sngags kyi dpe don mang po mkha' 'gro ma'i lag na yod pa yin gsungs nas yal/ der sngags la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal chag 'on kyang sngags spyod kyis tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba zhig bya dgos dgongs pa na dpal he ru ka byon te a wa dhū ti ba'i spyod pas gar yang mi phyin pas khyod rab tu byung zhig phyi zhig na rab byung gi gdul bya mang bar 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan/ yang mnal lam na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa gdugs tshod gsol ba'i gral mtha' na jo bo nyid 'dug pa la ston pa'i zhal nas mi ma gi ci la chags nas khyim mi spong ba yin gsung ba rmis/ yang gtsug lag khang zhig na byams pa dge slong gi cha byad du 'dug pa'i drung du 'byon par brtsams pas 'di rab tu byung ba'i sa yin khyod khyim pa'i sa min pas ma 'ong zhig gsung ba rmis/ rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma zhig dang mjal bas kyang a wa dhū ti'i spyod pa ma byas tshe 'di la bden pa mi mthong bar chad 'ong rab tu byung na bstan pa la phan zhes gsung bas bskul te dgung lo nyer dgu la rdo rje'i gdan ma ti bee ha ra'i gtsug lag khang du phal chen sde pa'i 658

bye brag 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bka' rgyud sbyor lam pa shī la ratta tas mkhan po mdzad de rab tu byung / dī bam ka ra shrī dzñā na dpal mar me mdzad ye shes su mtshan btags nas bsnyen par rdzogs/de'i tshe mkhan pos mu stegs cig dang rtsod pa byas pas smyo 'bog yor ba langs nas 'phro la lus/ jo bos 'phro blangs nas brtsad pas jo bo rgyal/ mu stegs na re sngar ma thos pa'i paṇḍita 'di ji lta bu yin zer/ jo bos paṇḍita tsam min sgra tshad la byang bar byas pa cig yin te byas pas 'o na ngal du 'phangs rig pa slobs zer/ de la bsten nas mkhan pos kyang bskul te slar yang bya ka ra ṇa sde brgyad du grags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgra mdo sarba dzñā na ind+ra pā ṇi ka tsa na ma ṇi bya kā ra 9 kun tu bzang po sogs sgra'i gnas mtha' dag dang / bram ze nor lhas byas pa tshig gi sgron ma sogs phyi rol ba'i sgra mdo mtha' yas sbyangs/ rkang mig pa'i rigs pa'i lta ba dang nang pa'i sde bdun mdo bcas sogs tshad ma'i phul du phyin/ rdo rje gdan du sgra tshad la shin tu mkhas pa'i mu stegs pa gdugs bcu gsum phub pa cig dang phyi lo gdugs bdun phub pa cig byung ba jo bos tshegs med par btul/ phyi lo gdugs lnga phub pa cig byung ba sgra tshad la cher mkhas pas dang por paṇḍita kun gyis go de nas rim gyis go ba je nyung du song ste shin tu mkhas pa lnga tsam las gzhan gyis ma go de nas shin tu phra bas khong rang gnyis ma gtogs pas ma go de nas mu stegs des sgra'i tshigs bcad gcig gi don jo bo la dris pas lan ma thebs nas khyod cung zhig sdod cig gsungs te nang du byon sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas thugs la gsal ler byung ste lan btab nas tshar bcad gdugs lnga po jo bo la phul zhabs spyi bor blangs te nang pa la bkod do/ /rtsis kyi gtsug lag lugs kyi bstan bcos gso ba'i gzhung phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnas ma lus pa 659

la 'gran pa'i zla med/ nang rig pa la theg pa chung ngu'i sde bzhi'i rtsa ba'i bstan bcos bye brag bshad khu / chen po bam po sum brgya yod pa de o tu nta pu rir dha rma rakṣi ta las gsan te sngags kyi sbom po mi 'byung ba'i phyir zhag drug nang du bzhugs bdun pa la phyir byon/ de lta bus lo bdun la tshar/ gzhan brtson 'grus can gyis kyang lo bcu gnyis dgos skad/ sde pa bco brgyad po so so'i sde snod gsum po mang du gsan zhing phal cher gzigs pas mkhyen te sdom pa'i gtong thob rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo sogs re re zhing ma 'dres par 'byed pa la mkhas/ theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa la bden bzhi'i sgor zhugs pa'i theg chen ni lung dbyug nga/ gsum gyi phreng ba dang rigs pa rta dbyangs kyi mdo sde rgyan dang lta ba bye smra dang thun mong du byas nas blo sbyong ba rnams dharma rakhri ta snying rje chen po mnga' ba mi gson po'i sha min pas mi sos zer ba'i nad pa cig la rang gi brla las sha bcad de byin pas sos nas na tsha byung ba'i tshe mnal lam du mi dkar po cig gis byang chub 'dod pas brtson 'grus 'di lta bu brtsam par bya'o zhes phyag gis byugs pa'i mod la rma sos pa de la gsan/ lung dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo dang rigs pa byang sa lta ba sems tsam la bsten nas spyod pa phyis gser gling pa las gsan/ lung nam mkha' snying po'i mdo dang rigs pa bslab spyod gnyis lta ba mdo sde pa la bsten nas spyod pa byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa ces bya ba byams pas dngos su rjes su bzung ba de la gsan/ yang dge bsnyen zhig 'khor 'ga' la chos 'chad sar mi zhig gis khyi la rdo brgyab pas bla ma a na zerwa nas ling bog khyi la rdo phog sar smug khyur gyis srangs 'dug skad de bdag gzhan brje nus pa de dang / ri dwags dman ma thams cad skyabs zhu ba'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig la'ang byang chub kyi sems kyi bka' drin zhus/ /mdo sde sna tshogs pa'i theg chen ni mdo mang 'di 660

rnams te re re zhing nyams su len pa'i gdams pa dang bcas pa gsan zhing mkhyen/ shes phyin gyi sgor zhugs pa'i theg chen ni lta ba sems tsam du bkrol ba shārti pa'i lugs dang dbu mar bkrol ba seng bzang gi lugs dang mdor na theg chen gyi sde sgod bstan bcos thams cad bṛ ka ma lar bzhugs pa de thams cad rdzogs par mkhyen/ gsang sngags rtog pa'i rgyud bya ba spyod pa gnyis / rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor chen po rnal 'byor bla med dang bdun du bzhed pa'i re re'i yang rgyud sde mtha' yas pa gsan zhing mkhyen/ da ni rgyud thams cad mkhyen snyam pa na mnal lam du go so ma pu ri'i sgo srung ngag dbang grags pa dang mjal bas don dam pa'i rgyud drug ces pa mthar thug 'ba' zhig ston pa'i rgyud sogs rgyud 'bum phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga gsan te mnal sad pa na thams cad mkhyen nas gda' skad/ phyi rig pa zhes bya ba phyi rol pa'i gzhung lugs/ rig byed pa/ grangs can pa/ bye brag pa dpyod pa pa ces bya ba rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la bsten nas tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug gis byas par smra ba'i gzhung dang / drang srong ser skyas byas pa'i grangs bdun bcu pa la sogs bstan bcos dang / rnal 'byor snying po sogs phyi rol pa'i gsang sngags mang du yod pa de thams cad ma lus par mkhyen/ o rgyan du byon nas gzhan la grags pa dang ma grags pa'i bla ma mang du bsten te gsang sngags gsan/ zangs gling dang nas gling la sogs pa'i rgya mtsho'i gling phran du yang chos re re'i phyir byon/ khyad par du gser gling pa'i snyan pa gsan pas mi bzod pa'i dad pa 'khrungs te rgya mtsho nas nor bu len pa'i tshong pa dang lhan du gru po cher zhugs te zla ba bdun tsam du byon/ dung gi mtsho dang 'o ma'i mtsho dang mtsho sa non la sogs par gzings rlung gis ded de khyer/ chu srin nya mid dang nya mid chen po sogs dbu ru g.yo ru'i bar gyi ri tsam pa gzigs/ dbang phyug chen pos 661

bar chad brtsams pa bshed dmar gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis btul/ gangs can mtsho rgyal gyi sku'i dbu gtsug nas chu chen po 'bab pa yang gzigs/ gser gling du byon pas lha'i yul 'dra zhing bstan pa dar bar 'dug bla mas snod brtag pa'i phyir zla ba bcu gnyis su ma mjal/ mchod pa cig gi sar mjal bas tshe rabs sngon gyi dpon slob yin pas gnyis gas ngo mkhyen ste bla mas jo bo'i dbu la phyag bzhag nas shis pa mang du brjod/ khyod byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la slob nus sam/ lo bcu gnyis sdod nus sam gsungs nas khong rang gis rnyed pa'i ston pa'i gser sku de gnang / lo bcu gnyis su dbu sngas sprad par yol bas bcad de bzhugs nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gshegs shul bstan pa'i rim pa dang bslab btus spyod 'jug la sogs pa'i spyod pa'i gzhung mtha' dag dang khyad par du byang chub kyi sems rin po che bdag gzhan brje pa'i blo sbyong gi gdams pa gzhan la med pa gsan pas bla ma gzhan thams cad las khyad par du drin che bar mdzad de phyis gzhan la lo mchod tsam mdzad gser gling pa la zla mchod mdzad/ bla ma gzhan gyi mtshan gsan tshe phyag thugs /ra thal mo sbyor/ gser gling pa'i mtshan gsan tshe spyi bor thal mo sbyor zhing spyan chab shar gyis 'ong / nga la yon tan du byas pa bsam pa bzang po spring tsam zhig yod 'di mgon po gser gling pa'i bka' drin yin gsung skad/ gser gling pa'i slob ma dzha na shrī mi tra dang shārti pa dang ratna kirti gsum la chos gang mnga' ba gsan te de gsum jo bo dang bzhi la gser gling pa'i bu chen bzhir byed/ mdor na ku sā li che chung ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang yon tan mnyam zhing brgyad pa'i bka' babs mtha' yas pa mnga' la de'i yon tan thams cad gser gling pa la mnga'/ de'i yon tan thams cad bum pa gcig nas gcig tu byo ba ltar jo bo la rdzogs te spyir lo gsum na 662

'dzam gling gi tshong pa gser gling du lan re yong ba las de'i tshe gru bo lan gsum du bub nas lo bcu gnyis pa la gru bo che byung ba'i tshe rgya gar du byon/na ro pa la byin gyis rlob par zhus pas nga'i slob ma ḍimbi pa la gsol ba thob cig des rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ de btsal bas ma rnyed maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab pas dge slong sha na'i gosi gyon pa cig mi sha lag pa cig za zhing byung / sbom po mi 'ong ngam byas pas sangs rgyas la 'khrul pa mnga' 'am gsungs/ de ga la mnga' byas pas 'o na khyod kyang cig 'dod dam gsungs nas srin lag bcad nas byin/ de zos pas ro dpe med pa cig byung ste sang dro'i gaṇḍi la thug gi bar ting nge 'dzin bzang po gcig la song /ḍombi ba'i byin rlabs yin nam su'i yin snyam pa las sang lo dus na sngags pa cig gis ḍimbi pa la gsol ba btab pas nga dang las 'brel med/ ngas na ning 'di tsam na 'di ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta dī paX ka ra'i drung du song zhig gsungs te 'ongs nas maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab pas zhag 'ga' na bka' drin gyis khyab he ru ku'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gyur gsungs te na bza' 'dra mnga' ba go lang btsongs nas dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas te bzhud/ jo bo de nam gzigs bzhed tsam na nga 'di na yod gsung gin lam gyis byon/ phyis bod du 'byon shar nga'i slob ma de gar yod dam dgongs tsa na gcer bu rus rgyan can du lam byung ste kho bo 'di na mchis gsungs/ de phyin bod du ma byon te yul mi gcig pas lan nam zhing khams gzhan du bzhud dam gsung skad/ gzhan yang lta ba lung ston pa'i bla ma na ro pa/ brtul zhuṭa byin gyis rlob pa tambi ba/ las tshogs byin rlabs ster ba ba li ā tsarya/ rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs ster ba mkhas pa mi chen po/ phag mo'i byin rlabs ster ba bhū ta ko ṭi/ klu sgrub kyi gdams pa ster ba mkhas pa rta mchog byang chub kyi 663

sems brtan par byed pa shes rab bzang po/ tshig don rgyas par byed pa shārnyi pa/ bstan pa'i sgo 'byed blo sbyong gi rim pa ster ba gser gling pa ste bka' drin che ba dgu/ de'i steng du byang chub bzang po/ dze ta ridharma rakhri ta bsnan pas rtsa ba'i bla ma bcu gnyis/ gzhan yang du ha ra nag po/ rā hu la/ na ro pa'i slob ma mngon shes can ste mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' ba gsum/a wa dhū ti pa dang ka ma la raṇi ta ste phyag rgya chen po grub pa gnyis/ gzhan yang a wa dhū ti pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ ḍimbi pa/ rab tu 'byin par bskul pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ sgrol ma/ dzñā na shrīs lung bstan pa'i rnal 'byor ma gnyis/ phag mo'i byin rlabs ster ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje gdan gyi lam du lung ston pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ bod du bka' chems lung ston pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ mngon shes can gsum rnams la lung rtogs gnyis ka dang ldan pa'i bla ma bcu gsum du grags shing / gser gling pa/ shārti pa/dze ta ri/ byang chub bzang po ste rtag du bsten pa'i bla ma bzhi'o/ /de thams cad kyi yon tan bum pa gcig nas gcig du byo ba ltar jo bo la mnga' zhing /'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub yab sras/ zla ba grags pa/ rigs pa'i khu byug che chung / a wa dhū ti pa che chung ste lta ba rnam par dag pa zab mo dbu ma'i brgyud pa dang / byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ 'phags grol/ btsun grol/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam snang mdzad/ seng ge bzang po/ ku sā li che ba rin chen bzang po/ chung ba rin chen sde/ gser gling pa/ yang na dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma blo brtan la ku sā li gnyis gas thug ste spyod pa rnam par dag pa rgya chen pha rol tu phyin pa'i brgyud pa dang / rdo rje 'chang / te lo na ro/ ḍombi pa ste nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ste gtso bor byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum mnga' zhing / gzhan du mdo rgyud man ngag gi bka' 664

babs brjod kyi mi lang pa gcig du 'dus pa ste brgyud pa de thams cad kyi yon tan jo bo la mnga' 'o/ /nga la so thar gyi sdom pa la nyes pas ye ma gos byar btub/ byang sdom la nyes byas sna re tsam 'ong / sngags sdom la lhung ba che re nye re 'ong / 'on kyang de ma thag bshags te ltung ba dang zhag du 'grogs ma myong gsung ste btsun pa'i mthar thug thugs dam gyi lha dpag med zhal gzigs/ gser gling nas rdo rje gdan du byon pa'i tshe rang byung khrar sa pā ṇa gcig la rabs chad rgan gon gnyis kyis mchod pa chen po bya bar yod pa'i tshe rgan po'i rmi lam du nga la mchod pa ma byed par 'di na dge slong di paX ka ra yod pa la gyis bsod nams de che'o zhes lung bstan/ sde pa bzhi ku'i khrod du btsal bas ma rnyed/ kha sang mgron btsun zhig 'dug pa de yin nam zer nas btsal pas bzhugs 'dug ste rdo rje gdan du de'i bsnyen bkur bzhes shing bzhugs/ da ni rtse gcig du mnyam par bzhag la myur du 'tshang rgya bar bya'o zhes dgongs tshe bla ma rā hu la skad cig gis byon te yi dam gyi zhal mthong ba dang dkyil 'khor mang po mngon sum du gyur pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub mang du thob pa dang ting nge 'dzin ri rgyun tsam yod pa sogs khyod kyi yon tan de rnams kyis gar yang mi phyin gyi byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sbyongs/thugs rje chen po snying rje'i lha yin pas yi dam du bzung la 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don byed par dam chos shig gsungs/ rdo rje gdan gyi 'khor sa la skor ba mdzad pa'i tshe lder tsho mang du bzhugs pa'i gcig bzhengs nas gzhan gcig la myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas chos gang la bslab par bgyi zhes dris pas gzhan de na re byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o gsungs nas phar phyin theg pa'i lugs kyi sems sbyang thabs shig gsungs/ yang skor ba mdzad dus cig rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs kyi nam 665

mkha' la bu mo lha'i lus rgyan gyis brgyan pa gnyis byung nas gcig gis gcig la snga ma ltar dri lan byas te sngags lugs kyi sems sbyang thabs shig gsungs te sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can yin skad/ yang bdud 'dul mchod rten gyi drung na bud med gnyis dang / sgrol ma'i lha khang du bud med rgan gzhon gnyis kyi dri lan dang / bya mdab kyi 'og na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang /rdo rje'i ra ba'i logs kyi ba so'i thub pa dang rdo rje gdan du bud med cig gis 'chags byas nas lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs pas grub pa thob pa ste de rnams re re zhing myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o zhes kho na mgrin gcig du gsung ba gsan pas sngar bla ma gser gling pas nges par mdzad pa'i steng du lhag par yang byang chub kyi sems la thugs nges par gyur/ de'i tshe dge tshul zhig gis ba ci ge ra'i gling na skyes pa dang bud med thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pho mo sha stag yin zer ba thos nas bltar phyin pas sangs rgyas byon no bzhud do zer nas smyos pa 'dra ba ma gtogs yid 'ches pa ma mthong / sum mdo cig na thams cad la lung bstan byed pa cig 'dug pa la phyag cig kyang byas/ log 'ongs pa'i lam gar tshong pa mang po ngo mtshar gyi gtam gleng ba la dge tshul des zer tshad mi bden/ ba ci ge ra'i gling na grub thob sha stag yin zer nas ngas bltar phyin pas mi bden par 'dug zer/ku sā li dge ba bya ba'i rnal 'byor pa cig tshong pa'i khrod na yod pas dge tshul de'i log rtog bsal ba'i phyir gud du khrid nas rnal 'byor pa nang phan tshun shes pa yin khyod kyis mi shes de thams cad rnal 'byor pa sha stag yin/ khyod kyis phyag byas pa de ni tshe 'di don du gnyer ba yin gyis rnal 'byor pa ma yin/ngas kyang dngos grub phra mo thob zer nas ka wa li na mdo dang gser dang spu gri 'dug pa mngon par shes nas bshad pas yid 'chis te gus pa byas nas 666

'grogs te 'ong sa/ yul dbus na gang zag khyad par can ci 'dra yod gsangs/rdo rje gdan na jo bo a ti sha zhes bya ba bzhugs byas pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas skyes bu dam pa mthong bar dka' bas zhal bltar 'dod gsungs nas byon/ dge tshul des jo bo la zhus pas skyes bu dam pa mthong ba ni don dang ldan pa yin gyis zhal blta bar bya'o gsungs nas rnal 'byor pa de nu gro tta'i sdong bo cig gi rtsa bar de nub nyal ba'i shing lo 'phyag cing 'dug pa ra byon/rnal 'byor pa des jo bo la lus thams cad sa la phab ste/ dzaspu'i gling gi mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag byas/ khong rten khyim par bzhugs pas jo bos dngos su phyag ma mdzad yid kyis phyag mdzad de mkhas pa bya ba khyed yin te don la mkhas pa yin nga ni tshig la mkhas par zad gsungs nas mkhas dang byis pa 'byed pa ces bya ba'i bstan bcos brtsams/ paṇḍita grags pa'i cha zhes bya bas rnal 'byor pa de la myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas gang la bslab dris pas byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o gsungs/ yid ma 'ches pas 'o na khye'u gtsang ma zhig khrid shog gsungs te pra phab nas sgrol ma dang rigs gsum mgon po rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi snang ba rim par bstan nas dris pus lan de kho na byung bas gdod yid 'ches/ theg pa che chung yang lta bas ma phye snying rjes phye ba yin/ chos zab mo la yid 'chis pa la tshogs dpag med gsog dgos zhes jo bo gsung skad/ /rnal 'byor pa de la paṇḍita chen po gzhan zhig gis mngon par shes pa 'char ba'i thabs dris/gcig gis tshul khrims dag pa'i rgyu dris pas kyang byang chub kyi sems kho na sbyongs shig gsungs/ de ltar sangs rgyas byang sems dang grub thob pho mo dpag tu med pas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la sbyar bas da ni sangs rgyas 667

dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam bskang ba dang bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgrub pa dang rang gzhan gyi phun tshogs sgrub pa gang la'ang byang chub kyi sems las lhag pa mi 'dug pas da ni thugs rje chen po yi dam du bzung nas byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba las med do snyam du dgongs nas rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs na 'od dpag med kyi lha khang yod par byams pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas dang byang sems mtha' yas pa dang khyad par thugs rje chen po dngos su byon te skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so bya ba byas so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa khyod kyis shes so/ /'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ lha mo sgrol ma yang de na sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs su song zhig ces lung bstan/ de'i tshe rgyal po ma hā pā las dzo ka ma la shī lar spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i sde bzhi paṇḍita lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang bcas pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ thams cad kyi the tshom dri ba'i gnas su bzhugs shing mu stegs mang po tshar bcad/ de'i ngos gcig la paṇḍita rnams dang ngos gcig na grub thob rnams bris yod pa la jo bo gnyis kur du bris/ snga gdong g.yas la klu sgrub dang g.yon la jo bo bris te klu sgrub dang mnyam par byed skad/ jo bos ci bder spyod pa shas gcig gnas nas kyang phyung / khyad par mi zhu paṇḍi tas rnal 'byor ma'i dam rdzas chang zhig khyer ba gzhan gyis mthong nas 'di khyed la mi gnod kyang gzhan la gnod pas bzhud par zhu gsungs nas phyung bas nyams pa sgo la 'gror mi btub gsungs nas rtsig pa la ma thogs par bzhud/ jo bos legs sam ma legs snyam nas sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas bu ma legs so zhes pa'i sgra lan gsum byung ste gzigs pas sgrol ma'i zhal nas mi rta pa sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ byang chub sems dpa' la sdig bsaṭa 668 ོ

pa rnam smin shin tu che ste ri rab la lan gsum bskor ba'i sems can chen po cig du skyes te bya sna tshogs kyis za bar 'gyur/ bod du phyin nas theg chen dar bar byas/ nyin re la sā tsha bdun re btab na las 'byang gsungs/ de skad bla ma ga ga pā la la zhus pas khyod kyis phan sems kyis byas pas nyes pa chung ste 'on kyang 'bras chan bre gang sbyin par btang ba zhig bod na rgyal po byed/ khyod de'i mchod gnas la 'gro dgos par 'dug gsungs/ de nas sras nirya pā las ma ga dha'i rgyal po byed pa'i tshe de dang nub phyogs kurṇa'i mu stegs kyi rgyal po ma mthun nas mu stegs kyi rgyal pos ma ga dhar dmag drangs pas grong ma thub par bṛ ka ma lar drangs te rab byung bzhi dge bsnyen gcig dang lnga bsad/ yo byad mang po khyer ba'i tshe jo bo thugs 'khrug pa med par byams snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas de'i mthus phyis dmag log ste mu stegs kyi dmag thams cad gsod du cha ba'i tshe srog bskyabs nas btang bas kurṇa'i rgyal po dad de nub phyogs su spyan drangs nas bsnyen bkur chen po byas/ jo bos kyang lam bar na chu bo chen po yod pa la lus srog la ma gzigs par yang yang brgal te yo byad thams cad bsdums kyi phyir btang nas rgyal po gnyis bsdums nas 'dza' bor mdzad/ de'i tshe bod kyi rgyal brgyud lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis jo bo'i snyan pa gsan nas lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge 'khor brgya tsam dang bcas pa la gser ling ba gcig la shing srang bcu drug yod pa cig gis sna drangs mang du bskur te jo bo spyan 'dren du btang bas jo bo'i zhal nas bod du 'gro ba la rgyu gnyis yin/ yang na gser 'dod nas 'gro ba yin te nga la gser gyi dgos pa med/ yang na bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis 'gro ba yin te de yang nga la med/ da mi 'gro gsungs nas gser tshur gtad/ lo tsā ba'i 'khor phal cher yang shi/ gser sil ma rnams kyang brlag pas lo tsā ba tshur 669

log ste gser ling ba rgyal po la gtad/ rgya brtson seng jo bo la chos nyan du log pa'i phyi la nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrica/sa rgyal ba zhes bya ba yul gung thang gdung nag tsho chung ngu nas rab tu byung ste shin tu btsun pa'i 'dul ba 'jin pa de yang mngon pa nyan cing 'brengs/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis gser sgrub tu mtha' 'khob cig du byon pas gar log gi rgyal pos shes te btson du bzung /khyod rang gi rgyal khams mu stegs la 'god na bya dga' chen po ster/ tha na yang skyabs 'gro gtong na blud ma mi 'dod/ gzhan du gser lus tshad dang mnyam pa ma byung na mi gtong zer/ dpon po lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyis bod khams gsum gling dgu la gser bsdus nas sku lus tsam zhig rnyed de blu bar brtsams pas da dung dbu'i tshad ma longs na mi gtong zer nas ma btang / khong rang gi gsungs nas nga rgas shing mu stegs kyis sman log dpyad log mang pos shes pa yang mi gsal bas blus kyang bstan pa'i don mi nus/ gser des jo bo spyan drongs la bod du bstan pa dar bar gyis/ ngas khyed kyi ched du lus srog gar log gi rgyal po ngan pa la byin yod pas de la dgongs nas khyed bod du byon te bstan pa dar ba zhig mdzad par zhu/ de'i tshe nga yang khyed kyi drung du skyes nas theg chen gyi chos spyod par smon lam 'debs so zhes jo bo'i snyan du thong zhig gsungs te ring po ma lon par gar log gis bkrongs/ nag tshos rgya gar du lo gnyis bzhugs/ mngon pa dang lo tsā mkhas par gyur te slar bod du byon pa'i tshe lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis spyan sngar bos te bod yul 'dir bstan pa la dar gud shin tu che bar byung / a tsa ra dmar po zhes bya bas gsang sngags thig le'i skor bshad nas rab byung phal cher ser khyim la bkod/ phyi rol pa lags sam sham/ thabs sngon po can bya bas sbyor dgrol gyi chopo/ bstan/ sngags pa rnams kyis kyang gsang sngags sgra ji ba zhin du spyad nas sdeg pa la 'god pa 670

cig byung ste bstan pa 'in tu 'grib/ yab mes kyis paṇḍi ta che chung 'ga' gdan drangs nas gda' yang bstan pa la phan pa phar zhog slar gnod pa byas pa bzhin du song bas a ti sha spyan 'dren pa la lan gnyis btang yang gser chud zos/ pho nya ma log pa las ma byung / da khyed kyis jo bo'i snyan du khu bo'i gsung 'phrin de thong / 'di na gser srang bdun brgya yod de 'dis mi nor thams cad rdzogs nas yod kyis 'di la mgon po bod du ma byon na khyed dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje yang de 'dra bas bdag cag rnams kyi ci bde bar spyad par bgyi'o zhes ma byon yang snyan du lhon pa gyis gsungs nas dpon g.yog lnga brdzangs te byon/ byang phyogal su dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa 'byung / des nga'i bstan pa rgyas par byed par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar 'brom ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mang pos lam du 'jigs pa bsal dbugs phyung 'di ltar byos kyi gdams pa bstan te bṛ ka ma lar btol/ jo bo la gser ling ba de'i mtha' sil mas bskor ba'i maṭil phul nas gsol ba btab/ zhu 'phrin brjod pas lha bla ma khu dpon byang chub sems dpar 'dug pas byang chub sems dpa'i bka' yang bcag tu mi rung / nga'i phyir khong gi nor mang po chud zos pas ngo yang gnong bar yod/ bod snying yang rje ste nga yang na so rgas lde mig mang po 'dzin bya ba mang po'i 'phro yang yod pas thon te mi 'ong / 'on kyang bod kyi sems can la phan thogs sam mi thogs ngas brtag pa bya yis re zhig khyed rang gi gser zung zhig gsungs nas gtad/ de'i nub sgrol ma la gsol ba btab ste ngas bod tu phyin na bstan pa la phan thogs sam/ rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa rdzogs sam/ lus srog gi bar chad du mi 'gyur ram zhes don gsum gsol ba btab pas rmang lam du bṛ ka ma la shī la'i drung na mu khen zhes pa mu stegs pa'i grong khyer zhig gi dbus na 671

nang pa'i lha khang chung ngu zhig yod pa der song la rnal 'byor ma zhig 'ong ba de la dris zhes byung nas der byon te mantul mdzad cing yod tsa na ga nas byung cha med par rnal 'byor ma ral pa sa la slebs pa cig byung / de la gsol ba btab pas bod du byon na phan thogs/ khyad par du u pa si ka cig la bsten nas phan thogs/ bod du ma byon na tshe lo dgu bcu rtsa gnyis thub/ byon na bdun bcu rtsa gnyis las mi thub gsung bas sems can la phan na tshe ring thung la mi lta snyam pa 'khrungs/ yang rdo rje gdan du gsol ba gdab dgos bsams nas bzhud kur dzña na shrī la zhus pas khyod kyi dri ba de rlabs che ba zhig 'dug pas rdo rje gdan gyi lha ris pa'i gseb na rdo rje sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor ma rgan mo ral pa ser shar re ba zhig yod/ de la 'di phul la dris zhes mgron bu snyim pa gang bskur/ de'i lam du bud med mi'i lus las 'das lha'i lus su ma slebs pa cig la yid kyis phyag dang dri ba mdzad pas khyod nges par lus srog la ma bltas par song zhig 'gro ba mang po la phan par 'gyur ro gsungs te sgrol ma yin skad/rdo rje gdan du byon pa dang rgan mo ral pa ser ba zhig na re jo bo dzñā na shrīs bskur ba'i mgron bu tshur thong gsungs te phul nas yid kyis dris pas u pa si ka la bsten nas phan par 'gyur/ des khyod kyi chos kyi sgrib pa zad nas phyi ma la phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'thob kyi gsungs/ de rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma yin skad/ de nas tshur byon te bod la phan thogs par lung bstan pas 'gro bar ni bya na bya ba gsar pa mi brtsam par chos 'phro btul ba dang gtsug lag khang gi gnyer gtad pa sogs rnying pa 'phro can rnams zin pa la brtson 'grus bskyed kyang zla ba bco brgyad dgos par 'dug pas de'i bar lo tsā bas sdod nus sam gsungs/ ji tsam 'gor yang sdod par zhus pas 'o na spyan 'dren pa sodas las gnas brtan ratna ā ka ra la gnas kyi slob dpon la zhus slob 672 ོ —

gnyer gyis gsungs te nag tshos slob gnyer gdams ngag thams cad rgya gar nyid du rdzogs par byas/ de'i tshe rje na ro pa chen po de bṛ ka ma lar byon rab tu byung ba thams cad kyis bsu ba mdzad/ jo bo dang dzñā na shrī mi tra gnyis kyis phyag g.yas g.yon nas brten te mdo li la spyan drangs/ seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i tshe kho bo yun ring du mi sdod pas da phyin sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bdag po ni jo bo dī paX kā ra khyod yin no zhes bstan pa gtad nas lho phyogs su byon te zhag nyi shu tsam na mya ngan las 'das te gdung zhig spyan drangs pa mchod sdong na bzhugs/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa du ha ra nag pos jo bo las dpyad 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba gnang ste khyod bod du 'gro bar 'dug khyod la gdan sa byang bskyabs pa sto gzhol ba shing rtsi nags tshal can zhig 'ong /bod nas tshur mi ldog par 'dug bu slob mang po 'ong / de rnams kyis sde dgon mang po gzheng bar 'gyur/ de'i tshe 'di dgos pa yin/ khyod kyi bu slob rnams kyang bu tsha bo yang tsha gsum tsam la legs par 'ong / de nas ni 'chol gyis 'gro nyen yod gsungs/ lho phyogs mthar skyes kyi grong na mu stegs pa rgan po lo bzhi brgya dang lnga brgya lon pa mang po nag tshos mthong nas jo bo la zhus pas/ des don med rlung 'dzin pa yin/ phyi ba dang grum pas kyang shes gsungs/ jo bo'i phyir nag tshos chu 'gram zhig tu phyin pas bram ze rgan po cig gis rgyal bu'i ro zhig khur nas byung ste ro de chus bkrus/ cung zad na ro de langs bram ze de shi nas bram ze'i ro chur bskur te song / jo bo'i zhal nas gsang sngags la yon tan 'di 'dra yod gsungs/ yang slob ma dge slong zhig byung nas kho bo spyod pa bgyid par zhu zer ba la jo bos da dung sngas pa srid gsungs pas mi mos pa mi mdzad par zhu zer nas chos gos de bzhag spyang ki cig du byas te mi ro zhig khyer nas zos/ /yang dge slong du khrod byung bas jo 673

bos 'o na bgyid par zhu gsungs / de nas gzhan rnams mig brid pa'i phyir gnas chen po brgyad la mchod pa mdzad/ res gar gshegs res gar gshegs nas rdo rje gdan du mchod pa mdzad/ rgya gar mtha' 'khob tsisnyi li kra ma bya bar chos blon zhig gis gtsug lag khang bzheng pa'i sa gnon bcol ba la sngar 'gro ma khom da res 'gro bas khyed rnams phyir log cig gsungs nas 'khor byin zlog yang gnas brtan ratna ā ka ra sogs bdag cag kyang 'gro bar zhu gsungs nas byon te sa gnon mdzad/ da ni bal yul rang byung gi mchod rten la mchod par 'gro bas khyed rnams log cig gsungs pa dang gnas brtan ratna a ka ra na re da ngas go tshe dang ldan pa yang slob gnyer byed par mi 'dug bod rgyal pos nged kyi mi rkur btang bar 'dug jo bo yang gshegs pa la dgyes par 'dugam btang na gzhan don gyi bar chad du 'gro tshe dang ldan pa yang nga rang gi slob ma yin pas mi dga' ba byar mi rung lo gsum khyed la g.yar du btang / de nas tshur spyan drongs/ khyod kyis kyang bal yul tshun ma bskyal na dam tshig nyams so/ jo bo mi bzhugs na rgya gar na bstan pa nub pa 'dra ba yin no gsungs/jo bos kyang gser de rnams cha bzhir bgos nas lha khang dang dge 'dun la phul te bod du byon/ lam du mu stegs kyis bkrong ba'i gshed ma btang ba dang ri brags pa'i chom rkun byung ba rnams rengs par mdzad de slar snying rjes bkrol/rgya brtson seng gis sngar mu stegs pa cig la rdzu 'phrul mig mthong gi sa la 'phur nas 'gro ba zhig zhus/ de'i rngan pa gser zho do 'dod pa la med nas gser gyi bsdud pa cig byin pas sregs la blang zer te ma 'dod par de dang 'gras/ des mthu byas nas bal por grongs/ khong gis dpe kha cig bal por bcol ba ma lon nas de'i gseb tu rtsa ltung rgya cher 'grel jo bo dang rgyas bṛ ka ma lar bsgyur ba de yang lus/ rgya grongs pa la jo bos thugs khral ltar mdzad pa nag 674

tshos thugs khral bsangs pas nged rgya gar na paṇḍi ta'i mya ngan rnal 'byor pas bsang / rnal 'byor pa'i chos kyi rgyab rten paṇḍitas byed pa yin/ dma' mo'i mya ngan mchog gis sel dgos pa la mtho shos kyi mya ngan dma' shos kyis sel ba min gsungs nas bkyon/ de'i tshe ma ga dhari rgyal po nirya pā la la 'phrin yig mdzad de nag tshos bsgyur/ bal por sthā bee ha ra bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te rgya bod kyi dge 'dun la sā tra btsugs/ mang yul gung thang du lo gcig bzhugs/ de nas pu rangs su gshegs te lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos spyan drangs/ rag dung yang sngar med pa la jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i phyir bcos te lo paṇa spyan 'dren gyi dung du grags/ lha btsun pas bsnyun rmed pa dang bod spyi'i spyod pa la bzod gsol dang nag tsho la gtang rag gi tshigs bcad kyang gsol te/ e ma'o dge slong byang chub 'od bdag gis/ /rtag du bsams pa'i bla ma spyan 'drongs pas/ /bod kyi yul du skyes bu chen po 'di'i/ /gzhung lugs shin tu dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces smon lam mdzad/ bod la chos zab zab mtshar mtshar bas kyang las rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis skyong bar zhu zhus pas shin tu mnyes nas chos shin tu zab pa las rgyu 'bras kho na yin/ rgyu 'bras la yid 'ches thob na de las lhag pa med/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa yi dam gyi zhal mthong bas nga 'di tsam la bstos te mi 'ong snyam nas dge 'dun gyi yo byad thugs thub tu spyad pas yi dwags gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs can du skyes pa dang / bṛ ka ma la'i lag bde bas de ring gi bsnyen bkur nang par bsgyur bas de'i nub mo yi dwags kyi snang ba shar ba dang / gnas brtan zhig gis dge 'dun la dbang chen byas shing 'bras bre phyed thugs thub tu spyad pas yi dwags dbang chung dur skyes pa sogs mang du gsungs nas rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis bskyed par zhal sdis bzhes te de phyin 675

paṇḍita las 'bras par mtshan thogs te mtshan des kyang bstan pa la phan par byung / mkhas pa mang pos jo bo la lta ba gang bzhed zhus pas khyed rang gang 'dod gsungs te dbu sems sogs gtam rnying ltar 'di 'dod zhus pa na/ kho bo yang de ltar 'dod de la lung rigs 'di lta bu bdog gsungs/ mnga' ris pa blo gsal zhes bya ba blo gros zla med pa cig gis go nas nyid kyi bzhed pa mi gsung bar kun la mthun 'gyur gnang ba ji ltar lags zhus pas/ nga yang sangs rgyas kyi rjes su slob pa yin pas gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par lan btab pa yin gsungs/ gzhan zhig gis 'o na nyid ji ltar bzhed zhus pas/ nga la 'dod pa med gsungs/ don dam du bzhed pa mi mnga' yang kun rdzob tu ji ltar bzhed zhus pas/ rab rib can gyis skra shad mthong ba ltar 'di thams cad de ltar gnas pa yin gsungs/ snang ba sel lam mi sel zhus pas 'bras chan la rab rib dag pa lta bu yin gyi khyed rang dpyod dang gsungs/rig shes tshad ma'i ngor chos can snang ngam mi snang zhus pas mi snang ste med nas mi snang ba dang yul ma yin nas mi snang ba gnyis las 'dir med nas mi snang ba yin gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na ye shes mnga' 'am mi mnga' zhus pas cha med 'tshang rgya ma myong gsungs/ yang sgyu ma'i mkhan pos blon po bslus pa 'dra ba zhig yin gyis khyed rang dpyod dang gsungs/ ye shes mi mnga' bar bzhed par go nas thams cad brgyal bog pa bzhin du gyur pa dang khyed bod la nga'i dbu ma'i lta ba las sems tsam bstan kyang mi bzod gsungs/ khyed sgyu ma'i dpe ji ltar 'dod gsung ba la bod ston rnams kyi rde'u shing bu la sngags kyis btab pas rta glang du snang ba ltar 'dod zhus pas zhal nag thing mdzad de stong gzhi 'dod pa sems tsam pa'i lugs/ nam mkha' la sngags kyis btab pas rta glang du snang ba lta bu yin gyi sna tshogs su snang ba tsam las 'khrul gzhi kun 676

rdzob tu yang med gsungs/ rab rib kyi dpe ci lags zhus pas rgan mo zhig rab rib kyis khebs pas 'bras chan la skra shad mthong ste khong par sran zhugs/phyis bus sman pa bkug ste sman gyis rab rib bsal bas zas la skra shad med par go nas khong pa'i sran rang bzhin gyis zhi ba lta bu yin gsungs pas bod thams cad spobs pa zhig ste chos 'di la rgya gar kha spu can rang dgos pa 'dug zer skad/ de'i dus lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po bod na zla med par grags pas paṇḍita la chos zhu rgyu med/ gsang sngags la nga rang mkhas/ 'o na yang sna len bya dgos snyam nas spyan drangs/ stan mnyam par bshams/ jo bos tho ling gi lha khang na rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dpag med bris 'bur du bzhugs pa la lha re la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa re mdzad cing dbu dud pa re mdzad/ de thams cad lo tsā ba chen pos kyang thugs la zin te gsang sngags kyi bdag por dgongs te rang gi stan cung zad phri/ jo bos lo tsā ba la chos 'di dang 'di mkhyen nam zhes dris pa thams cad la de yang 'tshal lags so zhes pa kho na byung bas jo bo mnyes te khyed lta bu bod na yod na kho bo 'ong mi dgos par 'dug pa la gsungs/ lo tsā bas jo bo la chos ci mkhyen dris pas khyed thun mong ma yin pa la zer ram gsungs pas thun mong ba la shin tu mkhas thun mong ma yin pa la dris gsung bar go nas dris pas sngar lo tsā bas gsan ma myong ba'i chos dpag tu med pa'i ming shar gyis gsungs pas ha las te rang gi stan 'brid thebs gsum byas nas mthar stan med pa tsam mdzad/ de nub lo tsā bas rgyud sde so so'i lha khang du byon te thugs dam so sor mdzad pa mkhyen nas gdams ngag med pa 'dra dgongs te chos thams cad gang zag gcig gis stan 677

thog gcig tu ji ltar sgrub gsungs pas/ so so nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin nyams su len lags mod zhus pas kho bo 'ong dgos par 'dug dbo/ngas nas zhal nag thing gis —song / lo tsā ba der dul nas nyams su len tshul zhus pas jo bo'i zhal nas thabs gcig gi steng du thabs ma tshang ba med par sgrub dgos pa yin/ de yang phar phyin theg par slob dpon thogs med rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs kyi chos thams cad tha snyad kyi dus su yang mtshan nyid gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs/ nyams su yang mtshan nyid gsum gyis len/ 'bras bu yang mtshan nyid gsum ste sprul sku kun btags longs sku gzhan dbang chos sku yongs grub bo/ /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi tha snyad kyang bden gnyis kyis gtan la 'bebs/ nyams len yang mnyam bzhag don dam spros bral ngang rjes thob kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu ste bden gnyis la byed/ 'bras bu yang chos sku don dam dang gzugs sku kun rdzob ste bden gnyis mngon du byed/ gsang sngags su tha snyad kyang rgyud gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs/ lam dus kyang stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du gzod nas gnas pa rgyu rgyud skyed rdzogs sgom pa thabs rgyud/ stan thog gcig tu lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa tshang bar sgom pa 'bras rgyud de rgyud gsum gyis nyams su len/ 'bras bu yang rgyud gsum ste chos sku rgyu rgyud longs sku 'bras bu'i rgyud sprul sku thabs rgyud de/ de rnams chos re re'i steng du thams cad tshang bar bsgoms te skyed rim gcig po'i steng du yang thams cad tshang bar sgom gsungs/ de nas bde mchog gi rim pa dang phag mo'i byin rlabs zhus pas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/ dngos po ci yod phul te de gnyis thung/la dam du mdzad/ sgrub pa'i man ngag gsan nas nye rgyu'i sgrub pa mdzad do/ /lha btsun pas gser gug srang sum brgya phul te bod na theg chen gyi lta spyod la 678

bshes gnyen gyis ma zin par rang rang gi rtog ges dpyad nas mi mthun pa 'di ltar mchis pa rnams bsal nas theg chen gyi bstan bcos jo bo nyid ji ltar sku nyams su bzhes pa zhig brtsam par zhu/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabab/ lugs la bsten pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs shig zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas byang chub lam sgron dang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs gnang / der lo tsā ba yang jo bo rgya gar du spyan 'dren par 'dod/ jo bo yang u pa si ka med rnal 'byor mas bslus sam zhes skabs su gsungs/ de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dge bsnyen dharma tā la zhes gnas brtan bcu drug gi rung ba mdzad pa por bzhugs pa de nyid bod yul du mir skye ba bzhes pa 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni dbu ru byang phyogs gnam bye ma lung gi rtswa sgye mor yab stag gsum khu bzher dang yum khu rbo za lha gcig gi sras su shing 'brug la 'khrungs mtshan chos 'phel/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs/ dgung lo bcu bdun la khams su byon te grum gyi mkhan bu se btsun byang chub gzhon nu bsten/ mngon pa dang sngags rnying ma sogs mang du bslabs/khong gi rta rdzi mel 'tshe yos 'thag thal 'phyag thams cad mdzad/ gra pa rnams sgros gleng byas pas ston pa thub pa ma byung nas chos mkhas su grags te rta rdzi dang yos 'thag las bton nas lo bzhi bzhugs/ khu rngog 'brom gsum du'ang ma gir grags/ paṇḍita sgra'i tsher ma la sgra bslabs/ rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus thob par gyur pa'i dus 'dir chos rnal ma zhig bya dgos de la 'di tsam gyis chog gam mi chog paṇḍita mkhas pa zhig la 'dri dgos snyam pa dang se btsun gyis kyang pha dang phra/da du song gsungs nas brdzangs/ sog chu khar phred kha yer chung dang mjal bas de dad nas ra skreng phul/ chos 'khor 'dzugs par zhus pas nga 679

da res paṇḍi ta'i drung du 'gro bas sdod mi khom/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab bya ba zhig myur du 'ong bas de la zhus gsungs/ ra sgreng gi dgon pa phyis 'debs par byas nas yar byon/ dge bsnyen gyi slob dpon la phyag mdzad/ lha btsun po dhi rā dzā sogs la phyag mdzad cing paṇḍi ta spyan 'drongs na bsu ba mdzad par zhus/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug la btsun mo'i mur ja phul te ngas 'phrin byung na khyed kyis bskul ma mdzad nas paṇḍi ta la stod nas bsu bar zhu ba phul/ byang lam la byon pas lam ngo ma shes pa na pe gar gyis lam bstan/ yang sgrol ma'i sprul pa sha ba 'theng mo zhig gis kyang lam bstan/ jo bo pu rangs rgya zhing na bzhugs pa'i tshe sgrol mas da ni zhag gsum dro dang bzhi na bod kyi u pa si ka chen po 'byon pas de la byin gyis rlobs shig gsungs/ jo bos kyang bum pa bzhengs nas zhag gsum gyi nyin bar bya ra mdzad/ dro tshun ma byon pas rje btsun ma rdzun gsung cang srid dam gsungs/ grong du chos ston la gshegs pa'i shul du phebs pas nga bla ma dang mjal ba skad cig snga phyi la khyad par yod gsungs nas byon te srang bar zhig tu mjal bas gnyis gas ngo cer mkhyen te gus pas btud/ jo bos phyag 'brom gyi dbu thog tu bzhag nas shis pa mang po brjod/ de nas gzims khang du byon te bum pa dbu thog du bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs/ rgya gar na paṇḍi ta mkhas pa ji lta bu yod/ nga'i sngar gyi chos lam du song ngam/ nyid kyi spyan sngar bsdad na ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ rgya gar na mkhas pa mang du yod cing da lta'ang shar phyogs bhaX ga lar nyin re grub thob re 'byon zhing yod/ khyod kyis chos sngar byas pa gzhan lam du ma song / bla ma'i zhabs tog lam du song / da khyod nga'i drung du sdod/ sgrol mas lung bstan pa yin gyi bka' rgyud 'di la byin rlabs yod byin rlabs che yi gsungs/ de nyin gyi ston skal mar tshal zhig byung ba de nub mar me mtshan thub cig phul/ de phyin 680

ra sgreng na gdung khang bzhugs pa'i bar mar dkar gyi mar me rgyun ma chad skad/de nub nas dbu sngas sbrel phal chen sde pa yol bas nub lhag nyal thub par 'dod pas bar ras yol gyis bcad de rig pa bslabs/ jo bo zhag gsum na rgya gar la thegs rgyu der 'brom gyis phebs/ bzhugs par zhus pas/ /grags pa ma yin mi spyod ba/ /zhes pa byang sems kyi nyes byas yin pas 'gro gsungs te gser la gzigs nas bzhud bya ba dang / bod na ma rgyud gsung bya ba dang bod ba lang lta bu'i dbus na chos thams cad stong nyid yin gsung gi 'dug lo zhes rgya gar du sgrog pa re gnyis byung bas phyir zlog par bzhed/ lo tsā ba yang chad so'i dbang gis skyel bar bzhed/ lha btsun pas kyang zhu ma nus pa'i tshe 'brom thugs zab la dkyel che bas dbus kyi lha sa bsam yas sogs gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar ba na dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po bzhugs pa de thams cad jo bo phebs su re ba rtse gcig par mchis pa sogs thabs kyis zhus pas/tshangs spyod pa grangs mang po de lta bu rgya gar na yang dkon/ de tsam gyi khrod du dgra bcom pa bzhugs par lung bstan pas bzhugs mchi gsungs nas bod phyogs la phyag mang po mdzad/ de thams cad nga 'ong bar bzhed na ngas dge 'dun gyi ngag mi gcog par dam bcas pa yin gsungs pas spobs pa skyes te bod du 'byon par zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes kyang lo tsā bas ma gsan pas/dang po tshur spyan ma 'drongs da phar spyan ma 'drongs ngas lo tsā ba sbyangs gsung skad/ de nas 'brom gyis dbus kyi mi chen rnams la/ shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam gling gi /bye brag brjid ldan gangs ri'i byang / /lo nyin ta ra rin chen khungs/ /kha ba can ges ming grags na/ /blo chen stobs ldan mi srun pa/ /bod ces bya ba gnas pa'i phyir/ /mi rgyal byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dpa' chen mang ba'i 'khor bcas kyis/ /phan gdags slad du dam chos bsgyur/ /681

rgyu bangong bkod legs gtsug lag khang / /bsam yas la sogs gnas mchog na/ /sngon rgyal 'phrupa rjeri dgongs bskang phyir/ /bstan pa'i bdud rtsi rgyas mdzad cing / /rgyal sras 'dren pa dkyel che ba'i/ /mi yi rgyal po shākya'i sras//lha btsun bo dhirā dzā dang / /dang por dge 'dun lugs 'byin dpon/ /btsun chen ye shes blo gros dang / /theg chen gdung rgyud ston mdzad pa'i/ /bstan pa'i ka ba rnam gsum po/ /dmigs byed bshes gnyen rnam gnyis dang //rjes slob dpal ldan bcu gnyis dang / /chos 'khor khrica/sa bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /ring lugs chen po rnam gnyis dang / chos gra'i slob dpon thugs rgyal can/ /ka ba gar mi mched gnyis dang / /dge bshes che rnaca/sa dgongs skong ba'i/ /kun phan dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang / /gnas brtan ban skya'i re gnas sa/ /shākra gzhon rgyal ba'i sras gnyis dang / /mkhas btsun chen por snyan grab/sa pa/ /legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa/ /'phags pa'i dge slong dge 'dun che/ /slob dpon yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /dge bsnyen rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ /gus pa sngon 'gros mchid gsol pa/ /zhes sogs kyi 'phrin yig mdzad/ jo bo phar thegs pa'i phyags phyir byon te ci 'gor mdzad/lo tsā bas ci mgyogs mdzad pas mang yul gyi bar byon/ de'i tshe sa man ste gsum gyi 'khrug pa langs pas bal po'i rdzong 'gags nas ma thon/ de bod kyi bsod nams su byung / jo bos blo mi bde mi dgos sgrub par ma nus pa la nyes pa med gsungs pas lo tsā ba thugs bde ste slar bod du spyan drangs nas mang yul du lha khang dkar po bzhengs/ dbus su chab shog slebs pa dang dge bshes ka pas 'phrin yig tu 'khod pa'i mi chen rnams rgya sar sgang du sum pa ye shes blo gros kyi sar spyan drangs gros mdzad pas khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung zhes bya ba mngon pa la shin tu mkhas shing klu mes pa thams cad kyi 682

gnas brtan mdzad khong las mi che ba che/da pa de'i mtshan ma 'tshud pab/ cha/ mnyes te sngon la jo bo 'thob par bya snyam nas de 'phral byon pas gzhan thams cad kyang myur bar byon pas jo bo phar ma gshegs par slebs/ bod ston rnams tshag zhu ber chen gsol ba'i skya rags gzigs pas mi ma yin mang po byung gsungs nas dbu thum phur/ de nas bod ston rnams kyis snam sbyar gsol te ser sbreng mdzad phyag rten phul bas jo bo mnyes nas phyag mang po mdzad/ der lo tsā ba mang du tshogs pas gang la bya ma mthun pa na khu ston dbang che bas thog mtha' bar gsum du jo bo'i phyir dka' ba spyad pa nag tsho yin gsungs nas gu ling gi chos gos shig phul te lo paṇa du bsdebs dpal thang la tshur 'byon dus mdo khams nas phyis dge bshes dgon pa par grags pa mdzed dbang phyug rgyal mtshan de pham thing pa'i drung du chas pa dang mjal/ byin rlabs zhus pas bar chad 'ong bas ma 'gro ngas chos dang zan sbyar gyi gsungs/longs spyod rnams phul ba la dgon pa pa'i sa tra mdzad/ chos sgo skyel du mdzad nas bskyangs/ de nas mdog tshe snar cig car ba'i lam do ha gsungs pa 'brom gyis bkag mang sgar du bzangs bzhon nu 'bar dang 'brog mi lo tsās spyan drangs/ leng lo tsā'i sa snying lha khang la rab gnas mdzad/ 'khren gyi brag lung gzigs pas byang chub sems dpa' drod thob pa cig bzhugs 'dug gsungs nas phyag mdzad de zangs dkar mdzod khur bzhugs par gda'/ zha lu ri phug tshong dus/ nyan tsho sogs su byon/ yol chos dbang sku mched la thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i skor mang du gsungs pas zla ba drug nas bcu gcig zhal dang rta mgrin zhal gzigs/ der rnal 'byor pa chen por mtshan grags pa'i a mes byang chub de mdo khams smad du 'khrungs/ spun bdun gyi tha chung yin pas bu med pa cig la byin/ der bu zhig skyes nas yang gzhan zhig la 683

byin/ der yang skyes pas bkra shis par grags pa'i tshe yum byung nas khyod rab tu byung ba'i don du skyed pa yin zer nas rab tu byung / mkhan po'i g.yog byed cing yod tsa na 'dir ma sdod dbus su song zer nas bskul te nyin lam gsum tsam du bskyal nas/ bu khyod dbus su phyin nas yang dag pa'i bla ma dang mjal zhing thugs zin nas gdams pa dang rjes bstan gsungs pa tshul bzhin du sgrub par gyur cig de'i tshe nga yang khyod kyi drung du skyes nas ma smad gnyis lhan cig du sangs rgyas sgrub par gyur cig ces smon lam btab nas gyes/ jo bo dang mjal bas de ma thag dam tshig gsum bkod gnang nas bzlas pa stong brgyad brgya song ba dang zhal gzigs/ de phyin jo bo'i nye gnas mdzad/ de nas dbus su byon te byang thang nas lha sa'i nam mkha' la gzigs te 'ja'i gur sum brtsegs dang lha mang pos mchod pa rgyun ma chad par 'dug gsungs/chu bo ri 'di rin po che sna lnga las grub par 'dug gsungs/ 'ching rur bu mo zhig gis rgyan thams cad phul ba myur du shi ba gsan nas gzhung stag dkar gyi gad phug tu zhag lnga bzhugs nas ngan song sbyong chog dang sā tsha mdzad de lhar skyes gsungs/ dol mdar lha rje rags bya ba'i chu rags mdzad de yul 'di nas byang chub sems dpa' sha mtshan can zhig 'byung zhes rog dmar zhur ba lung bstan/ snon mdar ārya de wa'i lha khang la rab gnas mdzad nas bcu gcig zhal 'di la rab gnas khyad par du chags yod pas sgos mchod re gyis gsungs tshong dus kyi lha khang rab gnas mdzad/ phag lo la bsam yas su phyags phebs/ lam yig mnga' rinasakyi sā ra mar phag lo bris nor du byas 'dug kyang / 'di drug bcu re drug bzhes pa'i me mo phag lo yin no/ /byang chub chen po'i sku la rgya gar gyi ma hā po dhi dang khyad mi 'dug gsungs/ sems skyed byang chub gling du byon pa ma mthong bar sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i zhal gyi 684

rdul 'phyi zhing 'dug mar la mi thar ba ltar mdzad de skas la spyan drangs/ pe kur gling gi dkor mdzod byang ngos mar bzhugs/ nub gcig nga'i dad pa de nyams song skyes rabs spyan drongs dang gsungs nas mar me la gzigs/ lha btsun bo dhi rā dzā sogs la rim pa'i cho ga mdzad/ ka chur khu rngog gis zhus nas rigs tshogs gsungs/ mchims phur 'brom la sngags kyi gdams pa mang du gnang / der spyan snga na dge tshul zhig las med tsa na dge slong gzhon nu gnyis byon te gcig gis zad par chu'i ting nge 'dzin gzigs par 'tshal lam zer nas dang por khong rang gi smin mtshams chur song / de nas mched de ngam shod thams cad chur gyur/ gcig gis zad par dkar po gzigs par 'tshal lam zhes smin mtshams nas 'od dkar pos ngam shod thams cad dkar cham song / ting nge 'dzin las langs pa dang yang smin mtshams su 'dus te song /jo bo'i zhal nas pha la pha la ting nge 'dzin bzang gsungs/ yang skabs cig de gnyis byon nas sgyu ma lta bu'i thang ka gzigs par 'tshal lam zhes thang ka phad tse tsam zhig la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa bkra lam me ba zhig dang sgrol ma'i thang ka bkra lam pa zhig gzigs dbu rtser ston mo'i dus dge tshul des de gnyis gar thal zhus pas khong der mi 'ong sa'i lha mo dang shing gi lha mos bshos 'dren pa yin gsungs/ jo bo nyid dbu rtse'i bya mdab kyi nam mkha' la skor ba mdzad pa rgan mo zhig gis mthong / rgya gar nas slob ma zhig gsol ba 'debs pa'i dril bu'i sgra gsan/ a mes kyi thugs la thag ring po nas chos la 'ongs pa bya bas g.yengs pa 'di mi 'ongs bar 'dug snyam pa mkhyen nas 'brom la 'di ni bsam ngan rgyu'o gros thob cig gsungs/ dkor mdzod gling du rgya dpe'i dkor mdzod cig kha phye nas gzigs pas sngar ma gzigs pa'i rgyud mang du snang bas ngas mi yul gyi rgyud rnams su ma 685

sga' 'gro mas bstan pa yang dpag med mthong ste de rnams na yang 'di 3dug gsang sngags 'di la mtha' mngon rgyu yod yod mi 'dra gsungs myal na yod pa'i gsang sngags ma lus pa mkhyen dgongs pa'i thugs rgyal chag slob dpon padmas srin po'i yul sogs nas blangs par nges spyir / dpon padmas nā lend+ra nas rgyud kyi rgya dpe thams cad rdzu 'phrul gyis /sa su blangs pas mang ba yin/ de'i dus kyi bstan pa lta bu rgya gar du sgrung pa 'dug rā dzā bodhis tra gsung zhing yi rang mdzad/ ston pa sa ci tsam song gi gtan rtsis mdzad/ khu ston gyis yar lungs su spyan sa 'brom gyi thugs la khu thugs rgyal che bas zhabs tog thob mi 'ong bang ston la ngas thabs kyis yar lungs nas bsam yas su spyan drang sa khyod kyis rta pas bsus la snye thang du spyan drongs shig zhes chad byas// khang rnying ma la rab gnas kyang mdzad/ thang po cher ra brtsigs khang kas te nyi khri snang ba dang byams chos phyi ma gsum la sogs mang du de nas khu ston rang lha sdings su bzhugs ste mtha'i mi bya ba grangs dgo ska zer nas zhabs tog tho ba yang ma byas/ 'brom dang a mes la / se byas pas a mes kyis nye gnas mi bgyid par zhus pas ma gnang // ston pas zhu grogs mdzad pas deng rgya gar na yin na grogs rnal ma ngas pho nyas dbang du byas te dgug dgos pa'i tshod yin gsung zhing da nas dbu dkar po a me'i pang du bzhag ste nga rgya gar shar du skyes skud du skyes pa de las kyis 'phrad pa yin/ nga'i mgo 'di ltar song / kyis 'jog phod na nye gnas ka ma byed gsungs pas mchi ma phrul na ji srid bzhugs kyi bar bgyid par zhu zer/ 'brom gyis khu ston /ra 'dug pas bdag dbu rur mchi lags sam zhus pas/ u pa sā

ka bzhubs na kho bo'ang bzhugs/ u pa sā ka bzhud na kho bo'ang bzhud gsungs/ jo bo khu ston gyis gtong na dbu ru na snye thang bya ba nags tshal dang ni sing rgyas pa dgun yang me tog skye ba zhig bzhugs sar mchis zhus pas/khus mi tshor ba'i thabs bzang po yod da lta rang gshegs gsungs nas de nub grabs byas nang par tho rengs gshegs/ jo bos mi zhig la khu ston gyi rtsar song la jo bo dbu rur gshegs so zhes gyis shig gsungs nas sa la ri mo zhig mdzad nas de bsubs pa dang mi des dgon par phyin yang res ma rtol res brjod nas lan bya ba ma byung / khu ston sngar phyir skyo seng la 'byon pa la de nyin sgo bldams nas lan ma ster/ thos kyang rta bye nag de sngar skad thos pa dang drung du 'ong ba la de nyin phra shags byas nas ma zin/ zin nas rta pa mang pos bsnyeṭa te byon/ 'on gyi gru la dge bshes ston pa dpon g.yog sngon la byon/ de nas jo bo byon pa'i gru mdo ma gang tsam 'phags pa dang khu ston rang sngon la byon nas bzhugs par zhus bas ma gnang bar mchod gnas su dbu zhwa rgyang gis bskyur/ jo bos 'on khru snar bzhugs te rgan mo zhig gis zla gcig chos 'khor btsugs pa'i srol yun ring du byung / de nas bsam yas su phebs phal chen la sogs pa rgya gar na med pa'i dpe du ma bris nas bskur/ der dge bshes ston pa la phrang ka ber chung gi gdan 'dren byung bas da 'ong mi khom jo bo sku na mtho zhing sku gcong mnga' bas zhabs tog gal che/ nga jo bo dang shi bral byed/ de nas ma shi na khyed kyi mchod gnas bya'o de bar 'di rnams dgongs shig zhes chos kyi tshigs bcad bskur/ sngon po ṭa lar phyag na rdo rjes bskul nas mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i phyir spyan ras gzigs kyis dkrong skyed du bzhengs pa'i gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi sku rigs gsum mgon pos rab gnas mdzad/ bde ba can lcang lo can po ṭa la ri bo rtse lnga rnams su lo lnga brgya re bzhugs nas 'od 687

dpag med la sogs pa'i thugs dam gyi rten mdzad/ de nas o rgyan du ind+ra bo dhi lcam lakṣa/ klu mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis lo lnga bcu re mchod/ sa ra has lo sum bcu/ klu sgrub kyis lo nyis brgya/ zla grags kyis lo brgya/ bīrla bas lo sum bcu/ mi tra pas lo nyi shur thugs dam gyi rten mdzad/ de nas li yul du chos rgyal dkon mchog 'phel gyis sum bcur mchod/ de nas rgyal po dge ba'i blo gros kyis mchod nas lo lnga bcu lon pa na jo bo rgya gar nas bod du 'byon pa'i tshe jo bo yab sras kyi sprul pa 'brog pa pha pad gnyis kyis khal sum bcu tsam ded nas sku chas rna 64 bi kra ma nas bal por bskyal ba'i tshe sprul pa'i khye'u 'brog phrug gi rnam pa des jo bo'i bka' 'phrin khyer nas mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i phyir bzhengs pa'i lha de skur zhig ra sgreng gi gtsug lag khang ka ba brgya dang bzhi bcu lhag par bzhugs te me tog shang shang gi tshal/ spang spos dang shug ba'i nags/ chu bo'i mchod yon/ bya tshogs kyi sgra snyan/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun rnams kyis rtag tu mchod cing 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bkur sti bya'o zhes gsungs pas rgyal pos 'phreng bzhin du nyin lam du mar bskyal te bal por khye chung des phad bu'i nang du bcug nas rten gsum thams cad kyi steng du bzhag pas gzhan rnams kyis 'bar bas/ 'phyor po ma la mi dgos kyang / /'brog stong yul du dgos dus yod/ /gzhan la mi reg rgyang nge 'jog /zer nas nam mkha' rten med la bzhag pas ngo mtshar nas ci yod dris pas/ ma bskor dgu bskor rgyags phye yod/ /mi lag brgyud pa'i snying po yod/ /su la'ang ma brin nga mkho yod/ /'bag 'bug med pa'i mi chung yod/ /'khyog 'gul med pa'i lag pa yod/ /gang la'ang mi 'phog mda' gzhu yod/ /ma tshogs dgu tshogs lag cha yod/ /'di na ma yod degu yod do/ /zhes smras pa'i byis pa'i rtsed mo zhig yod par 'dug zer skad/ de ltar 688

spyan drangs pa'i rten 'jam pa'i rdo rje yang bskur te da lta'ang ra sgreng gi rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs so/ /de nas bang ston gyis rta pa nyis brgyas bsus te bsam yas phu'i la la byon/ de dus mis phul ba'i rta phyugs mang du yod pas thugs 'dod che bar sgrog pa yang byung / 'di rnams mi 'tshong bar zhus pas khyed pha ma rgan rgon yang 'tshong ngam gsungs/ bsam yas kyi la la rta rgan zhig gi lag pa rdza bar du 'tshud nas ma thon par lus pa mkhyen te 'don du btang / rngog legs shes lha sar spyan drangs/ mi dkar po cig sngun bsur byung ste ma hā paṇḍita byon pa legs so rgyal bar gyur cig gsungs jo bo de ma thag chibs las bab ste phyag thal mo sbyar mdo 'don gyin mgyogs par 'phrul snang du bzhud/mi de thugs rje chen po yin par 'dug byin rlabs zhu bar 'dod de ma zin 'di la thim gsungs nas rang byung thugs rje chen po'i drung na bzhugs te spyan ras gzigs dngos su 'dug gsungs/ jo bo shākya gzigs pas sprul pa'i sku dngos su 'dug gsungs nas 'dra 'bag gi sku yang bris te thugs dam gyi rten mdzad/yod smra'i sde pa la spyi bshags yod dam zhus pas khyed rang gi slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas mdzad pa yod gsungs nas gnang ste mi shes pa dang brjed pas byas pa'i ltung ba rnams 'dis 'dag gsungs/ phal chen pa'i sde pa cig gzug sa gsung ba la ston pas bkag pas nga sde pa gzugs dbang yang med/ gsang sngags dang do ha yang bshad dbang med na kho bo 'ongs pa la don ma mchis gsungs/lha sar ya mtshan gyi rtags mang po yang gzigs/ rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma mang po dang yang mjal/ dgra bcom pa cig kyang 'dug bod na dur khrod kyi gnas cig yod par bshad pa 'di yin par 'dug khyad par gsang sngags sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mchog yin gsungs nas thugs tshim pa med par skor ba dang sgrub pa mdzad/ jo bo zhabs sa la mi reg pa rngog gis gzigs nas zhus pas kho bo 689

la rgya gar na yang de ltar grags gsungs/ /skor ba mdzad cing gtsug lag khang 'di'i lo rgyus shig 'ong thang dgongs pa na sprang mo smyon ma zer ba zhig na re lkog pha gir gshegs 'tshal zer te 'di'i lo rgyus shig 'tshal lam gsung /rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor mar mkhyen te cis kyang 'tshal zhus pas/ 'o na ka ba bum pa can nas 'dom phyed dang gsum gzhal ba na yod gzhan la ma smra zhig gsungs/ 'don par brtsigs pas gter srung gnyan po cig 'dug ste de ring tsam zin zhig 'brir btang gzhan mi ster zer nas rnal 'byor pa dang ston pa sogs bzhis snag smyug ci rnyed kyis bris pas lhag dum zhig lus/ de rnal 'byor pa la gnang nas su la yang ma ston zhig gsungs/ phyis bya yul bas thugs rje chen po'i che ba'i yon tan zhig dkon gnyer la gtad/ gzhan gdung khang du bcug skad/ de nas zhag gnyis na rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma lha rnams kyis bsus nas gshegs gsungs te rnal 'byor pas phyin pas grongs ma thag du 'dug lha sar dgun cig bzhugs nas dbyar rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis yer par spyan drangs te ba rang du bzhugs/ gnas brtan dad pa bla mas jo bo'i gzims khang du dmigs pa cig brtsigs par zhag gcig bzhugs te gzims khang du grags/ zhang btsun 'ol rgod 'bar gyis bsnyen bkur cher byas nas gdams pa zhus pas/ tshe yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / tshe tshad kyang mi shes pas khyod kyis sgoms shig bsgoms pas mang po mang po go ba yin/mnyan pas nyung ngu nyung ngu las mi gro khyod sgrub pa snying por gyis shig gsungs/der dge bshes ston pas gser zho dgu la srang rer byas pa'i srang brgya rtsa brgyad/ rta nyi shu rtsa gcig bla gor gyi gzhong pa la sogs nor sna brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ bod du nyin gcig gi 'bul ba la che bar grags/ jo bo'i sku che ba'i yon tan 'brom gyis bsdebs pa de yang tshogs su bklags pas 'o na nga la 690

yo/'o tan de las med dam gsungs nas chos la dka' spyad mdzad tshul dang gyi ba pa nyams su blangs tshul cung zad gsungs te khyed kyis dka' ba ma spyang par chos zab mo rnyed pa don che yis legs par spyod cig gsungs/ yang rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang gi rnam thar zur tsam gsungs nas bla ma de la 'dong pa med kyang rten 'brel gyi che ba yin pas bla ma'i zhabs tog dgos pa yin gsungs/ bla gor gyi gzhong sgor de jo bo'i gsol sder mdzad nas phyis shangs mtshal gyis nyid kyi sku 'dra phyag bris su mdzad nas dad pa'i rten du bzhag ste da lta yer pa ra ba na bzhugs/ dar yul mngon shes pa bya ba 'dres yi dam du brdzus nas lung bstan 'chad pa des rngog la g.yu rngan par byin te grogs bcol nas mjal du byung ba la khu ston gyis jo bo'i sku skye snga phyi sogs dris pas mang po cig shar gyis byung / der khus 'gram pa g.yas g.yon du gar gong dang sran kya bcug nas 'o na nga'i 'gram pa g.yas g.yon na ci yod dris pas ma shes par skyengs te song bas phyis bar chad de ma byung zhing bod na sngar de 'dra mang po yod pa phyis 'phrig tshud nas nyung ngur gyur/ lan pa'i lcil bor zla ba gcig bzhugs/ byis pa cig la byin rlabs mdzad nas gzhan la phan pa cig 'ong gsungs te phyis lcang phyi'i nyang mi chen por snang / bran gas bar chad brtsams pas ma tshugs par rta mgrin shā na bzhi skor gyi sgo nas btul/ 'phan yul du spyan drangs pas rta ro dmar po kha phye ba 'dra ba 'dir mi 'gro gsungs nas ma byon/ rta phyugs dang gra khal thams cad yer pa'i rtswa kha la ri dwags ltar yan du bcug snye thang du spyan 'dren pa'i tshe bang ston la bal 'khor bzhi dang nas sran khal brgyad las med pa la sring mo ban rma phyug mo zhig na re lo paṇa spyan 'dren pa la yo byad ci yod zer/ sna len ldang tsam yod/ de nas a ti sha yid bzhin gyi nor bu yin pas khong rang las 'ong rang re gnyis kyang jo bo'i 691

thab la zos pas chog gi khyod rang yang gang yod phul zhig byas pas des yo byang btang ste sna len dpe med pa grub/ khong rang gi bal 'khor bzhi sogs phul/bang ston gyi mi chos 'jangs pa rnams kyis nas bong rgyab 'jangs nas snye thang du 'brel yang da dung ma rdzogs pa phul/ de nas ban mo la jo bo'i dad rdzas khyod kyis mi 'ju zer nas bang ston gyis zar ma bcug jo bo'i gsol zho skul gyi phu nas sbrengs pas de phyin yul de la phyugs nad dang gcan gzan ma byung /de'i tshe bod khams gsum gling dgu'i mi chen thams cad tshogs nas chos mang po zhus/ lha btsun pas bod kyi rab byung thams cad la mkhan rgyud ded sham thabs khral bsdus nas snye thang na mo cher 'bul ba chen po byas te 'brom stong btsan nam mkha' bya ba bod na gzugs mdzes pa cig gis phyag tu 'bul du bcug yang de la btsun mo rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sogs rgyal srid sna bdun yang phul/ brgyad stong pa jo bo nyid kyis gang mkhyen pa cig zhus pa la phya dar ston pas zin bris byas pas phar phyin khams lugs su grags pa shin tu rtsis che ba de byung / sna chung ston pa sogs bzhis jo bo la grub mtha' zhig zhus pas phyi pa'i 'jug pa lnga dang nang pa'i gcig ces pa la bsten pa tho re ba zhig gsungs nas de thams cad rnam par rtog pa yin tshe thung 'di la rnam rtog bgrang gis mi lang bas snying po bsdus mdzod gsungs/ snying po ji ltar bsdu zhus pas/ sems can thams cad la snying rjes khyab par gyis/ de ma bzod pas byang chub tu sems skyed/ de 'grub pa'i ched du tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzod/ de'i dge ba sems can thams cad la thun mong du bsngo bar mdzod/phyi nang gi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur goms par gyis/ de lta/ra gyis la snying po bsdus mdzod gsungs/ gcig gis ci yang ma byas par 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs zhus pas/ byung na kho bo yang 'dod de tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs pa'i 692

sangs rgyas kho bos mi shes gsungs/ bod ston kha cig gis chos zhu bar byas pas zhang sna chung ston pa na re jo bo la chos zhus tshad la byang chub kyi sems sbyongs bya ba las mi 'ong byas pas gsan nas khyod re bden/ nga la rgya gar na yang khyod 'dra ba man ngag la dga' zhing sgrub pa la mi dga' ba'i slob ma zhig yod kho yang byang chub kyi sems la yid ma 'ches zhes grags pa'i cha'i gtam rgyud gsungs/ dge bshes ston pas jo bo la zla grags lugs kyi rtogs pa phul bas jo bo thal mo shar phyogs su sbyar te da lta rgya gar shar phyogs na lta ba 'di kho na 'dzin/ khyod lta bu'i sems can chen po bod na yod pa bod bsod nams re mi chung / kho bo 'ong mi dgos par 'dug pa la gsungs nas gdams pa shas shig gnang / 'brom la dgun me tog 'char ba zhig yod zer ba de ga re gsungs/ na mo cher spyan drangs nas gsing ma'i me tog bstan pas rdzun ma btang tsam 'dug me tog la dga' na me tog 'byung bar bya'o gsungs nas phyogs der me tog khyad par can mang po byung / na mo cher jo bo skyo bsang mdzad cing dud 'gro kun la rta'i bu chung sku khams bde'am ra'i bu chung sku khams bde'am gsungs/ khyad par khyi gu rnams phyag du bsnams shing khyi'i bu chung sku khams bde'am lus ngan 'di lta bu len pa khyed rang gis nongs khyed rang gis nongs gsungs/ res 'dze sprang kun la bag chags ngan gsungs nas shangs skyor/ res 'dze sprang gi gseb tu bzhugs te pham phabs gnang zhing byams snying rje sgom/ khu ston gyis jo bos kyang mi chen po mi mkhyen par gda' de ltar mdzad pa ma lags zhus pas/ bod kyi mi chen gyis dgos pa med nga'i byams snying rje la gnod gsungs/ nyin cig de ring su yang ma gtong zhig gsungs te rgya gar nag chung gis 'bul ba byed du btang zer ba'i mi khres chung can zhig byung ba de btang bas khres po'i nang nas lcags kyi sbar mo zhig 'ur 693

gyis song bas jo bo'i sku rgyab kyi rtsig ngos la tham song nas phri li li 'dug ste mu stegs kyi ngan sngags kyis ma tshugs gsungs/ yang rgya gar nas dge slong shin tu btsun pa sbyangs yon dang ldan pa gnyis byung jo bos gang zag gi bdag med gsungs pa na thal mo sbyar nas nyan/ chos kyi bdag med gsungs pa na a ti sha 'jigs 'jigs mi gsung bar zhu zer nas rna ba 'gebs/ shes rab snying po 'don pa thos na yang rna ba 'gebs pas jo bo thugs chad de byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs pa'i tshogs khyad par can la 'bad pa ma byas na srung sdom dag la gcig pus gar yang mi phyin par 'dug gsungs/ yang tsong kha'i rgyal po la longs spyod yod tshul sogs zhus pas bod na dge slong bzhi sde la 'tsho ba drangs pa'i bsod nams la spyod pa su'ang mi 'dug gsungs/yang rgya gar gyi 'bul skyel la dris pas ngo mtshar gyi gtam rnal 'byor pa cig gis lo bcu gnyis 'chag pas grub pa thob ste da lta sku lus mang por sprul nas byams snying rje las brtsam/sa ste chos gsung zhing gda'/ yang rnal 'byor ma zhig gis maṇḍal lnga phul bas de las padma'i sdong po re skyes me tog shar nas zhag bdun du so le sdod pa cig yod zer/ dge bshes dgon pa bas dbu mdzad jo bo'i bla mchod rnams bur gyi nyams dga' mor bzhugs pas bla mchod rnams kyi zhal lta gsungs nas yang yang 'byon/ dgon pa ba la nub cig 'ur sgra chen po'i rjes la sa 'og nas sdig pa chen po cig byung nas jo bo la gsol ba btab pas med song / sang jo bo snga bar byon nas mdang khyod nga spron pa ci byung gsungs/ byung tshul zhus pas mi g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor srung ba'i skor gnang /bsam gtan pa'i gnas yin gsungs nas dgon pa kun la phyag mdzad/ 'di na mi me/da zhus kyang phyingashe sgom mkhan 'ong ste mchi/ kho bo sgom pa la dga' kho bo la sgo co/ phru ga ma byung / bod du 'ongs pa don med gsungs / khyed rang yang 694

ri 3/ sgoms gsungs/ 'dre 'ong zhus pas khyed rang tshul khrims ca le co ler song ba min nam/ nged rgya gar na 'dre'i gseb tu sgom pa yin/ nga'i slob ma zhig la 'dre'i bar chad byung ba stong nyid du bsgoms pas zhi 'dug gsungs/res gcig pur bsdad pa 'dres khyer ba mang zhes kyang gsungs/ rngog gis dbang skur ma byas par sgrub thabs chang chung mnyan du rung ngam zhus pas byang chub kyi sems brtan po yod na de tsam rung / bod kyi dbang skur gyis dbang skur gyi go mi chod par snang / bod dad pa che bas snong rung gi slob ma yod srid dbang bskur nus kyis slob dpon mi 'dug gsungs/ rngog phyis kyang gsung 'di la yid 'ches so gsung skad/ yang chos zhus pa na dad pa dad pa dad pa kho na gal che gsungs/ bcud len zhus pas kho bo ni byang chub kyi sems bcud du len gsungs/ chos gos gyon pa gding ba 'dings pa nam gung la nyal ba rnams la sangs rgyas kyi rjes su bslab snyam pa'i dus dran re med na nyes pa 'byung ste bod kyi rab byung la ci cha gsungs/ sems skyed zhu ba tshan gcig la ston pa 'di kun la chos zhu ba'i rgyags 'dug ste mchod pa'i yo byad mi 'dug gsungs/ khams pa tshan gcig la dge bshes ston pas lo tsā bsgyur te rgyu byin rlabs nas bzung rab gnas kyi gdams pa gnang / slob ma so sos zhus te khro bo mi g.yo ba sogs dang gser gling pa'i a ra pa tsa na sogs dang jo bo nyid kyi spyan ras gzigs zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs dang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i mdo sogs dang 'jig rten dbang phyug khradma pa ṇa'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa sogs dang / ārya de wa'i spyan ras gzigs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sgrub thabs sogs ches mang po 'brom dang lo tsā bas bsgyur/ lo tsā ba mchims phur dge sbyor la byon pa rong pa 'gar dge sogs ston chen mang du byon pas dge bshes ston pas bos te ma rgyud kyi gdams pa mang du bsgyur 695

ro/ /da bu g.yor gtsang gsum gyis zhus te byang sa dang byams chos la sogs pa bsgyur zhing bslab spyod sogs spyi ltar gsungs/ lo tsā bas jo bo'i chos rnams khungs phyung zhing dge bshes ston pas gsan/ bod kyi bstan bcos mang po gzigs su phul bas a ro'i theg chen rnal 'byor ma gtogs gzhan la ma mnyes/de phan chad bod yul gyi sa la lo bdun dang zla ba lnga bzhugs nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi glu dang 'khor ba las nges 'byung gi glu dang bde ba drug gi glu dang byang chub sems kyi glu sogs mgur du bzhes pa ma gtogs chos tsam mi gsungs/ mtshan mo phal cher mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs su gsang sngags zab mo'i don lta ba rdo rje'i glu dang spyod pa rdo rje'i glu dang sgom pa rdo rje'i glu dang rdo rje chos kyi glu sogs mgur du bzhes pa bla mas gnang nas lo tsā bas bsgyur/ lo tsā bas mchims phur zo gsod zhus pas gnang nas zla ba drug bzhugs/ jo bo bsnyung ba re byung thugs dam gyi lha re zhal gzigs shing dwangs/ de lta bu lan mang du byung / spyir snye thang du zhal gzigs mang / khyad par zla ba nya'i nub gcig la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' gzigs/ de nas nub re bzhin gzigs/ nyin gcig rlung chen po cig la jo bo maṇḍal mdzad cing phyag ser ga shig ge yod pa la jo mo sgrol ma byon nas da de tsam gyi dka' ba bgyi ga na 'tshal gsungs/ yang mnal lam du bud med kyi rgyan gyi sil khrol gsan pas lta mi rung dgongs nas ma gzigs tsa na khyod ma la yang mi gzigs sam gsungs 'phral sad tsa na sgrol ma rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa cig mngon sum du gzigs skad/ nga rmi lam du sgrol ma la yang ma'i 'du shes sgom pa yin te jo mo rang 'di na bzhugs pa dpang po yin gsungs te sgrol ma'i thang sku la phyag mdzub btsugs pa de da lta ra sgreng na yod skad/ yang gzims chung du gdugs tshod kyi bshos 'dren du byon pas spyan nam mkha' la gzigs 696

sge sa mi rta mi tram̐ gsung bas log yang de bzhin du 'dug ste dge bshes ston rdzu/sa a che/ la jo bo'i 'tsho ba de grangs su ma gzhug par sros shig jo bon byams pa zhal gzegs chod du 'dug 'o skol gnyis kyis mthong dus ni med gsungs gung yol khar nga'i chos ston khyer la shog gsungs te ji ltar lags zhus pas/ mee rta bhi kho ri gsung / dro thon nas da nang nas rje btsun byam sa pa dang 'jam dpal gnyis mdun gyi nam mkha' 'dir byon theg pa chen po'i chos la bgro ba mdzad/ phyag rdor gyis bar chad spung / lha'i bu rnams kyis zin bris byas/ da de 'bri dgos gsung nas phyag bris mdzad/ ngas 'di 'dra zh-iXg mthong bas 'di dang byang chub chen po pu ri ma dang yi ge drug pa brag ri ma gsum bris la tshur skur zhes bṛ ka ma lar bskur bas rgya gar shar phyogs nas paṇḍi ta mkhas pa bos nas bris te bskur byung ba snye thang na yod skad/ yang sangs rgyas thams cad gdul bya la gang 'dul du bstan pa las rang mdog gser mdog 'dug gsungs nas rigs lnga ser 'jam du mdzad/ de dus khams ston rmā chen rga chung gnyis ba ri ba sogs rgya gar du lam rgyus dang 'phral skad dang byin rlabs zhur byung bas byin rlabs mdzad/ khyed rang la bar chad med gzhan la phan thogs par 'ong ba 'dug gis bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i spyan sngar song zhig gsungs/ de'i dus chos thams cad kyang zhal chems su gsung zhing dharma a lo ka yam chos bya ba'i dus yin gsungs/ gsang sngags kyi lam 'di sbrul smyug dong du bcug pa'am glang po che'i sna la ral gri btags pa dang 'dra ste khe nyen che ba yin gsungs/ bod kyis rgyud sde bzhi ga longs spyad mi nus bod la rnal 'byor rgyud 'tshams gsungs/ gzims khang gi sgo bsdams tshe phyir gdugs la bzhugs gdang bas dge bshes ston pas a ti sha rtsig pa la thogs pa med mchi skad na med dam zhes zhus pas rgya gar na de skad du grags 697

gsung zhing sku gshegs kur khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la bzhud pa kun gyis mthong / rgya gar nas slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i dril bu'i sgra dang lhas mchod pa'i rol mo'i sgra rnams gsan gsungs/ nga'i bla ma rnams dga' ldan na bzhugs/ nga yang dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs/ de lta bu mang du gsung bas dge bshes ston pas 'di na ngo mtshar gyi gtam mang zhes lo tsā ba spyan drangs/sngon na ro pa'i slob ma paṇḍi ta dzñā na kā ra la 'phags skor gyi man ngag zhig zhur yod pa de yid la bcags so gsung bas lo tsā bas bal por mi mtho btsugs nas bzhag pas paṇḍi ta de byon/ rgya gar la 'byon pa 'dug pas myur du byon zer ba byung / lo tsā bas de snyan bskul bas de ltar yin yang kho bo ni rgas pas nyan pa'i mthu med/ khyod 'bod pa cig 'ong gis de'i dus song la chos de nyon/ de'i bar 'u cag 'grog nga yang da ste zla ba bcu tsam na dga' ldan du byams pa'i drung du 'gro sems can kun rtag tu gcig por 'gro ba yin pas 'u cag kyang rtag tu mi 'grogs song gsungs/ lo tsā bas bdag gis jo bo 'bor mi nus par gda' bas mi 'chi bar zhu zhus pas/ theg pa chen po'i chos la bar chad mang bas khyod cis kyang 'gro dgos/ de'i bar du mchod pa dang gsol ba thob gsungs/ zla ba gcig na slob dpon rgyal rin gyis pho nya gnyis la myur du byon zer ba byung nas/ jo bos nga yang dga' ldan du lha'i bu nam mkha' dri med bya bar 'gyur/ khyod kyis nga'i lus tshad du gzugs brnyan legs par bris/ nga dga' ldan nas khug la rab gnam gyis/ gsol ba thob nga dga' ldan nas 'ong ba yin no/ /da dung zla gcig sdod la gsol ba thob gsungs te zla ba phyed dang gnyis su mchod cing gsol ba btab/ de'i dus bod ston thams cad 'dus nas jo bo'i rnam srol sus 'dzin zer bas lo tsā ba'i gsung nas/chos thams cad nas yon tan bla ma gas skye bar bshad 'dug bla ma'i zhabs 698

tog 'brom gyi 'dra ba sus kyang ma grub/ jo bo'i srol 'brom ston pas 'dzin thang gsungs pas thams cad ma dag /'a/ 'brom sto na 'dra bal zer te phyis de kho na yin par snang / de nas jo pos lo tsa ba da song gsungs te lo tsā bas bla ma dbakhun ldan gyi gnas nas bdag la gzigs su gsol byin gyis brlab tu gsol spyan ras kyis btsar gsol bla ma nyid sku'i gzugs brnyan du 'byon par zhu 'tshal zhes gsol ba btab/ jo bos kyang de ltar bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ 'brom gyis kyang mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba sogs zhal gdams su mdzad de lo tsā ba byon/ rnal 'byor pa chen pos bdag bsod nams chung bas bla ma'i zhabs tog las sgom rgyu ma byung snyam pa na jo bo'i zhal nas sgo gsum bla ma'i zhabs tog la bkol na sgom gyi dmigs pa gzhan nas btsal mi dgos gsungs te phyis dge shes dgon pa ba'i gsung nas slob dpon ston pas lo tsā byas/slob dpon rnal 'byor pas g.yog byas/ ngas bsgoms pa yin te rtogs pa de khong gnyis mtho bar 'dug gsung skad/ a tsa ra zhig gi drung na gser cung zad yod pa 'di skyel du rnal 'byor pa gtong dgos/ nad med pa ni bde ba'i mchog /dga' ba byin pa sbyin pa'i mchog /mya ngan 'das pa bde ba'i mchog /blo gtad thub pa grogs kyi mchog /gsungs/ 'brom gyis khong mi gtong bar zhus kyang kho bsam pa bzang bas don 'grub 'ong gsungs nas gser srang sum bcu'i ko thum dang gzhan shas cig la byin rlabs shig bya bas ma reg zhig gsung ba la gcig gis reg pas bar chad cig 'ong bar 'dug ste mi tshugs par 'dug gi gsungs/ rnal 'byor pas jo bo dang da mi mjal snyam nas mtshan rangs bshums pas spyan kun tho ba tsam du song skad/ bar chad lan gsum du byung yang skyon med du bi kra ma lar 'khyol/ jo bo sku 'da' gar mi re la zhal chems re gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa dang dgon pa gas da man ji ltar bgyi zhus — (9zhu

pas/ 'jig rten blos thong / tshe mjug 'di ston pa chen po dang ma bral ba gyes gsungs/ ci lags zhus pas ngas byin gyis brlabs pa yin gsungs/phyango/ khri mchog gis jo bo 'das nas bdag gis bshad dam zhus pas bya ba ngan pa 'phro chod gsungs/ sgom mam zhes dang / goXm yang sgom bshad kyang bshad dam zhus/ kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ dben ba gyis gsungs/ sems bzang po med na thos bsam sgom gsum ci byas kyang don med pas sem — bzang po gyis gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa la shing rta'i srol gsum gyi skyes bu chen po'i chos lugs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyi shing rta chen po'i lam 'di khyod la gtad kyis zung zhig ces dang / da ni gung thang pa yang yar la song / /a mes dam pa rgya gar yul du chas/ khu rngog la sogs che ba rang sar skyong / khyod kyi drung na kho bo dgong nyi tsam/ /yin min kun gyi mgo ltag 'byed pa'i dus/ /snying po thams cad gcig tu dril ba'i dus/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gcig tu sprug pa'i dus/ /'brom rje thub pa'i bstan pa lnga stong gnas/ /'on kyang bod du chos spyod ji ltar dar/ /bdag gis bstan pa dkrong skyed byas pa yin/ /da ni legs par gzhi bzhengs tshar ba yis/ /chos 'di legs par skyongs shig rgyal ba 'brom/ /mtha' rgya byang nas skyed cig snying stobs can/ /pho rus rnam thar zung zhig khrel gzhung can/ /pha gcig bu gcig yin no snying la sogs/ /gung thang pa ni bla ma gnyis pa 'chol/ /'brom rje khyod nyid kho bo gcig bu sems/ /sbrul gyi lpags pa brjes kyang sbrul mi rje/ kho bo 'chi tshul bstan yang a ti sha/ /bdag gi bstan pa 'di ni khyod la gtad/ /lo skor gcig gi nang du byang phyogs su/ /chos kyi char pa phob la gzhan don mdzod/ /de nas khyod kyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /gang zag gcig bi/sa blang bar mi nus kyi/ /las tshan brgyad bcur bgos la mtha' 700 ོ

rgya skyed/ /gtso bo sprul pa'i sku mched gsum po la/ /gzhung dang man ngag thun mong gsum byin la/ /lhag chad med par rang gi gdan sa gtod/ /gnas kyi gdan sar a mes chen po skos/ /de nas zhen zhing chags par ma byed par/ /dga' ldan gnas su bdag gi drung du shog /ces 'brom la bstan pa btad/ jo bo'i bkas bla mchod rnams man chad kyis bshes gnyen pa la/dbu mdzad rnal 'byor pa bzhis sna drangs nas/ /sna thag sor bzhi de ring 'brom la gtod/ /hral hrul thams cad mi tshe byang du 'byid/ /tshe mjug nyi ma'i 'de sa byang du bya/ /zhes mgo lus phul/ de yang glegs bam nas gsungs pa ltar na yer par zab chos rnams bgro ba rdzogs nas sgrol mas snye thang du bskul/ lam du lha sar thub pa'i zhal nas mar me mdzad khyod kyis rdo rje'i gdan nas 'dir 'ongs sems can mang po'i don byas bstan pa nyin mor byas pas da ni dga' ldan na don che bas sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab tu zhog la dga' ldan du 'byon par gnang ngo gsungs/ sgrol mas kyang da ni dga' ldan du smon lam btab pa'ang grub par nye'o gsungs/ snye thang du phebs te khrums zla'i bco lnga nas bzung dbyug gu'i bco brgyad kyi bar nyin re zhing 'da' ba'i ltas re snang ste/ de yang bco lnga'i nyin bdud ris rnams dga' zhing spro ba/ bcu drug la lha rnams smre sngags 'don pa/ de bzhin du gar yang bag mi phebs pa dang / shar ri'i rtser drang srong lo stong lon pa cig smon lam grub pa ngas jo bo bzhugs par gsol ba ma thebs so zhes ngu ba dang / sto ri'i rtser bram ze tshe bskal pa bgrangs pa zhig jo bo rgyal ba gshegs so zhes ngu ba dang / nub ri'i rtse na drang srong lo stong lon pa zhig rgyal ba myur du 'da'o zhes ngu ba dang /sgrol ma mya ngan mdzad pa dang / byang ri'i rtser gnod sbyin rnams mya ngan byed pa dang / la rnams 'ja' tshon gyi lam 'chos pa dang / yi dwags rnams gtor ma ha 701
