chad pa'i sems khral byed pa dang / dga' ldan du 'dir mgon po 'khrung zhes sprul pa'i padma la dga' bas skor ba dang / 'ur zhing sa g.yos pa'i gseb nas padma byung ba la jo bo bzhugs te lha bzhis spyan 'dren par rtsom pa dang / sa dang rtsi shing thams cad dus min du mdangs yal bas mya ngan ltar ston pa dang / chu rnams thogs shing mya ngan gyi sgra 'byin pa dang / bya dang ri dgas rnams mya ngan byed pa dang / gnam stong gi nyin dam tshig gsum bkod la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor bas sras kyi dbugs 'byin mdzad/ 'di yan chad ni dge bshes ston pa nyid kyis gzigs pa ste lha'i mig dag pa rnams kyi yul lo/ /tshur mthong gi dpyod ldan 'ga' res dge bshes thugs brel ba la som nyi tsam byung / dbyug gu'i tshes gcig la kun gyis mthong bar lha bzhi'i kha dog gi sprin so so phyogs bzhi nas 'khrigs te 'ja' 'od kyis gang / me tog gi char 'bab rol mo sna tshogs sgrog par thos/ 'brom gyis rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kyis bar snang gang / jo bo rgyan can du bzhengs pas shes phyin gsung zhing nyan pa'i sems dpa' mang pos dbugs 'byin par gzigs/ de bzhin du sa rdo ri brag thams cad shes phyin gyi sgrar 'ur zhing gzhan ngor 'ur sgra chen po gra gasprin gug dkar po cig dbu thog tu yal ma thag zab mo lta rgyud kyi bla ma rnams byon nas dbugs phyung / ltas chen po dang bcas nas bla ma thig ler thim pa dang rgyal ba'i skur bzhengs pa dang rdo rjeri glu dri lan du ma mdzad cing sgrol mas dbugs phyung / dbyug gu'i tshes bzhi nas dgu'i bar du thub pa/ sgrol ma/bde mchog mkha' 'gro blo ma rna mas kyis lung bstan bskul te bzhugs par zhus/ bde gshegs brgyad kyis nabugs phyung bcu la nang gi lha tshogs thams cad tshogs 'khor mdzad/ bcu gcig nas bla ma sku cung zad bsnyun par bstan/ bcu gsum la sku'i bkod pas phyogs thams cad bkang ste thig ler stu 702

ba dang bzhengs par bstan/ bcu bzhi la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la sogs pa thams cad byon mchod pa shoms/ kho bo 'chi bar gda' lhan skyes kyi lha yang ngu zhing 'dug gsungs te 'brom gyis lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa phyogs kun na mya ngan byed pa gzigs pas cung zad brgyal/ bla ma dang sgrol mas dbugs phyung zheng / khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sde la gyis/ a mes byang chub kyis mayo/ byas tha mal gyi rnam tog mi rgyu ba'i dge slong bzhi sde re la 'tsho ba drongs/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde zhig tshugs/ nga zer ba yin gyis la khyod rang gnyer ga byed lo gyis dang / 'di la byed pa po zhig 'ong gis gsungs/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbugs phyung / bla ma dang sangs rgyas thams cad thig ler gyur pa'i thig le 'brom gyi thugs gar thim/ ci zhig na gzugs skur bzhengs so/ /nya la 'brom la yer pa'i brag ri 'gyel ba dang jo bo la sa gzhi bar snang 'brom gyi sras kyis gang bar rmis te dri lan mdzad/ mthar yab sras dbyer med du thig ler gyur pa las slar so sor bzhengs so/ /de ltar lo gcig dang khyad par khrums kyi bco lnga nas dbyug gu'i bco brgyad kyi bar nyin re zhing 'brom gyi sprul pa dpag tu med pas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba las sku dngos kyi gdul bya med pa'i phyir bzhugs par zhal gyis ma bzhes kyang de srid du gzugs sku'i snang brnyan bstan la/ dgung lo don gsum rta lo dbyug gu'i bco brgyad la bab tshe dge bshes pas kyang nongs pa bzod gsol dang dge ba bsngos te jo bo nyid gzugs sku spro ba dang bsdu ba'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas pas dga' ldan du gshegs shing gzhan ngor gdung tsam zhig bstan no/ /de phyin thugs khral gyi tshul mi ston par bod ston rnams kyi mya ngan sangs/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdung 'phags pa mya ngan las 'das pa ltar sbyong gsung bas snye thang na mo cher pur zhugs kyis sbyangs/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug — 703

byon nas dge bshes pas lde mig thams cad khong la phul/ khong gis jo bo'i gdung dang rgya dpe gser gling pa'i dngul gdugs can sogs dge bshes pa la gnang / khu rngog sogs gzhan rnams la gang 'os re gnang ste sku bldad chen po mdzad/ 'or du gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bshes gnyen pas lo gcig snye thang du bzhugs nas jo bo'i sa tra bteg ste dge slong tshul khrims dag pa gnyis kyis gdung spyan drangs/ khang nag du ba can du ma bzhugs par gur dkar du bzhuṭa te stod lungs la byon/ gnam gyi bye ma lung du gnas gzhi mdzad bzhed pa skyi ston jo yis kyis bkag zhang phreng kha ber chung gis spyan drangs te ra sgreng du lug lo la phebs/ lung bstan pa'i gnas 'di yin par mkhyen/ gnyan grong nas mdom lnga brgya'i sar dgon pa gong ma btab ste nub phyogs su rnal 'byor pa chen po a mes byang chub kyi gzims khang byas/ de nas dgon pa ba 'dzing dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje dang rnal 'byor pa byams pa'i blo gros ste rnal 'byor pa bzhi'i gzims khang rnams yon bdag zhang drung pha bzhi zhes grags pa dgra bcom lhun po shākya grags gla ba kha ser ste phreng kha ber chung gi sras ber rgyud bzhir grags pa so sos byas/ dgon pa 'og tu klu rgyal ne'u lung pa'i pho brang gi steng du dge bshes ston pa'i gzims khang btab/ me bya la dbu rtse ka gnyis ma btab ste jo bo'i gdung phyag dpe rnams dre'u rig pa can la bkal te btang bas ne'u cag cig shang shang skyes pa cig tu nyal nas der rmang bting / sngon seng ge brag phug tu mnal lam brtags pas gser gyi mchod rten gzigs pa'ang 'di yin/ dge bshes kyi zhal nas jo bo'i gdan sa 'di la ngo mtshar gyi rtags mang po byung bas khyod rnams kyis snabs dang mchiḍa/ ma sogs ma dor zhig gsungs/ sa 'dul la brgyad stong 'grel chen gsungs/ chu mig gnyis 'dug pa sgrom du drangs/ shar rgyang grags gnyis kyi 704

sa nas gser g.yu dngul mchong gi shug pa bzhi klus phul te dngul ma gser ma gnyis bcad/ shing gzo ba bi ris phyi ka ba bcu gnyis nang ka gnyis rgya phubs bre mgyogs kyis rtsig pa'i go chod ba'i gzo khyad can byas/ khyams stode ka ba bcu gnyis phub nas 'di man la byed po zhig 'ong gis gsungs nas bzhagaphyag khri mchog gis bal yul nas dngul gyi byang bu bslangs/ lam du sgrol mas bskyabs/ rgya gar gyi lha bzo mkhas pa ma nus dngul gyi mchod rten nang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par byas par gdung rnams bzhugs/ gzungs rnams kyang dngul gyi byang bu la yi ge brkos nas bzhugs/ 'dzin mdo yon tan 'bar bya ba la khyod 'jig rten gyi shes pa che bas 'jig rten byed lo zhig gyis dang ngas 'jig rten spong lo zhig byed gsungs nas res khyung mgo can la skor ba mdzad res ci yang mi mdzad/ shangs snabs dang spyan chab skog ma na mar sleb pa mi 'phyid par/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / sogs gsung zhing chos brgyad la btang stoms chen po mdzad cing bzhugs/ phyag khri mchog gis mang skol dang spong dag mdzad nas nga'i gtam 'di ri gzar gyi rbab 'dra ba zhig 'ong ste bzod pa mdzod cig gsungs nas/ dge bshes ston pas mi shes kho na ma gsungs bar jo bo'i chos ma sba bar shod/ a mes khyod mi chos su ngan te jo bo'i phyags phyi bzhag nas sbas rgya mtsho'i g.yog byed/ lha chos su ngan te jo bo'i chos bzhag nas lha chung ston pa la bdag med ma'i rdzogs rim zhus/ khyed sa tra pa rnams kyang jo bo'i sa tra bzhag nas rog lha bzo'i zan za ba/ zhes sogs thams cad 'a/ bka' babs yal me ba re mdzad nas kho bo yang sang nas mtshams byed par zhu gsung tsa na shug gseb na phar su dang yang gtam mi mdzad par ci bder bzhugs te rnam par rtog pa las mtshams po che bcad par gda'/ phyis sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du byon te shul na mchod rten yod/ khu 705

rngog dang rong pa 'gar dges jo bo'i dngul gyi gdung khang re mdzad/ lo tsā bas ras khru bcu bzhi pa la sku tshad la bla ma rnams dang bod ston dang rnam thar gyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu bstod pa brgyad bcu pa yod pa bris/ spyir jo bo la slob ma byon tshul ni/ rgya gar du ṭombi pas lung bstan pa'i sngags pa dang /byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'i dge tshul dang / nag tshos gzigs par yang spyod pa bgyid par zhu ba'i dge slong dang / grong 'jug byed pa'i bram ze gziṭa pa dang / mchims phur ting nge 'dzin 'bul ba'i dge slong gnyis sogs byung bas grub thob sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ni mtha' mi mngon pa yod par snang la/tshur mthong gi spyod yul du/ pu to pa/ dbu ma seng ge bshes gnyen gsang ba/ dzñā na ma ti/ phyi nang shan 'byed pa la mkhas pa sa'i snying po ste rgya gar gyi paṇa chen de rnams gtso bo yin la spyir sde pa bco brgyad po thams cad kyis tshad mar bekur zhing lung len pa'i gnas byed do/ /bod du ni zhal mjal dang gus pa ma byas pa su yang med kyang gtso bor lha bla ma khu dpon/ lo chen rin bzang / rgya brtson seng / nag tsho/ ston pa yang rab/ sgom pa tshul khrims/btsun pa dge skyong / dge blo/ shākra blo/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs mnga' ris pa dang / gtsang du brag ston che chung / leng 'brog gnyis/mgar 'gos gnyis/ yol mched gsum sogs dang / dbus su khu rngog 'brom gsum sogs dang / rnal 'byor pa bzhi sogs khams pa ste bgrang gis mi lang ba byon zhing / rnal 'byor pa g.yung drung rgyal mtshan bya ba nyan thos kyi sa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs la phal cher ni phyir mi ldog pa ste re res kyang bstan pa'i bya ba cher mdzad la bka' rgyud kyi gzhung tshugs pa ni ston pa chen po kho na'o/ /dge bshes ston pas gdan sa lo dgu mdzad pa'i bar la skyu ra gzhon 'od/lhab mi ye shes g.yung drung / rug pa'i zhang chen po/ rka yung pa ba/ kham pa 706

'u/nga pa la sogs dang khyad par sku mched gsum smin par mdzad/ spyir tshos kyi las tshan brgyad bcur bgos shing thun mong gi snang ba la tshogs pa drug bcu tsam byung ba thams cad yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa sha stag yod skad/ drurga bcu pa chu yos bre phul zla ba se ba me tog dkar ltem pa'i dus pu to pa la ngas khyod kyi bsten sa gzhan ma mthong bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sde la chol kha yar pung gdang chos la 'dug cig gsungs nas gshegs/ de nas rnal 'byor pa chen pos 'og tu ka ba bcu drug ma'i sar bzhugs nas gdan sa lo bcu gsum mdzad/ stod lung pa chen po/ lo mkhar bu ba/ mang ra ba sogs mang po smin/rta lo bdun bcu pa shing yos la thegs/ de'i ring ber rgyud dgra bcom gyi sras dar ma ye shes kyis khyams smad khyams chung nag tshang rnams mdzad/ de nas dgon pa pas gong nyid du bzhugs te gdan sa lo bdun mdzad/ 'brug lo re drug pa chu bya la 'das/ slob ma dgon gyi bu bzhi zhes pa las zhang ka ma pa shes rab 'od ni sngon jo bo lan pa'i lcil por phebs dus bu mo zhig la 'di la bu bzang po zhig yong gsungs pa bzhin me bya la 'khrungs/ dgon pa pas chos dang zang zing gis bskyangs/ rtog ge la 'bar ba'i 'gyur bcos kyang mdzad/ka ma'i gtsug lag khang btab/ don lnga pa lcags phag la thegs/ sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar ni chu rta la 'khrungs/ dgon pa pas rjes su bzung / yi dam mtha' yas pa zhal gzigs/ phyis pu to ba bsten phyag rdor la nus pa thob pas 'dze nad mang po bsal/ lam zhig tu pha bong la zhabs btad de phyags sgrog bcings pas sbrul dkar po cig thon song ste de na mdze bo yod pa'i nad thon/phyis sne zur du bzhugs/ gzhung man ngag gi skyes chen mang po 'dus/ mnga' ris pa byang chub dge mdzes zhes pa mgon po zhal gzigs tshe nga'i sdom pa gsum la nyes skyon 'dug na khyed kyis snying khrog 'thung zhig byas pas dge slong gi 707

dam bca' 'jigs gsung ba de la sogs pa byon zhing / rgyud 'dzin ni gtsang na drang po lung pa dang spyi po lhas pa sogs so/ /don bdun pa sa khyi la thegs/'di'i phyag g.yas pa gnyal gser phye mchod rten na bzhugs pas byin rlabs che ba yin no/ /de gnyis kyi khar gnyan sna mo ba dang / 'bre ko de lung pa bsnan pas dgon gyi bu bzhi zer la/ gzhan yang sha bo sgang pa padma byang chub dang kha rag sgom chung yang yin no/ /yang phu chung pas jeng sang nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig smin bdo gsungs pa rnal 'byor pa chen po'i slob ma mang ra ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan de'i slob ma snyug rum pa brtson 'grus 'bar yin no/ /de nas pu to bas gdan sa mdzad pa khams pa 'gas bzhugs su ma ster/ de nas bar nyag byung ste khyim pas bzung / pu to ba gshegs nas lo gnyis gsum na mtha' bzhi sgom pas sha ra ba/ ka ma ba/ bya yul ba/ glang thang pa rnams dang bgros/ nyag nyug phud nas sa tra btsugs/ de nas dpon brgyad pa dang zir gu chos grags kyis ka gnyis ma'i nub tu ka ba bcu drug ma bzhengs/ de nas rngog lo la phul nas chos bar sa mdzad/ ka gnyis ma bzhengs nas lo go gsum na zhang 'od 'jo pas ra sgreng bzung / ber rgyud se bo gzhon tshul dang gnyis kyis ka gnyis ma la gser thog phub cing se bo gzhon tshul gyis dbu rtse ka ba nyer bzhi ma bzhengs nas lo gnyis na 'od 'jo ba gshegs/ de nas sgang thang dkar bas lo nyer dgu/ 'od 'jo bas lo bcu drugayon btsun brtson rdor gyis ka gnyis ma'i rgyab tu ka bzhi ma bzhengs/ spyir khyams ka ba brgya dang bzhi bcu/ brang khang stong / rten lugs ma ngo mtshar can lnga bcu/ thang sku byin rlabs can sum stong drug brgya lhag pa/ gsung rten po ti sa ya phrag bcu/ gdung rten bdun brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga la sogs pa bzhugs zhes snang / bar skabs su me'i gnod pa gcig gnyis byung mod kyi da lta'ang 708

sku gsung thugs rten me brdugs ma du ma yod do/ /rgya 'dul lo gcig gtsang pa jo stan lo lnga/ ko khyim pa lo gsum/ snar bas lo bcu gcig 'di dus hor dmag gi gnod pa byung / gur ston gyis gsos/ de nas lha 'gro mgon gyi slob ma rma ston sogs byon zhing deng du'ang bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam snang ste gdan sa ra sgreng dngos kyi skabs so/ /khyad par bka' gdams kyi bstan pa nyin mor byed pa sku mched gsum zhes grags pa ni bka' gdams pa yon tan gsang ba nyid mdzad kyang gsang chos glegs bam las yang yang gsal zhing spyir bal yul shing kun du rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pa cig gis mi ma yin gyi gseb tu skor ba byas pa na mkha' 'gro'i glu las 'phags pa wa ti mched gsum dang sku mched gsum po tha mi dad par rigs gsum mgon po'i ngo bor thos pa las mched nas rigs gsum mgon por kha tshon chod pa las/ spyan ras gzigs phu chung pa ni phu chung du 'khrungs/ 'brom bsten nas man ngag yongs su rdzogs shing rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis yer par jo bo yab sras la gsan nas rdzu 'phrul gyis bkod pa'i sprul pa'i glegs bam mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan la brgyud de glegs bam gyi bka' babs/ sha gzug rang za zhes sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/ sprul pa ma nga pos gzhung man ngag gnyis spel/ zhang ka ma ba rin chen rgyal mtshan thig ler smin grol mdzad/ glegs bam gtad de don drug pa me khyi la bkod pa bsdus/ de nas zhang ston dar ma rgyal mtshan/ stabs ka ba byang chub bzang po/snar thang pa nam mkha' rin chen/ de yan gsang chos bka' rgya mar yod cing de nas mang du 'phel te rtsa ba byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba ni 'brom gyis jo bo'i gsung bsdus pa yin la 'di dang jo bos rgyal po nirya pā la la 'phrin yig mdzad pa phal cher gcig tu byung bas rgyal po de 'brom dang thugs 709

rgyud gcig pa'o zhes kho bo 'ba' zhig sems la thig le bcu drug lha chos bdun rjes dran lnga tshad med bzhi brtag pa gnyis mdor na rang sems srung ba gcig por chos thams cad bsdus te ston pa bka' gdams glegs bam gyi bka' babs yin no/ /rgyal ba'i bka' nyid gdams ngag tu byed pas bka' gdams zhes gzhung man ngag gnyis 'chad la 'brom gyis yi dam lha bzhi chos byang chub kyi sems gnyis sogs bdam khar bdams pas bka' bdams ces glegs bam las 'chad do/ /deng sang chos spong shes pa tsam la chos go gcod pa dag kha cig glegs bam la sgro skur byed pa ni bdud kyi las so/ /dge ye ba tshul khrims seng ge sogs sku mched gsum gyi 'khrungs lo gzhon du smra yang / jo bo bod du phebs lo las lo bcus snga ba'i lcags mo lug la phu chung ba dang pu to pa 'khrungs/ de nas lo bdun 'das pa sa pho stag la spyan snga ba 'khrungs par deb sngon pa sogs 'dod pa 'di dag par snang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs pu to ba chen po ni 'phan yul gyi pras bra'o sgang du sku gshen srid lha 'bar gyi sras su 'khrungs/yer pa'i rngog dang rgyal gyi glan tshul byang la bsten te rab tu byung / mtshan rin chen gsal yin/ brag rgyab tu dge slongabazhes/ dge 'dun gyi gnyer yang cung zad dang mdo mang tshar gcig gi phyag len pa mdzad/ dge 'dun spyi las lhag pa zho zhal tsam yang ma gsol/ jo bo dang zhal mjal chos thob tsam byung /nyer brgyad pa sa khyi la 'brom dang mjal/ gdams ngag sna bstan tsam gyis ji lta ba thugs la 'khrungs/ 'brom gshegs nas lo bco brgyad sgrub pa mdzad nga gcig pa lcags bya nas tshogs bskyangs te gzhung mkhan brag ltag lung sgro lab mkhar thog sogs ma nges par gzhi ji bzhin pas bzhugs/ tshe blos btang gi tshogs pa nyis stong brgyad brgya re 'dus/ spyir dge slong khas nyan khyad par byang chub sems dpa' khas nyan gsungs te gnod lan mi mdzad/ chos lam sgron gyi 710

rgyab tu bslab btus dang spyod 'ju4/ mdo sde rgyan ngang byang sa/ skyes rabs dang ched du brjod pa'i tshoms te gzhung drug 'chad pas bka' gdams gzhung par grags/ chos tshig gcig kyang phyir ma lus par nyaca/sa len kho nar gsungs/phyis pu tor dgon pa btab ste bzhugs pas pu to bar grags/ nga'i don gyi mkhan po de ra sgreng gi dge bsnyen rgan po de yin par 'dug gsungs nas sngar dge slong sogs blangs pa de nges 'byung rnal ma skyes pa nas so thar mtshan nyid par 'gyur pa sdom pa gnas gyur zhes bzhed/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung du zhal gyis bzhes/ don lnga la bkod pa bsdus/ slob ma gzhan don nus pa bgrang gis mi lang yang gtso bor gtsang na ram snang gnyis/ dol na 'be rog gnyis/ gnyal na glang gnyos gnyis/ 'phan yul na nyi zla zung gcig ste ka chen brgya da yin la/ deb sngon pas gtsang stod du bya phag gnyis dang / yar lungs jo bos khams su bya phag gnyis zhes dang dge ye bas mnga' ris su bya 'dul dang phag sgur ba zhes ka ba bcur 'chad kyang 'di bdag gis ni ma 'tshal to/ /de la gtsang du ram sding ma ba ni skye pa snga ma rgya gar shar phyogs su paṇḍi ta rdo rje gzhon nur yod pa sgrol mas bod du gzhan don la bskul te byon/ la stod la 'ub shing 'gram du yab rdo rje 'bum dang yum dpal mo 'tsho'i sras su 'khrungs/ rgyags chad pa na nang nas kyis gang ba dang yab yum gyi phyag mthil du mchil ma thigs pa re blug pa bldad bas zhag bdun du zas ma dgos pa byung / sems can sdug bsngal pa gzigs tshad la ngas bu 'di rnams nam 'drongs na zhes bshum/ mkhan po le 'byung dang slob dpon 'ol phu ba las smur rab byung mdzad/ mtshan 'byung gnas rdo rje/byams pa dang ston pas lung bstan te lo bcu dgu la pu tor byon/ pu to ba la yang sgrol ma dang spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dpal gyis de ring sprul pa'i sku 711

zhig 'ong gsungs/ pu to bas dge 'dun gyi tshogs su sang skyes bu dam pa zhig 'ong ba de'i mjal sna sus byas mchog 'grub bo gsungs/ thams cad kyis btsal bas jo stan bzang po cig gis mjal phyag byas pas/ khyed 'dag sbyar lo bcu gsum gyi dam bcas nas lo bdun song ba'i 'phags pa cig bdag so skye zhig la phyag byas nas ci byed gsungs pas mngon shes mnga' bar rig ste zhabs spyi bor blangs pas rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ bla mas kyang bsu ba'i mchod ba bshams te de bzhin gshegs pa byon nas yod do gsungs/ mjal ma thag mos gus kyis cung zad brgyal/ sangs pa na zhabs la gtugs te bdag la thugs rjes skyob par zhu zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas khyed dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yin gyi ngas kyang cung zad byin gyis rlob bo gsungs/ chos thams cad mgo smos pa tsam gyis rang shar du mkhyen te yab sras chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da'/ dge 'dun rnams kyis rtogs pa dris pas/ rgyu 'bras phra zhib bsgoms tsa na sdig pa las blo log nas dge ba 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pas bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs shig bdog sogs dang / sems ma bcos lhug par bzhag pas sangs rgyas rang chas su rtogs pa'i thabs shig bdog sogs gsungs pas thams cad la ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes skad/ lo gsar zhig la sa'i lha mos me tog padma phub tsam zhig phul ba bla mas dkon mchog la phul bas mi snang bar gyur te dri bzang po byung / bla mas 'byor pa mang po dang dbyar gyi 'tsho ba gnang ste tshogs rdzoṭa pa'i slad du rgyal ba'i sras kyis bzhes su gsol gsungs/ yang lan gcig ja gsol dus rtogs pa zhig phul dang gsung ba la gzung ba'i yul sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la zhen zhing chags pa mi gda' 'o/ /sogs phul ste kho bo ni skyed rim 'byongs pa lags pas gzigs dang gsungs pas ston pa'i skur mngon sum du 712

gzigs te phyag gi dkar yol shor nas spyan ha re gda' skad/ chab tsha thom bu gang la ji tsam spyad kyang ma zad sngon ngas rgya gar du 'bras chan bre gang gis mi stong kheb myong gsungs/ sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyis khyed kyi zhal du zan kham re thongs pa rnams kyang 'khor ba las thar bas zan bsod mdzod cig 'gro don che'o gsungs kyang bla mas bka' ma gnang / nang zhig bla ma spyan chab tsa re byon nas ngas blos mi thongs par 'dug ste sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can mi dgyes par gda' bas bzhud cig gsungs/ bzhud pa'i nyin de ring las skyo ba cig gsungs skad/ rmya lha shangs 'bar dang 'u yug rdor legs kyis srog snying phul/chu mig ser po dang rta shi'i brag la bzhugs pas lnga ba sbubs su nub/ zag pa zad/ khams gsum thams cad gzigs/ slob ma 'dus pa lan gnyis bkye ba'i tshe zam pa chen po la byon pas phar gar thon pa na zam pa brtul nas mi rnams smre sngags 'don pa gzigs te tshogs bskyangs/ nub cig pu to ba seng ge la bcibs nas byon te nga mya ngan las 'da' ba khyod la phreng nas 'ongs pa yin zhes zhal gdams du ma gsungs nas nam mkha' la gshegs/ zhag bdun du nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa'i thugs khrul byung bas bla ma'i sku gzigs te chos gsung ba gsan pas sdug bsngal zhi/ rang nyid ston pa dngos su gzigs/ pu to ba'i slob ma bcu drug byung nas bla ma dam pa grongs/ tshe phyi ma don du gnyer tshad 'byung gnas rdo rje'i drung du song gsungs nas nged rnams yong pa yin zer bas/ 'o skol tsho'i chos sa zhig btsal yong gi gsungs nas ram sding mar byon/ gzhi bdag thams cad kyis sa phul/ bud med chen mo chu dar smug po'i gos gyon pa cig gis sems skyed zhus dung gi mdzo mo zhig phul nas 'di la chu zhig yong zer/ de sa la thim gar cung zad sdod cig rab gnas bya'o gsungs/ mod der sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang pu to ba 'a/ sogs bla 713

ma thams cad byon nas mdzo ngang bcas pa sa la thim pas chu 'o ma 'dra ba zhig rdol/ phud dkon mchog mchod nas hub gang gsol/ 'thungs tshad la ngan song med do gsungs/ der tshogs pa yang cher bskyangs/ ri rtse nas dgon par skad cig gis 'byon pa dang nub mo'ang nyin mo ltar gsal ba dang stong gsum gsal bar ston pa sogs mdzad/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis khyed kyi mtshan thos tshad la ngan song med pas khyed kyi mtshan sgrogs zhes bskul/ dge slong dar gyi chos gos can zhig gis ja cung zad phul nas sprin gyi gseb la song / ja de ji tsam skol yang ma zad/ phyis de bzhes nas dga' ldan nas kyi 'bul ba 'di kha zas kyi mtha' ma yin no gsungs/ lus 'dis mkha' spyod du gshegs gsungs par sku gdung 'jog par zhus/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams nga 'byung gnas rdo rje la gsol ba thob/ 'das grongs med do gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa gnas 'di mu stegs kyis 'jig phyis sto phyogs nas skal ldan zhig gis gsos te nga'i mchod rten byed ces gsungs te g.yu lo bkod par gshegs/ phyis dgon pa hor gyis bshig ci zhig na 'gro mgon sor rde pa chen po de lho brag brag lung gi smad bkra shis sgang du 'khrungs/ dang spror mkhan po ma dang slob dpon dbu ma pa las rab tu byung / mtshan bsod nams seng ge mdo sngags la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dang spror dbu ma'i zur chos pa mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu nas shangs 'bar gyis gdan drangs te ram sding mar byon nas sngon gnas mang po gsungs/ sku 'bum rmang nas gsos zhig gso rgya cher lan gsum mdzad/ pu to dang snye thang 'or rgya grong rnams la'ang zhig gso mdzad/lho brag tu hor dmag lhags tshe 'jigs skyob mdzad/ thub pa'i gser sku zhig gis sor rdel zhig 'phangs pa der bab par gzigs nas phyag sen gyi dkyil bra thur bya ba'i ri la sto brag sding ma'i gtsus lag khang btab/ ram sding ma ba'i 714

sprul par zha9pa gyis bzhes shing de thams cad du 'phrin las kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs shing mya ngan las 'das so/ /snang gis snang dre'u lhas kyi lha khang btab/ dol pa 'be so ker gyis gzhung mdar ra sregs kyi lha khang btab/rog dol pa shes rab rgya mtsho ni shangs zhur dmar po yod pas rog dmar zhur bar grags/ rta mgrin gyi sprul pa yin/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa' sha mtshan can 'byung zhes sngon jo bos lung bstan/ yang gad kyi gtsug lag khang btab/gnyal nas glang bya rab pa yon tan blo gros kyis chos sgro sho por grong mkhar dang skyid stengs btab/ gnyos chen po ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon la ba bas tsā ri rong bskor nas lab phug tu bzhugs/ de nas smyal du byon te la ba phug tu bzhugs nas bra 'or gyis byin gyis brlabs/ slar rgya gar du gshegs te sku'i lngags pa la bde mchog gi lha tshogs rtsa ris su 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs te bzhag bsams bzhin bra 'or gyi 'gram gnyos kyi grong du 'khrungs/ chos thams cad rang byung du mkhyen/ lo bcu nas pu to ba bsten/ nyer gcig la sku mched gsum las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan chos 'bar/ pu to bas lung bstan te la ba phug gi mdun thang rgyal mtshan 'dra bar bra 'or gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ slob ma ras chung pa dang ras chung ma la bka' bsgos te rgya gar nas skye ba snga ma'i lngags pa dang ṭa dril sogs blangs/ pu to ba la thugs brgyad byon pa'i thugs gcig dang bcas bzhugs pa'i mchod rten nub ma bzhengs/glang bya rab pa la phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi lung bestan byung ste zhabs la gtugs/zhang dang gro lung pas bstud/ re gsum pa 'brug lo la gshegs/ sgal tshigs la sangs rgyas stong byon/ slob ma gun pa thugs rje rgyal mtshan gyis gser phye 'bum pa bzhengs/ dkor 'dul 'dzin gyis rta'u ra btab/ chag dragra bcom gyis gdan sa byas/ 'brang rin po ches 'o gro btab/ zhang bsod na mas rgyal mtshan 715

gyis bye sa btab/ dbon po gnyos chos kyi seng ges bra 'or du gdan sa mdzad de nas mtsho sna pa chen po/ mon grab pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ chos bskyabs dpal bzang po rnams byon pa yin no/ /'phan yul nas nyi ma lta bu sha ra ba yon tan grags ni byang rom po'i 'brog tu lcags khyi la 'khrungs/ pu to ba bsten/ bka' 'gyur thugs la bzhugs par grags/ pa tshab lo tsā ba'i dbu ma'i 'phrin las spel ba'i grogs mdzad/ sems skyed lu gas gnyis gcig pa'i grub mtha' mdzad/ tshogs pa sum stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam rtag tu 'du/don gnyis pa me bya la thegs/ slob ma 'phrin las can mang na'ang gtso bor byang chub seca/sa kyi bka' babs mchad ka ba/ rnam thar gyi bka' babs nyi ma 'dul 'dzin/ gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs stabs ka ba/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs rong ston shes 'od/ 'phrin las kyi bka' babs gtum ston blo gros grags/ longs spyod kyi bka' babs rnal 'byor shes rdor te bka' babs drug zer/ bya mchad ka ba ni lo ror lcags sbrul la 'khrungs/ blo sbyong la rtsal du bton/ phyis blo sbyong la tshogs chos mdzad/ mchad ka btab/ don lnga pa shing lug la 'das/ de'i slob ma se lcil bu ba chos kyi rgyal ca/tshan ni gnyal se khun du 'khrungs/ lcil bu dang mchad ka gsar ma btab/ 'di'i slob ma rnal 'byor byang seng ges gro sa btab/ rgya spang sa ba/ lha dge 'dun sgang pa/nyan lha sdings pa rnams so sos rang ming gi dgon pa btab/ lha lung gi dbang phyug yar lungs su 'od srung rgyud par sa stag la 'khrungs/ se'i gdan sa mdzad/don lnga pa chu 'brug la thegs/ de'i dbon po lha 'gro mgon dbang phyug 'od ni me rta la 'khrungs/ wal ti las rab tu byung / khu bo las chos thams cad gsan/ gdan sa mdzad dus kong po nas ta bar sogs gtsug lag khang sum bcu/ dwags po nas bla mda' sogs dang / gnyal nas zangs po che sogs 716

dang / g.ye nas bu dal sogs te gtsug lag khang brgya phrag mang po'i bdag po mdzad/ dbyar gnas la gnas brtan bcu drug kyang byon/ lha sar dngos su jo bos chos gsungs/ 'dam gyi lha mo che'i bgegs bskrad/ don bzhi pa sa lug la thegs/ de nas rim par lha brag kha ba blo gros ye shes/ lha blo gros 'od/lha rin seng / lha shākya bsod nams nas deng sang gi bar du lha'i gdung gis 'dzin no/ /stabs ka bas stabs ga 'od 'jo/ khra phu gsum btab/gtum ston la bla mas khyod kyis dge slong bzhi sde re ma bral bar bsten gsungs nas snar thang btab/ lo bcu bzhi nas rdo ston shes rab grags bskos te la stod chos lung du dben ba mdzad nas gshegs pas chos lung sku gshegs zer/rdo ston shes rab grags nas zhang zhung rdo rje 'od/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/'di sangs rgyas stong gi ya gyal du grags/ dbu rtse rnying ma bzhengs/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa 'di'i ring skyel nag grags seng spyan drangs bshad gra btsugs/ byang chen bzhengs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bla ma mdzad/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims kyis lha khang chen mo dang lcags ri bzhengs/ nyi ma rgyalamatshan ze'u grags pa brtson 'grus/grags pa shes rab/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan soṭa byon te mkhan po la gnas brtan bcu drug 'byon par grags/ zla ba lta bu glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge ni shing rta la 'khrungs/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul par rdo rje gdan pas lung bstan/ rtag tu 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sems pas sku tshe la zhal 'dzum pa lan gsum las ma byung bar grags/ lan gcig tshe rabs thams cad du dge slong gi dngos po dang mi 'bral ba'i dam bca' mdzad pas dpal lha mo dre'u'i skad lhang gis byon te de srid ngas khyod kyis grogs bya'o gsungs/ glang thang btabaska bdun bcu pa chu yos la thegs /717

slob ma sha po sgang pa padma byang chub sogs mang du byon/ gdan sar sha po ba glang thang zhang / dge bshes gnyan sogs byung zhing phyis rgya ma ba la phul lo/ /bka' gad mas gzhung ba'i skabs so/ /phyag rdor gyi ngo bo spyan snga tshul khrim sa 'bar ni nyan gyi sna nga ra sgang du dbas shākya rdo rje dang yum li mo ye shes sgron gyi sras su sa stag la 'khrungs/ bco brgyad pa la mal sems dpa' shes rab las rab tu byung / nyi shu pa la 'brom dang mjal/ nye gnas rtag tu mdzad pas spyan snga bar grags te spyan snga'i mtshan thob pa'i dang po yin/ jo bo'i sngags kyi man ngag rnams kyang khong la gnang / nyer bdun la 'brom gshegs nas rnal 'byor pa gong 'og rnams bsten/ gtsang nas gong mo sgang pa bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma zhig gis gdams ngag btab byung ba'i nyams myong gi tshad du ma phyin nas dgon pa pas gsang 'dus rim lnga zhig btab pas tshad du skyol skad/ lo tsā mkhyen/ gsang sngags thams cad kyi bzlas pa grub/ sā tsha kho na'ang ri de'u tsam song zer/ chos skyong 4kun gyis srog snyinge phul/ chos thams cad yang na don dam yang na kun rdzob rtsesi bzhed/ nga brgyad nas 'khrungs yul du lo dgon pa btab/ lo drug bzhugs/ thugs zo ma sod nas smyug rum du lo gsum bzhugs te don drug pa chu lug la thegs/ slob ma 'gro don can mang na'ang spyan snga'i sgom bzhi skad na/ zar pa phag sgom rdor yes kyis mal gror zar btab/ dgag dbye shes rin gyis cher skyes lha khang / rug pa ston sgom gyis klung shod rug pa/ ral pa pad sgom gyis dar lha khang btab bo/ /stod lung pa rin chen snying po ni chu spre la 'khrungs/ stod lung tsan gro dgon pa btab/gya lnga pa me spre la thegs/ 'di'i yang slob lho brag srin po ba sogs yin/ spyan snga'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni sprul sku bya yul pa chen po ste stod lung gol gyi lung du 'khrungs/ yab gshegs yum gyis bor te ne ne mo zhig gis bskyangs/ bcu 718

gnyis la rab tu byung zhing bcu drug nas stod lung pa'i nye gnas lo lnga ca/dzad/bslab btus sogs mkhyen par sbyangs/ stod lung pas spyan snga mjal du byon tshe mjal bas mnyes te ston pa re skyid 'di lta bu'i nye gnas yod pa gsungs/ 'o na 'bul lam zhus pas 'bul cang phod dam gsungs pas dar yug gcig btags nas phul/ spyan snga nas ye mi bkyon pas sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bcos min du shar/ phyag gas gas su zhal zas rdzi ba sogs dka' ba ches bzod cing mtshan mo maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba kho na btab/ lo'i lha khang mdzad tshe sa rdo la ma 'jus pa med/ sha khrug spu bar so/nga song zhabs tog la 'bungs/ spyan snga ba shin tu mnyes shing pu to bas kyang bsngags pa cher mdzad/stod lung khu/sa btsun chung 'di ci 'dra zhus pas/ 'di dad pa dang shes rab ni che chos thams cad nam mkha' la mdung bskor gsungs/ g.yeng ba kho na byed dgos pa ltar snang yang zhogs gcig thal ba 'bor du 'gro ba na skas gdang gsum pa 'i khar babs tshe mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don mngon sum du lam shar/skyi ming nga 'i dbe ba'es 'di rnams bla ma'i zhabs tog mi byed par thob/ pa kho na byed pa 'di nor gsungs/ spyan sngas kyang khyod ni thar zin gyis nga ma bzhag zhig gsungs/ mya ngan las 'da' ku'i tshe'ang chos sku gcig tu ma gyur bar du mi 'bral lo gsungs/ lo dgu bsten lo bzhir mtshams mdzad/ de nas tshogs bskyangs/ zha bas bya yul gyi sa phul bas klu gsen rnams gnas spos/ klu che ba zhig 'dug pa btul nas pha bong thag thug rnams bcag cing sbas te bya yul btab/ shing rnams nags shod nas drangs/ rten dang sa rgyan gnam rgyan mi shong ba 'dus/ 'gro don cher mdzad de re bzhi pa sa rta la gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas du bas gar kheb tu ring srel byung / tshogs pa nyis stong lhag tsam gyi nang nas ting nge 'dzin skyes pa lnga brgya/ dge bshes chen po brgya dang bcu/ 719

phyi'i chen po dgu bar gyi chen po brgyad/ nang thugs kyi sras gsum zhes deb sngon pa 'chad la/ chen po bcu gsum zherdza/ yar lungs jo bos bris snang / de la rab sgang ba dang ngang tshang ba gnyis khams/ sha pa gling pa dang bo thang pa gnyis dwagal po/ mer pa dang rgya ri ba gnyis g.ye/ brag dmar pa brag nag pa mus sman pa rnams gtsang ste yul de rnams su 'phrin las che zhing / dbur stod du bul pas rgyal po steng btab/ 'chums su 'khrungs pa khrom zher chen po rin chen seng ges ke ke btab/ der skyo ston byang chub rin chen khrom gzher rin chen seng ge phyi ma sogs gdan sa pa bzang po ring du byung / dum pu ri pa zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi dum bu ri btab/ sgyer sgom chen pos rgya ma'i mchod khang rnying ma dang rin chen sgang btab/ 'di sne zur ba dang bya yul ba thun mong gi slob ma yin/ mtshan gzhon nu grags pa/ lcags rta la 'khrungs nas gya gnyis pa lcags yos la thegs/ de'i cung po bu mo stag gi sras sangs rgyas dbon ston gzhon nu sangs rgyas ni sa rta la 'khrungs/ bya yul ba chen po'i skye ba dran/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas skal ldan shing rtar saddhi gling gi dgra bcom pas lung bstan/ rgya ma'i lha khang chen mo bzhengab// kha che paṇa chen dang mjal tshe sgrol mas shing rta myur du 'chag par lung bstan pa ltar don gsum pa lcags pho rta paṇa chen sa skyar dbyar gnas pa'i lo 'dun ma'i zhal bskos mdzad pa 'khor tsho ma nyan pas nga'i skya ma de ring nas tsen bsdus chog gsungs 'pho ba mdzad nas gshegs/ sangs rgyas yon tan/ bde gshegs chen po sogs gdan rim bzang du byung / bdag gi lo so gsum pa me spre la rgya ma'i lha khang chen mo mes gsheṭa pa yin no/ /slob ma rtogs ldan bzang mo ba/ lho brag dang spro'i dbu ma pa dge bor pa sogs bu chen brgyad byon/ bya yul ba'i thugs kyi sras gca nga pa rin po che rdo rje mi skyod pa ni gtsang stod snubs kyi yul du sngags pa'i sras su 720

'khrungs/ chung ngu nas gtor ma gtong baṇire tshul mdzad/ mig sgyu'i stong gzuṭa rang byung du byung / mkha' 'gro ma 'bar mas rjes su bzung / rngog lo chen po sogs lo tsā ba rang yang lnga tsam bsten/ sngags mtshan nyid la 'di ma spyangs bya ba med/ stod bsnyung ba spyan ras gzigs kyis bsal/ rgya gar la 'byon pa'i lam ding rir dam pa dang mjal bas khong rang gi gos dril te spyi bor bzhag thub pa'i tsa ka li cig gtad/ khur mang gi me tog cig chu la bskur/rdo ba zhig gtad de shar du 'phen bcug byung bas der 'khod pa rnams na re mi 'di bsod nams re che/ dam pa bzhengs pa dang thug gos spyi bor bzhag pa sogs kun gyis 'khur zhing bstan pa'i bdag po byed/ gang la'ang ma chags pa cig 'ong / shar phyogs la song dang don 'grub 'ong gsung bar 'dug zer/rgya bal na mu ge che zer bas log dbus gtsang gi ston pa sus kyang ma thub/khong rnams bka' gdams pa la skur ba 'debs pa na kha bzung / bya yul ba de bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa ni yin chos mi shes zer bas de gnyis ni 'gal/ gang lta na'ang zhal lta snyam nas mjal/ rta bzang po gcig dang gser srang gang phul/ tshogs chos cig gsan pas sngar gyi tsho kha bshad tsam yin par 'dug snyam du bcos min gyis mos gus skyes/ sngon rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis spyan snga bskyangs pa ltar skyong gsungs nas chos tshur bskyal zhing rdzogs par gnang / rgya ston dang gnyis la dbang bskur zhig gnang bas rgya ston gyis mi g.yo ba zhal gzigs/ nyid la rgyud sde rab 'byam gyi tshig don thams cad thugs la byon/ chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs/ chos zhu res bzhin gser zho phyed ma tha mar yang phul/ phyis sku bsod skyes nas chos po ti brgya lhag dang gser phye ca/ bu mo lo brgyad ma zhig gis mi theg pa phul/ sngar lo'i gdan sa dang phyis lo bya yul gnyis ku'i gdan sa mdzad/ rten dge bsnyen mtshan nam mkha' rdo rje 721

yin/ gya lnga pa lcags sbrul la thegs/ slob ma gtsang pa'i bu bzhi sogs mang du byung / glang lung pa brtson 'grus gzhon nu stod lung mtshur du chu yos la 'khrungs/ pa tshab lo tsā dang chos kyi padma las rab tu byung / bya 'dul dang phya pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gtsang pa rin po che'i gdams ngag rdzogs te lo bya yul gyi gdan sa lo so gnyis mdzad nas don gcig pa chu glang la gshegs/sangs rgyas sgom pa rdo rje gzhon nu ni yul gzhung sne gdong du lcags 'brug la 'khrungs/ lngal ti las rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ glang lung pa'i gdams pa rdzogs nas sgrub pa mdzad tshe chos thams cad mkhyen/ gdan sa yun ring du bskyangs te bdun bcu pa sa glang la thegs/ zam rin po che grags pa seng ge ni 'phan yul mdar lcags phag la 'khrungs/ yum sgrol mar gzigs/ lcam mos sangs rgyas sgom pa la skyabs su mchi zer bas dad cing sangs rgyas sgom pa zhal gzigs/ rnal 'byor byang seng las rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i gdams pa yongs su rdzogs/ lha mos bskul te gdan sa mdzad/re drug pa me 'brug la gshegs/ de'i slob ma 'od gsal bas zhogs su 'od gsal btab/ ri mer bas lho brag shar du ri mer btab/ bar dor mchog thob par grags pa kham pa lung pa nyan du chu 'brug la 'khrungs pa des lo bya yul gyi gdan sa lo nyer bdun mdzad de chu rta la gshegs/ sangs rgyas jo bo dbang phyug gzhon nu chu 'brug de nyid la 'khrungs/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i skye bar grags/ drug bcu pa yos la gdan sa mdzad/ chos skyong la nus pa thon pas bya yul zhig gso'i dus chos skyong gi gtor ma sku dang bcas pa bzhi sbas/gya gcig pa chu yos la thegs/ 'bri khung pa sku zhang tshul rgyal gyis lor sde dmag drangs mi mang po bsad dus gtor ma gcig 'phangs pa ma skam par 'dug skad de sku zhang pa zhal ngo rnams mis bsad skad/ de nas gtsang ston 722

gyis gdan sa lo gsum mdzad pa'i shing bya la 'bri khung pa'i dmag gis bya yul bsregs/ gtsang ston bkrongs/ de nas lo lnga song ba lcags stag la /'bri khung gling log byung / phyi lo lcags yos la sangs rgyas jo bos gdan sa mdzad de lo gcig la gsos de nas gru shul pa sangs rgyas ston pa dang sangs rgyas sgom pa phyi ma sangs rgyas dbon rnams dang gtsan gro ba tshul khrims mgon po sogs byon te lo bya yul dang mdor na bka' gdams man ngag pa'i skabs so/ yang sku mched gsum gyi khar kham pa lung pa bsnan pas zhal bzhi zhes kyang grags te de ni sgang shākya yon tan zer/ shing glang la 'khrungs/ go gcig/ shing 'brug la thegs te slob ma rnams sne'u zur pa dang thun mong du gyur to/ /rong pa phyag sor ba ni jo bo'i dngos slob brgyad yang slob dang nying slob mang po bsten pas cungabad ma mthun nas snga ris su nag tsho dngos la btugs/ gdams pa mang du gsan phyis jo bo spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus zhus pas de la nga mkhas pa yin kyang khyod min pa rtsad gcod pa ma byung zhes rgyas par gsungs/ 'byon khar ri lag sor lta bur sgoms shig gsungs te ra sgreng gi 'og com chung gi nang lag sor dgon par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/ lan gcig pa tshab dang phreng ga rje'i 'khrug bsdums la mtshams bkrol ba na phod mdor rma tsho byang rdor dang mjal te dad nas 'u shang rdor spyan drangs/ khong dpon slob lnga brgya la chos gsungs/ zur chos pa bzhi'i bya 'dul gyis rnam thar gtso bor bris/ rnam bar ba zhes pa stod lungs ram pa lha sdings 'debs mkhan gsang phu'i gdan sa'ang mdzad pa de dang / rngog mchims phu ba gnyis kyis gdams ngag gtso bor bris/zhus lan pas gnyis ka rgyas par bris te bstan rim bzhi byung zhing phyis yi ge thams cad bya 'dul gyi phyag tu byung nas jo bo'i rnam thar rgyas pa lam yig chen mo dang bstan rim mdzad/ phyag sor ba nas brgyud pa la bka' gdams 'og 7lha3

mar grags so/ /rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi rjes 'brang gas/nga phu ba ste/ sngon bod rgyal po la she mong cher bldabs pa'i blon po chen po rngog las slob dpon padma'i dngos slob phur pa'i grub thob zar ma chad pa'i rigs las ya 'brog gi mtsho'i byang 'gram sgog ces par yab rngog ston rdo rje gzhon nu la sras lnga yod pa'i che ba legs pa'i shes rab ni 'bring ye shes yon tan las rab tu byung /khams su se btsun las mkhas par sbyangs/ 'brom bod la byon pa'i phyi lo bya lo la dbus su byon/ jo bo rje la gdams pa mtha' da ga gsan/ lung pa pha gi'i nang na dung g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra ba yod der gtsug lag khang thob ces jo bos lung bstan pa thog mar brag nag tu btab/ phyis ne'u thog yin par mkhyen nas chu glang la btab/ jo bo'i slob ma'i nang nas grub mtha' la mkhas par grags pa rnal 'byor pa chag khri mchog gis lo gcig chos bshad/ de nas lo tsā ba chen po byon pa yin no/ /de ni rngog legs she'i gcung po klu khri klu byang chos skyabs thub pa bzhi las chos skyabs kyi sras rngog lo chen po lcags phag la 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus 'o brgyal bar byung bas lo bcu bdun la khu bo'i mtshan la bsnyegs te byon/ na bza' hrul po rkyang gcig la dres ma'i sku raṭa 'khor gcig yod/ chu thags pa la slongs pas yos cung zad byin pa phag tu blugaganas tshang ma rnyed bar rta bres su gzims pas khu bos mnal lam na rta bres su seng ge gser gyi mdog can gzigs te dris pas dpon por mkhyen te bos/phyag tshol gsungs pas slobs dang zer/ phyag btsal bas sku rags chad de yos 'thor bas zhal ba khyab pas 'phrin las chen po yong par 'dug gsungs/ rig pa brtag phyir zho phor pa gang phye btab pa byur mo zhig drangs pas mdun du zhog zer/ gos kyi gong pa nas khab sbom pa cig bton pas mtha' nas dril bas cung zad re 'gos pa zos pas ci zhig na dma' zhom song / rked pa nas rtsib 7 ཿ4

ma'i thur ma zhig bton nas dkrugs te gsol/ cung zad kyang ma bo bas ngo mtshar du byas/ rab tu phyung nas mtshan blo ldan shes rab ces btags pas blo ldan dang shes rab gcig pa la gnyis brtsegs nas ci byed gsungs pas 'o na blo ldan bzang po gyis gsungs te phyis bstan bcos mang po'i sbyar byang la blo ldan bza/nga po yod/ klog yig snga nas mkhyen pas 'grel pa don gsal mtshan ma zhig gtad nas de ring nags gseb pha gir 'di zung shog gsungs nas dgong mo byon pa na tsam zin gsungs pas yi ge a ma rnams bzung yod/ bu chung tsho 'dzin dgos na sang zung chog zer/ khyod kyi slob dpon ngas mi yong ba 'dug gsungs nas rgya gar du btang zhes rje 'phrin las zhabs gsungs/ ka churi sbo chung tshul khrims bla ma la yang gsan pa cung zad mdzad zer/ mnga' bdag rtse lde'i chos 'khor la byon pas gser cung zad yod pa stor bas rgyal pos gser mang du bskur sras mnga' bdag dbang ldes yon bdag bgyi bar chad nas gcan kha bo cha/ rngo ston khyung po chos brtson/ rwa lo/ gnyan lo rnams dang 'grogs te byon/ yul dbus dang kha che la sogs par paṇḍita sadzdza na dang / 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / pa ra he ha dang / mā hā dza na dang / su ma ti kirti dang /a tu lya dang / ba rend+ra ru ci dang / skal ldan rgyal po la sogs pa mang du lus srog la bsdos nas kyang btsal zhing bsten/ 'bum phrag gsum pa la chos gsan dus rgya tshad bsnyung bas chos rar sku smad shong ba'i dong brus par bzhuṭa te gsan/ chos thams cad gsan pa tsam gyis mkhyen pas grogs kyis phra dog gis skad rigs gzhan du gsung bar zhus pas skad rigs thams cad la byang bar gyur/ ḍimbi he ru ka byon te nga'i stag 'phongs la zhon mkha' spyod la 'khrid gsungs pa na bod la gzigs nas sprin nag ling ba pha gi'i 'og bstan ba nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig ma byas par mi 'gro gsungs skad/ bod du gser slong gi 725

'phrin yig mdzad/ lo bcu bdun sbyangs pa mdzad nas bod du byon/ sngon khu bo dang phyis mkhar phu ba la bka' gdams gsan/ rgyal yum gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhung / /'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum/ /stong phrag gsum ni lhag bcas bsgyur/ /zhes bod kyi lo tsā ba'i nang na chos bsgyur ba mang / dpe cha gang gzigs kyang tha na tsheg shad tsam la'ang zhus dag mdzad/ chos gzhi bskor ba'i gnas kyang / lha sa bsam yas sgang thog dang / /lha yangar ba lam myug gu snar/ /'khor gyi grangs ni rim pa bzhin/ khri dang sum stong bdun brgya dang / /gnyis su stong tsho bcu gsum tshogs/ khri tsho gnyis dang khri tsho gcig /rnal 'byor pho mo khri tsho gnyis/ /tshogs so lung rigs smra ba yi/ /zhar chos stong dang brgyad brgya dang / /brgyad bcu rtsa lnga yod pa la/ /rgyan dang chos mchog lnga bcu lnga/ /rnam nges nyis brgya lnga bcu lnga/ /lung chos smra ba stong dang ni/ /lnga brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga yod/ /ces so/ /gsang mda' sha ba rtsar brag ri'i bar du chos gsung dus tshangs pa'i gsung mnga' bas gsung la nye ring med kyang zhal lta ba'i phyir mi re'i shul la gser srang phyed ma'i nyo tshong byed/ phyis sku dar yol gyis bskor ba'i nang nas zhal brag la gtad nas gsung tshe chu phar kha thams cad nas nyan/ mjug tu legs par gsungs so zhes ka wa li kha btab pa'i skad kyis ri'i phyugs khyu 'drogs skad/ bka' bstan 'gyur thams cad thugs la mnga'/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor 'dus pa chung ngu tsam rtag tu 'du/ lo bcu bdun 'gro don mdzad/ slob dpon skal ldan rgyal po dang por phyi pa yin pa dang / dge slong la dud 'gro bsad pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa las med par go bas phyi pa'i lha dngos grub myur bas spang ma nus par srog gi mchog sbyin byed pa ma 'phrigs/ bod du spyan 'dren dgos gsungs nas bal po'i bar byon/ nyan gcig ra bsad pa'i mchod sbyin byas pa dgongs nas bod 726

la dar dogs gdan mi 'dren par zhus pas bla ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi nus pa can thugs log nas sbyin sreg byas/ lo 'ga' na dris pas 'phrin las shin tu che bar shes/ sbyin sreg nyer lngas 'khor bsgyur/ lnga bcus sar kunas kyi sems dpa' dgrol bas de byas kyang ma grongs zer/ slar brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dag sa pa dgrol bar bshad pa byas pas rtags byung nas ri ya ri ma ri'i 'gram klu byar bying gsum gyi mtshams su sgur sdod ces 'phrin bskur/ der phebs pa na bsnyung bas gaṇḍi rdungs gsungs pas gaṇa g.yog ma byung / dung bus gsungs pas rtsam pa'i snod dang 'brel bas subs/ btsun chung zhig la gzhung zhig thon gsungs pas/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrung ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang / /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong / /zhes zer/ da dung zhig thon gsungs pas/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang / /sogs bton pas/ mthu 'di zlog thub par 'dug ste dam tshig gi sel du 'gro bas mi zlog gsungs/ 'di la 'dzegs nas rgya mtsho'i pha rol du//'gro'o snyam nas rgya mtshor 'jug pa gang yin pa/ /sbya ba rdos 'dra rab tu 'jig pa'i lus 'di ni/ /ri mchog 'dra ba'i rang bzhin 'dis ni gtan nas bslus/ khyed kyang sde snod chos la sbyongs shig rig pa yi/ /chos nyid mthong bas tshad ma'i nges shes skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bu'i thu bo zhang dang gro lung pa la gsungs te ma ri'i rtsar mya ngan las 'das/ spur shing rta la gdan drangs tshe sa g.yos/ 'ja' 'od dang sgra chen po byung / gsangs te brdzus ma spyan drangs pas bsam yas kyi rgan mo zhig na re/ lo tsā ba chen po de bsam yas kyi rgya sgo la nges par dbu zhwa 'bud/ nga la yang gsol ras re skyel/ de'i ring bya rnams kyang 'bu mi za ba yin pa la de rnams mi 'dug pas gshegs ngebam̐/ zer skad/gsang mdar gdung sbyangs pas ston nga'i sku sogs rten khyad par can byon/ slob 727

ma'i tshogs mtha' yas kyang gtso bo zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma/ zhang gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ khyung rin chen grags te sras kyi thu bo bzhi/ gangs pa she'u/ gong bu rwa can/ sham po me dig me lhang tsher/ dmar sga lang / rngog skya bo/ kre bo mchog bla sogs mang du byon/lam rim yang mdzad cing / gro lung pas kyang bstan rim chen mo mdzad de dngos slob yan jo bo'i lugs mdzad do/ /zhang tshe spong ni gnyal chos sgo sho bor tshe spong du 'khrungs/ gro lung pa 'khrungs sa'ang phyogs mthun du yod/ tshe spong gis gsang phu'i gdan sa lo so lnga mdzad/ 'du khang bzhengs/ gro lung pas lo chen gyi thugs dang na bza' bzhugs stan bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang 'dra 'bag gi thang chen brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ lo chen gyis bsgyur rtsom mdzad pa thams cad tshar gsum du bzhengs te gcig gsang phur phul/ gcig sku 'bum du bzhugs/ gcig drin las kyi sder bzhag gsang sngags la da lta gro lung hral mo mkhas zhes rdo rje gdan gyi sgo gong la mkha' 'gro mas yi ge lan gsum btab pa dang po gnyis phyi rol pas phyis/ phyi ma phyi ma thub/ gsang phur bzhugs dus gnyal nas rgyags len pa la zhag res 'khor skad de rdzu 'phrul mnga' bar byed/ zur chos pa sku 'bum gyi shar du phya pas tshad ma/ lhor rgya ma ching ru bas byams chos/ nub tu rin tshul gyis mngon pa/ byang du yon tan shes rab kyis 'dul ba 'chad/ drin las kyi thang de dge 'dun gyis gang ba'i ka wa li kha btab pa'i sgras chu byang kha'i rta pa 'drogs skad/ drin las dang sa —chung chos bar mdzad tshe mdzo dkar po zhig la drin las kyi rgya sgo'i nang nas bcibs te brgyang stong pa zhal thon mdzad cing byon pas sab chung gi rgya sgo'i nang du phebs pa dang rdzogs so 'grig mar la'ang de ka byung bas nga'i 'phrin las 'di yun ring po mi yong ba 'dra gsungs skad/ dang por yo byad kyis 728

phongs kyang gun pa lha rje las dzam bha la'i sgrub thabs gsan pas dzaX las gser gyi sbrang ma'i gzugs kyis gsol dkar gyi nang du 'khor ba phyin longs spyod kyi rlabs 'phyur/ lo tsā ba chen po'i bzhed pa ji lta ba 'dzin zhing bstan bcos mang du mdzad de tshig gi sbyor ba kho na yang mkhas pa'i dbus na nyi ma ltar lham me'o/ /zhang tshe spong gi 'og tu gsang phur gnyal pa ri lus lo gnyis/ rnam par bas lo brgyad/ de nas gro lung pa spyan drangs pas nga'i grogs mched tshe spong gi 'og tu nga 'os pa yin yang de rjes 'ga' zhig 'dug zer bas su yin gyi gdan sar 'gro ba mi yong / zur chos ba mkhas pa cig gdan sar gtong zhes phya pa gdan sar bskos/ 'di stod lung rgya dmar ba'i slob ma yang yin/gdan sa lo bco brgyad mdzad de chu glang la thegs/ slob ma thugs sras seng chen brgyad ces/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dan 'bag smra ba'i seng ge bru sha bsod nams seng ge rma bya rtsod pa'i seng ge rtsags dbang phyug seng ge nyang bran chos kyi seng ge 'dan ma dkon mchog seng ge gnyal pa yon tan seng ge kha cig gtsang pa 'jam dpal seng ge yang 'dren/ rngog sras ra mo/ khon sras rtse mo/ gnyos sras dpal la/ khu sras ne tso ste jo sras bzhi/ 'gar dbang grub/ kong po 'jag chung / lho pa sgog zan/ par phu ba ste shes rab can bzhi/ gzhan yang 'jad pa ston skyabs dang rdo rje 'od zer sogs mkhas pa mang du byung zhing khams pa mi gsum gyis kyang thug go phu pa 'di ni bod skad smra ba la mkhas par grags/ tshad ma bsdus pa sogs mdzad de klog pa po rnams kyi bsdus pa ces pa'ang 'di nas dar ro/ /spyir bye mdo'i lugs la thugs tshis che zhing slob dpon zla ba'i lugs 'gog par mdzad do/ /gtsang nag pa ni dang por shes rab chung ba la sri mda'i brag tu mi g.yo ba bsgrubs pas mi dkar po zhig gis ral gris lus btubs pa'i snang ba byung ba nas thugs 729

rab kyi nam nangs/ phyis 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas nam mkha' ral gris gang bar gzigs te phyis sa paṇa gyis skyes bu chen po de sa thob pa'i gnas yin zhes phug pa de la phyag mdzad pas dus 'dir sa thob par grags/ bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing slob dpon zla ba'i lugs la mchog tu mdzad/ shin tu bkren zhing phyis sa skyar bzhugs zer ba sogs kyi ngag sgros 'khyam po ni mi dag par snang ngo / /rma bya byang brtson rtsod pa'i seng ge yang rang bzhin gyi gzugs 'dod rgur bsgyur ba grub cing slob dpon zla ba'i lugs mdzad/ phya pa'i gdan sar rtsags dbang phyug seng ges lo lnga/ de gnyis kyi slob ma gnyal pa dad pa bzang pos lo bdun/ 'jam rtse nes lo bdun/ /'di'i slob ma gtsang pa 'jam dpal seng ges gling stod du bshad pas gling stod smad gyes te gdan sa dngos gling smad yinapar yar lung jo bo'i chos byung dang tshal pa'i deb dmar las bris pa/ phyis kyi gnyal zhig bu dgu'i nang gi mkhas pa jo nam gyis gling smad du bshad pas gdan sa phyed du song bas gdan sa dngos gling stod yin par gsang phu ba kha cig gis bris snang / deb ther sngon po na rtsegs dang gnyal pa'i bar du gtsang pa 'jam seng lo gsum zhes bris shing gling stod kyi gdan rabs la gnyal pa dang 'jam rtse mi 'dren pa de ni ma yin no/ /'jam rtse ne phyin gling smadasgyudu bzang ba dar ma 'od dang bzang pa don grub kyis lo sum bcu gtsang pa jo nam gyis 'gral gyi chos gzhi dang gnyis dril nas lo bco lnga/ de'i slob ma rog gis zla ba druga'od zer mgon pos lo sum bcu mdzad/ slob ma 'jam dbyangs shāka gzhon/don grub dpal/ kha rag pa byang gzhon sogs byung / 'jam dbyangs shāka gzhon gyis tshal gung thang gi bshad gra btsugs/ lo drug nas gling smad kyi gdan sa lo nyer bdun mdzad/ blo gros mtshungs med phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rgya sde ba gzhon 'or sogs mkhas pa mang du byung / rgya ma ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan lo 740

brgyad/ phyogs las rnam rgyal lo brgyad sogs gling smad pa'i skabs so/ /gling stod du gtsang pa 'jam dpal seng ge 'jam ston rdo rje shes rab/ zhu ston hral mo/ blo gros 'bar/ de'i 'og tu gnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje mtshan dngos shes rab blo gros ni gnyal se khun pa zhang g.ye pa dang ngan 'bag smra seng gi slob ma yin/ grub pa thob par grags/ gdan sa lo nyer brgyad mdzad/gsang phu nas sdon la 'byon dus gra pa rnams mda' bskor/ khong rang ri la ma thogs par 'byon skad/ gsol dkar dang phyag dpe nam mkha' la bzhag ste sgro gleng mdzad thal skad bton pas gdon bgegs yul 'bud/ gsang chab kyis nad gdon thams cad zhi thub pas gsang chab dang 'o ma brje ba mi thob pa yod skad/ des 'u shang rdor lo dgur mtshams bcad de bshad pas gnyal zhig bu dgu zhes gzang ring / phu thang dar dkon/ gtsang pa gru gu ste snga tshar gsum/'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge bu dong rin rtse/ gtsang pa jo nam ste bar tshar gsum/ rgya mching ru ba/ 'jam sar/ skyel nag grags seng ste phyi tshar gsum ste phrin las can dgu byung la/ de'i gzang ring ni sa paṇa las myur ba'i shes rab mnga' bar grags/ des khro phu lo tsā ba rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten nas grub pa brnyes/ khro phur bshad gra mdzad de phyis rgal tshigs la sangs rgyas sum bcu so lnga dang dbu thod la sman bla mched brgyad byon/ lho pa grub seng la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang du byung zhing stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan dang dpang lo chen po dang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyang bshad rgyun de la byon pa yin no/ /phu thang pas stod lung mtsho smad dang yar lung sogs su bshad pas gnyan dar ma seng ge dang bya yul dkar mo sogs byung / gtsang pa gru gus zha lur bshad gra btsugs/ 'u yug pas sa paṇa la rtsod du byon pas gral dbu zhig mdzad kyi 'dug khres po ma phog par dri ba mdzad pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa re zhig 731

chos ston gsol gsungs bag phab ste gzang ring ma 'khugs pas sa skyar bshad gra btsugs/ sa paṇa gyis shārti pa dang mnyam par gsungs/ khong gis kyang sa paṇa la rnam 'grel gsan nas bshad pas rnam 'grel dar/ sngon tshad ma bsdus 'bring kho na las rnam 'grel ma dar pa las chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ nub pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes pa bstan bcos kyi mtha'i tshig spra ma legs par dgongs nas/mkhas pa'i padma rgyas byed yin/ zhes pa'i blo ka bsnan pas rnam 'grel cher dar te deng sang ni 'bring bsdus nub pa ltar snang ste/ rje btsun gyis/ phyi ma'i dus na bstan bcos kun gyi mig gcig tu ni 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa thog tu bab bo/ bu dong rin rtses brag ram du bshad gra btsugs/ slob dpon dar 'od/ dbu ma pa shes 'bum/ bu ston grags seng / o rgyan pa rin chen dpal la sogs mkhas pa mang du byung / rgya mching ru bas snye thang bde ba can btab/ sangs rgyas dpal dang snyags grags tshul sogs byon/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma bas slob dpon gnyal zhig nyid dang phyogs chos dpe la 'gro mi 'gro la nyin rangs pa gsum du brtsad pas mtha' ma'i nyin slob dpon gyis dar yug gnang mang ja bskol te gnas 'di la nga 'jam dbyangs la'ang mi 'dri bsam pa yod de khyod 'jam dbyangs dngos su gda' gsung nas 'jam dbyangs gsar mar btags/ rkyang 'dur du bshad gra btsugs/ phyis sbyor drug gi grub thob tu gyur/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar yang byon/ mchims chen pos bdag rkyen mdzad de skyel nag grags seng gis snar thang du bshad gra btsugs pa tshugs dka' na'ang mchims kyi gsung bzhin chang pa'i mang ja mang du bskol nas mtha' ma la chang pa ni phul yod/ da sgro gleng byed zer nas byas pas legs par tshugs te skyi ston grags 'bum dang chu mig pa seng ge dpal sogs byung /bcom ldan ral gri ni phu thang ba bsam yas mchod rten dkar po pa'i gra pa 7ni2

byas/ dga' ba gdong du dbyar nyi ma brtson 'grus la phar phyin slob tshe sa nad kyi rtog pa byung nas snar thang du mchims kyi gdan sar skyo ston pa phyag rdor la bsnyen pa lo bcu gnyis nyi ma ma mthong bar bsgrubs pa de'i drung du byon/ snar thang gi sgo'i them pa la zhabs bzhag pa dbu la nyi ma shar ba tshogs dung bus pa rnams mtshungs pas rten 'brel legs par byung / nad 'di la zhed mi dgos/rnam nges kyi gzhung de grog po pha gir skyor gsungs/ rnam nges stong bskyar bas sa nad yul bud/ skyi ston grags 'bum la bsten te mkhas par gyur te rigs pa'i ral grir grags/ snar thang du bshad pa mdzad pas sde sdod 'dzin pa sum gnyis 'dus par grags/ mkhan po zi dbon/ skyi ston shākra 'bum sogs mkhas pa mang du byon/ 'jam sgeg pag shi slob ma'i mchog yin yang slob dpon la 'dre'i sdigs ri bskur bas thugs log ste 'khor sa ma byung nas sa skyar bzhugs/ phyis hor rgyal po bu yan du'i bla ma mdzad/ 'bul ba ci bskur yang ma mnyes pa la phyis rgya snag sgam gang shog bu smyug gu sogs phul bas mnyes te nga'i bu de la shes rab yod gsungs skad/ des kyang bstan bcos mang du mdzad de mkhas pa mchog tu grags/ de gnyis po'i slob ma dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes kyis 'dul ba lung gi lung rgyun rgya nag nas blangs/bka' bstan 'gyur la bam tshad 'gyur byang sogs nges pa'i dkar chag brtsams/'jam sgeg gis yo byad gnang ste lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer dang rgyang ro byang 'bum sogs gsum gyis dka' ba chen pos dbus gtsang thams cad nas phyi mo btsal te bka' dang bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs te snar thang bka' 'gyur dang snar thang bstan 'gyur zhes thog ma yin la/ phyis bod yul thams cad du mang du mched pa yin no/ /gnyal zhig dpon slob kyi skabs so/ / 733

gling stod du gnyal zhig la 'og tu rgyal ba se ston/ rgya mching ru ba/chu mig pa seng ge dpal 'di snar thang gi dge bshes yin yang mching ru pa la rtsod du yong pas ma thub par dad de rgya mching gi slob mar gyur to/ /ldan ma grags rin lho brag pa sogs byung ngo / /lo tsā ba'i slob ma zhang gnyis kyi skabs so /'bre shes rab 'bar gyis nyang stod gnas rnying du phar phyin bshad/ gtsang pa 'bre sgur ar byang yis sogs byon la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar gyis gdan sa mdzad de dbon rgyud kyis 'dzin no/ /gtsang pa 'bre skur gyis dga' ba gdong bya rog tshang sogs su bshad/ ar byang yes kyis gcig por 'phan yul nas sgo la la byon pas sa 'phyis te la thog tu grog sul zhig tu gzims/ der bu mo mi ngan gyis gos phral ba'i gcer bu zhig kyang byung / de 'khyags nas 'chi bar 'dug pas lus kyi drod la bcar te/ na tshod mnyam par ma dang bu mo dang /sring mo'i 'du shes skyed bgyi gsungs pa yin/ khyod rang nga la pha'i 'du shes zhog ngas khyod la bu mo'i 'du shes bzhag gi chags par ma byed cig gsungs/bu mo des snga bar pha ma'i sar phyin te 'di 'dra ba'i dge bshes bzang po zhig 'byon gyi 'dug smras pas spyan drangs te pha mas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gsung rab sogs phul/ 'di nas 'phrin las rgyas pas mkhas mgo btsun gyis thon pa ar zhes grags shing gnam tseng ldeng dang / gzhu kun ra/ gnam rdzing kha la sogs par bshad/ gra pa dpe 'grems brgyad brgya tsam 'dus/ dkar chung ring mo dang khu sher brtson sogs mang du byon/ de gsum ku'i slob ma zhang g.ye pas mon 'dra dang rgya grong 'or la sogs par mdo smad tsho bzhi'i gra pa la bshad/ mkhas pa bsod rin/ gnyal zhig rgyal ba se ston sogs mtha' yas pa byon/ gral stan za 'og la bhed pa dang / mang ja re la ja sig chen lnga bcu 7kyi4

tsam dgos par grags/ mkhan po bsod rin/ 'gral shes rgyal/ gtsang pa jo nam rnams rim par gdan sa mdzad/ 'di yan dpe thog nas 'chad pa la 'gral gyis thugs thog nas bshad pas chos blo 'chad kyi snga mar grags te de phyin gling smad pa dang 'dres pa yin no/ /'gral gyi sku tshe'i smad la shab 'bre sgang du bshad gra btsugs/ rwa grags she sogs byon/ 'bre ar gyi chos grar lha 'du bas dri zhim po 'ong bar grags shing / de phyin gyi phar phyin pa phal cher 'bre ar la bsten pa yin no/ /rngog lo'i dngos slob las 'bre khyung gi skabs so /mdor na dpal ldan gsang phu 'di ni bod kyi klog pa po'i chu bo thams cad kyi 'byung gnas gangs ri lta bu yin la phyis kyang mkhas pa chen po g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal/ de'i slob ma rong ston shes bya kun rig dang / snye thang bde ba can du sbyangs pa mdzad cing red mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi slob ma shar tsong kha pa chen po rnams so so'i rgyud 'dzin gyis bod yul khyab par gnas shing bka' gdams kyi lta grub 'dzin pa deng sang mi snang yang 'di thams cad bka' gdams pa las 'phros pa ni yin la/ rje sgam po pa phyin gyi dwags rgyud pa rnams ni bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres zhes zab mo lta ba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung gnyis bka' gdams dngos 'dzin pa yin no/ /bod yul na bka' gdams par grags pa jo bo rje a ti sha'i bka' rgyud kyi skabs te/ chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bod yul gyi skabs las jo bo bka' rgyud bshad pa ste skabs drug pa'o// //kyi/ yig bkos byed po gnyal gyi sgang brgyud nas/ / tshe dbang dar po dpon slob dgu yis bgyis/ bya yul dpon sa tshogs gnyis grub ma yis/ /par gyi mthun rkyen sbyar dge byang chub bsngo/ / 735
yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs las bdun pa bka' brgyud spyi'i chos byung bzhugs/ /

le'u bdun pa bka' brgyud spyi'i chos byung / rgyal bas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kun/ /ming tshig don spyi tsam du ma lus par/ /mngon sum nyid du rtogs pa rgyud la skyed/ /tshe 'di'i ched du sbyor dgrol dbang dgug sogs/ /chos ltar bcos pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /'chi chos snying nas bzod med dran pa dang / /srid dang zhi bas ma 'phrogs nges 'byung dang / /bdag pas gzhan gces kun rdzob byang sems dang / /sangs rgyas bla mar shes pa'i mos gus dang / /chos kun mnyam nyid mthong ba'i dag snang dang / /cis kyang dgos pa med pa'i zhen log dang / /yin lugs nang nas shar ba'i rtogs pa dang / /sangs rgyas sems las rnyed pa'i 'bras bu dang / /gcig shes thams cad grol ba'i kun mkhyen rnams/ /mngon sum nyid du rgyud la skyed byed pa/ /bstan pa'i yang snying bka' rgyud rin po che/ /'di ni grub chen kun gyi gshegs bshul te/ khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog mir bstan pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan te lo pas/ /bka' babs bzhi yi chu bo gcig tu bsdus/ /rdo rje7 'chang las mngon sum chos kun gsan/ /rdo rje phag mos gsang ba'i sgo kun phye/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi bdag por gyur pa des/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal ldan na ro par/ /snying po'i bstan pa yongs su tshang bar gtad/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje mar pa lo tsā dang / /gsang ba 'dus pa'i ngo bo mi la rje/ /gsung gi rdo rje sgam po pa la sogs/ /bstan pa'i bdag por rim par dbang bskur zhing / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprul sku dpag med dang / /bskal bzang sangs rgyas grub thob brgyad bcu 739

sogs/ /gang 'dul sku dang mtshan du snang ba yis/ /skal ldan nam mkha'i mthas klas grol mdzad pa/ /snying po'i bstan pa bka' rgyud rin chen gyis/ /'dzam gling khyab par rgyun mi chad par byung / /byang chub sems kyi rtsa brtan zhi lhag dang / /bslab gsum rang bzhin byang phyogs yal ga can/ /lung dang mngon rtogs bye ba'i lo mdab rgyas/ /skyed dang rdzogs pa'i me tog rab bkra zhing / /brtson 'grus dbang gis 'di dang 'chi srid dang / /bar dor grol ba'i 'bras bu bzang po can/ /rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs chos kyi yongs 'du che/ khams gsum kun tu gnyis pa ma mchis pa/ /'di la bsten nas bstan pa'i yan lag gi /'khri shing sna tshogs brten nas gnas pa yin/ /de phyir rmad byung snying po'i bstan pa dngos/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gral rim ma nyams pa/ /mar mi dwags po'i bka' brgyud rin chen la/ /rnam pa kun tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /(bod yul phyi rabs 'dir rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa ni bka' brgyud rin po che nyid yin te/ de yang theg pa chen po'i 'di las gsungs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku chen po de nyid la sngags bla med du thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes bya zhing / thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya dag pa la phun tshogs lnga ldan du rgyun mi chad par bzhugs pa de la sprul pa'i sku te lo pas dngos su thun mong ma yin pa'i chos mtha' dag gsan pas bha ga la ru sangs rgyas mjal/ zhes bshad pa yin la/ mi'i bla ma med do snyam pa dag sel phyir bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma bstan pa yin la de yang / sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ āryā de wa/ zla ba grags pa/ ma rta gi ste shar gyi bka' babs so/ lca i pa/ ḍi gi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ sa khadha ri rnams lho'i 'o/ /ḍombi pa/ bee na sa/ la ba pa/ ind+rasgyi ti rnams nub kyi'o/ /su ma ti/ thang lo pa/ shing lo ba/ garsha ri pa/ dzā lanta ra pa/ tsānd+ra ba rnams byang gi'o) de yang rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa he ru gas rgyud mtha' dag gsungs/ sdud pa pos bsdus te o rgyan gyi yul dharma dzag tra chos kyi pho brang na glegs bam gyi 740

rnam par bzhugs so/ /de yang sngags bar ma'i grub thob thams cad kyi mchog dpal sa ra ha ni ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya dang so drug na —byon par rje rang byung zhabs kyis gsungs la/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pas bla med don rdzogs 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni bzhi gnyis lon pa na/ /o rgyan yul du nga nyid 'byung / /'jig rten kun gyi dpal dang ldan/ padma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ /sngags kyi ston par lung du bstan/ /zhes dang / lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /cig car mchog gi skal ba can/ /sa ra ha zhes bya ba 'byung / /rkyen bral gsum gyi don rtogs nas/ /sangs rgyas sa la de nyid 'gro/ /zhes 'dren la/ bdag gis ni rgyud de cha ma 'tshal to/ /mdor na de tsam na lho phyogs bee dharbha ste bod la be ta'i yul du grags pa der bram ze chen po zhig la sras mched lnga yod pa'i tha chung ngo / /de thams cad bram ze'i rig pa la shin tu mkhas shing rgyal po ma hā pā las bkur ba las nyin cig skyed mos tshal du skyo gseng la byon pas bram ze'i bu mo phul du byung ba bzhi rigs ngan ma dang lnga 'dug pa la gang nas kyang ma 'ongs zhes sogs dri lan gyis chos bstan pa khong du chud cing phu bo bzhi bram ze mo re dang bcas mkha' spyod du yal lo/ /der tha chung skyo bar gyur te sras dgra gcan zin gyi mkhan bu theg chen dpal gyi grags pa las rab tu byung bar rang byung zhabs bzhed cing phal cher sras dgra gcan zin las rab tu byung bar 'chad/der tshul khrims rdzogs cing mkhas pa zla med par gyur/ lan cig skyed tshal du byon pas sngar gyi mna' ma bzhi dkyil 'khor bshams tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed pa gzigs te thod par chang sna mi 'dra ba bzhi byin pa cung zad 'thungal pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes/ bram ze mo bzhi rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dngos su gyur te dbang bzhi bskur la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gros khyod kyi bla ma 'di na gsungarsha/ pas 741

nam mkha' la lha sras bde ba'i mgon po zhes sam blo gros rin chen zhes bya ba de dang dpal rta ca/grin byon/ phyag rgya chen po cig car pa'i gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / der lus chang gis ra ro/ ngag rdo rje'i glus ra ro/ sems lhan skyes ye shes kyis ra ro ste/ du ma ro gcig rgya mtsho 'dra/ bde chen bdal ba'i ngang la lus/ /cir snang phyag rgya chen por shar/ /nyam nga med pa'i ngang la lus/ /gzhi med spyod pa smyon pa 'dra/ /bdag 'dzin bral ba'i ngang la lus/ /zhen pa rang log bu chung 'dra/ /snang la ma zhen ngang la lus/ khar sang phan chod bram ze min/ /gtsang sbra byed pa'i bram ze yin/ /de ring phyin chad bram ze yin/ /don gyi bram ze gtsang sbra che/ khar sang phan chad dge slong min/ /dka' thub byed pa'i dge slong yin/ /de ring phyin chad dge slong yin/ /don gyi dge slong dka' thub che/ /zhes sogs gsungs te tshong 'dus su byon bas mda' mkhan ma mda' byed pa la gzigs pas snang ba thams cad brdar shar te mda' mkhan ma phyag rgyar khrid nas spyod pa mdzad/ dmangs rnams kyis mi mdzad par zhus pas sprul sku gtso bor ston pa dmangs do ha gsungs/ rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams kyis zhus pas longs sku gtso bor ston pa btsun mo do ha gsungs/ rgyal po nyid kyis zhus pas chos sku gtso bor ston pa— rgyal po do ha gsungs pas thams cad grol te yul de stongs bar gyur/ phyis gzhung gsum tā la'i lo ma la bris pa sgra mkhan spun gnyis kyi lag tu babs pa nas dar skad/'phags pa klu sgrub dge 'dun gyi zhal ta bar bskos te dpal gyi ri la bzhud/klu sgrub dge 'dun gyi nang na bzhugs tshe nang cig bu mo gzhon nu zhig gis nang thams cad byi dor byas te gnangs nang par 'bod pa zhig 'ong gis der ma 'grokhrig zer/ gnangs 'bod pa la ma phyin pas yang bu mo de byung nas khang pa shag 'i/ga na sha khrag za ba'i mi mang po yod sar khrid de phyin nas sha zo zhig zer ma 742

zos pas de rnams mi snang bar gyur/ bu mo na re da gnangs nang par khyod kyi mdun na bya ngang pa tshan gcig 'ong gis de'i nang na yi dam 'phagal pa 'jam dpal bzhugs yod kyis gcig zung zhig zer/ der gang yin nam bsam pa la shor/ yang byung ste gnangs bud med kha cig 'ong gis gcig cis kyang zung zhig zer/ gnangs nyin de ltar bzung bas mer 'bar/ da dung bzung bas chur gyur/ chu bzung bas 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gyur nas steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags te dngos grub ci 'dod gsung ba na/ mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba zhig zhu/ thun mong gi dngos grub rgya mtsho'i nang na rin po che'i mkhar rtsa ba klu'i yul du yod pa rtse mo lha yul du sleb pa lha klu mi gsum gyi longs spyod la dbang byed pa zhig zhu byas pas gnyi ga byin gyis su la'ang ma smra zhig gsungs/ lha klu mtha' yas pas brtsigs te mkhar tshar la khad pa na dga' ches te ma la zur tsam smras pas mkhar rtsa ba nas 'gyel/ khyod kyis dngos grub len mi shes par 'dug gsungs/ der thos pa chung bas lan snyam ste/ ha cang thos pa ma chung zhig /thos pa chung na'ang nga bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te thos pa mdzad pas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad mkhyen yang thugs ma gang ste/ ha cang thos pa ma che zhig /thos pa ches na'ang nga bzhin no/ /gsungs skad/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bud med du sprul pa zhig gi rkya ba gser du 'dug nas gser 'gyur gyi gdams pa zhus pas gnang ste dge 'dun bskyangs/ dpal gyi ri la bram ze chen po'i drung du byon te bdud rtsi bum pa gang la phyag rten byas pas rgya mtsho chen po bdud rtsir bsgyur bas thugs rgyal chag mchog gi dngos grub thob pa des ārya de wa rjes su bzung / klu sgrub dbu sbyin par btang tshe 'jig rten du nyi ma nub bo zhes ngus pas nam mkha' nas mkha' 'gros/ nga ni 'di nas lo ni lnga brgya na/ /so na zhes pa'i 743

grong khyer chen po ru/ /nyi ma nub kyang zla bas mun sel ba/ /rnam dag rigs las 'khrungs pa'i paṇḍita/ /zla ba grags pa zhes bya'i mkhas pa 'byung / /zhes lung bstan/ ārya de wa la bsten te grol/ des ma taX gi la gdams/ des slob dpon te lo ba la gdams te ma taXm gi 'tshol du byon pas ba la nga rdzi ma taX gi zhes pa mi gzhan pas nyis 'gyur gyis che ba zhig yod zer te rnyed nas gnyi ga'i 'tsho ba sbyor zhig gsungs te ting 'dzin la bzhugs/ des sgyu lus 'od gsal la sogs pha rgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / 'di 'phags pa klu'i dngos slob kyang yin/ pha rgyud rlung gtso bor ston pa shar gyi bka' babs so/ /rgyal po cig gi sras 'bring po cig yab dang gcen la gnod zer nas sgyugs pa rgyal khams gzhan du yi ge'i gra zhig tu phyin/ yig dpon gyi g.yog byas pas yi ge mkhas par shes te rgyal po'i yig mkhan du gyur/ yang btsun mo dang dum mo zhes phra ma byung ste sprugs/ yul gzhan zhig tu slebs te shing drung zhig na 'khor ba la skyo zhing yid 'byung ba'i tshe lho phyogs nas 'brug sgra lta bu dang bcas te rnal 'byor pa gzi 'od dang ldan pa zhig lam byon nas spyi bor phyag bzhag pa'i mod la de kho na nyid mngon du gyur te lo bcu gnyis su rtogs pa 'di skyongs shig gsungs te sa ra ha yin skad/ der chu bo gaX gā la nya pa lnga brgya tsam gyis nya rtag par gsod cing de'i rgyu lto bor ba'i phung po chen po 'dug nas 'di bdag gir ma byas pa dang rnyed sla ba dang 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa dang rgyun du 'ong bas 'tsho ba dag par 'dug snyam ste des 'tsho ba mdzad cing ri sna'i gad phug zhig tu sgrub pa mdzad/ grub pa thob ga'i tshe gnod sbyin rnams kyis zhag bdun du ser ba phab pas gangs ri ltar gyur nas ri sna de chad nas chur lhung yang slob dpon ting nge 'dzin ma sad pa nya chen po zhig gis mid/ ci zhig na nya de nya pa rnams kyis zin nas bshas pas slob dpon byung ste ting nge 'dzin las 744

sad/ nya'i rgyu sto gsol ba dang / nya'i lto nas byung ba gnyi ga'i rgyu mtshan gyis ltu yi pa ste nya rgyu pa'am nya sto pa zhes grags so/ /des lho phyogs o ṭi pi sha'i yul du mar sī tra'i rgyal po bi ma la tsand+ra gdul byar gzigs te rgyal po skyed mos tshal du 'byon pa'i lam du gcer bur gzims pa na bram ze mdun na 'don 'a/'or bcas kyis bkra mi shis pa'i rtags sel du 'ongs pas mthong ste/ rigs ngan dag phyir khyed cig zer ba na/ ma lus pa 'di ji tsam yin te 'jig rten gsum po ji tsam yin/ /de nyid kyi ni cha gcig mi bdag gzhan yin de nyid de'i g.yog yin na/ /blo bzang de yang gzhan gyi dam pa'i spyod la bzhad gad byed pa ni/ /e ma 'khor ba ngo mtshar re che 'di la smra mang ci zhig dgos/ /ces gsungs pas thams cad kyis 'then yang sgul ma nus/ rgyal po la zhus pas glang chen smyon pas rdzir chug gsungs te btang bas bskor ba byas shing zhabs la lces bldags/ rgyal po nyid 'ongs nas khyod su yin byas pas/ ra tsa ho yi nga rgyal po yin zer/ rgyal po'i yo byad rnams ga re gsungs pas/ sa yi mal stan chen po la/ /lag pa'i sngas ni 'bol la mnyen/ /nyi ma zla ba'i sgron me dang / /dus kyi rlung gis bsil g.yab byas/ /rgyal ltar srid na 'jigs med pa'i/ /rnal 'byor nga ni bde bar nyal/ /zhes smras pas rnal 'byor par go ste pho brang du spyan drangs/ gdams pa zhus pas rgyal srid spongs shig gsungs te bde mchog gi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas rtog pa gang la 'phro dris pas rgyal po smad tshong ma la 'phro zer mdun na 'don des ḍim gi yi sgra la 'phro zer/ der byin gyis brlabs te rgyal po la rgyal srid spongs la o ṭa pu ri khur ba'i grong na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma smad tshong du bstan pa de'i khol po gyis la rtogs pa skyongs dang lo bcu gnyis na 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa mchog gi dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /blon po la grong khyer 'di nyid kyi chang tshong 745

ma 'di zhes bya ba'i khol po gyis la rtogs pa 'di skyongs shig lo bcu gnyisan thams cad grol bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ /slob dpon 'dis bde mchog gi sgrub thabs mdzad do/ /rgyal pos kyang yo byad rnams mchod yul la phul/phongs pa la byin/ cha shācig rgyal srid kyi rgyur bzhag ste btsun mo stong phrag bcu gnyis dang rgyal sa spangs nas smad tshong ma'i g.yog byas/ nyin zhing las dang nang nub chang nyo dang nyal po la yong pha kun gyi lus bkru pa dang bsku mnye byas/nub mo bsgoms/ ḍim gi pas kyang chang nyo mi kun gyi skyel bsu dang bzi ba kun gyi ngan skyugs 'phyag pa dang / go la'i rtsigs ma 'dor ba sogs g.yog gus par byas pas chu len pa na bum pa mgo thog tu khur yang mgo la mi reg par byung / rgyal po la bltas pas reg cing 'dug pas/ bla ma'i bka' yin bsam nas gus por mdzod byas pas rgyal pos kyang gus par byas pa na bum pa nam mkha' la lding bar gyur/ lo bcu gnyis na ḍim gi pas yul khams kyi skye bo thams cad dang bcas te phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ des rgyal po grol bar byas/ des smad tshong ma su kha dha ri sogs bud med stong phrag bcu bzhi grol bar byas/ nyal po la 'ongs pa'i skyes pa gcig kho na lus pa'i tshe nam mkha' las sgra byung ba/ grong khyer 'di'i dbus na rdo ring gi steng na rdo'i glang po che zhig yod pa da lta kha shar du bltas yod/ lo re la til tsam re nur nas de nub phyogs su kha bltas pa'i tshe da lta'i yul mi thams cad grong 'dir skyes nas khyod dang bcas pa grub pa 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes pa byung / rgyal po dā ri dra bas bde mchog gi bstod pa dang keng rus kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad/ gzhan lus shes rab la sogs pa'i bka' drin rnyed pa lho'i bka' babs so/ /ḍombi he ru ka ni nub phyogs o rgyan gyi grong khyer chen po cig na bram ze'i khye'u dad pa can rtsed mo'ang dkon mchog gi las las mi 746

byed gtam du dkon mchog las mi smra ba gnyis yod pa/ yul chos kyis dus bzang la dur khrod dang lha khang du mchod pa byed du 'gro bas tshes bcu'i dus sngags kyi lha khang du mchod pa la phyin/ tshur lam dur khrod la lam yod pa la 'ongs pas dur khrod kyi dbus su sa sros/ ce spyang gis gnod kyis dogs/ de na ri chung zhig 'dug pa'i brag skyibs su bsdad pas ri de la yang mi ro'i rgyal mtshan zhig phyar te 'dug dar zhig na ḍa ma ru'i sgra grag tsam na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mtha' yas pa nang du yib song / ci zhig na mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo gri thod thogs pa du ma byung ste dur khrod thams cad btsal nas tshogs kyi rgyu gnyi ga 'di na 'dug zer nas byung / ci byed dris pas lus kyis dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mchod do zer/ der lus don can du song ba go bcad 'on kyang smon lam gdab kyi byas pas 'di skal pa dang ldan par 'dug gtso mo la zhu'o zer nas song bas khrid shog gsungs te nang du khrid de dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dbus su he ru ka yab yum gyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pas bram ze'i khye'u che ba de de nyid du yal te 'di la ḍimbi he ru ka chen por grags so/ /cig shos kyang yal bar byung ba la mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis sku mi sdud par gsol ba btab cing rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rnam smin gyi lus ma sdud par skal ldan rjes su zung zhig gsungs mkha' 'gro ma lha'i lus las 'das pa cig phyag rgyar phul bas de sprang mo hul mo zhig tu sprul te dur khrod du 'jag lcil mdzad de des 'tsho ba slongs nas sbyor ro/ /nam zhig nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchod rten brgya rtsa bzheng pa la slongs pas ma byin par sprang mo ngan ma 'di zer nas brdegs pas des slob dpon la rdzu 'phrul ston par zhus te lta stangs kyis mchod rten rnams mgo mjug bsgyur nas bzhag nang par khong rnams mchod rten zhal sror 'ongs pa na de ltar mthong bas kha sang gi sprang mo de 747

brdungs pas lan/ de rnal 'byor pa zhig gi chung ma yin/ dur khrod na 'dug zer te 'ongs pas 'jag lcil gyi sgo na maṭaṃl byed cing 'dug nang du rnal 'byor pa la bzod par gsol bas rnal 'byor ma la bzod par gsol zhig gsungs/ bzod par gsol bas lan gnyis su ci yang mi zer/ gsum pa la bzod do zer/ 'o na mchod rten rnams bsgyur du gsol byas pas bla ma la zhu'o zer te zhus nas rnal 'byor pa de byung / des lta stangs gyen du ldog pas mchod rten gzhan rnams drang por gyur/ thog mtha' gnyis mgo zhabs 'o/ga rung 'dug pas 'di'ang bsgyur bar zhu byas pas 'di tsam zhig phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa la ston pa'i phyir 'jog gsungs pa deng sang yang yod skad/ skye ba bdun pa'i sha btsal te don bya'o dgongs nas 'bras ldan gyi grong nas bram ze dung gi rna cha can bya ba skye ba bdun pa cig gi ro blangs te stag la chibs/ dug sbrul la gong rmed dang lcag byas/ g.yung po'i bu mo zhig chibs longs su bskyon/ skye bdun gyi ro pang par blangs te dngos grub su 'dod gsungs nas grong khyer bskor bas nang pa'i rnal 'byor pa stag la sbrang rgod blud/ sbrul la bla rtsi blud nas nus pa yod tshul ston pa zer nas kun ma mos skad/ g.yung mo la longs spyad pas ḍimbi he ru ka zhes g.yung po khrag 'thung du grags/ yirlu pa'i slob ma ḍombi pa ko mkhan nyid yin la/ 'di la rje rang byung bas kyang / /bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs rnal 'byor pa/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /bsod stoms pa zhig gis bdag rjes su bzung bar zhu zer ba la/ skye bdun gyi srin lag zhig bcad de byin pas de nyid du grol/ der chang tshong ma pi ca sa'i khyim du byon te chang nyo'o gsungs pas rin ci yod zer/ nyi grib mtshams su phur pa btab nas 'di ma 'das par 'jal lo zer bas chang drangs pas chang thams cad zad/ da dung nyi ma ma song chang 'dod zer bas chang tshong ma lnga brgya'i chang bskyes nas drangs/ rgyal 748

po'i chu tshod sogs rtsis thams cad 'phyugs/ mi thams cad gnyid kyis myos te rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis rnal 'byor pas nyi ma bzung ba zhig 'dug zer nas rtsad bcad pas bi ma las rnal 'byor pa 'di 'dra zhig 'dug zer te nyi ma gtong bar zhus pas 'di btang na nga la chang rin med gsungs/ chang rin rgyal pos gzhal bas bre bo che'i 'bras khal lnga brgya song / chang tshong ma de dad nas dbang gdams ngag gnang ste spyod pa 'di nyid kyis lam sgrubs shig gsungs te sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du bzhugs te chang 'thungs pas nad 'tsho ba dang ye shes rang byung du shar ba du ma byung ngo / /nam zhig rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti sbrul gyi rigs shig gis zin pa na rgya mtsho'i gting gi chu la sman nam sngags btab na ma gtogs mi 'tsho zer ba la/ bee na sa grub thob mar grags pas lon nam zer nas bka' bsgos pas/ chang bum pa gang khyer te rigs kyi rtog pa spongs la 'di gsol chu yang blang gis zer te chang gsol bas nad phal cher zhi/ chu len du song ba la rkang mgyogs pa bltar btang bas de ma thag hal zhing byung ste skad cig gis rgya mtsho'i steng la sa la 'gro ba bzhin du song nas mtsho'i gting du song zer de ma thag chu khyer te byung / rgyal pos gdams pa zhus pas rigs kyis snyems pas snod du mi rung / bu zhig bskyed la 'dul du gzhug dgos snyam nas bskyed de rab tu byung nas mkhas pa chen por gyur te chos 'chad pa na yum gyis zas chang mang du bsnams te khyod kyi bu smad la phrad du 'ongs so gsungs pas paṇḍita tshul khrims kyis yus te brgyal/ sangs pa dang bu smad kyi 'dzin pa dang ma bral pa de ga bu smad yin mod gsungs pas nges shes skyes te dbang gdams ngag bstan nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pas skyongs shig par bsgo bas grong khyer du 'tsho ba slo res su byas nas bsgoms/ nam zhig 'bras chan snga ma zad nas phyi ma 'tshed kyi bar du sgo drung du 'od gsal la zhugs pas sad/ des 'bras chan 749
