drangs pa'ang so mar 'dug ste lo bcu gnyis lon/ rgyal pos ngas bur bzung paṇḍita bcol bas 'di lta bur srang du nyal ba zhes dmad tshe steng gi nam mkha' la byon pas dad de dbang dang gdams pa gnang bas rgyal po grol lo/ /dus der o rgyan gyi bud med thams cad 'jig rten bgyi ba'i mkha' 'gro mar yod cing rgyal po'i btsun mo lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi tha chung kho na nang pa'i mkha' 'gro'i rigs can yin la gzhan thams cad phyi pa'i rigs can yin pas sha za'i mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus te slob dpon la rdo char phab pa sdigs mdzub bstan pas rdo khang pa tsam na mkhar lus pa la ba pa'i rdo brdugs su grags pa da dung yod skad/ slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro ma de rnams lug tu byin gyis brlabs nas bal bregs te la ba sku la gsol bas la ba bar grags/ skyes pa rnams kyis bud med ma rnyed nas rgyal po la zhus pas slob dpon la zhus gsungs te zhus pas chad pa khal len na gtong gsungs te bud med rnams mgo la lham gyon/ sna la sna bcu chug sbrul gyi ga sha gyis gsungs te da lta'ang o rgyan gyi bud med rnams de bzhin yod/ rgyal pos chu bo ko tam pa ri'i phar 'gram du slob dpon bzhuṭa su gsol/ btsun mo rnams re mos kyis sba'i dpyang thag las 'tsho ba skyel 'jug pa las/ btsun mo tha chung gi res la rgyal pos sgo ba brjed de nam phyed na dran/ grub thob kyi 'tsho ba nang re chag na mu ge lo bcu gnyis yong bas de 'phral btsun mo la bsgos te rgyal po intu bo dhis mi tshangs par spyod pa spangs pa'i bden pas chu khyod gyen la ldog par gyur cig gyis la song zhigabaden pas chu chad pa'i bar la phyin te 'tsho ba drangs pas bzhes te dro mdzad/nga slob dpon la ba pas gnyid dang kham gyi zas spangs pa'i bden pas chu khyod gyen la ldog par gyur cig gyis la song zhig gsungs te de bzhin byung bas btsun mo dad de rgyal po dang slob dpon gyis byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes kyi 750

mkha' 'gror gyur/ der btsun mo lnga bcu pos sprang po la ba pa 'dis rgyal po nang par bcug gis bsad par bya'o zhes bgros te gnyis kyis nyin myul te mtshan mo thams cad song ba na slob dpon 'od gsal la zhugs pas sku ma mthong ste la ba spung nge 'dug nas da ko 'di na 'dug pa yin te zhes mdzub mo btsuṭa pa shangs la reg byung skad/ rnal 'byor pa 'di g.yo che bas la bar brdzus pa yin te 'ong zer nas la ba dum bur byas nas zos/ sang nyin slob dpon gcer bur byon pas ci lags zhus pas khyed kyi btsun mo rnams smyo nas la ba zos song gsungs/ spyi bor thal lcag re brgyab pas la ba dum bu re bskyugs byung ba gcig tu gyur te gsol/ de ltar slob dpon dang rgyal pos o rgyan gyi skye bo rnams btul to/ /rmi lam dang bar do'i gdams pa rnyed pa nub kyi bka' babs so/ /mkha' 'gro skal pa bzang mo ni su mi ta kun tu bzang mo zhes kyang bya ste rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi sku'i bkod pa'o/ /des mya ngam gyi thang du bzhugs pa thang lo ba dang / des ljon shing gi rtse la bzhugs pa shing lo pa rjes su bzung / des ba rend+ra'i rgyal sa spangs te nālarnar slob dpon rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung ba mtshan blo gros snying po'i dpal rtsod pa las rgyal bas slob dpon dgra las rgyal ba zhes grags pa de dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs te o ḍi bi sha'i nags la rtse gcig du sgrub pa'i tshe yul de'i rgyal po ri dwags gshor du 'ongs bas mthong ste dad nas ras kyi thod phul bas slob dpon gyis ma bzhes te/ dngos rnams sems su shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams la brnyas par mi bya ste/ de ni rtswa rtse chung ngu bas kyang chung ba'i dngos la chags pa min/ /rngul 'dzag pas ni 'gram yang nag por 'gyur ba yi/ /glang chen rnams ni padma'i skud pa phra mo dag gis 'khyig par mi nus bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyal po skyengs te nags gseb kyi dge slong 'di 'bebs nus na bya dga' chen po ster 751

ro zhes dritshopa bsgrags pas chang tshang ma ma smad kyis khas blangs te bkur sti byas/bu mo bcu drug ma zhig yod pa slob dpon gyi zham ring du phul bas padma can du gzigs shing rim pa gsum pa nor bu 'gengs pa'i skabs su son nas phyag rgya bsgrubs te rim pa lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa grub pa na sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo'ang bzhag go der rgyal pos 'bangs na bza' mi yod do cog gi bud mid kyis chang bum pa bteg cing skyes pas rgyal po la 'dren dgos pa'i khrims bcas chang tshong ga la bab tshe bu mos chang ban bteg cing slob dpon gyis 'dren pa na rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas sngar gyi tshig go ldog ste/ brnyas par bya ba ste/ /zhes dang / 'khyig par nus pa bzhin/ /zhes brjod cing thal mo brdabs pa na slob dpon gyis chang bum brdabs pas chang gi rgyun ma chad pas yul de chang gi mtshor song zhing grong kun yang chang gi steng la yom byung / slob dpon gyis btsun mo kriṇi sā ra'i pags par byas nas rked la dkris/ sras pho mo rdo rjer dril bur byas te mkha' spyod du 'byon par dgongs te steng gi nam mkhar byon pa dang / chang gi sbu ba'i gseb nas thugs rje chen po'i sku zhig byon nas rigs kyi bu sems can 'di snyed yal bar 'dor ram gsung bas sa la bab ste rdo rje sa la bsnun pas bug pa zhig byung bar chang thams cad song ste sku de'ang byin rlabs can du grags/ bug pa'i sgo de yang chang gi dri chen pos myos thub pa zhig deng sang 'dug skad/ slob dpon gyis yul khams de thams cad rdo rje theg pa la bkod cing khyad par rgyal po de mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa ni slob dpon dzā laddhā ra pa'o/ /tsārya pa ni sti ga lar rje rigs su 'khrungs/ slob dpon dzā ladzhai ras rjes su bzung ste bde mchog gi sgo nas spyod pa sgrub tu nye ba na slob dpon gyis ga'u zhig bskur te 'di kha ma dbye bar o rgyan gyi yul dur khrod cig na bud med mang po gral byas pa'i gsha༄ na bud med ngams nag la bongs thung 752

ba mkhur tshol g.yon na rme ba nag po sum brtsegs can yod kyis de la 'di phul la byin rlabs zhus shig gsungs/ de ltar byas pas des ga'u'i steng du me tog cig bzhag nas kha ma dbye par bla ma la phul zhig stag sogs byung na lta stangs gyis dang zlog par 'gyur ro gsungs/ stag la lta stangs byas pas rengs pa dang ga'u kha phye bas rgyan drug 'dug pa btags te spyod pa la rgyu bar zhus pas da dung ma ran gsungs/ ma gsan par 'khor mang po dang bcas byon pas ri bor zhig tu skom pas nyen pa dang mi zhig thong pa khur glang gnyis ded pa dang phrad de chu long ste nga'i glang stag gis bzar 'ong zer bas srung bar byas te chu 'tshol du song ba na stag byung ba cis kyang ma thub ste glang zos/ mi de byung bas slob dpon dzālandha rang gyur te spyod pa ma ran pa'i rtags 'di yin gyis ma byed zer te mi snang yang byon pas bkres te chu 'gram na mi ro za bar 'dod nas mi zhig la gri g.yar bas/ spyod pa byed na 'di ltar gyis zer nas bya rog tu byas te zos nas slob dpon du gyur nas sngar bzhin gsungs/ yang chu bo chen po cig la 'dze mo nyam nyes pa cig gis spyod pa 'khor bcas nga khur zer bas sus kyang 'khur ma nus/ 'khor gyi tha ma bsod stoms pa cig gis snying rjes khur bas chu'i dbus su slebs tshe rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur te bsod stoms pa grol te grub thob tsa phu par gyur/ st+waṃ ga lar rgyal po rol ba'i zla ba mu stegs pa rang blon po dge ba'i mgon po sangs rgyas pa yin pas blon pos spyan ras gzigs lha dbang phyug chen po'i dbyibs su byas pa zhig gi rab gnas zhus pas su pra tiṣṭha zhes me tog dbur bzhag blon po yid ma 'ches pa nas me tog phog nas go la gsol 'phro zhig lha'i rna bar bcug pas sku de phyags phyir byung / go la bton nas me tog bzhag ste bstan pa gnas ring 'dir bzhugs gsungs pas spyan ma 'drongs te de gar lha khang brtsigs nas bzhugs/ blon pos bde mchog gi sgrub 753

thabs zhus/ bris sku bris pa rgyal pos thos nas 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma nan pas chad pa 'ong bar zhus te slob dpon gyis sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud las bshang gsungs pas/ bde mchog gi bris sku dang / de go ldog pa cig bris te phyi rol pa'i lha khang du zhal g.yogs nas zhag bdun mchod pa byas pas bde mchog 'od du 'bar zhing cig shos kyang 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa 'od 'bar bar gyur pas rgyal po sangs rgyas par gyur/ de'i dus dur khrod du tshogs 'khor byed pa na mi nag po zhig tshogs dpon byed zer ba la ma bcol bas tshogs grol khar de bde mchog tu gyur nas bla ma dang yi dam dang mkha' 'gros ma gnang bas spyod pa mi 'grub kyis bshags par bstan bcos du ma rtsoms/ bar dor dngos grub 'thob bo zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur/ slob dpon 'di las bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya ba gtum mo'i gdams pa mnos shing spyir 'pho ba dang grong 'jug gtso bor gyur pa byang gi bka' babs so/ /grub chen 'di rnams kyi byon tshul la bde mchog chos byung gi rigs na 'dra min mang du snang yang / rgyud pa 'di nyid kyi bka' bzhi'i rnam thar snga ma rnams nyid bkod pa'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' babs thams cad gcig tu 'dres shing rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug te lo ba ste shar lho za hor gyi yul gyi bye brag dza go ra zhes bya ba'i yul du yab bram ze chen po rab gsal yum bram ze mo gsal ba sras mo gsal ldan ma rnams yod pa bu 'dod nas dkon mchog la mchod pa cher byas nas khye'u zhig btsas ma thag yul thams cad 'od kyis gang bar gyur zhing bram ze mtshan mkhan gyis kyang lha klu gnod sbyin 'khor los bsgyur ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan sna tshogs par 'gyur zhing byung bas lung bstan par ma nus te 'khrungs pa'i ltas las gsal ba'i 'od cer btags nas gces par skyongs shig rang bzhin gsal bar 'gyur ro zhes 754

zer ro/ /der dben par nyi grib kyi mtshams su rig byed kyis brid/ bcud kyis gso zhing skyed pa'i tshe bu'i lus la grib ma zhig byung ba phyir bltas pas bud med mi sdug sa'i mtshan so bdun yod pa zhig na re/ gces par bskyangs kyang mi 'chi ba'i/ /sa phyogs gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /ji ltar byas na mi 'chi byas pas/ ma he skyong zhing yi ge ltos/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis lung ston 'gyur/ /zer ste mi snang bar song / der bus lo gcig tsam lon pa na gzhan gyi lo bcu gsum pa tsam gyi tshad du gyur te ma he'i khyu mdun du bkod de khol po dang bcas nags su btang ste shing sha pa'i sdong po la rgyab bstan/ ma he skyong bzhin pas yi ge sbyong zhing gnas tshe mi sdug pa'i bud med de 'ongs nas khyod su yul dang pha ma gang zhes 'dri ba la/ yul ni shar phyogs dza go ra/ /pha ni bram ze rab gsal te/ /ma ni bram ze gsal ba mo/ /sring mo rab mdzes gsal sgron ma/ /nga rang khye'u gsal ba'i 'od/ /shing ni sha pa'i ljon pa ste/ /ma he khyim gyi nyer 'kho'i nor/ /yi ge tha snyad don 'tshol yin/ /zhes smras pas khros te de thams cad log par smra'am/ 'o na khyod kyis smros shig/ des smras pa/ yul ni shar phyogs dza gor ma yin nub phyogs o rgyan gnas kyi gtso/ pha ni bram ze rab gsal ma yin 'khor lo bde mchog bde ba'i mchog /ma ni bram ze gsal ma ma yin rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum/ /sring mo rab mdzes gsal sgron ma yin bde ster nga ni khyod kyi sring / khyod ni khye'u gsal 'od ma yin rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /shing ni sha ba'i sdong po ma yin yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dpag bsam mchog /ma he khyim gyi nyer 'kho ma yin nyams myong sna tshogs re 'dod sbyin/ /yi ge tha snyad don 'tshol ma yin snyan rgyud yi ge med pa mtshon/ /zhes zer/ snyan rgyud ji ltar 'tshol byas pas/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas na yod/ /lung bstan dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /grub thob khyod kyis blangs na lon/ /7dadu

zhes grub pa'i na chung du gyur zhing de nyid du de kho na nyid rtogs nas nam mkha' la lding zhing ched du brjod pa du ma mdzad/ legs so legs so de kho na nyid ni 'di'o zheng nges pa bskyed de mi snang bar gyur/ de ma thag sku'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas rdo rje 'chang la chos gsan pa dang / bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma so so bsten pa dang / dge slong ma til tshong ma'i sras su mdzad de rab tu byung / mtshan shes rab bzang por btags nas cha ga pa'i phung po rnam shes spar ba la sogs mdzad cing / sku'i bkod pa gcig o rgyan du byon dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dngos su bzhengs te rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba thams cad kyi khyab bdag tu gyur nas o rgyan gyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ na ro ri ri ka so ri/ /bu rnam gsum gyi don du ni/ /gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon pa ru/ /nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin du/ /thogs med shes rab bzang po 'gro /gsungs te byon/ de'i tshe gzugs med pa'i bud med kyi skad grag pa/ smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud shig /spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob/ dam tshig rang sems me long stos/ /dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'des/ /ro stoms spyi yi me long zung / /bde chen gsung gi rin chen chongs/ /rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo skor/ /rang grol phyag rgya chen po sgoms/ /rig pa ye shes sgron me stos/ /zhes grag ste lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgur grags/khyad par du slob dpon ma taX gis lung bstan pa/ shar phyogs za hor gyi yul sngon sprul pa'i rā dzā utma ke sa ras byin gyis brlabs pas rang bzhin gyis sgrub thag nye ba na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma smad tshong du bstan pa'i dha ri ma 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa yod kyis de'i g.yog gyis la rtogs pa 'di skyongs shig gsungs te/der byon nas nyin par til brdung pa dang nang nub skyes pa bsu skyel sogs byas shing rtogs 4 bskyangs pas lo bcu gnyis na skyu la me 'bar ba dang / bu mo 7du'i

mang pos bskor ba sogs mthong snang sna tshogs pa byung ste rgyal po dang skye bo thams cad 'dus pa na dha ri mas dris pas/ gang dag snying por gyur pa til gyi mar/ /zhes sogs gsungs te bde mchog tu dngos su snang zhing dha ri mgatso mo dang tha mi dad par gyur/ yul khams de'i bya dang ri dwags yan chad skad cig gis grol lo/ /yang rgyal po ma la gus pa zhig gis ma'i ngag ltar rnal 'byor pa thams cad bsdus te nus pa che ba zhig gis tshogs dpon byed par rtsom pa na bud med mi sdug pa zhig na re tshogs dpon khyod kyis mi 'ong nga'i ming pos bya dgos zer te te lo pa byon/ snga mas kyang dkyil 'khor sprul pa dang tshogs rdzas 'gugs pa dang chang 'o mar bsgyur pa sogs nus kyang te lo pas nyi zla la chibs pa dang / ba spu'i khung bu rer dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa dpag med bstan pas dad pa la/ bde ba la zhen rtsa rlung sbyangs gyur pas/ /snang ba thoṭa med mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ khams 'dus lha yi bde la zhen pa yis/ /don dam gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rtogs mi 'gyur/ /sogs gsungs pas grub pa thob ste rnal 'byor pa nus ldan rdo rje zhes o rgyan na bzhugs so/ /yang mu stegs kyi ston pa rdzu 'phrul can zhig gis thams cad nag 'byam du btang tshe te lo pas rtsod pas pham par byas shing khos nyi ma gtod la mnan pa'ang phul nas nub par byas pas kho khros kha nas me phyung ste/ khams gsum thams cad 'jig byed pa/ /me yis mi 'jigs rnal 'byor su/ /zer ba la de bas me che ba btang ste/ /nga ni 'jigs pa thams cad las/ /yongs su grol ba'i te lo yin/ /gsungs pas dad pa la/ mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran/ /yang dag lam la 'jug pa la/ /gzer drug gnad kyi man ngag dgos/ /sogs gsungs pas grub thob zhen por gyur te nag po dge ba zhes gsil ba tshal na bzhugs so/ /yang rgyal po zhig la sgyu ma mkhan sgyu ma byang pa zhig gis skyu ma'i dam ga bshams pa 7du7

na dmag dpon mdzad sprul pa'i dmag gis btul te sgyu ma mkhan rang btson du bzung bas/ chos la bsten pa'i dam pa khyod/ /'di ltar byed pa ga la rigs/ /zer bas/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu gsad sogs la/ /sems med phyir na sdig pa med/ / gsungs pas dad pa la/ bram ze slu byed sgyu ma mkhan/ /snang srid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la/ /dug gsum sgyu ma'i zhen pa thong / /sogs bstan pas grol te rnal 'byor pa bden par smra ba zhes dur khrod ha ha sgrog pa na bzhugs so/ /yang chang tshong ma grags pa can zhig gi chang med par byas pas bcad cing btubs pa las bzhengs te chang sngar bas mang bar bstan par ras chung pa bzhed cing dam rdzong pas nyi ma gta' mar bzung ste gcig dang du mar sprul nas gsol chang tshong ma mdun gyi chang zad snod stong pa rnams la stos shig gsungs pas 'brus gang bas dad par 'chad la/ sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sogs gsungs pas grub pa thob ste rnal 'byor ma nyi ma 'dzin zhes dur khrod so sa gling na bzhugs so/ /yang bshan pa'i rgyal po dzi na bya ba nyin re zhing srog chags dpag med gsod pa las bu gces pa zhig mi snang bar byas te bu'i mgo sug btsos par mthong ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis btul te grub pa thob pa ni rnal 'byor pa bde byed bya ba srin po'i gling na bzhugs so/ /yang rgyang 'phen pa tshe snga phyi med par 'dod pa dang sangs rgyas pa'i paṇḍita cig rtag tu rtsod pa'i dpang po mdzad de su rgyal zer ba na kun rdzob tu yod pa rgyal/ don dam par gnyi ga ma yin gsungs pas/ 'o na khyod rang dang rtsod do zer nas brtsad pas lan gsum du te lo pa rgyal yang las 'bras dkar nag gnyi ga dngos su ma mthong na mi 'jug zer bas dmyal ba dang lha gnas mngon sum du bstan pas dmyal ba na rgyang 'phen pa de shi nas 'tshed zer ba'i zangs zhun 'khol ba dang sum bcu rtsa gsum na sangs rgyas pa'i paṇita de lha'i bur skye ba la lha mo sdod par mthong nas rjes 7du8

su bzung ste/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /de kho na nyid rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes sogs bstan pas grol te rnal 'byor pa dga' ba dang ldan pa zhes lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs so/ /yang glu mkhan du sprul ste glu mkhan dregs pa can zhig dang 'gran tshe tshangs pa'i glu sogs blangs pas dad de/ stong nyid 'gag med gnyis su med/ /ces sogs bstan pas grol te dbyangs ldan skugs pa zhes shrī nā ga rar bzhugs so/ /yang mu stegs mthu bo che zhig gis rgyal khams dbang du byed pa na de'i 'khor thams cad bsad pa dang sos bar bstan pas dad de/ thams cad lhan skyes rang bzhin yin pa la/ /sogs bstan pas grol te rnal 'byor pa zla ba zhes mi tsi mi li'i gling na bzhugs shing de thams cad la yul khams kyi skye bo bya dang ri dwags kyi bar grol bar gyur to/ /yang dge sdig lung ma bstan byed pa thams cad la sku mang po snang zhing de las kyang rlabs che ba'i dge sdig lung ma bstan mdzad de/ don rtogs rnal 'byor te lo pas/ /dge sdig ci yang byas pa med/ /gsungs/ yang rgyal po seng ge zla ba'i grong du shin tu dul ba'i dge slong du byas nas byon te sngon ma thos pa'i mdo mang du gsungs pas dad de dris byas pas/ nga ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /nga yis shes bya ma bslabs te/ /sgra tshad rig pa rang rdol yin/ /bde mchog sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /nga ni dbyer med brjod du med/ gsungs pas dad cing rdo rje'i theg par smin nas grub thob dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor pa mtha' yas pa 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi slob dpon zhus pas thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo tha dad par mthong ste/ rgyal pos zhus pas/ rgyal po/ bdag lus dgyes pa'i rdo rje ste/ /ngag ni ma hā mā ya yin/ /sems ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ /dbang po gsang ba 'dus pa yin/ /yan lag dgra rgyud dmar nag ste/ /nying lag rdo rje 'jiṭa byed yin/ /rtsa gnas rdo rje gdan bzhi la/ /rlung gnas rdo rje phreng ba yin/ / — 759

thig le gsang ba mdzod yin te/ /gtsug tor sangs rgyas thod pa yin/ /bde chen sangs rgyas mnyam par sbyor/ /thams cad bdag nyid dus 'khor la/ /ba spu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med yin/ /zhes gsungs te rdo rje 'chang dngos yin la da lta'ang mya ngan las 'da' ba mi mnga' bar bzhugs so/ /smin grol du mdzad pa'i slob ma ni yul khams chen po bcu gnyis kyi bya dang ri dwags kyi bar grol bar mdzad de bgrang gis mi lang ngo / /des chos drug gi sa bon tsam zhig mdzad pa da lta bzhugs so/ /des rjes su bzung ba ni dpal na ro pa ste ras chung snyan rgyud pa shar phyogs bhe ga la par byed kyang mar pa'i gsung ji lta ba rngog gis bris ba'i sre 'pho'i zhal gdams las/ rje na ro pa ni mi chos yul kha che ba yin/ dpal me mur pa zhes kyang grags te 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa yin/ zhes dang / na ro 'grel chen gyi le mtshams re re zhing dpal kha che ba chen pos sbyar ba zhes bshad pas nub phyogs kha che ba yin/ bram ze dkar nag gnyis la brgyad brgyad yod pa'i dkar po'i bzang shos nā ro ta ba yin zhes kha cig zer yang shangs pa dang bka' rgyud rin po che mthun par rigs rgyal rigs/ yab rgyal po dge ba'i go cha/ yum dpal gyi blo gros la sras kyis dben nas tshogs gsog rgya cher mdzad pas 'khrungs/ mtshan mkhan gyis khyim du bzhugs na sa thams cad la dbang ba dang rab tu byung na sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par lung bstan/ mtshan kun du bzang po/ rig gnas mtha' dag rang byung du shes/ yab yum gyis bkag kyang ma thub par slob dpon sbyim ka la warta sogs bsten te dge bsnyen paṇḍi tar gyur/paṇḍita mang pos bskor nas yul du chos gsung ba'i tshe yab kyis khab bzhes par nan gyis zhus pa na/ rtog med gtsang ldan ming dri med/ /theg chen rigs can mu stegs kyi/ /bu mo rnyed na bka' stsol zhig /gsungs pas blon po brtag 760

tu btang ba na bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bu mo dri med ma chu sgod thogs pas mgron po ༄ngal ba ngag mthong ste chu byin pas snying rje che bar rig snod med pa na zangs skyogs nyi da du 'thung bcug pas rtog pa chung bar shes/ legs par bkrus pas gtsang sbra che bar shes/ rigs dang ming dris pas bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bu mo dri med ma bya ba yin zer bas tshang bar go nas btsun mor blangs/ 'khor du bsten nas chos gsung ba'i tshe rab tu 'byung bar dgongs nas btsun mo la dris pas de— lta na bdag gis mi rigal pa'i spyod pa cung zad bya'i skye bo dag smod pa na bdag gis 'gro yis slar ci dgar gshegs shig ces zer ba ltar byas te gtsug lag khang mya ngan med pa'i tshal du sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mkhan po dang slob dpon ye shes 'od las rab tu byung ste mtshan sangs rgyas ye shes su btags/ slar kha che'i yul du puṇḍa'i gtsug lag khang du mkhan po chos kyi ye shes zhabs sogs las bsnyen par rdzog sa/ sde snod rgyud sde mtha' dag la zla med pa'i tshe gtsug lag khang mya ngan med tshal gyi gnas brtan mdzad pas gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin par grags/ dus der nā la rdo'i byang sgo ba med nas thog mar nang pa'i paṇḍita rnams dang brtsad pas zla med par gyur/ slar phyi rol pa rnams dang brtsad pas thams cad tshar bcad de nang par bcug pas dpal 'jigs med grags pa zhes thogs/ byang gi sgo srung ba mdzad de 'di'i4 tshe shar sgo ba mi thub zla ba/ sto sgo ba dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ nub sgo ba nag po zhabs zhes snga ma kha cig na 'dug pa 'di dag par snang / der gnas brten chen po'i bya bas dus 'da' ba na nyin cig phyogs bzhi gar du phyag dpe bkod nas gzigs pa'i tshe grib ma zhig byung ba na bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan so bdun tshang ba zhig 'dug nas khyod lta ba de ci yin/ shes sam zer/ sde snod rgyud sde yin/ shes byas pas/ tshig she sa sam don shes zer/ tshig shes byas pas 761 7

dga' tshor ci yang byas/ don yang shes sam zer/ shes byas pas khros/ ci yin dris pas tshig shes pa bden/ da lta khyod las tshig la mkhas pa med/ don shes pa nga'i ming po las med zer/ 'o na sprod dang byas pas gsol ba thob dang skal pa dang ldan na mjal bar 'gyur zer nas mi snang bar song / der mi sdug pa'i mtshan so bdun po de phyi ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs so bdun/ nang ltar rtsa so bdun dang byang phyogs so bdun/ gsang bar lha so bdun yin pa las phyi'i don rtogs te kho bo bla ma zhig 'tshol du 'gro zhes spong dag mdzad pas kun gyis bshol btab cing bzhugs par zhus pa la ca/ gsan par byon/dgyes rdor gyi sgo nas 'tshol bzhed pas rgyal po zhig gis sbyin bdag byas te dgyes rdor gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste/ kun rdzob rten 'brel tha dad pas/ /'khor lo bde mchog la brten nas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas tshol dang rnyed/ /ces grag bde mchog gi sgrub pa mdzad pa na bu mo gnyis byung nas bde mchog ji ltar sgrub 'dri ba la/ skal ldan grags pa'i lugs yin/'di ltar sgrub byas pas/ de paṇḍitas bslad 'dug nged kyis rdo rje 'chang dngos la zhus pa yin zer ba la mig btsum nas bsams pas bden par 'dug bsams nas mig phye bas gang na'ang mi snang / tho rengs mnal lam du byung nas nged gnyis zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma yin/ da nged kyis bstan pa ltar sgrubs zer nas sgrubs pas yig bdun 'bum phrag gcig song tshe sa gzhi g.yos te khyod ni shar phyogs te lo pa'i rigs yin no zhes thos nas shar phyogs su byon pas sgyid lug pa na nam mkha' las/ le lo'i bdud la ma sgur bar/ /shar phyogs sangs rgyas te lo tshol/ /zhes grag nas thams cad du btsal ba na brag 'phrang dog po gzur sa med pa zhig na 'dze mo nyams thag pa rkang chad lag rdum zhig 'dug pa la lam phye gsungs pas/ rings na 'gong sa la song / mi rings 762

na skor la song zer bas shangs bkab ste 'gongs song ba na/ rnam rtog 'chi nga bas dam /thacings pa/ khyod kyis bla ma ji ltar rnyed/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang mtha' gcig tu/ /byis pa rnams kyis btags pa tsam/ /zhes cong rong sogs kyang mi snang bar bye stong zhig na 'dug bla ma'i sprul pa ste ma shes na da ni su mthong yang dri'o snyam pas song ba na lam 'phrang dog mo zhig tu khyi mo ro smad 'bus gzhigs pa ro stod gzhan la zug pa cig 'dug ste 'gongs song ba na/'gro drug bla mar ma shes na/ /btsal bas rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /zer nas mi snang / de bzhin du mi gcig gis gcig gi mgo bo gcod grogs gyis zer te/ngar 'dzin 'gong po ma bcom na/ /zhes dang / rgyu ma gcod pas/ 'khor ba'i rgyun thag ma bcad na/ /zhes dang / mi'i ljan ljin 'khru pas/ bag chags dri ma ma bkrus na/ /zhes dang / pha bsad shing la btsugs ma khri mun du bcug ste gsod pas/ chags sdang pha ma ma bsad na/ /zhes dang / rngon pas ri dwags ded de byung bas/ /gzung 'dzin ri dwags ma bsad na/ /zhes dang / btsun rgan bza' mi nya gsod pa zhig gis dgong mo zhig nya gson po btsos nas byin te/ tha mal rtog pas bcings pa yis/ /zhes dang / mi sngo skya tho ba thogs pa zhig gis srog chags thams cad gsod cing / nyon mongs dug lnga ma bsad na/ /zhes dang / po ti mang po me la sreg cing / /tha snyad zhen pa ma bcad na/ /bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa re grag ste mi snang ngo / /yang rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes pa zhig mthong ste dris pa na/ rgyal po de na re te lo pa dang sprad kyis 'dir sdod zer te lha gcig byin nas sngar yang gyis zer ba rnams ma byas pas 4nongs snyam ste khyim thab byas nas sras pho mo'ang byung tshe gzhan dag gis sras pho mo bsad/ lha gcig kyang skyes pa gzhan la song / rgyal po la zhus pas khyong lta bu la lha gcig ga na sdod ces rgya gad mang po byas/ te lo pa ston byas pas bla 763

ca 'tshol rnga/ la mos gus dang brtson 'grus dgos pa yin/ khyod tshul 'chal 'dod yon la zhen pas ga na rnyed zer/ der rgyal po 'dis nga bla ma tshol ba na gnas min gyi gnod pa 'di lta bu byas pas rig sngags kyis dgral lo snyam nas dur khrod du song ste bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mthu byed par brtsams pas/ 'dod yon la zhen zherme sdang can/ /bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal po ga myo/ bslus sam/ /zer te pho brang sogs ci yang mi snang bar bye stong zhig na 3dug yang btsal bas gtsug lag khang zhig tu dge 'dun gyis ngo shes ste —kasu pa zhus pas ma gnang / rje btsun te lo pa mthong ngam dris pas sprang po te lo pa bya ba zhig las ma mthong zer/ de ston dang byas pas mi sngon po sprang po'i yo byad can 'dug pa la the tshom med par phyag byas pas shig par pa gang gtad te srogs shig zer/ ma nus pa na/ sems dang bsam byung rnam rtog rnams/ /ma bsregs bla ma ga la rnyed/ /ces mi snang ngo / /der da shar phyogs na ma bzhugs pa yin nam nub phyogs su 'tshol snyam pa na/ da dung shar phyogs su song zhig zhes grag nas song ba las nyin zhig mig gcig pa'i rgyal khams su slebs/ mi thams cad la ltag pa na mig re re las med pa'i khrom chen po 'dug dmus long gis lta/ 'on pas nyan/ zha bo rgyug skugs pa smra/ro gar byed pa sogs 'dug pa la dris pas thams cad ma grin gcig du bsdebs nas/ mig gcig du ma ro gcig yin/ /dmus long lta ru med par ltos/ /'on pa nyan du med par nyon/ /skugs pa smra ru med par smros/ /zha bo 'gro 'ong med par rgyugs/ /dbugs bral skye med g.yab mo byed/ /ces zer te ci yang mi snang bar bye stong zhig na 'dug go /der rnam smin gyi lus dang bcas mjal ba'i skal ba med pa zhig da ni bar dor mjal bar shog cig ces spu gris rke gnyeg pa na/ bla ma ma rnyed sangs rgyas rang / /bsad bas bla ma ga la 761

rnyed/ khyod 'dod sdig can nga min nam/ /zhes grag ste rnal 'byor pa mthing nag 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil na skyabs sbyin cimadzad pa cig lam byung ba la/ nam mkha'i sprin bzhin nges med pa'i/ /dam pa btsal pas ga la rnyed/ /kye ma thuṭa rjes mi gzigs sam/ /zhes yus ches pa'i gdung shugs gsol bas/ nga dang 4po 'dze mor mthong ba nas skad cig kyang ma bral bar yod de khyod rang gi sgrib pas ma mthong ba yin/ da lta srog la mi lta ba'i gus pas sgrib pa dag pa yin gsungs/ snod ldan dri med gzi brjid khyod/ /mkha' 'gro gsang sngags gsang ba'i gnas/ /gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /gdams ngag snod du da gyur to/ /gsung nas sa gzhi la byon no/ /'di yan ni las dang rnam smin gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba dbang bskur ba na las bum gyi chus bkru ba'i don mngon du gyur pa'o/ /de nas ci zhig na maṇḍal phul te gsol ba btab pas thog mar dbang skur bar bya'o/ /gsungs nas ras yug la me stag zhig bzhag pas bsregs te ji lta bu gsungs pa na/ dbang don me stag lta bus nyon mongs ras yug lta bu sreg dgos par go zhus pas ci yang mi gsung / de bzhin du shel gong bstan/ rgya mdud cig mdzad nas bkrol/ yid bzhin nor bu zhig bstan/nor bu phyag mthil du bzhag pa la spyan mi 'gyur bar gzigs/ chu skyogs gang lhag med du gsol/ sdod mang po chus bkang / chos 'byung gi phyag rgya mdzad/thugs gar thig le zhig bstan/ —ljags la rgya mdud cig mdzad/ skugs pa ltar cung zad bzhugs/ shing thog ngo mtshar ba zhig bstan nas cir go gsungs/shing thog bdag gzhan gnyis kyi don 'grub par go zhes pa'i bar du dri lan mdzad de mthar don ngo sprad pa/ nyon mongs ras yug ltar srogs shig rang rgyud shel gong ltar dag gyis/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i rgya mdud khrol/ /nor bu rin chen bla ma yin/ /dad gus dbang po 'gyur med kyis/ /dri med gdams 765

ngag chu rgyun 'thung / /chu snod du ma ro gcig yin/ /chos 'byung skye ba med pa ste/ /chos sku thig le rang la gnas/ /rgya mdud smra bsam brjod du med/ /lkugs pa mi smra rgya cher gsungs/ /shing thog don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ /bcu gnyis brda yi mdud pa khrol/ khyod ni brda shes skyes bu yin/ /ma smin smin byed dbang gi ni/ /gdams ngag snod du da gyur to/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob mas kyang nges pa cung zad rnyed de gsol ba/ chu dang cod pan la sogs la/ /dbang du zhen pa'i mun pa bcom/ /bcu gnyis brda yis bdag smin gyur/ /ji ltar lta ba bka' stsol zhig /bka' bstsal pa/ lta ba med pa'i tshul du ltos/ /mthong ba med pa'i dad nyid las/ /grol ba med pa'i tshul gyis grol/ /don mthong rnal 'byor rang grol 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas nges pa cung zad rnyed de/ dbang gi don ma thong rnal 'byor pa/ /dbang don me stag lta bu yis/ /nyon mongs ras yug ltar bsregs bde/ /zhes ched du brjod pa byas so/ /'di ni smin par byed pa rgyu'i dbang ste na ro pa rgyung sde la ches mkhas pas tshogs bshad kyi rim pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la zhen pa sogs gcod phyir brda'i dbang bcu gnyis ste dbang re re la brda gsum gsum du 'gyur ro/ /de nas dka' chen bcu gnyis kyis lam bgrod de de yang mtho khyad rgya phubs rim pa bcu gsum yod pa'i rtser skad cig gis byon te 'di la mchong nus pa su yod gsungs pas tsham tshom med par mchongs pas yan lag hrag hrug tu chag ste 'chi ku'i tshe phyag ji/sa reg pa tsam gyis lus sngon pas lhag par gyur to/ /yang smyug ma'i thur ma rno zhing ngar ba mang du bzos ste mkhal khung nas phar tshur thal mar phug nas zing zing por btang nas phyag gis reg pas sngar las lhag par sos so/ /yang srin bu pad pas gang ba'i 'dam la lus smyang nas zwam pa byas te yun ring du zhabs kyis brdzis te bor bas lus go mtshams 766

med par pad pas khyab ste khrug zad pa na phyag reg pas pad pa gcig kyang mi snang ste lus sngar las lhag par gyur to/ /de gsum gyis/ dka' ba spyod pa'i rnam pa bum pa'i dbang gis sbyang gzhi lus kyi dri ma dngos su sbyangs te sbyong byed lus snang stong dbyer med skyed rim brtan zhing sku rdo rje sprul sku la gegs byed kyi dri ma bsal pa'o/ /de bzhin du me phung gis lus bsregs pa las sos pa dang /ston mo byed pa zhig na zas sngon ma myong ba'i dri can zhig byung ba bzar 'phangs nas bla ma la drangs pas na ro pa'i zhal zas zhim da dung long zhig gsungs pas lan gnyis ster ba'i khrims med pas bcus te bros pa zin nas shi la thug par brdegs/ phyag reg pas sos te bum pa sogs bskur nas rim par skyur la shog gsungs nas sdod cig la zas de cung zad 'byags 'dug pa khyer nas bros/ded pa na dang por bum pa'i chu pho bas 'obs chen por gyur/ de nas thag pa bskyur bas chu bor gyur/ de nas me long bskyur ba mtshor gyur/ de thams cad las 'das te zin la khad pa na ral gri g.yugs pas lcags kyi lcil por gyur pa'i nang du bros pa phyogs kun nas me btang bas phyir don pa na brdegs te 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe phyag reg pas sos so/ /'di'i dang po ni gtum mo'i me dbang ste rnam smin gyi lus ngag dngos su bsregs pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis kyis bza' ba'i dam tshig ste spyir dka' ba ltar snang ba gsang ba'i dbang gis sbyang gzhi ngag dag nas sbyong byed rlung gi rnal 'byor brtan pa gsung rdo rje longs sku la gegs byed kyi dri ma bsal ba'o/ /yang rgyal po'i btsun mo khug gsungs te reg pas nyung rum gyis yan lag thams cad bcad nas dor ba phyag gis mthud nas reg pa tsam gyis sos/ yang blon po'i chung ma khug gsungs te bkug pas blon po'i 'khor gyis shi bar brdegs te rgyogs la 'phangs pa phyag reg pas sos/yang rig ma 'tshol la sten zhig gsungs/ rig ma de bla ma la phul bas 'dis 767

'di'i yid bzung ngo gsungab/ nas na ro pa'i gsang rdor rdo'i bar du brdungs te rtsa'i rnal ma chu 'dor shes tsam las ma lus bas na ro pa zhes rtsa shad pa zer te sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las bcom ldan rtsa shad phyir mi ldog /ces lung bstan to zhes spyod pa 'di bzhed la/ ro ga rtsod pa la dgag pa'i na sngon du byin nas ga phyis pas na ro ste rtsod med yin zhes lo tsā ba du ma bzhed do/ /slar phyag gis reg pa tsam gyis sngar bzhin sos te 'di gsum ni yid dang thig le dag pa dbang gsum pa bskur ba ste bde stong dbyer med kyi rtogs pa brtan zhing chos sku thugs rdo rje la gegs byed kyi dri ma bsal ba'o/ /yang thang zhig la mi zhig song ba 'di zung zhig gsungs/ phyin pa na je ring du song ste rnamathar 'gyel zhing brgyal/dran pa rnyed dbugs ma chad tsam na byon te reg pa tsam gyis sos/ yang mya ngacha/ gyi thang zhig tu maṇḍal gyis gsungs/ chu dang me tog ma rnyed pas khrug gis chag chag btab/ dbang po rnams dang yan lag lnga tshom bur byas/ lag pa g.yas pa'ang rang brul te tshom bur gyur nas/ nam mkha' las maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshiṭa bcad mang po grag pas tshom bu dbus ma mgo bo'i spyi bor phyag bzhag ste/ lus ni dum bu brgyar 'thor yang / /sems ni mya ngan med pa khyod/ /tsarnyi'i gnad kyis da tshim bya'o/ /gsungs pas snga ma las ches lhag pa'i lus su gyur to/ /yang ci zhig na gdams pa zhus pas 'di ji tsam bstan yang go bas dben pa gsungs te mchil lham thugs gar brgyab kyang zer/ zhabs kyis bsnun yang ze ra te dran med du ling bog brgyal sangs pa na te lo pa'i thugs rgyud kyi spangs rtogs yon tan par btab pa ltar gyur te/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ /ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ /te lo pas ni ci yang bstan du med/ /rang yi/sa rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos/ /zhes ngo sprad do/ /'di gsu ma gyis sbyang gzhi gnyug ma'i ye shes la sbyang bya ma rig pa'i dri ma sbyangs te 768

sbyong byed so so rang rig pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa sbyangs 'bras bde ba chen po'i sku la gegs byed kyi dri ma bsal ba yin no/ /mdor na tshogs bshad kyi dbang la zhen pa sbang pa'i phyir dka' ba bcu gnyis po 'di dag gis lam gyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ des na lam dbang zhes pa yang sa lam bgrod dgos pa yin gyi dgyes rdor gyi las dang po pa'i bdas/ 'jug kha thon du byed pa la lam dbang du grags pa ni man ngag dang bral ba'o/ /'di dag tu chos kyi rnam grangs rdzogs tshul la ras chung snyan rgyud pa ni dka' ba dang po la rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ gnyis pa la thun mong yid bzhin nor bu/ gsum pa la dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu/ bzhi pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar chos drug gi steng du grong 'jug dang las rgya bsnan pas brgyad/ bcu gnyis pa la phyag rgya chen po ste snyan rgyud rdzogs par 'chad/ dbang rnon gyi dbang du byas na dka' ba bcu gnyis kyi mthar/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /zhes pa tsam gyis chos drug gzhi lam 'bras gsum du bsdus nas gsungs par 'chad/ shin tu dbang po yang rab kyi ngor/ te los tshig gcig ma gsungs la/ na ros tshig gcig ma nyan te/ /byin rlabs rtogs pa 'phos pas grol/ /zhes 'chad pa yin ste/ mdo las chos gang yang ma bstan pa dang stong nyid gcig po bstan pa dang chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs par bshad pa bzhin no/ /der bla ma la zhus pa/ snang ba gzugs kyi phung po 'di/ /skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /spyad du yod na spyod rigs te/ /med par spyad du 'dod pa ci/ /zhes sogs phul bas shing a shātta'i steng du bzhugs nas lan gsungs pa/ snang ba rten zhing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /skye ba med par ma rtogs par/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'khor lo dang / 'bral bar ma byed na ro pa/ /skye med ston pa'i slob dpon du/ /snang ba dkar dmar shar ba na/ /shes pa 769

gzings kyi bya ltar thong / /'dod yon spyod cig na ro pa/ /sems nyid rang dag rang gsal ba/ /skye med spros dang bral ba la/ /nyams myong dran rig blo bur 'di/ /rdzun par rtogs na ci dgar thong / /cir snang chod cig na ro pa/ / 'khor ba'i mun mthar skyel ba yi/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di/ /rtogs pa'i sta re rnon po yis/ /thad kur chod cig na ro pa/ /sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /snang cha rten 'brel ma rtogs na/ /zhen pa dang bcas nyams myong gis/ /bdag nyid 'ching 'gyur na ro pa/ /'dod yon gzugs sgra sna tshogs la/ /sems kyi zhen pa skyes pa na/ /sbrang ma rtsi la 'byar ba 'dra/ /zhen pa thong zhig na ro pa/ /lta pa sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ /gcig tu rtogs na dge sdig med/ /gal te rtogs pa zhan gyur na/ /brtul zhugs spyod cig na ro pa/ /zhes gsungs te dbang ma bskur chos ma bshad rtsod pa ma byas par phyag rgya ma bsten la rtogs pa skyongs shig gsungs/ de nas spyod pa la zhuṭa te slang slang kho na gsungs pas/ ci byed zer za ba yin gsungazlo pas 'di zo zhig ces cig gis chu gri rnon po zhig byin pa ljags steng du bzhag pas mar bzhin du zhu nas gsol bas dad de byin gyis brlabs pas de nyid du grol te nam mkha' la ldings so/ /nyams sad pa'i phyir rgyal po cig gis glang po che smyon pa rbad pa la bsad gso mdzad pas dad de mchod gnas su bzhugs par gsol/lha gcig ye shes sgron phyag rgyar phul/ der rngon pa'i spyod pa mdzad pas mchod gnas nyan thos pa rnams dang bcas pa ma mos te mi mdzad par zhus pas slar yang ltung ba'i lta stangs kyis bya thams cad bsad/ zlog pa'i lta stangs kyis sa 'og na gnas pa thams cad byung nas bsad/ thabs sna tshogs kyis skam dang chu nang na rgyu ba thams cad bsad pas thams cad ma mos te lha gcig dang bcings nas tsandan gyi mes bsregs pas me'i dbus na yab yum gnyis rgyan gyis brgyan 770

nas gar byed cing sku zil pa phrom me byon te/ khyed cag tshig rtsub mtshon cha de ni bzod pa'i go cha 'chang ba'i grogs/ /ngan sems dug gi phreng ba de ni grub pa'i rma bya mdzes pa'i rgyu/ /bzod dka' tsandan me chen de ni bde chen padma'i rdzing yangs te/ khyed cag lhan cig khrims su bcas pa nges par bdag la dga' ba 'phel/ /zhes gsungs shing rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas kyang rmi lam du bskal pa du mar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba mthong bas 'gyod cing bshags te gsol ba btab pa na/ su dag ma rtogs pa la sdig dang dge /las dang las kyi 'bras bu zhes grags te/ /de nyid rtogs pa su zhig de ltar rtog /de bas rang ngo ye shes chen po stos/ /zhes byin gyis brlabs nga/'i mod la rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa grol bar gyur to/ /yang chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram gyi bye ma la byis pa rnams dang rtsed mo mdzad pa na te lo pa nam mkhar byon te/ phyag rgya che la bstan du med kyis kyang / /dka' ba spyod cing bla ma la gus pa/ /sdug bsngal bzod byed blo ldan na ro pa/ /skal ldan khyod kyi snying la 'di ltar byos/ /zhes sogs phyag rgya chen po gam gā ma gsungs paca/ mthar thug gi don mngon du gyur te ched du brjod pa/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /dmigs med spros bral sgrib med sems kyi ni/ /ngo bo mthong ste su la'ang dri mi bya/ /dri med shugs 'byung rnal 'byor rang grol yin/ 4zhes gar byas so/ /de'i tshe ri ri pa dang ka so ri pas kyang gzhan don la bskul zhing / bla mas phyag spyi bor bzhag ste/ pugri ha ri'i dgon par ni/ /rang grol ye shes nyi ma yis/ /ma ti'i ma rig mun pa sol/ /ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis4 /gsungs pas phyag byas te/ /bla ma dam pa'i bka' lung dang / /rdo rje spun gyi gsung bzhin du/ /mdo rgyud snying po don gyi bcud/ nges med yul du bsgrag par bya'o/ /zhes zhus nas slar yang byang sgo srung ba mdzad la 'di'i tshe shar na shārti pa/ sto 771

na ngag gi dbang phyug nub na shes 'byung blo gros rnams bzhugs so/ /slo ba ma smin gro'/ du ma dzad pa mtha/'a yas shing mi ny-i pa dang shārti pa so sgos mabs grub mtha' dag kyang na ro ba'i slob ma yin no/ /dngos grub brnyes nas bka' dpe phyi ma dang rim lnga bsdus pa gsal ba sogs mdzad do/ /'di'i dus rje mar pas gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gsan pa ste gsang sngags mtha' dag dang khyad par chos drug ge rgyud pa'o/ /khyad par du phyag rgya chen po snying po'i don gyi bka' babs ni/ rdo rje 'chang / sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/sha wa ra/ mi tree pa/ rje mar pa ste de la sha wa ra ni glu gar gyis 'tsho ba'i gar mkhan ming sring gsum yod pa re zhig nā landar slong ba na klu sgrub zhabs kyis rigs ngan la —rtog pa ma mdzad par nang du bos zas bzang po gnang bas dad de sa ra ha'i do ha glur blangs pas de'i don shes sam gsungs/ ma 'tshal te mos nas len pa lags zhus pas shes par 'dod dam gsungs/ shin tu dga' nas 'tshal lags zhus pas skal ldan du gzigs nas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pas cig car ba'i rtogs pa skyes/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi zhal mthong / /rngon pa'i cha byad kyis dpal gyi ri la rnam smin gyi lus 'dis 'gro ba'i don gyis shig gsungs te da lta'ang bzhugs/ mi tram̐ ba ni/ yul dbus su bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ (do ha'i lo rgyus sogs yongs grags ltar byas pa ste/ rje mar pas/ khyed 'gro ba'i don du 'dzam gling 'dir/ /rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba bzhes/ /ces gsungs pas rgyal rigs su 'thad do/) sgra la mthar phyin par mkhyen nas na ro pa dang rtsod pas na ro pa rgyal te slob dpon du bkur/ —bram ze'i brtul zhugs dang bslab par bya ba mthar phyin nas shānti pa las rab tu byung / mtshan mi rta ste byams par grags/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa zla med par gyur/ /bi kra ma la shī lar bzhugs tshe yi dam rnal 'byor ma'i 772

nang gi dam rdzas bsten pa jo bo rje lha gcig sogs zhal ta pas mthong ste dge 'dun gyis gnas nas phyung bas nyams pa sgo la 'gror mi rung zhes rtsig pa la thal bzhud/ mdun na chu bo gi gā yod pa la gding ba bting ste g.yog gu sa ka ra'i lag pa nas bzung ste song bas nyi ma nub bo zhes dge 'dun kun gyis ngus/jo bos gzings bskor te rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas da lta lcags ri gcig gi paṇḍita phan tshun rjes su 'dzin par smre nus kyi ngas bla ma dam pa cig dang mjal ba rmis pas mjal na rjes su bzung ngo nga'i brang khang na sgrol ma'i bris sku zhig yod pa de la yi dam gyis shig gsungs/ khradma pā khor bsnyung ba byas te rmi lam brtags pas ri bo ma ṇi bha ga lar gu ru sa ra ha pas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes dang / yang gnas gzhan du brtags pas ri bo ma ṇi bha ga la rtse gsum pa dang / sha wa ra dbang phyug smyag nag 'od ma'i gzhu la phag pa'i steng khog smad khog bkal ba dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis bsten pa gzigs te/ rgya mtshor 'dong ba'i tshong pa'i gseb tu mchod gnas mdzad de lho phyogs su ring du byon pas rmi lam bzhin ri de wal byung ba na der byon nas shing thog za zhing btsal/yang bsnyung ba byas nas btsal bas kyang ma rnyed/ bar dor zhal lta snyam pas lceb par rtsom tshe sha wa ra rmi lam gyi lta bu sa ka ras mthong ste sbran nas brkyang phyag byas pas nga ye nas 'di na 'dug pa yin te khyod rang gi sgrib pas bsgribs par zad/ nga mthong bas kyang 'ching ba ste/ /nga ma mthong yang 'ching par 'gyur/ /nga mthong bas kyang grol 'gyur te/ /nga ma mthong yang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ phyag rgya bzhi khrid dang do ha dang theg chen nyi shu pa sogs mang du gsungs/ sa ka ra ni grol te mi snang bar gyur/ yang nags gseb la phag rgod cig 'gro ba la mda' brgyab nas bsad/ cung ma mos pa na/ 'khor ba'i nags tshal skye med na/ /ma rig phag 773

rgod rgyu ba la/ /shes rab gsal ba'i mda' zhig brgyab/ /ma rig phag rgod bdag gis bsad/ /sha ni gnyis su med par zos/ /ro ni bde ba chen por myong / /gsungs te mi snang bar gyur/ yang gsol ba btab pas nga'i rnam smin gyi lus ro las bstan pa'i skal ba med kyi sprul pa'i lus rigs ngan gyi grong khyer ༄dhū ti bya bar dge tshul rgan po cig la dge tshul ma rgan mo gnyis kyis bskor ba yod kyis der song zhig ces grag ste der gdams ngag gi sgro 'dogs thams cad bcad/ gnyid kyis log pa las sad pa na chos thams cad brjed 'dug nas lceb dgos snyam tshe naca/ mkha' la dngos su byon te/ /ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la/ /shes zhes bya ba ga la yod/ /ma 'gags pa yi chos rnams la/ /brjed ces bya ba ga la yod/ /sogs gsungs te khyod yul dbus su song / nga'i 'dra 'bag gyis la slob dpon du zung / snod ldan rjes su zung zhig gsungs/ de ltar mdzad de seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas mu stegs na ti ka ra btul/ shārnyi pas kyang rtsod yig bzhag ste bros/ gzhan sus kyang rtsod ma nus te rdo rje gdan gyi mchod dpon mdzad/ /ma ga tta'i rgyal pos gtsug tu bkur bas mnga' bdag chen po mi thu4 pa zhes mtshan 'angon te ri bo me 'bar gyi dgon par bzhugs a maṇa si'i chos skor nyer bzhi mdzad/ /slob ma'ang mu stegs na ti ka ra btul pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje dang / de wa kā ra tsand+ra stong nyid ting 'dzin dang / rgyal po ra ma pā la dga' ba skyong / badripā ṇi rgya gar phyag na ste khyad par gyi slob ma bzhi/a bhi yukta sogs 'bring bdun/ te ngu ba dang pa lam ta a tsarya sogs chung ba bcu la sogs pa byon/ rgya bod thams cad na nyi zla ltar grags pa las rje mar pas gsan no/ /rje lo tsā ba ni lho brag nub kyi nang ma sbe sar gyi dkon mchog stod bkra shis ling ba bya bar 'khrungs/ gdung mar pa/ yab dab nga phyug 'od zer/ yum rgyal mo mtsho/ sras lnga'i gsum pa yin/ lo bcu gnyis nas myu gu 774

lung du 'brog mi la lo tsā bslabs/ bco lnga la bal por byon/ spyi ther pa bsten lo gsum nas rgya gar du byon/ nub tu la khre trar ye shes snying po dang mjal kṛ ya mang du gsan/ tshogs 'khor gyi sar na ro pa'i slob ma rdzu 'phrul can bzhi'i rnam 'phrul mthong bas dad cing de'i pentu bas na ro pa dang sprad / dgyes rdor gdams ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ na ro pas lung bstan te ye shes snying po la gsang 'dus/ ku ku ri ba la ma hā nā ya/ mai tram̐ po la phyag chen/rus pa'i rgyan can ma la gdan bzhi sogs gsan/ spyir snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum sogs bzhugs/ slar bod du byon/ mes rngog mtshur/ mgo legs soṭa kyis mjal/ gser mang du bsnams te 'bul ba dang mchod pa mdzad/ slar lan gcig yong dgos par lung bstan/ slar bod du byon 'gro don mdzad tshe na ro pa spyod pa la gshegs par mkhyen nas mkha' 'gros bskul te rgya gar la byon/bla ma thams cad la zla ba re tshogs dang maṇḍal phul te gsol ba btab pas thams cad kyis mjal bar lung bstan/ mthar ka so ri pas zla ba brgyad na mjal bar lung bstan/ zla ba re re la nyams su mjal thengs re byung / mthar mngon sum du mjal te lo'i lung bstan ltar putpa ha rir khrid de gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang / slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang bar lung bstan kha ba can 'dul bar bskos/ mkha' spyod du byon par gzigs te gsol ba btab pas seng ldeng stug po'i nags su dngos su byon te chos drug dril pa rdo rje'i mgur gsungs pas 'du 'bral med pa'i gdeng thob bo/ /bla ma gzhan rnams la'ang gtang rag gi phyag mdzad ngo mtshar du ma gzigs te bod du byon/bu slob mtha' yas pa smin par mdzad/ phyag gi rten 'brel 'phyugs pas bla ma sa lung bstan pa ltar sras kyi mchog sku yal/ rngog pa la dgyes rdor sogs rgyud bshad dang sre 'pho/ mtshur ston la gsang 'dus dang rim lnga/ mes tshon po la 775

ma hā mā ya dang 'od gsal/ mi la la gtum mo gtso bor bton nas gdams ngag thams cad dang / mgo legs la thugs rgyud gdams skor bco lnga sogs gnang ste chos gi bka' babs so sor gtad cing skal ldan mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad de dgung lo gya drug pa zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga la jo mo bdag med ma 'od du zhu nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ dbu gtsug nas 'od zla ba lta bu dang bcas te dag par gshegs so/ /yum gyi dbu thod du grags pa ni jo mo gzhan gyi'o/ /bu chen yang mnyes pa'i bu lnga/ bka' babs kyi bu drugamos gus can gyi slob ma bzhi/ zhar la bskyangs pa dpag tu med pa byon la/rdog ston chen po/ la stod rnal 'byor ma/ chibs kha ba lho pa rta sgom ste gsum lus 'dis mkha' spyod du byon no/ /rgyud pa'i bka' zin ba ka chen bzhi las sto'i ka ba rngog chos sku rdo rje ni 'khrungs yul gzhung ri bor 'khrungs/ rngog zings po rje bya ba lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su 'phrul dga'i lha zhig mi yul du babs kyang zer la mi bu rigs bzhi las stong du gtogs kyang zer/ rngog gtsan gnyan gyis chos rgyal khri srong gi sku srog bton zhing rngog gtsan gzigs snang zhes slob dpon padma'i dngos slob tu gyur pas rgyal po'i sku rim pa sngags mkhan chen po mdzad/ de phyin rnying ma'i grub thob rgyud pa'i rngog g.yu khri la dpal le/ ratna/ yul byin gsum byung ba'i yul byin gyi sras mi rabs gnyis nas rngog lo khu dpon byon zhing / dpal le'i yang tsha ni rngog ban chen kha pa'o/ /yab de dang yum 'od ldan ma'i sras su 'khrungs/ yab chos sogs la mkhas par gyur tshe pa bza' chos 'tsho khab tu bzhes/ gzhung se lung du dge bshes dgyer chung pa la rnying ma gsan pa na khong gis snying nas rang chos byed na skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā'i spyan sngar 'dong ngam zhes gsung pas mtshan thos pa tsam gyis dang pa rang dbang med pa skyes nas de nub rang chos 'phro dril te nang par byon/ mjal ma 776

thag rta phul pas phyag rten yi/na na che zhu rten yin na chung gsungs// ri bor gdan drangs nas spong dag dang po la gnag brgya sbra dang bcab/ pa dang / bar pa la chos po ti sum bcu sogs gang yod/ mtha' ma la lug tsher mo brgya la sogs pa gang yod phul/ rim par dgyes rdor/ gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā ya rnams kyi rgyud man ngag dang gdams ngag dpag med gsan/ chos skyong du dud sol ma gnang / gzhan yang gnam bye ma lung pa dang / khamarnga/ pa shes rab rdo rje la mtshan brjod gsan zhing dgyes rdor lha dgu bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga/gdan bzhi lte mang / ye shes dbang phyug ma/ ma hā mā ya lha lnga/ gur rigs bsdus te rje mar pa las byung ba drug dang / smṛ ti lugs kyi 'jam dpal gsang ldan te bdun la rngog dkyil bdun du grags/ ri bo khyung lding gi lha khang btab/'di'i dkyil 'khor stegs bu mdzad sar rngog yab sras kyis lha mo bco lnga lan gsum gzigs/ zhing gi bar na ne sing khyung 'dra ba yod pas khyung lding zer dgung lo drug bcu rtsa brgyad la sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du byon/ slob ma ram rtsa can/ pa lnga ba can/ rngog mun pa can/ sum pa phod ka can te can bzhi sogs byon/ khyad par rigs chos gnyis ga'i sras rngog zhe sdang rdo rje ni pug ye rgyal gyi skye ba yin/ mtshan mdo sde/ lo bzhi pa'i dus mi las g.yog byas te spong dag bar pa mdzad/ rgyud 'grel gyi chos grar shin tu 'tshub cing bla ma dang yab kyi dbu skra dang rmang ra nas re mos kyis 'then pas rngog gis 'di sang nas khrid mi yong dgos pa 'dug gsungs pas rje mar pa'i zhal nas 'di bla ma lho pa —chen po la rgyud dngos su thos pa yin zer nas nga la rgyud pa 'ded pa/ bod kyi sngas/sa pa'i mchog cig 'ong pas khrid shog gsungs/ lo bcu gnyis pa rta lo la yab ga'egs/ de srid yab la bka' lung thams cad nod nas slar rngog dang pa lba ba can /la zhib tsha gas mdzad/ bya lo chag lo ra lo gnyan chung lo tsā shud bu 777

lo tsā zangs dkar ba ri sogs mang du bsten/ lo bco brgyad pa la yab kyi jo mo zhig gis ka wa li dra ba sngon po can dang phying khug dra ba sngon po can bya ba yab kyis bzhag pa gtad byung ba ka wa la nas rgyud bshad khyad par ba dang phying khug nas man ngag khyad par can du ma byung / gtsang du byon nas chu mig ring mo na bzhugs tshe jo mo sgre mo bya ba ras chung pa'i slob ma de na re nga'i mkhan po chu mig ring mo na 'o brgyal chang la chu rgyob gsungs nas spyan drangs te sang dgong rig ma 'di'i sar byon na gdung rgyud 'ong zhes dang / rje mar mi'i gdung sogs bzhugs pa'i gdung rten zhig phul te tshags mdzad par zhus/ sras gtsang tsha jo sras tshul khrims shes rab 'khrungs te lo bzhi lon pa zhig dbus su phul phyis kyang byon pa mkhyen zhing gdung rten de khams su thegs pa mkhyen nas phyis mad mi'i gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten khyad par can phul te da lta mar pa gdung khang na bzhugs/ mkhas pa phya g.yor gnyis dang zhang rin po che sogs dge bshes gdugs thogs bzhi brgya tsam la nya mo skyur du chos 'khor chen po mdzad/rje mar pa'i sras mo zhig byon pa la gral dbu zhus/ des rje mar pa'i gdung rnams phyag tu phul/ chos 'khor ba kun gyis dbon mo la 'bul ba byas pas khong phyag rten gyis nub pa byung skad/ gdung rnams la dngul gyi gdung khang zhig bzhengs/ dgung lo don bdun pa khyi lo la nya mo skyur du mya ngan las 'das/slob ma rtsags dar ma rgyal po/ mgar ston bkra shis dbang phyug 'di gnyis nas mgar 'bum dang rtsags 'bum byung / rngog tsha chos sku/ ngo rje chen po 'di nas gnyal dwags kyi ngo rje rnams byung / bya nag chen po 'di nas bya ba rnams byung zhing lha mo gser gyi spu gri dang dud sol ma nyid yin/ mtshur dum bu kha ba/ lho nag chen po dkar ston chos 'od sogs mang du byon zhing dge bshes gdugs thogs sum brgya dang drug bcu byon par grags/ yum jo skyabs 778

la sras lnga 'khrungs/ gsum ba/zhon rim gyis ga'e/gres/ jo bsod lo nyer lnga la gshegs/ jo sras thogs med grags pa 'phrin las che yang so bdun la thegs/de'i sras rgyal tshal mo dang rgyal tsha rdor seng yin/ gcen po gtsang tsha— tshul she lo zhe bzhi bzhugs/ sras rngog kun dga' 'khrungs ma thag tu yab gshegs nas dbon po gsum ga mes pos bskyangs shing kun dga' lo bcu lon tshe mes po gshegs nas slob dpon ra mo la chos tshar bar mdzad/ 'dis rje sgam po pa'i dngos slob ma la nag la chos mtha' dag zhus/ tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa zhus pa gdung rgyud spel dgos gsungs nas ma gnang / phyis ra mo'i sras lcam mo sku mched gsum gyi dus bgo bsha' mdzad pas sa gdan phyag rdzas rnams sku mched gsum dang mar pa'i gdung khang gis gtsos pa'i byin rlabs lha rten rnams kun dga'i sku skal du byung ste khur nas byon pa na yon bdag spre'u bya bas nga'i zhing steng 'dir gzims khang gyis zer ba ltar mdzad de spre zhing du grags lo don brgyad bzhugs/ mar pa'i gdung khang gi rten 'brel gyis gdan sa dngos su song zhing sras rgyud gdan sa rngog gzi brjid grags pa/ 'dis rab byung mdzad/'di yan sngags chas can rim dgung lo brgyad bcu bzhugs/ de nas rim — bzhin rngog rin chen bzang po/ rngog chos rgyal ba/ rngog don grub dpal bzang /rngog byang chub dpal ba/ rngog bkra shis dpal grub/ rngog byang chub dpal grub/ rngog byang chub grags pa'i bar du skyes bu dam pa byon la de dag gi —mched zla dang rngog tshang 'og ma'i zhal ngo yang 'phrin las can du ma byon zhing spyir sngar rngog chos shin tu dar bas zhal ngo dang slob rgyud kyise byas pa'i rgyud bshad dang skyed rdzogs kho na'ang deng dus bgrang gis mi lang bar snang ngo / /rje mar pa'i bka' rgyud las rngog nga 'i bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ /shar gyi ka chen mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje ni yu la dol mda'/ gdung 779

mtshur/ yab sngags pa mthu bo che zhig gi sras su 'khrungs/ slob gnyer la dka' ba du ma mdzad/ phyis 'bum bzheng ba'i yig mkhan las rje mar pa'i snyan pa thos te dro bo 'u nga du byon/ sku dgra mar pa mon nag btul/ phyis dol du yang spyan drangs shing spyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud man ngag rdzogs par gnang /de la slob ma'i gtso bo khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje ni rgya gar du gsang 'dus 'chol du byon pas nyan sa ma rnyed par bod du byon/ mtshur la rdzogs par zhus/rgyud kyi ṭī ga'ang mdzad par gnyis med rnam rgyal chen mo drangs 'dug skad/khon 'dab gīrti ni mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs kyi slob ma gsang 'dus la shin tu mkhas pa yin yang man ngag ma byung bas mtshur la bsten zhing sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin no/ /de nas rim pas bya khang ba bsod rin/thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang se pa 'phags pha skyabs/ gser sdings pa 4/zhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu rin po che/ des dar rgyas su mdzad la/ phyis rje tsong kha pa chen pos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ gsang pa 'dus pa'i bshad sgrub mtshur ston bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ /nub kyi ka chen gtsang rong gi mes chen po ni nyang stod stag tshal ba yin/mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gnas gzhi ra do'i bdag po yin/ spong dag lan gsum gyis rje mar pa shin tu mnyes/ ma hā mā ya dang gdams ngag mtha' yas par gnang / slob ma zhang bsod nams mkha' sogs grub thob du ma byon no/ /mes ston bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ / byang gi ka chen rje mi la ni/ yul la stod mang yul gung thang gi bye brag skya rnga/ de las rtsa/ de las ko ron du 'khrungs/ gdung khyung po khyad par mi la/ yab shes rab rgyal mtshan dang yum nyang tsha dkar rgyan/ chung ngu la yab 780 —

grongs pas khu bo dang a zhes nor gzhis phrogs/ yum gyi bkas dbus su byon te mthu ser gyis dgra thams cad brlag par mdzad/ rdzogs chen pa mdzad dus rong ston lha dgas rje mar pa'i snyan pa brjod pa gsan pas mi bzod pa'i dad pa skyes te de ma thag byon/ rje mar pa la yang bud med gnyis kyis shel gyi rdo rje zhig gtad nas 'di khrus la rgyal mtshan gyi rtser zhog bla ma'i bka' lung yin zer ba ltar byas pas 'od kyis 'dzam gling khyab pa'i ltas gzigs pas bsu bar byon te nga rgyal mi skye ba'i phyir phru slog pa ltar mdzad/ 'di rkos shig gsungs te bka'i thog ma bsgrubs/ chang gnang ba 'thungs pas gdams ngag gi sgod du dgongs/ sku mkhar zlum po/ sog / zla kham/ gru gsum rnams brtsigs shing bshig mthar gru bzhi dgu thog rtse mo rin po che 'bar ba lta bu rtsigs gsungs nas brtsigs shing mdo khyams dang dbu rtse sogs brtsigs/ dbang gral nas ca/na mang du bton pa sogs yid chad chen po bdun gyis sgrib pa sbyangs/ yi chad chen po lan dgu thongs na thos pas grol ba zhig 'ong ba la/ da snying rus shig dgos te sla nas 'ong gsungs sngon gyi mnal ltas las rdo rje rgyal mtshan du mtshan btags te bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur tshe 'di ni mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor yin/ mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor 'di na zhes nam mkha' bstan pas bde mchog gi lha tshogs dngos su gzigs te lha dang bla mas gsang mtshan bzhad pa'i rdo rjer btags/ gdams ngag thams cad tshang sprugs su gnang nas sgom du bcug mnal lam du yul gyi khang pa zhig yum grongs sring mo 'khyar pa sogs gzigs pas yul la 'byon par 'dod nas zhur byon pas mkhar dang skar khung nas bla ma'i dbu la nyi ma shar/ bla ma mnal du song /yum gsol 'dren du byung ba'i dbu sngas su gtsang la yar 'gro'i glu phul bas khyod 'gro na btang bas chog ste nga gnyid du song ba dang thug pas phyis mi phrad/781

mkhar dang nga'i mgo la nyi ma dazhar bas khyod kyis bstan pa spyi dang bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa nyin mor byed/ bdag med mas zas khyer ba 'dis khyod ting 'dzin gyis 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs te gdams ngag thams cad gnang ste sdug thug pa'i dus 'di stos de bar ma lta gsungs nas shog dril la tham ma zhig gnang /khyod la byin dang gzhan la byin/ /gal te srang la bcal yod na/ /sum 'gyur bas kyang mi lhag ri/ /gsung ste bstan pa gtad/ chos la'i bar skyel thung mdzad de spyi bor phyag bzhag nas smon lam dang / gtsang sil ma la yi la rtse na/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ma yod/ /sang nyin 'gro ba'i lam bar la/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yod/ /pha yu la zhen pa'i mkhar zhing na/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i slob dpon yod/ /a ni sring mo'i nye 'khor la/ /sgyu ma ba shig pa'i man ngag yo/da/ /yul mi rtsis chung rang yul der/ /'phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod/ /zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la/ /bde la lha yi pham phabardo yod/ /mi med lung pa'i brag phug na/ /'khor 'das brje ba'i tshong 'dus yod/ /mtshams dam po mi med khyi med na/ /rtags myur du mthong ba'i sgron me yod/ /nad med thā yi tshogs 'khor la/ /ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i bdud rtsi yod/ /'phrul 'khor gnad kyi kha bsgyur la/ /'bras rin chen skye ba'i so nam yod/ /grib dwangs pa lha yi gzhal yas na/ /rang don chen 'grub pa'i ltad mo yod/ /mi la ras pa'i snying rus la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yod/ /mar pa lo tsā'i bu rgyud la/ /gtam snyan mang po'i yong sgo yod/ /ces lung bstan te gangs ti se/ la phyi chu bar/ brag dmar spo mthon/ yol mo gangs ra rnams la sgoms/ shar phyogs na tsā ri tra yod de da lta dus la ma babs ma 'ongs ba khyod kyi sgrub rgyud kyis 'dzin par 'gyur zhes gnas dang rgyud 'dzin lung du bstan te byon/ rngog la phyi phyag mdzad/ zhag gsu ma la yul du 782

phebs/ mnal lam bakhrin gzigs pas skyo shas cher skyes te dang por lo/nga chugs phug tu zhing rin la bsten nas bsgoms/ de nas brag dkar rta so ra zwa'i tshod ma la bsten te bcu gnyis cha bzhi'i dam bca' mdzad nas bsgoms tshe sring rma dang mdzes se'i zas skom gyis rkyen byas te khams 'dus pa'i rnam pa ci yang byung tshe shog dril gzigs pas rlung sems gnyis med kyi gdams ngag byung ste bo ga/sa su thon/ grub pa thob nas smin khyugs grib ma'i ri dang phan tshun du 'phur zhing bsgoms/ ling pa'i brag tu dbu ma'i mar snar me rlung tshud pa'i rten 'brel brag srin mo'i cho 'phrul snang ba dang / sman lung chu bar du mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud zhig pari rten 'brel tshe ring ma'i skor snang / chu la mi bying pas zhu yardza dar ma dbang phyug dang khyi dang sha ba ma smad ltar dul bas khyi ra ba rdo rje mgon po btul/ mtsho ma pham phyag sor gyi rtse la len pa dang / ti se'i rtser gshegs pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis na ro bon chung btul/ snyan pas sa thams cad khyab cing rje sgam po ba la bstan pa gtad de dgung lo gya bzhi la mngon dgar gshegs/ snang ba dag pa'i ngor sku gdung ma byung / 'a dri nga gis shel gyi mchod rten du byas pa dang seng ge la bcibs pa mkha' 'gros spyan drangs par mthong / tha mas spur gnyis byung ba brin dang chu bar gnyis kur bzhu zhing gdung rus ma bzhag par mthong ngo / /slob ma'i mchog ni lkog gyur dbang po yang rab kyi don byed pa sngags skyes lhan cig skyed pa'i sgron me/ mi ma yin 'dul ba bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi 'dul ba rje sgam po pa/ ras chung pa/'bri sgom ras pa/ se ban ras pa/ ras pa zhi pa 'od/ khyi ra ras pa/ngam rdzong ras pa/ bde ba skyong / ra rdzi ras pa ste ras pa mched brgyad/ sku sgres kur 'khrungs pa'i ston pa drug ran/ ma bcu gnyis/ khyim pa'i tshul can gyi grub thob ma drug sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba byon/ zhi ba 'od/ khyi ra ras 783

pa/ sang sa rgyas skyabs/ rong chung ras ba/— lcam pre ta/ mdzes se/ dpal dar 'bum/ sal le 'od/ ras chung ma/ nya ma legs se ste 'u sa 3nges mkha' spyod du byon pa mang du byung ngo / khyad par chos rgyud zin pa mus ta mo gling kha'i 'bri sgom ras pa ni rngog dbyal sogs bla ma mang du bsten pa zhig gis rje mi la rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten/ lo sum bcur sgrub pa mdzad cing / mal yer ba pa la sogs pa'i slob ma byung ngo / /ras pa zhi ba 'od ni brag sgye chur sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad mthar brag phug gi spyi bo btol nas mkha' spyod du byon te slob ma dam pa ras chen nas brgyud pa zhi ba 'od kyi snyan rgyud 'dzin pa byung ngo / /mdo bkra lcim lung gi ngam rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal po ni byams chos dang gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i ston pa zhig gis rje mi la rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten nas snyan rgyud bskyangs pa la ngam rdzong snyan rgyud ces gung thang ras pa nas rgya pho ba lung pa la brgyud pa dang gnyal pa gsung bcad pa nas dmar bu brag pa la brgyud pa sogs byung ngo / /slob ma'i gtso bo gcig ni ras chung pa ste mang yul gung thang yi/ padma dkar po'i grong phreng rar gnyan dar ma grags kyi sras su 'khrungs rdo rje grags su btags/ lo bdun na yab gshegs/ yum dang khu bo 'dus pa shin tu sdang bar byung / klog tshigs med du mkhyen nas klog gi zas yon gyis ma khu bskyangs/ lo bcu gnyis la rje mi la dang mjal te rang byung gi sgom skyes/yang ma khus sa gnyan du ma rkor bcug pas bsnyung 'dze byung / dzo gi ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro ba zhi ga gis skyel ma la sbyar te rgya gar du btol/ bla ma wa la tsastus gtum po khyung sham can gnang ste zla ba gsum bsgrubs pas dang por bsnyung du song yang mthar rtags khyad par can byung / nad gdon yul bud/ slar gtang rag tu gser srang gsum btsal nas phul/ rje btsun mi la bsten pas ras chung par grags/ slar lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor bzhi len pa la bla mas 784 ༄

rgya gar du mngags te byon/ ti pu ba/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ bal por ye rang pa rnams la gdams ngag mtha' yas gsan/ ti pu pas rje mi/ la la a ga ru/nag po'i phyag mkhar sogs kyi skyes bskur/ lo tsā bas tshig yi/ lha da bcug pa'i skyon rnams bal por bha ri rnal 'byor ma grub thob ma des bsal/ rje btsun mi las kyang ras chung pa shel gyi mchod rten du rtag tu gzigs/ mu stegs kyi ston pa cig gis phan gnod kyi man ngag mang du phul bas de phyin rlung 'tshub kyis btums par gzigs/ bla ma la phyag lan re ba dang / log rtog skye ba dang / thugs rgyal skye ba thams cad 'dis lan par 'chad/ des na gnod byed lta zhog phan byed yin yang mu stegs dang 'brel ba ni gtan mi rung ba yin no/ /bla mas dpal thang nas bsus te g.yag ru'i skor dang rkyang mgur skor rnams byung zhing mchog gi gdams pa rnams mkha' 'gros spyan drang sa shing mu stegs kyi man ngag rnams bsregs/ dad pa rtsa ba nas log pa rdzu 'phrul mang pos btul te slar gsol ba btab pas mkha' 'gro'i chos rnams tshang bar byung ste dad pa lhag par skyes nas sngar lo bcu gnyis phyags phyi byas/ da dung lo bcu gnyis mi 'bral ba'i dam bca' phul/ man ngag rnams bla ma la yang phul/ bla mas kyang /bcu gsum bar du chig rgyud rgya yis gdab/ /ces pa bde mchog snyan rgyud gnang bas thugs tshim ste nya ma rnams kyis ras chen las ras chung ngo mtshar che zhes bsnyen bkur go log tu byas pas dbus su 'byon par zhus pa bla mas ji tsam bshol yang ga gsan par byon/ 'jig rten pa'i khyi mo zhig gis rkang pa nas 'dzin par 'dug go de la zon cher gyis shig gsungs/ bla ma bal po dang mtshur ston dang mjal bas phyis rgya bod na rje mi la las lhag pa mi 'dug par yid 'ches/ lha lcam ldem bu'i skor gyis thugs byung ste bla ma'i drung du byon te ring du bzhugs/ bla mas gser g.yu ka pā la gang gnang nas dgos pa'i dus 785

yod pas khyer gsungs/ ras chung pa khyod dbus su 'gro ran gsungs shing /bu bzhi'i nang gi don po song / /snyan rgyud 'dzin pa'i sgron me khyod/ /ma rig mun pa sel zhing song / /dbu ru'i byang phyogs 'grim zhing song / /dge bshes 'ga' zhig gdul byar 'gyur/ /sham po'i gangs la sgrub pa gyis/ /lho phyogal zur kha 'grim zhing song / /rdo bod mtshams su dgon pa thob/ /gsungs pas byon/ 'di'i mang res 'khrungs yul du dge bshes khyung po rtse mang dang / dbon po gnyan chos skyabs/ la stod cung bar la stod zangs ri ba/ mchog dkar gyi bra ga la bzhugs tshe mnga' ris pa gsal mchog tsā ri sgom chung / dbon po gnyan nag lhun po rnams smin/ der lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa lam du stongs/ snubs rong du cung zad bzhugs pas jo mo smre mo smin/ dbur stod du dge ba'i bshes gnyen sne zur bas gdams ngag zhus/ bya yul du sgo btsir byung ba la dbyangs gsungs pas bya yul pa dad de gdams pa zhus/ 'dir spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyis gdams pa zhus zhes bris pa ni mi dag ste bya yus pas spyan snga bzhugs kyi bar nye gnas mdzad nas phyis bya yul btab pa yin pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan zhig dang nor ba yin no/ /bsam yas su byon nas rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan/ gra phyi nang sbrags sogs su bzhugs ste 'bro sgom don grub/ bur sgom nag po/ 'bro sgom lha 'od/ bsod nams 'od zer/ gnyal rdo rje 'od zer/ rta shod ras pa snga phyi rnams smin/ 'phyos skyi tshang du bzhugs/nyang dgon pa skyabs ne tshan/ shes rab dbang phyug sogs smin/ ra mo srin mo brag du bzhugs/ zhang brag rtse ba/ zhang grom pa skyes/ gnyags gcer bu ba sogs smin/ shas yu dkar du bzhugs te byar po'i rnal 'byor ma gsum grol nas mkha' spyod grub/ mkhar chur byon nas ro stomagadang sangs rgyas thos chog gi gter sbas/ slar sham po'i nub gsang phug sogs du mar bzhugs/ yar 786

lung du lha rje lha 'bar/ sgom chen smon lam 'bar/ dge bshes khyung po sogs smin/ g.yer khyung po ldan dmar smin/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i sku'i bkod pa lo ro g.yo ba g.yo ba btsun chung mas spyan drangs lam du sho ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang cung pa rgyan ni sogs kyis mjal/ lo ror byes mgol btab/mkha' 'gro btsun chung ma khrom gyi dbus nas mkha' spyod du byon/ byar du byon te byar smad du thugs dam khyad par can byung / rwa shes snang sku mched smin/byes mgol du mkha' 'gro btsun chung ma'i jo jo g.yo ba 'bar re de'i bu grags pa dpal chos sgor zhugs pas sgom pa chos grags zhes zer zhing grub thob chen por gyur te sangs rgyas sgom par grags/ de'i rigs kyi sras po ston pa yang dag dpal yin la don gnyis mthar phyin nam mkha' la skyil krung 'cha' zhing 'phur ba dang grong 'jug nus/ sangs rgyas ston yang du grags/ lha lcam ldem bus bshags pa phul/ bla mas gnang ba'i gser g.yu las sku gsung thugs rten byed du bcug lha lcam sogs thams cad kyi nad sos/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu gyur/ bya yu/la ba'i slob ma rtsa'i rgyal ba lo/ la stod cung ba nas sum pa las rab tu byung mdo sngags kyi mkhas par gyur pa seng ge dpal gyis srin mdzub mar mer phul/ nye gnas mdzad pas thugs kyi sras dam pa mtheb rdum du grags/ nyi ma rjes la 'ong gi yod bya ba'i mnal ltas bzhin stod lung pa ye shes bla ma mdo sngags la mkhas pa byung ba la snyan rgyud chig rgyud rnams gnang / lan gsum mjal ba'i dang po zhag dgu bcu/ gnyis pa la lnga bcu/ gsum pa la zhag sum bcu yin yang rten 'brel gyis phyed phyed gsongs gsungs nas dang po la zhag zhe lnga bsdad sogs kyis gsungs/ phyis khyung tshang brag la sgrub pa mdzad pas rgyal ba khyung tshang bar grags/ 'di la gling gi rnam thar na khyung tshang pas ras chung pa ma mjal bya ba dang / lo ro'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung las rje btsun 787

la khyung tshang ba bya ba'i slob ma che/da gsung bya ba yod kyang khyung tshang ba gzhan zhig dang nor ba'i ma dag pa 'phel ba zhig go /sog pa tshe skong dang sku steng kha sogs su slob dpon nga dmas rigs lnga'i zhing bstan zhing rigs lnga thams cad rang gi 'khor du gzigs/ bud med shin tu mi sdug pa zhig sang sprul pa zhig sprul pa mjal bar 'ong ngo zer bas khams pa dbu se byon/ lan gsum du bsten/ bu slob cig la gdams ngag thob che bar grags/ gangs bar gser kha'i rin chen gling pa gdams pas rjes su gzung / chu bar nas shel gyi mchod rten mkha' 'gros gdan 'dren pa gzigs te skad cig gis byon pas lam du rje btsun dngos dang mjal/ sgrub khang du byon pas gdung bzhu ba dang thug ste gzhon pa 'gas ma btang bas mgur lhang gsungs ma thag spur la me mched/ me lce'i nang nas rje btsun gyi skus lan gyi glu mdzad/ snang ba thams cad brdar shar zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gros brda 'dri ba'i lan bkrol/ shing gi lha la chos gsubs/sangs rgyas ston yang la byin rlabs rten sogs rgyas par gnang ste byes mgol la sogs dgon gnas rnams skyongarme shig gsungs/ rgyal ba los zhabs la thug pa'i tshogs pa rnams skyongs shig gsungs/ sum pa la phug mo che sogs sgru ba gnas rnams skyongs shig gsungs te sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du byon par snang ngo / /dgung lo don brgyad dang gya bzhi sogs ci rigs snang zhing sgrub pas mnyes pa sangs rgyas ston yang sogs lho'i bu che ba bzhi/ te lo'i sprul pa khyung tshang ba sogs byang gi bu che ba bzhi/ thabs lam gyi bka' babs zangs ri ras pa sogs bka' babs kyi bu bcu bdun sogs byung la de re res kyang 'phrin las cher byung la/ khyad par khyung tshang pa nas ma gcig ong jo dang des zhang lo grub pa dpal sogs nas ras chung snyan rgyud dar ro/ /mi la'i bka' rgyud las dwags po'i bka' rgyud las gzhan bshad pa'i skabs so/ /788

mi 'dul ba'i mchog rje sgam po pa ni mdo laca/ dge slong 'tsho byed du lung bstan zhing ting 'dzin rgyal por phyi dus bram ze dang dge sbyong rnams chos sbong ba'i tshe zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas lus dang srog blos btang ste ting nge 'dzin 'di 'dzin par dam bcas shing chos smra ba brgyad brgya langs te ting nge 'dzin 'di 'dzin par dam bcas pa'i tshe lha klu bye ba brgyad bcu dang khrag khrig drug bcus de dag gi grogs su khas blangs pa'i zla 'od gzhon nu rje sgam po ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' brgyad brgya po bka' rgyud kyi bla ma gzhan rnams dang lha klu rnams bka' srung dang sbyico/ bdag sogs yin no/ /de la rje sgam po ba ni 'khrungs yul skyal bod snyi/ gdung rus kyang snyi ba la rgya snyi g.yu snyi bod snyi gsum las bod snyi ba la rus chen cher yod pa'i nang nas sman dang sngags mkhyen pa'i rgyal po dga'/ yum sho mo bza' che lcam/ che ba rgya pa gser re/ chung ba snyi chung ba/ 'bring po rje 'di sa mo lug la 'khrungs/ mtshan dar ma skyabs/sman dang sngags la mkhas par gyur/ dbon dar ma 'od kyi lcam mo zhig jo mor yod pas sras pho mo gnyis byon pa yang 'das/ jo mo yang nad drag pos thebs pas thugs skyo ste snying nas chos byed par 'dod tshe jo mos kyang chos rang gyis shig zer nas 'das/ thams cad dge phyogs su btang / rmos mdzad 'phro la byon phyags kyi 'jim pa brdabs sar me tog padma re skyes/ dwags po dprongs gar dge bshes mang yul pa blo ldan shes rab dang slob dpon sha pa gling pa las spre'u lo nyer drug la chig rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan bsod nams rin chen du btaṭa/mkhan po la rgyud man ngag mang du gsan/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa' la mi la'i man ngag yod par mkhyen nas zhus pas gnas pa bzang po zhag bcu gsum du ting nge 'dzin gcig la 'gro ba byung / nyon mongs mgo non/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yid la mi 'gyu ba byung / zangs dkar lo tsā ba la yo ga dang bde 789

mchog bya 'dul la 'dul ba rnams mkhas par sbyangs/ dge bshes snyug rum pa zla ba bdun bsten pas kun rdzob byang sems la brtan pa thob/ lcags ri gong kha ba dang rgya yon bdag la jo bo'i man ngag mtha' dag gsan/ thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe sgrib pa dag pa dang 'jigs pa las grol ba dang sa thob pa la sogs pa'i ltas su bshad pa'i rmi lam kho na rmi/ phyi nang gi srin bu med pa dang kham gyi zas la ma stos/ rtag tu ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa byung / lan cig skyo sangs la byon pas sprang po gsum zas skom la smon pa la gcig gis rje btsun mi la ras pa lta bu zas su mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi 'dren/seng ge la zhon nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba de yin na dga' mod zer/ de gsan pa tsam gyis dad pa mi bzod pa skyes/ sngar gyi shes pa de ma yin pa zhig shar/yun ring du 'byon yang ma mkhyen/ dal bus brang khang du byon te yan lag bdun pa byas pas 'phro stor zhing song / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yid yul du gsal/ sems can thams cad kyi khams dang dbang po shes pa snyam byed/ de nas sprang po de kun la grub thob de ga na yod dris pas brin dang snye nam na bzhugs/ mar pa lo tsā'i slob ma na ro'i chos drug gsung ba yin par 'dugasku'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa ston/ snyan grags shin tu che bas la stod rang nas shes 'ong zer/ de rnams zas skom gyis tshim par mdzad/ phyi nas gar song mi 'dug ste sprul par shes/ der 'byon par thag bcad tshe bod yul na sgra che zer ba'i rag dung bus pa dang / nam mkha' la rnga bo che 'dug pa brdungs pas sgra chen po byung / mon mo zhig gis 'o ma thod phor gang byin te mi 'di rnams la rnga brdungs/ ri dwags 'di rnams la 'o ma 'di byin zer/ 'dis ri dwags mang po de mi kheb byas pas/ thog mar khyod rang 'thung dang sems can thams cad kyang kheb/ nga rnab phyogs su 'gro zer/ phyis rnga'i sgra la nyan pa'i mi rnams 790

bka' gdams kyi chos kyis bskyangs pa rnams dang ri dwags rnams bka' rgyud kyi sgo ma chen rnams yin par 'dug bka' gdams kyang bka' drin che gsungs/bla ma rnams la 'byon phyag myo/dzad pas rgya yon bdag gis rnal 'byor pa de 'grub pa thob nges su 'dug pas chos thams cad dris gdams ngag gi khyos ma khyer la shog gsungs/ spyan snga bas khyod rnal 'byor pa'i rtsar cis kyang 'gro na nged kyi rtags ma dor bar shog zangs nged kyis brdungs zangs skad mis 'don par 'dug ste ser kha la phan na khyi tshil yin na yang yin pas thabs med gsungs/snyug rum pas nga rgas gar khyod kyis ma bor bar shog cig gsungs/ 'di'i dus ras pa rnams kyis gdan sa zhig sko bar zhus kyang zer/ ras chung pas rgyud pa sus 'dzin zhus kyang zer te/ mdang rmi lam na nga'i lag na shel bum bdud rtsis gang ba zhig 'dug pa dbus nas dge slong zhig byung bas dngul gyi bum par byo nas song ba rmis/ nga'i rgyud pa 'di ras pas mi 'dzin par rab byung gis 'dzin par 'dug gsung zhing / 'khor du sprul sku 'du ba 'di e ma ho/ /zhes dwags po lung bstan gyi mgur gsungs/ der gtsang la byon pas nyi ma phyed dang gnyis kyis slebs pa'i sar mgo yoms kyi bsnyung gzhi byung nas rlung brgyal yang yang byung / rje btsun chos gsung tshe res bzhad/ res spyan chab phrom phrom 'dug pa na ci lags zhus pas/ nga'i bu dbus pa ston pa de 'ong zhing 'dug pas dga' ba zhig kyang byung / ngal stegs kyi kha nas yang yang 'gyel zhing 'dug pas snying rje ba zhig kyang byung / da myur bar sleb pa 'dug pas de'i mjal sna sus byas la ngan song med gsungs/ nya ma zhig gis nga'i bu mo sgom cha zhig yod pa la mjal sna 'chol zhes bshad kyang zer/ ras pa zhig gis bsus te bshad kyang zer te thugs rgyal cung zad skyes pa gcog phyir zla ba phyed du mjal ka ma byung /de nas pha bong zhig gi steng na bzhugs 'dug pa la gser dang ja phul pas/791

gser dang mi rgan lo mi mthun/ /ja la skol ba'i thab ka med/ /gsung zhes phal cher las 'chad la/ gser gyi 'bul ba yang mi zhan snyam pa na sa rdo gser du mdzad nas nga rgyal bcag pa dang ston pa'i ja lan yin gsungs nas sngo gang byung ba bsdus pa'i khu ba la chab bsil bas ro mchog byung zhes re gnyis na snang / khyod kyi ming ci gsungs/ bsod nams rin chen lags zhus pas bsod nams rin chen zhes lan gsum gsungs nas/ bsod nams tshogs chen bsaṭa las byung / 'gro drug kun gyi rin po che/ gsungs/ chang ka pā la gang gsol zhing 'dug pa gnang bas the tshom pa na rnam rtog ma mang bar 'di 'thung gsungs/ the tshom med par gsol bas/ gdams ngag rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig /shar seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de/ /zhes sogs sne len gyi mgur mdzad/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur mdzad/ sngar dbang thos tshul dang ting nge 'dzin yod tshul zhus pas 'bras bu mtho yang 'du shes —med pa'i lha gsungs nas bzhad/ lar bod kyi snying la 'dre zhugs a ti sha gsang sngags 'chad du ma bcug pas mi mang po 'phu nga gsungs/ bka' gdams pa la'ang gsang sngags mang du yod zhus pas de kun gsang sngags yin te man ngag min gsungs/ tshogs gsog pa'i thabs gang che zhus pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa las slob dpon gyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che/ de las kyang bla ma'i gdams ngag chud ma zos par nyams su blangs na bsod nams che gsungs/ tshe gcig la 'tshata rgya ba srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la bstos pa spu tsam med pa zhig gis bla ma mtshan lda na zhig la dbang gdams ngag zhus nas bar ma chad bsgoms na rab tshe 'di/'bring 'chi ka ma bar do/4 tha ma skye ba bdun nam bcu drug na grol ba yin/lar lha rje ston pa khyod lta ba kha tho la skur ba'i mi dang blo ma stun/ sgom pa 792

nyams su len pa'i mi dang blo stun de'i ngag la nyon/ gros phugs tshe 'di blos btang ba'i bya btang la gyis/ tshe 'di pa rnams kyis chos brgyad slob tu 'ong ba yin/ spyir stong nyid la shor sa bzhi yod de stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor bra bya ba blo'i yul du gyur pa thams cad stong par sgom pa yin mod bya ba dang / stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba bya ba 'khor 'das thams cad stong pa nyid yin mod zer ba dang / stong nyid gnyen por shor ba nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gang skyes la bltas pas de ga stong pa nyid yin mod zer ba dang / stong nyid chad ltar shor ba bya ba pa da lta kho bo la sgom du med zer ba yod/ de thams cad yang dag ma yin/ 'on kyang las dang po ba'i zhan pa phyogs re zlog pa la phan du rung tsam yin/ lar sems kyi gzhi rtsa ma chod na bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ji tsam bzang yang khams gsum las mi 'da' ste rtsa ba ma chod pa'i nyams bya ba yin/ 'o na lam yang dag pa gang yin na/ mtshan ldan gyi bla mas slob ma snod ldan khrid de gnyug ma'i shes pa sems can thams cad la gnas/ sangs rgyas la chos sku'i dgongs par rang gsal/ rnal 'byor pa la thabs du mas mtshon te ngo sprad nas bsgoms pas lta ba shugs la rtogs/ nyon mongs ngang gis 'gagarnam rtog rang sar grol/ ye shes mngon du gyur/ gnas lugs nyams su myong ba de ngag tu smrar mi btub/ brjod pas mtshon mi nus/ gzhon nu ma'i bde ba'am skugs ba'i rmi lam bzhin smrar med/ gzhi de kun la yod kyang ngo ma shes/des na rgyud ldan gyi bla ma bsten pa gal che bar gda'/ gnyug ma tha mal gyi shes pa de bu gar yang ma gtad/ dpe gang gis kyang mi mtshon/ brjod pa gang gis kyang mi rtogs/ tha snyad gang gis kyang mi rig des na bcas bcos mi bya/rang ga so ma'i ngang la lhod de zhog mdzod gsungs nas/ lta ba yin par nges kyis rang gis sems la stos/ /la sogs pa gsungs/ der do nub gsung gleng 793

kho thag chod pa zhig zhu dgos snyam yang gzi brjid ma bzod par ma tshad du gzims/ de nas yon tan ma 'tshong par brin/ snye nam la bsod stoms gyis/nub mo spro bde phug tu stogs gsung ba ltar byas/ gtum mo gnang nas ras rkyang mdzad de bsgoms pas zhag bdun na rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhal mthong ba zhus pas 'byung ba lnga'i rlung cung zad zin pa yin skyon yon gang yang ma yin gsungs te du sogs kyi rtags su ngo sprad/ de bzhin du stong gsum 'khor lo ltar 'khor zhing dran med du brgyal ba ro rkyang gi rlung dhū tir tshud pa dang / nam mkha' thams cad thugs rje chen pos gang ba'i dbu thog na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re 'dug pa spyi bo'i 'khor lor thig le 'phel ba dang / dmyal ba thig nag mthong bas snying rlung drag po byung ba gyen rgyu'i rlung rtsub zin yin la sgom thag thungs pas kyang lan pa dang / lus la 'dod lha drug mthong ba gong mas 'og ma la bdud rtsi'i char phab pas tshim pa la bdag gi ma skom drir 'chi ba mthong ba mgrin par thig le 'phel zhing dhū ti'i mar sna kha ma phyed pa yin zhes 'phrul 'khor btsan thabs kyi rdeg chog gnang / lus 'phar 'dar sogs drag tu byung ba snying gar khams 'phel ba yin 'phrul 'khor 'bad las sgoms gsungs/ de nas dga' bdes gang ste zas skom yang cher mi dgos pa byung / yang nyi zla gnyis gza' rta rnga phra mos bzung ba mthong ba na ro rkyang gi rlung thig dhū tir ro mnyam pa yin skyon yon gang yang min lar pho rgod rab 'dug da ni da ni da ni gsungs/ dgyes rdor dmar po'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas snying gar la las thob pa'i rakta brtan pa dang / bde mchog lo hi ba'i keng rus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba na lte bar dkar cha brtan pa dang / yang lus nam mkha' dang mnyam pa la rigs drug thams cad tshang ba 'o cha/ 'thung ba mthong bas rtsa phran thams cad du thig les gang ba yin/ rlung de ye shes kyi rlung du bsgyur dgos gsungs 794
