ca/sa myo/cho ba/ hri / gtu ma mo gnang / de thams cad skyon yon gang yang min pas sgoms shig gsu ngas te bsgoms pa las byung bas skyon ma yin la/ 'di dag la mchog du bzung co/ lam gong ma'i bar chod byed pas yon tan ma yin par bstan zhing 'di yan gyi rtags snang thams cad rnam shes 'gag pa'i rtags me 'a/ bar ba na du ba 'byung ba ltar mthar dag dgos par bstan pa yin no/ /de'i tshe gser gyi padma la skyil krung bcas pa sogs rmi lam ngo mtshar can bcu drug rmis te ma 'ongs lung bstan rmi 'a ma zhus lan gyi mgur mdzad/ de nas zla ba gcig na sman bla ma mched brgyad dang sangs rgyas stong bi/ gtso bo shākya thub pas mdzad pa dang longs sku'i zhing rab 'byams rnams mthong bas nang par zhur byon pas brag rtsa cig na gzims 'dug pa la phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la bzhengs nas/ da ni sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ste longs sprul gnyis dngos su mthong / chos sku da gzod mthong par 'gyur gyi da nga dang 'grogs mi dgos pas dbus su song la sgoms/ da mngon shes kyi phrang yod de mngon shes byung tshe gsang ba gal che/rlung lag sor la tshud na rlung gi phrang las thar ba yin gsungs/ thal ba la lag sor btang ste bcun pas spu ru ru byung bas rtsa rlung la dbang thob pa ni min te rtsa rlung las su rung ba yin gsungs/ bu khyod la sems kyi ngo bo bcos min du mthong ba'i rtogs pa 'char zhing mi rgan nga la yang sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus 'byung / de'i rtogs pa de brtan nas tshogs pa skyongs zhes mgur bzhengs pa/ bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud/ /ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na/ /res 'ga' zas kyi snang ba 'char/ /zas kyi snang ba shar tsa na/ /zas su zag med ting 'dzin zo/ /zhim mngar sgyu mar shes par mdzod/ /cir snang chos skur nyams su longs/ /res 'ga' gos kyi snang ba 'char/ /gos kyi snang ba shar tsa na/ /gos su gtum mo'i bde drod gyon/ /'jam legs sgyu mar shes 795

par mdzod/ /cir snang chos skur nyams su 'o/ngas/ /res 'ga' nor kyi sang ba 'char/ /nor gyi snang ba shar tsa na/ /nor du 'phags pa'i nor bdun spel/ /nor rdzas sgyu mar shes bar mdzod/ /cir snang chos skur nyams su longs/ /res 'ga' yul gyi snang ba 'char/ /yul gyi snang ba shar tsa na/ /yul du chos nyid gtan yul zungs/ /pha yul sgyu mar shes par mdzod/ /cir snang chos skur nyams su longs/ /res 'ga' grogs kyi snang ba 'char/ /grogs kyi snang ba shar tsa na/ /grogs su rang byung ye shes sten/ zla grogs sgyu mar shes par mdzod/ /cir snang chos skur nyams su longs/ /res 'ga' bla ma'i snang ba 'char/ /bla ma'i snang ba shar tsa na/ /'bral med spyi bor gsol ba thob/ /rjed med snying gi dkyil du sgoms/ /bla ma yang sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra/ /lar thams cad sgyu mar shes par mdzod/ /shar sgam po bdar gyi ri bo de/ /ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ /rtse mo rin chen prog zhu 'dra/ /rgyab ri dar dkar phyar ba 'dra/ /mdun ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /ri bdun blon po 'dud pa 'dra/ /spang thang gser gyi maṇḍal 'dra/ /ri de yi mgul na gdul bya yod/ khyod de ru song la 'gro don sgrubs/ /bu khyod kyi sku don 'grub ste mchi/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di ni ye shes mthong ba'i rtags te rdo rje'i ye shes dang chos kyi skur ngo sprad par bya ba sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du gong 'phel du 'gro ba yin no/ /des na rnam shes dang ye shes kyi rtags phyed pa ni bod na bka' rgyud 'di las gzhan mi snang ngo / /de nas shing stag pa'i nags dang chu rdo zam zhig yod pa'i bar skyel thung mdzad/ rten 'brel gyi gnad cig gis chu 'di'i phar khar kho bo mi 'gro 'o skol pha phad kyi phrin bgos 'dir bya gsungs nas a ru ra gse ra mdog zhig dang me cha zhig gnang / nga la yang nyams myong yun ring du ma skyes pa 'di la brten nas skyes/ khyod la'ang nyams myong 'phel 796

'grib cig 'byung ba'i dus su 'di dgos pa yin gsungs nas rlung sems gnyis med gnang / khyod la sgom chen pa mthar thug pa cig 'ong / bu khyod kyi ming yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags pa bya ba yin no/ /dbus pa ston pa pha tshan gyi khe dregs spongs/ gnyen 'dun gyi thag pa chod/ tshe 'di'i rdos thag med par gyis/ ri'i bu gyis/ chos thams cad gcig du dril la nyams su longs/ mi rgan nga la yang gsol ba thob/ dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung / spyir yang ri dwags mas ma'am bya bzhin du zon bag che bar bya/ zhi ba dul ba rtse reg chung bar bya/ bzod pa che bar bya/thams cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ rtog pa shin tu chung bar bya/ ri mtshams dang smra bcad dang / 'dag sbyar gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spong pa la bslab/ gsag sbyang gnyis pa rang sar dag kyang tshogs chung ngu chung ngu nas gsag /las 'bras nam mkha' ltar go yang sdig pa chung ngu nas 'dzem/ mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i nyams yod kyang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun chad med par blang / bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du go yang chos dang gang zag la skur ba mi gdab/ ces sogs rgyas par gsungs te bu khyod yos bu'i lo rta'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la brin snye nam gyi ri la sleb par gyis shig gsungs nas/ bu spros bral sems la shar dus su/ /tha snyad tshig phyir ma 'breng zhig/ /chos brgyad sgrog du 'tshud nyen yod/ /bu nga rgyal med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba/ /de go'am dwags po lha rje ba/ /rang grol nang nas shar dus su/ /tshad ma'i sbyor ba ma bkod cig /don med 'bad rtsol byed nyen yod/ /bu rnam rtog med pa'i ngang la zhog /rang sems stong nyid rtogs dus su/ /gcig dang du mar ma sbrel zhig /chad pa'i stong par 'gro nyen yod/ /bu spros pa med pa'i ngang 797

la zhog /phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su/ /lus ngag gi dge sbyor ma rtsom zhig /mi rtog ting 3dzin yal nyen yod/ /bu ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /rtags dang /pūng bstan byung dus su/ /dga' rlom ched du ma 'dzin zhig /bdud kyi lung bstan 'byung nyen yod/ /bu ched 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog /rang sems gtan la 'bebs dus su/ /mngon shes la 'dod pa ma skye zhig /rlom sems bdud kyis 0khyer nyen yod/ /bu re dogs med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba/ /de go'am dwags po lha rje ba/ /zhes gsungs te dbus su byon/ rje btsun gyis ras pa rnams bsdus te mdang rmi lam na nga'i rtsa ba nas bya rgod ser po cig dbus su 'phur song ba ri chen po cig gi rtser bab pa la ngang pa'i 'khor mtha' yas pa 'dus/ ci zhig nas gyes song bas ngang pa re la'ang ngang g.yog lnga brgya tsam re 'dus nas lung pa thams cad ngang pas ser myog gis gang ba rmis/ dbus pa ston pa des 'gro don dpag med yong bar 'dug kho bo rnal 'byor pa yin kyang rjes su rab byung dpag med yong ba 'dug pas kho bos kyang bstan pa la bya ba byas par 'dug gsungs/ de nas bka' gdams pa'i chas mdzad nas snyug rum pa la sgrol dkar gsan/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros gdugs tshod drangs/ bla ma'i gsung dran nas rgya ba gser re la gser mang po bskyis te byon pa rje btsun yos bu lo rta'i zla ba'i bcu bzhi la gshegs zhes thos pas cung zad brgyal/ sangs pa na gser thams cad brin gyi phyogs su gtor te rje gangs dkar ma'i gdung dbyangs mdzad/ bka' gdams kyi tshogs su nyams myong yal ba na bla ma'i gsung dran te gsol ba btab pas bde drod klungs su 'chud/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa shar/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa ltar sems kyi sgro 'dogs chod de rje btsun chen po de sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug pa la ngas grub thob chen po cig tu bzung 798

ba 'dug snya ma nas mos gus bcos min du skyeb// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis nga lung bstan na sheng 'di la shing khyod skye bar gyur cig ces bo rti tsa'i phreng ba lcang ma la brgyab pas lcang ma la bo dhi tsi 'phral du skyes so/ /de nas 'ol kha dge lung dang 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bzhugs tshe 'o de gung rgyal gyis skyabasa'agro sems skyed zhus nas 'dir mi bzhugs na nga'i bu dwags lha sgam pos phrin las sgrub pas der gshegs pa zhu zer/ der dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa grangs nas sgam por byon/ lo bcu gnyis 'dag sbyar mdzad par dgongs tshe bud med dgus zhal ba byugs shing rma bya'i sgro thogs pa zhig gis/ bcu gnyis 'dag sbyar byas pa bas/ /bcu gnyis bstan pa spel na dga'/ /zer/ de ma thag dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sgod ldan mtha' yas pa 'dus te thams cad ring por ma lon par rtsa rlung thig le'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa/ mngon shes drug shar ba/ ma dag pa'i dngos po brgyad mi 'chang ba/ cog bu'i sbyangs yon can/ ri mtshams dang smra bcad 'dag sbyar gyis dus 'da' ba/ snying rje pad dkar las dag pa'i 'khor lung bstan pa lta bu sha stag byung ngo / /yang tshes bcu bzhi bco lnga bcu drug gsum la dwags po lha sa ba'i rab gnas dang /yon bdag dgyer 'bum gyi rten rab gnas dang / mtshams nas byung ste dbus gtsang khams gsum la khrid mdzad pa dang / gzims mal nyid du bzhugs pa ste sku'i bkod pa bzhi dus gcig tu snang / 'byung ba'i zad par lnga dang rten la dngos su ye shes pa bstim pa dang / sku sgam po'i ri bas che ba gzims khang chung ngur chud pa dang / lus snang sems gsum 'dres pas ka ba la phyag ma thoṭa par g.yug pa dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba rgyun mi chad pa dang /gtsang po la gding ba bting ba la bzhugs nas chu sbyin mdzad pa dang / 'ja' la chibs pa la sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa bstan zhing sku tshe'i smad la sems 799

kyi ngo bo sto na pa phyag rgya chen po chig chod kho na gtso bor mdzad de/ ras bal bzhin du shes pa glod la zhog /sogs dang / ma bcos bzhag pa'i sems 'di sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes sogs bla ma rang sems la bzhugs pa'i zhal chems mdzad cing / sems can la phan pa ni dka'/ gnod pa ni yod ba sa gdan sa dang sku lder dang 'bum pa sogs mi mdzad par zhu/ gdan sa dang bla ma'i rnam thar la sogs pa gang yin na chos dang mthun pa de yin pas rgyal ba'i bka' dang mi 'gal ba re mdzad par zhu/ gsungs nas dgung lo don lnga pa chu mo bya 'o/ khrums kyi zla ba'i bco lnga ri sked nyi shar dus mya ngan las 'das/ ltas bsam gyis mi khyab cing gdung bzhu pa'i thugs sgo mang du bzhugs so/ /rje de la mjal ba dang mos pa byas pas rtogs pa skyes pa mang du byung zhing / sgam po'i ri mthong ba dang zhal mthong ba tsam gyis grol ba mang du yod la/ spyir sho sgom 'phags pa/ zim shi ye shes snying po/ gser sgom ye shes snying po/ ram snyi chos g.yung ste grub thob bzhi/ dwags po sgom tshul/ gru thob dbu se/ phag gru ba/ 'bab rom pa ste rgyud 'dzin bzhi/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ 'gar sgo ma dkar po/ lho la yag pa/ kye bo ye rdor te nye ba'i sras bzhi/ rmog cog pa/ sgom chung / grol sgom chos g.yung / gsal stong sgom she ste thugs kyi sras bzhi/ jo stan/ legs mdzes/ gsal byang / gsal me ste nye gnas bzhi/ gzhan yang gnyags nag po dang rdzi sgom skyes se sogs mtha' yas par byon no/ khyad par rje sgom tshul ni bla ma rin po che'i gcen po rgya ba gser re'i sras su 'khrungs/ sku mched gsum las gcen po slob dpon sgom pa/ bla ma chen pos so brgyad bzhes pa me spre la 'khrungs/ 'bring sgom pa grags shes bya ba yon tan dang ldan pa byon yang snga bar 'das/ chung ba sgo ma chung yin/slob dpon sgom pa lo lnga par bla ma rin mo che dang mjal/ mtshan 'dzam gling 800

grags par btags/ mi g.yo ba yi dam du phog pas zhal gzigs/ bcu gcig la sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/ bcu bdun la mnga' ring/ pa las rab tu byung / cha/tshan tshul khrims snying por gsol/ nyi shu la sha pa gling pa las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ bla ma chen pos man ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang ste bco brgyad par sgom med kyi rtogs pa skyes/ snyags lha byar ma dang sha 'ug stag sgo la sogs par sgrub pa mdzad/ sho sgom 'phags pas nyams kyi 'char lugs go lags sam gsungs pas/ nyams rtogs ngo bo gcig du 'dres/chos kyi sku la 'du 'bral med/ /nyams rtogs can la nga mi smon/ /sogs gsungs pas 'phags pas bshums/ rje sgam po'i zhal nas da 'o skol gyis kho mi thub nyal du 'gro gsungs skad/ dbang zhu phug tu zhwa sna ring gi sna bltab ste mnabs pas slob dpon sgom pa'i zhwa zhes sgom zhar grags pa byung / sgom tshul 'di kun sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' kho bos sad par byas pa tsam yin gsung zhing so lnga pa lcags rta la 'khor rnams skyong bar bskos/ de nas lo gsum na bla ma chen po gshegs pa'i thugs ljags kyi bzhugs khang sgo mang dang mchod khang rnying ma dang sgom sde mdzad/ stod lung du mtshur lha lung btab/ lha sa rba 'bring gi sde 'khrug gis zhig cing stongs pa'i skabs su bla ma rin po che dang jo bo tha mi dad pas khyod kyis da 'jog phod dam gsung zhing gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khorwar du gzigs nas/ sngon chos rgyal nyid kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' shar stor sku 'khrungs pa/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes bu dam pa ni/ /gtsug lag khang chen 'di la phan par 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar sde 'khrug bsdums/ zhig gso rgya cher mdzad de zhang rin po che la gtad/ phya pa dang rong pa phyag sor bas zhabs la btugs/ gtsang nag nga sa/ skal med skye bos ring nas ngan brjod kyang / /mthong dang 'dris pa'i skye bo dad 801

'gyur zhing / /mngon rlom dregs pa brgya dag zi'/ gnon pa/ /bsod nams gzi ldan sku la skyebs su mchi/ /zhes bstod pa byas/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa glang lo la sku'i bkod pa bsdub/ so/ /rnal 'byor chos g.yung gnyis kyi klung shod pa ni grub thob chen por bzhugs la/ 'ol kha chos g.yung ni chos drug gi yon tan mthar phyin/ se mo dor ngang pa la grong 'jug mdzad pas dpal rga lo slob mar 'dus/ rje sgam po ba dang dpon slob thugs rgyud gcig par grags/ tshogs kyi res la lha'i bdud rtsi drangs/ ba ri lo tsā dang pha dam pa 'i mchod gnas mdzad/ zhang rin po che'i bla mar gyur/ go bdun pa sa lug la thegs/ lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub ni tar kha bo dhi rā dza zhes pa rnying ma'i grub thob lo brgya dang bcu gnyis bzhugs pa'i sras tar kha dpal skyed dang yum mkha' 'gro ma zhig gi sras su 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus lag pa dkar po rgyan can zhig gis bu rji byed pa byung / klog ma bslabs par shes/ mdo sngags mtha' dag la sbyangs/ sgom pa zhi mdzes kyis khrid nas sgam por byon/ nyi ma rgas ku'i sbang than 'dra ste rje btsun dang nga'i las 'brel lta bu zhig 'di dang nga la yod gsungs nas mtshams khong du bcug nas gdams ngag thams cad gnang /rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu 'khrungs/ bla mas lung bstan pa ltar phyis bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dang dwags po'i chos bzhi'i 'grel ba sogs mdzad de deng du'ang dar ro/ /'bab rom pa dar ma dbang phyug ni 'phan yul mdar ka ba'i gdung du 'khrungs/ gzhon dus sprul pa'i sngags chung zhig gis sgam por 4khrid de mi snang bar song / chos rje'i chibs kha ba mdzad cing nyin mtshan dbyer med kyi sgyu lus 'byongs/ byang 'bab rom gyi brag la dgon pa mdzad/ phyis ti shri ras pa sogs kyis dar rgyas cher mdzad la bka' rgyud bzang du byon/ da lta'ang ka bzhi drug gis gdan sa re mos su 'dzin pa yod do/ khyad par du ti shri ras pa 802

la phrin las cher byung zhing sgom sde sku 'bum zhes rgya'i gzo khyad can bzhugs la 'di'i slob rgyud sgom sde nang ya gnyis yin no/ /grub thob dbu se ni bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas seng ge shākya'i bstan pa la tshangs par spyod pa ste shar kre shod du 'khrungs/ mchog gi bla ma las rab tu byung / de'i tshe mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis dbu zhwa nag po 'bul ba dang kurma pa'i mtshan gsol bar gziṭa pas phyis dbu zhwa nag po mnabs/ lo nyi shu la dbus su byon te stod lung rgya dmar ba dang phya ba sogs bsten/ gsung rab mtha' dag la sbyangs/ shar ba pa dang dpal rga lo sogs bsten te gdams ngag bod na bzhugs so 'tshal gsan/dgung lo sum bcu bzhes pa chos rjes re gcig bzhes pa na rjeo sgam po pa khu dbon mjal/ gdams ngag thams cad gnang ste sgom chen brgyad brgya'i nang na sgom sran che bar grags/ chos rjes lung bstan ste 'ol kha/ zangs ri/ phag mo gru man dom tshang sogs su bsgoms/ rje btsun mi la'i dngos slob bdun gyi gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs/ chos rjes bu khyod sgrub pa khams kyi kum po gangs rar gyis 'gro don dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab par 'byung zhes gzhan la ma gnang ba skyed rim lhan cig skyes ma dang rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med sogs gnad mtha' dag gnang / jo mo gangs dang gzhu gru bzhi la sogs par sgrub pa mdzad/ chos rje gshegs pa mkhyen nas byon pas nam mkha' la dngos su byon/ dgung lo nga lnga la khams su byon ste kum po gnas nang du sgrub pa rtse gcig du mdzad/ don lnga nas 'bri chu'i rgyud sogs su gzhan don mdzad de brgyad bcu nas mtshur phur dgon pa btab/ sngon dgung lo lnga bcu tsam gyi tshe dpal phag mo gru bas khyed khams su ma 'byon/ 'byon na'ang dbang skur dang rab gnas mang po ma mdzad sku tshe la bar chad byung dogs yod ces byung ba na kho bo dbang bskur yang brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi ma bskur yang brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi 803

yin zhes gsungs pa ltar gya bzhi la rten dang phyag dpe rnams ma 'thor ba gyis gsungs te thegs/ bka' bab kyi bu lnga/ rgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhi/ nye gnas 'od bzhi/ bla ma bzhi/ snga bu bzhi/ phyi bu bzhi sogs mtha' yas par byon zhing sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi chad par byin gyis brlabs te sangs rgyas ras chen la brgyud pa gtad cing khyad par grub thob kurma pag shis hor rgyal pos bstan pa gzhig mi nus par mdzad/ rje rang byung rdo rjes grub thob mtha' yas pa phyung / rje rol pa'i rdo rjes rgya bod hor gsum btul/ rje de bzhin gshegs pas bod rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs/ rje mthong ba don ldan gyis sngags kyi gdul bya rnams btul/ rje bdun pas lung rtogs gnyi ga'i bstan pa slel/ phyi dus spyir bstan pa thams cad dang khyad par bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa nyams te zas gos kyis phongs pa'i mu to pa thams cad kyis bka' rgyud phar kha g.yar te sgab rdum mgo sog re byas nas chang tshul kha thams cad nyul zhing rnam rtog chos sku e yin khyod kyis rkyen e theg zer zhing rtsod rus bsnun pas bsad shi mang du byed cing grag shos rnams kyang blang dor med zer zhing las 'bras khyad du gsod/ rnyed bkur sna re'i ched du mi bya ba dang mi zer ba ci yang med pas bod yul gang ba'i dus su bdag gi bla ma /rma pa brgyad pa'i zhabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rmang nas bsos te chos min rnams nub ci nga nyan thos kyi nges 'byung theg chen gyi sems skyed gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang / khyad par bka' rgyud rin po che'i mar rngog gi rgyud bshade/mi la'i snying rus dang man ngag sgam po pa'i ngo bo'i ga dar/ phag gru pa'i gsang sngags/ 'bri khung pa'i khyad chos rnams kyi dgongs pa gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rten 'brel dang ro stoms/ lo rgod kyi mos gus dang zhen log de thams cad rlung sems dbyer med kyi ngo bor gnyis med du tshang la ma 'dres pa dar 804

bar mdzad de mar mi dwags gsum gyi bka' rgyud thams cad kyi bstan pa rmang nas bsos pa yi/na la rje btsun gyis rje dwags po la dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang ma 'grog spyer yang ri dwags rmas ma'am bya bzhin du zon bag che bar bya/zhi ba/ dul ba/ tse reg chung bar bya/ bzod pa che bar bya/ poms cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin du che bar bya/ rtog pa shin du chung bar bya/ re mtshams dang / smra bcad dang / 'dag sbyar gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya/rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spong ba la bslab/ gsag sbyang gnyis po rang sar dag kyang tshogs chung ngu chung ngu nas gsag las 'bras nam mkha' ltar go yang sdig pa chung ngu nas 'dzem/ mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i nyams yod kyang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun chad med par nyams su blang / bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du go yang chos dang gang zag la skur pa mi gdab/ ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad do/ /rje dus mkhyen gyi nye gnas nam mkha' 'od kyi sku'i skye ba brgyud pa sha grags pa seng ge nas bzung / zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i bka' rgyud dar rgyas su gyur la/ spyir zhwa nag gi cod pan 'dzin pa na rim bcu gcig dang / zhwa dmar gyi cod pan 'dzin pa nyi shu rtsa gcig 'byon par gsungs pa las da lta zhwa nag gi cod pan 'dzin pa dgu pa byon ma thag dang zhwa dmar gyi cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa seng khri la bzhugs pa zhabs brtan par gyur cig rje sgom tshul gyis lo bcu dgu gdan sar bzhugs pa nas/ rje sgom chung / lho la yag pa/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin rnams rje sgam po ba nyid kyi dngos slob dang / de nas rje 'jig rten mgon pos gdan sa'i mi nga ma mdzad par bskyangs/ de nas spyan snga 'bri khung gling pa/ dam chos gling pa/ chos tshul pa rnams 'bri khung pa'i zhal slob dang / de nas sgom pa mched kyi bu chen lha lung pa/ bor gnas pa/ chos dbang ba yin la/ de nas 805

spyan snga jo sras pa nas phyi rus gcig pa'i dbon rgyud kyis gdan sa bskyangs pa ste (redi thams cad phyi mas snga ma la chos gre/san par ma nges so/ /rje sgom tshul gyi slob ma'i gtso bo ne zhang rin po che ste/ 'khrungs yul skyid sho da tsha ba gru gdung sna nam zhang / yab rdo rje sems dpa' yum yag mo mang skyid kyi sras su chu stag la 'khrungs/ mtshan dar ma grags/ chung ngu nas sprul par grags te thams cad kyis byin rlabs zhu/ lo drug pa na yab kyis gzhan la dmyal ba'i sdug sngal bshad pa go ste ci phan dris pas skyabs 'gro dang lha phyag phan zer bas rten gyi drung du kyi bas 'gro dang phyag mdzad/ mas yig brgya bslabs te nang nub nyin gsum du ma chag par bton/ chag pa na rmi lam du bred sdangs byung bas 'chag ma stub/ dgu nas bco brgyad kyi bar la mdo sngags mang du gsan/ lo gsum du 'dre'i mthu bsgrubs/ yab yum grongs pas skyo ste khams su byon/gzhan gyi mthu pa mdzad tshe cis kyang dogs med skyes mthu'i rdzas rnams gtor/ru btsun chung gi bshid kyi dus rab byung mdzad par brtsams bas nged khams pa kun dbus su 'gro ba la dbus pa khams su chos byed pa ga na 'ong zer bla ma dang yon bdag kun gyis gshol yang de srid mi 'chi ba'i gdeng ci yod snyam nas mkhan po rgya ston mkhar mgo ba dang las slob gra ba mkhar ba las lo nyer drug la bsnyen par rdzogs ste mtshan brtson 'grus grags par btags/ dpal chen po rga lo khams su byon pa mjal/ mos gus rtsol med du skyes/ snga phyir gdems ngag thams cad rdzogs/ phugs su bdag rab sgang du mchis la sgom par zhu zhus pas nam phugs sem pa'i sgom chen pa skyug bro gsungs/ gdams pa de rang che bar byung / bsgoms pas nyams myong ji lta bu yang byung / dbus su byon nas 'gar grong brag la bsgoms pas gegs mang du byung nas spos khar byon pas ma mjal yang dad pa skyes/ gegs sel gyi saspu tra gnang bas phan thogs/ phyis 806

mjal ba na dpal chen po'i gdams ngag gis thugs khengs pa mkhyen te gegs sel la bsnyad nas na ro pa'i gdams ngag la btsud/ na za rkyang pa mdzad nas bsgo3 sa te de phyin rlung gi skyon ma byung / bza' btung bzang po rlung bcos dgos pa'ang ngan lang du 'dug gsungs/ rmi lam la rang dbang thob/ rje yer pa ba mjal nas bsams pas sngar dge sbyor byas tshad la tshe 'di'i rtog ngan lo 'dod g.yo sgyu zol zog gzhan gyi phye gtor 'gams pa sogs dang 'dres pa da gdod tshor/ phyin chad zhe dam dang gnyen pos 'bur 'joms byas/ nga la ni tshe 'di'i rtog ngan kho na spang dka' bar byung gsungs/ chos byed na gnad 'di shes dgos par go lam 'bras zha ma'i lugs kyi lha go rar zhugs shing lus la bstim pa mdzad pas rje btsun ma'i skur zhag gsum bzhugs/ rje sgom tshul dang mjal bas bka' rgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi ngo bo yang dag par gzigs pas sngar nas mkhyen pa'i chos thams cad ji lta bar rtogs nas sgro 'dogs kun chod/ spyir dpal hwa lo ye shes mgon po yin nges/ mal yer pa ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin nges/ dngul chu be ro ba he ru ka yin nges/ rje sgom tshul rdo rje 'chang yin nges te yin nges kyi bla ma bzhi/ de'i steng du 'ol kha ba dang gshen pa rdo rje seng ge bsnan pas rtsa ba'i bla ma drug spyir chos thob kyi bla ma so drug yod/ mnal lam bzung nas sum bcu tsa gsum du byon/ o nun du 'byon bzhed pa na ye shes mgon pos phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub phul/gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyis srog snying phul/ rang nyid yi ge hūṃ dmar por gyur pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba nas drangs/ grongs pa yin nam bsam pa yud tsam shar/ lte bar 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad dang sngar 'das pa'i bla ma stong rtsa brgyad sogs dang / ma 'ongs pa gzheng ba'i mchod khang dang / mchod rten bang rim gsum tshar ba'i steng na nyid kyi gdung bzhu ba sogs 807

dang / snying khar 'dzam/ gling bye ba phrag brgya na nyid bye ba phrag brgyas /rdo rje gdan la mchod pa byed pa dang / mgrin par sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa'i dbus na rang nyid rnam snang du sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / spyi bor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gzigs shing 'khor lo bzhir yas rim gyis dbang bzhi thob nas he ru ka'i rnam pas phyir byung nas mtsho skyes rdo rjer mtshan gsol ba dang / yang rnal 'byor mas chos shig gsungs pa las mnal sad nas nam smin gyi lus dag ste sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skur gyur lus gzugs sku dang sems chos skur sangs rgya—sa pa'o/ /gzhan yang gnas bdun du gsang ba'i rnam thar bdun zab chos dang bcas pa bstan zhing spyir de'i dus bod rgyal khrims med pa sil bur song ba'i skabs yin pas thams cad la ri rgya klung rgya lam rgya mdzad/ rgya 'og tu mi 'du ba rnams la dmag g.yul ngo sogs drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pas slob ma rnams la'ang 'khrug gral du phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes pa mang du byung zhing dpon dar ma gzhon nus 'khrug gral du bde mchog zhal mthong / tshal gyi na sbal ljong gis gang ba de la shing ring po'i sna gnyis la thag pa btags/ de nyid kyi mgul la bzhes nas 'drud pa mang du mdzad nas na kha dmar nyog gis song ba na de ring don chen po byung gsungs nas mnyes par mdzad/ spyir ngan song gsum bsgral ba'i zhing du bshad kyang drag po'i 'phrin las mngon sum du mdzad pa rgya gar du birlu ba dang bod du zhang rin po che las ma byung zhes grub thob o nun pas gsungs/ rje sgom tshul gyis lung bstan te me lug la gung thang gi gtsug lag khang lha chen dang bcas pa bzhengs/ bde mchog gi pho brang gzigs sar yang dgon btab/ rdzu 'phrul dang sku'i bkod pa dang phrin las ni mtha' yas/ don gnyis pa chu glang la 'bum mo che rmang bting pa'i bang rim gsum tshar ba na mya ngan las 'das te 808

de'i steng du gdung bzhu zhing rten ngo mtshar can mang du byon no/ /sngon nam mkha' 'od la gdan sa'i bka' gnang ba bcag pas sku tshe thung ba dang / phyi ma nas 'phrin las che bar lung bstan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas ye shes zhes pas yar 'brog stag lung la mkhas grub chen po de khrid gnyer mdzad bzhin pa las zhang rin po che re bdun bzhes tshe gdan sar bskos/ lo nyer gcig bzhugs te sku 'bum chen mo/ gdung rten mthong grol chen mo/ khyams smad/ lcags ri nang ma/ rgya phibs gser phru sogs bzhengs/ de nas lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od kyis lo lnga/ khong gi nye gnas sangs rgyas 'bum gyis lo lnga byas tshe bla tshang dang dpon tshang zhig nas khong zur du bzhugs pa las sgom sde ba byung / slar sangs rgyas snying po lo bdun/ sangs rgyas ras pa lo nyer gsum/ gser khang steng pa lo so gsum sogs rim par byon no/ /zhang rin po che'i bu chen 'od bzhir grags pa las da ma mkha' 'od ni yul gra'i 'jad/ 'dis spang gshong lha ri kha btab cing sangs rgyas lha dge sangs rgyas dpon/ de wa ku ma ra yan du skyes bu dam pa byon/ 'di'i yan lag kong por gyang mtho/ zu ru gdong /gsom kha brag ste dgon skor gsum dang / 'brog yang steng la sogs pa'o/ /lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od ni dol gyi zhur na lung du 'khrungs/ lha phyug mkhar btab/bla ma spyan snga ba/ mkhas pa ston nam/ bla ma ba lam pa sogs gdan sa rim par byung zhing 'di dag gi slob ma snang sgom zhig pos brag rta sgar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa nas mnga' ris glo po men zhang sogs su skyed tshal mtha' yas par 'phel lo/ /rtogs ldan ru thog pas mal 'gro ru thog btab cing de las mched pa'ang du ma byung ngo / kha rag ba 'dul ba 'od ni mtshan dge slong dngos grub bla ma zer/ zhang rigapo ches 'dul ba 'od du btags/ rtogs ldan nyag po seng ger yang grags/ 'khrug pa la sogs pa zhang rin po che'i bka' 809

thams cad bsgrubs/ kha rag tu sgrub pa mthar phyin/ slob ma'i nang na7 /grub rtags che bar grags/ dgon pa mang du btab cing dbon pos gdan sa bzung nas mgon po'i grub thob tu gyur to/ /'drir pa shākya 'od kyis byang du dgon pa btab cing dar rgyas su gyur to/ /yang brag nag pas zhang gi lung bstan ltar ya 'brog tu brag nag btab ste de las lho brag gi bde chen dang zhong kha sogs mched cing 'di las mkhas btsun seng ge rdzong pa mkhar chu nas mkha' spyod la dngos su byon no/ /yar lung pa grags pa seng ges zhang rin po che'i lung bstan bzhin mi nyag gi yul du sgrub pa mdzad de rgyal po'i bla mar gyur nas go ra dgon mo che dang bha ti sogs mi nyag gi yul dang 'phrin las hor yul du'ang dar zhing rgyas la phyis rgyal po se chen gyis tshal pa sgos mi dang gung thang sgos kyi lha khang du byas nas zhabs tog byed cing gtsug lag khang zla med par gyur to/ /ros skam pa lo sgom nyi ma shes rab kyis ros skam du dar rgyas byung / ti shri ras pa yang zhang rin po ches ji ltar byas kyang phyag chen yin gsungs pas ngo 'phrod pas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi dbu skra bcad de rab byung bsnyen rdzoṭa gnang bas phyis ra lung pas dkon gnyer yang lo shas blangs pa yin no/ /zhang rin po che'i bu chen gzhan ni/ lo zhig mar sgom/ ri sgom/ sbra sgom/ gtsang ston blo ldan/ 'ja' sgom byang snying / shangs pa rol pa'i rdo rje sogs dang /'phrin las sgrub pa'i bu chen/ chos skyong gi sprul pa dpon dar ma gzhon nu/ phreng ngo/'i lha btsun dbang seng / bsam yas kyi brtsad po khri seng / bzang yul gyi gnas brtan dge seng / gru gu sgang gi gnas brtan seng ge grags/ sga 'dra'i gnas brtan grub thob dkon mchog seng ge sogs mi chen mang po dang / lha gzo ba dbon phog ro dang mar pa lha dkar shing mkhan phag lha gzo sogs gzo po ri rnam pas 'phrin las sgrub la/ dpon chen dar ma gzhon nu nas nyid kyi sku 810

tshab mugs gnyis kyi bdag por bskos pa'i nye garnas chen mo la rim par 'byas pa las tshal dpon sangs rgyas dngos grub phyin blon po mgar gyi rgyud la 'byags pa'i tshal pa'i dpon chen rnams kyis lo brgya dang bzhi bcur nye bar dbus gtsang gi bdag po dang 'dra ba'i sku dbang gis thams cad la pha ma ltar byams pas bskyangs shing de srid bstan pa dngos gnas la de phyin gzugs brnyan la spyod cing zhang rin po che nyid kyis lo 'di la mes sreg pa'i lung bstan 'dug zer ba ltar bdag gi lo zhe bzhi pa me mo lug lo zla ba bzhi pa'i bco lnga'i mtshan mo mes bsregs pa'i tshul gyis gtsug lag khang gi bkod pa bsdus pa yin la deng sang tshal pa'i chos shes pa mi snang yang bka' rgya bka' 'bum tsam la thams cad mos pa byed par snang ngo / /dwags po'i bka' rgyud las rje sgom tshul gyi bka' rgyud gnyis pa tshal pa'i skabs te phag gru bka' rgyud las gzhan bshad zin to/ /dpal phag mo gru pa ni mdo khams 'bri chu'i rgyad rme shod kyi rtag ngos sab khang du 'khrungs/ gdung dba'as/ yab we na a thar/ yum btsun nee/ yum la gser gyi rdo rje zhig skyes pa'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal ba rmis/ zo zhabs stong pa zhig na mar 'ongs pa snyam byed tsa na 'khrungs te skye ba'i sdug bsngal ma byung zhing de dus yab kyis phag khog khyer byung ba gzigs/gnas pa rang 'khrungs su byung / skye ba mang du dran pa pha mas rme sha byin pas brjed/ yab yum grongs pas gcung po shul du bzhag ste bya khyi lha khang du mkhan po lding nge tshul khrims 'bar dang slob dpon lding nge 'od zer rgyal las lo dgu la rab tu byung / mtshan rdo rje rgyal por btags/ bris klog lha bris rang byung du mkhyen nas mkhan po'i dpon yig gi sdebs dang lha bris mdzad/ gnas bzhi'i dbus na tha ba'i rdo khrod chen po zhig yod pa shing rtas ma 'drongs pa sku shed che bas sku rgyab la bsnams kyin por/ bla ma rgya la chang mi gsol ba'i dam 811

bca' mdzad/ dbu ri rgyal 'bar la chos gsan zhing de gtso bo'i rnam/par snang rung sa bcu pa bar 'dug gsung / slob dpon dgu'i chos rdzogs/ spyir khams su bla ma bcu drug bzhugs/ spyod 'jug sogs gzhan la yang bshad/kho/ nyer gnyis la dbangs chen po dang bsdongs nas bong du byon/ yo byad thams cad khong gis sbyar/ sog tu dbus kyi phyogs nag po ra ri zhig gis gang 'dug pa mi g.yo ba'i ral gris bcad par gzigs/ thog mar stod lung rgya ngamar gyi gra sar rta sga phog rgya dmar ba dang nyang bran la dbu tshad byams chos dang spyod phyogs gsan/ yang gad pa/ don steng pa/ bya yul pa sogs la bka' gdams gsan/ nyer lnga la zul phur mkhan po bya 'dul/ las slob rgya dmar ba/ar gyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba mtha' dag gsan/gra sa rnams su'ang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor chag ma myong / dmar chos kyi rgyal po la bde mchog gi rgyud man ngag gsan/ dba'as chen po yul du bzhud tshe phyag dpe sogs bskur nas phyir bzhugs/ 'jang brag stag pa dang rngog mu ne la 'phags skor dang ca4ngon pa zhus/ bur sgom la ras chung pa'i skor zhus pas snang ba bde bar shar/ stod lung na sangs rgyas smyal chung bya ba dngos rig gi rnal 'byor pa zhig la gdamarnga/ pa mang du zhus shing dge bshes khams pa khyed kyi phyi la mkha' 'gro ma gser rgyan can bzhi 'brang gi 'dug ngam shod ri nag gi drung du 'gro ba'i don yod gsungs/ 'jim lo tsā ba sogs gzhan yang mang du bsten/khyad par rje sa skya pa chen po la rgyud dang lam 'bras la sogs rdzogs par gsan te mthong lam par ngo sprad/ chos mang po tshur dri zhing khams pa shes rab can zhes mnyes/ mdor na gzhung man ngag la mi mkhyen bya ba med/ khams pa yar 'du ba zhig la chos tshang pa'i grags pa byung / dge bshes zhang sum thog pa mi chen po des chos zhus/ mchod gnas su khur yang re zhig bka' rgya btab ste 812

slob ma'i tshul mdzad/ dwags po snyi sgom de grags pa che bar 'dug pas zhal zhig lta/ chos mi shes pa zhu rgyu med/ de nas khams la 'gro dgongs te zhang dang gnyica/ sngaca/ por byon/ sku rim du mchod rten zhig rtsig 'dug pa'i la4ka rem pa'i thog chod/ zhag bzhi na mjal/ ja bzhur grang mo zhig drangs byung bas thang chad pa la ja grang mo 'di phan snyam pa cig byung / yang mang ja'i tshwa gzigs 'bul 'dug pa hub gang bzhes nas rkyan du blug song bas gsol ras kyis thams cad la khyab par 'dug snyam pa'i dad pa skyes/ zhang la ma dag pa'i rnam rtog re re byung / phyi nyin drung du mjal ba na phyag na zan zhig changs changs mdzad cing / dge bshes khams pa khyod kyis chos ci shes gsungs/ 'di ltar thos zhus pas thos pa de tsam la nga rgyal rgyu ci yod/ 'phags pa klu sgrab kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong mkhyen yang khengs pa rdul tsam mi madro'/khyod kyis lo du bsgoms gsungs/ lo bdun bsgoms zhus pas/ sgom yun de tsam la nga rgyal rgyu ci yod/ kho bos lo bzhi bcu bsgoms pa yin/ nyams myong 'dra ci skyes gsungs/ mthong lam skyes tshul zhus pas de la mthong lam du 'dzin nam gsungs/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang las bshad tshul zhus nas mthong lam yin zhus pas/ a kyang de la mthong lam du 'dzin nam gsung / bla mas kyang mthong lam du ngo sprad cis kyang yin zhus pas/ a pa zhe nas rang de la mthong lam da 'dzin nam gsung / mdo rgyud nyams myong thams cad kyis grub pa'i mthong lazlo yin zhus pas/ khyed kyi mthong lam bzang po de las nga'i zan changs 'di mi dga' re gsungs pas sngar gyi bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams bzang po de hral gyis zhig nas shes pa'i ngo bo de sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa ltar yer byurje ba na 'o mthong lam bya ba de 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin gsungs / de las lhag nga/ zhig bstan du med kyang kho bo rang gi lugs bya'o gsungs nas lhan cib/ skye sa sbyo ra gnang / 'di la phyis kyang kho bo'ang chos rmi nga chen ngo/ zhib/ gis de'u bslus/813

zhes dang / bla ma rin po che dang ma mjal na kho bo'i mi tshe 'di don med du de'u song / zhes dang / bla ma rin po che dang ma mjal gyi bar du stong nyid sgom shes pa su yang ma byung zhes gsung ba yin la rjes kyang 'o skol dpon slob gnyis sa bcu'i byang sems yin kyang khyod kho bo dang ma phrad na don 'grub par gda'am zheca/ gsungs pa yin no/ /mthong bya dang mthong mkhan la sogs pa/ dmigs gtad kyi gnyid las ma sangs par/ /mngon sum gyi mthong lam re ba tsho chab rom la shel du zhen pa 'dra/ /dus rtag tu yod pa'i sems nyid kyi/ /rang zhal rang nyid la mngon sum ston/ /mthong ma mthong gi 'dzin pa gzhig mdzad pa/ /bka' rgyun 'di bsams kyin ngo mtshar che/ /bar skabs kyi —tshigs bcad do/ /de nas nga'i bla ma de tsho'ang bla ma 'di dang mjal na bsams te bdag dpe cha len du 'gro bar zhu zhus pas bsdad na khebs che ste gsungs/bla ma rnams khyed dwags po snyi sgom can du phyin ang zer ba tsam dang 'o skol las lhag pa'i man ngag cang yod dam zer ba las mi 'dug pas phyag dpe blangs te byon/ khams la 'byon pa'i spros pa'ang chod/ dbyangs rta dang bstod pa ma byas pa zhig gyis gsung bas mnyam med dam pa mdzad/ da ni gtsang gi gnas gzhi zhig la 'jug yon btsal te phul nas sgrub pa byed dgos bsams pa na nang bar snga bar shog gsungs te phyag 'tshal zhing yod tsa na zhal 'dzum mdzad nas dge bshes khams pa 'tsho ba'i sems khral ni mi 'tshal/ khyod kyi gdul bya ngam shod ri nag gi drung na yod gsungs/ de ltar rje sgam po pa don gsum bzhes shing nyid zhe gcig bzhes pa lcags mo lug la mjal nas lo ngo gsum bsten te don lnga chu bya la chos rje mya ngan las 'das/ gshegs kur nga dang dge bshes khams pa la khyad rta rnga tsam yang med pas thams cad kyis 'dud gsungs nas chos zhus/ dus kyi rgyal po bya lo shar ba'i tshe/ /zhes pa'i gdung dbyangs kyang mdzad/ sa'i bkrag nyams sdod mi 'dod par gyur kyang 'jig rten pa khrel yod 814

kun kyang / dbyar dgun re mya ngan byed pas kho bo'ang slo ba dpon sgochu/ pa'i sdug grogs byed pa yin gsungs nas 'tsho ba bkren pa las med kyang bzhugs te slob dpon sgom pa'i zhabs tog mdzad/ zhe bzhi la 'ol khar byon na hrul bas bsod stoms mdzad gsungs nas ldom lugs kyi mgur mdzad de nye gnas shan grong pas na bza' sku gang brjes/ dam shod bya ra byi/ yar lungs/ 'on tshan sgang / spang chung dgon pa sogs su bzhugs/ slob ma'ang mang du 'dus ste rje dwags po'i lugs bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kho nas bskyangs shing 'dul ba la gtso bor mdzad/ bla ma sa skya pa sngon nas nga la chos 'dri zhing mnyes pa la da kho bo chos thams cad nam mkha' la mdung bskor ba ltar song ba 'di la bla ma'i lan tshul bzhin gdab dgos snyam nas 'bul ba rnams skyel pa dang sgres pa 'ga' dbang bskur zhu 'dod dang bcas byon/ rtsis kyi lha khang du zhag gsum bzhugs pas dam pa rgya gar dang mjal te zhi byed mnal lam ma sogs mang du gsan/ da res chos kyang mi 'dri/ spyan rtsa'ang 'gyur 'dug ste 'grongs ltas ma lags sam gsungs te myur du grongs/ 'on du thugs zo ma sod nas da ni ri khrod kyi dgon pa zhig 'dzin dgongs/ gra pa rnams la kho bo phyed lam tsam du 'gro bas kho bo'i rjes la su yang ma yong zhig dbyar bzhugs thon nas so sor yul la byon zhig kho bo mtshams byed pas nang bar yang su yang ma yong zhig gsungs/ de nub dpon slob bzhis bros te byon/ mthar rtsa'i grong mdar grong 'di la phag mo dang gru 'di la phag mo gru zer zer bas yi dam phag mo bzhugs shing sems can 'khor ba'i chu las sgrol bar dgongs te lung bstan gyi gnas de yin par mkhyen/ 'di'i phur bsdad chog gam dris pas chog yong ste tsha rong btsad po la 'dri dgos zer bas 'drir byon pa na kho rang mig mang rtse zhing 'dug khyed kyi lung pa ya gir dgon pa zhig btab chog gam lan gnyis gsungs pas thob thob zer/ yang gsungs pas brgya dgos na stong thob 815

zer bas dar ba'i rten /'brel 'grig ste zhe dgu pa sa pho stag la phag gru bzung /de nas lo bdun 'das nga shing bya la stag lung thang pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'gro ba zhig gis mjal te nye gnas mdzad/ gra pa rnams kyang rim pas byung / rgya sgom rmi ras bya ba'i 'jag lcil du tsha ba la gdan drangs pas khyod kyi lcil po 'di skyid lan gsum gsungs pas mnyes na 'bul zer ba la 'o na nga'i kom stan da lta long shog gsungs te gzims lcil mdzad/ sngon byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis khyod kyis zla stod la mtshams gyis zla smad la khrid gyis rkang bzhi'i 'bul ba ma len dbang bskur ma byed/ de ltar byas na tshe ring zhing 'gro ba mang po la phan par /3gyur zhes lung bstan pa dang / bla ma lha rje'i rnam par thar pa yang de nyid yin pas slob ma bya ba bla ma'i rnam thar 'dzin pa la zer ba yin/ kho bo'ang bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin byed pa yin gsungs nas de bzhin mdzad do/ /bla ma mgol phu ba dang 'gro mgon smar pa sogs ni gzhan bla ma mang du bsten/ chos gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs/ nyams myong gis thugs khengs pa re rje de'i drung du byon/ mgol phu ba phyag 'tshal zhing yod tshe/ smra bsam brjod med sogs nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum yang de nyid yin/ /zhes gsungasu pas rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa na 'o de las lhag pa med kyis de nyid kyi rtsal sbyongs shig gsungs/ 'gro mgon smar pa zhag 'ga' khams ma bde ba las sos nas mjal du phyin pas/ phyag ma 'tshal bar skyil krung chos la bzhugs shig gsungs/ chos ci'ang mi gsung / khams kyi dri rmed mdzad/ nga gang du bzhugs sar lus gnad chos la bzhugs/ shes pa la ci byung yang su la'ang ma zlo zhig gsungs/de ltar byas pas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ 'o bka' rgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor 'das kyi 'brel thag chod/ khyod kyis dbu ma'i don yang gzod go ba yin/ bdag pos ma tshor bar sgom 'debs pa gzhan gyis mi shes 816

gsangs/ 'gro mgon yel pa ba thugs dam dpyica/ phyin pa zhig gis bar phu ba la do ha zhus nga/sa bshad rkyang du 'dug pa dgongs te/ nyid la phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung gi sgom chen snang ba la nga'i bla ma rin po che dang mjal na nyams rtogs kyang skye bas 'byon par zhu byas pas lta'o gsungs te byon/ thugs rgyal gyis yon tan ma skyes/ yang phyis bskul te byon/ bu ram padma'i bar la btab pa'i tsa go ra drangs pas khong chags te ma gsol/ yel pa bas bcag ste da gsol bar zhu byas nas gsol zhing yod tshe/ zhal nas phar phyin/ dbu ma/gsang sngags/ phyag rgya chen po thams cad sgom dgos pa kho na yin pas sgoms shig gsungs pa na sgom lugs ci yang ma bstan par sgoms shig gsung ba ci yin snyam tshe sgom bya sgom byed kyi 'dzin pa zhig ste gnas lugs mngon du gyur nas bzhengs te khyod ni mthong dang thos dang dran pas kyang / /ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs la mi stos par/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'char ba yi/ /bla ma byin rlabs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag mdzad/ gzhan yang rlangs seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zhal mthong ba tsam gyis sgom skyes/ de la sogs pa mtshan la mos pa tsam dang / zhal mjal ba tsam dang / brda dang rnam 'gyur bstan pa tsam dang / byin rlabs gnang ba tsam gyi grol ba mang du byung ngo / /gra pa sum brgya tsam tshogs pa na kho bos chos bstan na khyed rnams la phan yang tshe thung bar 'ong / mtshams 'ba' zhig byas khyed rnams dang rme phrad na tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa rgya gar gyi grub chen las lhag par 'ong bas gdam kha gyis zhes gsungs pas dge bshes rlangs sogs rgan pa rnams kyis 'gro don mdzad par zhus/ mi nyag sgom ring sogs rnams kyis sgrub pa mdzad par zhus/ der sgrub pa mdzad pa na dge bshes zhang byon te zhu phod mdzad pas tshogs pa bskyangs/ ci dgos kyang rten 'brel 'ba' zhig gis mdzad/ sku 'da' ba'i lo la tshogs pa brgyad 817

brgya tsam 'dus shing thams cad yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa sha stag tu byung /phag mo grur byon nas grong du 'byon ma myong / sngon dbang bskur gsan dus tshogs kyi sha chang ma gsol bas da gsol na bla ma de kun gyi dbu skor bar 'gro gsungs nas sha chang lta ci smos te yang dgon du tshil bu'i sdor 'debs ma myong /sku 'da' khar yang sman rta'i sings po tsam yang ma gnang / mdor na skal ldan mtha' yas pa tshegs chung ngus grol bar mdzad cing phag mo grur lo bcu gsum bzhugs nas lcags pho stag gi lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer snga'i snga dro mya ngan las 'das te ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung ngo / /skyes rabs kyang dge slong chos kyi dpal du gyur pa sogs skyes rabs chen mor gsungs pa ltar te thun mong gi gdul bya'i snang ba so skye ltar bstan pa'o/ /skal pa mchog gi gdul bya la rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi bar pa dang / yang pañtsa pa nas gsang ba bkrol/ sogs sku'i bkod pa brgyad dang / srong btsan sgam po sogs rgyal po'i sku'i bkod pa bzhi dang / ga ya dhar la sogs pa sku'i bkod pa bzhi la sogs gsang ba'i mdzod sgo dbye ba las bstan pa ltar dang / sku 'di nyid kyis dus gcig la o rgyan nas bde mchog gi rgyud man ngag len pa dang / 'di la ston pa'i bdag nyid me yi rlung / /zhes pa tsaskra sam bha rar bshad kyang dza yig dgos pas dzā la the bha ra dra ba sdom pa zhes pa 'byor bar snang / nye ba'i zhing tsā gong du mkha' 'gro btul nas nad yatshe/sa bcad pa dang / rgya gar gyi mun pa mi bzad pa'i dur khrod du rnal 'byor pa gti mug rdo rje mchog sgrub pa'i tshogs gral du byon pa dang /rgya gar lho phyogs su mu stegs kyi rgyal po shrī nag po btul pa dang / dzaspu'i gling gi shar lho gling phran zhig tu dge slong blo gros rgyal por bstan pa dang / gling de nyid kyi nub phyogs su sngon skye ba du ma'i gong gi ma zhig ngan 'gror lhung bar 'dug pa las drangs pa dang / byang stag lung gi sa'i mi ma yin thams cad btul 818

te sa chu thams cad byin gyis brlabs ba dang / rgya nag gi rgyal po za ma ho sdig pa las ldog ba 'i phyir nad bsal ba dang / dur khrod ha ha rgod par 'byung po rengs byed btul ba dang / khams kyi lhor zing a bstan rgya'o 'drer skyes pa btul ba dang / phag mo gru nyid na bzhugs pa ste bcu gnyis cig char bstan pa ni dbang po 'bring la grub thob chen por bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /'aḥdas pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang da ltar ston pa nyid dang ma 'ongs pa'i mi skyod sman pa'i rgyal por zhal gyis bzhes pa ni gdul bya yang rab la sangs rgyas nyid du bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /de'i slob ma la spyir tshogs pa brgyad brgya la gdugs thogs lnga brgyar grags shing khyad par du bu chen nyer bzhi la/mos gus mthar thug stag lung pa/ rtogs pa'i mthar thug sna phu pa/ shes rab mthar thug par phu pa/ nus pa'i mthar thug mchan bu rgya ras te mthar thug gi bu bzhi/ skal ldan ye shes seng ge mi nyag sgom ring / nyag re se bo/ kun ldan ras chung ste gdams pa'i bu bzhi/ 'jig rten mgon po/ chos rje ldum/chos rje gtum/ bandhe phug pa dang ro gcig rtogs pa phyed dang bzhi ste gtum la gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs pas phyed mar 'jog go gshen dgon dkar ba/ myang shan grong pa/ rdog seng ge kha ba/ rtsi 'u nga pa rnams la thugs kyi sras bzhi zer/ rin po che shug tshar ba/ lha sa pa dag 'dun skyabs/ gru gu blo gros seng ge rgyan thang pa ste yi ge ma'i bu bzhi/ bla ma smar pa/ yal phug pa/dgyer sgom pa/ seng ge dpal te nye ba'i sras bzhi zhes snga rabs rnams 'dren la/ bar phu ba ni sngon rten 'brel gyis rtogs pa skyed cing stod lung phur par bu dgon pa mdzad nas do ha'i 'phrin las shin tu che/ mchan bu rgya ras ni mgon po'i grub pa thob/ mi nyag sgom ring ni kho'i drung du ral gri zhig bzhag kho'i pha gsod mi de khrid nas byon pas kho zhe sdang skyes ste ral gri khyer nas ded pas khyod 819

rang gi zhe sdang la ltos gsungs pas ngo bo mthong ste de 'dag sbyar yun ring du byas nas bskyangs/ phyis 'gro mgon gyi slob ma gsar pa rnams la sgom lugs slob cing nyams lta mdzad/ 'gro mgon gshegs nas 'bri khung bzung ste khyed rnams bla ma ngan du mi 'gro gsung ngo / /nyag re se bos dom la chibs shing klu mi mgon dkar po rol du khrid nas 'byon/ gam po rdo rje dpal brtsegs btul/ khams su sne dgon btab bo/ /gshen dgon dkar ba rdo rje dbang phyug ni zhang rin po che'i bla ma gshen pa yin par deb sngon pa sogs 'chad kyang zhang gi bla ma de ni gshen pa rdo rje seng ge yin no/ /nyang shan grong pa ni zhabs tog shin tu che/ 'khrungs yul du sgrub pa mdzad/ mkha' spyod du byon par grags/ rngog seng ge kha ba ni ljang seng ge kha 'debs mkhan yin/ phyis 'khrungs yul du bzhugs/ 'di'i slob ma dpal chen chos yes yin/ rtsi lung pa ni rje 'jig rten mgon po'i las slob mdzad/ 'on dang dol gyi rtsi lung btab/rgyan thang pa ni sprul pa'i bya rog gis gtor sgod bzhag sar g.ye rgyan thang gi dgon pa btab/ rje 'jig rten mgon po'i bstan bcos glang po che'i bems kyang de na bzhugs par grags/ gzhan yang mched grogs las slob mar gyur pa'i mi chen phyis rje 'jig rten mgon po'i mkhan po mdzad pa zhang sum thog pa dang /—sangs rgyas gnyan ras zhes bya ba ma yul dang lo ror mgon pa mdzad de mi rabs 'ga' yar du sgrub rgyud bzang du byung ba la sogs pa ni ches mang ngo /gdung gi thugs mes ma gnod pa gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar du bzhugs shing / 'jag lcil du sku gdung gi zhabs rjes dus bzang la 'khor pa la las mthong la las mi mthong ba zhig byung / gdung thal dang dri 'dam la sku 'dra rin po che bzhes pa la tshon gang yang ma bzhes pas bzo po rnams skyo zhing dro la song ba'i bar du ra rji bu mo skugs ma zhig 'dug pa des tshon thams cad bsres nas 820

bzhag 'dug pa de ka byugs pas bzhes te sku mdog smug nag 'di byung bas zhal bzhugs dus kyi sku rnams sku mdog dkar bar snang yang 'di bsnyung dus kyi sku mngog yin par snang zhing / 'di'i 'dam dras ro las ru ma byas te bshengs pa la dras ma dang / chos khri steng du'ang de ltar bzhengs pas bud med cig ga nas 'ongs cha med par byung nas nga'i bla ma rin po che 'di rang 'dra/ 'di ka la zhog zer ba bzhag pa slob ma mang po la chos gsungs pa de'i sku'i sta zur nas byi bas brus pas stos cig zhes gsung byon pa de'i sa la rum byas nas bzhengs pa la byi sa ma thes grags pa yin no/ /li dkar dmar sogs rgyu sna tshogs 'dres pa la gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje blug pas yab li dkar dang yum li dmar shangs rtse 'brel ba zhig byon/ phyis 'bri gdan bye ba'i dus shangs rtse 'brel ba de chad/ rje 'jig rten mgon po nga drug bzhes pa'i sa rta la 'bri khung pas mang mkhar sgang du bzhengs pa na rdo rje gdan tshun 'du gsung yang stag lung pas nga'i bla ma'i sku rjen par mi 'jog zhes 'jag lcil mchod khang gis btums pa mdzad/ brag brkos chen mo sogs mdzad de mchod khang chen mo skor khang bcas pa mdzad/ bka' rgyud tshugs pa'i bu chen gyi gtso bo brgyad las bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa skyu ra rin po che ni mdo khams 'bri klung dam pa chos phyug gi yul tsar stod g.yon lung gi grong tsu dur 'dru rgyal skyu ra'i gdung 'dzin par mdzad do/ /de yang sngon rgyal po glang dar gyi dus tsam na skyu ra'i sngags 'chang chen po cig la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo sna nam bza' chos kyi da bang phyug blangs pa la nga la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bu bzhi 'ong zer zhing sha gzug gcig drangs pas phag nas gri grug dang thod pa phyung ste sha'i gsum cha gcig thod par gtor ma ༅sa nas/ cha gcig rang gis zos/ cha gcig khol mo la byin skad/ gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur zhing ri rab khang khyim la thongang/sa 821

me da du rgyu zhing dus min du 'gro 'ong byed/ nga mthar sku lus 'dis bka' srung kun gyi gco mor gyur te rgyud 'dzin rnams kyis mtshan nas bos pa tsam gyis dgra kha phung du 'gro ba deng sang yang 'bri khung a phyi zhes grags pa de'i sras nam ma/ba' dbang phyub gi rgyud pa a mes dbang rgyal bya ba nus pa can de'i sras bzhi pa mdo sngags la mkhas pa 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje/ yum btsun ma zhes bya ba bud med bu dang bral ba la bu yid la ma byed dang sdug bsngal mi skye'i zhes ston pa cig gi sras su chu mo phag lo la 'khrungs/ lhums su 'jug pa nas ltam pa'i skabs kun tu rdo rje mchu'i po ti dkar po 'od kyi rnam par yum gyis gzigs/ sku gces pas bon po la gtad de des mtshan dbal ba thar dang phyis rang gis btsun pa skyabs su mtshan spos/ dgung lo drug nas klog mkhas par mkhyen te za yon gyis mi ngas kyis nyen pa'i skye bo mang po bskyabs shing da lta'ang 'bri khung thel ba'i klog ces klog chod che zhing skyon chung ba/ sa sgra ra sgra sogs thon pa 'phul rten sogs la'ang mchu sbyor tha dad thon pa yod do/ /slob dpon lnga drug tsam yod/ chos mang du gsan/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/mnal lam du'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po byang / mdo rgyud las gsungs pa'i las tshogs rnams grub/ chos mkhas pa dang nad sel ba dang mthu che ba sogs nus pa che ba'i grags pa thob/ 'on kyang dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pas thugs phrogs te dam can rdor legs kyis 'phrin las bsgrubs te byon/ chas pa'i nyin khams nas dbus kyi bar 'ja' sa 'brel/ bla ma de'i drung na gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya yod kyang thugs kyi sras nga rang yin snyam du ngam ngam pa byung / mnal lam du rje phag mo gru pa spyan ras gzigs su mjal/ sbal lo tsā ba la dbas rdo rje rgyal po sku khams bzang ngam byas pas kho khros te rdo phyar byung / gcig na re khams pa phag mo grur 'gro bar 'dug zer bas 'o na song zheg bla ma rin po 822 4

che sku la/ mas bzang ngo zer/ khong ni ma gadhar lo bcu gnyis bsdad pa cig phag mo grur gzims lcil la skor ba bdun byas pas thugs dam 'khrungs pa yin par snang / de nas dgung lo nyer lnga ba me phag gi mjug la phag mo grur mjal/ja dang dar zab dang rta kun phul bas kho bo rkang bzhi'i 'bul ba mi le na pa yin zhes rta ma bzhes/ ja de la phyag bcug mnams nas bzang po cig 'dug thon par skol/ 'di 'di rnams bos gsungs te dbu che brgyad bcu tsam tshogs pa la drangs/ rje nyid kyis yang yang bzhes pas sku gzi mdangs dang ldan par gyur/ bla ma 'di lta bu rnyed pa nga re tshogs bsags snyam pa na/ khyod da nga rang la re che bar 'dug ste ngas khyed rnams kyi don du dka' ba dpag me/da spyad pa yin gsungs/ sngar rtogs ldan thod pa bor chog yin yang srid mi len/ 'on kyang da dung kho bo'i slob ma ma tshang gsung zhing nga'i rgyud pa 'di ni dge bsnyen sa bcu pa cig gis 'dzin gsung ba la chos rje nyid phebs phyin chad da ni nga'i 'khor tshang gsung zhing rtogs ldan skye ba'i 'khor lo skor bya ba sogs gsungs pas snga ma kha cig ma mos skad/ lan cig rje bzhengs nas lus gnad bcos/mdun du yi ge gsum gsung chen po cig mdzad nas khyod la sgom chen bzang po zhig 'ong / sgom chen tsam la bzang ba zhig 'ong / de la kho bo dga' ba lags mod gsungs/ dag snang la ltem rkyang byung bas ser phyag gi zhe dam mdzad pas sor chud/ mos gus la ltem rkyang byung ba zhus pas de phyin chad ltem rkyang ma byung /sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du chos lnga po 'di dang ma bral bar gyis/ rtogs pa 'dis chog snyam na da dung mang du gor yod pa yin gsungs/ chos bsgugs kyi sar yang yan lag bdun pa kho na phul/ phyag rten sna re med par mjal ma myong /byang chub sems sdom gnang nas khyod kyi ming ni byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal lo gsungs/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ji ltar 'char zhus pas 823

de khyod rang gis shes nas 'ong lan gsum gsungs/ gshegs gar bla ma'i thuṭa ka nas gser gyi rdo rje byung ste rje 'di'i thugs gar thim pa der yod kun gyis mthong / lcil po'i rdo yan chod sku 'bum gyi phyogs su btang / phyi sa g.ye chung du bla ma yal gyis zhabs tog byas te sgrub pa mdzad pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad shar/ rlung dbu mar chud/ chos zab mo 'di rnams bla mas sngon nas gsungs 'dug pa snyam nas mos gus khyad par can skyes/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs/ slar yang lo gnyis sgrub pa mdzad pa na bsnyung 'dze drag po thog babasasu byung bas rkyen byas te snying rje blo rdeg tu 'khrungs pas klu chen po de yang sku lus las bud par gzigs pas bsnyung gzhi skad cig gis grol/ rtogs pa mthar phyin te sangs rgyas thams cad dang dgongs pa mnyam pa nyid du gyur/ tsho'on kyang gzhan gyi ngor/ zhag phyed dang bzhi yi nang par la/ /mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag /zhes gsungs/ sngon bla ma rin po ches kyang khyod rab tu byung gsungs pa la/ rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba brgyad khal dang 'dra ba'i steng du bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba spong ba gong tsha lta bu mi theg dgongs nas ma blangs/phyis g.ye chung du bcas rang ngo bo gcig pa dang bkag ba ye bkag gnang ba spu gnang dang chos kyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa dang nyams pa las ma blangs pa nyes pa lci ba sogs kyi gnad dgongs pas rab tu mi 'byung ka med du 'dug par mkhyen nas dgung lo so lnga pa me mo bya lo la zhang gis mkhan po dang / rtsi lung pas slob dpon/ smyal ba 'dul 'dzin gyis gsangs ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ smyal 'dul la 'dul ba gsan/ dpal chen birlu pa dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhig dge slong du phebs pa 'di pho rgod yin gsungs/bla ma ldum sku lu sa gum pa dmigs pas zhag gsum la bsal/ mkhan po la 824

bsnyung 'dze thog babs su byung ba zhag bco lngas bsal/ gzhan yang byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis nad zhi ba dang / nus pa phul du byung bas skye bo dag blor ma chud de rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa gleng ba na rje phag mo gru pa'i slob ma tsā ri ba bya ba grub thob tu grags pa zhig na re ngas lta zer skad/ khong gis mjal bas dad pa thob ste de grub thob rtsod med du 'dug nged gnyis bla ma mi gcig par 'dug nga'i bla ma dge bshes khams pa yin par 'dug khong gi bla ma sangs rgyas yin par 'dug zer skad de mdo las kyang sangs rgyas la dag sa pa rnams kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos kyi dbyings thams cad par mthong ba dang /theg chen gyi 'phags pas rtag pa'i skur mthong ba dang / so skyes mya ngan las 'da' bar mthong ba rnams mos pa'i khyad par yin la rang nyid rgyud tshod mthor song nas mos gus gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin no/ /der gdan sar phebs pas stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyis 'dze 'ur 'ded mdzad pa'i bla ma gral dbu la bzhugs zhes gtam btang pas 'dze 'ur 'ded par mtshan grags/ gdan sar lo ngo gsum bzhugs la khong rnams rtsing spyod byas pas mi bzhugs bar dgongs/ rje gong mas za 'og gi 'bol rnying pa 'di khong rang tsho la gtod la khyod rang byang pha gir song gsung ba gzigs te gzhi ba tsho la gdan sa 'phrod yod do gsungs nas byon/ 'bri khung gi gzhi bdag bar lhas bon po'i gzugs kyis bsus/ sha ba dang bya rgod la sgom btab/ lam du gsang phur rtsegs dbang phyug seng ge dang gtsang pa 'jam dpal seng ge sogs la gdams pa gsungs/ mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyis bsus nas dgung lo so brgyad pa lcags pho byi ba la 'bri gung du byon/ skal ldan gyi slob ma mang du 'dus shing byang du byon pas gnyan chen po thang lhas gsu ba byas/ nyi ma gtod la mnan/mkhan po kol ti pas sems skyed gsal ma btab pa dang gso sbyong la 'tshog 825

dka' ba na phyis mi mdzad par dgongs pas tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gso sbyong dang rab byung gnang bar gsol ba btab/ ngam shod du byon/ thugs rjes 'khrug pa yun ring du zhi/ dwags por byon te mu ge yod pa phebs ma thag nas zhi ste bka' drin tshad med par gyur/ dgung lo drug bcu'i dus rten 'brel mdzad pas sku tshe'i bar chad zhi/ dmu chu'i bsnyun 'phrul 'khor gyis dwangs/phyis ngam shod pa'i rabs chad cig gi yo byad dang gsung rab gdan sar phul ba la brten lung pa'i mi thams cad kyis gdan sa bshig par thag chod tshe slob ma'i bde legs bla ma la rten 'brel sgrig dgos par dgongs/ gsung rab des gtso byas phag gru'i gsung rab kun sgam por phul bas rtsod pa'ang rang zhi/ phyis phag gru dar ba'i rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig pas rje nyid kyi 'phrin las 'di che zhing bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par byas pa la de tsam zhig grub gsung zhing 'di ni na ro ba'i dka' ba bcu gnyis las lhag ces gsungs la/gzhan kun gyis skur pa btab/ phyis bla ma'i gdan sa ngas brgya 'gyur du btang ngo gsungs nas rje spyan snga bskos pa yirna no/ /gnas chen dang ri phran kun gyi gzhi bdag gis mchod gnas zhus te thams cad la ri pa gnang / lha mo lo tog 'byor ma la sogs 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs nas gsungs pa'i lo tog gi lha mos 'brus gang ba'i bre bo 'bul du byung ba sogs byung ste nas ches mod pas skyi shod pa rnams 'bri khung nas nas sgrub pa byung / gnyos kyi bur ston la lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya tshogs pa dang / dge slong 'bum phrag lhag pas tshul shing len pa byung / bla yel rtsig pa'i tshe las ches thun ches so zhes nags shod mkhan pos 'bar bas rtsig pa rnams mgon po beng gis bshig tsā ri'i dag pa shrī'i bkod pa'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang rta rnga'i dra bar bcug ste mkha' 'gros gzigs phul/ siṅga gling nas dgra bcom pas mgon po klu sgrub yin 826

zhes me tog padma dkar po'i mchod pa phul/ gzhan yang sku'i bkod pas 'dzam gling gi rgyal po chen po bcu gsum btul/ rdo rje gdan la gar log gi dmag zlog stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med bstan pas bstan pa nyi ma shadza ba ltar mdzad/ rig spyod khyad par du 'phags pa tshul khrims rin po che yin zhes ston zhing sha chang gi tshogs 'khor yang mi mdzad/ sku gshegs gar yang glo ba skam po zhig gsol thug la 'debs par zhus pa'ang ma gnang / dpal phag mo gru pa la skyob pa rin po che zhes dang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'ba' zhig tu gsung bas slob ma rnams kyis kyang rje nyid la mtshan de ltar du 'don/ thugs kyi dgongs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas dgung lo don lnga pa mngon par byang chub pa'i zla ba'i nyer lnga la mya ngan las 'das/ spyan snga ba rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas slar bzhengs te zhag gnyis bzhugs/ gsol ba btab pa bzhin tshogs su zhal bstan zhing chos gsungs/ bzhugs par zhus pas kho bo'i gdul bya rdzogs gsungs/ dus mchod gang la 'dzin zhus pas mchod pa bla ma la 'bul bas nyer lnga la zung zhig gsungs te mya ngan las 'das/ ngo mtshar ni mtha' yas pa byung ngo / /slob ma'ang spyan snga dbon rin po che/ rje spyan snga ba/ spyan snga 'bri khung gling pa/ spyan snga dam chos gling pa sogs thugs kyi sras rnams dang / gnyos 'gar chos gsum sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bgrang las 'das pa/ dpal chen thag ma pa sogs dpal chen bcu gnyis/ mdor na slob ma dang yang slob kyis o rgyan nas kha che rgya gar sogs 'dzam gling thams cad kyi gnas chen ming che chung grags ma grags bas mtha' ri khrod thams cad du mang ba khri phrag nas nyung ba gcig gnyis kyi bar ma khyab pa med la de thams cad tshe blos btang sdom gsum rnam par dag pa 'ba' zhig shas che'o / /sngon sgam po ba'i dus kye po ye rdor gyis byon pa tsam las gzhan mis mi bgrod pa'i dus 827

gnyos 'gar chos gsum gyis brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang ye shes kyi rtsal gyis tsā ri tra'i gnas sgo phye ste sgrub rgyud kyi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyi sgom pa'i gnas dang skye bo mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyi skor ba sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi yul zla ma mchis par gyur to/ khyad par du gnyos chen po ni kha rag gi gnyos lo'i rgyud gnyos nag grags pa dpal gyi sras yin/ yab chos dang mdo phyogs mkhas/ thag ma pa dang lngal ti las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/chos rjes rjes su bzung / ti ser lha nang du sgrub pa mdzad pas lha nang bar grags/ byang du lha thel sogs btab/ lha pa nyis stong brgyad brgya sogs byung zhing dbon po lha rin chen rgyal po la sogs pa lha ba'i bka' rgyud bzang bar byung la/ 'gar dam pa gzhon nu rdo rje'am shākya dpal ni rme 'dor du lcags byi la 'khrungs/ 'jigs byed kyi grub thob yin/ gdan sa thel du gnang yang ma bzhes/ 'bri khung du thugs dam skad gtong ba mdzad/ dwags por 'dre dmag btul/ zu rer chos sdings btab pa gdan sa'i 'gran zlar song dogs ma bzung / phyis po bor phu lung dgon pa btab cing da dung dar/ dpal chen chos ye'i rjes 'breng la nag tshang par grags so/ /mkhas pa gru skya mo zhos bya ba shin tu mkhas pa zhig gis rtsod du 'ongs pas zhal mjal ba tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig re re gsungs pas sgro 'dogs thams cad chod/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs te rje'i dgongs pa rtsal du bton pa theg chen bstan pa'i snying po rtsa 'grel mdzad/ spyan snga 'bri khung gling pa ni 'ad5na gyi yul du skyu ra lha sgra'i rgyud yab ston pa sangs rgyas dpal dang yum rin chen sgro la ma la sras drug gi dang por 'khrungs/ rje 'jig rten myo/gon po'i zhe bzhi ba me lug la 'khrungs par deb sngon na snang la rnam thar na spre lo par bris snang / gnyis pa thub pa bsod stoms pa/ tha chung spyan snga sgam po pa yin la chung ngu nas 'bri 828

klog mkhas par mkhyen/ las 'bras kyi blang dor mkhas shing dad pa che/ bcu bdun pa la dpal ldan dad phu ba mjal/ mtshan rin chen rgyal por btags/ spros bral gyi rtogs pa skyes/ dad phu ba gshegs nas dgung lo nyer gcig pa la 'bri khung du dad phu ba'i gra pa du ma dang lhan du byon/ chos rje'i mnal lam du zhing hreb be ba zhig la nas rdog bzhi lnga tsam chags pa'i snye ma tho re 'dug pa nas kha yar zhig sku phag tu bsnams pa rmis pa'i nang bar byung nas cig gis bla ma rin po che dang dpal chen dad phu ba gnyis snying gar zhal sprad de sgom mam bshibs nas sgom zer ba la lan ma gsungs/ tshogs chos kyi dus da nang cig na re de skad zer du byung / kho dang nga gnyis bshib pa rnam rtog yang za gsungs pas de gdams ngag tu song bas de kun la khyad par can re byung zhes pa'i nang tshan yin/ rtsom yig pa mdzad pas mnyes shing lung mnyel ba'i tshul ston pa rnams mnyel bsos pas thugs shin tu mnyes/ sku na byon pa dang tshems 'ga' re byon pa dang ljags ldib pas gsung mi gsal tsam la dang por thugs ma gang tsam byung / de ma thag nyams myong gis zin te de phyin bla ma chos sku'i mos gus la ltem rkyang ma byung zhing byin rlabs thams cad zhugs pas snga ma'i log rtog cung zad de stongs yin par mkhyen/ gzims g.yog sogs spyan snga'i bya ba kun gus par mdzad thugs la btags te nor dang mgron ma gtad/ mjal sna dang zhu sna ma bcol khyad par bka' bkyon gyi bka' bab ste su la thugs ma cha/nyes kyang nyid la bka' bkyon/ de tsam gyis dad pa lhag par 'phel/ bdag ni 'di rang ngo mtshar che snyam/ 'bri khung gi ri bya rgod phung po'i ri mdo'i gleng gzhir bshad pa lta bu dang / gzims chung gser khang pho brang rnam snang gi snying po can dang / bla yel sogs a mo ni ka gi rdo leb bteg mnan gyis 'phar nim du byed pa la sogs pa rdul phra rab re re la'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa mtha'atho823

yas gnas pa sogs nyin re zhing gong 'phel du gzigs/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos gser mdog gi rtogs brjod gsung ba gzigs/ thugs dam sgo mang gzheng ba'i tshad rten bzhugs dkar chag sogs dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad/ 'bri khung gi gdan sa gyis gsung yang bdag gis kun spangs kyi spyod pas 'phrin las spel zhus/ dgung lo so gcig pa glang lo la rje 'jig rten mgon po gshegs/ gdung bzhu ba'i tshe thugs ma nyams pa phyag tu byon pa soṭa gdung cung zad kyang ma god par sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan du bzhugs shing rje rin po che snam sbyar dang dbu zhwa mnabs/ phyag mkhar kom tshugs mdzad pa cig kho bo 'di na rtag tu yod pa yin gsung ba gzigs/ spyir tshogs pa thams cad kyis slob dpon du bkur zhing mched grogs rnams kyis kyang dag snang mang du mthong ba sogs kyis 'bul nod kyi rlabs 'phyur ba yong yang zur gyi thab skyong skyid chos sogs skad cig kyang mi mdzad par zhal bzhugs ring bla ma dang gshegs nas kyang gdan sa 'ba' zhig tu gtong / chos rje rin po ches kyang thugs kyi sras su dgongs nas khyad chos kyi mdzod thams cad gtad/ phyis gnam mtsho ti se la sogs par byon zhing thugs dam gyi spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogasaṃ/mnga' ris ya tse/ gar log la sogs pa'i rgyal blon 'bangs bcas/ paṇḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pas zhabs spyi bor blangs shing gus pas mchod/ so dgu pa shing bya la 'bri khung du byon/ lo mjug la sto brag tu byon/ lam du sa paṇa gyis zhabs rjen spos reng gis bsus/ khyi lo'i dbyar dro bo lung phul ba bzhes/ dgun mkhar chur khyad chos brgya ཿrdagu bcu pa dang de rjes brgya lnga bcu pa yi7ger mdzad/ phyis rang bzhed rkyang pa can dang / gzhan 'dod bsnan pa dang / spyi bzhed bsnan pa sogs mang du mdzad cing zin bris kyang mang du byung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig pa ston pas 830

dgongs gcig ces grags la/ phyi rabs ni bstan dgongs gnyis zhes rje 'jig rten mgon po'i chos kyi snying por grags so/ /sku tshe'i smad phal cher dwags por bzhugs shing sgam po'i gdan sar yang bzhugs la/ 'bri‘khung du 'bul ba zhabs tog bgrang gis mi lang ba mdzad cing / 'brug mdar mgar dam pa dang mjal zhing chos gsan res mdzad/ spyir rkang bzhi la mi rten pa sogs kun spangs kyi brtul zhugs mdzad kyang dge slong gtsang ma lnga brgya re rgyun mi chad cing chos kyi 'phrin las ni mtha' yas pa yin la dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga la sku'i bkod pa bsdus par bstan no/ /shri phug pa mdo khams su 'phrin las che zhing yul skyong lha khang bzhengs/ pho bo bkra shis ni zangs ri ba yin yi ge ar sprul pa sogs mdzad/ chos rjes shin tu mnyes pas khong gi gsung bka' 'bum du yang bcug skad/ gtsang zhig gis gnyal du sgrub pa mdzad/ dbu zhwa ngang bas khyer nas bzhag sar ngang bskyal gyi dgon pa btab/ chang la mnyes pas chang gi mchod pa dar/ de'i skye pa smyal tshan gsum dga' ldan gyi za ra dge slong yin pas gtsang zhig gi sku la chang mchod byas pas gzi yong skad/ chos rgyud bzang du byon zhing gsal rje bas yul mi thams cad srog sdom la bkod/de la sogs pa 'gro don can bris kyis mi lang ngo / khyad par du gdan sa phag mo grur rje 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyis gdan sa lo gsum mdzad/ de nas lo nyer brgyad kyi bar 'bri khung nas phyi rgya tsam skyong ba las gdan sa dngos med/de nas rje spyan snga bskos te de yang chos rje rin po ches 'gro mgron yel pa ba phag mo grur gdan 'dren la btang bas nga rgas pas mi 'ong / nga'i 'di na btsun chung shes rab can zhig yod pa gtong bas gdan sa 'pher ba zhig 'chos la sko bar zhu zer ba byung ba de yin/ de yang mdo stod gnas drug gi sar 'khrungs/ gdung rlangs lha gzigs/ dgon chen rgyal ba skyabs dang yum 'gro 831

ldog bza' khu byug sman gyi sras gsum gyi gcen por 'khrungs/ bcu gsum la lha gzigs kyi spyi gnas g.yug gur ma khan po rjod mgo ba dang slob dpon ston pa las rab tu byung / 'gro mgon yel pa ba las gdams ngag gsan/ bco lnga pa la chos rje rin po che dang mjal/ bu tsha 'di kun mig rtsa dang grung zhwa bu'i gyon lugs dang byas pas khyod kyang sgom chen cig tu rdzu bar 'ong gsungs te sngon rje nyid la chos rje gong mas lung bstan pa de dang 'dra gsungs pa yin/phyag spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po 'khrungs/ gzims g.yog mdzad cing chos thams cad gsan/ gsan tshad skad cig kyang mi bsnyel bar mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la zhang sum thog pa dang lha 'bri sgang pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo so bzhi ma lon gyi bar 'bral med du bsten pa la chos rjes dbu'i ltag pa gzigs ma myong / bla ma rin po che la nga'i yo byad kyi phud 'bul ba yin/ tshogs pa bskyangs pa'i phud 'di yin pas bla ma'i gdan sar 'bul gsungs nas chos rje nyid kyis kyang phyag dang bkur sti mdzad de so bzhi pa sa 'brug la phag mo gru'i gdan sar phebs/ gdan sar phebs zhwaphral nas gdan sa dang zhing rgyas/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi/ dge 'dun thams cad kyang tshul khrims dang ting 'dzin la bkod/ chos rjes rin po che'i rnam thar ji bzhin mdzad/ bsam yas btsad po'i stos ma tshugs/ gdan sa lo nyer drug mdzad nas slar 'bri khung gi gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa gcig mdzad/ dor ta'i hor dmag rdzu 'phrul gyi rdo char phab pas btul te gya gcig la 'bri khung du gshegs/ slob ma rin po che grags bsod pa rgyal ba'i gcen po shar gling dbon por grags pas khams su zla dgon btab/ gzhan yang yang dgon pa dang snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa sogs byon/ dbon po rgyal ba thog brdugs pa grags pa brtson 'grus kyis gdan sa lo so gsum/ sku la thog gis ma tshugs/832

rgyal po hu la'i 'bul mo che lan gsum/ siṅgha gling / ti ra hu ti/ ya tse rnams kyi rgyal pos 'bul ba byas/ bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen gyis lo btsi bzhi/ grags ye ba lo bzhi/ gnyis mchod pa grags pa rin chen lo nyer gnyis/'di'i slob ma dung mtsho ras pas sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i gter bton te 'phrin las che zhing bka' rgyud bzang du byung / tshes bzhi rnying ma ba grags pa rgyal mtshan lo so bzhi/ 'di'i slob ma rdor 'dzin sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/mgon gzhon pa/ mtshungs med rin chen gzhon nu sogs yin/ bcu gnyis gsar ma ba grags pa shes rab lo bcu gcig 'di 'gro mgon rin po che dngos su grags/ tshes bzhi gsar ma ba grags pa byang chub lo brgyad/ bsod grags pa lo nyi shu/ dpal ldan bzang po lo dgu/ nyer gnyis rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan lo bco brgyad/ de'i bar du skyes bu dam pa phal cher byon la/ phyis su zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pas gdan sa yun ring du mdzad cing spyir rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung gis gdan sa dngos dang sku tshab mdzad pa rgyun ma chad do/ /phag gru'i dpon rabs ni/ dpal phag gru pa'i dus dge bshes rlangs rgan pho ba na ba la rten 'brel mdzad de stag lung thang pa la byang pha gir song la rlangs kyi gtso bo nga yin/ 'dzam gling gi mi chen nga yin/nga'i so bud pa 'di byang g.yag gi sha za bas bud pa yin gyis gsung ba ltar byas pas ras pa ston rin gyis 'dzam bu gling gi mi chen khyod yin na 'dzam gling gi mi chen zad pa yin zer bas ston rin gyis rten 'brel zlog zhus pas a'u tsi gzims lcil la phyag dang skor ba ldog la gyis gsungs pa 'di rten 'brel gyi thog ma mdzad pa yin la khyad par rje 'jig rten mgon pos rten 'brel du ma mdzad pas lha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung la bod kyi rgyal po byung ba yin no/ /de yang rlangs kyi po ti ser ru la sogs las byung ba bsdu na/ sngon dung gi sgo nga las 833

lha'i bu lta na sdug pa zhig tu gyur te bsams chad grub pas yid smon rgyal por btags te lha mi'i rjer gyur/ de'i rgyud pa mang ldom stag btsan dang tshangs sras lha mo'i bu btsas ma thag mas smod bor te lha ri'i rtser dar bas lha'i khye'u spyi gtsug nas rlangs pa 'byung ba/ lha dang srog chags kun gyis mchod pa cig byung bas rlangs pa'i rgyu mtshan las rlangs zhes sam lag pas blangs pas blangs zhes kyang grags shing de'i rgyud mtsho ma pham gyi 'gram du btsas pas mtsho bzang lha gzigs byung ba phyin rlangs lha gzigs su grags la phyag bris can mang du byung zhing khyad par slob dpon padma'i dngos slob lha 'dre bran du bkol pa a mi byang chub 'dre skol nas mi rabs bcu gsum na bod kyi bdag po yong bar lung bstan pa bzhin spyir khri dpon rdo rje dpal 'bri khung sgom pa shag rin gyis dbus kyi dpon la bskos dus sne gdong sogs gzhis ka bcu gnyis btab/ phyis dbon rin chen skyabs kyi sras ta si chen po byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis dbus gtsang gi bdag po lo bzhi bcu tsam mdzad cing rtses dang btab/ dbon po 'jam dbyangs go'o shri shākya rgyal mtshan la bod chol kha gsum zhes pa'i lung byung ste rgyal sa lo dgu de nas grags byang ba/ bsod grags pa/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bdag po grags pa 'byung gnas sogs byon zhing bod shing gi sgo gtod pa mtha' dag gi rgyal por grags pa'o/ /dpal phag gru pa'i gdan sa bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ /skyob pa rin po che nyid 'da' khar mkhan chen gu ra ba la khri 'di khyod kyis bzung la lo gsum na bsod nams grags pa la gtod gsungs te dbon rin po che bskos nas zhag gsum na gshegs so/ /dbon rin po che ni skyob pa rin po che'i khu bo dkon mchog rin chen gyi sras a me grags rgyal gyi sras gsum las che ba/ 'bring dbon rgyud rdo rje seng ge chung ba gcung rin po che rdo rje grags pa'o/ /dpal shrī phug pa mngags te lo bcu bzhi la chos 834

rje rin po che mjal/ sbyangs pa mdzad cing zab chos thams cad ga san/ thog mar lo bcu gnu/ma/ bar du lo drug mtha' mar lo bzhi rnams sgrub pa mdzad/so lnga la khrir phebs/ so dgu la sgo mang bzhengs/ zhe dgu la thegs/ rje 'jig rten mgon po nyidi dang thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs/ rje spyan sngas gdan sa lo nyer gcig mdzad/ gcung rin po che lo drug la 'jig rten mgon po mjal/ 'di te lo ba yin/ nged rang thams cad las lhag pa 'ong zhes lung bstan/ dbon rin po che las gdams pa rdzogs mchog ma thob bar them pa las 'da' ri zhes dam bca' mdzad de sgrub pa mdzad/ nyer lnga la dbon rin po che gshegs kyang sgrub pa ma bkrol bar smra ba'i seng ge spyan snga ba gdan sar skos gsungs te slar yang lo sum bcur sgrub pa mdzad/ zhe drug la gdan sar phebs/ kurma pag shi hor rgyal pos tsandan gyi me la zhag phyed dang bzhir bsres pas zhing 'pho bar bzhed tshe te lo ba seng ge bcibs nas byon te yi ge gsum thugs kur bstims te me'i gnyen por me thong zhig kho bo stong gsum kun na yod cing 'bri khung na gcung rdo rje grags pa'o zhes gsungs/ khe ra khe ta'i hor dmag 'dam du slebs tshe bde mchog dngos su bstan pas su la yang ma gnod par phyir log sgo mang dang bka' bstan dang gtsug lag khang ka ba brgya dang brgyad bcu lha chen du ma gser thog gser phru dang bcas pa bzhengs/dge 'dun khri phrag bcu gsum gyis me tog 'thor/ re dgu la dwags po rdzam du thegs/ dbon rgyud pa'i sras che ba thog kha ba rin chen seng ge me khyi la 'khrungs/ gcung rin po che'i chos thams cad rdzogs/ lo bcu bdun sgrub pa mdzad/ gcung rin po che thegs kyang bug sgo nas 'gro don mdzad pa las gdan sa ma bzhes/ nga gsum pa la khrir phebs nas gdan sa lo bdun mdzad de nga dgu pa la gshegs/ gcung tha chung mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod 835

nams ni chu byi 'a 'khrungs/ bcu dgu la bsnyen rdzogs dang sgrub pa lo btsu gsum mdzad/ khri lo gsum mdzad de zhe dgu la thegs/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos gdan sa snubs la ma sko gsung ba yod kyang zhal ngo sku na phra pas chos sgo pa snubs ston rdo rje ye shes khri la bskos/ de nas lo drug pa lcags stag la gling log byung / sgo mang bcu gsum dang lha khang chen mo dang gling bsregs/gling nas nam mkha' la 'phur te chu 'phan gyi rtser bab/ slar mkha' spyod du song ba'ang khri phrag tsam byung bar grags/ sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan dang gser khang chos rje sogs me brdugs la bzhugs/ zhal ngo kong por byon/ sgom pa dbon po stod hor la byon te 'jam 'a myo bcad pas slar gso ba'i cha rkyen dpag med phul nas bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen dgung lo bcu gsum la khrir phebs shing nyams pa bsos/ lo nyer brgyad gdan sa mdzad/ rdo rje rgyal pos lo so lnga/ nyer gnyis rin po ches gdan sa lo so dgu nas kun spangs mdzad/ chos rje don grub rgyal pos lo bco lnga gdan sa mdzad/ de nas dbang rin po che snga ma rgyal srid spangs nas ri bo rtse lnga la byon/ de'i sras chos rgyal rin chen dpal dang de'i sras chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang gnyi ga'ang gil ngo dkon pas gdung rgyud pa mdzad dgos byung bas gdan sar ma phebs kyang grub thob chen por bzhugs shing 'di skabs gling pa mtha' dag mtshan nyid par gyur yod kyang / slar dbang rin po ches bstan dgongs zab chos sogs rnyed grags la ji mi snyam par stag lung chos rje la gsan zhing rje 'jig rten mgon po dngos su 'byon par lung bstan pa rje kun dga' rin chen gyis 'bri khung pa'i bstan pa rmang nas gso bar mdzad de slar phag mo rtser gdung rgyud kyi bzhugs stan chags pa las chos dang srid kyi bstan pa rgya cher 'phel ba 'di yin no/ /phag gru bka' rgyud las 'bri khung gdan rabs kyi skabs so/ /stag lu‘nga thang pa 836

ni mdo khams g.yang shod bong ra steng du 'khrungs/ gdung dbra'i nang tshan tsho zi/ yab ban blon klu 'bar yum dge gsum gyi sras su chu khyi 'a 'khrungs/ phyi lo 'bri khung chos rje 'khrungs pa yin/ yum snga bar grongs/ phyis bco brgyad la thang skya lha khang du gla gang pa shes rab rdo rje dang slob dpon tshar ston las rab tu byung / mtshan bkra shis dpal slob dpon 'ga' la chos du ma gsan/rgya gar la 'byon par yang yang brtsams kyang ma thon/ phag gru pa'i sku mthong pas 'di'i dung du mi 'gro ri snyam pa'i zhe bcad byung / mnal lam du skas ring po zhig la 'dzegs pas mi dkar po zhig gis ngas ma 'then na mi thon zer ba dang / lam du rta chu rab 'byams pa la rtas po to cig la rkang pa tshugs nas thon pas de kho bos byas pa yin gsungs/ phag mo grur mjal bas kho bo gar 'dug kyang khyod 'ong dgos pa yin skye ba 'di kho na'i bla ma ma yin gsungs/ ma mjal ba nas gsar pa'i lus las gsar pa zhig chad nas kho bo la thim gsungs shing 'di bya yul pa 'dra ang gsungs/ da gsol ba btab pa gcig pus chog snyam nas gser zho gang phul te bdag zhu yas dngos grub lta bu zhig byed pa yin chos kyang mi zhu byas pas zhal 'dzum mdzad de de dad pas khams sos ba bya ba yin/ da dung gsol ba thob mang du 'char rgyu yod/ chos gsungs tshad nyon gsungs te gsungs tshad zin bris su btab/ lan cig zhal ba la bris nas slar gzigs pas de phyin brjed pa ma byung / kho bo'i chos kyi bdag po khyod kyis byed pa yin yang gsungs/ dpal phag mo gru pa gshegs nas mal gror byon/ mchad ka ba la chos kyang gsan/ yang dbyar zhig phag mo grur gdung rten la sogs pa'i bya ba mdzad/ se sler bzhugs dus sangs rgyas sgom pas phyi nas dpal phag gru ba'i gsung nyid du tshor te sngar chos rje'i gsung nas nga gar 'gro sar khyod khrid pa yin gsung ba de 'di yin par 'dug gsungs nas 'bral med 837

du bzhugs/ zhang sho ma ra ba sgres po zhig gis mkhan po dang mar bcom thag pas las slob mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ stag lung du bzhugs kyang da dung mi non pas 'phos zer ba byung ste se ba lung du lo bdun bzhugs/ slar dgung lo so dgu pa lcags byi la phod mdo ba dang dar pras rong gsum gyis gdan drangs te stag lung du byon/ bla brang nang/ por phyags phab/ bya rog gis rtswa shing dang bong ba sogs yang dgon du bskyal bas der spos/ spyir rgyun du bzhes pa dang chab tsha'i dus ma gtogs gsung bcad mdzad/ zla smad la mtshams mdzad/rab tu byung phyin khyim pa'i khang par ma byon/ sha chang zhal du ma bzhes/ sha chang gi mgron mi byed/ gling gseb tu bud med mi 'jog pa sogs kyi srol mdzad/stag lung du sum stong gi dge 'dun tshogs/ phag mo grur 'bul chen yang yang mdzad/ phag gru'i gsung rab rnams sgam por thegs pa gsan pas thugs ma bde ba ltar mdzad cing dgung lo re dgu rta lo la sku 'da' bar bstan/ de ma thag sangs rgyas sgom pa yang gshegs/ sku yal ba rin chen mgon ni sku'i dbon por 'khrungs/ rje sku yal ba de nyid byon pa yin gsungs pas sku yal bar grags/'khrungs 'phral yab la shul na bu zhig skyes 'dug pa nga la phul gsungs shing spyos rab tu byung la ming rin chen mgon du thogs shig gsungs/ gling du sgrub pa lo bdun mdzad/ bcu dgu la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ nyi shu la stag lung thang pa gshegs gar gdan sar bskos/ dngul gdung chen mo dang stag lung thang pa'i dngul sku chen mo/ sku 'bum chen mo lha khang ka ba brgyad bcu'i sa rnams mdzad/lugs gnyi ga'i dar rgyas che zhing gzims khyi'ang stag lung ldog tsha zer ba 'di nas byung / 'di'i dbon po sangs rgyas yar byon ni dpon chen mgon rgyal gyi sras su stag lung thang pa'i re gnyis pa/ sku yal pa'i bcu gsum pa chu phag la 'khrungs/ mtshan shes rab bla ma/ bcu dgu la dbus su byon zhing bsnyen rdzogs 838

mdzad/ sku yal ba las gdams ngag rdzogs te lo bco lngar sgrub pa mdzad/bdun bcu la bde bar gshegs/ khu dbon de gnyis kyi slob ma kong do ba dar shes mgon po'i grub pa thob/ kong dgon btab ste dar rgyas cher byung / sangs rgyas dbon grags pa dpal rje sgam po pa'i sku'i skye bar grags pa grub rtags mang du bstan pa de la gdan sa gtad de dpe cha rten gsum byin rlabs can 'di rnams dang ma bral bar gyis shig gsungs/ sa skya pa'i 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che la dbon po maXg lu gu ru phul te stag lung gi bdag rkyen zhus/dbon rnam pa gnyis thugs ma mthun par snang ba'i tshe sa skya bas rma ga la gu ru'i bdag rkyen mdzad pas sangs rgyas dbon gyis gdan sa lo gcig mdzad de rje btsun mi la'i phyag mkhar dang zhal skyogs kyis gtsos pa'i rten gsum phyag dpe thams cad bsnams te khams su byon/ stag lung thang pa nyid kyis 'debs par dgongs shing phyis gdan 'dren byung dus 'bri chu la phyags bskur ba sogs rten 'brel mdzad pa bzhin ri bo che'i sde chen po ma las bu dga' bar grags pa de chags te deng sang du'ang dar zhing rgyas so/ /rma ga la gu ru chos yags kyi sras su sangs rgyas yar byon gyi nyer dgu pa lcags mo yos la 'khrungs/ khams su rab byung mdzad/ nyer lnga la dbus su phebs/ sangs rgyas yar byon las gdams pa gsan te sgrub pa lo bcu drug mdzad/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa phul/zhe gsum pa chu bya la gdan sar phebs/ lha chen stong gsum zil gnon bzhengs/re bdun me bya la thegs/ de nas rim bzhin dpal bzang po lo bcu gsum/ratna gu ru so gcig radhā kā ra nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'di nas cho ga rnams dar bas dpal ldan bla ma'i rjes su 'breng pa rnams gos bzang bas smug khyu ba dang /zha lu ba'i rjes 'breng rnams dar zab gon pa mang bas khra khyu bar grags/ nam mkha' dpal bzang lo bco lnga 'di yan yar byon yin la 'di nas dbon rgyud 839
