bod du 'khrungs pa yin no / /bkra shis dpal brtsegs lo bco lnga 'di stag lung thang pa dngos su byon par grags 'phrin las shin tu che/ byang chub rgya mtsho lo bdun 'di zhwa dmar pa chos dpal ye shes dang thugs rgyud gcig par grags/bkra shis dpal lo so gcig de nas mkhas grub ngag dbang grags pa byon te bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag po lta bu mdzad/ de nas bkra shis dpal ba/rnam rgyal grags pa'i bar du bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad ldan 'ba' zhig byon la/ gling chags nas da lta'i bar pha rol gyi dmag gi gnod pa/ ser dmag skul ba/ gling gseb tu bud med 'ong ma myong ba 'di lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab la/ me mo lug gi lo sos ka phung thang mes gshegs pa'i dgun bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga la lha khang chen mo lha chen bcu gsum sogs me lhas bzhes cing slar chos kyi rje sku mched rnams kyis nyams pa gso bar mdzad la gling gi dar rgyas ni gong 'phel du bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /phag gru bka' rgyud las stag lung bka' rgyud kyi sa bon tsam ste rgyas par sto rong chos byung las shes par bya'o/ /za ra ba bskal ldan ye shes seng ge ni mon 'gar du 'khrungs/ chung dus ra lug 'tsho ba na phag mo gru mthong ba tsam gyis rang byung gi sgom skyes chos rjes ngo sprod btab pa tsam gyis rtogs pa phu thag chod de gra rabs su za ra dgon pa btab nas bzhugs/ de'i slob ma g.yam bzang chos rje ni gtsang zhal gyi dmar mor sa glang la 'khrungs/ ting nge 'dzin rang byung du skyes/ bya zhing dang mchad kur du bka' gdams pa mdzad/ rgya dur du klubs dkar las bsnyen par rdzogs te 'dul ba mkhas par sbyangs pas snubs 'dul ba 'dzin par graṭa/za ra ba chen po dang mjal ba tsam gyis rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ gdams ngag thams cad gnang ste kho bo rabs mi chad par 'dug gsungs/ ra mo mtha' lung la sogs par sgrub pa ring du mdzad/ shaspus srog snying phul/ so brgyad pa 840

me stag la g.yam bzang btab/ lha mo tsaṭi gas bka' srung du khas blangs te g.yam bzang lha mo zhes shin tu gnyan par grags/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sngon gnas gsal bar dran/ tshogs pa cher bskyangab/ shing bka' rgyud rin po che'i khri srol ma nyams par mdzad/ smyal sto brag par lung sogs mtha' dag tu lam rgya dang gzhan don rgya cher mdzad/ re lnga pa sbrul lo la thegs/ slob ma spyan snga'i sgom bzhi skad pa smyal dpal ri sangs rgyas bya sgom/ gor gdong pa sangs rgyas lha sgom/ gser lnga pa sangs rgyas le sgom/ dbon gsar ba sangs rgyas rgya sgom rnams so/ /nye gnas rin chen jo sras kyis gdan sa lo dgu/rtogs ldan rgyal po dge mdzes 'od kyis lo so brgyad mdzad de gtsug lag khang chen mo btab/ mkhar chu ba chos bsam 'od kyis lo bco brgyad/ za ra ba bde legs 'od kyis nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gdung rgyud pa bkra shis 'od kyis nyer brgyad/ des lha grags 'od pa bskos te de phyin lhas bzung ngo / /phag gru bka' rgyud las g.yam bzang bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ /dbyer sgom chen po ni yar lung du 'khrungs/ mal ka ba can pa dang rnal 'byor chos g.yung las chos rdzogs/ phyis 'gro mgon rin po che las rtogs pa brnyes grub thob chen por gyur te snye phu shug gseb btab ste 'phrin las che'o/ /khams su 'gro mgon dmar yel gnyis su grags pa'i dmar ba la gtsang du byon na 'phrin las nyid dang mnyam par lung bstan na'ang khams su byon sho dgon btab pas tshogs pa nyis stong tsam 'dus/ gdan sa'ang sha yang dgon pa/rmog spyan snga ba/ rnal rin chen gling ba/ de'i slob ma 'ga' li chos 'od kyis ri rgya dgon dang rgyal dgon sogs btab/ dbang 'od zer bla mas thugs rje chen po grub ste ril bus 'gro don cher mdzad do/ /'gro mgon yel phug pas ni shar rdo rdzong sto yel phug byang rta rna sogs btab ste 'phrin las che'o/ /phag 841

gru bka' rgyud las shug gseb pa dang dmar yel gyi skabs so/ /rgyal tsha rin chen mgon ni gtsang stod shab kyi smad du snubs kyi sngags 'chang nus pa can 'ba' zhig gi rgyud par 'khrungs/ bla ma brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis bsten/ bla ma bcu gsum gyi gdams ngag gi bka' bab/ phag mo gru pa rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ yul du 'dug pas skye shis 'jigs pa rnams la chos sbyin zhig gsung ba ltar mdzad/ khro phu btab/ don gnyis shing yos la thegs/nyer lnga bzhes pa'i sa 'brug la dbon po kun ldan ras pa gcen po'i sras su 'khrungs/ phag mo grur khu bo'i rgyags skyel du byon pas mi la'i rnam thar gsung ba dang 'grig pas de tsam zhig mi byed ri zhes chos ra de gar mgo cog dang zhe mna' lan gsum byas/ rtogs pa'i mthar phyin zhing grub pa thob ste phyis mu ge'i dus cig ngas nas kyi char 'bebs sam/ chos rgyud 'bri gdan lta bu zhig bya'am/ lus 'dis mkha' spyod du 'gro 'doms shig gsungs pas nas kyi char 'bebs par zhus pas dbu rtse'i sgo la mkha' 'gro ma rnams nas slang zhes phyag mkhar tug tug mdzad pas sgo bar nas nas zad mi shes pa zhag lnga'i bangayul mi kun gyis len tshad byung ste nas gzhan las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba zhig byung /'di 'dems kha nor ba yin skad/ lo bdun bcur gzhan don mdzad/ deb sngon na rgyal tsha dang kun ldan sku mched du bris pa ni mi dag ste/ khu bo shākya thub pa la/ /dbon po rigs gsum mgon po yod/ /ces khu dbon du bshad do/ khro phu lo tsā ba ni kun ldan gyi gcung po jo 'phan dang yum gsal byed kyi sras yin/ yab de mthu shin tu che yi dam gyi zhal gzigs kyang mthu mang po mdzad pas skye ba bdun nas dpon slob bcu gcig dmyal bar skye bar mkhyen te gcen po la chos gsan nas thugs dam rtse gcig du mdzad pas gdeng tshad khyad par can rnyed do/ kun ldan gyi nyer lnga pa sa 'brug la 'khrungs/ rin po che rgyal 842

tshas mkhan po mdzad de lo bcu la dge tshul dang nyi shu la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ca/tshan tshul khrims shes rab yin/ gtsang nag gtsang dkar la tshad 'dul dang zhang dge ba la lo tsā sogs gzhung lugs mtha' dag sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la sa skyar rtse mo gshegs ba'i chos 'khor byung ba sogs chos 'khor du ma la byon/ 'chad rtsod gnyi ga la kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ snur pa'i lugs gsang sngags mtha' dag sbyangs/ rgyal tsha dang kun ldan gyi gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs shing phyis rje sgam po ba'i slob ma grub thob slong rtse pas bogs bton pas sgro 'dogs chod de phyis paṇa grub gsum dang mjal yang rtogs pa la skyed 'don ma dgos/ rin po che rgyal tshas khyod rag dung bzhin du je sbom la 'gro gsungs/ lo nyer bzhi la rgyal tsha gshegs nas bal por byon/ sbyangs pa rgya cher mdzad/ rnam sras kyis 'phrin las thams cad bsgrubs/ paṇa grub gsum spyan drangs/ khro phu'i byams chen khru brgyad bcu pa pho brang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ bshad sgrub mtha' dag dar rgyas su mdzad/bshad gra la mkhas pa gzang ring bskos shing phyis mchod rten chen mo yang mdzad/bla chen bsod dbang dang khro phu sems dpa' chen pos gdan sa rim par mdzad cing yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge dang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs khro phu'i bka' rgyud bzang la mang ba byung ngo / khro phu'i bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ /phag gru bka' rgyud las gling gi bka' rgyud las gzhan bshad pa'i skabs theb /grub thob gling ras pa ni yul nyang stod bzhengs kyi glang po snar gdung gling smad pa/ yab sman dang sngags mkhyen pa rgyal po sgrub be yum gtum mo dar skyid kyi sras su sa spre la 'khrungs/ sman dang sngags la sbyangs/ 'o ma thang ba las rab tu byung / zhang dang ra lo sogs bsten/ jo mo sman mo dang bsdongs rnal 843

'byor ba'i cha byad mdzad/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' gnyis kyis bud meng lachos bstan pa la dge slong drug bcus 'khrig pa'i skur ba btab pas de gnyis la kun ma mos/ des drug bcu po ngan song dang mi khom pa mtha' yas myong nas mthar ston pa'i drung du byang chub sems dpa' drug cur gyur nas gshegs shing phyis sdom par khas blangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus 'od du gyur pa'i skye ba dkon brtsegs gzigs pas/ mkhyen/ sman mo dang 'brel ba'ang de'i las kyi lhag ma yin/ rgyal ba khyung tshang ba la gdams pa zhus/ khyung tshang pa ras chung pa dngos dang mjal ba'i lo rgyus mang po gsung ba la ma dad pas phyis kyang drod chung bar byung lo ror byon te lo la dbang zhus/ sum pa la gdams pa thams cad rdzogs par zhus/ mnal lam du mi dkar po cig gis da de lo phyed dang lnga na don 'grub ces pa byung / so brgyad pa shing bya'i dgun phag mo grur byon dad pa dbang med du skyes/ bya ri dwags 'di rnams kyang bla ma'i sprul pa yin snyam pa byung / rje 'gro mgon de rnal 'byor pa dang khyim thab can la mi mnyes kyang nyid la shin du thugs la 'dogs par byung / lo bdun zla ba bdun gyi mtshams kyi dam bca' byas nas bsgoms pas zhag gsum na rtogs pa zang thal du shar te tshogs su byon te/ rje yi zhal nas gnyug ma'i don/ /sgoms shig gsungs nas bsgoms lags pas/ /sgom bya dang sgom byed stor nas thal/ /sgom thun mtshams su bzung rgyu yang mi gda'o/ /sogs kyi rtogs pa phul bas mnyes shing chu bo gaṅgā tshun la rtogs pa mtho bar grags/ 'gro mgon gyis rten 'brel mdzad de jo mo phyir bslog khams su byon te zang zing ci yang ma bsnams par byon/ lo ro'i bla ma rnams mjal nas phag mo grur byon pas gdung yang sbyangs zin 'dug nas/ grong khyer rtswa mchog lta bu yi/ /dpal phag mo gru yi nags khrod du/ /sogs kyi gdung dbyangs mdzad/ sbrags yang rdzong sogs dbus 844 —

gtsang gi sa mang por bzhugs/ sna phur gtsad pos gdan drangs te dgon pa bzung / bsam yas su bud med cig gis po ti cig byin pa mid par phyin chos thams cad mi mkhyen pa ma byung / rgyud kyi 'grel pa byed par mkha' 'gro mas bka' gnang nas cung zhig mdzad pas ma nyan bar bshad zer nas skur pa 'debs pa byung bas bzod gsol mgur du bzhengs nas 'phro bcad/ dpal he ru ka dngos su bzhugs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad de/ nga med ma sems rang gi sems la stos/ sems kyi de nyid mthong na nga dang mjal/ /zhes sogs kyi zhal chems dpe gseb tu bcug ste re gcig la chos gsung 'phro la dam sel can gnyis byung bas gshegs par bstan/ gdung bzhu tshe du ba gtan med cing dri bzang khyad par can dang me lce la ri mo sna tshogs pa byung ngo / /de'i slob ma kun go gcig gis chod pa gtsang pa rgya ras ni ha bo gang bzang dang nye ba'i nyang stod khu le'i sar 'khrungs/ yab rgya zur so tshab be yum mar bza' dar skyid/sras bdun gyi tha chung yin/ yum gyis gces par byas nas bon po la bcol te g.yung drung dpal du btags/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la slob dpon rta thang pa la dbu skra bcad/ shes rab bdud rtsi 'khor lo zhes btags/ nyer gnyis yan la slob dpon brgyad tsam la mngon pa tshad ma yo ga bka' gdams rdzogs chen soṭa chos mang du sbyangs/ che sar bton zhing chos mkhas par grags/ grub thob gling ra lung na bzhugs pa dang mjal te chos ma zhus kyang byin rlabs de dus zhugs/ de nas sna phur byon gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas zhag bdun na ras thub pa byung / phyag chen gyi sems gnas dka' bar byung yang brtson 'grus skyed pas nyin mtshan khor yug gi gnas pa bzang po byung / bla ma la zhus pas de yang yin te rtogs pa cig yod kyi gsungs/ ji zhig na nyams thams cad dag nas rtogs pa lhag gis shar bas bla ma la mos gus bzod med du skyes/ blo sna 845

thung sbyang tser song / 'thor pa snyung tshabs che ba zhig byung ba grub thob chen pos nga rang gis nad g.yog byed gsungs nas mdzad/ sna phu'i mchod khang bzheng pas gra pa mtshams byed pa dang phyogs la 'gro ba la gser zho re'i chad pa 'bebs kyi 'dug pas gser zho gang phul nas mtshams byed par zhus pas khyod rang sle'u chung du song la gyis gsungs/ der ga re bla ma ma mnyes pa'i sgrub pas ci byed bsams nas bshags pa byas/ da mkhar las byed par zhu byas pas 'o chos go ba bya ba de tsug 'ong ba yin gsungs nas shin tu mnyes/ zhar la phyag dpe 'bri ba dang / grogs mched stoms chung gi dpe bris sogs 'khrobs par mdzad/ chos skad mdzad pa na dpon slob sus kyang ma thub pas shes rab can du grags/ sgom du 'gro bar zhus pas lo gsum na mkhar chur btang gis de bar 'dir sdod gsungs nas spyir sna phur lo lnga bzhugs ring gdams ngag thams cad tshar/ rlung phyi nang sre ba dang rtsig pa la ma thogs pa sogs rje mi la'i yon tan lta bu byung / rnal 'byor pa ma mdzad par gtsang sgom sadzod ces mkha' 'gro ma skal bzang gis lung bstan/ zhar chos pa'ang mdzad/ bde mchog gi dbang gnang ba'i sta gon gyi tshe rmi lam na gser btul ma gzhong pa gang ma btul ba gang 'dug pa la dgra la zhe 'tsher ba bag tsam 'dug pa rmis pas rmi ltas bzang / gtor zan skyong dgos par 'dug gsungs/ de ma grub pas sku tshe thung bar byung spyi las dang nad pa'i g.yog kun la slebs par byas/de nas nan gyis mkhar chur 'gro bar zhus nas byon pas gser steng du slebs dus grub thob chen po gshegs pa gsan nas byon pas gdung bzhu ba dang thugagadung dbyangs mdzad/ dgung lo nyer brgyad nas nyer dgur 'pho ba la mkhar chur byon/ grang la 'tsho ba dkon pas 'khor rnams kyis ma tshugs/ nyid kyis lcags phur can du 'dag sbyar la lo gsum bzhugs paca snying rlung 'dre dmag la 846

sogs phyi nang gi cho 'phrul ci yang byung yang 'chi nus thog 'gel du nyams su blangs pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu shar/ rten 'brel thams cad me long la gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal/ /ro stoms kyi gter yang rnyed/mtshur phur rin po che dbu se dang mjal/ thugs yid 'dre bar byung zhing thabs lam gyi gnad du ma gsan/ 'bri khung rin po che la chos gsan/ tsā ri la byon te gzigs snang khyad par can byung / klong rdol btab/ zhang rin po che dang mjal bas snying rje la bogs thon/ cis kyang rab tu byung gsungs nas dgung lo so gsum pa la mkhan po gzad pas rab byung dang zhang rin po ches mkhan po mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ pha las rgya'i chos la mnga' brnyes kyang / /bu gtsang sgom byed pa'i sgom chen yin/ /ra thug lug thug gi sgom chen min/ /bong reng skya bo'i chos pa min/ /zhes dang / rgas kyang rab byung byas pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba yin/ /chos mgo mjug log par mi dgongs 'tshal/ /zhes kyang gsungs/ dge ye chos byung na 'di gling ras la sbyar ba ni shin tu 'khrul lo/ /rnam thar na mi snang yang deng sang ngag sgros la/rje 'jig rten mgon pos sgom zhwa skyel du btang ba gsol pas zhang rin po che'i zhwa sna ring mi mdzad par sgom zhwa gsol ba byung zer ro/ /'brug dang ra lung sogs bzung ste tshogs pa mang du 'dus/ skyo shas shin tu che/ gzhan mi dga' ba mi mdzad pa sogs gzhan don dang 'brel ba'i rnam thar bcu dang / su dang 'grogs kyang gong du 'khur zhing sna thag gzhan la mi 'chor ba sogs sku'i rnam thar gsum/ dgos med kyi drag sngags rnam gsum rtag tu 'dren pas phyi tshig gi rdos thag chod pa sogs gsung gi rnam thar gsum/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang mi 'bral ba sogs thugs kyi gsum/ rang gzhan su yang bcas rang gi mi dge bas gos su mi 'jug pa sogs sku gsung thugs thun mong gi rnam thar gsum 847

ste thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar bcu gnyis mdzad/ dgung lo nga gcig pa lcags lug la rang sems chos skur rtogs na nga dang mjal/ /zhes sogs kyi zhal chems mdzad de gshegs/ zhe dgu la gshegs zer ba ni ma dag pa 'phel ba'o/ /slob ma'ang dang por che ba sba rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/ mtha' mar che ba lo rgod gnyis zhes grags pa'i sba ri bas sba ri byang chub gling gong btab cing chu bo ri la kha shar sogs mched/ rkyang mo kha bas rkyang mo kha btab/ rgya yags pas grar rgya yags btab/ 'bras mo bas nyang stod 'bras mo btab ste re re zhing 'phrin las cher byung / khyad par rje nyid kyi gdung gi dbon po chos kyi sras dbon ras dar ma seng ge ni me bya la 'khrungs/so lnga la chos rje gshegs nas gdan sa mdzad de bu chen phyi tshar rnams kyi bla ma'ang yin/ re gcig la gshegs/ de'i dbon po rim bzhin gzhon nu seng ge lcags spre la 'khrungs/ re bdun la thegs/ nyi ma seng ge lcags phag la 'khrungs/so bdun la thegs/ spos skya ba seng ge rin chen ni sa rta la 'khrungs/ nga drug la thegs/ seng ge rgyal po sa glang la 'khrungs/ so bdun la thegs/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge shing stag la 'khrungs/ so bzhi la thegs/ blo gros seng ge shing bya la 'khrungs/ zhe drug la thegs/ shes rab seng ge lcags phag la 'khrungs/ nyer gnyis la thegs/ 'di yan la seng ge dgu tshar du grags so/ /ye shes rin chen shing 'brug la 'khrungs/ lnga bcu la thegs/ rgyal dbang chos rje sa spre la 'khrungs/ 'phrin las shin du che zhing sgam po'i gdan sa'ang mdzad de zhe dgu la thegs/ 'di yan du gdan sa mdzad pa rnams gtsang sgom mdzad/ gdung rgyud pa khyim pa mdzad cing bu chen 'gro don 'pher ba re re zhing mang la phyis kyang rtogs ldan lha btsun pa dang bla ma bsam gtan pa dang /'brug smyon kun dga' legs pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du ma byung ngo //bar 'brug du grags ba ra lung gi gdan sa bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ / 848

rje rgod tshang pa ni lho brag do lo chung khrar 'khrungs/ gdung chu cal/ yab mon grags yum zug mo dpal rgyan gyi sras su sa bya la 'khrungs/ mtshan mgon po dpal du btags/ gling ras sku 'da' ba'i tshe byin rlabs thams cad 'phos/ 'khrungs nas zhag dgu tshun chad thams cad dran/ dgung lo gsum nas yab yum bral te yab kyis gces par gsos/ dgung lo lnga drug nas klog tsheṭa med du mkhas par mkhyen te yab sras gnyis ka bde bar 'tsho/ slob dpon brgyad tsam la sgra smra sgo sogs dang / bstan rim/ dbu ma/ spyod 'jugaphar phyin sogs gsan pas ji lta bar mkhyen/ lo re la mdo mang lan gnyis re gzigs pas kun thugs la chub pa ltar yod/ bcu gnyis nas glu bro kho na mdzad pas lha las 'phos par grags/ lo re la lha sa lan gsum du bskor te chos kyi dngos grub kho na zhus pas lho pa'i dad pa can zhes grags/ chos rgyud gang la 'jug gam snyam pa na/ mnal lam du/ rgyud pa bzang ba mang na yang / /dgas po'i bka' rgyud gong na med/ /ces sogs byung / grogs bshes kun gyis gshol/ lan cig gtsang pa'i glu mkhan du mas/ dgon pa ra lung gi chos rje rgya ras la/ /tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bde legs yod/ /snying nas lha chos la gshegs na de ru gshegs/ /zer ba gsan pas thugs mi bzod pa skyes ste lo bcu dgu pa la byon/ yab kyis kyang khyod kyis chos gyis la nga 'drongs par gyis pha yul du ma sdod ces bskul te ra lung du byon/ chos rje chos gsung ba dang mjal bas dad pa lhag par skyes te byin rlabs zhugs/ mtshan mgon po rdo rjer btags/ mkhan slob las dge tshul mdzad de 'dul ba mdo rtsa gsan pas tshegs med par mkhyen/ chos rje rin po ches gtor dbang zhig gnang nas khrid bskyangs panashe nam rtog 'ba' zhig byung ba zhus pas rtog pa rang thug 'dug stos gsungs/ rtog pa la rang bzhin mi 'dug zhus pas de ka ltar sgoms gsungs/stong pa yin na 'gyur mi thad snyam pa na stong pa rang 'gyu bar shes/ byi bas 849

gnod pa byas pas snang ba sems yin par thag chod/ chos gsungs tshad la bsam mno dogs dpyod mdzad pas sgro 'dogs thams cad chod de nga/ pe char mi stos par gyur/ dpon slob sus kyang chos skad kyi lan ma ldon pas thugs rab kyi grags pa thob/ 'bri khung rin po che la zab chos gsan/ nyer gsum la 'gro mgon gshegs te mkhar chur sgrub pa lo gsum mdzad pa'i dbyar dang po la rnam rtog dang ye shes rtse sprod kyi dus dang / de nas nyon mongs mgo non te nyin par rkyen gyis mi gnod pa byung / da dung slob gnyer cig bya bar sem pa na chos rje ras pa byon te bu sgrub pa kho na gyis mi la'i rnam thar skyongs/ tshur 'dus pa rnams ri khrod tu skyongs/ 'brug tu sku 'bum rtsig pa la rgyug gsung ba la ma slebs pas phyis 'khor dang longs spyod kyi rten 'brel cung zad 'phyugs/ padma'i thugs dam gyi nang la lan gsum drangs pas bde stong gi ye shes skyes/ nyer lnga la gangs ti se la byon/ snye mor thugs ma bde ba na ci byung yang sdug bsngal mi mdzad pa dam bca' dang po mdzad/1 de bzhin du rkyen re la bsten nas bzang ngan 'bring gsum spyi bor 'khur ba/3 su la yang skur pa mi 'debs pa/riganod lan du phan 'dogs pa/4 nyin mtshan thun drug du dge sbyor bdun pa la 'bad pa/5 bla ma'i mos gus dang ma bral ba/༄ gang la'ang bdag gir mi 'dzin pa/4 bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang ma bral ba/8 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gzhan don mdzad pa/khya sdug bsngal bdag la len pa/10 bde dge gzhan la ster ba/11 le lor ma lus par tshogs gnyis gsog pa ste dam bca' bcu gnyis/ de mthar 'don ba'i go cha dang bcu gsum mdzad/ yang lus kyis mtshams 'dag sbyar ri khrod gsum gyis dus 'da' ba/ ngag smra bcad bsnyen pa gsol 'debs gsum gyis 'da' zhing long gtam chig gsum du mi sbrel/ yid kyis 'khrul rtog gsum mi sbrel ba ste sku gsung thugs kyi dam bca' gsum/ yang gzhi bdag bzung mi mdzad pa/ rang don du grong du mi 'gro ba/850

sngar shul du phyis mi gshegs pa/ tshe 'di'i zhal ta mi mdzad pa/ ci yod ltos med du gtong ba/ gzhan mi dga' ba skad cig yang mi mdzad pa/ ci byung ro stoms kyis lam du 'khyer ba ste dam bca' bdun/ yang mos gus kyis bla mas ci gsungs sgrub pa/ dag snang gis snang srid bla mar lta ba/ zhen log gis tshe 'di blos gtong ba/ gang byung la zlog sgom gyis thog rjis mdzad pa/ bya ba gang byed mthar 'don pa ste khyad 'phags kyi dam bca' lnga sogs mdzad de thams cad mthar phyin/ ti se dang dzā laddhā rar lo bzhi/ 'di nas nyin mtshan khor yug gi sgom byung zhing / rten 'brel shar/ pho ma lha khab tu lo gsum/ der chos rje ras pa 'di sa bcu pa ba yin nam snyam pa bred tsam byung ba bar chad du mkhyen/ de phyin bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang ma bral/ tsā rir lo gsum/ der sku rgyab sgal bar song rung gzhan gyi tsam ngos drangs/ snang grags bde chen du shar/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin/ slar rgyal gyi shri'i rir lo gsum rnams rtse gcig du sgrub pa mdzad/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas po ti cig byin pa mid pas chos thams cad mkhyen/ so dgu nas rgod tshang du lo bdun 'di nas sgrub khong nas gzhan don yang mdzad/ rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor 'gro/gsungs nas steng 'gro/ bde chen steng la sogs par gzhan don mdzad de dgung lo bdun bcu pa la gdan sa ma sko/ rten ma bzheng / su chos bzhin byed pa rnams nga'i gdan sa yin no gsungs nas bar 'brog rdo rje gling du thegs/slob ma mtha' yas kyang brtul zhugs rang dang ma nyam pa grub thob o rgyan pa ni rnying ma'i grub thob 'ba' zhig gi rgyud par rgyus nag po jo 'phan gyi sras su la stod sto nas zlum du lcags pho stag la 'khrungs/ bu dong rin rtse dang dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje sogs la mtshan nyid dang dus 'khor mkhas par sbyangs/mtshan rin chen dpal/ rje rgod tshang pa las cig car ba'i rtogs pa thos grol 851

byung / chos rjes lung bstan te o rgyan du byon/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las bsnyen sgrub ba/san/ rje rgod tshang pa'i dgon gnas thams cad bskyangs/ rgya bod bal gsum du bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad/ rgyal po se chen gyis 'phags pa rin po che'i tham ga phul ba ma bzhes/ dgung lo brgyad bcu pa sa bya la thegs/ slob ma rje rang byung ba/ rin po che mkhar chu ba/ mkhas btsun bsod nams 'od zer/ rtogs ldan zla seng ba/ snye mdo ba sku mched dang chag lo dbon po soṭa mang du byung zhing zla seng ba'i rjes 'breng 'on chos sdings pa dang shel brag pa sogs kyang yin no/ /gzhan yang sgrub tshugs rang dang mnyam pa spyil mkhar ba/dka' spyad rang dang mnyam pa pho ri ba/ snying rje rang dang mnyam pa ma mdun pa/rtel 'brel rang dang mnyam pa sras bde legs rgyal mtshan 'dis zang zang ne ring btab/ rtogs pa rang dang mnyam pa yang dgon pa ni rnying ma'i grub thob kyi brgyud par la stod lho'i lha gdong dgon par chu bya la 'khrungs/ gsung bye 'phral nas chos thogs med du gsungs/ mngon mkhyen dang grub rtags mnga'/ko brag pa/ rje spyan snga/ sa paṇa ste rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhir grags kyang chos rje'i rgyud pa 'dzin/ zhe drug la thegs/ slob ma mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum nas rin po che shes rab 'bum sogs dang rtogs ldan shes mgon pa sogs bka' rgyud bzang du byung zhing / slob ma'i gtso bo spyan snga rin ldan ni ding rir chu byi la 'khrungs/ lo nyer gnyis la yang dgon pa bcu gnyis pa zhes pa'i phyags phyi byas te 'bral med du bsten/ phyis ding rir 'phrin las bskyangs/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal ni shen gyi dpe'u chung du 'khrungs/ mdo sngags kyi sbyangs pa mang du mdzad/ grub chen o rgyan pa dang spyan snga rin ldan las rtogs pa rnyed/gdams ngag rdzogs te shri zur phug tu 'phrin las bskyangs/ slob ma ri ba dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang de'i slob ma gtsang pa blo bzang pa bya ba'i 'phrin las can 852

byung ngo / /slob ma'i gtso bo ni 'ba' ra ba ste shangs kyi chab li grong du sa skya'i nye gnas chen mo'i rgyud par lcags khyi la 'khrungs/ dpal ldan bla rme sku mched kyi gsol ja ba ma dzad pa las bros te bla ma du ma bsten/ zur phug pa las gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs/ 'phrin las shin tu che zhing pa gror gya gnyis la thegs/ slob ma rgyud pa zin pa du ma byung la khyad par du dol lha sna ba klong mkhar ba rin chen tshul khrim sa/ de'i slob ma lum pa ba kun dga' don grub/de'i slob ma 'brog khang dmar ba kun dga' dpal ldan ni sgrub pa mthar phyin/mon rtse ba chen po zhes grags te thud la sogs pa btab cing re gnyis bzhugs la rgyud 'dzin mang ngo / /bka' rgyud rin po che nyid las kyang zhen log mos gus ro stoms gsum rtsal du 'don zhing tshe 'di la phyi phyag btsal ba 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi bka'i rgyud 'di yin yang dus kyi dbang gis shug 'brug rtsod pa dang lha 'brug rtsod pa sogs du ma byung zhing lo ras kyi dbon po rnams kyis kyang 'thab rtsod mang du mdzad pa dang rje rgod tshang ba'i sku tshe'i smad la da 'brug pa'i sgrub tshugs de nyams 'dug gsungs pa ltar gyur kyang rje rgod tshang pas chos rje'i chos chu babs su gsungs pa rnams kyang khrid chen brgyad du phye/thams cad kyang thugs nyams su myong ba'i rtogs chos kyis brgyan pas gnad zin pa/ gzhan la ston pa las brgya 'gyur gyis lhag par rang gis nyams su bzhes pas chos rnam thar gyis bstan pa/ dpang lo chen pos spyod 'jug la rgod tshang pa dang gu ru thogs med las mkhas pa med gsung ba ltar sems dpa' chen po rnamab/ kyi rnam thar thams cad rdzogs pa/ nga'i rgyud pa la 'thab rtsod mi 'ong /rtogs pa'i bstan pa 'di byams pa la thug gis ma song 'dug na kho rgod tshang pas rten 'ibrel ma shes kyis gsungs te rgod tshang pa las brgyud pa'i chos kyis de phyin gyi bod kyi chos rgyud thams cad la khyab cing kun gyis tshad mar gyur pa 'di 853—

yin no/ /phag gru bka' rgyud kyi nang tshan gling gi bka' rgyud las rje rgod tshang pa las brgyud pa stod 'brug du grags pa'i skabs so/ /rgyal ba lo ras ni gdung lo nad/ gzhung grags chen du yab rnal 'byor shes rab dang / yum mar bza' skyid kyis lha sar jo bo la gsol ba btab pas 'khrungs/ lo bcu drug la 'gro mgon gzhung du phebs pa la dbang chos gsan pas rtogs pa ngo 'phrod de phyis kyang skyed 'don du ma byung / bco brgyad pa la bros nas mkhan po lpal ti las rab tu byung / mtshan dbang phyug brtson 'grus chos rje la gdams ngag rnams gsan te ras rkyang mdzad/ chos rje gdan drangs te nas khal nyi stong brgyad brgya sogs phul te chos rje 'bul bas 'tshengs/gnyen rabs chad kyis 'tshengs/ mtha' bzhi bor gyis 'tshengs/ lo ras chos kyis 'tshengs bya ba byung / srog la bab kyang gnod lan mi byed/ skye bo'i khyim du mi 'byon/ sgos su dad zas mi gsol/ gzhan la g.yar skyi mi mdzad/ rtag du cog pur bzhugs/ gnyis tshogs kyi long gtam mi byed pa ste dam bca' chen po drug rtag du dben pa bsten/ ras rkyang dang zhabs rjen mdzad pa/ zas stan gcig dus gtor dang thun gtor ma chag pa/ bde mchog gi skyed rdzogs thun bzhir sgom pa/ mtshams kyi dus ma gtogs sang phan chad ldang ba mi 'dzin pa ste zhar byung gi dam bca' drug 'dze sprang yan chad zhe nas gong du 'khur pa khyad par gyi dam bca' gcig dang bcu gsum mdzad pas chos rje'i zhal nas ston pas kyang lo drug dka' ba mdzad pa yin/ lo drug skyongs la de nas ci bder mdzod gsungs/ lo ngo bdun du bsten gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs/chos rje gshegs nas kha rag gi gangs/ gnam mtsho se mo do sogs la dka' ba mtha' yas pa spyad de sgrub pa mdzad/ grub thob dbu se nam mkha' la byon te nga'i gdan sa mtshur phu nas byang du nyin lam gcig gi sar dgon pa thob/854

sems can ma phan zhes lung bstan pas dbu ri btab/ gtsang phyogs su 'gro don cher mdzad nas lho brag kho thing lha khang gi zhig pa bsos shing seng ge rir dgung lo re bzhi la thegs/ dbon po tsā ri ras chen dang sangs rgyas dbon gyis gdan sa bskyangs shing rgyud 'dzin nyang stod pa 'jam dbyangs mgon po mkhas shing grub pa dang / stod lung pa rtogs ldan mgon yes zhes bya ba grub thob chen po de la sogs pa byon la/ phyis rgyal ba lo'i sku skyer grags pa gtsang chen chos kyi dbang phyug gis slar yang dar bar mdzad nas dgon gnas rnams zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa la phul te bstan pa'i chu bo dbyer med par gyur to/ /smad 'brug du grags pa'i skabs ste spyir phag gru bka' rgyud kyi skabs so/ /chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag chen po lnga'i yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs las rje mar mi dwags gsum gyi bka' rgyud rin po che yan lag dang bcas pa spyir bstan pa'i chos byung ste le'u tshan bdun pa'o// //mar mi dwags po'i bka' rgyud rin chen gyi/ /bstan 'dzin yan lag bcas pa byung tshul 'di/ /gnam gshegs dpal 'byor bzang mo'i dgongs rdzoṭa phyir/ /lho stod gnas su par du bsgrabs pa yi/ /yig rkos gnyis kyi byed po g.ye pa yin/ /ngage bas 'go gan dmong po'i ngon rngogs thog // /des ri sgo/ //ste / phyi / 8da5
